definition_en: a married man considered in relation to his spouse | to use resources carefully so they last longer
example1_en: Her husband brought her lunch during a busy shift.
example1_zh: 她忙着上班时，丈夫给她送来了午饭。
example2_en: When husbands share household responsibilities equally, both partners have more opportunities to pursue their careers.
example2_zh: 当丈夫平等分担家务时，伴侣双方都有更多机会发展事业。
collocations: her husband｜她的丈夫 ; husband and wife｜夫妻 ; husband resources｜节约使用资源
tip_zh: 作动词时较正式，表示节约使用资源。

meanings_zh: adj. 正确的；准确的 | v. 改正；纠正；批改 | adj. 恰当的；合适的
definition_en: free from mistakes and matching the facts | to identify mistakes or change something to make it right | suitable or accepted as proper for a particular situation
example1_en: You were correct about the keys being under the sofa.
example1_zh: 你说钥匙在沙发下面，果然没错。
example2_en: Teachers should help students correct their mistakes rather than simply provide them with the right answers.
example2_zh: 教师应帮助学生纠正错误，而不是仅仅给他们正确答案。
collocations: the correct answer｜正确答案 ; correct a mistake｜纠正错误 ; correct procedure｜正确流程 ; factually correct｜符合事实的
tip_zh: 既是形容词也是动词；correctly才是副词。

meanings_zh: n. 动物 | adj. 动物的
definition_en: a living creature that feeds on plants or other creatures | relating to animals rather than plants
example1_en: My sister loves watching animals at the local farm.
example1_zh: 我妹妹喜欢在当地农场看动物。
example2_en: Protecting animal habitats is essential because biodiversity supports stable ecosystems and benefits human wellbeing.
example2_zh: 保护动物栖息地至关重要，因为生物多样性有助于维持生态系统稳定，并造福人类。
collocations: wild animal｜野生动物 ; animal welfare｜动物福利 ; animal behaviour｜动物行为 ; animal habitat｜动物栖息地
tip_zh: animal 不仅指哺乳动物；鸟、鱼和昆虫也属于动物。

meanings_zh: adj. 口渴的 | adj. 渴望的
definition_en: feeling that you need or want a drink | having a strong desire for something
example1_en: I felt thirsty after walking home in the sun.
example1_zh: 我顶着太阳走回家后觉得口渴。
example2_en: Children who are thirsty for knowledge benefit from lessons that encourage questions and independent exploration.
example2_zh: 渴求知识的孩子能从鼓励提问和自主探索的课程中受益。
collocations: feel thirsty｜感到口渴 ; thirsty for knowledge｜渴求知识 ; make someone thirsty｜使某人口渴
tip_zh: 表示渴望某物用thirsty for，不用thirsty of。

meanings_zh: n. 笔；钢笔 | n. 动物围栏；圈 | v. 撰写
definition_en: A tool that uses ink to write or draw. | A small enclosed area where animals are kept. | To write a letter, story or other piece of writing.
example1_en: Could you lend me a pen for this form?
example1_zh: 你能借我一支笔填这张表吗？
example2_en: Some students prefer using a pen because writing by hand helps them organise their ideas.
example2_zh: 有些学生更喜欢用笔，因为手写有助于他们整理思路。
collocations: ballpoint pen｜圆珠笔 ; fountain pen｜钢笔 ; a sheep pen｜羊圈 ; pen a letter｜写一封信
tip_zh: pen泛指墨水笔；钢笔可明确说fountain pen。

meanings_zh: v. 离开；出发 | v. 留下；忘带 | n. 休假；假期
definition_en: To go away from a person or place. | To let something remain somewhere, deliberately or accidentally. | An officially allowed period away from work.
example1_en: We need to leave before the traffic gets worse.
example1_zh: 我们得在交通变得更拥堵之前出发。
example2_en: Paid parental leave allows new parents to care for their children without immediately returning to work.
example2_zh: 带薪育儿假让新手父母能够照顾孩子，而不必立即重返工作岗位。
collocations: leave home｜离家 ; leave a message｜留言 ; leave for｜动身前往 ; annual leave｜年假
tip_zh: leave 的过去式和过去分词均为 left。

meanings_zh: n. 窗；窗户 | n. 电脑窗口 | n. 可利用的短暂时机
definition_en: An opening with glass that lets light into a building | An area on a screen displaying a program or document | A limited period when something can be done
example1_en: Please open the window and let some fresh air in.
example1_zh: 请打开窗户，让新鲜空气进来。
example2_en: Installing larger windows can reduce the need for artificial lighting in homes during daylight hours.
example2_zh: 安装更大的窗户可以减少住宅在白天对人工照明的需求。
collocations: open a window｜打开窗户 ; window frame｜窗框 ; browser window｜浏览器窗口 ; a window of opportunity｜机会之窗
tip_zh: 电脑窗口也叫window；机会之窗强调时机有限。

meanings_zh: v. 骑；乘坐 | n. 乘车行程；骑行
definition_en: To travel on a bicycle, animal, or vehicle. | A journey on a bicycle, animal, or vehicle.
example1_en: We ride our bikes to the lake every weekend.
example1_zh: 我们每个周末都骑自行车去湖边。
example2_en: Safer cycling routes could encourage more residents to ride bicycles rather than drive for short urban journeys.
example2_zh: 更安全的自行车道可以鼓励更多居民在城市短途出行时骑车，而不是开车。
collocations: ride a bike｜骑自行车 ; ride a horse｜骑马 ; go for a ride｜骑车或乘车兜风 ; give someone a ride｜让某人搭车
tip_zh: 不规则变化：ride—rode—ridden。

meanings_zh: n. 腿 | n. 家具的腿；支脚 | n. 一段行程
definition_en: a body part used for standing and walking | a support beneath a table, chair, or similar object | one stage of a journey or race
example1_en: My legs felt tired after the long walk home.
example1_zh: 走了很长一段路回家后，我的双腿很累。
example2_en: Regular walking strengthens the muscles in our legs and can improve health without expensive equipment.
example2_zh: 经常步行能增强腿部肌肉，无需昂贵器材就能改善健康。
collocations: stretch your legs｜活动一下腿脚 ; a table leg｜桌腿 ; the final leg of a journey｜旅程的最后一段
tip_zh: leg也指桌椅的支脚或旅程中的一段。

meanings_zh: n. 番茄；西红柿
definition_en: a soft, juicy fruit often eaten as a vegetable
example1_en: She sliced a ripe tomato for her cheese sandwich.
example1_zh: 她切了一个熟番茄，放进奶酪三明治里。
example2_en: Growing tomatoes in community gardens can improve access to fresh food in urban neighbourhoods.
example2_zh: 在社区花园种植番茄，可以让城市居民更容易获得新鲜食物。
collocations: ripe tomato｜熟番茄 ; tomato sauce｜番茄酱汁 ; cherry tomato｜圣女果
tip_zh: 复数是tomatoes；英美发音的重读元音不同。

meanings_zh: v. 尝试；试图 | v. 试用；试验 | n. 尝试
definition_en: make an effort to do something | use or do something to see whether it works | an attempt to do something
example1_en: I'll try to fix the lamp before dinner.
example1_zh: 我会试着在晚饭前把灯修好。
example2_en: Schools should try different teaching methods to meet the needs of students with varying abilities.
example2_zh: 学校应尝试不同的教学方法，以满足能力各异的学生的需求。
collocations: try to do something｜努力做某事 ; try doing something｜试着做某事 ; give it a try｜试一试 ; try on clothes｜试穿衣服
tip_zh: try to do强调努力；try doing强调试试办法。

meanings_zh: n. 餐馆；餐厅
definition_en: A place where people pay to eat prepared meals.
example1_en: We found a quiet restaurant beside the river.
example1_zh: 我们在河边找到了一家安静的餐馆。
example2_en: Local restaurants can attract tourists by serving traditional dishes made with ingredients from nearby farms.
example2_zh: 当地餐馆可以用附近农场的食材制作传统菜肴，以此吸引游客。
collocations: book a table at a restaurant｜预订餐馆座位 ; run a restaurant｜经营餐馆 ; a seafood restaurant｜海鲜餐馆
tip_zh: restaurant指用餐场所；hotel主要指住宿的酒店。

meanings_zh: n. 公共汽车 | v. 用公共汽车运送
definition_en: a large road vehicle that carries passengers | to transport people somewhere by bus
example1_en: We caught the last bus home after the concert.
example1_zh: 音乐会结束后，我们赶上了回家的末班公交车。
example2_en: More frequent bus services could reduce traffic congestion and improve access to employment in outer suburbs.
example2_zh: 增加公交班次可以缓解交通拥堵，并改善远郊居民的就业出行条件。
collocations: catch a bus｜赶上公交车 ; bus stop｜公交车站 ; bus route｜公交线路 ; by bus｜乘公共汽车
tip_zh: by bus不加冠词；take a bus需加冠词。

meanings_zh: n. 父亲；爸爸 | n. 奠基人；创始人 | v. 成为…的生父
definition_en: A male parent. | A man who established or greatly influenced a field. | To become the biological father of a child.
example1_en: Her father taught her to ride a bicycle.
example1_zh: 她爸爸教她骑自行车。
example2_en: Flexible working arrangements can allow fathers to take a more active role in raising their children.
example2_zh: 灵活的工作安排可以让父亲更积极地参与养育子女。
collocations: single father｜单亲父亲 ; father figure｜父亲般的人物 ; biological father｜生父 ; the father of modern medicine｜现代医学之父
tip_zh: father较正式，dad更口语化；父亲节用Father's Day。

meanings_zh: n. 脚；足 | n. 英尺 | n. 底部；下端
definition_en: the body part below the ankle used for standing and walking | a unit of length equal to twelve inches | the lowest part of something tall or sloping
example1_en: A tiny stone in my shoe hurt my foot.
example1_zh: 鞋里的一颗小石子硌疼了我的脚。
example2_en: Making essential services accessible on foot can encourage physical activity and reduce dependence on private cars.
example2_zh: 让人们步行就能获得基本服务，可以促进身体活动并减少对私家车的依赖。
collocations: on foot｜步行 ; at the foot of｜在……底部 ; set foot in｜踏入 ; foot the bill｜支付账单
tip_zh: 脚和英尺的复数均为feet；步行用on foot。

meanings_zh: n. 飞机
definition_en: A powered flying vehicle with fixed wings.
example1_en: We watched the airplane disappear behind a white cloud.
example1_zh: 我们看着飞机消失在一朵白云后面。
example2_en: Travelling by airplane connects remote communities to essential services, although it also contributes to carbon emissions.
example2_zh: 乘飞机出行让偏远社区能够获得必要服务，但也会增加碳排放。
collocations: board an airplane｜登机 ; fly an airplane｜驾驶飞机 ; passenger airplane｜客机
tip_zh: airplane常用于美式英语，英式通常用aeroplane。

meanings_zh: adj. 法国的；法语的 | n. 法语 | n. 法国人（总称）
definition_en: relating to France, its people, or its language | the language spoken in France and several other countries | the people of France, referred to collectively as the French
example1_en: We bought fresh bread from a small French bakery.
example1_zh: 我们在一家法国面包店买了新鲜面包。
example2_en: Learning French can improve employment prospects in regions where the language is widely used in business.
example2_zh: 在商业活动中广泛使用法语的地区，学习法语可以改善就业前景。
collocations: French cuisine｜法国菜 ; speak French｜说法语 ; French literature｜法国文学 ; the French｜法国人
tip_zh: 首字母始终大写；the French表法国人总称。

meanings_zh: pron. 他（宾格）
definition_en: used for a male person receiving an action or following a preposition
example1_en: My brother forgot his lunch, so I brought it to him.
example1_zh: 我哥哥忘了带午饭，所以我给他送了过去。
example2_en: When a student struggles with reading, teachers can support him through regular practice and constructive feedback.
example2_zh: 当一名男学生阅读有困难时，教师可以通过定期练习和建设性反馈帮助他。
collocations: help him｜帮助他 ; with him｜和他一起 ; give him a chance｜给他一个机会
tip_zh: he作主语，him作动词或介词的宾语。

meanings_zh: adv. 下午；午后至午夜前
definition_en: after noon and before midnight, used when stating a time
example1_en: The swimming pool closes at eight p.m. today.
example1_zh: 游泳池今天晚上八点关门。
example2_en: Keeping public libraries open until nine p.m. would allow more working adults to access educational resources.
example2_zh: 让公共图书馆开放至晚上九点，可以使更多在职成年人获取教育资源。
collocations: at three p.m.｜在下午三点 ; until ten p.m.｜直到晚上十点
tip_zh: 放在时间后；12 p.m.是中午，12 a.m.是午夜。

meanings_zh: n. 开始；开端
definition_en: The first part or starting point of something.
example1_en: We missed the beginning of the film yesterday.
example1_zh: 我们昨天错过了电影的开头。
example2_en: The beginning of formal education marks an important stage in a child's social development.
example2_zh: 正规教育的开始标志着儿童社会性发展的一个重要阶段。
collocations: at the beginning of｜在……开始时 ; from beginning to end｜从头到尾 ; a new beginning｜新的开始
tip_zh: at the beginning of后接名词；in the beginning表示起初。

meanings_zh: adj. 脏的 | adj. 卑鄙的；不公平的 | v. 弄脏；变脏
definition_en: Covered with dirt or other unwanted substances. | Dishonest or unfair, especially when trying to gain an advantage. | To make something dirty or become dirty.
example1_en: Please leave your dirty boots outside the kitchen door.
example1_zh: 请把你的脏靴子放在厨房门外。
example2_en: Limited access to clean water forces many communities to rely on dirty sources that can spread disease.
example2_zh: 清洁水源不足迫使许多社区依赖可能传播疾病的污浊水源。
collocations: dirty clothes｜脏衣服 ; dirty water｜污水 ; get dirty｜弄脏 ; dirty tricks｜卑鄙伎俩
tip_zh: 比较级dirtier，最高级dirtiest。

meanings_zh: n. 语法；语法规则
definition_en: The rules for combining words and changing their forms.
example1_en: Our teacher explains grammar using examples from everyday conversations.
example1_zh: 我们的老师用日常对话中的例子讲解语法。
example2_en: Although grammar instruction is important, language courses should also give learners opportunities to communicate in realistic situations.
example2_zh: 虽然语法教学很重要，语言课程也应让学习者有机会在真实情境中交流。
collocations: grammar rules｜语法规则 ; English grammar｜英语语法 ; correct grammar｜正确的语法 ; a grammar exercise｜语法练习
tip_zh: 表示语法知识时不可数；一个语法错误用a grammar mistake。

meanings_zh: det. 那；那个 | pron. 那个；那件事；关系代词 | conj. 引导陈述性从句
definition_en: used before a noun to identify something farther away | refers to something indicated, or introduces a defining relative clause | introduces a clause expressing a statement, belief, or fact
example1_en: Could you pass me that bowl beside the window?
example1_zh: 你能把窗边的那个碗递给我吗？
example2_en: Research suggests that access to green spaces can improve mental health among people living in cities.
example2_zh: 研究表明，能够接触绿地有助于改善城市居民的心理健康。
collocations: at that time｜在那时 ; that kind of｜那种 ; now that｜既然 ; so that｜以便
tip_zh: 作指示词时复数为those；引导宾语从句常可省略。

meanings_zh: n. 票；入场券 | n. 交通违章罚单 | v. 向……开交通罚单
definition_en: A paper or electronic pass allowing travel or entry. | An official notice requiring payment for a traffic offence. | To give someone an official notice for a traffic offence.
example1_en: I bought a return ticket from the station machine.
example1_zh: 我在车站的售票机上买了一张往返票。
example2_en: Lower ticket prices could encourage more commuters to choose trains instead of driving to work.
example2_zh: 降低票价可以鼓励更多通勤者选择乘火车而非开车上班。
collocations: return ticket｜往返票 ; single ticket｜单程票 ; parking ticket｜违章停车罚单 ; book a ticket｜订票
tip_zh: 英式single/return ticket分别指单程票和往返票。

meanings_zh: num. 第三 | n. 三分之一
definition_en: Coming after the second and before the fourth. | One of three equal parts of something.
example1_en: Our flat is on the third floor, beside the lift.
example1_zh: 我们的公寓在三楼，电梯旁边。
example2_en: Approximately one third of the city's residents rely on public transport for their daily commute.
example2_zh: 该市约三分之一的居民依靠公共交通进行日常通勤。
collocations: third place｜第三名 ; the third floor｜三楼 ; one third of｜……的三分之一 ; a third party｜第三方
tip_zh: 表示分数：one third；two thirds。

meanings_zh: n. 数学
definition_en: The study of quantities, shapes, and relationships using logical rules
example1_en: We used coloured blocks to practise maths after lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭后，我们用彩色积木练习数学。
example2_en: Strong maths skills help students interpret financial information and make informed decisions in everyday life.
example2_zh: 扎实的数学技能有助于学生理解财务信息，并在日常生活中作出明智决定。
collocations: maths teacher｜数学老师 ; maths lesson｜数学课 ; maths skills｜数学技能 ; good at maths｜擅长数学
tip_zh: 英式用 maths，美式用 math；作主语用单数动词。

meanings_zh: num. 第二 | n. 秒；片刻 | v. 附议；支持提议
definition_en: Coming immediately after the first in an order. | A unit of time equal to one sixtieth of a minute. | To formally support a proposal made by someone else.
example1_en: This is my second cup of tea today.
example1_zh: 这是我今天喝的第二杯茶。
example2_en: Learning a second language can broaden career opportunities and help students understand perspectives from other cultures.
example2_zh: 学习第二语言可以拓宽职业机会，并帮助学生理解其他文化的观点。
collocations: second place｜第二名 ; a second chance｜第二次机会 ; a split second｜一瞬间 ; second a motion｜附议动议
tip_zh: the second指第二个；a second可指又一个。

meanings_zh: n. 地板；室内地面 | n. 楼层 | n. 海底；谷底
definition_en: The surface inside a building that people walk on. | A level of a building. | The bottom surface of a sea, valley, or similar area.
example1_en: My keys fell onto the kitchen floor again.
example1_zh: 我的钥匙又掉到厨房地板上了。
example2_en: Converting unused upper floors into apartments could help cities address housing shortages without expanding outwards.
example2_zh: 把闲置的较高楼层改建成公寓，有助于城市在不向外扩张的情况下缓解住房短缺。
collocations: wooden floor｜木地板 ; ground floor｜底层 ; top floor｜顶层 ; ocean floor｜海底
tip_zh: 英式first floor是二楼；美式first floor是一楼。

meanings_zh: n. 农场 | v. 务农；耕种；养殖
definition_en: land and buildings used for growing crops or raising animals | to grow crops or raise animals for food or other products
example1_en: We bought fresh eggs from a nearby farm.
example1_zh: 我们从附近的农场买了新鲜鸡蛋。
example2_en: Small farms can support local food supplies while creating employment opportunities in rural communities.
example2_zh: 小型农场既能支持当地食品供应，也能为农村社区创造就业机会。
collocations: a dairy farm｜奶牛场 ; work on a farm｜在农场工作 ; farm animals｜农场牲畜 ; farm the land｜耕种土地
tip_zh: 表示在农场通常用on a farm，不用in。

meanings_zh: adj. 低的；少的 | adj. 情绪低落的 | adv. 在低处；低声地
definition_en: Not high in position, amount, level, or degree. | Feeling sad or lacking confidence. | At a small height, level, or volume.
example1_en: The low shelf is easy for children to reach.
example1_zh: 这个低矮的架子很方便孩子们取东西。
example2_en: Low wages can prevent essential workers from finding affordable housing close to their places of employment.
example2_zh: 低工资可能让从事必要服务的劳动者难以在工作地点附近找到负担得起的住房。
collocations: low income｜低收入 ; low temperatures｜低温 ; feel low｜情绪低落 ; run low on｜所剩不多
tip_zh: 价格低用low，东西便宜用cheap。

meanings_zh: n. 绘画作品；画 | n. 绘画；画画 | n. 刷漆；粉刷
definition_en: A picture made using paint. | The activity of creating pictures with paint. | The activity of covering a surface with paint.
example1_en: We hung a colourful painting above the sofa.
example1_zh: 我们在沙发上方挂了一幅色彩鲜艳的画。
example2_en: Public galleries make important paintings accessible to everyone, regardless of their income or educational background.
example2_zh: 公共美术馆让所有人都能欣赏重要画作，不受收入或教育背景的限制。
collocations: oil painting｜油画 ; landscape painting｜风景画 ; abstract painting｜抽象画 ; house painting｜房屋粉刷
tip_zh: 指一幅画时可数；指绘画活动时不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 地图 | v. 绘制地图；标出分布
definition_en: A drawing showing where places or features are located | To draw or record the position of places or features
example1_en: We spread the map across the table before leaving.
example1_zh: 出发前，我们把地图铺在桌上。
example2_en: Researchers use satellite images to map changes in forest cover and identify areas needing urgent protection.
example2_zh: 研究人员利用卫星图像绘制森林覆盖变化图，并确定急需保护的区域。
collocations: read a map｜看地图 ; street map｜街道地图 ; map out a route｜规划路线 ; map changes｜绘制变化分布图
tip_zh: map作动词时，过去式mapped，分词mapping。

meanings_zh: v. 移动；搬家 | v. 使感动 | n. 行动；举措
definition_en: To change position or go to live somewhere else. | To make someone feel a strong emotion. | An action taken to achieve a particular result.
example1_en: Could you move this chair closer to the window?
example1_zh: 你能把这把椅子挪到靠窗一点的位置吗？
example2_en: The decision to expand public transport is a positive move towards reducing urban congestion.
example2_zh: 扩大公共交通的决定是缓解城市拥堵的一项积极举措。
collocations: move house｜搬家 ; move forward｜向前移动；取得进展 ; be deeply moved｜深受感动 ; a positive move｜积极举措
tip_zh: moving指令人感动的，moved指感到感动的。

meanings_zh: v. 发送；寄送 | v. 派遣；打发
definition_en: To make something go or be delivered to another place. | To arrange for someone to go somewhere.
example1_en: Please send me a photo of your new puppy.
example1_zh: 请发一张你家新养的小狗的照片给我。
example2_en: Governments should send medical teams to isolated communities that lack access to basic healthcare.
example2_zh: 政府应向缺乏基本医疗服务的偏远社区派遣医疗队。
collocations: send a message｜发送消息 ; send a parcel｜寄包裹 ; send someone to do something｜派某人去做某事
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为sent；可用send sth to sb。

meanings_zh: num. 六十
definition_en: the number equal to six times ten
example1_en: My grandfather turned sixty and celebrated with a picnic.
example1_zh: 我爷爷满六十岁时，办了一次野餐来庆祝。
example2_en: The survey found that sixty percent of respondents preferred reliable buses to additional parking spaces.
example2_zh: 调查发现，百分之六十的受访者更希望公交服务可靠，而不是增加停车位。
collocations: sixty percent｜百分之六十 ; sixty years old｜六十岁 ; in your sixties｜在六十多岁时
tip_zh: sixty重音在首音节；sixteen通常重读末音节。

meanings_zh: n. 清单；名单 | v. 列出
definition_en: Related items or names written one below another. | To write or state items one after another.
example1_en: I made a shopping list before leaving home.
example1_zh: 出门前，我列了一张购物清单。
example2_en: The report lists several practical measures that cities can adopt to reduce traffic congestion.
example2_zh: 这份报告列出了城市可以采取的几项缓解交通拥堵的实用措施。
collocations: make a list｜列清单 ; shopping list｜购物清单 ; waiting list｜候补名单
tip_zh: 在名单上用on the list，不用in。

meanings_zh: v. 遇见；会面；结识 | v. 满足；达到
definition_en: come together with someone, by arrangement or chance | fulfil a need or reach a required standard
example1_en: Let's meet outside the library after lunch today.
example1_zh: 我们今天午饭后在图书馆外见吧。
example2_en: Public transport services must meet the needs of residents who cannot afford private cars.
example2_zh: 公共交通服务必须满足那些买不起私家车的居民的需求。
collocations: meet someone for the first time｜初次见到某人 ; meet requirements｜符合要求 ; meet a deadline｜按期完成 ; meet demand｜满足需求
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为met；meet要求时意为满足。

meanings_zh: v. 停留；暂住 | v. 保持某种状态 | n. 停留；暂住期间
definition_en: To remain in a place or live somewhere temporarily. | To continue being in a particular condition. | A period spent living or visiting somewhere.
example1_en: We stayed at a small hotel beside the lake.
example1_zh: 我们住在湖边的一家小旅馆里。
example2_en: Tourists who stay longer in rural areas may contribute more to local businesses than short-term visitors.
example2_zh: 比起短期游客，在乡村停留更久的游客可能为当地商家带来更多收益。
collocations: stay at a hotel｜住旅馆 ; stay healthy｜保持健康 ; stay in touch｜保持联系 ; a short stay｜短暂停留
tip_zh: stay后可直接接形容词，如stay calm保持冷静。

meanings_zh: n. 食物；食品
definition_en: Things people or animals eat to live and grow.
example1_en: We packed enough food for a picnic by the lake.
example1_zh: 我们带了足够的食物，准备在湖边野餐。
example2_en: Reducing food waste at home can save money and lower the environmental impact of household consumption.
example2_zh: 减少家庭食物浪费既能省钱，也能降低家庭消费对环境的影响。
collocations: fresh food｜新鲜食物 ; food waste｜食物浪费 ; food safety｜食品安全 ; processed food｜加工食品
tip_zh: 泛指食物时不可数；foods表示不同种类的食物。

meanings_zh: n. 音乐；乐曲 | n. 乐谱
definition_en: Sounds arranged with rhythm or melody for people to enjoy | Written symbols showing how a piece should be played or sung
example1_en: Soft music drifted through the kitchen while we cooked.
example1_zh: 我们做饭时，轻柔的音乐在厨房里飘荡。
example2_en: Learning music at school can develop children's creativity and provide opportunities for cooperation through group performances.
example2_zh: 在学校学习音乐可以培养儿童的创造力，并通过集体表演提供合作机会。
collocations: listen to music｜听音乐 ; live music｜现场音乐 ; classical music｜古典音乐 ; a piece of music｜一首乐曲
tip_zh: music不可数；一首乐曲说a piece of music。

meanings_zh: n. 冰箱
definition_en: An electrical appliance that keeps food and drinks cold.
example1_en: Put the milk back in the fridge, please.
example1_zh: 请把牛奶放回冰箱。
example2_en: Choosing an energy-efficient fridge can reduce household electricity consumption and lower costs over time.
example2_zh: 选择节能冰箱可以减少家庭用电量，并在长期内降低开支。
collocations: in the fridge｜在冰箱里 ; fridge door｜冰箱门 ; fridge freezer｜冷藏冷冻冰箱
tip_zh: fridge是refrigerator的常用简短说法。

meanings_zh: n. 网站
definition_en: A collection of connected web pages available on the internet
example1_en: I found the museum's opening hours on its website.
example1_zh: 我在博物馆的网站上查到了开放时间。
example2_en: A well-designed government website can make public services more accessible to people in remote areas.
example2_zh: 设计良好的政府网站能让偏远地区的居民更便捷地获取公共服务。
collocations: visit a website｜访问网站 ; official website｜官方网站 ; website design｜网站设计 ; launch a website｜上线网站
tip_zh: 在网站上用on a website；webpage指单个网页。

meanings_zh: n. 中国
definition_en: a country in East Asia
example1_en: My cousin returned from China with beautiful mountain photographs.
example1_zh: 我的表亲从中国回来，带回了漂亮的山景照片。
example2_en: The expansion of high-speed rail in China illustrates how transport investment can improve connections between major cities.
example2_zh: 中国高铁网络的扩展说明了交通投资如何改善主要城市之间的联系。
collocations: mainland China｜中国大陆 ; visit China｜访问中国 ; made in China｜中国制造
tip_zh: China指中国；小写china指瓷器，形容词用Chinese。

meanings_zh: n. 电话；电话机 | v. 打电话；打电话给
definition_en: A device or system for speaking to people far away. | To contact someone or speak to them using a phone.
example1_en: The telephone rang just as I opened the door.
example1_zh: 我刚打开门，电话就响了。
example2_en: Telephone consultations can improve access to healthcare for rural residents who live far from medical centres.
example2_zh: 电话问诊可以让远离医疗中心的农村居民更方便地获得医疗服务。
collocations: telephone call｜电话通话 ; telephone number｜电话号码 ; by telephone｜通过电话 ; answer the telephone｜接电话
tip_zh: telephone并非美式专用；日常通常简称phone。

meanings_zh: n. 问题；疑问 | n. 议题；待解决的问题 | v. 询问；质疑
definition_en: Something you ask to obtain information or an answer | An issue that needs discussion, consideration, or a decision | To ask someone for information or express doubt about something
example1_en: I raised my hand to ask the teacher a question.
example1_zh: 我举手向老师提了一个问题。
example2_en: Researchers increasingly question whether longer working hours actually improve productivity in modern office environments.
example2_zh: 研究人员越来越质疑，在现代办公环境中，延长工作时间是否真的能提高生产效率。
collocations: ask a question｜提问 ; answer a question｜回答问题 ; raise a question｜提出问题 ; question an assumption｜质疑假设
tip_zh: 动词question可直接接人，表示询问或盘问。

meanings_zh: n. 村庄 | n. 全村居民
definition_en: A small community of homes, usually in the countryside. | The people who live in a village, considered together.
example1_en: Our village has a bakery beside the old bridge.
example1_zh: 我们村的老桥旁有一家面包店。
example2_en: Reliable public transport can help village residents access employment, education, and healthcare in nearby towns.
example2_zh: 可靠的公共交通可以帮助村民前往附近城镇就业、求学和就医。
collocations: a remote village｜偏远村庄 ; a fishing village｜渔村 ; village life｜乡村生活 ; village residents｜村民
tip_zh: the whole village可指全村居民，而非建筑。

meanings_zh: n. 新闻；消息 | n. 新闻节目；新闻报道
definition_en: information about recent events or something previously unknown | a broadcast or report presenting recent events
example1_en: She called her sister to share the good news.
example1_zh: 她给姐姐打电话，分享这个好消息。
example2_en: People should check several reliable sources before sharing news about health issues on social media.
example2_zh: 人们在社交媒体上分享健康问题的新闻前，应核实多个可靠来源。
collocations: good news｜好消息 ; breaking news｜突发新闻 ; watch the news｜看新闻 ; a piece of news｜一条消息
tip_zh: news不可数且接单数谓语：The news is good。

meanings_zh: n. 单词；词 | n. 诺言；保证 | v. 措辞；用言语表达
definition_en: A unit of language with meaning. | A promise or assurance that someone gives. | To express something using particular language.
example1_en: I looked up the unfamiliar word in a dictionary.
example1_zh: 我在词典里查了那个不认识的单词。
example2_en: Students remember new words more effectively when they encounter them repeatedly in meaningful contexts.
example2_zh: 学生在有意义的语境中反复接触新词时，记忆效果会更好。
collocations: keep your word｜信守诺言 ; in other words｜换句话说 ; word choice｜用词选择 ; word a question carefully｜仔细斟酌问题的措辞
tip_zh: keep your word指守信，其中word不用复数。

meanings_zh: adj. 黑暗的；昏暗的 | adj. 深色的 | n. 黑暗；夜色
definition_en: having little or no light | having a colour closer to black than white | the absence of light, especially at night
example1_en: The hallway was too dark to find my shoes.
example1_zh: 走廊太暗了，我找不到自己的鞋。
example2_en: Poorly lit streets can feel dark and unsafe, discouraging residents from walking after sunset.
example2_zh: 照明不足的街道会显得昏暗、不安全，使居民不愿在日落后步行。
collocations: get dark｜天色变暗 ; dark blue｜深蓝色 ; in the dark｜在黑暗中；不知情 ; after dark｜天黑以后
tip_zh: dark既指光线暗，也指颜色深；黑暗常用the dark。

meanings_zh: v. 看见 | v. 理解；明白 | v. 会见；探望
definition_en: to notice something using your eyes | to understand something | to meet or visit someone
example1_en: I can see a rainbow above the trees.
example1_zh: 我能看见树梢上方有一道彩虹。
example2_en: When students see how science applies to everyday life, they often become more interested in learning.
example2_zh: 当学生理解科学如何应用于日常生活时，他们往往会对学习更感兴趣。
collocations: see a doctor｜看医生 ; see the difference｜看出区别 ; see someone's point｜理解某人的意思
tip_zh: 过去式saw，过去分词seen；强调看见而非观看。

meanings_zh: n. 土豆；马铃薯
definition_en: A round underground vegetable with brown, red, or yellow skin.
example1_en: I baked a potato and filled it with cheese.
example1_zh: 我烤了一个土豆，并在里面填上奶酪。
example2_en: Potato farming provides an important source of food and income for many rural communities worldwide.
example2_zh: 马铃薯种植为世界各地许多农村社区提供了重要的食物和收入来源。
collocations: baked potato｜烤土豆 ; mashed potato｜土豆泥 ; peel potatoes｜削土豆皮
tip_zh: 复数是 potatoes，词尾加 es。

meanings_zh: det. 我的
definition_en: Belonging to or connected with the person speaking.
example1_en: I left my umbrella beside the front door.
example1_zh: 我把我的伞放在前门旁边了。
example2_en: In my view, cities should prioritise affordable housing rather than invest heavily in prestigious construction projects.
example2_zh: 在我看来，城市应优先提供可负担住房，而非大量投资于彰显声望的建设项目。
collocations: my own｜我自己的 ; in my opinion｜在我看来 ; to my surprise｜令我惊讶的是
tip_zh: my后须接名词；mine可独立使用，表示“我的”。

meanings_zh: adv. 后来；稍后 | adj. 较晚的；后期的
definition_en: at a time after now or another mentioned time | happening or existing after another time or stage
example1_en: I'll wash the dishes later, after we finish eating.
example1_zh: 等我们吃完饭，我稍后再洗碗。
example2_en: Children who develop strong reading habits often achieve better academic results later in life.
example2_zh: 养成良好阅读习惯的孩子，往往在日后的学习中取得更好的成绩。
collocations: see you later｜回头见 ; later on｜以后；后来 ; later in life｜在人生后期 ; at a later stage｜在较后的阶段
tip_zh: later表示稍后；latter表示两者中的后者。

meanings_zh: adv. 不久；很快
definition_en: After a short time from now or another stated time.
example1_en: Dinner will be ready soon, so wash your hands.
example1_zh: 晚饭很快就好了，去洗手吧。
example2_en: Unless cities improve public transport soon, traffic congestion is likely to become increasingly severe.
example2_zh: 除非城市尽快改善公共交通，否则交通拥堵很可能日益严重。
collocations: as soon as possible｜尽快 ; soon after｜不久之后 ; too soon｜太早 ; see you soon｜回头见
tip_zh: as soon as引导将来时间从句时，通常用一般现在时。

meanings_zh: n. 雨伞；阳伞 | adj. 统括的；综合性的
definition_en: a folding cover on a stick protecting against rain or sun | including several different groups, activities, or ideas
example1_en: We shared an umbrella on the walk home.
example1_zh: 走路回家时，我们共撑一把伞。
example2_en: An umbrella organisation can help small charities coordinate their activities and share resources more effectively.
example2_zh: 一个联合组织可以帮助小型慈善机构协调活动，更有效地共享资源。
collocations: open an umbrella｜撑开伞 ; under an umbrella｜在伞下 ; umbrella organisation｜联合组织 ; umbrella term｜统称
tip_zh: umbrella term指涵盖多个相关概念的统称。

meanings_zh: prep. 在……之后 | conj. 在……之后 | prep. 在……后面；追赶
definition_en: later than an event or time | following the time when something happens | behind or following someone or something
example1_en: We usually take a short walk after dinner.
example1_zh: 我们通常在晚饭后散一小会儿步。
example2_en: After cities improve public transport, more residents may choose to leave their cars at home.
example2_zh: 城市改善公共交通后，更多居民可能会选择不开车出门。
collocations: after school｜放学后 ; after a while｜过了一会儿 ; look after｜照顾 ; run after｜追赶
tip_zh: 介词后接名词或动名词；连词后接完整从句。

meanings_zh: prep. 围绕；在…周围 | adv. 大约；左右 | adv. 四处；到处
definition_en: On different sides of something or surrounding it. | Approximately, rather than exactly. | In or to various places within an area.
example1_en: We sat around the fire and watched the stars.
example1_zh: 我们围坐在火堆旁看星星。
example2_en: Planting trees around school buildings can provide shade and reduce indoor temperatures during hot weather.
example2_zh: 在教学楼周围种树可以提供遮阴，并在炎热天气下降低室内温度。
collocations: around the world｜世界各地 ; around the corner｜在拐角处；即将到来 ; look around｜四处看看 ; around midday｜中午前后
tip_zh: around可表大约；around ten即十点或十个左右。

meanings_zh: prep. 由；被 | prep. 通过；以某种方式 | prep. 不迟于；在……之前
definition_en: Shows who or what performs an action in passive sentences. | Using a particular method or means. | No later than a particular time.
example1_en: This wooden bowl was made by my grandfather.
example1_zh: 这个木碗是我祖父做的。
example2_en: Urban air quality can be improved by expanding public transport and encouraging residents to cycle more often.
example2_zh: 扩大公共交通服务并鼓励居民更多骑车，可以改善城市空气质量。
collocations: by bus｜乘公交车 ; by doing something｜通过做某事 ; by the end of｜不迟于……结束时 ; by hand｜用手工
tip_zh: by表示截止时间；until表示状态持续到某时。

meanings_zh: n. 气味；嗅觉 | v. 闻到；嗅 | v. 有……气味
definition_en: a quality sensed through the nose, or that sensing ability | notice or examine something using your nose | have or give off a particular scent
example1_en: The smell of fresh bread filled our kitchen.
example1_zh: 新鲜面包的香味弥漫在我们的厨房里。
example2_en: A reduced sense of smell can affect appetite and make it harder to detect spoiled food.
example2_zh: 嗅觉减退会影响食欲，也会让人更难察觉变质的食物。
collocations: sense of smell｜嗅觉 ; strong smell｜浓烈的气味 ; smell fresh｜闻起来新鲜 ; smell of smoke｜有烟味
tip_zh: smell作系动词后接形容词，如smell good。

meanings_zh: n. 祖父母或外祖父母之一
definition_en: The father or mother of one of your parents.
example1_en: Each grandparent brought a homemade dish to our picnic.
example1_zh: 每位祖辈都带了一道自制的菜来参加我们的野餐。
example2_en: A grandparent can provide valuable emotional support when both parents work outside the home.
example2_zh: 当父母都在外工作时，祖父母或外祖父母可以提供宝贵的情感支持。
collocations: grandparents and grandchildren｜祖辈与孙辈 ; visit your grandparents｜探望祖父母或外祖父母 ; maternal grandparents｜外祖父母
tip_zh: 单数指一位祖辈；复数可指祖父母或外祖父母。

meanings_zh: adj. 友好的；亲切的 | n. 友谊赛
definition_en: Kind, welcoming, and pleasant towards other people. | A sports match played outside an official competition.
example1_en: Our new neighbour is friendly and always waves hello.
example1_zh: 我们的新邻居很友善，总是挥手打招呼。
example2_en: Friendly staff can improve patients' experiences and encourage them to seek medical advice earlier.
example2_zh: 亲切的工作人员能改善患者的就医体验，并鼓励他们更早寻求医疗建议。
collocations: friendly smile｜友善的微笑 ; friendly atmosphere｜友好的氛围 ; friendly match｜友谊赛 ; friendly towards newcomers｜对新来者友好
tip_zh: 虽以-ly结尾，却是形容词，不是副词。

meanings_zh: adj. 宽的；宽阔的 | adj. 广泛的；种类多的 | adv. 充分地张开
definition_en: measuring a large distance from one side to the other | including many different people, things, or possibilities | as far open as possible
example1_en: The sofa will not fit through this wide doorway.
example1_zh: 即使门口这么宽，这张沙发也搬不进去。
example2_en: Universities should offer a wide range of courses to meet students' different interests and career goals.
example2_zh: 大学应提供种类丰富的课程，以满足学生不同的兴趣和职业目标。
collocations: a wide road｜宽阔的道路 ; a wide range of｜各种各样的 ; wide open｜完全敞开的 ; a wide gap｜巨大差距
tip_zh: wide表示张开程度；widely常表示广泛地。

meanings_zh: v. 飞；飞行 | v. 乘飞机旅行；驾驶飞机 | n. 苍蝇
definition_en: to move through the air using wings | to travel in or control an aircraft | a small insect with two wings, often found near food
example1_en: Small birds fly over our garden every morning.
example1_zh: 每天早晨都有小鸟飞过我们的花园。
example2_en: Choosing to travel by train rather than fly can significantly reduce the environmental impact of short journeys.
example2_zh: 短途出行选择火车而非飞机，可以显著减少对环境的影响。
collocations: fly abroad｜乘飞机出国 ; fly a plane｜驾驶飞机 ; fly a kite｜放风筝 ; a swarm of flies｜一群苍蝇
tip_zh: 动词变化fly–flew–flown；苍蝇复数为flies。

meanings_zh: adj. 冷的；寒冷的 | n. 感冒 | adj. 冷淡的；不友好的
definition_en: Having a low temperature or feeling a lack of warmth. | A common illness causing sneezing, coughing, and a runny nose. | Showing little friendliness, affection, or sympathy.
example1_en: My hands were cold, so I put on gloves.
example1_zh: 我的手很冷，于是戴上了手套。
example2_en: Cold weather can increase household energy costs, placing additional pressure on families with limited incomes.
example2_zh: 寒冷天气会增加家庭能源开支，给收入有限的家庭带来额外压力。
collocations: cold weather｜寒冷天气 ; catch a cold｜患感冒 ; have a cold｜感冒了 ; a cold welcome｜冷淡的迎接
tip_zh: “觉得冷”用be cold；“感冒了”用have a cold。

meanings_zh: n. 儿童；孩子们 | n. 子女
definition_en: Young people who have not yet become adults. | Someone's sons or daughters, regardless of their age.
example1_en: The children built a sandcastle together on the beach.
example1_zh: 孩子们一起在海滩上堆了一座沙堡。
example2_en: Safe public parks give children opportunities to exercise, develop social skills, and explore the natural world.
example2_zh: 安全的公共公园为儿童提供了锻炼身体、发展社交技能和探索自然的机会。
collocations: young children｜幼儿 ; raise children｜抚养孩子 ; children's books｜儿童读物
tip_zh: child 的不规则复数；所有格为 children's。

meanings_zh: n. 裤子；长裤
definition_en: Clothing covering the waist and legs, with separate leg sections.
example1_en: These trousers are too long, so I need them shortened.
example1_zh: 这条裤子太长了，我需要把它改短。
example2_en: Some employers require staff to wear formal trousers, while others allow more casual clothing in the workplace.
example2_zh: 一些雇主要求员工穿正式长裤，另一些则允许员工在工作场所穿得更休闲。
collocations: a pair of trousers｜一条长裤 ; formal trousers｜正装长裤 ; try on trousers｜试穿长裤
tip_zh: 用复数：trousers are；一条用a pair of trousers。

meanings_zh: n. 农民；农场主
definition_en: someone who grows crops or raises animals on a farm
example1_en: The farmer feeds her chickens before the sun rises.
example1_zh: 这位农民在日出前给她的鸡喂食。
example2_en: Small farmers need reliable access to water and affordable technology to maintain production during dry periods.
example2_zh: 小农户需要可靠的水源和负担得起的技术，才能在干旱期间维持生产。
collocations: dairy farmer｜奶农 ; local farmers｜当地农民 ; small farmers｜小农户 ; sheep farmer｜养羊农场主
tip_zh: farmer指人，farm指农场，farming指农业生产。

meanings_zh: n. 咖啡；咖啡粉；咖啡豆
definition_en: A drink made from roasted beans, or the beans and powder.
example1_en: I drink coffee with milk before leaving for work.
example1_zh: 我上班出门前会喝一杯加奶咖啡。
example2_en: Rising temperatures may threaten coffee production, affecting the incomes of farmers in several developing countries.
example2_zh: 气温上升可能威胁咖啡生产，影响一些发展中国家农民的收入。
collocations: a cup of coffee｜一杯咖啡 ; black coffee｜黑咖啡 ; coffee beans｜咖啡豆 ; instant coffee｜速溶咖啡
tip_zh: 通常不可数；点单时two coffees指两杯咖啡。

meanings_zh: n. 鞋
definition_en: A covering for the foot, usually with a firm sole.
example1_en: There was a small stone inside my shoe.
example1_zh: 我的鞋里有一颗小石子。
example2_en: Comfortable shoes are essential for workers who spend most of their working day standing.
example2_zh: 对于工作时大部分时间都站着的员工来说，舒适的鞋子至关重要。
collocations: a pair of shoes｜一双鞋 ; running shoes｜跑鞋 ; put on your shoes｜穿上鞋
tip_zh: 一双鞋用a pair of shoes，shoe为可数名词。

meanings_zh: n. 自行车；摩托车 | v. 骑自行车
definition_en: a bicycle or, informally, a motorcycle | to travel somewhere by bicycle
example1_en: I locked my bike outside the corner shop.
example1_zh: 我把自行车锁在街角商店外面。
example2_en: Encouraging commuters to travel by bike could reduce urban congestion and improve public health.
example2_zh: 鼓励通勤者骑自行车出行可以缓解城市拥堵，并改善公众健康。
collocations: ride a bike｜骑自行车 ; by bike｜骑自行车 ; bike lane｜自行车道 ; mountain bike｜山地自行车
tip_zh: by bike不加冠词；ride a bike中的a不能省。

meanings_zh: adj. 小的；年幼的 | det. 很少的；几乎没有的 | adv. 很少；略微
definition_en: Small in size or young in age. | Not much; almost no amount of something. | Only slightly or not very much.
example1_en: A little bird landed on our kitchen windowsill.
example1_zh: 一只小鸟落在我们厨房的窗台上。
example2_en: Many rural schools have little access to digital resources, which can widen existing educational inequalities.
example2_zh: 许多农村学校很难获得数字资源，这可能加剧现有的教育不平等。
collocations: a little child｜一个小孩子 ; little time｜很少的时间 ; a little water｜一点水 ; little by little｜逐渐地
tip_zh: little加不可数名词表示几乎没有；a little表示有一点。

meanings_zh: adj. 甜的 | adj. 亲切的；贴心的 | n. 糖果
definition_en: Having a taste like sugar or honey. | Kind, gentle, or thoughtful. | A small piece of sugary food eaten as a treat.
example1_en: These strawberries are sweet enough to eat without sugar.
example1_zh: 这些草莓已经够甜了，不加糖也好吃。
example2_en: Reducing children's consumption of sweet drinks may lower their risk of tooth decay and excessive weight gain.
example2_zh: 减少儿童含糖饮料的摄入，可能降低他们蛀牙和体重过度增长的风险。
collocations: sweet taste｜甜味 ; sweet tooth｜对甜食的喜爱 ; sweet smile｜甜美的微笑 ; sweet drinks｜甜饮料
tip_zh: 糖果英式常用sweets，美式常用candy。

meanings_zh: n. 早晨；上午
definition_en: The part of the day between midnight and noon
example1_en: I open the curtains every morning and water my plants.
example1_zh: 我每天早晨拉开窗帘，给植物浇水。
example2_en: Schools that start later in the morning may help teenagers get enough sleep and concentrate better.
example2_zh: 上午较晚上课的学校可能有助于青少年获得充足睡眠，更好地集中注意力。
collocations: early morning｜清晨 ; in the morning｜在早晨；在上午 ; on Monday morning｜在星期一早上 ; every morning｜每天早晨
tip_zh: 泛指用in the morning；具体某天早上用on。

meanings_zh: adv. 在外面；向外面 | prep. 在…外；超出…范围 | adj. 外面的；外部的
definition_en: In or towards a place that is not inside. | Beyond the boundaries or limits of something. | Located on the outer part or coming from elsewhere.
example1_en: The children played outside while their parents prepared lunch.
example1_zh: 父母准备午饭时，孩子们在外面玩耍。
example2_en: Schools should provide opportunities for students to learn outside the classroom through practical activities and community projects.
example2_zh: 学校应通过实践活动和社区项目，为学生提供课堂之外的学习机会。
collocations: go outside｜到外面去 ; outside the classroom｜在课堂之外 ; outside help｜外部帮助 ; the outside world｜外界
tip_zh: 后接地点用介词 outside；单独使用可作副词。

meanings_zh: n. 意大利面食
definition_en: food made from flour and water, shaped and usually boiled
example1_en: We cooked pasta with fresh tomatoes and mushrooms.
example1_zh: 我们用新鲜番茄和蘑菇做了意大利面。
example2_en: School canteens can serve wholegrain pasta with vegetables to provide affordable meals with more fibre.
example2_zh: 学校食堂可以供应搭配蔬菜的全麦意大利面，提供价格实惠、膳食纤维更多的餐食。
collocations: cook pasta｜煮意大利面 ; pasta sauce｜意面酱 ; fresh pasta｜新鲜意面 ; wholegrain pasta｜全麦意面
tip_zh: 不可数；一份意面可说a bowl of pasta。

meanings_zh: adj. 黑色的 | n. 黑色 | adj. 黑人的
definition_en: having the darkest colour, like coal | the darkest colour | relating to people with ancestry from sub-Saharan Africa
example1_en: She wore a black coat and bright yellow boots.
example1_zh: 她穿着黑色外套和亮黄色靴子。
example2_en: Black roofs absorb more sunlight than pale roofs, potentially increasing the energy needed for cooling.
example2_zh: 黑色屋顶比浅色屋顶吸收更多阳光，可能增加制冷所需的能源。
collocations: black coffee｜不加奶的咖啡 ; black and white｜黑白的 ; turn black｜变黑
tip_zh: 指族裔时常大写为Black；避免用作单数名词称人。

meanings_zh: n. 篮球运动 | n. 篮球
definition_en: a game where teams throw a ball through raised hoops | the large round ball used in this game
example1_en: We play basketball at the park after school.
example1_zh: 放学后，我们在公园打篮球。
example2_en: Team sports such as basketball help young people develop cooperation skills while improving their physical fitness.
example2_zh: 篮球等团队运动有助于年轻人培养协作能力，同时增强体质。
collocations: play basketball｜打篮球 ; basketball court｜篮球场 ; basketball team｜篮球队 ; basketball hoop｜篮球筐
tip_zh: play basketball不加冠词；指一个球用a basketball。

meanings_zh: n. 老虎
definition_en: A large wild cat with dark stripes on orange fur
example1_en: The tiger rested in the shade beside a pool.
example1_zh: 那只老虎在水池旁的阴凉处休息。
example2_en: Protecting tiger habitats also helps conserve other species that share the same forest ecosystems.
example2_zh: 保护老虎栖息地也有助于保护同一森林生态系统中的其他物种。
collocations: a wild tiger｜野生老虎 ; tiger conservation｜老虎保护 ; tiger habitat｜老虎栖息地
tip_zh: 可数名词；一只老虎用a tiger。

meanings_zh: n. 圣诞节；圣诞节期间
definition_en: the Christian festival celebrating Jesus's birth, or the surrounding period
example1_en: Our family usually shares a special meal at Christmas.
example1_zh: 我们一家通常在圣诞节一起享用一顿特别的饭菜。
example2_en: During Christmas, increased consumer spending can benefit local shops, although it may also generate additional packaging waste.
example2_zh: 圣诞节期间，消费支出的增加可以使当地商店受益，但也可能产生更多包装废弃物。
collocations: Christmas Eve｜平安夜 ; Christmas Day｜圣诞节当天 ; Christmas tree｜圣诞树 ; at Christmas｜在圣诞节期间
tip_zh: 首字母大写；节日期间用at，当天用on Christmas Day。

meanings_zh: n. 书桌；办公桌 | n. 服务台；接待处
definition_en: A table used for studying, writing, or office work | A counter where people receive information or services
example1_en: I keep my pencils in the top desk drawer.
example1_zh: 我把铅笔放在书桌最上面的抽屉里。
example2_en: Providing every student with a suitable desk can improve comfort and concentration in the classroom.
example2_zh: 为每位学生提供合适的课桌可以提高课堂上的舒适度和专注度。
collocations: desk drawer｜书桌抽屉 ; reception desk｜接待处 ; sit at a desk｜坐在书桌前
tip_zh: 在书桌前用at a desk，不用on a desk。

meanings_zh: v. 告诉；讲述 | v. 吩咐；命令 | v. 辨别；看出
definition_en: Give someone information or describe something in words. | Instruct someone to do something. | Recognise a difference or know something from available evidence.
example1_en: Please tell me what happened at school today.
example1_zh: 请告诉我今天在学校发生了什么。
example2_en: Schools should tell parents how personal information about their children is collected and stored.
example2_zh: 学校应告知家长，孩子的个人信息是如何被收集和保存的。
collocations: tell a story｜讲故事 ; tell the truth｜说实话 ; tell someone to do something｜吩咐某人做某事 ; tell the difference｜辨别差异
tip_zh: tell常直接接人；say接人时通常用to。

meanings_zh: n. 课程 | n. 路线；进程 | n. 一道菜
definition_en: A series of lessons about a particular subject. | The route something follows or the way events develop. | One part of a meal served separately from other parts.
example1_en: I joined a cooking course at the community centre.
example1_zh: 我报名参加了社区中心的烹饪课程。
example2_en: Universities should design each course to combine theoretical knowledge with practical skills relevant to future employment.
example2_zh: 大学应在设计每门课程时，将理论知识与未来就业所需的实用技能相结合。
collocations: take a course｜修读课程 ; training course｜培训课程 ; change course｜改变路线 ; main course｜主菜
tip_zh: course 是整门课程；lesson 是其中的一节课。

meanings_zh: n. 海滩；湖滩 | v. 使上岸；使搁浅
definition_en: an area of sand or small stones beside water | to bring a boat onto a shore
example1_en: We collected smooth stones on the beach after breakfast.
example1_zh: 早餐后，我们在海滩上捡了些光滑的石头。
example2_en: Local authorities should protect beaches from plastic waste while ensuring that tourism benefits nearby communities.
example2_zh: 地方政府应保护海滩免受塑料垃圾污染，同时确保旅游业惠及附近社区。
collocations: sandy beach｜沙滩 ; a pebble beach｜卵石海滩 ; on the beach｜在海滩上 ; beach cleanup｜海滩清理活动
tip_zh: 在海滩上用on the beach；shore泛指岸边。

meanings_zh: prep. 在……下方；低于 | adv. 在下面；在下文
definition_en: At a lower position, level, or amount than something. | In a lower place or later in a piece of writing.
example1_en: Our cat sleeps on the shelf below the window.
example1_zh: 我们的猫睡在窗户下方的架子上。
example2_en: Households with incomes below the national average may struggle to afford adequate heating during winter.
example2_zh: 收入低于全国平均水平的家庭可能难以负担冬季充足供暖的费用。
collocations: below average｜低于平均水平 ; below sea level｜低于海平面 ; below freezing｜低于冰点
tip_zh: below强调位置或数值较低，不一定在正下方。

meanings_zh: n. 妻子
definition_en: a woman who is married to someone
example1_en: His wife packed sandwiches for their afternoon walk.
example1_zh: 他的妻子为他们下午的散步准备了三明治。
example2_en: A husband and wife may share childcare responsibilities more equally when both have flexible working hours.
example2_zh: 如果夫妻双方的工作时间都很灵活，他们就可能更平等地分担育儿责任。
collocations: husband and wife｜夫妻 ; his wife｜他的妻子 ; future wife｜未来的妻子
tip_zh: 复数为wives；spouse指配偶，不限定性别。

meanings_zh: adv. 在那里；往那里 | pron. 用于表示存在的句式
definition_en: In, at, or towards that place. | Used before a verb to introduce something that exists.
example1_en: Leave your muddy boots there, beside the back door.
example1_zh: 把你沾满泥的靴子放在那儿，就在后门旁边。
example2_en: There are several practical ways for cities to reduce waste without increasing household expenses.
example2_zh: 城市可以采取几种切实可行的办法，在不增加家庭开支的情况下减少垃圾。
collocations: over there｜在那边 ; there is｜有；存在 ; there are｜有；存在 ; from there｜从那里
tip_zh: there表地点或引出存在句；别与their混淆。

meanings_zh: v. 驾驶；开车 | v. 推动；驱使 | n. 驾车出行；动力；驱动器
definition_en: to control a vehicle and make it move | to cause something to develop or someone to act | a car journey, strong motivation, or a computer storage device
example1_en: Can you drive me to the station after breakfast?
example1_zh: 早饭后你能开车送我去车站吗？
example2_en: Consumer demand can drive innovation by encouraging companies to develop products that use fewer natural resources.
example2_zh: 消费者需求可以鼓励企业开发消耗更少自然资源的产品，从而推动创新。
collocations: drive to work｜开车上班 ; drive economic growth｜推动经济增长 ; go for a drive｜开车兜风 ; hard drive｜硬盘
tip_zh: 不规则变化：drive—drove—driven；送某人用drive sb to。

meanings_zh: n. 脸；面部 | v. 面临；面对 | v. 面向；朝向
definition_en: The front of the head, including eyes, nose, and mouth. | To encounter or deal with a difficult situation. | To look or point in a particular direction.
example1_en: He washed his face before sitting down for breakfast.
example1_zh: 他洗了脸才坐下来吃早餐。
example2_en: Many coastal cities face increasing risks from flooding as sea levels rise and extreme weather becomes more frequent.
example2_zh: 随着海平面上升和极端天气日益频繁，许多沿海城市面临越来越大的洪水风险。
collocations: wash your face｜洗脸 ; face a challenge｜面对挑战 ; face south｜朝南 ; face to face｜面对面
tip_zh: 面对困难可说face difficulties或be faced with difficulties。

meanings_zh: n. 教师；老师
definition_en: someone whose job is to help people learn
example1_en: Our teacher brought a plant into class today.
example1_zh: 我们的老师今天带了一株植物来上课。
example2_en: A well-trained teacher can adapt classroom activities to support students with different learning needs and abilities.
example2_zh: 训练有素的教师能够调整课堂活动，以帮助学习需求和能力各不相同的学生。
collocations: primary school teacher｜小学教师 ; qualified teacher｜具备资质的教师 ; teacher training｜教师培训
tip_zh: 英语中称呼老师通常用Mr、Ms等加姓，不直接喊Teacher。

meanings_zh: n. 道路；公路 | n. 途径；进程
definition_en: a hard surface built for vehicles to travel along | a way of reaching a particular result or situation
example1_en: Look both ways before you cross the road.
example1_zh: 过马路前要向两边看。
example2_en: Investment in road maintenance can improve public safety and reduce transport costs for local businesses.
example2_zh: 投资道路养护能提高公共安全水平，并降低当地企业的运输成本。
collocations: road safety｜道路安全 ; a main road｜主干道 ; road maintenance｜道路养护 ; the road to recovery｜康复之路
tip_zh: on the road常指在旅途中；road to可比喻通往某结果的途径。

meanings_zh: adj. 热的；温度高的 | adj. 辣的 | adj. 热门的；备受关注的
definition_en: Having a high temperature. | Having a strong taste that burns your mouth. | Attracting a lot of interest or discussion.
example1_en: Be careful; the soup is still very hot.
example1_zh: 小心，汤还很烫。
example2_en: As summers become increasingly hot, cities need more shaded public spaces to protect residents from heat.
example2_zh: 随着夏季越来越炎热，城市需要更多有遮阴设施的公共空间来保护居民免受高温影响。
collocations: hot weather｜炎热天气 ; hot water｜热水 ; hot peppers｜辣椒 ; a hot topic｜热门话题
tip_zh: 形容食物时可指“烫”或“辣”，需结合语境。

meanings_zh: adj. 蓝色的 | n. 蓝色 | adj. 忧郁的；沮丧的
definition_en: having the colour of a clear daytime sky | the colour of a clear daytime sky | feeling sad or unhappy
example1_en: He wore a blue jacket to the picnic.
example1_zh: 他穿了一件蓝色夹克去野餐。
example2_en: Urban designers often use blue surfaces to create a sense of calm in busy public spaces.
example2_zh: 城市设计师常使用蓝色的表面，在繁忙的公共空间营造宁静感。
collocations: bright blue｜亮蓝色 ; dark blue｜深蓝色 ; blue sky｜蓝天 ; feel blue｜感到忧郁
tip_zh: feel blue表示心情低落；颜色较浅用light blue。

meanings_zh: adv. 在今晚 | n. 今晚；今夜
definition_en: during the evening or night of today | the evening or night of today
example1_en: We are making vegetable soup for dinner tonight.
example1_zh: 我们今晚要做蔬菜汤当晚餐。
example2_en: Residents will meet tonight to discuss how public transport could better serve the local community.
example2_zh: 居民们今晚将开会讨论公共交通如何更好地服务当地社区。
collocations: tonight's meeting｜今晚的会议 ; late tonight｜今晚晚些时候 ; by tonight｜到今晚为止
tip_zh: 作时间状语时直接用tonight，前面不加介词。

meanings_zh: n. 互联网；因特网
definition_en: The worldwide network connecting computers and other devices.
example1_en: The internet stopped working halfway through our video call.
example1_zh: 我们视频通话进行到一半时断网了。
example2_en: Reliable internet access enables rural students to use educational resources that may be unavailable locally.
example2_zh: 可靠的互联网接入让农村学生能够使用当地可能缺乏的教育资源。
collocations: internet access｜互联网接入 ; an internet connection｜网络连接 ; on the internet｜在网上 ; internet users｜网民
tip_zh: 通常说 the internet；作定语时不用 the。

meanings_zh: n. 出租车 | v. （飞机）在地面滑行
definition_en: A car with a driver whom you pay for a journey. | To move slowly on the ground before takeoff or after landing.
example1_en: We took a taxi home with our heavy bags.
example1_zh: 我们带着沉重的行李，打车回了家。
example2_en: Improving public transport could reduce dependence on taxis and private cars in crowded city centres.
example2_zh: 改善公共交通可以减少人们在拥挤的市中心对出租车和私家车的依赖。
collocations: take a taxi｜乘出租车 ; hail a taxi｜招手叫出租车 ; taxi fare｜出租车费 ; taxi rank｜出租车候车点
tip_zh: 乘出租车可说take a taxi或by taxi。

meanings_zh: n. 二月
definition_en: The second month of the year.
example1_en: My sister starts her new job in February.
example1_zh: 我姐姐二月份开始新工作。
example2_en: The community centre will introduce additional evening classes in February to meet growing demand.
example2_zh: 社区中心将在二月份增设夜间课程，以满足不断增长的需求。
collocations: in February｜在二月 ; early February｜二月初 ; late February｜二月下旬
tip_zh: 月份首字母大写；月份前用in，具体日期前用on。

meanings_zh: v. 丢失；遗失 | v. 失去；减少 | v. 输掉；失败
definition_en: to become unable to find something you had | to stop having something or have less of it | to fail to win a game or competition
example1_en: I always lose my keys inside this enormous bag.
example1_zh: 我总是在这个大包里找不到钥匙。
example2_en: Small businesses may lose customers when major retailers offer similar products at significantly lower prices.
example2_zh: 大型零售商以低得多的价格提供类似产品时，小企业可能会流失顾客。
collocations: lose weight｜体重减轻 ; lose touch｜失去联系 ; lose a match｜输掉比赛 ; lose your temper｜发脾气
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词都是lost；别与loose混淆。

meanings_zh: det. 你的；你们的
definition_en: Belonging or relating to the person or people being addressed
example1_en: Please leave your shoes by the door before entering.
example1_zh: 进来前请把你的鞋放在门边。
example2_en: Choosing a university near your home can reduce living expenses and make higher education more affordable.
example2_zh: 选择离家近的大学可以减少生活开支，让高等教育更负担得起。
collocations: your own｜你自己的 ; your family｜你的家人 ; do your best｜尽你最大的努力
tip_zh: your后接名词；yours独立使用；you're意为你是。

meanings_zh: n. 星；恒星 | n. 明星；杰出人物 | v. 主演；由…主演
definition_en: a huge ball of hot gas shining in space | a famous or exceptionally successful performer or other person | to play a leading role or feature someone doing so
example1_en: We watched the stars from our tent beside the lake.
example1_zh: 我们在湖边的帐篷里仰望星空。
example2_en: Light pollution prevents many urban residents from seeing stars, reducing their connection with the natural night sky.
example2_zh: 光污染使许多城市居民看不到星星，削弱了他们与自然夜空的联系。
collocations: a bright star｜明亮的星星 ; a film star｜电影明星 ; a rising star｜冉冉升起的新星 ; star in a film｜主演电影
tip_zh: star in表示“主演”；过去式starred，进行式starring。

meanings_zh: n. 演员 | n. 参与者；行动主体
definition_en: Someone who performs characters in plays, films, or television | A person or organisation involved in a particular situation
example1_en: The actor wore a silver crown on stage.
example1_zh: 那位演员在舞台上戴着一顶银色王冠。
example2_en: Professional actors can help students develop communication skills through drama workshops that encourage teamwork and creative expression.
example2_zh: 专业演员可以通过鼓励团队合作和创意表达的戏剧工作坊，帮助学生培养沟通能力。
collocations: a leading actor｜主演 ; a professional actor｜专业演员 ; a supporting actor｜配角演员 ; a key actor｜关键参与者
tip_zh: actor可指任何性别的演员；actress专指女演员。

meanings_zh: n. 艺术；美术 | n. 艺术作品 | n. 技巧；艺术性的方法
definition_en: creative expression through activities such as painting, sculpture, or drawing | objects or images created to express ideas or beauty | a skill developed through practice and careful understanding
example1_en: We spent the afternoon making art with coloured paper.
example1_zh: 我们花了一下午用彩纸创作艺术作品。
example2_en: Public funding for art can enrich community life and make cultural experiences accessible to a wider audience.
example2_zh: 公共艺术资助能丰富社区生活，让更多人有机会体验文化活动。
collocations: a work of art｜一件艺术作品 ; modern art｜现代艺术 ; an art gallery｜美术馆 ; the art of conversation｜交谈的艺术
tip_zh: art指艺术通常不可数；一件作品用a work of art。

meanings_zh: v. 打破；折断；破裂 | n. 休息；暂停 | v. 违反；违背
definition_en: To separate into pieces or damage something so it stops working. | A short period when an activity stops. | To fail to obey a rule or keep a promise.
example1_en: Be careful not to break that glass bowl.
example1_zh: 小心别打碎那个玻璃碗。
example2_en: Regular breaks during study sessions may improve concentration and help students retain new information.
example2_zh: 学习期间定时休息可能有助于提高注意力，并帮助学生记住新知识。
collocations: take a break｜休息一下 ; break the law｜违法 ; break a promise｜违背承诺 ; break a record｜打破纪录
tip_zh: 动词变化为break—broke—broken；休息用take a break。

meanings_zh: n. 蛋；卵 | n. 卵细胞；卵子
definition_en: a rounded object laid by female birds and some other animals | a female reproductive cell that can develop after fertilisation
example1_en: She cracked an egg into the hot frying pan.
example1_zh: 她把一个鸡蛋打进了热煎锅。
example2_en: Eggs provide an affordable source of protein and can form part of a balanced diet.
example2_zh: 鸡蛋是价格实惠的蛋白质来源，可以成为均衡饮食的一部分。
collocations: boiled egg｜水煮蛋 ; lay eggs｜产卵 ; egg yolk｜蛋黄 ; egg cell｜卵细胞
tip_zh: scrambled eggs指炒蛋；egg white指蛋清。

meanings_zh: n. 书店
definition_en: a shop where books are sold
example1_en: We found a tiny bookshop beside the railway station.
example1_zh: 我们在火车站旁发现了一家小书店。
example2_en: An independent bookshop can strengthen local cultural life by hosting reading groups and supporting emerging writers.
example2_zh: 独立书店可以通过举办读书会和支持新作家来丰富当地文化生活。
collocations: independent bookshop｜独立书店 ; second-hand bookshop｜二手书店 ; local bookshop｜本地书店
tip_zh: bookshop常用于英式英语，美式多用bookstore。

meanings_zh: n. 年；一年 | n. 学年；年度
definition_en: A period of twelve months | An annual period organised for education, business, or another purpose
example1_en: We moved into this flat almost a year ago.
example1_zh: 我们搬进这套公寓快一年了。
example2_en: A gap year can give students valuable work experience before they begin university studies.
example2_zh: 间隔年可以让学生在开始大学学习前获得宝贵的工作经验。
collocations: academic year｜学年 ; every year｜每年 ; all year round｜全年 ; gap year｜间隔年
tip_zh: last year等时间短语前不加介词；年龄用years old。

meanings_zh: adj. 免费的 | adj. 自由的；不受限制的 | v. 释放；使摆脱
definition_en: Costing no money. | Able to act or move without being controlled or restricted. | To release someone or something from control or confinement.
example1_en: The café offers free biscuits with every hot drink.
example1_zh: 这家咖啡馆每卖一杯热饮都会赠送饼干。
example2_en: Providing free public transport could reduce traffic congestion and improve access to employment for disadvantaged residents.
example2_zh: 提供免费公共交通可以缓解交通拥堵，并改善弱势居民的就业可及性。
collocations: free admission｜免费入场 ; free of charge｜免费 ; free speech｜言论自由 ; free someone from｜使某人摆脱
tip_zh: be free to do表示可以自由做；for free表示免费。

meanings_zh: n. 博物馆
definition_en: a building displaying objects of historical, scientific, or artistic interest
example1_en: We saw a huge dinosaur skeleton at the museum.
example1_zh: 我们在博物馆看到了一具巨大的恐龙骨架。
example2_en: Museums can help young people understand local history by connecting everyday objects with the lives of previous generations.
example2_zh: 博物馆可以将日常物品与前人的生活联系起来，帮助年轻人了解当地历史。
collocations: visit a museum｜参观博物馆 ; natural history museum｜自然历史博物馆 ; museum collection｜博物馆藏品
tip_zh: museum是可数名词；参观博物馆说visit a museum。

meanings_zh: n. 商店；店铺 | v. 购物
definition_en: A place where people buy goods or services. | To visit stores or websites to look for and buy things.
example1_en: The little shop near our house sells fresh bread.
example1_zh: 我们家附近的小店卖新鲜面包。
example2_en: Independent shops can strengthen local economies by creating jobs and keeping spending within the community.
example2_zh: 独立商店可以通过创造就业并让消费留在社区内，促进地方经济。
collocations: local shop｜本地商店 ; shop window｜商店橱窗 ; shop for clothes｜买衣服 ; shop around｜货比三家
tip_zh: 买某类商品用shop for；泛指去购物用go shopping。

meanings_zh: n. 周末
definition_en: Saturday and Sunday, often a time away from work.
example1_en: We usually visit the farmers' market at the weekend.
example1_zh: 我们通常在周末逛农贸市场。
example2_en: Affordable weekend activities can encourage families to spend more time together in their local communities.
example2_zh: 价格亲民的周末活动能鼓励家人在当地社区共度更多时光。
collocations: at the weekend｜在周末（英式） ; on the weekend｜在周末（美式） ; a long weekend｜连休的长周末 ; weekend break｜周末短途度假
tip_zh: 英式常说 at the weekend，美式常用 on。

meanings_zh: n. 毛衣；针织套衫
definition_en: A knitted garment worn over the upper body for warmth.
example1_en: I pulled on a warm sweater before going outside.
example1_zh: 出门前，我套上了一件暖和的毛衣。
example2_en: Choosing a durable wool sweater rather than several cheap alternatives can reduce clothing waste over time.
example2_zh: 选择一件耐穿的羊毛衫，而不是多件廉价替代品，长远来看可以减少衣物浪费。
collocations: wool sweater｜羊毛衫 ; knitted sweater｜针织毛衣 ; thick sweater｜厚毛衣
tip_zh: 英式英语也常用jumper；sweatshirt指运动衫。

meanings_zh: n. 母亲；妈妈 | v. 像母亲般照顾
definition_en: A female parent. | Care for someone protectively, as a mother would.
example1_en: My mother taught me how to ride a bicycle.
example1_zh: 我妈妈教会了我骑自行车。
example2_en: Affordable childcare can help a mother return to work without placing excessive pressure on the family budget.
example2_zh: 负担得起的托育服务能帮助母亲重返职场，而不给家庭预算带来过大压力。
collocations: working mother｜在职母亲 ; single mother｜单亲母亲 ; expectant mother｜准妈妈 ; mother tongue｜母语
tip_zh: 英式口语常用mum，美式口语常用mom。

meanings_zh: adj. 疲倦的；累的 | adj. 厌倦的；厌烦的
definition_en: needing rest or sleep because of physical or mental effort | annoyed or bored by something that continues or repeats
example1_en: I felt too tired to cook after the walk.
example1_zh: 散步后我累得不想做饭。
example2_en: Employees who regularly work long hours may become too tired to perform their duties safely.
example2_zh: 经常长时间工作的员工可能会疲惫不堪，无法安全地履行职责。
collocations: feel tired｜感到疲倦 ; tired of waiting｜等得不耐烦 ; too tired to concentrate｜累得无法集中注意力
tip_zh: tired形容人感到累；tiring形容事情令人累。

meanings_zh: n. 西班牙
definition_en: a country in southwestern Europe
example1_en: We travelled around Spain by train last summer.
example1_zh: 去年夏天，我们乘火车游览了西班牙。
example2_en: Spain attracts international visitors through its cultural heritage, varied landscapes, and well-developed tourism infrastructure.
example2_zh: 西班牙凭借文化遗产、多样的景观和完善的旅游基础设施吸引国际游客。
collocations: southern Spain｜西班牙南部 ; mainland Spain｜西班牙本土 ; travel to Spain｜前往西班牙旅行
tip_zh: 国名首字母大写，前面通常不加the。

meanings_zh: v. 玩耍；参加游戏或运动 | v. 演奏；播放；扮演 | n. 戏剧；剧本
definition_en: Enjoy an activity or take part in a game | Perform music or a role, or make a recording run | A story written for actors to perform
example1_en: The children played with wooden blocks on the floor.
example1_zh: 孩子们在地板上玩木制积木。
example2_en: Schools should provide safe outdoor spaces where children can play and develop essential social skills.
example2_zh: 学校应提供安全的户外空间，让孩子们玩耍并培养重要的社交技能。
collocations: play football｜踢足球 ; play the piano｜弹钢琴 ; play a role in｜在…中发挥作用 ; put on a play｜上演一部戏剧
tip_zh: 球类前通常不加冠词；乐器前通常用the。

meanings_zh: adj. 不同的；不一样的 | adj. 各不相同的；各种的
definition_en: not the same as someone or something else | used to describe several separate people, things, or types
example1_en: These gloves look similar, but their sizes are different.
example1_zh: 这些手套看起来相似，但尺码不同。
example2_en: Students from different cultural backgrounds can contribute valuable perspectives to classroom discussions about global issues.
example2_zh: 来自不同文化背景的学生能为课堂上的全球议题讨论提供宝贵的视角。
collocations: different from｜与……不同 ; different perspectives｜不同视角 ; completely different｜完全不同
tip_zh: 与……不同常用different from，适合正式写作。

meanings_zh: n. 游泳池；水塘 | n. 共同储备；备用资源 | v. 集中共用；合伙出资
definition_en: An artificial swimming basin or a small area of still water | A supply of money, people, or resources available for shared use | To combine resources so people can use them together
example1_en: We spent the afternoon swimming in the outdoor pool.
example1_zh: 我们整个下午都在室外游泳池游泳。
example2_en: Small businesses can pool their resources to purchase equipment that would otherwise be too expensive.
example2_zh: 小企业可以集中资源，购买单独承担会过于昂贵的设备。
collocations: a swimming pool｜游泳池 ; a pool of talent｜人才储备 ; pool resources｜集中资源 ; pool knowledge｜共享知识
tip_zh: pool resources指集中资源；play pool则指打美式台球。

meanings_zh: prep. 在……之前 | conj. 在……以前 | adv. 以前；先前
definition_en: Earlier than a particular time or event. | Earlier than the time when something happens. | At an earlier time.
example1_en: Please put your shoes by the door before dinner.
example1_zh: 请在晚饭前把鞋放到门边。
example2_en: Before introducing new transport policies, local authorities should consult residents about their daily travel needs.
example2_zh: 地方政府在推出新的交通政策之前，应就居民的日常出行需求征求意见。
collocations: before long｜不久以后 ; the day before｜前一天 ; before breakfast｜早餐前 ; before making a decision｜作决定之前
tip_zh: 时间从句表将来时，before后通常用一般现在时。

meanings_zh: adj. 极好的；令人愉快的
definition_en: Extremely good or enjoyable.
example1_en: We had a wonderful picnic beside the lake.
example1_zh: 我们在湖边度过了一段美好的野餐时光。
example2_en: Public libraries offer wonderful opportunities for children to discover new interests without placing financial pressure on families.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆为儿童发现新兴趣提供了极好的机会，又不会给家庭带来经济压力。
collocations: a wonderful experience｜美好的经历 ; a wonderful opportunity｜极好的机会 ; wonderful news｜令人高兴的消息
tip_zh: 表示极好或令人愉快，不等于奇怪的。

meanings_zh: n. 笔记本；笔记簿 | n. 笔记本电脑
definition_en: A book of blank pages for writing notes. | A small portable computer with a folding screen.
example1_en: She keeps a small notebook beside her bed.
example1_zh: 她在床边放着一本小笔记本。
example2_en: Keeping a notebook during fieldwork allows researchers to record observations that photographs alone may not capture.
example2_zh: 实地研究时使用笔记本，有助于研究人员记录仅靠照片可能无法捕捉的观察结果。
collocations: write in a notebook｜在笔记本上写 ; a spiral notebook｜螺旋装订笔记本 ; a notebook computer｜笔记本电脑
tip_zh: 通常指纸质笔记本；电脑义也可说notebook computer。

meanings_zh: adj. 白色的 | n. 白色 | n. 蛋白；蛋清
definition_en: having the colour of fresh snow or milk | the colour of fresh snow or milk | the clear part of an egg that turns white when cooked
example1_en: She wore a white cotton shirt to the picnic.
example1_zh: 她穿着一件白色棉衬衫去野餐。
example2_en: Painting roofs white can help buildings reflect sunlight and reduce the energy needed for cooling.
example2_zh: 把屋顶刷成白色有助于建筑物反射阳光，并减少制冷所需的能源。
collocations: white paint｜白色油漆 ; egg white｜蛋清 ; black and white｜黑白的
tip_zh: egg white指蛋清；蛋黄是yolk。

meanings_zh: adj. 大的；大量的
definition_en: greater than usual in size, amount, or number
example1_en: A large dog was sleeping beside the kitchen door.
example1_zh: 一只大狗正睡在厨房门旁。
example2_en: Large cities often offer better employment opportunities, although high housing costs can reduce residents' quality of life.
example2_zh: 大城市通常提供更好的就业机会，但高昂的住房成本可能降低居民的生活质量。
collocations: a large number of｜大量的 ; a large amount of｜大量的 ; large-scale development｜大规模开发 ; a large population｜众多人口
tip_zh: large number接可数名词，large amount接不可数名词。

meanings_zh: n. 小时 | n. 工作或营业时间
definition_en: a period of sixty minutes | the times when someone works or a service operates
example1_en: The walk to the lake took us an hour.
example1_zh: 我们走到湖边花了一个小时。
example2_en: Reducing working hours may improve employee wellbeing without necessarily lowering overall productivity in the workplace.
example2_zh: 缩短工作时间可能改善员工的身心健康，而不一定降低工作场所的整体生产率。
collocations: an hour｜一小时 ; working hours｜工作时间 ; opening hours｜营业时间 ; rush hour｜交通高峰期
tip_zh: h不发音，所以说an hour，而不是a hour。

meanings_zh: adj. 已婚的 | adj. 婚姻的；夫妻生活的
definition_en: Having a husband or wife. | Relating to marriage or life as a couple.
example1_en: My sister is married and lives near the coast.
example1_zh: 我姐姐已婚，住在海岸附近。
example2_en: Affordable housing can help newly married couples establish independent households without placing excessive pressure on their finances.
example2_zh: 可负担的住房有助于新婚夫妇独立成家，而不会给他们带来过重的经济压力。
collocations: get married｜结婚 ; be married to｜与……有婚姻关系 ; married couple｜已婚夫妇 ; married life｜婚后生活
tip_zh: 与某人结婚用 be/get married to，不用 with。

meanings_zh: adj. 满的；装满的 | adj. 完整的；全部的 | adj. 吃饱的
definition_en: Containing as much as possible, with no space left. | Including everything, with nothing missing. | Having eaten enough and not wanting more food.
example1_en: The basket is full, so we need another one.
example1_zh: 篮子已经满了，我们得再拿一个。
example2_en: Governments should publish the full results of environmental studies so that citizens can make informed decisions.
example2_zh: 政府应公布环境研究的完整结果，以便公民作出知情决策。
collocations: full of｜充满 ; full details｜完整细节 ; full potential｜全部潜力 ; feel full｜感觉饱了
tip_zh: full of表示“充满”；注意full与fool发音不同。

meanings_zh: n. 欧洲
definition_en: the continent west of Asia and north of Africa
example1_en: My cousin travelled across Europe by train last summer.
example1_zh: 我表亲去年夏天乘火车游历了欧洲。
example2_en: Many cities in Europe are expanding cycling networks to reduce traffic congestion and improve urban air quality.
example2_zh: 欧洲许多城市正在扩建自行车路网，以缓解交通拥堵并改善城市空气质量。
collocations: across Europe｜遍及欧洲 ; continental Europe｜欧洲大陆 ; Eastern Europe｜东欧 ; Western Europe｜西欧
tip_zh: Europe首字母大写，通常不加the；不等于欧盟。

meanings_zh: v. 发生 | v. 碰巧；恰好
definition_en: to take place, often without being planned | to do or be something by chance
example1_en: What happened to the plant beside your window?
example1_zh: 你窗边那盆植物怎么了？
example2_en: Traffic accidents are more likely to happen when drivers are tired or distracted by mobile phones.
example2_zh: 驾驶员疲劳或因手机分心时，更容易发生交通事故。
collocations: happen to someone｜发生在某人身上 ; happen to do something｜碰巧做某事 ; happen by chance｜偶然发生
tip_zh: 不用于被动语态；happen to do表示碰巧做某事。

meanings_zh: n. 数；数字；号码 | n. 数量 | v. 给…编号；总计
definition_en: a value used for counting, measuring, or identifying something | the total amount of people or things | to assign identifying figures or add up to a total
example1_en: I saved your phone number on my new phone.
example1_zh: 我把你的电话号码存到了新手机里。
example2_en: The number of people working from home has increased as digital communication tools have improved.
example2_zh: 随着数字通信工具的改进，居家办公的人数有所增加。
collocations: phone number｜电话号码 ; a large number of｜大量 ; the number of｜…的数量 ; number the pages｜给页面编号
tip_zh: a number of接复数谓语；the number of接单数谓语。

meanings_zh: v. 拿；取；带走 | v. 花费；需要 | v. 乘坐；搭乘
definition_en: To pick up, hold, or carry something away. | To require a particular amount of time or effort. | To use a particular form of transport.
example1_en: Take an umbrella because it might rain this afternoon.
example1_zh: 带把伞吧，今天下午可能会下雨。
example2_en: Developing reliable public transport networks takes considerable time and requires sustained investment from local authorities.
example2_zh: 建设可靠的公共交通网络需要相当长的时间，也需要地方政府持续投入资金。
collocations: take a bus｜乘公共汽车 ; take time｜花时间 ; take responsibility｜承担责任 ; take notes｜记笔记
tip_zh: 过去式took，过去分词taken；take带走，bring带来。

meanings_zh: v. 享受；喜爱 | v. 享有
definition_en: get pleasure from an activity or experience | have something good, such as a right or advantage
example1_en: We enjoy walking beside the river after dinner.
example1_zh: 我们喜欢晚饭后在河边散步。
example2_en: Residents enjoy better health when their neighbourhoods provide safe walking routes and accessible green spaces.
example2_zh: 社区提供安全的步行路线和便利的绿地时，居民的健康状况会更好。
collocations: enjoy doing something｜喜欢做某事 ; enjoy yourself｜玩得开心 ; enjoy good health｜身体健康 ; enjoy the benefits｜享有益处
tip_zh: 接动词时用-ing形式，不用to do。

meanings_zh: n. 一月
definition_en: the first month of the year
example1_en: Our swimming lessons begin in January this year.
example1_zh: 我们今年的游泳课从一月开始。
example2_en: Many people set health goals in January, but maintaining new habits requires consistent support.
example2_zh: 许多人在一月设定健康目标，但保持新习惯需要持续的支持。
collocations: in January｜在一月 ; early January｜一月初 ; late January｜一月下旬
tip_zh: 月份首字母大写；在一月用in January。

meanings_zh: n. 业余爱好
definition_en: An activity you regularly do for pleasure in your free time
example1_en: Growing herbs on my balcony has become my favourite hobby.
example1_zh: 在阳台种香草已成了我最喜欢的业余爱好。
example2_en: Having a creative hobby can help people manage stress and maintain a healthy balance between work and leisure.
example2_zh: 拥有创造性的业余爱好能帮助人们调节压力，保持工作与休闲之间的健康平衡。
collocations: take up a hobby｜开始培养一种爱好 ; a creative hobby｜创造性的业余爱好 ; pursue a hobby｜从事业余爱好
tip_zh: 可数名词，复数为hobbies；开始一种爱好用take up。

meanings_zh: n. 艺术家；画家 | n. 表演艺术家；艺人
definition_en: a person who creates paintings, sculptures, or other art | a person who performs music or other entertainment professionally
example1_en: The artist painted the harbour in soft blue colours.
example1_zh: 这位画家用柔和的蓝色描绘了港口。
example2_en: Public funding allows an artist to create work that enriches community life without depending entirely on sales.
example2_zh: 公共资助使艺术家能够创作丰富社区生活的作品，而不必完全依赖销售收入。
collocations: professional artist｜职业艺术家 ; local artist｜本地艺术家 ; recording artist｜录音艺人 ; talented artist｜有才华的艺术家
tip_zh: artist指艺术家；artistic是形容词“艺术的”。

meanings_zh: v. 站立；起立 | v. 忍受；容忍 | n. 立场；坚决的态度
definition_en: To be upright on your feet, or get into this position. | To accept something unpleasant without becoming too upset. | A firm opinion or action supporting or opposing something.
example1_en: Please stand near the door until the bus stops.
example1_zh: 请站在车门附近，等公交车停稳。
example2_en: Local residents took a stand against the proposed road because it would destroy valuable woodland.
example2_zh: 当地居民坚决反对这条拟建道路，因为它会破坏珍贵的林地。
collocations: stand still｜站着不动 ; stand up｜站起来 ; can't stand doing something｜无法忍受做某事 ; take a stand｜表明坚定立场
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为stood；忍受常用can't stand。

meanings_zh: v. 必须 | v. 一定；想必 | n. 必需的事物
definition_en: used to express a strong obligation or requirement | used to express a confident conclusion | something considered essential
example1_en: You must wear a helmet when riding here.
example1_zh: 在这里骑车必须戴头盔。
example2_en: Governments must ensure that all children have access to quality education, regardless of their family income.
example2_zh: 政府必须确保所有儿童都能接受优质教育，不论其家庭收入如何。
collocations: must be｜一定是 ; must have done｜想必已经做过 ; an absolute must｜绝对必需的事物
tip_zh: must是情态动词；mustn't表禁止，不是“不必”。

meanings_zh: n. 天空
definition_en: The space above the earth where clouds and stars appear.
example1_en: The sky turned orange as we walked home.
example1_zh: 我们步行回家时，天空变成了橙色。
example2_en: Light pollution prevents many urban residents from seeing stars clearly in the night sky.
example2_zh: 光污染使许多城市居民无法清楚地看到夜空中的星星。
collocations: clear sky｜晴朗的天空 ; night sky｜夜空 ; blue sky｜蓝天 ; cloudy skies｜多云的天空
tip_zh: 通常用the sky；skies常用于描述天气或某地天空。

meanings_zh: prep. 关于 | adv. 大约；左右 | prep. 在…周围；在…各处
definition_en: concerning a particular subject | approximately, rather than exactly | in various places within or around somewhere
example1_en: We talked about our holiday plans over dinner.
example1_zh: 我们吃晚饭时聊了假期计划。
example2_en: Schools should teach children about the environmental consequences of their everyday choices and habits.
example2_zh: 学校应教导孩子了解日常选择和习惯对环境的影响。
collocations: talk about｜谈论 ; worry about｜担心 ; about an hour｜大约一小时
tip_zh: about可表示话题或约数；be about to表示即将。

meanings_zh: n. 三明治 | v. 把……夹在中间
definition_en: Two slices of bread with a filling between them. | To place or squeeze something between two other things.
example1_en: I packed a cheese sandwich and an apple for lunch.
example1_zh: 我带了一个奶酪三明治和一个苹果当午餐。
example2_en: School cafeterias can promote healthier eating by offering sandwiches made with wholegrain bread and fresh vegetables.
example2_zh: 学校食堂可以提供用全麦面包和新鲜蔬菜制作的三明治，促进更健康的饮食。
collocations: cheese sandwich｜奶酪三明治 ; make a sandwich｜做三明治 ; be sandwiched between｜被夹在……之间
tip_zh: 动词常用被动结构be sandwiched between。

meanings_zh: adj. 缓慢的；耗时的 | v. 减速；使放慢 | adj. 钟表走得慢的
definition_en: Moving, happening, or taking place at a low speed. | To move or happen less quickly, or make something do so. | Showing a time earlier than the correct time.
example1_en: We took a slow walk along the river.
example1_zh: 我们沿着河边慢慢散步。
example2_en: Slow progress in expanding public transport may discourage commuters from giving up their private cars.
example2_zh: 公共交通扩建进展缓慢，可能会削弱通勤者放弃私家车的意愿。
collocations: slow progress｜缓慢的进展 ; slow down｜减速；放慢 ; a slow pace｜缓慢的节奏 ; slow economic growth｜缓慢的经济增长
tip_zh: slow多作形容词；修饰一般动作通常用slowly。

meanings_zh: v. 制作；制造 | v. 使；迫使 | n. 品牌；型号
definition_en: to create or produce something | to cause a state or force an action | the brand or type of a manufactured product
example1_en: We made a small table from leftover pieces of wood.
example1_zh: 我们用剩下的木料做了一张小桌子。
example2_en: Schools can make science more accessible by allowing students to conduct simple experiments with everyday materials.
example2_zh: 学校可以让学生用日常材料做简单实验，使科学更容易理解。
collocations: make a decision｜作决定 ; make progress｜取得进步 ; make a difference｜产生影响 ; make someone happy｜使某人开心
tip_zh: 主动式make sb do；被动式be made to do。

meanings_zh: det. 每个；每一 | det. 每隔；每逢 | det. 一切可能的；充分的
definition_en: referring to all members of a group individually | used to show how regularly something happens | used to emphasize all possibilities or a strong degree
example1_en: Every child brought a favourite toy to the picnic.
example1_zh: 每个孩子都带了一件最喜欢的玩具去野餐。
example2_en: Governments should ensure that every student has access to reliable internet services for learning.
example2_zh: 政府应确保每个学生都能使用可靠的互联网服务进行学习。
collocations: every day｜每天 ; every other week｜每隔一周 ; every effort｜一切努力 ; every reason to believe｜充分的理由相信
tip_zh: every后通常接单数可数名词，谓语也用单数。

meanings_zh: adj. 安静的；轻声的 | adj. 平静的；不繁忙的 | n. 安静；宁静
definition_en: making little or no noise | having little activity or excitement | a state with little or no noise
example1_en: The house was quiet after the children fell asleep.
example1_zh: 孩子们睡着后，屋子里安静了下来。
example2_en: Quiet study spaces in public libraries are essential for students who cannot concentrate at home.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆内安静的学习空间对无法在家集中注意力的学生至关重要。
collocations: keep quiet｜保持安静 ; a quiet neighbourhood｜安静的街区 ; peace and quiet｜平静与安宁
tip_zh: quiet是“安静的”，quite是“相当”，注意拼写。

meanings_zh: v. 添加；增加 | v. 相加；做加法 | v. 补充说
definition_en: to put something with something else or increase an amount | to combine numbers to find their total | to say something more after an earlier statement
example1_en: Add a little milk if the soup is too thick.
example1_zh: 如果汤太稠，就加一点牛奶。
example2_en: Adding more green spaces to urban neighbourhoods can improve residents' wellbeing and provide habitats for wildlife.
example2_zh: 为城市社区增加绿地可以改善居民的身心健康，并为野生动物提供栖息地。
collocations: add something to｜把某物加入…… ; add up｜加起来 ; add value｜增加价值 ; add that｜补充说
tip_zh: add A to B表示把A加入B；add to还可表示增添。

meanings_zh: n. 事实；真实情况
definition_en: Something known or proved to be true.
example1_en: We checked the facts before booking our train tickets.
example1_zh: 我们核实了相关情况后才订火车票。
example2_en: Students should learn to distinguish facts from opinions when evaluating information shared through digital media.
example2_zh: 学生在评估数字媒体传播的信息时，应学会区分事实和观点。
collocations: in fact｜事实上 ; the fact that｜……这一事实 ; establish the facts｜查明事实 ; facts and figures｜事实与数据
tip_zh: the fact that后接完整从句，说明事实内容。

meanings_zh: adj. 令人愉快的；美好的 | adj. 友善的；体贴的
definition_en: pleasant or enjoyable | kind and friendly towards other people
example1_en: We had a nice picnic beside the lake.
example1_zh: 我们在湖边愉快地野餐了一次。
example2_en: Although nice surroundings matter, affordable housing and reliable transport are more important to many urban residents.
example2_zh: 虽然宜人的环境很重要，但对许多城市居民而言，可负担的住房和可靠的交通更为重要。
collocations: nice weather｜好天气 ; a nice time｜愉快的时光 ; be nice to someone｜友善地对待某人
tip_zh: nice含义较宽，正式写作宜换成更具体的形容词。

meanings_zh: n. 花；开花植物 | v. 开花
definition_en: The often colourful part of a plant that produces seeds. | To produce flowers.
example1_en: She placed fresh flowers in a vase by the window.
example1_zh: 她把鲜花插进窗边的花瓶里。
example2_en: Planting native flowers in urban parks can support pollinating insects and improve local biodiversity.
example2_zh: 在城市公园种植本地花卉能够帮助传粉昆虫生存，并改善当地生物多样性。
collocations: a bunch of flowers｜一束花 ; cut flowers｜鲜切花 ; in flower｜开着花
tip_zh: flower既可作名词“花”，也可作动词“开花”。

meanings_zh: adj. 多云的；阴天的 | adj. 浑浊的；不透明的
definition_en: having many clouds in the sky | not clear or transparent
example1_en: It was cloudy, so we left our sunglasses at home.
example1_zh: 当时天阴着，所以我们把太阳镜留在了家里。
example2_en: Solar panels can still generate electricity on cloudy days, although their output is usually lower.
example2_zh: 太阳能电池板在阴天仍能发电，不过发电量通常较低。
collocations: cloudy sky｜多云的天空 ; cloudy weather｜多云天气 ; cloudy water｜浑浊的水
tip_zh: 既可形容天空多云，也可形容液体浑浊。

meanings_zh: adj. 重要的；重大的 | adj. 有影响力的；有地位的
definition_en: Having great value or a significant effect. | Having considerable power, influence, or status.
example1_en: Keep your important documents in this waterproof folder.
example1_zh: 把你的重要文件放在这个防水文件夹里。
example2_en: Access to reliable information plays an important role in helping citizens make informed decisions about their health.
example2_zh: 获取可靠信息对于帮助公民作出明智的健康决策起着重要作用。
collocations: an important role｜重要作用 ; an important factor｜重要因素 ; important to someone｜对某人很重要 ; equally important｜同样重要
tip_zh: 用It is important to do；importance是名词形式。

meanings_zh: n. 房屋；住宅 | v. 为……提供住所；容纳
definition_en: A building where a person or family lives. | To provide a place for people or things to stay.
example1_en: Their house has a small garden behind the kitchen.
example1_zh: 他们的房子在厨房后面有一个小花园。
example2_en: Local authorities could convert unused office buildings into apartments to house families in need of affordable accommodation.
example2_zh: 地方政府可以将闲置办公楼改造成公寓，为需要可负担住房的家庭提供住所。
collocations: buy a house｜买房 ; move house｜搬家 ; house prices｜房价 ; house families｜为家庭提供住所
tip_zh: 名词读/haʊs/，动词读/haʊz/；home更强调家的归属感。

meanings_zh: n. 女士；夫人
definition_en: a polite word for an adult woman
example1_en: A kind lady helped me find the station.
example1_zh: 一位好心的女士帮我找到了车站。
example2_en: An elderly lady at the meeting explained how the new bus route had improved her daily life.
example2_zh: 会上，一位年长女士讲述了新公交线路如何改善她的日常生活。
