collocations: an elderly lady｜一位年长女士 ; a young lady｜一位年轻女士 ; ladies and gentlemen｜女士们、先生们
tip_zh: woman是中性通用词；lady常用于礼貌称呼。

meanings_zh: n. 钢琴
definition_en: A large musical instrument played by pressing black and white keys.
example1_en: My sister practises the piano after dinner every evening.
example1_zh: 我姐姐每天晚饭后练钢琴。
example2_en: Learning to play the piano can help children develop concentration and express their emotions creatively.
example2_zh: 学习弹钢琴能帮助儿童培养专注力，并创造性地表达情感。
collocations: play the piano｜弹钢琴 ; piano lessons｜钢琴课 ; grand piano｜三角钢琴
tip_zh: 表示弹钢琴通常说play the piano。

meanings_zh: n. 集市；市场 | n. 市场需求；交易领域 | v. 推销；营销
definition_en: a place where people buy and sell goods | the demand for something or the business of trading particular goods | to promote and offer a product for sale
example1_en: We bought fresh peaches at the market this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上我们在集市买了新鲜桃子。
example2_en: Companies increasingly market environmentally friendly products to consumers who want to reduce their impact on the planet.
example2_zh: 企业越来越多地向希望减轻自身环境影响的消费者推销环保产品。
collocations: local market｜当地集市 ; job market｜就业市场 ; market research｜市场调查 ; market share｜市场份额
tip_zh: a market for sth指对某物的市场需求。

meanings_zh: n. 小山；丘陵
definition_en: A raised area of land, usually lower than a mountain.
example1_en: We climbed the hill and watched the sunset.
example1_zh: 我们爬上小山，看了日落。
example2_en: Building houses on steep hills can increase construction costs and expose residents to the risk of landslides.
example2_zh: 在陡峭的山坡上建房会增加建设成本，并使居民面临滑坡风险。
collocations: climb a hill｜爬山 ; rolling hills｜连绵起伏的丘陵 ; a steep hill｜陡峭的小山
tip_zh: hill通常比mountain低矮，但没有统一高度界限。

meanings_zh: adj. 迟到的；晚期的 | adv. 迟；晚 | adj. 已故的
definition_en: after the expected time or near the end of a period | after the expected time or towards a period's end | used before mentioning a person who has died
example1_en: I was late because my bicycle had a flat tyre.
example1_zh: 我迟到了，因为我的自行车轮胎没气了。
example2_en: Students who regularly stay up late may struggle to concentrate and perform well in morning classes.
example2_zh: 经常熬夜的学生在上午的课堂上可能难以集中注意力并取得良好表现。
collocations: be late for｜迟到 ; stay up late｜熬夜 ; late at night｜深夜 ; in the late stages｜在后期
tip_zh: late作副词指迟、晚；lately指最近，不能混用。

meanings_zh: n. 年龄；存在年限 | n. 时代 | v. 变老；使衰老
definition_en: The length of time someone or something has existed. | A period of history with particular features. | To become older or make someone or something seem older.
example1_en: My grandmother learned to swim at the age of seventy.
example1_zh: 我奶奶七十岁时学会了游泳。
example2_en: As populations age, governments need to invest more in accessible housing and community healthcare services.
example2_zh: 随着人口老龄化，政府需要加大对无障碍住房和社区医疗服务的投入。
collocations: at the age of｜在……岁时 ; the digital age｜数字时代 ; people of all ages｜各年龄段的人 ; age gracefully｜优雅地老去
tip_zh: 表示在几岁时用at the age of，不用in。

meanings_zh: n. 蛋糕 | v. 厚厚覆盖；结块
definition_en: A sweet food baked from flour, eggs, sugar, and fat. | To cover with a thick layer or form hard lumps.
example1_en: We shared a slice of lemon cake after lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭后，我们分着吃了一片柠檬蛋糕。
example2_en: Schools can encourage healthier eating by offering fresh fruit instead of cake at school celebrations.
example2_zh: 学校可以在校内庆祝活动中提供新鲜水果而非蛋糕，以鼓励更健康的饮食。
collocations: a slice of cake｜一片蛋糕 ; bake a cake｜烤蛋糕 ; a birthday cake｜生日蛋糕 ; be caked in mud｜沾满厚厚的泥
tip_zh: 整个蛋糕可数；泛指蛋糕这种食物时常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 照片；相片 | v. 拍摄；给……照相
definition_en: a picture made using a camera | to take a picture of someone or something using a camera
example1_en: This photograph shows my grandparents standing beside their first house.
example1_zh: 这张照片里，我的祖父母站在他们的第一所房子旁。
example2_en: Historical photographs provide valuable evidence of how urban landscapes and everyday lifestyles have changed over time.
example2_zh: 历史照片为城市景观和日常生活方式如何随时间变化提供了宝贵的证据。
collocations: take a photograph｜拍照 ; a family photograph｜全家福 ; a black-and-white photograph｜黑白照片
tip_zh: 拍照用take a photograph，不用make。

meanings_zh: n. 声音；声响 | v. 听起来；发出声音 | adj. 合理的；可靠的；完好的
definition_en: something you hear | to seem a certain way when heard, or produce noise | sensible, reliable, or in good condition
example1_en: The sound of rain woke me before sunrise.
example1_zh: 天还没亮，雨声就把我吵醒了。
example2_en: Environmental policies should be based on sound scientific evidence rather than assumptions about public behaviour.
example2_zh: 环境政策应以可靠的科学证据为基础，而非对公众行为的假设。
collocations: sound advice｜合理的建议 ; sound evidence｜可靠的证据 ; sound like｜听起来像 ; sound the alarm｜拉响警报
tip_zh: sound后接形容词；sound like后接名词。

meanings_zh: n. 国籍 | n. 民族群体
definition_en: the legal status of belonging to a particular country | a group sharing a national identity, culture, or history
example1_en: The application form asks for my nationality and address.
example1_zh: 申请表要求填写我的国籍和地址。
example2_en: Access to essential healthcare should depend on medical need rather than a person's nationality or income.
example2_zh: 获得基本医疗服务应取决于医疗需求，而非个人国籍或收入。
collocations: dual nationality｜双重国籍 ; acquire nationality｜取得国籍 ; people of different nationalities｜不同国籍的人
tip_zh: nationality指国籍，不等同于出生地或族裔。

meanings_zh: n. 尺子；直尺 | n. 统治者
definition_en: A straight tool for measuring lengths or drawing straight lines. | A person who governs a country or territory.
example1_en: Use a ruler to draw a straight line here.
example1_zh: 用尺子在这里画一条直线。
example2_en: The decisions of ancient rulers often influenced trade, architecture, and the daily lives of ordinary people.
example2_zh: 古代统治者的决策往往影响贸易、建筑以及普通人的日常生活。
collocations: a plastic ruler｜塑料尺 ; measure with a ruler｜用尺子测量 ; an absolute ruler｜专制统治者
tip_zh: a ruler可指一把尺子或一位统治者，需看语境。

meanings_zh: adj. 敞开的；营业的 | v. 打开；开办；开始营业 | adj. 坦诚的；愿意接受的
definition_en: Not closed, or available for people to enter and use. | To make something accessible or start operating a business. | Honest about your thoughts, or willing to consider new ideas.
example1_en: Leave the window open so fresh air can come in.
example1_zh: 让窗户开着，好让新鲜空气进来。
example2_en: Governments should remain open to public feedback when developing policies that affect access to essential services.
example2_zh: 政府制定影响基本服务获取的政策时，应保持开放态度，听取公众反馈。
collocations: open the door｜开门 ; open to the public｜向公众开放 ; open to suggestions｜愿意听取建议 ; keep an open mind｜保持开放心态
tip_zh: be open表示开着的状态；open作动词表示打开的动作。

meanings_zh: n. 歌手；歌唱家
definition_en: A person who sings, especially as a job.
example1_en: The singer smiled as the audience began to clap.
example1_zh: 观众开始鼓掌时，歌手露出了笑容。
example2_en: Local festivals provide young singers with valuable opportunities to perform publicly and develop confidence in their abilities.
example2_zh: 当地节庆为年轻歌手提供了宝贵的公开演出机会，帮助他们建立对自身能力的信心。
collocations: lead singer｜主唱 ; professional singer｜职业歌手 ; opera singer｜歌剧演唱家
tip_zh: sing 的过去式、过去分词分别是 sang、sung。

meanings_zh: adj. 真实的；正确的 | adj. 真正的；名副其实的 | adj. 忠实的；忠诚的
definition_en: matching the facts rather than being false or invented | having the essential qualities expected of someone or something | remaining loyal to a person, belief, or principle
example1_en: Is it TRUE that your cat can open doors?
example1_zh: 你的猫会开门，这是真的吗？
example2_en: Students must assess whether online claims are TRUE before using them as evidence in academic essays.
example2_zh: 学生在将网上的说法用作学术论文的论据之前，必须评估其是否属实。
collocations: true story｜真实的故事 ; come true｜实现 ; hold true｜成立；适用 ; true to your word｜信守诺言
tip_zh: true强调符合事实；real强调实际存在。

meanings_zh: n. 电视；电视节目 | n. 电视机 | n. 电视业
definition_en: broadcast programmes with moving pictures and sound | a device used to watch broadcast or streamed programmes | the industry that produces and broadcasts television programmes
example1_en: We watched a wildlife programme on television after dinner.
example1_zh: 晚饭后我们在电视上看了一档野生动物节目。
example2_en: Educational television can introduce children to scientific ideas that are difficult to demonstrate in classrooms.
example2_zh: 教育类电视节目可以让儿童接触难以在课堂上演示的科学概念。
collocations: watch television｜看电视 ; on television｜在电视上 ; television programme｜电视节目 ; television industry｜电视业
tip_zh: watch television不加冠词；指一台电视机用a television。

meanings_zh: n. 背部；后部 | adv. 向后；回原处 | v. 支持；资助
definition_en: The rear part of your body or of something else. | Towards the rear, or to a previous place or state. | To support a person, plan, or organization.
example1_en: My back feels stiff after sitting all morning.
example1_zh: 坐了一上午后，我感觉背部僵硬。
example2_en: Local residents are likely to back transport projects that reduce congestion and improve access to employment.
example2_zh: 当地居民很可能支持能缓解拥堵并方便就业出行的交通项目。
collocations: back pain｜背痛 ; go back｜回去 ; back a proposal｜支持提议 ; at the back of｜在…的后部
tip_zh: go back表示回去；back作动词可表示支持。

meanings_zh: adj. 灰色的；灰白的 | n. 灰色 | adj. 阴沉的；阴郁的
definition_en: having a colour between black and white | the colour between black and white | dark and cloudy, or lacking cheerfulness
example1_en: My grandfather wears a gray coat every winter.
example1_zh: 我祖父每年冬天都穿一件灰色外套。
example2_en: Replacing gray concrete surfaces with green spaces can make urban neighbourhoods more attractive and welcoming.
example2_zh: 用绿地取代灰色混凝土铺面，可以让城市社区更美观、更宜居。
collocations: gray hair｜灰白头发 ; gray skies｜阴沉的天空 ; a gray area｜灰色地带
tip_zh: gray为美式拼写，英式通常写grey。

meanings_zh: pron. 任何人 | pron. 有人；任何人
definition_en: any person, without restriction | a person, used in questions and negative statements
example1_en: Anyone can join our weekend walk by the river.
example1_zh: 任何人都可以参加我们周末的河边散步活动。
example2_en: Public libraries should provide free internet access to anyone who needs it, regardless of income.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆应向任何有需要的人免费提供互联网服务，不论其收入如何。
collocations: anyone else｜其他人 ; almost anyone｜几乎任何人 ; anyone who｜任何……的人
tip_zh: 作主语时谓语用单数；any one强调任意一个。

meanings_zh: adj. 美丽的；优美的
definition_en: Very pleasing to see, hear, or experience.
example1_en: The garden looks beautiful after the spring rain.
example1_zh: 春雨过后，花园看起来很美。
example2_en: Protecting beautiful natural landscapes can attract visitors while preserving valuable habitats for future generations.
example2_zh: 保护美丽的自然景观既能吸引游客，又能为后代保留宝贵的栖息地。
collocations: beautiful scenery｜美丽的风景 ; a beautiful voice｜优美的嗓音 ; a beautiful view｜美景
tip_zh: 可修饰景色、声音等；比较级用more beautiful。

meanings_zh: n. 牙齿 | n. 齿状部分
definition_en: a hard structure in the mouth used for biting and chewing | a pointed part of a tool, comb or wheel
example1_en: The dentist checked each tooth with a small mirror.
example1_zh: 牙医用一面小镜子检查了每颗牙齿。
example2_en: Regular dental checkups can help prevent tooth decay and reduce the need for expensive treatment.
example2_zh: 定期牙科检查有助于预防蛀牙，减少接受昂贵治疗的需要。
collocations: brush your teeth｜刷牙 ; tooth decay｜蛀牙；龋齿 ; a loose tooth｜松动的牙齿 ; wisdom tooth｜智齿
tip_zh: 复数是不规则形式teeth，注意元音也变化。

meanings_zh: v. 放松；休息 | v. 放松肌肉；松弛 | v. 放宽；放松限制
definition_en: To become calm and comfortable, or make someone feel this way. | To make muscles less tight, or become less tight. | To make rules or restrictions less strict.
example1_en: I like to relax with music after dinner.
example1_zh: 我喜欢晚饭后听音乐放松。
example2_en: Regular access to green spaces helps urban residents relax and may improve their overall mental health.
example2_zh: 经常接触绿地有助于城市居民放松，也可能改善他们的整体心理健康。
collocations: relax your muscles｜放松肌肉 ; relax restrictions｜放宽限制 ; sit back and relax｜靠着坐好并放松
tip_zh: 人感到放松用relaxed；事物令人放松用relaxing。

meanings_zh: n. 夏天；夏季
definition_en: The warmest season, between spring and autumn.
example1_en: We often eat outside during the long summer evenings.
example1_zh: 夏天傍晚很长，我们常在户外吃饭。
example2_en: Rising summer temperatures may increase demand for electricity as more households rely on air conditioning.
example2_zh: 夏季气温上升可能使更多家庭依赖空调，从而增加电力需求。
collocations: in summer｜在夏天 ; summer holidays｜暑假 ; summer heat｜夏季的炎热 ; summer camp｜夏令营
tip_zh: 泛指夏季可用in summer；季节名称通常小写。

meanings_zh: n. 组；群；团体 | v. 分组；聚集
definition_en: People or things together or connected by a shared feature. | Arrange people or things together, often according to shared features.
example1_en: A group of cyclists stopped outside the village bakery.
example1_zh: 一群骑行者在村里的面包店外停了下来。
example2_en: Teachers can group students by their learning needs to provide more effective support during classroom activities.
example2_zh: 教师可以根据学生的学习需求分组，以便在课堂活动中提供更有效的支持。
collocations: a group of｜一群；一组 ; age group｜年龄组 ; group discussion｜小组讨论 ; group work｜小组合作
tip_zh: a group of后常接复数名词；动词常用group A by B。

meanings_zh: n. 成员；会员
definition_en: a person who belongs to a group or organisation
example1_en: Each club member brought a dish to share.
example1_zh: 每位俱乐部成员都带了一道菜与大家分享。
example2_en: Every member of a community can contribute to protecting local green spaces through regular volunteer work.
example2_zh: 社区中的每一位成员都可以通过定期参与志愿服务，为保护当地绿地出力。
collocations: a member of｜……的成员 ; a team member｜团队成员 ; a family member｜家庭成员 ; a founding member｜创始成员
tip_zh: 表示某团体的成员，用a member of。

meanings_zh: n. 鱼；鱼肉 | v. 捕鱼；钓鱼
definition_en: an animal living in water with fins; its edible flesh | to try to catch fish
example1_en: We watched small fish swimming under the wooden bridge.
example1_zh: 我们看着小鱼在木桥下游动。
example2_en: Eating locally caught fish can support coastal communities, provided that fishing practices protect marine ecosystems.
example2_zh: 只要捕捞方式能保护海洋生态系统，食用本地捕获的鱼就能支持沿海社区。
collocations: fresh fish｜鲜鱼 ; go fishing｜去钓鱼 ; fish stocks｜鱼类资源量
tip_zh: 表示多条鱼通常仍用fish；鱼肉为不可数名词。

meanings_zh: n. 女儿
definition_en: Someone's female child.
example1_en: Their daughter made pancakes for the whole family.
example1_zh: 他们的女儿给全家人做了薄煎饼。
example2_en: Equal access to education ensures that daughters and sons have similar opportunities to develop their talents.
example2_zh: 平等的受教育机会确保女儿和儿子都能有相近的机会发展自身才能。
collocations: an eldest daughter｜长女 ; a teenage daughter｜十几岁的女儿 ; a mother and daughter｜一对母女
tip_zh: daughter-in-law是儿媳，不是继女。

meanings_zh: n. 绵羊
definition_en: a farm animal kept for its wool, meat or milk
example1_en: Several sheep were resting under a tree near the farm.
example1_zh: 几只绵羊正在农场附近的一棵树下休息。
example2_en: Keeping too many sheep on fragile grasslands can damage vegetation and increase the risk of soil erosion.
example2_zh: 在脆弱的草地上饲养过多绵羊会破坏植被，增加水土流失的风险。
collocations: a flock of sheep｜一群绵羊 ; raise sheep｜饲养绵羊 ; shear sheep｜给绵羊剪毛
tip_zh: sheep单复数同形；山羊是goat。

meanings_zh: n. 学校；上学 | n. 学派；流派 | n. 鱼群
definition_en: A place where children learn, or the time spent learning there. | A group sharing particular ideas, methods, or styles. | A group of fish swimming together.
example1_en: We walk to school together along the river.
example1_zh: 我们一起沿着河边步行上学。
example2_en: Every school should provide opportunities for students to develop practical skills alongside their academic knowledge.
example2_zh: 每所学校都应提供机会，让学生在学习学科知识的同时培养实践技能。
collocations: primary school｜小学 ; secondary school｜中学 ; school of thought｜学派 ; a school of fish｜一群鱼
tip_zh: go to school指上学；go to the school指去校址。

meanings_zh: adv. 总是；每次都 | adv. 一直；永远
definition_en: every time or on every occasion | throughout all time or for ever
example1_en: My neighbour always waves when she sees me.
example1_zh: 我的邻居每次看见我都会挥手。
example2_en: Higher levels of economic growth do not always lead to better living conditions for every citizen.
example2_zh: 更高水平的经济增长并不总能让每位公民的生活条件得到改善。
collocations: almost always｜几乎总是 ; not always｜并非总是 ; as always｜像往常一样
tip_zh: 通常放实义动词前、be动词后；not always是并非总是。

meanings_zh: adv. 通常；一般地
definition_en: On most occasions, but not always.
example1_en: I usually walk to work unless it rains.
example1_zh: 除非下雨，我通常步行上班。
example2_en: People usually find it easier to maintain healthy habits when their friends and family offer support.
example2_zh: 有朋友和家人的支持，人们通常更容易保持健康的习惯。
collocations: usually go｜通常去 ; usually available｜通常可获得的 ; as usually happens｜正如通常发生的那样
tip_zh: 通常放在实义动词前、be动词后。

meanings_zh: n. 历史；历史学 | n. 经历；既往记录
definition_en: Past events, or the study of them. | A record of someone's or something's past experiences or conditions.
example1_en: Our guide explained the history of the old castle.
example1_zh: 导游讲述了这座古堡的历史。
example2_en: Studying history helps citizens understand how past decisions continue to shape modern societies and institutions.
example2_zh: 学习历史有助于公民理解过去的决策如何持续塑造现代社会及其制度。
collocations: ancient history｜古代史 ; medical history｜病史 ; a history of｜有……的历史 ; throughout history｜纵观历史
tip_zh: historical指与历史有关；historic指有历史意义。

meanings_zh: n. 星期五
definition_en: the day after Thursday and before Saturday
example1_en: We usually cook dinner together at home on Friday.
example1_zh: 我们通常星期五在家一起做晚饭。
example2_en: Allowing employees to work from home on Friday may reduce commuting pressure and improve job satisfaction.
example2_zh: 允许员工星期五居家办公，可能减轻通勤压力并提高工作满意度。
collocations: on Friday｜在星期五 ; Friday evening｜星期五晚上 ; every Friday｜每周五
tip_zh: 首字母大写；on Friday，但 next Friday 前不加 on。

meanings_zh: n. 脚（foot的复数） | n. 英尺（foot的复数）
definition_en: the body parts at the ends of the legs | units of length, each equal to twelve inches
example1_en: My feet felt cold against the kitchen tiles.
example1_zh: 我的脚踩在厨房瓷砖上，感觉冰凉。
example2_en: Designing comfortable footwear can protect the feet of workers who spend most of their day standing.
example2_zh: 设计舒适的鞋子可以保护那些一天中大部分时间都站着工作的人的双脚。
collocations: bare feet｜赤脚 ; on your feet｜站着 ; six feet tall｜六英尺高 ; get to your feet｜站起来
tip_zh: foot的复数是feet；作前置修饰语用单数，如six-foot。

meanings_zh: v. 洗；清洗 | v. 冲走；冲刷 | n. 洗涤；清洗
definition_en: To clean something using water, often with soap. | To carry or move something through flowing water. | An act of cleaning with water.
example1_en: Please wash your hands before you help prepare dinner.
example1_zh: 帮忙准备晚餐前，请先洗手。
example2_en: Schools should teach children to wash their hands properly to reduce the spread of infectious diseases.
example2_zh: 学校应教孩子正确洗手，以减少传染病的传播。
collocations: wash your hands｜洗手 ; wash the dishes｜洗碗 ; wash away｜冲走 ; give something a wash｜把某物洗一洗
tip_zh: wash强调用水洗；clean泛指清洁，不一定用水。

meanings_zh: n. 沙发
definition_en: A soft seat with a back for several people
example1_en: We curled up on the sofa after dinner.
example1_zh: 晚饭后，我们蜷坐在沙发上。
example2_en: A comfortable sofa in a shared lounge can encourage residents to spend more time together.
example2_zh: 公共休息室里一张舒适的沙发可以鼓励住户多聚在一起。
collocations: sit on the sofa｜坐在沙发上 ; sofa bed｜沙发床 ; leather sofa｜皮沙发
tip_zh: 坐在沙发上用on the sofa，不用in。

meanings_zh: adj. 有趣的；引人关注的
definition_en: Making you want to pay attention or learn more.
example1_en: We found an interesting little museum near the station.
example1_zh: 我们在车站附近发现了一家有趣的小博物馆。
example2_en: The survey revealed an interesting connection between access to green spaces and residents' overall satisfaction with urban life.
example2_zh: 这项调查揭示了绿地可达性与居民对城市生活的总体满意度之间一种值得关注的联系。
collocations: an interesting question｜有趣的问题 ; an interesting finding｜值得关注的发现 ; find something interesting｜觉得某事有趣
tip_zh: interesting形容事物引人兴趣，不等于funny好笑。

meanings_zh: n. 大米；米饭；稻
definition_en: A cereal plant whose grains are cooked and eaten.
example1_en: We had rice with steamed fish for dinner.
example1_zh: 我们晚餐吃了米饭和清蒸鱼。
example2_en: Improved irrigation methods can help farmers grow rice while using less water in regions affected by drought.
example2_zh: 改进灌溉方式可帮助受干旱影响地区的农民在减少用水的同时种植水稻。
collocations: a bowl of rice｜一碗米饭 ; brown rice｜糙米 ; grow rice｜种水稻 ; rice field｜稻田
tip_zh: rice通常不可数；一粒米用a grain of rice。

meanings_zh: n. 地区；区域 | n. 面积 | n. 领域；方面
definition_en: A particular part of a place or geographical region | The amount of surface that something covers | A particular subject or part of an activity
example1_en: There is a quiet picnic area beside the lake.
example1_zh: 湖边有一处安静的野餐区。
example2_en: Investment in public transport can improve access to employment for people living in rural areas.
example2_zh: 投资公共交通可以让农村居民更容易获得就业机会。
collocations: a residential area｜住宅区 ; surface area｜表面积 ; an area of research｜研究领域 ; rural areas｜农村地区
tip_zh: 表示面积时常用平方米等单位；也可指研究领域。

meanings_zh: adj. 干净的；清洁的 | v. 打扫；清洗 | adj. 清洁无污染的
definition_en: Free from dirt, marks, or unwanted substances. | To remove dirt or unwanted substances from something. | Producing little or no pollution.
example1_en: There are clean towels on the shelf beside you.
example1_zh: 你旁边的架子上有干净的毛巾。
example2_en: Investing in clean energy can reduce air pollution while creating new employment opportunities in developing industries.
example2_zh: 投资清洁能源可以减少空气污染，同时在新兴产业中创造就业机会。
collocations: keep clean｜保持干净 ; clean water｜清洁的水 ; clean energy｜清洁能源 ; clean the kitchen｜打扫厨房
tip_zh: clean是干净；clear是清澈或清楚，不能随意互换。

meanings_zh: n. 商业；生意 | n. 企业；商店 | n. 事务；职责
definition_en: The activity of buying and selling goods or services. | An organisation that sells goods or services. | Matters that someone needs to deal with or is responsible for.
example1_en: Business is usually slow at the café on Mondays.
example1_zh: 这家咖啡馆周一的生意通常比较清淡。
example2_en: Small businesses often create local employment, but they may struggle to compete with larger companies.
example2_zh: 小企业通常能为当地创造就业机会，但可能难以与大公司竞争。
collocations: do business with｜与……做生意 ; run a business｜经营企业 ; on business｜出差 ; none of your business｜与你无关
tip_zh: 指商业活动时不可数；指具体企业时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 步行；散步
definition_en: Moving on foot, especially for exercise or pleasure.
example1_en: Walking to the shops takes about ten minutes.
example1_zh: 步行去商店大约需要十分钟。
example2_en: Cities can encourage walking by improving pavement quality and creating safer crossings near schools and shopping areas.
example2_zh: 城市可以通过改善人行道质量，并在学校和购物区附近设置更安全的过街设施，鼓励步行。
collocations: go walking｜去散步 ; walking boots｜徒步靴 ; walking distance｜步行可达的距离 ; brisk walking｜快步走
tip_zh: walking中的l不发音；步行去某地也可用on foot。

meanings_zh: n. 名字；名称 | v. 命名；说出名称 | n. 名声；声誉
definition_en: a word or words used to identify someone or something | to give a name or say what someone is called | the reputation someone or something has
example1_en: What name did you choose for your new kitten?
example1_zh: 你给新来的小猫取了什么名字？
example2_en: Companies often choose a memorable name to distinguish their products in an increasingly competitive market.
example2_zh: 企业往往选择容易记住的名称，以便在竞争日益激烈的市场中突出自己的产品。
collocations: full name｜全名 ; brand name｜品牌名称 ; name after｜以……的名字命名 ; make a name for yourself｜成名
tip_zh: 英式name A after B表示以B的名字命名A。

meanings_zh: n. 机场
definition_en: A place where planes take off, land, and collect passengers
example1_en: We arrived at the airport before the sun rose.
example1_zh: 太阳还没升起，我们就到了机场。
example2_en: Expanding an airport may boost tourism, but it can also increase noise pollution for nearby residents.
example2_zh: 扩建机场可能促进旅游业，但也可能加重附近居民受到的噪声污染。
collocations: international airport｜国际机场 ; airport terminal｜机场航站楼 ; airport shuttle｜机场接驳车 ; airport security｜机场安检
tip_zh: 在机场通常用at the airport；航站楼是terminal。

meanings_zh: adv. 经常；常常
definition_en: many times or on many occasions
example1_en: We often walk by the river after dinner.
example1_zh: 我们经常在晚饭后沿河散步。
example2_en: People who exercise regularly often report better sleep and higher energy levels throughout the day.
example2_zh: 经常锻炼的人往往表示，他们睡得更好，白天也更有精力。
collocations: quite often｜相当频繁 ; more often｜更经常 ; how often｜多久一次 ; as often as possible｜尽可能经常
tip_zh: 通常放实义动词前、be动词后；t也可发音。

meanings_zh: n. 美元；元（货币单位）
definition_en: A currency unit used in the US and several other countries.
example1_en: I paid one dollar for this small notebook.
example1_zh: 我花了一美元买这本小笔记本。
example2_en: A stronger dollar can make imported goods cheaper for American consumers while increasing costs for overseas buyers.
example2_zh: 美元走强可使美国消费者购买进口商品更便宜，同时增加海外买家的成本。
collocations: US dollar｜美元 ; Australian dollar｜澳大利亚元 ; a strong dollar｜强势美元 ; the dollar exchange rate｜美元汇率
tip_zh: 不只指美元，也用于加拿大元、澳大利亚元等。

meanings_zh: pron. 它；这；那 | pron. 作形式主语或宾语
definition_en: refers to a thing, animal, or situation already mentioned | used as a grammatical subject or object without naming anything
example1_en: I found your scarf and put it by the door.
example1_zh: 我找到了你的围巾，把它放在门边了。
example2_en: It is essential for cities to provide reliable public transport if they want to reduce traffic congestion.
example2_zh: 城市若想缓解交通拥堵，就必须提供可靠的公共交通。
collocations: it depends｜视情况而定 ; it seems that｜似乎 ; make it clear｜说清楚
tip_zh: 小写it是代词；大写IT才表示信息技术。

meanings_zh: n. 婴儿；幼崽 | adj. 幼小的；婴儿用的 | v. 娇惯；把…当婴儿对待
definition_en: a very young child or animal | very young, or intended for babies | treat someone as helpless or needing excessive care
example1_en: The baby fell asleep while her father sang softly.
example1_zh: 爸爸轻声唱歌时，宝宝睡着了。
example2_en: Affordable childcare helps parents of young babies return to work without placing excessive pressure on family finances.
example2_zh: 负担得起的托育服务有助于婴儿的父母重返工作岗位，而不会给家庭财务带来过大压力。
collocations: newborn baby｜新生儿 ; have a baby｜生孩子 ; baby food｜婴儿食品 ; baby clothes｜婴儿服装
tip_zh: 复数为babies；baby作动词常含“过度照顾”之意。

meanings_zh: n. 兔；家兔
definition_en: a small animal with long ears, soft fur, and strong back legs
example1_en: A white rabbit hopped across the grass towards us.
example1_zh: 一只白兔蹦蹦跳跳地穿过草地，朝我们跑来。
example2_en: Introducing rabbits into new environments can damage native vegetation and disrupt the balance of local ecosystems.
example2_zh: 将兔子引入新环境可能破坏原生植被，扰乱当地生态系统的平衡。
collocations: pet rabbit｜宠物兔 ; wild rabbit｜野兔 ; rabbit hole｜兔洞
tip_zh: rabbit泛指兔；hare通常指腿耳更长的野兔。

meanings_zh: n. 水 | v. 给……浇水
definition_en: The clear liquid people drink and plants need to grow. | To give water to plants or soil.
example1_en: Please water the plants before we leave today.
example1_zh: 今天出门前请给植物浇水。
example2_en: Access to clean drinking water is essential for preventing disease and improving public health.
example2_zh: 获得清洁的饮用水对预防疾病和改善公共健康至关重要。
collocations: drinking water｜饮用水 ; running water｜自来水；流动的水 ; water shortage｜缺水 ; water the garden｜给花园浇水
tip_zh: 表示水通常不可数：a glass of water是一杯水。

meanings_zh: n. 一半；半场 | det. 一半的 | adv. 半；部分地
definition_en: one of two equal parts of something | equal to one of two equal parts of something | to an extent that is not complete
example1_en: I saved half of my sandwich for later.
example1_zh: 我留了一半三明治，准备晚点吃。
example2_en: Nearly half of the residents surveyed supported creating more green spaces in the city centre.
example2_zh: 受访居民中近一半支持在市中心增设绿地。
collocations: half an hour｜半小时 ; half of｜……的一半 ; half price｜半价 ; half asleep｜半睡半醒
tip_zh: 复数为halves；“半小时”用half an hour。

meanings_zh: n. 刀；餐刀
definition_en: a tool with a handle and blade used for cutting
example1_en: Use a sharp knife to slice the bread.
example1_zh: 用一把锋利的刀把面包切成片。
example2_en: Learning to use a kitchen knife safely is an important part of practical food education.
example2_zh: 学习安全使用菜刀是实用饮食教育的重要组成部分。
collocations: kitchen knife｜菜刀 ; sharp knife｜锋利的刀 ; bread knife｜面包刀 ; knife and fork｜刀叉
tip_zh: k不发音；复数把-fe变为-ves：knives。

meanings_zh: int. 谢谢 | n. 感谢；谢意
definition_en: used to tell someone you are grateful | words or actions expressing gratitude
example1_en: Thanks for helping me carry these heavy bags upstairs.
example1_zh: 谢谢你帮我把这些沉重的袋子搬上楼。
example2_en: Public expressions of thanks can help volunteers feel valued and encourage continued participation in community projects.
example2_zh: 公开表达感谢能让志愿者感到受重视，并鼓励他们持续参与社区项目。
collocations: thanks for your help｜谢谢你的帮助 ; many thanks｜非常感谢 ; express thanks｜表达谢意 ; thanks to｜多亏；由于
tip_zh: thanks for后接名词或动名词；thanks to表示多亏。

meanings_zh: adj. 危险的
definition_en: Likely to cause harm, injury, or serious problems.
example1_en: That broken step is dangerous, so please avoid it.
example1_zh: 那级破损的台阶很危险，请避开它。
example2_en: Poorly maintained roads can create dangerous conditions for cyclists, especially during heavy rain or after dark.
example2_zh: 维护不善的道路会给骑行者带来危险，尤其是在大雨中或天黑后。
collocations: dangerous conditions｜危险状况 ; highly dangerous｜非常危险 ; dangerous driving｜危险驾驶
tip_zh: dangerous是形容词；修饰动作要用dangerously。

meanings_zh: n. 消息；口信 | n. 主旨；寓意 | v. 给……发消息
definition_en: Information sent or left for someone to read or hear. | The main idea that a story, speech, or artwork communicates. | To send someone an electronic communication.
example1_en: Please leave a message if I miss your call.
example1_zh: 如果我没接到你的电话，请留言。
example2_en: Public health campaigns need a clear message that people from different backgrounds can easily understand.
example2_zh: 公共卫生宣传需要传达清晰的信息，让不同背景的人都能轻松理解。
collocations: leave a message｜留言 ; send a message｜发送消息 ; get the message across｜把意思传达清楚 ; text message｜短信
tip_zh: message是可数名词；information通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 海；海洋 | n. 大量；一大片
definition_en: the large area of salt water covering much of Earth | a large mass of similar things seen together
example1_en: The children watched small boats sailing across the sea.
example1_zh: 孩子们看着小船在海上航行。
example2_en: Plastic waste entering the sea threatens marine wildlife and can eventually affect human food supplies.
example2_zh: 进入海洋的塑料垃圾威胁海洋野生生物，并可能最终影响人类的食物供应。
collocations: by the sea｜在海边 ; at sea｜在海上 ; sea level｜海平面 ; a sea of faces｜人头攒动
tip_zh: at sea指在海上；by the sea指在海边。

meanings_zh: n. 面包
definition_en: a food made from flour and water, usually baked
example1_en: Fresh bread was cooling beside the kitchen window.
example1_zh: 刚出炉的面包放在厨房窗边晾凉。
example2_en: Choosing wholegrain bread instead of refined varieties can increase fibre intake and support a balanced diet.
example2_zh: 选择全谷物面包而非精制面包，可以增加膳食纤维摄入，有助于均衡饮食。
collocations: a loaf of bread｜一条面包 ; a slice of bread｜一片面包 ; wholemeal bread｜全麦面包 ; bake bread｜烤面包
tip_zh: bread通常不可数；一片用a slice of bread。

meanings_zh: prep. 在……之间 | prep. 涉及双方或多方；由…共享 | adv. 在中间；在其间
definition_en: In the space or period separating people, things, or events. | Connecting distinct people or groups, or shared by them. | In the space or interval separating things.
example1_en: The cat squeezed between the sofa and the wall.
example1_zh: 猫从沙发和墙之间挤了过去。
example2_en: Cooperation between schools and local businesses can help students develop practical skills before entering employment.
example2_zh: 学校与当地企业的合作可以帮助学生在就业前培养实用技能。
collocations: between meals｜两餐之间 ; a link between｜……之间的联系 ; choose between｜在……之间选择 ; between them｜由他们共同；在他们之间
tip_zh: between不只限于两者，也可用于多个明确对象之间。

meanings_zh: adv. 远；遥远地 | adv. 很；大大地 | adj. 远处的；较远的
definition_en: At, to, or over a great distance. | To a much greater degree. | More distant from you or a particular point.
example1_en: We walked so far that our feet began to ache.
example1_zh: 我们走了很远，走得脚都开始疼了。
example2_en: Reliable public transport can make commuting far more affordable for people who live outside major city centres.
example2_zh: 可靠的公共交通可以让住在大城市中心以外的人通勤时省下很多钱。
collocations: far away｜遥远 ; far from｜远离；远非 ; far more｜多得多 ; so far｜到目前为止
tip_zh: far可修饰比较级，如far better；不用far good。

meanings_zh: num. 十八
definition_en: The number after seventeen and before nineteen.
example1_en: We baked eighteen muffins for the picnic this morning.
example1_zh: 我们今天早上为野餐烤了十八个松饼。
example2_en: In many countries, citizens gain the right to vote when they reach the age of eighteen.
example2_zh: 在许多国家，公民年满十八岁便获得投票权。
collocations: eighteen years old｜十八岁 ; at eighteen｜在十八岁时 ; under eighteen｜未满十八岁
tip_zh: eighteen是十八，eighty是八十；注意词尾发音。

meanings_zh: n. 时间；时刻 | n. 次；回 | v. 计时；安排时机
definition_en: what clocks measure, or a particular point in its passage | an occasion when something happens | to measure duration or choose when something should happen
example1_en: We still have time for a walk before dinner.
example1_zh: 晚饭前我们还有时间散步。
example2_en: Schools should give students enough time to explore creative activities alongside their preparation for formal examinations.
example2_zh: 学校应在学生准备正式考试的同时，给予他们足够的时间探索创意活动。
collocations: spend time doing something｜花时间做某事 ; on time｜准时 ; in time｜及时 ; time management｜时间管理
tip_zh: 时间通常不可数；表示次数时可数，如three times。

meanings_zh: n. 公司 | n. 陪伴；作伴
definition_en: An organisation that sells goods or services | The presence of another person or people with you
example1_en: My sister works for a company that makes bicycles.
example1_zh: 我姐姐在一家制造自行车的公司工作。
example2_en: A company that invests in staff training is more likely to retain skilled employees over time.
example2_zh: 一家愿意投入员工培训的公司，更有可能长期留住技术熟练的员工。
collocations: work for a company｜在一家公司工作 ; set up a company｜创办公司 ; keep someone company｜陪伴某人 ; enjoy someone's company｜喜欢与某人相处
tip_zh: 表“公司”可数；表“陪伴”不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 浴室；卫生间 | n. 洗手间；厕所
definition_en: A room with a bath or shower, often including a toilet. | A room containing a toilet, especially in American English.
example1_en: She hung a clean towel beside the bathroom sink.
example1_zh: 她在浴室洗手池旁挂了一条干净毛巾。
example2_en: Installing water-saving fixtures in the bathroom can help households reduce consumption without changing their daily routines.
example2_zh: 在浴室安装节水设备，可以帮助家庭在不改变日常习惯的情况下减少用水。
collocations: private bathroom｜独立卫浴 ; shared bathroom｜共用浴室 ; bathroom sink｜浴室洗手池 ; go to the bathroom｜上厕所
tip_zh: 美式英语中bathroom也可指没有浴缸的厕所。

meanings_zh: v. 跳舞 | n. 舞蹈；舞会
definition_en: to move your body rhythmically, usually to music | rhythmic movement to music, or an event for dancing
example1_en: We danced in the kitchen while dinner was cooking.
example1_zh: 晚饭还在做的时候，我们在厨房里跳起了舞。
example2_en: Traditional dance can strengthen community identity while offering younger generations a connection to their cultural heritage.
example2_zh: 传统舞蹈能够增强社区认同感，同时让年轻一代与自身文化遗产建立联系。
collocations: dance to music｜随着音乐跳舞 ; traditional dance｜传统舞蹈 ; dance class｜舞蹈课 ; go dancing｜去跳舞
tip_zh: 随音乐跳舞用dance to music，介词用to。

meanings_zh: adj. 最喜欢的 | n. 最喜爱的人或物 | n. 夺冠热门
definition_en: Liked or preferred more than others | A person or thing someone likes best | A competitor considered most likely to win
example1_en: This blue sweater is my favorite winter item.
example1_zh: 这件蓝色毛衣是我冬天最喜欢的一件衣服。
example2_en: Surveys of children's favorite leisure activities can help local authorities design more appealing public recreation spaces.
example2_zh: 调查儿童最喜欢的休闲活动，有助于地方政府设计更有吸引力的公共休闲空间。
collocations: a favorite pastime｜最喜爱的消遣 ; a firm favorite｜一直备受喜爱的人或物 ; the clear favorite to win｜明显的夺冠热门
tip_zh: favorite是美式拼写，英式为favourite；通常不用most修饰。

meanings_zh: n. 茶；茶水 | n. 茶叶 | n. 茶点；晚餐
definition_en: a drink made by putting tea leaves in hot water | dried leaves used to make tea | a light afternoon meal or, in Britain, an early evening meal
example1_en: I made a pot of tea while you rested.
example1_zh: 你休息的时候，我泡了一壶茶。
example2_en: In many cultures, sharing tea provides an opportunity for conversation and strengthens relationships between generations.
example2_zh: 在许多文化中，一起喝茶为交谈提供了机会，也增进了代际关系。
collocations: a cup of tea｜一杯茶 ; make tea｜泡茶 ; tea leaves｜茶叶 ; afternoon tea｜下午茶
tip_zh: 茶水通常不可数；点单时two teas指两杯茶。

meanings_zh: v. 改变；更换；兑换 | n. 变化；改变 | n. 零钱；找零
definition_en: to become different, replace something, or exchange money | an instance or process of becoming different | coins, or money returned when you pay more than the price
example1_en: We changed our plans when the rain started falling.
example1_zh: 开始下雨时，我们改变了计划。
example2_en: Governments should change transport policies to encourage cycling and reduce dependence on private cars in cities.
example2_zh: 政府应调整交通政策，鼓励骑行并减少城市居民对私家车的依赖。
collocations: change your mind｜改变主意 ; climate change｜气候变化 ; social change｜社会变革 ; small change｜零钱
tip_zh: 表示“零钱、找零”时不可数，不能说a change。

meanings_zh: n. 澳大利亚
definition_en: a country occupying a continent between the Indian and Pacific Oceans
example1_en: My cousin moved to Australia to study marine biology.
example1_zh: 我的表亲搬到澳大利亚学习海洋生物学。
example2_en: Australia attracts international students through its universities, diverse cities, and opportunities to study in English.
example2_zh: 澳大利亚凭借其大学、多元化城市以及英语授课的学习机会吸引国际学生。
collocations: travel to Australia｜去澳大利亚旅行 ; study in Australia｜在澳大利亚留学 ; mainland Australia｜澳大利亚大陆
tip_zh: Australia指澳大利亚；Austria才是奥地利。

meanings_zh: adj. 准备好的；可用的 | adj. 愿意的 | adj. 即将做某事的
definition_en: Prepared or available for use or action. | Willing to do something. | About to do something very soon.
example1_en: Dinner is ready, so please bring your plate.
example1_zh: 晚饭好了，请把你的盘子拿来。
example2_en: Schools must ensure that students are ready to meet the demands of a rapidly changing workplace.
example2_zh: 学校必须确保学生做好准备，以应对快速变化的职场需求。
collocations: ready for｜为……做好准备 ; ready to use｜可直接使用 ; get ready｜做好准备 ; ready and willing｜乐意且准备好
tip_zh: ready for后接名词；ready to后接动词原形。

meanings_zh: n. 主意；想法 | n. 概念；观念 | n. 了解；印象
definition_en: A thought or suggestion about what to do. | A mental understanding or belief about something. | Some knowledge or understanding of a situation.
example1_en: Your idea of growing herbs on the balcony sounds lovely.
example1_zh: 你在阳台上种香草的主意听起来很棒。
example2_en: The idea of free public transport attracts support, but its financial implications require careful consideration.
example2_zh: 免费公共交通这一想法获得了支持，但其财政影响需要慎重考虑。
collocations: come up with an idea｜想出一个主意 ; a good idea｜好主意 ; have no idea｜完全不知道 ; a rough idea｜大致了解
tip_zh: idea是可数名词；“不知道”可说have no idea。

meanings_zh: v. 画；绘制 | v. 拉；拖 | v. 吸引；引起
definition_en: Make a picture using a pencil, pen, or similar tool. | Move something by pulling it in a particular direction. | Attract people, interest, or attention to something.
example1_en: She drew a sleeping cat in her sketchbook.
example1_zh: 她在素描本上画了一只熟睡的猫。
example2_en: Free cultural events can draw more visitors to museums and encourage wider participation in the arts.
example2_zh: 免费文化活动可以吸引更多人参观博物馆，并鼓励公众更广泛地参与艺术活动。
collocations: draw a picture｜画画 ; draw attention to｜使人关注 ; draw a conclusion｜得出结论 ; draw the curtains｜拉窗帘
tip_zh: 过去式drew，过去分词drawn；另可指平局。

meanings_zh: adv. 向下；在下面 | prep. 沿着；向下 | adj. 情绪低落的
definition_en: Towards or in a lower place or position. | Along something, or from a higher to a lower point. | Feeling unhappy or discouraged.
example1_en: The cat jumped down from the kitchen table.
example1_zh: 猫从厨房的桌子上跳了下来。
example2_en: As housing costs go up, the amount young adults can save often goes down.
example2_zh: 随着住房成本上涨，年轻人能存下的钱往往会减少。
collocations: sit down｜坐下 ; go down｜下降 ; down the street｜沿着街道 ; feel down｜情绪低落
tip_zh: down后接名词可作介词；feel down表示心情低落。

meanings_zh: n. 机器；机械装置 | v. 用机器加工
definition_en: A device with moving parts that performs a particular job. | To shape or finish material using a machine.
example1_en: The washing machine shook loudly during its final spin.
example1_zh: 洗衣机在最后脱水时剧烈晃动，声音很大。
example2_en: A modern machine can perform repetitive tasks efficiently, allowing workers to focus on more complex problems.
example2_zh: 现代机器能高效完成重复性任务，让工人专注于更复杂的问题。
collocations: washing machine｜洗衣机 ; operate a machine｜操作机器 ; machine learning｜机器学习 ; machine parts｜机器零件
tip_zh: machine是可数名词；machinery是不可数集合名词。

meanings_zh: v. 获得；收到 | v. 变得 | v. 到达
definition_en: To obtain or receive something. | To become a particular way. | To arrive at a place.
example1_en: I got a warm scarf for my birthday.
example1_zh: 我生日时收到了一条暖和的围巾。
example2_en: Students from low-income families may struggle to get the financial support they need to complete university courses.
example2_zh: 低收入家庭的学生可能难以获得完成大学课程所需的经济支持。
collocations: get a job｜找到工作 ; get better｜好转 ; get to school｜到达学校 ; get permission｜获得许可
tip_zh: 过去式got；美式过去分词也用gotten。

meanings_zh: conj. 但是；而是 | prep. 除……以外
definition_en: Used to connect contrasting ideas or correct an earlier statement. | Except for someone or something.
example1_en: The bag looks small, but it holds everything I need.
example1_zh: 这个包看起来小，却装得下我需要的所有东西。
example2_en: Public transport can reduce traffic congestion, but services must be reliable enough to attract regular users.
example2_zh: 公共交通能缓解交通拥堵，但服务必须足够可靠，才能吸引经常乘坐的乘客。
collocations: not only ... but also ...｜不仅……而且…… ; not ... but ...｜不是……而是…… ; anything but｜绝非 ; nothing but｜只有；仅仅
tip_zh: although与but通常不在同一句中成对使用。

meanings_zh: adj. 红色的 | n. 红色
definition_en: having the colour of ripe tomatoes | the colour of ripe tomatoes
example1_en: She wore a red coat to the winter market.
example1_zh: 她穿着一件红色外套去了冬季集市。
example2_en: Designers often use red to draw attention to important warnings on machinery and in public spaces.
example2_zh: 设计师常用红色来突出机器上及公共场所中的重要警示。
collocations: bright red｜鲜红色 ; turn red｜变红；脸红 ; in the red｜负债；亏损
tip_zh: in the red表示负债或亏损，不是字面上的红色。

meanings_zh: n. 交谈；谈话
definition_en: A talk in which people exchange ideas, feelings, or information.
example1_en: We had a friendly conversation while waiting for the bus.
example1_zh: 等公交车时，我们友好地聊了一会儿。
example2_en: Regular conversation with fluent speakers helps language learners develop confidence and improve their listening skills.
example2_zh: 经常与语言流利的人交谈有助于语言学习者建立信心并提高听力。
collocations: have a conversation｜交谈 ; start a conversation｜开始交谈 ; a conversation about｜关于……的谈话
tip_zh: 与某人谈某事：have a conversation with某人about某事。

meanings_zh: n. 正餐；晚餐 | n. 正式宴会
definition_en: The main meal of the day, usually eaten in the evening. | A formal social occasion at which people eat a meal.
example1_en: Dinner is ready, so please bring the plates.
example1_zh: 晚饭做好了，请把盘子拿来。
example2_en: Sharing dinner regularly can strengthen family relationships by giving everyone an opportunity to discuss their daily experiences.
example2_zh: 经常共进晚餐能让每个人有机会交流日常经历，从而增进家庭关系。
collocations: have dinner｜吃正餐 ; cook dinner｜做晚饭 ; a formal dinner｜正式宴会
tip_zh: 日常说 have dinner，不加冠词；正式宴会可说 a dinner。

meanings_zh: v. 带来；拿来 | v. 引起；带来
definition_en: to carry someone or something to a place | to cause a situation, feeling, or result
example1_en: Please bring a warm coat when you visit.
example1_zh: 你来时请带一件暖和的外套。
example2_en: Improved public transport can bring significant benefits to residents who cannot afford their own cars.
example2_zh: 改善公共交通能为买不起私家车的居民带来显著益处。
collocations: bring someone something｜给某人带来某物 ; bring about change｜促成改变 ; bring good luck｜带来好运
tip_zh: bring强调带到说话者或指定地点；过去式brought。

meanings_zh: n. 原因；理由 | n. 理性；推理能力 | v. 推理；推断
definition_en: Something that explains why something happens or someone acts. | The ability to think logically and make sensible judgments. | To think logically in order to reach a conclusion.
example1_en: The heavy rain was the reason we stayed home.
example1_zh: 大雨是我们待在家里的原因。
example2_en: One reason for rising urban rents is that housing supply has failed to keep pace with population growth.
example2_zh: 城市租金上涨的一个原因是住房供应未能跟上人口增长。
collocations: reason for｜……的原因 ; a valid reason｜充分的理由 ; reason with someone｜和某人讲道理 ; within reason｜在合理范围内
tip_zh: 常用reason for加名词，或reason why加从句。

meanings_zh: n. 亚洲
definition_en: The world's largest continent, lying mainly east of Europe.
example1_en: My cousin spent three months travelling around Asia.
example1_zh: 我表亲花了三个月在亚洲各地旅行。
example2_en: Rapid urban growth in Asia has increased the need for affordable housing and reliable public transport.
example2_zh: 亚洲城市的快速发展增加了对可负担住房和可靠公共交通的需求。
collocations: East Asia｜东亚 ; Southeast Asia｜东南亚 ; Central Asia｜中亚 ; across Asia｜遍及亚洲
tip_zh: 洲名首字母大写，通常不加the；形容词为Asian。

meanings_zh: n. 颜色；色彩 | v. 给……涂色；染色
definition_en: The appearance of something as red, blue, green, and so on. | To give something a colour using pencils, paint, or dye.
example1_en: What colour should we paint the kitchen walls?
example1_zh: 我们该把厨房的墙刷成什么颜色？
example2_en: The colour of classroom walls may influence students' moods and their ability to concentrate.
example2_zh: 教室墙壁的颜色可能影响学生的情绪和专注能力。
collocations: bright colours｜鲜艳的颜色 ; colour scheme｜配色方案 ; colour in a picture｜给图画涂色 ; change colour｜变色
tip_zh: 英式拼写为colour，美式为color。

meanings_zh: n. 眼睛 | n. 眼光；鉴赏力 | v. 注视；打量
definition_en: one of the two body parts used for seeing | an ability to notice or judge particular qualities | to look at someone or something with particular interest
example1_en: She closed her eyes and listened to the rain.
example1_zh: 她闭上眼睛，听着雨声。
example2_en: Designers need an eye for detail to create public spaces that are both attractive and accessible.
example2_zh: 设计师需要善于观察细节，才能打造既美观又便于所有人使用的公共空间。
collocations: eye contact｜目光接触 ; keep an eye on｜留意；照看 ; an eye for detail｜对细节的敏锐观察力 ; catch someone's eye｜引起某人的注意
tip_zh: an eye for表示鉴赏力；keep an eye on表示照看。

meanings_zh: n. 下午
definition_en: The time between midday and evening.
example1_en: We spent the afternoon baking bread in the kitchen.
example1_zh: 我们整个下午都在厨房里烤面包。
example2_en: Schools could offer afternoon sports sessions to help students develop healthier habits and stronger friendships.
example2_zh: 学校可以在下午安排体育活动，帮助学生养成更健康的习惯并增进友谊。
collocations: in the afternoon｜在下午 ; this afternoon｜今天下午 ; late afternoon｜下午较晚的时候
tip_zh: 泛指下午用in；具体某天下午用on。

meanings_zh: n. T恤衫
definition_en: A casual shirt, usually with short sleeves and no collar.
example1_en: I packed a clean T-shirt for the picnic.
example1_zh: 我为野餐带了一件干净的T恤衫。
example2_en: Choosing a durable cotton T-shirt instead of disposable fashion can reduce waste and encourage more responsible consumption.
example2_zh: 选择耐穿的棉质T恤衫而非一次性时尚服饰，可以减少浪费并促进更负责任的消费。
collocations: cotton T-shirt｜棉质T恤衫 ; plain T-shirt｜纯色T恤衫 ; wear a T-shirt｜穿T恤衫
tip_zh: 可数名词，复数为 T-shirts，保留连字符。

meanings_zh: n. 结束；末尾；尽头 | v. 结束；终止 | n. 目的；目标
definition_en: the final part or furthest point of something | to stop, or cause something to stop | a purpose that someone wants to achieve
example1_en: There's a small bakery at the end of our street.
example1_zh: 我们这条街的尽头有一家小面包店。
example2_en: Governments should aim to end extreme poverty by improving access to education and secure employment.
example2_zh: 政府应通过改善教育机会和稳定就业的可及性，努力消除极端贫困。
collocations: at the end of｜在……末尾 ; come to an end｜结束 ; put an end to｜终止 ; a means to an end｜达到目的的手段
tip_zh: at the end指末尾；in the end指最终。

meanings_zh: adj. 美味的；可口的
definition_en: Having a very pleasant taste.
example1_en: This delicious vegetable pie is still warm from the oven.
example1_zh: 这份美味的蔬菜派刚出炉，还热乎着。
example2_en: School meals should be both nutritious and delicious to encourage children to develop healthier eating habits.
example2_zh: 学校餐食应兼顾营养与美味，以鼓励儿童养成更健康的饮食习惯。
collocations: delicious meal｜美味的一餐 ; delicious food｜美味的食物 ; absolutely delicious｜美味极了
tip_zh: delicious本身语气较强，常用absolutely加强。

meanings_zh: v. 装满；充满 | v. 填补；满足
definition_en: Make or become full | Occupy an empty position or meet a particular need
example1_en: Please fill the jug with water for our guests.
example1_zh: 请把水壶装满水，给客人们喝。
example2_en: Local training programmes can help fill vacancies in essential services such as healthcare and education.
example2_zh: 地方培训项目可以帮助填补医疗和教育等基本服务领域的职位空缺。
collocations: fill with water｜装满水 ; fill in a form｜填写表格 ; fill a gap｜填补空缺 ; fill a vacancy｜填补职位空缺
tip_zh: fill A with B表示用B装满A；be filled with表示充满。

meanings_zh: v. 变得；成为
definition_en: to start to be something or develop a particular quality
example1_en: The streets become quiet after the shops close.
example1_zh: 商店关门后，街道变得安静起来。
example2_en: Public transport must become more reliable and affordable if cities want residents to drive less frequently.
example2_zh: 如果城市希望居民减少开车，公共交通就必须变得更可靠、更实惠。
collocations: become aware of｜开始意识到 ; become increasingly important｜变得日益重要 ; become a teacher｜成为教师
tip_zh: 变化形式：become—became—become；后接名词或形容词。

meanings_zh: adv. 向上；在高处 | prep. 沿……向上；顺着 | adj. 醒着的；起床的
definition_en: Towards or in a higher position. | Towards a higher point or further along something. | Awake and out of bed.
example1_en: The child looked up at the bright red balloon.
example1_zh: 孩子抬头看着那个鲜红的气球。
example2_en: As housing costs go up, many young adults find it harder to live independently.
example2_zh: 随着住房成本上涨，许多年轻人发现独立生活变得更加困难。
collocations: look up｜抬头看 ; go up｜上升；上涨 ; up the stairs｜沿楼梯向上 ; be up early｜很早起床
tip_zh: up后接地点名词可作介词，如up the hill。

meanings_zh: n. 世界；地球 | n. 领域；界
definition_en: The earth and all the people and things on it. | A particular area of activity and the people involved.
example1_en: She dreams of travelling around the world by train.
example1_zh: 她梦想乘火车环游世界。
example2_en: Countries around the world need to cooperate more closely to address climate change and protect shared natural resources.
example2_zh: 世界各国需要更紧密地合作，以应对气候变化并保护共享的自然资源。
collocations: around the world｜世界各地 ; the natural world｜自然界 ; the business world｜商界 ; world population｜世界人口
tip_zh: 指整个世界通常用the world；商界为the business world。

meanings_zh: v. 喝；饮 | n. 饮料；一杯饮品 | v. 喝酒
definition_en: to take liquid into your mouth and swallow it | a liquid for swallowing or a serving of it | to consume alcoholic beverages
example1_en: I always drink some water after walking the dog.
example1_zh: 我遛完狗总会喝些水。
example2_en: Encouraging children to drink water instead of sugary beverages may improve their dental health over time.
example2_zh: 鼓励儿童喝水而非含糖饮料，长远来看可能改善他们的牙齿健康。
collocations: drink water｜喝水 ; a hot drink｜热饮 ; drinking water｜饮用水 ; soft drink｜不含酒精的饮料
tip_zh: 不规则变化：drink—drank—drunk。

meanings_zh: n. 墨西哥
definition_en: A country in North America, south of the United States.
example1_en: We explored ancient ruins during our holiday in Mexico.
example1_zh: 我们在墨西哥度假期间探访了古代遗址。
example2_en: Tourism in Mexico creates employment, but popular coastal destinations also face pressure on water supplies and natural habitats.
example2_zh: 墨西哥的旅游业创造了就业机会，但热门沿海旅游地的供水和自然栖息地也面临压力。
collocations: visit Mexico｜游览墨西哥 ; southern Mexico｜墨西哥南部 ; the coast of Mexico｜墨西哥海岸
tip_zh: 国名前通常不加the；Mexican指墨西哥的或墨西哥人。

meanings_zh: adj. 灰色的；灰白的 | n. 灰色 | v. 头发变灰白
definition_en: Having a colour between black and white. | The colour between black and white. | Develop grey hair as you get older.
example1_en: A grey cat was sleeping on the windowsill.
example1_zh: 一只灰猫正在窗台上睡觉。
example2_en: Grey concrete buildings can appear less welcoming than neighbourhoods with colourful homes and abundant green space.
example2_zh: 灰色混凝土建筑可能不如拥有彩色住宅和充足绿地的街区亲切宜人。
collocations: grey hair｜灰白的头发 ; grey clouds｜灰色的云 ; turn grey｜变灰白 ; a grey area｜模糊地带
tip_zh: grey为英式拼写，gray为美式拼写。

meanings_zh: det. 许多；大量 | pron. 很多；大量 | adv. 很；非常；更为
definition_en: A large amount of something, used with uncountable nouns. | A large amount, without naming what is being discussed. | To a great degree, especially with comparisons and certain verbs.
example1_en: We do not have much milk left for breakfast.
example1_zh: 我们剩下的早餐牛奶不多了。
example2_en: Investing in preventive healthcare can be much more economical than treating illnesses after they become severe.
example2_zh: 投资预防性医疗可能比在疾病变得严重后再治疗经济得多。
collocations: too much｜太多 ; much more｜多得多；更为 ; much better｜好得多 ; as much as｜与……一样多
tip_zh: 修饰不可数名词；可数名词复数用many。

meanings_zh: v. 学习；学会 | v. 得知；获悉
definition_en: To gain knowledge or a skill through study or experience. | To find out information about something.
example1_en: My grandfather is learning to swim at the local pool.
example1_zh: 我爷爷正在附近的游泳池学游泳。
example2_en: Students often learn more effectively when they apply new knowledge to practical problems rather than memorise isolated facts.
example2_zh: 与死记零散知识相比，学生将新知识用于实际问题时，往往学得更有效。
collocations: learn to drive｜学开车 ; learn from mistakes｜从错误中学习 ; learn by heart｜背熟 ; learn about｜了解
tip_zh: learn to do表示学会做；过去式可用learnt或learned。

meanings_zh: n. 南；南方 | adj. 南部的；朝南的 | adv. 向南；在南方
definition_en: the direction opposite north | in, towards, or facing the south | towards or in the south
example1_en: Our balcony faces south and gets plenty of sunshine.
example1_zh: 我们的阳台朝南，阳光很充足。
example2_en: Many families move to the south because its warmer climate allows more outdoor activities throughout the year.
example2_zh: 许多家庭搬到南方，因为那里气候更温暖，全年都能进行更多户外活动。
collocations: in the south｜在南方 ; head south｜向南走 ; south coast｜南部海岸
tip_zh: 南部用in the south；向南用go south，不加to。

meanings_zh: v. 能；可以；可能 | n. 金属罐；罐头 | v. 将食品装罐保存
definition_en: Used to express ability, permission, or possibility. | A metal container for food, drinks, or other substances. | To preserve food by sealing it in cans.
example1_en: I can carry both bags if you open the door.
example1_zh: 你要是把门打开，我就能把两个袋子都提进去。
example2_en: Access to reliable internet can help rural students benefit from a wider range of educational resources.
example2_zh: 稳定的互联网接入能帮助农村学生利用更丰富的教育资源。
collocations: can afford｜负担得起 ; can of soup｜一罐汤 ; canned food｜罐装食品
tip_zh: 作情态动词后接动词原形，第三人称不加s。

meanings_zh: int. 嘿；喂；嗨
definition_en: Used informally to greet someone or attract their attention.
example1_en: Hey, you left your umbrella beside the door!
example1_zh: 喂，你把伞落在门边了！
example2_en: Informal greetings such as hey may be inappropriate when students first contact university staff by email.
example2_zh: 学生初次通过电子邮件联系大学教职员工时，使用hey这类非正式问候语可能不太合适。
collocations: hey there｜嗨，你好 ; hey everyone｜嗨，大家好
tip_zh: 适合熟人间打招呼；正式邮件避免使用。

meanings_zh: n. 可乐
definition_en: A sweet, dark, fizzy drink, usually containing caffeine.
example1_en: He poured cold cola into a glass with ice.
example1_zh: 他把冰可乐倒进一个放了冰块的玻璃杯。
example2_en: Reducing the consumption of sugary drinks such as cola may help prevent tooth decay in children.
example2_zh: 减少可乐等含糖饮料的摄入，可能有助于预防儿童龋齿。
collocations: a can of cola｜一罐可乐 ; diet cola｜低热量可乐 ; sugar-free cola｜无糖可乐
tip_zh: 泛指饮料时不可数；a cola可指一杯或一份可乐。

meanings_zh: n. 淋浴；淋浴器 | n. 阵雨 | v. 淋浴
definition_en: Washing under falling water, or the equipment used for this | A short period of rain | Wash your body under water falling from a shower
example1_en: I always take a warm shower after cycling home.
example1_zh: 我骑车回家后总会洗个温水澡。
example2_en: Taking shorter showers is a simple way for households to reduce both water consumption and energy use.
example2_zh: 缩短淋浴时间是家庭减少用水和能源消耗的一种简单方法。
collocations: take a shower｜洗淋浴 ; have a shower｜洗淋浴 ; heavy showers｜强阵雨 ; a shower head｜淋浴喷头
tip_zh: 洗淋浴可用take或have a shower；阵雨也叫shower。

meanings_zh: n. 树；树木
definition_en: A tall plant with a wooden trunk and branches.
example1_en: A small bird built its nest in our tree.
example1_zh: 一只小鸟在我们家的树上筑了巢。
example2_en: Planting trees in urban areas provides shade, improves air quality, and creates valuable habitats for wildlife.
example2_zh: 在城市地区植树能提供树荫、改善空气质量，并为野生动物创造宝贵的栖息地。
collocations: plant a tree｜种树 ; climb a tree｜爬树 ; tree trunk｜树干 ; family tree｜家谱
tip_zh: tree是树；wood可指木材，woods通常指树林。

meanings_zh: v. 建造；建立 | n. 体形；体格
definition_en: to make structures or develop something over time | the size and shape of a person's body
example1_en: We built a small wooden shelter in the garden.
example1_zh: 我们在花园里搭了一个小木棚。
example2_en: Local authorities should build more affordable homes near public transport to support families on low incomes.
example2_zh: 地方政府应在公共交通设施附近建造更多经济适用住房，以帮助低收入家庭。
collocations: build a house｜建造房屋 ; build confidence｜建立信心 ; build relationships｜建立关系 ; a slim build｜苗条的体形
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为built；体格可用build。

meanings_zh: n. 成年男子；男人 | n. 人类 | v. 为…配备人员；值守
definition_en: An adult male human | Human beings considered collectively | To provide people to operate or guard something
example1_en: A man in a blue coat held the door open.
example1_zh: 一位穿蓝色外套的男子扶着门，让别人通过。
example2_en: Additional volunteers are needed to man information desks during the city's annual cultural festival.
example2_zh: 该市举办一年一度的文化节期间，需要更多志愿者在咨询台值守。
collocations: young man｜年轻男子 ; man a desk｜在服务台值守 ; man a checkpoint｜在检查站执勤
tip_zh: 复数为men；泛指人类时现代写作更常用humankind。

meanings_zh: adj. 早期的；较早的 | adv. 提前；在早期
definition_en: Near the beginning of a period or before the usual time | Before the expected time or near the beginning
example1_en: We caught an early train and arrived before breakfast.
example1_zh: 我们赶上了一班早车，在早餐前就到了。
example2_en: Early investment in childhood education can reduce inequality and improve employment prospects later in life.
example2_zh: 及早投资幼儿教育可以减少不平等，并改善孩子成年后的就业前景。
collocations: early childhood｜幼儿期 ; early stages｜早期阶段 ; arrive early｜提前到达 ; early detection｜早期发现
tip_zh: early兼作形容词和副词，不加-ly。

meanings_zh: det. 这些 | pron. 这些人；这些事物
definition_en: Used before plural nouns for nearby people or things. | Nearby people or things, or ones just mentioned.
example1_en: These strawberries smell lovely, so let's buy a basket.
example1_zh: 这些草莓闻起来很香，我们买一篮吧。
example2_en: These findings suggest that regular outdoor activities can improve children's concentration and emotional health.
example2_zh: 这些研究结果表明，经常参加户外活动可以改善儿童的注意力和情绪健康。
collocations: these days｜如今 ; these things｜这些事物 ; in these circumstances｜在这些情况下
tip_zh: these是this的复数，后接复数名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 最喜欢的 | n. 最喜爱的人或物 | n. 最有望获胜者
definition_en: liked more than any other of the same kind | a person or thing someone likes best | the competitor considered most likely to win
example1_en: This little bakery sells my favourite kind of bread.
example1_zh: 这家小面包店卖我最喜欢的那种面包。
example2_en: Public libraries allow readers to discover new authors as well as revisit their favourite books without additional cost.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆让读者无需额外花费，既能发现新作家，也能重读自己最喜爱的书。
collocations: favourite subject｜最喜欢的科目 ; a firm favourite｜一直备受喜爱的人或物 ; the favourite to win｜夺冠热门
tip_zh: 英式拼写favourite，美式favorite；一般不用most修饰。

meanings_zh: n. 成年人；成年动物 | adj. 成年的；成年人的
definition_en: A person or animal that has finished growing. | Fully grown, or relating to grown people.
example1_en: Children must visit the swimming pool with an adult.
example1_zh: 儿童必须由成年人陪同前往游泳池。
example2_en: Adult education programmes help people gain new qualifications and adapt to changes in the labour market.
example2_zh: 成人教育项目帮助人们获得新的资格，并适应劳动力市场的变化。
collocations: young adult｜年轻成年人 ; adult education｜成人教育 ; adult life｜成年生活 ; responsible adult｜负责任的成年人
tip_zh: 既可作可数名词，也可作形容词，如adult education。

meanings_zh: n. 时钟 | v. 测定速度；记录用时
definition_en: a device that shows the time | to measure or record the time or speed of something
example1_en: The kitchen clock stopped while we were making lunch.
example1_zh: 我们做午饭时，厨房的时钟停了。
example2_en: Flexible working arrangements allow employees to work when they are most productive, rather than watching the clock.
example2_zh: 弹性工作安排让员工在效率最高时工作，而不是盯着时钟等下班。
collocations: alarm clock｜闹钟 ; around the clock｜日夜不停地 ; clock in｜打卡上班 ; watch the clock｜盯着时间等下班
tip_zh: clock通常指钟；戴在手腕上的表叫watch。

meanings_zh: adv. 在楼下；往楼下 | adj. 楼下的
definition_en: On or towards a lower floor of a building | Located on a lower floor of a building
example1_en: I went downstairs when I smelled fresh bread.
example1_zh: 闻到新鲜面包的香味后，我下了楼。
example2_en: Providing a downstairs bedroom can help older residents remain independent in their own homes.
example2_zh: 在楼下设置卧室可以帮助老年住户在自己家中保持独立生活。
collocations: go downstairs｜下楼 ; downstairs bathroom｜楼下的浴室 ; downstairs neighbour｜楼下的邻居
tip_zh: 作副词时直接说go downstairs，不加to。

meanings_zh: n. 信息；资料
definition_en: Facts or details about someone or something
example1_en: The receptionist gave us useful information about local buses.
example1_zh: 接待员向我们提供了有关当地公交车的实用信息。
example2_en: Access to reliable information enables patients to make better decisions about their treatment and long-term health.
example2_zh: 获取可靠信息能帮助患者就治疗和长期健康作出更好的决定。
collocations: reliable information｜可靠信息 ; access to information｜信息获取渠道 ; provide information｜提供信息 ; a piece of information｜一条信息
tip_zh: 不可数：说some information，不说an information。

meanings_zh: n. 黑板
definition_en: A dark classroom board used for writing or drawing with chalk.
example1_en: Our teacher drew a huge circle on the blackboard.
example1_zh: 老师在黑板上画了一个大圆圈。
example2_en: Although digital screens offer interactive features, a traditional blackboard remains an affordable teaching tool for many schools.
example2_zh: 尽管电子屏幕具有互动功能，传统黑板仍是许多学校负担得起的教学工具。
collocations: write on the blackboard｜在黑板上书写 ; clean the blackboard｜擦黑板 ; blackboard eraser｜黑板擦
tip_zh: 在黑板上用on the blackboard；配合粉笔使用。

meanings_zh: n. 聚会；派对 | n. 政党 | n. 一方；当事人
definition_en: A social gathering where people celebrate or enjoy themselves. | An organised group seeking political power through shared policies. | A person or group involved in an agreement or dispute.
example1_en: We held a small party in the garden yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天我们在花园里办了一场小聚会。
example2_en: Each political party should explain how its education policies will benefit students from disadvantaged backgrounds.
example2_zh: 每个政党都应说明其教育政策将如何惠及弱势背景的学生。
collocations: a birthday party｜生日聚会 ; a political party｜政党 ; a third party｜第三方 ; throw a party｜举办派对
tip_zh: 合同中的party指当事方，不是聚会或政党。

meanings_zh: n. 一餐；一顿饭
definition_en: An occasion when you eat, or the food eaten then.
example1_en: Dad cooked a warm meal after our long walk.
example1_zh: 我们长途步行回来后，爸爸做了一顿热乎乎的饭。
example2_en: Providing healthy school meals can improve children's concentration and support their physical development.
example2_zh: 提供健康的学校餐食能提高儿童的专注力，并促进他们的身体发育。
collocations: balanced meal｜营养均衡的一餐 ; prepare a meal｜准备饭菜 ; skip a meal｜不吃一顿饭 ; main meal｜正餐
tip_zh: meal指一顿饭；food泛指食物，通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 椅子 | n. 会议主席；负责人 | v. 主持会议
definition_en: a seat for one person, usually with a back | the person responsible for leading a meeting or committee | to lead a meeting and manage its discussion
example1_en: She pulled a chair closer to the window.
example1_zh: 她把一把椅子拉到离窗户更近的地方。
example2_en: An independent expert should chair the meeting to ensure that all participants can contribute fairly.
example2_zh: 应由一位独立专家主持会议，确保所有参与者都能公平地发表意见。
collocations: office chair｜办公椅 ; committee chair｜委员会主席 ; chair a meeting｜主持会议
tip_zh: chair作动词直接接meeting，表示主持会议。

meanings_zh: adv. 从不；从未 | adv. 决不
definition_en: Not at any time. | Certainly not, used to express strong refusal or intention.
example1_en: I never leave home without my water bottle.
example1_zh: 我出门从来都带着水瓶。
example2_en: Public transport can never fully replace walking and cycling as accessible forms of daily exercise.
example2_zh: 作为方便易行的日常运动方式，步行和骑行永远无法被公共交通完全取代。
collocations: never again｜再也不 ; almost never｜几乎从不 ; never before｜以前从未
tip_zh: 通常放在实义动词前，be动词或助动词后。

meanings_zh: n. 中间；中部 | adj. 中间的；居中的
definition_en: The central part, point, or position of something | Located between other things or between the beginning and end
example1_en: Someone left a suitcase in the middle of the hallway.
example1_zh: 有人把一个行李箱放在了走廊正中央。
example2_en: Housing costs often force essential workers to live far from the middle of the cities they serve.
example2_zh: 住房成本常常迫使提供必要服务的工作者住在远离其服务城市中心的地方。
collocations: in the middle of｜在……中间 ; middle age｜中年 ; middle class｜中产阶级 ; middle ground｜折中立场
tip_zh: 名词常用the middle of；形容词直接修饰名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 凉的；凉爽的 | adj. 冷静的；沉着的 | v. 变凉；使冷却
definition_en: slightly cold, often in a pleasant way | calm and able to think clearly under pressure | to become or make something less hot
example1_en: A cool breeze drifted through the open kitchen window.
example1_zh: 一阵凉爽的微风从敞开的厨房窗户吹了进来。
example2_en: Planting more trees can help cool urban areas and reduce energy demand during summer.
example2_zh: 种植更多树木有助于为城市地区降温，并减少夏季的能源需求。
collocations: cool breeze｜凉爽的微风 ; keep cool｜保持冷静 ; cool down｜冷却；平静下来
tip_zh: cool 比 cold 温和；口语中还可表示“很酷的”。

meanings_zh: n. 九月
definition_en: The month after August and before October.
example1_en: Our evening photography course starts in September this year.
example1_zh: 我们今年的摄影夜课九月开课。
example2_en: In many countries, the academic year begins in September, creating seasonal demand for student accommodation near universities.
example2_zh: 许多国家的学年在九月开始，使大学附近的学生住宿出现季节性需求。
collocations: in September｜在九月 ; early September｜九月初 ; late September｜九月下旬
tip_zh: 月份首字母大写；用 in September，但 next September 前不加 in。

meanings_zh: adj. 容易的；不费力的 | adj. 轻松的；自在的
definition_en: Not difficult and requiring little effort. | Relaxed and free from worry or pressure.
example1_en: This soup is easy to make with fresh vegetables.
example1_zh: 用新鲜蔬菜做这道汤很容易。
example2_en: Providing easy access to reliable health information can help people make better decisions about their lifestyles.
example2_zh: 让人们方便地获取可靠的健康信息，有助于他们作出更好的生活方式选择。
collocations: easy to use｜易于使用 ; easy access to｜便于获取或到达…… ; take it easy｜放轻松 ; easy life｜安逸的生活
tip_zh: 常用easy to do；修饰动作通常用easily。

meanings_zh: n. 东西；物品 | n. 事情；情况 | n. 个人物品
definition_en: an object whose name is unknown or not specified | an action, event, fact, or situation | possessions or equipment, usually referred to in the plural
example1_en: Could you move that heavy thing off my chair?
example1_zh: 你能把那个沉东西从我的椅子上搬走吗？
example2_en: One important thing governments can do is ensure that affordable housing is available near public transport.
example2_zh: 政府可以做的一件重要事情，是确保公共交通附近有可负担的住房。
collocations: the right thing to do｜正确的做法 ; personal things｜个人物品 ; first thing in the morning｜早晨第一件事 ; one thing at a time｜一次一件事
tip_zh: thing很笼统；正式写作尽量换成具体名词。

meanings_zh: n. 嘴；口腔 | n. 河口；入口 | v. 用口形无声地说
definition_en: the opening in your face used for eating and speaking | the opening of a cave or where a river meets the sea | to form words with your lips without making a sound
example1_en: The dentist asked me to open my mouth wider.
example1_zh: 牙医让我把嘴张大一点。
example2_en: Wetlands near the mouth of a river provide valuable habitats and help protect coastal communities from flooding.
example2_zh: 河口附近的湿地提供了宝贵的栖息地，也有助于保护沿海社区免遭洪灾。
collocations: open your mouth｜张嘴 ; the mouth of a river｜河口 ; word of mouth｜口口相传
tip_zh: 名词末音为/θ/；动词末音为/ð/。

meanings_zh: v. 学习；研究 | n. 学习；研究 | n. 书房
definition_en: Spend time learning about or carefully examining a subject. | The activity of learning, or an investigation of a subject. | A room used for reading, writing, or working.
example1_en: I study English on the bus every morning.
example1_zh: 我每天早上在公交车上学英语。
example2_en: A recent study suggests that regular exercise can improve students' concentration during classroom activities.
example2_zh: 最近一项研究表明，经常锻炼能提高学生在课堂活动中的专注力。
collocations: study abroad｜出国留学 ; a recent study｜最近的一项研究 ; study for an exam｜为考试学习
tip_zh: study强调学习过程，learn常强调学会或获得知识。

meanings_zh: pron. 任何事物 | pron. 某事物；什么东西
definition_en: Any thing at all, without limits on choice | Something, used especially in questions and conditional statements
example1_en: You can choose anything from this basket of toys.
example1_zh: 你可以从这篮玩具里随便挑一件。
example2_en: Before introducing new policies, governments should check whether anything similar has worked successfully elsewhere.
example2_zh: 在推行新政策之前，政府应查明其他地方是否有类似的成功做法。
collocations: anything else｜其他东西 ; anything at all｜任何东西 ; anything but｜绝非
tip_zh: 疑问句中常指“什么”；陈述句中可指“任何事物”。

meanings_zh: n. 运动员；比赛参加者 | n. 演奏者 | n. 播放器
definition_en: someone who takes part in a sport or game | someone who plays a musical instrument | a device or program that plays recorded sound or video
example1_en: Each player shook hands before the football match began.
example1_zh: 足球比赛开始前，每位球员都握了手。
example2_en: Young players benefit from coaches who value teamwork and personal development rather than winning alone.
example2_zh: 教练若重视团队合作和个人成长，而非一味追求胜利，年轻运动员就能从中受益。
collocations: football player｜足球运动员 ; team player｜善于团队合作的人 ; piano player｜钢琴演奏者 ; media player｜媒体播放器
tip_zh: 乐器演奏者可用“乐器名＋player”，如piano player。

meanings_zh: num. 四十
definition_en: the number equal to four times ten
example1_en: We waited forty minutes before the bus finally arrived.
example1_zh: 我们等了四十分钟，公交车才终于到。
example2_en: The survey found that forty percent of local residents preferred cycling to driving for short journeys.
example2_zh: 调查发现，当地百分之四十的居民在短途出行时更愿意骑车而非开车。
collocations: forty minutes｜四十分钟 ; forty percent｜百分之四十 ; in her forties｜在她四十多岁时
tip_zh: 拼写是forty，不是fourty；四十多岁用in one's forties。

meanings_zh: n. 巧克力 | n. 巧克力糖
definition_en: A sweet food made from cocoa, often with milk and sugar. | An individual sweet made of chocolate, sometimes with a filling.
example1_en: He shared a bar of chocolate with his sister.
example1_zh: 他和妹妹分享了一块巧克力。
example2_en: Consumers increasingly expect chocolate producers to ensure fair wages and safe working conditions throughout their supply chains.
example2_zh: 消费者越来越期望巧克力生产商确保整个供应链中的公平工资和安全工作条件。
collocations: dark chocolate｜黑巧克力 ; milk chocolate｜牛奶巧克力 ; a bar of chocolate｜一块巧克力 ; a box of chocolates｜一盒巧克力糖
tip_zh: 食材巧克力不可数；单颗巧克力糖可数。

meanings_zh: n. 大小；规模 | n. 尺码；号 | v. 按大小分类；确定尺寸
definition_en: How big or small someone or something is. | A standard measurement used for clothes and other products. | To sort by measurements or make something a particular size.
example1_en: This suitcase is just the right size for weekends.
example1_zh: 这个行李箱的大小正适合周末出行。
example2_en: Reducing class size may allow teachers to provide more individual support to students with learning difficulties.
example2_zh: 缩小班级规模或许能让教师为有学习困难的学生提供更多个别辅导。
collocations: class size｜班级规模 ; sample size｜样本量 ; shoe size｜鞋码 ; in size｜在大小上
tip_zh: 问尺码用What size，不用How much size。

meanings_zh: adj. 小的；少的 | adj. 年幼的 | adj. 不重要的；轻微的
definition_en: Limited in size, amount, or degree. | Young and not yet fully grown. | Not very important or serious.
example1_en: Our small kitchen has room for only two chairs.
example1_zh: 我们的小厨房只能放下两把椅子。
example2_en: Even small improvements in home insulation can reduce energy consumption and lower household bills.
example2_zh: 即使对住宅保温做出小幅改善，也能减少能源消耗并降低家庭开支。
collocations: a small amount of｜少量的 ; small businesses｜小企业 ; small children｜幼儿 ; a small change｜小变化
tip_zh: 数量少可说a small number of，不能说small people。

meanings_zh: n. 体育运动 | v. 显眼地穿戴；展示
definition_en: Physical activities involving skill, effort, and often competition | To wear or display something in a noticeable way
example1_en: Swimming is the only sport my sister really enjoys.
example1_zh: 游泳是我姐姐唯一真正喜欢的运动。
example2_en: Regular participation in sport can improve physical health and help young people develop teamwork skills.
example2_zh: 经常参加体育运动能改善身体健康，并帮助年轻人培养团队合作能力。
collocations: take part in sport｜参加体育运动 ; competitive sport｜竞技体育 ; team sport｜团队运动 ; sporting event｜体育赛事
tip_zh: 泛指体育时英式常用sport，美式常用sports。

meanings_zh: n. 考试；测验
definition_en: A formal test of knowledge or ability.
example1_en: I have a maths exam on Friday morning.
example1_zh: 我周五上午有一场数学考试。
example2_en: Schools should consider practical skills alongside exam results when assessing students' overall progress.
example2_zh: 学校在评估学生的整体进步时，应将实践技能与考试成绩一并考虑。
collocations: take an exam｜参加考试 ; pass an exam｜通过考试 ; revise for an exam｜复习备考 ; exam results｜考试成绩
tip_zh: exam是examination的常用缩写；参加考试用take。

meanings_zh: n. 母牛；奶牛 | v. 恐吓；威吓
definition_en: an adult female bovine, often kept for milk | to frighten someone into obeying or giving up resistance
example1_en: A brown cow stood quietly beside the farm gate.
example1_zh: 一头棕色母牛静静地站在农场门旁。
example2_en: Improving the diet of dairy cows can increase milk production while supporting animal health.
example2_zh: 改善奶牛的饮食可以在促进动物健康的同时提高产奶量。
collocations: dairy cow｜奶牛 ; milk a cow｜给奶牛挤奶 ; be cowed into silence｜被吓得不敢出声
tip_zh: cow指成年母牛；cattle统称牛，不能说a cattle。

meanings_zh: n. 球；球状物 | n. 正式舞会
definition_en: A round object used in games or shaped like one. | A formal social event where people dance.
example1_en: The dog chased the ball across the grass.
example1_zh: 那只狗追着球跑过草地。
example2_en: Simple ball games can help children develop coordination while encouraging cooperation and regular physical activity.
example2_zh: 简单的球类游戏能帮助儿童发展协调能力，同时促进合作和日常体育锻炼。
collocations: throw a ball｜扔球 ; catch a ball｜接球 ; a ball of wool｜一团毛线 ; a charity ball｜慈善舞会
tip_zh: 球类运动前通常不用冠词，如play football。

meanings_zh: n. 野餐 | v. 去野餐
definition_en: a meal eaten outdoors, usually with food brought from home | to eat a meal outdoors for pleasure
example1_en: We had a picnic under a shady tree.
example1_zh: 我们在一棵树的荫凉下野餐。
example2_en: Public parks provide affordable spaces where families can enjoy picnics and spend quality time together.
example2_zh: 公共公园提供了花费不高的空间，让家庭享受野餐并共度美好时光。
collocations: have a picnic｜野餐 ; go on a picnic｜去野餐 ; picnic basket｜野餐篮
tip_zh: 动词过去式为picnicked，进行形式为picnicking。

meanings_zh: v. 开始；着手
definition_en: to start happening or start doing something
example1_en: We begin dinner when everyone is sitting at the table.
example1_zh: 大家都在餐桌旁坐好后，我们开始吃晚饭。
example2_en: Schools should begin teaching digital safety early so that children develop responsible habits when using the internet.
example2_zh: 学校应尽早开始教授网络安全知识，让孩子养成负责任地使用互联网的习惯。
collocations: begin with｜以……开始 ; begin to understand｜开始理解 ; begin a discussion｜开始讨论 ; to begin with｜首先；起初
tip_zh: 过去式began，过去分词begun；后接不定式或动名词。

meanings_zh: det. 足够的 | adv. 足够地 | pron. 足够的数量
definition_en: as much or as many as needed | to the degree that is needed | an amount that meets a need
example1_en: We have enough rice to feed everyone tonight.
example1_zh: 我们的米够今晚所有人吃。
example2_en: Many rural schools lack enough resources to provide students with a broad range of subjects.
example2_zh: 许多农村学校缺乏足够的资源，无法为学生开设广泛的课程。
collocations: enough time｜足够的时间 ; good enough｜足够好 ; enough to eat｜足够吃的东西
tip_zh: 修饰名词放前面，修饰形容词或副词放后面。

meanings_zh: n. 班级；课 | n. 社会阶层；类别 | v. 把…归类
definition_en: A group learning together, or a lesson they attend. | A social group or category sharing particular characteristics. | To place someone or something in a particular category.
example1_en: Our class is learning how to grow vegetables.
example1_zh: 我们班正在学习如何种蔬菜。
example2_en: Smaller class sizes may allow teachers to give more individual attention to students with learning difficulties.
example2_zh: 较小的班级规模可能让教师给予学习有困难的学生更多个别关注。
collocations: attend a class｜上课 ; class size｜班级规模 ; social class｜社会阶层 ; be classed as｜被归类为
tip_zh: in class通常指在上课；in the class指在这个班里。

meanings_zh: det. 很少的；几个 | pron. 很少的人或事物
definition_en: Not many; a small number of countable things. | A small number of people or things.
example1_en: There were few customers in the shop this morning.
example1_zh: 今天上午店里的顾客很少。
example2_en: Few rural communities have access to the specialist medical services available in major cities.
example2_zh: 很少有农村社区能获得大城市所提供的专科医疗服务。
collocations: a few days｜几天 ; very few people｜极少的人 ; few and far between｜少之又少
tip_zh: few表几乎没有，a few表有几个；均接可数名词复数。

meanings_zh: n. 国家 | n. 乡下；农村 | n. 乡村音乐
definition_en: An area of land governed as an independent political unit. | Land outside towns and cities, often with farms and villages. | A popular music style rooted in rural American traditions.
example1_en: She hopes to visit another country next summer.
example1_zh: 她希望明年夏天去另一个国家旅行。
example2_en: Each country should develop energy policies that reflect its natural resources and long-term environmental goals.
example2_zh: 各国都应根据本国自然资源和长期环境目标制定能源政策。
collocations: a developing country｜发展中国家 ; a neighbouring country｜邻国 ; live in the country｜住在乡下 ; country music｜乡村音乐
tip_zh: 表示“乡下”常用 the country，与国家义区分。

meanings_zh: v. 理解；懂得 | v. 体谅；理解感受 | v. 获悉；认为
definition_en: to know what something means or how it works | to recognise why someone feels or behaves a certain way | to believe something is true based on available information
example1_en: I finally understand how to use this washing machine.
example1_zh: 我终于懂得怎么用这台洗衣机了。
example2_en: Schools should help students understand how their daily choices affect the natural environment.
example2_zh: 学校应帮助学生理解自己的日常选择如何影响自然环境。
collocations: understand the meaning｜理解含义 ; fully understand｜完全理解 ; understand how｜理解如何
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为understood。

meanings_zh: v. 死亡；枯死 | v. 停止运转；逐渐消失 | n. 骰子
definition_en: Stop living. | Stop working or gradually become weaker and disappear. | A small cube with marked faces, thrown in games.
example1_en: These plants will die if we forget to water them.
example1_zh: 如果忘了浇水，这些植物就会枯死。
example2_en: Many marine animals die after swallowing plastic waste, highlighting the urgent need to reduce ocean pollution.
example2_zh: 许多海洋动物吞食塑料垃圾后死亡，这凸显了减少海洋污染的迫切需要。
collocations: die of cancer｜死于癌症 ; die out｜灭绝；消失 ; die down｜逐渐平息 ; die from injuries｜因伤死亡
tip_zh: die是动词，dead是形容词，death是名词。

meanings_zh: n. 四月
definition_en: The fourth month of the year.
example1_en: We are moving into our new flat in April.
example1_zh: 我们将在四月搬进新公寓。
example2_en: The community garden will open in April, giving local residents more opportunities to grow their own vegetables.
example2_zh: 社区菜园将于四月开放，让当地居民有更多机会自己种菜。
collocations: in April｜在四月 ; early April｜四月初 ; late April｜四月下旬
tip_zh: 月份首字母大写；月份前用in，具体日期前用on。

meanings_zh: prep. 和；与……一起 | prep. 有；带有 | prep. 用；借助
definition_en: Accompanied by another person or thing. | Having or including a particular feature or thing. | Using a particular tool, material, or means.
example1_en: I cooked dinner with my sister last night.
example1_zh: 昨晚我和姐姐一起做了晚饭。
example2_en: Schools should work with local communities to provide children with safe spaces for outdoor activities.
example2_zh: 学校应与当地社区合作，为儿童提供安全的户外活动空间。
collocations: work with someone｜与某人合作 ; with care｜小心地 ; agree with someone｜同意某人的看法 ; with the help of｜在……的帮助下
tip_zh: with后接名词或代词宾格，如with me。

meanings_zh: n. 盘子；碟子 | n. 薄板；金属板 | v. 给…镀上金属
definition_en: A flat, usually round dish used for serving food. | A flat piece of metal or another hard material. | To cover an object with a thin layer of metal.
example1_en: She placed a warm pancake on my plate.
example1_zh: 她在我的盘子里放了一张热乎乎的薄煎饼。
example2_en: Restaurants can reduce food waste by offering smaller plates and allowing customers to request extra portions.
example2_zh: 餐馆可以提供较小的餐盘，并允许顾客要求加量，从而减少食物浪费。
collocations: dinner plate｜餐盘 ; a plate of rice｜一盘米饭 ; steel plate｜钢板 ; gold-plated jewellery｜镀金首饰
tip_zh: plate通常指浅盘，bowl指较深的碗。

meanings_zh: adv. 一起；共同 | adv. 合在一起；相互连接
definition_en: with another person or other people | joined or combined with something else
example1_en: We cooked dinner together and shared stories about our day.
example1_zh: 我们一起做晚饭，分享各自一天的见闻。
example2_en: Schools and families should work together to help children develop healthy habits from an early age.
example2_zh: 学校和家庭应共同努力，帮助孩子从小养成健康习惯。
collocations: work together｜共同合作 ; get together｜相聚 ; put together｜组装；整理 ; live together｜一起生活
tip_zh: together通常作副词：一起做某事用动词加together。

meanings_zh: n. 星期六
definition_en: the day after Friday and before Sunday
example1_en: We usually buy fresh vegetables at the market on Saturday.
example1_zh: 我们通常星期六去市场买新鲜蔬菜。
example2_en: Opening public libraries on Saturday allows more working parents to participate in educational activities with their children.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆在星期六开放，让更多上班的家长能与孩子一起参加教育活动。
collocations: on Saturday｜在星期六 ; Saturday morning｜星期六早晨 ; every Saturday｜每星期六 ; this Saturday｜本周六
tip_zh: 首字母大写；on Saturday，但this Saturday前不用on。

meanings_zh: adj. 棕色的；褐色的 | n. 棕色；褐色 | v. 使变褐色；变褐色
definition_en: Having the colour of chocolate or dark wood. | The colour of chocolate or dark wood. | To become brown, or make food brown through cooking.
example1_en: A small brown dog was sleeping beside the door.
example1_zh: 一只棕色的小狗正在门边睡觉。
example2_en: During dry periods, grass often turns brown as plants conserve water and reduce their growth.
example2_zh: 在干旱时期，植物为了保存水分会减缓生长，草也常因此变成褐色。
collocations: dark brown｜深棕色 ; brown eyes｜棕色眼睛 ; brown rice｜糙米 ; golden brown｜金黄色的
tip_zh: brown作动词常用于烹饪，指把食物煎或烤至褐色。

meanings_zh: v. 花费钱 | v. 度过；花费时间
definition_en: to use money to pay for something | to use time doing something or being somewhere
example1_en: We spent all our money on fresh fruit.
example1_zh: 我们把钱全花在了新鲜水果上。
example2_en: Governments should spend more on preventive healthcare to reduce the future costs of treating chronic diseases.
example2_zh: 政府应增加预防保健方面的支出，以减少未来治疗慢性病的费用。
collocations: spend money on｜把钱花在……上 ; spend time doing｜花时间做…… ; spend the night｜过夜
tip_zh: 用spend时间doing或spend钱on；过去式spent。

meanings_zh: n. 秋天；秋季
definition_en: The season between summer and winter
example1_en: We collect fallen leaves in the park every autumn.
example1_zh: 我们每年秋天都在公园里收集落叶。
example2_en: Warmer autumn temperatures may delay leaf fall and affect the seasonal behaviour of local wildlife.
example2_zh: 秋季气温升高可能推迟落叶，并影响当地野生动物的季节性行为。
collocations: in autumn｜在秋天 ; autumn leaves｜秋叶 ; early autumn｜初秋
tip_zh: 字母n不发音；美式英语常用fall表示秋天。

meanings_zh: v. 帮助；有助于 | n. 帮助；援助
definition_en: Make something easier or better for someone. | Support that makes a difficulty or task easier.
example1_en: Could you help me carry these bags upstairs?
example1_zh: 你能帮我把这些袋子提上楼吗？
example2_en: Affordable public transport can help residents access jobs and reduce their dependence on cars.
example2_zh: 价格实惠的公共交通可以帮助居民获得就业机会，并减少他们对汽车的依赖。
collocations: help someone with something｜帮助某人做某事 ; ask for help｜寻求帮助 ; help to reduce｜有助于减少
tip_zh: help后接动词原形或to不定式均可。

meanings_zh: adj. 高的；高处的 | adj. 大量的；高水平的 | adv. 在高处；向高处
definition_en: extending far upwards or positioned far above the ground | greater than usual in amount, degree, or quality | at or to a position far above the ground
example1_en: The shelf is too high for me to reach.
example1_zh: 架子太高了，我够不着。
