example2_en: High housing costs can prevent young adults from living independently, particularly in major urban centres.
example2_zh: 高昂的住房成本可能使年轻人无法独立居住，在大城市中心尤其如此。
collocations: high standards｜高标准 ; high prices｜高价 ; high altitude｜高海拔 ; high above｜远在……上方
tip_zh: high常指位置或程度；人的身高用tall。

meanings_zh: n. 汤；羹
definition_en: A liquid food made by cooking ingredients in water or stock.
example1_en: She warmed her hands around a bowl of soup.
example1_zh: 她双手捧着一碗汤取暖。
example2_en: Community kitchens can provide affordable vegetable soup to help residents access nutritious meals during difficult economic periods.
example2_zh: 社区厨房可以提供价格实惠的蔬菜汤，帮助居民在经济困难时期获得有营养的餐食。
collocations: a bowl of soup｜一碗汤 ; vegetable soup｜蔬菜汤 ; make soup｜煮汤 ; chicken soup｜鸡汤
tip_zh: 通常不可数；点餐时two soups可指两份汤。

meanings_zh: v. 选择；挑选 | v. 决定；选择去做
definition_en: to decide which person or thing you want | to decide to do something rather than something else
example1_en: You can choose a seat beside the window.
example1_zh: 你可以选一个靠窗的座位。
example2_en: Many students choose to study abroad because they want to experience different cultures and teaching methods.
example2_zh: 许多学生选择出国留学，因为他们想体验不同的文化和教学方法。
collocations: choose between｜在……之间选择 ; choose from｜从……中挑选 ; choose to do something｜选择做某事 ; choose wisely｜明智地选择
tip_zh: 过去式chose，过去分词chosen；后接to do。

meanings_zh: n. 电影
definition_en: a recorded story or sequence of moving images for watching
example1_en: We watched a funny movie after dinner last night.
example1_zh: 昨晚晚饭后，我们看了一部有趣的电影。
example2_en: Movies can introduce audiences to unfamiliar cultures, although they sometimes reinforce stereotypes rather than challenge them.
example2_zh: 电影可以向观众介绍陌生文化，不过有时也会强化刻板印象，而非打破它们。
collocations: watch a movie｜看电影 ; movie star｜电影明星 ; movie theatre｜电影院 ; go to the movies｜去看电影
tip_zh: movie偏美式，英式常用film；the movies可指电影院。

meanings_zh: v. 相信；信以为真 | v. 认为；以为 | v. 信任；信仰
definition_en: To accept that something is true or someone is truthful. | To think that something is likely or correct. | To have confidence or faith in someone or something.
example1_en: I believe you, but your story sounds quite unusual.
example1_zh: 我相信你，但你讲的事情听起来很不寻常。
example2_en: Some educators believe that practical experience is just as valuable as academic knowledge in preparing students for employment.
example2_zh: 一些教育工作者认为，在帮助学生为就业做准备方面，实践经验与学术知识同样重要。
collocations: believe that｜相信；认为…… ; believe in yourself｜相信自己 ; widely believed｜被普遍认为 ; hard to believe｜难以置信
tip_zh: believe someone指相信其话；believe in someone指信任其能力。

meanings_zh: n. 火车；列车 | v. 训练；培训
definition_en: Connected railway vehicles that carry passengers or goods. | Teach or practise skills needed for an activity or job.
example1_en: We caught the last train home after dinner.
example1_zh: 晚饭后，我们赶上了回家的末班火车。
example2_en: Governments should train more healthcare workers to meet the needs of an ageing population.
example2_zh: 政府应培训更多医护人员，以满足老龄化人口的需求。
collocations: catch a train｜赶上火车 ; train station｜火车站 ; train staff｜培训员工 ; train for a marathon｜为马拉松训练
tip_zh: 交通方式用by train；在某列火车上用on the train。

meanings_zh: n. 纸；纸张 | n. 报纸 | n. 论文；试卷
definition_en: Thin material used for writing, printing, or wrapping. | A publication containing news, usually printed on large sheets. | An academic article or a written examination.
example1_en: She wrapped the small gift in bright yellow paper.
example1_zh: 她用鲜黄色的纸把小礼物包了起来。
example2_en: The university encourages students to submit assignments electronically to reduce paper consumption across its departments.
example2_zh: 这所大学鼓励学生以电子形式提交作业，以减少各院系的纸张消耗。
collocations: a sheet of paper｜一张纸 ; recycled paper｜再生纸 ; research paper｜研究论文 ; exam paper｜试卷
tip_zh: 纸不可数，用a piece of paper；论文、报纸可数。

meanings_zh: conj. 如果；假如 | conj. 是否
definition_en: introduces a condition for something to happen | introduces an indirect question about whether something is true
example1_en: If it rains, we can play indoors instead.
example1_zh: 如果下雨，我们可以改在室内玩。
example2_en: If cities invest in safe cycling routes, more residents may choose bicycles for their daily journeys.
example2_zh: 如果城市投资建设安全的自行车道，更多居民可能会选择骑车进行日常出行。
collocations: even if｜即使 ; only if｜只有…才 ; as if｜仿佛 ; if necessary｜如有必要
tip_zh: 谈未来条件时，if从句通常用一般现在时。

meanings_zh: adj. 大的；大量的 | adj. 重要的；影响大的
definition_en: Large in size, amount, or degree. | Important or likely to have a strong effect.
example1_en: We need a big bag for all these towels.
example1_zh: 我们需要一个大袋子来装所有这些毛巾。
example2_en: Public transport can make a big difference to air quality in rapidly growing cities.
example2_zh: 公共交通能显著改善快速发展城市的空气质量。
collocations: a big difference｜很大的差别 ; a big decision｜重大决定 ; a big mistake｜严重错误
tip_zh: big较口语；正式写作可按语境用large或major。

meanings_zh: n. 手 | n. 帮助 | v. 递给；交给
definition_en: The body part at the arm's end, with fingers and thumb. | Help with doing a task. | To give something to someone by holding it out.
example1_en: She held the warm cup in her left hand.
example1_zh: 她用左手握着温热的杯子。
example2_en: Practical workshops allow students to develop skills by making objects with their own hands.
example2_zh: 实践工作坊让学生通过亲手制作物品来培养技能。
collocations: hold hands｜手拉手 ; give someone a hand｜帮某人一把 ; hand in an assignment｜提交作业 ; by hand｜用手；手工
tip_zh: give someone a hand表示帮忙；by hand表示手工。

meanings_zh: adj. 黄色的 | n. 黄色 | v. 变黄；使变黄
definition_en: having the colour of lemons or ripe bananas | the colour of lemons or ripe bananas | to become yellow or make something yellow
example1_en: She picked a yellow umbrella for the rainy walk.
example1_zh: 她挑了一把黄色雨伞，准备在雨中散步。
example2_en: Yellow leaves may indicate that urban trees are suffering from water shortages or poor soil conditions.
example2_zh: 黄叶可能表明城市树木正受到缺水或土壤条件不佳的影响。
collocations: bright yellow｜明黄色 ; pale yellow｜淡黄色 ; turn yellow｜变黄
tip_zh: 可作动词表示变黄；不要用它描述人的种族。

meanings_zh: adj. 富有的；富裕的 | adj. 富含的；丰富的 | adj. 油腻的；浓厚的
definition_en: Having a lot of money or valuable possessions. | Containing a large amount or variety of something valuable. | Containing plenty of fat, cream, sugar, or strong flavour.
example1_en: Their rich uncle owns a large house by the sea.
example1_zh: 他们富有的叔叔在海边拥有一栋大房子。
example2_en: Rich countries can support global development by investing in clean energy projects in poorer regions.
example2_zh: 富裕国家可以通过投资贫困地区的清洁能源项目来支持全球发展。
collocations: rich countries｜富裕国家 ; rich in nutrients｜富含营养成分 ; rich cultural heritage｜丰富的文化遗产 ; rich food｜油腻的食物
tip_zh: “富含……”用 rich in，不用 rich of。

meanings_zh: v. 知道；懂得 | v. 认识；熟悉
definition_en: To have information or understanding about something | To be familiar with a person, place, or thing
example1_en: Do you know how to fix this bicycle?
example1_zh: 你知道怎么修这辆自行车吗？
example2_en: Consumers need to know how their personal information is collected before they can make informed choices online.
example2_zh: 消费者需要了解个人信息的收集方式，才能在网上作出知情选择。
collocations: know how to｜知道如何 ; know the answer｜知道答案 ; know someone well｜很了解某人 ; know for sure｜确切知道
tip_zh: 过去式knew，过去分词known；通常不用进行时。

meanings_zh: n. 堂兄弟姐妹；表兄弟姐妹
definition_en: A child of your aunt or uncle
example1_en: My cousin taught me to ride a bicycle yesterday.
example1_zh: 我的表姐昨天教我骑自行车。
example2_en: Children who regularly spend time with their cousins may develop strong family bonds beyond their immediate household.
example2_zh: 经常与堂表兄弟姐妹相处的孩子，可能与小家庭之外的亲人建立深厚感情。
collocations: a first cousin｜堂亲或表亲 ; a distant cousin｜远房堂亲或表亲 ; a younger cousin｜年幼的堂表亲
tip_zh: 不区分堂表、性别或长幼；需要时另加说明。

meanings_zh: n. 十一月
definition_en: The eleventh month of the year.
example1_en: We are moving into our new flat in November.
example1_zh: 我们将在十一月搬进新公寓。
example2_en: The university plans to launch its new scholarship programme in November, allowing more international students to apply.
example2_zh: 该大学计划在十一月推出新的奖学金项目，让更多国际学生能够申请。
collocations: in November｜在十一月 ; early November｜十一月初 ; late November｜十一月下旬
tip_zh: 月份首字母大写；月份前用in，具体日期前用on。

meanings_zh: n. 咖啡馆；小餐馆
definition_en: A small place serving drinks and light meals.
example1_en: We shared a sandwich at the cafe beside the station.
example1_zh: 我们在车站旁的小餐馆分着吃了一份三明治。
example2_en: A neighbourhood cafe can strengthen community ties by providing a welcoming space for residents to meet.
example2_zh: 社区咖啡馆可以为居民提供友好的聚会空间，从而加强社区联系。
collocations: outdoor cafe｜露天咖啡馆 ; local cafe｜附近的咖啡馆 ; internet cafe｜网吧
tip_zh: 也写作café；通常提供饮料和简餐。

meanings_zh: v. 居住；生活；活着 | adj. 现场直播的；现场的 | adj. 活的
definition_en: to have your home somewhere, lead a life, or remain alive | broadcast or performed as it happens, rather than recorded | alive rather than dead
example1_en: My grandparents live in a quiet village near the coast.
example1_zh: 我的祖父母住在海边一个安静的村庄里。
example2_en: People who live near public transport often depend less on private cars for their daily journeys.
example2_zh: 住在公共交通设施附近的人日常出行往往较少依赖私家车。
collocations: live alone｜独自居住 ; live a healthy life｜过健康的生活 ; live music｜现场音乐 ; live broadcast｜现场直播
tip_zh: 动词读/lɪv/；形容词及表示现场直播的副词读/laɪv/。

meanings_zh: pron. 她（宾格） | det. 她的
definition_en: the female person or animal receiving an action | belonging to or connected with a female person or animal
example1_en: I called her after lunch to arrange a walk.
example1_zh: 午饭后我给她打了电话，约好一起散步。
example2_en: When a student requests additional support, teachers should help her access appropriate learning resources.
example2_zh: 当一名女学生请求额外支持时，教师应帮助她获取合适的学习资源。
collocations: with her｜和她一起 ; for her｜为她 ; her own｜她自己的
tip_zh: her可作宾语或接名词表所属；hers独立使用。

meanings_zh: adj. 迅速的；敏捷的 | adj. 短暂的；用时少的
definition_en: moving or acting fast, without much delay | taking only a short time
example1_en: Her quick reaction stopped the glass from falling.
example1_zh: 她反应敏捷，及时接住了差点掉落的玻璃杯。
example2_en: A quick response to reports of water pollution can prevent serious damage to nearby ecosystems.
example2_zh: 对水污染报告作出迅速回应，可以防止附近生态系统遭受严重破坏。
collocations: quick response｜迅速的回应 ; quick decision｜迅速的决定 ; quick look｜匆匆一看 ; quick to react｜反应敏捷
tip_zh: 正式表达中用副词quickly修饰动作。

meanings_zh: n. 八月
definition_en: the eighth month of the year
example1_en: We usually visit our grandparents by the sea in August.
example1_zh: 我们通常八月去看望住在海边的祖父母。
example2_en: Tourist destinations often experience increased demand in August, putting pressure on local transport and accommodation.
example2_zh: 旅游目的地的需求往往在八月增加，给当地交通和住宿带来压力。
collocations: in August｜在八月 ; early August｜八月初 ; late August｜八月下旬
tip_zh: 月份首字母大写；月份前用in，具体日期前用on。

meanings_zh: n. 德国
definition_en: a country in central Europe
example1_en: My cousin moved to Germany to study engineering.
example1_zh: 我的表亲搬到德国去学工程了。
example2_en: Germany has invested in renewable energy as part of its efforts to reduce dependence on fossil fuels.
example2_zh: 德国投资可再生能源，以减少对化石燃料的依赖。
collocations: in Germany｜在德国 ; travel to Germany｜去德国旅行 ; made in Germany｜德国制造
tip_zh: Germany是国名；German可指德语、德国人或德国的。

meanings_zh: n. 包；袋 | v. 把……装进袋子
definition_en: A container made from flexible material, used for carrying things. | To put something into a bag.
example1_en: She put the apples in a reusable bag.
example1_zh: 她把苹果放进了一个可重复使用的袋子里。
example2_en: Charging customers for plastic bags can encourage shoppers to adopt more environmentally responsible habits.
example2_zh: 向顾客收取塑料袋费用，可以鼓励购物者养成更环保的习惯。
collocations: a shopping bag｜购物袋 ; a reusable bag｜可重复使用的袋子 ; pack a bag｜收拾行李包
tip_zh: a bag of后接所装物品，如a bag of rice。

meanings_zh: n. 网球运动
definition_en: a sport involving hitting a ball over a net with rackets
example1_en: We play tennis at the park on Sundays.
example1_zh: 我们每逢周日都在公园打网球。
example2_en: Providing affordable tennis lessons can encourage young people to exercise regularly and develop greater physical coordination.
example2_zh: 提供价格实惠的网球课程，可以鼓励年轻人经常锻炼并提高身体协调能力。
collocations: play tennis｜打网球 ; tennis court｜网球场 ; tennis racket｜网球拍 ; tennis match｜网球比赛
tip_zh: 说 play tennis，不加冠词；球拍用 racket。

meanings_zh: n. 猫 | n. 猫科动物
definition_en: A small furry animal often kept as a pet. | An animal belonging to the same family as lions.
example1_en: Our cat sleeps in a sunny spot by the window.
example1_zh: 我们家的猫睡在窗边阳光照得到的地方。
example2_en: Keeping pet cats indoors can help protect native birds, particularly in areas with vulnerable wildlife populations.
example2_zh: 将宠物猫养在室内有助于保护本地鸟类，尤其是在野生动物种群脆弱的地区。
collocations: a pet cat｜宠物猫 ; a stray cat｜流浪猫 ; big cats｜大型猫科动物
tip_zh: big cats指狮、虎等大型猫科动物。

meanings_zh: n. 地方；地点 | v. 放置 | n. 座位；名额
definition_en: A particular area, position, or location. | To put something in a particular position. | A space available for someone to sit, study, or participate.
example1_en: This shady spot is a lovely place for a picnic.
example1_zh: 这处阴凉的地方很适合野餐。
example2_en: Urban planners should place public facilities near residential areas to make essential services accessible to everyone.
example2_zh: 城市规划者应将公共设施设在住宅区附近，让所有人都能方便地获得基本服务。
collocations: a public place｜公共场所 ; place an order｜下订单 ; take place｜发生；举行 ; a university place｜大学录取名额
tip_zh: take place表示发生或举行，不用被动语态。

meanings_zh: n. 连衣裙 | v. 穿衣；给……穿衣 | n. 服装；衣着
definition_en: a one-piece garment with a top and a skirt | to put clothes on yourself or someone else | clothing of a particular type or worn for a particular occasion
example1_en: She wore a blue dress to her sister's party.
example1_zh: 她穿了一条蓝色连衣裙去参加姐姐的聚会。
example2_en: Some employers require formal dress, while others allow staff to wear casual clothing at work.
example2_zh: 有些雇主要求穿正装，而另一些则允许员工上班时穿便装。
collocations: a summer dress｜夏季连衣裙 ; get dressed｜穿好衣服 ; dress code｜着装规定 ; dress up｜盛装打扮
tip_zh: a dress指连衣裙；get dressed指穿好衣服。

meanings_zh: n. 老鼠 | n. 鼠标
definition_en: A small rodent with a pointed nose and long thin tail. | A handheld device for moving a pointer on a computer screen.
example1_en: A tiny mouse slipped behind the cupboard before breakfast.
example1_zh: 早饭前，一只小老鼠溜到了橱柜后面。
example2_en: Using a mouse for long periods may cause wrist discomfort, so office workers should take regular breaks.
example2_zh: 长时间使用鼠标可能引起手腕不适，因此办公室职员应定时休息。
collocations: a field mouse｜田鼠 ; a wireless mouse｜无线鼠标 ; a mouse click｜鼠标单击
tip_zh: 老鼠的复数是mice；鼠标的复数可用mice或mouses。

meanings_zh: n. 汽车；轿车 | n. 火车车厢
definition_en: a road vehicle with wheels, usually carrying a few people | one of the separate sections of a train
example1_en: Our car is parked under the tree outside.
example1_zh: 我们的汽车停在外面的树下。
example2_en: Reducing private car use could improve urban air quality and make streets safer for pedestrians.
example2_zh: 减少私家车使用可以改善城市空气质量，让街道对行人更安全。
collocations: by car｜乘汽车 ; electric car｜电动汽车 ; car park｜停车场 ; dining car｜餐车
tip_zh: by car不加冠词；in a car需要冠词。

meanings_zh: n. 早餐；早饭
definition_en: the meal you eat at the start of the day
example1_en: I usually have breakfast before taking the bus.
example1_zh: 我通常吃完早餐再去坐公交车。
example2_en: Schools that provide a healthy breakfast may help students concentrate better during morning lessons.
example2_zh: 提供健康早餐的学校可能有助于学生在上午的课堂上更加专注。
collocations: have breakfast｜吃早餐 ; skip breakfast｜不吃早餐 ; a balanced breakfast｜营养均衡的早餐
tip_zh: 泛指吃早餐用have breakfast，不加冠词。

meanings_zh: v. 拼写 | n. 一段时间 | n. 咒语；魔法
definition_en: To write or say the letters of a word in order. | A period during which a particular condition or activity continues. | Words or magic believed to have special powers.
example1_en: Could you spell your surname slowly for me, please?
example1_zh: 请你把姓氏慢慢拼给我听，好吗？
example2_en: A prolonged spell of dry weather can reduce crop yields and increase pressure on local water supplies.
example2_zh: 持续的干旱天气会降低农作物产量，并加大当地供水压力。
collocations: spell a word｜拼写单词 ; a dry spell｜一段干旱期 ; a spell of illness｜一段患病期 ; cast a spell｜施咒
tip_zh: 过去式及过去分词英式可用spelt或spelled。

meanings_zh: v. 接住；抓住 | v. 赶上；搭乘 | v. 感染；患上
definition_en: to stop and hold something moving, or capture someone | to reach a bus, train, or plane in time | to become ill with an infectious disease
example1_en: Can you catch the ball with just one hand?
example1_zh: 你能只用一只手接住球吗？
example2_en: More frequent bus services would help commuters catch connecting trains without relying on private cars.
example2_zh: 增加公交班次将帮助通勤者赶上接续列车，而不必依赖私家车。
collocations: catch a ball｜接住球 ; catch a train｜赶上火车 ; catch a cold｜感冒 ; catch someone's attention｜吸引某人的注意
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为caught；感冒用catch a cold。

meanings_zh: v. 爱；热爱；非常喜欢 | n. 爱；爱情；热爱
definition_en: feel deep affection for someone or enjoy something very much | a strong feeling of affection or great enjoyment
example1_en: I love walking by the river after dinner.
example1_zh: 我很喜欢晚饭后沿着河边散步。
example2_en: Schools can develop children's love of reading by providing diverse books and regular library visits.
example2_zh: 学校可以通过提供多样化的图书和安排定期参观图书馆，培养孩子对阅读的热爱。
collocations: fall in love｜爱上 ; love of learning｜对学习的热爱 ; love doing something｜喜欢做某事
tip_zh: love doing和love to do均可表示喜欢做某事。

meanings_zh: num. 四；四个
definition_en: the number after three and before five
example1_en: We put four chairs around the kitchen table.
example1_zh: 我们在厨房桌子周围放了四把椅子。
example2_en: The research team compared four methods of reducing household energy use during the winter months.
example2_zh: 研究团队比较了四种减少冬季家庭能源消耗的方法。
collocations: four times｜四次；四倍 ; four hours｜四小时 ; all four｜全部四个
tip_zh: four是基数词；表示顺序“第四”用fourth。

meanings_zh: v. 展示；给……看 | v. 表明；证明 | n. 演出；节目；展览
definition_en: To let someone see something or demonstrate how something works. | To provide information or evidence that something is true. | A performance, programme, or public display intended for an audience.
example1_en: Please show me how to fold this paper bird.
example1_zh: 请教我怎么折这只纸鸟。
example2_en: Recent studies show that access to green spaces can improve mental wellbeing in urban populations.
example2_zh: 近期研究表明，能够使用绿地有助于改善城市居民的心理健康。
collocations: show someone how to｜教某人如何 ; show that｜表明 ; show an improvement｜显示出改善 ; a live show｜现场演出
tip_zh: 过去式showed，过去分词通常用shown。

meanings_zh: prep. 在……上方 | prep. 超过；高于 | adv. 在上方；在上文
definition_en: In a higher position than something else. | Greater than a particular amount, level, or standard. | In a higher place or earlier in a piece of writing.
example1_en: A small wooden shelf hangs above the kitchen sink.
example1_zh: 厨房水槽上方挂着一个小木架。
example2_en: Temperatures above the seasonal average can increase water demand and put pressure on urban supplies.
example2_zh: 高于当季平均水平的气温会增加用水需求，给城市供水带来压力。
collocations: above sea level｜高于海平面 ; above average｜高于平均水平 ; above all｜最重要的是 ; as mentioned above｜如上所述
tip_zh: above 表示位置更高，不一定正上方，也不表示接触。

meanings_zh: n. 初学者；新手
definition_en: someone who has just started learning or doing something
example1_en: This swimming class is perfect for a complete beginner.
example1_zh: 这堂游泳课非常适合完全没有基础的初学者。
example2_en: Courses designed for beginners should provide clear guidance and regular opportunities to practise new skills.
example2_zh: 为初学者设计的课程应提供清晰的指导，以及定期练习新技能的机会。
collocations: a complete beginner｜零基础初学者 ; suitable for beginners｜适合初学者 ; a beginner's guide｜入门指南
tip_zh: beginner是可数名词，单数前通常要有限定词。

meanings_zh: v. 哭；流泪 | v. 喊叫；呼喊 | n. 叫声；喊声
definition_en: Produce tears because of sadness, pain, or strong emotion. | Call out loudly because of strong emotion or urgent need. | A loud sound expressing emotion or attracting attention.
example1_en: The baby began to cry when her toy fell.
example1_zh: 玩具掉了，宝宝就哭了起来。
example2_en: Young children may cry when separated from their parents, so schools should provide a welcoming environment.
example2_zh: 幼儿与父母分开时可能会哭，因此学校应营造亲切友好的环境。
collocations: cry for help｜呼救 ; cry with joy｜喜极而泣 ; a loud cry｜一声大喊 ; have a good cry｜痛哭一场
tip_zh: 过去式cried；现在分词crying；表示喊叫常用cry out。

meanings_zh: v. 购买 | v. 相信；接受 | n. 买到的东西；合算的购买
definition_en: to obtain something by paying money for it | to believe an explanation or accept an idea | something bought, especially something offering good value
example1_en: I need to buy some bread before breakfast.
example1_zh: 我需要在吃早饭前买些面包。
example2_en: Consumers can reduce packaging waste when they buy fresh produce from local markets.
example2_zh: 消费者在当地市场购买新鲜农产品时，可以减少包装废弃物。
collocations: buy in bulk｜批量购买 ; buy second-hand｜购买二手物品 ; buy time｜争取时间 ; a good buy｜合算的购买
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为bought；不要写成buyed。

meanings_zh: adj. 短的；短暂的；矮的 | adj. 不足的；短缺的 | adv. 未达到；突然停止
definition_en: Having little length, height, or duration. | Not having as much of something as is needed. | Before reaching a target, or with a sudden stop.
example1_en: We took a short walk before dinner tonight.
example1_zh: 今晚晚饭前，我们散了一小会儿步。
example2_en: Short training courses can help unemployed adults acquire practical skills without committing to several years of study.
example2_zh: 短期培训课程能帮助失业成年人获得实用技能，而不必投入数年时间学习。
collocations: a short distance｜一小段距离 ; short of time｜时间不足 ; in the short term｜短期内 ; fall short of｜未达到
tip_zh: short of表示缺少；shortly通常意为“不久”。

meanings_zh: n. 句子 | n. 刑罚；判决 | v. 判刑；宣判
definition_en: a group of words expressing a complete statement, question, or command | a punishment officially given by a court | to officially give someone a punishment in court
example1_en: Our teacher asked us to write one sentence about autumn.
example1_zh: 老师让我们写一个关于秋天的句子。
example2_en: Learning to vary sentence length can help students express complex ideas more clearly in academic essays.
example2_zh: 学会变化句子长度，可以帮助学生在学术文章中更清晰地表达复杂观点。
collocations: complete sentence｜完整的句子 ; sentence structure｜句子结构 ; prison sentence｜监禁刑罚 ; sentence someone to｜判处某人……刑罚
tip_zh: 判某人某种刑罚用sentence sb to sth。

meanings_zh: v. 穿；戴 | v. 磨损；用旧 | n. 磨损；损耗
definition_en: to have clothes, jewellery, or accessories on your body | to damage or become damaged through repeated use | damage caused by regular use over time
example1_en: I always wear thick socks when the floor feels cold.
example1_zh: 地板凉的时候，我总会穿上厚袜子。
example2_en: Encouraging employees to wear protective equipment can significantly reduce the risk of injuries in industrial workplaces.
example2_zh: 鼓励员工穿戴防护装备，可以显著降低工业场所的工伤风险。
collocations: wear glasses｜戴眼镜 ; wear a uniform｜穿制服 ; wear out｜磨坏；用坏 ; wear and tear｜日常磨损
tip_zh: wear强调穿戴状态，put on强调动作；过去式wore。

meanings_zh: n. 一天；一日 | n. 白天；白昼 | n. 时期；年代
definition_en: a period of twenty-four hours | the part of each day when there is natural light | a particular period in the past or present
example1_en: We spent the whole day building sandcastles on the beach.
example1_zh: 我们一整天都在海滩上堆沙堡。
example2_en: Shorter working days may improve employee wellbeing while allowing parents to spend more time with their children.
example2_zh: 缩短每日工作时间可能改善员工的身心状态，同时让家长有更多时间陪伴孩子。
collocations: every day｜每天 ; during the day｜在白天 ; a day off｜休息的一天 ; these days｜如今
tip_zh: every day意为每天；everyday是形容词，意为日常的。

meanings_zh: n. 家庭作业 | n. 事前准备工作
definition_en: Schoolwork that students are asked to complete outside lessons. | Research or preparation done before making a decision.
example1_en: I finished my homework before dinner and went outside.
example1_zh: 我在晚饭前做完了作业，然后出门了。
example2_en: Schools should limit homework so that children have enough time for exercise and family activities.
example2_zh: 学校应限制家庭作业量，让孩子有足够的时间锻炼和参加家庭活动。
collocations: do homework｜做家庭作业 ; hand in homework｜交作业 ; do your homework｜做好事前准备
tip_zh: 不可数名词；一项作业用a piece of homework。

meanings_zh: adj. 更好的；更合适的 | adv. 更好地 | adj. 身体好转的
definition_en: Of higher quality or more suitable than something else. | In a more effective or satisfactory way. | Less ill than before.
example1_en: This backpack is better than my old one.
example1_zh: 这个背包比我原来的那个好。
example2_en: Better public transport can reduce traffic congestion and improve access to employment in growing cities.
example2_zh: 更好的公共交通能缓解交通拥堵，并改善发展中城市的就业可达性。
collocations: better than｜比……更好 ; feel better｜感觉好些 ; better understanding｜更深入的理解 ; much better｜好得多
tip_zh: 是good和well的比较级，不说more better。

meanings_zh: prep. 进入；到……里面 | prep. 变成 | prep. 对……很感兴趣
definition_en: towards and then inside something | used to show the result of a change | interested in or enthusiastic about something
example1_en: The kitten jumped into the basket beside my chair.
example1_zh: 小猫跳进了我椅子旁的篮子里。
example2_en: Converting unused offices into affordable housing could help cities address shortages without expanding into surrounding countryside.
example2_zh: 将闲置办公室改造成经济适用住房，可帮助城市缓解住房短缺，而不必向周边乡村扩张。
collocations: walk into a room｜走进房间 ; turn into｜变成 ; be into music｜热衷音乐 ; look into a problem｜调查问题
tip_zh: into强调进入的过程；in通常表示在里面。

meanings_zh: n. 自行车 | v. 骑自行车
definition_en: a two-wheeled vehicle moved by pushing pedals | to travel by bicycle
example1_en: I locked my bicycle outside the small bakery.
example1_zh: 我把自行车锁在那家小面包店外面。
example2_en: Travelling by bicycle can reduce urban air pollution while providing residents with regular physical exercise.
example2_zh: 骑自行车出行既能减少城市空气污染，也能让居民经常锻炼身体。
collocations: ride a bicycle｜骑自行车 ; by bicycle｜骑自行车出行 ; bicycle lane｜自行车道 ; bicycle helmet｜自行车头盔
tip_zh: by bicycle不加冠词；ride a bicycle要加冠词。

meanings_zh: v. 拜访；参观；游览 | n. 拜访；参观；逗留
definition_en: To go to see a person or place. | An occasion when someone goes to see someone or somewhere.
example1_en: We visited our neighbours and shared some homemade soup.
example1_zh: 我们去拜访邻居，和他们分享了一些自制的汤。
example2_en: Students who visit science museums can connect classroom theories with practical examples from everyday life.
example2_zh: 参观科学博物馆的学生能够把课堂理论与日常生活中的实际例子联系起来。
collocations: visit relatives｜探望亲戚 ; pay a visit to｜拜访；参观 ; a guided visit｜有导游陪同的参观
tip_zh: 动词visit后直接接宾语；名词用a visit to。

meanings_zh: pron. 每个人；所有人
definition_en: Every person in a group, or all people.
example1_en: Everyone brought a dish to share at the picnic.
example1_zh: 每个人都带了一道菜，在野餐时一起分享。
example2_en: Public libraries should ensure that everyone can access reliable information, regardless of income or educational background.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆应确保每个人都能获取可靠信息，不论收入或教育背景如何。
collocations: everyone else｜其他所有人 ; almost everyone｜几乎所有人 ; everyone involved｜所有相关人员
tip_zh: everyone接单数谓语；every one强调逐个。

meanings_zh: adj. 错误的；不合适的 | adj. 不道德的；不正当的 | adv. 错误地；出差错地
definition_en: Not correct, accurate, or suitable. | Not morally acceptable or fair. | In an incorrect way, or with an unsuccessful result.
example1_en: I took the wrong bus and ended up near the airport.
example1_zh: 我坐错了公交车，结果到了机场附近。
example2_en: It is wrong to deny children educational opportunities simply because their families cannot afford school fees.
example2_zh: 仅仅因为家庭付不起学费就剥夺儿童受教育的机会，是不正当的。
collocations: the wrong answer｜错误答案 ; go wrong｜出问题 ; get something wrong｜把某事弄错 ; something is wrong with｜……出了问题
tip_zh: go wrong表示出问题；wrong的词首w不发音。

meanings_zh: n. 问题；困难 | n. 习题；待解答的问题
definition_en: a situation that causes difficulty and needs a solution | a question requiring thought or calculation to answer
example1_en: There's a problem with the kitchen tap: it keeps dripping.
example1_zh: 厨房的水龙头有问题：它一直滴水。
example2_en: Traffic congestion is a growing problem that requires investment in reliable public transport rather than additional roads.
example2_zh: 交通拥堵是日益严重的问题，需要投资建设可靠的公共交通，而不是增建道路。
collocations: solve a problem｜解决问题 ; a major problem｜重大问题 ; a maths problem｜数学题 ; a problem with｜……存在的问题
tip_zh: ……有问题用a problem with；问题的解决办法用to。

meanings_zh: n. 叔伯；舅舅；姑姨父
definition_en: a parent's brother or an aunt's husband
example1_en: My uncle taught me how to mend a bicycle.
example1_zh: 我叔叔教过我怎样修自行车。
example2_en: An uncle or aunt can provide valuable emotional support when parents are busy with work commitments.
example2_zh: 父母忙于工作时，叔伯姑姨等亲属可以提供宝贵的情感支持。
collocations: maternal uncle｜舅舅 ; paternal uncle｜伯父或叔父 ; uncle and aunt｜叔伯姑姨等亲属
tip_zh: uncle不区分父母哪一方，也不区分长幼。

meanings_zh: n. 钥匙 | n. 关键；秘诀 | adj. 关键的；主要的
definition_en: An object shaped to open or close a particular lock. | Something essential for understanding or achieving something. | Extremely important to a situation or its outcome.
example1_en: I left my house key in my coat pocket.
example1_zh: 我把家门钥匙放在外套口袋里了。
example2_en: Access to reliable information is key to helping consumers make informed decisions about their health.
example2_zh: 获取可靠信息是帮助消费者就自身健康作出明智决定的关键。
collocations: a spare key｜备用钥匙 ; the key to success｜成功的关键 ; a key factor｜关键因素 ; play a key role｜发挥关键作用
tip_zh: the key to中to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: v. 说话；交谈 | v. 会说；使用某种语言 | v. 发言；演讲
definition_en: Use your voice to say words or communicate with someone. | Be able to communicate in a particular language. | Address an audience about a subject.
example1_en: Could I speak to you after the lesson?
example1_zh: 下课后我能和你谈谈吗？
example2_en: Students who speak more than one language may find it easier to communicate across cultural boundaries.
example2_zh: 会说多种语言的学生可能更容易进行跨文化交流。
collocations: speak fluently｜流利地说 ; speak in public｜公开发言 ; speak to someone｜与某人交谈 ; speak up｜大声说；发表意见
tip_zh: 过去式spoke，过去分词spoken；语言前不用介词。

meanings_zh: v. 阅读；读懂 | v. 朗读 | v. 看懂；解读
definition_en: to look at written words and understand their meaning | to say written words aloud | to understand information shown by something
example1_en: I read a few pages before bed every night.
example1_zh: 我每天晚上睡前都会读几页书。
example2_en: Children who read regularly often develop stronger language skills and a broader understanding of the world.
example2_zh: 经常阅读的儿童通常能培养更强的语言能力，对世界也有更广泛的了解。
collocations: read aloud｜大声朗读 ; read a map｜看地图 ; read widely｜广泛阅读
tip_zh: 原形读/riːd/；过去式及过去分词读/red/。

meanings_zh: n. 电子邮件；电子邮件通信 | v. 给……发电子邮件
definition_en: An electronic message, or the system used to send it | Send someone a message using email
example1_en: Please email me the photos from our camping trip.
example1_zh: 请把我们露营旅行的照片通过电子邮件发给我。
example2_en: Although email enables rapid communication, excessive messages can distract employees and reduce productivity at work.
example2_zh: 虽然电子邮件可以实现快速沟通，但过多的邮件会分散员工注意力，降低工作效率。
collocations: send an email｜发送电子邮件 ; check your email｜查看电子邮件 ; an email address｜电子邮箱地址 ; by email｜通过电子邮件
tip_zh: 指一封邮件时可数；指通信方式时不可数，如by email。

meanings_zh: n. 测验；测试；检查 | v. 测验；检测；检验
definition_en: a procedure that checks knowledge, ability, condition, or performance | to check what someone knows or how something performs
example1_en: I have a spelling test at school tomorrow.
example1_zh: 我明天在学校有拼写测验。
example2_en: Researchers must test new materials under different conditions before recommending their use in public buildings.
example2_zh: 研究人员必须在不同条件下测试新材料，才能建议将其用于公共建筑。
collocations: take a test｜参加测验 ; blood test｜血液检查 ; test a theory｜检验理论 ; test results｜测试结果
tip_zh: 参加测验用take a test；通过测验用pass a test。

meanings_zh: n. 七月
definition_en: The seventh month of the year, following June
example1_en: We usually visit our cousins for a week in July.
example1_zh: 我们通常在七月去表亲家住一周。
example2_en: In many northern countries, tourism peaks in July, creating seasonal jobs but increasing pressure on local services.
example2_zh: 在许多北方国家，旅游业在七月达到高峰，创造了季节性岗位，却也增加了当地公共服务的压力。
collocations: in July｜在七月 ; early July｜七月初 ; late July｜七月下旬 ; by the end of July｜到七月底之前
tip_zh: 月份首字母大写；表示在七月用in July。

meanings_zh: num. 零 | n. 零度；零点
definition_en: The number representing no quantity. | The point marked as nothing on a measuring scale.
example1_en: The temperature fell below zero while we were sleeping.
example1_zh: 我们睡觉时，气温降到了零度以下。
example2_en: Achieving zero carbon emissions will require substantial investment in renewable energy, public transport, and more efficient buildings.
example2_zh: 实现零碳排放需要对可再生能源、公共交通和能效更高的建筑进行大量投资。
collocations: below zero｜零度以下 ; zero emissions｜零排放 ; zero tolerance｜零容忍 ; absolute zero｜绝对零度
tip_zh: 读电话号码时零也常读作oh；温度用zero。

meanings_zh: adv. 再一次；又
definition_en: One more time, or on another occasion.
example1_en: Could you say that again a little more slowly?
example1_zh: 你能再说一遍，稍微慢一点吗？
example2_en: If cities fail to address the causes of congestion, the same transport problems will occur again.
example2_zh: 如果城市不解决交通拥堵的成因，同样的交通问题就会再次出现。
collocations: try again｜再试一次 ; once again｜再一次 ; again and again｜一再；反复 ; never again｜再也不
tip_zh: again表示重复；again and again强调反复多次。

meanings_zh: int. 你好；喂 | n. 问候；招呼
definition_en: used to greet someone or begin a phone conversation | a greeting spoken when meeting someone
example1_en: Hello, would you like to sit next to me?
example1_zh: 你好，你愿意坐在我旁边吗？
example2_en: A simple hello between neighbours can encourage social contact and help newcomers feel welcome in a community.
example2_zh: 邻里之间一句简单的问候就能促进交往，让新来者感受到社区的欢迎。
collocations: say hello｜打招呼 ; hello there｜你好呀 ; a friendly hello｜友好的问候
tip_zh: 电话开头的hello可译为“喂”；say hello to表示向某人问好。

meanings_zh: n. 人；人们 | n. 民族
definition_en: Human beings considered together or referred to in general. | A group sharing a culture, history, or national identity.
example1_en: Several people were waiting outside the bakery this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早晨，有几个人在面包店外等候。
example2_en: Cities should provide accessible public transport so that people of all ages can travel independently.
example2_zh: 城市应提供无障碍公共交通，让各年龄段的人都能独立出行。
collocations: local people｜当地人 ; young people｜年轻人 ; indigenous peoples｜原住民族 ; people from all walks of life｜各行各业的人
tip_zh: 表示人们时用people；peoples指多个民族。

meanings_zh: n. 加拿大
definition_en: a country in North America, north of the United States
example1_en: My cousin moved to Canada to study environmental science.
example1_zh: 我的表亲搬到加拿大去学习环境科学。
example2_en: Canada attracts international students through its universities, although living costs vary considerably between cities.
example2_zh: 加拿大的大学吸引着国际学生，不过各城市的生活成本差异很大。
collocations: study in Canada｜在加拿大学习 ; across Canada｜遍及加拿大 ; move to Canada｜移居加拿大
tip_zh: 国名首字母大写，前面通常不加the。

meanings_zh: n. 猴子
definition_en: A primate that usually has a tail and climbs trees.
example1_en: A little monkey swung between branches above our heads.
example1_zh: 一只小猴子在我们头顶的树枝间荡来荡去。
example2_en: Protecting tropical forests helps preserve monkey populations and the complex ecosystems on which they depend.
example2_zh: 保护热带森林有助于保护猴类种群及其赖以生存的复杂生态系统。
collocations: a troop of monkeys｜一群猴子 ; wild monkeys｜野生猴子 ; monkey around｜胡闹
tip_zh: monkey通常有尾巴；ape指猿类，通常无尾。

meanings_zh: v. 坐；坐下 | v. 位于；坐落于 | v. 参加考试
definition_en: to rest with your weight supported by your bottom | to be in a particular place or position | to take an examination
example1_en: Come and sit beside me on the garden bench.
example1_zh: 过来坐在花园长椅上，坐我旁边。
example2_en: Students who sit for long periods should take regular breaks to support their physical health.
example2_zh: 长时间坐着的学生应定期休息，以维护身体健康。
collocations: sit down｜坐下 ; sit still｜坐着不动 ; sit an exam｜参加考试 ; sit beside someone｜坐在某人旁边
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为sat；现在分词为sitting。

meanings_zh: n. 座位 | v. 使就座；容纳……就座 | n. 议席；席位
definition_en: A place or object for someone to sit on. | To provide a sitting place or have room for seated people. | A position as a member of an elected body.
example1_en: She saved me a seat near the front.
example1_zh: 她在靠前的位置给我留了一个座位。
example2_en: Providing more seats on public transport would make daily travel easier for older passengers and families.
example2_zh: 在公共交通工具上增加座位，会让老年乘客和家庭的日常出行更方便。
collocations: take a seat｜坐下 ; a window seat｜靠窗座位 ; reserve a seat｜预订座位 ; win a seat｜赢得议席
tip_zh: sit是不及物动词；seat常接人，be seated表就座。

meanings_zh: n. 杯子；一杯的量 | n. 奖杯 | v. 使呈杯状；捧住
definition_en: A small drinking container, or the amount it holds. | A decorative container awarded for winning a competition. | To curve your hands into a hollow shape to hold something.
example1_en: I warmed my hands around a cup of tea.
example1_zh: 我双手捧着一杯茶取暖。
example2_en: Encouraging customers to bring a reusable cup can help cafés reduce waste from disposable packaging.
example2_zh: 鼓励顾客自带可重复使用的杯子，可以帮助咖啡馆减少一次性包装垃圾。
collocations: a cup of tea｜一杯茶 ; a reusable cup｜可重复使用的杯子 ; win the cup｜赢得奖杯 ; cup your hands｜将双手拢成杯状
tip_zh: a cup of后接饮品；cup作动词可表示用手捧住。

meanings_zh: n. 电影 | v. 拍摄 | n. 薄膜；胶卷
definition_en: a story or events recorded as moving pictures | to record moving pictures using a camera | a thin layer, or material used to record photographs
example1_en: We watched a funny film after dinner yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天晚饭后，我们看了一部有趣的电影。
example2_en: Documentary films can raise public awareness of environmental problems by showing their effects on local communities.
example2_zh: 纪录片可以通过展示环境问题对当地社区的影响，提高公众的环保意识。
collocations: watch a film｜看电影 ; film industry｜电影业 ; a thin film of oil｜一层薄薄的油膜
tip_zh: 表示电影时，film偏英式，movie偏美式。

meanings_zh: n. 美国 | n. 美洲
definition_en: the United States of America | North and South America considered together
example1_en: My cousin moved to America to study engineering.
example1_zh: 我的表亲搬到美国去学工程。
example2_en: Many universities in America attract international students through their research facilities and diverse academic programmes.
example2_zh: 美国的许多大学凭借研究设施和多样化的学术课程吸引国际学生。
collocations: North America｜北美洲 ; South America｜南美洲 ; across America｜遍及美国
tip_zh: 日常多指美国；南北美洲合称常用the Americas。

meanings_zh: n. 星期一
definition_en: the day after Sunday and before Tuesday
example1_en: We usually buy fresh fruit at the market on Monday.
example1_zh: 我们通常在星期一去市场买新鲜水果。
example2_en: Many employees find Monday mornings stressful because they must deal with tasks accumulated over the weekend.
example2_zh: 许多员工觉得星期一早上压力很大，因为他们必须处理周末积压的任务。
collocations: on Monday｜在星期一 ; Monday morning｜星期一早上 ; every Monday｜每周一 ; from Monday to Friday｜从星期一到星期五
tip_zh: 星期首字母大写；用on Monday，但next Monday前不加on。

meanings_zh: n. 瑞典
definition_en: a country in northern Europe, with Stockholm as its capital
example1_en: We travelled through Sweden by train last summer.
example1_zh: 去年夏天，我们乘火车游览了瑞典。
example2_en: Sweden is frequently discussed in international debates about public welfare, environmental policy, and the funding of education.
example2_zh: 在有关公共福利、环境政策和教育经费的国际讨论中，瑞典经常被提及。
collocations: southern Sweden｜瑞典南部 ; travel to Sweden｜前往瑞典旅行 ; Sweden's capital｜瑞典首都
tip_zh: Sweden是瑞典；Switzerland才是瑞士。

meanings_zh: adv. 其他；另外 | adv. 否则；要不然
definition_en: In addition to or different from someone or something mentioned | Used after or to introduce an alternative or consequence
example1_en: Would you like anything else with your soup?
example1_zh: 除了汤，你还想要点别的吗？
example2_en: Governments must improve public transport, or else growing traffic congestion may undermine the economic benefits of urban development.
example2_zh: 政府必须改善公共交通，否则日益严重的交通拥堵可能削弱城市发展带来的经济效益。
collocations: someone else｜其他人 ; anything else｜其他东西 ; what else｜还有什么 ; or else｜否则
tip_zh: 放在不定代词或疑问词后，如someone else。

meanings_zh: n. 葡萄牙
definition_en: A country in southwestern Europe, west of Spain.
example1_en: We travelled along the coast of Portugal by train.
example1_zh: 我们乘火车沿葡萄牙海岸旅行。
example2_en: Tourism contributes to the economy of Portugal, but coastal development requires careful planning to protect natural habitats.
example2_zh: 旅游业为葡萄牙经济作出贡献，但沿海开发需要周密规划，以保护自然栖息地。
collocations: mainland Portugal｜葡萄牙本土 ; northern Portugal｜葡萄牙北部 ; the coast of Portugal｜葡萄牙海岸
tip_zh: 国名前通常不加the；Portuguese指葡语或葡萄牙的。

meanings_zh: prep. 在……里面；在……中 | prep. 在……期间；在……之后 | adv. 在里面；进入；在家
definition_en: Inside a place, container, or larger area. | During a period or after a stated amount of time. | Inside a place, moving inside, or at home.
example1_en: Your keys are in the bowl beside the door.
example1_zh: 你的钥匙在门边的碗里。
example2_en: Investment in public libraries can help reduce educational inequality and strengthen connections within local communities.
example2_zh: 对公共图书馆的投资有助于减少教育不平等，并加强当地社区内部的联系。
collocations: in advance｜提前 ; in the morning｜在早上 ; in public｜公开地；在公共场合 ; in time｜及时
tip_zh: in two days常指两天后；月份、年份前也用in。

meanings_zh: n. 顶部；顶端 | adj. 最高的；最好的 | v. 位居……之首；超过
definition_en: the highest part or surface of something | highest in position, rank, or quality | to rank highest or be greater than something
example1_en: She placed the star on top of the tree.
example1_zh: 她把那颗星星放在树顶上。
example2_en: Improving access to affordable housing should be a top priority for governments facing rapid urban population growth.
example2_zh: 对于面临城市人口快速增长的政府来说，改善居民获得可负担住房的机会应是首要任务。
collocations: at the top of｜在……顶端 ; top priority｜首要任务 ; top marks｜最高分 ; top the list｜位居榜首
tip_zh: on top of指在上面；at the top of指在顶端。

meanings_zh: adj. 紫色的 | n. 紫色
definition_en: Having a colour made by mixing red and blue | A colour between red and blue
example1_en: He wore a purple scarf with his grey coat.
example1_zh: 他穿着灰色外套，围了一条紫色围巾。
example2_en: Garden designers often combine purple flowers with yellow varieties to create a striking visual contrast.
example2_zh: 花园设计师常将紫色花卉与黄色品种搭配，形成鲜明的视觉反差。
collocations: dark purple｜深紫色 ; pale purple｜浅紫色 ; purple flowers｜紫色花朵
tip_zh: purple可作形容词或名词；purplish表示“略带紫色的”。

meanings_zh: n. 瓶子；一瓶的量 | v. 把……装瓶
definition_en: A narrow-necked container for liquids, or the amount it holds. | To put a liquid into bottles for storage or sale.
example1_en: She filled her water bottle before leaving the house.
example1_zh: 她出门前把水瓶装满了。
example2_en: Choosing a reusable bottle instead of disposable plastic containers can help reduce waste in cities.
example2_zh: 选择可重复使用的瓶子而非一次性塑料容器，有助于减少城市垃圾。
collocations: a bottle of water｜一瓶水 ; reusable bottle｜可重复使用的瓶子 ; bottle cap｜瓶盖 ; bottled water｜瓶装水
tip_zh: a bottle of water是一瓶水；water bottle是水瓶。

meanings_zh: n. 六月
definition_en: The sixth month of the year, between May and July.
example1_en: My sister is getting married in June this year.
example1_zh: 我姐姐今年六月要结婚了。
example2_en: The community centre will open in June, providing local residents with affordable exercise classes.
example2_zh: 社区中心将于六月开放，为当地居民提供价格实惠的健身课程。
collocations: in June｜在六月 ; early June｜六月上旬 ; by the end of June｜到六月底为止
tip_zh: 月份首字母大写；在六月用in June。

meanings_zh: v. 转动；转向 | v. 变得；变成 | n. 轮到的机会；轮次
definition_en: Move around a centre or change direction. | Change to a different state, colour, or condition. | An opportunity to do something in an agreed order.
example1_en: Turn the handle gently and pull the door towards you.
example1_zh: 轻轻转动把手，然后朝自己这边拉门。
example2_en: As populations age, governments must turn their attention to accessible housing and community healthcare.
example2_zh: 随着人口老龄化，政府必须将注意力转向无障碍住房和社区医疗。
collocations: turn left｜向左转 ; turn red｜变红 ; take turns｜轮流 ; turn into｜变成
tip_zh: 表示变得时，turn后接形容词；turn into后接名词。

meanings_zh: n. 块；片；件 | n. 文章；艺术作品 | v. 拼合；拼凑
definition_en: a part of something or a single item | a work of writing, music, or art | to join separate parts to make something complete
example1_en: She saved the last piece of cake for her brother.
example1_zh: 她把最后一块蛋糕留给了弟弟。
example2_en: Each piece of evidence should be carefully assessed before researchers draw conclusions about environmental change.
example2_zh: 研究人员在对环境变化作出结论前，应仔细评估每一项证据。
collocations: a piece of advice｜一条建议 ; a piece of equipment｜一件设备 ; a piece of music｜一首乐曲 ; piece together｜拼凑；拼合
tip_zh: a piece of可量化advice等不可数名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 粉红色的 | n. 粉红色
definition_en: having a pale red colour | a colour made by mixing red with white
example1_en: The tree outside our window has pink flowers.
example1_zh: 我们窗外的树开着粉红色的花。
example2_en: Designers often use soft colours such as pink to create a welcoming atmosphere in children's healthcare facilities.
example2_zh: 设计师常用粉红色等柔和色彩，为儿童医疗机构营造温馨的氛围。
collocations: pale pink｜浅粉色 ; bright pink｜亮粉色 ; turn pink｜变成粉红色
tip_zh: pink既可作形容词，也可作名词表示粉红色。

meanings_zh: n. 课；一节课 | n. 教训；经验
definition_en: A period of teaching or learning a particular subject. | Something useful learned from an experience, especially a mistake.
example1_en: Our swimming lesson starts after school on Thursday.
example1_zh: 我们的游泳课在周四放学后开始。
example2_en: A key lesson from previous environmental policies is that effective regulation requires consistent monitoring and public support.
example2_zh: 以往环境政策带来的一条重要经验是，有效监管需要持续监测和公众支持。
collocations: take lessons｜上课学习 ; piano lesson｜钢琴课 ; learn a lesson｜吸取教训 ; a valuable lesson｜宝贵的经验
tip_zh: learn a lesson常指吸取教训，不只是学习课程。

meanings_zh: n. 花园；菜园 | v. 从事园艺
definition_en: an area of land where flowers or vegetables are grown | to grow and care for plants in a garden
example1_en: We picked fresh beans from the garden before lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭前，我们从菜园里摘了新鲜的豆角。
example2_en: Community gardens can strengthen neighbourhood relationships while giving urban residents access to fresh vegetables and green space.
example2_zh: 社区花园既能加强邻里关系，又能让城市居民获得新鲜蔬菜和绿色空间。
collocations: vegetable garden｜菜园 ; community garden｜社区花园 ; botanical garden｜植物园 ; garden tools｜园艺工具
tip_zh: 英式garden可指住宅庭院；美式常用yard。

meanings_zh: n. 地理学 | n. 地理特征；地形
definition_en: the study of Earth's places, environments, and human activity | the physical features and arrangement of a particular area
example1_en: In geography today, we learned how rivers shape valleys.
example1_zh: 今天的地理课上，我们学习了河流如何塑造河谷。
example2_en: The geography of coastal regions influences settlement patterns and determines how communities respond to rising sea levels.
example2_zh: 沿海地区的地理特征影响聚居格局，并决定当地社区如何应对海平面上升。
collocations: physical geography｜自然地理学 ; human geography｜人文地理学 ; study geography｜学习地理
tip_zh: geography是地理学；geology是地质学。

meanings_zh: n. 盐；食盐 | v. 给……加盐；用盐腌
definition_en: a white substance used to flavour or preserve food | to add salt to food or preserve it with salt
example1_en: Please pass the salt before the soup gets cold.
example1_zh: 趁汤还没凉，请把盐递过来。
example2_en: Reducing salt intake is an effective way to lower the risk of high blood pressure.
example2_zh: 减少盐的摄入量是降低高血压风险的有效方法。
collocations: a pinch of salt｜一小撮盐 ; salt intake｜盐摄入量 ; sea salt｜海盐 ; add salt｜加盐
tip_zh: 食盐通常不可数；“一小撮盐”用a pinch of salt。

meanings_zh: prep. 直到……为止 | conj. 直到……时
definition_en: Up to a particular time or event. | Up to the time when something happens.
example1_en: We waited outside until the rain finally stopped.
example1_zh: 我们在外面一直等到雨终于停了。
example2_en: Governments should continue supporting renewable energy until cleaner technologies become affordable for the majority of households.
example2_zh: 政府应持续支持可再生能源，直到大多数家庭都能负担得起更清洁的技术。
collocations: until recently｜直到最近 ; until further notice｜直至另行通知 ; not until｜直到……才
tip_zh: until强调持续到某时；by强调不迟于某时。

meanings_zh: det. 每个；各个 | pron. 每一个；各自 | adv. 每人；每个
definition_en: Every individual member of a group, considered separately. | Every person or thing in a group, taken separately. | For every individual person or thing.
example1_en: Each child carried a small basket into the garden.
example1_zh: 每个孩子都提着一个小篮子走进花园。
example2_en: Each household can reduce its environmental impact by conserving water and choosing products with less packaging.
example2_zh: 每个家庭都可以通过节约用水和选择包装较少的产品来减少对环境的影响。
collocations: each student｜每个学生 ; each of us｜我们每个人 ; each time｜每次 ; each other｜彼此
tip_zh: each后接单数名词；each of后接复数名词或代词。

meanings_zh: n. 成年女性（复数）
definition_en: More than one adult female person.
example1_en: Three women were planting flowers in the shared garden.
example1_zh: 三位女性正在公共花园里种花。
example2_en: Equal access to education enables more women to pursue careers in science and technology.
example2_zh: 平等的受教育机会使更多女性能够从事科技领域的职业。
collocations: women's health｜女性健康 ; women's rights｜女性权利 ; women in leadership｜担任领导职务的女性
tip_zh: woman的复数；首音节读/wɪ/，不是/wʊ/。

meanings_zh: n. 情绪；感受 | n. 知觉；身体感觉 | n. 直觉；看法
definition_en: An emotional state or response to something | A physical sensation or the ability to sense touch | An impression or belief not necessarily supported by evidence
example1_en: A feeling of relief washed over me after the exam.
example1_zh: 考试结束后，我顿时感到如释重负。
example2_en: A strong feeling of belonging can improve students' confidence and encourage participation in school activities.
example2_zh: 强烈的归属感可以增强学生的自信，并鼓励他们参与学校活动。
collocations: a feeling of relief｜如释重负的感觉 ; hurt someone's feelings｜伤害某人的感情 ; lose feeling｜失去知觉 ; mixed feelings｜复杂的心情
tip_zh: feelings常指感情；have a feeling that表示直觉。

meanings_zh: n. 洗澡；泡澡 | n. 浴缸
definition_en: Washing your body while sitting or lying in water. | A large container that you fill with water for washing yourself.
example1_en: A warm bath helped me relax after the hike.
example1_zh: 徒步之后，泡个温水澡让我放松了下来。
example2_en: Taking shorter showers instead of a daily bath can reduce household water consumption significantly.
example2_zh: 用较短时间的淋浴代替每天泡澡，可以显著减少家庭用水量。
collocations: have a bath｜洗澡 ; take a bath｜洗澡 ; run a bath｜给浴缸放水 ; hot bath｜热水澡
tip_zh: 英式常说have a bath；美式常说take a bath。

meanings_zh: num. 九
definition_en: The number after eight and before ten.
example1_en: We packed nine apples for our picnic today.
example1_zh: 我们为今天的野餐装了九个苹果。
example2_en: The survey found that nine local schools had introduced cycling lessons to encourage more sustainable travel.
example2_zh: 调查发现，当地九所学校已开设骑行课程，以鼓励更可持续的出行。
collocations: nine o'clock｜九点钟 ; nine times out of ten｜十有八九 ; nine months｜九个月
tip_zh: nine是基数词；序数词第九写作ninth。

meanings_zh: num. 十二
definition_en: the number after eleven and before thirteen
example1_en: There are twelve fresh eggs in this carton.
example1_zh: 这个蛋盒里有十二枚新鲜鸡蛋。
example2_en: The training programme lasts twelve weeks and combines practical experience with classroom instruction for young adults.
example2_zh: 这项培训为期十二周，为年轻成年人提供实践经验与课堂教学相结合的学习。
collocations: twelve months｜十二个月 ; twelve o'clock｜十二点 ; twelve years old｜十二岁
tip_zh: twelve是基数词；序数词twelfth拼写有变化。

meanings_zh: n. 片刻；一会儿 | n. 时刻；时机
definition_en: A very short period of time. | A particular point in time, sometimes especially important.
example1_en: Wait a moment while I put my shoes on.
example1_zh: 等一会儿，我穿上鞋就好。
example2_en: The opening of the new railway marked a significant moment in the region's economic development.
example2_zh: 新铁路的开通标志着该地区经济发展中的一个重要时刻。
collocations: at the moment｜目前；此刻 ; in a moment｜马上；一会儿后 ; a brief moment｜短暂的一瞬 ; a turning point moment｜转折时刻
tip_zh: at the moment指现在；in a moment指马上。

meanings_zh: v. 想要；希望 | n. 缺乏；贫困
definition_en: To desire something or wish for something to happen. | A lack of something needed, especially basic necessities.
example1_en: I want to grow tomatoes on our balcony.
example1_zh: 我想在我们的阳台上种番茄。
example2_en: Many young adults want governments to invest more in affordable housing rather than expensive urban redevelopment projects.
example2_zh: 许多年轻人希望政府更多投资于可负担住房，而不是昂贵的城市重建项目。
collocations: want to do something｜想做某事 ; want someone to do something｜想让某人做某事 ; for want of｜由于缺少
tip_zh: 用want to do或want sb to do，不用want doing表想做。

meanings_zh: n. 英格兰
definition_en: A country forming part of the United Kingdom.
example1_en: My cousin lives in a quiet village in England.
example1_zh: 我的表亲住在英格兰一个安静的村庄里。
example2_en: Historic towns in England attract international visitors, creating jobs while increasing pressure on local infrastructure.
example2_zh: 英格兰的历史城镇吸引着国际游客，既创造了就业机会，也增加了当地基础设施的压力。
collocations: southern England｜英格兰南部 ; the north of England｜英格兰北部 ; travel to England｜前往英格兰
tip_zh: England仅指英格兰，不等于整个英国。

meanings_zh: v. 认为；觉得 | v. 思考；考虑
definition_en: To have an opinion or belief about something. | To use your mind to consider ideas or solve problems.
example1_en: I think this soup needs a little more salt.
example1_zh: 我觉得这汤需要再加一点盐。
example2_en: Some people think that schools should devote more time to practical skills rather than examination preparation.
example2_zh: 一些人认为，学校应将更多时间用于实用技能，而不是备考。
collocations: think about｜思考；考虑 ; think of｜想到 ; think carefully｜仔细思考 ; think critically｜批判性思考
tip_zh: 过去式、过去分词均为thought；认为时通常不用进行时。

meanings_zh: det. 又一；另一 | pron. 另一个；再一个
definition_en: one more, or a different one | one more person or thing, or a different one
example1_en: This cup is cracked, so please bring me another.
example1_zh: 这个杯子裂了，请再给我拿一个。
example2_en: Another reason to invest in public transport is its potential to reduce urban air pollution.
example2_zh: 投资公共交通的另一个理由是，它有望减少城市空气污染。
collocations: another chance｜再一次机会 ; another option｜另一个选择 ; one after another｜一个接一个 ; another two days｜再过两天
tip_zh: 通常接单数名词；another two days表示再两天。

meanings_zh: n. 建筑物；楼房 | n. 建筑；建造
definition_en: a structure with walls and a roof | the activity of constructing houses or other structures
example1_en: Our apartment building has a garden on the roof.
example1_zh: 我们住的公寓楼屋顶上有一个花园。
example2_en: Improving insulation in older buildings can reduce energy consumption and lower heating costs for residents.
example2_zh: 改善老旧建筑的隔热性能可以减少能源消耗，降低居民的取暖费用。
collocations: office building｜办公楼 ; building materials｜建筑材料 ; building site｜建筑工地 ; historic building｜历史建筑
tip_zh: 指建筑物时可数，指建造活动时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 阳光充足的；晴朗的 | adj. 开朗的；乐观的
definition_en: having plenty of bright sunlight | cheerful and positive in character or mood
example1_en: We ate breakfast on the sunny balcony this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上，我们在阳光充足的阳台上吃了早餐。
example2_en: Regions with sunny climates can generate substantial amounts of electricity through well-planned solar energy projects.
example2_zh: 阳光充足的地区可以通过规划合理的太阳能项目产生大量电力。
collocations: sunny weather｜晴朗的天气 ; sunny day｜晴天 ; sunny spot｜阳光充足的地方 ; sunny disposition｜开朗的性格
tip_zh: sunny强调阳光足，不一定表示气温高。

meanings_zh: v. 游泳；游过 | n. 一次游泳
definition_en: To move through water using your body. | An occasion when you move through water for exercise or pleasure.
example1_en: We swim in the indoor pool every Saturday morning.
example1_zh: 我们每周六早上都在室内泳池游泳。
example2_en: Schools should teach children to swim because this essential skill improves both physical fitness and water safety.
example2_zh: 学校应教孩子游泳，因为这项基本技能既能增强体能，又能提高水上安全性。
collocations: go for a swim｜去游泳 ; learn to swim｜学习游泳 ; swim across｜游过
tip_zh: 不规则变化：swim—swam—swum。

meanings_zh: n. 科学；自然科学 | n. 科学学科
definition_en: Study of the natural world through observation and experiments | A particular field of study using scientific methods
example1_en: We grew tiny crystals in our science class today.
example1_zh: 今天的科学课上，我们培育了微小的晶体。
example2_en: Investment in science can help countries develop cleaner energy sources and improve public health.
example2_zh: 科学投入能帮助各国开发更清洁的能源，并改善公共健康。
collocations: science education｜科学教育 ; natural sciences｜自然科学 ; advances in science｜科学进展 ; computer science｜计算机科学
tip_zh: 泛指科学通常不可数；指具体学科可用a science。

meanings_zh: n. 雪；积雪 | v. 下雪
definition_en: Soft white frozen flakes falling from clouds or covering the ground. | For snow to fall from the sky.
example1_en: Fresh snow covered the garden when we woke up.
example1_zh: 我们醒来时，新下的雪覆盖了花园。
example2_en: Heavy snow can disrupt public transport and prevent rural communities from accessing essential services.
example2_zh: 大雪可能扰乱公共交通，使农村社区无法获得基本服务。
collocations: heavy snow｜大雪 ; fresh snow｜新下的雪 ; snow heavily｜下大雪
tip_zh: snow作名词通常不可数；下雪用it snows。

meanings_zh: v. 忘记；记不起 | v. 忘记做；忘带
definition_en: to fail to remember a fact, person, or experience | to fail to do or bring something through not remembering
example1_en: I always forget where I put my reading glasses.
example1_zh: 我总是忘记把老花镜放在哪里了。
example2_en: Students may quickly forget new vocabulary unless they review it regularly and use it in meaningful contexts.
example2_zh: 如果学生不定期复习新词，并在有意义的语境中运用，就可能很快忘记。
collocations: forget to do something｜忘记做某事 ; forget about｜忘记；不再考虑 ; completely forget｜完全忘记
tip_zh: forget to do忘记去做；forget doing忘记做过。

meanings_zh: adv. 缓慢地；慢慢地
definition_en: At a low speed or over a long time.
example1_en: She slowly poured the hot soup into bowls.
example1_zh: 她慢慢地把热汤倒进碗里。
example2_en: Although public attitudes are changing slowly, more consumers are choosing products with less plastic packaging.
example2_zh: 尽管公众观念改变得较慢，但越来越多的消费者正在选择塑料包装更少的产品。
collocations: move slowly｜缓慢移动 ; speak slowly｜慢慢说 ; slowly but surely｜缓慢而稳步地
tip_zh: slowly是副词，修饰动作；slow通常作形容词。

meanings_zh: n. 公寓；一套住房 | adj. 平的；平坦的 | adj. 瘪了的；没气的
definition_en: a set of rooms forming a home within a building | level and smooth, without raised or curved parts | having too little air inside, especially a tyre
example1_en: We rent a small flat above a busy bakery.
example1_zh: 我们在一家生意兴隆的面包店楼上租了一套小公寓。
example2_en: Building affordable flats near public transport could reduce commuting costs for many urban workers.
example2_zh: 在公共交通设施附近建造价格合理的公寓，可以降低许多城市工作者的通勤成本。
collocations: rent a flat｜租公寓 ; flat surface｜平坦的表面 ; flat tyre｜瘪了的轮胎
tip_zh: “公寓”英式常用 flat，美式常用 apartment。

meanings_zh: n. 眼镜 | n. 玻璃杯（复数）
definition_en: Two lenses in a frame worn to improve sight. | Containers made of glass, usually used for drinking.
example1_en: I left my glasses beside the bed last night.
example1_zh: 我昨晚把眼镜落在床边了。
example2_en: Regular eye examinations help students obtain suitable glasses, allowing them to read comfortably and participate fully in lessons.
example2_zh: 定期眼部检查有助于学生配到合适的眼镜，让他们舒适阅读并充分参与课堂。
collocations: a pair of glasses｜一副眼镜 ; wear glasses｜戴眼镜 ; reading glasses｜老花镜 ; drinking glasses｜饮水玻璃杯
tip_zh: 指眼镜时用复数；一副眼镜用a pair of glasses。

meanings_zh: adj. 特别的；特殊的 | adj. 专门的；专用的 | n. 特价品；特色菜
definition_en: Different from usual, often in an important or valued way. | Intended for a particular purpose or person. | A specially priced product or a featured restaurant dish.
example1_en: We saved this special cake for your birthday.
example1_zh: 我们把这个特别的蛋糕留到了你生日时享用。
example2_en: Schools should provide special equipment so that students with disabilities can participate fully in classroom activities.
example2_zh: 学校应提供专用设备，让残障学生能够充分参与课堂活动。
collocations: special occasion｜特别的场合 ; special offer｜特价优惠 ; special equipment｜专用设备 ; special attention｜特别关注
tip_zh: specially强调专门；especially常表示尤其。

meanings_zh: n. 植物 | v. 种植；栽种 | n. 工厂；工业设施
definition_en: a living thing that usually grows in soil and has leaves | to put seeds or young plants into soil to grow | a factory or facility where industrial processes take place
example1_en: This little plant needs more sunlight and less water.
example1_zh: 这株小植物需要更多阳光和更少的水。
example2_en: Local authorities should plant more trees to improve air quality and provide shade in crowded neighbourhoods.
example2_zh: 地方政府应多种树，以改善空气质量，并为人口密集的社区提供绿荫。
collocations: water a plant｜给植物浇水 ; plant trees｜种树 ; power plant｜发电厂 ; manufacturing plant｜制造厂
tip_zh: plant可指植物或工厂；作动词时常表示种植。

meanings_zh: n. 肉；食用肉类
definition_en: The flesh of animals eaten as food.
example1_en: We keep raw meat separate from vegetables in the fridge.
example1_zh: 我们把生肉和蔬菜分开放在冰箱里。
example2_en: Reducing meat consumption may lower the environmental impact of food production in many countries.
example2_zh: 在许多国家，减少肉类消费可能降低食品生产对环境的影响。
collocations: raw meat｜生肉 ; lean meat｜瘦肉 ; red meat｜红肉 ; meat consumption｜肉类消费
tip_zh: 泛指食用肉时不可数；meats指不同种类的肉。

meanings_zh: n. 游泳
definition_en: The activity of moving through water using your body.
example1_en: We go swimming at the indoor pool every Saturday.
example1_zh: 我们每周六都去室内泳池游泳。
example2_en: Regular swimming can improve physical fitness while placing relatively little stress on the joints.
example2_zh: 经常游泳可以增强体质，同时对关节造成的压力相对较小。
collocations: go swimming｜去游泳 ; swimming pool｜游泳池 ; swimming lessons｜游泳课
tip_zh: 表示运动时不可数；去游泳用go swimming。

meanings_zh: n. 草；草地
definition_en: A low plant with narrow green leaves covering the ground.
example1_en: We spread a blanket on the grass beside the river.
example1_zh: 我们在河边的草地上铺了一条毯子。
example2_en: Replacing natural grass with artificial surfaces can reduce habitats for insects and increase local temperatures.
example2_zh: 用人造地面取代天然草地可能减少昆虫的栖息地，并使当地气温升高。
collocations: cut the grass｜割草 ; a blade of grass｜一片草叶 ; long grass｜长草 ; wet grass｜湿草地
tip_zh: 通常不可数；一片草叶用a blade of grass。

meanings_zh: v. 教；教授；教导
definition_en: Help someone learn knowledge, skills, or ways of behaving
example1_en: My aunt taught me how to mend a shirt.
example1_zh: 姑姑教会了我如何缝补衬衫。
example2_en: Schools should teach children how to evaluate online information rather than simply memorise facts.
example2_zh: 学校应教孩子如何评估网上的信息，而非只是死记事实。
collocations: teach a subject｜教授一门学科 ; teach someone to swim｜教某人游泳 ; teach a lesson｜授课；给以教训
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为taught；教某人做用teach sb to do。

meanings_zh: n. 瑞士
definition_en: a country in central Europe known for the Alps
example1_en: We travelled through Switzerland by train during our holiday.
example1_zh: 假期里，我们乘火车游览了瑞士。
example2_en: Switzerland demonstrates how reliable rail networks can support tourism while reducing dependence on private cars.
example2_zh: 瑞士展示了可靠的铁路网络如何在支持旅游业的同时减少对私家车的依赖。
collocations: visit Switzerland｜游览瑞士 ; in Switzerland｜在瑞士 ; travel to Switzerland｜前往瑞士
tip_zh: Switzerland 是瑞士，Sweden 是瑞典；瑞士的用 Swiss。

meanings_zh: v. 拿；提；搬运 | v. 随身携带 | v. 传播；携带病菌
definition_en: Hold or support something while moving it somewhere | Have something with you wherever you go | Contain and potentially pass on a disease or infection
example1_en: Could you carry this heavy bag upstairs for me?
example1_zh: 你能帮我把这个沉重的袋子拿上楼吗？
example2_en: Reusable bottles allow commuters to carry drinking water without purchasing disposable plastic containers every day.
example2_zh: 可重复使用的水瓶让通勤者能随身带水，无须每天购买一次性塑料容器。
collocations: carry a bag｜提包 ; carry passengers｜运送乘客 ; carry a virus｜携带病毒 ; carry out research｜开展研究
tip_zh: carry强调携带或搬运；bring和take还体现方向。

meanings_zh: n. 头发；毛发 | n. 一根头发；一根毛
definition_en: Thin strands growing on the skin of people and animals. | A single strand growing from skin.
example1_en: She tied her hair back before making lunch.
example1_zh: 她做午饭前把头发扎了起来。
example2_en: Some workplaces are relaxing rules about hair and clothing to create a more inclusive environment.
example2_zh: 一些工作场所正在放宽对发型和服装的规定，以营造更包容的环境。
collocations: brush your hair｜梳头 ; have your hair cut｜理发 ; a strand of hair｜一缕头发 ; hair loss｜脱发
tip_zh: 整体头发不可数；一根头发用a hair。

meanings_zh: adj. 绿色的 | adj. 环保的 | n. 绿色
definition_en: Having the colour of grass and most leaves. | Causing little harm to the environment. | The colour of grass and most leaves.
example1_en: She wore a green jacket to match her shoes.
example1_zh: 她穿了一件绿色夹克来搭配鞋子。
example2_en: Governments can encourage green transport by improving public services and building safer routes for cyclists.
example2_zh: 政府可以通过改善公共服务和修建更安全的自行车道来鼓励绿色出行。
collocations: green vegetables｜绿色蔬菜 ; green energy｜绿色能源 ; green spaces｜绿地 ; go green｜采取环保生活方式
tip_zh: 除颜色外，green常表示环保；形容人还可指缺乏经验。

meanings_zh: v. 打电话；呼叫 | v. 称呼；把…叫作 | n. 电话；呼吁
definition_en: To telephone someone or shout to get their attention. | To give someone or something a particular name. | A telephone conversation or a public request for action.
example1_en: I'll call you when I get home tonight.
example1_zh: 今晚到家后我会给你打电话。
example2_en: Environmental groups call for stricter regulations to reduce plastic waste entering rivers and oceans.
example2_zh: 环保团体呼吁制定更严格的法规，减少流入河流和海洋的塑料垃圾。
collocations: make a call｜打电话 ; call for action｜呼吁采取行动 ; call someone back｜给某人回电话
tip_zh: call sb表示给某人打电话，不加to。

meanings_zh: n. 奶酪；干酪
definition_en: A food made by pressing or ripening the solids of milk.
example1_en: I added some cheese to my warm vegetable sandwich.
example1_zh: 我在热乎乎的蔬菜三明治里加了些奶酪。
example2_en: Although cheese provides protein and calcium, some varieties contain high levels of salt and saturated fat.
example2_zh: 虽然奶酪能提供蛋白质和钙，但有些品种的盐和饱和脂肪含量较高。
collocations: a slice of cheese｜一片奶酪 ; grated cheese｜奶酪碎 ; cream cheese｜奶油奶酪 ; cheese sandwich｜奶酪三明治
tip_zh: 通常不可数；一块奶酪用a piece of cheese。

meanings_zh: adj. 长的；长时间的 | adv. 长时间地；很久 | v. 渴望；盼望
definition_en: Extending a great distance or lasting a great time. | For a great amount of time. | To want something very strongly, especially something unavailable.
example1_en: Her long scarf nearly touched the wet pavement.
example1_zh: 她的长围巾差点碰到湿漉漉的人行道。
example2_en: Long commuting times can reduce workers' leisure opportunities and negatively affect their overall quality of life.
example2_zh: 长时间通勤会减少劳动者的休闲机会，并对其整体生活质量产生负面影响。
collocations: a long time｜很长时间 ; long hours｜长时间的工作 ; long for｜渴望 ; long to do something｜渴望做某事
tip_zh: 动词long后接for加名词，或to加动词原形。

meanings_zh: n. 会议 | n. 会面；碰面
definition_en: an occasion when people gather to discuss something | an occasion when people come together, by arrangement or chance
example1_en: Our team meeting starts right after lunch today.
example1_zh: 我们团队今天午饭后马上开会。
example2_en: Regular meetings between teachers and parents can help identify learning difficulties at an early stage.
example2_zh: 教师与家长定期会面有助于及早发现学习困难。
collocations: hold a meeting｜召开会议 ; attend a meeting｜参加会议 ; arrange a meeting｜安排会面 ; staff meeting｜员工会议
tip_zh: 参加会议用attend a meeting；meeting也可指会面。

meanings_zh: n. 餐厅服务员；男侍者
definition_en: A person, traditionally male, who serves food in a restaurant
example1_en: The waiter brought our soup and two warm rolls.
example1_zh: 服务员端来了我们的汤和两个热乎乎的小面包。
example2_en: A well-trained waiter can improve the dining experience by responding patiently to customers with different needs.
example2_zh: 训练有素的服务员可以耐心回应不同顾客的需求，提升用餐体验。
collocations: work as a waiter｜当餐厅服务员 ; head waiter｜餐厅领班 ; ask the waiter｜询问服务员
tip_zh: waiter传统上指男服务员；server更不强调性别。

meanings_zh: n. 银行 | n. 河岸；湖岸 | v. 把钱存入银行
definition_en: an organisation that holds money and provides financial services | land along the edge of a river or lake | put money into an account at a bank
example1_en: I went to the bank to open an account.
example1_zh: 我去银行开了一个账户。
example2_en: Banks can support local economic development by offering affordable loans to small businesses and new entrepreneurs.
example2_zh: 银行可以向小企业和初创创业者提供低成本贷款，以支持当地经济发展。
collocations: bank account｜银行账户 ; bank loan｜银行贷款 ; river bank｜河岸 ; bank statement｜银行对账单
tip_zh: 岸边用on the bank；银行里用at或in the bank。

meanings_zh: n. 教室
definition_en: a room where students are taught
example1_en: Sunlight filled the classroom as we opened our books.
example1_zh: 我们打开书本时，阳光洒满了教室。
example2_en: A well-designed classroom should provide adequate lighting, comfortable furniture, and enough space for students to work together.
example2_zh: 设计良好的教室应有充足的照明、舒适的家具，以及供学生合作学习的足够空间。
collocations: classroom management｜课堂管理 ; classroom activities｜课堂活动 ; classroom teaching｜课堂教学
tip_zh: in the classroom强调教室内；in class强调上课中。

meanings_zh: n. 计划；方案 | v. 计划；打算 | n. 平面图
definition_en: An arrangement or idea for what to do in future. | To decide what to do and how to do it. | A drawing showing the layout of a building or area.
example1_en: Our plan is to leave early and avoid traffic.
example1_zh: 我们的计划是早点出发，避开拥堵。
example2_en: Cities need a clear plan for expanding public transport before introducing restrictions on private vehicles.
example2_zh: 城市在实施私家车限制措施之前，需要制定明确的公共交通扩展计划。
collocations: make a plan｜制定计划 ; plan to do something｜计划做某事 ; floor plan｜楼层平面图 ; long-term plan｜长期规划
tip_zh: plan to do表示打算做；过去式planned双写n。

meanings_zh: adj. 滑稽的；好笑的 | adj. 奇怪的；反常的
definition_en: making you laugh or smile | unusual or difficult to explain
example1_en: That funny story made everyone at the table laugh.
example1_zh: 那个好笑的故事逗得桌边的人都笑了。
example2_en: Teachers sometimes use funny examples to make difficult concepts more memorable and encourage students to participate.
example2_zh: 教师有时会用有趣的例子，让复杂概念更容易记住，并鼓励学生参与。
collocations: a funny story｜好笑的故事 ; a funny joke｜好笑的笑话 ; a funny smell｜奇怪的气味 ; find something funny｜觉得某事好笑
tip_zh: funny侧重好笑或奇怪；fun侧重令人愉快、有趣。

meanings_zh: v. 支付；付工资 | n. 工资；薪酬 | v. 值得；划算
definition_en: To give money for something or for someone's work | Money received regularly for doing a job | To bring a benefit or be worth doing
example1_en: Can I pay for these apples by card?
example1_zh: 这些苹果可以刷卡付款吗？
example2_en: Employers should pay workers fairly to improve staff morale and reduce the number of people leaving.
example2_zh: 雇主应公平支付员工薪酬，以提高士气并减少人员流失。
collocations: pay a bill｜付账单 ; pay for something｜为某物付款 ; pay attention to｜注意 ; equal pay｜同等报酬
tip_zh: pay for接所购物品；pay接账单或款额；过去式paid。

meanings_zh: adj. 年老的；古老的；旧的 | adj. ……岁的；有……年历史的 | adj. 以前的；原来的
definition_en: Having lived or existed for a long time. | Having a particular age. | Belonging to an earlier period of someone's life.
example1_en: Our old dog sleeps beside the warm kitchen stove.
example1_zh: 我们家的老狗睡在温暖的厨房炉子旁。
example2_en: Preserving old buildings can protect cultural heritage while attracting visitors and supporting the local economy.
example2_zh: 保护古老建筑既能保护文化遗产，也能吸引游客并支持当地经济。
collocations: old age｜老年 ; years old｜……岁 ; old friend｜老朋友 ; old buildings｜古老建筑
tip_zh: an old friend通常指相识已久，不一定年纪大。

meanings_zh: n. 意大利
definition_en: A country in southern Europe whose capital is Rome.
example1_en: We travelled around Italy by train last summer.
example1_zh: 去年夏天我们乘火车游览了意大利。
example2_en: Italy attracts international visitors through its historic cities, distinctive cuisine, and rich artistic heritage.
example2_zh: 意大利凭借历史名城、特色美食和丰富的艺术遗产吸引着国际游客。
collocations: southern Italy｜意大利南部 ; travel to Italy｜去意大利旅行 ; made in Italy｜意大利制造
tip_zh: 国家名首字母大写，通常不加the；Italian指意大利语等。

meanings_zh: n. 错误；失误 | v. 认错；误以为
definition_en: Something incorrect that you do, say, or believe. | To wrongly identify someone or understand something incorrectly.
example1_en: I took your umbrella by mistake this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上我误拿了你的伞。
example2_en: Teachers should encourage students to learn from mistakes rather than feel ashamed of making them.
example2_zh: 教师应鼓励学生从错误中学习，而不是因为犯错而感到羞愧。
collocations: make a mistake｜犯错 ; by mistake｜错误地；无意中 ; learn from mistakes｜从错误中学习 ; mistake A for B｜把A误认成B
tip_zh: 说make a mistake，不说do；动词过去式为mistook。

meanings_zh: v. 重复；重说；重做 | n. 重复；重演；重播
definition_en: To say or do something again. | Something that happens or is shown again.
example1_en: Could you repeat the address a little more slowly?
example1_zh: 你能把地址再慢一点说一遍吗？
example2_en: Students who repeat new vocabulary aloud regularly may develop greater confidence when speaking a foreign language.
example2_zh: 经常大声重复新词汇的学生，在说外语时可能会更有信心。
collocations: repeat a mistake｜重犯错误 ; repeat a question｜重复问题 ; repeat after someone｜跟着某人复述 ; a repeat performance｜再次演出
tip_zh: repeat已含“再次”之意，通常不必再加again。

meanings_zh: v. 欢迎；欣然接受 | adj. 受欢迎的；令人欣喜的 | n. 欢迎；迎接
definition_en: to greet someone warmly or accept something with pleasure | wanted, appreciated, or gladly accepted | the way someone is greeted when they arrive
example1_en: Our neighbours came outside to welcome us home.
example1_zh: 邻居们走到外面，欢迎我们回家。
example2_en: Many communities welcome new cultural festivals because they encourage social interaction and support local businesses.
example2_zh: 许多社区欢迎新的文化节庆活动，因为这些活动能促进社交互动并支持当地商家。
collocations: welcome visitors｜欢迎来访者 ; a warm welcome｜热情的欢迎 ; a welcome change｜令人欣喜的变化 ; you're welcome｜不客气
tip_zh: be welcome to do表示可随意做；You're welcome用于回应感谢。

meanings_zh: n. 草莓
definition_en: a soft red fruit with tiny seeds on its surface
example1_en: I picked a ripe strawberry and put it in my basket.
example1_zh: 我摘了一颗熟透的草莓，放进篮子里。
example2_en: Growing strawberries locally can reduce transport distances, although heated greenhouses may increase overall energy consumption.
example2_zh: 在本地种植草莓可以缩短运输距离，但加温温室可能增加总体能源消耗。
collocations: strawberry jam｜草莓酱 ; ripe strawberries｜成熟的草莓 ; strawberry plants｜草莓植株
tip_zh: 可数名词，复数为strawberries。

meanings_zh: num. 十六
definition_en: the number after fifteen and before seventeen
example1_en: We baked sixteen small cakes for the family picnic.
example1_zh: 我们为家庭野餐烤了十六个小蛋糕。
example2_en: In some countries, students can choose vocational training instead of continuing general education at the age of sixteen.
example2_zh: 在一些国家，学生十六岁时可以选择职业培训，而不继续接受普通教育。
collocations: sixteen years old｜十六岁 ; at sixteen｜在十六岁时 ; sixteen students｜十六名学生
tip_zh: 注意与sixty（六十）区分，sixteen词尾有/n/。

meanings_zh: n. 周；星期 | n. 工作周
definition_en: a period of seven days | the days or hours normally spent working each week
example1_en: I borrowed this book from the library last week.
example1_zh: 我上周从图书馆借了这本书。
example2_en: A shorter working week could improve employee wellbeing, provided that workloads are reduced rather than compressed.
example2_zh: 缩短工作周可能改善员工的身心状况，前提是减少工作量，而非把工作集中完成。
collocations: last week｜上周 ; once a week｜每周一次 ; working week｜工作周 ; a week off｜一周假期
tip_zh: last/next/this week前不加介词。

meanings_zh: num. 十七
definition_en: The number after sixteen and before eighteen.
example1_en: My sister is seventeen and loves playing volleyball.
example1_zh: 我妹妹十七岁，喜欢打排球。
example2_en: The survey found that seventeen students preferred practical training to traditional classroom instruction.
example2_zh: 调查发现，十七名学生更喜欢实践培训，而非传统课堂教学。
collocations: seventeen years old｜十七岁 ; seventeen students｜十七名学生 ; at seventeen｜在十七岁时
tip_zh: 注意与seventy（七十）区分，词尾读清。

meanings_zh: n. 星期三
definition_en: the day after Tuesday and before Thursday
example1_en: We meet for lunch every Wednesday near the library.
example1_zh: 我们每周三在图书馆附近一起吃午饭。
example2_en: The community centre offers free language classes every Wednesday to help newcomers participate in local life.
example2_zh: 社区中心每周三提供免费语言课程，帮助新来者融入当地生活。
collocations: on Wednesday｜在星期三 ; Wednesday morning｜星期三上午 ; every Wednesday｜每周三
tip_zh: 首字母大写；on Wednesday，但every Wednesday前不加on。

meanings_zh: adv. 午夜后至中午前
definition_en: During the time from midnight until just before midday.
example1_en: My alarm rings at seven a.m. every weekday.
example1_zh: 每个工作日，我的闹钟都在早上七点响。
example2_en: Starting school before eight a.m. may reduce the amount of sleep that teenagers get on weekdays.
example2_zh: 早上八点前上课可能会减少青少年在上学期间的睡眠时间。
collocations: at six a.m.｜在早上六点 ; from nine a.m.｜从上午九点起 ; until eleven a.m.｜直到上午十一点
tip_zh: 放在钟点后；12 a.m.是午夜，12 p.m.是正午。

meanings_zh: adj. 新的；新近出现的 | adj. 新买的；新接触的 | adj. 不熟悉的；初来乍到的
definition_en: Recently made, discovered, introduced, or begun. | Recently obtained or experienced by someone, though possibly already existing. | Not yet familiar with a place, activity, or situation.
example1_en: Our new neighbours brought us a basket of apples.
example1_zh: 我们的新邻居送来了一篮苹果。
example2_en: New technologies can make healthcare more accessible, but their benefits must be shared across different income groups.
example2_zh: 新技术能让医疗服务更易获得，但不同收入群体都应能享受到这些益处。
collocations: brand new｜全新的 ; new technology｜新技术 ; new to the job｜刚接触这份工作 ; a new approach｜一种新方法
tip_zh: be new to表示初次接触、不熟悉，to是介词。

meanings_zh: n. 烹饪；烹调 | adj. 烹调用的
definition_en: The activity of preparing food by heating it. | Intended for use in preparing food.
example1_en: My brother does the cooking while I wash dishes.
example1_zh: 我哥哥做饭，我洗碗。
example2_en: Teaching basic cooking skills at school can help young people develop healthier eating habits.
example2_zh: 在学校教授基本烹饪技能，有助于年轻人养成更健康的饮食习惯。
collocations: do the cooking｜做饭 ; cooking skills｜烹饪技能 ; cooking oil｜食用油 ; home cooking｜家常烹饪
tip_zh: cooking指烹饪活动；cook可指厨师，cooker指炊具。

meanings_zh: n. 家庭；家人；亲属 | n. 科；语族；同类群
definition_en: a group of people related to one another | a group of related animals, plants, languages, or other things
example1_en: My family gathers around the kitchen table every Sunday.
example1_zh: 我的家人每周日都会围坐在厨房的餐桌旁。
example2_en: Flexible working hours can help parents balance family responsibilities with the demands of paid employment.
example2_zh: 弹性工作时间可以帮助父母平衡家庭责任与有偿工作的要求。
collocations: extended family｜大家庭 ; family member｜家庭成员 ; family responsibilities｜家庭责任 ; language family｜语族
tip_zh: family作整体用单数；英式英语强调成员时可用复数。

meanings_zh: n. 例子；实例 | n. 榜样
definition_en: Something specific that shows what a general idea means | A person or action that others can learn from or copy
example1_en: Could you give me an example of a healthy breakfast?
example1_zh: 你能给我举一个健康早餐的例子吗？
example2_en: Public buildings can set an example by using renewable energy and reducing unnecessary water consumption.
example2_zh: 公共建筑可以通过使用可再生能源和减少不必要的用水来树立榜样。
collocations: for example｜例如 ; give an example｜举例 ; set an example｜树立榜样 ; a typical example｜典型例子
tip_zh: for example用于举例；set an example意为树立榜样。

meanings_zh: n. 十二月
definition_en: the final month of the year, following November
example1_en: My cousin is coming to stay with us in December.
example1_zh: 我表亲十二月要来我们家住。
example2_en: In many northern countries, energy demand increases in December as households need more heating during colder weather.
example2_zh: 在许多北方国家，十二月天气更冷，家庭需要更多供暖，因此能源需求增加。
collocations: in December｜在十二月 ; early December｜十二月初 ; late December｜十二月下旬
tip_zh: 月份首字母大写；在十二月用in December。

meanings_zh: n. 米；公尺 | n. 诗歌格律
definition_en: A unit of length equal to one hundred centimetres. | A regular pattern of stressed and unstressed syllables in poetry.
example1_en: This shelf is just over a metre long.
example1_zh: 这个架子长一米多一点。
example2_en: Raising coastal barriers by one metre could help protect nearby homes from increasingly severe flooding.
example2_zh: 将海岸屏障加高一米，有助于保护附近住宅免受日益严重的洪水侵袭。
collocations: a square metre｜一平方米 ; a cubic metre｜一立方米 ; a metre long｜一米长
tip_zh: 长度单位英式写metre，美式写meter；复数metres。

meanings_zh: v. 憎恨；非常讨厌 | n. 憎恨；强烈厌恶
definition_en: To dislike someone or something very strongly. | A very strong feeling of dislike towards someone or something.
example1_en: I hate finding wet socks on the bathroom floor.
example1_zh: 我特别讨厌在浴室地板上发现湿袜子。
example2_en: Although many commuters hate crowded trains, affordable public transport remains essential for reducing urban traffic.
example2_zh: 虽然许多通勤者讨厌拥挤的列车，但价格实惠的公共交通对于缓解城市交通拥堵仍然至关重要。
collocations: hate doing something｜讨厌做某事 ; hate to admit｜不愿承认 ; full of hate｜充满仇恨
tip_zh: hate后可接动名词或不定式，语气比dislike强。

meanings_zh: v. 睡觉 | n. 睡眠
definition_en: to rest with eyes closed and awareness reduced | the natural resting state in which awareness is reduced
example1_en: Our cat likes to sleep beside the warm radiator.
example1_zh: 我们的猫喜欢睡在温暖的暖气片旁边。
example2_en: Regular sleep supports memory and concentration, making it particularly important for students preparing for examinations.
example2_zh: 规律的睡眠有助于记忆和注意力，因此对备考学生尤其重要。
collocations: get enough sleep｜获得充足睡眠 ; fall asleep｜入睡 ; sleep well｜睡得好 ; lack of sleep｜睡眠不足
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为slept；入睡用fall asleep。

meanings_zh: n. 牙刷
definition_en: A small brush used for cleaning your teeth.
example1_en: I packed my toothbrush in the side pocket.
example1_zh: 我把牙刷装进了侧面的口袋。
example2_en: Replacing a worn toothbrush regularly helps maintain oral hygiene by ensuring that teeth are cleaned effectively.
example2_zh: 定期更换磨损的牙刷有助于确保牙齿得到有效清洁，从而保持口腔卫生。
collocations: electric toothbrush｜电动牙刷 ; soft toothbrush｜软毛牙刷 ; toothbrush holder｜牙刷架
tip_zh: 复数是toothbrushes，不是teethbrushes。

meanings_zh: n. 桌子 | n. 表格
definition_en: a piece of furniture with a flat top and legs | information arranged in rows and columns
example1_en: We gathered around the table to share fresh bread.
example1_zh: 我们围坐在桌边，一起吃新鲜面包。
example2_en: The table compares average household spending on transport in three cities over a ten-year period.
example2_zh: 该表比较了三个城市十年间的家庭平均交通支出。
collocations: dining table｜餐桌 ; set the table｜摆好餐具 ; clear the table｜收拾餐桌 ; a table of results｜结果表
tip_zh: set the table指摆餐具，不是摆放桌子。

meanings_zh: v. 加入；参加 | v. 连接；接合 | v. 与……会合；一起做
definition_en: To become a member or take part with others. | To connect things or become connected. | To go where someone is and spend time with them.
example1_en: Would you like to join us for lunch today?
example1_zh: 你今天愿意和我们一起吃午饭吗？
example2_en: Students who join local volunteer groups can develop practical skills while contributing to their communities.
example2_zh: 加入当地志愿者团体的学生可以在服务社区的同时培养实用技能。
collocations: join a club｜加入俱乐部 ; join in｜参与 ; join forces｜联合行动 ; join together｜连接起来
tip_zh: join a club指加入组织；join in指参与活动。

meanings_zh: adj. 有用的；有帮助的
definition_en: Helping you do something or achieve a purpose
example1_en: This little torch is useful when the power fails.
example1_zh: 停电时，这个小手电筒很有用。
example2_en: Reliable online resources can be useful for learners who lack access to well-equipped libraries.
example2_zh: 对于无法使用设备完善的图书馆的学习者来说，可靠的网络资源可能很有帮助。
collocations: useful advice｜有用的建议 ; useful information｜有用的信息 ; useful for learning｜对学习有用 ; a useful tool｜实用工具
tip_zh: 首音是辅音/j/，所以说a useful tool，不用an。

meanings_zh: v. 喜欢；喜爱 | prep. 像；与……相似 | prep. 例如；比如
definition_en: to enjoy something or feel positively about someone | similar to someone or something | used to introduce an example
example1_en: I like reading by the window on rainy afternoons.
example1_zh: 我喜欢在下雨的午后坐在窗边读书。
example2_en: Many residents like having green spaces nearby because they provide opportunities for exercise and relaxation.
example2_zh: 许多居民喜欢附近有绿地，因为绿地提供了锻炼和放松的机会。
collocations: like doing something｜喜欢做某事 ; would like to｜想要 ; look like｜看起来像 ; feel like doing something｜想做某事
tip_zh: would like to do 比 want to do 更礼貌。

meanings_zh: n. 便条；笔记 | v. 注意到；记下 | n. 音符；单音
definition_en: A short written message or record of useful information. | To notice something or record it in writing. | A single musical sound or a symbol representing it.
