example1_en: Their son helped them plant flowers in the garden.
example1_zh: 他们的儿子帮他们在花园里种花。
example2_en: Parents should give their sons and daughters equal opportunities to pursue education and develop practical skills.
example2_zh: 父母应给予儿子和女儿平等的机会，让他们接受教育并培养实用技能。
collocations: an only son｜独生子 ; an eldest son｜长子 ; raise a son｜养育儿子
tip_zh: son与sun同音；成年男性也仍是父母的son。

meanings_zh: prep. 在……上方；越过 | prep. 超过 | adv. 结束
definition_en: above something or from one side to the other | more than a particular amount, age, or level | finished or no longer happening
example1_en: A small bird flew over the garden wall.
example1_zh: 一只小鸟飞过了花园的围墙。
example2_en: Over half of the residents surveyed supported plans to create more green spaces in their neighbourhood.
example2_zh: 受访居民中有超过一半支持在社区内增设绿地的计划。
collocations: over the bridge｜越过桥梁 ; over half｜超过一半 ; be over｜结束 ; all over the world｜世界各地
tip_zh: over可指越过或超过；be over表示结束。

meanings_zh: n. 蔬菜
definition_en: a plant or plant part eaten as food
example1_en: We bought fresh vegetables at the market this morning.
example1_zh: 我们今天早上在市场买了新鲜蔬菜。
example2_en: Schools can encourage healthier eating by serving a wider variety of vegetables at lunchtime.
example2_zh: 学校可以在午餐时供应更多种类的蔬菜，鼓励更健康的饮食。
collocations: fresh vegetables｜新鲜蔬菜 ; leafy vegetables｜叶菜 ; vegetable soup｜蔬菜汤 ; vegetable garden｜菜园
tip_zh: 通常为可数名词；泛指多种蔬菜用vegetables。

meanings_zh: n. 词典；字典
definition_en: a resource listing words with their meanings, pronunciations, or translations
example1_en: I checked the pronunciation of this word in a dictionary.
example1_zh: 我查了词典，确认这个词的发音。
example2_en: Using a bilingual dictionary can help language learners understand unfamiliar vocabulary without relying entirely on their teachers.
example2_zh: 使用双语词典能帮助语言学习者理解陌生词汇，而不必完全依赖教师。
collocations: bilingual dictionary｜双语词典 ; online dictionary｜在线词典 ; consult a dictionary｜查阅词典 ; dictionary entry｜词典条目
tip_zh: 查词用look up a word in a dictionary。

meanings_zh: adv. 也许；可能
definition_en: Used to say that something is possible but not certain.
example1_en: Maybe we can have a picnic if the weather improves.
example1_zh: 如果天气好转，也许我们可以去野餐。
example2_en: Maybe cities could reduce traffic congestion by offering cheaper public transport rather than building more roads.
example2_zh: 也许城市可以通过提供更便宜的公共交通，而非修建更多道路，来缓解交通拥堵。
collocations: maybe later｜也许晚点 ; maybe not｜也许不会 ; maybe next time｜也许下次
tip_zh: maybe是副词；may be是情态动词加be。

meanings_zh: pron. 他们；她们；它们 | pron. 指性别未知或非二元者
definition_en: Used for people or things already mentioned or understood. | Used for someone of unknown or nonbinary gender.
example1_en: The children waved as they boarded the bus.
example1_zh: 孩子们一边上公交车一边挥手。
example2_en: When a student receives constructive feedback, they are more likely to identify weaknesses and improve their performance.
example2_zh: 学生收到建设性反馈后，更有可能发现不足并改善表现。
collocations: they are｜他们是 ; they have｜他们有 ; they say｜据说
tip_zh: 单数they也搭配are、have，不用is、has。

meanings_zh: det. 许多的 | pron. 许多；许多人或物
definition_en: a large number of, used with plural countable nouns | a large number of people or things
example1_en: How many apples do we need for the pie?
example1_zh: 做这个派需要多少个苹果？
example2_en: Many cities are investing in cycling infrastructure to reduce traffic congestion and improve public health.
example2_zh: 许多城市正在投资自行车基础设施，以缓解交通拥堵并改善公众健康。
collocations: how many｜多少 ; too many｜太多 ; many of｜……中的许多 ; a great many｜大量的
tip_zh: many 接可数名词复数；much 接不可数名词。

meanings_zh: v. 烹调；煮；烧 | n. 做饭的人；厨师
definition_en: to prepare food by heating it, or become ready through heating | someone who prepares and cooks food
example1_en: I usually cook vegetable soup when the weather turns cold.
example1_zh: 天气变冷时，我通常会煮蔬菜汤。
example2_en: Teaching children to cook simple meals can encourage healthier eating habits and greater independence later in life.
example2_zh: 教孩子做简单饭菜，可以培养更健康的饮食习惯，让他们日后更加独立。
collocations: cook a meal｜做一顿饭 ; cook from scratch｜从原材料开始做饭 ; a good cook｜做饭好吃的人 ; cook over low heat｜用小火烹调
tip_zh: cook可指厨师；cooker在英式英语中指炉灶。

meanings_zh: adv. 离开；远离 | adv. 不在；外出
definition_en: Moving or staying at a distance from someone or something. | Not at home or at the usual place.
example1_en: The little bird flew away when I opened the window.
example1_zh: 我打开窗户时，小鸟飞走了。
example2_en: Moving away from crowded cities can improve wellbeing, but may reduce access to employment.
example2_zh: 搬离拥挤的城市可能改善身心健康，但也可能减少就业机会。
collocations: go away｜离开 ; far away｜在远处 ; away from home｜不在家 ; put away｜收好
tip_zh: away是副词；表示“远离某处”用away from。

meanings_zh: n. 沙拉；凉拌菜
definition_en: a cold dish of vegetables or other mixed ingredients
example1_en: I added cucumber and tomatoes to the salad.
example1_zh: 我往沙拉里加了黄瓜和番茄。
example2_en: Offering fresh salad in school cafeterias can encourage children to eat a wider variety of vegetables.
example2_zh: 学校食堂供应新鲜沙拉，有助于鼓励儿童摄入更多种类的蔬菜。
collocations: green salad｜绿叶蔬菜沙拉 ; fruit salad｜水果沙拉 ; salad dressing｜沙拉酱
tip_zh: 可指一份沙拉，也可不可数地指沙拉这种食物。

meanings_zh: adv. 在外；向外；不在家 | adv. 熄灭；停止运转 | adv. 公开；问世
definition_en: Away from the inside of a place, or from home. | No longer burning, shining, or working. | Available to the public or no longer secret.
example1_en: We went out for a walk after dinner.
example1_zh: 晚饭后我们出去散步了。
example2_en: When a new research report comes out, journalists should examine its evidence before reporting its conclusions.
example2_zh: 新的研究报告发布时，记者应先审查其证据，再报道其结论。
collocations: go out｜外出 ; eat out｜在外就餐 ; come out｜出版；发布 ; put out a fire｜灭火
tip_zh: out 常作副词；在某物外面可用 outside。

meanings_zh: adj. 兴奋的；激动的
definition_en: Feeling very happy and enthusiastic about something.
example1_en: The children were excited about their first camping trip.
example1_zh: 孩子们对第一次露营旅行感到兴奋。
example2_en: Students are often more excited about learning when lessons involve practical experiments and opportunities for discovery.
example2_zh: 当课程包含实践实验和探索机会时，学生往往对学习更有热情。
collocations: excited about｜对……感到兴奋 ; excited to hear｜听到……很激动 ; get excited｜兴奋起来
tip_zh: 人感到兴奋用excited；事物令人兴奋用exciting。

meanings_zh: v. 邀请 | v. 征求；引起
definition_en: to ask someone to attend something or do something | to request a response or make a reaction likely
example1_en: Let's invite our new neighbours over for dinner.
example1_zh: 我们邀请新邻居过来吃晚饭吧。
example2_en: Local councils should invite residents to discuss proposed changes before making decisions about public spaces.
example2_zh: 地方议会在就公共空间作出决定前，应邀请居民讨论拟议的改动。
collocations: invite someone to dinner｜邀请某人吃晚饭 ; invite someone to do something｜邀请某人做某事 ; invite feedback｜征求反馈 ; invite criticism｜招致批评
tip_zh: invite sb to＋活动；invite sb to do＋动作。

meanings_zh: n. 电话；手机 | v. 给……打电话
definition_en: a device used to speak to people at a distance | to contact someone using a telephone
example1_en: My phone rang while I was washing the dishes.
example1_zh: 我洗碗时，电话响了。
example2_en: Limiting phone use in classrooms may help students concentrate more effectively on lessons and group activities.
example2_zh: 限制课堂上的手机使用，可能有助于学生更专注于课程和小组活动。
collocations: answer the phone｜接电话 ; on the phone｜在通话 ; mobile phone｜手机 ; phone someone back｜给某人回电话
tip_zh: 动词直接接人：phone someone，不加to。

meanings_zh: v. 错过；未赶上 | v. 想念 | v. 未击中；未察觉
definition_en: to fail to catch, attend, or experience something | to feel sad because someone or something is absent | to fail to hit a target or notice something
example1_en: Hurry up, or we will miss the last bus.
example1_zh: 快点，否则我们会错过末班公交车。
example2_en: Students who miss several lessons may need additional support to keep up with their classmates.
example2_zh: 缺了几节课的学生可能需要额外帮助，才能跟上同学的进度。
collocations: miss the bus｜没赶上公交车 ; miss an opportunity｜错失机会 ; miss someone｜想念某人 ; miss the point｜没理解要点
tip_zh: miss后接名词或动名词，不接to do。

meanings_zh: v. 旅行；行进 | n. 旅行；出行 | v. 传播；传送
definition_en: To go from one place to another. | The activity of going to other places. | To move or spread from one place to another.
example1_en: We usually travel by train to visit our grandparents.
example1_zh: 我们通常坐火车去看望祖父母。
example2_en: Affordable public transport enables residents to travel more sustainably and reduces dependence on private cars.
example2_zh: 价格合理的公共交通让居民能够以更可持续的方式出行，并减少对私家车的依赖。
collocations: travel abroad｜出国旅行 ; travel by train｜乘火车出行 ; air travel｜航空旅行 ; travel insurance｜旅行保险
tip_zh: 泛指旅行时travel不可数；一次旅行用a trip。

meanings_zh: v. 跟随；沿着走 | v. 遵循；听从 | v. 理解；听懂
definition_en: To move behind someone or along a route. | To act according to instructions, rules, or advice. | To understand what someone says or explains.
example1_en: Follow this path until you reach the wooden bridge.
example1_zh: 沿着这条小路走，直到到达木桥。
example2_en: Schools should teach children how to follow safety guidelines when using digital devices and online services.
example2_zh: 学校应教导儿童在使用数字设备和网络服务时如何遵守安全准则。
collocations: follow instructions｜按照指示做 ; follow advice｜听从建议 ; follow a path｜沿小路走 ; follow an argument｜理解论证思路
tip_zh: follow直接接宾语：follow me，不加with。

meanings_zh: adj. 美国的；美国人的 | n. 美国人
definition_en: relating to the United States, its people, or its culture | a person from the United States
example1_en: My American neighbour invited us over for pumpkin pie.
example1_zh: 我的美国邻居邀请我们去他家吃南瓜派。
example2_en: American universities attract international students through their diverse courses, research facilities, and opportunities for professional development.
example2_zh: 美国大学凭借多样的课程、科研设施和职业发展机会吸引国际学生。
collocations: American English｜美式英语 ; American culture｜美国文化 ; an American citizen｜美国公民
tip_zh: 首字母始终大写；通常指美国，而非整个美洲。

meanings_zh: adj. 俄罗斯的；俄语的 | n. 俄罗斯人 | n. 俄语
definition_en: Relating to Russia, its people, or its language. | A person from Russia. | The main language spoken in Russia.
example1_en: We cooked Russian dumplings for dinner last night.
example1_zh: 昨晚我们做了俄式饺子当晚餐。
example2_en: Studying Russian literature can help students explore how historical events influence cultural identity and artistic expression.
example2_zh: 学习俄罗斯文学可以帮助学生探究历史事件如何影响文化认同和艺术表达。
collocations: Russian literature｜俄罗斯文学 ; Russian speaker｜说俄语的人 ; learn Russian｜学俄语
tip_zh: 首字母须大写；指俄语时通常不加冠词。

meanings_zh: n. 天气 | v. 经受住；渡过难关 | v. 风化；受风雨侵蚀
definition_en: Conditions outside, such as rain, sunshine, wind, and temperature. | To survive a difficult situation without serious damage. | To change or become damaged through exposure to outdoor conditions.
example1_en: The weather turned sunny just before our picnic.
example1_zh: 就在我们野餐前，天气转晴了。
example2_en: Extreme weather can disrupt food production and increase the cost of basic goods for vulnerable communities.
example2_zh: 极端天气会扰乱粮食生产，并推高弱势社区基本商品的价格。
collocations: weather forecast｜天气预报 ; extreme weather｜极端天气 ; weather conditions｜天气状况 ; weather a storm｜经受风暴；渡过危机
tip_zh: 表示天气时不可数；climate指长期气候特征。

meanings_zh: adv. 两次 | adv. 两倍
definition_en: On two occasions. | To double the amount, degree, or size.
example1_en: I checked my bag twice but couldn't find my keys.
example1_zh: 我检查了两次包，却没找到钥匙。
example2_en: Residents who exercise at least twice a week may experience improvements in their physical and mental health.
example2_zh: 每周至少锻炼两次的居民，身心健康可能得到改善。
collocations: twice a week｜每周两次 ; twice as much｜两倍那么多 ; think twice｜再三考虑 ; twice the size｜两倍大
tip_zh: 两倍常用twice as…as或twice the＋名词。

meanings_zh: v. 唱；唱歌 | v. 鸟鸣；鸣啭
definition_en: To make musical sounds with your voice. | For a bird to make pleasant musical sounds.
example1_en: We sing our favourite songs while washing the dishes.
example1_zh: 我们一边洗碗，一边唱自己最喜欢的歌。
example2_en: Children who sing together regularly may develop greater confidence and stronger relationships with their classmates.
example2_zh: 经常一起唱歌的孩子可能会变得更加自信，与同学的关系也更加紧密。
collocations: sing a song｜唱一首歌 ; sing along｜跟着唱 ; sing in a choir｜在合唱团唱歌
tip_zh: 不规则变化：sing—sang—sung。

meanings_zh: n. 大学
definition_en: an institution offering degree courses and conducting advanced research
example1_en: My sister studies engineering at a university near home.
example1_zh: 我姐姐在离家不远的一所大学读工程学。
example2_en: Governments should improve access to university so that talented students are not excluded by financial barriers.
example2_zh: 政府应扩大接受大学教育的机会，避免有才华的学生因经济障碍被拒之门外。
collocations: go to university｜上大学 ; university degree｜大学学位 ; university campus｜大学校园 ; university tuition fees｜大学学费
tip_zh: 用a university而非an，因开头发辅音/j/。

meanings_zh: v. 给；赠送 | v. 提供；带来 | v. 举办；作出
definition_en: to hand something to someone or let them have it | to provide something or cause someone to experience something | to hold an event or perform an action for others
example1_en: Please give your sister a clean towel after swimming.
example1_zh: 游泳后请给你妹妹一条干净的毛巾。
example2_en: Schools should give students opportunities to develop practical skills through projects that address real community needs.
example2_zh: 学校应通过解决社区实际需求的项目，让学生有机会培养实践技能。
collocations: give advice｜提供建议 ; give a presentation｜作报告 ; give someone a chance｜给某人机会 ; give permission｜给予许可
tip_zh: give sb sth＝give sth to sb；过去式gave。

meanings_zh: n. 衬衫
definition_en: an upper-body garment, usually with sleeves, a collar, and front buttons
example1_en: He ironed his blue shirt before the interview.
example1_zh: 他在面试前熨好了自己的蓝衬衫。
example2_en: Some employers require staff to wear a formal shirt, while others allow more casual clothing.
example2_zh: 一些雇主要求员工穿正式衬衫，另一些则允许更休闲的着装。
collocations: a cotton shirt｜棉质衬衫 ; a short-sleeved shirt｜短袖衬衫 ; button up a shirt｜扣好衬衫扣子
tip_zh: shirt通常指衬衫；T-shirt才是T恤。

meanings_zh: n. 英国；大不列颠
definition_en: the United Kingdom, or the island containing England, Scotland and Wales
example1_en: My cousin moved to Britain to study nursing.
example1_zh: 我的表亲搬到英国学习护理。
example2_en: Britain has invested in offshore wind farms to reduce its reliance on fossil fuels for electricity generation.
example2_zh: 英国投资建设海上风电场，以减少发电对化石燃料的依赖。
collocations: across Britain｜遍及英国 ; modern Britain｜现代英国 ; Great Britain｜大不列颠
tip_zh: Britain常指英国；Great Britain不包括北爱尔兰。

meanings_zh: n. 长颈鹿
definition_en: A tall African animal with a long neck and spotted coat
example1_en: The giraffe stretched its neck to reach the highest leaves.
example1_zh: 那只长颈鹿伸长脖子去够最高处的叶子。
example2_en: Protecting natural habitats is essential for maintaining healthy giraffe populations and preserving biodiversity in African grasslands.
example2_zh: 保护自然栖息地对于维持健康的长颈鹿种群和保护非洲草原的生物多样性至关重要。
collocations: a herd of giraffes｜一群长颈鹿 ; a giraffe calf｜长颈鹿幼崽 ; giraffe conservation｜长颈鹿保护
tip_zh: 重音在第二音节，复数通常加-s。

meanings_zh: prep. 在……后面 | adv. 在后面；落后 | prep. 是……的幕后原因
definition_en: at or towards the back of someone or something | at the back or making less progress than expected | responsible for causing or supporting something
example1_en: Your umbrella is behind the door in the kitchen.
example1_zh: 你的伞在厨房的门后面。
example2_en: Students who fall behind at school may benefit from additional support rather than stricter discipline.
example2_zh: 在学校学习落后的学生可能更需要额外的支持，而非更严格的纪律。
collocations: behind the scenes｜在幕后 ; fall behind｜落后 ; behind schedule｜落后于进度
tip_zh: behind可作介词或副词；fall behind表示落后。

meanings_zh: adj. 便宜的；价低的 | adj. 劣质的；廉价的
definition_en: costing little money or less than usual | of poor quality and little value
example1_en: We found a cheap café near the train station.
example1_zh: 我们在火车站附近找到了一家价格实惠的咖啡馆。
example2_en: Cheap public transport can improve access to employment and reduce dependence on private cars in large cities.
example2_zh: 价格低廉的公共交通能改善大城市居民的就业可达性，并减少对私家车的依赖。
collocations: cheap tickets｜便宜的票 ; cheap labour｜廉价劳动力 ; cheap and cheerful｜价廉实用 ; a cheap alternative｜便宜的替代选择
tip_zh: cheap有时暗示质量差；中性表达可用inexpensive。

meanings_zh: adj. 极好的；出色的 | adj. 巨大的；程度很高的 | adj. 伟大的；杰出的
definition_en: Very good or enjoyable. | Very large in amount, size, or degree. | Highly important, admired, or successful.
example1_en: We had a great afternoon swimming in the lake.
example1_zh: 我们在湖里游泳，度过了一个愉快的下午。
example2_en: Access to reliable internet is of great importance for students living in remote areas.
example2_zh: 对于居住在偏远地区的学生来说，能够使用可靠的互联网至关重要。
collocations: a great opportunity｜极好的机会 ; of great importance｜非常重要 ; a great deal of｜大量的 ; a great achievement｜杰出成就
tip_zh: a great deal of后接不可数名词，表示大量。

meanings_zh: n. 雨；雨水 | v. 下雨
definition_en: Water that falls from clouds in drops | For water drops to fall from clouds
example1_en: Heavy rain kept us inside for the whole afternoon.
example1_zh: 大雨让我们整个下午都待在屋里。
example2_en: Farmers increasingly depend on stored water because seasonal rain has become less predictable in many regions.
example2_zh: 由于许多地区的季节性降雨越来越难以预测，农民日益依赖储存的水。
collocations: heavy rain｜大雨 ; pouring rain｜倾盆大雨 ; rain heavily｜下大雨 ; a chance of rain｜降雨的可能性
tip_zh: rain作名词通常不可数；说下雨用It rains。

meanings_zh: adj. 好的；优质的 | adj. 有益的；有好处的 | n. 益处；善
definition_en: Of a high or satisfactory standard. | Having a helpful or healthy effect. | Something that benefits people or is morally right.
example1_en: This bakery makes good bread with a crisp crust.
example1_zh: 这家面包店做的面包很好，外皮酥脆。
example2_en: Good public transport allows residents to reach essential services without relying on private cars.
example2_zh: 优质的公共交通让居民无需依赖私家车也能获得基本服务。
collocations: good quality｜优良品质 ; good at｜擅长 ; good for｜对……有益 ; do good｜有益；行善
tip_zh: good是形容词；修饰动作通常用well。

meanings_zh: det. 两者都 | pron. 两者；双方
definition_en: referring to two people or things together | the two people or things already mentioned
example1_en: Both windows were open, letting in the cool breeze.
example1_zh: 两扇窗户都开着，凉风吹了进来。
example2_en: Both governments and individuals have a responsibility to reduce waste and protect natural resources.
example2_zh: 政府和个人都有责任减少浪费并保护自然资源。
collocations: both sides｜双方 ; both of them｜他们两个都 ; both ... and ...｜既……又……
tip_zh: both指两者；both A and B作主语用复数谓语。

meanings_zh: prep. 在……里面；向……里面 | adv. 在里面；往里面 | n. 里面；内部
definition_en: in or into the inner part of something | in or into an enclosed place or container | the inner part or surface of something
example1_en: Your keys are inside the small pocket of your bag.
example1_zh: 你的钥匙在包的小口袋里。
example2_en: Air quality inside buildings deserves greater attention because many people spend most of their day indoors.
example2_zh: 建筑物内部的空气质量值得更多关注，因为许多人一天中的大部分时间都在室内度过。
collocations: inside the building｜在建筑物内 ; stay inside｜待在里面 ; on the inside｜在内侧 ; from the inside｜从内部
tip_zh: inside后接名词时是介词；单独用可作副词。

meanings_zh: n. 橡皮擦
definition_en: A small object used to remove pencil marks.
example1_en: I borrowed an eraser to correct my pencil drawing.
example1_zh: 我借了一块橡皮擦来修改铅笔画。
example2_en: Providing basic classroom supplies, including pencils and erasers, helps ensure that all children can participate in lessons.
example2_zh: 提供铅笔和橡皮擦等基本课堂用品，有助于确保所有孩子都能参与课堂学习。
collocations: a pencil eraser｜铅笔橡皮擦 ; use an eraser｜用橡皮擦
tip_zh: eraser常用于美式英语；英式英语常说rubber。

meanings_zh: n. 旅行；出行 | v. 绊倒；使绊倒
definition_en: a journey to a place and usually back again | to stumble or make someone stumble by catching a foot
example1_en: Our weekend trip to the coast was wonderfully relaxing.
example1_zh: 我们周末的海滨之旅让人十分放松。
example2_en: School trips to museums can enrich classroom learning by giving students direct access to historical objects.
example2_zh: 学校组织的博物馆参观能让学生直接接触历史实物，从而丰富课堂学习。
collocations: go on a trip｜去旅行 ; business trip｜商务出行 ; school trip｜学校组织的出游 ; trip over｜被……绊倒
tip_zh: trip 是可数名词；travel 表示旅行活动时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 司机；驾驶员 | n. 驱动因素 | n. 驱动程序
definition_en: A person who controls a car or another road vehicle. | Something that strongly influences or causes a development. | Software that lets a computer communicate with a device.
example1_en: The bus driver waited while I found my ticket.
example1_zh: 公交车司机等着我找到车票。
example2_en: Investment in public transport can be a major driver of economic growth in expanding cities.
example2_zh: 在不断扩张的城市，公共交通投资可以成为经济增长的重要驱动力。
collocations: bus driver｜公交车司机 ; a key driver of growth｜增长的关键驱动因素 ; install a driver｜安装驱动程序
tip_zh: a driver of change指推动变化的因素。

meanings_zh: num. 一；一个 | pron. 一个；某个事物 | pron. 任何人；人们
definition_en: the smallest positive whole number | used instead of a countable noun already mentioned | people in general, including the speaker, in formal language
example1_en: There is only one apple left in the bowl.
example1_zh: 碗里只剩一个苹果了。
example2_en: One major benefit of public transport is that it reduces the demand for parking spaces in cities.
example2_zh: 公共交通的一大好处是能减少城市对停车位的需求。
collocations: one at a time｜一次一个 ; one another｜彼此 ; one by one｜逐个
tip_zh: one可替代单数可数名词；复数用ones。

meanings_zh: n. 作家；作者
definition_en: someone who writes books, articles, or other texts
example1_en: The writer filled her notebook while waiting for the train.
example1_zh: 那位作家等火车时，把笔记本写得满满的。
example2_en: A skilled writer can make complex environmental issues accessible to readers without oversimplifying the scientific evidence.
example2_zh: 优秀的作者能让读者理解复杂的环境问题，同时不过度简化科学证据。
collocations: professional writer｜职业作家 ; travel writer｜游记作家 ; freelance writer｜自由撰稿人 ; short-story writer｜短篇小说作家
tip_zh: writer范围较广；author常指某部作品的作者。

meanings_zh: adj. 英国的；英国人的 | n. 英国人（总称）
definition_en: Relating to the United Kingdom, its people, or their culture. | The people of the United Kingdom, considered collectively.
example1_en: My British neighbour invited us over for tea.
example1_zh: 我的英国邻居邀请我们过去喝茶。
example2_en: British universities attract international students through their research strengths and the wide range of courses they offer.
example2_zh: 英国大学凭借科研实力和丰富的课程选择吸引国际学生。
collocations: British culture｜英国文化 ; British citizen｜英国公民 ; British English｜英式英语
tip_zh: 英国人总称用the British；单个人用a Briton。

meanings_zh: n. 床 | n. 河床；海底；湖底 | n. 花坛；苗床
definition_en: A piece of furniture used for sleeping | The ground at the bottom of a river, sea, or lake | An area of soil prepared for growing plants
example1_en: The cat curled up on my bed after lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭后，猫蜷缩在我的床上。
example2_en: Maintaining a regular time to go to bed can improve sleep quality and support mental health.
example2_zh: 保持固定的就寝时间可以改善睡眠质量，并有益于心理健康。
collocations: go to bed｜上床睡觉 ; make the bed｜整理床铺 ; river bed｜河床 ; flower bed｜花坛
tip_zh: go to bed指就寝，不加the；make the bed指铺床。

meanings_zh: adj. 相同的；同一个的 | pron. 同样的事物
definition_en: Exactly alike, or referring to one particular thing rather than another. | The very thing already mentioned, or something exactly like it.
example1_en: We take the same bus to school every morning.
example1_zh: 我们每天早上乘同一班公交车上学。
example2_en: Students from different backgrounds should have the same opportunities to access high-quality education and develop their talents.
example2_zh: 不同背景的学生应享有同样的机会，接受优质教育并发展自己的才能。
collocations: the same as｜与……相同 ; at the same time｜同时 ; stay the same｜保持不变 ; the same age｜同龄
tip_zh: 通常用the same；比较时用the same as。

meanings_zh: n. 视频；录像 | v. 录制视频；录像
definition_en: A recording of moving images, usually with sound. | Record moving images of someone or something.
example1_en: We watched a video of penguins sliding across ice.
example1_zh: 我们看了一段企鹅在冰上滑行的视频。
example2_en: Educational video can make complex processes easier to understand, especially for students with limited background knowledge.
example2_zh: 教学视频可以让复杂的过程更容易理解，对背景知识有限的学生尤其如此。
collocations: watch a video｜观看视频 ; record a video｜录制视频 ; video clip｜视频片段 ; video call｜视频通话
tip_zh: 一段视频用a video；泛指视频媒介时可不可数。

meanings_zh: prep. 在……期间
definition_en: at some point within, or throughout, a particular period
example1_en: Please keep your phone silent during the concert.
example1_zh: 音乐会期间请将手机调为静音。
example2_en: During periods of extreme heat, local authorities should provide cool indoor spaces for vulnerable residents.
example2_zh: 在极端高温期间，地方政府应为脆弱群体提供凉爽的室内场所。
collocations: during the day｜在白天 ; during the summer｜在夏季 ; during working hours｜在工作时间内
tip_zh: during后接名词；while后常接句子；for表示持续时长。

meanings_zh: n. 云 | n. 一团烟尘等 | v. 使判断模糊；使困惑
definition_en: a visible mass of tiny water drops in the sky | a mass of smoke, dust, or similar material in air | to make thoughts or judgment less clear
example1_en: A dark cloud drifted slowly across the afternoon sky.
example1_zh: 一朵乌云缓缓飘过午后的天空。
example2_en: Strong emotions can cloud public judgment when communities debate the benefits and risks of new technologies.
example2_zh: 当社区讨论新技术的利弊时，强烈的情绪可能影响公众的判断。
collocations: dark clouds｜乌云 ; a cloud of dust｜一团尘土 ; cloud someone's judgment｜影响某人的判断
tip_zh: cloud作动词可指使判断不清，如cloud your judgment。

meanings_zh: adj. 活着的 | adj. 充满活力的；热闹的
definition_en: Living rather than dead | Full of energy, activity, or excitement
example1_en: The tiny plant is still alive after our holiday.
example1_zh: 我们度假回来后，那株小植物还活着。
example2_en: Protecting natural habitats helps keep endangered species alive and preserves the ecological balance of entire regions.
example2_zh: 保护自然栖息地有助于让濒危物种存活，并维持整个地区的生态平衡。
collocations: stay alive｜活下去 ; keep alive｜使存活；使延续 ; come alive｜活跃起来 ; alive with activity｜热闹非凡
tip_zh: 通常放在系动词后；“活鱼”说a live fish。

meanings_zh: n. 圆；圆圈 | n. 圈子；交际圈 | v. 环绕；圈出
definition_en: A round shape whose edge is equally distant from its centre. | A group of people connected by friendship or shared interests. | To move around something or draw a ring around it.
example1_en: The children sat in a circle on the grass.
example1_zh: 孩子们在草地上围坐成一圈。
example2_en: Joining community activities can help older adults expand their social circle and reduce feelings of isolation.
example2_zh: 参加社区活动可以帮助老年人扩大社交圈，减少孤独感。
collocations: draw a circle｜画圆 ; in a circle｜围成一圈 ; social circle｜社交圈 ; circle overhead｜在上空盘旋
tip_zh: circle是圆或圆圈；cycle才常指循环或周期。

meanings_zh: int. 请再说一遍 | v. 原谅；赦免 | n. 赦免；宽恕
definition_en: Used politely to ask someone to repeat what they said. | To forgive someone or officially release them from punishment. | Official forgiveness for a crime, or forgiveness for an offence.
example1_en: Pardon? I couldn't hear you over the washing machine.
example1_zh: 请再说一遍？洗衣机太吵，我没听清。
example2_en: A legal pardon can help someone rebuild their life, although public acceptance may take longer.
example2_zh: 法律上的赦免可以帮助一个人重建生活，但获得公众接纳可能需要更久。
collocations: pardon me｜请原谅；劳驾 ; I beg your pardon｜请再说一遍；对不起 ; grant a pardon｜给予赦免
tip_zh: 没听清时可说Pardon?，语调通常上扬。

meanings_zh: v. 成功；达成目标 | v. 接替；继任
definition_en: To achieve what you are trying to do. | To take someone's position after they leave it.
example1_en: After several attempts, I succeeded in fixing the lamp.
example1_zh: 尝试了几次后，我终于把灯修好了。
example2_en: Students are more likely to succeed when schools provide consistent feedback and practical support.
example2_zh: 学校持续提供反馈和实际支持时，学生更有可能取得成功。
collocations: succeed in doing something｜成功做成某事 ; succeed as a manager｜作为经理取得成功 ; succeed someone as chair｜接替某人担任主席
tip_zh: 表示成功做成某事，用succeed in doing，不用to do。

meanings_zh: adv. 容易地；轻松地 | adv. 无疑；远远 | adv. 很可能
definition_en: without difficulty or much effort | by a clear margin, especially in comparisons | with a strong possibility of something happening
example1_en: This small suitcase fits easily beneath the train seat.
example1_zh: 这个小行李箱轻轻松松就能放到火车座位下面。
example2_en: Public information should be presented clearly so that people with different literacy levels can easily understand it.
example2_zh: 公共信息应清晰呈现，让识字水平不同的人都能轻松理解。
collocations: easily accessible｜容易获取或到达的 ; easily understood｜容易理解的 ; easily the best｜无疑是最好的 ; could easily happen｜很可能发生
tip_zh: easily可修饰最高级：easily the best表示远胜其他。

meanings_zh: n. 一点；少量；小块 | n. 比特；二进制位
definition_en: A small amount or piece of something. | The smallest unit of information stored by a computer.
example1_en: There is a bit of cake left for you.
example1_zh: 还给你留了一点蛋糕。
example2_en: Even a small bit of practical experience can help students understand difficult scientific concepts.
example2_zh: 即使只有少量实践经验，也能帮助学生理解困难的科学概念。
collocations: a bit of｜一点 ; a little bit｜一点点 ; bit by bit｜一点一点地 ; bits and pieces｜零碎物品
tip_zh: a bit of接名词；a bit可修饰形容词；bit也是bite过去式。

meanings_zh: n. 打字；键盘输入
definition_en: The activity of entering words using a keyboard.
example1_en: My typing has become faster since I started practising.
example1_zh: 开始练习以后，我的打字速度变快了。
example2_en: Although voice recognition is improving, accurate typing remains a valuable skill in many office jobs.
example2_zh: 尽管语音识别技术正在进步，准确打字仍是许多办公室工作中的宝贵技能。
collocations: typing speed｜打字速度 ; touch typing｜盲打 ; typing skills｜打字技能 ; typing error｜打字错误
tip_zh: 作名词时不可数；也是type的现在分词。

meanings_zh: adj. 男性的；雄性的 | n. 男性；雄性动物
definition_en: Relating to men or boys, or the sex that produces sperm. | A male person or animal.
example1_en: The male duck has a shiny green head.
example1_zh: 这只公鸭有一个亮闪闪的绿色脑袋。
example2_en: Encouraging more male applicants to enter nursing could help address staff shortages and challenge gender stereotypes.
example2_zh: 鼓励更多男性申请进入护理行业，有助于缓解人员短缺并打破性别刻板印象。
collocations: male students｜男学生 ; male nurse｜男护士 ; male and female｜男性和女性；雄性和雌性
tip_zh: male可作形容词或名词；日常指男人通常用man。

meanings_zh: n. 音乐专辑 | n. 相册；集邮册
definition_en: A collection of recorded music released as one product. | A book for keeping photographs, stamps or similar collections.
example1_en: Her new album kept us singing all afternoon.
example1_zh: 她的新专辑让我们跟着唱了整整一个下午。
example2_en: Digital platforms allow independent musicians to release an album without relying on a traditional record company.
example2_zh: 数字平台让独立音乐人无需依赖传统唱片公司就能发行专辑。
collocations: release an album｜发行专辑 ; debut album｜首张专辑 ; photo album｜相册
tip_zh: 音乐专辑用album；单曲用single。

meanings_zh: v. 燃烧；烧毁 | v. 烧伤；烫伤 | n. 烧伤；烫伤
definition_en: To produce flames, or destroy something with fire. | To damage skin or other material through heat. | An injury caused by heat, chemicals, or electricity.
example1_en: A small fire burned quietly in the fireplace.
example1_zh: 壁炉里，一小团火静静地燃烧着。
example2_en: Burning fossil fuels releases greenhouse gases, making cleaner energy sources essential for environmental protection.
example2_zh: 燃烧化石燃料会释放温室气体，因此清洁能源对环境保护至关重要。
collocations: burn fossil fuels｜燃烧化石燃料 ; burn calories｜消耗热量 ; burn your hand｜烫伤手 ; a severe burn｜严重烧伤
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词可用burnt或burned。

meanings_zh: v. 敲；敲击 | v. 碰撞；撞倒 | n. 敲击声；撞击
definition_en: to hit a surface, especially a door, to make a sound | to hit something accidentally, often making it move or fall | a sound or blow caused by hitting something
example1_en: Please knock on the door before you come in.
example1_zh: 进来之前请先敲门。
example2_en: Strong winds can knock down trees, causing serious disruption to transport networks in urban areas.
example2_zh: 强风可能刮倒树木，严重扰乱城市地区的交通网络。
collocations: knock on the door｜敲门 ; knock something over｜碰倒某物 ; knock down｜撞倒；拆除 ; a loud knock｜响亮的敲击声
tip_zh: 词首k不发音；敲门用knock on或at the door。

meanings_zh: v. 滑雪 | n. 滑雪板
definition_en: to move over snow wearing long narrow boards on your feet | a long narrow board worn on a foot for travelling over snow
example1_en: We learned to ski on a gentle snowy slope.
example1_zh: 我们在一处平缓的雪坡上学会了滑雪。
example2_en: Tourists who ski in mountain resorts contribute to local employment but may also increase environmental pressure.
example2_zh: 在山地度假区滑雪的游客促进了当地就业，但也可能增加环境压力。
collocations: go skiing｜去滑雪 ; ski resort｜滑雪度假区 ; ski slope｜滑雪坡道 ; a pair of skis｜一副滑雪板
tip_zh: 过去式skied，现在分词skiing；ski复数为skis。

meanings_zh: n. 运动鞋（美式）
definition_en: A comfortable shoe with a rubber sole, worn for exercise.
example1_en: One sneaker was hiding under the kitchen chair.
example1_zh: 一只运动鞋藏在厨房的椅子下面。
example2_en: A well-designed sneaker can provide support during exercise, although suitable footwear varies according to the activity.
example2_zh: 设计良好的运动鞋能在锻炼时提供支撑，但适合的鞋类因运动项目而异。
collocations: a pair of sneakers｜一双运动鞋 ; running sneakers｜跑步鞋 ; wear sneakers｜穿运动鞋
tip_zh: 美式常用 sneakers，英式通常说 trainers。

meanings_zh: n. 铃；钟 | n. 铃声；钟声
definition_en: a hollow metal object that rings when struck | the ringing sound made by a bell
example1_en: The bicycle bell rang as a cyclist approached.
example1_zh: 一位骑车人靠近时，自行车铃响了。
example2_en: In many schools, a bell marks the beginning and end of each lesson.
example2_zh: 在许多学校，铃声标志着每节课的开始和结束。
collocations: ring a bell｜摇铃；敲钟 ; door bell｜门铃 ; church bell｜教堂的钟
tip_zh: ring a bell也可表示“听着耳熟；似曾相识”。

meanings_zh: v. 设计；构思 | n. 设计；设计方案 | n. 装饰图案
definition_en: plan how something will look or work before making it | the planning of something's appearance or function, or its plan | a decorative pattern on an object or surface
example1_en: My cousin designed a wooden desk for her bedroom.
example1_zh: 我表姐为自己的卧室设计了一张木书桌。
example2_en: Cities should design public spaces that encourage social interaction while remaining accessible to people with disabilities.
example2_zh: 城市应设计既能促进社交互动、又方便残障人士使用的公共空间。
collocations: design a building｜设计建筑 ; be designed to do something｜旨在做某事 ; graphic design｜平面设计 ; interior design｜室内设计
tip_zh: be designed to do表示“旨在做……”。

meanings_zh: adj. 明亮的；鲜艳的 | adj. 聪明的；机灵的 | adj. 充满希望的；愉快的
definition_en: giving much light or having a strong, clear colour | quick to learn and understand things | promising success or showing happiness
example1_en: Bright sunlight streamed through the kitchen window this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早晨，明亮的阳光从厨房窗户照了进来。
example2_en: Access to quality education can give young people a bright future regardless of their family background.
example2_zh: 无论家庭背景如何，获得优质教育都能让年轻人拥有光明的未来。
collocations: bright colours｜鲜艳的颜色 ; bright student｜聪明的学生 ; bright future｜光明的未来 ; bright sunlight｜明亮的阳光
tip_zh: 形容光线强用bright；形容房间暗用dim。

meanings_zh: n. 老板；上司 | v. 对…发号施令
definition_en: A person who manages workers or runs a business. | To order people around in an annoying or controlling way.
example1_en: My boss let me leave early for my appointment.
example1_zh: 我的上司允许我提前下班去赴约。
example2_en: A supportive boss can improve employee satisfaction by offering constructive feedback and recognising individual contributions.
example2_zh: 支持员工的上司可以通过提供建设性反馈和认可个人贡献来提高员工满意度。
collocations: talk to your boss｜与你的上司交谈 ; a supportive boss｜支持员工的上司 ; be your own boss｜自己当老板 ; boss someone around｜对某人指手画脚
tip_zh: boss较口语；作动词常用boss someone around。

meanings_zh: n. 小提琴
definition_en: A four-stringed instrument held under the chin and usually bowed.
example1_en: My sister practises the violin after dinner every evening.
example1_zh: 我姐姐每天晚饭后都练习小提琴。
example2_en: Learning the violin can help children develop concentration, although regular lessons may be expensive for some families.
example2_zh: 学习小提琴有助于儿童培养专注力，但定期上课对某些家庭来说可能费用较高。
collocations: play the violin｜拉小提琴 ; violin lessons｜小提琴课 ; a violin concerto｜小提琴协奏曲
tip_zh: 小提琴手是violinist；拉小提琴常说play the violin。

meanings_zh: adj. 粗鲁的；无礼的
definition_en: speaking or behaving without respect for others
example1_en: It was rude to interrupt her during dinner.
example1_zh: 吃晚饭时打断她说话很不礼貌。
example2_en: Schools should teach children how to disagree respectfully without making rude comments about others.
example2_zh: 学校应该教孩子如何礼貌地表达不同意见，而不是对他人出言不逊。
collocations: rude to someone｜对某人无礼 ; rude behaviour｜粗鲁的行为 ; rude remark｜无礼的话
tip_zh: 对某人无礼用 rude to someone，不用 rude with。

meanings_zh: n. 手套
definition_en: A hand covering with separate sections for fingers and thumb.
example1_en: I found my missing glove under the kitchen chair.
example1_zh: 我在厨房椅子下面找到了丢失的那只手套。
example2_en: Healthcare workers should change disposable gloves between patients to reduce the risk of spreading infections.
example2_zh: 医护人员在接诊不同患者之间应更换一次性手套，以降低传播感染的风险。
collocations: a pair of gloves｜一副手套 ; disposable gloves｜一次性手套 ; protective gloves｜防护手套 ; boxing gloves｜拳击手套
tip_zh: 一副手套用 a pair of gloves，注意 gloves 用复数。

meanings_zh: v. 完成；填写完 | adj. 完整的；齐全的 | adj. 完全的；彻底的
definition_en: to finish doing something or filling in information | having every necessary part, with nothing missing | total, without any limit or exception
example1_en: I completed the puzzle just before dinner was ready.
example1_zh: 我刚拼好拼图，晚饭就做好了。
example2_en: Students who complete vocational training often gain practical skills that help them enter the workforce more confidently.
example2_zh: 完成职业培训的学生往往能获得实用技能，从而更有信心地进入职场。
collocations: complete a course｜完成课程 ; complete a form｜填完表格 ; a complete set｜完整的一套 ; a complete success｜圆满成功
tip_zh: complete a form指填写完表格，不是制作表格。

meanings_zh: v. 亲吻 | n. 吻
definition_en: to touch someone or something with your lips affectionately | an affectionate touch made with the lips
example1_en: She kissed her daughter gently before leaving for work.
example1_zh: 她上班前轻轻亲了亲女儿。
example2_en: In some cultures, a kiss on the cheek is a common greeting between close friends.
example2_zh: 在一些文化中，亲吻脸颊是亲密朋友之间常见的问候方式。
collocations: kiss someone goodbye｜亲吻某人道别 ; give someone a kiss｜亲某人一下 ; a kiss on the cheek｜脸颊上的一吻
tip_zh: 吻某人的脸颊用 kiss someone on the cheek。

meanings_zh: n. 空间；空地；间隔 | n. 太空 | v. 使隔开；留间隔
definition_en: Room available for something, or a gap between things | The vast area beyond Earth's atmosphere | To arrange things with gaps between them
example1_en: There is enough space for your bike beside mine.
example1_zh: 我的自行车旁边有足够的地方放你的车。
example2_en: Providing more green space in crowded neighbourhoods can improve residents' wellbeing and encourage outdoor physical activity.
example2_zh: 在人口密集的社区增加绿地，可以改善居民身心健康并鼓励户外锻炼。
collocations: green space｜绿地 ; outer space｜外太空 ; parking space｜停车位 ; space exploration｜太空探索
tip_zh: 泛指空间、太空时不可数；具体车位等可数。

meanings_zh: v. 发音；读出 | v. 正式宣布；宣告
definition_en: To make the sounds of a word when speaking. | To state an official decision or judgment.
example1_en: Could you teach me how to pronounce your name?
example1_zh: 你能教我怎么读你的名字吗？
example2_en: Language learners often find unfamiliar sounds easier to pronounce after regular listening practice and feedback.
example2_zh: 经过规律的听力练习并获得反馈后，语言学习者往往会觉得陌生的音更容易发准。
collocations: pronounce a word｜读出单词 ; pronounce correctly｜正确发音 ; pronounce someone innocent｜宣布某人无罪
tip_zh: 名词是pronunciation，注意中间没有字母o。

meanings_zh: n. 能力；才能
definition_en: the skill or power needed to do something
example1_en: Her ability to fix bicycles impressed all her friends.
example1_zh: 她修自行车的本领让朋友们都很佩服。
example2_en: Regular reading can strengthen children's ability to understand complex ideas and express their own views clearly.
example2_zh: 经常阅读可以增强儿童理解复杂概念和清晰表达自身观点的能力。
collocations: the ability to learn｜学习能力 ; develop an ability｜培养一种能力 ; academic ability｜学业能力 ; natural ability｜天赋
tip_zh: 表示“做某事的能力”用ability to do。

meanings_zh: n. 录音机；记录器 | n. 竖笛 | n. 记录员
definition_en: a device that captures sound, images, or information | a wooden or plastic wind instrument with finger holes | a person who keeps an official record
example1_en: I placed the recorder beside her before the interview.
example1_zh: 采访前，我把录音机放在她身旁。
example2_en: Using a digital recorder allows researchers to review interviews carefully and identify recurring themes.
example2_zh: 使用数字录音机使研究人员能够仔细回顾访谈，识别反复出现的主题。
collocations: digital recorder｜数字录音机 ; voice recorder｜录音设备 ; play the recorder｜吹竖笛
tip_zh: play the recorder指吹竖笛，不是播放录音机。

meanings_zh: prep. 沿着；顺着 | adv. 向前 | adv. 一起；随同
definition_en: following the length or direction of something | forward from one place towards another | with someone when they go somewhere
example1_en: We walked along the river and watched the ducks.
example1_zh: 我们沿着河边散步，看着水里的鸭子。
example2_en: Planting trees along busy roads can provide shade for pedestrians and improve the appearance of urban areas.
example2_zh: 在繁忙道路沿线植树可以为行人遮阴，并改善城市面貌。
collocations: along the coast｜沿着海岸 ; come along｜一起来 ; bring someone along｜带某人一起来 ; along with｜连同；与……一起
tip_zh: along沿着长线走；across强调从一边横穿到另一边。

meanings_zh: n. 女士；夫人（尊称）
definition_en: A formal, polite way of addressing a woman.
example1_en: Would you like a table by the window, madam?
example1_zh: 女士，您想坐靠窗的桌子吗？
example2_en: In formal customer service settings, staff may address a female customer as madam to show respect.
example2_zh: 在正式的客户服务场合，工作人员可能用madam称呼女性顾客，以示尊重。
collocations: Dear Madam｜尊敬的女士 ; yes, madam｜好的，女士 ; Madam Chair｜主席女士
tip_zh: 正式称呼女性时使用；日常熟人交谈中通常不用。

meanings_zh: v. 错过；未赶上 | v. 未击中；未察觉 | v. 想念
definition_en: failed to catch, attend, or take advantage of something | failed to hit or notice someone or something | felt sad because someone or something was absent
example1_en: We missed the bus and walked home together.
example1_zh: 我们没赶上公交车，便一起走回了家。
example2_en: Students who missed lessons due to illness should receive additional support to catch up with their classmates.
example2_zh: 因病缺课的学生应获得额外帮助，以跟上同学的学习进度。
collocations: missed opportunity｜错失的机会 ; missed call｜未接来电 ; missed deadline｜未按期完成
tip_zh: miss的过去式和过去分词；词尾-ed读/t/。

meanings_zh: n. 金；黄金 | n. 金牌 | adj. 金制的；金色的
definition_en: A valuable yellow metal used for jewellery and money | The medal awarded for first place in a competition | Made of gold or having its yellow colour
example1_en: My grandmother keeps her gold ring in a wooden box.
example1_zh: 我奶奶把她的金戒指放在一个木盒里。
example2_en: Demand for gold can increase during economic uncertainty, as investors seek assets they consider relatively safe.
example2_zh: 经济不确定时期，投资者会寻求他们认为相对安全的资产，黄金需求因此可能上升。
collocations: pure gold｜纯金 ; gold medal｜金牌 ; gold jewellery｜黄金首饰 ; gold reserves｜黄金储备
tip_zh: gold作材料名通常不可数；a gold可指一枚金牌。

meanings_zh: n. 发音；读音
definition_en: the way a word or language is spoken
example1_en: I practise my pronunciation by recording short voice messages.
example1_zh: 我通过录制简短的语音消息练习发音。
example2_en: Clear pronunciation helps language learners communicate effectively, even when their grammar is not always accurate.
example2_zh: 即使语法并非总是准确，清晰的发音也能帮助语言学习者有效沟通。
collocations: clear pronunciation｜清晰的发音 ; correct pronunciation｜正确的发音 ; improve your pronunciation｜改善发音 ; pronunciation practice｜发音练习
tip_zh: 拼写是pronunciation，注意中间不是noun。

meanings_zh: n. 培训；训练 | n. 体能训练；体育训练
definition_en: Learning and practice that develop skills for a particular activity. | Physical exercise and practice to prepare for sport.
example1_en: My first day of training involved helping customers.
example1_zh: 培训第一天，我就参与了为顾客提供帮助的工作。
example2_en: Regular professional training helps employees adapt to technological changes and improves their long-term career prospects.
example2_zh: 定期职业培训有助于员工适应技术变化，并改善他们的长期职业前景。
collocations: vocational training｜职业培训 ; on-the-job training｜在职培训 ; training course｜培训课程 ; strength training｜力量训练
tip_zh: 通常不可数；一次培训可说a training session。

meanings_zh: n. 薄片；一片 | v. 切成薄片 | n. 一部分；份额
definition_en: a thin, flat piece cut from something larger | to cut something into thin, flat pieces | a share or portion of something
example1_en: She put a slice of lemon in my tea.
example1_zh: 她在我的茶里放了一片柠檬。
example2_en: Housing costs consume a large slice of household income, leaving many families with little money for leisure.
example2_zh: 住房开支占据家庭收入的很大一部分，使许多家庭几乎没有钱用于休闲。
collocations: a slice of bread｜一片面包 ; slice thinly｜切成薄片 ; a slice of the market｜一部分市场份额
tip_zh: slice强调切出的片；piece泛指一块或一件。

meanings_zh: n. 日常饮食 | n. 特定饮食；节食方案 | v. 节食
definition_en: The food and drink someone regularly consumes. | A planned way of eating for health or weight control. | To control what you eat, usually to lose weight.
example1_en: My usual diet includes plenty of rice and vegetables.
example1_zh: 我的日常饮食中有大量米饭和蔬菜。
example2_en: A balanced diet can improve concentration and help students maintain their energy throughout the school day.
example2_zh: 均衡饮食能提高注意力，并帮助学生在整个上学期间保持精力。
collocations: a balanced diet｜均衡饮食 ; a diet rich in fibre｜富含纤维的饮食 ; go on a diet｜开始节食
tip_zh: diet不一定指节食，也可指日常饮食。

meanings_zh: adj. 荷兰的；荷兰人的 | n. 荷兰语 | n. 荷兰人（总称）
definition_en: Relating to the Netherlands, its people, or their language. | The language spoken in the Netherlands and parts of Belgium. | The people of the Netherlands, considered as a group.
example1_en: Our Dutch neighbour taught us how to bake apple pie.
example1_zh: 我们的荷兰邻居教我们烤苹果派。
example2_en: Dutch cities are often studied by urban planners seeking to develop safer and more accessible cycling networks.
example2_zh: 希望建设更安全、更便利的自行车交通网络的城市规划者经常研究荷兰城市。
collocations: Dutch culture｜荷兰文化 ; speak Dutch｜说荷兰语 ; the Dutch｜荷兰人
tip_zh: Dutch首字母大写；the Dutch统指荷兰人。

meanings_zh: det. 更少的 | adv. 较少地；更不 | pron. 更少的量
definition_en: a smaller amount of something | to a smaller degree or extent | a smaller amount
example1_en: Please put less sugar in my tea this time.
example1_zh: 这次请在我的茶里少放点糖。
example2_en: Households can use less energy by improving insulation and choosing appliances that consume electricity more efficiently.
example2_zh: 家庭可以通过改善隔热措施和选用更节能的电器来减少能源消耗。
collocations: less than｜少于 ; less likely｜可能性更小 ; less and less｜越来越少 ; no less than｜多达；不少于
tip_zh: 修饰不可数名词用less；可数名词复数通常用fewer。

meanings_zh: n. 陆军；军队 | n. 大群；大批
definition_en: A country's military force trained mainly to fight on land. | A large group of people working toward a shared purpose.
example1_en: My cousin joined the army after leaving school.
example1_zh: 我的表亲毕业后参军了。
example2_en: During major floods, the army can provide essential transport and supplies when civilian services are overwhelmed.
example2_zh: 发生严重洪灾时，如果民用服务不堪重负，军队可以提供必要的运输服务和物资。
collocations: join the army｜参军 ; serve in the army｜在陆军服役 ; an army of volunteers｜大批志愿者
tip_zh: army主要指陆军；armed forces泛指各军种。

meanings_zh: adj. 破碎的；断裂的 | adj. 坏掉的；失灵的 | adj. 不流利的；断续的
definition_en: Damaged by being split or separated into pieces. | Not working properly because of damage. | Spoken with difficulty and frequent pauses or errors.
example1_en: She carefully swept the broken glass into a dustpan.
example1_zh: 她小心地把碎玻璃扫进簸箕里。
example2_en: Repairing broken household appliances rather than replacing them can reduce waste and conserve valuable natural resources.
example2_zh: 维修损坏的家用电器而非更换它们，可以减少废弃物并节约宝贵的自然资源。
collocations: broken glass｜碎玻璃 ; a broken bone｜骨折 ; broken English｜不流利的英语 ; a broken promise｜未兑现的承诺
tip_zh: 也是break的过去分词；过去式为broke。

meanings_zh: n. 森林；林区
definition_en: a large area of land covered mainly with trees
example1_en: We followed a narrow path deep into the forest.
example1_zh: 我们沿着一条狭窄的小路走进森林深处。
example2_en: Protecting natural forests helps preserve biodiversity and reduces the amount of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere.
example2_zh: 保护天然森林有助于维护生物多样性，并减少大气中的二氧化碳含量。
collocations: tropical forest｜热带森林 ; forest conservation｜森林保护 ; forest fire｜森林火灾 ; dense forest｜茂密的森林
tip_zh: forest通常指大片森林；wood也可指较小树林。

meanings_zh: n. 香肠
definition_en: finely chopped meat enclosed in a thin, tube-shaped skin
example1_en: We grilled sausages and served them with fresh vegetables.
example1_zh: 我们烤了香肠，配上新鲜蔬菜端上桌。
example2_en: Consumers are increasingly choosing vegetarian sausages as they seek alternatives to traditional meat products.
example2_zh: 随着消费者寻找传统肉制品的替代品，越来越多人开始选择素香肠。
collocations: grilled sausages｜烤香肠 ; vegetarian sausage｜素香肠 ; sausage meat｜香肠肉馅
tip_zh: 单根香肠可数；sausage meat指香肠肉馅，不可数。

meanings_zh: v. 组织；筹办 | v. 整理；使有条理
definition_en: To plan and arrange an event or activity | To arrange things in a clear, useful order
example1_en: Our neighbours organized a picnic by the river.
example1_zh: 我们的邻居组织了一次河边野餐。
example2_en: Schools should organize practical workshops that help students develop communication skills and prepare for employment.
example2_zh: 学校应组织实践工作坊，帮助学生培养沟通技能并为就业做好准备。
collocations: organize an event｜组织活动 ; organize a meeting｜安排会议 ; organize your time｜合理安排时间 ; organize files｜整理文件
tip_zh: 英式也常拼作organise；organize是规范拼写。

meanings_zh: n. 驴
definition_en: an animal like a small horse with long ears
example1_en: A grey donkey carried baskets along the narrow mountain path.
example1_zh: 一头灰驴驮着篮子走在狭窄的山路上。
example2_en: In some rural communities, donkeys remain important for transporting goods where roads are unsuitable for vehicles.
example2_zh: 在一些乡村社区，道路不适合车辆通行，驴仍是运输货物的重要工具。
collocations: a pack donkey｜驮货的驴 ; ride a donkey｜骑驴 ; a donkey brays｜驴叫
tip_zh: 指动物时donkey最常用；用来称呼人有贬义。

meanings_zh: adj. 野生的；野长的 | adj. 狂热的；失控的 | n. 野外；自然环境
definition_en: living or growing naturally, without human care | showing strong excitement or uncontrolled behaviour | natural places where animals and plants live freely
example1_en: We spotted wild deer drinking beside the forest stream.
example1_zh: 我们看见野鹿在森林的小溪旁喝水。
example2_en: Protecting wild animals requires governments to preserve habitats and reduce illegal trade across national borders.
example2_zh: 保护野生动物需要各国政府保护栖息地，并减少跨境非法贸易。
collocations: wild animals｜野生动物 ; in the wild｜在野外 ; go wild｜变得狂热 ; wild flowers｜野花
tip_zh: 表示“在野外”用in the wild，不能漏掉the。

meanings_zh: adj. 社会的 | adj. 社交的；交际的 | adj. 群居的
definition_en: relating to society and how people live together | relating to meeting people and spending time with them | living naturally in organised groups rather than alone
example1_en: My new job leaves little time for social activities.
example1_zh: 我的新工作让我几乎没时间参加社交活动。
example2_en: Affordable housing policies can reduce social inequality by helping families access safe homes near essential services.
example2_zh: 可负担住房政策帮助家庭在基本服务设施附近获得安全住所，从而减少社会不平等。
collocations: social inequality｜社会不平等 ; social skills｜社交技能 ; social activities｜社交活动 ; social change｜社会变革
tip_zh: social指社会或社交的；sociable指人爱交际。

meanings_zh: n. 洞；孔；坑 | n. 漏洞；缺陷
definition_en: An opening through something or a hollow space in the ground. | A weakness or missing part in a plan or argument.
example1_en: There's a small hole in my favourite sock.
example1_zh: 我最喜欢的袜子上有一个小洞。
example2_en: The discovery of a hole in the safety fence prompted residents to request urgent repairs.
example2_zh: 安全围栏上发现了一个破洞，促使居民要求紧急维修。
collocations: dig a hole｜挖坑 ; fill a hole｜填洞 ; a hole in the ground｜地上的坑 ; pick holes in｜挑毛病
tip_zh: hole指洞；whole指完整的，两词同音。

meanings_zh: n. 欧元
definition_en: The currency used by many countries in the European Union.
example1_en: I found a euro in my coat pocket today.
example1_zh: 今天我在外套口袋里发现了一枚一欧元硬币。
example2_en: Using the euro allows tourists to visit several European countries without exchanging money at each border.
example2_zh: 使用欧元让游客能够游览多个欧洲国家，而不必每过一次边境就兑换货币。
collocations: the euro area｜欧元区 ; pay in euros｜用欧元支付 ; adopt the euro｜采用欧元
tip_zh: 普通英语中复数通常为euros；并非所有欧盟国家都用欧元。

meanings_zh: n. 书柜；书架
definition_en: A piece of furniture with shelves for books.
example1_en: She keeps her favourite novels in a wooden bookcase.
example1_zh: 她把最喜欢的小说放在一个木书柜里。
example2_en: Placing accessible bookcases in classrooms can encourage children to read independently during their free time.
example2_zh: 在教室里摆放方便取书的书柜，可以鼓励孩子在空闲时间自主阅读。
collocations: wooden bookcase｜木书柜 ; built-in bookcase｜嵌入式书柜 ; a bookcase full of books｜装满书的书柜
tip_zh: bookcase指整件书柜，bookshelf指书架或一层搁板。

meanings_zh: n. 规则；规定 | n. 统治；管辖 | v. 统治；裁定
definition_en: an instruction stating what is allowed or required | control of a country or people by a leader or group | to govern a country or make an official legal decision
example1_en: Our main rule is to leave muddy shoes outside.
example1_zh: 我们最主要的规矩是把沾泥的鞋子留在外面。
example2_en: Clear rules on industrial waste disposal are essential for protecting rivers and ensuring safe drinking water.
example2_zh: 关于工业废物处理的明确规定对于保护河流和保障饮用水安全至关重要。
collocations: follow the rules｜遵守规则 ; break a rule｜违反规定 ; as a rule｜通常 ; rule out｜排除
tip_zh: as a rule意为“通常”；rule out意为“排除”。

meanings_zh: n. 刷子；画笔 | v. 刷；刷净 | v. 轻擦；掠过
definition_en: a tool with bristles used for cleaning, painting or arranging hair | to clean, paint or arrange something using a brush | to touch something lightly while moving past it
example1_en: Use a soft brush to clean your muddy shoes.
example1_zh: 用软毛刷清理你沾满泥的鞋子。
example2_en: Children should learn to brush their teeth properly, as good habits can prevent many dental problems.
example2_zh: 儿童应学会正确刷牙，因为良好的习惯可以预防许多牙齿问题。
collocations: brush your teeth｜刷牙 ; brush your hair｜梳头发 ; a paint brush｜画笔；油漆刷 ; brush against｜轻擦
tip_zh: brush against表示轻擦；brush up on表示温习。

meanings_zh: adj. 自豪的；骄傲的 | adj. 自负的；高傲的
definition_en: Feeling pleased about achievements or people you care about. | Believing you are better or more important than others.
example1_en: He felt proud of the cake he baked himself.
example1_zh: 他为自己亲手烤出的蛋糕感到自豪。
example2_en: Residents are often proud of their cultural heritage and support efforts to preserve historic buildings.
example2_zh: 居民往往为自己的文化遗产感到自豪，并支持保护历史建筑的行动。
collocations: proud of｜为……自豪 ; proud to be｜以身为……而自豪 ; make someone proud｜让某人自豪 ; too proud to ask｜太好面子而不肯问
tip_zh: be proud of后接名词或动名词，表示为……自豪。

meanings_zh: adj. 简单的；容易的 | adj. 朴素的；不加修饰的
definition_en: Easy to understand or do; not complicated. | Plain and without unnecessary decoration or extra features.
example1_en: This simple recipe takes just ten minutes to prepare.
example1_zh: 这道简单的菜只需十分钟就能做好。
example2_en: Schools should provide simple instructions so that all students can complete classroom tasks independently.
example2_zh: 学校应提供简单易懂的说明，让所有学生都能独立完成课堂任务。
collocations: simple solution｜简单的解决办法 ; simple instructions｜简单易懂的说明 ; keep it simple｜保持简单
tip_zh: simple可指容易或朴素，不一定表示简陋。

meanings_zh: adv. 还；尚；已经 | conj. 然而；可是 | adv. 更；还要
definition_en: Up to now, especially in questions and negative statements. | But, despite what has just been stated. | Used to emphasize a further increase or addition.
example1_en: I haven't finished dinner yet, so please wait.
example1_zh: 我还没吃完晚饭，请等一下。
example2_en: Renewable energy is becoming cheaper, yet many countries still depend heavily on fossil fuels.
example2_zh: 可再生能源正在变得更便宜，然而许多国家仍严重依赖化石燃料。
collocations: not yet｜还没有 ; have yet to do｜尚未做 ; yet another｜又一个 ; better yet｜更好的是
tip_zh: 表示“还未”常用于否定句末；疑问句中可表示“已经”。

meanings_zh: n. 珠宝；首饰
definition_en: decorative objects worn on the body, such as rings and necklaces
example1_en: She keeps her jewelry in a small wooden box.
example1_zh: 她把首饰放在一个小木盒里。
example2_en: Consumers increasingly want assurance that the materials used in jewelry are sourced responsibly and without environmental damage.
example2_zh: 消费者越来越希望得到保证：首饰所用材料的来源负责任，且不损害环境。
collocations: a piece of jewelry｜一件首饰 ; handmade jewelry｜手工首饰 ; gold jewelry｜黄金首饰 ; costume jewelry｜仿珠宝首饰
tip_zh: 美式拼写，英式为jewellery；不可数，用piece计件。

meanings_zh: n. 距离；间距 | n. 疏远；隔阂 | v. 使疏远；撇清关系
definition_en: The amount of space between two places or things | A lack of emotional closeness between people | To separate yourself from someone, something, or their views
example1_en: The distance from our house to school is quite short.
example1_zh: 从我们家到学校的距离很短。
example2_en: Reducing the distance between residential areas and workplaces could lower transport emissions and improve urban quality of life.
example2_zh: 缩短住宅区与工作地点之间的距离，可以减少交通排放并改善城市生活质量。
collocations: walking distance｜步行可达的距离 ; in the distance｜在远处 ; keep your distance｜保持距离 ; distance yourself from｜与……划清界限
tip_zh: in the distance指在远处；at a distance指隔一段距离。

meanings_zh: adj. 地下的；秘密的 | adv. 在地下；秘密地 | n. 地铁
definition_en: Below the ground, or operating secretly. | Below the ground, or in a hidden, secret way. | A railway system running mainly beneath a city.
example1_en: We left our car in an underground garage.
example1_zh: 我们把车停在了地下车库。
example2_en: Underground transport systems can ease congestion, although constructing tunnels requires substantial investment and careful planning.
example2_zh: 地铁交通系统能缓解拥堵，但隧道建设需要大量投资和周密规划。
collocations: underground station｜地铁站 ; underground car park｜地下停车场 ; travel underground｜在地下乘车出行 ; go underground｜转入秘密活动
tip_zh: 名词表地铁主要用于英式英语，此时重音在首音节。

meanings_zh: v. 拒绝；谢绝 | n. 垃圾；废弃物
definition_en: to say that you will not do or accept something | unwanted waste material that people throw away
example1_en: She refused to leave without her favourite blue umbrella.
example1_zh: 不带上她最喜欢的蓝色雨伞，她就不肯走。
example2_en: Local authorities may refuse permission for developments that threaten wildlife habitats or increase flood risks.
example2_zh: 地方政府可能拒绝批准威胁野生动物栖息地或增加洪灾风险的开发项目。
collocations: refuse to do something｜拒绝做某事 ; refuse an offer｜谢绝提议 ; refuse permission｜不予许可 ; refuse collection｜垃圾收运
tip_zh: 名词读/ˈrefjuːs/；动词后接to do，不接doing。

meanings_zh: adj. 懒惰的；不愿出力的 | adj. 悠闲的；懒洋洋的
definition_en: unwilling to work or make an effort | relaxed and involving little activity
example1_en: I felt too lazy to cook dinner tonight.
example1_zh: 今晚我懒得做饭。
example2_en: Students who struggle with homework should not automatically be considered lazy, as learning difficulties may be involved.
example2_zh: 不应一概认为做作业有困难的学生懒惰，因为这可能涉及学习障碍。
collocations: too lazy to｜懒得做 ; a lazy afternoon｜悠闲的午后 ; feel lazy｜感到懒洋洋的
tip_zh: lazy afternoon指悠闲的午后，不一定含贬义。

meanings_zh: adj. 吓人的；令人害怕的
definition_en: Making someone feel afraid or nervous.
example1_en: That scary noise was just a branch against the window.
example1_zh: 那个吓人的声音只不过是树枝在碰窗户。
example2_en: Starting school can be scary for young children, so teachers should create a welcoming environment.
example2_zh: 开始上学可能让年幼的孩子害怕，因此教师应营造友善的环境。
collocations: scary movie｜恐怖电影 ; scary experience｜可怕的经历 ; look scary｜看起来吓人
tip_zh: scary形容事物吓人；scared形容人感到害怕。

meanings_zh: n. 孙子；外孙
definition_en: the son of your son or daughter
example1_en: Her grandson visits every Sunday and helps with cooking.
example1_zh: 她的孙子每周日都来看她，并帮忙做饭。
example2_en: Regular contact with a grandson or granddaughter can help older adults feel more socially connected.
example2_zh: 经常与孙辈联系能帮助老年人增强与社会的联系感。
collocations: youngest grandson｜最小的孙子或外孙 ; eldest grandson｜最大的孙子或外孙
tip_zh: 不区分父系与母系，既指孙子也指外孙。

meanings_zh: adv. 在任何地方；去任何地方 | adv. 在某处；在任何一处
definition_en: in or to any place | in any place, used in questions and negative statements
example1_en: You can sit anywhere you like in this room.
example1_zh: 在这个房间里，你想坐哪儿都行。
example2_en: Reliable internet access allows employees to work from anywhere, reducing the need for daily commuting.
example2_zh: 可靠的网络连接使员工能够在任何地方工作，减少了每天通勤的必要。
collocations: anywhere else｜其他任何地方 ; from anywhere｜从任何地方 ; hardly anywhere｜几乎没有地方
tip_zh: 不定副词，通常不直接作名词；anywhere else指别处。

meanings_zh: n. 旗；旗帜 | v. 标记；提醒注意 | v. 衰退；减弱
definition_en: a cloth symbol representing a country, group, or organisation | to mark something as needing attention | to become weaker or less energetic
example1_en: A bright flag fluttered above the school gate.
example1_zh: 一面鲜艳的旗帜在校门上方飘扬。
example2_en: Teachers should flag potential learning difficulties early so that students can receive appropriate support.
example2_zh: 教师应尽早指出潜在的学习困难，以便学生获得适当的支持。
collocations: raise a flag｜升旗 ; national flag｜国旗 ; flag an issue｜标记问题 ; flagging energy｜逐渐减退的精力
tip_zh: 动词过去式flagged，进行式flagging，双写g。

meanings_zh: v. 与……结婚；结婚 | v. 为……主持婚礼
definition_en: To become someone's husband or wife. | To perform the ceremony that makes two people legally married.
example1_en: My cousin plans to marry her partner next spring.
example1_zh: 我表姐计划明年春天与伴侣结婚。
example2_en: Many young adults choose to marry later because they want financial stability before starting a family.
example2_zh: 许多年轻人选择晚婚，因为他们希望在组建家庭前拥有稳定的经济基础。
collocations: marry someone｜与某人结婚 ; get married｜结婚 ; marry young｜年纪轻轻就结婚
tip_zh: 说marry someone或get married to，不说marry with。

meanings_zh: num. 第七 | n. 七分之一
definition_en: Coming after sixth and before eighth in an ordered sequence. | One of seven equal parts of something.
example1_en: Our new flat is on the seventh floor.
example1_zh: 我们的新公寓在七楼。
example2_en: By the seventh week of the course, students were able to analyse basic scientific data independently.
example2_zh: 到课程第七周时，学生已能独立分析基本的科学数据。
collocations: the seventh floor｜七楼 ; in seventh place｜位列第七 ; a seventh of｜……的七分之一
tip_zh: 序数词前通常用the；已有物主限定词时不用the。

meanings_zh: adj. 天然的；自然界的 | adj. 天生的 | adj. 正常的；合乎常理的
definition_en: existing in nature rather than made by people | having an ability from birth rather than through training | normal and expected in a particular situation
example1_en: This soap is made entirely from natural ingredients.
example1_zh: 这块肥皂完全由天然原料制成。
example2_en: Protecting natural habitats is essential for maintaining biodiversity and supporting communities that depend on local ecosystems.
example2_zh: 保护自然栖息地对于维持生物多样性、支持依赖当地生态系统的社区至关重要。
collocations: natural resources｜自然资源 ; natural habitat｜自然栖息地 ; natural talent｜天赋 ; perfectly natural｜完全正常的
tip_zh: natural指天然的；nature是名词，指自然。

meanings_zh: n. 园艺；种植花木
definition_en: The activity of growing and caring for plants in gardens.
example1_en: My grandmother enjoys gardening on cool spring mornings.
example1_zh: 我奶奶喜欢在凉爽的春日早晨打理花园。
example2_en: Community gardening can improve urban environments while helping residents develop stronger social connections.
example2_zh: 社区园艺既能改善城市环境，也能帮助居民建立更紧密的社会联系。
collocations: gardening tools｜园艺工具 ; do some gardening｜做些园艺活 ; community gardening｜社区园艺
tip_zh: 通常为不可数名词：do some gardening。

meanings_zh: n. 冲浪运动 | n. 网上浏览
definition_en: The sport of riding waves while standing on a board. | The activity of browsing websites on the internet.
example1_en: We went surfing at the beach early this morning.
example1_zh: 今天一大早我们去海滩冲浪了。
example2_en: The growing popularity of surfing can support coastal economies while increasing pressure on fragile marine environments.
example2_zh: 冲浪运动日益流行，既能促进沿海经济，也会加大脆弱海洋环境承受的压力。
collocations: go surfing｜去冲浪 ; surfing lessons｜冲浪课程 ; web surfing｜网页浏览
tip_zh: 运动用go surfing；网上浏览也可说surf the internet。

meanings_zh: n. 使用者；用户
definition_en: A person who uses a product, service, or facility.
example1_en: Each user can choose a different colour for their profile.
example1_zh: 每位用户都可以为自己的个人资料选择不同的颜色。
example2_en: Software developers should consider the needs of every user, including people with limited technical skills.
example2_zh: 软件开发者应考虑每位用户的需求，包括技术能力有限的人。
collocations: user account｜用户账户 ; user feedback｜用户反馈 ; road user｜道路使用者 ; regular user｜经常使用者
tip_zh: use作动词及user中的s读/z/。

meanings_zh: n. 地铁；地铁系统
definition_en: An urban railway system that often runs underground.
example1_en: We took the metro to the museum this morning.
example1_zh: 今天上午，我们乘地铁去了博物馆。
example2_en: Expanding the metro could reduce traffic congestion by providing residents with a reliable alternative to private cars.
example2_zh: 扩建地铁能为居民提供可靠的私家车替代出行方式，从而缓解交通拥堵。
collocations: take the metro｜乘地铁 ; metro station｜地铁站 ; metro line｜地铁线路 ; metro network｜地铁网络
tip_zh: metro不限于法国；乘地铁常说take the metro。

meanings_zh: v. 挽救；救助 | v. 节省；储蓄 | v. 保存；保留
definition_en: To prevent someone or something from being harmed or lost. | To use less of something or keep money for later. | To keep something for future use, especially computer data.
example1_en: The lifeguard saved a child from the deep water.
example1_zh: 救生员从深水中救起了一个孩子。
example2_en: Investing in reliable public transport can save commuters time and reduce household travel costs.
example2_zh: 投资建设可靠的公共交通可以节省通勤者的时间，并降低家庭出行成本。
collocations: save a life｜挽救生命 ; save money｜省钱；存钱 ; save time｜节省时间 ; save a file｜保存文件
tip_zh: save money既可指省钱，也可指存钱。

meanings_zh: n. 珠宝；首饰
definition_en: Decorative objects worn on the body, such as rings and necklaces.
example1_en: She keeps her jewellery in a small wooden box.
example1_zh: 她把首饰放在一个小木盒里。
example2_en: Traditional jewellery can reflect cultural identity while providing income for skilled craftspeople in rural communities.
example2_zh: 传统首饰既能体现文化认同，也能为农村社区的熟练手工艺人带来收入。
collocations: a piece of jewellery｜一件首饰 ; gold jewellery｜黄金首饰 ; handmade jewellery｜手工首饰
tip_zh: 不可数；一件用a piece of；美式拼写jewelry。

meanings_zh: n. 塑料 | adj. 塑料制的 | adj. 可塑的
definition_en: a lightweight manufactured material that can form many different shapes | made of plastic | able to be shaped or changed easily
example1_en: This lunch box is made of strong recycled plastic.
example1_zh: 这个午餐盒由结实的再生塑料制成。
example2_en: Reducing single-use plastic packaging could protect marine ecosystems and lower the costs of managing household waste.
example2_zh: 减少一次性塑料包装可以保护海洋生态系统，并降低生活垃圾处理成本。
collocations: single-use plastic｜一次性塑料 ; plastic waste｜塑料垃圾 ; plastic packaging｜塑料包装 ; recycled plastic｜再生塑料
tip_zh: 表示塑料材料时通常不可数；a plastic指一种塑料。

meanings_zh: prep. 朝；向 | prep. 对；对于 | prep. 用于；有助于
definition_en: In the direction of someone or something. | In relation to someone or something, especially in attitude. | Helping to achieve a goal or pay for something.
example1_en: The puppy ran towards me with its tail wagging.
example1_zh: 小狗摇着尾巴朝我跑来。
example2_en: Investment in public transport is an important step towards reducing air pollution in cities.
example2_zh: 投资公共交通是减少城市空气污染的重要一步。
collocations: walk towards｜朝……走去 ; attitude towards｜对……的态度 ; work towards a goal｜努力实现目标 ; go towards the cost｜用于支付部分费用
tip_zh: towards与toward意思相同；前者英式更常用。

meanings_zh: n. 西兰花
definition_en: A green vegetable with thick stems and tightly clustered flower buds.
example1_en: We steamed the broccoli until it turned bright green.
example1_zh: 我们把西兰花蒸到颜色变得鲜绿。
example2_en: Schools can encourage healthier eating by serving vegetables such as broccoli alongside familiar dishes.
example2_zh: 学校可以在常见菜肴旁搭配西兰花等蔬菜，鼓励更健康的饮食。
collocations: broccoli florets｜西兰花小朵 ; steamed broccoli｜蒸西兰花 ; a head of broccoli｜一整颗西兰花
tip_zh: 通常不可数；小朵西兰花可说broccoli florets。

meanings_zh: v. 保护；防护
definition_en: To keep someone or something safe from harm or damage
example1_en: Wear thick gloves to protect your hands from thorns.
example1_zh: 戴上厚手套，保护双手不被刺扎伤。
example2_en: Governments should protect endangered species by preserving natural habitats and restricting activities that threaten their survival.
example2_zh: 政府应通过保护自然栖息地并限制威胁生存的活动，来保护濒危物种。
collocations: protect the environment｜保护环境 ; protect against disease｜预防疾病 ; protect from harm｜保护……免受伤害 ; protect privacy｜保护隐私
tip_zh: 常用protect sb/sth from或against，表示免受伤害。

meanings_zh: adj. 奇怪的；反常的 | adj. 陌生的；不熟悉的
definition_en: Unusual or unexpected in a way that seems surprising | Not known or experienced before
example1_en: There was a strange noise coming from the cupboard.
example1_zh: 橱柜里传出一阵奇怪的声音。
example2_en: Customs that seem strange to visitors may reflect important social values within the local community.
example2_zh: 在游客看来奇怪的习俗，可能体现了当地社区重要的社会价值观。
collocations: strange behaviour｜奇怪的行为 ; feel strange｜感觉不自在 ; a strange place｜陌生的地方 ; a strange noise｜奇怪的声音
tip_zh: strange 可指奇怪，也可指陌生；stranger 是陌生人。

meanings_zh: adj. 最新的；最近的 | n. 最新消息；最新事物
definition_en: Most recent or newest. | The most recent news, developments, or products.
example1_en: Have you heard the latest news about our neighbour?
example1_zh: 你听说关于我们邻居的最新消息了吗？
example2_en: The latest research suggests that regular physical activity can improve both memory and mental health.
example2_zh: 最新研究表明，规律运动可以改善记忆力和心理健康。
collocations: the latest research｜最新研究 ; the latest version｜最新版本 ; at the latest｜最迟
tip_zh: latest指最新；last常指上一个或最后一个。

meanings_zh: n. 蛇 | v. 蜿蜒延伸；曲折前行
definition_en: a long reptile without legs | to move or extend along a winding path
example1_en: A small snake slid quietly through the dry grass.
example1_zh: 一条小蛇悄悄滑过干草丛。
example2_en: Although snakes often cause fear, they help maintain ecological balance by controlling populations of rodents and other animals.
example2_zh: 虽然蛇常令人恐惧，但它们通过控制啮齿动物及其他动物的数量，帮助维持生态平衡。
collocations: a poisonous snake｜毒蛇 ; a snake bite｜蛇咬伤 ; snake through｜蜿蜒穿过
tip_zh: 作动词表示蜿蜒，常搭配through或along。

meanings_zh: n. 衣柜；衣橱 | n. 某人的全部衣物
definition_en: a tall cupboard used for storing clothes | all the clothes that a person owns
example1_en: Her winter coats fill most of the wardrobe.
example1_zh: 她的冬季外套占了衣柜的大部分空间。
example2_en: Building a smaller wardrobe with durable clothing can reduce the environmental impact of fashion consumption.
example2_zh: 减少衣物数量并选择耐穿的服装，可以降低时尚消费对环境的影响。
collocations: fitted wardrobe｜嵌入式衣柜 ; capsule wardrobe｜精简百搭衣橱 ; update your wardrobe｜添置新衣
tip_zh: 既指衣柜，也可指某人拥有的全部衣物。

meanings_zh: n. 家乡；故乡
definition_en: The town or city where you grew up or come from.
example1_en: I return to my hometown every summer to visit relatives.
example1_zh: 我每年夏天都回家乡探望亲人。
example2_en: Many graduates leave their hometown to seek better employment opportunities in larger urban centres.
example2_zh: 许多毕业生离开家乡，前往更大的城市寻求更好的就业机会。
collocations: return to your hometown｜回到家乡 ; leave your hometown｜离开家乡 ; hometown residents｜家乡居民
tip_zh: 可指小镇或城市，不一定是出生地。

meanings_zh: adj. 聪明的；明智的 | adj. 整洁时髦的 | adj. 智能的
definition_en: intelligent or showing good judgment | neat, stylish, and suitable for a formal occasion | using computer technology to perform tasks automatically
example1_en: That was a smart way to fix the shelf.
example1_zh: 用那个办法修好架子真聪明。
example2_en: Smart irrigation systems can reduce water waste by adjusting supply according to soil conditions.
example2_zh: 智能灌溉系统可根据土壤状况调节供水，从而减少水资源浪费。
collocations: a smart choice｜明智的选择 ; smart clothes｜整洁时髦的衣服 ; smart technology｜智能技术 ; look smart｜看起来整洁得体
tip_zh: 英式常指衣着整洁时髦；美式常指聪明。

meanings_zh: n. 婆婆；岳母
definition_en: the mother of your husband or wife
example1_en: My mother-in-law taught me how to grow tomatoes.
example1_zh: 我婆婆教我如何种番茄。
example2_en: Support from a mother-in-law can reduce childcare costs and allow parents to continue their education.
example2_zh: 婆婆或岳母的支持可以降低育儿成本，让父母能够继续接受教育。
collocations: future mother-in-law｜未来的婆婆或岳母 ; supportive mother-in-law｜给予支持的婆婆或岳母
tip_zh: 指配偶的母亲；复数mothers-in-law。

meanings_zh: n. 山羊
definition_en: A hoofed animal, often with horns, kept for milk or meat.
example1_en: A curious goat poked its head through the fence.
example1_zh: 一只好奇的山羊把头探出了围栏。
example2_en: Raising goats can provide rural families with a reliable source of milk and additional income.
example2_zh: 饲养山羊可以为农村家庭提供稳定的奶源和额外收入。
collocations: goat's milk｜山羊奶 ; goat's cheese｜山羊奶酪 ; a herd of goats｜一群山羊
tip_zh: goat是山羊，sheep是绵羊；替罪羊用scapegoat。

meanings_zh: adj. 清楚的；明确的 | adj. 清澈的；晴朗的 | v. 清除；清空
definition_en: Easy to understand, see, or hear | Free from cloud, dirt, or anything blocking light | To remove unwanted things from a place
example1_en: The instructions were clear, so I assembled the shelf easily.
example1_zh: 说明很清楚，所以我轻松地组装好了架子。
example2_en: Public health campaigns should provide clear advice that people from different educational backgrounds can easily understand.
example2_zh: 公共卫生宣传应提供明确的建议，让不同教育背景的人都能轻松理解。
collocations: clear instructions｜清楚的说明 ; clear evidence｜明确的证据 ; crystal clear｜清澈透明的；非常清楚的 ; clear the table｜收拾餐桌
tip_zh: make it clear that…表示明确说明……。

meanings_zh: n. 博客；网络日志 | v. 写博客
definition_en: A website or page with regularly added posts. | To write and publish posts on a blog.
example1_en: She writes a blog about growing vegetables at home.
example1_zh: 她写一个介绍在家种菜的博客。
example2_en: A well-researched blog can make scientific information more accessible to readers without specialist knowledge.
example2_zh: 一个研究充分的博客可以让没有专业知识的读者更容易理解科学信息。
collocations: write a blog｜写博客 ; blog post｜博文 ; travel blog｜旅行博客 ; blog about something｜写关于某事的博客
tip_zh: 一篇博文叫a blog post；blog常指整个博客。

meanings_zh: adj. 数字技术的；数码的
definition_en: using electronic systems that store and process information as digits
example1_en: She keeps digital copies of all her family photos.
example1_zh: 她保存着所有家庭照片的电子副本。
example2_en: Improving digital skills can help older adults access public services and maintain contact with distant relatives.
example2_zh: 提高数字技能可以帮助老年人使用公共服务，并与远方亲属保持联系。
collocations: digital technology｜数字技术 ; digital skills｜数字技能 ; digital divide｜数字鸿沟 ; digital camera｜数码相机
tip_zh: digital侧重数字技术；表示“数字上的”常用numerical。

meanings_zh: adj. 有礼貌的；客气的
definition_en: Showing respect and consideration for other people.
example1_en: The polite child held the door open for us.
example1_zh: 那个有礼貌的孩子为我们扶着门。
example2_en: Polite communication in the workplace can reduce misunderstandings and help employees build stronger professional relationships.
example2_zh: 职场中的礼貌沟通可以减少误解，并帮助员工建立更牢固的工作关系。
collocations: polite to someone｜对某人有礼貌 ; polite request｜礼貌的请求 ; polite conversation｜客气的交谈 ; polite refusal｜婉言拒绝
tip_zh: 对某人有礼貌用be polite to，不用polite with。

meanings_zh: n. 精力；活力 | n. 能量；能源
definition_en: The strength and enthusiasm needed for physical or mental activity | Power used to produce heat, movement, light, or electricity
example1_en: After a short nap, I had energy to cook.
example1_zh: 小睡一会儿后，我有精力做饭了。
example2_en: Investing in renewable energy can reduce dependence on fossil fuels while creating new employment opportunities.
example2_zh: 投资可再生能源可以减少对化石燃料的依赖，同时创造新的就业机会。
collocations: full of energy｜精力充沛 ; renewable energy｜可再生能源 ; energy consumption｜能源消耗 ; save energy｜节约能源
tip_zh: 表示精力或能源时通常不可数，不说 an energy。

meanings_zh: n. 政府 | n. 治理；政体
definition_en: the group of people officially controlling a country or region | the activity or system of controlling a country
example1_en: The government plans to build a new hospital nearby.
example1_zh: 政府计划在附近建一所新医院。
example2_en: Local government plays a crucial role in providing affordable housing and maintaining essential public services.
example2_zh: 地方政府在提供可负担住房和维持基本公共服务方面发挥着关键作用。
collocations: local government｜地方政府 ; central government｜中央政府 ; government policy｜政府政策 ; a system of government｜政体
tip_zh: 英国英语中，指政府群体时可接单数或复数谓语。

meanings_zh: v. 组织；筹办 | v. 整理；有序安排
definition_en: plan and arrange an event or activity | put things into a clear and useful order
example1_en: We organise a picnic for our neighbours every summer.
example1_zh: 我们每年夏天都会为邻居们组织一次野餐。
example2_en: Local councils can organise community workshops to teach residents practical ways to reduce household waste.
example2_zh: 地方议会可以组织社区工作坊，教居民减少家庭垃圾的实用方法。
collocations: organise an event｜筹办活动 ; organise a meeting｜组织会议 ; organise your time｜安排时间 ; organise files｜整理文件
tip_zh: organise常见于英式英语；美式通常写organize。

meanings_zh: adv. 正确地；恰当地
definition_en: in a way that is accurate or follows the rules
example1_en: Check that you have entered your address correctly.
example1_zh: 检查一下，确保你的地址输入正确。
example2_en: Students need regular feedback to ensure that they apply newly learned scientific concepts correctly in practical situations.
example2_zh: 学生需要定期获得反馈，以确保他们能在实际情境中正确运用新学的科学概念。
collocations: answer correctly｜回答正确 ; correctly identify｜正确识别 ; correctly interpret｜正确解读 ; if I remember correctly｜如果我没记错
tip_zh: 修饰动作；correct是形容词或动词，不作副词使用。

meanings_zh: adj. 公平的；合理的 | adj. 肤色白皙的；浅色的 | n. 展销会；集市
definition_en: treating people equally or reasonably | having pale skin or light hair | an event where people display or sell goods and services
example1_en: We took turns choosing games to keep things fair.
example1_zh: 我们轮流选游戏，以保证公平。
example2_en: A fair education system should give every child access to quality teaching, regardless of family income.
example2_zh: 公平的教育制度应让每个孩子都能获得优质教学，不受家庭收入影响。
collocations: fair treatment｜公平待遇 ; a fair price｜合理的价格 ; fair hair｜浅色头发 ; trade fair｜贸易展览会
tip_zh: fair指待遇公平；fairly还可表示“相当”。

meanings_zh: n. 假期；度假 | v. 度假
definition_en: time away from work or study for rest or travel | to spend a holiday somewhere away from home
example1_en: We spent our summer vacation camping beside a lake.
example1_zh: 我们暑假在湖边露营。
example2_en: Taking a regular vacation may improve employees' mental health and help them return to work with greater motivation.
example2_zh: 定期休假可能改善员工的心理健康，并让他们回到工作岗位时更有动力。
collocations: on vacation｜在度假 ; take a vacation｜休假 ; summer vacation｜暑假 ; paid vacation｜带薪假期
tip_zh: 主要用于美式英语；英式英语一般用holiday。

meanings_zh: n. 旅行者；旅客
definition_en: a person who travels from one place to another
example1_en: A tired traveler asked me where the station was.
example1_zh: 一位疲惫的旅客问我车站在哪里。
example2_en: Every traveler can support local communities by choosing accommodation and services owned by residents.
example2_zh: 每位旅行者都可以选择当地居民经营的住宿和服务，以支持当地社区。
collocations: solo traveler｜独自旅行者 ; business traveler｜商务旅客 ; frequent traveler｜经常出行的人
tip_zh: traveler是美式拼写；英式通常写traveller。

meanings_zh: n. 工具；用具 | n. 手段；辅助工具
definition_en: An object used to build, repair, or make things. | Something that helps you perform a task or achieve something.
example1_en: This small tool helps me tighten the loose screws.
example1_zh: 这个小工具帮我拧紧松动的螺丝。
example2_en: Digital maps are a valuable tool for urban planners seeking to design more accessible public transport networks.
example2_zh: 数字地图是城市规划者设计更便捷的公共交通网络的重要辅助工具。
collocations: hand tools｜手工工具 ; power tools｜电动工具 ; a useful tool｜实用工具 ; a tool for learning｜学习工具
tip_zh: tool是可数名词；equipment通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 脚踝；踝关节
definition_en: the joint connecting your foot to your leg
example1_en: She twisted her ankle while walking down the steps.
example1_zh: 她下台阶时扭伤了脚踝。
example2_en: Appropriate footwear can reduce the risk of ankle injuries during physical exercise and outdoor activities.
example2_zh: 合适的鞋子可以降低体育锻炼和户外活动中脚踝受伤的风险。
collocations: sprain an ankle｜扭伤脚踝 ; a swollen ankle｜肿胀的脚踝 ; ankle support｜护踝
tip_zh: ankle指脚与小腿连接处，不是脚后跟heel。

meanings_zh: n. 早餐麦片 | n. 谷物；谷类作物
definition_en: a breakfast food made from grains, often eaten with milk | a plant grown for grain, or the grain it produces
example1_en: She poured cold milk over her bowl of cereal.
example1_zh: 她把冷牛奶倒进盛着早餐麦片的碗里。
example2_en: Farmers may need to grow different cereal crops as changing rainfall patterns affect agricultural production.
example2_zh: 随着降雨模式变化影响农业生产，农民可能需要种植不同的谷类作物。
collocations: breakfast cereal｜早餐麦片 ; a bowl of cereal｜一碗麦片 ; cereal crops｜谷类作物 ; wholegrain cereal｜全谷物麦片
tip_zh: 早餐食品泛指时常不可数；指谷物种类可用cereals。

meanings_zh: n. 昆虫
definition_en: A small animal with six legs and three main body sections.
example1_en: A tiny green insect landed on my sleeve.
example1_zh: 一只绿色的小昆虫落在了我的袖子上。
example2_en: Many insect species pollinate crops, making their protection essential for food production and healthy ecosystems.
example2_zh: 许多昆虫物种为农作物授粉，因此保护它们对粮食生产和健康的生态系统至关重要。
collocations: insect bite｜昆虫叮咬 ; insect repellent｜驱虫剂 ; insect species｜昆虫物种
tip_zh: 可数名词；蜘蛛有八条腿，不属于昆虫。

meanings_zh: n. 法国男子
definition_en: a man who is French
example1_en: A Frenchman on the train helped me lift my suitcase.
example1_zh: 火车上一位法国男子帮我提起了行李箱。
example2_en: The exhibition explores how a Frenchman adapted to life abroad while maintaining connections with his home culture.
example2_zh: 这场展览探讨了一位法国男子如何适应海外生活，同时保持与本国文化的联系。
collocations: a young Frenchman｜一位年轻的法国男子 ; a native Frenchman｜一位土生土长的法国男子
tip_zh: 首字母大写，复数Frenchmen；不限性别用French person。

meanings_zh: n. 经理；管理者
definition_en: A person responsible for running a business, team, or department.
example1_en: The manager helped a new employee arrange the shelves.
example1_zh: 经理帮一位新员工整理了货架。
example2_en: An effective manager encourages open communication and ensures that employees have sufficient resources to complete their tasks.
example2_zh: 高效的管理者鼓励开放沟通，并确保员工有充足的资源完成任务。
collocations: project manager｜项目经理 ; store manager｜商店经理 ; senior manager｜高级经理 ; line manager｜直属上司
tip_zh: manager指管理者；management可指管理工作或管理层。

meanings_zh: adj. 独自的；单独的 | adv. 独自地；独力地 | adv. 仅仅；单是
definition_en: without anyone else present | without other people or their help | only, excluding everything or everyone else
example1_en: I was alone in the kitchen when the kettle boiled.
example1_zh: 水壶里的水烧开时，厨房里只有我一个人。
example2_en: Governments cannot solve environmental problems alone, as lasting progress also requires cooperation from businesses and individual citizens.
example2_zh: 政府无法独力解决环境问题，因为持久的进步也需要企业和公民个人的合作。
collocations: live alone｜独居 ; travel alone｜独自旅行 ; leave someone alone｜不打扰某人 ; go it alone｜独自干
tip_zh: alone指独自，不一定孤独；lonely强调孤独感。

meanings_zh: n. 竞争 | n. 比赛；竞赛
definition_en: The effort to succeed against others seeking the same goal. | An organised event in which people try to win.
example1_en: Our school is holding a painting competition next Friday.
example1_zh: 我们学校下周五要举办绘画比赛。
example2_en: Competition between businesses can lower prices, but effective regulation is needed to protect consumers from unfair practices.
example2_zh: 企业间的竞争可以降低价格，但仍需有效监管来保护消费者免受不公平商业行为的侵害。
collocations: fierce competition｜激烈竞争 ; competition for jobs｜求职竞争 ; enter a competition｜参加比赛 ; win a competition｜赢得比赛
tip_zh: 表示竞争通常不可数；表示一场比赛时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 牛肉
definition_en: meat from cattle, eaten as food
example1_en: We cooked the beef slowly with carrots and potatoes.
example1_zh: 我们把牛肉和胡萝卜、土豆一起慢炖。
example2_en: Reducing beef consumption could lower greenhouse gas emissions because raising cattle requires substantial land and resources.
example2_zh: 减少牛肉消费可能降低温室气体排放，因为养牛需要大量土地和资源。
collocations: roast beef｜烤牛肉 ; minced beef｜牛肉末 ; beef stew｜炖牛肉 ; lean beef｜瘦牛肉
tip_zh: 表示食物时通常不可数：some beef，不用a beef。

meanings_zh: v. 讨论；商讨 | v. 论述
definition_en: to talk about something and exchange ideas | to examine a subject in speech or writing
example1_en: Let's discuss our holiday plans over dinner tonight.
example1_zh: 今晚我们边吃晚饭边商量度假计划吧。
example2_en: Students should discuss different solutions before deciding how to reduce waste on their campus.
