example2_zh: 学生应先讨论不同的解决办法，再决定如何减少校园垃圾。
collocations: discuss a problem｜讨论问题 ; discuss something with someone｜与某人讨论某事 ; discuss in detail｜详细讨论
tip_zh: 直接接讨论内容：discuss sth，不加about。

meanings_zh: n. 零食；小吃 | v. 吃零食；吃点心
definition_en: A small amount of food eaten between main meals. | To eat small amounts of food between main meals.
example1_en: I packed an apple and some nuts for a snack.
example1_zh: 我装了一个苹果和一些坚果，留着当零食吃。
example2_en: Schools can encourage healthier eating habits by offering nutritious snacks instead of foods high in sugar.
example2_zh: 学校可以提供营养丰富的点心来代替高糖食品，从而鼓励更健康的饮食习惯。
collocations: a healthy snack｜健康零食 ; a light snack｜少量点心 ; snack on nuts｜吃坚果当零食
tip_zh: 动词常用snack on sth，表示吃某物当零食。

meanings_zh: n. 番茄调味酱
definition_en: A thick, usually tomato-based sauce served with food.
example1_en: He squeezed some ketchup onto his plate of chips.
example1_zh: 他往那盘薯条上挤了些番茄酱。
example2_en: Reducing added sugar in everyday products such as ketchup could help consumers make healthier dietary choices.
example2_zh: 减少番茄酱等日常食品中的添加糖，有助于消费者作出更健康的饮食选择。
collocations: tomato ketchup｜番茄调味酱 ; a bottle of ketchup｜一瓶番茄酱 ; a squeeze of ketchup｜挤出的一点番茄酱
tip_zh: 不可数；与浓缩烹饪用的tomato paste不同。

meanings_zh: n. 模型；模式 | n. 模范；榜样 | n. 模特儿
definition_en: a representation showing how something looks, works, or is organised | someone or something that provides a good example to follow | a person who displays clothes or poses for artists
example1_en: He built a model of a bridge from cardboard.
example1_zh: 他用硬纸板做了一座桥的模型。
example2_en: Researchers use a computer model to predict how rising temperatures may affect regional water supplies.
example2_zh: 研究人员利用计算机模型预测气温上升可能如何影响区域供水。
collocations: scale model｜比例模型 ; computer model｜计算机模型 ; role model｜榜样 ; fashion model｜时装模特
tip_zh: model还可作动词，表示建模或当模特。

meanings_zh: n. 复印机
definition_en: A machine that makes paper copies of documents or pictures.
example1_en: The office photocopier has run out of paper again.
example1_zh: 办公室的复印机又没纸了。
example2_en: Providing a shared photocopier allows small businesses to reduce equipment costs while meeting their daily printing needs.
example2_zh: 配备共用复印机可让小企业在满足日常打印需求的同时降低设备成本。
collocations: use a photocopier｜使用复印机 ; office photocopier｜办公室复印机 ; colour photocopier｜彩色复印机
tip_zh: photocopier是机器；photocopy是复印件或复印动作。

meanings_zh: n. 邮件；邮政 | v. 邮寄
definition_en: letters and parcels sent or delivered through a postal service | to send a letter or parcel through a postal service
example1_en: The mail arrived just as we finished breakfast.
example1_zh: 我们刚吃完早饭，邮件就到了。
example2_en: Although digital communication is widespread, many rural residents still depend on mail for essential documents.
example2_zh: 尽管数字通信已很普及，许多农村居民仍依赖邮政收取重要文件。
collocations: send by mail｜通过邮政寄送 ; check the mail｜查看邮件 ; mail a parcel｜邮寄包裹
tip_zh: mail作“邮件”通常不可数；英式日常也常用post。

meanings_zh: adj. 虚弱的；无力的 | adj. 薄弱的；缺乏说服力的 | adj. 淡的；微弱的
definition_en: lacking physical strength or energy | not effective, convincing, or well supported | having little intensity, flavour, or power
example1_en: I felt too weak to carry the shopping upstairs.
example1_zh: 我觉得浑身无力，没法把买来的东西提上楼。
example2_en: Policies based on weak evidence may fail to address the underlying causes of unemployment.
example2_zh: 依据薄弱证据制定的政策可能无法解决失业的根本原因。
collocations: feel weak｜感到虚弱 ; weak evidence｜薄弱的证据 ; weak signal｜微弱的信号 ; weak tea｜淡茶
tip_zh: weak与week同音；weakness可指弱点，也可指虚弱。

meanings_zh: v. 发明；创造 | v. 编造；虚构
definition_en: To design or make something that did not exist before. | To make up a story or excuse that is untrue.
example1_en: My sister invented a clever tool for picking apples.
example1_zh: 我姐姐发明了一种巧妙的摘苹果工具。
example2_en: Engineers must invent affordable technologies that help rural communities gain access to clean drinking water.
example2_zh: 工程师必须发明价格可负担的技术，帮助农村社区获得清洁饮用水。
collocations: invent a device｜发明装置 ; invent an excuse｜编造借口 ; invent a story｜虚构故事
tip_zh: invent是创造新事物；discover是发现已有事物。

meanings_zh: v. 发现
definition_en: to find something or learn something previously unknown
example1_en: We discovered a quiet beach behind the cliffs.
example1_zh: 我们在悬崖后面发现了一片安静的海滩。
example2_en: Scientists may discover new ways to treat diseases by studying plants in tropical forests.
example2_zh: 科学家可能通过研究热带森林中的植物，发现治疗疾病的新方法。
collocations: discover a cure｜发现疗法 ; discover a new species｜发现新物种 ; discover the truth｜发现真相
tip_zh: discover发现原本存在的事物；invent创造新事物。

meanings_zh: n. 设计师；设计者 | adj. 名牌设计师设计的
definition_en: Someone who plans how something will look or work. | Made by a famous fashion designer, usually expensive.
example1_en: The designer showed us a model of our kitchen.
example1_zh: 设计师给我们看了我们厨房的模型。
example2_en: A skilled designer can make public spaces more accessible to people with limited mobility.
example2_zh: 技艺娴熟的设计师能够让行动不便的人更方便地使用公共空间。
collocations: fashion designer｜时装设计师 ; graphic designer｜平面设计师 ; interior designer｜室内设计师 ; designer clothes｜设计师品牌服装
tip_zh: 作形容词常置于衣物等名词前，强调设计师品牌。

meanings_zh: n. 体育场
definition_en: a large sports venue with seating around a central area
example1_en: Fans filled the stadium before the football match began.
example1_zh: 足球比赛开始前，球迷们就坐满了体育场。
example2_en: Building a new stadium may attract visitors, but its long-term maintenance costs require careful consideration.
example2_zh: 修建新体育场或许能吸引游客，但其长期维护费用需要仔细考虑。
collocations: football stadium｜足球场 ; packed stadium｜座无虚席的体育场 ; stadium capacity｜体育场容纳人数
tip_zh: 复数可用stadiums或stadia，前者更常见。

meanings_zh: n. 小学生；中学生 | n. 瞳孔
definition_en: A child who attends school. | The dark opening in the eye that lets light enter.
example1_en: Each pupil brought a leaf to the science lesson.
example1_zh: 每个学生都带了一片树叶来上科学课。
example2_en: Smaller classes may allow teachers to give each pupil more individual support and useful feedback.
example2_zh: 小班教学可能让教师为每个学生提供更多个别指导和有用的反馈。
collocations: primary school pupil｜小学生 ; former pupil｜校友；昔日学生 ; dilated pupils｜扩大的瞳孔
tip_zh: 英式英语常指中小学生；大学生用 student。

meanings_zh: adj. 迷路的；丢失的 | adj. 困惑的；不知所措的 | v. 丢失；失去；输掉
definition_en: Unable to find the way, or unable to be found. | Unable to understand something or decide what to do. | Past tense and past participle of lose.
example1_en: We got lost while walking through the old town.
example1_zh: 我们在老城区步行时迷路了。
example2_en: Without clear guidance, new university students may feel lost when choosing courses that affect their future careers.
example2_zh: 缺少明确指导时，大学新生在选择影响未来职业的课程时可能会感到迷茫。
collocations: get lost｜迷路 ; lost property｜失物 ; feel lost｜感到迷茫 ; lost in thought｜陷入沉思
tip_zh: get lost可指迷路；单独用作命令语气粗鲁。

meanings_zh: num. 一千 | n. 数千；大量
definition_en: The number equal to ten hundreds. | A very large quantity, expressed as thousands.
example1_en: The repair cost nearly a thousand dollars in total.
example1_zh: 维修费总共将近一千美元。
example2_en: Several thousand residents have benefited from the new cycle routes connecting suburban neighbourhoods with the city centre.
example2_zh: 连接郊区社区与市中心的新自行车道已让数千名居民受益。
collocations: a thousand people｜一千人 ; two thousand years｜两千年 ; thousands of｜数以千计的
tip_zh: 具体数词后不加s；泛指数千用thousands of。

meanings_zh: n. 上帝；唯一的神
definition_en: The supreme being worshipped in religions believing in one god.
example1_en: My grandmother thanks God before each meal at home.
example1_zh: 我祖母在家每次用餐前都会感谢上帝。
example2_en: Belief in God can influence people's values, charitable activities, and responses to difficult circumstances.
example2_zh: 对上帝的信仰可能影响人们的价值观、慈善活动及应对困境的方式。
collocations: believe in God｜信仰上帝 ; pray to God｜向上帝祈祷 ; faith in God｜对上帝的信仰
tip_zh: 指唯一的神用God，通常不加冠词；泛指神用god。

meanings_zh: adj. 兼职的；非全日制的 | adv. 兼职地；非全日制地
definition_en: Involving fewer hours than a full working or studying week. | For fewer hours than a full working or studying week.
example1_en: My sister has a part-time job at a bakery.
example1_zh: 我姐姐在一家面包店做兼职。
example2_en: Part-time employment allows university students to gain practical experience while continuing to focus on their studies.
example2_zh: 兼职工作让大学生能够在继续专注学业的同时积累实践经验。
collocations: a part-time job｜一份兼职工作 ; work part-time｜做兼职 ; a part-time course｜非全日制课程
tip_zh: 可作形容词或副词：a part-time job；work part-time。

meanings_zh: adv. 无疑；肯定 | adv. 当然可以
definition_en: Used to express that something is definitely true. | Used to agree politely to a request.
example1_en: This warm coat will certainly keep you comfortable outside.
example1_zh: 这件暖和的大衣肯定能让你在外面也舒舒服服的。
example2_en: Improved public transport would certainly benefit commuters, although its success would depend on reliable services and affordable fares.
example2_zh: 改善公共交通无疑会惠及通勤者，但成效取决于服务是否可靠、票价是否合理。
collocations: almost certainly｜几乎肯定 ; certainly not｜当然不 ; will certainly help｜肯定会有帮助
tip_zh: 常置于实义动词前、be后；也可单独礼貌回应请求。

meanings_zh: n. 词汇量；词汇 | n. 专业词汇
definition_en: The words someone knows or uses in a language. | The words used in a particular subject or activity.
example1_en: Reading short stories helps me build my English vocabulary.
example1_zh: 读短篇故事有助于我扩大英语词汇量。
example2_en: Students need a broad academic vocabulary to understand lectures and express complex ideas clearly in essays.
example2_zh: 学生需要掌握丰富的学术词汇，才能理解讲座并在论文中清晰表达复杂观点。
collocations: expand your vocabulary｜扩大词汇量 ; a limited vocabulary｜有限的词汇量 ; academic vocabulary｜学术词汇 ; technical vocabulary｜专业术语
tip_zh: 单个词用word；vocabulary通常指词汇总量或集合。

meanings_zh: n. 香烟；纸烟
definition_en: A thin paper tube filled with tobacco for smoking.
example1_en: He refused a cigarette and went for a walk instead.
example1_zh: 他拒绝了递来的香烟，转而出去散步。
example2_en: Higher cigarette taxes may discourage smoking, but accessible support services are also essential for people trying to quit.
example2_zh: 提高香烟税可能有助于减少吸烟，但对尝试戒烟的人来说，便捷的支持服务也必不可少。
collocations: cigarette smoke｜香烟烟雾 ; a packet of cigarettes｜一包香烟 ; cigarette taxes｜香烟税
tip_zh: 可数名词；一包香烟可说a packet of cigarettes。

meanings_zh: n. 危险；风险 | n. 危险因素；威胁
definition_en: The possibility that someone or something will be harmed. | Someone or something that may cause harm.
example1_en: Keep away from the edge; there's a danger of falling.
example1_zh: 离边缘远一点，有掉下去的危险。
example2_en: Poorly maintained roads pose a serious danger to cyclists, particularly in areas without dedicated cycling lanes.
example2_zh: 维护不善的道路对骑车人构成严重威胁，尤其是在没有专用自行车道的地区。
collocations: in danger｜处于危险中 ; out of danger｜脱离危险 ; pose a danger to｜对……构成威胁 ; danger of extinction｜灭绝的危险
tip_zh: in danger指处于危险中；dangerous指会带来危险。

meanings_zh: adj. 勤奋的；努力工作的
definition_en: putting considerable effort and care into work
example1_en: Our hardworking neighbour grows vegetables for the whole street.
example1_zh: 我们勤劳的邻居种菜，供整条街的居民享用。
example2_en: Even hardworking students may struggle academically without access to suitable learning resources and support.
example2_zh: 即使是勤奋的学生，如果缺乏合适的学习资源和支持，也可能在学业上遇到困难。
collocations: hardworking student｜勤奋的学生 ; hardworking staff｜勤勉的员工 ; hardworking family｜勤劳的家庭
tip_zh: 是形容词；“努力工作”用动词短语work hard。

meanings_zh: adj. 室内的
definition_en: Located, used, or happening inside a building.
example1_en: Our hotel has an indoor pool beside the gym.
example1_zh: 我们酒店的健身房旁边有一个室内游泳池。
example2_en: Indoor sports facilities allow children to remain physically active regardless of weather conditions throughout the year.
example2_zh: 室内运动设施让孩子们全年都能保持运动，不受天气条件影响。
collocations: indoor swimming pool｜室内游泳池 ; indoor activities｜室内活动 ; indoor air quality｜室内空气质量
tip_zh: indoor作定语；indoors作副词，如stay indoors。

meanings_zh: adj. 电的；电动的 | adj. 令人激动的
definition_en: Using, producing, or relating to electricity. | Full of excitement and energy.
example1_en: Our electric kettle boils water in two minutes.
example1_zh: 我们的电水壶两分钟就能把水烧开。
example2_en: Electric buses can reduce urban air pollution, especially when their power comes from renewable sources.
example2_zh: 电动公交车可以减少城市空气污染，尤其是在使用可再生能源供电时。
collocations: electric car｜电动汽车 ; electric current｜电流 ; electric shock｜电击 ; electric atmosphere｜热烈的气氛
tip_zh: 电动设备多用electric；电气系统多用electrical。

meanings_zh: n. 主管；负责人；董事 | n. 导演
definition_en: Someone who manages an organisation, department, or company. | Someone who guides actors and controls a film or play.
example1_en: Our director welcomed the new staff at breakfast.
example1_zh: 我们的主管在早餐时欢迎了新员工。
example2_en: A museum director must balance the need to attract visitors with the responsibility to preserve valuable collections.
example2_zh: 博物馆馆长必须在吸引参观者的需求与保护珍贵藏品的责任之间取得平衡。
collocations: managing director｜总经理 ; board of directors｜董事会 ; film director｜电影导演 ; director of operations｜运营总监
tip_zh: 既可指机构主管或董事，也可指影视、戏剧导演。

meanings_zh: adj. 方便的；合适的 | adj. 附近的；便于到达的
definition_en: Easy to use or suitable for your needs and plans. | Situated close to somewhere you need to reach.
example1_en: Is Saturday morning a convenient time for your visit?
example1_zh: 你周六上午来方便吗？
example2_en: Online learning offers a convenient way for working adults to develop skills without travelling to a campus.
example2_zh: 在线学习为在职成年人提供了无需前往校园就能提升技能的便捷途径。
collocations: a convenient time｜合适的时间 ; convenient for someone｜对某人方便 ; a convenient location｜便利的位置 ; a convenient way to｜做……的便捷方式
tip_zh: 说 It is convenient for me，不说 I am convenient。

meanings_zh: adv. 在市中心；往市中心 | adj. 市中心的 | n. 市中心；商业中心区
definition_en: in or towards the central business area of a city | located in the central business area of a city | the central business area of a city
example1_en: We took the bus downtown to buy new shoes.
example1_zh: 我们乘公交车去市中心买新鞋。
example2_en: Improved public transport can encourage more residents to shop downtown rather than drive to suburban shopping centres.
example2_zh: 改善公共交通可以鼓励更多居民到市中心购物，而不是开车前往郊区购物中心。
collocations: go downtown｜去市中心 ; downtown area｜市中心地带 ; downtown shops｜市中心的商店
tip_zh: 主要用于美式英语；作副词时前面不加to。

meanings_zh: n. 战争 | n. 斗争；对抗
definition_en: armed fighting between countries or groups | a determined effort to defeat something harmful
example1_en: The museum displays uniforms worn during the war.
example1_zh: 博物馆展出了战争期间穿过的军服。
example2_en: War can disrupt children's education and force families to leave their homes in search of safety.
example2_zh: 战争可能打断儿童的学业，迫使家庭离开家园寻求安全。
collocations: civil war｜内战 ; at war｜处于交战状态 ; declare war｜宣战 ; war on poverty｜消除贫困的斗争
tip_zh: 表示处于交战状态用at war，不加冠词。

meanings_zh: n. 读者；阅读者 | n. 阅读器；读卡器 | n. 分级读物；阅读课本
definition_en: A person who reads, especially books, newspapers, or magazines | A device that displays written material or reads stored information | A book designed to help learners develop reading skills
example1_en: An eager reader, Lina always carries a book.
example1_zh: 莉娜热爱阅读，总是随身带着一本书。
example2_en: Digital libraries allow readers in remote communities to access educational resources without travelling to larger towns.
example2_zh: 数字图书馆让偏远社区的读者无需前往较大的城镇，就能获取教育资源。
collocations: an avid reader｜热衷阅读的人 ; a card reader｜读卡器 ; a graded reader｜分级读物
tip_zh: reader既可指人，也可指设备或供学习的读物。

meanings_zh: n. 教育；受教育过程
definition_en: The process of learning or teaching knowledge and skills.
example1_en: Her grandparents saved money to pay for her education.
example1_zh: 她的祖父母攒钱供她读书。
example2_en: Access to quality education can improve employment prospects and reduce inequality across different social groups.
example2_zh: 获得优质教育的机会能够改善就业前景，并缩小不同社会群体之间的不平等。
collocations: higher education｜高等教育 ; compulsory education｜义务教育 ; access to education｜受教育的机会 ; education system｜教育体系
tip_zh: 通常不可数；但可说a good education（良好教育）。

meanings_zh: n. 职业；职业生涯 | v. 飞驰；猛冲
definition_en: a person's working life, often within a particular profession | to move very fast in a way that seems uncontrolled
example1_en: My sister hopes to build a career in nursing.
example1_zh: 我姐姐希望在护理行业发展事业。
example2_en: Access to affordable training enables adults to change career and adapt to a rapidly evolving labour market.
example2_zh: 获得负担得起的培训，使成年人能够转行并适应快速变化的劳动力市场。
collocations: career prospects｜职业前景 ; career development｜职业发展 ; pursue a career｜从事某种职业 ; a career in teaching｜教学生涯
tip_zh: career侧重长期职业发展，job指具体工作。

meanings_zh: adj. 孤独的；寂寞的 | adj. 偏僻的；荒凉的
definition_en: Unhappy because you lack companionship or close connections. | Far from people or rarely visited.
example1_en: I felt lonely until my neighbour invited me for tea.
example1_zh: 我一直觉得孤单，直到邻居邀请我去喝茶。
example2_en: Older adults may feel lonely after retirement, so community centres should provide regular opportunities for social interaction.
example2_zh: 老年人退休后可能感到孤独，因此社区中心应定期提供社交机会。
collocations: feel lonely｜感到孤独 ; a lonely life｜孤独的生活 ; a lonely road｜偏僻的道路
tip_zh: alone强调独自一人；lonely强调内心孤独。

meanings_zh: n. 小狗；幼犬
definition_en: A young dog.
example1_en: The puppy fell asleep inside my empty shoe.
example1_zh: 小狗钻进我的空鞋子里睡着了。
example2_en: Adopting a puppy requires a long-term commitment to training, exercise, and regular veterinary care.
example2_zh: 领养幼犬意味着要长期承担训练、运动和定期兽医护理的责任。
collocations: a litter of puppies｜一窝幼犬 ; adopt a puppy｜领养幼犬 ; puppy training｜幼犬训练
tip_zh: 复数为puppies；通常专指幼犬。

meanings_zh: n. 风格；方式 | n. 款式；时尚 | v. 设计造型
definition_en: A distinctive way of doing something or expressing ideas. | The design of something or a fashionable appearance. | To arrange or design something to achieve a particular look.
example1_en: Her colourful paintings have a cheerful, playful style.
example1_zh: 她色彩丰富的画作有一种欢快、俏皮的风格。
example2_en: Modern architects often adapt traditional building styles to preserve local identity while meeting contemporary housing needs.
example2_zh: 现代建筑师常改良传统建筑风格，在满足当代住房需求的同时保留地方特色。
collocations: writing style｜写作风格 ; architectural style｜建筑风格 ; in style｜流行的 ; style your hair｜给头发做造型
tip_zh: style可指个人风格，不一定表示流行时尚。

meanings_zh: n. 味道；味觉 | v. 品尝；尝起来 | n. 品味；喜好
definition_en: A food's flavour, or the sense that detects it. | To try food or drink, or have a particular flavour. | Someone's preferences or ability to judge what is attractive.
example1_en: The soup has a rich taste of roasted tomatoes.
example1_zh: 这汤有浓郁的烤番茄味。
example2_en: Children may develop a taste for healthier foods when schools offer varied and appealing meals.
example2_zh: 学校提供多样且诱人的餐食，可能会让孩子逐渐喜欢上更健康的食物。
collocations: taste delicious｜尝起来很美味 ; a bitter taste｜苦味 ; a taste for｜对……的喜好 ; good taste｜好品味
tip_zh: taste表示“尝起来”时接形容词，不接副词。

meanings_zh: v. 跳；跳过 | v. 猛增；骤升 | n. 跳跃；猛增
definition_en: To push yourself off the ground into the air. | To increase suddenly by a large amount. | An act of jumping or a sudden large increase.
example1_en: The dog jumped over a puddle beside the gate.
example1_zh: 狗跳过了大门旁的一摊积水。
example2_en: Housing costs have jumped sharply in cities where demand continues to exceed the supply of affordable homes.
example2_zh: 在住房需求持续超过可负担住房供应的城市，住房成本已大幅上涨。
collocations: jump over a fence｜跳过篱笆 ; jump at the chance｜欣然抓住机会 ; a sharp jump in prices｜价格的猛涨
tip_zh: jump at the chance意为欣然抓住机会。

meanings_zh: n. 记录；档案 | v. 记录；录音；录像 | n. 最高纪录
definition_en: Stored information about events, activities, or a person's history. | To store information, sounds, or images for future use. | The best result ever achieved in a particular activity.
example1_en: I keep a record of everything I spend.
example1_zh: 我把每一笔花费都记下来。
example2_en: Accurate medical records allow healthcare professionals to make informed decisions and avoid unnecessary treatments.
example2_zh: 准确的医疗记录让医护人员能够作出有依据的决定，避免不必要的治疗。
collocations: keep a record｜保留记录 ; medical records｜医疗档案 ; break a record｜打破纪录 ; record a conversation｜录下谈话
tip_zh: 名词重音在首音节；动词重音在第二音节。

meanings_zh: n. 助手；助理 | adj. 助理的；副的
definition_en: A person who helps someone with their work. | Having a supporting role below the main person in charge.
example1_en: The assistant brought fresh towels into the treatment room.
example1_zh: 助手把干净的毛巾拿进了治疗室。
example2_en: Teaching assistants can provide additional support for children who need more individual attention in large classes.
example2_zh: 在大班教学中，助教可以为需要更多个别关注的孩子提供额外支持。
collocations: teaching assistant｜助教 ; personal assistant｜私人助理 ; shop assistant｜店员 ; assistant manager｜助理经理
tip_zh: assistant指人，assistance指帮助，通常不可数。

meanings_zh: adv. 清楚地；清晰地 | adv. 显然；明显地
definition_en: In a way that is easy to see, hear, or understand. | In a way that shows something is obviously true.
example1_en: Please speak clearly so everyone can hear you.
example1_zh: 请说清楚些，让大家都能听清。
example2_en: Public health information should clearly explain the benefits and potential risks of any recommended treatment.
example2_zh: 公共卫生信息应清楚说明任何推荐疗法的益处和潜在风险。
collocations: speak clearly｜说话清楚 ; clearly explain｜清楚解释 ; clearly visible｜清晰可见
tip_zh: 句首Clearly常表示“显然”，而非“清晰地”。

meanings_zh: adj. 瑞典的；瑞典语的 | n. 瑞典语
definition_en: relating to Sweden, its people, or its language | the main language spoken in Sweden
example1_en: Our Swedish neighbour taught us to bake cinnamon buns.
example1_zh: 我们的瑞典邻居教我们烤肉桂卷。
example2_en: Swedish cities offer useful examples of how urban planning can support cycling and reduce dependence on cars.
example2_zh: 瑞典城市提供了有益的实例，展示城市规划如何支持骑行并减少对汽车的依赖。
collocations: Swedish culture｜瑞典文化 ; learn Swedish｜学习瑞典语 ; Swedish design｜瑞典设计
tip_zh: 首字母大写；一位瑞典人用a Swede。

meanings_zh: n. 咖喱菜肴 | v. 用咖喱烹调
definition_en: A dish of vegetables or meat cooked with spices. | To cook food with curry spices.
example1_en: This vegetable curry tastes wonderful with rice and warm bread.
example1_zh: 这道蔬菜咖喱配米饭和热面包非常好吃。
example2_en: School cafeterias can offer vegetable curry as an affordable alternative to meals containing meat.
example2_zh: 学校食堂可以提供蔬菜咖喱，作为价格实惠的非肉类餐食选择。
collocations: chicken curry｜咖喱鸡 ; vegetable curry｜蔬菜咖喱 ; curry powder｜咖喱粉 ; curry paste｜咖喱酱
tip_zh: curry常指菜肴；咖喱粉用curry powder。

meanings_zh: n. 护士 | v. 护理；照料
definition_en: A trained person who cares for ill or injured people. | To care for someone who is ill or injured.
example1_en: The nurse gently wrapped a bandage around my wrist.
example1_zh: 护士轻轻地用绷带包住我的手腕。
example2_en: Employing more community nurses could improve access to healthcare for older people living in rural areas.
example2_zh: 增聘社区护士可以改善农村老年人获得医疗服务的机会。
collocations: registered nurse｜注册护士 ; community nurse｜社区护士 ; nurse someone back to health｜照料某人直至康复
tip_zh: 作动词可直接接人：nurse a patient。

meanings_zh: n. 迷；爱好者 | n. 风扇；扇子 | v. 扇风；煽动
definition_en: someone who greatly enjoys or admires a person or thing | a device or object moved to create a cooling airflow | to move air towards something, or make a feeling stronger
example1_en: As a football fan, I rarely miss a match.
example1_zh: 作为一名足球迷，我几乎不错过任何一场比赛。
example2_en: Sports fans can strengthen local communities by supporting neighbourhood teams and participating in shared events.
example2_zh: 体育迷可以通过支持社区球队、参与共同活动来增强当地社区的凝聚力。
collocations: a fan of｜……的爱好者 ; football fan｜足球迷 ; electric fan｜电风扇 ; fan the flames｜煽风点火
tip_zh: 表示“……的爱好者”用a fan of。

meanings_zh: n. 花瓶
definition_en: a container used to hold flowers or for decoration
example1_en: I put fresh flowers in the vase by the window.
example1_zh: 我把鲜花插进窗边的花瓶里。
example2_en: Traditional pottery, including decorative vases, can provide valuable insights into the artistic practices of past societies.
example2_zh: 包括装饰花瓶在内的传统陶器，可以为了解过去社会的艺术实践提供宝贵线索。
collocations: a vase of flowers｜一瓶花 ; a glass vase｜玻璃花瓶 ; a ceramic vase｜陶瓷花瓶
tip_zh: 英式通常读/vɑːz/；美式常读/veɪs/。

meanings_zh: n. 锯；锯子 | v. 锯；锯开 | v. 看见（see的过去式）
definition_en: a tool with a toothed blade for cutting hard materials | cut something using a saw | past tense of see: noticed or looked at something
example1_en: He used a saw to cut the wooden shelf.
example1_zh: 他用锯子切割那块木制搁板。
example2_en: The last decade saw significant improvements in public transport, particularly in rapidly growing urban areas.
example2_zh: 过去十年，公共交通取得了显著改善，尤其是在快速发展的城市地区。
collocations: a hand saw｜手锯 ; saw through wood｜锯穿木头 ; saw something in half｜把某物锯成两半
tip_zh: 表“锯”的过去式为sawed；表“看见”则是see的过去式。

meanings_zh: n. 教练；培训师 | n. 运动鞋
definition_en: someone who teaches people or animals particular skills | a shoe designed for sport or casual wear
example1_en: My trainer showed me how to lift weights safely.
example1_zh: 我的教练教我如何安全地举重。
example2_en: A qualified trainer can help employees develop practical skills that improve their performance at work.
example2_zh: 合格的培训师可以帮助员工培养实用技能，从而改善工作表现。
collocations: personal trainer｜私人健身教练 ; fitness trainer｜健身教练 ; a pair of trainers｜一双运动鞋
tip_zh: 运动鞋英式常用trainers，美式常用sneakers。

meanings_zh: prep. 直到……为止 | conj. 直到……才；直到 | n. 收银机；现金抽屉
definition_en: up to a particular time | up to the time when something happens | a machine or drawer where a shop keeps cash
example1_en: The little bakery stays open till six every evening.
example1_zh: 这家小面包店每天晚上营业到六点。
example2_en: Some parents work till late evening, making affordable childcare essential for families in urban areas.
example2_zh: 有些家长工作到深夜，因此价格可负担的托育服务对城市家庭至关重要。
collocations: till late｜直到很晚 ; wait till｜等到 ; at the till｜在收银台
tip_zh: till与until意思相同；作连词谈将来时通常接一般现在时。

meanings_zh: adj. 已离婚的 | adj. 脱离的；分离的
definition_en: No longer married because the marriage legally ended. | Separated from something that should be closely connected.
example1_en: My divorced uncle lives happily near his children.
example1_zh: 我离婚的叔叔住在孩子们附近，生活很幸福。
example2_en: Housing policies should consider the needs of divorced parents who share responsibility for raising children.
example2_zh: 住房政策应考虑共同承担育儿责任的离异父母的需求。
collocations: get divorced｜离婚 ; divorced parents｜离异父母 ; divorced from reality｜脱离现实
tip_zh: get divorced表示离婚；脱离某事用divorced from。

meanings_zh: n. 意思；含义 | n. 意义；价值
definition_en: The idea that a word, action, or message communicates. | The importance or purpose that makes something worthwhile.
example1_en: Could you explain the meaning of this unusual word?
example1_zh: 你能解释一下这个不常见的词是什么意思吗？
example2_en: Volunteering can give people a sense of meaning while strengthening connections within their local communities.
example2_zh: 志愿服务既能让人感到生活有意义，也能加强当地社区内部的联系。
collocations: the meaning of a word｜词义 ; literal meaning｜字面意思 ; convey meaning｜传达含义 ; give meaning to life｜赋予生活意义
tip_zh: 问词义用the meaning of；不要与opinion混淆。

meanings_zh: n. 意大利细长面条
definition_en: Pasta shaped into long, thin strands.
example1_en: She twirled the spaghetti around her fork before taking a bite.
example1_zh: 她先用叉子卷起意大利细面，再吃了一口。
example2_en: Simple meals such as spaghetti with vegetables can help students eat affordably while maintaining a balanced diet.
example2_zh: 蔬菜意大利面等简单餐食，可以帮助学生在节省开支的同时保持均衡饮食。
collocations: a plate of spaghetti｜一盘意大利细面 ; spaghetti sauce｜意大利面酱 ; cook spaghetti｜煮意大利细面
tip_zh: 不可数名词；一盘用a plate of spaghetti。

meanings_zh: n. 大蒜
definition_en: A plant whose strong-smelling bulbs are used to flavour food.
example1_en: Crush the garlic before adding it to the soup.
example1_zh: 先把大蒜压碎，再放进汤里。
example2_en: Using garlic and herbs can add flavour to meals without increasing their salt content.
example2_zh: 使用大蒜和香草可以给饭菜增添风味，而不增加盐含量。
collocations: a clove of garlic｜一瓣大蒜 ; crushed garlic｜压碎的大蒜 ; garlic bread｜蒜香面包
tip_zh: 通常不可数；一瓣大蒜用a clove of garlic。

meanings_zh: n. 控制；管理 | v. 控制；管理；抑制 | n. 操纵装置
definition_en: The power to direct or limit someone or something. | To direct, manage, or limit someone or something. | A device used to operate a machine or vehicle.
example1_en: Keep control of the kite by holding the string firmly.
example1_zh: 抓紧风筝线，控制好风筝。
example2_en: Stricter control of industrial emissions could improve air quality and reduce health risks in densely populated cities.
example2_zh: 更严格地控制工业排放可以改善空气质量，并降低人口密集城市的健康风险。
collocations: take control of｜掌控 ; under control｜处于控制之下 ; lose control｜失去控制 ; control pollution｜控制污染
tip_zh: 过去式controlled、现在分词controlling均双写l。

meanings_zh: n. 奥林匹克运动会
definition_en: An international sporting competition with summer and winter editions.
example1_en: Our family watched the Olympics together after dinner.
example1_zh: 我们全家晚饭后一起观看了奥运会。
example2_en: Hosting the Olympics can improve transport infrastructure, but governments must consider the long-term costs of maintaining sports facilities.
example2_zh: 举办奥运会可以改善交通基础设施，但政府必须考虑维护体育设施的长期成本。
collocations: host the Olympics｜举办奥运会 ; compete in the Olympics｜参加奥运会 ; the Summer Olympics｜夏季奥运会 ; the Winter Olympics｜冬季奥运会
tip_zh: 首字母大写，通常与the连用；也称the Olympic Games。

meanings_zh: n. 晚饭；睡前便餐
definition_en: An evening meal, sometimes a light meal before bed.
example1_en: We had soup and fresh bread for supper.
example1_zh: 我们晚饭喝了汤，吃了新鲜面包。
example2_en: Sharing supper regularly can help families maintain close relationships despite increasingly demanding work schedules.
example2_zh: 尽管工作安排日益繁忙，经常共进晚餐仍有助于家人维持亲密关系。
collocations: have supper｜吃晚饭 ; a light supper｜清淡的晚餐 ; after supper｜晚饭后
tip_zh: 常指较随意的晚饭，也可指睡前便餐。

meanings_zh: adj. 严重的；重大的 | adj. 认真的；严肃的
definition_en: causing harm or requiring careful attention | not joking, or thinking carefully about something
example1_en: The leaking pipe caused serious damage to our kitchen.
example1_zh: 漏水的管道给我们的厨房造成了严重损坏。
example2_en: Air pollution remains a serious threat to public health, especially in densely populated cities.
example2_zh: 空气污染仍然严重威胁着公众健康，在人口稠密的城市尤其如此。
collocations: serious damage｜严重损坏 ; serious consequences｜严重后果 ; serious about｜认真对待 ; take something seriously｜认真对待某事
tip_zh: serious about 后接名词或动名词，表示认真对待。

meanings_zh: adj. 舒适的；舒服的 | adj. 自在的；安心的 | adj. 生活宽裕的
definition_en: physically pleasant and free from discomfort | feeling relaxed and confident in a situation | having enough money to live well without financial worry
example1_en: This soft chair is comfortable enough for an afternoon nap.
example1_zh: 这把柔软的椅子很舒服，足以让人午睡一会儿。
example2_en: Comfortable classrooms with adequate lighting can help students concentrate and participate more actively in lessons.
example2_zh: 舒适且照明充足的教室有助于学生集中注意力，更积极地参与课堂活动。
collocations: comfortable shoes｜舒适的鞋 ; feel comfortable｜感到自在 ; comfortable with something｜对某事感到自在 ; a comfortable income｜宽裕的收入
tip_zh: comfortable指舒服；convenient指方便。

meanings_zh: adj. 活跃的；积极参与的 | adj. 运作中的；起作用的 | adj. 主动语态的
definition_en: regularly moving, doing things, or taking part | currently working or producing an effect | describing a verb whose subject performs the action
example1_en: My grandfather stays active by swimming every morning.
example1_zh: 我祖父每天早晨游泳，保持活力。
example2_en: Schools should encourage an active lifestyle to improve students' physical health and overall wellbeing.
example2_zh: 学校应鼓励积极运动的生活方式，以改善学生的身体健康和整体身心状态。
collocations: stay active｜保持活力 ; an active lifestyle｜积极运动的生活方式 ; play an active role｜发挥积极作用 ; active ingredient｜有效成分
tip_zh: active指积极活动或参与；不等于表示乐观的positive。

meanings_zh: n. 攀岩；登山运动 | adj. 攀缘的
definition_en: The sport of going up rocks, mountains, or artificial walls. | Growing upwards by attaching to or winding around supports.
example1_en: I tried indoor climbing with my sister yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天我和姐姐尝试了室内攀岩。
example2_en: Schools can use supervised climbing activities to develop students' confidence, physical coordination, and ability to assess risks.
example2_zh: 学校可以通过有人指导的攀岩活动，培养学生的自信、身体协调性和风险评估能力。
collocations: rock climbing｜攀岩 ; indoor climbing｜室内攀岩 ; climbing equipment｜攀登装备 ; climbing plants｜攀缘植物
tip_zh: climb中的b不发音；climbing plants指攀缘植物。

meanings_zh: n. 游览；参观；巡游 | n. 巡回演出；巡回比赛 | v. 游览；巡回演出
definition_en: A journey visiting several places, or a guided visit somewhere. | A series of performances or matches held in different places. | To travel around places for sightseeing, performances, or other activities.
example1_en: We took a guided tour of the old castle.
example1_zh: 我们在导游带领下参观了那座古堡。
example2_en: Organized tours can introduce visitors to local traditions while providing reliable income for community guides.
example2_zh: 有组织的游览既能让游客了解当地传统，也能为社区导游提供稳定收入。
collocations: guided tour｜有导游带领的游览 ; walking tour｜徒步游览 ; concert tour｜巡回演唱会 ; go on tour｜进行巡回活动
tip_zh: tour强调参观或多站行程；trip泛指一次出行。

meanings_zh: n. 公寓；套房
definition_en: A set of rooms forming one home within a building.
example1_en: Our apartment has a small balcony overlooking the park.
example1_zh: 我们的公寓有一个面向公园的小阳台。
example2_en: Building affordable apartments near railway stations can reduce commuting costs for young workers.
example2_zh: 在火车站附近建设价格可负担的公寓，可以降低年轻上班族的通勤成本。
collocations: rent an apartment｜租公寓 ; apartment block｜公寓楼 ; studio apartment｜单间公寓
tip_zh: 美式常用apartment，英式日常多用flat。

meanings_zh: prep. 在……中间 | prep. 在某群体之中
definition_en: surrounded by people or things | within or shared by a group
example1_en: We found a small wooden house among the trees.
example1_zh: 我们在树林中发现了一座小木屋。
example2_en: Regular exercise is increasingly popular among office workers who spend most of their day sitting.
example2_zh: 经常锻炼在一天大部分时间坐着的上班族中越来越受欢迎。
collocations: among friends｜在朋友之间 ; among other things｜除了别的以外还 ; divide among｜在……之间分配
tip_zh: among强调群体内部；between也可用于多者的明确关系。

meanings_zh: n. 烤面包片 | v. 烘烤；烤至焦黄 | n. 祝酒；敬酒
definition_en: Sliced bread browned and made crisp by heat. | To heat food until it becomes brown and crisp. | An occasion when people raise drinks to honour someone or something.
example1_en: I spread butter on my toast while it was warm.
example1_zh: 我趁烤面包片还热着，在上面抹了黄油。
example2_en: A simple breakfast of toast and fruit can help students maintain their energy during morning lessons.
example2_zh: 一顿由烤面包片和水果组成的简单早餐，有助于学生在上午上课时保持精力。
collocations: a slice of toast｜一片烤面包 ; toast bread｜烤面包 ; propose a toast｜提议干杯 ; a toast to someone｜为某人祝酒
tip_zh: 表示烤面包时不可数；表示一次祝酒时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 长沙发 | v. 措辞；表述
definition_en: A comfortable seat for two or more people. | To express something in a particular way.
example1_en: We curled up on the couch after dinner.
example1_zh: 晚饭后，我们蜷坐在沙发上。
example2_en: Public health advice should be couched in clear language so that everyone can understand it.
example2_zh: 公共卫生建议应以清晰的语言表述，让每个人都能理解。
collocations: on the couch｜在沙发上 ; a leather couch｜皮沙发 ; couched in diplomatic terms｜以委婉措辞表达
tip_zh: 动词常用be couched in，指以某种措辞表达。

meanings_zh: n. 田地；牧场 | n. 领域；专业 | n. 运动场
definition_en: an area of land used for crops or farm animals | a particular area of study or work | an area of ground used for playing a sport
example1_en: We watched sheep grazing in the field behind our cottage.
example1_zh: 我们看着羊群在小屋后面的牧场上吃草。
example2_en: Research in the field of renewable energy could create employment opportunities and reduce dependence on fossil fuels.
example2_zh: 可再生能源领域的研究可以创造就业机会，并减少对化石燃料的依赖。
collocations: a wheat field｜麦田 ; in the field of｜在……领域 ; a football field｜足球场 ; field research｜实地研究
tip_zh: 表示研究或工作领域时，常用in the field of。

meanings_zh: adj. 网上的；联网的 | adv. 在网上；联网地
definition_en: Available through the internet or connected to a computer network. | Using the internet or while connected to a computer network.
example1_en: I booked our train tickets online after dinner.
example1_zh: 晚饭后，我在网上订了我们的火车票。
example2_en: Online courses can widen access to education, especially for learners who live far from universities.
example2_zh: 网络课程可以扩大受教育的机会，尤其有利于远离大学的学习者。
collocations: online shopping｜网上购物 ; online learning｜在线学习 ; go online｜上网 ; available online｜可在网上获取的
tip_zh: 既可作形容词，也可作副词：shop online。

meanings_zh: n. 扶手椅 | adj. 无实践经验的；空谈的
definition_en: A comfortable chair with supports for your arms. | Giving opinions without direct experience or active involvement.
example1_en: Grandpa fell asleep in his armchair beside the window.
example1_zh: 爷爷在窗边的扶手椅上睡着了。
example2_en: Armchair critics may underestimate the practical challenges that teachers face when managing large classes with limited resources.
example2_zh: 缺乏实践经验的评论者可能低估教师在资源有限时管理大班所面临的实际困难。
collocations: comfortable armchair｜舒适的扶手椅 ; sit in an armchair｜坐在扶手椅里 ; armchair critic｜空谈的评论者
tip_zh: 坐在扶手椅里用in；作形容词时置于名词前，常含贬义。

meanings_zh: n. 音乐家；乐手
definition_en: someone who plays music, especially professionally
example1_en: A musician played the violin outside the station.
example1_zh: 一位乐手在车站外拉小提琴。
example2_en: Local musicians can strengthen community identity by performing traditional songs at public festivals and cultural events.
example2_zh: 当地音乐人可以在公共节庆和文化活动中演奏传统歌曲，增强社区认同感。
collocations: professional musician｜职业音乐人 ; talented musician｜有才华的音乐家 ; street musician｜街头乐手
tip_zh: musician指音乐人；作曲家更具体地用composer。

meanings_zh: prep. 自……以来 | conj. 自……以来；因为 | adv. 此后；从那时起
definition_en: from a past time until a later time, usually now | from when something happened; because something is true | at a time or throughout the period after that
example1_en: I have lived in this neighbourhood since childhood.
example1_zh: 我从小就住在这个街区。
example2_en: Since public transport reduces traffic congestion, governments should invest in more reliable bus services.
example2_zh: 由于公共交通能够缓解交通拥堵，政府应投资建设更可靠的公交服务。
collocations: ever since｜从那以后一直 ; since then｜从那时起 ; since childhood｜自幼 ; long since｜早已
tip_zh: 表时间时，since接起点，for接时长。

meanings_zh: n. 教堂 | n. 礼拜活动 | n. 基督教教会；教派
definition_en: a building where Christians gather to worship | Christian religious worship attended as a service | an organized group of Christians sharing beliefs and practices
example1_en: The old church has beautiful windows and a stone tower.
example1_zh: 这座古老的教堂有漂亮的窗户和一座石塔。
example2_en: Preserving a historic church can protect local heritage while providing opportunities for education and tourism.
example2_zh: 保护历史悠久的教堂既能保护当地文化遗产，也能为教育和旅游创造机会。
collocations: go to church｜去做礼拜 ; attend church｜参加礼拜 ; church service｜礼拜仪式 ; historic church｜历史悠久的教堂
tip_zh: go to church指做礼拜；go to the church指去教堂。

meanings_zh: n. 消防员
definition_en: A person trained to put out fires and rescue people
example1_en: The firefighter showed us how to use the hose.
example1_zh: 那位消防员向我们演示了如何使用消防水带。
example2_en: Every firefighter requires regular training to respond safely and effectively to emergencies in increasingly complex urban environments.
example2_zh: 每位消防员都需要定期接受培训，以便在日益复杂的城市环境中安全、有效地应对紧急情况。
collocations: a trained firefighter｜训练有素的消防员 ; a volunteer firefighter｜志愿消防员 ; firefighter training｜消防员培训
tip_zh: firefighter不区分性别，比fireman更通用。

meanings_zh: n. 王宫；高级官邸
definition_en: A grand official home for a royal or important leader.
example1_en: We walked through the palace gardens before lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭前，我们在王宫花园里散了步。
example2_en: Opening a historic palace to visitors can generate income for conservation and support local tourism.
example2_zh: 向游客开放历史悠久的宫殿，可以筹集保护资金并支持当地旅游业。
collocations: royal palace｜王宫 ; presidential palace｜总统府 ; palace grounds｜宫殿庭园
tip_zh: 主要用作名词；palace gardens中作名词定语。

meanings_zh: n. 桥；桥梁 | v. 弥合；连接 | n. 桥牌
definition_en: A structure carrying people or vehicles over an obstacle. | To connect separated things or reduce differences between them. | A card game played by four people in two partnerships.
example1_en: We crossed the wooden bridge and entered the village.
example1_zh: 我们走过木桥，进了村子。
example2_en: Community language programmes can bridge cultural differences and help newcomers participate more fully in local life.
example2_zh: 社区语言项目可以弥合文化差异，帮助新来者更充分地参与当地生活。
collocations: cross a bridge｜过桥 ; suspension bridge｜悬索桥 ; bridge the gap｜缩小差距 ; play bridge｜打桥牌
tip_zh: bridge the gap常指缩小群体或事物间的差距。

meanings_zh: n. 进食；饮食 | v. 吃（eat的现在分词）
definition_en: the activity of taking food into your body | taking food into your mouth and swallowing it
example1_en: Healthy eating starts with small changes to your meals.
example1_zh: 健康饮食始于对日常餐食的小调整。
example2_en: Schools can encourage healthy eating by providing balanced lunches and teaching children how to prepare simple meals.
example2_zh: 学校可以通过提供营养均衡的午餐并教孩子制作简单餐食来鼓励健康饮食。
collocations: healthy eating｜健康饮食 ; eating habits｜饮食习惯 ; eating out｜外出就餐
tip_zh: eating可作动名词；eat out表示外出就餐。

meanings_zh: n. 实用建议；窍门 | n. 尖端；末端 | n. 小费
definition_en: a useful piece of advice | the narrow or pointed end of something | extra money given to someone for providing a service
example1_en: My neighbour shared a useful tip for growing tomatoes.
example1_zh: 邻居分享了一个种番茄的实用窍门。
example2_en: Schools can offer practical tips on managing money to help young people develop responsible spending habits.
example2_zh: 学校可以提供实用的理财建议，帮助年轻人养成负责任的消费习惯。
collocations: a useful tip｜实用建议 ; the tip of the tongue｜舌尖 ; leave a tip｜留下小费
tip_zh: tip作“建议”可数，advice不可数：a tip。

meanings_zh: n. 技术；科技
definition_en: Practical use of scientific knowledge, especially through tools and machines.
example1_en: New technology lets us control the lights from our phones.
example1_zh: 新技术让我们可以用手机控制灯光。
example2_en: Investment in clean technology can reduce industrial pollution while creating skilled jobs in emerging sectors.
example2_zh: 投资清洁技术可以减少工业污染，同时在新兴领域创造技术岗位。
collocations: digital technology｜数字技术 ; advanced technology｜先进技术 ; information technology｜信息技术 ; develop new technologies｜开发新技术
tip_zh: 泛指科技时不可数；多种具体技术可用technologies。

meanings_zh: n. 小路；小径 | n. 路线；轨迹 | n. 途径；发展道路
definition_en: A narrow track for people to walk along. | The route along which someone or something moves. | A way of achieving something or developing over time.
example1_en: We followed a narrow path down to the beach.
example1_zh: 我们沿着一条狭窄的小路走向海滩。
example2_en: Access to affordable education can provide a path out of poverty for disadvantaged communities.
example2_zh: 获得负担得起的教育可以为弱势社区提供一条摆脱贫困的道路。
collocations: follow a path｜沿小路走 ; career path｜职业发展道路 ; flight path｜飞行路线 ; a path to success｜通往成功的道路
tip_zh: 表示实现目标的途径，用a path to，to后接名词。

meanings_zh: n. 系统 | n. 制度；体制 | n. 方法；成套程序
definition_en: A set of connected parts that work together. | An organised structure through which services or institutions operate. | An organised way of doing something.
example1_en: The heating system stopped working during a cold night.
example1_zh: 在一个寒冷的夜晚，供暖系统停止了运行。
example2_en: An effective education system should support students with different abilities and prepare them for future employment.
example2_zh: 有效的教育体系应支持能力各异的学生，并帮助他们为未来就业做好准备。
collocations: heating system｜供暖系统 ; education system｜教育体系 ; public transport system｜公共交通系统 ; immune system｜免疫系统
tip_zh: systematic指有条理的，systemic指全系统的。

meanings_zh: n. 东北；东北部 | adj. 东北的；来自东北的 | adv. 向东北；在东北
definition_en: The direction between north and east, or an area's northeastern part. | Located in, facing, or coming from the northeast. | Towards or in the direction between north and east.
example1_en: The storm is moving northeast towards the coastal villages.
example1_zh: 暴风雨正向东北方向的沿海村庄移动。
example2_en: Investment in rail connections could improve access to employment for communities in the northeast of the country.
example2_zh: 投资铁路交通可以为该国东北部的社区居民提供更多就业便利。
collocations: in the northeast｜在东北部 ; head northeast｜向东北行进 ; the northeast coast｜东北海岸
tip_zh: northeast of表示在……东北方；英式也写north-east。

meanings_zh: n. 厘米；公分
definition_en: A unit of length equal to one hundredth of a metre.
example1_en: This little plant grew one centimetre in a week.
example1_zh: 这株小植物一周长高了一厘米。
example2_en: Even a small rise in sea level, measured in centimetres, can increase flooding risks in coastal communities.
example2_zh: 即使海平面仅上升几厘米，也可能增加沿海社区的洪水风险。
collocations: a centimetre long｜一厘米长 ; square centimetre｜平方厘米 ; cubic centimetre｜立方厘米
tip_zh: 英式拼写centimetre，美式centimeter；缩写cm。

meanings_zh: n. 生物学 | n. 生物特征；生理机制
definition_en: the scientific study of living things | the natural processes and characteristics of a living thing
example1_en: We examined onion cells under microscopes in biology today.
example1_zh: 今天的生物课上，我们用显微镜观察了洋葱细胞。
example2_en: A basic understanding of biology helps people evaluate health information and make informed decisions about their lifestyles.
example2_zh: 掌握基础生物学知识有助于人们评估健康信息，并对生活方式作出明智决定。
collocations: study biology｜学习生物学 ; marine biology｜海洋生物学 ; human biology｜人体生物学 ; molecular biology｜分子生物学
tip_zh: 学科名称，通常不可数；生物学家是biologist。

meanings_zh: n. 画家 | n. 油漆工
definition_en: Someone who creates pictures using paint. | Someone whose job is painting buildings or other surfaces.
example1_en: The painter mixed blue and green on her palette.
example1_zh: 画家在调色板上混合蓝色和绿色。
example2_en: Local painters can preserve cultural traditions while introducing younger audiences to new artistic styles.
example2_zh: 当地画家既能传承文化传统，也能让年轻观众接触新的艺术风格。
collocations: a landscape painter｜风景画家 ; a portrait painter｜肖像画家 ; a house painter｜房屋油漆工
tip_zh: 既可指艺术画家，也可指刷墙的油漆工。

meanings_zh: n. 气球 | n. 热气球
definition_en: A thin rubber bag filled with air or gas. | A large gas-filled bag carrying people in a basket.
example1_en: A yellow balloon floated above the birthday cake.
example1_zh: 一只黄色气球飘在生日蛋糕上方。
example2_en: Releasing balloons outdoors can harm wildlife when the rubber fragments fall into rivers and oceans.
example2_zh: 在户外放飞气球可能危害野生动物，因为橡胶碎片会落入河流和海洋。
collocations: blow up a balloon｜吹气球 ; hot-air balloon｜热气球 ; release balloons｜放飞气球
tip_zh: blow up a balloon指吹气球，不是炸毁气球。

meanings_zh: adj. 成功的；有成效的 | adj. 事业有成的
definition_en: Achieving the result that was wanted or intended. | Having achieved wealth, respect, or a good position.
example1_en: Our first attempt at baking bread was surprisingly successful.
example1_zh: 我们第一次尝试烤面包，出乎意料地成功了。
example2_en: Successful recycling programmes depend on convenient collection facilities and clear guidance for households and businesses.
example2_zh: 成功的回收计划依赖便利的收集设施，以及面向家庭和企业的明确指引。
collocations: successful career｜成功的职业生涯 ; successful outcome｜圆满的结果 ; highly successful｜非常成功 ; successful in doing something｜成功做成某事
tip_zh: 常用be successful in doing；动词为succeed。

meanings_zh: n. 话题；主题；学科 | adj. 受……影响的；取决于 | v. 使遭受；使经历
definition_en: Something discussed, studied, or taught. | Affected by something or dependent on a condition. | To make someone experience something, especially something unpleasant.
example1_en: Science was my favourite subject when I was younger.
example1_zh: 我小时候最喜欢的学科是科学。
example2_en: Schools should give creative subjects sufficient attention because they help students develop imagination and problem-solving skills.
example2_zh: 学校应给予创意类学科充分重视，因为这些学科有助于培养学生的想象力和解决问题的能力。
collocations: school subject｜学校科目 ; change the subject｜转移话题 ; subject to approval｜须经批准 ; subject someone to stress｜使某人承受压力
tip_zh: 动词重音在后：/səbˈdʒekt/；常用subject A to B。

meanings_zh: adj. 荒唐的；不理智的 | adj. 着迷的；狂热喜爱的 | adj. 令人烦躁的；受不了的
definition_en: very unreasonable, foolish, or strange | extremely enthusiastic about someone or something | extremely annoyed or upset
example1_en: It seems crazy to wear sandals in this snow.
example1_zh: 下着这样的雪还穿凉鞋，实在很不明智。
example2_en: Although some people consider car-free cities a crazy idea, such policies could significantly improve urban air quality.
example2_zh: 尽管一些人认为无车城市是个荒唐的想法，这类政策却可能显著改善城市空气质量。
collocations: crazy about｜对……着迷 ; drive someone crazy｜让某人抓狂 ; a crazy idea｜荒唐的想法
tip_zh: 偏口语；crazy about表示着迷，不宜用来称呼精神疾病患者。

meanings_zh: n. 夫妇；情侣 | n. 两个；几个 | v. 连接；结合
definition_en: Two people who are married or in a romantic relationship. | Two things or people, or a small number of them. | To join two things or consider them together.
example1_en: The couple next door invited us over for dinner.
example1_zh: 隔壁那对夫妇邀请我们去吃晚饭。
example2_en: High housing costs, coupled with limited childcare, can discourage young couples from starting a family.
example2_zh: 高昂的住房成本加上有限的托育服务，可能使年轻夫妇不愿生育孩子。
collocations: a married couple｜一对已婚夫妇 ; a couple of days｜两三天 ; coupled with｜加上；结合
tip_zh: a couple of后接复数名词，可指两个或少数几个。

meanings_zh: adj. 害怕的；恐惧的
definition_en: Feeling afraid of something or worried that something bad might happen.
example1_en: The puppy looked scared when it heard the thunder.
example1_zh: 小狗听到雷声时显得很害怕。
example2_en: Students who are scared of making mistakes may avoid speaking during foreign language lessons.
example2_zh: 害怕犯错的学生可能会在外语课上避免开口。
collocations: scared of｜害怕…… ; scared to ask｜不敢问 ; scared stiff｜吓得僵住
tip_zh: scared形容感到害怕；scary形容令人害怕。

meanings_zh: adj. 较低的；较下方的 | v. 降低；放下
definition_en: below something else in position, level, or amount | to move something down or reduce its level
example1_en: Keep the heavy bowls on the lower shelf.
example1_zh: 把重碗放在下面那层架子上。
example2_en: Governments can lower transport costs by investing in reliable bus services and safe cycling routes.
example2_zh: 政府可以通过投资可靠的公交服务和安全的自行车道来降低交通成本。
collocations: lower income｜较低收入 ; lower prices｜降低价格 ; lower your voice｜压低声音 ; lower back｜下背部
tip_zh: lower作动词通常接宾语；表示物价下降也可不及物。

meanings_zh: n. 硬币 | v. 创造（新词或说法）
definition_en: a small, flat piece of metal used as money | to invent a new word or expression
example1_en: A silver coin rolled under the kitchen table.
example1_zh: 一枚银色硬币滚到了厨房桌子下面。
example2_en: As digital payments become more widespread, fewer consumers carry coins for everyday purchases such as bus fares.
example2_zh: 随着数字支付日益普及，随身携带硬币用于公交车费等日常支出的人越来越少。
collocations: a gold coin｜金币 ; toss a coin｜抛硬币 ; coin a term｜创造术语
tip_zh: coin作动词常指创造词语，如coin a term。

meanings_zh: n. 技能；技巧；本领
definition_en: an ability to do something well, developed through practice
example1_en: Baking good bread takes patience and a little skill.
example1_zh: 烤出好面包需要耐心和一点技巧。
example2_en: Schools should teach practical skills that help young people manage money and communicate effectively.
example2_zh: 学校应教授实用技能，帮助年轻人管理金钱并进行有效沟通。
collocations: communication skills｜沟通技能 ; practical skills｜实用技能 ; develop a skill｜培养一项技能 ; skill in doing something｜做某事的技巧
tip_zh: 具体技能可数；泛指熟练程度时常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 风筝 | n. 鸢
definition_en: A lightweight frame flown in the wind on a string | A bird of prey with long wings and often a forked tail
example1_en: We flew a bright kite on the windy beach.
example1_zh: 我们在风大的海滩上放了一只色彩鲜艳的风筝。
example2_en: Outdoor activities such as flying kites offer families affordable recreation and encourage children to spend time away from screens.
example2_zh: 放风筝等户外活动为家庭提供了经济实惠的娱乐方式，也鼓励孩子暂时远离屏幕。
collocations: fly a kite｜放风筝 ; kite string｜风筝线 ; kite flying｜放风筝活动
tip_zh: “放风筝”用 fly a kite，不用 play a kite。

meanings_zh: n. 行动；措施 | n. 行为；举动 | n. 精彩刺激的场面；剧情
definition_en: Something done to achieve a result or address a problem. | A particular thing that someone does. | Exciting events in a story, film, or real situation.
example1_en: We need to take action before the leak worsens.
example1_zh: 我们得在漏水加重之前采取行动。
example2_en: Governments must take urgent action to protect coastal communities from the growing risks of climate change.
example2_zh: 政府必须紧急采取行动，保护沿海社区免受日益加剧的气候变化风险影响。
collocations: take action｜采取行动 ; urgent action｜紧急行动 ; course of action｜行动方案 ; action film｜动作片
tip_zh: take action中的action不可数；具体举动可用actions。

meanings_zh: v. 建造；建立（过去式及分词） | adj. 有……体格的
definition_en: past tense and past participle of build | having a particular body shape or physical build
example1_en: We built a small shelter for the garden tools.
example1_zh: 我们搭了一个小棚子，用来存放园艺工具。
example2_en: New homes should be built near public transport to reduce residents' dependence on private cars.
example2_zh: 新住宅应建在公共交通设施附近，以减少居民对私家车的依赖。
collocations: built to last｜经久耐用的 ; well built｜体格健壮的；建造牢固的 ; built environment｜建成环境 ; purpose-built facilities｜专门建造的设施
tip_zh: build的过去式、过去分词均为built，不是builded。

meanings_zh: v. 取决于 | v. 依赖；信赖
definition_en: to be determined or affected by something | to need or trust someone or something for support
example1_en: Our weekend plans depend on how the weather turns out.
example1_zh: 我们周末的安排取决于天气怎么样。
example2_en: Many rural communities depend on reliable public transport to access healthcare, education, and employment opportunities.
example2_zh: 许多农村社区依靠可靠的公共交通来获得医疗、教育和就业机会。
collocations: depend on｜取决于；依赖 ; depend heavily on｜严重依赖 ; depend on someone to do something｜指望某人做某事
tip_zh: 常接on或upon；It depends意为“看情况”。

meanings_zh: n. 中午；正午
definition_en: The middle of the day, around twelve o'clock.
example1_en: We stopped for lunch at mid-day beside the river.
example1_zh: 中午，我们在河边停下来吃午饭。
example2_en: Outdoor workers should have access to shade at mid-day, when exposure to direct sunlight can be intense.
example2_zh: 户外工作者在中午应有地方遮阴，因为此时阳光直射可能很强。
collocations: at mid-day｜在中午 ; by mid-day｜到中午时 ; mid-day meal｜午餐
tip_zh: 现代英语通常写midday；在正午用at midday。

meanings_zh: n. 笑话；玩笑 | v. 开玩笑
definition_en: Something said or done to make people laugh. | To say something funny or not seriously meant.
example1_en: My brother told a joke that made everyone laugh.
example1_zh: 我哥哥讲了个笑话，把大家都逗笑了。
example2_en: Teachers sometimes use jokes to reduce anxiety and create a more relaxed classroom atmosphere.
example2_zh: 教师有时会用笑话缓解焦虑，营造更轻松的课堂氛围。
collocations: tell a joke｜讲笑话 ; play a joke on someone｜捉弄某人 ; joke about something｜拿某事开玩笑
tip_zh: 讲笑话用tell a joke，不用say a joke。

meanings_zh: n. 客人；受邀嘉宾 | n. 旅馆住客
definition_en: Someone invited to visit a home or attend an event. | Someone staying at a hotel or similar accommodation.
example1_en: Each guest brought a dish to share at dinner.
example1_zh: 每位客人都带了一道菜，在晚餐时与大家分享。
example2_en: Hotels can encourage guests to conserve water by offering towel replacement only when requested.
example2_zh: 酒店可以仅在住客提出要求时更换毛巾，以鼓励节水。
collocations: invite guests｜邀请客人 ; hotel guest｜酒店住客 ; guest speaker｜特邀演讲者 ; guest room｜客房
tip_zh: guest可指受邀客人，也可指付费的酒店住客。

meanings_zh: n. 屏幕；银幕 | v. 筛查；审查 | v. 放映；播出
definition_en: A surface on which electronic images or films appear. | To check people or things for problems or suitability. | To show a film or programme to an audience.
example1_en: I wiped the fingerprints off my laptop screen.
example1_zh: 我擦掉了笔记本电脑屏幕上的指纹。
example2_en: Health services should screen vulnerable patients regularly to detect diseases before serious symptoms develop.
example2_zh: 医疗服务机构应定期对易患病患者进行筛查，在严重症状出现前发现疾病。
collocations: screen time｜屏幕使用时间 ; touch screen｜触摸屏 ; screen for disease｜筛查疾病 ; screen a film｜放映电影
tip_zh: screen A for B表示检查A是否存在B问题。

meanings_zh: n. 洗碗机 | n. 洗碗工
definition_en: a machine that washes dishes and kitchen utensils | a person employed to wash dishes
example1_en: Please load the dishwasher after you finish your lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭吃完后，请把餐具放进洗碗机。
example2_en: Running a dishwasher only when it is full can help households conserve water and energy.
example2_zh: 等洗碗机装满后再运行，有助于家庭节约水和能源。
collocations: load the dishwasher｜把餐具装进洗碗机 ; unload the dishwasher｜取出洗碗机里的餐具 ; dishwasher detergent｜洗碗机专用洗涤剂
tip_zh: 日常多指洗碗机；招聘语境中也可指洗碗工。

meanings_zh: adv. 完全地；彻底地
definition_en: In every way or to the fullest possible degree.
example1_en: My shoes were completely wet after walking through the rain.
example1_zh: 在雨中走过之后，我的鞋全湿透了。
example2_en: Although online courses offer flexibility, they cannot completely replace the social benefits of classroom learning.
example2_zh: 虽然在线课程提供了灵活性，但它们无法完全取代课堂学习带来的社交益处。
collocations: completely different｜完全不同的 ; completely forget｜忘得一干二净 ; completely agree｜完全同意
tip_zh: 表示程度达到全部，常修饰形容词或动词。

meanings_zh: n. 搭档；合作伙伴；合伙人 | n. 配偶；伴侣 | v. 与…搭档；合作
definition_en: Someone you work, play, or share a business with. | Someone you share a romantic relationship or married life with. | Work or take part in an activity with someone.
example1_en: My dance partner waited patiently while I practised.
example1_zh: 我练习时，我的舞伴耐心地等着。
example2_en: Universities can partner with local businesses to offer students practical experience before they enter the workforce.
example2_zh: 大学可以与当地企业合作，让学生在就业前获得实践经验。
collocations: business partner｜商业伙伴；合伙人 ; dance partner｜舞伴 ; life partner｜终身伴侣 ; partner with｜与…合作
tip_zh: partner不表明性别；作动词常用partner with。

meanings_zh: n. 羽毛球运动
definition_en: A sport involving hitting a shuttlecock over a net with rackets
example1_en: We play badminton at the sports centre every Saturday.
example1_zh: 我们每周六都在体育中心打羽毛球。
example2_en: Schools can encourage regular exercise by offering accessible activities such as badminton and swimming.
example2_zh: 学校可以通过提供羽毛球和游泳等易于参与的活动来鼓励学生经常锻炼。
collocations: play badminton｜打羽毛球 ; badminton court｜羽毛球场 ; badminton racket｜羽毛球拍
tip_zh: 运动名通常不可数；“打羽毛球”用play badminton。

meanings_zh: pron. 没有人 | n. 无名小卒
definition_en: not a single person | a person considered unimportant or unknown
example1_en: Nobody noticed the kitten sleeping behind the sofa.
example1_zh: 没人注意到睡在沙发后面的小猫。
example2_en: Nobody should be denied access to education because their family cannot afford school fees.
example2_zh: 任何人都不应因家庭付不起学费而被剥夺受教育的机会。
collocations: nobody else｜没有其他人 ; almost nobody｜几乎没有人 ; nobody knows｜无人知晓
tip_zh: 作主语时谓语用单数；本身含否定意义。

meanings_zh: n. 海岸；海滨 | v. 滑行；靠惯性前进 | v. 不费力地应付
definition_en: the land along the edge of the sea | to move without using power or much effort | to succeed or progress without trying very hard
example1_en: We walked along the coast and collected smooth stones.
example1_zh: 我们沿着海岸散步，捡了一些光滑的石头。
example2_en: Communities along the coast face increasing risks from rising sea levels and severe storms.
example2_zh: 沿海社区面临着海平面上升和强风暴带来的日益严重的风险。
collocations: along the coast｜沿着海岸 ; off the coast｜在近海海域 ; coast downhill｜顺坡滑行 ; coast through｜轻松应付
tip_zh: on the coast指在海边；off the coast指在近海。

meanings_zh: v. 进入 | v. 参加；加入 | v. 输入；录入
definition_en: To go or come into a place. | To become involved in a competition, activity, or organisation. | To put information into a computer or official record.
example1_en: Please wipe your shoes before you enter the kitchen.
example1_zh: 进入厨房前，请把鞋底擦干净。
example2_en: Young people often need practical training before they enter the workforce and take on professional responsibilities.
example2_zh: 年轻人在进入职场、承担职业责任之前，往往需要接受实践培训。
collocations: enter a competition｜参加比赛 ; enter the workforce｜进入职场 ; enter data｜输入数据 ; enter a room｜进入房间
tip_zh: 进入某地用enter a place，不加into。

meanings_zh: n. 城堡
definition_en: A large fortified building with thick walls and towers.
example1_en: We climbed the hill to explore the old castle.
example1_zh: 我们爬上山丘，去探索那座古堡。
example2_en: Restoring a historic castle can attract tourists while preserving valuable evidence of a region's architectural heritage.
example2_zh: 修复历史城堡既能吸引游客，也能保留体现当地建筑遗产的珍贵实物。
collocations: medieval castle｜中世纪城堡 ; castle walls｜城堡城墙 ; ruined castle｜残破的城堡
tip_zh: castle中的t不发音；palace指宫殿。

meanings_zh: adj. 糟糕的；令人难受的
definition_en: Extremely bad or unpleasant.
example1_en: The soup tasted awful, so I made a sandwich.
example1_zh: 这汤太难喝了，所以我做了个三明治。
example2_en: Residents described the awful conditions in overcrowded housing and called for stricter safety standards.
example2_zh: 居民描述了过度拥挤住房中的恶劣条件，并呼吁制定更严格的安全标准。
collocations: awful weather｜糟糕的天气 ; feel awful｜感觉很难受 ; awful smell｜难闻的气味
tip_zh: feel awful可指身体难受，也可指内疚或心情差。

meanings_zh: n. 文字；文本 | n. 短信 | v. 发短信
definition_en: Written words, especially the main written content of something. | A short written message sent using a phone. | Send someone a short written message using a phone.
example1_en: The text on this menu is too small.
example1_zh: 这份菜单上的字太小了。
example2_en: Teachers can combine text with images to help students understand complex scientific concepts more easily.
example2_zh: 教师可以将文字与图像结合，帮助学生更轻松地理解复杂的科学概念。
collocations: text message｜短信 ; plain text｜纯文本 ; text someone｜给某人发短信
tip_zh: 文字内容通常不可数；一条短信可说a text。

meanings_zh: n. 结果；后果 | n. 成绩；比赛结果 | v. 导致；由……造成
definition_en: something that happens because of an action or event | the final score or outcome of a test or competition | to happen because of something or cause something to happen
example1_en: The shiny floor was the result of hours of cleaning.
example1_zh: 这光亮的地板是花了好几个小时打扫的成果。
example2_en: Investing in reliable public transport can result in lower emissions and shorter commuting times for urban residents.
example2_zh: 投资建设可靠的公共交通，可以减少排放并缩短城市居民的通勤时间。
collocations: as a result｜因此 ; result in｜导致 ; result from｜由……造成 ; exam results｜考试成绩
tip_zh: result in后接结果；result from后接原因。

meanings_zh: n. 浴缸
definition_en: A large container that you sit in to wash your body.
example1_en: The kitten watched water dripping into the empty bathtub.
example1_zh: 小猫看着水滴进空浴缸。
example2_en: Replacing a bathtub with a shower can save space in small urban apartments.
example2_zh: 在小型城市公寓中，用淋浴设施替换浴缸可以节省空间。
collocations: fill the bathtub｜往浴缸放水 ; an empty bathtub｜空浴缸 ; a freestanding bathtub｜独立式浴缸
tip_zh: bathtub尤常用于美式英语；英式常说bath。

meanings_zh: n. 信箱；邮筒 | n. 电子邮箱
definition_en: A box where letters are delivered or collected. | An electronic space where email messages are received and stored.
example1_en: A postcard from my cousin arrived in our mailbox.
example1_zh: 表亲寄来的一张明信片到了我们家的信箱里。
example2_en: Residents in remote areas may travel considerable distances to reach the nearest public mailbox.
example2_zh: 偏远地区的居民可能需要走很远才能到达最近的公共邮筒。
collocations: check your mailbox｜查看信箱 ; an overflowing mailbox｜塞满的信箱 ; an electronic mailbox｜电子邮箱
tip_zh: 美式常用词；英式常用letterbox或postbox。

meanings_zh: n. 习惯；习性
definition_en: something you do regularly, often without thinking
example1_en: Checking my phone before breakfast has become a habit.
example1_zh: 早餐前查看手机已经成了我的习惯。
example2_en: Developing the habit of regular exercise during childhood can improve health throughout adult life.
example2_zh: 在童年时期养成规律锻炼的习惯，可以改善整个成年阶段的健康状况。
collocations: form a habit｜养成习惯 ; break a habit｜改掉习惯 ; out of habit｜出于习惯 ; get into the habit of｜养成……的习惯
tip_zh: 表示做某事的习惯，用habit of doing。

meanings_zh: n. 岩石；石块 | n. 摇滚乐 | v. 摇动；摇晃
definition_en: The hard natural material forming much of Earth's surface. | Popular music with a strong beat, often featuring electric guitars. | Move gently backwards and forwards or from side to side.
example1_en: We sat on a flat rock beside the river.
example1_zh: 我们坐在河边一块平坦的岩石上。
example2_en: Studying ancient rock layers helps scientists understand how the Earth's climate has changed over time.
example2_zh: 研究古老的岩层有助于科学家了解地球气候随时间发生的变化。
collocations: solid rock｜坚硬的岩石 ; rock music｜摇滚乐 ; rock formation｜岩层；岩石构造 ; rock a baby｜轻摇婴儿
tip_zh: rock 作岩石材料不可数；指一块石头时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 驾驶；驾车方式 | adj. 推动的；起促进作用的 | adj. 风雨猛烈的
definition_en: the activity of controlling a car or another road vehicle | strongly influencing something and making it happen | blown hard by strong winds
example1_en: Her careful driving made the mountain journey feel safe.
example1_zh: 她开车很谨慎，让这段山路旅程令人安心。
example2_en: Technological innovation is a driving force behind economic growth, although its benefits are not always shared equally.
example2_zh: 技术创新是经济增长的推动力，但其收益并不总能得到公平分享。
collocations: driving test｜驾驶考试 ; driving licence｜驾驶执照 ; driving force｜推动力 ; driving rain｜疾风骤雨
tip_zh: driving force意为推动力；driving也可作drive的现在分词。

meanings_zh: n. 电脑键盘 | n. 乐器键盘；电子键盘乐器
definition_en: A set of keys used to enter information into a computer | A musical instrument's keys, or an electronic instrument with keys
example1_en: I brushed the crumbs off my keyboard before starting work.
example1_zh: 开始工作前，我把键盘上的碎屑刷掉了。
example2_en: Students with limited mobility may benefit from an adapted keyboard that makes digital learning more accessible.
example2_zh: 行动不便的学生可能受益于经过改装的键盘，从而更方便地参与数字化学习。
collocations: wireless keyboard｜无线键盘 ; keyboard shortcut｜键盘快捷键 ; play the keyboard｜弹电子键盘乐器
tip_zh: 电脑键盘常说a keyboard；演奏键盘乐器用play the keyboard。

meanings_zh: n. 抽屉
definition_en: a sliding storage compartment in a desk or other furniture
example1_en: I keep spare keys in the top kitchen drawer.
example1_zh: 我把备用钥匙放在厨房最上面的抽屉里。
example2_en: Office desks with lockable drawers help employees store personal belongings securely in shared working environments.
example2_zh: 配有可上锁抽屉的办公桌有助于员工在共享办公环境中安全存放私人物品。
collocations: open a drawer｜打开抽屉 ; top drawer｜最上层抽屉 ; desk drawer｜书桌抽屉 ; chest of drawers｜抽屉柜
tip_zh: 抽屉是drawer；衣橱是wardrobe。

meanings_zh: n. 橡胶 | n. 橡皮擦
definition_en: an elastic material used to make tyres and other products | a small object used to remove pencil marks
example1_en: These rubber boots keep my feet dry in puddles.
example1_zh: 这双橡胶靴让我踩水坑时双脚也不会湿。
example2_en: Recycling rubber from used tyres can reduce waste and provide material for safer playground surfaces.
example2_zh: 回收废旧轮胎中的橡胶可以减少废物，并为更安全的游乐场地面提供材料。
collocations: natural rubber｜天然橡胶 ; rubber band｜橡皮筋 ; rubber gloves｜橡胶手套 ; rubber boots｜橡胶靴
tip_zh: 橡胶不可数；橡皮擦可数，美式英语通常用eraser。

meanings_zh: v. 混合；拌和 | n. 混合物；组合 | v. 交往；相处
definition_en: To combine different substances or things. | A combination of different substances, people, or things. | To spend time socially with other people.
example1_en: Mix the flour and eggs in a large bowl.
example1_zh: 把面粉和鸡蛋放进大碗里拌匀。
example2_en: Successful neighbourhoods often contain a mix of housing types that serve people with different incomes.
example2_zh: 成功的社区通常包含多种住房类型，以满足不同收入人群的需求。
collocations: mix ingredients｜混合原料 ; mix with others｜与他人交往 ; a diverse mix｜多样化的组合 ; mix things up｜把东西弄混
tip_zh: mix A with B指混合；mix A up with B指混淆。

meanings_zh: n. 电；电力
definition_en: Energy carried by charged particles, used to power devices
example1_en: The storm cut off electricity to our entire street.
example1_zh: 暴风雨导致我们整条街停电了。
example2_en: Generating electricity from renewable sources can reduce dependence on fossil fuels and lower greenhouse gas emissions.
example2_zh: 利用可再生能源发电可以减少对化石燃料的依赖，并降低温室气体排放。
collocations: generate electricity｜发电 ; electricity supply｜电力供应 ; an electricity bill｜电费账单 ; save electricity｜节约用电
tip_zh: electricity不可数；electric多指用电的，electrical指电相关的。

meanings_zh: n. 产品；制品 | n. 产物；结果 | n. 乘积
definition_en: something made or grown to be sold or used | something that results from a process or situation | the result of multiplying two or more quantities
example1_en: This cleaning product removes stains from my kitchen tiles.
example1_zh: 这款清洁产品能去除我家厨房瓷砖上的污渍。
example2_en: Consumers increasingly prefer products that use less packaging and can be repaired rather than replaced.
example2_zh: 消费者越来越偏好包装更少、能够维修而不必更换的产品。
collocations: launch a product｜推出产品 ; dairy products｜乳制品 ; product development｜产品开发 ; the product of｜……的产物
tip_zh: product是产品或结果，production是生产过程。

meanings_zh: n. 斑马
definition_en: an African wild animal with black and white stripes
example1_en: A zebra stood quietly beside the watering hole.
example1_zh: 一匹斑马静静地站在水塘旁。
example2_en: Protecting grasslands helps zebra populations survive while preserving habitats for many other wild animals.
example2_zh: 保护草原有助于斑马种群生存，同时也为许多其他野生动物保留栖息地。
collocations: a herd of zebras｜一群斑马 ; zebra stripes｜斑马条纹 ; zebra crossing｜斑马线
tip_zh: zebra crossing 是英式英语中的斑马线。

meanings_zh: n. 洗发水 | v. 用洗发水洗头
definition_en: a liquid product used to wash hair | to wash hair using shampoo
example1_en: I packed a small bottle of shampoo for our trip.
example1_zh: 我为这次旅行装了一小瓶洗发水。
example2_en: Using refillable shampoo containers can reduce plastic waste generated by households and the tourism industry.
example2_zh: 使用可补充装的洗发水容器可以减少家庭和旅游业产生的塑料垃圾。
collocations: a bottle of shampoo｜一瓶洗发水 ; mild shampoo｜温和洗发水 ; shampoo your hair｜用洗发水洗头 ; dry shampoo｜干洗洗发剂
tip_zh: 泛指洗发水通常不可数；一瓶用a bottle of shampoo。

meanings_zh: n. 实验室
definition_en: A room or building equipped for scientific experiments and tests
example1_en: We wore safety goggles while mixing liquids in the lab.
example1_zh: 我们在实验室混合液体时戴着护目镜。
example2_en: A well-equipped school lab allows students to test scientific ideas through practical experiments rather than memorisation alone.
example2_zh: 设备齐全的学校实验室让学生通过实际实验检验科学观点，而非仅仅死记硬背。
collocations: research lab｜研究实验室 ; science lab｜科学实验室 ; lab equipment｜实验室设备 ; lab technician｜实验室技术员
tip_zh: lab是laboratory的常用缩写，二者均为可数名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 惊讶的；感到意外的
definition_en: Feeling that something unexpected has happened.
example1_en: I was surprised to find flowers outside my door.
example1_zh: 发现门外放着鲜花，我很惊讶。
example2_en: Researchers were surprised by how strongly access to green spaces influenced residents' reported levels of wellbeing.
example2_zh: 绿地的可及性对居民自报幸福感的影响如此之大，令研究人员感到惊讶。
collocations: surprised at the result｜对结果感到惊讶 ; pleasantly surprised｜感到惊喜 ; surprised to hear｜听到后感到意外
tip_zh: surprised形容人的感受；surprising形容事物令人惊讶。

meanings_zh: n. 加热器；取暖器
definition_en: a device that heats air, water, or another substance
example1_en: We switched on the heater before the guests arrived.
example1_zh: 客人到来前，我们打开了取暖器。
example2_en: Replacing an inefficient water heater can lower household energy bills and reduce overall electricity consumption.
example2_zh: 更换效率低下的热水器能降低家庭能源账单，并减少总体用电量。
collocations: electric heater｜电暖器 ; water heater｜热水器 ; portable heater｜便携式取暖器
tip_zh: heater是设备；heating指供暖或供暖系统。

meanings_zh: n. 律师
definition_en: Someone qualified to advise people about law and represent them.
example1_en: Our lawyer explained the contract before we signed it.
example1_zh: 我们的律师在我们签字前解释了合同内容。
example2_en: Access to an affordable lawyer helps ensure that everyone can defend their legal rights.
example2_zh: 能以可负担的费用聘请律师，有助于确保每个人都能维护自己的合法权利。
collocations: hire a lawyer｜聘请律师 ; criminal lawyer｜刑事律师 ; consult a lawyer｜咨询律师
tip_zh: lawyer是律师的统称，区别于法官judge。

meanings_zh: n. 商店 | v. 储存；贮藏 | n. 储备；储存物
definition_en: a place where people buy goods | to keep something somewhere for future use | a supply of something kept for future use
example1_en: The store near our house sells fresh bread.
example1_zh: 我们家附近的商店卖新鲜面包。
example2_en: Modern batteries can store energy from solar panels for use when sunlight is no longer available.
example2_zh: 现代电池可以储存太阳能板产生的能量，以便在没有阳光时使用。
collocations: department store｜百货商店 ; store data｜存储数据 ; store food｜储存食物 ; a store of knowledge｜知识储备
tip_zh: 商店在美式中常用store，英式日常更常用shop。

meanings_zh: n. 轮子；车轮 | n. 方向盘 | v. 推着有轮之物移动
definition_en: A round object that turns to move a vehicle. | The circular control used to steer a vehicle. | To move something along on its wheels.
example1_en: The front wheel of my bicycle needs replacing.
example1_zh: 我的自行车前轮需要更换。
example2_en: Transport planners should ensure that passengers can wheel their luggage easily through stations and onto trains.
example2_zh: 交通规划者应确保乘客能轻松推着行李穿过车站并登上列车。
collocations: front wheel｜前轮 ; steering wheel｜方向盘 ; behind the wheel｜开车；掌舵 ; wheel a trolley｜推手推车
tip_zh: at或behind the wheel常表示正在开车。

meanings_zh: n. 一件物品；一件商品 | n. 项目；条目；一则消息
definition_en: A single object, especially one in a collection. | One part of a list, programme, or news report.
example1_en: Please place each item carefully in the shopping bag.
example1_zh: 请把每件商品小心地放进购物袋。
example2_en: Each item on the meeting agenda addresses a different challenge facing local public transport services.
example2_zh: 会议议程中的每一项都涉及当地公共交通服务面临的不同挑战。
collocations: household item｜家居用品 ; luxury item｜奢侈品 ; agenda item｜议程项目 ; news item｜一则新闻
tip_zh: item是可数名词；一件衣物可说an item of clothing。

meanings_zh: n. 接待员；前台人员
definition_en: Someone who welcomes visitors and handles enquiries at a reception desk.
example1_en: The receptionist smiled and handed us our room keys.
example1_zh: 接待员微笑着把房间钥匙递给了我们。
example2_en: A skilled receptionist can improve patients' experiences by managing appointments efficiently and responding calmly to enquiries.
example2_zh: 熟练的接待员能够高效安排预约、沉着回应咨询，从而改善患者的就诊体验。
collocations: hotel receptionist｜酒店接待员 ; work as a receptionist｜担任接待员 ; ask the receptionist｜询问接待员
tip_zh: reception 是接待处；receptionist 是接待员。

meanings_zh: n. 男销售员；男推销员
definition_en: A man whose job is to sell goods or services.
example1_en: The salesman showed us how to fold the bicycle.
example1_zh: 那位男销售员向我们演示了如何折叠自行车。
example2_en: A skilled salesman should explain product limitations honestly rather than pressure customers into making unnecessary purchases.
example2_zh: 有技巧的销售员应如实解释产品的局限，而不是强迫顾客购买不必要的东西。
collocations: a car salesman｜汽车销售员 ; a travelling salesman｜旅行推销员 ; an experienced salesman｜经验丰富的销售员
tip_zh: salesman明确指男性；不强调性别时用salesperson。

meanings_zh: adj. 极好的；出色的 | adj. 奇幻的；异想天开的 | adj. 极大的；惊人的
definition_en: extremely good or enjoyable | strange and imaginative, rather than realistic | extremely large in amount or degree
example1_en: We had a fantastic view of the mountains from our balcony.
example1_zh: 从阳台望去，山景美极了。
example2_en: Community sports programmes offer young people a fantastic opportunity to develop teamwork skills and build confidence.
example2_zh: 社区体育项目为年轻人提供了培养团队合作技能和增强自信的绝佳机会。
collocations: fantastic opportunity｜绝佳机会 ; fantastic view｜极美的景色 ; fantastic achievement｜了不起的成就 ; fantastic creatures｜奇幻生物
tip_zh: 表示“极好的”偏口语；正式写作可用excellent。

meanings_zh: n. 跑步 | n. 管理；运作 | adj. 流动的；运转中的
definition_en: the activity or sport of moving quickly on foot | the work of managing or operating something | flowing continuously or operating rather than stopped
example1_en: Running along the beach always clears my head.
example1_zh: 沿着海滩跑步总能让我头脑清醒。
example2_en: Local volunteers play a crucial role in the daily running of community sports centres.
example2_zh: 当地志愿者在社区体育中心的日常管理中发挥着关键作用。
collocations: go running｜去跑步 ; day-to-day running｜日常管理 ; running water｜自来水；流动的水 ; running costs｜运营成本
tip_zh: 表示跑步活动时不可数；the running of指管理。

meanings_zh: n. 大门；栅栏门 | n. 登机口
definition_en: A movable barrier controlling entry through a fence or wall. | An airport area where passengers board a plane.
example1_en: She closed the garden gate to keep the dog inside.
example1_zh: 她关上花园的门，免得狗跑出去。
example2_en: Airports should provide clear directions so passengers can reach their departure gate without unnecessary stress.
example2_zh: 机场应提供清晰的指引，让乘客无需过度紧张就能找到登机口。
collocations: front gate｜前门 ; departure gate｜登机口 ; school gate｜校门 ; lock the gate｜锁上大门
tip_zh: gate多指围墙或栅栏上的门；房间的门通常用door。

meanings_zh: n. 标题；书名；名称 | n. 头衔；职称 | n. 冠军称号
definition_en: the name given to a book, film, or other work | a name indicating someone's rank, position, or professional role | the position of winner in a sporting competition
example1_en: I remember the book's cover but not its title.
example1_zh: 我记得这本书的封面，却不记得书名了。
example2_en: An effective essay title should clearly indicate the main issue being discussed without revealing every detail.
example2_zh: 好的文章标题应清楚表明所讨论的主要问题，而不必透露所有细节。
collocations: book title｜书名 ; job title｜职位名称 ; win the title｜夺得冠军 ; defend a title｜卫冕
tip_zh: title是标题或名称；topic是讨论的主题。

meanings_zh: n. 站台；月台 | n. 讲台；高台 | n. 网络平台；交流平台
definition_en: The area beside railway tracks where passengers board trains. | A raised surface where people can stand or perform. | A service or system for sharing information or doing activities.
example1_en: We waited on the platform as the train approached.
example1_zh: 火车驶近时，我们正在站台上等候。
example2_en: Online learning platforms allow students in remote areas to access courses that are unavailable locally.
example2_zh: 在线学习平台让偏远地区的学生能够学习当地没有开设的课程。
collocations: railway platform｜火车站台 ; online platform｜网络平台 ; a platform for debate｜辩论的平台
tip_zh: 在站台上用on the platform，不用in。

meanings_zh: n. 停车；泊车 | n. 停车空间；停车设施
definition_en: The act of leaving a vehicle in a particular place. | Space or facilities where vehicles can be left.
example1_en: Parking is difficult on this narrow street after sunset.
example1_zh: 日落后，在这条狭窄的街道上停车很困难。
example2_en: Reducing free parking in city centres may encourage commuters to use public transport more frequently.
example2_zh: 减少市中心的免费停车位可能促使通勤者更频繁地使用公共交通。
collocations: a parking space｜停车位 ; parking restrictions｜停车限制 ; free parking｜免费停车 ; underground parking｜地下停车设施
tip_zh: 名词通常不可数；一个停车位说a parking space。

meanings_zh: v. 替换；取代；更换 | v. 把……放回原处
definition_en: To take something's place or put something else in its place. | To put something back where it was before.
example1_en: We need to replace the broken kitchen chair.
example1_zh: 我们需要换掉厨房里那把坏椅子。
example2_en: Renewable energy could gradually replace fossil fuels if governments invest sufficiently in infrastructure and storage technology.
example2_zh: 如果政府充分投资基础设施和储能技术，可再生能源就可能逐步取代化石燃料。
collocations: replace A with B｜用B替换A ; replace a battery｜更换电池 ; be replaced by｜被……取代
tip_zh: replace A with B是用B换掉A，别弄反方向。

meanings_zh: n. 院子；庭院 | n. 码（长度单位）
definition_en: An outdoor area beside a building, often enclosed. | A unit of length equal to three feet or 0.9144 metres.
example1_en: Our dog chased a yellow ball across the yard.
example1_zh: 我们的狗追着一个黄色的球跑过院子。
example2_en: Converting an unused school yard into a garden can provide valuable outdoor learning opportunities for urban children.
example2_zh: 把闲置的校园庭院改成花园，可以为城市儿童提供宝贵的户外学习机会。
collocations: back yard｜后院 ; school yard｜校园庭院 ; a yard of fabric｜一码布料
tip_zh: 美式yard可指住宅草坪庭院；英式多用garden。

meanings_zh: n. 打印机 | n. 印刷工；印刷商
definition_en: a machine that produces paper copies of digital documents or images | a person or business that prints books and other materials
example1_en: The printer ran out of paper halfway through my homework.
example1_zh: 我的作业打印到一半时，打印机没纸了。
example2_en: Schools can reduce paper waste by setting every printer to print on both sides automatically.
example2_zh: 学校可以将所有打印机设为自动双面打印，从而减少纸张浪费。
collocations: laser printer｜激光打印机 ; inkjet printer｜喷墨打印机 ; printer cartridge｜打印机墨盒
tip_zh: print是打印；printer可指机器，也可指印刷从业者。

meanings_zh: n. 陆地；土地 | v. 着陆；降落；使着陆 | v. 成功获得
definition_en: Earth's solid surface, or an area used for a particular purpose. | To reach the ground, or bring an aircraft to the ground. | To succeed in getting something desirable, especially a job.
example1_en: After hours at sea, we finally spotted dry land.
example1_zh: 在海上航行数小时后，我们终于看到了陆地。
example2_en: Protecting agricultural land from urban expansion is essential for maintaining food production near growing cities.
example2_zh: 保护农业用地免受城市扩张侵占，对维持发展中城市周边的粮食生产至关重要。
collocations: agricultural land｜农业用地 ; by land｜经陆路 ; land safely｜安全着陆 ; land a job｜成功找到工作
tip_zh: 表示土地通常不可数；land a job指成功获得工作。

meanings_zh: n. 商人；男企业家
definition_en: A man who works in business, especially managing a company.
example1_en: A local businessman opened a bakery near our school.
example1_zh: 一位当地商人在我们学校附近开了一家面包店。
example2_en: A successful businessman can support local development by investing in training and creating stable employment opportunities.
example2_zh: 成功的商人可以通过投资培训和创造稳定就业机会来支持当地发展。
collocations: successful businessman｜成功的商人 ; local businessman｜当地商人 ; wealthy businessman｜富商
tip_zh: 复数为businessmen；不限定性别可用businessperson。

meanings_zh: adj. 高兴的；欣慰的 | adj. 乐意的
definition_en: Feeling happy or pleased about something. | Willing and pleased to do something.
example1_en: I'm glad you came to dinner with us tonight.
example1_zh: 我很高兴你今晚来和我们一起吃饭。
example2_en: Many residents were glad that the council had decided to preserve the local park.
example2_zh: 许多居民都很高兴，地方议会决定保留当地的公园。
collocations: glad to hear｜很高兴听到 ; glad to help｜乐意帮忙 ; glad about｜为……高兴 ; glad that｜很高兴……
tip_zh: 常作表语；用be glad to do或be glad that从句。

meanings_zh: v. 发光；照耀 | v. 擦亮 | n. 光泽；光亮
definition_en: To give out or reflect light. | To polish something until its surface becomes bright and smooth. | Brightness on a smooth surface that reflects light.
example1_en: The sun shone through my bedroom window this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上，阳光透过我卧室的窗户照了进来。
example2_en: Streetlights that shine directly into homes can disturb sleep and reduce residents' quality of life.
example2_zh: 直接照进住宅的路灯会干扰睡眠，降低居民的生活质量。
collocations: shine brightly｜明亮地照耀 ; shine a light on｜用灯照向 ; shine your shoes｜擦亮鞋子 ; a healthy shine｜健康的光泽
tip_zh: 发光的过去式常用shone；擦亮的过去式用shined。

meanings_zh: n. 梨
definition_en: A sweet, juicy fruit, often narrower at the top
example1_en: She sliced a ripe pear into her breakfast bowl.
example1_zh: 她把一个熟梨切成片，放进早餐碗里。
example2_en: Buying locally grown pears during their natural season may reduce the need for long-distance food transport.
example2_zh: 在自然成熟的季节购买本地种植的梨，可能减少长途食品运输的需求。
collocations: a ripe pear｜熟梨 ; a pear tree｜梨树 ; pear juice｜梨汁
tip_zh: pear与pair同音；一个梨用a pear。

meanings_zh: n. 休息日；休假日
definition_en: A day when you do not have to work.
example1_en: On my day off, I cycled to the lake.
example1_zh: 休息那天，我骑车去了湖边。
example2_en: Taking a regular day off allows employees to recover and may improve their performance at work.
example2_zh: 定期休息一天能让员工恢复精力，也可能提高工作表现。
collocations: take a day off｜休息一天 ; have a day off｜有一天休假 ; a day off work｜一天不上班
tip_zh: 复数是days off；请一天假可说take a day off。

meanings_zh: n. 喜剧；喜剧作品 | n. 滑稽；喜剧性
definition_en: Entertainment intended to make people laugh. | The humorous quality of a situation or event.
example1_en: We watched a comedy and laughed all evening.
example1_zh: 我们看了一部喜剧，整个晚上都笑个不停。
example2_en: Comedy can encourage audiences to question social attitudes by presenting familiar problems in unexpected and amusing ways.
example2_zh: 喜剧可以用出人意料又有趣的方式呈现常见问题，促使观众反思社会观念。
collocations: romantic comedy｜浪漫喜剧 ; stand-up comedy｜单口喜剧 ; a comedy series｜喜剧连续剧
tip_zh: 指喜剧类型时通常不可数；一部喜剧用a comedy。

meanings_zh: adv. 立即；马上 | adv. 紧接地；紧邻地 | conj. 一……就
definition_en: without waiting or any delay | directly before, after, or next to something | as soon as something happens
example1_en: When the doorbell rang, I immediately opened the door.
example1_zh: 门铃一响，我就立刻打开了门。
