example2_en: Schools should respond immediately to safety concerns rather than waiting for a serious incident to occur.
example2_zh: 学校应立即回应安全方面的担忧，而不是等到严重事件发生才采取行动。
collocations: respond immediately｜立即回应 ; immediately after｜紧接着……之后 ; immediately available｜可立即获得的
tip_zh: 作连词表示“一……就”主要见于英式英语。

meanings_zh: n. 冷冻柜；冷冻室
definition_en: an appliance or compartment that keeps food frozen
example1_en: Put the ice cream back in the freezer.
example1_zh: 把冰激凌放回冷冻室。
example2_en: Using a freezer allows households to store seasonal produce longer and reduce food waste.
example2_zh: 使用冷冻柜能让家庭更长时间地储存时令农产品，减少食物浪费。
collocations: chest freezer｜卧式冷冻柜 ; freezer compartment｜冷冻室 ; defrost the freezer｜给冷冻柜除霜
tip_zh: freezer用于冷冻；fridge主要用于冷藏。

meanings_zh: n. 双肩背包
definition_en: A bag carried on your back using shoulder straps.
example1_en: I packed my lunch and jacket in a rucksack.
example1_zh: 我把午餐和夹克装进了双肩背包。
example2_en: Travellers carrying only a rucksack can move more easily between public transport services.
example2_zh: 只背一个双肩包的旅行者换乘公共交通时行动更方便。
collocations: pack a rucksack｜收拾背包 ; carry a rucksack｜背双肩包 ; hiking rucksack｜徒步背包
tip_zh: 英式英语常用rucksack；不限定帆布材质。

meanings_zh: n. 论说文；短文；随笔
definition_en: A short piece of writing exploring a particular subject.
example1_en: I finished my history essay just before dinner.
example1_zh: 我刚好在晚饭前写完了历史课论文。
example2_en: Writing an essay encourages students to organise their ideas and support arguments with relevant evidence.
example2_zh: 撰写论说文能促使学生整理思路，并用相关证据支持论点。
collocations: write an essay｜写一篇短文 ; essay question｜论述题 ; an essay on｜一篇关于……的文章
tip_zh: 可数名词；一篇关于某主题的文章用an essay on。

meanings_zh: n. 酒馆；酒吧
definition_en: A place serving alcoholic drinks and often meals, especially in Britain.
example1_en: We had vegetable soup at the village pub.
example1_zh: 我们在村里的酒馆喝了蔬菜汤。
example2_en: In some rural communities, the local pub provides an important meeting place for residents.
example2_zh: 在一些乡村社区，当地酒馆为居民提供了重要的聚会场所。
collocations: a local pub｜当地酒馆 ; a village pub｜乡村酒馆 ; pub food｜酒馆餐食
tip_zh: pub多见于英国语境，常供应餐食，不等于旅馆。

meanings_zh: n. 小孩；孩子 | v. 开玩笑；戏弄 | n. 小山羊
definition_en: A child or young person, in informal language. | Say something playfully that is not meant to be believed. | A young goat.
example1_en: The kids built a tiny bridge across the stream.
example1_zh: 孩子们在小溪上搭了一座小桥。
example2_en: Outdoor activities can help kids develop social skills while improving their physical health.
example2_zh: 户外活动可以帮助孩子们发展社交技能，同时改善身体健康。
collocations: young kids｜年幼的孩子 ; just kidding｜只是开玩笑 ; kid around｜闹着玩
tip_zh: kid较口语；正式作文中“孩子”宜用child。

meanings_zh: v. 设法做到 | v. 管理；经营 | v. 应付；支撑下去
definition_en: To succeed in doing something, especially something difficult. | To direct or control a business, team, or activity. | To cope with a situation despite difficulties or limited resources.
example1_en: I managed to carry all the bags upstairs.
example1_zh: 我总算把所有袋子都提上了楼。
example2_en: Many students manage to balance academic demands with paid employment by planning their weekly schedules carefully.
example2_zh: 许多学生通过仔细安排每周日程，设法兼顾学业要求与有薪工作。
collocations: manage to do something｜设法做成某事 ; manage a team｜管理团队 ; manage your time｜管理时间 ; manage without help｜独自应付
tip_zh: manage to do表示成功做成，不只是尝试。

meanings_zh: n. 马戏团；马戏表演
definition_en: A group or show featuring acrobats, clowns, and other performers.
example1_en: We watched the circus performers juggle brightly coloured balls.
example1_zh: 我们看着马戏演员抛接色彩鲜艳的球。
example2_en: Modern circus performances can preserve traditional entertainment skills while creating opportunities for artists from diverse backgrounds.
example2_zh: 现代马戏表演既能保留传统娱乐技艺，也能为不同背景的艺术工作者创造机会。
collocations: circus performer｜马戏演员 ; circus tent｜马戏帐篷 ; circus act｜马戏节目 ; travelling circus｜巡回马戏团
tip_zh: 可指马戏团或表演；复数为circuses。

meanings_zh: n. 游客；观光者
definition_en: Someone who visits places for pleasure rather than work
example1_en: A tourist asked me how to reach the castle.
example1_zh: 一位游客问我怎么去城堡。
example2_en: Large numbers of tourists support local businesses but can also place pressure on public transport.
example2_zh: 大量游客为当地企业带来生意，但也可能给公共交通造成压力。
collocations: tourist attraction｜旅游景点 ; tourist destination｜旅游目的地 ; tourist information｜旅游咨询信息 ; overseas tourists｜海外游客
tip_zh: tourist通常是名词，在tourist attraction中修饰名词。

meanings_zh: n. 餐叉；叉子 | n. 岔路口；分叉处 | v. 分叉
definition_en: A tool with pointed prongs for picking up food | A place where a road or path divides | Divide into separate branches or directions
example1_en: She picked up a carrot with her fork.
example1_zh: 她用餐叉叉起了一块胡萝卜。
example2_en: Where a rural path forks, clear directions can prevent visitors from entering environmentally sensitive areas.
example2_zh: 在乡间小路分叉处提供清晰指引，可以防止游客进入生态敏感区域。
collocations: a knife and fork｜一副刀叉 ; a fork in the road｜道路岔口 ; fork left｜向左岔开
tip_zh: 道路forks表示分叉；a fork in the road指岔路口。

meanings_zh: v. 浪费 | n. 废物；垃圾 | n. 浪费
definition_en: Use more of something than necessary or without useful results. | Unwanted material left after something has been used or made. | An unnecessary or unproductive use of time, money, or resources.
example1_en: Don't waste water by leaving the tap running.
example1_zh: 别让水龙头一直开着，白白浪费水。
example2_en: Reducing household waste requires both convenient recycling facilities and greater public awareness of responsible consumption.
example2_zh: 减少生活垃圾既需要便利的回收设施，也需要提高公众的负责任消费意识。
collocations: waste time｜浪费时间 ; a waste of money｜浪费金钱 ; household waste｜生活垃圾 ; food waste｜食物浪费
tip_zh: 用waste time doing sth，通常不用to do。

meanings_zh: n. 总统 | n. 主席；总裁；大学校长
definition_en: the head of state in a country without a monarch | the person leading an organisation, company, club, or university
example1_en: The president waved to the crowd outside the palace.
example1_zh: 总统向宫殿外的人群挥手致意。
example2_en: The newly elected president promised to improve public healthcare and expand access to affordable education.
example2_zh: 新当选的总统承诺改善公共医疗，并扩大可负担教育的覆盖范围。
collocations: elect a president｜选举总统 ; presidential election｜总统选举 ; university president｜大学校长 ; vice president｜副总统；副总裁
tip_zh: 可指总统，也可指机构负责人；具体译法看语境。

meanings_zh: n. 理发师（主要为男士）
definition_en: Someone who cuts men's hair and trims or shaves beards.
example1_en: The barber trimmed my hair before the wedding.
example1_zh: 婚礼前，理发师给我修剪了头发。
example2_en: Local businesses, such as a neighbourhood barber, provide essential services and create opportunities for informal social interaction.
example2_zh: 社区理发师等本地商家提供基本服务，也为非正式社交创造机会。
collocations: go to the barber's｜去理发店 ; a barber shop｜男士理发店 ; a barber's chair｜理发椅
tip_zh: barber主要为男士理发修面；barber's可指理发店。

meanings_zh: adj. 睡着的
definition_en: Sleeping rather than awake.
example1_en: The baby was asleep before we reached home.
example1_zh: 我们还没到家，宝宝就睡着了。
example2_en: People who use electronic devices late at night may find it harder to fall asleep.
example2_zh: 深夜使用电子设备的人可能更难入睡。
collocations: fall asleep｜入睡 ; fast asleep｜熟睡的 ; stay asleep｜保持睡眠状态
tip_zh: asleep通常作表语；“熟睡的婴儿”用a sleeping baby。

meanings_zh: n. 记者
definition_en: Someone who gathers and presents news for the public.
example1_en: A reporter interviewed the coach after the match.
example1_zh: 比赛结束后，一名记者采访了教练。
example2_en: A responsible reporter checks information carefully before publishing stories that could influence public opinion on important social issues.
example2_zh: 负责任的记者在发表可能影响公众对重要社会问题看法的报道之前，会仔细核实信息。
collocations: news reporter｜新闻记者 ; television reporter｜电视记者 ; sports reporter｜体育记者
tip_zh: reporter侧重新闻采访报道；journalist涵盖范围更广。

meanings_zh: n. 女王；王后 | n. 蜂王；蚁后 | n. 国际象棋中的后
definition_en: A female monarch, or the wife of a king. | The main egg-laying female in a social insect colony. | The chess piece that moves any distance in any direction.
example1_en: The queen waved to the crowd from her carriage.
example1_zh: 女王从马车里向人群挥手。
example2_en: In some constitutional monarchies, the queen performs ceremonial duties while elected representatives make political decisions.
example2_zh: 在一些君主立宪制国家，女王履行礼仪职责，而民选代表作出政治决策。
collocations: queen bee｜蜂王 ; the reigning queen｜在位女王 ; king and queen｜国王与王后
tip_zh: queen 可指统治国家的女王，也可指国王的妻子。

meanings_zh: n. 教学；教师职业 | n. 教义；学说
definition_en: The work of helping people learn knowledge or skills. | Ideas or principles taught by a person or tradition.
example1_en: Her love of teaching began at a small village school.
example1_zh: 她对教学的热爱始于一所小乡村学校。
example2_en: Effective teaching should combine clear explanations with practical activities that encourage students to apply their knowledge independently.
example2_zh: 有效的教学应将清晰的讲解与实践活动结合起来，鼓励学生独立运用知识。
collocations: teaching methods｜教学方法 ; teaching materials｜教学材料 ; teaching experience｜教学经验 ; a career in teaching｜教师职业生涯
tip_zh: 指教学时不可数；指教义或学说常用teachings。

meanings_zh: n. 物理学
definition_en: the science of matter, energy, forces, and their interactions
example1_en: Our physics teacher showed us how magnets attract iron.
example1_zh: 我们的物理老师演示了磁铁如何吸引铁。
example2_en: A strong understanding of physics can help engineers develop safer buildings and more efficient transport systems.
example2_zh: 扎实的物理学知识能帮助工程师设计更安全的建筑和更高效的交通系统。
collocations: study physics｜学习物理学 ; the laws of physics｜物理定律 ; nuclear physics｜核物理学
tip_zh: 虽以s结尾，仍作不可数名词，谓语用单数。

meanings_zh: n. 结账离店；退房 | n. 最晚退房时间
definition_en: The process of paying and leaving a hotel | The latest time guests must leave their hotel rooms
example1_en: We left our bags at reception after check-out.
example1_zh: 退房后，我们把行李留在了前台。
example2_en: Flexible check-out times can improve the travel experience for families with young children.
example2_zh: 灵活的退房时间可以改善带幼儿出行家庭的旅行体验。
collocations: late check-out｜延迟退房 ; check-out time｜退房时间 ; express check-out｜快速退房
tip_zh: 名词也写作checkout；动词用check out。

meanings_zh: v. 发展；成长；培养 | v. 开发；研制 | v. 逐渐出现；患上
definition_en: to grow or make something stronger, larger, or more advanced | to create a new product, method, or idea | to begin to have a condition, problem, or feeling
example1_en: Children develop confidence when they try new activities.
example1_zh: 孩子们尝试新活动时会逐渐建立自信。
example2_en: Governments should fund research to develop affordable technologies that address water shortages in rural communities.
example2_zh: 政府应资助研究，开发价格可负担的技术，以解决农村社区的缺水问题。
collocations: develop skills｜培养技能 ; develop a habit｜养成习惯 ; develop new technology｜开发新技术 ; develop symptoms｜出现症状
tip_zh: 可及物也可不及物：develop skills；skills develop。

meanings_zh: n. 慢跑
definition_en: Running slowly and steadily as a form of exercise.
example1_en: She goes jogging around the park before breakfast.
example1_zh: 她早饭前会绕着公园慢跑。
example2_en: Regular jogging can improve physical fitness, especially when combined with a balanced diet and adequate rest.
example2_zh: 经常慢跑可以改善体能，尤其是在配合均衡饮食和充足休息的情况下。
collocations: go jogging｜去慢跑 ; jogging shoes｜慢跑鞋 ; jogging route｜慢跑路线
tip_zh: jog变为jogging时须双写g。

meanings_zh: v. 准备；做好准备 | v. 制作；拟订
definition_en: Make someone or something ready for an activity or situation | Make food, a document, or a plan ready for use
example1_en: I prepare my lunch before leaving home each morning.
example1_zh: 我每天早上出门前都会准备好午餐。
example2_en: Schools should prepare students for employment by developing practical skills alongside their academic knowledge.
example2_zh: 学校应在传授学术知识的同时培养实用技能，让学生为就业做好准备。
collocations: prepare for an exam｜准备考试 ; prepare a meal｜准备饭菜 ; prepare a report｜撰写报告 ; prepare to leave｜准备离开
tip_zh: prepare for后接名词；prepare to后接动词原形。

meanings_zh: adj. 瑞士的；瑞士人的 | n. 瑞士人（统称）
definition_en: Relating to Switzerland, its people, or their culture. | The people of Switzerland, considered as a group.
example1_en: We enjoyed Swiss cheese during our picnic by the lake.
example1_zh: 我们在湖边野餐时品尝了瑞士奶酪。
example2_en: Swiss railways demonstrate how reliable public transport can connect remote mountain communities and support sustainable tourism.
example2_zh: 瑞士铁路展示了可靠的公共交通如何连接偏远山区社区并支持可持续旅游。
collocations: Swiss cheese｜瑞士奶酪 ; Swiss Alps｜瑞士阿尔卑斯山 ; Swiss watches｜瑞士手表
tip_zh: 首字母须大写；the Swiss统称瑞士人，不加s。

meanings_zh: n. 大柄杯；马克杯 | v. 拦路抢劫
definition_en: a large cup with a handle, usually for hot drinks | to attack someone in public and steal from them
example1_en: I warmed my hands around a mug of tea.
example1_zh: 我双手捧着一大杯茶取暖。
example2_en: Providing reusable mugs in offices can reduce the waste generated by disposable cups each day.
example2_zh: 在办公室提供可重复使用的杯子，可以减少每天由一次性杯子产生的垃圾。
collocations: a mug of coffee｜一大杯咖啡 ; ceramic mug｜陶瓷马克杯 ; get mugged｜遭到抢劫
tip_zh: mug通常有柄、较大；作动词可指拦路抢劫。

meanings_zh: n. 沙；沙子 | v. 用砂纸打磨
definition_en: Tiny loose grains of rock found on beaches and in deserts. | To make a surface smooth by rubbing it with sandpaper.
example1_en: The children built a castle from wet sand.
example1_zh: 孩子们用湿沙堆了一座城堡。
example2_en: Removing sand from riverbeds for construction can damage habitats and increase the risk of erosion.
example2_zh: 为建筑工程开采河床中的沙子可能破坏栖息地，并增加侵蚀风险。
collocations: fine sand｜细沙 ; a grain of sand｜一粒沙 ; sand dunes｜沙丘 ; sand down｜打磨平整
tip_zh: 表示沙子时不可数；一粒沙用a grain of sand。

meanings_zh: n. 雨衣
definition_en: A coat that keeps your clothes dry in the rain.
example1_en: I grabbed my raincoat before stepping into the rain.
example1_zh: 走进雨中之前，我一把拿起了雨衣。
example2_en: Travellers visiting regions with unpredictable weather should carry a lightweight raincoat to stay comfortable during outdoor activities.
example2_zh: 前往天气多变地区的旅行者应携带轻便雨衣，以便在户外活动时保持舒适。
collocations: waterproof raincoat｜防水雨衣 ; lightweight raincoat｜轻便雨衣 ; put on a raincoat｜穿上雨衣
tip_zh: 英美英语都使用raincoat，并非仅限美式。

meanings_zh: n. 日记；日记簿 | n. 日程簿
definition_en: A book containing personal accounts of daily events and feelings. | A book used to record appointments and future plans.
example1_en: I write in my diary before going to bed.
example1_zh: 我睡前会写日记。
example2_en: Keeping a learning diary encourages students to reflect on their progress and identify difficulties.
example2_zh: 坚持写学习日记能鼓励学生反思自己的进步并发现困难。
collocations: keep a diary｜记日记 ; diary entry｜一篇日记 ; personal diary｜私人日记
tip_zh: diary是日记，dairy是乳制品；注意字母顺序。

meanings_zh: n. 摩托车 | v. 骑摩托车
definition_en: A motor vehicle with two wheels, usually for one or two. | To travel by motorcycle.
example1_en: He parked his motorcycle beside the garden gate.
example1_zh: 他把摩托车停在花园门旁。
example2_en: Although motorcycles require less parking space than cars, riders are more exposed to injury in road accidents.
example2_zh: 尽管摩托车所需的停车空间比汽车小，骑手在交通事故中却更容易受伤。
collocations: ride a motorcycle｜骑摩托车 ; motorcycle helmet｜摩托车头盔 ; motorcycle licence｜摩托车驾驶证
tip_zh: 骑摩托车用ride，通常不用drive。

meanings_zh: v. 握住；拿着 | v. 举行；召开 | v. 容纳；装得下
definition_en: to keep something in your hands or arms | to organise an event or meeting | to have enough space for something or someone
example1_en: Could you hold my bag while I tie my shoes?
example1_zh: 我系鞋带时，你能帮我拿一下包吗？
example2_en: Local councils should hold public meetings before making major changes to transport services.
example2_zh: 地方议会在对交通服务作出重大调整之前，应当召开公众会议。
collocations: hold hands｜手拉手 ; hold a meeting｜召开会议 ; hold your breath｜屏住呼吸 ; hold up to｜最多容纳
tip_zh: 过去式、过去分词均为held；举行会议用hold。

meanings_zh: n. 接待处；服务台 | n. 招待会；欢迎会 | n. 接收效果；反响
definition_en: the area where visitors are welcomed and given information | a formal social event held to welcome or celebrate someone | how well signals are received, or how people respond
example1_en: Please leave your room key at reception before breakfast.
example1_zh: 请在早餐前把房间钥匙留在前台。
example2_en: The proposal received a positive reception from local residents because it addressed their concerns about road safety.
example2_zh: 这项提议回应了当地居民对道路安全的担忧，因此获得了积极反响。
collocations: reception desk｜接待台 ; wedding reception｜婚宴 ; poor reception｜信号接收差 ; warm reception｜热情欢迎
tip_zh: 英式英语常说at reception，表示在接待处。

meanings_zh: adj. 外国的；来自国外的 | adj. 异物的；外来的 | adj. 陌生的；不相符的
definition_en: From or relating to a country other than your own. | Present where it does not naturally belong. | Unfamiliar to someone or inconsistent with something.
example1_en: My sister enjoys learning foreign languages in her spare time.
example1_zh: 我姐姐喜欢在空闲时间学习外语。
example2_en: Foreign investment can create jobs, but governments should ensure that local communities also benefit from economic growth.
example2_zh: 外国投资可以创造就业机会，但政府应确保当地社区也能从经济增长中受益。
collocations: foreign language｜外语 ; foreign investment｜外国投资 ; foreign policy｜外交政策 ; foreign body｜异物
tip_zh: foreign to可指对某人陌生，或与某事不相符。

meanings_zh: n. 地球 | n. 泥土；土壤
definition_en: the planet where humans and other known living things exist | the loose material on the ground in which plants grow
example1_en: The children dug into the damp earth with small spades.
example1_zh: 孩子们用小铲子挖开湿润的泥土。
example2_en: Life on earth depends on healthy ecosystems that provide clean water, food, and breathable air.
example2_zh: 地球上的生命依赖于能够提供洁净水源、食物和可呼吸空气的健康生态系统。
collocations: on earth｜在地球上 ; planet Earth｜地球 ; damp earth｜湿润的泥土
tip_zh: 指行星时常写Earth；on earth中不加the。

meanings_zh: n. 小包；小袋；小盒 | n. 数据包
definition_en: A small container or wrapped quantity of something. | A small unit of data transmitted across a network.
example1_en: She opened a packet of biscuits for the journey.
example1_zh: 她打开了一包饼干，准备在路上吃。
example2_en: Charging customers for each packet of disposable utensils could encourage more sustainable habits in the food industry.
example2_zh: 对每包一次性餐具收费，可以推动餐饮行业形成更可持续的习惯。
collocations: a packet of biscuits｜一包饼干 ; seed packet｜种子袋 ; data packet｜数据包
tip_zh: 英式常用a packet of；美式常依物品用pack或bag。

meanings_zh: n. 滑板 | v. 玩滑板；滑行
definition_en: A narrow board with small wheels, ridden standing up. | To move or perform tricks on a skateboard.
example1_en: He carried his skateboard home when the rain started.
example1_zh: 开始下雨时，他抱着滑板回家了。
example2_en: Providing dedicated areas for skateboard users can encourage physical activity while reducing conflicts with pedestrians in public spaces.
example2_zh: 为滑板使用者提供专用区域，可以鼓励体育活动，同时减少公共空间中与行人的冲突。
collocations: ride a skateboard｜玩滑板 ; skateboard tricks｜滑板技巧 ; a skateboard park｜滑板公园
tip_zh: skateboard无扶手；scooter通常有扶手。

meanings_zh: n. 高速公路
definition_en: a wide road designed for fast travel over long distances
example1_en: We left the motorway and stopped for lunch.
example1_zh: 我们驶离高速公路，停下来吃午饭。
example2_en: Building a new motorway may reduce journey times, but it can also damage nearby wildlife habitats.
example2_zh: 修建新的高速公路可能缩短行程时间，但也会破坏附近的野生动物栖息地。
collocations: motorway junction｜高速公路交叉口 ; motorway services｜高速公路服务区 ; join the motorway｜驶入高速公路
tip_zh: 主要用于英式英语；美式常用freeway。

meanings_zh: adj. 欧洲的；欧洲人的 | n. 欧洲人
definition_en: Relating to Europe or its people. | A person from Europe.
example1_en: We explored several European cities during our summer holiday.
example1_zh: 暑假期间，我们游览了几座欧洲城市。
example2_en: Many European countries have invested in railway networks to reduce dependence on short domestic flights.
example2_zh: 许多欧洲国家投资建设铁路网，以减少对短途国内航班的依赖。
collocations: European countries｜欧洲国家 ; European culture｜欧洲文化 ; the European Union｜欧洲联盟
tip_zh: 首字母大写；前用a而非an，不等同于欧盟的。

meanings_zh: n. 疼痛 | n. 悲痛；痛苦 | v. 使痛苦；使难过
definition_en: an unpleasant physical feeling caused by injury or illness | strong emotional suffering caused by loss or distress | to cause someone emotional suffering
example1_en: I felt a sharp pain in my left ankle.
example1_zh: 我的左脚踝感到一阵剧痛。
example2_en: Regular exercise may reduce back pain among office workers who remain seated for long periods.
example2_zh: 经常锻炼可能减轻长时间久坐的办公室职员的背痛。
collocations: sharp pain｜剧痛；刺痛 ; chronic pain｜慢性疼痛 ; relieve pain｜缓解疼痛 ; emotional pain｜情感上的痛苦
tip_zh: 泛指疼痛常不可数；具体一阵疼痛可用a pain。

meanings_zh: adv. 肯定地；确实；当然
definition_en: certainly, with no doubt about something
example1_en: I will definitely bring an umbrella after yesterday's rain.
example1_zh: 昨天下过雨后，我今天肯定会带伞。
example2_en: Improved insulation will definitely reduce heat loss, although total energy savings depend on household behaviour.
example2_zh: 改善隔热性能肯定能减少热量流失，不过总节能量取决于住户的行为。
collocations: definitely worth｜绝对值得 ; definitely agree｜完全赞同 ; definitely not｜绝对不
tip_zh: 拼写是definitely；不要与defiantly混淆。

meanings_zh: n. 英里
definition_en: A unit of distance equal to approximately 1.61 kilometres.
example1_en: The nearest swimming pool is only a mile away.
example1_zh: 最近的游泳池只有一英里远。
example2_en: Replacing short car journeys with walking even one mile could improve public health and reduce emissions.
example2_zh: 用步行替代短途驾车，哪怕只走一英里，也能改善公众健康并减少排放。
collocations: a mile away｜一英里远 ; square mile｜平方英里 ; miles per hour｜英里每小时
tip_zh: 英里是距离单位；mile可数，复数加s。

meanings_zh: adj. 风大的；多风的
definition_en: Having a lot of wind.
example1_en: It was too windy to eat lunch outside today.
example1_zh: 今天风太大，没法在外面吃午饭。
example2_en: Windy coastal regions can generate renewable electricity, although turbines must be positioned carefully to protect wildlife.
example2_zh: 多风的沿海地区可以生产可再生电力，但风力涡轮机必须谨慎选址，以保护野生动物。
collocations: windy weather｜大风天气 ; a windy day｜刮大风的一天 ; windy conditions｜多风的环境
tip_zh: 天气义读/ˈwɪndi/；描述道路蜿蜒通常用winding。

meanings_zh: adv. 在某处；到某处 | adv. 大约
definition_en: in or to a place that is not specified | approximately, when used before an amount or range
example1_en: I left my keys somewhere near the sofa.
example1_zh: 我把钥匙落在沙发附近的某个地方了。
example2_en: Young people need somewhere affordable to live before they can fully participate in the local economy.
example2_zh: 年轻人需要有负担得起的住所，才能充分参与当地的经济活动。
collocations: somewhere else｜别处 ; somewhere quiet｜某个安静的地方 ; somewhere around｜大约
tip_zh: 形容词放后面：somewhere quiet；前面通常不加to。

meanings_zh: n. 计算器
definition_en: A device or application used for mathematical calculations
example1_en: I used a calculator to check the shopping total.
example1_zh: 我用计算器核对了购物总额。
example2_en: Allowing students to use a calculator can help them focus on solving more complex mathematical problems.
example2_zh: 允许学生使用计算器，可以帮助他们专注于解决更复杂的数学问题。
collocations: use a calculator｜使用计算器 ; scientific calculator｜科学计算器 ; pocket calculator｜袖珍计算器
tip_zh: calculator指工具；calculation指计算过程或结果。

meanings_zh: n. 月亮；月球 | n. 天然卫星
definition_en: the natural object that moves around Earth | a natural object that moves around a planet
example1_en: The moon rose slowly above the trees behind our house.
example1_zh: 月亮在我们屋后的树梢上缓缓升起。
example2_en: Research on the moon may help scientists understand how Earth and other rocky planets formed.
example2_zh: 对月球的研究可能帮助科学家了解地球和其他岩石行星的形成过程。
collocations: full moon｜满月 ; crescent moon｜新月；月牙 ; the surface of the moon｜月球表面
tip_zh: 指地球的月亮通常用the moon；其他行星的卫星可数。

meanings_zh: det. 这样的；这类的 | det. 如此的；这么的
definition_en: of the kind already mentioned or being described | used to emphasise a quality or degree before a noun
example1_en: It was such a lovely day that we ate outside.
example1_zh: 天气如此宜人，我们就在外面吃了饭。
example2_en: Many cities face severe traffic congestion, and such problems require coordinated investment in public transport.
example2_zh: 许多城市面临严重的交通拥堵，这类问题需要统筹公共交通投资来解决。
collocations: such as｜例如 ; such a pity｜真可惜 ; such problems｜这类问题 ; such ... that ...｜如此……以至于……
tip_zh: 单数可数名词前用such a/an；so后直接接形容词。

meanings_zh: v. 打败；胜过 | v. 反复敲打；跳动 | n. 节拍；有节奏的敲击
definition_en: To defeat someone in a game, competition, or contest. | To hit repeatedly, or move with a regular rhythm. | A regular pulse of sound or movement.
example1_en: My sister beat me at chess again yesterday.
example1_zh: 我姐姐昨天又下棋赢了我。
example2_en: Athletes need consistent training and psychological support to beat their strongest competitors in international events.
example2_zh: 运动员需要持续训练和心理支持，才能在国际赛事中击败最强劲的对手。
collocations: beat an opponent｜击败对手 ; beat a record｜打破纪录 ; a steady beat｜稳定的节拍 ; beat an egg｜打鸡蛋
tip_zh: 过去式 beat，过去分词 beaten；赢比赛用 win。

meanings_zh: n. 汽油
definition_en: a liquid fuel used in cars and other engines
example1_en: We stopped for petrol before driving into the mountains.
example1_zh: 开车进山前，我们停车加了汽油。
example2_en: Higher petrol prices may encourage commuters to use public transport rather than drive to work.
example2_zh: 汽油价格上涨可能促使通勤者乘坐公共交通，而不是开车上班。
collocations: petrol station｜加油站 ; unleaded petrol｜无铅汽油 ; petrol prices｜汽油价格 ; run out of petrol｜汽油用尽
tip_zh: 不可数名词；英式用petrol，美式用gasoline或gas。

meanings_zh: n. 薪水；薪金
definition_en: A fixed regular payment for work, often expressed yearly
example1_en: Her new job offers a higher salary and shorter hours.
example1_zh: 她的新工作薪水更高，工时也更短。
example2_en: Although salary influences career choices, many graduates also value job security and opportunities for professional development.
example2_zh: 虽然薪水会影响职业选择，但许多毕业生也重视工作保障和职业发展机会。
collocations: annual salary｜年薪 ; starting salary｜起薪 ; salary increase｜加薪 ; competitive salary｜有竞争力的薪酬
tip_zh: salary指固定薪金；wages常指按时或按周计算的工资。

meanings_zh: n. 嗓音；说话声 | n. 发言权；影响力 | v. 表达；吐露
definition_en: The sound someone makes when speaking or singing. | The right or opportunity to express opinions and influence decisions. | To express an opinion, feeling, or concern.
example1_en: Her gentle voice helped the frightened puppy settle down.
example1_zh: 她温柔的声音让受惊的小狗安静了下来。
example2_en: Public consultations give local residents a voice in decisions that directly affect their communities.
example2_zh: 公众咨询让当地居民有机会参与直接影响其社区的决策。
collocations: raise your voice｜提高嗓门 ; a voice in decisions｜决策中的发言权 ; voice concerns｜表达担忧 ; lose your voice｜嗓子失声
tip_zh: voice侧重人的嗓音；sound泛指声音。

meanings_zh: n. 国王
definition_en: a male ruler who usually inherits his position
example1_en: The king waved to the crowd from his carriage.
example1_zh: 国王从马车上向人群挥手。
example2_en: In some countries, the king performs ceremonial duties while elected representatives make political decisions.
example2_zh: 在一些国家，国王履行礼仪职责，而民选代表作出政治决策。
collocations: become king｜成为国王 ; crown a king｜为国王加冕 ; the king's reign｜国王的统治时期
tip_zh: king指男性君主；queen可指女王或王后。

meanings_zh: n. 差异；不同之处 | n. 分歧；意见不合 | n. 差额；差值
definition_en: A way in which people or things are not alike | A disagreement between people or groups | The amount by which one quantity exceeds another
example1_en: The main difference between these jackets is their weight.
example1_zh: 这两件夹克的主要区别在于重量。
example2_en: Understanding cultural differences can help international students adapt more successfully to life in a new country.
example2_zh: 了解文化差异有助于留学生更顺利地适应新国家的生活。
collocations: the difference between｜……之间的区别 ; make a difference｜产生影响 ; a significant difference｜显著差异 ; settle differences｜解决分歧
tip_zh: 比较两者用the difference between A and B。

meanings_zh: v. 希望；期望 | n. 希望；期盼
definition_en: to want something to happen and believe it may happen | a feeling that something wanted may happen
example1_en: I hope the rain stops before our picnic.
example1_zh: 我希望野餐前雨能停。
example2_en: Many graduates hope to find meaningful employment that allows them to contribute positively to society.
example2_zh: 许多毕业生希望找到有意义的工作，使自己能够为社会作出积极贡献。
collocations: hope to do something｜希望做某事 ; hope for the best｜抱最好的希望 ; give up hope｜放弃希望 ; in the hope of｜怀着……的希望
tip_zh: 可说hope to do，不说hope sb to do。

meanings_zh: n. 导游；向导 | n. 指南；入门书 | v. 引导；指导
definition_en: someone who leads people and explains places they visit | a book or resource giving useful information or instructions | to show someone the way or help them decide
example1_en: Our guide led us through the narrow market streets.
example1_zh: 导游带我们穿过市场里狭窄的街道。
example2_en: Teachers should guide students towards reliable sources rather than simply provide answers to every question.
example2_zh: 教师应引导学生寻找可靠的信息来源，而不是直接给出每个问题的答案。
collocations: tour guide｜导游 ; a guide to｜……的指南 ; guide someone through｜引导某人完成 ; guided tour｜有导游带领的游览
tip_zh: 指南用a guide to；指导某人完成用guide someone through。

meanings_zh: n. 金属
definition_en: a usually hard, shiny material that conducts heat and electricity
example1_en: The metal handle felt cold against my fingers.
example1_zh: 金属把手摸起来冰凉。
example2_en: Recycling metal reduces the demand for mining and can significantly lower energy consumption in manufacturing.
example2_zh: 回收金属可以减少采矿需求，并显著降低制造业的能源消耗。
collocations: scrap metal｜废金属 ; precious metal｜贵金属 ; metal frame｜金属框架 ; heavy metal｜重金属
tip_zh: 泛指材料时不可数；指金属种类时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 碗；盆 | v. 打保龄球；投球
definition_en: a round, deep container used for food or liquids | to roll a bowling ball or deliver a cricket ball
example1_en: She warmed her hands around a bowl of soup.
example1_zh: 她双手捧着一碗汤取暖。
example2_en: Serving meals in smaller bowls may help people control portions and reduce unnecessary food waste.
example2_zh: 用较小的碗盛饭可能有助于人们控制食量，减少不必要的食物浪费。
collocations: a bowl of soup｜一碗汤 ; mixing bowl｜搅拌碗 ; salad bowl｜沙拉碗 ; bowl a ball｜投球
tip_zh: a bowl of表示“一碗”；bowling指保龄球运动。

meanings_zh: n. 工作日；周一至周五
definition_en: any day from Monday to Friday
example1_en: The swimming pool is quieter on weekday mornings.
example1_zh: 游泳池在工作日的早晨比较安静。
example2_en: Extending library opening hours on weekdays would benefit students who work during the day.
example2_zh: 延长图书馆工作日的开放时间，将有利于白天工作的学生。
collocations: on weekdays｜在工作日 ; weekday mornings｜工作日早晨 ; a weekday service｜工作日班次
tip_zh: 指周一至周五，不保证当天实际上需要上班。

meanings_zh: v. 提供；供应 | v. 供养；赡养
definition_en: To give someone something they need or make it available. | To support someone financially by supplying what they need.
example1_en: The campsite provides clean towels and blankets for every guest.
example1_zh: 营地为每位客人提供干净的毛巾和毯子。
example2_en: Local authorities should provide affordable public transport to ensure that all residents can access essential services.
example2_zh: 地方政府应提供价格可负担的公共交通，确保所有居民都能获得基本服务。
collocations: provide support｜提供支持 ; provide access to｜提供使用……的机会 ; provide someone with something｜向某人提供某物 ; provide for a family｜养家
tip_zh: 用provide sb with sth或provide sth for sb。

meanings_zh: n. 购物中心
definition_en: a large building or complex containing many shops
example1_en: We spent the rainy afternoon browsing in the mall.
example1_zh: 下雨的下午，我们一直在购物中心闲逛。
example2_en: A new shopping mall may create jobs, but it can also threaten small independent retailers.
example2_zh: 新的购物中心可能创造就业机会，但也可能威胁独立小零售商的生存。
collocations: shopping mall｜购物中心 ; indoor mall｜室内购物中心 ; mall entrance｜购物中心入口
tip_zh: mall常用于美式英语；英式常说shopping centre。

meanings_zh: n. 门厅；走廊 | n. 礼堂；大厅；会堂 | n. 大学学生宿舍
definition_en: an entrance area or passage connecting rooms in a building | a large room or building used for public gatherings | a building where university students live
example1_en: Please leave your wet shoes in the hall.
example1_zh: 请把湿鞋留在门厅里。
example2_en: The community hall provides an affordable space where residents can attend classes and organise local events.
example2_zh: 社区会堂为居民提供了一个价格实惠的场所，供他们上课和组织当地活动。
collocations: an entrance hall｜门厅 ; a concert hall｜音乐厅 ; a town hall｜市政厅 ; halls of residence｜大学学生宿舍
tip_zh: 英式英语中，大学宿舍常称halls或halls of residence。

meanings_zh: adj. 有帮助的；有用的 | adj. 乐于助人的
definition_en: Making something easier to do or understand. | Willing to help other people.
example1_en: Your map was helpful when we explored the village.
example1_zh: 我们游览村庄时，你的地图帮了大忙。
example2_en: Clear feedback is particularly helpful for students who are learning to organise their ideas in academic essays.
example2_zh: 对于正在学习如何组织学术论文思路的学生来说，清晰的反馈尤其有帮助。
collocations: helpful advice｜有用的建议 ; helpful information｜有用的信息 ; helpful staff｜乐于助人的员工 ; find something helpful｜觉得某物有帮助
tip_zh: helpful可形容事物有用，也可形容人乐于助人。

meanings_zh: n. 苏格兰
definition_en: A country in the northern part of Great Britain.
example1_en: We explored old castles during our holiday in Scotland.
example1_zh: 我们在苏格兰度假时游览了古老的城堡。
example2_en: Scotland attracts visitors with its dramatic landscapes, while rural communities benefit from spending on accommodation and local services.
example2_zh: 苏格兰以壮丽的风景吸引游客，而乡村社区则受益于游客在住宿和当地服务上的消费。
collocations: the west coast of Scotland｜苏格兰西海岸 ; rural Scotland｜苏格兰乡村地区 ; a trip to Scotland｜苏格兰之旅
tip_zh: 苏格兰是英国的组成部分；形容词通常用Scottish。

meanings_zh: n. 疾病
definition_en: An illness affecting humans, animals or plants
example1_en: The vet checked our rabbit for signs of disease.
example1_zh: 兽医检查了我们的兔子，看是否有患病迹象。
example2_en: Access to clean drinking water can significantly reduce the spread of infectious diseases in vulnerable communities.
example2_zh: 获得清洁饮用水可以显著减少传染病在脆弱社区中的传播。
collocations: heart disease｜心脏病 ; infectious diseases｜传染病 ; prevent disease｜预防疾病 ; the spread of disease｜疾病传播
tip_zh: 重音在第二音节；泛指疾病可不加冠词。

meanings_zh: n. 布告栏；公告板
definition_en: A board displaying announcements for people to read.
example1_en: Someone pinned a lost cat poster to the noticeboard.
example1_zh: 有人把寻猫启事钉在了布告栏上。
example2_en: A shared noticeboard can help residents discover local events and participate more actively in community life.
example2_zh: 共用布告栏可以帮助居民了解当地活动，更积极地参与社区生活。
collocations: community noticeboard｜社区布告栏 ; on the noticeboard｜在布告栏上 ; put up a noticeboard｜安装布告栏
tip_zh: 英式常用noticeboard，美式常用bulletin board。

meanings_zh: v. 挑选；选择 | v. 采摘 | n. 镐；鹤嘴锄
definition_en: to choose someone or something from available options | to remove fruit or flowers from a plant | a tool with a pointed metal head for breaking hard ground
example1_en: You can pick any colour for your new curtains.
example1_zh: 新窗帘的颜色你可以随便选。
example2_en: Schools should help students pick courses that match their interests rather than focus only on future earnings.
example2_zh: 学校应帮助学生选择符合兴趣的课程，而不是只关注未来收入。
collocations: pick a winner｜选出获胜者 ; pick fruit｜采摘水果 ; pick carefully｜仔细挑选 ; take your pick｜随你挑选
tip_zh: pick可指挑选或采摘；捡起通常用pick up。

meanings_zh: n. 车库 | n. 汽车修理厂
definition_en: A building or part of a building for keeping vehicles. | A business where vehicles are repaired and serviced.
example1_en: We keep our car and bicycles in the garage.
example1_zh: 我们把汽车和自行车停在车库里。
example2_en: Converting an unused garage into living space can provide additional accommodation without requiring new land.
example2_zh: 将闲置车库改成居住空间，可以在不占用新土地的情况下增加住房。
collocations: double garage｜双车位车库 ; garage door｜车库门 ; local garage｜当地汽车修理厂
tip_zh: 英式英语也常用 garage 指汽车修理厂。

meanings_zh: n. 服务；公共服务 | v. 检修；保养 | n. 宗教仪式
definition_en: Help or useful work provided for people or customers. | Check and repair a vehicle or machine to keep it working. | A formal religious ceremony.
example1_en: The friendly service made us feel welcome at the café.
example1_zh: 咖啡馆里热情的服务让我们感到宾至如归。
example2_en: Reliable bus services allow residents without cars to reach hospitals, schools and workplaces.
example2_zh: 可靠的公交服务让没有汽车的居民也能到达医院、学校和工作地点。
collocations: customer service｜客户服务 ; public services｜公共服务 ; service a car｜保养汽车 ; religious service｜宗教仪式
tip_zh: 表示服务质量常不可数；各项服务可用复数。

meanings_zh: n. 同班同学
definition_en: Someone who studies in the same class as you.
example1_en: My classmate lent me a pencil before the lesson.
example1_zh: 上课前，我的同班同学借给我一支铅笔。
example2_en: Working with classmates on group projects can help students develop communication and problem-solving skills.
example2_zh: 与同班同学合作完成小组项目可以帮助学生培养沟通和解决问题的能力。
collocations: a former classmate｜以前的同班同学 ; help a classmate｜帮助同班同学 ; a new classmate｜新同学
tip_zh: classmate指同班同学，schoolmate指同校同学。

meanings_zh: n. 访客；参观者；游客
definition_en: Someone who goes to see a person or place.
example1_en: A visitor left her umbrella beside our front door.
example1_zh: 一位访客把她的伞落在了我们前门旁。
example2_en: The museum attracts international visitors by offering exhibitions that explore local history and culture.
example2_zh: 这家博物馆通过举办探究当地历史与文化的展览吸引国际游客。
collocations: attract visitors｜吸引游客 ; overseas visitors｜海外游客 ; visitor centre｜游客中心
tip_zh: visitor指人；visit可作动词或名词。

meanings_zh: n. 千米；公里
definition_en: a unit of distance equal to one thousand meters
example1_en: The nearest bakery is about a kilometer from here.
example1_zh: 最近的面包店离这里大约一公里。
example2_en: Providing reliable public transport within a kilometer of residential areas could reduce dependence on private cars.
example2_zh: 在居民区一公里范围内提供可靠的公共交通，可以减少人们对私家车的依赖。
collocations: a square kilometer｜一平方公里 ; kilometers per hour｜公里每小时 ; a kilometer away｜一公里远
tip_zh: 美式拼写；英式为kilometre，符号km不加s。

meanings_zh: n. 死亡；去世
definition_en: the end of a person's or animal's life
example1_en: The old dog's death left the family deeply sad.
example1_zh: 老狗的离世让全家人深感悲伤。
example2_en: Improved access to clean drinking water has reduced deaths from preventable diseases in many communities.
example2_zh: 更便利地获得清洁饮用水，已减少了许多社区中可预防疾病导致的死亡。
collocations: cause of death｜死因 ; premature death｜过早死亡 ; prevent deaths｜防止死亡 ; death rate｜死亡率
tip_zh: die是动词，dead是形容词，death是名词。

meanings_zh: n. 流行音乐 | v. 爆开；发出砰声 | v. 短暂去；顺手放
definition_en: popular music with catchy tunes and usually simple structures | to burst or make a short, sharp sound | to go somewhere briefly or put something somewhere quickly
example1_en: My sister listens to pop while she cooks dinner.
example1_zh: 我姐姐做晚饭时会听流行音乐。
example2_en: Pop can introduce young listeners to other cultures, especially when artists combine different musical traditions.
example2_zh: 流行音乐可以让年轻听众了解其他文化，尤其是在艺人融合不同音乐传统时。
collocations: pop music｜流行音乐 ; pop a balloon｜弄爆气球 ; pop into a shop｜顺便进店 ; pop up｜突然出现
tip_zh: 表示短暂去或顺手放时属非正式用法。

meanings_zh: n. 橱柜；壁橱
definition_en: A cabinet with doors and shelves for storing things
example1_en: The clean bowls are in the cupboard above the sink.
example1_zh: 干净的碗放在水槽上方的橱柜里。
example2_en: Well-designed cupboards can maximise storage space in small apartments without making living areas feel crowded.
example2_zh: 设计合理的橱柜可以充分利用小公寓的储物空间，又不会让起居区域显得拥挤。
collocations: kitchen cupboard｜厨房橱柜 ; built-in cupboard｜嵌入式橱柜 ; cupboard door｜橱柜门
tip_zh: cupboard中的p不发音；通常指带门的储物柜。

meanings_zh: adj. 更差的；更严重的 | adv. 更差地；更糟地
definition_en: Less good or more unpleasant, harmful, or serious. | Less well or more badly.
example1_en: The weather grew worse as we climbed the hill.
example1_zh: 我们爬山时，天气变得更糟了。
example2_en: Traffic congestion may become worse unless cities invest in reliable and affordable public transport.
example2_zh: 除非城市投资建设可靠且价格合理的公共交通，否则交通拥堵可能进一步恶化。
collocations: get worse｜变得更糟 ; even worse｜甚至更糟 ; make matters worse｜使情况更糟
tip_zh: bad和badly的比较级；最高级是worst。

meanings_zh: n. 文件；证件；文档 | v. 记录；记载
definition_en: a paper or digital record containing information | record information about something in writing, photographs, or other forms
example1_en: Please save the document before you close your laptop.
example1_zh: 合上笔记本电脑之前，请保存文档。
example2_en: Researchers should document changes in local wildlife to assess the environmental impact of urban development.
example2_zh: 研究人员应记录当地野生生物的变化，以评估城市开发对环境的影响。
collocations: official document｜正式文件 ; travel documents｜旅行证件 ; save a document｜保存文档 ; document changes｜记录变化
tip_zh: 动词末尾读/ment/，名词末尾读/mənt/。

meanings_zh: n. 板球运动 | n. 蟋蟀
definition_en: A team sport using a bat, ball, and wickets. | A jumping insect that makes a chirping sound.
example1_en: We played cricket in the park after lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭后，我们在公园里打板球。
example2_en: Team sports such as cricket can help young people develop cooperation skills and build lasting friendships.
example2_zh: 板球等团队运动可以帮助年轻人培养合作能力，建立持久的友谊。
collocations: play cricket｜打板球 ; a cricket match｜一场板球比赛 ; a cricket bat｜板球球拍 ; crickets chirping｜蟋蟀鸣叫
tip_zh: 指板球运动时不可数；指蟋蟀时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 鲨鱼 | n. 骗子；敲诈者
definition_en: A fish with a cartilage skeleton and usually sharp teeth. | Someone who cheats others, especially to get their money.
example1_en: We watched a shark swim slowly behind the aquarium glass.
example1_zh: 我们看着一条鲨鱼在水族馆的玻璃后缓缓游动。
example2_en: Protecting shark populations helps maintain balanced marine ecosystems because many species regulate the numbers of other animals.
example2_zh: 保护鲨鱼种群有助于维持海洋生态平衡，因为许多鲨鱼物种能调节其他动物的数量。
collocations: shark fin｜鲨鱼鳍 ; whale shark｜鲸鲨 ; shark conservation｜鲨鱼保护 ; loan shark｜放高利贷者
tip_zh: loan shark指放高利贷者，不是某种鲨鱼。

meanings_zh: v. 取消；撤销 | v. 抵消
definition_en: To decide that something planned will not happen. | To balance an opposing effect so neither changes the result.
example1_en: We had to cancel our picnic because of heavy rain.
example1_zh: 由于下大雨，我们不得不取消野餐。
example2_en: Improved energy efficiency may cancel out some environmental benefits if it encourages people to consume more.
example2_zh: 如果能源效率提高促使人们增加消费，就可能抵消部分环境效益。
collocations: cancel a booking｜取消预订 ; cancel a flight｜取消航班 ; cancel out｜抵消
tip_zh: 英式过去式cancelled，美式常用canceled；抵消用out。

meanings_zh: n. 质量；品质 | n. 特质；品德 | adj. 优质的
definition_en: How good or bad something is. | A characteristic of a person or thing. | Of a high standard.
example1_en: The quality of these shoes surprised me for the price.
example1_zh: 以这个价格来说，这双鞋的质量让我感到惊喜。
example2_en: Governments should improve the quality of public transport before encouraging people to give up driving.
example2_zh: 政府应先提高公共交通的质量，再鼓励人们放弃开车。
collocations: high quality｜高质量 ; quality of life｜生活质量 ; leadership qualities｜领导才能 ; quality control｜质量控制
tip_zh: 表示质量通常不可数；表示特质时可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 国际的；跨国的 | n. 国际比赛；国家队选手
definition_en: Involving two or more countries. | A match between countries, or a player representing a country.
example1_en: My sister is taking an international flight tomorrow morning.
example1_zh: 我姐姐明天早上要乘坐国际航班。
example2_en: International cooperation is essential for tackling environmental problems that extend beyond the borders of individual countries.
example2_zh: 国际合作对于解决超越单个国家边界的环境问题至关重要。
collocations: international trade｜国际贸易 ; international cooperation｜国际合作 ; an international flight｜国际航班 ; international students｜国际学生
tip_zh: international涉及多国；domestic指国内的。

meanings_zh: n. 活动；重大事件 | n. 比赛项目
definition_en: Something that happens, especially an important or planned occasion. | A particular contest within a sports competition.
example1_en: The outdoor concert was our town's biggest summer event.
example1_zh: 这场户外音乐会是我们镇上夏季最大的活动。
example2_en: Hosting a major cultural event can boost local tourism, although the financial benefits may be unevenly distributed.
example2_zh: 举办大型文化活动可以促进当地旅游业，但经济收益的分配可能不均。
collocations: organise an event｜组织活动 ; major event｜重大事件 ; sporting event｜体育赛事 ; in the event of｜万一发生
tip_zh: in the event of后接名词，意为“万一发生”。

meanings_zh: adv. 然而；不过 | adv. 无论多么 | conj. 无论以何种方式
definition_en: Used to introduce a contrasting statement. | No matter how much or to what degree. | In any way that someone chooses.
example1_en: The jacket looked warm; however, it felt surprisingly thin.
example1_zh: 这件夹克看起来很暖和，摸起来却出奇地薄。
example2_en: Online courses offer greater flexibility; however, some learners benefit more from direct interaction with teachers.
example2_zh: 在线课程更加灵活；不过，有些学习者从与教师的直接互动中获益更多。
collocations: however difficult｜无论多困难 ; however much｜无论多少 ; however hard you try｜无论你多努力
tip_zh: 表转折时不是并列连词；勿仅用逗号连接两句。

meanings_zh: adj. 在场的；目前的 | v. 展示；提出；颁发 | n. 礼物；现在
definition_en: being in a place; existing or happening now | to show, explain or formally give something | something given to someone; the time happening now
example1_en: All the children were present for the class photo.
example1_zh: 拍班级合照时，所有孩子都在场。
example2_en: Researchers should present their findings clearly so that policymakers can make informed decisions about public health.
example2_zh: 研究人员应清楚地展示研究结果，以便政策制定者就公共卫生作出有依据的决策。
collocations: be present at｜出席 ; at present｜目前 ; present evidence｜提供证据 ; birthday present｜生日礼物
tip_zh: 名词、形容词重音在首音节；动词重音在第二音节。

meanings_zh: adj. 亚洲的；亚洲人的 | n. 亚洲人；亚裔人士
definition_en: Relating to Asia or its people. | A person from Asia or with family origins there.
example1_en: The museum displays pottery from several different Asian countries.
example1_zh: 这家博物馆展出了多个亚洲国家的陶器。
example2_en: Many Asian cities are expanding public transport networks to reduce traffic congestion and improve urban air quality.
example2_zh: 许多亚洲城市正扩建公共交通网络，以缓解交通拥堵并改善城市空气质量。
collocations: Asian countries｜亚洲国家 ; Asian cultures｜亚洲文化 ; Asian economies｜亚洲经济体
tip_zh: 首字母须大写；Asia是洲名，Asian可作形容词。

meanings_zh: n. 形状；外形 | v. 塑造；影响 | v. 使成形
definition_en: the outer form of something | to influence how something develops | to give something a particular physical form
example1_en: She cut the biscuits into the shape of stars.
example1_zh: 她把饼干坯切成了星星的形状。
example2_en: Early childhood experiences can shape attitudes towards learning and influence future educational achievement.
example2_zh: 幼年经历可以塑造学习态度，并影响未来的学业成就。
collocations: in the shape of｜呈……形状 ; take shape｜逐渐成形 ; shape attitudes｜塑造态度 ; stay in shape｜保持良好的身体状态
tip_zh: in shape可指身体状态好，不只表示形状。

meanings_zh: n. 洗手间；厕所
definition_en: a room with toilets and facilities for washing hands
example1_en: There is a washroom just beside the lifts.
example1_zh: 电梯旁边就有一间洗手间。
example2_en: Every public library should provide an accessible washroom to accommodate visitors with a range of mobility needs.
example2_zh: 每座公共图书馆都应配备无障碍洗手间，以满足行动能力各异的访客的需求。
collocations: public washroom｜公共洗手间 ; accessible washroom｜无障碍洗手间 ; washroom facilities｜卫生间设施
tip_zh: 主要用于北美，尤其加拿大；英国常说toilet。

meanings_zh: adj. 令人惊讶的；出乎意料的
definition_en: unexpected and causing a feeling of surprise
example1_en: The tiny bakery offers a surprising variety of fresh bread.
example1_zh: 这家小面包店的新鲜面包种类多得令人惊讶。
example2_en: The survey revealed a surprising decline in car ownership among young adults living in major cities.
example2_zh: 调查显示，大城市年轻人的汽车拥有率出现了出人意料的下降。
collocations: surprising results｜令人惊讶的结果 ; a surprising number of｜数量出奇多的 ; hardly surprising｜毫不奇怪的
tip_zh: surprising形容事物；surprised形容人的感受。

meanings_zh: adj. 下雪的；多雪的 | adj. 被雪覆盖的
definition_en: Having falling snow or frequent snowfall. | Covered with snow.
example1_en: We stayed indoors and baked bread on that snowy afternoon.
example1_zh: 那个下雪的下午，我们待在屋里烤面包。
example2_en: In snowy regions, reliable public transport requires regular road maintenance and vehicles designed for winter conditions.
example2_zh: 在多雪地区，可靠的公共交通需要定期道路养护和适合冬季路况的车辆。
collocations: snowy weather｜下雪的天气 ; snowy mountains｜白雪覆盖的群山 ; snowy winter｜多雪的冬季
tip_zh: snowy可描述天气，也可指地面等被雪覆盖。

meanings_zh: n. 汽水 | n. 苏打水
definition_en: a sweet fizzy drink, especially in American English | water containing dissolved gas, often mixed with other drinks
example1_en: I spilled orange soda all over the kitchen floor.
example1_zh: 我把橙味汽水洒得厨房地板上到处都是。
example2_en: Replacing sugary soda with water can help reduce daily sugar intake and support better dental health.
example2_zh: 用水代替含糖汽水有助于减少每日糖摄入，并改善牙齿健康。
collocations: a can of soda｜一罐汽水 ; soda water｜苏打水 ; sugary soda｜含糖汽水
tip_zh: 美式常指汽水；baking soda才是小苏打。

meanings_zh: pron. 任何人；有人
definition_en: Any person, or someone whose identity is not specified.
example1_en: Does anybody know where I left my blue umbrella?
example1_zh: 有人知道我把蓝色雨伞放在哪里了吗？
example2_en: Public libraries should be accessible to anybody who wishes to learn, regardless of their income or background.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆应向所有想学习的人开放，不论其收入或背景如何。
collocations: anybody else｜其他人 ; hardly anybody｜几乎没有人 ; anybody at all｜任何人
tip_zh: anybody作主语时，谓语用单数形式。

meanings_zh: n. 乒乓球运动 | v. 来回移动；反复往返
definition_en: A game hitting a light ball across a table with bats | To move or pass repeatedly back and forth
example1_en: We played ping-pong together while waiting for dinner.
example1_zh: 等晚饭时，我们一起打了乒乓球。
example2_en: Community centres can offer inexpensive activities such as ping-pong to encourage social interaction among older residents.
example2_zh: 社区中心可以提供乒乓球等花费不高的活动，鼓励老年居民进行社交。
collocations: play ping-pong｜打乒乓球 ; ping-pong table｜乒乓球台 ; ping-pong ball｜乒乓球 ; ping-pong bat｜乒乓球拍
tip_zh: 较口语化；正式比赛和写作常用table tennis。

meanings_zh: n. 租金 | v. 租用；租借 | v. 出租
definition_en: money paid regularly to use someone else's property | to pay to use something owned by someone else | to let someone use your property in exchange for payment
example1_en: My monthly rent includes water but not electricity.
example1_zh: 我每月的租金包含水费，但不含电费。
example2_en: Rising rents in urban areas can force essential workers to live further from their workplaces.
example2_zh: 城市地区租金上涨可能迫使提供基本服务的劳动者住得离工作地点更远。
collocations: pay rent｜付租金 ; rent a flat｜租公寓 ; rent out a room｜出租房间 ; monthly rent｜月租
tip_zh: rent可指租入或出租；rent out明确表示出租。

meanings_zh: n. 侄子；外甥
definition_en: A son of your sibling or your spouse's sibling.
example1_en: My nephew proudly showed me his new bicycle.
example1_zh: 我的侄子自豪地给我看他的新自行车。
example2_en: Looking after a nephew or niece can help young adults understand the responsibilities of raising children.
example2_zh: 照顾侄子或侄女可以帮助年轻人理解养育孩子的责任。
collocations: young nephew｜年幼的侄子或外甥 ; nieces and nephews｜侄甥辈孩子
tip_zh: nephew 指男性晚辈；女性对应词是 niece。

meanings_zh: v. 打架；战斗 | v. 抗争；努力争取 | n. 打斗；斗争
definition_en: To use physical force against another person or group. | To try hard to stop something or achieve a goal. | An occasion of physical conflict or a determined effort against something.
example1_en: The two cats fought over a sunny window seat.
example1_zh: 两只猫为了窗边一个有阳光的位置打了起来。
example2_en: Governments should fight poverty by improving access to education, healthcare, and stable employment opportunities.
example2_zh: 政府应通过改善教育和医疗服务的可及性、增加稳定就业机会来消除贫困。
collocations: fight poverty｜与贫困作斗争 ; fight for equality｜争取平等 ; fight against discrimination｜反对歧视 ; get into a fight｜卷入打斗
tip_zh: 过去式、过去分词均为fought；fight for表示争取。

meanings_zh: adv. 极其；非常
definition_en: To a very great degree.
example1_en: The soup was extremely hot, so I waited.
example1_zh: 汤烫极了，所以我等了一会儿。
example2_en: Access to reliable internet is extremely important for students who depend on online learning.
example2_zh: 对于依赖在线学习的学生来说，能够使用可靠的网络极其重要。
collocations: extremely important｜极其重要 ; extremely difficult｜极其困难 ; extremely useful｜极其有用
tip_zh: 修饰可分程度的形容词或副词，语气强于very。

meanings_zh: n. 滑板运动
definition_en: the activity of riding and performing tricks on a skateboard
example1_en: We went skateboarding at the park after lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭后，我们去公园玩滑板了。
example2_en: Dedicated skateboarding facilities give young people safe spaces to exercise and develop their balance and coordination.
example2_zh: 专用滑板设施为年轻人提供了安全的锻炼空间，帮助他们提高平衡感和协调能力。
collocations: go skateboarding｜去玩滑板 ; skateboarding skills｜滑板技巧 ; skateboarding facilities｜滑板运动设施
tip_zh: 运动用skateboarding；滑板这件器材用skateboard。

meanings_zh: n. 生菜；莴苣
definition_en: a vegetable with leaves often eaten raw in salads
example1_en: Wash the lettuce before adding it to your sandwich.
example1_zh: 把生菜洗净后再夹进三明治里。
example2_en: Growing lettuce in urban gardens can give residents access to fresh food near their homes.
example2_zh: 在城市菜园种植生菜能让居民在家附近获得新鲜食材。
collocations: lettuce leaves｜生菜叶 ; a head of lettuce｜一棵生菜 ; crisp lettuce｜脆嫩的生菜
tip_zh: 指食材通常不可数；一棵生菜用a head of lettuce。

meanings_zh: adj. 丑陋的；难看的 | adj. 令人不快的；险恶的
definition_en: Unpleasant to look at. | Unpleasant or threatening, especially involving anger or conflict.
example1_en: We hid the ugly pipes behind a wooden screen.
example1_zh: 我们用木制屏风遮住了那些难看的管道。
example2_en: Poorly planned developments can create ugly urban landscapes that reduce residents' satisfaction with their neighbourhoods.
example2_zh: 规划不善的开发项目可能形成难看的城市景观，降低居民对社区的满意度。
collocations: ugly building｜难看的建筑 ; ugly sight｜不堪入目的景象 ; turn ugly｜变得险恶 ; ugly confrontation｜激烈冲突
tip_zh: 比较级uglier，最高级ugliest；形容人外貌不礼貌。

meanings_zh: n. 成功；成就 | n. 成功的人或事物
definition_en: the achievement of an aim or a desired result | a person or thing that achieves a good result
example1_en: The school concert was a success despite the rain.
example1_zh: 尽管下了雨，学校音乐会还是很成功。
example2_en: Long-term success in education depends not only on funding but also on the quality of teaching.
example2_zh: 教育的长期成功不仅取决于资金投入，也取决于教学质量。
collocations: achieve success｜取得成功 ; a great success｜巨大的成功 ; the key to success｜成功的关键 ; success rate｜成功率
tip_zh: 泛指成功时不可数；a success指成功的人或事。

meanings_zh: n. 套头毛衣（英） | n. 跳跃者；跳高或跳远运动员 | n. 无袖连衣裙（美）
definition_en: A knitted piece of clothing covering the upper body. | A person or animal that jumps, especially in sport. | A sleeveless dress worn over a shirt or blouse.
example1_en: I packed a warm jumper for the camping trip.
example1_zh: 我为这次露营带了一件暖和的套头毛衣。
example2_en: Wearing a jumper indoors can reduce the need for heating during colder months.
example2_zh: 在寒冷的月份，室内穿毛衣可以减少供暖需求。
collocations: woollen jumper｜羊毛套头衫 ; put on a jumper｜穿上套头毛衣 ; high jumper｜跳高运动员
tip_zh: 英式英语指套头毛衣；美式通常用sweater。

meanings_zh: n. 一段时间；时期 | n. 课时；一节课 | n. 月经；经期
definition_en: A length of time or a stage in history. | A scheduled length of time for a school lesson. | The monthly flow of blood from the uterus.
example1_en: We stayed indoors during a short period of heavy rain.
example1_zh: 在那阵短暂的大雨期间，我们一直待在室内。
example2_en: A prolonged period of unemployment can affect both financial security and mental health.
example2_zh: 长期失业既会影响经济保障，也会影响心理健康。
collocations: a period of time｜一段时间 ; a transition period｜过渡期 ; a historical period｜历史时期 ; a heavy period｜月经量多
tip_zh: 表示一段时间常用a period of；美式英语也指句号。

meanings_zh: n. 床单 | n. 一张；薄片
definition_en: A large piece of cloth used to cover a bed. | A thin, flat piece of paper, metal, or another material.
example1_en: I spread a clean sheet over the mattress.
example1_zh: 我在床垫上铺了一条干净的床单。
example2_en: Schools can reduce paper waste by encouraging students to use both sides of each sheet.
example2_zh: 学校可以鼓励学生使用每张纸的正反两面，以减少纸张浪费。
collocations: bed sheet｜床单 ; a sheet of paper｜一张纸 ; a sheet of glass｜一块玻璃 ; sheet metal｜金属薄板
tip_zh: sheet是可数名词；一张纸说a sheet of paper。

meanings_zh: n. 升（容量单位）
definition_en: A unit of volume equal to one thousand milliliters.
example1_en: This bottle holds exactly one liter of fresh milk.
example1_zh: 这个瓶子正好能装一升鲜奶。
example2_en: Measuring household water consumption by the liter can help residents understand how much they use each day.
example2_zh: 以升为单位测量家庭用水量，可以帮助居民了解自己每天用了多少水。
collocations: a liter of water｜一升水 ; per liter｜每升 ; half a liter｜半升
tip_zh: liter是美式拼写，英式为litre；一升等于一千毫升。

meanings_zh: v. 躺；平放 | v. 说谎 | n. 谎言
definition_en: Rest with your body or an object in a flat position | Say something you know is not true | Something untrue that someone says deliberately
example1_en: I like to lie on the grass after lunch.
example1_zh: 我喜欢午饭后躺在草地上。
example2_en: Advertisements that lie about environmental benefits can undermine public trust and discourage genuinely sustainable purchasing decisions.
example2_zh: 就环保效益撒谎的广告会损害公众信任，并阻碍真正可持续的购买决策。
collocations: lie down｜躺下 ; lie awake｜躺着睡不着 ; lie to someone｜对某人说谎 ; tell a lie｜说谎
tip_zh: 躺：lie–lay–lain；说谎：lie–lied–lied。

meanings_zh: n. 塔；塔楼 | v. 高耸；远高于
definition_en: a tall, narrow structure, standing alone or on a building | rise much higher than nearby people or things
example1_en: We climbed the tower and watched boats cross the bay.
example1_zh: 我们爬上塔，看着船只驶过海湾。
example2_en: The historic tower attracts visitors throughout the year, providing valuable income for nearby shops and restaurants.
example2_zh: 这座历史悠久的塔全年吸引着游客，为附近的商店和餐馆带来可观收入。
collocations: a clock tower｜钟楼 ; a watch tower｜瞭望塔 ; tower above｜高耸于……之上 ; tower over｜远高于
tip_zh: 作动词常接over或above，表示远高于周围事物。

meanings_zh: adj. 愚蠢的；欠考虑的
definition_en: Showing poor judgment or a lack of sensible thought.
example1_en: It was stupid to leave my umbrella at home.
example1_zh: 把伞留在家里真是太傻了。
example2_en: Calling students stupid can damage their confidence and discourage them from asking questions in class.
example2_zh: 说学生愚蠢会损害他们的信心，使他们不敢在课堂上提问。
collocations: a stupid mistake｜愚蠢的错误 ; a stupid idea｜愚蠢的主意 ; feel stupid｜觉得自己很傻
tip_zh: 直接说别人stupid带侮辱性，评价人时应避免。

meanings_zh: adv. 曾经；在任何时候 | adv. 始终；不断地 | adv. 究竟；到底
definition_en: At any time, especially in questions and negative statements. | Continuously or always, often describing an ongoing change. | Used to emphasize surprise in a question.
example1_en: Have you ever watched the sunrise from a mountain?
example1_zh: 你曾经在山上看过日出吗？
example2_en: Public transport is more important than ever as growing cities struggle with congestion and air pollution.
example2_zh: 随着不断扩张的城市面临交通拥堵和空气污染，公共交通比以往任何时候都更重要。
collocations: ever since｜自从……以来一直 ; hardly ever｜几乎从不 ; more than ever｜比以往任何时候都更 ; ever-growing demand｜不断增长的需求
tip_zh: 问经历常用Have you ever…；肯定句不随意代替always。

meanings_zh: n. 幸福；快乐
definition_en: The feeling of being pleased or satisfied with life.
example1_en: Her face shone with happiness when the puppy arrived.
example1_zh: 小狗到来时，她的脸上洋溢着喜悦。
example2_en: Strong social connections often contribute more to lasting happiness than the purchase of expensive possessions.
example2_zh: 与购买昂贵物品相比，牢固的社会联系往往更能带来持久的幸福。
collocations: lasting happiness｜持久的幸福 ; personal happiness｜个人幸福 ; bring happiness｜带来快乐 ; a sense of happiness｜幸福感
tip_zh: 通常不可数：表达幸福用happiness，不加a。

meanings_zh: n. 孙女；外孙女
definition_en: The daughter of someone's son or daughter
example1_en: Her granddaughter brought fresh flowers when she visited on Sunday.
example1_zh: 她的孙女星期天来看她时带来了鲜花。
example2_en: Regular contact with a granddaughter or grandson can help older adults feel more connected to family life.
example2_zh: 经常与孙辈联系，可以帮助老年人更好地融入家庭生活。
collocations: youngest granddaughter｜最小的孙女或外孙女 ; granddaughter's birthday｜孙女或外孙女的生日
tip_zh: 既指孙女也指外孙女，英语不区分父系与母系。

meanings_zh: n. 乘客；旅客
definition_en: Someone travelling in a vehicle without driving or operating it
example1_en: A passenger left a blue umbrella on the bus.
example1_zh: 一位乘客把一把蓝色雨伞落在了公交车上。
example2_en: Improved rail services could increase passenger numbers and reduce reliance on private cars.
example2_zh: 改善铁路服务可以增加乘客数量，减少人们对私家车的依赖。
collocations: passenger train｜客运列车 ; passenger seat｜乘客座位 ; passenger numbers｜乘客数量
tip_zh: 指乘坐交通工具的人，不包括驾驶员或机组人员。

meanings_zh: n. 文章；报道 | n. 物品；一件东西 | n. 冠词
definition_en: A piece of writing in a newspaper, magazine, or website. | A single item, especially one belonging to a particular group. | A word such as a, an, or the before a noun.
example1_en: I read an interesting article about growing tomatoes indoors.
example1_zh: 我读了一篇关于室内种植番茄的有趣文章。
example2_en: The article examines how access to green spaces influences mental health in densely populated cities.
example2_zh: 这篇文章探讨了在密集人口城市中，绿地的可及性如何影响心理健康。
collocations: a newspaper article｜报纸文章 ; write an article｜写文章 ; an article of clothing｜一件衣物 ; the definite article｜定冠词
tip_zh: 一件衣物可说an article of clothing。

meanings_zh: n. 网站主页
definition_en: The main page of a website, linking to other sections.
example1_en: The library's homepage has a photo of its new reading room.
example1_zh: 图书馆主页上有一张新阅览室的照片。
example2_en: A university homepage should provide clear access to course information, application guidance, and support services for international students.
example2_zh: 大学主页应提供清晰的入口，方便国际学生查看课程信息、申请指南及支持服务。
collocations: website homepage｜网站主页 ; homepage design｜主页设计 ; visit the homepage｜访问主页
tip_zh: 也可写作home page；不等于网站中的任意网页。

meanings_zh: adv. 百分之……
definition_en: For every hundred, used when expressing a proportion.
example1_en: I saved twenty percent on my new winter coat.
example1_zh: 我买新冬衣时省了百分之二十的钱。
example2_en: Nearly forty percent of surveyed residents supported investing more public money in cycling infrastructure.
example2_zh: 近百分之四十的受访居民支持将更多公共资金投入自行车基础设施。
collocations: ten percent of｜百分之十的 ; a five percent increase｜百分之五的增长 ; one hundred percent｜百分之百
tip_zh: 英式也写per cent；具体比例用percent。

meanings_zh: n. 十三至十九岁青少年
definition_en: A person aged thirteen to nineteen.
example1_en: As a teenager, I cycled to school every day.
example1_zh: 我十几岁时每天骑自行车上学。
example2_en: Schools should provide spaces where teenagers can discuss their concerns and receive support from trained staff.
example2_zh: 学校应提供场所，让青少年能够讨论自己的困扰，并获得受过培训的工作人员的支持。
collocations: a young teenager｜十三四岁的青少年 ; as a teenager｜在青少年时期 ; teenagers' needs｜青少年的需求
tip_zh: 特指13至19岁的人，不泛指所有未成年人。

meanings_zh: n. 方向；发展趋势 | n. 路线指引；使用说明 | n. 指导；管理
definition_en: the way something points, moves, or develops | instructions explaining how to reach somewhere or do something | the control or guidance of an activity or group
example1_en: The dog suddenly ran in the opposite direction.
example1_zh: 那只狗突然朝相反的方向跑去。
example2_en: Government investment can influence the direction of technological development by supporting research into cleaner energy sources.
example2_zh: 政府投资可以通过支持清洁能源研究来影响技术发展的方向。
collocations: in the opposite direction｜朝相反方向 ; ask for directions｜问路 ; follow the directions｜遵照说明 ; under the direction of｜在……的指导下
tip_zh: 表示路线指引或操作说明时，通常用复数directions。

meanings_zh: adv. 代替；反而
definition_en: in place of someone or something else
example1_en: The café was closed, so we went home instead.
example1_zh: 咖啡馆关门了，于是我们改为回家。
example2_en: Instead of expanding roads, cities should invest in public transport to reduce congestion and pollution.
example2_zh: 城市应投资公共交通，而不是拓宽道路，以减少拥堵和污染。
collocations: instead of｜而不是；代替 ; go instead｜改为去 ; use something instead｜改用某物
tip_zh: instead可单独作副词；instead of后接名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 令人惊叹的；极好的
definition_en: Causing great surprise or admiration.
example1_en: The view from the mountain was absolutely amazing.
example1_zh: 从山上望去的景色真是令人惊叹。
example2_en: Recent medical research has produced amazing results, offering new hope to patients with previously untreatable conditions.
example2_zh: 近期医学研究取得了惊人的成果，为患有过去无法治疗的疾病的患者带来了新希望。
collocations: absolutely amazing｜极其精彩的 ; amazing results｜惊人的成果 ; an amazing experience｜一次奇妙的经历
tip_zh: amazing形容令人惊叹的事物；amazed形容人的感受。

meanings_zh: n. 家庭主妇
definition_en: A married woman managing her home rather than doing paid work.
example1_en: As a housewife, she manages a busy household.
example1_zh: 作为家庭主妇，她操持着一个忙碌家庭的日常事务。
example2_en: The unpaid work of a housewife contributes to family welfare but is often excluded from economic statistics.
example2_zh: 家庭主妇的无偿劳动有助于家庭福祉，却往往不被纳入经济统计。
collocations: a full-time housewife｜全职家庭主妇 ; work as a housewife｜做家庭主妇
tip_zh: 复数为housewives；homemaker不限定性别。

meanings_zh: n. 所有者；物主
definition_en: A person or organisation that something belongs to.
example1_en: The owner of the bakery greets us every morning.
example1_zh: 面包店老板每天早上都向我们打招呼。
example2_en: Property owners should maintain their buildings to ensure the safety of tenants and nearby residents.
example2_zh: 房产业主应维护其建筑，确保租户和附近居民的安全。
collocations: business owner｜企业主 ; property owner｜房产业主 ; rightful owner｜合法所有者
tip_zh: 表示某物的所有者，用the owner of加名词。

meanings_zh: n. 盘；碟 | n. 一道菜；菜肴 | n. 餐具（复数）
definition_en: A container used for serving or cooking food. | Food prepared in a particular way as part of a meal. | Plates, bowls, and other utensils used for meals.
example1_en: Please put the strawberries in that blue dish.
example1_zh: 请把草莓放进那个蓝色盘子里。
example2_en: Traditional dishes can attract international tourists while helping local communities preserve their distinctive food culture.
example2_zh: 传统菜肴既能吸引国际游客，也能帮助当地社区保留独特的饮食文化。
collocations: serving dish｜上菜用的盘子 ; traditional dish｜传统菜肴 ; do the dishes｜洗餐具 ; main dish｜主菜
tip_zh: a dish可指一道菜；do the dishes指洗餐具。

meanings_zh: adv. 相当；颇 | adv. 完全；十分
definition_en: To a fairly large degree, but not extremely. | Completely or to the greatest possible degree.
example1_en: The soup is quite spicy, but I like it.
example1_zh: 这汤挺辣的，不过我喜欢。
example2_en: Although cycling is quite popular among students, inadequate infrastructure prevents many commuters from choosing this sustainable option.
example2_zh: 虽然骑行在学生中颇受欢迎，但基础设施不足使许多通勤者无法选择这种可持续的出行方式。
collocations: quite good｜相当不错 ; quite a few｜相当多 ; quite different｜完全不同 ; not quite｜不完全；还差一点
tip_zh: quite good常指相当好；quite impossible指完全不可能。

meanings_zh: n. 克
definition_en: A unit of mass equal to one thousandth of a kilogram.
example1_en: Add one gram of salt and stir the soup.
example1_zh: 加入一克盐，然后搅拌汤。
example2_en: Comparing the nutrients provided per gram can help consumers make more informed choices about packaged foods.
example2_zh: 比较每克食物所含的营养成分，有助于消费者更明智地选择包装食品。
collocations: a gram of salt｜一克盐 ; per gram｜每克 ; weigh in grams｜以克为单位称重
tip_zh: 符号为g；复数为grams；一千克等于一千克中的一千克？

meanings_zh: n. 曲奇饼；小甜饼 | n. 网站存于设备的小型数据
definition_en: A small, flat, sweet baked food | A small piece of data a website stores on your device
example1_en: There is one chocolate cookie left in the jar.
example1_zh: 罐子里还剩一块巧克力曲奇。
example2_en: Websites often use cookies to remember user preferences, but some also track browsing behaviour.
example2_zh: 网站常用cookie记住用户偏好，但有些也会追踪浏览行为。
collocations: chocolate chip cookie｜巧克力豆曲奇 ; cookie jar｜饼干罐 ; accept cookies｜接受网站cookie ; delete cookies｜删除网站cookie
tip_zh: 美式泛指小甜饼；网站cookie不等同于缓存文件。

meanings_zh: adj. 找不到的；失踪的 | adj. 缺少的；缺失的
definition_en: lost or absent, with whereabouts unknown | not present where something should be
example1_en: We found the missing kitten asleep behind the sofa.
example1_zh: 我们发现那只找不到的小猫正在沙发后面睡觉。
example2_en: Missing data can undermine the reliability of research findings and lead policymakers to draw inaccurate conclusions.
example2_zh: 数据缺失会削弱研究结果的可靠性，并导致政策制定者得出不准确的结论。
collocations: go missing｜失踪；不见 ; a missing person｜失踪者 ; missing data｜缺失数据 ; a missing piece｜缺失的一块
tip_zh: missing作形容词表不见或缺失；be missing from表缺少。

meanings_zh: adj. 左侧的；左手边的
definition_en: Located on the left side.
example1_en: Keep your ticket in the left-hand pocket of your jacket.
example1_zh: 把票放在夹克左侧的口袋里。
example2_en: Separating cyclists from vehicles in the left-hand lane could make this busy road safer for everyone.
example2_zh: 将骑行者与左侧车道的车辆隔开，可以让这条繁忙道路对所有人都更安全。
collocations: the left-hand side｜左侧 ; the left-hand corner｜左边的角落 ; the left-hand lane｜左侧车道
tip_zh: left-hand指左侧；left-handed指惯用左手的。

meanings_zh: n. 口袋 | v. 把…放入口袋；私吞 | adj. 袖珍的
definition_en: A small bag sewn into clothing for carrying things. | To put something in your pocket, or take money dishonestly. | Small enough to fit easily inside a pocket.
example1_en: I found my missing key in my coat pocket.
example1_zh: 我在外套口袋里找到了丢失的钥匙。
example2_en: Pocket dictionaries remain useful for language learners when internet access is unavailable or unreliable.
example2_zh: 当无法上网或网络不稳定时，袖珍词典对语言学习者仍然很有用。
collocations: coat pocket｜外套口袋 ; pocket money｜零花钱 ; out of pocket｜自掏腰包的；亏钱的 ; pocket dictionary｜袖珍词典
tip_zh: pocket money指零花钱，英式英语中常用。

meanings_zh: adj. 总的；完全的 | n. 总数；总额 | v. 总计达；合计
definition_en: including everything, or complete in degree | the amount obtained by adding everything together | to reach a particular amount or add amounts together
example1_en: The total cost includes breakfast and a bus ticket.
example1_zh: 总费用包含早餐和一张公交车票。
example2_en: Improving home insulation can reduce total energy consumption while making housing more comfortable throughout the year.
example2_zh: 改善住宅隔热性能可以减少能源总消耗，同时让住房全年都更加舒适。
collocations: total cost｜总费用 ; in total｜总共 ; a total of｜总计…… ; total energy consumption｜能源总消耗
tip_zh: in total表示“总共”；totally常表示“完全地”。

meanings_zh: n. 士兵；军人
definition_en: a person who serves in an army
example1_en: The soldier helped carry supplies across the flooded road.
example1_zh: 那名士兵帮忙把物资运过被洪水淹没的道路。
example2_en: Soldiers can support emergency services by delivering food and rescuing residents after major natural disasters.
example2_zh: 重大自然灾害发生后，军人可以通过运送食物和救助居民来支援应急部门。
collocations: serve as a soldier｜当兵服役 ; professional soldier｜职业军人 ; train soldiers｜训练士兵
tip_zh: 通常指陆军军人；水手和飞行员另有专称。

meanings_zh: n. 饼干（英式用法） | n. 松软小圆面包（美式）
definition_en: a small, flat, crisp baked food, often sweet | a small, soft bread roll raised without yeast
example1_en: She dipped a biscuit into her warm tea.
example1_zh: 她把一块饼干浸进温热的茶里。
example2_en: Replacing sugary biscuits with fresh fruit can help children develop healthier eating habits over time.
example2_zh: 用新鲜水果代替高糖饼干，可以帮助儿童逐渐养成更健康的饮食习惯。
collocations: chocolate biscuit｜巧克力饼干 ; a packet of biscuits｜一包饼干 ; biscuit tin｜饼干盒
tip_zh: 英式biscuit通常对应美式cookie；美式另指松软面包。

meanings_zh: adj. 非洲的；非洲人的 | n. 非洲人
definition_en: relating to Africa or its people | a person from Africa
example1_en: We spotted several African elephants beside a muddy waterhole.
example1_zh: 我们在一个泥泞的水塘边发现了几头非洲象。
example2_en: Many African countries are investing in solar energy to improve electricity access in remote rural communities.
example2_zh: 许多非洲国家正投资太阳能，以改善偏远农村社区的电力供应。
collocations: African countries｜非洲国家 ; African wildlife｜非洲野生动物 ; African languages｜非洲语言
tip_zh: 首字母须大写；表示来自非洲，不限定肤色。

meanings_zh: n. 画廊；美术馆 | n. 楼座；旁听席 | n. 图片集；图库
definition_en: A room or building where artworks are displayed or sold. | A raised seating area overlooking a hall or theatre. | A collection of images available to view, especially online.
example1_en: We spent a rainy afternoon exploring the local gallery.
example1_zh: 一个下雨的下午，我们逛了当地的美术馆。
example2_en: Free entry to a public gallery can make visual art accessible to people from different economic backgrounds.
example2_zh: 公共美术馆免费开放，可以让不同经济背景的人都有机会接触视觉艺术。
collocations: art gallery｜美术馆；画廊 ; public gallery｜公共美术馆；旁听席 ; photo gallery｜图片集
tip_zh: gallery主要展示艺术品；museum涵盖的展品范围更广。

meanings_zh: n. 脂肪；食用油脂 | adj. 肥胖的；肥的
definition_en: a substance stored in bodies or used in cooking | having a large amount of body fat
example1_en: Let the soup cool, then remove the fat.
example1_zh: 让汤凉下来，再撇去油脂。
example2_en: Although the body needs some fat, excessive consumption can increase the risk of certain health problems.
example2_zh: 虽然人体需要一定的脂肪，但摄入过多会增加某些健康问题的风险。
collocations: body fat｜体脂 ; saturated fat｜饱和脂肪 ; low in fat｜脂肪含量低
tip_zh: 用fat形容人可能冒犯；谈健康宜用overweight。

meanings_zh: n. 出售；销售 | n. 降价促销 | n. 销售额；销量
definition_en: the act of exchanging something for money | a period when a shop sells goods at reduced prices | the amount sold or money earned from selling goods
example1_en: I bought these boots in the winter sale.
example1_zh: 我在冬季促销时买了这双靴子。
example2_en: The sale of locally produced food can support farmers while reducing emissions associated with long-distance transport.
example2_zh: 销售本地生产的食品既能支持农民，也能减少长途运输带来的排放。
collocations: for sale｜待售 ; on sale｜出售中；降价出售 ; sales figures｜销售数据 ; a clearance sale｜清仓促销
tip_zh: for sale指待售；销售额或销量通常用复数sales。

meanings_zh: n. 滑雪运动
definition_en: The activity of moving over snow on skis.
example1_en: We went skiing together during our winter holiday.
example1_zh: 寒假期间，我们一起去滑雪了。
example2_en: Skiing attracts winter tourists to mountain regions, creating seasonal jobs but increasing demand for water.
example2_zh: 滑雪吸引冬季游客前往山区，创造了季节性工作，但也增加了用水需求。
collocations: go skiing｜去滑雪 ; cross-country skiing｜越野滑雪 ; downhill skiing｜高山速降滑雪 ; skiing lessons｜滑雪课程
tip_zh: 滑雪用go skiing；滑水需说water skiing。

meanings_zh: n. 密码；口令
definition_en: A secret word or sequence used to gain access.
example1_en: I forgot my password and couldn't open my account.
example1_zh: 我忘了密码，无法登录账户。
example2_en: Using a different password for each account can reduce the risk of personal information being stolen.
example2_zh: 为每个账户设置不同的密码，可以降低个人信息被盗的风险。
collocations: a strong password｜安全性高的密码 ; reset a password｜重置密码 ; enter a password｜输入密码 ; password protection｜密码保护
tip_zh: password是密码；passcode也可指数字口令。

meanings_zh: n. 邮筒；邮政信箱
definition_en: A public box where people put mail to be collected.
example1_en: I dropped the birthday card into the postbox outside.
example1_zh: 我把生日贺卡投进了外面的邮筒。
example2_en: Keeping a postbox within walking distance helps residents without internet access maintain contact with essential services.
example2_zh: 在步行可达的范围内保留邮筒，有助于无法上网的居民与基本服务机构保持联系。
collocations: nearest postbox｜最近的邮筒 ; put something in a postbox｜把某物投入邮筒
tip_zh: 英式英语指公共寄信邮筒；美式通常用mailbox。

meanings_zh: n. 结尾；结局 | n. 词尾
definition_en: the final part of a story, event, or activity | a final word part that often shows grammatical information
example1_en: The film had a surprisingly cheerful ending for everyone.
example1_zh: 这部电影的结局出人意料，所有人都皆大欢喜。
example2_en: An ambiguous ending can encourage readers to question their assumptions and consider alternative interpretations of a novel.
example2_zh: 含义不明确的结局可以促使读者质疑自己的假设，并考虑对小说的其他解读。
collocations: a happy ending｜圆满结局 ; a surprise ending｜出人意料的结局 ; a verb ending｜动词词尾
tip_zh: 故事结局用ending；at the end表示在末尾。

meanings_zh: v. 支持；帮助；供养 | v. 支撑；承托 | n. 支持；援助；支撑
definition_en: to help, encourage, provide for, or agree with someone | to hold something up or bear its weight | help, encouragement, money, or something that holds another thing up
example1_en: My sister supports me whenever I try something new.
example1_zh: 每当我尝试新事物时，姐姐都会支持我。
example2_en: Governments should provide financial support for small businesses that create jobs in economically disadvantaged communities.
example2_zh: 政府应为在经济困难社区创造就业机会的小企业提供资金支持。
collocations: financial support｜资金支持 ; support a family｜养家 ; support an argument｜为论点提供依据 ; emotional support｜情感支持
tip_zh: support是及物动词；名词常用support for。

meanings_zh: n. 直升机
definition_en: An aircraft with rotating blades that can rise straight upwards.
example1_en: A helicopter landed in the field behind our house.
example1_zh: 一架直升机降落在我们屋后的田野里。
example2_en: A rescue helicopter can reach isolated communities when floods make roads unsafe for emergency vehicles.
example2_zh: 当洪水使道路无法供救援车辆安全通行时，救援直升机可以抵达被困的偏远社区。
collocations: rescue helicopter｜救援直升机 ; helicopter pilot｜直升机驾驶员 ; by helicopter｜乘直升机
tip_zh: 乘直升机用by helicopter，中间不加冠词。

meanings_zh: adj. 凌乱的；不整洁的 | adj. 不爱收拾的
definition_en: not neat or well arranged | not keeping your belongings or surroundings neat
example1_en: Her untidy desk was covered with cups and notebooks.
example1_zh: 她凌乱的书桌上堆满了杯子和笔记本。
example2_en: Shared workspaces can quickly become untidy unless employees take responsibility for keeping communal areas clean and organised.
example2_zh: 如果员工不主动保持公共区域干净有序，共享办公空间很快就会变得凌乱。
collocations: an untidy room｜凌乱的房间 ; an untidy desk｜杂乱的书桌 ; untidy handwriting｜潦草的字迹
tip_zh: untidy强调不整齐，不一定像dirty那样有污垢。

meanings_zh: n. 足球运动
definition_en: A game where two teams kick a ball into goals.
example1_en: We play soccer in the park every Saturday morning.
example1_zh: 我们每周六早上都在公园踢足球。
example2_en: Community soccer clubs provide affordable exercise and help young people develop teamwork skills outside the classroom.
example2_zh: 社区足球俱乐部提供费用低廉的锻炼机会，帮助年轻人在课堂之外培养团队协作能力。
collocations: play soccer｜踢足球 ; soccer team｜足球队 ; soccer field｜足球场 ; soccer match｜足球比赛
tip_zh: 英式英语通常称football，美式称soccer。

meanings_zh: n. 靴子 | n. 汽车后备箱 | v. 启动电脑
definition_en: footwear that covers the foot and part of the leg | the enclosed storage space at the back of a car | to start a computer and load its operating system
example1_en: My boots kept my feet dry in the rain.
example1_zh: 我的靴子让双脚在雨中保持干爽。
example2_en: Protective boots are essential for construction workers because they reduce the risk of serious foot injuries.
example2_zh: 防护靴对建筑工人至关重要，因为它们能降低脚部严重受伤的风险。
collocations: a pair of boots｜一双靴子 ; walking boots｜徒步靴 ; car boot｜汽车后备箱 ; boot up a computer｜启动电脑
tip_zh: 汽车后备箱英式说boot，美式说trunk。

meanings_zh: n. 戒指；环状物 | v. 响铃；使响铃 | v. 打电话给
definition_en: a circular band, especially one worn on a finger | to make a bell sound or cause one to sound | to contact someone by telephone
example1_en: She slipped the silver ring onto her finger.
example1_zh: 她把那枚银戒指戴在了手指上。
example2_en: Passengers should silence their phones because devices that ring repeatedly can disturb others on public transport.
example2_zh: 乘客应将手机调至静音，因为设备反复响铃会打扰公共交通工具上的其他人。
collocations: a wedding ring｜结婚戒指 ; ring the doorbell｜按门铃 ; give someone a ring｜给某人打电话 ; a ring of trees｜一圈树
tip_zh: 响铃、打电话的过去式为rang，过去分词为rung。

meanings_zh: n. 供暖；暖气系统 | n. 加热
definition_en: The system or process that keeps a building warm. | The process of making something warmer.
example1_en: We turned the heating on when the evening grew chilly.
example1_zh: 傍晚天凉起来时，我们打开了暖气。
example2_en: Improving home insulation can reduce heating costs and lower the environmental impact of household energy consumption.
example2_zh: 改善住宅保温可以降低供暖费用，并减轻家庭能源消耗对环境的影响。
collocations: central heating｜中央供暖 ; underfloor heating｜地板供暖 ; heating bills｜供暖账单 ; heating system｜供暖系统
tip_zh: 指供暖时通常不可数：turn on the heating。

meanings_zh: n. 烟；烟雾 | v. 吸烟 | v. 冒烟
definition_en: a mixture of gases and particles produced when something burns | to breathe in smoke from burning tobacco | to produce smoke
example1_en: Dark smoke rose from the toast in the kitchen.
example1_zh: 厨房里的吐司冒出了黑烟。
example2_en: Smoke from forest fires can reduce air quality in cities hundreds of kilometres away.
example2_zh: 森林火灾产生的烟雾会降低数百公里外城市的空气质量。
collocations: thick smoke｜浓烟 ; smoke alarm｜烟雾报警器 ; smoke cigarettes｜吸香烟 ; give off smoke｜冒烟
tip_zh: smoke作“烟雾”通常不可数；smoky意为烟雾弥漫的。

meanings_zh: n. 录音；录像 | n. 录制；记录
definition_en: sound or moving images saved for later listening or viewing | the process of saving sounds, images, or information
example1_en: We listened to a recording of birds during breakfast.
example1_zh: 早餐时，我们听了一段鸟鸣录音。
example2_en: Access to a lecture recording allows students to review difficult concepts at their own pace.
example2_zh: 能够获取讲座录像，让学生可以按自己的节奏复习难懂的概念。
collocations: make a recording｜录音；录像 ; recording studio｜录音棚 ; audio recording｜音频录音 ; accurate recording｜准确记录
tip_zh: 一段录音可数；表示录制过程时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 禁止吸烟的 | adj. 不吸烟的
definition_en: describing a place where smoking is not allowed | describing someone who does not smoke
example1_en: We asked for a non-smoking room at reception.
example1_zh: 我们在前台要求安排一间无烟客房。
example2_en: Non-smoking areas in public buildings help protect visitors and employees from exposure to tobacco smoke.
example2_zh: 公共建筑内的禁烟区域有助于保护访客和员工免受烟草烟雾的影响。
collocations: non-smoking room｜无烟客房 ; non-smoking area｜禁烟区 ; non-smoking household｜无人吸烟的家庭
tip_zh: 可指场所禁烟，也可指人不吸烟。

meanings_zh: n. 邮政编码
definition_en: a code identifying a postal delivery area
example1_en: Please include your postcode when you fill in the form.
example1_zh: 填写表格时，请填上你的邮政编码。
example2_en: Researchers used postcode data to compare access to public transport across different residential areas.
example2_zh: 研究人员利用邮政编码数据，比较不同住宅区的公共交通便利程度。
collocations: enter a postcode｜输入邮政编码 ; postcode area｜邮编区域 ; postcode search｜邮编查询
tip_zh: 英式常用postcode；美式常用ZIP code。

meanings_zh: adj. 金发的；浅金色的 | n. 金发女子
definition_en: Having pale yellow hair, or describing this hair colour. | A woman or girl with pale yellow hair.
example1_en: Her blonde hair shone brightly in the afternoon sun.
example1_zh: 她的金发在午后的阳光下闪闪发亮。
example2_en: Films that repeatedly associate blonde hair with particular personalities can reinforce unfair stereotypes about appearance.
example2_zh: 电影若反复将金发与特定性格联系起来，可能会强化对外貌的不公平刻板印象。
collocations: blonde hair｜金发 ; naturally blonde｜天生金发的 ; platinum blonde｜浅银金色的
tip_zh: blonde多用于女性；描述男性通常用blond。

meanings_zh: v. 借出；贷出 | v. 给予；增添
definition_en: Let someone use something temporarily, expecting its return. | Give support or add a particular quality to something.
example1_en: Could you lend me your umbrella until tomorrow?
example1_zh: 你能把雨伞借给我用到明天吗？
example2_en: Local banks could lend small businesses money to invest in cleaner production methods.
example2_zh: 地方银行可以向小企业贷款，帮助它们投资更清洁的生产方式。
collocations: lend someone something｜把某物借给某人 ; lend money to｜借钱给 ; lend support to｜支持 ; lend a hand｜帮忙
tip_zh: lend是借出，borrow是借入；过去式为lent。

meanings_zh: n. 凉鞋
definition_en: A light shoe with straps that leaves much of the foot uncovered.
example1_en: A small stone got stuck inside my sandal.
example1_zh: 一颗小石子卡进了我的凉鞋里。
example2_en: In warm climates, sandals are popular because their open design allows air to circulate around the feet.
example2_zh: 在气候温暖的地区，凉鞋很受欢迎，因为其开放式设计能让脚部通风。
collocations: a pair of sandals｜一双凉鞋 ; leather sandals｜皮凉鞋 ; flat sandals｜平底凉鞋
tip_zh: 单只用sandal，一双用a pair of sandals。

meanings_zh: n. 兴趣；关注 | n. 利息 | v. 使感兴趣
definition_en: a desire to learn about or become involved in something | money paid for borrowing money or earned on savings | to make someone want to know or learn more
example1_en: My interest in cooking began in my grandmother's kitchen.
example1_zh: 我对烹饪的兴趣始于祖母的厨房。
example2_en: Schools can stimulate interest in science by giving students opportunities to conduct experiments and explore practical problems.
example2_zh: 学校可以让学生有机会进行实验并探索实际问题，从而激发他们对科学的兴趣。
collocations: take an interest in｜对……产生兴趣 ; stimulate interest｜激发兴趣 ; interest rate｜利率 ; pay interest｜支付利息
tip_zh: 兴趣用interest in；具体爱好可用复数interests。

meanings_zh: adj. 死的；枯死的 | adj. 没电的；无法运作的 | adv. 完全地；正好
definition_en: No longer alive | No longer working, often because power has run out | Completely or exactly, used for emphasis
example1_en: We removed the dead flowers from the balcony pots.
example1_zh: 我们清除了阳台花盆里枯死的花。
example2_en: Leaving dead trees in forests can support biodiversity by providing habitats for insects and small animals.
example2_zh: 将枯树留在森林中能为昆虫和小动物提供栖息地，从而促进生物多样性。
collocations: dead leaves｜枯叶 ; a dead battery｜没电的电池 ; dead silence｜一片死寂 ; dead centre｜正中心
tip_zh: dead是状态，die是动作，death是名词。
