meanings_zh: n. 鸭；鸭肉 | v. 低头躲闪；弯身避开 | v. 逃避；回避
definition_en: A waterbird with a broad bill, or its meat | Lower your head or body quickly to avoid something | Avoid a difficult question, responsibility, or situation
example1_en: A duck paddled past us with several tiny ducklings.
example1_zh: 一只鸭子带着几只小鸭从我们身旁游过。
example2_en: Urban parks with healthy ponds provide valuable habitats for ducks and other wildlife throughout the year.
example2_zh: 拥有健康池塘的城市公园全年都能为鸭子和其他野生动物提供宝贵的栖息地。
collocations: wild duck｜野鸭 ; roast duck｜烤鸭 ; duck your head｜迅速低头 ; duck a question｜回避问题
tip_zh: 指鸭子时可数，指鸭肉时不可数。

meanings_zh: v. 意思是；意味着；打算 | adj. 刻薄的；吝啬的 | n. 平均值
definition_en: to express, involve, or intend something | unkind or unwilling to share or spend money | the total of several values divided by how many exist
example1_en: I didn't mean to leave you waiting outside.
example1_zh: 我不是故意让你在外面等着的。
example2_en: Higher energy prices may mean that low-income households have less money available for other essential needs.
example2_zh: 能源价格上涨可能意味着低收入家庭可用于其他基本需求的钱会更少。
collocations: mean to do something｜打算做某事 ; mean doing something｜意味着做某事 ; mean value｜平均值 ; be mean to someone｜对某人刻薄
tip_zh: mean to do是“打算做”；mean doing是“意味着做”。

meanings_zh: n. 梦；梦境 | n. 梦想；理想 | v. 做梦；梦想
definition_en: images, feelings, and events experienced while sleeping | something you strongly hope to achieve or experience | to experience dreams while sleeping or imagine something you want
example1_en: Last night, I had a dream about flying over mountains.
example1_zh: 昨晚我做了一个飞越群山的梦。
example2_en: Access to affordable education allows more young people to pursue their dream of entering a skilled profession.
example2_zh: 负担得起的教育让更多年轻人能够追求从事技术性职业的梦想。
collocations: have a dream｜做梦 ; pursue a dream｜追求梦想 ; dream of becoming｜梦想成为 ; a dream come true｜梦想成真
tip_zh: dream of/about后接名词或动名词；过去式可用dreamt或dreamed。

meanings_zh: adj. 定期的；经常的 | adj. 规则的；均匀的 | n. 常客
definition_en: Happening repeatedly, often with similar gaps between events. | Having an even shape, pattern, or arrangement. | Someone who often visits the same place.
example1_en: Our dog needs regular walks to stay happy and healthy.
example1_zh: 我们的狗需要经常散步，才能保持快乐和健康。
example2_en: Regular exercise can reduce the risk of chronic disease and improve overall wellbeing in older adults.
example2_zh: 规律运动可以降低老年人患慢性病的风险，并改善其整体身心健康。
collocations: regular exercise｜规律运动 ; at regular intervals｜每隔固定时间 ; a regular customer｜常客 ; a regular pattern｜规则的模式
tip_zh: regular侧重规律或经常，不等于持续不停的continuous。

meanings_zh: n. 楼梯；梯级
definition_en: A set of steps connecting different levels of a building.
example1_en: We carried the heavy suitcase up the narrow stairs.
example1_zh: 我们把沉重的行李箱沿着狭窄的楼梯搬了上去。
example2_en: Public buildings should provide lifts alongside stairs to ensure equal access for people with limited mobility.
example2_zh: 公共建筑应在楼梯之外配备电梯，确保行动不便者也能平等使用。
collocations: climb the stairs｜爬楼梯 ; a flight of stairs｜一段楼梯 ; take the stairs｜走楼梯
tip_zh: stairs是复数，谓语用复数；一段楼梯用a flight of stairs。

meanings_zh: v. 接受；同意 | v. 承认；认可 | v. 承担；接受现实
definition_en: Agree to receive something or say yes to an offer | Recognize that something is true or valid | Take responsibility or stop resisting an unpleasant situation
example1_en: I gladly accepted her invitation to dinner on Saturday.
example1_zh: 我欣然接受了她周六共进晚餐的邀请。
example2_en: Governments must accept responsibility for ensuring that all children have access to basic education.
example2_zh: 政府必须承担责任，确保所有儿童都能接受基础教育。
collocations: accept an offer｜接受提议 ; accept responsibility｜承担责任 ; accept an invitation｜接受邀请 ; accept that｜承认……
tip_zh: 接受建议用accept；接受某物不等于仅仅收到receive。

meanings_zh: adv. 在国外；到国外
definition_en: in or to a foreign country
example1_en: My sister moved abroad and now lives near the sea.
example1_zh: 我姐姐移居国外，现在住在海边。
example2_en: Studying abroad can help students develop independence and gain a better understanding of other cultures.
example2_zh: 出国留学能帮助学生培养独立性，并更好地理解其他文化。
collocations: study abroad｜出国留学 ; go abroad｜出国 ; live abroad｜在国外生活 ; travel abroad｜出国旅行
tip_zh: abroad是副词：说go abroad，不说go to abroad。

meanings_zh: v. 出席；参加；上学 | v. 处理；照料
definition_en: to go to an event or regularly visit an institution | to deal with something or care for someone
example1_en: My sister attends a dance class every Saturday morning.
example1_zh: 我姐姐每周六上午都去上舞蹈课。
example2_en: Students who attend lectures regularly are more likely to understand difficult concepts and complete assignments successfully.
example2_zh: 经常听课的学生更有可能理解难懂的概念并顺利完成作业。
collocations: attend a meeting｜参加会议 ; attend school｜上学 ; attend to a problem｜处理问题
tip_zh: 参加活动直接接宾语；处理、照料用attend to。

meanings_zh: phr. 买走食用；外带 | phr. 拿走；移除
definition_en: to buy prepared food and eat it somewhere else | to remove something from a place or person
example1_en: Could I have a vegetable sandwich to take away?
example1_zh: 请给我一个蔬菜三明治打包带走，好吗？
example2_en: Restaurants should offer reusable containers to customers who buy meals to take away, reducing packaging waste.
example2_zh: 餐馆应为购买外带餐食的顾客提供可重复使用的容器，以减少包装废弃物。
collocations: food to take away｜外带食品 ; take away the plates｜收走盘子 ; take away someone's rights｜剥夺某人的权利
tip_zh: take away是动词短语；外卖餐名词写takeaway。

meanings_zh: n. 糖果
definition_en: a sweet food made mainly from sugar
example1_en: She offered each guest a small piece of candy.
example1_zh: 她给每位客人递了一小块糖果。
example2_en: Limiting advertisements for candy aimed at children could help families develop healthier eating habits.
example2_zh: 限制面向儿童的糖果广告，可以帮助家庭养成更健康的饮食习惯。
collocations: a piece of candy｜一块糖果 ; hard candy｜硬糖 ; a candy bar｜一条巧克力糖 ; a candy store｜糖果店
tip_zh: 美式常用candy，英式常用sweets；一块用a piece of。

meanings_zh: adj. 基本的；基础的 | adj. 简单的；无额外设施的
definition_en: Forming the main or most necessary part of something. | Having only necessary features, without anything extra.
example1_en: This course teaches basic cooking skills to complete beginners.
example1_zh: 这门课程向零基础学员教授基本烹饪技能。
example2_en: Governments should ensure that all citizens have access to basic healthcare, regardless of their income.
example2_zh: 政府应确保所有公民都能获得基本医疗服务，不论其收入如何。
collocations: basic skills｜基本技能 ; basic needs｜基本需求 ; basic knowledge｜基础知识 ; basic principles｜基本原则
tip_zh: 名词“基础知识”用复数 the basics。

meanings_zh: adj. 公众的；公用的；公开的 | adj. 政府的；公立的 | n. 公众；民众
definition_en: For everyone to use, see, or know about. | Provided or controlled by the government. | Ordinary people in society considered as a group.
example1_en: The public garden stays open until sunset every day.
example1_zh: 这座公共花园每天开放到日落。
example2_en: Investment in public transport can improve access to employment while reducing dependence on private cars.
example2_zh: 投资公共交通可以让人们更方便地上班，同时减少对私家车的依赖。
collocations: public transport｜公共交通 ; public services｜公共服务 ; the general public｜普通民众 ; in public｜在公共场合
tip_zh: the public指公众；in public指在公共场合。

meanings_zh: n. 登机牌
definition_en: A document that allows a passenger to board a plane.
example1_en: Keep your boarding card handy until you reach your seat.
example1_zh: 到座位之前，把登机牌放在方便拿取的地方。
example2_en: Passengers can now download a boarding card, reducing paper consumption and waiting times at airport counters.
example2_zh: 乘客现在可以下载登机牌，从而减少纸张消耗和在机场柜台的等候时间。
collocations: show your boarding card｜出示登机牌 ; print a boarding card｜打印登机牌 ; electronic boarding card｜电子登机牌
tip_zh: 指登机牌，不是机票；boarding pass也很常用。

meanings_zh: n. 垃圾；废物 | n. 废话；胡说
definition_en: Things people throw away because they no longer need them. | Ideas or statements that are silly or untrue.
example1_en: Please put your rubbish in the bin outside.
example1_zh: 请把垃圾放进外面的垃圾桶。
example2_en: Reducing household rubbish requires both convenient recycling facilities and greater public awareness of unnecessary packaging.
example2_zh: 减少生活垃圾既需要便利的回收设施，也需要提高公众对过度包装的认识。
collocations: household rubbish｜生活垃圾 ; rubbish bin｜垃圾桶 ; collect rubbish｜收集垃圾 ; talk rubbish｜胡说八道
tip_zh: 通常不可数；英式常用词，美式常说garbage或trash。

meanings_zh: n. 公共洗手间；厕所
definition_en: a room with toilets in a public place
example1_en: I stopped at the restroom before boarding the bus.
example1_zh: 上公交车前，我去了一趟洗手间。
example2_en: Providing a clean public restroom near busy transport hubs improves comfort for commuters and tourists alike.
example2_zh: 在繁忙的交通枢纽附近提供干净的公共洗手间，能让通勤者和游客都更加舒适。
collocations: public restroom｜公共洗手间 ; restroom facilities｜卫生间设施 ; accessible restroom｜无障碍洗手间
tip_zh: 美式英语中指公共厕所，不是普通的休息室。

meanings_zh: n. 午夜；半夜十二点
definition_en: Twelve o'clock at night, when one day ends and another begins.
example1_en: We stayed awake until midnight watching the snow fall.
example1_zh: 我们一直醒着看雪，直到午夜。
example2_en: Extending public transport services beyond midnight would benefit shift workers who currently rely on expensive taxi journeys.
example2_zh: 将公共交通服务延长至午夜之后，将有利于目前依赖昂贵出租车出行的轮班工作者。
collocations: at midnight｜在午夜 ; until midnight｜直到午夜 ; around midnight｜午夜前后 ; a midnight snack｜午夜点心
tip_zh: 在午夜用at midnight，不用in midnight。

meanings_zh: n. 酒吧；饮品吧台 | n. 条；棒；长条块 | v. 禁止；阻止
definition_en: a place or counter where drinks, especially alcoholic drinks, are served | a long narrow piece of solid material | to officially prevent someone from entering or doing something
example1_en: We ordered fresh orange juice at the hotel bar.
example1_zh: 我们在酒店的酒吧点了鲜榨橙汁。
example2_en: Sports centres should not bar residents from using essential facilities simply because they cannot afford membership fees.
example2_zh: 体育中心不应仅因居民付不起会员费，就禁止他们使用基本设施。
collocations: a hotel bar｜酒店酒吧 ; a bar of chocolate｜一条巧克力 ; metal bars｜金属棒 ; bar someone from doing something｜禁止某人做某事
tip_zh: 表禁止用bar sb from doing；过去式barred。

meanings_zh: n. 选择；选择权 | n. 可选之物；选择范围 | adj. 优质的；精选的
definition_en: the act or freedom of choosing between different possibilities | something you can choose, or the range of available options | of especially good quality
example1_en: You have a choice between soup and salad.
example1_zh: 你可以在汤和沙拉之间选择。
example2_en: Reliable public transport gives commuters a wider choice and reduces their dependence on private cars.
example2_zh: 可靠的公共交通为通勤者提供更多选择，并减少他们对私家车的依赖。
collocations: make a choice｜作出选择 ; have no choice｜别无选择 ; a wide choice of｜种类丰富的 ; freedom of choice｜选择自由
tip_zh: choice是名词，choose是动词；选择做某事用choose to do。

meanings_zh: v. 返回；归还 | n. 返回；归来 | n. 收益；回报
definition_en: To go back, or give something back. | The act of coming or going back. | Money or benefits gained from an investment or activity.
example1_en: Please return these library books before you go away.
example1_zh: 请在离开之前归还这些图书馆的书。
example2_en: Investment in early childhood education can generate a substantial economic return by improving future employment opportunities.
example2_zh: 投资幼儿教育可以通过改善未来就业机会，带来可观的经济回报。
collocations: return home｜回家 ; return to work｜重返工作岗位 ; in return for｜作为……的回报 ; return on investment｜投资回报
tip_zh: return已含“回”的意思，通常不再加back。

meanings_zh: adv. 正确地；恰当地 | adv. 充分地；彻底地
definition_en: In the correct or suitable way. | Completely or to the degree that is needed.
example1_en: The kitchen door will not close properly in winter.
example1_zh: 冬天厨房的门总是关不严。
example2_en: Public recycling schemes are more effective when residents understand how to sort household waste properly.
example2_zh: 当居民了解如何正确分类生活垃圾时，公共回收计划会更有效。
collocations: function properly｜正常运作 ; behave properly｜举止得体 ; properly trained｜受过充分培训的 ; properly equipped｜配备齐全的
tip_zh: 修饰动作常用properly；修饰名词用proper。

meanings_zh: n. 西北方；西北部 | adj. 西北部的；来自西北的 | adv. 向西北；在西北
definition_en: The direction between north and west, or an area's northwestern part. | Located in the northwest, or coming from that direction. | Towards or in the direction between north and west.
example1_en: Our cabin is in the northwest of the island.
example1_zh: 我们的小木屋位于岛的西北部。
example2_en: Investment in rail networks could improve access to employment for communities in the northwest of the country.
example2_zh: 对铁路网的投资可以为该国西北部的社区提供更多就业便利。
collocations: in the northwest｜在西北部 ; head northwest｜向西北行进 ; a northwest wind｜西北风
tip_zh: 西北风从西北吹来；向西北走用head northwest。

meanings_zh: n. 跑步者；赛跑选手
definition_en: a person who runs, especially for exercise or in races
example1_en: A runner in bright shoes passed us by the lake.
example1_zh: 一位穿着亮色鞋子的跑步者在湖边从我们身旁跑过。
example2_en: Urban parks provide runners with safer exercise spaces away from heavy traffic and polluted main roads.
example2_zh: 城市公园为跑步者提供更安全的锻炼空间，远离繁忙交通和污染严重的主干道。
collocations: long-distance runner｜长跑运动员 ; marathon runner｜马拉松选手 ; keen runner｜热衷跑步的人
tip_zh: run加-er时双写n；runner-up指亚军。

meanings_zh: n. 猪肉
definition_en: Meat from a pig, used as food.
example1_en: We cooked the pork slowly with apples and onions.
example1_zh: 我们把猪肉和苹果、洋葱一起慢炖。
example2_en: Clear food labelling helps consumers identify products containing pork and make choices that suit their dietary requirements.
example2_zh: 清晰的食品标签有助于消费者识别含猪肉的产品，并作出符合自身饮食要求的选择。
collocations: roast pork｜烤猪肉 ; pork chop｜猪排 ; minced pork｜猪肉末 ; pork belly｜五花肉
tip_zh: pork是不可数名词，指肉；活猪用pig。

meanings_zh: n. 戏剧；戏剧艺术 | n. 戏剧性事件；激动场面
definition_en: Plays and the art of writing or performing them. | An exciting or emotional event or situation.
example1_en: Our drama group rehearses in the hall every Thursday.
example1_zh: 我们的戏剧小组每周四在大厅排练。
example2_en: Teaching drama in schools can develop students' confidence and encourage them to consider different perspectives.
example2_zh: 在学校教授戏剧可以培养学生的自信，并鼓励他们从不同角度思考。
collocations: drama club｜戏剧社 ; television drama｜电视剧 ; study drama｜学习戏剧 ; historical drama｜历史剧
tip_zh: 戏剧艺术用不可数drama；一部戏剧用a drama。

meanings_zh: n. 惊讶；意外之事 | v. 使惊讶
definition_en: An unexpected event, or the feeling it causes. | To make someone feel amazed by something unexpected.
example1_en: Finding a birthday cake in the kitchen was a lovely surprise.
example1_zh: 在厨房里发现一个生日蛋糕，真是个美好的惊喜。
example2_en: The survey results may surprise policymakers who assume that young people prefer online learning.
example2_zh: 调查结果可能让那些认为年轻人偏爱线上学习的政策制定者感到意外。
collocations: a pleasant surprise｜惊喜 ; to someone's surprise｜令某人惊讶的是 ; take someone by surprise｜使某人措手不及 ; a surprise visit｜突然来访
tip_zh: 人感到惊讶用surprised；事物令人惊讶用surprising。

meanings_zh: n. 情况；事例；病例 | n. 盒；箱；套 | n. 案件；论据
definition_en: A particular situation or example, including an instance of illness. | A container that holds or protects something. | A legal matter or arguments supporting a particular position.
example1_en: Take an umbrella in case it rains later.
example1_zh: 带把伞吧，以防待会儿下雨。
example2_en: In many cases, investing in preventive healthcare is more cost-effective than treating diseases after they develop.
example2_zh: 在许多情况下，投资预防保健比在疾病出现后进行治疗更具成本效益。
collocations: in some cases｜在某些情况下 ; in case of emergency｜遇到紧急情况时 ; a strong case for｜支持某事的有力论据 ; a phone case｜手机保护壳
tip_zh: in case后接从句；in case of后接名词。

meanings_zh: n. 蜘蛛
definition_en: a small creature with eight legs, often making webs
example1_en: A tiny spider built a web beside our window.
example1_zh: 一只小蜘蛛在我们窗边结了网。
example2_en: Although many people fear spiders, these creatures help control insect populations in gardens and agricultural environments.
example2_zh: 虽然许多人害怕蜘蛛，但它们有助于控制花园和农业环境中的昆虫数量。
collocations: a spider web｜蜘蛛网 ; a spider bite｜蜘蛛咬伤
tip_zh: 蜘蛛有八条腿，不属于六条腿的昆虫。

meanings_zh: n. 胡椒粉；胡椒 | n. 甜椒；辣椒 | v. 使布满；大量加入
definition_en: A spice used to give food a hot flavour. | A hollow vegetable that can taste sweet or hot. | To cover or fill something with many small things.
example1_en: Could you pass me the pepper for my soup?
example1_zh: 能把胡椒粉递给我，让我加到汤里吗？
example2_en: Farmers can grow peppers in greenhouses to maintain a reliable food supply throughout the year.
example2_zh: 农民可以在温室里种植甜椒，以维持全年的稳定食物供应。
collocations: black pepper｜黑胡椒 ; red pepper｜红椒 ; pepper something with examples｜在某事物中加入大量例子
tip_zh: 胡椒粉不可数；指一个甜椒时可说a pepper。

meanings_zh: v. 允许；准许 | v. 使可能；容许 | v. 留出；预留
definition_en: to let someone do something | to make something possible | to provide enough time or resources for something
example1_en: The library allows visitors to borrow five books at once.
example1_zh: 图书馆允许访客一次借五本书。
example2_en: Flexible working arrangements allow employees to balance their professional responsibilities with family commitments more effectively.
example2_zh: 灵活的工作安排使员工能够更有效地兼顾工作职责与家庭义务。
collocations: allow someone to do something｜允许某人做某事 ; allow enough time｜留出足够时间 ; allow for delays｜考虑到可能的延误
tip_zh: 用allow sb to do；无宾语时可用allow doing。

meanings_zh: n. 露营；野营
definition_en: staying outdoors in a tent, usually for a holiday
example1_en: We are going camping by the river this weekend.
example1_zh: 这个周末我们要去河边露营。
example2_en: Camping can encourage greater appreciation of nature, provided visitors avoid disturbing wildlife and take their rubbish home.
example2_zh: 露营能增进人们对自然的欣赏，前提是游客不打扰野生动物，并把垃圾带走。
collocations: go camping｜去露营 ; camping equipment｜露营装备 ; a camping trip｜露营之旅
tip_zh: 活动名词camping不可数；去露营说go camping。

meanings_zh: n. 蚂蚁
definition_en: A small insect that lives in organised groups.
example1_en: An ant carried a crumb across the kitchen floor.
example1_zh: 一只蚂蚁叼着面包屑爬过厨房地板。
example2_en: Ants contribute to healthy ecosystems by moving seeds and improving the structure of soil.
example2_zh: 蚂蚁通过搬运种子和改善土壤结构，促进生态系统健康。
collocations: an ant colony｜蚁群 ; an ant nest｜蚁巢 ; worker ants｜工蚁
tip_zh: ant是可数名词；一只蚂蚁用an ant。

meanings_zh: v. 提高；举起 | v. 筹集 | v. 养育；饲养
definition_en: to move something higher or increase its amount or level | to collect money for a particular purpose | to care for children or animals as they grow
example1_en: Please raise your hand if you need another pencil.
example1_zh: 如果你还需要一支铅笔，请举手。
example2_en: Community events can raise funds for conservation projects while helping residents understand local environmental challenges.
example2_zh: 社区活动可以为自然保护项目筹集资金，同时帮助居民了解当地的环境问题。
collocations: raise awareness｜提高认识 ; raise funds｜筹集资金 ; raise a child｜养育孩子 ; raise a question｜提出问题
tip_zh: raise是及物动词，后接宾语；rise表示自身上升。

meanings_zh: v. 放置；设置；确定 | n. 一套；一组 | adj. 固定的；事先确定的
definition_en: Put something somewhere, or establish a condition, value, or rule. | A group of related things that belong together. | Fixed or arranged in advance.
example1_en: She set the bowl gently on the kitchen table.
example1_zh: 她把碗轻轻放在厨房的桌子上。
example2_en: Governments should set clear targets for reducing air pollution and regularly assess progress towards achieving them.
example2_zh: 政府应设定明确的空气污染减排目标，并定期评估实现这些目标的进展。
collocations: set a goal｜设定目标 ; set the table｜摆好餐具 ; a set of tools｜一套工具 ; a set time｜固定时间
tip_zh: 过去式、过去分词均为set；现在分词为setting。

meanings_zh: v. 喂养；进食 | n. 动物饲料 | n. 信息流
definition_en: Give food to someone or an animal, or eat food. | Food given to farm animals. | A regularly updated stream of online content.
example1_en: Please feed the cat before you leave for school.
example1_zh: 请在上学前喂一下猫。
example2_en: School meal programmes help feed children whose families cannot consistently afford nutritious food.
example2_zh: 学校供餐计划帮助那些家庭无法持续负担营养食物的儿童吃上饭。
collocations: feed the animals｜喂动物 ; feed on insects｜以昆虫为食 ; animal feed｜动物饲料 ; news feed｜新闻信息流
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为fed；feed on表示以……为食。

meanings_zh: n. 薄煎饼；松饼
definition_en: A flat, round cake made by frying a liquid mixture
example1_en: He flipped the pancake and reached for the honey.
example1_zh: 他把煎饼翻了个面，伸手去拿蜂蜜。
example2_en: Preparing pancakes in cooking classes allows students to practise measuring ingredients and using kitchen equipment safely.
example2_zh: 在烹饪课上制作煎饼，让学生有机会练习称量食材和安全使用厨房设备。
collocations: pancake batter｜煎饼面糊 ; flip a pancake｜给煎饼翻面 ; a stack of pancakes｜一摞松饼
tip_zh: 英式通常较薄，美式通常较厚且蓬松。

meanings_zh: prep. 除……之外 | conj. 只是；除了……情况
definition_en: Not including a particular person or thing. | Used to introduce a fact limiting what was just said.
example1_en: Everyone except my brother wanted to walk home.
example1_zh: 除了我弟弟，大家都想走路回家。
example2_en: The proposed transport policy benefits most residents, except those living in remote rural communities.
example2_zh: 拟议的交通政策惠及大多数居民，但偏远农村社区的居民除外。
collocations: except for｜除……之外 ; except that｜只是；不过 ; everyone except｜除……之外的所有人
tip_zh: except排除在外；besides表示另外还包括。

meanings_zh: adv. 仍然；还 | adj. 静止的；不动的 | adv. 尽管如此；不过
definition_en: Continuing up to a particular time without stopping or changing. | Not moving. | Despite what has just been said.
example1_en: It is nearly midnight, but my sister is still awake.
example1_zh: 快到午夜了，可我姐姐还醒着。
example2_en: Despite improvements in public transport, many commuters still rely on private cars because services remain unreliable in rural areas.
example2_zh: 尽管公共交通有所改善，许多通勤者仍依赖私家车，因为农村地区的公共交通服务依然不可靠。
collocations: still waiting｜仍在等待 ; stand still｜站着不动 ; keep still｜保持不动 ; still water｜静止的水
tip_zh: 表“仍然”时，通常放实义动词前、be动词后。

meanings_zh: adj. 新鲜的 | adj. 清新的；凉爽宜人的 | adj. 新的；不同于以往的
definition_en: Recently produced or picked, and not preserved or stale. | Clean, cool, and pleasant, especially when describing air. | New or different from what existed or was used before.
example1_en: I bought fresh strawberries from the market this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上我在市场买了新鲜草莓。
example2_en: Access to fresh fruit and vegetables is essential for improving diets in low-income urban communities.
example2_zh: 让城市低收入社区居民能获得新鲜果蔬，对改善其饮食至关重要。
collocations: fresh produce｜新鲜农产品 ; fresh air｜新鲜空气 ; a fresh start｜全新的开始 ; fresh water｜淡水
tip_zh: fresh water指淡水；fresh air指新鲜空气。

meanings_zh: n. 逗号
definition_en: A punctuation mark separating parts of a sentence or list.
example1_en: I added a comma to make the sentence clearer.
example1_zh: 我加了一个逗号，让句子更清楚。
example2_en: A misplaced comma can change the meaning of a sentence and confuse readers of academic writing.
example2_zh: 位置不当的逗号可能改变句意，使学术文章的读者产生困惑。
collocations: add a comma｜加逗号 ; a misplaced comma｜位置不当的逗号 ; separate items with commas｜用逗号分隔各项
tip_zh: comma是逗号，句号通常叫full stop（英）或period（美）。

meanings_zh: v. 摧毁；毁灭 | v. 彻底破坏；使丧失
definition_en: To damage something so badly that it cannot be used. | To completely end something valuable, such as trust or hope.
example1_en: A sudden storm destroyed the old shed behind our house.
example1_zh: 一场突如其来的暴风雨摧毁了我们屋后的旧棚子。
example2_en: Uncontrolled urban expansion can destroy natural habitats and threaten the survival of species that depend on them.
example2_zh: 不受控制的城市扩张会摧毁自然栖息地，威胁依赖这些栖息地的物种生存。
collocations: destroy habitats｜摧毁栖息地 ; destroy evidence｜销毁证据 ; destroy confidence｜摧毁信心 ; completely destroy｜彻底摧毁
tip_zh: destroy比damage程度重，通常指彻底毁坏。

meanings_zh: n. 教授
definition_en: A university teacher, especially one holding a senior academic position.
example1_en: Our professor brought ancient coins to class today.
example1_zh: 我们的教授今天带了古钱币来上课。
example2_en: The professor encouraged students to evaluate different sources before drawing conclusions about climate policy.
example2_zh: 这位教授鼓励学生在对气候政策下结论之前评估不同的信息来源。
collocations: university professor｜大学教授 ; professor of economics｜经济学教授 ; visiting professor｜客座教授
tip_zh: 英国通常指高级职称；美国也泛指大学教师。

meanings_zh: n. 耳机的一个听筒
definition_en: one of two earpieces worn over the ears for listening
example1_en: I wear headphones so my music won't disturb anyone.
example1_zh: 我戴着耳机听音乐，这样就不会打扰别人。
example2_en: Students using headphones in shared study spaces should keep the volume low to protect their hearing.
example2_zh: 在公共学习空间使用耳机的学生应保持较低音量，以保护听力。
collocations: a pair of headphones｜一副耳机 ; wireless headphones｜无线耳机 ; headphone jack｜耳机插孔
tip_zh: 日常说耳机通常用复数headphones，一副用a pair of。

meanings_zh: v. 改善；提高；变好
definition_en: To become better or make something better.
example1_en: My cooking has improved since I started practising daily.
example1_zh: 自从开始每天练习，我的厨艺进步了。
example2_en: Investing in teacher training can improve educational outcomes, especially in schools serving disadvantaged communities.
example2_zh: 投资教师培训可以改善教育成果，尤其是在服务弱势社区的学校中。
collocations: improve performance｜提高表现 ; improve access to｜改善获取……的机会 ; improve significantly｜显著改善 ; improve living standards｜提高生活水平
tip_zh: 既可及物也可不及物：improve skills；skills improve。

meanings_zh: n. 棉花 | n. 棉布；棉线
definition_en: Soft white plant fibres used to make thread and fabric. | Fabric or thread made from cotton fibres.
example1_en: This cotton shirt feels soft even after many washes.
example1_zh: 这件棉衬衫洗了很多次后摸起来仍然很柔软。
example2_en: Cotton production can place considerable pressure on water supplies, particularly in regions with limited rainfall.
example2_zh: 棉花生产会给供水带来相当大的压力，尤其是在降雨量有限的地区。
collocations: organic cotton｜有机棉 ; cotton fabric｜棉织物 ; cotton wool｜脱脂棉 ; cotton industry｜棉纺织业
tip_zh: 通常不可数；cotton shirt中cotton作名词定语。

meanings_zh: n. 人际关系；恋爱关系 | n. 关联；联系
definition_en: The way people know, feel about, and treat each other. | A connection between things or the way they affect each other.
example1_en: She has a warm relationship with her younger sister.
example1_zh: 她和妹妹的关系很亲密。
example2_en: Researchers are investigating the relationship between access to green spaces and mental health in urban communities.
example2_zh: 研究人员正在调查城市社区中绿地的可及性与心理健康之间的关系。
collocations: build a relationship｜建立关系 ; a close relationship｜亲密关系 ; the relationship between A and B｜甲与乙之间的关系
tip_zh: 与某人的关系用with；两者关系用between。

meanings_zh: prep. 加；加上 | n. 优点；有利因素 | adj. 正的；零以上的
definition_en: With something added to an amount or group. | An advantage or positive feature. | Greater than zero, especially when describing temperatures.
example1_en: The room costs sixty pounds plus breakfast each night.
example1_zh: 房间每晚六十英镑，早餐另收费。
example2_en: Affordable housing plus reliable public transport can make expanding cities more accessible to workers on modest incomes.
example2_zh: 经济适用的住房加上可靠的公共交通，能让收入不高的劳动者更容易在扩张中的城市生活。
collocations: plus tax｜另加税费 ; a big plus｜一大优点 ; plus ten degrees｜零上十度
tip_zh: plus作名词表示优点时可数，如a big plus。

meanings_zh: n. 爵士乐
definition_en: Music with strong rhythms and often freely invented melodies.
example1_en: We listened to jazz while cooking dinner together.
example1_zh: 我们一起做晚饭时听了爵士乐。
example2_en: Community jazz festivals can attract visitors while giving local musicians valuable opportunities to perform.
example2_zh: 社区爵士音乐节既能吸引游客，也能为当地音乐人提供宝贵的演出机会。
collocations: jazz band｜爵士乐队 ; jazz festival｜爵士音乐节 ; jazz musician｜爵士乐手
tip_zh: 表示音乐类型时通常不可数，不加 a。

meanings_zh: n. 千克；公斤
definition_en: A unit of mass equal to one thousand grams.
example1_en: We bought a kilogramme of apples at the market.
example1_zh: 我们在市场买了一公斤苹果。
example2_en: Producing a kilogramme of beef generally requires more water than producing the same weight of vegetables.
example2_zh: 生产一公斤牛肉通常比生产同等重量的蔬菜需要更多的水。
collocations: a kilogramme of rice｜一公斤大米 ; half a kilogramme｜半公斤 ; per kilogramme｜每公斤
tip_zh: 英式拼写变体；kilogram更常用，符号kg不加s。

meanings_zh: n. 洋葱
definition_en: a round vegetable with layers and a strong smell
example1_en: Chopping this onion is making my eyes water again.
example1_zh: 切这个洋葱又让我流眼泪了。
example2_en: Growing onions and other vegetables locally can shorten supply chains and provide communities with fresher produce.
example2_zh: 在本地种植洋葱等蔬菜可以缩短供应链，为社区提供更新鲜的农产品。
collocations: chop an onion｜切碎洋葱 ; peel an onion｜剥洋葱 ; onion rings｜洋葱圈
tip_zh: 开头是元音音素，单数前用an：an onion。

meanings_zh: n. 暴风雨；风暴 | v. 怒气冲冲地走 | n. 风波；强烈反响
definition_en: severe weather with strong winds and rain, snow, or thunder | to move somewhere angrily and forcefully | a sudden wave of strong public anger or criticism
example1_en: We stayed indoors while the storm shook the windows.
example1_zh: 暴风雨震得窗户直响，我们一直待在屋里。
example2_en: Coastal communities need stronger flood defences to protect homes and essential services during severe storms.
example2_zh: 沿海社区需要更坚固的防洪设施，以在强风暴期间保护住房和基本公共服务。
collocations: a severe storm｜强风暴 ; a storm of protest｜抗议浪潮 ; storm out of the room｜怒气冲冲地走出房间
tip_zh: storm out表示愤然离开，不是风暴向外移动。

meanings_zh: n. 街区；附近地区 | n. 街坊邻里
definition_en: An area around people's homes within a town or city. | The people living in a particular local area.
example1_en: A small bakery has just opened in our neighbourhood.
example1_zh: 我们街区刚开了一家小面包店。
example2_en: Investing in neighbourhood parks can improve residents' health while creating opportunities for people to meet and socialise.
example2_zh: 投资建设社区公园可以改善居民健康，同时创造见面和社交的机会。
collocations: a quiet neighbourhood｜安静的街区 ; in the neighbourhood｜在附近 ; a residential neighbourhood｜住宅区
tip_zh: 英式拼写为neighbourhood，美式为neighborhood。

meanings_zh: adj. 薄的；细的 | adj. 瘦的 | v. 使稀疏；变稀薄
definition_en: Having little distance between opposite sides or surfaces. | Having little body fat or flesh. | To make or become less dense, thick, or numerous.
example1_en: I wore a thin jacket and felt cold outside.
example1_zh: 我穿了件薄外套，在外面觉得冷。
example2_en: Thin layers of insulation can improve energy efficiency without significantly reducing the usable space inside buildings.
example2_zh: 薄层隔热材料能提高能源效率，同时不会明显减少建筑内部的可用空间。
collocations: a thin layer｜薄薄的一层 ; thin slices｜薄片 ; thin air｜稀薄的空气 ; thin out｜变稀疏；疏除
tip_zh: 形容身材时，thin不一定褒义；slim通常含赞美。

meanings_zh: v. 印刷；打印 | n. 印刷文字；字体 | n. 印痕；印迹
definition_en: To produce words or images on paper using a machine | Letters and words produced on paper by printing | A mark left by something pressed against a surface
example1_en: Could you print two copies of this recipe?
example1_zh: 你能把这份食谱打印两份吗？
example2_en: Schools can reduce paper waste by encouraging students to print assignments only when physical copies are necessary.
example2_zh: 学校可以鼓励学生仅在需要纸质版时打印作业，以减少纸张浪费。
collocations: print a document｜打印文件 ; small print｜小号字；细则 ; in print｜已出版且仍可购得 ; out of print｜已绝版
tip_zh: print out指打印出来；out of print则指书已绝版。

meanings_zh: n. 许可；准许
definition_en: agreement allowing someone to do something
example1_en: You need permission to borrow your sister's bicycle.
example1_zh: 你得先征得姐姐同意，才能借她的自行车。
example2_en: Researchers must obtain permission from participants before collecting personal information for a scientific study.
example2_zh: 研究人员为科学研究收集个人信息前，必须征得参与者同意。
collocations: ask for permission｜请求许可 ; give permission｜给予许可 ; without permission｜未经许可 ; permission to do something｜做某事的许可
tip_zh: 通常不可数；说give permission，不加a。

meanings_zh: adj. 困倦的；想睡的 | adj. 安静冷清的
definition_en: feeling tired and ready to sleep | quiet and having very little activity
example1_en: I felt sleepy after lunch and took a short nap.
example1_zh: 午饭后我觉得困，就小睡了一会儿。
example2_en: Students who feel sleepy during lessons may struggle to concentrate and retain new information effectively.
example2_zh: 上课时感到困倦的学生可能难以集中注意力，也难以有效记住新知识。
collocations: feel sleepy｜感到困倦 ; sleepy village｜宁静的村庄 ; sleepy eyes｜惺忪的睡眼
tip_zh: sleepy是想睡的；asleep是已经睡着的。

meanings_zh: adj. 生病的；不舒服的 | adj. 恶心的；想吐的 | adj. 厌烦的；受够了的
definition_en: Suffering from an illness or feeling unwell. | Feeling that you might vomit. | Very annoyed or tired of someone or something.
example1_en: He stayed in bed because he felt sick this morning.
example1_zh: 他今天早上觉得不舒服，所以一直躺在床上。
example2_en: Paid sick leave allows employees to recover at home and reduces the spread of infections in workplaces.
example2_zh: 带薪病假让员工能在家康复，并减少感染在工作场所传播。
collocations: sick leave｜病假 ; feel sick｜觉得恶心；不舒服 ; be sick of｜厌烦 ; call in sick｜打电话请病假
tip_zh: 英式英语中be sick常指呕吐，feel sick常指恶心。

meanings_zh: adj. 直的；笔直的 | adv. 径直；直接 | adj. 坦诚的；直率的
definition_en: not curved or bent | directly, without turning or stopping | honest and clear rather than hiding the truth
example1_en: Use a ruler to draw a straight line.
example1_zh: 用尺子画一条直线。
example2_en: Building straight roads across mountainous regions can be expensive and may damage natural habitats.
example2_zh: 在山区修建笔直的道路可能成本高昂，还可能破坏自然栖息地。
collocations: a straight line｜直线 ; go straight ahead｜一直往前走 ; a straight answer｜直截了当的回答
tip_zh: straight本身可作副词，不用加-ly。

meanings_zh: n. 家务劳动
definition_en: Work done to keep a home clean and tidy.
example1_en: We share the housework so nobody spends Sunday cleaning alone.
example1_zh: 我们分担家务，这样就没人需要独自在周日打扫了。
example2_en: Sharing housework fairly allows family members to balance paid employment with responsibilities at home more effectively.
example2_zh: 公平分担家务可以让家庭成员更有效地平衡有偿工作与家庭责任。
collocations: do the housework｜做家务 ; share the housework｜分担家务 ; household chores｜家务杂事
tip_zh: 不可数，不能说a housework；做家务用do。

meanings_zh: n. 名词
definition_en: a word naming a person, place, thing, quality, or idea
example1_en: Our teacher asked us to circle every noun.
example1_zh: 老师让我们把每个名词都圈出来。
example2_en: Understanding whether a noun is countable helps language learners choose appropriate articles and express quantities accurately in academic writing.
example2_zh: 了解名词是否可数，有助于语言学习者在学术写作中选用合适的冠词并准确表达数量。
collocations: countable noun｜可数名词 ; uncountable noun｜不可数名词 ; proper noun｜专有名词 ; noun phrase｜名词短语
tip_zh: 名词不只指实物，也可指advice等抽象概念。

meanings_zh: n. 平板电脑 | n. 药片 | n. 碑；刻字板
definition_en: a portable computer with a flat touchscreen | a small solid dose of medicine swallowed whole | a flat stone or metal slab bearing an inscription
example1_en: I use my tablet to watch cooking videos.
example1_zh: 我用平板电脑看烹饪视频。
example2_en: Providing every student with a tablet may improve access to resources, but teachers still need suitable training.
example2_zh: 为每名学生配备平板电脑可能有助于获取学习资源，但教师仍需接受适当培训。
collocations: tablet computer｜平板电脑 ; take a tablet｜服用药片 ; vitamin tablet｜维生素片
tip_zh: tablet既指平板电脑，也指药片，需看语境。

meanings_zh: n. 牙痛
definition_en: pain in a tooth or the surrounding area
example1_en: My toothache kept me awake for most of the night.
example1_zh: 牙痛让我大半夜都没睡着。
example2_en: Affordable dental services allow people with toothache to seek treatment before more serious problems develop.
example2_zh: 价格可负担的牙科服务让牙痛患者能在问题恶化前就医。
collocations: have toothache｜牙痛 ; severe toothache｜剧烈牙痛 ; relieve toothache｜缓解牙痛
tip_zh: 英式常说have toothache，美式常说have a toothache。

meanings_zh: n. 温度；气温；体温 | n. 发烧
definition_en: A measure of how hot or cold something is. | A body temperature higher than normal because of illness.
example1_en: The temperature dropped sharply after the sun went down.
example1_zh: 太阳落山后，气温急剧下降。
example2_en: Rising ocean temperatures can damage coral reefs and threaten the survival of many marine species.
example2_zh: 海洋温度上升会破坏珊瑚礁，并威胁许多海洋物种的生存。
collocations: room temperature｜室温 ; body temperature｜体温 ; take someone's temperature｜测量某人的体温 ; have a temperature｜发烧
tip_zh: have a temperature通常指发烧，不只是有体温。

meanings_zh: n. 敌人；敌方 | n. 危害物；大敌
definition_en: A person or group that opposes or wants to harm another. | Something that seriously harms or threatens something else.
example1_en: In the story, the prince becomes friends with his enemy.
example1_zh: 故事里，王子和他的敌人成了朋友。
example2_en: Public distrust can become an enemy of effective environmental policy, particularly when governments fail to explain their decisions.
example2_zh: 公众的不信任可能成为有效环境政策的大敌，尤其是在政府未能解释其决策时。
collocations: bitter enemy｜死敌 ; common enemy｜共同的敌人 ; enemy forces｜敌军
tip_zh: enemy指敌人；比赛对手通常用opponent。

meanings_zh: n. 单板滑雪运动
definition_en: The sport of travelling down snowy slopes on one board.
example1_en: I tried snowboarding yesterday and landed in soft snow.
example1_zh: 昨天我尝试了单板滑雪，摔进了松软的雪里。
example2_en: Snowboarding lessons should include safety training so that beginners can share mountain slopes responsibly.
example2_zh: 单板滑雪课程应包含安全训练，让初学者能负责任地与他人共用山坡雪道。
collocations: go snowboarding｜去玩单板滑雪 ; snowboarding lessons｜单板滑雪课程 ; snowboarding equipment｜单板滑雪装备
tip_zh: snowboarding双脚固定在一块板上，区别于双板滑雪。

meanings_zh: v. 滑冰；滑旱冰 | n. 冰鞋；旱冰鞋
definition_en: to move over ice or ground wearing special wheeled or bladed shoes | a boot with a blade or wheels for moving smoothly
example1_en: We skate around the rink every Saturday afternoon.
example1_zh: 我们每周六下午都在溜冰场滑冰。
example2_en: Public facilities where children can skate safely encourage physical activity and provide affordable recreation for families.
example2_zh: 供儿童安全滑冰的公共设施能鼓励体育活动，并为家庭提供经济实惠的娱乐选择。
collocations: ice skate｜滑冰 ; roller skate｜滑旱冰 ; a pair of skates｜一双溜冰鞋
tip_zh: 鞋子常用复数skates；go skating表示去滑冰。

meanings_zh: n. 观点；要点 | n. 尖端；尖头 | v. 指向；指给……看
definition_en: an idea or detail expressed in speech or writing | the sharp, narrow end of something | show a direction or object with a finger or tool
example1_en: You made a good point about sharing the kitchen.
example1_zh: 关于共用厨房，你说得很有道理。
example2_en: The main point of this argument is that education should remain accessible to everyone.
example2_zh: 这一论证的核心观点是，每个人都应能获得教育机会。
collocations: make a point｜提出观点 ; main point｜要点 ; point of view｜观点；看法 ; point at something｜指着某物
tip_zh: make a point是提出观点；point at是指着。

meanings_zh: pron. 一个也没有；毫无 | adv. 毫不；一点也不
definition_en: not any of the people or things being considered | not at all, used before certain comparative expressions
example1_en: I checked the biscuit tin, but there were none left.
example1_zh: 我看了看饼干罐，但一块也没剩下。
example2_en: Although several solutions were proposed, none addressed the underlying causes of inequality in access to education.
example2_zh: 虽然提出了多种解决办法，但没有一种触及教育机会不平等的根本原因。
collocations: none of｜……中没有一个 ; none at all｜完全没有 ; none the wiser｜仍然不明白 ; none other than｜正是；不是别人而是
tip_zh: none可独立用；修饰名词用no，如no books。

meanings_zh: n. 海洋；大洋
definition_en: The vast salt water covering much of Earth's surface.
example1_en: We watched the sun rise over the ocean.
example1_zh: 我们看着太阳从海面上升起。
example2_en: Plastic waste entering the ocean threatens marine wildlife and can eventually affect human health through food chains.
example2_zh: 进入海洋的塑料垃圾威胁海洋野生动物，并最终可能通过食物链影响人类健康。
collocations: ocean currents｜洋流 ; the ocean floor｜海底 ; ocean pollution｜海洋污染
tip_zh: ocean通常比sea范围大；专名常加the。

meanings_zh: adj. 令人愉快的；舒适的 | adj. 友善的；和蔼的
definition_en: Enjoyable or comfortable to experience. | Friendly and polite towards other people.
example1_en: We enjoyed a pleasant walk beside the river.
example1_zh: 我们在河边愉快地散了步。
example2_en: Public gardens provide pleasant spaces where residents can exercise, socialise, and escape the pressures of urban life.
example2_zh: 公共花园提供舒适宜人的空间，让居民锻炼、社交，并暂时摆脱城市生活的压力。
collocations: pleasant weather｜宜人的天气 ; a pleasant surprise｜惊喜 ; a pleasant atmosphere｜愉快的氛围
tip_zh: pleasant形容事物令人愉快；pleased形容人感到高兴。

meanings_zh: v. 借入；借用 | v. 借鉴；引入
definition_en: To take and use something with permission, then return it. | To use an idea or word from another source.
example1_en: Could I borrow your umbrella until tomorrow morning?
example1_zh: 我能借用一下你的伞，明天早上还吗？
example2_en: Many languages borrow words from others as international trade and cultural exchange bring communities closer.
example2_zh: 随着国际贸易和文化交流拉近各群体的距离，许多语言会从其他语言中引入词汇。
collocations: borrow from｜向……借；借鉴 ; borrow money｜借钱 ; borrow a book｜借书 ; borrow heavily｜大量举债
tip_zh: borrow是借入，lend是借出；向某人借用from。

meanings_zh: v. 似乎；看来
definition_en: To appear to be a certain way.
example1_en: You seem tired after your long walk home.
example1_zh: 你走了那么远的路回家，看起来很累。
example2_en: Although online courses seem convenient, some learners benefit more from direct interaction with teachers and classmates.
example2_zh: 尽管网络课程似乎很方便，一些学习者仍能从与老师和同学的直接互动中获益更多。
collocations: seem likely｜似乎有可能 ; seem to be｜似乎是 ; it seems that｜看来
tip_zh: 常用seem＋形容词或seem to do，不表示装作。

meanings_zh: n. 搁板；架子 | n. 陆架；岩石凸台
definition_en: A flat board used to support or store things. | A broad, relatively flat area of rock or seabed.
example1_en: Put the clean cups on the shelf above the sink.
example1_zh: 把干净杯子放在水槽上方的架子上。
example2_en: Placing healthy snacks on shelves at eye level may encourage shoppers to make more nutritious food choices.
example2_zh: 把健康零食摆在与视线齐平的货架上，可能促使购物者选择更有营养的食品。
collocations: top shelf｜最上层搁板 ; shelf space｜货架空间 ; shelf life｜保质期 ; continental shelf｜大陆架
tip_zh: 复数是shelves；shelf life指保质期。

meanings_zh: n. 葡萄牙语 | adj. 葡萄牙的；葡萄牙语的 | n. 葡萄牙人（统称）
definition_en: The language spoken in Portugal, Brazil, and several other countries | Relating to Portugal, its people, or their language | The people of Portugal, considered as a group
example1_en: My neighbour speaks Portuguese with her family at home.
example1_zh: 我的邻居在家和家人说葡萄牙语。
example2_en: Learning Portuguese can help students access a wider range of literature and international career opportunities.
example2_zh: 学习葡萄牙语能帮助学生接触更广泛的文学作品，并获得国际就业机会。
collocations: speak Portuguese｜说葡萄牙语 ; European Portuguese｜欧洲葡萄牙语 ; Portuguese culture｜葡萄牙文化
tip_zh: 首字母大写；单个葡萄牙人用a Portuguese person。

meanings_zh: adv. 即使如此；无论如何 | adv. 再说；总之
definition_en: Despite what has happened or what someone has said. | Used to add a reason or return to the main subject.
example1_en: It started raining, but we went for a walk anyway.
example1_zh: 虽然开始下雨了，但我们还是去散步了。
example2_en: Some residents oppose the new railway, but the government intends to proceed anyway because of its economic benefits.
example2_zh: 一些居民反对修建新铁路，但政府考虑到其经济效益，仍打算推进项目。
collocations: do it anyway｜无论如何还是去做 ; go anyway｜即使如此也去 ; thanks anyway｜不管怎样还是谢谢你
tip_zh: anyway是副词；any way指任何方式。

meanings_zh: n. 口红；唇膏
definition_en: A cosmetic applied to lips to give them colour.
example1_en: She put on red lipstick before leaving the house.
example1_zh: 她出门前涂了红色口红。
example2_en: Cosmetics companies are developing refillable lipstick containers to reduce packaging waste and respond to environmental concerns.
example2_zh: 化妆品公司正在开发可替换内芯的口红管，以减少包装废弃物并回应环保关切。
collocations: wear lipstick｜涂着口红 ; apply lipstick｜涂口红 ; a tube of lipstick｜一管口红 ; lipstick stain｜口红印
tip_zh: 物质义不可数；一管口红用a tube of lipstick。

meanings_zh: n. 炉灶；炊具
definition_en: an appliance used for cooking food
example1_en: The soup is bubbling in a pot on the cooker.
example1_zh: 锅里的汤正在炉灶上咕嘟咕嘟地冒泡。
example2_en: Replacing an inefficient cooker with a modern appliance can reduce household energy consumption over time.
example2_zh: 用现代设备替换低效炉灶，长远来看可以减少家庭能源消耗。
collocations: gas cooker｜燃气灶 ; electric cooker｜电炉灶 ; pressure cooker｜高压锅 ; rice cooker｜电饭锅
tip_zh: 英式cooker指炉灶，美式常用stove；厨师是cook。

meanings_zh: n. 衣服；服装（总称）
definition_en: Things people wear to cover or protect their bodies.
example1_en: Pack some warm clothing for our weekend camping trip.
example1_zh: 为我们周末的露营之旅带些保暖衣物。
example2_en: The clothing industry can reduce its environmental impact by using recycled materials and designing products that last longer.
example2_zh: 服装行业可以通过使用再生材料和设计更耐穿的产品来减少对环境的影响。
collocations: warm clothing｜保暖衣物 ; protective clothing｜防护服 ; an item of clothing｜一件衣物 ; clothing industry｜服装业
tip_zh: clothing不可数；一件衣服用an item of clothing。

meanings_zh: n. 高度；身高 | n. 离地高度；海拔 | n. 顶峰；最盛时期
definition_en: the measurement of how tall someone or something is | the distance of something above the ground or sea | the time when something is strongest or most successful
example1_en: She adjusted the chair's height so her feet reached the floor.
example1_zh: 她调节了椅子的高度，让双脚能够踩到地面。
example2_en: Restricting the height of new buildings can protect historic views and preserve the character of older neighbourhoods.
example2_zh: 限制新建筑的高度可以保护历史景观，并保留老街区的特色。
collocations: average height｜平均身高；平均高度 ; at a height of｜在……的高度 ; a fear of heights｜恐高 ; at the height of｜在……的鼎盛时期
tip_zh: height 是名词；形容人高用 tall，物体高可用 high。

meanings_zh: v. 烘焙；烤
definition_en: To cook food in an oven using dry heat.
example1_en: I baked some bread while the children set the table.
example1_zh: 孩子们摆餐具时，我烤了些面包。
example2_en: Schools can teach children to bake simple foods as part of practical lessons about nutrition and independence.
example2_zh: 学校可以教孩子烘焙简单的食物，将其作为营养与独立生活实践课的一部分。
collocations: bake bread｜烤面包 ; bake a cake｜烤蛋糕 ; freshly baked｜刚出炉的
tip_zh: bake常用于面包、蛋糕；烤肉通常用roast。

meanings_zh: n. 园丁；园艺爱好者
definition_en: someone who grows and cares for plants in a garden
example1_en: The gardener planted bright flowers along our front path.
example1_zh: 园丁沿着我们门前的小路种下了鲜艳的花。
example2_en: Community gardeners can improve urban biodiversity by growing native plants that provide food and shelter for wildlife.
example2_zh: 社区园艺爱好者可以种植为野生动物提供食物和栖息处的本土植物，从而改善城市生物多样性。
collocations: a professional gardener｜职业园丁 ; a keen gardener｜热衷园艺的人 ; an experienced gardener｜有经验的园丁
tip_zh: 既可指职业园丁，也可指在自家种花种菜的爱好者。

meanings_zh: adv. 几乎；差不多
definition_en: Almost, but not completely or exactly.
example1_en: I nearly missed the bus because I overslept.
example1_zh: 我睡过了头，差点没赶上公交车。
example2_en: Nearly half of the surveyed residents supported expanding public transport rather than building additional roads.
example2_zh: 受访居民中近一半支持扩建公共交通系统，而不是增建道路。
collocations: nearly half｜近一半 ; nearly finished｜快完成了 ; nearly impossible｜几乎不可能 ; not nearly enough｜远远不够
tip_zh: nearly表示差一点达到；not nearly表示远远不。

meanings_zh: n. 睡衣裤
definition_en: a loose top and trousers worn for sleeping
example1_en: I put on my pyjamas and climbed into bed.
example1_zh: 我穿上睡衣裤，爬上了床。
example2_en: Choosing comfortable pyjamas and maintaining a regular bedtime may help children establish healthier sleep routines.
example2_zh: 选择舒适的睡衣裤并保持固定的就寝时间，可能有助于儿童养成更健康的睡眠习惯。
collocations: a pair of pyjamas｜一套睡衣裤 ; cotton pyjamas｜棉质睡衣裤 ; put on pyjamas｜穿上睡衣裤
tip_zh: 用复数；一套用a pair of；美式拼pajamas。

meanings_zh: n. 世纪；一百年
definition_en: A period of one hundred years.
example1_en: This bridge was built more than a century ago.
example1_zh: 这座桥建于一个多世纪以前。
example2_en: Over the past century, improvements in sanitation have contributed significantly to longer life expectancy worldwide.
example2_zh: 过去一个世纪里，卫生条件的改善对全球预期寿命的延长作出了重大贡献。
collocations: the twentieth century｜二十世纪 ; over a century ago｜一个多世纪以前 ; the turn of the century｜世纪之交
tip_zh: 世纪序数比年份前两位大一：如1901—2000为20世纪。

meanings_zh: n. 得分；分数 | v. 得分；获得分数 | n. 配乐；乐谱
definition_en: the points gained in a game, test, or competition | to gain points in a game, test, or competition | music written for a film or the written music itself
example1_en: My score improved after a week of practice.
example1_zh: 练习一周后，我的分数提高了。
example2_en: Test scores provide useful information, but they cannot fully reflect students' creativity or practical skills.
example2_zh: 考试分数能提供有用的信息，却无法全面反映学生的创造力或实践技能。
collocations: a high score｜高分 ; score a goal｜进球得分 ; test scores｜考试分数 ; a film score｜电影配乐
tip_zh: score可作名词或动词；score a goal指进球得分。

meanings_zh: n. 骑自行车；自行车运动
definition_en: The activity of riding a bicycle for transport or exercise.
example1_en: We go cycling beside the river every Sunday morning.
example1_zh: 我们每个星期天早上都沿河骑自行车。
example2_en: Investing in safe cycling routes can encourage commuters to choose healthier and less polluting forms of transport.
example2_zh: 投资建设安全的自行车道可以鼓励通勤者选择更健康、污染更少的交通方式。
collocations: go cycling｜去骑自行车 ; cycling route｜骑行路线 ; cycling helmet｜自行车头盔 ; cycling infrastructure｜骑行基础设施
tip_zh: 表示这项活动时通常不可数；常说go cycling。

meanings_zh: v. 行动；表现；扮演 | n. 行为；举动 | n. 法令；法案
definition_en: To take action, behave in a way, or perform a role. | Something that someone does. | A law formally approved by a legislative body.
example1_en: We must act quickly before the kitchen sink overflows.
example1_zh: 我们必须赶快采取行动，免得厨房水槽里的水溢出来。
example2_en: Governments need to act decisively to reduce air pollution and protect the health of urban residents.
example2_zh: 政府需要果断采取行动，减少空气污染，保护城市居民的健康。
collocations: act quickly｜迅速行动 ; act as｜充当 ; an act of kindness｜善举 ; pass an act｜通过法案
tip_zh: act as表示充当；act还可指戏剧的一幕。

meanings_zh: n. 季节 | n. 旺季；赛季；活动期 | v. 给……调味
definition_en: One of the main yearly periods with particular weather conditions. | A period when a particular activity or event usually happens. | Add salt, herbs, or spices to improve food's flavour.
example1_en: Autumn is my favourite season for walking in the woods.
example1_zh: 秋天是我最喜欢去林中散步的季节。
example2_en: A longer tourist season can create more stable employment, although it may increase pressure on local resources.
example2_zh: 更长的旅游旺季可以创造更稳定的就业，但也可能加大当地资源的压力。
collocations: rainy season｜雨季 ; peak season｜旺季 ; football season｜足球赛季 ; season with salt｜用盐调味
tip_zh: season作动词指调味，常用season food with…。

meanings_zh: v. 猜测；猜中 | n. 猜测；推测 | v. 认为；想来
definition_en: To give an answer without having enough information to be certain. | An answer or opinion given without being certain. | To think something is probably true, without being completely sure.
example1_en: Can you guess what is inside this little box?
example1_zh: 你能猜出这个小盒子里装着什么吗？
example2_en: Without reliable data, researchers can only guess how changes in transport costs will affect household spending.
example2_zh: 没有可靠的数据，研究人员只能猜测交通费用变化会如何影响家庭支出。
collocations: make a guess｜猜一猜 ; an educated guess｜有依据的猜测 ; guess correctly｜猜对
tip_zh: I guess偏口语，表示“我想、大概”，语气不确定。

meanings_zh: n. 时间表；时刻表；课程表 | v. 为…安排时间
definition_en: A schedule showing when lessons, journeys, or other events happen. | To arrange when an event or activity will happen.
example1_en: I checked the timetable before leaving for the station.
example1_zh: 去车站前，我查看了时刻表。
example2_en: A flexible school timetable can help students balance academic subjects with physical activity and creative learning.
example2_zh: 灵活的学校课程表有助于学生兼顾文化课、体育活动和创造性学习。
collocations: train timetable｜列车时刻表 ; school timetable｜学校课程表 ; a revised timetable｜调整后的时间表
tip_zh: 英式常用timetable；美式常用schedule。

meanings_zh: n. 公主；王妃
definition_en: A king's or queen's daughter, or a prince's wife.
example1_en: The princess waved to the crowd from her carriage.
example1_zh: 公主从马车里向人群挥手。
example2_en: Traditional stories often portray a princess as dependent, whereas modern adaptations increasingly emphasise her independence and leadership.
example2_zh: 传统故事常将公主塑造成依赖他人的形象，而现代改编作品越来越强调她的独立性和领导力。
collocations: a royal princess｜王室公主 ; a fairy-tale princess｜童话公主
tip_zh: 可指君主的女儿，也可指王子的妻子。

meanings_zh: n. 克
definition_en: a unit of mass equal to one thousandth of a kilogram
example1_en: Add one gramme of salt to the soup.
example1_zh: 往汤里加一克盐。
example2_en: Even a single gramme of certain pollutants can harm aquatic life when released into a small pond.
example2_zh: 某些污染物即使只有一克，排入小池塘后也可能危害水生生物。
collocations: a gramme of salt｜一克盐 ; per gramme｜每克 ; weigh in grammes｜以克称重
tip_zh: gramme是英式变体；gram更常用，单位符号为g。

meanings_zh: adj. 能够的 | adj. 能干的；有才干的
definition_en: having the skill, opportunity, or means to do something | skilled and effective at doing things
example1_en: I am finally able to swim across the pool.
example1_zh: 我终于能够游到泳池的另一端了。
example2_en: With reliable internet access, rural students are able to attend courses previously available only in cities.
example2_zh: 有了可靠的互联网接入，农村学生就能参加以前只有城市才提供的课程。
collocations: be able to｜能够 ; an able leader｜能干的领导者 ; an able student｜有才干的学生
tip_zh: 表示能够做某事用be able to do，不用able doing。

meanings_zh: n. 火腿
definition_en: Meat from a pig's leg, preserved by salting or smoking.
example1_en: I put some ham and cheese in my sandwich.
example1_zh: 我在三明治里放了些火腿和奶酪。
example2_en: Processed meats such as ham often contain substantial amounts of salt, which consumers should consider when planning meals.
example2_zh: 火腿等加工肉类通常含盐量较高，消费者安排膳食时应考虑这一点。
collocations: a slice of ham｜一片火腿 ; smoked ham｜烟熏火腿 ; ham sandwich｜火腿三明治
tip_zh: 表示火腿肉通常不可数；一片用a slice of ham。

meanings_zh: n. 垃圾；废弃物 | n. 废话；无价值的东西
definition_en: waste material that people throw away | something considered untrue, useless, or very poor in quality
example1_en: Please take the garbage out before it starts smelling.
example1_zh: 请在垃圾发臭之前把它拿出去。
example2_en: Cities can reduce the amount of garbage sent to landfill by improving recycling facilities and public awareness.
example2_zh: 城市可以通过改善回收设施和提高公众意识，减少运往填埋场的垃圾量。
collocations: take out the garbage｜把垃圾拿出去 ; garbage collection｜垃圾收集 ; a garbage bag｜垃圾袋 ; a garbage can｜垃圾桶
tip_zh: 不可数名词；常见于美式英语，英式多用rubbish。

meanings_zh: n. 清洁工 | n. 清洁剂；清洁器 | adj. 更干净的；更清洁的
definition_en: a person paid to clean buildings or rooms | a substance or device used to remove dirt | having less dirt or causing less pollution
example1_en: The cleaner emptied the bins before the office opened.
example1_zh: 清洁工在办公室开门前清空了垃圾桶。
example2_en: Hospitals should provide every cleaner with suitable protective equipment and training to reduce infection risks.
example2_zh: 医院应为每位清洁工提供合适的防护装备和培训，以降低感染风险。
collocations: office cleaner｜办公室清洁工 ; window cleaner｜窗户清洁工；玻璃清洁剂 ; vacuum cleaner｜吸尘器 ; household cleaner｜家用清洁剂
tip_zh: a cleaner通常指清洁工；cleaner也是clean的比较级。

meanings_zh: n. 个人电脑
definition_en: A computer designed for use by one person.
example1_en: My PC takes ages to start on cold mornings.
example1_zh: 天气寒冷的早晨，我的个人电脑要很久才能启动。
example2_en: Providing each student with a PC may improve access to digital resources, but requires substantial funding.
example2_zh: 为每个学生配备一台个人电脑或许能改善数字资源的获取条件，但需要大量资金。
collocations: desktop PC｜台式个人电脑 ; use a PC｜使用个人电脑 ; PC software｜个人电脑软件
tip_zh: PC是personal computer的缩写；复数为PCs。

meanings_zh: n. 学位 | n. 程度 | n. 度；度数
definition_en: a qualification awarded after completing a university course | the amount or level of something | a unit used to measure temperature or angles
example1_en: My cousin earned a degree in engineering last summer.
example1_zh: 我表姐去年夏天获得了工程学学位。
example2_en: Although a university degree can improve employment prospects, practical experience remains highly valuable in many industries.
example2_zh: 虽然大学学位能改善就业前景，但实践经验在许多行业仍然十分重要。
collocations: a degree in economics｜经济学学位 ; a bachelor's degree｜学士学位 ; to some degree｜在某种程度上 ; degrees Celsius｜摄氏度
tip_zh: 某专业的学位用a degree in；程度义常见to some degree。

meanings_zh: n. 教科书；课本 | adj. 典型的；标准的
definition_en: A book used to study a particular subject. | Showing exactly how something usually happens or should be done.
example1_en: I left my science textbook on the kitchen table.
example1_zh: 我把科学课本落在厨房桌上了。
example2_en: Digital textbooks can reduce school expenses, although some students find printed materials easier to study.
example2_zh: 电子教材可以降低学校开支，不过一些学生觉得纸质材料更便于学习。
collocations: school textbook｜学校教材 ; textbook example｜典型例子 ; textbook publisher｜教材出版商
tip_zh: 作形容词时指典型或标准，如textbook example。

meanings_zh: n. 皮革
definition_en: animal skin treated for making clothes, bags, and other goods
example1_en: Her old leather bag still feels soft and smooth.
example1_zh: 她的旧皮包摸起来仍然柔软光滑。
example2_en: Some consumers avoid leather products because they are concerned about animal welfare and the environmental impact of production.
example2_zh: 一些消费者避免购买皮革制品，因为他们关心动物福利以及生产对环境的影响。
collocations: leather jacket｜皮夹克 ; genuine leather｜真皮 ; leather goods｜皮革制品 ; synthetic leather｜合成革
tip_zh: 通常不可数；leather jacket中名词作定语。

meanings_zh: n. 卡车；载货汽车 | v. 用卡车运输
definition_en: A large road vehicle used for carrying goods. | To transport goods by truck.
example1_en: A truck delivered fresh vegetables to the market this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早晨，一辆卡车把新鲜蔬菜送到了市场。
example2_en: Transporting goods by truck offers flexibility, but rail freight can reduce emissions over longer distances.
example2_zh: 用卡车运输货物较为灵活，但长途铁路货运能减少排放。
collocations: delivery truck｜送货卡车 ; truck driver｜卡车司机 ; truck goods｜用卡车运货
tip_zh: truck常用于美式英语，英式英语常用lorry。

meanings_zh: n. 烤面包机
definition_en: an electrical appliance that heats bread until crisp and brown
example1_en: Two slices of bread popped out of the toaster.
example1_zh: 两片面包从烤面包机里弹了出来。
example2_en: Small appliances such as toasters should be designed for easy repair rather than frequent replacement.
example2_zh: 烤面包机等小型电器的设计应便于维修，而不是让人频繁更换。
collocations: put bread in the toaster｜把面包放进烤面包机 ; two-slice toaster｜双片烤面包机 ; toaster oven｜台式烤箱
tip_zh: toaster是电器；toast指烤面包时不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 酸奶
definition_en: A thick, slightly sour food made by fermenting milk.
example1_en: I mix fresh berries into my yogurt every morning.
example1_zh: 我每天早上都往酸奶里拌入新鲜浆果。
example2_en: Plain yogurt can contribute to a balanced diet by providing protein and calcium without added sugar.
example2_zh: 原味酸奶能提供蛋白质和钙，且不含添加糖，有助于实现均衡饮食。
collocations: plain yogurt｜原味酸奶 ; low-fat yogurt｜低脂酸奶 ; a pot of yogurt｜一小罐酸奶
tip_zh: 英式也常拼作yoghurt；通常不可数，一份可用a yogurt。

meanings_zh: adj. 最近的；不久前的
definition_en: having happened or started a short time ago
example1_en: Have you seen any recent photos of our puppy?
example1_zh: 你看过我们家小狗最近的照片吗？
example2_en: Recent advances in medical technology have improved treatment options for patients living in remote communities.
example2_zh: 医疗技术的近期进步改善了偏远社区患者的治疗选择。
collocations: recent research｜近期研究 ; recent developments｜近期进展 ; in recent years｜近年来
tip_zh: recent是形容词；修饰动作要用recently。

meanings_zh: n. 汉堡包；汉堡肉饼
definition_en: A flat food patty, often served inside a round bread roll
example1_en: I ordered a bean burger with salad for lunch.
example1_zh: 我午餐点了一个豆类汉堡配沙拉。
example2_en: Restaurants can reduce their environmental impact by offering plant-based burgers alongside traditional meat dishes.
example2_zh: 餐馆可以在供应传统肉类菜肴的同时提供植物基汉堡，以减少对环境的影响。
collocations: beef burger｜牛肉汉堡 ; veggie burger｜素食汉堡 ; burger bun｜汉堡面包
tip_zh: burger也可指肉饼本身，并非都以牛肉制成。

meanings_zh: adj. 最近的；最接近的 | adv. 最近地；最接近地
definition_en: Closest in distance, time, or similarity | At the shortest distance from someone or something
example1_en: Could you show me the way to the nearest pharmacy?
example1_zh: 你能告诉我去最近的药店怎么走吗？
example2_en: For many rural residents, the nearest hospital is several hours away, making access to emergency care difficult.
example2_zh: 对许多农村居民而言，最近的医院也有数小时路程，这让急诊医疗服务难以获得。
collocations: nearest hospital｜最近的医院 ; nearest neighbour｜最近的邻居 ; nearest available｜最近可用的 ; to the nearest kilometre｜四舍五入到整公里
tip_zh: near的最高级；作定语时通常用the nearest。

meanings_zh: n. 蜡烛
definition_en: a piece of wax with a central string that burns
example1_en: He lit a candle when the electricity went off.
example1_zh: 停电时，他点了一支蜡烛。
example2_en: Although candles create a pleasant atmosphere, they should never be left burning unattended in homes or public spaces.
example2_zh: 虽然蜡烛能营造宜人的氛围，但在住宅或公共场所，绝不能让其在无人看管时燃烧。
collocations: light a candle｜点蜡烛 ; blow out a candle｜吹灭蜡烛 ; scented candle｜香薰蜡烛
tip_zh: 点蜡烛用light；吹灭用blow out。

meanings_zh: n. 行为；举止 | n. 运行特性；反应方式
definition_en: the way a person or animal acts | the way a substance or system acts under particular conditions
example1_en: The puppy's calm behavior surprised everyone at the park.
example1_zh: 这只小狗安静的表现让公园里的每个人都很惊讶。
example2_en: Schools can encourage responsible behavior by giving students meaningful opportunities to participate in decisions affecting their community.
example2_zh: 学校可以让学生有实质性机会参与影响其社区的决策，以此鼓励负责任的行为。
collocations: good behavior｜良好行为 ; consumer behavior｜消费者行为 ; animal behavior｜动物行为 ; patterns of behavior｜行为模式
tip_zh: 美式拼写；英式为behaviour。通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 工厂
definition_en: A building or group of buildings where goods are manufactured.
example1_en: My aunt works at a factory that makes bicycles.
example1_zh: 我姑姑在一家生产自行车的工厂工作。
example2_en: Governments should require factory owners to reduce harmful emissions without compromising the safety and livelihoods of their workers.
example2_zh: 政府应要求工厂主减少有害排放，同时不损害工人的安全和生计。
collocations: factory worker｜工厂工人 ; factory owner｜工厂主 ; factory production｜工厂生产
tip_zh: 复数为factories；指制造产品的场所。

meanings_zh: adj. 可获得的；可使用的 | adj. 有空的
definition_en: Ready or possible to get, buy, or use. | Not busy and able to meet or help someone.
example1_en: There are still tickets available for the afternoon show.
example1_zh: 下午那场演出的门票还有余票。
example2_en: Affordable housing should be available to all residents, regardless of their income or employment status.
example2_zh: 所有居民都应能获得负担得起的住房，不论其收入或就业状况如何。
collocations: readily available｜容易获得的 ; available to everyone｜人人都可获得的 ; available for use｜可供使用的 ; make something available｜使某物可供使用
tip_zh: available to接使用者；available for接用途。

meanings_zh: v. 但愿；希望 | n. 愿望；心愿 | v. 祝愿
definition_en: To want something, especially something unlikely or not currently true. | A strong desire for something to happen or be true. | To express hope for someone's happiness or success.
example1_en: I wish our flat had a bigger kitchen.
example1_zh: 要是我们的公寓有个更大的厨房就好了。
example2_en: Many residents wish their neighbourhoods had more green spaces where children could play safely and families could relax.
example2_zh: 许多居民希望社区有更多绿地，让孩子能够安全玩耍，让家人能够放松休息。
collocations: make a wish｜许愿 ; wish someone luck｜祝某人好运 ; best wishes｜美好祝愿 ; wish to do something｜希望做某事
tip_zh: wish后用过去式表现在的遗憾；过去完成式表过去的遗憾。

meanings_zh: n. 家具
definition_en: Movable objects such as chairs, tables, and beds in buildings.
example1_en: We moved the furniture to make room for dancing.
example1_zh: 我们挪开家具，腾出地方跳舞。
example2_en: Buying second-hand furniture can lower household expenses while reducing demand for raw materials and limiting waste.
example2_zh: 购买二手家具既能降低家庭开支，也能减少原材料需求和废弃物。
collocations: a piece of furniture｜一件家具 ; wooden furniture｜木制家具 ; second-hand furniture｜二手家具 ; office furniture｜办公家具
tip_zh: 不可数：一件家具说a piece of furniture。

meanings_zh: n. 玫瑰；蔷薇 | v. 上升；增加（rise过去式）
definition_en: a flower with layered petals, often growing on thorny stems | past tense of rise: moved upwards or increased
example1_en: She placed a single rose in a glass vase.
example1_zh: 她把一枝玫瑰插进了玻璃花瓶。
example2_en: Demand for public transport rose sharply after the city introduced cheaper fares and more frequent services.
example2_zh: 该市降低票价并增加班次后，公共交通需求大幅上升。
collocations: a bunch of roses｜一束玫瑰 ; rose petals｜玫瑰花瓣 ; rose sharply｜急剧上升
tip_zh: rose也可作rise的过去式；过去分词是risen。

meanings_zh: n. 按钮 | n. 纽扣 | v. 扣上纽扣
definition_en: A small control you press to operate something | A small object that fastens clothing through a hole | Fasten clothing using buttons
example1_en: Press the green button to start the washing machine.
example1_zh: 按绿色按钮启动洗衣机。
example2_en: Emergency buttons on public transport allow passengers to alert staff quickly when assistance is needed.
example2_zh: 公共交通工具上的紧急按钮让乘客能够在需要帮助时迅速通知工作人员。
collocations: press a button｜按按钮 ; push a button｜按下按钮 ; button up a coat｜扣好外套 ; sew on a button｜缝上纽扣
tip_zh: button up指扣好纽扣；拉链用zip，不用button。

meanings_zh: n. 复活节
definition_en: A Christian festival celebrating Jesus Christ's return to life.
example1_en: We decorated eggs together at the kitchen table for Easter.
example1_zh: 我们一起坐在厨房桌旁，为复活节装饰彩蛋。
example2_en: During Easter, many destinations attract additional visitors through seasonal events, creating temporary employment in the tourism sector.
example2_zh: 复活节期间，许多旅游目的地通过节庆活动吸引更多游客，为旅游业创造临时就业机会。
collocations: Easter Sunday｜复活节星期日 ; Easter eggs｜复活节彩蛋 ; the Easter holidays｜复活节假期
tip_zh: 节日名首字母大写；at Easter指复活节期间。

meanings_zh: n. 岛；岛屿
definition_en: An area of land completely surrounded by water.
example1_en: We took a small boat to the island yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天我们乘小船去了那座岛。
example2_en: Small island communities often depend on tourism, but increasing visitor numbers can threaten fragile coastal environments.
example2_zh: 小岛上的社区往往依赖旅游业，但游客数量的增加可能威胁脆弱的海岸环境。
collocations: remote island｜偏远岛屿 ; tropical island｜热带岛屿 ; island nation｜岛国 ; uninhabited island｜无人岛
tip_zh: s不发音；在岛上用on an island。

meanings_zh: n. 奶油；乳脂 | n. 护肤霜；药膏 | adj. 奶油色的；淡黄色的
definition_en: The thick, fatty part of milk, used in food. | A thick substance applied to skin for protection or treatment. | Having a pale yellowish-white colour.
example1_en: She poured fresh cream over a bowl of strawberries.
example1_zh: 她把新鲜奶油浇在一碗草莓上。
example2_en: Replacing cream with lower-fat ingredients can reduce the energy content of meals without greatly affecting flavour.
example2_zh: 用低脂食材替代奶油，可以降低餐食的热量，而不会明显影响风味。
collocations: whipped cream｜打发奶油 ; face cream｜面霜 ; apply cream｜涂抹乳霜 ; cream walls｜奶油色墙面
tip_zh: cream是奶油或乳霜；cheese才是奶酪。

meanings_zh: adj. 担心的；焦虑的
definition_en: feeling anxious about problems or something that might happen
example1_en: She looked worried when her cat failed to return.
example1_zh: 猫没有回来时，她显得很担心。
example2_en: Many parents are worried about the effects of excessive screen time on their children's sleep.
example2_zh: 许多家长担心过长的屏幕使用时间会影响孩子的睡眠。
collocations: worried about｜担心…… ; deeply worried｜深感忧虑的 ; a worried expression｜担忧的表情
tip_zh: worried形容人担忧；worrying形容事物令人担忧。

meanings_zh: adj. 小心的；谨慎的 | adj. 仔细的；细致的
definition_en: taking care to avoid danger, damage, or mistakes | giving close attention to details
example1_en: Be careful with that bowl; it belonged to Grandma.
example1_zh: 小心拿那个碗，那是奶奶以前用的。
example2_en: Careful planning can help cities expand public transport while keeping construction costs under control.
example2_zh: 周密的规划可以帮助城市扩展公共交通，同时控制建设成本。
collocations: be careful with｜小心对待 ; careful planning｜周密规划 ; careful consideration｜慎重考虑 ; careful analysis｜细致分析
tip_zh: be careful with后接物；be careful to后接动词。

meanings_zh: adj. 错误的；不真实的 | adj. 假的；人造的 | adj. 不真诚的；虚伪的
definition_en: not true or based on facts | made to resemble something real or natural | intended to hide someone's real feelings or intentions
example1_en: That rumour about our neighbour is completely FALSE.
example1_zh: 那条关于我们邻居的传闻完全不实。
example2_en: Claims that all online information is reliable are FALSE, so students should learn to evaluate sources critically.
example2_zh: 声称所有网络信息都可靠是错误的，因此学生应学会批判性地评估信息来源。
collocations: false information｜虚假信息 ; false impression｜错误印象 ; false alarm｜虚惊；误报 ; false teeth｜假牙
tip_zh: false指不真实；fake更强调刻意仿冒。通常写作小写。

meanings_zh: adj. 不寻常的；与众不同的
definition_en: Different from what is common, normal, or expected.
example1_en: This carrot has an unusual shape, like a tiny hand.
example1_zh: 这根胡萝卜的形状很特别，像一只小手。
example2_en: Scientists are investigating unusual weather patterns that may be linked to rising global temperatures.
example2_zh: 科学家正在研究可能与全球气温上升有关的异常天气模式。
collocations: unusual circumstances｜特殊情况 ; an unusual feature｜不寻常的特征 ; highly unusual｜极不寻常的
tip_zh: It is unusual for sb to do表示某人很少这样做。

meanings_zh: n. 应用程序
definition_en: A computer program designed for a particular task.
example1_en: This app reminds me to water my plants every Sunday.
example1_zh: 这个应用程序每周日提醒我给植物浇水。
example2_en: A language learning app can provide affordable practice, although it cannot fully replace interaction with a teacher.
example2_zh: 语言学习应用可以提供价格低廉的练习机会，但无法完全取代与教师的互动。
collocations: download an app｜下载应用程序 ; mobile app｜移动应用 ; install an app｜安装应用程序 ; language learning app｜语言学习应用
tip_zh: app是application的缩写；为可数名词，用an app。

meanings_zh: n. 嘴唇 | n. 边缘；边沿
definition_en: Either fleshy edge of the opening of the mouth. | The projecting edge of a container, opening, or hollow.
example1_en: My lips felt dry after walking in the wind.
example1_zh: 在风中走了一阵后，我觉得嘴唇很干。
example2_en: Clear face coverings can improve communication for people who rely on watching lips to understand speech.
example2_zh: 透明面罩可以帮助那些依靠观察嘴唇来理解话语的人更顺畅地交流。
collocations: upper lip｜上嘴唇 ; dry lips｜干燥的嘴唇 ; bite your lip｜咬嘴唇 ; the lip of a cup｜杯口边缘
tip_zh: 上下嘴唇合称lips；lip也可指容器等的边沿。

meanings_zh: n. 旅游业；观光旅游
definition_en: travel for pleasure and the businesses serving people who travel
example1_en: Tourism brings many visitors to our village each summer.
example1_zh: 每年夏天，旅游业都会为我们村带来许多游客。
example2_en: Sustainable tourism can generate income for local communities while protecting the natural landscapes that attract visitors.
example2_zh: 可持续旅游能为当地社区创造收入，同时保护吸引游客的自然景观。
collocations: sustainable tourism｜可持续旅游 ; mass tourism｜大众旅游 ; domestic tourism｜国内旅游 ; tourism industry｜旅游业
tip_zh: tourism通常不可数；表示一个游客用a tourist。

meanings_zh: n. 袋鼠
definition_en: An Australian mammal with powerful hind legs; females carry pouch young.
example1_en: A young kangaroo peeked out of its mother's pouch.
example1_zh: 一只小袋鼠从妈妈的育儿袋里探出头来。
example2_en: Habitat loss can force kangaroo populations closer to roads, increasing the risk of collisions with vehicles.
example2_zh: 栖息地丧失可能迫使袋鼠种群靠近道路，增加它们与车辆相撞的风险。
collocations: a kangaroo's pouch｜袋鼠的育儿袋 ; red kangaroo｜赤袋鼠 ; kangaroo population｜袋鼠种群
tip_zh: 复数直接加-s：kangaroos；育儿袋叫pouch。

meanings_zh: n. 旅行；行程 | n. 发展历程 | v. 旅行
definition_en: an occasion of travelling from one place to another | a process of personal change or development over time | to travel from one place to another
example1_en: The train journey took us through snowy mountains.
example1_zh: 这趟火车旅程带我们穿过了白雪覆盖的群山。
example2_en: Improved rail services could shorten the daily journey to work and encourage commuters to leave their cars at home.
example2_zh: 改善铁路服务可以缩短每日通勤时间，并鼓励通勤者不开车出门。
collocations: a long journey｜漫长的旅程 ; a return journey｜返程 ; a journey of discovery｜探索之旅 ; make a journey｜进行一次旅行
tip_zh: journey侧重路途；trip常指包含往返的出行。

meanings_zh: n. 手提包；女式手袋
definition_en: A small bag for carrying personal items, typically used by women.
example1_en: She found her keys at the bottom of her handbag.
example1_zh: 她在手提包底部找到了钥匙。
example2_en: Consumers can reduce waste by choosing a durable handbag rather than replacing inexpensive accessories every season.
example2_zh: 消费者可以选择耐用的手提包，而不是每季更换廉价配饰，从而减少浪费。
collocations: a leather handbag｜皮革手提包 ; a shoulder handbag｜单肩手提包 ; carry a handbag｜提着手袋
tip_zh: 美式常用purse指女式手袋；英式purse通常指零钱包。

meanings_zh: n. 樱桃 | n. 樱桃树；樱花树
definition_en: A small round fruit with a stone and usually red skin | A tree grown for its cherries or attractive blossoms
example1_en: He placed a ripe cherry on top of the cake.
example1_zh: 他在蛋糕顶上放了一颗熟透的樱桃。
example2_en: Cherry trees attract visitors during spring, providing seasonal income for rural communities through tourism.
example2_zh: 樱花树在春季吸引游客，通过旅游业为乡村社区带来季节性收入。
collocations: cherry blossom｜樱花 ; cherry tree｜樱桃树；樱花树 ; ripe cherries｜熟透的樱桃
tip_zh: 复数为cherries；果核用stone（英）或pit（美）。

meanings_zh: adj. 沉重的 | adj. 大量的；强烈的 | adj. 繁重的；难以承受的
definition_en: Weighing a lot and often difficult to lift | Greater than usual in amount, strength, or intensity | Demanding considerable effort or causing serious difficulty
example1_en: This suitcase is too heavy for me to lift.
example1_zh: 这个行李箱太重了，我提不起来。
example2_en: Heavy traffic contributes to urban air pollution and increases the time people spend commuting.
example2_zh: 繁忙的交通加剧了城市空气污染，也增加了人们的通勤时间。
collocations: heavy rain｜大雨 ; heavy traffic｜繁忙的交通 ; heavy workload｜繁重的工作量 ; heavy lifting｜搬运重物
tip_zh: 大雨用heavy rain，不用big rain。

meanings_zh: n. 男邮递员
definition_en: a man whose job is to deliver letters and parcels
example1_en: The postman left a parcel beside our front door.
example1_zh: 邮递员把一个包裹放在了我们家门旁。
example2_en: In remote villages, a postman may provide an essential link between residents and public services.
example2_zh: 在偏远村庄，邮递员可能是连接居民与公共服务的重要纽带。
collocations: the local postman｜当地邮递员 ; work as a postman｜当邮递员 ; the postman's round｜邮递员的投递路线
tip_zh: 英式常用；美式常用mail carrier，且不限定性别。

meanings_zh: v. 闲聊；网聊 | n. 闲聊；聊天
definition_en: To talk informally, in person or through electronic messages. | A friendly, informal conversation.
example1_en: We chatted about our weekend while waiting for the bus.
example1_zh: 等公交车时，我们聊起了各自的周末。
example2_en: Community gardens allow neighbours to chat regularly, helping them build stronger relationships and reduce social isolation.
example2_zh: 社区花园让邻居能够经常闲聊，有助于加深彼此的关系，减少社交孤立。
collocations: chat with friends｜和朋友聊天 ; chat about work｜聊工作 ; have a chat｜聊一聊 ; online chat｜在线聊天
tip_zh: chat with人、about话题；过去式chatted双写t。

meanings_zh: v. 疼痛；使受伤 | v. 伤感情；损害 | adj. 受伤的；伤心的
definition_en: To feel pain or cause physical injury. | To cause emotional pain or damage something. | Physically injured or emotionally upset.
example1_en: My ankle still hurts when I climb the stairs.
example1_zh: 我上楼梯时，脚踝还是疼。
example2_en: Cuts to public transport funding may hurt rural communities that depend on buses for essential journeys.
example2_zh: 削减公共交通经费可能损害依赖公交出行办理必要事务的农村社区的利益。
collocations: hurt your back｜伤到背部 ; hurt someone's feelings｜伤害某人的感情 ; get hurt｜受伤
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为 hurt；疼痛部位可作主语。

meanings_zh: adv. 幸运地；幸好
definition_en: Luckily, especially when something bad could have happened.
example1_en: Fortunately, I found my keys before the bus arrived.
example1_zh: 幸好，我在公交车到站前找到了钥匙。
example2_en: Fortunately, improvements in water treatment have helped many communities reduce the spread of preventable diseases.
example2_zh: 幸运的是，水处理技术的改进帮助许多社区减少了可预防疾病的传播。
collocations: fortunately for us｜对我们来说幸运的是 ; fortunately enough｜很幸运 ; fortunately, nobody was hurt｜幸好无人受伤
tip_zh: 常置于句首，后加逗号，评价整件事令人庆幸。

meanings_zh: v. 滚动；使滚动 | v. 卷起；卷成 | n. 一卷；小面包
definition_en: To move or make something move by turning over repeatedly | To form something into a curved or cylindrical shape | Material wound around itself, or a small individual bread
example1_en: The orange rolled off the table and under my chair.
example1_zh: 橙子从桌上滚下来，滚到了我的椅子底下。
example2_en: Workers roll sheets of recycled material into compact bundles to simplify storage and transportation.
example2_zh: 工人把再生材料薄片卷成紧实的捆，以便储存和运输。
collocations: roll down a hill｜滚下山坡 ; roll up your sleeves｜卷起袖子 ; a roll of paper｜一卷纸 ; bread roll｜小圆面包
tip_zh: roll强调翻转滚动；卷起常用roll up。

meanings_zh: n. 四分之一 | n. 季度 | n. 城区；街区
definition_en: One of four equal parts of something. | A period of three months within a year. | An area of a town with a particular character.
example1_en: She cut the sandwich into quarters for the children.
example1_zh: 她把三明治切成四等份给孩子们吃。
example2_en: Almost a quarter of the city's residents depend on public transport for their daily commute.
example2_zh: 这座城市近四分之一的居民依靠公共交通日常通勤。
collocations: a quarter of｜……的四分之一 ; a quarter of an hour｜一刻钟 ; the first quarter｜第一季度 ; the historic quarter｜历史街区
tip_zh: a quarter of an hour是一刻钟；季度也是quarter。

meanings_zh: n. 任务；工作 | v. 给……分派任务
definition_en: A piece of work that needs to be done. | Give someone responsibility for a particular piece of work.
example1_en: My first task today is to water the plants.
example1_zh: 我今天的第一项任务是给植物浇水。
example2_en: Dividing a complex task into smaller stages can help students manage their time more effectively.
example2_zh: 把复杂任务分成较小的阶段，可以帮助学生更有效地管理时间。
collocations: complete a task｜完成任务 ; a challenging task｜有挑战性的任务 ; task someone with doing something｜指派某人做某事
tip_zh: 作动词用task sb with doing sth，表示指派任务。

meanings_zh: n. 建议；忠告
definition_en: suggestions about what someone should do in a particular situation
example1_en: Your advice helped me choose a comfortable bicycle.
example1_zh: 你的建议帮我选到了一辆骑着舒服的自行车。
example2_en: Schools should provide practical career advice so that students can make informed decisions about their future.
example2_zh: 学校应提供实用的职业建议，让学生能够对自己的未来作出明智决定。
collocations: give advice｜提供建议 ; seek advice｜寻求建议 ; follow advice｜听从建议 ; a piece of advice｜一条建议
tip_zh: 不可数，不用an advice；动词advise末尾读/z/。

meanings_zh: adj. 极好的；优秀的
definition_en: Extremely good or of very high quality.
example1_en: The soup was excellent, so I ordered another bowl.
example1_zh: 这汤好喝极了，所以我又点了一碗。
example2_en: Excellent public transport can reduce car dependence and make cities more accessible to all residents.
example2_zh: 优质的公共交通可以减少人们对汽车的依赖，让所有居民出行更便利。
collocations: excellent service｜优质服务 ; excellent results｜优异成绩 ; excellent opportunity｜绝佳机会
tip_zh: 已含“极好”之意，通常不用very修饰。

meanings_zh: v. 沸腾；使煮沸 | v. 用沸水煮 | n. 疖子
definition_en: to reach, or heat liquid until it reaches, bubbling temperature | to cook food in water that is bubbling from heat | a painful swollen lump in the skin containing pus
example1_en: Boil the potatoes until you can pierce them easily.
example1_zh: 把土豆煮到能轻松戳穿为止。
example2_en: Residents should boil drinking water when flooding has damaged local supplies and increased the risk of infection.
example2_zh: 当洪水破坏当地供水并增加感染风险时，居民应将饮用水煮沸。
collocations: boil water｜烧开水 ; boil an egg｜煮鸡蛋 ; bring to the boil｜使煮沸 ; boil down to｜归结为
tip_zh: boil指沸腾或煮沸；simmer指小火慢煮。

meanings_zh: n. 酱；调味汁
definition_en: A liquid or thick mixture added to food for flavour.
example1_en: This tomato sauce tastes lovely with fresh pasta.
example1_zh: 这种番茄酱汁配新鲜意面很好吃。
example2_en: Preparing sauce at home allows families to control the amount of salt and sugar in their meals.
example2_zh: 在家制作酱汁，能让家庭控制饭菜中的盐和糖含量。
collocations: tomato sauce｜番茄酱汁 ; soy sauce｜酱油 ; pasta sauce｜意面酱 ; a rich sauce｜浓郁的酱汁
tip_zh: sauce泛指酱汁；酱油应说soy sauce。

meanings_zh: n. 上唇胡须；小胡子
definition_en: Hair growing above the upper lip.
example1_en: My uncle carefully trims his moustache every Sunday.
example1_zh: 我叔叔每个星期天都会仔细修剪他的小胡子。
example2_en: In historical portraits, a carefully styled moustache often reflected contemporary ideas about fashion and social status.
example2_zh: 在历史肖像画中，精心打理的小胡子往往反映了当时关于时尚和社会地位的观念。
collocations: grow a moustache｜留小胡子 ; trim a moustache｜修剪小胡子 ; a thick moustache｜浓密的小胡子
tip_zh: moustache指上唇胡须；beard指下巴等处的胡须。

meanings_zh: n. 制服；校服 | adj. 一致的；均匀的
definition_en: Special clothing worn by members of a particular group. | Remaining the same in form, quality, or amount.
example1_en: My school uniform is still drying by the window.
example1_zh: 我的校服还在窗边晾着。
example2_en: Uniform safety standards across all factories can help protect workers and improve overall working conditions.
example2_zh: 所有工厂实行统一的安全标准，有助于保护工人并改善整体工作条件。
collocations: school uniform｜校服 ; wear a uniform｜穿制服 ; uniform standards｜统一标准 ; uniform distribution｜均匀分布
tip_zh: 开头是辅音/j/，所以说a uniform，不用an。

meanings_zh: n. 指示；操作说明 | n. 命令；指令 | n. 指导；教学
definition_en: Information explaining what to do or how to do something | An order telling someone what they must do | The activity of teaching someone a skill or subject
example1_en: The instructor gave one clear instruction: hold the rope tightly.
example1_zh: 教练给出了一条明确指示：紧紧抓住绳子。
example2_en: Students often benefit from practical instruction that connects classroom theory with everyday problems.
example2_zh: 将课堂理论与日常问题联系起来的实践教学往往能让学生受益。
collocations: follow instructions｜遵照指示 ; step-by-step instructions｜逐步操作说明 ; give instructions｜发出指示 ; practical instruction｜实践指导
tip_zh: 操作说明常用复数instructions；表示教学时不可数。

meanings_zh: v. 下载 | n. 下载；下载的文件
definition_en: to copy data from the internet onto your device | the act of downloading, or a file obtained this way
example1_en: Download the map before you leave the hotel tomorrow.
example1_zh: 明天离开酒店前，先把地图下载好。
example2_en: Students can download course materials at home, allowing them to study even when internet access is unavailable.
example2_zh: 学生可以在家下载课程资料，这样即使无法联网也能学习。
collocations: download a file｜下载文件 ; download an app｜下载应用 ; free download｜免费下载 ; download speed｜下载速度
tip_zh: 动词重音在后，名词重音在前；反义词是upload。

meanings_zh: adj. 害怕的；受惊的
definition_en: Feeling afraid because of danger or something unexpected.
example1_en: The frightened kitten hid behind the sofa during the storm.
example1_zh: 暴风雨中，受惊的小猫躲到了沙发后面。
example2_en: Children who feel frightened in unfamiliar environments may benefit from patient support and predictable routines.
example2_zh: 在陌生环境中感到害怕的儿童，可能会从耐心的支持和规律的日常安排中受益。
collocations: frightened of｜害怕…… ; frightened to death｜吓得要命 ; a frightened child｜受惊的孩子
tip_zh: frightened形容感到害怕；frightening形容令人害怕。

meanings_zh: n. 姓；姓氏
definition_en: the name shared by members of a family
example1_en: My surname is often difficult for strangers to pronounce.
example1_zh: 陌生人常常觉得我的姓很难念。
example2_en: Naming traditions vary across cultures, and a person's surname may reflect family history or regional origins.
example2_zh: 不同文化的命名传统各不相同，一个人的姓氏可能反映其家族历史或地域来源。
collocations: family surname｜家族姓氏 ; common surname｜常见姓氏 ; change your surname｜更改姓氏
tip_zh: surname指姓，given name指名；姓不一定在最后。

meanings_zh: n. 记忆力；记忆 | n. 回忆 | n. 计算机内存
definition_en: the ability to store and recall information or experiences | something from the past that you remember | the part of a computer that stores information
example1_en: My grandmother has an excellent memory for faces.
example1_zh: 我奶奶特别善于记住别人的长相。
example2_en: Regular physical exercise may improve memory and help older adults maintain their independence for longer.
example2_zh: 经常锻炼可能改善记忆力，帮助老年人更长久地保持独立生活的能力。
collocations: short-term memory｜短期记忆 ; childhood memories｜童年回忆 ; from memory｜凭记忆 ; computer memory｜计算机内存
tip_zh: 记忆力通常不可数；一段段回忆用memories。

meanings_zh: n. 枕头
definition_en: A soft support for your head when resting or sleeping.
example1_en: She placed a fresh pillow on the guest bed.
example1_zh: 她在客床上放了一个干净的枕头。
example2_en: Choosing a supportive pillow may improve sleep quality by helping maintain a comfortable neck position.
example2_zh: 选择支撑性好的枕头，有助于保持舒适的颈部姿势，从而可能改善睡眠质量。
collocations: soft pillow｜柔软的枕头 ; feather pillow｜羽毛枕 ; pillow cover｜枕套
tip_zh: pillow主要用于睡觉；cushion多指靠垫或坐垫。

meanings_zh: n. 计算机程序 | v. 编写程序；设定运行 | n. 计划；课程；节目
definition_en: A set of instructions that tells a computer what to do. | Write computer instructions or set a machine to operate automatically. | An organised plan, course of activities, or broadcast show.
example1_en: This program helps me organise all my holiday photos.
example1_zh: 这个程序帮我整理所有度假照片。
example2_en: Schools should teach students how to program computers rather than simply how to use existing software.
example2_zh: 学校应教学生如何给计算机编程，而不只是如何使用现有软件。
