collocations: computer program｜计算机程序 ; run a program｜运行程序 ; program a computer｜给计算机编程 ; training program｜培训计划
tip_zh: 英式计算机程序用program；计划、节目用programme。

meanings_zh: n. 迹象；征兆 | n. 标牌；符号；手势 | v. 签名；签署
definition_en: Something indicating that a condition exists or may develop | An object, mark, or gesture that communicates information | Write your name to identify yourself or show agreement
example1_en: Those dark clouds are a sign of approaching rain.
example1_zh: 那些乌云预示着雨就要来了。
example2_en: A decline in local wildlife may be a sign of wider environmental damage caused by urban expansion.
example2_zh: 当地野生动物数量下降可能意味着城市扩张造成了更广泛的环境破坏。
collocations: a sign of improvement｜好转的迹象 ; warning signs｜警示信号 ; a road sign｜道路标牌 ; sign a contract｜签署合同
tip_zh: sign中的g不发音；a sign of后接名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: prep. 每；每一
definition_en: For each unit of something.
example1_en: The swimming pool costs five pounds per visit.
example1_zh: 这个游泳池每次收费五英镑。
example2_en: Reducing energy consumption per household is an important step towards lowering a country's carbon emissions.
example2_zh: 减少每户家庭的能源消耗是降低一个国家碳排放的重要一步。
collocations: per person｜每人 ; per hour｜每小时 ; per capita｜人均 ; per year｜每年
tip_zh: per后通常接单数名词，不加冠词，如per day。

meanings_zh: n. 化学 | n. 化学组成与变化 | n. 默契；相互吸引
definition_en: the science of substances and how they react | the chemical properties and processes of a substance | a natural connection or attraction between people
example1_en: We mixed two clear liquids in chemistry class today.
example1_zh: 今天化学课上，我们把两种透明液体混合在一起。
example2_en: Understanding the chemistry of seawater helps scientists explain how rising carbon emissions affect marine life.
example2_zh: 了解海水的化学特性有助于科学家解释碳排放增加如何影响海洋生物。
collocations: organic chemistry｜有机化学 ; study chemistry｜学习化学 ; soil chemistry｜土壤化学
tip_zh: 学科名通常不可数：study chemistry，不加a。

meanings_zh: v. 悬挂；吊着 | v. 垂下；低垂
definition_en: attach something above the ground, or remain suspended | fall or bend downwards loosely
example1_en: Please hang your wet coat beside the front door.
example1_zh: 请把你的湿外套挂在前门旁边。
example2_en: Museums often hang paintings at different heights to make their collections accessible to visitors of all ages.
example2_zh: 博物馆常将画作挂在不同高度，方便各年龄段的参观者欣赏馆藏。
collocations: hang a picture｜挂画 ; hang on a wall｜挂在墙上 ; hang your head｜垂下头 ; hang out the washing｜晾衣服
tip_zh: 悬挂的过去式、过去分词均为hung；绞死则用hanged。

meanings_zh: adv. 尤其；特别
definition_en: more than usual, or more than other people or things
example1_en: I enjoy cooking, especially when friends come for dinner.
example1_zh: 我喜欢做饭，尤其是在朋友来吃晚饭的时候。
example2_en: Reliable public transport is especially important for residents who cannot afford to own a car.
example2_zh: 对于买不起汽车的居民来说，可靠的公共交通尤其重要。
collocations: especially important｜尤其重要 ; especially useful｜特别有用 ; especially for｜尤其是对
tip_zh: especially强调“尤其”；specially常指“专门地”。

meanings_zh: n. 乡村；农村地区
definition_en: land outside towns and cities, including fields, woods, and farms
example1_en: We spent the weekend cycling through the quiet countryside.
example1_zh: 我们周末在宁静的乡间骑车游玩。
example2_en: Reliable public transport in the countryside can improve access to employment and reduce rural residents' dependence on cars.
example2_zh: 乡村地区可靠的公共交通可以改善就业机会的可及性，并减少农村居民对汽车的依赖。
collocations: in the countryside｜在乡下 ; surrounding countryside｜周边乡村 ; unspoilt countryside｜未受破坏的乡村 ; protect the countryside｜保护乡村环境
tip_zh: 通常不可数，常说the countryside，不说a countryside。

meanings_zh: n. 健康；身体状况 | n. 良好状况；兴旺
definition_en: The condition of someone's body and mind. | How well an organisation, economy, or system is functioning.
example1_en: Walking to work has really improved my health.
example1_zh: 步行上班确实改善了我的健康状况。
example2_en: Governments can improve public health by providing safe drinking water and affordable access to medical services.
example2_zh: 政府可以通过提供安全饮用水和可负担的医疗服务来改善公众健康。
collocations: mental health｜心理健康 ; public health｜公共卫生 ; in good health｜身体健康 ; economic health｜经济运行状况
tip_zh: 通常不可数；表示身体健康用in good health。

meanings_zh: adj. 可移动的；流动的 | adj. 移动通信的 | n. 手机
definition_en: able to move or be moved easily between places | relating to phones or services used while away from home | a telephone you can carry and use almost anywhere
example1_en: The mobile library visits our village every Friday morning.
example1_zh: 流动图书馆每周五早晨来我们村。
example2_en: Mobile clinics can improve access to basic healthcare for people living in remote rural communities.
example2_zh: 流动诊所可以让偏远农村社区的居民更容易获得基本医疗服务。
collocations: mobile phone｜手机 ; mobile clinic｜流动诊所 ; mobile workforce｜流动劳动力 ; mobile network｜移动通信网络
tip_zh: 英式英语常用a mobile指手机；美式常说a cell phone。

meanings_zh: n. 叶子（leaf的复数） | v. 离开；留下
definition_en: The usually flat, green parts of plants. | Goes away from somewhere, or lets something remain.
example1_en: Golden leaves covered the path outside our house.
example1_zh: 金黄色的落叶铺满了我们家门外的小路。
example2_en: Fallen leaves provide habitats for small organisms and return valuable nutrients to the soil as they decompose.
example2_zh: 落叶为小型生物提供栖息地，并在分解时将宝贵的养分归还土壤。
collocations: fallen leaves｜落叶 ; green leaves｜绿叶 ; autumn leaves｜秋叶 ; rake leaves｜耙落叶
tip_zh: 既是leaf的复数，也是leave的第三人称单数形式。

meanings_zh: adj. 极好的；棒极了的 | adv. 非常；特别
definition_en: Extremely good or enjoyable, used informally. | Very or extremely, used informally before adjectives or adverbs.
example1_en: We had a super afternoon playing games in the garden.
example1_zh: 我们在花园里玩游戏，度过了一个特别愉快的下午。
example2_en: Although users may describe an app as super helpful, researchers need objective evidence to assess its educational value.
example2_zh: 尽管用户可能形容某款应用特别有帮助，研究人员仍需客观证据来评估其教育价值。
collocations: a super idea｜很棒的主意 ; super helpful｜特别有帮助的 ; super easy｜非常容易的
tip_zh: 口语色彩强；正式写作宜用excellent或very。

meanings_zh: n. 决定；抉择
definition_en: a choice made after considering different possibilities
example1_en: Moving closer to work was a good decision.
example1_zh: 搬到离工作地点更近的地方是个明智的决定。
example2_en: Governments should base every major transport decision on reliable evidence and consultation with the communities affected.
example2_zh: 政府的每项重大交通决策都应以可靠证据及与受影响社区的协商为基础。
collocations: make a decision｜作出决定 ; reach a decision｜达成决定 ; informed decision｜基于充分了解的决定 ; final decision｜最终决定
tip_zh: 作决定用make a decision，不用do。

meanings_zh: n. 热；高温 | v. 加热；变热 | n. 预赛
definition_en: warmth or a high temperature | to make or become warmer | a race that decides who enters the next round
example1_en: We rested under a tree to escape the heat.
example1_zh: 我们在树下休息，躲避酷热。
example2_en: Cities can reduce extreme heat by planting trees and replacing dark surfaces with materials that reflect sunlight.
example2_zh: 城市可以通过植树以及用反射阳光的材料替换深色表面来缓解酷热。
collocations: extreme heat｜酷热 ; heat loss｜热量流失 ; heat up food｜加热食物 ; a qualifying heat｜一场预赛
tip_zh: heat作名词指热，hot作形容词指热的。

meanings_zh: n. 午餐时间
definition_en: The time around the middle of the day when people eat.
example1_en: At lunchtime, we sat outside and shared some sandwiches.
example1_zh: 午餐时，我们坐在外面分着吃了一些三明治。
example2_en: Providing quiet spaces at lunchtime may help employees relax and return to work with greater focus.
example2_zh: 在午餐时间提供安静的空间，可能有助于员工放松，并在重返工作时更加专注。
collocations: at lunchtime｜在午餐时间 ; a lunchtime walk｜午餐时段的散步 ; a lunchtime break｜午间休息
tip_zh: 表示“在午餐时间”通常用at lunchtime。

meanings_zh: n. 获胜者；优胜者 | n. 成功的人或事物；受益者
definition_en: a person or team that wins a competition | someone or something successful or benefiting from a situation
example1_en: The winner lifted her trophy as the crowd cheered.
example1_zh: 获胜者举起奖杯，人群欢呼起来。
example2_en: Consumers may be the main winners when greater competition encourages companies to lower prices and improve services.
example2_zh: 当更激烈的竞争促使企业降价并改善服务时，消费者可能成为主要受益者。
collocations: a prize winner｜获奖者 ; the overall winner｜总冠军 ; a clear winner｜明显的赢家
tip_zh: winner 指获胜者；winning 可作形容词修饰队伍。

meanings_zh: n. 数学
definition_en: The study of quantities, shapes, patterns, and their relationships.
example1_en: She enjoys mathematics, especially solving puzzles about shapes.
example1_zh: 她喜欢数学，尤其喜欢解与图形有关的谜题。
example2_en: A strong foundation in mathematics enables students to interpret data and evaluate claims in everyday life.
example2_zh: 扎实的数学基础使学生能够解读数据，并评估日常生活中的各种说法。
collocations: applied mathematics｜应用数学 ; pure mathematics｜纯数学 ; mathematics teacher｜数学教师
tip_zh: 虽以s结尾，作学科名用单数谓语；英式简称maths。

meanings_zh: adj. 埃及的；埃及人的 | n. 埃及人
definition_en: relating to Egypt, its people, or its culture | a person from Egypt
example1_en: We admired Egyptian pottery at the museum yesterday.
example1_zh: 我们昨天在博物馆欣赏了埃及陶器。
example2_en: Ancient Egyptian irrigation systems demonstrate how communities adapted farming practices to seasonal changes in river levels.
example2_zh: 古埃及的灌溉系统展示了当地居民如何调整耕作方式，以适应河流水位的季节性变化。
collocations: ancient Egyptian civilisation｜古埃及文明 ; Egyptian art｜埃及艺术 ; Egyptian cotton｜埃及棉
tip_zh: 首字母须大写；指多名埃及人时用 Egyptians。

meanings_zh: n. 恐惧；担忧 | v. 害怕；担心
definition_en: An unpleasant feeling about danger or something bad happening. | To feel afraid or worried about someone or something.
example1_en: She held my hand because of her fear of heights.
example1_zh: 她因为恐高而握住了我的手。
example2_en: Fear of failure may prevent students from asking questions, especially in highly competitive learning environments.
example2_zh: 对失败的恐惧可能使学生不敢提问，在竞争激烈的学习环境中尤其如此。
collocations: fear of heights｜恐高 ; overcome a fear｜克服恐惧 ; fear for someone's safety｜担心某人的安全 ; for fear of｜唯恐；生怕
tip_zh: fear sth是害怕某事；fear for sb是为某人担忧。

meanings_zh: v. 更喜欢；宁愿
definition_en: To like or choose something more than another option.
example1_en: I prefer fresh fruit to cake after dinner.
example1_zh: 晚饭后，比起蛋糕，我更喜欢吃新鲜水果。
example2_en: Some employees prefer working from home because it offers greater flexibility and eliminates daily commuting.
example2_zh: 一些员工更喜欢居家办公，因为这样更灵活，也免去了每天通勤。
collocations: prefer A to B｜比起B更喜欢A ; prefer to do｜更愿意做 ; would prefer｜宁愿；更想
tip_zh: 用prefer A to B；过去式preferred双写r。

meanings_zh: n. 黄瓜
definition_en: A long vegetable with green skin and crisp, watery flesh.
example1_en: She sliced a cucumber and added it to the salad.
example1_zh: 她把一根黄瓜切成片，加入沙拉。
example2_en: Growing cucumbers in greenhouses can provide a reliable food supply, but heating these structures requires energy.
example2_zh: 在温室中种植黄瓜可以提供稳定的食物供应，但为这些设施供暖需要消耗能源。
collocations: sliced cucumber｜黄瓜片 ; cucumber salad｜黄瓜沙拉 ; as cool as a cucumber｜非常镇定
tip_zh: 通常可数：a cucumber；表示食材时也可不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 无线网络；无线联网技术
definition_en: Technology connecting devices to a network without cables.
example1_en: The café offers free wifi near the window seats.
example1_zh: 这家咖啡馆靠窗的座位附近有免费无线网络。
example2_en: Providing reliable public wifi can help residents access essential services and participate in online learning.
example2_zh: 提供可靠的公共无线网络，有助于居民使用基本服务并参与在线学习。
collocations: free wifi｜免费无线网络 ; wifi connection｜无线网络连接 ; wifi password｜无线网络密码 ; wifi signal｜无线网络信号
tip_zh: 常规范写作Wi-Fi；通常不可数，不加a。

meanings_zh: n. 美；美丽 | n. 妙处；优点
definition_en: The quality of being pleasing to see, hear, or experience. | A particularly useful or attractive feature of something.
example1_en: We stopped to admire the beauty of the lake.
example1_zh: 我们停下来欣赏湖泊的美景。
example2_en: Protecting the natural beauty of coastal areas can support tourism while preserving valuable habitats for wildlife.
example2_zh: 保护沿海地区的自然美景既能促进旅游业，也能保全珍贵的野生动物栖息地。
collocations: natural beauty｜自然美 ; outstanding beauty｜非凡的美 ; the beauty of something｜某事物的妙处
tip_zh: 表示“美”通常不可数；the beauty of也指妙处。

meanings_zh: adj. 附近的；邻近的 | adv. 在附近；不远处
definition_en: located a short distance away | at or to a place a short distance away
example1_en: We bought fresh bread from a nearby bakery.
example1_zh: 我们从附近的一家面包店买了新鲜面包。
example2_en: Access to nearby parks encourages urban residents to exercise regularly and spend more time outdoors.
example2_zh: 附近有方便前往的公园，能鼓励城市居民经常锻炼，并增加户外活动时间。
collocations: a nearby park｜附近的公园 ; nearby residents｜附近居民 ; live nearby｜住在附近
tip_zh: nearby不用作介词：说near the school，不说nearby the school。

meanings_zh: n. 费用；成本 | v. 价钱为；使花费 | n. 代价；损失
definition_en: the money needed to buy or do something | to require a particular amount of money | something valuable lost to achieve or obtain something
example1_en: The cost of our weekly groceries keeps rising.
example1_zh: 我们每周购买食品杂货的费用不断上涨。
example2_en: Improving public transport can reduce the cost of commuting and make cities more accessible.
example2_zh: 改善公共交通可以降低通勤成本，并让城市出行更加便利。
collocations: the cost of living｜生活成本 ; cover the cost｜支付费用 ; at all costs｜不惜一切代价 ; cost a fortune｜花一大笔钱
tip_zh: 表示花费时，过去式和过去分词均为cost。

meanings_zh: n. 帐篷
definition_en: a portable fabric shelter supported by poles and ropes
example1_en: We pitched our tent beside a quiet lake.
example1_zh: 我们在一个宁静的湖边搭起帐篷。
example2_en: Visitors who sleep in a tent should follow campsite rules to minimise their impact on local wildlife.
example2_zh: 住帐篷的游客应遵守营地规定，尽量减少对当地野生动物的影响。
collocations: pitch a tent｜搭帐篷 ; put up a tent｜搭起帐篷 ; take down a tent｜拆帐篷 ; camping tent｜露营帐篷
tip_zh: “搭帐篷”用pitch或put up a tent。

meanings_zh: det. 谁的；其…的 | pron. 谁的东西
definition_en: used before a noun to ask or show who owns something | used to ask who something belongs to
example1_en: Whose umbrella is dripping water all over the floor?
example1_zh: 谁的雨伞把水滴得满地都是？
example2_en: Children whose parents read regularly at home may develop a stronger interest in books.
example2_zh: 父母经常在家阅读的孩子可能会对书籍产生更浓厚的兴趣。
collocations: whose turn｜轮到谁 ; whose idea｜谁的主意 ; whose responsibility｜谁的责任
tip_zh: whose表示所属；who’s是who is或who has的缩写。

meanings_zh: n. 培根；腌熏猪肉
definition_en: salted or smoked pork, usually served in thin slices
example1_en: He cooked bacon and eggs for breakfast on Sunday.
example1_zh: 星期天，他做了培根和鸡蛋当早餐。
example2_en: Reducing consumption of processed meat, including bacon, is often recommended as part of a healthier diet.
example2_zh: 减少包括培根在内的加工肉类摄入，常被建议作为更健康饮食的一部分。
collocations: a slice of bacon｜一片培根 ; crispy bacon｜香脆培根 ; bacon and eggs｜培根配鸡蛋
tip_zh: 通常不可数；一片培根用a slice of bacon。

meanings_zh: adv. 快乐地；高兴地 | adv. 乐意地 | adv. 幸好；幸运地
definition_en: In a way that shows pleasure or enjoyment. | Willingly and without objection. | With a fortunate or pleasing result.
example1_en: The children chatted happily while making sandwiches together.
example1_zh: 孩子们一起做三明治，开心地聊着天。
example2_en: Many residents would happily use public transport if services were more reliable and affordable.
example2_zh: 如果公共交通服务更可靠、价格更实惠，许多居民都会乐意乘坐。
collocations: smile happily｜开心地微笑 ; happily married｜婚姻幸福的 ; happily agree｜欣然同意
tip_zh: 句首Happily可表“幸好”，不只表示开心。

meanings_zh: n. 大脑；脑 | n. 智力；头脑
definition_en: The organ inside your head controlling thought and bodily activity. | The ability to think clearly and understand things.
example1_en: A helmet helps protect your brain if you fall.
example1_zh: 跌倒时，头盔有助于保护你的大脑。
example2_en: Adequate sleep supports healthy brain function and helps learners remember information more effectively.
example2_zh: 充足的睡眠有助于大脑正常运作，并帮助学习者更有效地记忆信息。
collocations: brain function｜大脑功能 ; brain damage｜脑损伤 ; use your brain｜动动脑筋
tip_zh: 表示智力时常用复数brains；器官用brain。

meanings_zh: adj. 拥挤的；挤满的
definition_en: Containing so many people or things that little space remains
example1_en: The bus was so crowded that we stood all the way.
example1_zh: 公交车太拥挤了，我们一路都站着。
example2_en: Crowded urban neighbourhoods need accessible parks where residents can exercise and enjoy some personal space.
example2_zh: 拥挤的城市社区需要方便到达的公园，让居民能够锻炼并享有一些个人空间。
collocations: crowded bus｜拥挤的公交车 ; crowded with people｜挤满人的 ; crowded streets｜拥挤的街道
tip_zh: be crowded with 表示“挤满……”。

meanings_zh: v. 承诺；答应 | n. 承诺；诺言 | n. 潜力；前景
definition_en: to say firmly that you will do something | a firm statement that you will do something | signs that someone or something may succeed
example1_en: I promise to return your bicycle before dinner.
example1_zh: 我保证晚饭前把自行车还给你。
example2_en: Although renewable technologies show considerable promise, further investment is needed to make them widely affordable.
example2_zh: 虽然可再生能源技术展现出巨大潜力，但仍需进一步投资，使其价格能被大众接受。
collocations: keep a promise｜信守承诺 ; break a promise｜违背诺言 ; promise to do something｜承诺做某事 ; show promise｜展现潜力
tip_zh: 用promise to do，不用promise doing。

meanings_zh: adj. 不快乐的；难过的 | adj. 不满意的
definition_en: Feeling sad or lacking happiness | Not satisfied with someone or something
example1_en: He looked unhappy when the picnic was cancelled.
example1_zh: 野餐取消后，他显得很不开心。
example2_en: Residents are unhappy with the proposed road expansion because it would remove valuable green space.
example2_zh: 居民对拟议中的道路扩建不满意，因为它会占用宝贵的绿地。
collocations: feel unhappy｜感到不快乐 ; unhappy with the service｜对服务不满意 ; an unhappy childhood｜不快乐的童年
tip_zh: unhappy with常表示“对……不满意”。

meanings_zh: n. 事情；问题 | v. 要紧；有关系 | n. 物质
definition_en: a subject, situation or problem needing thought or attention | to be important or make a difference | physical substance that occupies space and has mass
example1_en: We can discuss this matter after lunch today.
example1_zh: 我们可以今天午饭后讨论这件事。
example2_en: The quality of teaching matters more than expensive equipment when schools aim to improve student achievement.
example2_zh: 学校若想提高学生成绩，教学质量比昂贵的设备更重要。
collocations: a serious matter｜严重的问题 ; a matter of time｜时间问题 ; organic matter｜有机物 ; it doesn't matter｜没关系
tip_zh: 指事情时通常可数；指物质时不可数；作动词表示要紧。

meanings_zh: n. 阳光 | n. 欢乐；带来快乐的人或事
definition_en: light and warmth coming from the sun | happiness, or someone or something that brings happiness
example1_en: We ate our breakfast outside in the warm sunshine.
example1_zh: 我们在外面温暖的阳光下吃了早餐。
example2_en: Access to parks and sunshine can improve residents' wellbeing, especially in densely populated urban areas.
example2_zh: 能够享用公园和阳光可以改善居民的身心健康，在人口密集的城市地区尤其如此。
collocations: bright sunshine｜明媚的阳光 ; in the sunshine｜在阳光下 ; hours of sunshine｜日照时长 ; a ray of sunshine｜带来快乐的人或事
tip_zh: sunshine通常不可数；表示晴天可说a sunny day。

meanings_zh: n. 工程师 | v. 设计制造；策划促成
definition_en: Someone who designs or builds machines, structures, or technical systems. | To design something technical or skilfully arrange an outcome.
example1_en: An engineer checked the bridge before it opened.
example1_zh: 一位工程师在桥梁通车前进行了检查。
example2_en: Engineers can reduce urban energy consumption by designing buildings that require less heating and cooling.
example2_zh: 工程师可以通过设计供暖和制冷需求更低的建筑来减少城市能源消耗。
collocations: civil engineer｜土木工程师 ; software engineer｜软件工程师 ; engineer a solution｜精心设计解决方案
tip_zh: engineer也可作动词，表示设计或策划促成。

meanings_zh: n. 中午；正午
definition_en: the middle of the day, around twelve o'clock
example1_en: We stopped for a picnic beside the lake at midday.
example1_zh: 中午，我们停下来在湖边野餐。
example2_en: Outdoor workers should avoid direct sunlight around midday to reduce the risk of heat exhaustion.
example2_zh: 户外工作者应避免在中午前后受到阳光直射，以降低热衰竭的风险。
collocations: at midday｜在中午 ; around midday｜中午前后 ; the midday sun｜正午的阳光
tip_zh: 时间前用at；也可置于名词前，如midday sun。

meanings_zh: n. 书架；书橱中的搁板
definition_en: a shelf used for storing books
example1_en: She placed her favourite novel on the wooden bookshelf.
example1_zh: 她把最喜欢的小说放到了木书架上。
example2_en: A well-stocked bookshelf in every classroom can encourage children to explore subjects beyond the school curriculum.
example2_zh: 每间教室都配备藏书丰富的书架，可以鼓励孩子探索学校课程以外的主题。
collocations: a wooden bookshelf｜木书架 ; on the bookshelf｜在书架上 ; a well-stocked bookshelf｜藏书丰富的书架
tip_zh: 复数为bookshelves，注意把f变为ves。

meanings_zh: adj. 好看的；有魅力的 | adj. 有吸引力的
definition_en: Pleasant to look at | Having qualities that make people interested in choosing something
example1_en: The garden looks especially attractive when the roses bloom.
example1_zh: 玫瑰盛开时，这座花园显得格外美丽。
example2_en: Flexible working hours make teaching a more attractive career option for some university graduates.
example2_zh: 灵活的工作时间让教师职业对一些大学毕业生更具吸引力。
collocations: an attractive appearance｜好看的外表 ; an attractive salary｜诱人的薪资 ; an attractive option｜有吸引力的选择 ; attractive to visitors｜吸引游客的
tip_zh: 既可形容外表好看，也可形容方案、薪资诱人。

meanings_zh: n. 观点；看法 | n. 景色；视野 | v. 看待；观看
definition_en: An opinion or belief about something. | What you can see from a particular place. | To consider something in a particular way, or look at it.
example1_en: My view is that we should leave earlier.
example1_zh: 我的看法是我们应该早点出发。
example2_en: Many residents view investment in public transport as an effective way to reduce urban pollution.
example2_zh: 许多居民认为，投资公共交通是减少城市污染的有效方式。
collocations: express a view｜表达观点 ; in my view｜在我看来 ; a sea view｜海景 ; view something as｜将某事视为
tip_zh: 观点用view on；把某事视为用view…as…。

meanings_zh: adv. 终于 | adv. 最后
definition_en: After a long wait, delay, or effort. | Used to introduce the last point or action.
example1_en: After searching all morning, I finally found my keys.
example1_zh: 找了一上午后，我终于找到了钥匙。
example2_en: Finally, governments should invest in reliable public transport to reduce traffic congestion and urban air pollution.
example2_zh: 最后，政府应投资建设可靠的公共交通，以缓解交通拥堵和城市空气污染。
collocations: finally arrive｜终于到达 ; finally succeed｜终于成功 ; finally agree｜终于同意
tip_zh: 表示终于常置于实义动词前；引出最后一点常置句首。

meanings_zh: n. 玩偶；洋娃娃
definition_en: A toy shaped like a person.
example1_en: My little cousin tucked her doll into a tiny bed.
example1_zh: 我的小表妹把她的洋娃娃安顿在一张小床上。
example2_en: Playing with dolls can help young children develop communication skills and explore different social roles.
example2_zh: 玩玩偶可以帮助幼儿培养沟通能力，并探索不同的社会角色。
collocations: a rag doll｜布娃娃 ; play with dolls｜玩玩偶 ; a doll's house｜玩偶屋
tip_zh: 通常指人形玩具；用来称呼女性可能显得轻慢。

meanings_zh: n. 借口；辩解理由 | v. 原谅；宽恕 | v. 准许免做；准许离开
definition_en: a reason given to explain or defend a fault | forgive someone for a mistake or impolite behaviour | allow someone to avoid a duty or leave
example1_en: He made an excuse for arriving late to dinner.
example1_zh: 他为晚餐迟到找了个借口。
example2_en: Limited funding should not become an excuse for neglecting essential maintenance in schools and public hospitals.
example2_zh: 资金有限不应成为忽视学校和公立医院必要维护工作的借口。
collocations: make an excuse｜找借口 ; an excuse for｜为……找的借口 ; excuse me｜劳驾；对不起 ; excuse someone from｜准许某人免于
tip_zh: 名词末尾读/s/，动词读/z/；excuse me常用于礼貌打断。

meanings_zh: adj. 厚的；粗的 | adj. 浓密的；浓重的 | adj. 黏稠的
definition_en: having a large distance between opposite surfaces | having many things close together or being difficult to see through | flowing slowly rather than easily, like heavy cream
example1_en: She wrapped a thick blanket around her cold shoulders.
example1_zh: 她把一条厚毯子裹在冰冷的肩膀上。
example2_en: Thick layers of insulation can reduce heat loss and lower household energy bills during winter.
example2_zh: 厚厚的隔热层可以减少热量流失，降低冬季家庭能源开支。
collocations: thick fog｜浓雾 ; thick hair｜浓密的头发 ; thick soup｜浓汤 ; thick layer｜厚厚的一层
tip_zh: 形容液体时指黏稠，不一定表示味道浓。

meanings_zh: n. 国际象棋
definition_en: a two-player board game involving pieces with different permitted moves
example1_en: My grandfather taught me chess during the winter holidays.
example1_zh: 寒假期间，爷爷教我下国际象棋。
example2_en: Playing chess regularly may help children develop concentration and practise planning several steps ahead.
example2_zh: 经常下国际象棋可能有助于儿童提高专注力，并练习提前规划多个步骤。
collocations: play chess｜下国际象棋 ; chess board｜国际象棋棋盘 ; chess tournament｜国际象棋锦标赛 ; chess piece｜国际象棋棋子
tip_zh: 说play chess，不加冠词the。

meanings_zh: n. 千克；公斤
definition_en: A kilogram, a unit used to measure mass.
example1_en: Could I have half a kilo of tomatoes, please?
example1_zh: 请给我半公斤西红柿，好吗？
example2_en: Comparing food prices per kilo can help households manage their budgets and make more economical purchasing decisions.
example2_zh: 比较食品每公斤的价格，有助于家庭管理预算，作出更经济的购买决定。
collocations: half a kilo｜半公斤 ; a kilo of rice｜一公斤大米 ; per kilo｜每公斤
tip_zh: kilo通常是kilogram的简称，不指公里。

meanings_zh: n. 疾病；生病
definition_en: a disease, or the state of being unwell
example1_en: She missed our picnic because of a sudden illness.
example1_zh: 她突然生病，没能参加我们的野餐。
example2_en: Early access to medical care can prevent minor illnesses from developing into serious health problems.
example2_zh: 及早获得医疗服务可以防止小病发展为严重的健康问题。
collocations: serious illness｜重病 ; mental illness｜精神疾病 ; recover from an illness｜病后康复 ; due to illness｜因病
tip_zh: 泛指生病时不可数；指具体疾病时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 头痛 | n. 令人头痛的难题
definition_en: Pain felt in the head. | A problem that causes worry or is difficult to manage.
example1_en: I have a headache, so I need some quiet.
example1_zh: 我头痛，需要安静一会儿。
example2_en: Ageing transport infrastructure has become a major headache for local authorities facing increasingly limited budgets.
example2_zh: 对于预算日益紧张的地方政府而言，老化的交通基础设施已成为一大难题。
collocations: have a headache｜头痛 ; a severe headache｜剧烈头痛 ; a major headache｜一大难题
tip_zh: 表示一次头痛用a headache，通常说have a headache。

meanings_zh: n. 垃圾桶
definition_en: A large container for rubbish, usually kept outside.
example1_en: Please put that rubbish in the dustbin outside.
example1_zh: 请把那些垃圾放进外面的垃圾桶。
example2_en: Providing a separate dustbin for food waste can help households reduce the amount of rubbish sent to landfill.
example2_zh: 为厨余垃圾提供单独的垃圾桶，可以帮助家庭减少送往填埋场的垃圾量。
collocations: empty the dustbin｜清空垃圾桶 ; dustbin lid｜垃圾桶盖 ; put rubbish in the dustbin｜把垃圾放进垃圾桶
synonyms: rubbish bin, garbage can, trash can
tip_zh: 英式用词；美式常用garbage can或trash can。

meanings_zh: v. 出现；显现 | v. 似乎；显得 | v. 登场；出庭
definition_en: To become visible or come into view. | To seem to be a certain way. | To take part in a performance or attend court formally.
example1_en: Stars began to appear as the sky grew darker.
example1_zh: 天空渐渐变暗，星星开始出现。
example2_en: Online courses appear to offer greater flexibility, although some learners still prefer traditional classroom interaction.
example2_zh: 网络课程似乎提供了更大的灵活性，但一些学习者仍更喜欢传统课堂互动。
collocations: appear suddenly｜突然出现 ; appear to be｜似乎是 ; appear in court｜出庭
tip_zh: 表“似乎”可接形容词或to do；不能直接接宾语。

meanings_zh: adv. 无处；哪里都不
definition_en: not in or to any place
example1_en: There was nowhere to sit on the crowded train.
example1_zh: 拥挤的火车上没有地方可坐。
example2_en: Without affordable housing, some low-income families have nowhere to live despite having regular paid employment.
example2_zh: 如果缺乏可负担的住房，一些低收入家庭即使有固定工作，也无处居住。
collocations: nowhere else｜别的地方都不 ; nowhere near｜远不及；远非 ; get nowhere｜毫无进展 ; in the middle of nowhere｜在偏僻之地
tip_zh: 本身含否定意义：I have nowhere to go。

meanings_zh: n. 蜜蜂
definition_en: a flying insect that collects pollen; some kinds make honey
example1_en: A bee landed gently on the yellow flower.
example1_zh: 一只蜜蜂轻轻落在那朵黄花上。
example2_en: Protecting bees is essential for agriculture because these insects pollinate many crops that humans depend on.
example2_zh: 保护蜜蜂对农业至关重要，因为它们为许多人类赖以生存的作物授粉。
collocations: honey bee｜蜜蜂 ; a swarm of bees｜一群蜜蜂 ; bee sting｜蜂蜇 ; bee colony｜蜂群
tip_zh: bee与be同音；蜂群可用a swarm of bees。

meanings_zh: n. 户外烧烤聚餐 | n. 烧烤架 | v. 烧烤
definition_en: An outdoor meal where food is cooked over a fire. | Equipment for cooking food over a fire outdoors. | To cook food on a grill over a fire.
example1_en: We invited our neighbours to a barbecue in the garden.
example1_zh: 我们邀请邻居来花园参加烧烤聚餐。
example2_en: Designated barbecue areas allow visitors to cook outdoors while reducing the risk of fires in public parks.
example2_zh: 指定烧烤区既能让游客在户外烹饪，也能降低公园发生火灾的风险。
collocations: have a barbecue｜举办烧烤聚餐 ; barbecue sauce｜烧烤酱 ; barbecue vegetables｜烧烤蔬菜
tip_zh: 既指烧烤聚餐或烤架，也可作动词；常缩写为BBQ。

meanings_zh: n. 邀请；请帖
definition_en: a request for someone to attend or join something
example1_en: We received an invitation to our neighbour's garden party.
example1_zh: 我们收到了邻居花园聚会的邀请。
example2_en: An invitation to participate in local planning can encourage residents to take greater responsibility for their neighbourhood.
example2_zh: 邀请居民参与地方规划，可以鼓励他们为社区承担更多责任。
collocations: accept an invitation｜接受邀请 ; decline an invitation｜谢绝邀请 ; an invitation to dinner｜晚餐邀请 ; by invitation only｜仅限受邀者
tip_zh: 参加活动用invitation to；邀请做事用to do。

meanings_zh: n. 秘书 | n. 协会或组织的书记；干事 | n. 部长；大臣
definition_en: Someone who arranges meetings and handles office communication. | An official managing an organisation's records and routine business. | A senior government official responsible for a particular department.
example1_en: The secretary arranged a meeting for tomorrow afternoon.
example1_zh: 秘书安排了明天下午的会议。
example2_en: A school secretary often provides essential support by coordinating appointments and communicating with parents throughout the day.
example2_zh: 学校秘书常常通过安排会面及全天与家长沟通，提供不可或缺的支持。
collocations: personal secretary｜私人秘书 ; club secretary｜俱乐部干事 ; foreign secretary｜外交大臣
tip_zh: 既可指办公室秘书，也可指某些政府部长。

meanings_zh: prep. 到……上面
definition_en: Moving to a position on a surface.
example1_en: The cat jumped onto the sofa beside me.
example1_zh: 猫跳到我旁边的沙发上。
example2_en: Moving freight onto trains could reduce road congestion and lower emissions from the transport sector.
example2_zh: 将货物转移到火车上运输，可以缓解道路拥堵并降低运输业的排放。
collocations: climb onto｜爬到……上 ; step onto｜踏上 ; load goods onto｜把货物装到……上
tip_zh: onto强调移动到表面；on常表示已在上面。

meanings_zh: n. 奖品；奖金；奖项 | v. 珍视；高度重视
definition_en: something given for winning a competition or achieving something | to value something very highly
example1_en: Lina won a prize for her colourful garden.
example1_zh: 莉娜因她色彩缤纷的花园获了奖。
example2_en: Offering a prize for innovative designs can encourage students to develop practical solutions to environmental problems.
example2_zh: 为创新设计设奖，可以鼓励学生提出解决环境问题的实用方案。
collocations: win a prize｜获奖 ; first prize｜一等奖 ; prize money｜奖金 ; highly prized｜备受珍视的
tip_zh: prize可作动词表珍视，常见be highly prized。

meanings_zh: n. 爆米花
definition_en: corn kernels heated until they burst into light, fluffy pieces
example1_en: We shared a bowl of popcorn during the film.
example1_zh: 看电影时，我们一起吃了一碗爆米花。
example2_en: Cinemas often earn additional revenue by selling snacks such as popcorn alongside tickets for film screenings.
example2_zh: 电影院除了出售电影票，往往还通过销售爆米花等零食获得额外收入。
collocations: a bowl of popcorn｜一碗爆米花 ; salted popcorn｜咸味爆米花 ; make popcorn｜做爆米花
tip_zh: 通常是不可数名词；一颗可说a piece of popcorn。

meanings_zh: n. 速度；速率 | v. 快速移动；疾驰 | v. 超速驾驶
definition_en: How fast something moves, happens, or operates | To move or travel very fast | To drive faster than the legal limit
example1_en: The train picked up speed as we left town.
example1_zh: 我们离开小镇时，火车加快了速度。
example2_en: Reducing vehicle speeds near schools can significantly improve road safety for children walking or cycling to class.
example2_zh: 降低学校附近的车速，可以显著提高步行或骑车上学的儿童的道路安全。
collocations: at high speed｜高速地 ; a speed limit｜速度限制 ; pick up speed｜加速 ; speed up｜加快
tip_zh: speed up表示加快；speed也可作动词指超速驾驶。

meanings_zh: n. 炉灶；火炉
definition_en: a device used for cooking food or heating a room
example1_en: A pot of soup is bubbling on the stove.
example1_zh: 一锅汤正在炉灶上咕嘟咕嘟地煮着。
example2_en: Replacing traditional indoor stoves with cleaner models can reduce household air pollution and improve respiratory health.
example2_zh: 用更清洁的炉具替换传统室内炉灶，可以减少家庭空气污染并改善呼吸系统健康。
collocations: gas stove｜燃气灶 ; electric stove｜电炉 ; wood-burning stove｜烧木柴的火炉 ; on the stove｜在炉灶上
tip_zh: stove用于烹饪或取暖；oven专指烤箱。

meanings_zh: n. 芒果
definition_en: A tropical fruit with sweet orange flesh and a large stone
example1_en: This mango is sweet enough to eat without sugar.
example1_zh: 这个芒果已经很甜了，不用加糖就能吃。
example2_en: Improved storage facilities can help mango farmers reduce food waste and earn more reliable incomes.
example2_zh: 改善储存设施可以帮助芒果种植户减少食物浪费，获得更稳定的收入。
collocations: a ripe mango｜熟芒果 ; mango juice｜芒果汁 ; mango flesh｜芒果果肉
tip_zh: 复数mangoes和mangos均正确。

meanings_zh: n. 药丸；药片 | n. 口服避孕药
definition_en: a small solid piece of medicine that you swallow | an oral medicine used to prevent pregnancy
example1_en: He swallowed the pill with a glass of water.
example1_zh: 他用一杯水把药片吞了下去。
example2_en: Although a pill may relieve symptoms, lasting improvements in health often require changes to daily habits.
example2_zh: 虽然药物可能缓解症状，但要持久改善健康，往往需要改变日常习惯。
collocations: take a pill｜服药 ; swallow a pill｜吞服药片 ; vitamin pill｜维生素片 ; the pill｜口服避孕药
tip_zh: take a pill指服药；the pill常特指口服避孕药。

meanings_zh: adj. 当地的；本地的 | n. 当地人 | adj. 局部的
definition_en: relating to the area where someone lives or something happens | a person who lives in a particular area | affecting only a limited part of something
example1_en: We buy fresh bread from our local bakery every morning.
example1_zh: 我们每天早晨都在附近的面包店买新鲜面包。
example2_en: Supporting local businesses can strengthen community ties and keep more money circulating within the regional economy.
example2_zh: 支持本地企业可以加强社区联系，并让更多资金在区域经济内部流通。
collocations: local community｜当地社区 ; local authorities｜地方当局 ; local residents｜当地居民 ; local anaesthetic｜局部麻醉药
tip_zh: 名词复数locals指当地人；locally是副词。

meanings_zh: v. 隐藏；躲藏 | v. 隐瞒；掩饰 | n. 兽皮
definition_en: To put or stay somewhere out of sight. | To prevent others from knowing or noticing something. | The skin of a large animal, often used for leather.
example1_en: We hid the birthday present under the bed.
example1_zh: 我们把生日礼物藏在了床底下。
example2_en: Companies should not hide information about environmental risks associated with their products or manufacturing processes.
example2_zh: 企业不应隐瞒其产品或生产流程所涉及的环境风险信息。
collocations: hide from view｜藏起来不让看见 ; hide the truth｜隐瞒真相 ; hide your feelings｜掩饰感情 ; animal hide｜兽皮
tip_zh: 过去式hid，过去分词hidden；hide from意为躲避。

meanings_zh: adj. 醒着的 | v. 醒来；唤醒
definition_en: not sleeping | to stop sleeping or cause someone to stop sleeping
example1_en: I was still awake when the rain finally stopped.
example1_zh: 雨终于停下时，我还醒着。
example2_en: Students who stay awake late at night may struggle to concentrate during lessons the following morning.
example2_zh: 熬夜不睡的学生第二天上午上课时可能难以集中注意力。
collocations: wide awake｜完全清醒的 ; stay awake｜保持清醒 ; lie awake｜躺着睡不着
tip_zh: 形容词通常作表语；动词变化为awoke、awoken。

meanings_zh: n. 噪音；响声
definition_en: a sound, especially one that is loud or unwanted
example1_en: The noise outside woke me before my alarm rang.
example1_zh: 外面的噪音在闹钟响之前就把我吵醒了。
example2_en: Prolonged exposure to traffic noise can affect sleep quality and reduce the wellbeing of urban residents.
example2_zh: 长期接触交通噪音会影响睡眠质量，降低城市居民的身心健康水平。
collocations: noise pollution｜噪音污染 ; background noise｜背景噪音 ; make a noise｜发出声响 ; traffic noise｜交通噪音
tip_zh: 泛指噪音时不可数；指某个具体声响可用a noise。

meanings_zh: n. 棍；枝条；手杖 | v. 粘贴；粘住 | v. 插入；刺入
definition_en: A long, thin piece of wood used for various purposes. | To attach something, or become attached, using a sticky substance. | To push a pointed object into something.
example1_en: The dog brought a stick back to me.
example1_zh: 那只狗把一根树枝叼回给我。
example2_en: Students can stick pictures onto a shared poster to present their research on local wildlife.
example2_zh: 学生可以把图片贴在共同制作的海报上，展示他们对当地野生动物的研究。
collocations: walking stick｜手杖 ; stick to a plan｜坚持计划 ; stick a picture on｜把图片贴在……上 ; stick together｜团结一致
tip_zh: 动词过去式和过去分词均为stuck；stick to表示坚持。

meanings_zh: adj. 爱尔兰的；爱尔兰人的 | n. 爱尔兰语 | n. 爱尔兰人（统称）
definition_en: relating to Ireland, its people, or their culture | a Celtic language traditionally spoken in Ireland | the people of Ireland, referred to collectively
example1_en: An Irish musician played the fiddle at our festival.
example1_zh: 一位爱尔兰音乐家在我们的节庆活动上拉小提琴。
example2_en: Traditional Irish music can strengthen cultural identity while attracting visitors to rural communities across the country.
example2_zh: 爱尔兰传统音乐既能增强文化认同，也能吸引游客前往全国各地的乡村社区。
collocations: Irish culture｜爱尔兰文化 ; Irish music｜爱尔兰音乐 ; speak Irish｜说爱尔兰语 ; the Irish｜爱尔兰人
tip_zh: the Irish统称爱尔兰人；单个人用an Irish person。

meanings_zh: adj. 常见的；普遍的 | adj. 共同的；共有的
definition_en: happening often or found in many places | shared by two or more people or groups
example1_en: Heavy rain is common here during the summer.
example1_zh: 这里夏天经常下大雨。
example2_en: Governments should address the common challenges that prevent rural communities from accessing affordable healthcare.
example2_zh: 政府应解决阻碍农村社区获得可负担医疗服务的共同难题。
collocations: a common problem｜常见问题 ; a common goal｜共同目标 ; have something in common｜有共同之处 ; common practice｜惯常做法
tip_zh: common指常见或共有；ordinary强调普通、不特别。

meanings_zh: n. 烧水壶
definition_en: A container with a handle and spout for boiling water.
example1_en: Put the kettle on while I find the cups.
example1_zh: 你先烧水，我来找杯子。
example2_en: Boiling only the water needed in a kettle can reduce household electricity consumption over time.
example2_zh: 每次只烧所需的水，长期下来可以减少家庭用电量。
collocations: electric kettle｜电热水壶 ; put the kettle on｜烧水 ; boil the kettle｜烧一壶水
tip_zh: kettle 用来烧水，teapot 用来泡茶。

meanings_zh: n. 柔道
definition_en: A sport using throws and holds to overcome an opponent.
example1_en: Our judo teacher showed us how to fall safely.
example1_zh: 我们的柔道老师教了我们如何安全地倒地。
example2_en: Practising judo under qualified supervision can help young people develop balance, self-discipline, and respect for others.
example2_zh: 在合格教练的指导下练习柔道，可以帮助年轻人提高平衡能力、自律性以及对他人的尊重。
collocations: do judo｜练柔道 ; judo instructor｜柔道教练 ; judo club｜柔道俱乐部 ; judo match｜柔道比赛
tip_zh: 练柔道用do judo，不用play judo。

meanings_zh: adj. 相反的；对面的 | prep. 在…对面 | n. 相反的人或事物
definition_en: completely different, or on the other side | facing someone or something from the other side | someone or something completely different from another
example1_en: We left the station and walked in opposite directions.
example1_zh: 我们离开车站，朝相反的方向走去。
example2_en: Although the policy aimed to reduce traffic, it had the opposite effect in several residential areas.
example2_zh: 尽管该政策旨在减少交通流量，却在几个住宅区产生了相反的效果。
collocations: opposite directions｜相反方向 ; the opposite effect｜相反的效果 ; the exact opposite｜截然相反的事物
tip_zh: 介词opposite后直接接地点；名词常用the opposite of。

meanings_zh: adj. 女性的；雌性的 | n. 雌性动物；女性
definition_en: Relating to women, girls, or animals that typically produce eggs. | An animal or person of the female sex.
example1_en: The female lion rested beside her cubs in the shade.
example1_zh: 母狮和幼狮一起在阴凉处休息。
example2_en: Encouraging female students to study engineering can help reduce gender inequality in the technology sector.
example2_zh: 鼓励女生学习工程学有助于减少科技行业中的性别不平等。
collocations: female students｜女生 ; female employees｜女性员工 ; a female elephant｜一头母象
tip_zh: 指成年女性通常用women；female作定语较自然。

meanings_zh: v. 想象；设想 | v. 猜想；认为
definition_en: Form a picture or idea of something in your mind. | Think something is probably true without being certain.
example1_en: Imagine living in a little house beside the sea.
example1_zh: 想象一下住在海边一栋小房子里的情景。
example2_en: Urban planners must imagine how future residents will use shared spaces before designing new neighbourhoods.
example2_zh: 城市规划者在设计新社区之前，必须设想未来居民将如何使用公共空间。
collocations: imagine doing something｜想象做某事 ; hard to imagine｜难以想象 ; imagine the future｜设想未来
tip_zh: imagine后接动名词，不接to do。

meanings_zh: n. 文件；档案；文件夹 | v. 归档；提交 | n. 锉刀
definition_en: Stored information on a computer, or an organized collection of papers. | To store documents systematically or submit them to an authority. | A rough metal tool used to smooth or shape surfaces.
example1_en: I saved the file before switching off my laptop.
example1_zh: 我关掉笔记本电脑之前保存了文件。
example2_en: Public institutions should store confidential files securely to prevent unauthorized access and protect citizens' personal information.
example2_zh: 公共机构应安全存储机密文件，以防止未经授权的访问并保护公民的个人信息。
collocations: save a file｜保存文件 ; attach a file｜附加文件 ; file a complaint｜正式提出投诉 ; file documents｜将文件归档
tip_zh: file a complaint 指正式投诉，不是把投诉归档。

meanings_zh: n. 航空公司
definition_en: A company that transports passengers or goods by aircraft
example1_en: The airline sent us new tickets after cancelling our flight.
example1_zh: 航班取消后，航空公司给我们发了新机票。
example2_en: Airlines can lower their environmental impact by investing in more efficient aircraft and reducing unnecessary flights.
example2_zh: 航空公司可以通过投资更高效的飞机并减少不必要的航班来降低环境影响。
collocations: budget airline｜廉价航空公司 ; airline ticket｜机票 ; airline industry｜航空业
tip_zh: airline指航空公司；具体航班用flight。

meanings_zh: n. 建议；提议 | n. 暗示；细微迹象
definition_en: an idea offered for someone to consider | a slight sign that something exists or may be true
example1_en: Your suggestion to bring a picnic was really helpful.
example1_zh: 你提议带上野餐食物，真是帮了大忙。
example2_en: The suggestion to expand cycle lanes received strong support from residents concerned about road safety.
example2_zh: 扩建自行车道的建议得到了关注道路安全的居民的大力支持。
collocations: make a suggestion｜提出建议 ; a useful suggestion｜有用的建议 ; a suggestion of｜一丝；些许
tip_zh: suggestion是可数名词；advice通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 海滨；海边 | adj. 海滨的；海边的
definition_en: The area beside the sea, especially where people spend holidays | Located beside the sea, especially in a holiday area
example1_en: We spent the afternoon building sandcastles at the seaside.
example1_zh: 我们下午在海边堆沙堡。
example2_en: Seaside towns often depend on summer tourism, which can create unstable employment for local residents.
example2_zh: 海滨小镇往往依赖夏季旅游业，这可能使当地居民的就业不稳定。
collocations: at the seaside｜在海边 ; seaside resort｜海滨度假胜地 ; seaside town｜海滨小镇 ; seaside holiday｜海滨度假
tip_zh: 名词常用 the seaside；表示“在海边”用 at。

meanings_zh: pron. 我们自己 | pron. 我们亲自
definition_en: used when we are both doing and receiving an action | used to emphasize that we do something, not others
example1_en: We saw ourselves reflected in the clear lake.
example1_zh: 我们看到了自己映在清澈湖水中的倒影。
example2_en: By involving ourselves in community projects, we can develop practical skills and strengthen local relationships.
example2_zh: 通过参与社区项目，我们可以培养实用技能并增进邻里关系。
collocations: by ourselves｜独自；靠我们自己 ; enjoy ourselves｜玩得开心 ; pride ourselves on｜我们以……为傲 ; for ourselves｜为我们自己
tip_zh: by ourselves可指独自，也可指不靠别人。

meanings_zh: adj. 油炸的；油煎的
definition_en: cooked in hot oil or fat
example1_en: We had fried eggs and toast for breakfast.
example1_zh: 我们早餐吃了煎蛋和烤面包。
example2_en: Eating fried foods too frequently can increase calorie intake and make maintaining a healthy weight more difficult.
example2_zh: 过于频繁地吃油炸食品会增加热量摄入，使维持健康体重更加困难。
collocations: fried rice｜炒饭 ; fried eggs｜煎蛋 ; deep-fried food｜油炸食品
tip_zh: fried是fry的过去式和过去分词，也作形容词；不限于油炸。

meanings_zh: v. 主动提供；提议 | n. 提议；录用或录取通知 | v. 出价
definition_en: Say you are willing to give something or do something. | A proposal of help, an opportunity, or a place. | Say how much you are willing to pay.
example1_en: Our neighbour offered to carry the heavy bags upstairs.
example1_zh: 邻居主动提出帮我们把沉重的袋子搬上楼。
example2_en: Universities should offer practical training that helps students develop skills relevant to the workplace.
example2_zh: 大学应提供实践培训，帮助学生培养与职场相关的技能。
collocations: offer help｜主动提供帮助 ; offer someone a job｜给某人提供工作 ; accept an offer｜接受提议 ; make an offer｜出价；提出提议
tip_zh: 主动做某事用offer to do，不用offer doing。

meanings_zh: n. 种类；类型 | v. 分类；整理；排序 | v. 处理妥当；解决
definition_en: a group of things sharing similar characteristics | to arrange things in groups or a particular order | to deal successfully with a problem or practical matter
example1_en: What sort of music do you listen to at home?
example1_zh: 你在家听哪种音乐？
example2_en: Households should sort their waste carefully so that recyclable materials can be processed more efficiently.
example2_zh: 家庭应仔细将垃圾分类，以便更高效地处理可回收材料。
collocations: all sorts of｜各种各样的 ; sort by size｜按大小分类 ; sort out a problem｜解决问题 ; sort of｜有点；算是
tip_zh: a sort of表示“一种”；sort of也可口语表示“有点”。

meanings_zh: n. 项目；工程；课题 | v. 预计；预测 | v. 投射；放映
definition_en: A planned piece of work with a particular purpose. | To estimate a future amount or situation using current information. | To send light or images onto a surface.
example1_en: Our garden project started with three pots of herbs.
example1_zh: 我们的园艺项目是从三盆香草开始的。
example2_en: Researchers project that demand for electricity will increase as more households switch to electric vehicles.
example2_zh: 研究人员预计，随着更多家庭改用电动汽车，电力需求将会增加。
collocations: a research project｜研究项目 ; carry out a project｜开展项目 ; be projected to rise｜预计会上升 ; project an image｜投射图像
tip_zh: 名词重音在前，动词重音在后；音标按此顺序列出。

meanings_zh: n. 女演员
definition_en: a woman who performs characters in plays or films
example1_en: The actress waved to the crowd outside the theatre.
example1_zh: 那位女演员向剧院外的人群挥手。
example2_en: A successful actress can encourage young people to explore careers in the performing arts.
example2_zh: 一位成功的女演员可以鼓励年轻人探索表演艺术领域的职业道路。
collocations: leading actress｜女主角 ; supporting actress｜女配角 ; award-winning actress｜获奖女演员
tip_zh: actor也可指女性；actress明确指女演员。

meanings_zh: v. 安排；筹备 | v. 排列；整理
definition_en: Make plans or preparations for something to happen. | Put things in a particular order or position.
example1_en: I arranged to meet my cousin outside the cinema.
example1_zh: 我约好和表亲在电影院外见面。
example2_en: Schools can arrange visits to local businesses to help students understand the practical demands of different careers.
example2_zh: 学校可以安排学生参观当地企业，帮助他们了解不同职业的实际要求。
collocations: arrange a meeting｜安排会议 ; arrange to meet｜约好见面 ; arrange for someone to do something｜安排某人做某事 ; arrange flowers｜插花
tip_zh: 安排某人做某事用arrange for sb to do。

meanings_zh: adj. 受欢迎的；流行的 | adj. 大众的；通俗的
definition_en: Liked or enjoyed by many people. | Intended for ordinary people rather than specialists.
example1_en: This small café is popular with local students.
example1_zh: 这家小咖啡馆很受当地学生欢迎。
example2_en: Popular science books can encourage public interest in research by explaining discoveries in accessible language.
example2_zh: 通俗科普书籍通过用易懂的语言解释科学发现，可以激发公众对研究的兴趣。
collocations: popular with students｜受学生欢迎 ; increasingly popular｜越来越受欢迎 ; popular culture｜大众文化 ; popular science｜通俗科学
tip_zh: 表示受某群体欢迎，常用popular with或among。

meanings_zh: v. 修理；解决 | v. 固定；安装 | v. 确定；安排
definition_en: Make something work properly or solve a problem. | Attach something firmly in a particular place. | Decide an exact time, price, or arrangement.
example1_en: My neighbour helped me fix the broken kitchen tap.
example1_zh: 邻居帮我修好了厨房里坏掉的水龙头。
example2_en: Governments should fix weaknesses in existing transport networks before investing in expensive new infrastructure.
example2_zh: 政府应先解决现有交通网络的薄弱环节，再投资昂贵的新基础设施。
collocations: fix a problem｜解决问题 ; fix a date｜确定日期 ; fix something to a wall｜把某物固定在墙上 ; fix a leak｜修补漏处
tip_zh: fix既可修理物品，也可解决问题或确定日期。

meanings_zh: n. 垃圾桶；储物箱 | v. 扔掉；丢弃
definition_en: A container used for rubbish or for storing things. | To throw something away, especially into a rubbish container.
example1_en: Please put the banana skin in the kitchen bin.
example1_zh: 请把香蕉皮放进厨房的垃圾桶。
example2_en: Providing a separate bin for food waste can help households recycle more effectively and reduce landfill use.
example2_zh: 提供单独的厨余垃圾桶有助于家庭更有效地回收废物，并减少垃圾填埋量。
collocations: rubbish bin｜垃圾桶 ; recycling bin｜回收桶 ; storage bin｜储物箱 ; empty the bin｜清空垃圾桶
tip_zh: “垃圾桶”英式常说bin，美式常说trash can。

meanings_zh: adj. 烤制的；炙烤的
definition_en: Cooked using strong direct heat, often on a metal rack.
example1_en: We shared grilled vegetables and warm bread for lunch.
example1_zh: 午餐我们一起吃了烤蔬菜和热面包。
example2_en: Offering grilled fish alongside plant-based dishes can help school cafeterias provide a wider range of nutritious meals.
example2_zh: 学校食堂同时供应烤鱼和植物性菜肴，有助于提供更多种类的营养餐。
collocations: grilled chicken｜烤鸡肉 ; grilled fish｜烤鱼 ; grilled vegetables｜烤蔬菜
tip_zh: grilled强调直接高温烤制；不表示“有格子的”。

meanings_zh: prep. 穿过；横过 | prep. 在……对面；遍及 | adv. 从一边到另一边；在对面
definition_en: From one side of something to the other. | On the opposite side of, or throughout, an area. | From one side to another, or on the opposite side.
example1_en: We walked across the bridge before the rain started.
example1_zh: 下雨前，我们走过了那座桥。
example2_en: Improved internet access allows students across rural regions to benefit from a wider range of educational resources.
example2_zh: 互联网接入条件的改善，让广大农村地区的学生能够利用更丰富的教育资源。
collocations: across the road｜在马路对面 ; across the country｜遍及全国 ; walk across a bridge｜走过桥
tip_zh: across强调横跨表面；through强调从内部穿过。

meanings_zh: v. 表现；举止 | v. 守规矩 | v. 运转；作出特定反应
definition_en: to act in a particular way | to act politely and do what is expected | to work or react in a particular way
example1_en: Our dog behaves calmly when visitors come to the house.
example1_zh: 有客人来家里时，我们的狗表现得很平静。
example2_en: Children often learn how to behave in social situations by observing the adults around them.
example2_zh: 孩子往往通过观察身边的成年人，学习在社交场合如何举止得当。
collocations: behave responsibly｜负责任地行事 ; behave well｜表现良好 ; behave yourself｜规矩一点 ; behave like｜表现得像
tip_zh: behave yourself意为守规矩，不是“表现自己”。

meanings_zh: n. 马来西亚
definition_en: a Southeast Asian country occupying parts of a peninsula and Borneo
example1_en: We explored a rainforest during our holiday in Malaysia.
example1_zh: 我们在马来西亚度假期间探索了一片热带雨林。
example2_en: Tourism in Malaysia creates employment opportunities, but protecting fragile coastal ecosystems remains an important priority.
example2_zh: 马来西亚的旅游业创造了就业机会，但保护脆弱的沿海生态系统仍是一项重要任务。
collocations: visit Malaysia｜访问马来西亚 ; travel to Malaysia｜前往马来西亚旅行 ; Peninsular Malaysia｜马来西亚半岛地区
tip_zh: 国名首字母大写，通常不加冠词the。

meanings_zh: n. 露天停车场
definition_en: An outdoor area where cars can be parked.
example1_en: Our car is near the parking lot entrance.
example1_zh: 我们的车就在停车场入口附近。
example2_en: Planting trees around a parking lot can provide shade and reduce surface temperatures during hot weather.
example2_zh: 在停车场周围种树可以提供遮阴，并降低炎热天气下的地表温度。
collocations: empty parking lot｜空停车场 ; crowded parking lot｜拥挤的停车场 ; parking lot entrance｜停车场入口
tip_zh: 美式常用；立体停车楼通常叫parking garage。

meanings_zh: n. 邮件；邮政 | v. 邮寄；发布 | n. 职位；岗位
definition_en: Letters and parcels, or the system used to deliver them. | To send something by mail or share it publicly. | A job or position in an organisation.
example1_en: A parcel arrived in the post this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上寄来了一个包裹。
example2_en: Local authorities should post regular updates online to keep residents informed about changes to public services.
example2_zh: 地方政府应定期在网上发布最新消息，让居民了解公共服务的变化。
collocations: by post｜通过邮寄 ; post a letter｜寄信 ; post online｜在网上发布 ; apply for a post｜申请职位
tip_zh: 邮寄义中，英式常用post，美式常用mail。

meanings_zh: v. 创造；创作 | v. 造成；引起
definition_en: to make something new or bring something into existence | to cause a situation, feeling, or problem to develop
example1_en: We created a colourful bird from folded paper.
example1_zh: 我们用折纸做出了一只色彩鲜艳的小鸟。
example2_en: Investment in renewable energy can create jobs while reducing dependence on imported fossil fuels.
example2_zh: 投资可再生能源能创造就业机会，同时减少对进口化石燃料的依赖。
collocations: create opportunities｜创造机会 ; create jobs｜创造就业机会 ; create a problem｜造成问题 ; create a work of art｜创作艺术作品
tip_zh: create强调创造新事物，也可接problem表示造成问题。

meanings_zh: n. 组织；机构；团体 | n. 组织安排；条理
definition_en: A group of people working together for a particular purpose. | The planning and arrangement of activities, people, or things.
example1_en: He joined a local organisation that rescues injured birds.
example1_zh: 他加入了一个救助受伤鸟类的当地组织。
example2_en: Effective organisation of healthcare services can shorten waiting times and improve access for rural communities.
example2_zh: 有效组织医疗服务能够缩短等候时间，并改善农村社区获得医疗服务的机会。
collocations: charitable organisation｜慈善组织 ; international organisation｜国际组织 ; non-governmental organisation｜非政府组织 ; require careful organisation｜需要周密安排
tip_zh: 英式常写organisation，美式通常写organization。

meanings_zh: v. 合身；装得下；适合 | adj. 健康强健的 | adj. 适合的；合格的
definition_en: To be the right size, shape, or type for something. | Physically healthy and strong, especially through exercise. | Suitable or good enough for a particular purpose.
example1_en: These boots fit perfectly, even with my thick socks.
example1_zh: 即使穿着厚袜子，这双靴子也非常合脚。
example2_en: Public exercise facilities can help older adults stay fit while strengthening social connections within their communities.
example2_zh: 公共健身设施可以帮助老年人保持健康，同时加强他们与社区内其他人的联系。
collocations: keep fit｜保持健康 ; fit perfectly｜完全合身 ; fit for purpose｜符合用途 ; fit in with｜适应；与……协调
tip_zh: 衣物fit指尺寸合适；suit多指款式或颜色适合。

meanings_zh: adj. 正常的；通常的 | n. 常态；正常水平
definition_en: usual, expected, or typical in a particular situation | the usual state or level of something
example1_en: It is normal to feel nervous before an interview.
example1_zh: 面试前感到紧张是正常的。
example2_en: Flexible working hours are becoming a normal feature of employment in many sectors of the economy.
example2_zh: 弹性工作时间正成为许多经济领域中常见的用工安排。
collocations: normal life｜正常生活 ; return to normal｜恢复正常 ; perfectly normal｜完全正常 ; normal working hours｜正常工作时间
tip_zh: normal强调符合常态；ordinary强调普通、不特别。

meanings_zh: n. 排球运动；排球
definition_en: A game of hitting a ball over a high net.
example1_en: We played volleyball on the beach until the sun set.
example1_zh: 我们在沙滩上打排球，一直打到日落。
example2_en: Team sports such as volleyball can help students develop communication skills while encouraging regular physical activity.
example2_zh: 排球等团队运动既能帮助学生培养沟通能力，也能鼓励他们定期锻炼。
collocations: play volleyball｜打排球 ; beach volleyball｜沙滩排球 ; volleyball court｜排球场 ; volleyball team｜排球队
tip_zh: 指运动时不可数，play volleyball中不加冠词。

meanings_zh: adj. 古代的 | adj. 非常古老的
definition_en: belonging to a period thousands of years in the past | having existed for a very long time
example1_en: We explored an ancient temple during our holiday.
example1_zh: 我们度假时游览了一座古代寺庙。
example2_en: Studying ancient civilisations helps researchers understand how early societies managed water, trade, and public health.
example2_zh: 研究古代文明有助于研究人员了解早期社会如何管理用水、贸易和公共卫生。
collocations: ancient history｜古代史 ; ancient civilisation｜古代文明 ; ancient ruins｜古代遗址 ; ancient monument｜古代历史遗迹
tip_zh: ancient强调年代久远，不宜代替一般的old。

meanings_zh: n. 数量；数额 | v. 总计；相当于
definition_en: How much of something there is. | To total something or be equivalent to it.
example1_en: Add a small amount of milk to the bowl.
example1_zh: 往碗里加少量牛奶。
example2_en: Reducing the amount of food wasted by households could significantly lower the environmental impact of food production.
example2_zh: 减少家庭食物浪费量可以显著降低食品生产对环境的影响。
collocations: a large amount of｜大量的 ; total amount｜总量；总额 ; amount to｜总计；相当于
tip_zh: amount of接不可数名词；动词常用amount to。

meanings_zh: n. 自拍照
definition_en: A photograph you take of yourself, usually with a phone.
example1_en: We took a selfie beside the lake after our walk.
example1_zh: 散步后，我们在湖边拍了一张自拍照。
example2_en: Sharing a selfie online can express personal identity, but users should consider their privacy settings first.
example2_zh: 在网上分享自拍照可以展现个人身份，但用户应先考虑隐私设置。
collocations: take a selfie｜拍自拍照 ; post a selfie｜发布自拍照 ; selfie stick｜自拍杆
tip_zh: 拍自拍照用take a selfie，不用make a selfie。

meanings_zh: v. 经过；通过 | v. 传递；递给 | v. 通过考试；及格
definition_en: To move past something or through a place. | To give something to another person. | To achieve the required standard in an examination or test.
example1_en: We pass a small bakery on our way home.
example1_zh: 我们回家的路上会经过一家小面包店。
example2_en: Students must pass a practical assessment before they can begin working independently in the laboratory.
example2_zh: 学生必须通过实践考核，才能开始在实验室独立工作。
collocations: pass an exam｜通过考试 ; pass the ball｜传球 ; pass through｜穿过
tip_zh: pass是动词；past可作介词：walk past。

meanings_zh: n. 蜂蜜
definition_en: a sweet, sticky food made by bees
example1_en: She stirred a spoonful of honey into her tea.
example1_zh: 她往茶里加了一勺蜂蜜，搅拌均匀。
example2_en: Local honey production can provide rural income while encouraging farmers to protect habitats for bees.
example2_zh: 本地蜂蜜生产能为农村带来收入，同时鼓励农民保护蜜蜂的栖息地。
collocations: a spoonful of honey｜一勺蜂蜜 ; a jar of honey｜一罐蜂蜜 ; honey production｜蜂蜜生产
tip_zh: 表示蜂蜜时不可数；一罐蜂蜜说a jar of honey。

meanings_zh: n. 东南；东南部 | adj. 东南的；来自东南的 | adv. 向东南；在东南
definition_en: The direction between south and east, or an area's southeastern part. | Located in the southeast, or coming from that direction. | Towards or in the southeast.
example1_en: Our kitchen window faces southeast and catches the morning sun.
example1_zh: 我们厨房的窗户朝东南，早晨能照到阳光。
example2_en: Population growth in the southeast has increased demand for affordable housing and reliable public transport.
example2_zh: 东南部的人口增长增加了对可负担住房和可靠公共交通的需求。
collocations: in the southeast｜在东南部 ; southeast of｜在……的东南方 ; head southeast｜向东南行进 ; the southeast coast｜东南海岸
tip_zh: 名词前常用the；副词不用：head southeast。

meanings_zh: n. 计划；方案；课程 | n. 电视或广播节目 | v. 安排；设定运行方式
definition_en: an organised set of activities with a particular purpose | a show broadcast on television or radio | to arrange activities or set a machine to operate automatically
example1_en: I joined a fitness programme at the local gym.
example1_zh: 我参加了当地健身房的一项健身计划。
example2_en: A well-designed training programme can help unemployed adults gain the skills needed for new careers.
example2_zh: 设计合理的培训项目能帮助失业成年人掌握新职业所需的技能。
collocations: training programme｜培训项目 ; television programme｜电视节目 ; degree programme｜学位课程 ; launch a programme｜启动一项计划
tip_zh: 英式通常用programme，计算机程序用program；美式均用program。

meanings_zh: n. 短裤
definition_en: trousers with legs ending above or near the knees
example1_en: I packed shorts and sandals for our beach holiday.
example1_zh: 我为这次海滨度假打包了短裤和凉鞋。
example2_en: In hot weather, lightweight shorts can help people stay comfortable while taking part in outdoor exercise.
example2_zh: 天气炎热时，轻薄的短裤能帮助人们在户外锻炼时保持舒适。
collocations: a pair of shorts｜一条短裤 ; wear shorts｜穿短裤 ; denim shorts｜牛仔短裤 ; running shorts｜跑步短裤
tip_zh: shorts用复数；一条短裤说a pair of shorts。

meanings_zh: n. 手镯；手链
definition_en: A piece of jewellery worn around the wrist.
example1_en: She wears a silver bracelet that her grandmother gave her.
example1_zh: 她戴着祖母送给她的一条银手链。
example2_en: A handmade bracelet can reflect local artistic traditions while providing income for craftspeople in rural communities.
example2_zh: 手工手链既能体现当地艺术传统，又能为农村社区的手艺人带来收入。
collocations: silver bracelet｜银手镯；银手链 ; charm bracelet｜吊饰手链 ; wear a bracelet｜戴手镯
tip_zh: bracelet戴在手腕；anklet戴在脚踝。

meanings_zh: n. 木板；板 | n. 董事会；委员会 | v. 登上交通工具
definition_en: A flat piece of wood or other firm material. | A group responsible for managing an organisation or making decisions. | Get onto a ship, aircraft, train, or bus.
example1_en: She placed a wooden board across the muddy path.
example1_zh: 她在泥泞的小路上横放了一块木板。
example2_en: The board approved a plan to reduce factory emissions without cutting jobs or lowering wages.
example2_zh: 董事会批准了一项在不裁员、不降薪的前提下减少工厂排放的计划。
collocations: a wooden board｜一块木板 ; board of directors｜董事会 ; board a plane｜登机 ; on board｜在船、飞机等上
tip_zh: board作动词可直接接交通工具：board a train。

meanings_zh: n. 演讲者；发言者 | n. 说某种语言的人 | n. 扬声器；音箱
definition_en: a person who gives a talk or addresses others | a person who speaks a particular language | a device that produces sound from electrical signals
example1_en: The speaker made everyone laugh with her opening story.
example1_zh: 演讲者开场讲的故事把大家都逗笑了。
example2_en: Inviting a guest speaker from the scientific community can help students understand how classroom knowledge applies to real problems.
example2_zh: 邀请科学界的嘉宾来演讲，可以帮助学生理解课堂知识如何应用于实际问题。
collocations: guest speaker｜特邀演讲者 ; native speaker｜母语使用者 ; fluent speaker｜说话流利的人 ; wireless speaker｜无线音箱
tip_zh: a native speaker of English指英语母语者。

meanings_zh: n. 太阳镜；墨镜
definition_en: glasses with dark lenses that protect eyes from bright sunlight
example1_en: I put on my sunglasses before leaving the house.
example1_zh: 出门前，我戴上了太阳镜。
example2_en: Wearing sunglasses with adequate ultraviolet protection can reduce the risk of eye damage during outdoor activities.
example2_zh: 在户外活动时，佩戴具有充分紫外线防护功能的太阳镜可以降低眼睛受损的风险。
collocations: a pair of sunglasses｜一副太阳镜 ; wear sunglasses｜戴太阳镜 ; put on sunglasses｜戴上太阳镜
tip_zh: 通常用复数；一副说a pair of sunglasses。

meanings_zh: n. 侄女；外甥女
definition_en: A daughter of your sibling or your spouse's sibling.
example1_en: My niece brought her new puppy to our picnic.
example1_zh: 我的侄女带着她新养的小狗来参加我们的野餐。
example2_en: Flexible working hours can help adults care for relatives, including a young niece or nephew.
example2_zh: 弹性工作时间可以帮助成年人照顾亲属，包括年幼的侄女或侄子。
collocations: young niece｜年幼的侄女或外甥女 ; nieces and nephews｜侄子侄女及外甥外甥女
tip_zh: niece指女性晚辈，nephew指男性晚辈。

meanings_zh: n. 化妆品 | n. 组成；构成
definition_en: Products applied to the face to change or enhance appearance. | The parts or qualities that together form something.
example1_en: She keeps her make-up in a small blue bag.
example1_zh: 她把化妆品放在一个蓝色小包里。
example2_en: The social make-up of a neighbourhood can change significantly as new housing attracts different residents.
example2_zh: 随着新建住房吸引不同的居民，一个社区的社会构成可能显著改变。
collocations: wear make-up｜化着妆 ; apply make-up｜化妆 ; remove make-up｜卸妆 ; genetic make-up｜基因构成
tip_zh: 名词也写作makeup；动词短语make up不加连字符。

meanings_zh: n. 音乐会；演唱会
definition_en: a live musical performance given before an audience
example1_en: We enjoyed an outdoor concert in the park yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天我们在公园欣赏了一场露天音乐会。
example2_en: Free public concerts can make cultural activities more accessible and encourage residents to use shared urban spaces.
example2_zh: 免费公共音乐会能让更多人参与文化活动，并鼓励居民使用城市公共空间。
collocations: attend a concert｜出席音乐会 ; give a concert｜举办音乐会 ; concert hall｜音乐厅 ; live concert｜现场音乐会
tip_zh: 去听音乐会用 go to a concert。

meanings_zh: v. 加入；参加 | v. 连接；接合
definition_en: Becoming a member of a group or taking part. | Connecting two or more things together.
example1_en: I'm joining a swimming club near my house.
example1_zh: 我正准备加入家附近的一家游泳俱乐部。
example2_en: Joining local volunteer groups allows young people to gain practical experience while contributing to their communities.
example2_zh: 加入当地志愿者团体能让年轻人在服务社区的同时积累实践经验。
collocations: joining a club｜加入俱乐部 ; joining forces｜联手合作 ; joining two pieces together｜把两块连接起来
tip_zh: 是join的-ing形式；加入组织直接接宾语，不加in。

meanings_zh: n. 问候；招呼 | n. 祝愿；祝福
definition_en: Words or actions used when meeting or welcoming someone. | Friendly wishes expressed on a special occasion.
example1_en: She gave us a cheerful greeting at the door.
example1_zh: 她在门口愉快地向我们打招呼。
example2_en: Learning local greeting customs can help international students build relationships and avoid misunderstandings in their new environment.
example2_zh: 了解当地的问候习俗可以帮助国际学生建立人际关系，避免在新环境中产生误解。
collocations: a warm greeting｜热情的问候 ; exchange greetings｜互致问候 ; a greeting card｜贺卡 ; birthday greetings｜生日祝福
tip_zh: 表示节日祝福常用复数greetings，如birthday greetings。

meanings_zh: adj. 半价的 | adv. 以半价
definition_en: costing half the usual price | at half the usual price
example1_en: We bought half-price tickets for the afternoon boat trip.
example1_zh: 我们买了下午游船的半价票。
example2_en: Offering half-price public transport to students could improve access to education and reduce car use.
example2_zh: 向学生提供半价公共交通服务可以改善受教育机会，并减少汽车使用。
collocations: half-price tickets｜半价票 ; half-price sale｜半价促销 ; buy something half-price｜以半价购买某物
tip_zh: 名词前常写half-price；at half price不加连字符。

meanings_zh: adv. 悲伤地；难过地 | adv. 遗憾的是；不幸地
definition_en: in a way that expresses unhappiness | used to express regret about an unfortunate situation
example1_en: He waved sadly as his best friend's train departed.
example1_zh: 最好的朋友乘坐的火车离站时，他难过地挥手告别。
example2_en: Sadly, many historic buildings have been demolished to make room for roads and commercial developments.
example2_zh: 遗憾的是，许多历史建筑已被拆除，为道路和商业开发腾出空间。
collocations: smile sadly｜伤感地微笑 ; sadly lacking｜严重不足 ; sadly missed｜深受怀念的
tip_zh: 句首Sadly常表示“遗憾的是”，修饰整句话。

meanings_zh: n. 报告；报道 | v. 报告；报道 | v. 报到
definition_en: A spoken or written account giving information about something | To give information about an event or situation | To arrive somewhere and tell the person in charge
example1_en: I finished my report before lunch and emailed it.
example1_zh: 我午饭前写完了报告，并通过电子邮件发了出去。
example2_en: The report suggests that improved access to green spaces can benefit residents' physical and mental health.
example2_zh: 这份报告指出，让居民更方便地使用绿地有益于他们的身心健康。
collocations: write a report｜撰写报告 ; a news report｜新闻报道 ; report a problem｜报告问题 ; report for duty｜报到上班
tip_zh: report on后接报道主题；report for duty指报到上班。

meanings_zh: n. 人行横道；穿越处 | n. 横渡；渡程
definition_en: A designated place where people or vehicles cross. | A journey across water or another geographical barrier.
example1_en: We waited at the crossing until the cars stopped.
example1_zh: 我们在人行横道前等到车辆停下才过马路。
example2_en: Installing a pedestrian crossing near every school can help protect children and encourage more families to walk.
example2_zh: 在每所学校附近设置人行横道，有助于保护儿童并鼓励更多家庭步行。
collocations: pedestrian crossing｜人行横道 ; level crossing｜铁路平交道口 ; border crossing｜边境口岸 ; ferry crossing｜渡轮航程
tip_zh: 作名词可指过街地点，也可指乘船横渡的行程。

meanings_zh: v. 覆盖；遮盖 | v. 包括；涉及；足以支付 | n. 盖子；封面；保护套
definition_en: To put something over a surface or object. | To include something, deal with it, or pay its cost. | An outer layer that protects or encloses something.
example1_en: Cover the bread with a cloth while it cools.
example1_zh: 面包冷却时，用一块布盖住它。
example2_en: University scholarships should cover living expenses as well as tuition fees for students from low-income families.
example2_zh: 大学奖学金应为低收入家庭的学生支付生活费和学费。
collocations: cover something with｜用……盖住某物 ; cover the cost｜支付费用 ; cover a topic｜涉及某个话题 ; a book cover｜书籍封面
tip_zh: cover A with B表示用B盖住A；cover费用指足以支付。

meanings_zh: n. 棒球运动 | n. 棒球
definition_en: A team sport involving hitting a ball and running between bases | The small, hard ball used in this sport
example1_en: We played baseball in the park after lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭后，我们在公园打棒球。
example2_en: Team sports such as baseball can help young people develop cooperation skills and maintain physical fitness.
example2_zh: 棒球等团队运动能帮助年轻人培养合作能力并保持身体健康。
collocations: play baseball｜打棒球 ; baseball bat｜棒球棒 ; baseball glove｜棒球手套 ; baseball field｜棒球场
tip_zh: 运动名称不可数；表示一个棒球时用a baseball。

meanings_zh: adj. 聪明的；机灵的 | adj. 巧妙的
definition_en: Quick to learn, understand, or find solutions. | Showing skill or an original way of solving a problem.
example1_en: That clever child fixed the puzzle before lunch.
example1_zh: 那个聪明的孩子午饭前就解开了这道谜题。
example2_en: Clever design can make small urban apartments feel spacious without increasing their environmental impact.
example2_zh: 巧妙的设计可以让城市小公寓显得宽敞，同时不增加其环境影响。
collocations: clever idea｜巧妙的主意 ; clever at｜擅长 ; clever solution｜巧妙的解决办法
tip_zh: 比较级cleverer，最高级cleverest。

meanings_zh: adv. 到处；处处
definition_en: in, at, or to all places
example1_en: We looked everywhere, but the kitten was under the sofa.
example1_zh: 我们到处找，结果小猫就在沙发底下。
example2_en: Although digital services are expanding rapidly, reliable internet access is not yet available everywhere.
example2_zh: 尽管数字服务正在迅速扩展，可靠的互联网接入仍未覆盖所有地方。
collocations: look everywhere｜到处找 ; almost everywhere｜几乎到处 ; everywhere else｜其他所有地方
tip_zh: everywhere是副词，前面通常不加in或at。

meanings_zh: n. 护照 | n. 通往成功等的途径
definition_en: an official document identifying you when travelling between countries | something that makes success or an opportunity possible
example1_en: I checked my bag twice to find my passport.
example1_zh: 我翻了两遍包才找到护照。
example2_en: A university degree is often viewed as a passport to better employment, although practical experience also matters.
example2_zh: 大学学位常被视为获得更好工作的通行证，不过实践经验也很重要。
collocations: valid passport｜有效护照 ; renew a passport｜换发护照 ; passport control｜护照查验处 ; a passport to success｜成功的通行证
tip_zh: 比喻用法a passport to中，to后接名词。

meanings_zh: n. 现金；现款 | v. 将支票兑现
definition_en: Money in the form of coins and banknotes | Exchange a cheque for money
example1_en: I keep some cash in my wallet for emergencies.
example1_zh: 我在钱包里放了一些现金，以备急用。
example2_en: Although digital payments are increasingly common, many small businesses still prefer customers to pay in cash.
example2_zh: 尽管电子支付日益普及，许多小商家仍然更希望顾客用现金付款。
collocations: pay in cash｜用现金付款 ; withdraw cash｜提取现金 ; cash a cheque｜兑现支票 ; cash flow｜现金流
tip_zh: cash作现金讲不可数；用现金付款是pay in cash。

meanings_zh: n. 围巾；头巾
definition_en: Cloth worn around the neck or head.
example1_en: She wrapped a wool scarf around her neck.
example1_zh: 她在脖子上围了一条羊毛围巾。
example2_en: In colder regions, a locally woven scarf can reflect traditional craftsmanship while providing essential warmth.
example2_zh: 在较寒冷的地区，当地织造的围巾既能体现传统手艺，又能提供必要的保暖。
collocations: wear a scarf｜戴围巾 ; a wool scarf｜羊毛围巾 ; wrap a scarf around your neck｜在脖子上围围巾
tip_zh: 复数可用scarves或scarfs，前者更常见。

meanings_zh: n. 肩；肩膀 | v. 承担；肩负
definition_en: the body part where an arm joins the upper body | to accept responsibility for something difficult
example1_en: She rested her head on her father's shoulder.
example1_zh: 她把头靠在父亲的肩膀上。
example2_en: Governments and businesses must shoulder greater responsibility for reducing the environmental impact of industrial production.
example2_zh: 政府和企业必须承担更大的责任，减少工业生产对环境的影响。
collocations: shoulder responsibility｜承担责任 ; shoulder the burden｜承担重担 ; shoulder to shoulder｜肩并肩 ; look over your shoulder｜回头看
tip_zh: 作动词常接responsibility或burden，表示承担。

meanings_zh: n. 冰箱；冷藏柜
definition_en: an appliance that keeps food and drinks cold
example1_en: Put the milk in the refrigerator before it spoils.
example1_zh: 把牛奶放进冰箱，免得变质。
example2_en: Replacing an old refrigerator with an efficient model can reduce household electricity consumption significantly.
example2_zh: 用节能型号替换旧冰箱，可以显著减少家庭用电量。
collocations: open the refrigerator｜打开冰箱 ; store food in the refrigerator｜把食物存放在冰箱里 ; refrigerator door｜冰箱门
tip_zh: 日常口语常用fridge；freezer专指冷冻柜或冷冻室。

meanings_zh: n. 王子；亲王 | n. 公国君主
definition_en: A male royal family member, often a monarch's son. | A male ruler of a small independent state.
example1_en: The prince waved to visitors from the palace balcony.
example1_zh: 王子在宫殿阳台上向来访者挥手。
example2_en: In some constitutional monarchies, a prince may support charitable organisations without holding any direct political power.
example2_zh: 在一些君主立宪制国家，王子可能支持慈善组织，但不掌握任何直接的政治权力。
collocations: crown prince｜王储 ; young prince｜年轻的王子
tip_zh: prince不一定是王子，也可指亲王或公国君主。

meanings_zh: n. 帆船运动；帆船航行 | n. 船舶航班
definition_en: The activity of travelling in a boat powered by wind. | A scheduled journey or departure by a ship or ferry.
example1_en: We went sailing on the lake last weekend.
example1_zh: 上周末我们去湖上玩帆船了。
example2_en: Sailing clubs can encourage outdoor exercise while teaching young people teamwork and respect for marine environments.
example2_zh: 帆船俱乐部能鼓励户外锻炼，同时培养年轻人的团队合作精神和对海洋环境的尊重。
collocations: go sailing｜去玩帆船 ; a sailing club｜帆船俱乐部 ; a sailing boat｜帆船 ; regular sailings｜定期船舶航班
tip_zh: 运动义不可数；航班义可数，如daily sailings。

meanings_zh: num. 第九 | n. 九分之一
definition_en: Coming after the eighth and before the tenth. | One of nine equal parts of something.
example1_en: Our new apartment is on the ninth floor.
example1_zh: 我们的新公寓在九楼。
example2_en: By the ninth year of the conservation programme, several endangered species had begun to recover.
example2_zh: 到保护项目实施的第九年，几种濒危物种的数量已开始回升。
collocations: the ninth floor｜九楼 ; the ninth century｜九世纪 ; in ninth place｜排在第九位 ; one ninth of｜……的九分之一
tip_zh: nine变ninth时去掉e；序数词前通常用the。

meanings_zh: n. 大自然；自然界 | n. 性质；本质 | n. 天性；性格
definition_en: The physical world, including plants, animals, and landscapes. | The basic qualities that make something what it is. | The qualities that shape how a person usually behaves.
example1_en: Camping helps us enjoy nature away from busy streets.
example1_zh: 露营让我们远离繁忙的街道，享受大自然。
example2_en: Understanding the nature of urban poverty is essential for developing policies that address its underlying causes.
example2_zh: 了解城市贫困的本质，对制定解决其根本原因的政策至关重要。
collocations: protect nature｜保护自然 ; the nature of｜……的本质 ; human nature｜人性 ; by nature｜天生地
tip_zh: 指大自然时通常不加the；某事的性质用the nature of。

meanings_zh: v. 回答；答复 | n. 回答；答复
definition_en: to answer someone or respond to a message | an answer given in speech or writing
example1_en: Please reply before Friday so I can book dinner.
example1_zh: 请在周五之前回复，好让我预订晚餐。
example2_en: Local officials should reply promptly to residents who raise concerns about public transport services.
example2_zh: 地方官员应及时答复对公共交通服务提出担忧的居民。
collocations: reply to a message｜回复消息 ; a prompt reply｜及时的答复 ; in reply to｜作为对……的答复
tip_zh: reply to后接人或消息，不直接接宾语。

meanings_zh: n. 石油；原油 | n. 油；食用油；润滑油 | v. 给…加润滑油
definition_en: A thick underground liquid used to produce fuel and chemicals. | A slippery liquid used for cooking, lubrication or other purposes. | To apply oil so that something moves smoothly.
example1_en: The truck carried oil from the well to the refinery.
example1_zh: 卡车把原油从油井运往炼油厂。
example2_en: Reducing dependence on oil requires sustained investment in renewable energy and more efficient public transport.
example2_zh: 减少对石油的依赖，需要持续投资于可再生能源和更高效的公共交通。
collocations: crude oil｜原油 ; oil prices｜石油价格 ; cooking oil｜食用油 ; oil a hinge｜给铰链加润滑油
tip_zh: 通常不可数；表示不同种类的油时可用oils。

meanings_zh: n. 豆；豆类植物
definition_en: An edible seed, or the plant that produces it.
example1_en: I added some beans to the vegetable soup.
example1_zh: 我在蔬菜汤里加了些豆子。
example2_en: Beans provide an affordable source of protein and can support a balanced plant-based diet.
example2_zh: 豆类是价格实惠的蛋白质来源，有助于形成均衡的植物性饮食。
collocations: green beans｜四季豆 ; kidney beans｜芸豆 ; coffee beans｜咖啡豆 ; baked beans｜茄汁焗豆
tip_zh: 可数名词；泛指食用豆类时通常用beans。

meanings_zh: v. 失败；未能做到 | v. 不及格；使不及格 | v. 失灵；衰退
definition_en: to be unsuccessful or not do something required | to not pass a test, or give an unsuccessful grade | to stop working properly or become weaker
example1_en: The cake failed to rise despite an extra egg.
example1_zh: 尽管多加了一个鸡蛋，蛋糕还是没发起来。
example2_en: Recycling programmes often fail when local authorities do not provide clear guidance or convenient collection services.
example2_zh: 地方政府若不提供清晰指导或便捷的收集服务，回收计划往往会失败。
collocations: fail to do something｜未能做某事 ; fail an exam｜考试不及格 ; fail to meet expectations｜未达到预期
tip_zh: fail to do表示未能做；fail an exam表示考试不及格。

meanings_zh: v. 介绍；引见 | v. 引进；推行 | v. 使初次了解
definition_en: Tell people each other's names when they first meet. | Bring something into use or a place for the first time. | Help someone experience or learn about something for the first time.
example1_en: Let me introduce you to my new neighbour.
example1_zh: 让我把你介绍给我的新邻居。
example2_en: Schools should introduce practical financial education to help students manage money responsibly in adult life.
example2_zh: 学校应引入实用的理财教育，帮助学生成年后负责任地管理财务。
collocations: introduce yourself｜介绍自己 ; introduce someone to someone｜把某人介绍给某人 ; introduce new measures｜推行新措施 ; introduce someone to a subject｜引导某人了解一门学科
tip_zh: 把甲介绍给乙用introduce A to B，不能用with。

meanings_zh: n. 舞者；舞蹈演员
definition_en: someone who dances, especially as a job
example1_en: The dancer spun gracefully across the small stage.
example1_zh: 那位舞者在小舞台上优雅地旋转。
example2_en: Professional dancers require regular physical training and adequate rest to maintain performance quality and prevent injuries.
example2_zh: 专业舞蹈演员需要定期体能训练和充分休息，以保持表演水平并预防受伤。
collocations: professional dancer｜专业舞蹈演员 ; ballet dancer｜芭蕾舞演员 ; talented dancer｜有天赋的舞者
tip_zh: dancer不限定性别，也不一定指职业舞者。

meanings_zh: adj. 倒霉的；不幸的 | adj. 被认为不吉利的
definition_en: Experiencing bad things because of chance | Believed to bring bad luck
example1_en: We were unlucky to miss the bus by seconds.
example1_zh: 我们真倒霉，只差几秒就错过了公交车。
example2_en: Students who are unlucky enough to fall ill during examinations should be offered alternative assessment arrangements.
example2_zh: 不幸在考试期间生病的学生应获得其他考核安排。
collocations: unlucky in love｜情场失意 ; unlucky enough to｜不幸竟然…… ; an unlucky day｜倒霉的一天
tip_zh: unlucky强调运气差，不等于unhappy（不开心）。

meanings_zh: adj. 不可能的 | adj. 极难应付的
definition_en: unable to happen, exist, or be done | extremely difficult to deal with or satisfy
example1_en: It is impossible to fit this sofa through the doorway.
example1_zh: 这张沙发根本无法从门口搬进去。
example2_en: Without reliable public transport, it is almost impossible for some rural residents to access essential services.
example2_zh: 没有可靠的公共交通，一些农村居民几乎无法获得基本服务。
collocations: almost impossible｜几乎不可能 ; impossible task｜不可能完成的任务 ; make it impossible to｜使……无法做到
tip_zh: 常用it is impossible to do，表示不可能做某事。

meanings_zh: adv. 在前面；向前 | adv. 领先；提前 | adv. 在未来；预先
definition_en: In front of someone or something, or moving forward. | Further advanced than others or earlier than expected. | In the future, or in preparation for it.
example1_en: Walk straight ahead until you reach the little bridge.
example1_zh: 一直往前走，直到走到那座小桥。
example2_en: Cities need to plan ahead to ensure that transport networks can meet the demands of growing populations.
example2_zh: 城市需要提前规划，确保交通网络能满足人口增长带来的需求。
collocations: straight ahead｜正前方；径直向前 ; ahead of schedule｜比预定时间提前 ; plan ahead｜提前规划 ; ahead of the competition｜领先竞争对手
tip_zh: ahead是副词；后接人或事物时用ahead of。

meanings_zh: n. 行李
definition_en: bags and cases that hold your belongings when travelling
example1_en: Our luggage barely fitted into the small taxi.
example1_zh: 我们的行李勉强塞进了那辆小出租车。
example2_en: Providing secure luggage storage at railway stations can encourage tourists to explore nearby attractions on foot.
example2_zh: 在火车站提供安全的行李寄存服务，可以鼓励游客步行游览附近景点。
collocations: hand luggage｜手提行李 ; luggage storage｜行李寄存 ; a piece of luggage｜一件行李 ; luggage allowance｜行李限额
tip_zh: 不可数；一件行李用a piece of luggage。

meanings_zh: n. 牛排；肉排；鱼排
definition_en: A thick slice of meat, especially beef, or fish.
example1_en: She served the steak with potatoes and green beans.
example1_zh: 她端上牛排，配了土豆和四季豆。
example2_en: Replacing beef steak with plant proteins occasionally can reduce the environmental impact of a person's diet.
example2_zh: 偶尔用植物蛋白代替牛排，可以减少个人饮食对环境的影响。
collocations: grilled steak｜烤牛排 ; sirloin steak｜西冷牛排 ; tuna steak｜金枪鱼排 ; well-done steak｜全熟牛排
tip_zh: steak与stake同音；单说steak通常指牛排。

meanings_zh: adj. 整洁的；整齐的 | v. 整理；收拾
definition_en: Neatly arranged, with everything in its proper place. | To put things in order and make a place neat.
example1_en: Her desk stays tidy, even during the busiest weeks.
example1_zh: 即使在最忙的几周里，她的书桌也保持整洁。
example2_en: Keeping shared workplaces tidy can help employees find equipment quickly and create a more pleasant environment.
example2_zh: 保持共用工作场所整洁，有助于员工迅速找到设备，并营造更舒适的环境。
collocations: keep tidy｜保持整洁 ; tidy up｜收拾整齐 ; neat and tidy｜干净整齐
tip_zh: tidy强调摆放整齐；clean强调没有污垢。

meanings_zh: n. 羊毛；毛线；毛料
definition_en: Sheep's soft hair, or yarn and cloth made from it.
example1_en: This wool scarf keeps my neck warm on windy mornings.
example1_zh: 这条羊毛围巾让我的脖子在刮风的早晨保持温暖。
example2_en: Wool provides natural insulation, making it a useful material for clothing designed for cold climates.
example2_zh: 羊毛具有天然保温性能，因此适合用来制作寒冷气候下穿着的衣物。
collocations: pure wool｜纯羊毛 ; a ball of wool｜一团毛线 ; wool blanket｜羊毛毯 ; wool production｜羊毛生产
tip_zh: 通常不可数；一团毛线说a ball of wool。

meanings_zh: n. 零钱包；女式手提包 | n. 资金；财力 | v. 噘起；撮拢嘴唇
definition_en: a small money holder; in American English, a handbag | money available to a person, organisation, or government | to press your lips together into a small rounded shape
example1_en: She opened her purse and took out a coin.
example1_zh: 她打开零钱包，取出一枚硬币。
example2_en: Investment in preventive healthcare could reduce the long-term burden on the public purse.
example2_zh: 投资预防性医疗可以减轻公共财政的长期负担。
collocations: a leather purse｜皮质零钱包 ; the public purse｜公共财政 ; purse your lips｜噘起嘴唇
tip_zh: 英式purse多指零钱包，美式常指女式手提包。

meanings_zh: n. 日落；日落时分 | n. 落日景象；晚霞
definition_en: the time when the sun disappears below the horizon | the colourful sky seen as the sun goes down
example1_en: We reached the beach just before sunset yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天我们在日落前刚好赶到了海滩。
example2_en: Coastal destinations often attract tourists with spectacular sunset views, creating valuable opportunities for local businesses.
example2_zh: 沿海目的地常以壮丽的落日景色吸引游客，为当地企业创造宝贵商机。
collocations: at sunset｜在日落时分 ; watch the sunset｜看日落 ; a spectacular sunset｜壮丽的落日景象
tip_zh: 表示在日落时用at sunset，通常不加冠词。

meanings_zh: v. 注意到；察觉 | n. 通知；告示 | n. 提前通知
definition_en: to become aware of something through your senses | a written statement giving information or instructions | information given before something happens or ends
example1_en: Did you notice the tiny bird outside our window?
example1_zh: 你注意到窗外那只小鸟了吗？
example2_en: Residents often notice improvements in air quality when cities restrict traffic in central areas.
example2_zh: 城市限制中心区域的交通时，居民常会察觉空气质量有所改善。
collocations: notice a difference｜察觉差异 ; take notice of｜留意 ; give notice｜提前通知 ; at short notice｜在通知很仓促的情况下
tip_zh: notice sb do强调全过程；notice sb doing强调正在发生。

meanings_zh: n. 英国；联合王国
definition_en: The country comprising England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland.
example1_en: We travelled around the United Kingdom by train last summer.
example1_zh: 去年夏天，我们乘火车游览了英国各地。
example2_en: International students in the United Kingdom contribute to university communities through their diverse experiences and perspectives.
example2_zh: 在英国的国际学生以多样的经历和视角为大学社区作出贡献。
collocations: the United Kingdom｜英国 ; across the United Kingdom｜遍及英国 ; the United Kingdom economy｜英国经济
tip_zh: 前面通常加the；包括北爱尔兰，不等同于大不列颠。

meanings_zh: adv. 很可能；大概
