definition_en: Used when something is likely but not certain.
example1_en: The bakery will probably close before we get there.
example1_zh: 我们到那儿之前，面包店很可能就关门了。
example2_en: Cities that invest in reliable public transport will probably experience less traffic congestion over time.
example2_zh: 投资建设可靠公共交通的城市，交通拥堵很可能会逐渐减轻。
collocations: will probably｜很可能会 ; probably not｜大概不会 ; probably because｜很可能是因为
tip_zh: 通常置于实义动词前、be动词后或第一个助动词后。

meanings_zh: n. 布；织物 | n. 抹布；一块布
definition_en: Material made by weaving or knitting fibres. | A piece of fabric used for cleaning or covering things.
example1_en: She chose soft cotton cloth for the baby's blanket.
example1_zh: 她选了柔软的棉布来做婴儿毯。
example2_en: Replacing disposable wipes with reusable cloth can reduce household waste and lower long-term cleaning costs.
example2_zh: 用可重复使用的布代替一次性湿巾，可以减少家庭垃圾并降低长期清洁成本。
collocations: cotton cloth｜棉布 ; a damp cloth｜湿抹布 ; a piece of cloth｜一块布
tip_zh: 布料义不可数；抹布可数，复数cloths；勿混clothes。

meanings_zh: n. 交通运输；交通工具 | v. 运输；运送
definition_en: Vehicles or systems used to move people and goods. | To move people or goods from one place to another.
example1_en: We rely on public transport to get around town.
example1_zh: 我们在城里出行靠公共交通。
example2_en: Better transport links between rural areas and cities can expand employment opportunities for local residents.
example2_zh: 改善乡村与城市之间的交通联系可以为当地居民增加就业机会。
collocations: public transport｜公共交通 ; transport links｜交通联系 ; transport goods｜运输货物 ; transport network｜交通网络
tip_zh: 上列为名词音标；动词重音后移，英/t/前为/n/。

meanings_zh: v. 落下；使掉落；下降 | n. 滴；少量液体 | v. 停止；放弃
definition_en: to fall, let something fall, or become lower | a very small, rounded amount of liquid | to stop doing or considering something
example1_en: I dropped my keys while reaching for my phone.
example1_zh: 我伸手拿手机时，钥匙掉了。
example2_en: If public transport becomes more reliable, the number of people driving to work may drop significantly.
example2_zh: 如果公共交通变得更可靠，开车上班的人数可能会显著下降。
collocations: a drop in prices｜价格下降 ; a drop of water｜一滴水 ; drop a course｜退选一门课 ; drop sharply｜急剧下降
tip_zh: drop by表示下降了多少；drop to表示降至多少。

meanings_zh: v. 分享；共用；分担 | n. 一份；份额 | n. 股份
definition_en: To use, enjoy or take responsibility for something with others. | One part of something divided among people or groups. | One of the equal units of ownership in a company.
example1_en: My sister and I share a desk by the window.
example1_zh: 我和姐姐共用窗边的一张书桌。
example2_en: When residents share responsibility for public spaces, neighbourhoods often become cleaner and more welcoming.
example2_zh: 当居民共同承担公共空间的维护责任时，社区往往会变得更整洁、更宜居。
collocations: share something with someone｜与某人分享某物 ; share responsibility｜分担责任 ; market share｜市场份额 ; buy shares｜购买股份
tip_zh: 与某人分享用share something with someone。

meanings_zh: n. 有轨电车
definition_en: An electric passenger vehicle running on tracks along city streets.
example1_en: We caught the tram outside the library this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上我们在图书馆外乘上了有轨电车。
example2_en: Investing in tram networks can reduce traffic congestion and improve access to busy city centres.
example2_zh: 投资建设有轨电车网络可以缓解交通拥堵，让人们更方便地前往繁忙的市中心。
collocations: catch a tram｜赶上有轨电车 ; tram stop｜有轨电车站 ; tram network｜有轨电车网络
tip_zh: 指车辆，不是轨道；美式英语常用streetcar。

meanings_zh: n. 信封
definition_en: A flat paper container used for sending a letter.
example1_en: She slipped the birthday card into a blue envelope.
example1_zh: 她把生日贺卡放进了一个蓝色信封。
example2_en: Although digital communication is widespread, official documents are still sometimes delivered in a sealed envelope for privacy.
example2_zh: 尽管数字通信十分普及，官方文件有时仍会装在密封信封里送达，以保护隐私。
collocations: a sealed envelope｜密封的信封 ; open an envelope｜拆信封 ; a padded envelope｜有衬垫的信封
tip_zh: envelope是“信封”；envelop是“包围”的动词。

meanings_zh: n. 鹦鹉 | v. 机械地重复；鹦鹉学舌
definition_en: a tropical bird with a curved beak, sometimes copying speech | to repeat someone's words without understanding or considering them
example1_en: The green parrot cracked a seed with its beak.
example1_zh: 那只绿色鹦鹉用喙啄开了一粒种子。
example2_en: Students who merely parrot their teachers' explanations may struggle to apply knowledge to unfamiliar situations.
example2_zh: 只会机械重复教师讲解的学生，可能难以将知识应用于陌生情境。
collocations: pet parrot｜宠物鹦鹉 ; parrot someone's words｜机械重复某人的话 ; parrot fashion｜鹦鹉学舌般地
tip_zh: 作动词常带贬义，强调不加理解或思考地重复。

meanings_zh: n. 帆板运动
definition_en: A water sport using a board with an attached sail.
example1_en: My sister tried windsurfing during our holiday by the lake.
example1_zh: 我们在湖边度假时，我姐姐尝试了帆板运动。
example2_en: Windsurfing schools can attract visitors to coastal towns, provided that local authorities establish clear water safety guidelines.
example2_zh: 只要地方政府制定明确的水上安全准则，帆板学校就能吸引游客前往沿海城镇。
collocations: go windsurfing｜去玩帆板 ; windsurfing equipment｜帆板运动装备 ; windsurfing lessons｜帆板课程
tip_zh: windsurfing借帆利用风力；surfing主要借海浪滑行。

meanings_zh: v. 穿过；横渡；交叉 | n. 十字形；十字架 | adj. 生气的；恼怒的
definition_en: to go from one side to another, or intersect | a shape made by two intersecting lines, or a religious symbol | annoyed or slightly angry
example1_en: We waited for the traffic to stop before crossing.
example1_zh: 我们等车辆停下后才过马路。
example2_en: Safer pedestrian routes encourage residents to cross busy roads on foot rather than drive short distances.
example2_zh: 更安全的步行路线鼓励居民步行穿过繁忙道路，而不是短途开车。
collocations: cross the road｜过马路 ; cross a bridge｜过桥 ; cross with someone｜生某人的气
tip_zh: cross是动词；across是介词或副词。

meanings_zh: n. 阶段；时期 | n. 舞台 | v. 上演；举办；组织
definition_en: A particular period or step in a process. | A raised area where performers appear before an audience. | To organise and present a performance or public event.
example1_en: The cake is cooling at this stage of preparation.
example1_zh: 制作进行到这个阶段，蛋糕正在冷却。
example2_en: Early intervention at a critical stage of childhood can significantly improve educational outcomes later in life.
example2_zh: 在童年的关键阶段及早干预，能显著改善日后的教育成果。
collocations: at an early stage｜在早期阶段 ; a stage of development｜发展阶段 ; on stage｜在舞台上 ; stage a play｜上演戏剧
tip_zh: 表示阶段常用at a stage；表示在舞台上用on stage。

meanings_zh: adv. 向前；向将来 | v. 转寄；转发 | n. 前锋
definition_en: towards the front or a later time | to send something received to another person or place | an attacking player in sports such as football
example1_en: Please step forward when there is space ahead.
example1_zh: 前面有空位时，请向前走一步。
example2_en: Investment in renewable energy can help countries move forward towards a more sustainable economic future.
example2_zh: 投资可再生能源有助于各国迈向更可持续的经济未来。
collocations: move forward｜向前移动；取得进展 ; look forward to｜期待 ; forward an email｜转发邮件 ; put forward a proposal｜提出建议
tip_zh: look forward to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: n. 同事；同僚
definition_en: Someone you work with, especially in a professional job.
example1_en: My colleague brought homemade soup to the office today.
example1_zh: 我的同事今天把自制的汤带到了办公室。
example2_en: Sharing knowledge with colleagues can improve workplace efficiency and help new employees develop essential skills.
example2_zh: 与同事分享知识可以提高工作效率，并帮助新员工培养必要技能。
collocations: work colleague｜工作同事 ; former colleague｜前同事 ; a close colleague｜关系密切的同事
tip_zh: colleague指同事，不一定是朋友或同级员工。

meanings_zh: n. 脏乱；杂乱 | n. 困境；混乱局面 | v. 弄乱；弄糟
definition_en: A dirty or untidy state or collection of things. | A situation full of problems or confusion. | To make something untidy or spoil it, usually with up.
example1_en: The kitchen was a mess after we baked biscuits.
example1_zh: 我们烤完饼干后，厨房一片狼藉。
example2_en: Without clear responsibilities, a community project can quickly become a mess, wasting both time and resources.
example2_zh: 如果职责不清，社区项目很快就可能陷入混乱，既浪费时间又浪费资源。
collocations: make a mess｜弄得一团糟 ; in a mess｜乱七八糟 ; mess up｜弄糟
tip_zh: 常说make a mess；mess up可指弄乱或搞砸。

meanings_zh: n. 水平；程度；高度 | adj. 平坦的；同高的 | v. 使平坦；使相等
definition_en: A particular standard, amount, or height of something. | Flat and even, or at the same height. | To make a surface flat or things equal.
example1_en: The water level rose after last night's heavy rain.
example1_zh: 昨晚的大雨过后，水位上升了。
example2_en: Improving the level of public transport can encourage more residents to leave their cars at home.
example2_zh: 提高公共交通服务水平可以鼓励更多居民不开私家车出行。
collocations: sea level｜海平面 ; a high level of｜高水平的；大量的 ; level ground｜平坦的地面 ; level the playing field｜创造公平竞争环境
tip_zh: at表示所处水平；on the same level可指同一楼层。

meanings_zh: adv. 后来；之后
definition_en: At a later time, following an event.
example1_en: We watched a film and had dinner afterwards.
example1_zh: 我们看了一部电影，之后吃了晚饭。
example2_en: Students who discuss a lecture afterwards may remember its key ideas more clearly than those who do not.
example2_zh: 课后讨论讲座内容的学生，可能比不讨论的学生更清楚地记住其中的要点。
collocations: shortly afterwards｜不久之后 ; soon afterwards｜随后不久 ; immediately afterwards｜紧接着
tip_zh: 是副词，后面不直接接宾语；after可接宾语。

meanings_zh: adj. 空的；无人的 | v. 倒空；清空 | adj. 空洞的；无诚意的
definition_en: Containing nothing or having no people inside. | To remove everything from a container or place. | Lacking real meaning, value, or sincere intention.
example1_en: The biscuit tin was empty when I opened it.
example1_zh: 我打开饼干盒时，里面已经空了。
example2_en: Converting empty office buildings into affordable housing could help cities address shortages without expanding into surrounding countryside.
example2_zh: 将空置办公楼改造成可负担住房，可以帮助城市缓解住房短缺，而不必向周边乡村扩张。
collocations: empty room｜空房间 ; empty promises｜空头承诺 ; empty the bin｜倒空垃圾桶 ; on an empty stomach｜空腹
tip_zh: empty强调里面没有东西；vacant常指房屋或职位空缺。

meanings_zh: v. 挣得；赚取 | v. 赢得；博得
definition_en: To receive money in return for work. | To gain something deserved through your actions or qualities.
example1_en: She earns extra money by walking dogs after school.
example1_zh: 她放学后帮人遛狗，赚些零花钱。
example2_en: Companies can earn public trust by reporting their environmental impact honestly and taking responsibility for their mistakes.
example2_zh: 企业可以通过如实报告环境影响并为自身错误负责来赢得公众信任。
collocations: earn a living｜谋生 ; earn money｜挣钱 ; earn respect｜赢得尊重 ; earn a reputation｜赢得声誉
tip_zh: earn强调劳动或表现所得；win多指比赛获胜。

meanings_zh: n. 冒险；奇遇 | n. 冒险精神
definition_en: An exciting experience involving uncertainty or possible danger | Willingness to explore unfamiliar or exciting situations
example1_en: Our camping trip turned into an adventure after dark.
example1_zh: 天黑后，我们的露营之旅变成了一次冒险。
example2_en: Outdoor adventure activities can help young people develop confidence and learn to cooperate with others.
example2_zh: 户外探险活动能帮助年轻人建立自信，并学会与他人合作。
collocations: go on an adventure｜去探险 ; a sense of adventure｜冒险精神 ; adventure tourism｜探险旅游
tip_zh: adventure指具体经历时可数，指冒险精神时不可数。

meanings_zh: num. 第十二 | n. 十二分之一
definition_en: Coming after the eleventh in a sequence. | One of twelve equal parts of something.
example1_en: We celebrated her twelfth birthday with a homemade cake.
example1_zh: 我们用自制蛋糕庆祝了她的十二岁生日。
example2_en: By the twelfth month of the programme, most participants had developed more effective study habits.
example2_zh: 到该项目的第十二个月时，大多数参与者已经养成了更有效的学习习惯。
collocations: twelfth birthday｜十二岁生日 ; the twelfth century｜十二世纪 ; one twelfth of｜……的十二分之一
tip_zh: twelve变序数词为twelfth，注意ve变为f。

meanings_zh: n. 腰带；皮带 | n. 带状区域；地带 | n. 传动带；输送带
definition_en: a strip worn around the waist to hold clothes | a long area with a particular feature | a continuous strip that moves machinery or carries objects
example1_en: This belt keeps my trousers from slipping down.
example1_zh: 这条腰带能防止我的裤子往下滑。
example2_en: A green belt around a city can limit urban expansion and protect nearby farmland from development.
example2_zh: 城市周边的绿化带可以限制城市扩张，保护附近农田免遭开发。
collocations: leather belt｜皮腰带 ; fasten a belt｜系好腰带 ; green belt｜城市周边绿化带 ; conveyor belt｜传送带
tip_zh: belt除腰带外也指带状区域，如green belt。

meanings_zh: n. 男消防员
definition_en: A man whose job is to put out fires.
example1_en: The fireman rescued a kitten from the smoky kitchen.
example1_zh: 这名男消防员从烟雾弥漫的厨房里救出了一只小猫。
example2_en: The fireman explained that regular safety inspections could prevent many accidents in residential buildings.
example2_zh: 这名男消防员解释说，定期安全检查可以预防住宅楼内的许多事故。
collocations: a brave fireman｜勇敢的男消防员 ; a fireman's helmet｜消防员头盔 ; a volunteer fireman｜志愿男消防员
tip_zh: 复数为firemen；现代通用表达多用中性的firefighter。

meanings_zh: n. 面试；面谈 | n. 采访；访谈 | v. 面试；采访
definition_en: a meeting to assess someone's suitability for a position | a conversation where someone answers questions for media or research | to ask someone questions for selection, reporting, or research
example1_en: I practised answering questions before my first job interview.
example1_zh: 第一次求职面试前，我练习了如何回答问题。
example2_en: Researchers should interview residents from diverse backgrounds to understand how housing policies affect different social groups.
example2_zh: 研究人员应访谈不同背景的居民，了解住房政策如何影响不同社会群体。
collocations: job interview｜求职面试 ; conduct an interview｜进行面试或访谈 ; interview candidates｜面试候选人 ; an in-depth interview｜深度访谈
tip_zh: interviewer是提问者；interviewee是接受面试或采访者。

meanings_zh: adj. 相似的；类似的
definition_en: Almost the same, but not exactly alike.
example1_en: Your jacket looks similar to mine, but slightly darker.
example1_zh: 你的夹克看起来和我的相似，不过颜色稍深一点。
example2_en: Cities with similar population sizes may require different transport policies because of their geographical features.
example2_zh: 人口规模相近的城市可能因地理特征不同而需要不同的交通政策。
collocations: similar to｜与……相似 ; similar characteristics｜相似的特征 ; broadly similar｜大致相似
tip_zh: 用similar to，不用similar with；相似不等于相同。

meanings_zh: adj. 整个的；完整的 | n. 整体；全部
definition_en: Complete, with no part missing or left out. | A complete thing made up of connected parts.
example1_en: We spent the whole afternoon baking bread together.
example1_zh: 我们整个下午都在一起烤面包。
example2_en: Transport policies should consider the needs of the whole community rather than focusing only on car owners.
example2_zh: 交通政策应考虑整个社区的需求，而不应只关注汽车拥有者。
collocations: the whole day｜一整天 ; as a whole｜作为整体 ; on the whole｜总的来说 ; a whole range of｜各种各样的
tip_zh: 注意语序：the whole day＝all the day。

meanings_zh: n. 想法；念头 | n. 思考；考虑 | v. 想；认为（过去式）
definition_en: an idea or opinion formed in the mind | the process of thinking carefully about something | past tense and past participle of think
example1_en: A sudden thought made me check my coat pocket.
example1_zh: 一个突然冒出的念头让我检查了一下外套口袋。
example2_en: Urban planning requires careful thought about how public spaces can serve people of different ages.
example2_zh: 城市规划需要仔细考虑公共空间如何服务不同年龄的人群。
collocations: give something some thought｜考虑某事 ; deep in thought｜陷入沉思 ; a sudden thought｜突然冒出的念头 ; food for thought｜引人深思的事物
tip_zh: 表具体想法时可数；表思考过程时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: adv. 大声地；响亮地
definition_en: With a sound that has high volume.
example1_en: Everyone cheered loudly when our team won the match.
example1_zh: 我们队赢得比赛时，大家都大声欢呼。
example2_en: Passengers who speak loudly on public transport can disturb others, particularly during early morning or late evening journeys.
example2_zh: 在公共交通工具上大声说话的乘客会打扰他人，尤其是在清晨或深夜的行程中。
collocations: speak loudly｜大声说话 ; laugh loudly｜放声大笑 ; cheer loudly｜大声欢呼
tip_zh: loudly强调音量大；aloud强调出声而非默读。

meanings_zh: n. 重量；体重 | n. 重物；砝码 | n. 重要性；影响力
definition_en: How heavy someone or something is. | A heavy object used for exercise or measuring weight. | The importance or influence given to something.
example1_en: The weight of this suitcase makes it hard to lift.
example1_zh: 这个行李箱太重，很难提起来。
example2_en: Policymakers should give greater weight to scientific evidence when designing strategies to improve public health.
example2_zh: 政策制定者在设计改善公共健康的策略时，应更加重视科学证据。
collocations: lose weight｜减重 ; gain weight｜增重 ; lift weights｜举重训练 ; give weight to｜重视
tip_zh: weight是名词；weigh是动词：How much does it weigh?

meanings_zh: n. 文件夹；纸夹 | n. 电脑文件夹
definition_en: A folded cover used to hold loose papers. | A place on a computer where files are grouped together.
example1_en: Keep your receipts in this folder beside the desk.
example1_zh: 把收据放在桌子旁的这个文件夹里。
example2_en: Organising digital resources into clearly named folders can help students locate information efficiently during research projects.
example2_zh: 将数字资源整理到命名清晰的文件夹中，可以帮助学生在研究项目中高效查找信息。
collocations: create a folder｜创建文件夹 ; a shared folder｜共享文件夹 ; save files in a folder｜将文件存入文件夹
tip_zh: file是文件；folder是存放文件的文件夹。

meanings_zh: v. 偷窃；盗用 | v. 偷偷移动 | n. 极便宜的东西
definition_en: to take something without permission and keep or use it | to move quietly without attracting attention | something bought for much less than its usual price
example1_en: Someone stole my bicycle while I was buying bread.
example1_zh: 我买面包的时候，有人偷走了我的自行车。
example2_en: Companies must protect customer information because criminals may steal personal data from insecure websites.
example2_zh: 企业必须保护客户信息，因为犯罪分子可能从不安全的网站窃取个人数据。
collocations: steal from someone｜偷某人的东西 ; steal an idea｜盗用创意 ; steal the show｜抢尽风头
tip_zh: 过去式stole，过去分词stolen；宾语通常是物。

meanings_zh: adj. 现代的；近代的 | adj. 新式的；时髦的
definition_en: Relating to the present or relatively recent times. | Using the latest ideas, methods, or styles.
example1_en: Our flat has a modern kitchen with large windows.
example1_zh: 我们的公寓有一间新式厨房，窗户很大。
example2_en: Modern technology allows students in remote areas to access educational resources previously available only in cities.
example2_zh: 现代技术让偏远地区的学生能够获取过去只有城市才有的教育资源。
collocations: modern society｜现代社会 ; modern technology｜现代技术 ; modern architecture｜现代建筑
tip_zh: modern强调现代或新式；不一定表示刚刚制造。

meanings_zh: n. 意见；看法
definition_en: a belief or judgement about someone or something
example1_en: What is your opinion of our new kitchen?
example1_zh: 你觉得我们的新厨房怎么样？
example2_en: In my opinion, public transport should be affordable enough to encourage people to leave their cars at home.
example2_zh: 在我看来，公共交通的价格应足够实惠，从而鼓励人们不开私家车出门。
collocations: in my opinion｜在我看来 ; public opinion｜公众舆论 ; express an opinion｜表达意见 ; a difference of opinion｜意见分歧
tip_zh: 表达“在我看来”用in my opinion，不用according to me。

meanings_zh: n. 病人；患者 | adj. 有耐心的；能忍耐的
definition_en: Someone receiving medical care. | Able to wait or handle difficulties without becoming annoyed.
example1_en: The nurse brought the patient a glass of water.
example1_zh: 护士给病人端来了一杯水。
example2_en: Allowing patients to discuss treatment options can improve trust and lead to better health outcomes.
example2_zh: 让患者讨论治疗方案可以增进信任，并改善健康结果。
collocations: treat a patient｜治疗患者 ; patient care｜患者护理 ; be patient with｜对……有耐心
tip_zh: 作名词是“患者”；作形容词常接with。

meanings_zh: n. 机器人；自动机械
definition_en: a machine programmed to perform tasks automatically
example1_en: A small robot cleaned the floor while we ate breakfast.
example1_zh: 我们吃早饭时，一台小机器人清扫了地板。
example2_en: Robots can perform repetitive factory tasks, but workers may need additional training to move into new roles.
example2_zh: 机器人可以执行重复性的工厂任务，但工人可能需要额外培训才能转入新岗位。
collocations: industrial robot｜工业机器人 ; robot arm｜机械臂 ; autonomous robot｜自主机器人
tip_zh: robot是可数名词；robotics指机器人学。

meanings_zh: n. 公公；岳父
definition_en: the father of your husband or wife
example1_en: My father-in-law helped us repair the garden fence.
example1_zh: 我岳父帮我们修好了花园的围栏。
example2_en: Living with a father-in-law may encourage families to share household expenses and provide care across generations.
example2_zh: 与公公或岳父同住，可能促使家人分担家庭开支，并提供代际照料。
collocations: future father-in-law｜未来的公公或岳父 ; elderly father-in-law｜年迈的公公或岳父
tip_zh: 不是继父；继父是stepfather。

meanings_zh: n. 领导者；带领者 | n. 领先者；领先机构
definition_en: Someone who guides or directs a group of people. | A person or organization ahead of others in a field.
example1_en: Our group leader showed us the safest mountain path.
example1_zh: 我们的领队给我们指明了最安全的山路。
example2_en: Effective leaders encourage employees to share ideas rather than simply follow instructions without question.
example2_zh: 高效的领导者鼓励员工分享想法，而不是毫无疑问地服从指令。
collocations: team leader｜团队负责人 ; political leader｜政治领袖 ; market leader｜市场领先企业 ; leadership skills｜领导技能
tip_zh: leader指领导者；leadership指领导能力或领导层。

meanings_zh: n. 地铁（美式） | n. 地下人行通道（英式）
definition_en: An urban railway system that runs mainly underground. | A passage allowing people to walk beneath a road.
example1_en: We took the subway to the museum this morning.
example1_zh: 今天上午我们乘地铁去了博物馆。
example2_en: Expanding subway networks can ease traffic congestion, provided that services remain affordable and accessible to local residents.
example2_zh: 扩建地铁网络可以缓解交通拥堵，前提是当地居民能够负担票价并方便地使用服务。
collocations: take the subway｜乘地铁 ; subway station｜地铁站 ; subway line｜地铁线路 ; pedestrian subway｜地下人行通道
tip_zh: 美式指地铁；英式常指地下人行通道。

meanings_zh: adj. 高兴的；满意的
definition_en: feeling happy or satisfied about something
example1_en: I'm really pleased with how the cake turned out.
example1_zh: 我对这个蛋糕做出来的效果非常满意。
example2_en: Residents were pleased that the council had created more green spaces for children to play safely.
example2_zh: 居民们很高兴，市政部门增设了更多绿地，让孩子们可以安全地玩耍。
collocations: pleased with｜对……满意 ; pleased to hear｜听到……很高兴 ; pleased to meet you｜很高兴认识你
tip_zh: 对结果满意用pleased with；听到喜讯用pleased to hear。

meanings_zh: adj. 主要的；最重要的 | n. 主管道；干线
definition_en: Most important or largest among others. | A large pipe or cable supplying water, gas, or electricity.
example1_en: The main entrance is beside the little coffee shop.
example1_zh: 正门就在那家小咖啡馆旁边。
example2_en: One main reason for urban migration is the wider range of employment opportunities available in cities.
example2_zh: 人们迁往城市的一个主要原因是城市提供的就业机会更多。
collocations: main reason｜主要原因 ; main entrance｜正门 ; main concern｜主要关切 ; water main｜供水主管道
tip_zh: 形容词通常放在名词前；主要地用mainly。

meanings_zh: n. 药店（兼售日用品）
definition_en: an American shop selling medicines and various everyday products
example1_en: I bought some toothpaste at the drugstore near the station.
example1_zh: 我在车站附近的药店买了些牙膏。
example2_en: In some communities, the local drugstore provides essential health advice as well as affordable medicines.
example2_zh: 在一些社区，当地药店不仅提供价格实惠的药品，也提供必要的健康建议。
collocations: local drugstore｜当地药店 ; drugstore chain｜连锁药店 ; drugstore counter｜药店柜台
tip_zh: 主要用于美式英语；英式常用chemist’s或pharmacy。

meanings_zh: det. 几个；数个 | pron. 几个；数个
definition_en: More than two but not many | A few people or things already mentioned or understood
example1_en: I tried several jackets before choosing the blue one.
example1_zh: 我试了几件夹克后，选中了蓝色的那件。
example2_en: Several studies suggest that access to green spaces can improve mental health among people living in cities.
example2_zh: 几项研究表明，能够接触绿地可能改善城市居民的心理健康。
collocations: several times｜几次 ; several years｜数年 ; several of them｜他们中的几个 ; for several reasons｜出于几个原因
tip_zh: 后接可数名词复数；several of后接限定词或代词。

meanings_zh: n. 理发师；美发师
definition_en: someone whose job is to cut and style hair
example1_en: The hairdresser trimmed my hair and dried it gently.
example1_zh: 美发师修剪了我的头发，然后轻轻吹干。
example2_en: Training as a hairdresser combines practical skills with customer service, offering a career path outside traditional academic education.
example2_zh: 美发师培训将实操技能与客户服务相结合，提供了传统学术教育之外的职业道路。
collocations: qualified hairdresser｜合格的美发师 ; go to the hairdresser's｜去理发店 ; hairdresser's salon｜美发沙龙
tip_zh: hairdresser指人；the hairdresser's通常指理发店。

meanings_zh: n. 顾客；客户
definition_en: A person or organisation that buys goods or services.
example1_en: The customer asked for a larger pair of shoes.
example1_zh: 这位顾客想要一双大一点的鞋。
example2_en: Businesses can build customer loyalty by providing reliable products and responding quickly to complaints.
example2_zh: 企业可以通过提供可靠的产品并迅速回应投诉来培养客户忠诚度。
collocations: customer service｜客户服务 ; regular customer｜常客 ; customer satisfaction｜客户满意度 ; customer loyalty｜客户忠诚度
tip_zh: customer泛指顾客；client常指专业服务的客户。

meanings_zh: v. 收集；收藏 | v. 领取；接走 | v. 募集；收取
definition_en: To gather things together or keep objects as a hobby | To go somewhere and bring someone or something away | To receive or gather money from people
example1_en: I collect smooth stones whenever we visit the beach.
example1_zh: 每次去海边，我都会收集光滑的石头。
example2_en: Researchers collect data from local households to assess how transport policies affect daily travel habits.
example2_zh: 研究人员收集当地家庭的数据，以评估交通政策如何影响日常出行习惯。
collocations: collect data｜收集数据 ; collect a parcel｜领取包裹 ; collect donations｜募集捐款 ; collect stamps｜集邮
tip_zh: 英式英语collect someone可指去接某人。

meanings_zh: n. 青蛙
definition_en: A small amphibian with long back legs for jumping.
example1_en: A green frog jumped from the stone into our pond.
example1_zh: 一只绿色的青蛙从石头上跳进了我们的池塘。
example2_en: Declining frog populations can indicate environmental damage because these animals are sensitive to changes in water quality.
example2_zh: 青蛙数量下降可能表明环境遭到破坏，因为它们对水质变化十分敏感。
collocations: tree frog｜树蛙 ; frog population｜青蛙种群 ; frog spawn｜蛙卵
tip_zh: 可数名词，复数为frogs；toad指蟾蜍。

meanings_zh: n. 魔法；魔术 | n. 魅力；奇妙之处 | adj. 有魔力的；魔术的
definition_en: An imaginary supernatural power, or tricks that seem to use it. | A special quality that makes something exciting or wonderful. | Having supernatural powers or used in performing tricks.
example1_en: The children laughed when he performed a magic trick.
example1_zh: 他表演魔术时，孩子们笑了起来。
example2_en: Although technology can improve education, it is not a magic solution to every problem schools face.
example2_zh: 虽然技术能够改善教育，但它不是解决学校所有问题的神奇办法。
collocations: magic trick｜魔术戏法 ; magic wand｜魔杖 ; magic solution｜神奇的解决办法
tip_zh: magic 多指魔法或魔术；magical 也可形容美妙体验。

meanings_zh: n. 话题；主题
definition_en: a subject that people discuss, write about, or study
example1_en: Food is always a popular topic in our house.
example1_zh: 食物在我们家一直是个热门话题。
example2_en: Climate change has become a central topic in school discussions about the future of our planet.
example2_zh: 气候变化已成为学校讨论地球未来时的核心话题。
collocations: a topic of discussion｜讨论的话题 ; a controversial topic｜有争议的话题 ; change the topic｜转换话题 ; research topic｜研究课题
tip_zh: topic指讨论或写作的主题；title指文章等的标题。

meanings_zh: adj. 糟糕的；令人厌恶的 | adj. 可怕的；令人震惊的
definition_en: very unpleasant or bad | causing strong fear or shock
example1_en: A horrible smell came from the forgotten lunch box.
example1_zh: 那个被遗忘的午餐盒散发出难闻的气味。
example2_en: Residents described the horrible conditions in overcrowded housing and called for stricter enforcement of safety standards.
example2_zh: 居民描述了拥挤住房中的恶劣条件，并呼吁更严格地执行安全标准。
collocations: a horrible smell｜难闻的气味 ; a horrible experience｜糟糕的经历 ; horrible weather｜恶劣的天气
tip_zh: horrible常指很糟糕；horrific多指骇人、惨烈。

meanings_zh: adj. 额外的；附加的 | adv. 额外地；格外地 | n. 额外项目；群众演员
definition_en: added to the usual or necessary amount | more than usual, or in addition to the normal amount | an additional item, or a background actor in a film
example1_en: I packed an extra sweater because the evenings get cold.
example1_zh: 我多带了一件毛衣，因为晚上会冷。
example2_en: Schools should provide extra support for students who struggle to access learning materials at home.
example2_zh: 学校应为在家难以获取学习资料的学生提供额外支持。
collocations: extra time｜额外时间 ; extra charge｜额外费用 ; extra care｜格外小心 ; pay extra｜额外付费
tip_zh: 形容词指额外的；pay extra中作副词。

meanings_zh: prep. 反对；与……对抗 | prep. 靠着；紧贴 | prep. 防备；抵御
definition_en: Opposing someone or something, or competing with them. | Touching or supported by a surface. | For protection from something harmful or unwanted.
example1_en: Our team is playing against the neighbours this afternoon.
example1_zh: 今天下午我们队要和邻居们比赛。
example2_en: Some residents are against airport expansion because they fear increased noise and damage to nearby habitats.
example2_zh: 一些居民反对机场扩建，因为他们担心噪声增加以及附近栖息地遭到破坏。
collocations: vote against｜投票反对 ; lean against｜倚靠 ; protect against｜防护；抵御 ; against the law｜违法
tip_zh: against是介词，后接名词、代词或动名词。

meanings_zh: n. 智能手机
definition_en: A mobile phone with internet access and computer-like functions.
example1_en: I used my smartphone to photograph the evening sky.
example1_zh: 我用智能手机拍下了傍晚的天空。
example2_en: Although smartphones provide convenient access to information, excessive use may disrupt sleep and reduce concentration.
example2_zh: 虽然智能手机让获取信息更加方便，但过度使用可能干扰睡眠并降低专注力。
collocations: smartphone app｜智能手机应用 ; smartphone user｜智能手机用户 ; smartphone addiction｜智能手机成瘾
tip_zh: smartphone是可数名词，通常写成一个词。

meanings_zh: adj. 精确的；确切的 | v. 强求；索取
definition_en: Correct in every detail, without any difference or error. | Demand and obtain something, often through authority or force.
example1_en: Can you tell me the exact time we should arrive?
example1_zh: 你能告诉我我们应该到达的确切时间吗？
example2_en: Researchers need exact measurements to determine whether changes in air quality are linked to new transport policies.
example2_zh: 研究人员需要精确的测量数据，以判断空气质量变化是否与新的交通政策有关。
collocations: exact location｜确切位置 ; exact amount｜准确数量 ; exact copy｜完全相同的复制品 ; exact a heavy toll｜造成惨重损失
tip_zh: exact强调分毫不差；副词形式为exactly。

meanings_zh: n. 复印件 | v. 复印
definition_en: A paper copy of a document made using a machine. | To make a paper copy of a document using a machine.
example1_en: Please bring a photocopy of your passport tomorrow.
example1_zh: 请明天带一份你的护照复印件来。
example2_en: Students should keep a photocopy of important application documents in case the originals are lost.
example2_zh: 学生应保留重要申请文件的复印件，以防原件丢失。
collocations: make a photocopy｜制作复印件 ; a photocopy of a document｜文件复印件 ; photocopy a form｜复印表格
tip_zh: 既作名词也作动词；复数和三单均为photocopies。

meanings_zh: n. 吸烟
definition_en: The activity or habit of breathing in smoke from tobacco.
example1_en: My uncle gave up smoking and now enjoys long walks.
example1_zh: 我叔叔戒了烟，现在很喜欢长距离散步。
example2_en: Banning smoking in public buildings can protect workers and visitors from the harmful effects of tobacco smoke.
example2_zh: 禁止在公共建筑内吸烟可以保护工作人员和访客免受烟草烟雾的危害。
collocations: give up smoking｜戒烟 ; passive smoking｜被动吸烟 ; smoking ban｜禁烟令
tip_zh: 表示吸烟活动时不可数；戒烟可用give up smoking。

meanings_zh: n. 男人；小伙子
definition_en: An informal word for a man.
example1_en: The guy next door helped carry my groceries.
example1_zh: 隔壁那位小伙子帮我提了买回来的东西。
example2_en: Calling a colleague a guy may sound friendly, but informal vocabulary is usually inappropriate in academic writing.
example2_zh: 称同事为guy可能显得亲切，但非正式词汇通常不适合学术写作。
collocations: a nice guy｜友善的男人 ; a young guy｜年轻小伙子 ; a regular guy｜普通人
tip_zh: guy属口语；正式写作通常用man或person。

meanings_zh: v. 比较；对比 | v. 把……比作 | v. 比得上；可相比
definition_en: To examine things to find similarities and differences. | To describe something as similar to another thing. | To be as good as, or similar to, something else.
example1_en: We compared several backpacks before choosing the lightest one.
example1_zh: 我们比较了几个背包，最后选了最轻的那个。
example2_en: Researchers should compare the long-term costs of renewable energy with those of traditional power sources.
example2_zh: 研究人员应比较可再生能源与传统能源的长期成本。
collocations: compare prices｜比较价格 ; compare A with B｜将A与B比较 ; compare A to B｜将A比作B；比较A和B ; compare favourably with｜比起来不逊于
tip_zh: 比较可用with或to；表示比喻时通常用to。

meanings_zh: adj. 有颜色的；着色的
definition_en: Having a particular colour or colours rather than being plain.
example1_en: Sunlight streamed through the coloured glass onto the floor.
example1_zh: 阳光透过彩色玻璃洒在地板上。
example2_en: Teachers can use coloured blocks to help young children recognise patterns and develop basic mathematical skills.
example2_zh: 教师可以用彩色积木帮助幼儿识别规律，培养基本数学技能。
collocations: coloured glass｜彩色玻璃 ; coloured pencils｜彩色铅笔 ; brightly coloured｜色彩鲜艳的
tip_zh: 英式coloured，美式colored；避免用于泛指族群。

meanings_zh: n. 手提箱；行李箱
definition_en: A case with a handle for carrying clothes when travelling.
example1_en: Her suitcase was too heavy to lift onto the train.
example1_zh: 她的行李箱太重，搬不上火车。
example2_en: Travellers can reduce transport emissions by packing a lighter suitcase and choosing public transport whenever possible.
example2_zh: 旅客可以通过减轻行李箱的重量，并尽量选择公共交通来减少交通排放。
collocations: pack a suitcase｜收拾行李箱 ; unpack a suitcase｜打开行李箱取出物品 ; a wheeled suitcase｜带轮行李箱
tip_zh: suitcase可数；统称行李的luggage不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 海报；招贴画
definition_en: A large printed picture or announcement displayed on a surface
example1_en: She hung a colourful poster above her desk.
example1_zh: 她在书桌上方挂了一张色彩鲜艳的海报。
example2_en: A well-designed poster can encourage people to recycle by presenting environmental messages clearly and attractively.
example2_zh: 设计精良的海报可以清晰而有吸引力地传达环保信息，鼓励人们回收利用。
collocations: put up a poster｜张贴海报 ; design a poster｜设计海报 ; advertising poster｜广告海报 ; poster campaign｜海报宣传活动
tip_zh: poster 是海报；postcard 是明信片，注意区分。

meanings_zh: n. 礼物；赠品 | n. 天赋；才能 | v. 赠送
definition_en: Something given freely to another person | A natural ability to do something well | To give something to someone as a present
example1_en: My sister wrapped the gift in bright yellow paper.
example1_zh: 姐姐用鲜黄色的纸把礼物包了起来。
example2_en: Schools should nurture each child's gift rather than judge everyone by the same narrow standards.
example2_zh: 学校应培养每个孩子的天赋，而不是用同一套狭隘的标准评判所有人。
collocations: birthday gift｜生日礼物 ; a gift for languages｜语言天赋 ; gift shop｜礼品店
tip_zh: 表示天赋时常用 a gift for，后接名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: n. 女式衬衫
definition_en: A shirt traditionally worn by women, often made from light fabric
example1_en: She wore a blue blouse with her favourite grey trousers.
example1_zh: 她穿了一件蓝色女式衬衫，搭配最喜欢的灰色长裤。
example2_en: Choosing a durable blouse rather than a cheaply made alternative may reduce clothing waste over time.
example2_zh: 选择耐穿的女式衬衫而非制作廉价的替代品，长期来看可能减少衣物浪费。
collocations: silk blouse｜丝绸女式衬衫 ; long-sleeved blouse｜长袖女式衬衫 ; loose-fitting blouse｜宽松女式衬衫
tip_zh: 通常指女式衬衫；shirt的适用范围更广。

meanings_zh: n. 细节；具体信息 | n. 详尽程度 | v. 详细说明
definition_en: a small fact or feature of something | the amount of specific information provided | to describe something fully, including specific facts
example1_en: Please check every detail before you send the invitation.
example1_zh: 发送邀请前，请核对每一处细节。
example2_en: The report details how improved housing conditions can reduce health inequalities among families in urban areas.
example2_zh: 该报告详细说明了改善住房条件如何减少城市家庭之间的健康差距。
collocations: in detail｜详细地 ; pay attention to detail｜注重细节 ; contact details｜联系方式 ; further details｜更多具体信息
tip_zh: in detail不用复数；联系方式用contact details。

meanings_zh: adv. 也许；可能 | adv. 或许（委婉建议或请求）
definition_en: Used when something is possible but not certain. | Used to make a suggestion or request sound less direct.
example1_en: Perhaps we should take an umbrella; those clouds look dark.
example1_zh: 也许我们该带把伞，那些云看起来很阴沉。
example2_en: Perhaps governments could encourage healthier diets by making fresh produce more affordable for low-income households.
example2_zh: 政府或许可以让低收入家庭更买得起新鲜农产品，以鼓励更健康的饮食。
collocations: perhaps not｜也许不是 ; perhaps the best｜或许是最好的 ; perhaps we could｜或许我们可以
tip_zh: perhaps比maybe略正式，可放句首使建议更委婉。

meanings_zh: n. 面包店；烘焙坊
definition_en: a place where bread and cakes are made or sold
example1_en: The bakery near our house sells warm bread every morning.
example1_zh: 我们家附近的面包店每天早上都卖热乎乎的面包。
example2_en: Small businesses such as bakeries provide local employment and help maintain vibrant neighbourhood shopping areas.
example2_zh: 面包店等小企业提供本地就业岗位，也有助于保持社区商业区的活力。
collocations: local bakery｜本地面包店 ; bakery owner｜面包店店主 ; bakery products｜烘焙食品
tip_zh: bakery指店铺或制作场所；烘焙食品用baked goods。

meanings_zh: v. 端上；供应；接待 | v. 为……服务；履行职责 | v. 用作；起……作用
definition_en: To give food or drink, or assist customers. | To work for people, an organisation, or your country. | To be used for a particular purpose.
example1_en: This little café serves fresh soup with warm bread.
example1_zh: 这家小咖啡馆供应新鲜的汤和温热的面包。
example2_en: Public libraries serve as community spaces where residents can access information, attend workshops, and meet other learners.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆是社区活动空间，居民可以在那里获取信息、参加工作坊并结识其他学习者。
collocations: serve a meal｜上餐 ; serve customers｜接待顾客 ; serve the community｜服务社区 ; serve as｜用作；充当
tip_zh: serve as后接角色或用途；serve for不这样用。

meanings_zh: n. 邻居；邻近的人或事物
definition_en: someone living nearby, or something located next to another
example1_en: Our neighbour watered the plants while we were away.
example1_zh: 我们不在家时，邻居帮忙给植物浇了水。
example2_en: Shared gardens can strengthen relationships between neighbours and create a greater sense of belonging in urban communities.
example2_zh: 共享花园可以增进邻里关系，增强城市社区居民的归属感。
collocations: next-door neighbour｜隔壁邻居 ; close neighbours｜近邻 ; neighbouring countries｜邻国
tip_zh: 英式拼写neighbour，美式拼写neighbor。

meanings_zh: v. 点击 | n. 咔嗒声；点击 | v. 突然明白；恍然大悟
definition_en: to press a mouse button or select something on screen | a short sharp sound, or an action selecting something onscreen | to suddenly become clear or understood
example1_en: Click on the picture to see a larger version.
example1_zh: 点击图片即可查看大图。
example2_en: Students should check whether a website is trustworthy before they click on links or share personal information.
example2_zh: 学生在点击链接或分享个人信息前，应检查网站是否可信。
collocations: click on a link｜点击链接 ; a mouse click｜一次鼠标点击 ; a sharp click｜清脆的咔嗒声
tip_zh: 点击链接常用click on；it clicked可指突然想通了。

meanings_zh: v. 慢跑 | n. 慢跑 | v. 轻碰；轻撞
definition_en: To run slowly and steadily, usually for exercise. | A period of slow, steady running. | To knock or push something slightly, often accidentally.
example1_en: We jog around the park before breakfast every morning.
example1_zh: 我们每天早饭前都绕着公园慢跑。
example2_en: People who jog regularly may improve their cardiovascular health without needing expensive equipment or gym memberships.
example2_zh: 经常慢跑的人无需昂贵的器材或健身房会员资格，也能改善心血管健康。
collocations: go for a jog｜去慢跑 ; jog along｜沿着……慢跑 ; jog someone's memory｜唤起某人的记忆
tip_zh: jog someone's memory意为“唤起某人的记忆”。

meanings_zh: det. 最少的；最小量的 | adv. 最少；程度最低 | pron. 最少量；最小程度
definition_en: the smallest amount of something | to the smallest degree or extent | the smallest amount or degree
example1_en: This soup needs the least salt of all.
example1_zh: 这些汤里，这道汤需要的盐最少。
example2_en: Public transport often causes the least pollution per passenger when compared with private car travel.
example2_zh: 与私家车出行相比，公共交通的人均污染通常最少。
collocations: at least｜至少 ; the least expensive｜最便宜的 ; least of all｜最不；尤其不
tip_zh: least是little的最高级；修饰可数名词用fewest。

meanings_zh: n. 微波炉 | v. 用微波炉加热或烹调 | n. 微波
definition_en: An electric oven that heats food using electromagnetic waves | To cook or heat food in a microwave oven | A short electromagnetic wave used for heating and communication
example1_en: I heated yesterday's soup in the microwave for lunch.
example1_zh: 我用微波炉热了昨天的汤，当作午餐。
example2_en: Using a microwave to reheat small portions can consume less energy than using a conventional oven.
example2_zh: 用微波炉加热少量食物，比使用普通烤箱可能更节能。
collocations: microwave oven｜微波炉 ; microwave food｜用微波炉加热食物 ; microwave radiation｜微波辐射
tip_zh: 作动词可直接接食物：microwave the soup。

meanings_zh: n. 蝴蝶 | n. 蝶泳
definition_en: An insect with broad, often colourful wings and a thin body. | A swimming stroke with both arms moving forward together above water.
example1_en: A yellow butterfly landed gently on my sleeve.
example1_zh: 一只黄色蝴蝶轻轻落在我的袖子上。
example2_en: Planting native flowers in urban gardens can support butterfly populations and contribute to greater local biodiversity.
example2_zh: 在城市花园中种植本地花卉可以帮助维持蝴蝶种群，并提升当地的生物多样性。
collocations: butterfly wings｜蝴蝶翅膀 ; butterfly species｜蝴蝶物种 ; swim butterfly｜游蝶泳
tip_zh: 复数为butterflies；蝶泳义通常不可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 加拿大的；加拿大人的 | n. 加拿大人
definition_en: relating to Canada, its people, or its culture | a person from Canada
example1_en: Our Canadian neighbour invited us over for dinner yesterday.
example1_zh: 我们的加拿大邻居昨天邀请我们去他家吃晚饭。
example2_en: Canadian cities face challenges in providing affordable housing while accommodating population growth and protecting green spaces.
example2_zh: 加拿大城市面临着提供可负担住房、容纳增长人口以及保护绿地的多重挑战。
collocations: Canadian culture｜加拿大文化 ; Canadian citizens｜加拿大公民 ; Canadian dollars｜加拿大元
tip_zh: 国籍词首字母大写；名词复数为Canadians。

meanings_zh: n. 祝贺；贺词 | int. 恭喜！
definition_en: words expressing pleasure at someone's success or good fortune | said to show happiness about someone's achievement or good news
example1_en: Congratulations on passing your driving test this morning!
example1_zh: 恭喜你今天上午通过了驾照考试！
example2_en: The research team received congratulations from colleagues after winning an international award for environmental innovation.
example2_zh: 研究团队获得国际环境创新奖后，收到了同事们的祝贺。
collocations: congratulations on your success｜祝贺你成功 ; offer congratulations｜表示祝贺 ; warm congratulations｜热烈祝贺
tip_zh: 祝贺通常用复数；congratulations on后接名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: v. 到达；达到 | v. 伸手；够到 | n. 可及范围；影响范围
definition_en: to arrive at a place or achieve a particular level | to stretch out your arm towards something or touch it | the distance or extent over which something can act
example1_en: We reached the station just before the rain started.
example1_zh: 我们刚到车站，雨就下起来了。
example2_en: Governments must invest in public transport if they hope to reach their targets for reducing urban emissions.
example2_zh: 政府若希望达到减少城市排放的目标，就必须投资公共交通。
collocations: reach a destination｜到达目的地 ; reach an agreement｜达成协议 ; reach for something｜伸手拿某物 ; out of reach｜够不着
tip_zh: 表示到达时直接接地点：reach the station，不加at。

meanings_zh: n. 脖子；颈部 | n. 瓶颈；狭长部分
definition_en: the body part connecting the head to the shoulders | a narrow part of an object, such as a bottle
example1_en: He wrapped a warm scarf around his neck.
example1_zh: 他在脖子上围了一条暖和的围巾。
example2_en: Office workers may experience neck pain if their computer screens are positioned at an unsuitable height.
example2_zh: 如果电脑屏幕的高度不合适，办公室职员可能会感到颈部疼痛。
collocations: neck pain｜颈部疼痛 ; a stiff neck｜脖子僵硬 ; the neck of a bottle｜瓶颈
tip_zh: neck指脖子；throat指喉咙，勿混用。

meanings_zh: n. 停车场
definition_en: An area or building where cars can be parked.
example1_en: We found a space in the station car park.
example1_zh: 我们在车站停车场找到了一个车位。
example2_en: Replacing an underused car park with green space could improve the quality of life for nearby residents.
example2_zh: 将利用率低的停车场改为绿地，可以提升附近居民的生活质量。
collocations: multi-storey car park｜多层停车场 ; underground car park｜地下停车场 ; car park entrance｜停车场入口
tip_zh: 英式常用car park；美式露天停车场常叫parking lot。

meanings_zh: n. 灯
definition_en: A device that produces light, often on a table.
example1_en: She switched on the lamp beside her bed.
example1_zh: 她打开了床边的灯。
example2_en: Using an adjustable desk lamp can improve comfort for students who study in poorly lit rooms.
example2_zh: 对于在光线不足的房间里学习的学生，使用可调节台灯可以提高舒适度。
collocations: desk lamp｜书桌台灯 ; bedside lamp｜床头灯 ; floor lamp｜落地灯 ; switch on a lamp｜开灯
tip_zh: lamp指灯具；light也可指光或光线。

meanings_zh: n. 葡萄
definition_en: A small round fruit growing in bunches on vines.
example1_en: She packed some grapes in my lunch box.
example1_zh: 她在我的午餐盒里装了一些葡萄。
example2_en: Farmers growing grapes may need more efficient irrigation systems as summers become hotter and drier.
example2_zh: 随着夏季变得更炎热、更干燥，葡萄种植者可能需要更高效的灌溉系统。
collocations: a bunch of grapes｜一串葡萄 ; seedless grapes｜无籽葡萄 ; grape juice｜葡萄汁
tip_zh: 单颗葡萄用a grape，一串用a bunch of grapes。

meanings_zh: n. 平底锅；烤盘 | v. 严厉批评 | v. 摇摄；转动镜头
definition_en: a metal container used for cooking or baking food | to criticize a performance, book, or film very harshly | to turn a camera slowly across a scene
example1_en: Heat the oil in a pan before adding onions.
example1_zh: 先把锅里的油烧热，再放入洋葱。
example2_en: Television chefs can encourage healthier eating by demonstrating how to prepare nutritious meals using a single pan.
example2_zh: 电视厨师可以通过演示如何用一口锅烹制营养餐，来鼓励更健康的饮食。
collocations: frying pan｜煎锅 ; baking pan｜烤盘 ; be panned by critics｜受到评论家的严厉批评 ; pan across a scene｜摇摄整个场景
tip_zh: 作动词时过去式为panned，现在分词为panning。

meanings_zh: n. 一步；台阶 | n. 步骤；措施 | v. 迈步；踏；踩
definition_en: a foot movement when walking, or a stair surface | one action in a process or towards a goal | to move by lifting and placing your foot
example1_en: Take one step forward and close the door.
example1_zh: 向前迈一步，把门关上。
example2_en: Improving public transport is an important step towards reducing traffic congestion and air pollution in cities.
example2_zh: 改善公共交通是减少城市交通拥堵和空气污染的重要一步。
collocations: take a step｜迈一步；采取措施 ; step by step｜逐步地 ; take steps to｜采取措施以 ; step on｜踩到
tip_zh: take steps to do sth表示“采取措施做某事”。

meanings_zh: adj. 有雾的；雾蒙蒙的 | adj. 模糊的；迷糊的
definition_en: filled with fog, making things difficult to see | unclear or difficult to remember or understand
example1_en: The road was so foggy that we drove slowly.
example1_zh: 路上雾很大，我们只好慢慢开车。
example2_en: Foggy conditions can disrupt air travel, causing delays that affect both passengers and airport operations.
example2_zh: 大雾天气可能扰乱航空出行，造成延误，影响乘客和机场运营。
collocations: foggy weather｜雾天 ; a foggy morning｜雾蒙蒙的早晨 ; foggy conditions｜大雾天气
tip_zh: foggy既可形容天气，也可形容记忆模糊。

meanings_zh: adj. 两倍的；双份的 | v. 加倍；使翻倍 | n. 两倍；双倍量
definition_en: twice the usual amount, size, or quantity | become twice as much, or make something twice as much | an amount that is twice as large as another
example1_en: I ordered a double portion of rice for lunch.
example1_zh: 我午饭点了双份米饭。
example2_en: The city plans to double its investment in cycling infrastructure to reduce traffic congestion.
example2_zh: 该市计划将自行车基础设施投资增加一倍，以缓解交通拥堵。
collocations: double the amount｜两倍的量 ; double in size｜规模扩大一倍 ; double check｜仔细复核 ; double room｜双人房
tip_zh: double表示变为原来的两倍，即增加一倍。

meanings_zh: n. 地毯
definition_en: A thick woven covering for a floor.
example1_en: We sat on the carpet and played cards.
example1_zh: 我们坐在地毯上打牌。
example2_en: Installing carpet in classrooms can reduce noise, although regular cleaning is necessary to maintain good hygiene.
example2_zh: 在教室里铺地毯可以降低噪声，但需要定期清洁以保持良好卫生。
collocations: lay a carpet｜铺地毯 ; fitted carpet｜满铺地毯 ; carpet cleaning｜地毯清洁
tip_zh: carpet常指大面积地毯；rug多指可移动的小块地毯。

meanings_zh: n. 双胞胎之一 | adj. 成对的；双胞胎的
definition_en: One of two children born to the same mother together. | Forming a matching pair, or relating to twins.
example1_en: My twin and I share a love of swimming.
example1_zh: 我的双胞胎手足和我都喜欢游泳。
example2_en: Studies involving identical twins help researchers understand how genes and environment influence human development.
example2_zh: 涉及同卵双胞胎的研究有助于研究人员了解基因和环境如何影响人的发育。
collocations: identical twins｜同卵双胞胎 ; twin sister｜双胞胎姐妹 ; twin beds｜两张单人床
tip_zh: a twin指双胞胎中的一人；twins指两人。

meanings_zh: prep. 穿过；贯穿 | prep. 通过；凭借 | adv. 从头到尾；通过
definition_en: From one side or end to the other, within something. | By using a particular method, person, or process. | From beginning to end, or from one side to another.
example1_en: Sunlight streamed through the curtains and warmed the room.
example1_zh: 阳光透过窗帘洒进来，让房间暖和起来。
example2_en: Students can develop practical skills through projects that require cooperation and creative problem solving.
example2_zh: 学生可以通过需要合作和创造性解决问题的项目来培养实践技能。
collocations: walk through｜穿过 ; through experience｜通过经验 ; read through｜通读 ; all through the night｜整夜
tip_zh: through强调从内部穿过；across强调横越表面。

meanings_zh: n. 设备；器材；装备
definition_en: the tools and other items needed for a particular activity
example1_en: Please put the camping equipment back in the garage.
example1_zh: 请把露营装备放回车库。
example2_en: Schools need suitable laboratory equipment to give students practical experience and encourage an interest in science.
example2_zh: 学校需要合适的实验室设备，让学生获得实践经验并培养科学兴趣。
collocations: sports equipment｜体育器材 ; medical equipment｜医疗设备 ; safety equipment｜安全装备 ; a piece of equipment｜一件设备
tip_zh: 不可数；一件设备说a piece of equipment。

meanings_zh: n. 麻烦；困难；故障 | v. 使烦恼；麻烦
definition_en: problems or difficulties that cause worry or inconvenience | to cause someone worry or ask them for help
example1_en: We had trouble opening the stiff kitchen window.
example1_zh: 厨房的窗户很紧，我们费了好大劲才打开。
example2_en: Many older adults have trouble accessing public services that are available only through digital platforms.
example2_zh: 许多老年人难以使用那些仅通过数字平台提供的公共服务。
collocations: have trouble doing something｜做某事有困难 ; get into trouble｜惹上麻烦 ; engine trouble｜发动机故障 ; take the trouble to do something｜费心做某事
tip_zh: 表示做某事有困难，用have trouble doing。

meanings_zh: n. 胶；胶水 | v. 用胶粘合
definition_en: a sticky substance used to join things together | to join things together using glue
example1_en: Use a little glue to fix the paper wing.
example1_zh: 用一点胶水把纸翅膀粘好。
example2_en: Some packaging contains layers joined with glue, which can make the materials more difficult to recycle.
example2_zh: 有些包装的各层材料用胶粘合，这可能增加回收难度。
collocations: glue stick｜固体胶棒 ; wood glue｜木工胶 ; glue together｜粘在一起 ; be glued to a screen｜盯着屏幕看
tip_zh: 作名词通常不可数；be glued to可指目不转睛地看。

meanings_zh: v. 争吵；争论 | v. 论证；主张
definition_en: To disagree with someone, often in an angry way. | To give reasons supporting an opinion or position.
example1_en: The children argued about whose turn it was to play.
example1_zh: 孩子们为轮到谁玩而争吵。
example2_en: Some researchers argue that affordable public transport is essential for reducing inequality in large cities.
example2_zh: 一些研究者认为，价格可负担的公共交通对于减少大城市中的不平等至关重要。
collocations: argue with someone｜与某人争论 ; argue about something｜就某事争论 ; argue that｜主张…… ; argue for｜据理支持
tip_zh: argue that常用于议论文，表示提出有理由的主张。

meanings_zh: adj. 安全的；无危险的 | adj. 稳妥的；风险小的 | n. 保险箱
definition_en: Protected from danger or unlikely to cause harm. | Unlikely to fail or lead to loss. | A strong locked container for money and valuable objects.
example1_en: Your bike is safe inside our locked garage.
example1_zh: 你的自行车放在我们锁好的车库里很安全。
example2_en: Governments should ensure that all communities have access to safe drinking water and reliable sanitation.
example2_zh: 政府应确保所有社区都能获得安全饮用水和可靠的卫生设施。
collocations: safe and sound｜安然无恙 ; safe drinking water｜安全饮用水 ; a safe investment｜稳妥的投资 ; keep someone safe｜保护某人安全
tip_zh: safe是形容词，safety是名词；注意词性区别。

meanings_zh: adj. 美味的；可口的
definition_en: having a pleasant flavour
example1_en: This tasty soup is perfect for a cold evening.
example1_zh: 这道美味的汤很适合寒冷的夜晚。
example2_en: School canteens can encourage healthier eating by offering tasty meals made with fresh vegetables and whole grains.
example2_zh: 学校食堂可以提供用新鲜蔬菜和全谷物制作的美味餐食，鼓励更健康的饮食。
collocations: tasty meal｜美味的饭菜 ; tasty snack｜可口的小吃 ; tasty dish｜美味的菜肴
tip_zh: tasty指食物美味；tasteful指有品位。

meanings_zh: n. 行为；举止 | n. 运行方式；反应特性
definition_en: The way a person or animal acts. | The way something functions or reacts under particular conditions.
example1_en: The puppy's calm behaviour surprised everyone at the park.
example1_zh: 小狗温顺的表现让公园里的每个人都感到意外。
example2_en: Schools can encourage positive behaviour by establishing clear expectations and recognising students' efforts to cooperate.
example2_zh: 学校可以通过明确要求并肯定学生的合作努力，鼓励良好行为。
collocations: good behaviour｜良好行为 ; consumer behaviour｜消费者行为 ; animal behaviour｜动物行为 ; behaviour patterns｜行为模式
tip_zh: 通常不可数；英式拼写behaviour，美式拼写behavior。

meanings_zh: n. 邮票 | n. 印章；印记 | v. 盖章；跺脚
definition_en: A small official sticker showing that postage has been paid. | A tool that presses a mark, or the mark it leaves. | Press a mark onto something, or bring a foot down hard.
example1_en: She put a stamp on the envelope before leaving.
example1_zh: 她出门前在信封上贴了一张邮票。
example2_en: Although digital communication has reduced letter writing, collecting stamps remains a way to explore history and culture.
example2_zh: 尽管数字通信减少了书信往来，集邮仍是一种探索历史与文化的方式。
collocations: postage stamp｜邮票 ; collect stamps｜集邮 ; stamp a passport｜在护照上盖章 ; stamp your feet｜跺脚
tip_zh: 邮票用a stamp；“在信封上贴邮票”用put a stamp on。

meanings_zh: adv. 不幸的是；遗憾的是
definition_en: used to say that something is disappointing or unlucky
example1_en: Unfortunately, the bakery had sold out of fresh bread.
example1_zh: 遗憾的是，面包店的新鲜面包已经卖完了。
example2_en: Unfortunately, many rural schools lack the resources needed to provide students with reliable internet access.
example2_zh: 遗憾的是，许多乡村学校缺乏为学生提供可靠网络连接所需的资源。
collocations: unfortunately for someone｜对某人来说不幸的是 ; unfortunately not｜遗憾的是并非如此
tip_zh: 常置于句首并加逗号，对整件事表示遗憾。

meanings_zh: adj. 通常的；惯常的
definition_en: happening or done most often in a particular situation
example1_en: Our usual table by the window was already taken.
example1_zh: 我们平时坐的窗边那张桌子已经有人了。
example2_en: Working from home has become the usual arrangement for some employees in the technology sector.
example2_zh: 对科技行业的一些员工来说，居家办公已成为常规安排。
collocations: as usual｜像往常一样 ; the usual routine｜惯常的生活规律 ; than usual｜比平时
tip_zh: as usual意为“照常”；than usual意为“比平时”。

meanings_zh: n. 方法；办法 | n. 条理；系统性
definition_en: A particular way of doing something. | An organized and systematic approach to an activity.
example1_en: This method keeps my herbs fresh for several days.
example1_zh: 这个方法能让我的香草保鲜好几天。
example2_en: Teachers should adapt their teaching methods to meet the varied needs of students in mixed-ability classrooms.
example2_zh: 教师应调整教学方法，以满足能力水平不同的学生的多样化需求。
collocations: teaching method｜教学方法 ; research method｜研究方法 ; method of payment｜付款方式 ; effective method｜有效方法
tip_zh: 常用a method of/for doing sth表示做事的方法。

meanings_zh: n. 正方形 | n. 广场 | adj. 正方形的；平方的
definition_en: a shape with four equal sides and four right angles | an open public area surrounded by buildings | shaped like a square, or expressing area in squared units
example1_en: Fold the paper into a square before cutting it.
example1_zh: 先把纸折成正方形，再剪。
example2_en: Creating a public square can encourage social interaction and provide space for cultural events in crowded cities.
example2_zh: 在拥挤的城市中，建设公共广场可以促进社交互动，并为文化活动提供空间。
collocations: town square｜城镇广场 ; square metre｜平方米 ; square root｜平方根 ; square table｜方桌
tip_zh: 面积用square metres；长度用metres，勿混淆。

meanings_zh: n. 底部；最下端 | n. 臀部 | adj. 最下面的
definition_en: The lowest part of something. | The part of your body that you sit on. | In the lowest position.
example1_en: My keys were at the bottom of my bag.
example1_zh: 我的钥匙在包的最底下。
example2_en: Waste often collects at the bottom of rivers, damaging habitats and threatening aquatic life.
example2_zh: 废弃物经常堆积在河底，破坏栖息地并威胁水生生物。
collocations: at the bottom of｜在……底部 ; bottom shelf｜最下层架子 ; from top to bottom｜从上到下
tip_zh: 在某物底部用at the bottom of。

meanings_zh: n. 鳄鱼
definition_en: a large reptile with tough skin, long jaws and tail
example1_en: We watched a crocodile slide into the river.
example1_zh: 我们看着一条鳄鱼滑入河中。
example2_en: Wetland conservation protects crocodile habitats while also supporting the fish and birds that depend on these ecosystems.
example2_zh: 湿地保护既能保护鳄鱼的栖息地，也有利于依赖这些生态系统的鱼类和鸟类。
collocations: crocodile habitat｜鳄鱼栖息地 ; crocodile eggs｜鳄鱼蛋 ; crocodile tears｜假慈悲；虚假的眼泪
tip_zh: alligator指短吻鳄，与crocodile并非同一种动物。

meanings_zh: v. 鼓掌；拍手 | n. 拍手声；响亮的短促声
definition_en: To strike your hands together, often to show approval. | A sudden loud sound, especially from hands striking together.
example1_en: Everyone clapped when the children finished their song.
example1_zh: 孩子们唱完歌时，大家都鼓起掌来。
example2_en: Audiences often clap after live performances to express appreciation for the skill and effort of the artists.
example2_zh: 现场演出结束后，观众常常鼓掌，以表达对艺术家技艺和付出的赞赏。
collocations: clap your hands｜拍手 ; clap along｜跟着节奏拍手 ; a clap of thunder｜一声霹雳
tip_zh: 过去式clapped；现在分词clapping，双写p。

meanings_zh: n. 中午；正午
definition_en: Twelve o'clock in the middle of the day.
example1_en: Let's meet outside the library at noon tomorrow.
example1_zh: 我们明天中午在图书馆外见吧。
example2_en: Outdoor workers should avoid intense physical activity around noon, when temperatures and sunlight can be particularly strong.
example2_zh: 户外工作者应避免在正午前后进行高强度体力活动，此时气温可能很高，阳光也可能特别强烈。
collocations: at noon｜在中午 ; around noon｜中午前后 ; by noon｜到中午之前
tip_zh: 说at noon，不说in noon；正午是12 p.m.。

meanings_zh: n. 讨论；商讨 | n. 论述；探讨
definition_en: An exchange of ideas or opinions about a subject. | A detailed examination of a subject in speech or writing.
example1_en: We had a lively discussion about our holiday plans.
example1_zh: 我们热烈讨论了度假计划。
example2_en: Public discussion of transport policy can help governments design services that better meet residents' needs.
example2_zh: 对交通政策的公开讨论可以帮助政府设计更符合居民需求的服务。
collocations: have a discussion｜进行讨论 ; group discussion｜小组讨论 ; under discussion｜在讨论中 ; in-depth discussion｜深入探讨
tip_zh: 名词可接about或of；动词discuss后直接接话题。

meanings_zh: n. 婚礼
definition_en: A ceremony in which two people get married.
example1_en: Their wedding took place in a small garden.
example1_zh: 他们的婚礼在一个小花园里举行。
example2_en: Wedding traditions often reflect cultural values, although many couples now choose simpler and less expensive celebrations.
example2_zh: 婚礼习俗往往反映文化价值观，不过如今许多新人选择更简单、费用更低的庆祝方式。
collocations: wedding ceremony｜婚礼仪式 ; wedding reception｜婚宴 ; wedding anniversary｜结婚纪念日 ; attend a wedding｜参加婚礼
tip_zh: wedding指婚礼；marriage指婚姻关系。

meanings_zh: n. 血；血液 | n. 血缘；家世
definition_en: the red liquid that carries oxygen around your body | family relationships or origins
example1_en: The nurse took some blood from my arm.
example1_zh: 护士从我的手臂抽了一些血。
example2_en: Regular physical activity can lower blood pressure and reduce the risk of heart disease.
example2_zh: 经常进行体育活动可以降低血压，并减少患心脏病的风险。
collocations: blood pressure｜血压 ; blood test｜血液检查 ; donate blood｜献血 ; blood vessel｜血管
tip_zh: blood通常不可数；一次验血用a blood test。

meanings_zh: n. 钱包；皮夹
definition_en: A small folding case for carrying money and cards.
example1_en: I left my wallet beside the kitchen sink.
example1_zh: 我把钱包落在厨房水槽旁了。
example2_en: As digital payments become more common, fewer consumers need to carry cash in a wallet.
example2_zh: 随着数字支付日益普及，需要在钱包里携带现金的消费者越来越少。
collocations: leather wallet｜皮钱包 ; digital wallet｜数字钱包 ; lost wallet｜遗失的钱包
tip_zh: wallet通常指放纸币和卡片的折叠式钱包。

meanings_zh: phr. 据……所说；根据 | phr. 按照；依据
definition_en: As stated or reported by someone or something | In a way determined by a rule or particular factor
example1_en: According to the forecast, rain will arrive this evening.
example1_zh: 据天气预报，今晚会下雨。
example2_en: Public funding should be distributed according to local needs rather than the political influence of individual regions.
example2_zh: 公共资金应按当地需求分配，而不应取决于各地区的政治影响力。
collocations: according to research｜根据研究 ; according to plan｜按计划 ; according to need｜按需要
tip_zh: 通常用according to，不单独作形容词。

meanings_zh: n. 保龄球运动 | n. 板球投球
definition_en: a game of rolling a heavy ball to knock down pins | the action of delivering the ball towards a cricket batter
example1_en: My cousins and I went bowling on Saturday.
example1_zh: 星期六，我和表兄弟姐妹一起去打保龄球了。
example2_en: Leisure centres offering activities such as bowling can encourage social interaction among people of different ages.
example2_zh: 提供保龄球等活动的休闲中心能够促进不同年龄人群之间的社交互动。
collocations: go bowling｜去打保龄球 ; bowling alley｜保龄球馆 ; bowling ball｜保龄球 ; fast bowling｜板球快速投球
tip_zh: 保龄球运动用go bowling；也可指板球中的投球。

meanings_zh: n. 人群；观众 | v. 挤满；聚集
definition_en: A large group of people gathered in one place. | To gather closely together or fill a place with people.
example1_en: A crowd gathered around the musicians in the square.
example1_zh: 一群人聚在广场上的乐手周围。
example2_en: Large crowds at popular attractions can damage historic sites unless visitor numbers are carefully managed.
example2_zh: 热门景点的大量游客可能破坏历史遗址，除非游客数量得到妥善管理。
collocations: a large crowd｜一大群人 ; attract a crowd｜吸引人群 ; crowd into｜挤进 ; crowd control｜人群管控
tip_zh: a crowd of后接复数名词；crowded表示拥挤的。

meanings_zh: n. 烤箱；烤炉
definition_en: an enclosed appliance used to bake or roast food
example1_en: The bread is still warm from the oven.
example1_zh: 面包刚出烤箱，还热乎着。
example2_en: Using an energy-efficient oven can reduce household electricity consumption without changing cooking habits significantly.
example2_zh: 使用节能烤箱可以减少家庭用电量，而不必大幅改变烹饪习惯。
collocations: preheat the oven｜预热烤箱 ; bake in the oven｜放入烤箱烘烤 ; oven temperature｜烤箱温度
tip_zh: oven指封闭烤箱；炉顶灶具通常叫hob或stove。

meanings_zh: adj. 最差的；最严重的 | adv. 最差地；最严重地 | n. 最坏的情况；最糟的部分
definition_en: Worse than all others in quality, condition, or effect. | More badly or severely than anyone or anything else. | The most unpleasant situation, outcome, or part.
example1_en: That was the worst meal I have ever cooked.
example1_zh: 那是我做过的最糟糕的一顿饭。
example2_en: The worst effects of air pollution are often experienced by children and older people in densely populated cities.
example2_zh: 在人口密集的城市，儿童和老年人往往受到空气污染最严重的影响。
collocations: the worst possible outcome｜最坏的可能结果 ; at worst｜在最坏的情况下 ; prepare for the worst｜做最坏的打算 ; worst affected｜受影响最严重的
tip_zh: worst是bad和badly的最高级；比较级是worse。

meanings_zh: adv. 轻声地；安静地 | adv. 悄悄地；不张扬地
definition_en: with little or no noise | without attracting attention or making something widely known
example1_en: Please close the door quietly; the baby is sleeping.
example1_zh: 请轻轻关门，宝宝正在睡觉。
example2_en: Students who work quietly in shared study areas help create an environment that supports concentration.
example2_zh: 在公共学习区域安静学习的学生有助于营造利于专注的环境。
collocations: speak quietly｜轻声说话 ; sit quietly｜安静地坐着 ; quietly confident｜自信而不张扬
tip_zh: quietly是副词；注意别与quite（相当）混淆。

meanings_zh: adj. 可爱的；讨人喜欢的
definition_en: Attractive in a sweet or charming way.
example1_en: That cute kitten is sleeping inside my slipper.
example1_zh: 那只可爱的小猫正睡在我的拖鞋里。
example2_en: Advertisements often feature cute animals to attract attention and create positive feelings towards a product.
example2_zh: 广告常用可爱的动物吸引注意，让人们对产品产生好感。
collocations: a cute baby｜可爱的婴儿 ; a cute smile｜可爱的笑容 ; look cute｜看起来可爱
tip_zh: 偏口语，常形容婴儿、小动物或讨喜的外表。

meanings_zh: n. 教练 | n. 长途客车 | v. 训练；辅导
definition_en: someone who trains people to improve their sporting skills | a comfortable bus used for longer journeys | to train or teach someone to improve particular skills
example1_en: Our coach showed us how to hold the racket.
example1_zh: 我们的教练示范了如何握球拍。
example2_en: A skilled coach can help young athletes build confidence while developing healthy attitudes towards competition.
example2_zh: 优秀的教练能帮助年轻运动员建立信心，同时培养他们对竞争的健康态度。
collocations: sports coach｜体育教练 ; travel by coach｜乘长途客车出行 ; coach a team｜训练一支队伍 ; coach someone for an exam｜辅导某人备考
tip_zh: 英式英语中coach也指长途客车，bus多指公交车。

meanings_zh: n. 发动机；引擎 | n. 推动力 | n. 专用软件引擎
definition_en: a machine that produces power to make something move | something that strongly drives growth or change | software that performs a particular core task within a system
example1_en: The engine stopped just as we reached the driveway.
example1_zh: 我们刚到车道入口，发动机就熄火了。
example2_en: Cleaner engine technology can reduce air pollution, although expanding public transport remains essential for sustainable urban travel.
example2_zh: 更清洁的发动机技术可以减少空气污染，但扩大公共交通仍是实现城市可持续出行的关键。
collocations: start the engine｜启动发动机 ; jet engine｜喷气发动机 ; search engine｜搜索引擎 ; an engine of growth｜增长的推动力
tip_zh: engine多指燃料发动机；电动机通常用motor。

meanings_zh: n. 法律；法规 | n. 法学 | n. 定律；规律
definition_en: an official rule, or the system of such rules | the study or profession concerned with legal rules | a general scientific rule describing how something always behaves
example1_en: The law requires drivers to stop at red lights.
example1_zh: 法律要求驾驶员在红灯前停车。
example2_en: Governments should enforce environmental laws consistently to prevent businesses from gaining advantages through harmful practices.
example2_zh: 政府应始终如一地执行环境法律，防止企业通过有害行为获取优势。
collocations: break the law｜违法 ; enforce the law｜执法 ; study law｜学习法学 ; the laws of physics｜物理定律
tip_zh: 具体一条法律可数；法学用不可数的law。

meanings_zh: n. 账单 | n. 法案 | n. 钞票
definition_en: a written statement of money owed for goods or services | a proposed law being considered by a lawmaking body | a piece of paper money, especially in American English
example1_en: We asked for the bill after finishing our lunch.
example1_zh: 吃完午饭后，我们请服务员拿来账单。
example2_en: The proposed bill would require companies to disclose more information about their impact on the environment.
example2_zh: 这项拟议法案将要求企业披露更多有关其环境影响的信息。
collocations: pay a bill｜支付账单 ; electricity bill｜电费账单 ; pass a bill｜通过法案 ; a dollar bill｜一张美元钞票
tip_zh: bill是待审议的法案；通过并生效后才成为法律。

meanings_zh: v. 应该；应当 | v. 按理会；应该会 | v. 本应该
definition_en: used to give advice or say what is right | used to say something is expected or likely | used with have to describe an unfulfilled duty or expectation
example1_en: You should take an umbrella because it looks cloudy.
example1_zh: 你应该带把伞，因为天看起来阴沉沉的。
example2_en: Governments should invest in affordable public transport to reduce congestion and improve urban air quality.
example2_zh: 政府应该投资于价格实惠的公共交通，以缓解拥堵并改善城市空气质量。
collocations: should do something｜应该做某事 ; should have done｜本应该做过 ; should be able to｜应该能够
tip_zh: 情态动词，后接动词原形；should have done常指本该做却未做。

meanings_zh: n. 自然环境 | n. 生活或工作环境
definition_en: The natural world, including land, water, air, and living things. | The conditions and surroundings in which someone lives or works.
example1_en: We cycle to school to help protect the environment.
example1_zh: 我们骑车上学，为保护环境出一份力。
example2_en: A supportive learning environment can improve students' confidence and encourage them to participate more actively.
example2_zh: 支持性的学习环境能够增强学生的信心，鼓励他们更加积极地参与。
collocations: protect the environment｜保护环境 ; natural environment｜自然环境 ; working environment｜工作环境 ; learning environment｜学习环境
tip_zh: 泛指自然环境常用the environment。

meanings_zh: adj. 完美的；最合适的 | v. 使完善；使精通 | adj. 完成时的
definition_en: without faults, or exactly right for a particular purpose | to improve something until it is as good as possible | describing verb forms using have with a past participle
example1_en: This quiet corner is perfect for reading after lunch.
example1_zh: 这个安静的角落特别适合午饭后看书。
example2_en: Although no transport system is perfect, reliable public services can significantly reduce a city's dependence on cars.
example2_zh: 尽管没有完美的交通系统，可靠的公共交通服务仍能显著减少城市对汽车的依赖。
collocations: perfect timing｜恰到好处的时机 ; perfect for｜非常适合 ; perfect a technique｜完善一项技术 ; present perfect｜现在完成时
tip_zh: 形容词重音在前；动词读/pəˈfekt/（英）。

meanings_zh: n. 西南方；西南部 | adj. 西南的；来自西南的 | adv. 向西南；在西南
definition_en: the direction between south and west, or an area's southwestern part | in the southwest, or coming from that direction | towards or in the direction between south and west
example1_en: Our village lies southwest of the nearest town.
example1_zh: 我们的村庄位于最近那座城镇的西南方。
example2_en: The southwest of the country attracts visitors because of its mild climate and varied coastal landscapes.
example2_zh: 该国西南部因气候温和、海岸景观多样而吸引游客。
collocations: in the southwest｜在西南部 ; southwest of｜在……西南方 ; head southwest｜向西南行进 ; southwest coast｜西南海岸
tip_zh: 英国英语也常写作south-west。

meanings_zh: adj. 每周的；每周一次的 | adv. 每周一次地 | n. 周刊；周报
definition_en: Happening once a week or relating to one week | Once every week | A newspaper or magazine published once a week
example1_en: Our weekly shopping trip usually ends at the bakery.
example1_zh: 我们每周的购物之行通常以去面包店收尾。
example2_en: Weekly exercise classes at community centres can help older residents stay active and build social connections.
example2_zh: 社区中心每周开设的健身课可以帮助老年居民保持活力并建立社交联系。
collocations: a weekly meeting｜每周例会 ; weekly earnings｜周收入 ; published weekly｜每周出版
tip_zh: 既可作形容词也可作副词：a weekly meeting；meet weekly。

meanings_zh: v. 杀死；使死亡 | v. 使终止；扼杀
definition_en: To cause a person, animal, or other organism to die | To cause something to stop or fail
example1_en: This soap helps kill germs on your hands.
example1_zh: 这种肥皂有助于杀灭手上的病菌。
example2_en: Excessive use of pesticides can kill beneficial insects and disrupt the natural balance of agricultural ecosystems.
example2_zh: 过量使用农药会杀死益虫，破坏农业生态系统的自然平衡。
collocations: kill germs｜杀灭病菌 ; kill time｜消磨时间 ; kill off｜使全部死亡；彻底消除 ; kill enthusiasm｜打击热情
tip_zh: kill强调造成死亡；die表示自身死亡，不接宾语。

meanings_zh: n. 窗帘；帘子 | n. 舞台幕布
definition_en: hanging fabric used to cover a window or divide space | a large hanging cloth that hides or reveals a stage
example1_en: She pulled the curtain aside to watch the rain.
example1_zh: 她把窗帘拉到一边，看着外面的雨。
example2_en: Installing a thick curtain over each window can reduce heat loss and improve comfort in older homes.
example2_zh: 在每扇窗户上安装厚窗帘，可以减少热量流失，提升老房屋的居住舒适度。
collocations: draw the curtains｜拉上或拉开窗帘 ; shower curtain｜浴帘 ; stage curtain｜舞台幕布 ; curtain rail｜窗帘轨道
tip_zh: draw the curtains可指拉开或拉上，需看语境。

meanings_zh: v. 拉；拖；拔 | n. 拉；拉力 | v. 拉伤肌肉
definition_en: to move something towards you or along by holding it | an act of pulling or a force drawing something closer | to injure a muscle by stretching it too much
example1_en: Please pull the door gently instead of pushing it.
example1_zh: 请轻轻拉门，不要推。
example2_en: Horses once pulled heavy loads through cities, but motor vehicles eventually replaced them in most transport roles.
example2_zh: 马匹曾在城市中拉运重物，但机动车最终取代了它们的大部分运输职能。
collocations: pull a muscle｜拉伤肌肉 ; pull a door open｜把门拉开 ; pull out a tooth｜拔牙 ; gravitational pull｜引力
tip_zh: pull是朝自己方向拉；push是向外推。

meanings_zh: n. 交通；路上车辆 | n. 通信量；网络流量
definition_en: Vehicles moving along roads in a particular area | The amount of data or messages passing through a system
example1_en: Heavy traffic made us late for dinner again.
example1_zh: 交通拥堵又让我们吃晚饭迟到了。
example2_en: Investing in reliable public transport can reduce traffic congestion and improve urban air quality.
example2_zh: 投资建设可靠的公共交通可以缓解交通拥堵，并改善城市空气质量。
collocations: heavy traffic｜繁忙的交通 ; traffic congestion｜交通拥堵 ; traffic lights｜交通信号灯 ; internet traffic｜互联网流量
tip_zh: 表示交通或车流时不可数，不说a traffic。

meanings_zh: prep. 朝；向 | prep. 对于；对待 | prep. 用于；有助于
definition_en: In the direction of someone or something | In relation to someone or something, especially attitudes or behaviour | Helping to achieve or pay for something
example1_en: The puppy ran toward me with a muddy ball.
example1_zh: 小狗叼着一个沾满泥的球向我跑来。
example2_en: Investment in public transport is an important step toward reducing traffic congestion and improving urban air quality.
example2_zh: 投资公共交通是缓解交通拥堵、改善城市空气质量的重要一步。
collocations: move toward｜朝……移动 ; attitudes toward｜对……的态度 ; a step toward｜迈向……的一步 ; go toward the cost｜用于支付费用
tip_zh: toward与towards同义；前者美式更常用。

meanings_zh: n. 行星
definition_en: A large round object that travels around a star.
example1_en: We watched a bright planet through the telescope tonight.
example1_zh: 今晚我们用望远镜观察了一颗明亮的行星。
example2_en: Scientists study distant planets to understand whether conditions suitable for life exist beyond Earth.
example2_zh: 科学家研究遥远的行星，以了解地球以外是否存在适合生命的条件。
collocations: a distant planet｜遥远的行星 ; orbit a planet｜绕行星运行 ; protect the planet｜保护地球
tip_zh: planet是行星，star是恒星；the planet常指地球。

meanings_zh: adj. 传统的；沿袭已久的
definition_en: Following customs or methods passed down over a long time.
example1_en: We cooked a traditional meal for the family gathering.
example1_zh: 我们为家庭聚会做了一顿传统饭菜。
example2_en: Traditional farming methods can preserve local knowledge, although some require adaptation to cope with climate change.
example2_zh: 传统耕作方法能够保留地方知识，但其中一些需要调整以应对气候变化。
collocations: traditional customs｜传统习俗 ; traditional crafts｜传统手工艺 ; traditional methods｜传统方法
tip_zh: traditional强调传承已久，不一定表示落后。

meanings_zh: n. 软件
definition_en: programs that tell a computer how to perform tasks
example1_en: This software helps me edit photos on my laptop.
example1_zh: 这个软件帮助我在笔记本电脑上编辑照片。
example2_en: Schools need reliable software and adequate teacher training to make effective use of digital learning tools.
example2_zh: 学校需要可靠的软件和充分的教师培训，才能有效利用数字学习工具。
collocations: install software｜安装软件 ; software development｜软件开发 ; software update｜软件更新 ; open-source software｜开源软件
tip_zh: 不可数：说some software，不说a software。

meanings_zh: v. 要不要；好吗 | v. 将会；必将 | v. 必须；应当
definition_en: Used with I or we to offer or suggest something. | Used with I or we to express future intentions formally. | Used in formal rules to state a requirement.
example1_en: Shall we take a short walk after dinner?
example1_zh: 我们晚饭后去散一会儿步好吗？
example2_en: Under the proposed regulations, employers shall provide appropriate safety equipment for all workers handling hazardous materials.
example2_zh: 根据拟议规定，雇主必须为所有接触危险材料的工人提供适当的安全装备。
collocations: shall we｜我们要不要 ; shall I｜要我来……吗 ; shall not｜不得
tip_zh: 情态动词，后接动词原形；Shall we常用于提议。

meanings_zh: n. 篮子；筐 | n. 篮筐；投篮得分
definition_en: A container made from woven strips, wire, or similar materials | The hoop and net in basketball, or a score through it
example1_en: I carried a basket of fresh apples into the kitchen.
example1_zh: 我提着一篮新鲜苹果走进厨房。
example2_en: Providing reusable shopping baskets can encourage customers to reduce their reliance on disposable plastic bags.
example2_zh: 提供可重复使用的购物篮可以鼓励顾客减少对一次性塑料袋的依赖。
collocations: shopping basket｜购物篮 ; laundry basket｜洗衣篮 ; a basket of fruit｜一篮水果 ; score a basket｜投篮得分
tip_zh: a basket of apples指一篮苹果；篮子数量用baskets。

meanings_zh: n. 小偷；窃贼
definition_en: someone who steals another person's belongings
example1_en: The thief took my bicycle while I was shopping.
example1_zh: 我购物时，小偷偷走了我的自行车。
example2_en: Secure bicycle parking can make it harder for a thief to steal from commuters.
example2_zh: 安全的自行车停车设施能让小偷更难偷走通勤者的自行车。
collocations: a bicycle thief｜偷自行车的人 ; catch a thief｜抓住小偷 ; a petty thief｜小偷小摸的人
tip_zh: 复数是thieves；robber通常涉及暴力或威胁抢劫。

meanings_zh: n. 万维网 | n. 蜘蛛网 | n. 复杂网络；错综关系
definition_en: The system of connected pages accessed through the internet. | A structure of fine threads a spider makes to catch insects. | A complicated network of connected things or relationships.
example1_en: I found a simple soup recipe on the web.
example1_zh: 我在网上找到了一份简单的汤谱。
example2_en: Although the web provides convenient access to information, students must learn to evaluate the reliability of online sources.
example2_zh: 虽然万维网让获取信息更方便，但学生必须学会评估网络来源的可靠性。
collocations: browse the web｜浏览网页 ; a spider's web｜蜘蛛网 ; a web of relationships｜错综复杂的关系网
tip_zh: 上网常用on the web；web不完全等同于internet。

meanings_zh: n. 雇员；员工
definition_en: Someone paid to work for a person or organisation.
example1_en: A new employee showed me around the bakery.
example1_zh: 一位新员工带我参观了面包店。
example2_en: Employers should provide every employee with appropriate training to maintain a safe and productive workplace.
example2_zh: 雇主应为每位员工提供适当培训，以保持工作场所的安全和高效。
collocations: full-time employee｜全职员工 ; employee benefits｜员工福利 ; employee training｜员工培训 ; employee turnover｜员工流动率
tip_zh: employee是雇员，employer是雇主。

meanings_zh: n. 铁路；铁路系统
definition_en: Tracks and services used by trains to transport people or goods.
example1_en: Our house overlooks the railway near the old bridge.
example1_zh: 从我们家能望见旧桥附近的铁路。
example2_en: Investment in railway networks can reduce road congestion while improving access to employment in neighbouring cities.
example2_zh: 投资铁路网络可以缓解道路拥堵，同时方便人们前往邻近城市就业。
collocations: a railway station｜火车站 ; a railway line｜铁路线 ; a railway network｜铁路网 ; railway infrastructure｜铁路基础设施
tip_zh: railway常用于英式英语，美式常用railroad。

meanings_zh: n. 描述；描写
definition_en: an account explaining what someone or something is like
example1_en: Your description helped me find the little bakery.
example1_zh: 你的描述帮我找到了那家小面包店。
example2_en: A clear description of research methods allows other scientists to evaluate the reliability of a study.
example2_zh: 清楚描述研究方法，有助于其他科学家评估研究的可靠性。
collocations: a detailed description｜详细描述 ; give a description of｜描述 ; a job description｜岗位职责说明 ; an accurate description｜准确描述
tip_zh: 表示对某物的描述，用a description of，不用about。

meanings_zh: n. 锅 | n. 盆；罐；壶 | v. 把植物栽入盆中
definition_en: A deep container used for cooking food. | A container used for plants, storage, or serving drinks. | To put a plant into a container with soil.
example1_en: The soup is bubbling gently in a large pot.
example1_zh: 汤在一口大锅里咕嘟咕嘟地轻轻翻滚。
example2_en: Growing vegetables in pots allows residents with limited outdoor space to produce some of their own food.
example2_zh: 用盆种菜能让户外空间有限的居民自己种出一些食物。
collocations: a pot of soup｜一锅汤 ; a plant pot｜花盆 ; a pot of tea｜一壶茶 ; pot plants｜把植物栽入盆中
tip_zh: 锅、盆、罐都可用pot；平底煎锅常用pan。

meanings_zh: n. 千米；公里
definition_en: A unit of distance equal to one thousand metres.
example1_en: The nearest bus stop is about a kilometre away.
example1_zh: 最近的公交车站大约在一公里外。
example2_en: Building safe cycle lanes within a kilometre of schools could encourage more children to cycle daily.
example2_zh: 在学校周边一公里内修建安全的自行车道，可以鼓励更多孩子每天骑车。
collocations: a kilometre away｜一公里外 ; square kilometre｜平方公里 ; kilometres per hour｜公里每小时
tip_zh: 英式拼写为kilometre，美式为kilometer。

meanings_zh: n. 送奶工
definition_en: A man whose job is delivering milk to homes.
example1_en: The milkman left two glass bottles outside our door.
example1_zh: 送奶工在我们门外放了两瓶玻璃瓶装的牛奶。
example2_en: Regular deliveries by a local milkman can encourage households to reuse glass bottles rather than discard plastic containers.
example2_zh: 当地送奶工定期送奶可以鼓励家庭重复使用玻璃瓶，而不是丢弃塑料容器。
collocations: local milkman｜当地送奶工 ; the milkman's round｜送奶工的配送路线
tip_zh: 复数为milkmen；不指挤奶者，挤奶者是milker。

meanings_zh: n. 航班；空中旅程 | n. 飞行 | n. 一段楼梯
definition_en: A journey through the air, especially in an aircraft. | The act or ability of moving through the air. | A continuous set of stairs between floors or landings.
example1_en: Our flight leaves early, so we should pack tonight.
example1_zh: 我们的航班出发很早，所以今晚应该收拾好行李。
example2_en: Reducing the number of short domestic flights could lower emissions where reliable rail alternatives already exist.
example2_zh: 在已有可靠铁路替代方案的地区，减少短途国内航班可以降低排放。
collocations: book a flight｜预订航班 ; direct flight｜直达航班 ; in flight｜飞行中 ; a flight of stairs｜一段楼梯
tip_zh: a flight of stairs指两层或平台之间的一段楼梯。

meanings_zh: n. 原因；起因 | v. 导致；引起 | n. 事业；奋斗目标
definition_en: something that makes an event or situation happen | make something happen, especially something unpleasant | an aim or principle that people support and work towards
example1_en: The plumber found the cause of the leak.
example1_zh: 水管工找到了漏水的原因。
example2_en: Heavy traffic is a major cause of air pollution in many rapidly growing urban areas.
example2_zh: 在许多快速发展的城市地区，繁忙的交通是空气污染的主要原因。
collocations: cause of｜……的原因 ; cause damage｜造成损害 ; root cause｜根本原因 ; a good cause｜公益事业
tip_zh: 名词常接of；动词可用cause sb to do sth。

meanings_zh: n. 知识；学识 | n. 知晓；了解
definition_en: information and understanding gained through learning or experience | awareness of a particular fact or situation
example1_en: My grandfather shared his knowledge of birds with me.
example1_zh: 祖父和我分享了他对鸟类的了解。
example2_en: Schools should help students apply their knowledge to practical problems rather than simply memorise facts.
example2_zh: 学校应帮助学生运用知识解决实际问题，而不只是记忆事实。
collocations: gain knowledge｜获取知识 ; practical knowledge｜实用知识 ; knowledge of｜对……的了解 ; without someone's knowledge｜在某人不知情的情况下
tip_zh: 通常不可数；可说a good knowledge of某领域。

meanings_zh: n. 顺序；秩序 | v. 订购；点餐；命令 | n. 订单；命令
definition_en: the arrangement of things or a controlled, peaceful situation | to request goods or food, or tell someone what to do | a request for goods or an instruction that must be obeyed
example1_en: Please put these photos in the correct order.
example1_zh: 请把这些照片按正确顺序排列。
example2_en: Online shoppers can now order fresh produce directly from local farms, supporting regional economies.
example2_zh: 网购者如今可以直接向当地农场订购新鲜农产品，从而支持地区经济。
collocations: in alphabetical order｜按字母顺序 ; place an order｜下订单 ; order a meal｜点餐 ; order someone to do something｜命令某人做某事
tip_zh: in order指按顺序；in order to后接动词，表示为了。

meanings_zh: n. 地面；土地 | n. 理由；根据 | v. 使停飞
definition_en: The solid surface of the earth. | Reasons or evidence supporting a belief, decision, or action. | To prevent an aircraft from flying.
example1_en: We spread a blanket on the ground beneath a tree.
example1_zh: 我们在树下的地面上铺了一条毯子。
example2_en: Planting trees helps the ground retain moisture and reduces the risk of soil erosion.
example2_zh: 植树有助于土地保持水分，并降低水土流失的风险。
collocations: on the ground｜在地面上 ; grounds for complaint｜投诉的理由 ; common ground｜共同点 ; ground a plane｜使飞机停飞
tip_zh: 表示理由常用复数grounds；ground也是grind的过去式。

meanings_zh: n. 卡车；货车
definition_en: A large road vehicle used for carrying goods.
example1_en: A lorry delivered fresh vegetables to the shop.
example1_zh: 一辆货车把新鲜蔬菜送到了店里。
example2_en: Restricting lorry deliveries during peak hours could reduce congestion and improve road safety in city centres.
example2_zh: 限制货车在高峰时段送货，可以缓解市中心的拥堵并改善道路安全。
collocations: lorry driver｜货车司机 ; delivery lorry｜送货卡车 ; load a lorry｜给卡车装货
tip_zh: lorry主要用于英式英语，美式英语通常用truck。

meanings_zh: n. 爱尔兰（国家） | n. 爱尔兰岛
definition_en: a European country occupying most of the island of Ireland | an island west of Great Britain
example1_en: We explored the west coast of Ireland by bicycle.
example1_zh: 我们骑自行车游览了爱尔兰西海岸。
example2_en: Ireland attracts international students through its English-speaking universities and opportunities to experience a different culture.
example2_zh: 爱尔兰凭借其英语授课的大学和体验不同文化的机会吸引国际学生。
collocations: in Ireland｜在爱尔兰 ; the Republic of Ireland｜爱尔兰共和国 ; the island of Ireland｜爱尔兰岛 ; rural Ireland｜爱尔兰乡村地区
tip_zh: 可指国家或整座岛；北爱尔兰属于英国，不属于该国。

meanings_zh: v. 赶紧；催促 | n. 匆忙；仓促
definition_en: To move or act quickly, or make someone do so. | A need to act quickly because time is limited.
example1_en: We hurried home before the rain began to fall.
example1_zh: 我们赶在下雨前匆忙回家了。
example2_en: When teachers hurry through difficult material, students may struggle to develop a clear understanding of key concepts.
