collocations: disagree with someone｜不同意某人的看法 ; disagree about something｜在某事上意见不合 ; strongly disagree｜强烈反对
tip_zh: 不同意某人用disagree with；争议话题用on或about。

meanings_zh: n. 美国邮政编码
definition_en: A code identifying a postal delivery area in the United States.
example1_en: Please include your ZIP code when entering your address.
example1_zh: 填写地址时，请附上你的美国邮政编码。
example2_en: Researchers grouped households by ZIP code to examine geographical differences in access to healthcare services.
example2_zh: 研究人员按美国邮政编码对住户进行分组，以考察医疗服务可及性的地区差异。
collocations: enter a ZIP code｜输入邮政编码 ; ZIP code lookup｜邮政编码查询 ; ZIP code area｜邮政编码区域
tip_zh: 用于美国；英国通常说postcode，统称postal code。

meanings_zh: n. 作者；作家 | v. 撰写；创作
definition_en: A person who writes books, articles, or other written works. | To write a book, report, or other written work.
example1_en: The author answered questions about her new adventure novel.
example1_zh: 这位作者回答了有关她新出版的冒险小说的问题。
example2_en: An author can challenge social attitudes by presenting familiar problems through the experiences of unfamiliar characters.
example2_zh: 作者可以借助陌生人物的经历呈现熟悉的问题，从而挑战社会观念。
collocations: the author of a novel｜一部小说的作者 ; a bestselling author｜畅销书作家 ; author a report｜撰写报告
tip_zh: “……的作者”用the author of；也可作动词。

meanings_zh: n. 肥皂 | n. 肥皂剧 | v. 用肥皂擦洗
definition_en: A substance used with water to clean skin or objects. | A continuing television or radio drama about everyday relationships. | To rub or wash something with soap.
example1_en: Please wash your hands with soap before lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭前请用肥皂洗手。
example2_en: Providing clean water and soap in schools can help prevent infections and improve children's overall health.
example2_zh: 在学校提供清洁用水和肥皂有助于预防感染，改善儿童的整体健康状况。
collocations: a bar of soap｜一块肥皂 ; liquid soap｜洗手液；液体皂 ; soap and water｜肥皂和水 ; soap opera｜肥皂剧
tip_zh: 指清洁用品通常不可数；一块用a bar of soap。

meanings_zh: n. 豌豆；豌豆粒
definition_en: A small, round, green seed eaten as a vegetable
example1_en: She added frozen peas to the vegetable soup.
example1_zh: 她往蔬菜汤里加了些冷冻豌豆。
example2_en: Growing peas and other vegetables at school can help children understand where their food comes from.
example2_zh: 在学校种植豌豆和其他蔬菜，可以帮助孩子了解食物的来源。
collocations: frozen peas｜冷冻豌豆 ; pea soup｜豌豆汤 ; a pea pod｜一个豌豆荚
tip_zh: 可数名词；泛指食用的豌豆通常用复数peas。

meanings_zh: adj. 色彩鲜艳的；五彩缤纷的 | adj. 生动有趣的；丰富多彩的
definition_en: Having many bright colours | Full of interesting, unusual or exciting details
example1_en: Colourful balloons floated above the tables at the party.
example1_zh: 聚会上，五彩缤纷的气球飘浮在桌子上方。
example2_en: Colourful public murals can transform neglected urban spaces and encourage residents to take pride in their neighbourhoods.
example2_zh: 色彩鲜艳的公共壁画能改变被忽视的城市空间，增强居民对社区的自豪感。
collocations: colourful flowers｜色彩鲜艳的花朵 ; a colourful display｜绚丽的展示 ; a colourful character｜有趣独特的人物 ; a colourful history｜丰富多彩的历史
tip_zh: 英式拼写colourful，美式拼写colorful。

meanings_zh: prep. 据……所述；根据 | prep. 按照；依照
definition_en: as stated or reported by someone or something | following a rule, plan, or particular standard
example1_en: According to the forecast, rain will arrive this afternoon.
example1_zh: 据天气预报，今天下午会下雨。
example2_en: According to recent research, regular physical activity can improve concentration and reduce stress among university students.
example2_zh: 根据近期研究，经常进行体育活动可以提高大学生的专注力并减轻压力。
collocations: according to research｜根据研究 ; according to plan｜按计划 ; according to the rules｜按照规则
tip_zh: 引述他人观点用according to；自己的观点用in my opinion。

meanings_zh: v. 扔；投；掷 | v. 举办聚会 | n. 投掷；投掷距离
definition_en: To send something through the air using your hand | To organise and host a party | An act of throwing, or the distance something is thrown
example1_en: Throw me the ball before the dog grabs it.
example1_zh: 趁狗还没抢到球，快把球扔给我。
example2_en: Schools can teach children to throw and catch safely through games that develop coordination and teamwork.
example2_zh: 学校可以通过培养协调能力和团队精神的游戏，教孩子安全地投接球。
collocations: throw a ball｜扔球 ; throw a party｜举办聚会 ; throw away rubbish｜扔掉垃圾
tip_zh: 不规则变化：throw–threw–thrown；聚会也可用throw。

meanings_zh: adj. 令人不快的；难闻的 | adj. 恶意的；不友善的 | adj. 严重的；疼痛的
definition_en: Very unpleasant to experience, taste, smell, or see. | Deliberately unkind or hurtful towards another person. | Severe or painful, especially describing an illness or injury.
example1_en: A nasty smell came from the kitchen bin.
example1_zh: 厨房垃圾桶里散发出一股难闻的气味。
example2_en: Nasty comments on social media can discourage young people from participating in otherwise valuable online discussions.
example2_zh: 社交媒体上的恶意评论可能使年轻人不愿参与原本有价值的网络讨论。
collocations: nasty smell｜难闻的气味 ; nasty comment｜恶意评论 ; nasty injury｜严重的伤 ; nasty shock｜令人不快的打击
tip_zh: 比bad更带厌恶感；形容人时通常指刻薄、不友善。

meanings_zh: v. 解释；说明 | v. 说明……的原因
definition_en: to make something clear or easy to understand | to give or be the reason why something happens
example1_en: Could you explain how this coffee machine works?
example1_zh: 你能说明一下这台咖啡机怎么用吗？
example2_en: Differences in access to healthcare may partly explain why life expectancy varies considerably between regions.
example2_zh: 医疗服务可及性的差异，可能在一定程度上解释不同地区预期寿命差距较大的原因。
collocations: explain something to someone｜向某人解释某事 ; explain why｜解释为什么 ; explain in detail｜详细解释 ; explain the difference｜说明区别
tip_zh: 说explain something to someone，不说explain someone。

meanings_zh: adv. 可能；也许 | adv. 究竟；无论如何
definition_en: Used when something may happen or may be true. | Used with can or could to emphasise possibility or difficulty.
example1_en: We could possibly have a picnic if the rain stops.
example1_zh: 如果雨停了，我们也许可以去野餐。
example2_en: Expanding urban green spaces could possibly reduce summer temperatures while improving residents' physical and mental health.
example2_zh: 扩大城市绿地可能降低夏季气温，同时改善居民的身心健康。
collocations: could possibly｜或许能够 ; quite possibly｜很有可能 ; can't possibly｜绝不可能
tip_zh: can't possibly表示“绝不可能”，语气很强。

meanings_zh: n. 银 | adj. 银色的；银制的 | n. 银牌
definition_en: A shiny greyish-white precious metal used for jewellery and coins. | Having a shiny greyish-white colour, or made of silver. | A medal awarded for second place in a competition.
example1_en: This little spoon is made of pure silver.
example1_zh: 这把小勺子是纯银做的。
example2_en: Silver is widely used in electronic devices because it conducts electricity exceptionally well.
example2_zh: 银的导电性能极佳，因此被广泛用于电子设备。
collocations: pure silver｜纯银 ; a silver medal｜银牌 ; silver jewellery｜银首饰
tip_zh: 表示金属银时不可数；a silver可指一枚银牌。

meanings_zh: n. 副本；一本；一份 | v. 复制；抄写；模仿 | n. 待刊稿件；广告文案
definition_en: A reproduction, or one example of a book or document | To reproduce something or imitate someone's actions | Written material prepared for publication or advertising
example1_en: Please keep a copy of the receipt at home.
example1_zh: 请在家里留一份收据副本。
example2_en: Students should learn to evaluate sources rather than simply copy information from websites into their assignments.
example2_zh: 学生应学会评估资料来源，而不是直接把网站信息抄进作业。
collocations: a copy of｜一份；一本 ; a digital copy｜电子副本 ; copy and paste｜复制粘贴 ; advertising copy｜广告文案
tip_zh: 复数为copies；广告文案义的copy通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 旅行；出行 | adj. 巡回的；四处流动的 | v. 旅行；行进
definition_en: The activity of going from one place to another | Moving between places rather than staying in one location | Going from one place to another
example1_en: Travelling by train gives me time to enjoy the scenery.
example1_zh: 乘火车旅行让我有时间欣赏沿途风景。
example2_en: Travelling abroad can broaden students' perspectives by exposing them to different customs and ways of life.
example2_zh: 出国旅行能让学生接触不同的习俗和生活方式，从而拓宽视野。
collocations: go travelling｜去旅行 ; travelling abroad｜出国旅行 ; travelling expenses｜差旅费 ; a travelling exhibition｜巡回展览
tip_zh: 英式拼写双写l；美式通常写traveling。

meanings_zh: adv. 不同地；以不同方式
definition_en: in a way that is not the same
example1_en: My sister and I arrange our desks differently.
example1_zh: 我和姐姐布置书桌的方式不同。
example2_en: Students learn differently, so teachers should offer varied activities rather than rely on a single method.
example2_zh: 学生的学习方式各不相同，因此教师应提供多样化活动，而不是依赖单一方法。
collocations: think differently｜以不同方式思考 ; treat someone differently｜区别对待某人 ; react differently｜作出不同反应 ; do things differently｜换种方式做事
tip_zh: 副词修饰动词；形容人或事物不同用different。

meanings_zh: n. 警察；警官 | n. 军官 | n. 官员；主管人员
definition_en: A member of the police. | A member of the armed forces with authority to command. | Someone with an official role in an organisation or government.
example1_en: A police officer helped us find the station.
example1_zh: 一位警察帮我们找到了车站。
example2_en: A local housing officer can advise residents on applying for affordable accommodation and accessing financial support.
example2_zh: 当地住房事务官员可以指导居民申请可负担住房并获取经济援助。
collocations: police officer｜警察 ; army officer｜陆军军官 ; housing officer｜住房事务官员 ; chief executive officer｜首席执行官
tip_zh: officer可指警察或军官，具体含义看搭配。

meanings_zh: n. 大熊猫
definition_en: a large black and white bear native to China
example1_en: The panda sat quietly, chewing a fresh bamboo shoot.
example1_zh: 那只大熊猫静静地坐着，嚼着一根新鲜竹笋。
example2_en: Protecting panda habitats also benefits other species that depend on the same mountain forests for survival.
example2_zh: 保护大熊猫栖息地也有益于其他依赖同一片山林生存的物种。
collocations: giant panda｜大熊猫 ; panda cub｜大熊猫幼崽 ; panda habitat｜大熊猫栖息地
tip_zh: panda通常指大熊猫；red panda指小熊猫。

meanings_zh: n. 经验 | n. 经历；体验 | v. 经历；感受
definition_en: knowledge or skill gained by doing things | something that happens to you or that you do | to have something happen to you or feel something
example1_en: My sister has years of experience repairing old bicycles.
example1_zh: 我姐姐有多年修理旧自行车的经验。
example2_en: Work experience can help graduates develop practical skills that employers value alongside academic qualifications.
example2_zh: 工作经验能帮助毕业生培养实践技能，而雇主不仅重视学历，也看重这些技能。
collocations: gain experience｜积累经验 ; work experience｜工作经验 ; a rewarding experience｜有收获的经历 ; experience difficulties｜遇到困难
tip_zh: 表“经验”不可数；表具体“经历”可数。

meanings_zh: v. 增加；提高 | n. 增加；增长
definition_en: Become greater in amount or size, or make something greater | A rise in the amount, size, or level of something
example1_en: The bakery increased its prices again this week.
example1_zh: 这家面包店本周又涨价了。
example2_en: An increase in public transport investment could reduce traffic congestion and improve air quality in cities.
example2_zh: 增加公共交通投资可以缓解交通拥堵，并改善城市空气质量。
collocations: increase by｜增加了 ; increase to｜增加到 ; an increase in demand｜需求的增长 ; a significant increase｜显著增长
tip_zh: 动词重音在后，名词在前；by接增量，to接终值。

meanings_zh: v. 属于；归某人所有 | v. 应在某处；归入 | v. 有归属感
definition_en: To be owned by someone | To have a proper place or category | To feel accepted as part of a group
example1_en: This blue umbrella belongs to my younger sister.
example1_zh: 这把蓝色雨伞是我妹妹的。
example2_en: Community centres provide welcoming spaces where newcomers can feel they belong and build lasting friendships.
example2_zh: 社区中心提供友好的空间，让新来者获得归属感并建立持久的友谊。
collocations: belong to someone｜归某人所有 ; belong in a museum｜应放在博物馆 ; feel you belong｜感到有归属感
tip_zh: belong to表示属于，不用被动语态或进行时。

meanings_zh: adv. 几乎；差不多
definition_en: Nearly, but not completely or not quite.
example1_en: I almost missed the bus while tying my shoes.
example1_zh: 我系鞋带时差点错过了公交车。
example2_en: Almost all participants agreed that affordable public transport would improve their access to employment opportunities.
example2_zh: 几乎所有参与者都认为，价格实惠的公共交通能让他们获得更多就业机会。
collocations: almost all｜几乎所有 ; almost certainly｜几乎肯定 ; almost impossible｜几乎不可能 ; almost every day｜几乎每天
tip_zh: almost可接all、every和no；不能直接接most。

meanings_zh: n. 磁带录音机
definition_en: A device that records and plays sound using magnetic tape.
example1_en: My grandfather still uses a tape-recorder to record songs.
example1_zh: 我祖父仍用磁带录音机录制歌曲。
example2_en: Before digital devices became widespread, researchers often used a tape-recorder to preserve interviews for later analysis.
example2_zh: 在数字设备普及之前，研究人员常用磁带录音机保存访谈内容，以供后续分析。
collocations: a portable tape-recorder｜便携式磁带录音机 ; a cassette tape-recorder｜盒式磁带录音机
tip_zh: 现代通常写作tape recorder，不加连字符。

meanings_zh: adv. 精确地；恰好 | adv. 正是；完全正确
definition_en: Precisely, with no difference or error. | Used to confirm that something is completely correct.
example1_en: This jacket is exactly the colour I wanted.
example1_zh: 这件夹克正是我想要的颜色。
example2_en: Researchers must record exactly how much energy each household uses to ensure reliable comparisons between regions.
example2_zh: 研究人员必须准确记录每户家庭的能耗，以确保地区之间的比较可靠。
collocations: exactly the same｜完全一样 ; exactly right｜完全正确 ; know exactly｜确切知道
tip_zh: not exactly常表示并非完全，也可委婉否定。

meanings_zh: det. 两者任一；两边各一 | pron. 两者中的任何一个 | adv. 也不
definition_en: One or the other of two; each of two sides. | One or the other of two people or things. | Also not, used after a negative statement.
example1_en: You can borrow either umbrella; both are dry.
example1_zh: 两把伞你随便借哪把都行，都是干的。
example2_en: Students can choose either vocational training or university education, depending on their interests and career goals.
example2_zh: 学生可以根据自己的兴趣和职业目标，选择职业培训或大学教育。
collocations: either way｜无论哪种情况 ; either side｜两边中的任一边；两边各自 ; not either｜也不 ; either of them｜他们两者中的任一个
tip_zh: either…or…表二选一；否定句末either表“也不”。

meanings_zh: n. 营地；度假营 | v. 露营；扎营 | n. 阵营；派别
definition_en: A place where people stay temporarily, often in tents. | Stay outdoors temporarily in a tent or similar shelter. | A group sharing the same opinions or aims.
example1_en: We returned to camp before the rain started.
example1_zh: 我们在下雨前回到了营地。
example2_en: Schools can organise outdoor camps to help students develop independence and learn practical skills beyond the classroom.
example2_zh: 学校可以组织户外营地活动，帮助学生培养独立性并学习课堂之外的实用技能。
collocations: set up camp｜扎营 ; go camping｜去露营 ; a summer camp｜夏令营 ; opposing camps｜对立阵营
tip_zh: go camping表示去露营；camp也可指观点相同的阵营。

meanings_zh: adv. 突然；忽然
definition_en: Quickly and unexpectedly, with little or no warning.
example1_en: The lights suddenly went out while we were cooking.
example1_zh: 我们做饭时，灯突然灭了。
example2_en: When demand suddenly increases, public transport systems may struggle to provide enough services for passengers.
example2_zh: 当需求突然增加时，公共交通系统可能难以为乘客提供足够的班次。
collocations: suddenly appear｜突然出现 ; suddenly realise｜突然意识到 ; stop suddenly｜突然停下
tip_zh: 可置于句首或动词前；强调变化突然、事先无预兆。

meanings_zh: n. 气体 | n. 燃气；天然气 | n. 汽油（美式）
definition_en: A substance that spreads freely to fill its container. | Gas used as fuel for heating or cooking. | Petrol used to power vehicles, in American English.
example1_en: We use gas to cook our meals at home.
example1_zh: 我们在家用燃气做饭。
example2_en: Reducing greenhouse gas emissions requires investment in cleaner energy and more efficient public transport systems.
example2_zh: 减少温室气体排放需要投资更清洁的能源和更高效的公共交通系统。
collocations: greenhouse gas｜温室气体 ; natural gas｜天然气 ; a gas leak｜燃气泄漏 ; a gas station｜加油站（美式）
tip_zh: 泛指气体通常不可数；多种气体用gases。

meanings_zh: n. 剪刀
definition_en: A tool with two blades for cutting things.
example1_en: Please use these scissors to cut the wrapping paper.
example1_zh: 请用这把剪刀裁剪包装纸。
example2_en: Teachers should supervise young children when they use scissors during classroom craft activities.
example2_zh: 幼儿在课堂手工活动中使用剪刀时，教师应在旁监督。
collocations: a pair of scissors｜一把剪刀 ; sharp scissors｜锋利的剪刀 ; cut with scissors｜用剪刀剪
tip_zh: 通常用复数；一把剪刀说a pair of scissors。

meanings_zh: n. 金鱼
definition_en: A small ornamental fish, often orange, kept in ponds or tanks.
example1_en: Our goldfish swims between the plants in its large tank.
example1_zh: 我们的金鱼在大鱼缸里的水草间游来游去。
example2_en: Keeping goldfish in suitably sized tanks can teach children responsibility and the importance of animal welfare.
example2_zh: 在大小适宜的鱼缸里养金鱼，可以教会孩子承担责任，并认识动物福利的重要性。
collocations: keep goldfish｜养金鱼 ; feed the goldfish｜喂金鱼 ; goldfish pond｜金鱼池
tip_zh: goldfish单复数同形：one goldfish，two goldfish。

meanings_zh: n. 尾巴；尾部 | v. 尾随；跟踪
definition_en: the rear part of an animal or an aircraft | to follow someone closely and watch where they go
example1_en: The dog wagged its tail when I came home.
example1_zh: 我回家时，那只狗摇起了尾巴。
example2_en: Some animals use their tails for balance, which helps them move safely through complex forest habitats.
example2_zh: 一些动物用尾巴保持平衡，这有助于它们在复杂的森林栖息地中安全移动。
collocations: wag its tail｜摇尾巴 ; a bushy tail｜蓬松的尾巴 ; the tail end｜末尾
tip_zh: tail指尾巴；tale指故事，两词同音。

meanings_zh: adj. 自己的 | v. 拥有
definition_en: Belonging to a particular person, rather than someone else. | To have something that legally belongs to you.
example1_en: I finally have my own room in our new flat.
example1_zh: 在我们的新公寓里，我终于有了自己的房间。
example2_en: People who own their homes may feel more financially secure, although maintenance costs can be substantial.
example2_zh: 拥有住房的人可能在经济上更有安全感，不过房屋维护费用也可能相当高。
collocations: my own room｜我自己的房间 ; own a home｜拥有住房 ; on your own｜独自；独立地 ; of your own｜属于你自己的
tip_zh: own表“自己的”前通常有物主词，如my own。

meanings_zh: v. 庆祝 | v. 赞颂；颂扬
definition_en: To mark a special occasion by doing something enjoyable. | To praise someone or something publicly.
example1_en: We cooked a special dinner to celebrate her graduation.
example1_zh: 我们做了一顿特别的晚餐来庆祝她毕业。
example2_en: Community festivals celebrate local traditions while giving residents opportunities to strengthen relationships with their neighbours.
example2_zh: 社区节庆活动在弘扬当地传统的同时，也让居民有机会增进邻里关系。
collocations: celebrate a birthday｜庆祝生日 ; celebrate an achievement｜庆祝一项成就 ; celebrate diversity｜赞颂多样性
tip_zh: 庆祝某事用celebrate；祝贺某人用congratulate。

meanings_zh: adj. 木制的 | adj. 呆板的；僵硬的
definition_en: made of wood | showing little natural feeling or movement
example1_en: She stirred the soup slowly with a wooden spoon.
example1_zh: 她用木勺慢慢搅拌汤。
example2_en: Wooden buildings can offer environmental benefits when their materials come from responsibly managed forests.
example2_zh: 如果木材来自负责任管理的森林，木制建筑就能带来环境效益。
collocations: wooden floor｜木地板 ; wooden furniture｜木制家具 ; wooden spoon｜木勺 ; wooden performance｜呆板的表演
tip_zh: wooden指木制；woody多指木质或像木头的。

meanings_zh: adj. 必要的；必需的
definition_en: needed for a particular purpose or situation
example1_en: Take a warm coat if you think it's necessary.
example1_zh: 如果你觉得有必要，就带上一件暖和的外套。
example2_en: Investment in public transport is necessary to reduce traffic congestion and improve urban air quality.
example2_zh: 投资公共交通对于缓解交通拥堵和改善城市空气质量是必要的。
collocations: if necessary｜如有必要 ; necessary precautions｜必要的预防措施 ; necessary for｜对……必需 ; absolutely necessary｜绝对必要的
tip_zh: 常用it is necessary to do；necessarily意为“必然地”。

meanings_zh: v. 建议；提议 | v. 表明；暗示
definition_en: To offer an idea or possible action for consideration. | To indicate that something may be true.
example1_en: I suggest taking an umbrella because those clouds look dark.
example1_zh: 我建议带把伞，因为那些云看起来很阴沉。
example2_en: Recent studies suggest that access to green spaces can improve mental health among urban residents.
example2_zh: 近期研究表明，能够接触绿地可能有助于改善城市居民的心理健康。
collocations: suggest a solution｜提出解决方案 ; suggest doing something｜建议做某事 ; strongly suggest｜强烈暗示 ; evidence suggests that｜证据表明
tip_zh: 用suggest doing或suggest that从句，不用suggest to do。

meanings_zh: n. 空调；空气调节系统
definition_en: A system that cools indoor air and controls humidity.
example1_en: Please turn on the air-conditioning before the guests arrive.
example1_zh: 请在客人到来之前打开空调。
example2_en: Greater reliance on air-conditioning during heatwaves can place considerable pressure on urban electricity supplies.
example2_zh: 热浪期间对空调依赖加深，可能给城市电力供应带来很大压力。
collocations: air-conditioning system｜空调系统 ; central air-conditioning｜中央空调 ; turn on the air-conditioning｜打开空调
tip_zh: 不可数；一台空调机用an air conditioner。

meanings_zh: adj. 凌乱的；脏乱的 | adj. 复杂难办的；棘手的
definition_en: Untidy or dirty, with things scattered or out of place. | Complicated and difficult to deal with.
example1_en: His desk was messy after an afternoon of painting.
example1_zh: 画了一下午画后，他的书桌变得脏乱不堪。
example2_en: Without clear responsibilities, cooperation between public agencies can become messy and delay the delivery of essential services.
example2_zh: 如果没有明确的职责，公共机构之间的合作可能变得混乱，延误基本服务的提供。
collocations: messy room｜凌乱的房间 ; messy handwriting｜潦草的字迹 ; messy situation｜棘手的局面
tip_zh: messy可指物品脏乱，也可指局面复杂难处理。

meanings_zh: adv. 最近；不久前
definition_en: Not long ago, or during the period just before now.
example1_en: We recently moved into a flat near the river.
example1_zh: 我们最近搬进了河边的一套公寓。
example2_en: Researchers have recently explored how access to green spaces influences the mental health of urban residents.
example2_zh: 研究人员最近探讨了绿地的可及性如何影响城市居民的心理健康。
collocations: until recently｜直到最近 ; only recently｜就在不久前 ; recently published｜最近出版的
tip_zh: 可用于一般过去时或现在完成时，不只限于完成时。

meanings_zh: adv. 主要地；大多
definition_en: mainly, or for the largest part
example1_en: My weekend was mostly spent cooking and reading.
example1_zh: 我的周末大部分时间都用来做饭和看书了。
example2_en: In many rural areas, residents rely mostly on private vehicles because public transport services are limited.
example2_zh: 在许多农村地区，由于公共交通服务有限，居民主要依靠私家车出行。
collocations: mostly sunny｜大部分时间晴朗 ; mostly made of｜主要由……制成 ; mostly because｜主要因为
tip_zh: mostly指大部分情况；almost指差一点或几乎。

meanings_zh: adj. 音乐的；有音乐天赋的 | n. 音乐剧；歌舞片 | adj. 悦耳的
definition_en: Relating to music, or showing skill and interest in it. | A play or film whose story includes songs and dancing. | Having a pleasant sound resembling music.
example1_en: He keeps his musical instruments beside the sofa.
example1_zh: 他把乐器放在沙发旁边。
example2_en: Schools that offer musical training give children valuable opportunities to develop creativity and practise teamwork.
example2_zh: 提供音乐训练的学校为孩子们培养创造力和练习团队合作提供了宝贵机会。
collocations: musical instrument｜乐器 ; musical talent｜音乐天赋 ; musical performance｜音乐表演 ; a stage musical｜舞台音乐剧
tip_zh: 作形容词指“音乐的”；作可数名词指音乐剧等。

meanings_zh: v. 摇动；抖动；颤抖 | v. 使震惊；动摇 | n. 摇动；抖动
definition_en: to move quickly back and forth, or cause this movement | to upset someone deeply or weaken their confidence | a quick movement back and forth
example1_en: Shake the bottle well before pouring juice into your glass.
example1_zh: 把果汁倒进杯子前，先充分摇匀瓶子。
example2_en: Repeated failures in public transport can shake commuters' confidence in the reliability of urban services.
example2_zh: 公共交通反复出现故障，可能动摇通勤者对城市服务可靠性的信心。
collocations: shake hands｜握手 ; shake your head｜摇头 ; shake with fear｜吓得发抖 ; shake confidence｜动摇信心
tip_zh: 不规则变化：shake—shook—shaken。

meanings_zh: n. 升（容积单位）
definition_en: a unit of volume equal to one thousand millilitres
example1_en: We need a litre of milk for this pudding.
example1_zh: 做这道布丁需要一升牛奶。
example2_en: Measuring household water use in litres can help residents understand consumption and identify opportunities to reduce waste.
example2_zh: 以升为单位测量家庭用水量，有助于居民了解消耗情况并找到减少浪费的方法。
collocations: a litre of milk｜一升牛奶 ; half a litre｜半升 ; litres per minute｜每分钟升数
tip_zh: 英式拼写litre，美式liter；复数加s。

meanings_zh: n. 理发；发型
definition_en: An act of cutting hair, or the resulting hairstyle.
example1_en: I need a haircut before my cousin's wedding.
example1_zh: 表亲的婚礼之前，我需要理个发。
example2_en: Offering affordable haircuts at community centres can help trainee hairdressers gain practical experience while serving local residents.
example2_zh: 在社区中心提供价格实惠的理发服务，能让实习理发师在服务当地居民的同时积累实践经验。
collocations: get a haircut｜去理发 ; a short haircut｜短发造型 ; need a haircut｜需要理发
tip_zh: 说get或have a haircut，不说cut a haircut。

meanings_zh: v. 预料；预计 | v. 要求；期望 | v. 等待；期待到来
definition_en: to believe that something will probably happen | to regard something as necessary or reasonably required | to believe someone or something will arrive soon
example1_en: We expect rain, so take an umbrella with you.
example1_zh: 我们预计会下雨，所以带上雨伞吧。
example2_en: Employers increasingly expect graduates to demonstrate practical skills as well as a strong understanding of their subject.
example2_zh: 雇主越来越期望毕业生既展现实践技能，又具备扎实的专业知识。
collocations: expect to do something｜预计做某事 ; expect someone to do something｜期望某人做某事 ; fully expect｜完全预料到 ; as expected｜正如预料
tip_zh: expect偏重认为会发生，hope偏重希望发生。

meanings_zh: n. 菠萝；凤梨
definition_en: a tropical fruit with rough skin and sweet yellow flesh
example1_en: She sliced a fresh pineapple for our picnic.
example1_zh: 她为我们的野餐切了一个新鲜菠萝。
example2_en: Growing pineapple for export can support rural incomes, but intensive farming may damage local soils.
example2_zh: 种植菠萝用于出口可以增加农村收入，但集约化种植可能损害当地土壤。
collocations: fresh pineapple｜新鲜菠萝 ; pineapple juice｜菠萝汁 ; pineapple chunks｜菠萝块
tip_zh: 整个菠萝可数，作为食物的菠萝果肉常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 骨；骨头 | v. 剔去……的骨头
definition_en: One of the hard parts forming a body's supporting frame. | To remove the bones from meat or fish.
example1_en: He broke a bone in his wrist while skating.
example1_zh: 他滑冰时摔断了手腕的一块骨头。
example2_en: Regular weight-bearing exercise helps maintain bone strength and can reduce the risk of fractures in older adults.
example2_zh: 规律的负重运动有助于保持骨骼强度，并能降低老年人骨折的风险。
collocations: break a bone｜骨折 ; bone strength｜骨骼强度 ; bone marrow｜骨髓 ; bone density｜骨密度
tip_zh: bone作动词指去骨；boneless表示无骨的。

meanings_zh: n. 镜子 | v. 反映；与……相似
definition_en: A smooth surface, usually glass, that shows a reflected image. | Show the same qualities, changes, or features as something else.
example1_en: He checked his hair in the mirror before leaving.
example1_zh: 他离开前照镜子检查了一下头发。
example2_en: Changes in consumer spending often mirror broader economic trends, particularly during periods of financial uncertainty.
example2_zh: 消费者支出的变化往往反映更广泛的经济趋势，在金融形势不明朗时期尤其如此。
collocations: look in the mirror｜照镜子 ; a full-length mirror｜全身镜 ; mirror changes｜反映变化 ; mirror reality｜反映现实
tip_zh: 照镜子用look in the mirror，不用look the mirror。

meanings_zh: n. 简陋小屋；棚屋
definition_en: A small, simple building, often made of wood or grass.
example1_en: We sheltered from the rain in a wooden hut.
example1_zh: 我们躲进一间木屋避雨。
example2_en: Mountain huts provide essential shelter for hikers, but their construction should minimise damage to fragile ecosystems.
example2_zh: 山间小屋为徒步者提供必要的庇护，但建造时应尽量减少对脆弱生态系统的破坏。
collocations: wooden hut｜木屋 ; mountain hut｜山间小屋 ; thatched hut｜茅草屋
tip_zh: hut强调简小朴素，通常不是设施齐全的住宅。

meanings_zh: adj. 酸的；酸味的 | adj. 酸腐的；变质的 | v. 变坏；使恶化
definition_en: Having a sharp taste like a lemon. | Having an unpleasant taste or smell after becoming spoiled. | To become less pleasant or make a relationship worse.
example1_en: These grapes are too sour for my taste.
example1_zh: 这些葡萄对我来说太酸了。
example2_en: Disagreements over shared resources can sour relations between neighbouring countries and delay important environmental projects.
example2_zh: 共享资源方面的分歧可能使邻国关系恶化，并延误重要的环境项目。
collocations: sour taste｜酸味 ; go sour｜变酸；变质 ; sour relations｜使关系恶化
tip_zh: go sour可指食物变质，也可指关系变坏。

meanings_zh: n. 货币；通货 | n. 流传；通行
definition_en: The money used in a particular country. | The state of being widely accepted or used.
example1_en: We exchanged our money for local currency at the airport.
example1_zh: 我们在机场把钱兑换成了当地货币。
example2_en: A weaker currency can attract international tourists by making accommodation and other services more affordable.
example2_zh: 货币贬值可以降低住宿和其他服务的价格，从而吸引国际游客。
collocations: foreign currency｜外币 ; local currency｜当地货币 ; currency exchange｜货币兑换 ; gain currency｜逐渐流行
tip_zh: 货币种类可数；泛指货币通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 学历；资格证书 | n. 资历；资格条件 | n. 限定条件；保留意见
definition_en: An official award showing successful completion of education or training. | A skill or quality making someone suitable for a role. | A condition that limits the meaning or acceptance of something.
example1_en: This qualification helped me find work at a nursery.
example1_zh: 这个资格证书帮助我在一家幼儿园找到了工作。
example2_en: Employers increasingly value practical experience alongside formal qualifications when recruiting graduates for demanding professional roles.
example2_zh: 招聘毕业生担任要求较高的专业岗位时，雇主越来越重视实际经验与正式学历。
collocations: academic qualifications｜学历 ; professional qualification｜职业资格 ; entry qualifications｜入学资格 ; without qualification｜毫无保留地
tip_zh: 谈学历或资历常用复数qualifications。

meanings_zh: n. 议题；重要问题 | v. 发布；发放 | n. 报刊的一期
definition_en: An important subject or problem that needs discussion. | To officially announce or give something to people. | One edition of a regularly published newspaper or magazine.
example1_en: We discussed the parking issue at our neighbourhood meeting.
example1_zh: 我们在邻里会议上讨论了停车问题。
example2_en: Governments must address the issue of housing affordability to ensure that young adults can live independently.
example2_zh: 政府必须解决住房负担能力问题，确保年轻人能够独立生活。
collocations: address an issue｜处理问题 ; a controversial issue｜有争议的议题 ; issue a warning｜发布警告 ; the latest issue｜最新一期
tip_zh: issue 作问题常指需讨论的议题，不一定是困难。

meanings_zh: adv. 在室内；往室内
definition_en: Inside a building, or into a building.
example1_en: We stayed indoors and played chess during the storm.
example1_zh: 暴风雨期间，我们待在室内下棋。
example2_en: Children who spend most of their time indoors may have fewer opportunities for physical activity.
example2_zh: 大部分时间待在室内的孩子可能较少有机会进行体育活动。
collocations: stay indoors｜待在室内 ; go indoors｜进入室内 ; keep pets indoors｜把宠物养在室内
tip_zh: indoors是副词；修饰名词用indoor，如indoor sports。

meanings_zh: v. 使惊奇；使惊叹
definition_en: to surprise someone very much
example1_en: The magician's clever tricks never fail to amaze the children.
example1_zh: 魔术师巧妙的戏法总能让孩子们惊叹不已。
example2_en: Advances in medical technology continue to amaze researchers and offer new hope to patients with complex conditions.
example2_zh: 医疗技术的进步不断令研究人员惊叹，也为病情复杂的患者带来新的希望。
collocations: never cease to amaze｜始终令人惊叹 ; amaze an audience｜令观众惊叹 ; be amazed at｜对…感到惊奇
tip_zh: 人感到惊奇用amazed；事物令人惊奇用amazing。

meanings_zh: n. 制造者；制造商
definition_en: A person or company that produces something.
example1_en: The furniture maker carved a beautiful chair from oak.
example1_zh: 这位家具工匠用橡木雕出了一把漂亮的椅子。
example2_en: Car makers are investing in cleaner technologies to meet stricter environmental standards and changing consumer expectations.
example2_zh: 汽车制造商正在投资更清洁的技术，以满足更严格的环保标准和不断变化的消费者期望。
collocations: furniture maker｜家具制造商 ; car maker｜汽车制造商 ; decision maker｜决策者
tip_zh: 常与产品名搭配；决策者用decision maker。

meanings_zh: n. 解决办法；解答 | n. 溶液
definition_en: a way to solve a problem or answer a question | a liquid containing a substance dissolved in it
example1_en: Adding another shelf was a simple solution to the clutter.
example1_zh: 再加一个架子是解决杂乱问题的简单办法。
example2_en: Investment in renewable energy offers a long-term solution to the environmental problems caused by fossil fuels.
example2_zh: 投资可再生能源为化石燃料造成的环境问题提供了长期解决方案。
collocations: a solution to a problem｜问题的解决办法 ; find a solution｜找到解决办法 ; a practical solution｜切实可行的办法 ; a salt solution｜盐溶液
tip_zh: 表示“……的解决办法”用solution to，不用solution of。

meanings_zh: adv. 因此；所以
definition_en: as a result of what has just been stated
example1_en: The shop was closed; therefore, we went home empty-handed.
example1_zh: 商店关门了，因此我们空手回了家。
example2_en: Public parks encourage physical activity and social interaction; therefore, cities should invest in maintaining accessible green spaces.
example2_zh: 公共公园有助于促进体育活动和社交互动，因此城市应投入资金维护方便使用的绿地。
collocations: therefore conclude｜因此得出结论 ; therefore necessary｜因此有必要 ; and therefore｜因而
tip_zh: 是副词，不能仅用逗号连接两个完整句子。

meanings_zh: n. 惯例；日常安排 | adj. 例行的；常规的 | n. 一套表演动作
definition_en: A regular way of doing things in a particular order. | Done regularly as part of the usual process. | A planned sequence of movements in a performance.
example1_en: A short walk is part of my morning routine.
example1_zh: 短距离散步是我每天早晨的固定安排之一。
example2_en: Maintaining a regular sleep routine can improve concentration and help students cope with academic pressure.
example2_zh: 保持规律的睡眠作息能提高注意力，帮助学生应对学业压力。
collocations: daily routine｜日常安排 ; routine check｜例行检查 ; exercise routine｜一套锻炼动作 ; establish a routine｜建立固定规律
tip_zh: 名词指固定安排；形容词指按惯例进行的。

meanings_zh: v. 声称；宣称 | v. 索取；认领 | n. 说法；索赔要求
definition_en: to say something is true, often without providing proof | to ask for or take something you believe is yours | a statement of truth or a request for something owed
example1_en: He claims he can fix my bike by lunchtime.
example1_zh: 他声称能在午饭前修好我的自行车。
example2_en: Some researchers claim that access to green spaces can improve mental health and strengthen community relationships.
example2_zh: 一些研究人员认为，能够使用绿地有助于改善心理健康并加强社区联系。
collocations: claim that｜声称…… ; claim responsibility for｜宣称对……负责 ; claim compensation｜索赔 ; make a claim｜提出说法或索赔要求
tip_zh: claim强调某人的说法，不代表已得到证实。

meanings_zh: n. 自信；信心 | n. 信任；信赖
definition_en: Belief in your abilities or in a successful outcome. | Trust that someone or something is reliable.
example1_en: Practising with friends gave me confidence before the interview.
example1_zh: 和朋友一起练习让我在面试前有了信心。
example2_en: Supportive feedback can build students' confidence and encourage them to participate more actively in classroom discussions.
example2_zh: 鼓励性的反馈可以增强学生的自信，促使他们更积极地参与课堂讨论。
collocations: build confidence｜建立信心 ; confidence in someone｜对某人的信任 ; lack confidence｜缺乏信心 ; in confidence｜私下保密地
tip_zh: 对某人或某事有信心用confidence in。

meanings_zh: n. 志愿者；义工 | v. 自愿做；主动提供
definition_en: someone who freely offers to help, usually without payment | to freely offer to do something or give information
example1_en: A volunteer helped us carry the boxes upstairs.
example1_zh: 一位志愿者帮我们把箱子搬上了楼。
example2_en: Universities can encourage students to volunteer in their communities by offering flexible schedules and practical support.
example2_zh: 大学可以通过提供灵活的时间安排和实际支持，鼓励学生参与社区志愿服务。
collocations: volunteer work｜志愿工作 ; volunteer to help｜主动提出帮忙 ; volunteer for a charity｜为慈善机构做义工 ; recruit volunteers｜招募志愿者
tip_zh: 自愿做某事用volunteer to do；voluntary是常用形容词。

meanings_zh: n. 开关 | v. 转换；改变 | n. 转换；改变
definition_en: A device used to turn equipment on or off. | To change from one thing to another. | A change from one thing to another.
example1_en: The light switch is just behind the kitchen door.
example1_zh: 电灯开关就在厨房门后。
example2_en: Governments can encourage households to switch to renewable energy by offering financial support.
example2_zh: 政府可以提供经济支持，鼓励家庭改用可再生能源。
collocations: light switch｜电灯开关 ; switch off｜关闭 ; switch to｜改用；转向 ; make the switch｜作出转换
tip_zh: switch on/off表示开关设备；switch to表示改用。

meanings_zh: n. 大块；块状物 | v. 阻挡；堵塞 | n. 街区；大楼
definition_en: A solid piece of material with fairly flat sides. | To stop movement or prevent something from happening. | An area between streets, or a large building.
example1_en: The sculptor carved a bird from a block of wood.
example1_zh: 雕刻家用一块木头雕出了一只鸟。
example2_en: Poorly parked vehicles can block access to public buildings, creating difficulties for wheelchair users.
example2_zh: 停放不当的车辆可能堵住公共建筑的入口，给轮椅使用者带来困难。
collocations: a block of flats｜一栋公寓楼 ; block the entrance｜堵住入口 ; a block of ice｜一大块冰 ; city block｜城市街区
tip_zh: a block of flats指公寓楼，是英式常用表达。

meanings_zh: adj. 轻微的；不严重的 | adj. 温和的；不寒冷的 | adj. 味淡的；不辣的
definition_en: Not severe or strong in effect | Pleasantly warm rather than cold | Not strong or spicy in flavour
example1_en: I have a mild headache, so I'll rest briefly.
example1_zh: 我有点头痛，所以要稍微休息一下。
example2_en: Even mild air pollution can affect vulnerable groups, making regular monitoring essential in densely populated cities.
example2_zh: 即使轻度空气污染也会影响易受伤害的群体，因此人口密集的城市必须定期监测空气质量。
collocations: mild symptoms｜轻微症状 ; mild weather｜温和的天气 ; mild flavour｜清淡的味道 ; mild headache｜轻微头痛
tip_zh: mild 可形容症状、天气和味道，不等于“无害”。

meanings_zh: n. 廉价旅舍；青年旅舍 | n. 临时收容所
definition_en: An inexpensive place to stay, often with shared rooms. | A place providing temporary accommodation for people needing support.
example1_en: We shared a room with other travellers at the hostel.
example1_zh: 我们在旅舍和其他旅行者合住一个房间。
example2_en: Youth hostels make international travel more affordable for students while encouraging interaction between people from different backgrounds.
example2_zh: 青年旅舍让学生更能负担国际旅行，同时促进不同背景的人之间的交流。
collocations: youth hostel｜青年旅舍 ; stay in a hostel｜住旅舍 ; hostel accommodation｜旅舍住宿
tip_zh: hostel常有多人间，hotel通常提供独立客房。

meanings_zh: n. 英寸 | v. 缓慢移动
definition_en: a unit of length equal to 2.54 centimetres | to move very slowly over a short distance
example1_en: The shelf is an inch wider than the cupboard.
example1_zh: 这个架子比橱柜宽一英寸。
example2_en: During rush hour, buses inch through crowded streets, making public transport less attractive to commuters.
example2_zh: 高峰时段，公交车在拥挤的街道上缓慢行驶，降低了公共交通对通勤者的吸引力。
collocations: an inch thick｜一英寸厚 ; inch forward｜缓慢向前移动 ; inch by inch｜一点一点地
tip_zh: 英寸符号为″；作动词表示一点点移动。

meanings_zh: n. 姑嫂；妯娌；妻子的姐妹
definition_en: your spouse's sister, or your sibling's or spouse's sibling's wife
example1_en: My sister-in-law brought homemade soup when I was ill.
example1_zh: 我生病时，嫂子送来了她自己做的汤。
example2_en: Sharing childcare with a sister-in-law can help working parents balance professional responsibilities and family life.
example2_zh: 与姑嫂分担育儿工作，可以帮助在职父母平衡工作责任与家庭生活。
collocations: future sister-in-law｜未来的嫂子或弟媳 ; my sister-in-law's family｜我姑嫂的家人
tip_zh: 指姻亲姐妹，不是继姐妹；复数sisters-in-law。

meanings_zh: n. 绳；绳索 | v. 用绳捆绑
definition_en: a thick, strong cord made from twisted fibres | to tie or secure something with rope
example1_en: We tied the boat to a post with rope.
example1_zh: 我们用绳子把船系在一根柱子上。
example2_en: Climbers should inspect their ropes regularly because damaged equipment can put the entire group at risk.
example2_zh: 登山者应定期检查绳索，因为损坏的装备可能危及整个团队。
collocations: a length of rope｜一段绳子 ; climbing rope｜攀登绳 ; skip rope｜跳绳 ; rope off an area｜用绳围起一片区域
tip_zh: 材料泛指用rope；一根绳可说a rope。

meanings_zh: v. 倒；灌；倾注 | v. 下倾盆大雨 | v. 涌入；涌出
definition_en: To make liquid flow from a container. | To rain very heavily. | To move or arrive continuously in large quantities.
example1_en: She poured warm milk into a large blue mug.
example1_zh: 她把温牛奶倒进一个蓝色的大杯子里。
example2_en: When factories pour untreated waste into rivers, they threaten aquatic ecosystems and nearby communities' drinking water.
example2_zh: 工厂将未经处理的废弃物排入河流时，会威胁水生生态系统及附近社区的饮用水安全。
collocations: pour into｜倒入；涌入 ; pour out｜倒出；涌出 ; pour with rain｜下倾盆大雨 ; pour money into｜向……投入大量资金
tip_zh: 倒入用pour into；倒出用pour out of。

meanings_zh: adj. 极棒的；极好的 | adj. 令人惊叹的；令人敬畏的
definition_en: Extremely good or enjoyable. | Causing great admiration, wonder, or sometimes fear.
example1_en: The mountain view from our tent was absolutely awesome.
example1_zh: 从我们的帐篷望出去，山景简直棒极了。
example2_en: The awesome power of volcanic eruptions highlights the importance of effective monitoring systems in nearby communities.
example2_zh: 火山喷发令人敬畏的威力凸显了周边社区建立有效监测系统的重要性。
collocations: an awesome experience｜极棒的体验 ; an awesome view｜绝美景色 ; awesome power｜令人敬畏的力量
tip_zh: 表示“超棒”时较口语；正式写作宜选更具体的词。

meanings_zh: adj. 滑稽的；喜剧的 | n. 漫画书；连环漫画 | n. 喜剧演员
definition_en: funny or connected with comedy | a publication telling stories through sequences of pictures | a performer who entertains people by making them laugh
example1_en: His comic dance had everyone laughing at the party.
example1_zh: 他那滑稽的舞蹈逗得聚会上的每个人都笑了。
example2_en: Comic characters can make educational programmes more engaging and help children remember important information.
example2_zh: 滑稽的角色可以让教育节目更有吸引力，帮助儿童记住重要信息。
collocations: comic timing｜喜剧节奏感 ; comic strip｜连环漫画 ; comic book｜漫画书 ; comic effect｜喜剧效果
tip_zh: comic可指喜剧相关；comical侧重滑稽可笑。

meanings_zh: n. 内容；含量 | adj. 满意的；知足的 | v. 使满足；使满意
definition_en: Information in something, or the amount of a substance it contains | Happy with what you have or with your situation | To make someone satisfied with what is available
example1_en: The content of this podcast always makes me laugh.
example1_zh: 这个播客的内容总能让我笑起来。
example2_en: Schools should teach students to evaluate online content critically rather than accepting every claim as reliable information.
example2_zh: 学校应教学生批判性地评估网络内容，而不是把每一种说法都当作可靠信息。
collocations: online content｜网络内容 ; sugar content｜含糖量 ; content with｜对……满意 ; content yourself with｜使自己满足于
tip_zh: 名词重音在前，形容词和动词在后；目录用contents。

meanings_zh: num. 十二个；一打 | n. 许多；几十个
definition_en: a group of twelve | a large unspecified quantity, used in the plural
example1_en: Please buy a dozen eggs on your way home.
example1_zh: 请在回家的路上买十二个鸡蛋。
example2_en: Dozens of community gardens have opened across the city, giving residents more opportunities to grow food.
example2_zh: 全市已开设数十个社区菜园，让居民有更多机会种植食物。
collocations: a dozen eggs｜一打鸡蛋 ; half a dozen｜半打；六个 ; dozens of people｜几十个人
tip_zh: two dozen不加s；dozens of表示许多。

meanings_zh: n. 发展；发育 | n. 开发；研制 | n. 新进展；新情况
definition_en: the process of growing, changing, or becoming more advanced | the process of creating or improving products, land, or services | a new event or change in a situation
example1_en: Regular play supports a young child's development in many ways.
example1_zh: 经常玩耍能从多方面促进幼儿的成长。
example2_en: Investment in public transport can support economic development while reducing traffic congestion in growing cities.
example2_zh: 投资公共交通既能支持经济发展，也能缓解扩张中的城市的交通拥堵。
collocations: economic development｜经济发展 ; child development｜儿童发育 ; product development｜产品开发 ; sustainable development｜可持续发展
tip_zh: 泛指发展通常不可数；表示新进展时可数。

meanings_zh: adv. 目前；当前
definition_en: at the present time
example1_en: Our kitchen is currently full of boxes from the move.
example1_zh: 我们的厨房目前堆满了搬家用的箱子。
example2_en: Many cities are currently investing in cycling infrastructure to reduce traffic congestion and improve urban air quality.
example2_zh: 许多城市目前正在投资建设自行车基础设施，以缓解交通拥堵并改善城市空气质量。
collocations: currently available｜目前可获得的 ; currently working｜目前正在工作 ; currently under construction｜目前正在建设中
tip_zh: 表示“目前”，常放在实义动词前、be动词后。

meanings_zh: adj. 极冷的；冰冻的 | n. 冰点
definition_en: Extremely cold, or cold enough for water to become ice. | The temperature at which water turns into ice.
example1_en: My hands were freezing after waiting outside for the bus.
example1_zh: 在外面等公交车后，我的双手冰冷。
example2_en: Freezing temperatures can damage water pipes and disrupt essential services, particularly in areas with ageing infrastructure.
example2_zh: 冰冻天气可能损坏水管并扰乱基本服务，尤其是在基础设施老化的地区。
collocations: freezing cold｜冰冷的 ; freezing temperatures｜冰点及以下的气温 ; below freezing｜冰点以下 ; freezing point｜冰点
tip_zh: I'm freezing表示我冷极了，不一定真的结冰。

meanings_zh: n. 身体健康；体能 | n. 适合；胜任
definition_en: The condition of being physically healthy and strong. | The quality of being suitable for a task or purpose.
example1_en: Swimming every morning has really improved my fitness.
example1_zh: 每天早晨游泳确实提高了我的体能。
example2_en: Schools can improve children's fitness by providing regular opportunities for enjoyable physical activity throughout the week.
example2_zh: 学校可以在一周内定期提供有趣的体育活动机会，以增强儿童体能。
collocations: physical fitness｜身体素质 ; fitness level｜体能水平 ; fitness for work｜工作胜任能力 ; fitness centre｜健身中心
tip_zh: 不可数名词；fitness for表示对某事的适合程度。

meanings_zh: n. 总结；概要 | adj. 概括的；简要的
definition_en: a short account giving the main points of something | presenting only the main facts or points
example1_en: Could you give me a quick summary of the meeting?
example1_zh: 你能简要说说这次会议的内容吗？
example2_en: A clear summary at the beginning of a report helps readers understand its main findings quickly.
example2_zh: 报告开头清晰的概要有助于读者迅速了解主要研究结果。
collocations: a brief summary｜简短的概要 ; a summary of｜……的概要 ; in summary｜总而言之 ; an executive summary｜执行摘要
tip_zh: a summary of后接概括对象；in summary用于总结。

meanings_zh: n. 雕像；塑像
definition_en: A sculpture representing a person or animal.
example1_en: A bronze statue of a horse stands beside the fountain.
example1_zh: 喷泉旁矗立着一座马的铜像。
example2_en: Public statues can preserve local history, but communities should discuss which figures deserve such recognition.
example2_zh: 公共雕像可以保存地方历史，但社区应讨论哪些人物值得获得这样的认可。
collocations: a bronze statue｜铜像 ; a marble statue｜大理石雕像 ; erect a statue｜竖立雕像 ; unveil a statue｜为雕像揭幕
tip_zh: statue是雕像；status是地位，注意拼写区别。

meanings_zh: adj. 政治的；政党的
definition_en: relating to government, public power, or political parties
example1_en: We often discuss political issues around the dinner table.
example1_zh: 我们经常在餐桌上讨论政治问题。
example2_en: Political stability can encourage long-term investment and help governments maintain essential public services.
example2_zh: 政治稳定能够鼓励长期投资，并帮助政府维持必要的公共服务。
collocations: political party｜政党 ; political stability｜政治稳定 ; political debate｜政治辩论 ; political system｜政治制度
tip_zh: political是形容词；politics指政治，politician指政治家。

meanings_zh: n. 卷心菜；甘蓝
definition_en: a vegetable with large leaves forming a firm round head
example1_en: She sliced the cabbage thinly and added it to soup.
example1_zh: 她把卷心菜切成细丝，放进汤里。
example2_en: Locally grown vegetables such as cabbage can support healthier diets while reducing the environmental impact of food transport.
example2_zh: 卷心菜等本地种植的蔬菜有助于改善饮食健康，同时减少食品运输对环境的影响。
collocations: red cabbage｜紫甘蓝 ; shredded cabbage｜卷心菜丝 ; a head of cabbage｜一颗卷心菜
tip_zh: 整颗可数：a cabbage；作为食材通常不可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 价格低廉的
definition_en: Not costing much money.
example1_en: We found an inexpensive café near the train station.
example1_zh: 我们在火车站附近找到了一家价格实惠的咖啡馆。
example2_en: Cycling offers an inexpensive alternative to driving and can help reduce traffic congestion in growing cities.
example2_zh: 骑自行车是驾车之外一种经济实惠的选择，也有助于缓解发展中城市的交通拥堵。
collocations: inexpensive alternative｜廉价替代选择 ; relatively inexpensive｜相对便宜的 ; inexpensive accommodation｜价格低廉的住宿
tip_zh: 比cheap更中性，通常不暗示质量差。

meanings_zh: n. 小地毯 | n. 厚毯；盖毯
definition_en: a movable covering for part of a floor | a thick blanket used for warmth
example1_en: The cat curled up on the rug beside the sofa.
example1_zh: 猫蜷卧在沙发旁的小地毯上。
example2_en: Placing a rug on a hard floor can reduce noise and make shared housing more comfortable.
example2_zh: 在硬地板上铺一块小地毯可以降低噪声，让合住空间更舒适。
collocations: a wool rug｜羊毛小地毯 ; a woven rug｜编织地毯 ; a hearth rug｜壁炉前的小地毯
tip_zh: rug通常只覆盖部分地面；carpet可铺满整个房间。

meanings_zh: n. 代理人；代理商 | n. 特工 | n. 作用剂；促成因素
definition_en: A person or business acting on behalf of others | Someone secretly gathering information for a government or organisation | A substance or force that produces a particular effect
example1_en: The travel agent found us a cheaper flight home.
example1_zh: 旅行代理人为我们找到了更便宜的回程航班。
example2_en: Local community groups can act as agents of change by encouraging residents to adopt more sustainable habits.
example2_zh: 当地社区团体可以鼓励居民养成更可持续的生活习惯，从而推动变革。
collocations: travel agent｜旅行代理人 ; estate agent｜房地产经纪人 ; cleaning agent｜清洁剂 ; an agent of change｜变革推动者
tip_zh: agent不只指特工；cleaning agent中的agent指剂。

meanings_zh: n. 港口；港口城市 | n. 计算机端口；接口 | n. 船或飞机的左舷
definition_en: A place where ships load, unload, or shelter. | A physical connection point or virtual channel for computer communication. | The left side of a ship or aircraft, facing forward.
example1_en: We watched fishing boats returning to the port.
example1_zh: 我们看着渔船返回港口。
example2_en: Expanding the port could increase international trade, but it may also damage nearby marine habitats.
example2_zh: 扩建港口可能促进国际贸易，但也可能破坏附近的海洋生境。
collocations: a busy port｜繁忙的港口 ; a port city｜港口城市 ; a USB port｜USB接口 ; the port side｜左舷
tip_zh: port指左舷时，反义词是starboard（右舷）。

meanings_zh: n. 工作场所
definition_en: A place where people do their jobs.
example1_en: Our workplace has a quiet room for lunch breaks.
example1_zh: 我们的工作场所有一间安静的房间，供午休使用。
example2_en: Creating an inclusive workplace helps employees feel valued and encourages cooperation among people from different backgrounds.
example2_zh: 营造包容的工作环境有助于员工感到受重视，并促进不同背景的人之间的合作。
collocations: workplace safety｜工作场所安全 ; in the workplace｜在工作场所 ; workplace culture｜职场文化 ; workplace training｜在岗培训
tip_zh: 泛指办公室、工厂等工作场所，不等于单指办公室。

meanings_zh: adj. 聪明的；理解力强的 | adj. 智能的
definition_en: Able to learn, understand, and think well. | Able to process information and respond automatically in useful ways.
example1_en: Our intelligent puppy quickly learned how to open doors.
example1_zh: 我们那只聪明的小狗很快就学会了开门。
example2_en: Intelligent transport systems can reduce congestion by adjusting traffic signals in response to changing road conditions.
example2_zh: 智能交通系统可以根据道路状况的变化调整交通信号，从而缓解拥堵。
collocations: highly intelligent｜非常聪明的 ; intelligent systems｜智能系统 ; intelligent decision｜明智的决定
tip_zh: intelligent指聪明的；intelligible指可理解的。

meanings_zh: n. 就业；受雇；工作 | n. 使用；运用
definition_en: paid work or the state of having a paid job | the use of something for a particular purpose
example1_en: She found employment at a bakery near her home.
example1_zh: 她在家附近的一家面包店找到了工作。
example2_en: Investment in renewable energy can create employment opportunities while helping countries meet their climate targets.
example2_zh: 投资可再生能源可以创造就业机会，同时帮助各国实现气候目标。
collocations: employment opportunities｜就业机会 ; full-time employment｜全职工作 ; seek employment｜求职 ; employment rate｜就业率
tip_zh: 通常不可数；一份工作用a job，不用an employment。

meanings_zh: n. 赤道
definition_en: An imaginary line around Earth's middle, equally distant from both poles.
example1_en: Our guide explained why it stays warm near the equator.
example1_zh: 导游解释了为什么赤道附近一直很暖和。
example2_en: Regions near the equator receive intense sunlight throughout the year, contributing to consistently high temperatures.
example2_zh: 赤道附近的地区全年受到强烈的阳光照射，因此气温持续偏高。
collocations: near the equator｜在赤道附近 ; cross the equator｜穿越赤道 ; north of the equator｜赤道以北
tip_zh: 赤道前通常加the；形容词是equatorial。

meanings_zh: n. 防晒霜
definition_en: A cream that protects skin from the sun's harmful rays.
example1_en: I packed suncream and a hat for our afternoon walk.
example1_zh: 我为下午的散步带好了防晒霜和帽子。
example2_en: Schools can encourage children to use suncream and seek shade during outdoor activities in sunny weather.
example2_zh: 学校可以鼓励孩子们在晴天参加户外活动时涂防晒霜并注意遮阴。
collocations: put on suncream｜涂防晒霜 ; a tube of suncream｜一管防晒霜 ; high-factor suncream｜高防晒系数的防晒霜
tip_zh: 主要用于英式英语，也常写作sun cream。

meanings_zh: adj. 已签字的；有签名的 | v. 签字（过去式、过去分词）
definition_en: bearing someone's signature as proof of agreement or authorship | wrote a signature to identify oneself or show agreement
example1_en: I put the signed form in a blue envelope.
example1_zh: 我把签好字的表格放进了一个蓝色信封。
example2_en: A signed agreement helps protect both tenants and landlords by clearly defining their rights and responsibilities.
example2_zh: 签署的协议通过明确租客和房东的权利与责任，有助于保护双方。
collocations: a signed contract｜已签署的合同 ; a signed copy｜签名本 ; a signed agreement｜已签署的协议
tip_zh: signed可作形容词；“由某人签署”用signed by。

meanings_zh: adj. 防水的；不透水的 | v. 使防水
definition_en: not allowing water to pass through | to treat something so water cannot pass through it
example1_en: My waterproof jacket kept me dry during the storm.
example1_zh: 暴风雨中，我的防水夹克让我没有淋湿。
example2_en: Outdoor workers need waterproof clothing to remain comfortable and protected when carrying out tasks in wet weather.
example2_zh: 户外工作者需要防水衣物，以便在潮湿天气作业时保持舒适并得到保护。
collocations: a waterproof jacket｜防水夹克 ; waterproof boots｜防水靴 ; waterproof material｜防水材料 ; waterproof a roof｜给屋顶做防水
tip_zh: water-resistant仅指有一定抗水能力，防水程度较弱。

meanings_zh: adj. 有残疾的
definition_en: Having a condition that limits activities or participation in society.
example1_en: The pool has a lift for disabled swimmers.
example1_zh: 游泳池设有供残障游泳者使用的升降设备。
example2_en: Universities should provide accessible facilities and appropriate support to ensure that disabled students can participate fully in campus life.
example2_zh: 大学应提供无障碍设施和适当支持，确保残障学生能够充分参与校园生活。
collocations: disabled people｜残障人士 ; disabled access｜无障碍通行设施 ; disabled parking space｜残障人士专用停车位
tip_zh: 可说disabled people或people with disabilities，尊重本人偏好。

meanings_zh: v. 供应；提供 | n. 供应；供应量 | n. 必需品；物资
definition_en: to provide something that someone needs | the provision or available amount of something needed | essential items kept or provided for use
example1_en: A nearby farm supplies fresh eggs to our shop.
example1_zh: 附近一家农场给我们的商店供应新鲜鸡蛋。
example2_en: Cities must secure a reliable water supply as population growth and climate change place increasing pressure on resources.
example2_zh: 随着人口增长和气候变化给资源带来越来越大的压力，城市必须确保可靠的供水。
collocations: supply someone with something｜向某人供应某物 ; water supply｜供水 ; supply and demand｜供求 ; medical supplies｜医疗物资
tip_zh: supply A with B＝supply B to A；物资常用supplies。

meanings_zh: adj. 全职的；全日制的 | adv. 全职地；全日制地
definition_en: involving all the usual working or studying hours | for all the usual working or studying hours
example1_en: My sister starts her first full-time job next week.
example1_zh: 我姐姐下周开始做她的第一份全职工作。
example2_en: Affordable childcare enables more parents to return to full-time employment without placing excessive pressure on family finances.
example2_zh: 负担得起的托育服务使更多家长能够重返全职工作，同时不会给家庭经济带来过大压力。
collocations: full-time employment｜全职就业 ; a full-time student｜全日制学生 ; work full-time｜全职工作
tip_zh: 修饰名词时保留连字符，如a full-time job。

meanings_zh: v. 乘；做乘法 | v. 大量增加；繁殖
definition_en: to calculate a total by adding equal amounts repeatedly | to increase greatly in quantity, or produce more living organisms
example1_en: Multiply the price by three to find the total.
example1_zh: 把价格乘以三，就能算出总价。
example2_en: Bacteria can multiply rapidly in warm conditions, making proper food storage essential for public health.
example2_zh: 细菌在温暖环境中能迅速繁殖，因此妥善储存食物对公共健康至关重要。
collocations: multiply by｜乘以 ; multiply rapidly｜迅速增加或繁殖 ; multiply tenfold｜增加到十倍
tip_zh: A乘以B说multiply A by B；过去式为multiplied。

meanings_zh: n. 请求；要求 | v. 请求；要求
definition_en: an act of asking politely or formally for something | to ask politely or formally for something
example1_en: The hotel agreed to my request for extra pillows.
example1_zh: 酒店答应了我多要几个枕头的请求。
example2_en: Residents can request detailed information about proposed developments before local authorities make their final planning decisions.
example2_zh: 在地方政府作出最终规划决定之前，居民可以要求获取拟建项目的详细信息。
collocations: make a request｜提出请求 ; a request for information｜索取信息的请求 ; on request｜经要求即可提供 ; request permission｜请求许可
tip_zh: 名词接for；动词直接接宾语：request information。

meanings_zh: v. 回收利用
definition_en: to process used materials so they can be used again
example1_en: We recycle glass bottles at the centre near our house.
example1_zh: 我们把玻璃瓶送到家附近的回收中心回收。
example2_en: Cities can reduce landfill waste by making it easier for residents to recycle everyday packaging.
example2_zh: 城市可以通过方便居民回收日常包装来减少填埋垃圾。
collocations: recycle household waste｜回收生活垃圾 ; recycled paper｜再生纸 ; recycle plastic bottles｜回收塑料瓶
tip_zh: recycle指回收加工再利用，reuse侧重直接再次使用。

meanings_zh: n. 会议；研讨会
definition_en: a formal meeting to discuss a particular subject
example1_en: Our hotel is hosting a conference for local teachers.
example1_zh: 我们酒店正在举办一场面向当地教师的研讨会。
example2_en: At the international conference, researchers discussed how cities could reduce air pollution without limiting economic growth.
example2_zh: 在国际会议上，研究人员讨论了城市如何在不限制经济增长的情况下减少空气污染。
collocations: attend a conference｜参加会议 ; hold a conference｜举行会议 ; press conference｜新闻发布会 ; conference venue｜会议场地
tip_zh: 指正式会议；参加会议用attend a conference。

meanings_zh: v. 烤；烘烤 | adj. 烤制的 | n. 烤肉；烤肉餐
definition_en: To cook food using dry heat, especially in an oven. | Cooked using dry heat in an oven or over a fire. | A large piece of roasted meat, or a meal containing it.
example1_en: We usually roast potatoes with garlic and fresh herbs.
example1_zh: 我们通常用大蒜和新鲜香草烤土豆。
example2_en: Families can roast seasonal vegetables at home to prepare nutritious meals without relying on highly processed foods.
example2_zh: 家庭可以在家烤时令蔬菜，做出营养丰富的饭菜，而不必依赖高度加工的食品。
collocations: roast vegetables｜烤蔬菜 ; roast chicken｜烤鸡 ; a Sunday roast｜周日烤肉餐
tip_zh: roast多用于肉和蔬菜；烤面包、蛋糕通常用bake。

meanings_zh: n. 英雄；受敬佩的人 | n. 男主角；男主人公
definition_en: someone admired for courage, achievements, or good actions | the main male character in a story
example1_en: The firefighter became a local hero after the rescue.
example1_zh: 那次救援后，这位消防员成了当地的英雄。
example2_en: Films often portray the hero as an exceptional individual, although real social progress usually requires collective effort.
example2_zh: 电影常把主人公塑造成非凡的个人，然而真正的社会进步通常需要集体努力。
collocations: national hero｜民族英雄 ; local hero｜当地英雄 ; unsung hero｜无名英雄 ; action hero｜动作片男主角
tip_zh: 复数为heroes；故事中的hero不一定品德高尚。

meanings_zh: v. 切碎；砍；劈 | n. 砍；劈 | n. 带骨肉排
definition_en: To cut with repeated sharp blows using a blade | A sharp downward blow with a blade or hand | A piece of meat cut with a bone attached
example1_en: Please chop the carrots while I heat the soup.
example1_zh: 我来热汤，请你把胡萝卜切碎。
example2_en: When communities chop down trees for fuel, they may unintentionally damage habitats and increase soil erosion.
example2_zh: 当社区居民砍树用作燃料时，他们可能无意中破坏栖息地，加剧水土流失。
collocations: chop vegetables｜切蔬菜 ; chop down trees｜砍倒树木 ; chop wood｜劈柴 ; lamb chop｜羊排
tip_zh: 过去式chopped，进行式chopping，均双写p。

meanings_zh: n. 橄榄；油橄榄树 | adj. 橄榄绿的；浅褐色的
definition_en: A small bitter fruit used for oil, or its tree | Yellowish green in colour, or describing light brown skin
example1_en: She added a few olives to the fresh salad.
example1_zh: 她在新鲜沙拉里加了几颗橄榄。
example2_en: Olive cultivation supports rural livelihoods in dry regions, although prolonged drought can significantly reduce harvests.
example2_zh: 橄榄种植支撑着干旱地区农村居民的生计，但长期干旱会使收成大幅下降。
collocations: olive oil｜橄榄油 ; olive grove｜橄榄树林 ; olive skin｜浅褐色皮肤
tip_zh: olive可指果实、树或颜色；olive oil通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 悲伤；难过
definition_en: The feeling of being unhappy, especially after loss or disappointment.
example1_en: She felt a deep sadness when her friend moved away.
example1_zh: 朋友搬走时，她感到深深的难过。
example2_en: Regular social contact can help reduce feelings of sadness among older people who live alone.
example2_zh: 经常与人交往有助于减轻独居老年人的悲伤情绪。
collocations: deep sadness｜深切的悲伤 ; a sense of sadness｜一种悲伤感 ; overcome with sadness｜悲痛不已
tip_zh: 通常作不可数名词；a sense of sadness指一种悲伤感。

meanings_zh: n. 出租车 | n. 驾驶室
definition_en: A car with a driver whom you pay for transport. | The enclosed part of a vehicle where the driver sits.
example1_en: We shared a cab home after the concert.
example1_zh: 音乐会结束后，我们合乘一辆出租车回家。
example2_en: Affordable night buses could reduce reliance on cabs among workers whose shifts end after midnight.
example2_zh: 价格实惠的夜间公交车可以减少午夜后下班的工人对出租车的依赖。
collocations: hail a cab｜招手叫出租车 ; take a cab｜乘出租车 ; cab fare｜出租车费 ; a truck cab｜卡车驾驶室
tip_zh: 表示出租车时与taxi同义；也可指卡车等的驾驶室。

meanings_zh: n. 章；回 | n. 人生或历史的重要阶段 | n. 组织的地方分会
definition_en: one of the main sections of a book | a distinct period in someone's life or in history | a local branch of a larger organisation
example1_en: I read one chapter before turning off the light.
example1_zh: 我读了一章才关灯。
example2_en: The final chapter examines how public transport investment can reduce inequality in rapidly growing cities.
example2_zh: 最后一章探讨公共交通投资如何减少快速发展城市中的不平等现象。
collocations: the opening chapter｜开篇章节 ; a new chapter｜新的篇章 ; a chapter in history｜历史上的一个阶段 ; a local chapter｜地方分会
tip_zh: 书的“章”用chapter；章内较小部分常用section。

meanings_zh: v. 更新；使掌握最新情况 | n. 最新消息；更新
definition_en: to make something current or give someone the latest information | new information or a change that makes something more current
example1_en: Please update your address before we send the parcel.
example1_zh: 请在我们寄出包裹前更新你的地址。
example2_en: Governments should regularly update environmental regulations to reflect scientific discoveries and respond to emerging risks.
example2_zh: 政府应定期更新环境法规，以反映科学发现并应对新出现的风险。
collocations: update software｜更新软件 ; update someone on something｜告知某人某事的最新情况 ; a software update｜软件更新 ; regular updates｜定期更新
tip_zh: 动词重音在后；名词重音在前，读/ˈʌpdeɪt/。

meanings_zh: v. 集中注意力 | v. 集中；聚集 | n. 浓缩物；浓缩液
definition_en: To give all your attention to a particular task. | To bring things together in one place or direct efforts there. | A substance made stronger by removing water or other material.
example1_en: I cannot concentrate with the television playing so loudly.
example1_zh: 电视声音这么大，我没法集中注意力。
example2_en: Governments should concentrate resources on preventive healthcare to reduce pressure on hospitals in the long term.
example2_zh: 政府应将资源集中于预防性医疗，以长期减轻医院的压力。
collocations: concentrate on a task｜专注于任务 ; concentrate resources on｜将资源集中于 ; fruit juice concentrate｜浓缩果汁
tip_zh: concentrate on后接名词或动名词，表示专注于。

meanings_zh: adj. 非常漂亮的；绚丽的 | adj. 极好的；令人愉快的
definition_en: Extremely beautiful or attractive. | Very pleasant or enjoyable.
example1_en: The garden looks gorgeous in the early morning sunshine.
example1_zh: 花园在清晨的阳光下显得格外美丽。
example2_en: Although coastal destinations offer gorgeous scenery, uncontrolled tourism can damage the natural environments that attract visitors.
example2_zh: 虽然海滨旅游地景色迷人，但不加控制的旅游活动会破坏吸引游客的自然环境。
collocations: gorgeous scenery｜迷人的风景 ; gorgeous weather｜极好的天气 ; look gorgeous｜看起来非常漂亮
tip_zh: 语气比beautiful强，多用于口语中的赞美。

meanings_zh: v. 瞥一眼；匆匆看 | n. 一瞥；匆匆一看
definition_en: To look at someone or something very briefly. | A quick, brief look at someone or something.
example1_en: She glanced out of the window before opening the door.
example1_zh: 她开门前往窗外瞥了一眼。
example2_en: Commuters often glance at their phones while walking, which can reduce their awareness of nearby traffic.
example2_zh: 通勤者常在走路时瞥看手机，这可能降低他们对周围交通状况的警觉性。
collocations: glance at｜瞥一眼 ; take a glance｜看一眼 ; at first glance｜乍一看 ; exchange glances｜交换眼色
tip_zh: glance at是短暂一瞥；stare at是盯着看。

meanings_zh: v. 使尴尬；使窘迫
definition_en: To make someone feel awkward, ashamed, or uncomfortable.
example1_en: Please don't embarrass me by sharing that childhood photo.
example1_zh: 请别把那张童年照片给别人看，让我难为情。
example2_en: Correcting every mistake publicly can embarrass language learners and discourage them from participating in classroom discussions.
example2_zh: 公开纠正每一个错误会让语言学习者感到尴尬，并使他们不愿参与课堂讨论。
collocations: embarrass someone｜使某人尴尬 ; deeply embarrassed｜十分窘迫 ; an embarrassing moment｜尴尬的时刻
tip_zh: 人感到尴尬用embarrassed；事情令人尴尬用embarrassing。

meanings_zh: n. 管；管子 | n. 软管容器 | n. 伦敦地铁
definition_en: a long, hollow object that carries liquids or gases | a soft container squeezed to release paste or cream | the underground railway system in London
example1_en: Water flowed through a clear tube into the tank.
example1_zh: 水通过一根透明管子流进了水箱。
example2_en: Taking the tube instead of driving can help commuters avoid congestion in central London.
example2_zh: 乘地铁而不是开车可以帮助通勤者避开伦敦市中心的交通拥堵。
collocations: a tube of toothpaste｜一管牙膏 ; a plastic tube｜一根塑料管 ; take the tube｜乘伦敦地铁
tip_zh: the tube特指伦敦地铁；一管牙膏用a tube of。

meanings_zh: n. 车辆；交通工具 | n. 媒介；表达工具
definition_en: A machine used to transport people or goods. | Something used to communicate ideas or achieve a purpose.
example1_en: We left our vehicle outside the small mountain hotel.
example1_zh: 我们把车停在了山间小旅馆外面。
example2_en: Electric vehicles can reduce urban air pollution, especially when their electricity comes from renewable sources.
example2_zh: 电动车可以减少城市空气污染，尤其是在使用可再生能源发电时。
collocations: electric vehicle｜电动车 ; commercial vehicle｜商用车 ; a vehicle for change｜推动变革的工具
tip_zh: 指交通工具时是可数名词，不仅指汽车。

meanings_zh: adj. 自然环境的；环保的 | adj. 周围环境的
definition_en: relating to nature or efforts to protect it | relating to the surroundings in which people or organisms live
example1_en: Our school organised an environmental project to clean the river.
example1_zh: 我们学校组织了一项清理河流的环保活动。
example2_en: Governments should consider the environmental impact of new roads before approving major construction projects.
example2_zh: 政府在批准大型建设项目之前，应考虑新道路对环境的影响。
collocations: environmental protection｜环境保护 ; environmental impact｜环境影响 ; environmental factors｜环境因素 ; environmental damage｜环境破坏
tip_zh: environmental是形容词，环境本身用environment。

meanings_zh: n. 海星
definition_en: A sea animal with a central body and usually five arms.
example1_en: We spotted an orange starfish in a shallow rock pool.
example1_zh: 我们在一个浅浅的岩石潮池里发现了一只橙色海星。
example2_en: Changes in ocean temperature can affect starfish populations and disrupt the balance of coastal ecosystems.
example2_zh: 海水温度变化会影响海星种群，并扰乱沿海生态系统的平衡。
collocations: a rock pool starfish｜岩石潮池里的海星 ; starfish populations｜海星种群 ; a starfish arm｜海星的腕
tip_zh: 单复数通常同形；海星是无脊椎动物，不是鱼类。

meanings_zh: adj. 难以置信的 | adj. 极好的；极大的
definition_en: So surprising that it is difficult to believe | Extremely good, impressive, or great in amount
example1_en: It seems incredible that this tiny seed becomes a tree.
example1_zh: 这粒小小的种子竟能长成大树，真令人难以置信。
example2_en: Advances in medical technology have brought incredible improvements in the quality of life for many patients.
example2_zh: 医疗技术的进步使许多患者的生活质量得到了惊人的改善。
collocations: an incredible achievement｜惊人的成就 ; an incredible amount｜极大的数量 ; find it incredible｜觉得难以置信
tip_zh: incredible可表难以置信，也可口语赞叹“极好”。

meanings_zh: n. 梯子 | n. 晋升阶梯；等级体系
definition_en: Equipment with steps for climbing up or down | A series of levels through which someone can progress
example1_en: She climbed the ladder to pick apples from the tree.
example1_zh: 她爬上梯子，摘树上的苹果。
example2_en: Access to professional training can help young employees move up the career ladder more quickly.
example2_zh: 获得专业培训的机会可以帮助年轻员工更快地晋升。
collocations: climb a ladder｜爬梯子 ; career ladder｜职业晋升阶梯 ; property ladder｜住房置业阶梯
tip_zh: ladder是可移动的梯子；stairs指建筑内楼梯。

meanings_zh: n. 责任；负责 | n. 职责；应尽的义务
definition_en: The duty to manage something or answer for its results. | A task or duty that you are expected to handle.
example1_en: Feeding the dog is your responsibility this weekend.
example1_zh: 这个周末喂狗是你的责任。
example2_en: Governments and businesses share responsibility for reducing waste, but individuals also have an important role to play.
example2_zh: 政府和企业共同承担减少废物的责任，但个人也发挥着重要作用。
collocations: take responsibility for｜对……负责 ; a sense of responsibility｜责任感 ; accept responsibility｜承担责任 ; share responsibility｜共同承担责任
tip_zh: 泛指责任常不可数；具体职责可数；后常接for。

meanings_zh: n. 电工；电气技师
definition_en: Someone trained to install and repair electrical systems.
example1_en: The electrician fixed the broken light in our kitchen.
example1_zh: 电工修好了我们厨房里坏掉的灯。
example2_en: Training more qualified electricians is essential as households increasingly adopt solar panels and electric vehicle charging equipment.
example2_zh: 随着越来越多家庭安装太阳能板和电动汽车充电设备，培养更多合格电工至关重要。
collocations: qualified electrician｜合格电工 ; apprentice electrician｜电工学徒 ; call an electrician｜请电工
tip_zh: electrician指电工；电气工程师是electrical engineer。

meanings_zh: n. 目的地；终点
definition_en: the place someone or something is travelling to
example1_en: We finally reached our destination just before sunset.
example1_zh: 我们终于在日落前抵达了目的地。
example2_en: Popular tourist destinations must balance economic benefits with the need to protect local communities and natural environments.
example2_zh: 热门旅游目的地必须在经济收益与保护当地社区和自然环境的需要之间取得平衡。
collocations: reach your destination｜抵达目的地 ; tourist destination｜旅游目的地 ; final destination｜最终目的地
tip_zh: reach a destination不加to；arrive at后接目的地。

meanings_zh: adj. 有光泽的；发亮的
definition_en: Having a smooth surface that reflects light.
example1_en: She polished her shoes until they looked shiny.
example1_zh: 她把鞋擦得亮亮的。
example2_en: Shiny packaging may attract consumers, but it often creates waste that is difficult to recycle.
example2_zh: 亮丽的包装可能吸引消费者，但往往会产生难以回收的废弃物。
collocations: shiny shoes｜锃亮的鞋 ; shiny surface｜光亮的表面 ; shiny hair｜有光泽的头发
tip_zh: 指表面反光，不等于物体本身发光。

meanings_zh: adj. 巨大的 | n. 巨人 | n. 大企业；杰出人物
definition_en: Much larger than usual | An imaginary person of enormous size | A very large company or an exceptionally important person
example1_en: A giant pumpkin filled almost the entire garden cart.
example1_zh: 一个巨大的南瓜几乎占满了整辆园艺推车。
example2_en: Technology giants have considerable influence over how people access information and communicate with one another.
example2_zh: 科技巨头对人们获取信息和相互交流的方式有很大影响。
collocations: a giant leap｜巨大的飞跃 ; a giant screen｜巨型屏幕 ; a technology giant｜科技巨头
tip_zh: 作形容词通常放名词前；作名词可指行业巨头。

meanings_zh: n. 单位；单元 | n. 装置；组件 | n. 部门；小组；部队
definition_en: a single part or quantity within a larger whole | a device or separate part of a machine | a group organised for a particular task
example1_en: We finished the first unit before our lunch break.
example1_zh: 我们在午休前学完了第一个单元。
example2_en: Each unit of the course introduces practical skills that students can apply in the workplace.
example2_zh: 这门课程的每个单元都介绍学生可以在工作中运用的实用技能。
collocations: a unit of measurement｜计量单位 ; a family unit｜家庭单位 ; an air-conditioning unit｜空调装置 ; an intensive care unit｜重症监护病房
tip_zh: 表示计量单位时常用a unit of，后接所计量的事物。

meanings_zh: v. 尖叫；尖声喊叫 | n. 尖叫声
definition_en: To give a loud, high cry from strong emotion. | A loud, high cry expressing fear, pain, or excitement.
example1_en: The children screamed with excitement as the ride began.
example1_zh: 游乐设施一启动，孩子们就兴奋地尖叫起来。
example2_en: Residents complain that visitors scream late at night, disturbing sleep and reducing the neighbourhood's quality of life.
example2_zh: 居民抱怨游客深夜尖叫，扰人睡眠，降低了社区的生活质量。
collocations: scream with excitement｜兴奋地尖叫 ; scream for help｜尖声呼救 ; let out a scream｜发出一声尖叫
tip_zh: scream强调声音尖厉；shout只强调喊得响。

meanings_zh: adj. 强有力的；动力强的 | adj. 有权势的；影响力大的
definition_en: Having great physical strength or producing a strong effect. | Able to control people or strongly influence events.
example1_en: The powerful wind blew our garden chairs onto the grass.
example1_zh: 大风把我们的花园椅子吹到了草地上。
example2_en: Powerful companies should take greater responsibility for reducing the environmental damage caused by their operations.
example2_zh: 有影响力的企业应承担更大责任，减少其经营活动造成的环境破坏。
collocations: powerful engine｜动力强劲的发动机 ; powerful influence｜强大的影响力 ; powerful argument｜有说服力的论据
tip_zh: 通常作形容词；副词用powerfully，不用powerful。

meanings_zh: n. 诗歌；诗歌艺术 | n. 诗意；诗一般的美
definition_en: Literature using carefully arranged language, rhythm, and imagery. | Beauty or emotional power resembling that of poems.
example1_en: She reads poetry aloud while her tea cools.
example1_zh: 她一边等茶凉下来，一边朗读诗歌。
example2_en: Studying poetry encourages students to explore complex emotions and appreciate the expressive possibilities of language.
example2_zh: 学习诗歌能鼓励学生探索复杂情感，并欣赏语言丰富的表达潜力。
collocations: write poetry｜写诗 ; poetry collection｜诗集 ; poetry reading｜诗歌朗诵会 ; modern poetry｜现代诗歌
tip_zh: poetry不可数；一首诗用a poem，不用a poetry。

meanings_zh: adj. 愚蠢的；不明智的
definition_en: Showing poor judgement or a lack of good sense.
example1_en: It was foolish to leave my umbrella at home.
example1_zh: 把伞留在家里真是不明智。
example2_en: It would be foolish to expand road networks without considering their long-term effects on air quality.
example2_zh: 不考虑道路扩张对空气质量的长期影响就扩大路网，是不明智的。
collocations: a foolish mistake｜愚蠢的错误 ; feel foolish｜觉得自己很傻 ; foolish to assume｜贸然假定是不明智的
tip_zh: 常用It is foolish to do表示做某事不明智。

meanings_zh: v. 测量；衡量 | n. 措施；办法 | n. 衡量标准
definition_en: Find the size, amount, or degree of something. | An action intended to achieve a particular result. | A way of judging the quality or degree of something.
example1_en: We measured the window before buying new curtains.
example1_zh: 我们买新窗帘前量了窗户的尺寸。
example2_en: Governments should introduce effective measures to reduce air pollution without placing excessive costs on low-income households.
example2_zh: 政府应采取有效措施减少空气污染，同时避免让低收入家庭承担过高费用。
collocations: measure progress｜衡量进展 ; take measures to do something｜采取措施做某事 ; a measure of success｜衡量成功的标准
tip_zh: 采取措施用 take measures；测量某物直接接宾语。

meanings_zh: n. 衣架
definition_en: A shaped frame used to hang clothes.
example1_en: She put her jacket on a wooden hanger.
example1_zh: 她把夹克挂在一个木衣架上。
example2_en: Retailers can reduce plastic waste by collecting used hangers and replacing damaged ones with recyclable alternatives.
example2_zh: 零售商可以回收旧衣架，并用可回收的替代品更换损坏的衣架，从而减少塑料垃圾。
collocations: coat hanger｜衣架 ; wooden hanger｜木衣架 ; wire hanger｜金属丝衣架
tip_zh: hanger是衣架；hangar是飞机库，注意拼写。

meanings_zh: n. 宝石；宝石饰物 | n. 珍贵的人或物
definition_en: A valuable stone, often used in decorative personal objects. | Someone or something especially valuable, beautiful, or admired.
example1_en: A blue jewel sparkled on her silver necklace.
example1_zh: 她银项链上的一颗蓝色宝石闪闪发光。
example2_en: The restored theatre is a cultural jewel that attracts visitors and supports local businesses.
example2_zh: 修复后的剧院是一颗文化明珠，吸引着游客，也带动了当地商业。
collocations: precious jewel｜珍贵宝石 ; a jewel in the crown｜最耀眼的成就或珍宝
tip_zh: jewel可数；jewellery指珠宝总称，不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 图像；影像 | n. 公众形象 | n. 脑海中的形象
definition_en: A picture or visual representation of someone or something. | The impression that people have of a person or organization. | A picture of someone or something formed in your mind.
example1_en: The camera captured a sharp image of the bird.
example1_zh: 相机拍下了那只鸟的清晰影像。
example2_en: Companies increasingly use social media to improve their public image and build stronger relationships with customers.
example2_zh: 企业越来越多地利用社交媒体改善公众形象，并加强与客户的联系。
collocations: digital image｜数字图像 ; public image｜公众形象 ; mental image｜脑海中的形象 ; high-resolution image｜高分辨率图像
tip_zh: 既可指具体图像，也可指个人或机构的公众形象。

meanings_zh: n. 怪物；怪兽 | n. 残忍的人 | adj. 巨大的
definition_en: an imaginary creature that is large, strange, or frightening | a person who behaves in an extremely cruel way | extremely large in size or amount
example1_en: The friendly monster in the cartoon has purple feet.
example1_zh: 动画片里那只友善的怪物长着紫色的脚。
example2_en: Stories about monsters can help children explore their fears within a safe and imaginative setting.
example2_zh: 有关怪物的故事可以帮助儿童在安全且富有想象力的情境中探索自己的恐惧。
collocations: sea monster｜海怪 ; a monster truck｜巨轮卡车 ; a fictional monster｜虚构的怪物
tip_zh: 形容词用法较口语化，置于名词前表示巨大。

meanings_zh: n. 目标；指标 | n. 靶子；攻击对象 | v. 以……为目标；面向
definition_en: A result or level that someone aims to achieve. | A person or thing aimed at or attacked. | To direct actions or attention towards a particular person or group.
example1_en: My savings target is enough for a new bicycle.
example1_zh: 我的储蓄目标是攒够买一辆新自行车的钱。
example2_en: Governments should set realistic targets for reducing emissions and regularly assess progress towards achieving them.
example2_zh: 政府应制定切实可行的减排目标，并定期评估实现目标的进展。
collocations: meet a target｜达到目标 ; set a target｜设定目标 ; target audience｜目标受众 ; target vulnerable groups｜针对弱势群体
tip_zh: 表示达成目标用meet或reach a target。

meanings_zh: adj. 流利的；表达流畅的
definition_en: Able to speak or write a language easily and smoothly.
example1_en: She became fluent in Spanish after living abroad.
example1_zh: 在国外生活后，她能流利地说西班牙语了。
example2_en: Fluent speakers may still make grammatical mistakes, so language assessments should consider both communication skills and accuracy.
example2_zh: 说话流利的人仍可能犯语法错误，因此语言测评应同时考虑沟通能力和准确性。
collocations: fluent in English｜英语流利 ; a fluent speaker｜表达流利的人 ; fluent speech｜流畅的讲话
tip_zh: 说某种语言流利用be fluent in；流利不等于零错误。

meanings_zh: v. 擦；揉；摩擦 | n. 擦；揉
definition_en: Move against a surface with pressure, often repeatedly. | An act of pressing and moving against a surface.
example1_en: She rubbed her cold hands together beside the heater.
example1_zh: 她在暖气旁搓着冰冷的双手。
example2_en: Protective gloves prevent workers from rubbing their skin against rough surfaces when handling heavy materials.
example2_zh: 搬运重物时，防护手套可以避免工人的皮肤与粗糙表面摩擦。
collocations: rub your eyes｜揉眼睛 ; rub your hands together｜搓手 ; rub against｜与……摩擦 ; give something a rub｜擦一擦某物
tip_zh: 过去式rubbed、现在分词rubbing均双写b。

meanings_zh: n. 灯塔
definition_en: A coastal tower with a powerful light that guides ships.
example1_en: The lighthouse beam swept across the dark sea.
example1_zh: 灯塔的光束扫过漆黑的海面。
example2_en: Although modern navigation relies on satellites, lighthouses remain valuable landmarks along dangerous stretches of coastline.
example2_zh: 尽管现代导航依赖卫星，灯塔在危险海岸地段仍是重要的地标。
collocations: lighthouse keeper｜灯塔看守人 ; lighthouse beam｜灯塔光束 ; historic lighthouse｜历史悠久的灯塔
tip_zh: 可数名词，复数直接加s：lighthouses。

meanings_zh: n. 回答；答复 | n. 反应；响应
definition_en: Something said or written as an answer. | An action or change caused by an event or situation.
example1_en: I sent an invitation but haven't received a response yet.
example1_zh: 我发出了邀请，但还没有收到答复。
example2_en: A rapid response to disease outbreaks can protect vulnerable communities and reduce pressure on local hospitals.
example2_zh: 迅速应对疾病暴发能够保护脆弱群体，并减轻当地医院的压力。
collocations: a response to｜对……的回应 ; in response to｜作为对……的回应 ; a rapid response｜迅速反应 ; receive a response｜收到答复
tip_zh: response后通常接to，不接of。

meanings_zh: adj. 太阳的 | adj. 利用太阳能的
definition_en: Relating to the sun. | Using energy from sunlight to produce heat or electricity.
example1_en: We wore special protective glasses to watch the solar eclipse.
example1_zh: 我们戴着专用防护眼镜观看日食。
example2_en: Investment in solar energy can reduce dependence on fossil fuels and create jobs in rural communities.
example2_zh: 投资太阳能可以减少对化石燃料的依赖，并为农村社区创造就业机会。
collocations: solar energy｜太阳能 ; solar panels｜太阳能板 ; the solar system｜太阳系 ; a solar eclipse｜日食
tip_zh: solar是形容词，常用于太阳或太阳能相关搭配。

meanings_zh: n. 使用机会；进入权 | n. 入口；通道 | v. 访问；获取；进入
definition_en: The opportunity or right to enter or use something. | A way of reaching or entering a place. | Reach, enter, or obtain something, especially information on a computer.
example1_en: Guests have access to the pool until sunset.
example1_zh: 客人在日落前都可以使用游泳池。
example2_en: Affordable internet access enables rural students to benefit from a wider range of educational resources.
example2_zh: 价格可负担的互联网接入能让农村学生受益于更丰富的教育资源。
collocations: access to education｜受教育的机会 ; internet access｜互联网接入 ; gain access to｜获得使用或进入的机会 ; access information｜获取信息
tip_zh: 名词后接to；动词直接接宾语，不加to。

meanings_zh: prep. 与……不同；不像 | prep. 非……一贯的表现
definition_en: different from someone or something | not typical of someone's usual behaviour
example1_en: Unlike her brother, Lina enjoys getting up early.
example1_zh: 莉娜和她哥哥不同，她喜欢早起。
example2_en: Unlike private cars, public transport can move large groups of people while using relatively little road space.
example2_zh: 与私家车不同，公共交通能在占用较少道路空间的同时运送大量乘客。
collocations: unlike most people｜与大多数人不同 ; quite unlike｜与……很不一样 ; unlike anything else｜与其他任何事物都不同 ; it's unlike someone to｜做某事不像某人的一贯作风
tip_zh: unlike后接名词或代词；不要直接接完整句子。

meanings_zh: n. 争论；争吵 | n. 论点；论据
definition_en: An angry disagreement between people. | A reason or set of reasons supporting an opinion.
example1_en: We had an argument about whose turn it was.
example1_zh: 我们为该轮到谁而争吵了起来。
example2_en: The strongest argument for public transport investment is its potential to reduce urban air pollution.
example2_zh: 支持投资公共交通最有力的论据是，它有望减少城市空气污染。
collocations: have an argument｜发生争吵 ; a convincing argument｜有说服力的论据 ; an argument for｜支持……的论据 ; an argument against｜反对……的论据
tip_zh: 争吵常接with或about；支持某观点用argument for。

meanings_zh: adj. 羞愧的；内疚的 | adj. 因难堪而不愿意的
definition_en: feeling guilty or embarrassed about something wrong or disappointing | unwilling to do something because it feels embarrassing
example1_en: I felt ashamed after laughing at my friend's mistake.
example1_zh: 嘲笑朋友的错误后，我感到很羞愧。
example2_en: Students should never feel ashamed to ask for help when they struggle with difficult subjects.
example2_zh: 学生在学习较难的科目遇到困难时，绝不应因求助而感到难堪。
collocations: feel ashamed｜感到羞愧 ; ashamed of yourself｜为自己感到羞愧 ; ashamed to admit｜羞于承认
tip_zh: 常作表语：be ashamed of或be ashamed to do。

meanings_zh: n. 收入；收益
definition_en: Money received regularly from work, investments, or other sources.
example1_en: My weekend job gives me a small extra income.
example1_zh: 我的周末兼职给我带来一小笔额外收入。
example2_en: Affordable public transport allows families on low incomes to access employment and essential services more easily.
example2_zh: 价格实惠的公共交通让低收入家庭更容易获得就业机会和基本服务。
collocations: low income｜低收入 ; household income｜家庭收入 ; disposable income｜可支配收入 ; source of income｜收入来源
tip_zh: income范围比salary广，也包括租金、投资收益。

meanings_zh: adv. 在户外；向户外 | n. 野外；户外环境
definition_en: outside a building, in the open air | the natural world away from buildings
example1_en: The weather is warm enough to eat outdoors tonight.
example1_zh: 今晚天气够暖和，可以在户外吃饭。
example2_en: Spending time outdoors can improve children's wellbeing and encourage greater interest in protecting the natural environment.
example2_zh: 在户外活动能改善儿童的身心健康，并增强他们保护自然环境的兴趣。
collocations: spend time outdoors｜在户外活动 ; eat outdoors｜在户外吃饭 ; the great outdoors｜大自然
tip_zh: outdoors是副词；修饰名词用outdoor，如outdoor activities。

meanings_zh: n. 帮忙；善意的举动 | n. 赞同；偏爱 | v. 偏爱；支持；有利于
definition_en: Something helpful you do for someone. | Approval, support, or preference shown towards someone or something. | To prefer, support, or give an advantage to someone or something.
example1_en: Could you do me a favour and water my plants?
example1_zh: 你能帮我一个忙，给我的植物浇浇水吗？
example2_en: Many residents favour investment in public transport because it can reduce congestion and improve air quality.
example2_zh: 许多居民支持投资公共交通，因为这有助于缓解拥堵并改善空气质量。
collocations: do someone a favour｜帮某人一个忙 ; in favour of｜支持；赞成 ; return the favour｜回报帮助 ; favour one option over another｜更倾向于某个选项
tip_zh: 英式拼写为favour，美式为favor；帮忙用do。

meanings_zh: n. 噩梦 | n. 极其糟糕的经历
definition_en: a frightening or deeply unpleasant dream | an experience or situation that is extremely unpleasant or difficult
