collocations: feel pity for｜同情 ; take pity on｜怜悯并帮助 ; what a pity｜真可惜 ; a sense of pity｜怜悯之情
tip_zh: 表同情通常不可数；表遗憾常用a pity。

meanings_zh: adj. 东部的；东方的
definition_en: In or relating to the east of an area.
example1_en: Our hotel overlooks the island's quiet eastern coast.
example1_zh: 我们的酒店俯瞰着岛上宁静的东海岸。
example2_en: Improved railway connections could help eastern regions attract investment and reduce economic differences within the country.
example2_zh: 改善铁路连接有助于东部地区吸引投资，缩小国内经济差距。
collocations: eastern coast｜东海岸 ; eastern region｜东部地区 ; eastern boundary｜东部边界
tip_zh: eastern通常只作形容词，不表示“东方人”。

meanings_zh: n. 滑板车 | n. 踏板式小型摩托车
definition_en: A small wheeled platform with handlebars, ridden standing up. | A small motorcycle with a low platform for your feet.
example1_en: The child pushed her scooter along the smooth path.
example1_zh: 那个孩子蹬着滑板车沿着平坦的小路前进。
example2_en: Shared electric scooter schemes may reduce short car journeys if cities provide safe routes and suitable parking areas.
example2_zh: 如果城市提供安全路线和合适的停车区域，共享电动滑板车项目可能减少短途驾车出行。
collocations: ride a scooter｜骑滑板车或踏板摩托车 ; an electric scooter｜电动滑板车 ; a motor scooter｜踏板式摩托车
tip_zh: 可指站着骑的滑板车，也可指踏板式小摩托。

meanings_zh: n. 束；串 | n. 一群；一帮 | v. 聚拢；使聚成一团
definition_en: a group of similar things held or growing together | a group of people, described informally | to gather closely together, or make things gather together
example1_en: He brought a bunch of flowers for the kitchen table.
example1_zh: 他带来一束花，准备放在厨房的餐桌上。
example2_en: When passengers bunch together near train doors, boarding becomes slower and less comfortable for everyone.
example2_zh: 当乘客聚集在列车门附近时，上车速度会变慢，所有人的乘车体验也会变差。
collocations: a bunch of grapes｜一串葡萄 ; a bunch of flowers｜一束花 ; a bunch of friends｜一帮朋友 ; bunch up｜挤在一起
tip_zh: a bunch of可指一束或一串；指人时较口语化。

meanings_zh: adj. 明智的；合乎情理的
definition_en: Showing good judgement and practical understanding.
example1_en: Taking an umbrella was sensible in this weather.
example1_zh: 这种天气带把伞是明智的。
example2_en: Investing in preventive healthcare is a sensible way to reduce pressure on public hospitals over time.
example2_zh: 投资预防性医疗是逐步减轻公立医院压力的明智之举。
collocations: a sensible decision｜明智的决定 ; a sensible approach｜合理的方法 ; sensible advice｜合理的建议
tip_zh: sensible指明智的；sensitive指敏感的。

meanings_zh: v. 使困惑 | v. 混淆；认错
definition_en: To make someone unable to understand or think clearly. | To wrongly think one person or thing is another.
example1_en: These complicated instructions confuse me every time I cook.
example1_zh: 每次做饭，这些复杂的说明都让我摸不着头脑。
example2_en: Public health messages can confuse audiences when experts use technical language without explaining its meaning.
example2_zh: 专家使用术语却不解释其含义时，公共卫生信息可能会让受众感到困惑。
collocations: confuse A with B｜把A与B混淆 ; confuse the issue｜把问题弄复杂 ; easily confused｜容易混淆的
tip_zh: confused形容人感到困惑；confusing形容事物令人困惑。

meanings_zh: adj. 毛茸茸的；覆有毛皮的
definition_en: covered with thick, soft hair or material resembling fur
example1_en: A furry little rabbit curled up beside my feet.
example1_zh: 一只毛茸茸的小兔子蜷缩在我的脚边。
example2_en: Many furry mammals depend on dense coats to maintain body temperature in extremely cold environments.
example2_zh: 许多毛茸茸的哺乳动物依靠浓密的皮毛，在极寒环境中维持体温。
collocations: furry animal｜毛茸茸的动物 ; furry coat｜毛茸茸的皮毛 ; furry paws｜毛茸茸的爪子
tip_zh: fur变furry需双写r；可形容动物或仿毛材质。

meanings_zh: n. 运动员
definition_en: A person trained to compete in sports requiring physical skill.
example1_en: The athlete stretched her legs before the morning race.
example1_zh: 那位运动员在早上的比赛前伸展了双腿。
example2_en: Young athletes need balanced training programmes that protect their health while allowing them to pursue sporting excellence.
example2_zh: 年轻运动员需要均衡的训练计划，在追求卓越运动表现的同时保护健康。
collocations: professional athlete｜职业运动员 ; elite athlete｜顶尖运动员 ; a promising young athlete｜有潜力的年轻运动员
tip_zh: athlete常泛指运动员，不只指田径选手。

meanings_zh: n. 小型公共汽车；小巴
definition_en: A small bus carrying fewer passengers than a standard bus.
example1_en: A minibus picked us up outside the village shop.
example1_zh: 一辆小巴在村里的商店外接上了我们。
example2_en: A community minibus can help older residents reach essential services in areas with limited public transport.
example2_zh: 在公共交通有限的地区，社区小巴可以帮助老年居民前往提供基本服务的场所。
collocations: hire a minibus｜租一辆小巴 ; a minibus service｜小巴接送服务 ; travel by minibus｜乘小巴出行
tip_zh: minibus指小型载客巴士，不是所有面包车都叫minibus。

meanings_zh: adj. 户外的；露天的
definition_en: happening, used, or located outside a building
example1_en: We bought comfortable chairs for our outdoor dining area.
example1_zh: 我们给户外用餐区买了舒适的椅子。
example2_en: Regular outdoor activities can improve children's physical health while helping them develop an appreciation of nature.
example2_zh: 定期开展户外活动可以改善儿童的身体健康，同时培养他们对自然的欣赏。
collocations: outdoor activities｜户外活动 ; outdoor sports｜户外运动 ; outdoor swimming pool｜露天游泳池 ; outdoor clothing｜户外服装
tip_zh: outdoor是形容词；表示在户外用副词outdoors。

meanings_zh: adj. 好奇的；求知欲强的 | adj. 奇怪的；不寻常的
definition_en: Wanting to learn or know more about something. | Unusual or strange in a way that attracts attention.
example1_en: The curious kitten peered into my open shopping bag.
example1_zh: 那只好奇的小猫探头看我敞开的购物袋。
example2_en: Teachers can encourage curious students to explore scientific questions through practical experiments rather than memorisation alone.
example2_zh: 教师可以鼓励求知欲强的学生通过动手实验探索科学问题，而不只是死记硬背。
collocations: curious about｜对……好奇 ; curious to know｜很想知道 ; a curious mixture｜奇特的混合物
tip_zh: be curious about表示“对……好奇”。

meanings_zh: n. 爱人；宝贝 | n. 热心善良的人
definition_en: someone you love, especially a romantic partner | a very kind and helpful person
example1_en: My sweetheart brought me flowers after a difficult day.
example1_zh: 辛苦了一天后，我的爱人给我带来了鲜花。
example2_en: Many older adults maintain strong emotional connections with sweethearts they first met during their school years.
example2_zh: 许多年长者与学生时代结识的恋人仍保持着深厚的感情联系。
collocations: childhood sweetheart｜青梅竹马的恋人 ; be a sweetheart｜做个热心人
tip_zh: 可指恋人，也可作亲昵称呼；不宜随意称呼陌生人。

meanings_zh: n. 术语；用语 | n. 学期 | n. 期限；任期
definition_en: A word or expression with a particular meaning. | One of the periods into which a school year is divided. | A fixed period during which something lasts or someone serves.
example1_en: Our teacher explained a scientific term using a simple drawing.
example1_zh: 老师用一幅简单的画解释了一个科学术语。
example2_en: The term sustainability describes meeting present needs without limiting the opportunities available to future generations.
example2_zh: 可持续性这一术语指满足当代需求，同时不限制后代可获得的机会。
collocations: technical term｜专业术语 ; school term｜学期 ; in the long term｜从长远来看 ; terms and conditions｜条款与条件
tip_zh: in terms of意为就…而言；条款义常用复数terms。

meanings_zh: adj. 温暖舒适的 | adj. 亲密愉快的
definition_en: warm, comfortable, and pleasant, often in a small space | friendly and relaxed in a private setting
example1_en: We spent a cosy evening beside the fire.
example1_zh: 我们在炉火旁度过了一个温暖惬意的夜晚。
example2_en: Small libraries can provide cosy spaces where residents read, relax, and build connections with their neighbours.
example2_zh: 小型图书馆可以提供舒适的空间，让居民阅读、放松并与邻里建立联系。
collocations: a cosy room｜温暖舒适的房间 ; a cosy atmosphere｜温馨的氛围 ; a cosy chat｜亲切闲聊
tip_zh: 英式拼写cosy，美式通常写cozy。

meanings_zh: n. 工资；工钱 | v. 开展；发动
definition_en: money earned for work, often calculated by the hour or week | to carry on a war or organised campaign
example1_en: The café pays a decent wage for weekend work.
example1_zh: 这家咖啡馆给周末上班的员工支付不错的工资。
example2_en: Raising the minimum wage may improve living standards, but small businesses could face higher operating costs.
example2_zh: 提高最低工资可能改善生活水平，但小企业可能面临更高的经营成本。
collocations: minimum wage｜最低工资 ; earn a wage｜挣工资 ; wage increase｜加薪 ; wage a campaign｜开展运动
tip_zh: wage常按小时或周计算；salary通常指固定薪金。

meanings_zh: v. 惊吓；使害怕 | n. 惊吓；恐慌
definition_en: to make someone feel frightened | a sudden feeling or period of fear
example1_en: Please knock gently so you don't scare the baby.
example1_zh: 请轻轻敲门，别吓到宝宝。
example2_en: Misleading reports about food safety can scare consumers and damage public confidence in local producers.
example2_zh: 有关食品安全的误导性报道可能吓到消费者，并损害公众对本地生产商的信任。
collocations: scare someone away｜把某人吓跑 ; give someone a scare｜吓某人一跳 ; a health scare｜健康恐慌
tip_zh: scared形容人感到害怕；scary形容事物吓人。

meanings_zh: v. 使失望
definition_en: To make someone unhappy by failing to meet their expectations.
example1_en: I knew cancelling our picnic would disappoint the children.
example1_zh: 我知道取消野餐会让孩子们失望。
example2_en: Public transport improvements may disappoint commuters if services remain unreliable despite substantial investment in new vehicles.
example2_zh: 尽管大量资金投入了新车辆，若服务仍不可靠，公共交通的改善可能会让通勤者失望。
collocations: disappoint customers｜让顾客失望 ; disappoint expectations｜辜负期望 ; never disappoint｜从不让人失望
tip_zh: 人感到失望用disappointed；事物令人失望用disappointing。

meanings_zh: adj. 恼怒的；不耐烦的
definition_en: slightly angry about something unpleasant or inconvenient
example1_en: Leila looked annoyed when the printer jammed again.
example1_zh: 打印机又卡纸了，莱拉显得有些恼火。
example2_en: Residents often become annoyed when construction noise continues late into the evening without prior warning.
example2_zh: 如果施工噪声持续到深夜且事先没有通知，居民往往会感到恼火。
collocations: annoyed with someone｜生某人的气 ; annoyed about something｜因某事恼火 ; visibly annoyed｜明显感到恼火
tip_zh: annoyed形容人的感受；annoying形容令人恼火的事物。

meanings_zh: adj. 发展中的 | adj. 逐渐形成的；成长中的
definition_en: Becoming more economically advanced, often with improving living standards. | Growing or becoming more complete over time.
example1_en: My cousin builds water pumps in a developing country.
example1_zh: 我表亲在一个发展中国家修建水泵。
example2_en: Developing economies often need sustained investment in education and infrastructure to improve living standards.
example2_zh: 发展中经济体往往需要持续投资教育和基础设施，以提高生活水平。
collocations: developing countries｜发展中国家 ; developing economies｜发展中经济体 ; a developing situation｜不断演变的局势
tip_zh: developing指发展中的；developed指已发展的、发达的。

meanings_zh: n. 大学毕业生 | v. 毕业；获得学位
definition_en: someone who has successfully completed a university degree | to successfully complete a course at a school or university
example1_en: My sister graduated from university and started work nearby.
example1_zh: 我姐姐大学毕业后，在附近开始工作。
example2_en: Many recent graduates struggle to find employment that matches their qualifications in an increasingly competitive labour market.
example2_zh: 在竞争日益激烈的劳动力市场中，许多应届毕业生难以找到符合自身资历的工作。
collocations: university graduate｜大学毕业生 ; recent graduate｜应届毕业生 ; graduate from university｜大学毕业 ; graduate with honours｜以优等成绩毕业
tip_zh: 名词尾音/ət/，动词/eɪt/；毕业于用graduate from。

meanings_zh: n. 广告宣传；广告业
definition_en: The activity or business of promoting products and services.
example1_en: My sister works in advertising and designs colourful posters.
example1_zh: 我姐姐从事广告工作，设计色彩鲜艳的海报。
example2_en: Advertising can influence consumer choices, which is why campaigns aimed at children require careful regulation.
example2_zh: 广告会影响消费者的选择，因此针对儿童的广告活动需要受到严格监管。
collocations: advertising campaign｜广告宣传活动 ; advertising agency｜广告公司 ; advertising revenue｜广告收入 ; misleading advertising｜误导性广告
tip_zh: 通常不可数；一则具体广告用an advertisement。

meanings_zh: n. 研究；调查 | v. 研究；调查
definition_en: Careful study aimed at discovering facts or developing knowledge. | To study a subject carefully to discover information.
example1_en: I did some research before choosing my new bicycle.
example1_zh: 挑选新自行车之前，我做了一番调查。
example2_en: Research into renewable energy can help governments develop cleaner and more reliable sources of electricity.
example2_zh: 对可再生能源的研究可以帮助政府开发更清洁、更可靠的电力来源。
collocations: conduct research｜开展研究 ; research into｜对……的研究 ; research findings｜研究结果 ; scientific research｜科学研究
tip_zh: 名词通常不可数；说a study，不说a research。

meanings_zh: n. 转弯处；岔路口 | n. 转动；旋转
definition_en: a place where a road branches off another road | the action of moving around a central point
example1_en: Take the next turning after the small bakery.
example1_zh: 过了那家小面包店，在下一个路口转弯。
example2_en: Poor visibility at this turning increases the risk of accidents for cyclists and other road users.
example2_zh: 这个转弯处视野不佳，增加了骑车者和其他道路使用者发生事故的风险。
collocations: miss a turning｜错过转弯路口 ; take a turning｜在路口转弯 ; a turning on the left｜左侧的岔路口
tip_zh: 表示岔路口时主要用于英式英语；也是turn的-ing形式。

meanings_zh: n. 集体寝室 | n. 学生宿舍楼
definition_en: A large room where several people sleep. | A building where students live, especially at American colleges.
example1_en: We shared a dormitory with six other travellers.
example1_zh: 我们和另外六名旅客合住一间集体寝室。
example2_en: Living in a university dormitory can help new students build friendships and adjust to campus life.
example2_zh: 住在大学宿舍可以帮助新生建立友谊，并适应校园生活。
collocations: shared dormitory｜集体寝室 ; university dormitory｜大学宿舍 ; dormitory room｜宿舍房间
tip_zh: 美式常指学生宿舍楼；英式也常指多人寝室。

meanings_zh: n. 链条；链子 | n. 连锁店；一连串 | v. 用链条拴住
definition_en: a series of connected metal rings | connected shops, events, or other things forming a series | to fasten someone or something with a chain
example1_en: He secured his bicycle with a heavy metal chain.
example1_zh: 他用一条沉重的金属链锁好了自行车。
example2_en: Large supermarket chains can offer lower prices, but their expansion may threaten small independent shops.
example2_zh: 大型连锁超市可以提供更低的价格，但其扩张可能威胁独立小商店。
collocations: a chain of events｜一连串事件 ; a supermarket chain｜连锁超市 ; a supply chain｜供应链 ; chain a bicycle to a railing｜用链条把自行车锁在栏杆上
tip_zh: a chain of后接复数名词，表示相连的一系列事物。

meanings_zh: adj. 累人的；令人疲倦的
definition_en: making someone feel that they need rest
example1_en: Carrying these heavy bags upstairs is tiring work.
example1_zh: 把这些沉重的袋子搬上楼是件累人的活。
example2_en: Long and tiring commutes can reduce workers' productivity and leave them with less time for family activities.
example2_zh: 漫长而累人的通勤会降低员工的工作效率，也会减少他们参与家庭活动的时间。
collocations: a tiring day｜劳累的一天 ; a tiring journey｜令人疲惫的旅程 ; physically tiring｜耗费体力的
tip_zh: tiring形容事物令人累；tired形容人感到累。

meanings_zh: n. 结构；构造 | n. 建筑物；构筑物 | v. 组织；安排
definition_en: The way parts are arranged and connected within a whole. | Something built from connected parts, such as a bridge. | Arrange parts or activities into an organised whole.
example1_en: The model shows the structure of a wooden bridge.
example1_zh: 这个模型展示了一座木桥的结构。
example2_en: A clear essay structure helps readers follow complex arguments and understand the writer's main conclusions.
example2_zh: 清晰的文章结构有助于读者理解复杂的论证，把握作者的主要结论。
collocations: social structure｜社会结构 ; sentence structure｜句子结构 ; structure an essay｜组织文章 ; supporting structure｜支撑结构
tip_zh: structure既可作名词，也可作动词表示组织、安排。

meanings_zh: n. 沙漠；荒漠 | v. 抛弃；擅离
definition_en: a very dry area with little rain and few plants | to leave someone or somewhere you should stay with
example1_en: We crossed the desert before the afternoon heat arrived.
example1_zh: 我们在午后的酷热到来之前穿过了沙漠。
example2_en: As desert areas expand, nearby farming communities face increasing pressure on their water supplies and agricultural land.
example2_zh: 随着荒漠地区扩张，附近的农业社区在供水和耕地方面面临越来越大的压力。
collocations: a vast desert｜广袤的沙漠 ; desert plants｜沙漠植物 ; desert a post｜擅离岗位
tip_zh: 动词读/dɪˈzɜːt/；dessert意为甜点。

meanings_zh: n. 联系；关系 | n. 亲属；亲戚
definition_en: a connection between people, things, or ideas | a person who belongs to your family
example1_en: The price seems to bear no relation to quality.
example1_zh: 这个价格似乎与质量毫无关系。
example2_en: Researchers are examining the relation between access to green spaces and mental health in urban communities.
example2_zh: 研究人员正在考察城市社区中绿地可及性与心理健康之间的关系。
collocations: in relation to｜关于；相对于 ; bear no relation to｜与……无关 ; relations between countries｜国家间的关系 ; a close relation｜近亲
tip_zh: 国家或群体间的关系常用复数relations。

meanings_zh: n. 体育联赛；联赛组织 | n. 联盟；联合会 | n. 水平；等级
definition_en: A group of sports teams that regularly compete against one another. | An association of people or groups sharing a common purpose. | A level of quality, ability, or achievement.
example1_en: Our team finished top of the league this season.
example1_zh: 我们队本赛季在联赛中排名第一。
example2_en: A local sports league can strengthen community ties by bringing together players from different social backgrounds.
example2_zh: 地方体育联赛可以让不同社会背景的球员聚在一起，从而加强社区联系。
collocations: a football league｜足球联赛 ; top of the league｜联赛榜首 ; in a different league｜远高于一般水平 ; out of my league｜超出我的能力范围
tip_zh: in a different league常指水平远胜一筹。

meanings_zh: n. 烘干机；干燥器
definition_en: A machine or device that removes moisture from things.
example1_en: The towels are still warm from the dryer.
example1_zh: 毛巾刚从烘干机里拿出来，还是热的。
example2_en: Using a clothesline instead of an electric dryer can lower household energy consumption and reduce monthly bills.
example2_zh: 用晾衣绳代替电烘干机，可以降低家庭能耗并减少每月账单支出。
collocations: tumble dryer｜滚筒式烘干机 ; hair dryer｜吹风机 ; hand dryer｜干手机 ; clothes dryer｜衣物烘干机
tip_zh: dryer通常是干燥设备；dry的比较级通常写drier。

meanings_zh: n. 卖方；销售者
definition_en: a person or business that sells something
example1_en: The seller wrapped the vase carefully before handing it over.
example1_zh: 卖家仔细包好花瓶后才递过来。
example2_en: Online marketplaces should require each seller to provide accurate product information and clear policies for returns.
example2_zh: 网络交易平台应要求每个卖家提供准确的产品信息和明确的退货政策。
collocations: online seller｜网络卖家 ; private seller｜私人卖家 ; buyers and sellers｜买方与卖方
tip_zh: seller侧重交易中的卖方，不一定是店内售货员。

meanings_zh: adj. 镇静的；平静的 | v. 使镇静；平静下来 | n. 平静；宁静
definition_en: Not worried or excited; without strong movement or disturbance. | To become less upset, or make someone feel more relaxed. | A peaceful state without worry, noise, or disturbance.
example1_en: She stayed calm when the lights suddenly went out.
example1_zh: 灯突然熄灭时，她依然保持镇静。
example2_en: A calm classroom atmosphere can help students concentrate and feel more confident about asking questions.
example2_zh: 平静的课堂氛围有助于学生集中注意力，也让他们更有信心提问。
collocations: stay calm｜保持镇静 ; calm down｜平静下来 ; calm waters｜平静的水面 ; a sense of calm｜宁静感
tip_zh: calm中的l不发音；calm down表示平静下来。

meanings_zh: adj. 抑郁的；沮丧的 | adj. 经济萧条的；不景气的
definition_en: very unhappy, sometimes persistently as part of a mental illness | having little economic activity or few opportunities
example1_en: He felt depressed after weeks of unsuccessful job hunting.
example1_zh: 连续数周求职无果后，他感到很沮丧。
example2_en: Investment in public transport can connect economically depressed areas with employment opportunities and essential services.
example2_zh: 投资公共交通可以让经济萧条地区的居民获得就业机会和基本服务。
collocations: feel depressed｜感到沮丧 ; severely depressed｜严重抑郁的 ; economically depressed area｜经济萧条地区
tip_zh: depressed形容人的感受；depressing形容令人沮丧的事。

meanings_zh: adj. 极好的；精彩的 | adj. 才华出众的；聪颖的 | adj. 明亮的；灿烂的
definition_en: Extremely good, impressive, or enjoyable. | Exceptionally intelligent or skilled. | Shining brightly or having a strong, vivid colour.
example1_en: Your brilliant idea saved us hours of work.
example1_zh: 你的绝妙主意为我们省下了好几个小时的工作。
example2_en: Brilliant teachers can inspire students to explore difficult subjects with confidence and genuine curiosity.
example2_zh: 出色的教师能激励学生带着信心和真正的好奇心探索难学的科目。
collocations: brilliant idea｜绝妙的主意 ; brilliant scientist｜杰出的科学家 ; brilliant sunshine｜灿烂的阳光
tip_zh: 英式口语中常用 brilliant 表示“太棒了”。

meanings_zh: n. 乐器 | n. 仪器；器械 | n. 手段；工具
definition_en: an object played to produce musical sounds | a tool or device for precise scientific or medical work | something used to achieve a particular purpose
example1_en: My sister plays a different instrument at each rehearsal.
example1_zh: 我姐姐每次排练都演奏不同的乐器。
example2_en: Learning a musical instrument can strengthen concentration and encourage cooperation among children from different backgrounds.
example2_zh: 学习乐器可以增强专注力，并促进不同背景的儿童之间的合作。
collocations: musical instrument｜乐器 ; scientific instrument｜科学仪器 ; surgical instrument｜外科器械 ; instrument of change｜推动变革的工具
tip_zh: 乐器和精密仪器均可用instrument；普通工具常用tool。

meanings_zh: n. 未婚夫
definition_en: A man who is engaged to be married.
example1_en: My fiance and I are choosing wedding flowers.
example1_zh: 我和未婚夫正在挑选婚礼用花。
example2_en: Moving abroad with a fiance can require careful planning around employment, housing, and future family responsibilities.
example2_zh: 与未婚夫一起移居海外，可能需要围绕就业、住房和未来的家庭责任仔细规划。
collocations: her fiance｜她的未婚夫 ; my fiance and I｜我和我的未婚夫
tip_zh: 也写作fiancé；未婚妻是fiancee或fiancée。

meanings_zh: n. 喷气式飞机 | n. 喷流；喷射流
definition_en: An aircraft powered by jet engines. | A narrow, forceful stream of liquid or gas.
example1_en: A jet flew low over the beach this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上一架喷气式飞机低空飞过海滩。
example2_en: Replacing older passenger jets with more efficient aircraft could reduce fuel consumption across the aviation industry.
example2_zh: 用效率更高的飞机替换老旧客机，可以降低整个航空业的燃料消耗。
collocations: passenger jet｜喷气式客机 ; jet engine｜喷气发动机 ; a jet of water｜一股喷射的水流
tip_zh: a jet of water指一股喷射的水流。

meanings_zh: n. 撞车；坠毁；碰撞 | v. 碰撞；坠毁 | v. 崩溃；暴跌
definition_en: an accident in which a vehicle hits something or falls | to hit something violently or fall and be badly damaged | to stop working suddenly or lose value very quickly
example1_en: Nobody was hurt in the crash outside our house.
example1_zh: 我们家外面的那起撞车事故没有造成人员受伤。
example2_en: Financial markets can crash when investors suddenly lose confidence in the stability of the economy.
example2_zh: 当投资者突然对经济的稳定性失去信心时，金融市场可能暴跌。
collocations: a car crash｜车祸 ; crash into a wall｜撞上墙 ; a computer crash｜电脑崩溃 ; a stock market crash｜股市崩盘
tip_zh: crash into后接撞上的物体；电脑崩溃也可用crash。

meanings_zh: v. 想要；想做 | adj. 精致的；豪华的 | v. 爱慕；觉得有吸引力
definition_en: To want something or feel like doing something. | Decorative, elaborate, or expensive rather than plain. | To feel romantically attracted to someone.
example1_en: Do you fancy a walk by the river after lunch?
example1_zh: 午饭后你想去河边散步吗？
example2_en: Some tourists prefer simple local accommodation to fancy hotels because it offers more opportunities for cultural exchange.
example2_zh: 一些游客更喜欢简朴的当地住宿，而非豪华酒店，因为前者提供更多文化交流机会。
collocations: fancy doing something｜想做某事 ; fancy a drink｜想喝点东西 ; a fancy restaurant｜一家豪华餐厅
tip_zh: 表示“想做”时用fancy doing，不用fancy to do。

meanings_zh: n. 抗议；抗议活动 | v. 抗议；反对
definition_en: An expression or action showing strong disagreement or opposition. | Express strong disagreement with something.
example1_en: Residents held a peaceful protest outside the town hall.
example1_zh: 居民在市政厅外举行了一场和平抗议。
example2_en: Citizens may protest against environmental policies that fail to protect local forests and water supplies.
example2_zh: 公民可能会抗议那些未能保护当地森林和水源的环境政策。
collocations: peaceful protest｜和平抗议 ; protest against｜抗议；反对 ; in protest at｜为抗议…… ; under protest｜不情愿地；抗议着
tip_zh: 所列为名词音；动词英音/prəˈtest/，常接against。

meanings_zh: n. 囚犯；被拘禁者 | n. 战俘；俘虏
definition_en: A person kept in prison or prevented from leaving. | A person captured and held by an enemy during war.
example1_en: The prisoner borrowed a novel from the prison library.
example1_zh: 那名囚犯从监狱图书馆借了一本小说。
example2_en: Providing prisoners with education and vocational training may improve their chances of finding employment after release.
example2_zh: 为囚犯提供教育和职业培训，可能提高他们获释后找到工作的机会。
collocations: release a prisoner｜释放囚犯 ; prisoner of war｜战俘 ; take someone prisoner｜俘虏某人
tip_zh: prisoner 不一定已被定罪，也可指被俘或被拘禁者。

meanings_zh: adj. 到期应付的；应交的 | adj. 预期的；预计到达的 | adj. 应得的；应有的
definition_en: Required to be paid or submitted by a particular time. | Expected to happen or arrive at a particular time. | Deserved or appropriate in a particular situation.
example1_en: Our rent is due at the end of the week.
example1_zh: 我们的房租本周末到期应付。
example2_en: When tuition fees are due, some students struggle to cover both educational expenses and basic living costs.
example2_zh: 学费到期应缴时，一些学生难以同时承担教育支出和基本生活费用。
collocations: payment due｜到期应付款项 ; due to arrive｜预计到达 ; due consideration｜应有的考虑 ; due to｜由于
tip_zh: be due to do表示预计做；due to＋名词表示由于。

meanings_zh: n. 宇航员；航天员
definition_en: a person trained to travel and work in space
example1_en: The astronaut floated gently through the small space station.
example1_zh: 那名宇航员轻轻地飘过小型空间站。
example2_en: Astronauts conduct experiments in space that help scientists understand how the human body responds to weightlessness.
example2_zh: 宇航员在太空中开展实验，帮助科学家了解人体对失重的反应。
collocations: astronaut training｜宇航员训练 ; a team of astronauts｜一队宇航员 ; astronaut crew｜宇航员乘组
tip_zh: astronaut是宇航员；astronomer是天文学家。

meanings_zh: v. 围绕；包围 | v. 与……密切相关；围绕
definition_en: be or move into positions on every side of something | be closely connected with an event, situation, or subject
example1_en: Tall trees surround the cottage and shade its windows.
example1_zh: 高大的树木环绕着小屋，为窗户遮阴。
example2_en: Uncertainty continues to surround the proposed transport scheme, making it difficult for local businesses to plan ahead.
example2_zh: 拟议中的交通方案仍存在不确定性，使当地企业难以提前规划。
collocations: be surrounded by｜被……包围 ; surround yourself with｜使自己身边充满 ; the circumstances surrounding｜与……有关的情况
tip_zh: 常用be surrounded by；surroundings指周围环境。

meanings_zh: v. 依靠；依赖 | v. 信赖；信任
definition_en: to need someone's help or depend on something | to trust someone or something to act as expected
example1_en: I rely on my bicycle to get to work.
example1_zh: 我靠自行车通勤。
example2_en: Communities that rely heavily on tourism may face economic difficulties when visitor numbers suddenly decline.
example2_zh: 高度依赖旅游业的社区，在游客数量骤降时可能面临经济困难。
collocations: rely on｜依靠；信赖 ; rely heavily on｜严重依赖 ; rely on someone to do something｜指望某人做某事
tip_zh: 不直接接宾语：用rely on或rely upon。

meanings_zh: adj. 咸的；含盐的
definition_en: Tasting of salt or containing a lot of salt.
example1_en: The soup was too salty, so I added water.
example1_zh: 汤太咸了，所以我加了些水。
example2_en: Eating salty snacks frequently can contribute to high blood pressure, increasing the risk of cardiovascular disease.
example2_zh: 经常吃咸味零食可能导致高血压，增加患心血管疾病的风险。
collocations: salty food｜咸的食物 ; a salty taste｜咸味 ; salty snacks｜咸味零食
tip_zh: salty强调咸味；salted强调加过盐。

meanings_zh: v. 道歉；认错
definition_en: To tell someone you are sorry for doing something wrong
example1_en: I apologized to my neighbour for the noise.
example1_zh: 我为噪声向邻居道了歉。
example2_en: Companies should apologize promptly for service failures and explain what steps they will take to prevent further problems.
example2_zh: 企业应及时为服务失误道歉，并说明将采取哪些措施来防止问题再次发生。
collocations: apologize to someone｜向某人道歉 ; apologize for doing something｜为做某事道歉 ; apologize sincerely｜真诚道歉
tip_zh: 向人道歉用to，为事情道歉用for；英式也写apologise。

meanings_zh: n. 外国人
definition_en: A person from a country other than the one being discussed.
example1_en: As a foreigner, I needed help understanding local customs.
example1_zh: 作为外国人，我需要别人帮助我了解当地习俗。
example2_en: Language courses can help foreigners participate more fully in community life and access essential public services.
example2_zh: 语言课程可以帮助外国人更充分地参与社区生活，并获得必要的公共服务。
collocations: as a foreigner｜作为外国人 ; foreigners living abroad｜在海外生活的外国人 ; welcome foreigners｜欢迎外国人
tip_zh: 泛指外国人；特指游客时用visitor更自然。

meanings_zh: adj. 已订婚的 | adj. 忙于；参与的 | adj. 占线的；使用中的
definition_en: Having formally agreed to marry someone. | Actively involved in an activity or task. | Currently being used and therefore unavailable.
example1_en: My sister got engaged during her holiday by the sea.
example1_zh: 我姐姐在海边度假时订婚了。
example2_en: Students who are actively engaged in classroom discussions often develop stronger communication and critical thinking skills.
example2_zh: 积极参与课堂讨论的学生往往能培养更强的沟通和批判性思维能力。
collocations: get engaged｜订婚 ; engaged to someone｜与某人订婚 ; engaged in research｜从事研究 ; the line is engaged｜电话占线
tip_zh: 订婚对象前用to；参与的活动前用in。

meanings_zh: prep. 遍及；贯穿整个时期 | adv. 到处；自始至终
definition_en: In every part of a place or during an entire period. | In every part or for the whole time.
example1_en: The smell of fresh bread spread throughout the house.
example1_zh: 新鲜面包的香味飘满了整栋房子。
example2_en: Reliable internet access throughout rural areas is essential for reducing inequalities in education and employment.
example2_zh: 在农村地区全面提供可靠的互联网接入，对减少教育和就业方面的不平等至关重要。
collocations: throughout the world｜遍及世界 ; throughout the year｜全年 ; throughout history｜纵观历史 ; remain consistent throughout｜始终保持一致
tip_zh: throughout强调整个范围或全程，不只是某一点。

meanings_zh: n. 傻瓜；蠢人 | v. 欺骗；愚弄
definition_en: someone who behaves without good sense or judgment | to make someone believe something that is not true
example1_en: The realistic plastic spider fooled everyone at the party.
example1_zh: 那只逼真的塑料蜘蛛骗过了聚会上的所有人。
example2_en: Misleading advertisements can fool consumers into buying products that offer little practical benefit.
example2_zh: 误导性广告可能诱使消费者购买几乎没有实际用处的产品。
collocations: fool someone into doing something｜骗某人做某事 ; make a fool of yourself｜出洋相 ; fool around｜胡闹
tip_zh: fool作名词称呼别人有贬义；动词可接into doing。

meanings_zh: v. 适合；合心意 | v. 使显得好看；相配 | n. 一套西装；套装
definition_en: to be convenient or right for someone | to make someone look attractive | matching clothes consisting of a jacket and trousers or skirt
example1_en: Would an earlier appointment suit you better tomorrow?
example1_zh: 明天把预约时间提前一点会更适合你吗？
example2_en: Flexible working hours suit employees who need to balance professional responsibilities with family commitments.
example2_zh: 弹性工作时间适合需要兼顾工作职责与家庭责任的员工。
collocations: suit your needs｜满足你的需求 ; suit everyone｜适合所有人 ; a business suit｜商务西装
tip_zh: suit强调合适或好看；fit强调尺寸合身。

meanings_zh: n. 休假；不上班的时间
definition_en: Time when you are not working or attending school.
example1_en: I need some time off to visit my grandparents.
example1_zh: 我需要请几天假去看望祖父母。
example2_en: Providing paid time off can improve employee wellbeing and reduce stress in the workplace.
example2_zh: 提供带薪休假可以改善员工身心健康，减轻工作压力。
collocations: take time off｜请假；休假 ; paid time off｜带薪休假 ; time off work｜不上班的时间
tip_zh: 通常不可数；请一天假可说 take a day off。

meanings_zh: v. 转移；调动；转账 | v. 转车；转学 | n. 转移；调动；转账
definition_en: To move someone or something from one place to another. | To change to another vehicle, school, or institution. | The act of moving something or someone to another place.
example1_en: Please transfer the photos from your camera to my laptop.
example1_zh: 请把相机里的照片传到我的笔记本电脑上。
example2_en: Governments should support the transfer of clean technology to regions that still depend heavily on fossil fuels.
example2_zh: 政府应支持向仍高度依赖化石燃料的地区转移清洁技术。
collocations: transfer money｜转账 ; transfer data｜传输数据 ; transfer to another school｜转学 ; technology transfer｜技术转移
tip_zh: 名词重音在首音节；过去式transferred双写r。

meanings_zh: adj. 浪漫的；爱情的 | adj. 理想化的；不切实际的 | n. 浪漫的人；理想主义者
definition_en: connected with love or expressing loving feelings | seeing things as more beautiful or exciting than they really are | someone strongly influenced by love, imagination, or idealistic hopes
example1_en: They enjoyed a romantic dinner beside the quiet lake.
example1_zh: 他们在宁静的湖边享用了一顿浪漫的晚餐。
example2_en: Advertisements often present a romantic image of rural life while ignoring limited services and employment opportunities.
example2_zh: 广告常把乡村生活描绘得很美好，却忽视了服务和就业机会不足的问题。
collocations: romantic relationship｜恋爱关系 ; romantic dinner｜浪漫晚餐 ; romantic comedy｜爱情喜剧 ; a romantic view of｜对……的理想化看法
tip_zh: 除爱情义外，也可指把现实想得过于美好。

meanings_zh: n. 点；小圆点 | v. 散布于；点缀 | n. 网址或邮箱中的点
definition_en: a small round mark | to appear in scattered places across an area | the spoken name for a full stop in online addresses
example1_en: Her yellow umbrella has a pattern of blue dots.
example1_zh: 她的黄色雨伞上有蓝色圆点图案。
example2_en: Small villages dot the coastline, attracting visitors who prefer quieter alternatives to crowded seaside resorts.
example2_zh: 小村庄散布在海岸线上，吸引了那些偏爱宁静而非拥挤海滨度假区的游客。
collocations: a red dot｜一个红点 ; on the dot｜准时 ; dotted line｜虚线 ; be dotted with｜散布着
tip_zh: on the dot表示准时，常接在具体时刻之后。

meanings_zh: n. 增长；增加 | n. 生长；成长；发展 | n. 赘生物；肿块
definition_en: An increase in size, amount, or level. | The process of growing physically or developing over time. | An unusual lump of tissue growing in or on the body.
example1_en: The rapid growth of our town surprised my grandparents.
example1_zh: 我们小镇的迅速扩张让我的祖父母感到惊讶。
example2_en: Governments should balance economic growth with environmental protection to ensure that rising prosperity does not exhaust natural resources.
example2_zh: 政府应平衡经济增长与环境保护，确保日益繁荣的经济不会耗尽自然资源。
collocations: economic growth｜经济增长 ; population growth｜人口增长 ; rapid growth｜快速增长 ; personal growth｜个人成长
tip_zh: 表示增长通常不可数；a growth可指一个肿块。

meanings_zh: n. 故事；传说 | n. 经历的讲述；叙述
definition_en: a story, especially one involving imaginary or exciting events | an account of something that happened to someone
example1_en: Grandfather told us a tale about a clever fox.
example1_zh: 祖父给我们讲了一个聪明狐狸的故事。
example2_en: Traditional tales can preserve cultural values while helping children explore complex emotions through memorable characters.
example2_zh: 传统故事既能传承文化价值观，也能通过令人难忘的角色帮助儿童探索复杂情感。
collocations: a fairy tale｜童话 ; a folk tale｜民间故事 ; a cautionary tale｜警示故事 ; tell a tale｜讲故事
tip_zh: tale指故事；tail指尾巴，两者同音。

meanings_zh: adv. 以前；先前
definition_en: At a time before now or before another event.
example1_en: I had previously met our neighbour at the library.
example1_zh: 我先前在图书馆见过我们的邻居。
example2_en: Online courses now provide educational opportunities for people who previously had limited access to universities.
example2_zh: 在线课程如今为那些以前难以接受大学教育的人提供了学习机会。
collocations: previously unknown｜先前未知的 ; previously mentioned｜先前提到的 ; previously published｜此前发表的
tip_zh: previously意为先前；表示提前准备通常用in advance。

meanings_zh: n. 污渍；污点 | v. 弄脏；染色 | n. 染色剂
definition_en: a dirty or coloured mark that is difficult to remove | to leave a lasting mark or colour on something | a substance used to colour wood or biological samples
example1_en: There is a coffee stain on your white shirt.
example1_zh: 你的白衬衫上有一块咖啡渍。
example2_en: Manufacturers are developing fabrics that resist stains, potentially reducing the water and energy required for washing.
example2_zh: 制造商正在开发防污面料，这有望减少洗涤所需的水和能源。
collocations: remove a stain｜去除污渍 ; a coffee stain｜咖啡渍 ; wood stain｜木材染色剂 ; stain-resistant fabric｜防污面料
tip_zh: 污渍用stain；普通颜色不叫stain，染色剂则可以。

meanings_zh: adj. 先前的；以前的
definition_en: happening or existing before the time or thing being discussed
example1_en: The previous tenant left some plants on the balcony.
example1_zh: 上一位租客在阳台上留下了几盆植物。
example2_en: Previous studies suggest that regular physical activity can improve concentration and academic performance among school children.
example2_zh: 先前的研究表明，经常运动能提高学龄儿童的专注力和学习成绩。
collocations: previous experience｜以往经验 ; previous studies｜先前研究 ; the previous year｜前一年
tip_zh: previous是形容词；表示“以前”用副词previously。

meanings_zh: n. 大鼠
definition_en: a rodent with a long tail, larger than a mouse
example1_en: A rat disappeared behind the bins near the gate.
example1_zh: 一只大鼠钻到大门附近的垃圾桶后面，不见了。
example2_en: Proper waste management helps control rat populations and reduces health risks in densely populated neighbourhoods.
example2_zh: 妥善管理垃圾有助于控制鼠群数量，并降低人口密集社区的健康风险。
collocations: rat population｜大鼠种群 ; rat trap｜捕鼠器 ; laboratory rat｜实验用大鼠
tip_zh: rat通常指大鼠，mouse通常指体型较小的小鼠。

meanings_zh: n. 素食者 | adj. 素食的；不含肉鱼的
definition_en: A person who does not eat meat or fish. | Containing no meat or fish, or following this diet.
example1_en: My sister became a vegetarian after learning to cook.
example1_zh: 我姐姐学会做饭后成了一名素食者。
example2_en: Providing vegetarian meals in school canteens can accommodate different dietary preferences and reduce environmental impacts.
example2_zh: 学校食堂提供素食可以满足不同的饮食偏好，并减少对环境的影响。
collocations: vegetarian diet｜素食饮食 ; vegetarian option｜素食选项 ; become a vegetarian｜成为素食者
tip_zh: vegetarian不吃肉和鱼；vegan还不吃蛋奶等动物产品。

meanings_zh: n. 晒成的棕褐肤色 | v. 晒成棕褐色 | adj. 棕黄色的；浅褐色的
definition_en: a darker skin colour caused by exposure to the sun | to become or make skin darker through exposure to sunlight | having a light brown colour
example1_en: His summer tan had faded by the middle of winter.
example1_zh: 到了隆冬，他夏天晒出的棕褐肤色已经褪去。
example2_en: Although a tan is sometimes considered attractive, prolonged exposure to sunlight increases the risk of skin damage.
example2_zh: 虽然晒成棕褐色有时被认为很有吸引力，但长时间日晒会增加皮肤受损的风险。
collocations: get a tan｜晒成棕褐色 ; a deep tan｜深棕褐肤色 ; tan leather｜棕黄色皮革
tip_zh: tan不只指晒黑；作形容词也可描述鞋包的浅褐色。

meanings_zh: n. 潜水；潜水运动 | n. 跳水；跳水运动
definition_en: the activity of swimming underwater, often using special breathing equipment | the sport of jumping into water, often with controlled movements
example1_en: We went diving and saw colourful fish near the reef.
example1_zh: 我们去潜水，在礁石附近看到了色彩鲜艳的鱼。
example2_en: Diving tourism can support coastal economies, provided operators protect marine habitats and teach visitors responsible behaviour.
example2_zh: 潜水旅游可以促进沿海经济，前提是经营者保护海洋栖息地并教导游客负责任地行动。
collocations: scuba diving｜水肺潜水 ; a diving board｜跳板 ; diving equipment｜潜水装备 ; a diving instructor｜潜水教练
tip_zh: go diving 常指去潜水；跳水运动也叫 diving。

meanings_zh: v. 迎接；问候 | v. 映入眼帘；传入耳鼻
definition_en: to welcome someone or say hello | to become noticeable when someone arrives or looks
example1_en: Our neighbours greeted us warmly when we moved in.
example1_zh: 我们搬来时，邻居们热情地向我们打招呼。
example2_en: Visitors are greeted by trained volunteers who explain the museum's collection and help them find their way.
example2_zh: 受过培训的志愿者迎接参观者，介绍博物馆的藏品并为他们指路。
collocations: greet someone warmly｜热情地问候某人 ; greet someone with a smile｜微笑着迎接某人 ; be greeted by｜受到迎接；首先看到
tip_zh: greet直接接人；表示向某人问好不加to。

meanings_zh: n. 宣传册；资料手册
definition_en: A small booklet giving information about products, services, or places.
example1_en: I picked up a travel brochure at the station.
example1_zh: 我在车站拿了一本旅游宣传册。
example2_en: University brochures can help prospective students compare courses, accommodation options, and the facilities available on campus.
example2_zh: 大学宣传册可以帮助有意申请的学生比较课程、住宿选择及校园设施。
collocations: travel brochure｜旅游宣传册 ; university brochure｜大学招生手册 ; promotional brochure｜推广宣传册
tip_zh: 可数名词，常指介绍旅游、课程或产品的小册子。

meanings_zh: n. 瓢虫
definition_en: A small beetle, often red with black spots
example1_en: A tiny ladybird landed on the edge of my sleeve.
example1_zh: 一只小瓢虫落在了我的袖口边。
example2_en: Ladybirds can help farmers control certain crop pests, reducing the need for chemical pesticides.
example2_zh: 瓢虫可以帮助农民控制某些农作物害虫，从而减少化学杀虫剂的使用。
collocations: a red ladybird｜一只红色瓢虫 ; ladybird larvae｜瓢虫幼虫 ; a seven-spot ladybird｜七星瓢虫
tip_zh: 英式常用ladybird，美式常用ladybug。

meanings_zh: n. 袖子 | n. 保护套；套管
definition_en: The part of a garment that covers an arm. | A protective cover that fits closely around an object.
example1_en: I caught my sleeve on the kitchen door handle.
example1_zh: 我的袖子被厨房门把手勾住了。
example2_en: Workers should keep loose sleeves away from moving machinery to reduce the risk of workplace injuries.
example2_zh: 工人应让宽松的袖子远离运转中的机器，以降低工伤风险。
collocations: long sleeves｜长袖 ; roll up your sleeves｜卷起袖子 ; protective sleeve｜保护套
tip_zh: sleeve指衣服的袖子，不是手臂arm。

meanings_zh: n. 信号；暗号 | n. 电子信号 | v. 示意；表明
definition_en: A sound, movement, or light that communicates a message. | An electrical or radio wave carrying information. | Communicate through an action, or indicate that something is happening.
example1_en: The coach gave a signal, and we started running.
example1_zh: 教练发出信号后，我们开始跑步。
example2_en: Increasing investment in renewable energy may signal a government's commitment to reducing its dependence on fossil fuels.
example2_zh: 增加可再生能源投资，可能表明政府致力于减少对化石燃料的依赖。
collocations: give a signal｜发出信号 ; a weak signal｜微弱的信号 ; signal a change｜预示变化
tip_zh: 过去式英式常写signalled，美式常写signaled。

meanings_zh: n. 考试 | n. 检查；仔细审查
definition_en: a formal test of knowledge or ability | the act of looking at something carefully to assess it
example1_en: She felt relieved when her final examination was over.
example1_zh: 最后一场考试结束后，她松了一口气。
example2_en: A detailed examination of local housing conditions can help governments identify communities that need urgent support.
example2_zh: 对当地住房条件进行详细调查，可以帮助政府找出急需援助的社区。
collocations: take an examination｜参加考试 ; pass an examination｜通过考试 ; a medical examination｜体检 ; close examination｜仔细检查
tip_zh: 考试义口语常简称exam；检查义常接of。

meanings_zh: n. 硬纸板
definition_en: Thick, stiff paper used for boxes and packaging
example1_en: We cut the cardboard into shapes for a model house.
example1_zh: 我们把硬纸板剪成各种形状，用来制作房屋模型。
example2_en: Replacing plastic packaging with recycled cardboard can reduce waste and encourage more sustainable consumption.
example2_zh: 用再生硬纸板替代塑料包装可以减少废弃物，并促进更可持续的消费。
collocations: cardboard box｜纸板箱 ; recycled cardboard｜再生硬纸板 ; a sheet of cardboard｜一张硬纸板
tip_zh: 通常不可数；一张硬纸板说a sheet of cardboard。

meanings_zh: adj. 负责的；有责任的 | adj. 造成某事的；应担责的 | adj. 可靠的；有责任心的
definition_en: having a duty to manage or look after something | being the cause of something, especially something bad | sensible and trustworthy in your actions and decisions
example1_en: I'm responsible for feeding our cat every morning.
example1_zh: 我负责每天早晨喂我们家的猫。
example2_en: Governments are responsible for ensuring that all children have access to safe and affordable education.
example2_zh: 政府有责任确保所有儿童都能接受安全且负担得起的教育。
collocations: responsible for｜对……负责 ; responsible behaviour｜负责任的行为 ; hold someone responsible｜认定某人应担责
tip_zh: responsible for后接名词或动名词；to后接上级。

meanings_zh: adj. 电子的；电子设备的 | adj. 电子形式的；数字化的
definition_en: using circuits to control electrical signals | stored, sent, or accessed using computers
example1_en: Please switch off your electronic devices during the performance.
example1_zh: 演出期间请关闭电子设备。
example2_en: Electronic health records can help doctors share information efficiently, but strong safeguards are needed to protect patient privacy.
example2_zh: 电子健康档案能帮助医生高效共享信息，但必须采取有力措施保护患者隐私。
collocations: electronic devices｜电子设备 ; electronic records｜电子档案 ; electronic payment｜电子支付 ; electronic waste｜电子垃圾
tip_zh: electronic强调电子电路；electric泛指用电的。

meanings_zh: adj. 华氏温标的 | n. 华氏温标
definition_en: Using a temperature scale where water freezes at thirty-two degrees | The temperature scale with water boiling at two hundred twelve degrees
example1_en: The recipe says to bake at three hundred degrees Fahrenheit.
example1_zh: 食谱说要在华氏三百度的温度下烘烤。
example2_en: International weather reports may provide temperatures in both Fahrenheit and Celsius to serve different audiences.
example2_zh: 国际天气预报可能同时提供华氏和摄氏温度，以满足不同受众的需要。
collocations: degrees Fahrenheit｜华氏度 ; Fahrenheit scale｜华氏温标 ; convert Fahrenheit to Celsius｜将华氏温度换算为摄氏温度
tip_zh: 指华氏温标，并非温度计；首字母始终大写。

meanings_zh: adv. 大约；近似地
definition_en: Close to a particular amount, but not exactly.
example1_en: The walk to the lake takes approximately twenty minutes.
example1_zh: 步行到湖边大约需要二十分钟。
example2_en: Approximately half of the households surveyed reported using public transport at least once a week.
example2_zh: 受访家庭中，约有一半表示每周至少使用一次公共交通。
collocations: approximately equal｜大致相等 ; approximately half｜大约一半 ; approximately double｜大约两倍
tip_zh: 多放在数量前，语气比about更正式。

meanings_zh: n. 走廊；过道 | n. 狭长通道；走廊地带
definition_en: a long passage connecting rooms inside a building | a strip of land connecting areas for movement or transport
example1_en: Her footsteps echoed along the empty corridor after class.
example1_zh: 下课后，她的脚步声在空荡荡的走廊里回响。
example2_en: Wildlife corridors allow animals to move safely between habitats that roads and urban development have separated.
example2_zh: 野生动物廊道使动物能够在被道路和城市开发分隔的栖息地之间安全迁移。
collocations: a narrow corridor｜狭窄的走廊 ; along the corridor｜沿着走廊 ; a wildlife corridor｜野生动物廊道 ; a transport corridor｜交通走廊
tip_zh: 既指建筑内走廊，也指连接地区的狭长地带。

meanings_zh: v. 打钩；作滴答声 | n. 钩号；滴答声 | n. 蜱；壁虱
definition_en: To mark an item as correct, or make repeated clicking sounds. | A mark showing correctness, or a short sound a clock makes. | A small creature that attaches to skin and feeds on blood.
example1_en: The old clock ticks softly beside my bed.
example1_zh: 那只旧钟在我的床边轻轻地滴答作响。
example2_en: Participants should tick the appropriate boxes to indicate how frequently they use public transport.
example2_zh: 参与者应在相应方框内打钩，说明自己使用公共交通的频率。
collocations: tick a box｜在方框内打钩 ; tick off｜打钩标记 ; a tick bite｜蜱虫叮咬 ; a clock ticks｜钟表滴答作响
tip_zh: “打钩”英式常用tick，美式常用check。

meanings_zh: n. 飓风
definition_en: a powerful tropical storm with extremely strong winds
example1_en: We stayed indoors as the hurricane approached the coast.
example1_zh: 飓风逼近海岸时，我们待在室内。
example2_en: Coastal cities need stronger flood defences and reliable warning systems to protect residents when a hurricane approaches.
example2_zh: 沿海城市需要更坚固的防洪设施和可靠的预警系统，以在飓风来临时保护居民。
collocations: powerful hurricane｜强烈的飓风 ; hurricane season｜飓风季 ; hurricane warning｜飓风警报 ; hurricane damage｜飓风造成的破坏
tip_zh: hurricane和typhoon均属热带气旋，名称因海域而异。

meanings_zh: n. 《圣经》
definition_en: the collection of sacred writings used in Christianity
example1_en: She keeps a Bible on the shelf beside her bed.
example1_zh: 她在床边的架子上放着一本《圣经》。
example2_en: Studying the Bible can help students understand religious references in European literature and visual art.
example2_zh: 研读《圣经》可以帮助学生理解欧洲文学和视觉艺术中的宗教典故。
collocations: read the Bible｜阅读《圣经》 ; a Bible translation｜《圣经》译本 ; Bible study｜《圣经》研读
tip_zh: 指《圣经》时首字母大写，通常用the Bible。

meanings_zh: n. 警告；提醒 | n. 预兆；警示信号
definition_en: Something said or done to alert someone to danger or problems. | A sign that something harmful or unpleasant may happen.
example1_en: We turned back after the guide's warning about slippery rocks.
example1_zh: 听到向导提醒岩石湿滑后，我们折返了。
example2_en: Effective flood warning systems allow residents to leave dangerous areas before roads become impossible to use.
example2_zh: 有效的洪水预警系统能让居民在道路无法通行前撤离危险区域。
collocations: issue a warning｜发出警告 ; early warning system｜预警系统 ; without warning｜毫无预警地 ; heed a warning｜听从警告
tip_zh: warning是名词，也可作warn的现在分词。

meanings_zh: v. 复述；重新讲述
definition_en: to tell a story or describe events again
example1_en: My grandmother retells her favourite story every winter.
example1_zh: 奶奶每年冬天都会再讲一遍她最喜欢的故事。
example2_en: Asking students to retell a story in their own words can improve comprehension and speaking skills.
example2_zh: 让学生用自己的话复述故事，可以提高理解能力和口语技能。
collocations: retell a story｜复述故事 ; retell events｜重述事件 ; retell in your own words｜用自己的话复述
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为retold。

meanings_zh: n. 扬声器；扩音器
definition_en: A device that makes recorded or transmitted sound audible
example1_en: A voice from the loudspeaker announced our train's arrival.
example1_zh: 扩音器里传来播报我们列车到站的声音。
example2_en: Public transport stations use loudspeaker systems to communicate urgent safety information to large numbers of passengers.
example2_zh: 公共交通车站利用扩音系统向大量乘客传达紧急安全信息。
collocations: loudspeaker system｜扩音系统 ; over the loudspeaker｜通过扩音器 ; portable loudspeaker｜便携式扬声器
tip_zh: loudspeaker指设备；speaker还可指说话者。

meanings_zh: n. 网；网状物 | adj. 净的；扣除费用后的 | v. 净赚；获得
definition_en: material made of crossing threads with spaces between them | remaining after costs, taxes, or other amounts have been deducted | to earn as profit or successfully obtain something
example1_en: A small silver fish wriggled inside the fishing net.
example1_zh: 一条银色的小鱼在渔网里扭动。
example2_en: The company increased its net profit by reducing energy consumption rather than raising prices for customers.
example2_zh: 这家公司通过减少能源消耗而非提高售价来增加净利润。
collocations: fishing net｜渔网 ; net profit｜净利润 ; net income｜净收入 ; net gain｜净增益
tip_zh: net指扣除成本或税款后的净额；gross指扣除前的总额。

meanings_zh: n. 递送；交付 | n. 分娩 | n. 演讲方式；表达方式
definition_en: the act of taking goods or messages to someone | the process of giving birth to a baby | the way someone speaks or performs in public
example1_en: Our grocery delivery arrived just before we started cooking.
example1_zh: 我们订购的食品杂货在开始做饭前刚好送到了。
example2_en: The growing demand for home delivery has increased traffic congestion in many urban neighbourhoods.
example2_zh: 不断增长的送货上门需求加剧了许多城市社区的交通拥堵。
collocations: free delivery｜免费配送 ; delivery service｜配送服务 ; delivery driver｜送货司机 ; a smooth delivery｜顺利分娩
tip_zh: delivery指递送服务或过程；deliver是动词。

meanings_zh: n. 大学校园；校区
definition_en: the grounds and buildings belonging to a university or college
example1_en: We found a quiet bench near the campus library.
example1_zh: 我们在校园图书馆附近找到了一张安静的长椅。
example2_en: Providing affordable accommodation on campus can help students spend less time commuting and more time studying.
example2_zh: 提供价格合理的校内住宿可以帮助学生减少通勤时间，增加学习时间。
collocations: on campus｜在校园内 ; off campus｜在校外 ; university campus｜大学校园 ; campus facilities｜校园设施
tip_zh: 表示“在校园内”通常用on campus，不加冠词。

meanings_zh: n. 相似；相似点
definition_en: The state of being alike, or a shared feature
example1_en: The similarity between these two jackets surprised me.
example1_zh: 这两件夹克如此相似，让我很惊讶。
example2_en: Despite their geographical distance, the two regions show striking similarities in traditional farming methods.
example2_zh: 尽管地理位置相距遥远，这两个地区的传统耕作方式却有着惊人的相似之处。
collocations: striking similarity｜惊人的相似 ; similarity between｜……之间的相似性 ; bear a similarity to｜与……相似
tip_zh: 相似性常不可数；具体相似点可数，常用复数。

meanings_zh: n. 武器；兵器
definition_en: an object used for fighting or causing physical harm
example1_en: The museum displays an ancient weapon behind thick glass.
example1_zh: 博物馆将一件古代兵器陈列在厚玻璃后。
example2_en: Stricter controls on weapon sales may help governments improve public safety and reduce violent crime.
example2_zh: 更严格地管控武器销售可能有助于政府改善公共安全并减少暴力犯罪。
collocations: nuclear weapon｜核武器 ; carry a weapon｜携带武器 ; weapon sales｜武器销售
tip_zh: 可数名词；武器的总称也可用weaponry。

meanings_zh: adv. 就个人而言 | adv. 亲自；本人 | adv. 针对个人地
definition_en: used to introduce your own opinion or preference | by a particular person rather than someone acting for them | as relating to someone's character rather than their actions
example1_en: Personally, I prefer walking to taking the bus.
example1_zh: 就我个人而言，我更喜欢步行而不是乘公交车。
example2_en: Personally, I believe that public libraries remain essential because they provide free access to reliable information.
example2_zh: 我个人认为，公共图书馆仍不可或缺，因为它们让人们免费获取可靠信息。
collocations: personally speaking｜就个人而言 ; take something personally｜认为某事针对自己 ; personally responsible｜负有个人责任 ; know someone personally｜与某人本人相识
tip_zh: take it personally指把事情看作针对自己。

meanings_zh: n. 喉咙；咽喉
definition_en: the passage inside the neck through which air and food pass
example1_en: My throat felt dry after talking all afternoon.
example1_zh: 说了一下午话后，我觉得喉咙很干。
example2_en: Poor air quality can irritate the throat and worsen breathing problems, particularly among children and older adults.
example2_zh: 空气质量差会刺激咽喉并加重呼吸问题，儿童和老年人尤其容易受到影响。
collocations: a sore throat｜喉咙痛 ; clear your throat｜清嗓子 ; throat infection｜咽喉感染
tip_zh: 喉咙痛用have a sore throat，注意冠词a。

meanings_zh: v. 敢于；胆敢 | v. 激将；挑战 | n. 激将；挑战
definition_en: to have enough courage to do something | to challenge someone to do something requiring courage | a challenge to do something difficult or frightening
example1_en: I finally dared to sing in front of everyone.
example1_zh: 我终于敢在大家面前唱歌了。
example2_en: Students are more likely to dare to question established ideas when teachers welcome respectful disagreement.
example2_zh: 当教师欢迎有礼貌的不同意见时，学生更有可能敢于质疑既有观念。
collocations: dare to ask｜敢于提问 ; dare someone to do something｜激某人做某事 ; not dare｜不敢 ; for a dare｜为了应对激将
tip_zh: 敢做用dare to do；激将用dare sb to do。

meanings_zh: adj. 自信的 | adj. 确信的；有把握的
definition_en: believing in your own ability to succeed | certain that something is true or will happen
example1_en: After weeks of practice, I felt confident on stage.
example1_zh: 经过几周练习，我站在台上时感到很自信。
example2_en: Students become more confident when teachers provide constructive feedback and opportunities to practise new skills.
example2_zh: 当教师提供建设性反馈和练习新技能的机会时，学生会变得更自信。
collocations: feel confident｜感到自信 ; confident about the future｜对未来有信心 ; confident that｜确信
tip_zh: confident是形容词；confidence是名词。

meanings_zh: n. 箭头；箭头符号 | n. 箭
definition_en: a pointed symbol showing direction | a thin pointed object shot from a bow
example1_en: Follow the arrow on the floor to the exit.
example1_zh: 沿着地板上的箭头走到出口。
example2_en: Clear arrows on station floors can improve passenger flow and reduce confusion during busy commuting periods.
example2_zh: 车站地面上清晰的箭头可以改善客流，减少通勤高峰期的混乱。
collocations: follow the arrow｜沿箭头方向走 ; an arrow points to｜箭头指向 ; bow and arrow｜弓箭 ; shoot an arrow｜射箭
tip_zh: arrow既指弓射出的“箭”，也指示方向的“箭头”。

meanings_zh: n. 成绩；等级 | n. 年级 | v. 评分；分级
definition_en: a mark showing achievement, or a level of quality | a school year level, especially in the American system | to assess work or sort things by quality
example1_en: I got a good grade on my science project.
example1_zh: 我的科学课项目得了个好成绩。
example2_en: Teachers should grade assignments consistently so that students understand how their performance is assessed across different subjects.
example2_zh: 教师应按一致的标准给作业评分，让学生了解不同学科如何评估他们的表现。
collocations: get a good grade｜取得好成绩 ; grade assignments｜给作业评分 ; in sixth grade｜在六年级 ; high-grade materials｜优质材料
tip_zh: 表示年级时多用于美式英语；英式英语常用year。

meanings_zh: n. 剧集的一集 | n. 一段经历；事件 | n. 疾病的一次发作
definition_en: one part of a television or radio series | a particular event or period within a longer story | a period when someone experiences a particular illness or symptom
example1_en: We watched the final episode together after dinner.
example1_zh: 晚饭后，我们一起看了最后一集。
example2_en: Each episode of the documentary explores how urban development affects wildlife in different parts of the world.
example2_zh: 这部纪录片每一集都探讨城市发展如何影响世界不同地区的野生动物。
collocations: the final episode｜最后一集 ; an episode of｜……的一集 ; a pilot episode｜试播集 ; a brief episode｜一段短暂经历
tip_zh: episode指一集；series指整部系列或连续剧。

meanings_zh: n. 框；框架；骨架 | v. 给……装框 | v. 组织表达；构思
definition_en: a structure that surrounds or supports something | to put a picture or similar object inside a frame | to express or present something in a particular way
example1_en: We chose a wooden frame for our family photograph.
example1_zh: 我们为全家福选了一个木制相框。
example2_en: The way journalists frame environmental issues can influence public attitudes towards conservation and government policy.
example2_zh: 记者呈现环境议题的方式会影响公众对环境保护和政府政策的态度。
collocations: a picture frame｜相框 ; a bicycle frame｜自行车车架 ; frame a question｜组织问题的措辞 ; a frame of reference｜参照体系
tip_zh: frame既可指实体框架，也可指组织表达的方式。

meanings_zh: n. 风景；景色 | n. 舞台布景
definition_en: The natural features of a place considered for their beauty. | Painted backgrounds and structures that create a play's setting.
example1_en: We stopped by the lake to admire the scenery.
example1_zh: 我们在湖边停下来欣赏风景。
example2_en: Protecting natural scenery can attract responsible tourism while preserving valuable habitats for local wildlife.
example2_zh: 保护自然风景可以吸引负责任的旅游活动，同时为当地野生动物保留宝贵的栖息地。
collocations: beautiful scenery｜美丽的风景 ; mountain scenery｜山间景色 ; spectacular scenery｜壮丽的景色 ; stage scenery｜舞台布景
tip_zh: scenery是不可数名词，不说a scenery或sceneries。

meanings_zh: n. 恋人；情人 | n. 爱好者
definition_en: Someone in a romantic or sexual relationship with another person. | Someone who enjoys or admires something very much.
example1_en: The two lovers walked hand in hand beside the river.
example1_zh: 这对恋人手牵着手沿河散步。
example2_en: Public gardens offer nature lovers valuable opportunities to observe wildlife without leaving the city.
example2_zh: 公共花园为自然爱好者提供了不出城就能观察野生动物的宝贵机会。
collocations: young lovers｜年轻恋人 ; a music lover｜音乐爱好者 ; a nature lover｜自然爱好者
tip_zh: 表爱好者常用名词＋lover；单用可能指情人。

meanings_zh: n. 肘；肘部 | v. 用肘推挤
definition_en: the joint where your arm bends | to push someone or something with your elbow
example1_en: I knocked my elbow against the kitchen door.
example1_zh: 我的胳膊肘撞到了厨房门上。
example2_en: Passengers sometimes elbow their way onto crowded trains, making public transport uncomfortable for others.
example2_zh: 乘客有时用肘推挤着登上拥挤的列车，让其他人乘车时感到不适。
collocations: bend your elbow｜弯曲手肘 ; rest your elbows on｜将双肘搁在……上 ; elbow your way through｜用肘推挤着穿过
tip_zh: elbow作动词时常指用肘推挤着前进。

meanings_zh: n. 文具；信纸信封
definition_en: Materials used for writing, such as paper, pens, and envelopes.
example1_en: I bought some stationery for my new evening class.
example1_zh: 我为新报的夜校课程买了些文具。
example2_en: Providing basic stationery can help disadvantaged students participate more fully in classroom activities and complete assignments.
example2_zh: 提供基本文具可以帮助弱势学生更充分地参与课堂活动并完成作业。
collocations: office stationery｜办公文具 ; stationery supplies｜文具用品 ; stationery shop｜文具店
tip_zh: 不可数；勿与stationary（静止的）混淆。

meanings_zh: conj. 虽然；尽管 | adv. 不过；然而
definition_en: Despite the fact that something is true. | Used to introduce a contrasting point, often at sentence end.
example1_en: Though it was raining, we still walked to the bakery.
example1_zh: 虽然下着雨，我们还是步行去了面包店。
example2_en: Though online courses offer greater flexibility, many students still benefit from direct interaction with teachers.
example2_zh: 虽然线上课程更加灵活，但许多学生仍能从与教师的直接交流中获益。
collocations: even though｜即使；尽管 ; as though｜仿佛；好像
tip_zh: 引导让步从句时不与but连用；句末可表“不过”。

meanings_zh: n. 心理压力；催迫 | n. 压力；压强 | v. 迫使；向…施压
definition_en: Worry or demands that make someone feel forced to act | Force pressing on a surface or within a substance | Try to make someone do something through strong persuasion
example1_en: I feel pressure to answer work messages immediately.
example1_zh: 我觉得自己必须立即回复工作消息，这让我有压力。
example2_en: Employers should avoid putting excessive pressure on staff, as this can damage both health and productivity.
example2_zh: 雇主应避免给员工施加过大压力，因为这既可能损害健康，也可能降低生产力。
collocations: under pressure｜承受压力 ; put pressure on｜向…施压 ; blood pressure｜血压 ; pressure someone into doing something｜迫使某人做某事
tip_zh: under pressure表示承压；动词常接into doing。

meanings_zh: n. 面粉；谷物粉 | v. 撒面粉于
definition_en: powder made by grinding grain, used especially in baking | to cover a surface or food lightly with flour
example1_en: Add the flour slowly and stir until smooth.
example1_zh: 慢慢加入面粉，搅拌至顺滑。
example2_en: Replacing some refined flour with wholemeal flour can increase the fibre content of everyday foods.
example2_zh: 用全麦面粉替代部分精制面粉，可以提高日常食品中的膳食纤维含量。
collocations: plain flour｜普通面粉 ; wholemeal flour｜全麦面粉 ; rice flour｜米粉 ; flour a surface｜在台面上撒面粉
tip_zh: flour通常不可数，且与flower同音。

meanings_zh: n. 健身锻炼；健身操
definition_en: Physical exercises done to stay healthy and fit.
example1_en: My aunt attends keep-fit classes at the community centre.
example1_zh: 我姑姑在社区中心参加健身课。
example2_en: Affordable keep-fit classes can encourage older adults to exercise regularly and maintain social connections within their communities.
example2_zh: 收费低廉的健身课可以鼓励老年人定期锻炼，并保持社区内的社交联系。
collocations: keep-fit classes｜健身课 ; keep-fit exercises｜健身运动
tip_zh: 主要用于英式英语；动词短语keep fit不加连字符。

meanings_zh: n. 晒伤
definition_en: red, painful skin caused by too much exposure to sunlight
example1_en: I got sunburn after spending all afternoon outside.
example1_zh: 我在外面待了一整个下午，结果晒伤了。
example2_en: Public health campaigns should explain that preventing sunburn requires suitable clothing and shade as well as sunscreen.
example2_zh: 公共卫生宣传应说明，预防晒伤不仅需要防晒霜，还需要合适的衣物和遮阴。
collocations: get sunburn｜被晒伤 ; severe sunburn｜严重晒伤 ; prevent sunburn｜预防晒伤
tip_zh: 英式常说get sunburn；美式也常说get a sunburn。

meanings_zh: n. 注射 | n. 资金等的注入
definition_en: Putting medicine into the body using a needle. | The addition of money or resources to improve something.
example1_en: The nurse gave me an injection in my arm.
example1_zh: 护士在我的手臂上打了一针。
example2_en: An injection of public funding could help local libraries modernise their facilities and expand community services.
example2_zh: 注入公共资金可以帮助当地图书馆更新设施并拓展社区服务。
collocations: give an injection｜打针 ; receive an injection｜接受注射 ; a cash injection｜一笔现金注入 ; an injection of funding｜资金的注入
tip_zh: 注入资金可说an injection of cash，属于比喻用法。

meanings_zh: n. 表演者；演出者 | n. 表现出某种水平的人或事物
definition_en: someone who entertains an audience by acting, singing, or playing | a person or thing achieving a particular level of success
example1_en: A street performer juggled oranges beside the crowded market.
example1_zh: 一名街头艺人在拥挤的市场旁抛接橙子。
example2_en: Public funding can help young performers develop their skills and bring live entertainment to underserved communities.
example2_zh: 公共资金可以帮助年轻表演者提升技能，并将现场演出带到文化服务不足的社区。
collocations: a street performer｜街头艺人 ; a live performer｜现场表演者 ; a top performer｜表现优异者
tip_zh: 不仅指演员；top performer也可指业绩优异的员工。

meanings_zh: n. 烟囱
definition_en: a structure that carries smoke from a fire outside
example1_en: Smoke rose from the chimney into the cold evening air.
example1_zh: 烟从烟囱升起，飘入傍晚寒冷的空气中。
example2_en: Installing filters in factory chimneys can reduce the amount of harmful particles released into the atmosphere.
example2_zh: 在工厂烟囱中安装过滤装置，可以减少排入大气的有害颗粒物。
collocations: factory chimney｜工厂烟囱 ; chimney pot｜烟囱顶管 ; chimney sweep｜烟囱清扫工
tip_zh: 复数直接加-s：chimneys，不改y为i。

meanings_zh: n. 长度 | n. 持续时间
definition_en: The distance from one end of something to the other. | The amount of time something lasts.
example1_en: We measured the length of the table before buying chairs.
example1_zh: 我们买椅子之前量了桌子的长度。
example2_en: The length of the school day can affect both student concentration and family routines.
example2_zh: 每天在校时间的长短既会影响学生的注意力，也会影响家庭的日常安排。
collocations: in length｜在长度上 ; the length of time｜时间的长短 ; at length｜详细地
tip_zh: at length常指“详细地”，不是“在长度上”。

meanings_zh: v. 认出；识别 | v. 承认；意识到 | v. 正式认可；表彰
definition_en: Identify someone or something known or seen before. | Accept or understand that something is true or important. | Officially accept someone's status, qualifications, or achievements.
example1_en: I recognized my old teacher by her familiar laugh.
example1_zh: 我听到熟悉的笑声，认出了以前的老师。
example2_en: Employers should recognize the value of practical experience when assessing candidates who lack formal qualifications.
example2_zh: 评估缺乏正式学历或资质的求职者时，雇主应认可实践经验的价值。
collocations: recognize a face｜认出一张脸 ; recognize the importance of｜认识到……的重要性 ; recognize someone as｜认可某人为…… ; internationally recognized｜国际公认的
tip_zh: 英式也常拼作recognise；表示“认出”时通常不用进行时。

meanings_zh: n. 震惊；意外打击 | v. 使震惊 | n. 休克；电击
definition_en: a strong feeling of surprise caused by something unexpected | to make someone feel very surprised or upset | a dangerous medical collapse, or an electrical jolt through the body
example1_en: The sudden rise in rent came as a shock.
example1_zh: 租金突然上涨，让人十分震惊。
example2_en: Moving abroad can cause culture shock, particularly when everyday customs differ greatly from those at home.
example2_zh: 移居国外可能带来文化冲击，尤其是当日常习俗与本国差异很大时。
collocations: come as a shock｜令人震惊 ; culture shock｜文化冲击 ; electric shock｜电击 ; in a state of shock｜处于震惊状态
tip_zh: 人感到震惊用shocked；事物令人震惊用shocking。

meanings_zh: v. 临时照看小孩
definition_en: To look after children while their parents are away.
example1_en: Could you baby-sit for us on Saturday evening?
example1_zh: 你能在周六晚上帮我们照看孩子吗？
example2_en: Relatives who baby-sit regularly can reduce childcare costs and help parents remain in employment.
example2_zh: 经常帮忙照看孩子的亲属可以降低育儿成本，帮助父母继续工作。
collocations: baby-sit for someone｜替某人照看孩子 ; baby-sit the children｜临时照看孩子
tip_zh: 更常写作babysit；过去式为baby-sat。

meanings_zh: adj. 黏的；有黏性的 | adj. 湿热的；闷热的 | adj. 棘手的；难处理的
definition_en: able to stick to things, often because of a substance | uncomfortably warm and damp | difficult or awkward to deal with
example1_en: My fingers were sticky after eating the honey cake.
example1_zh: 吃完蜂蜜蛋糕后，我的手指黏糊糊的。
example2_en: Food packaging often contains sticky residues that must be removed before the materials can be recycled effectively.
example2_zh: 食品包装上常有黏性残留物，必须先清除才能有效回收材料。
collocations: sticky tape｜胶带 ; sticky fingers｜黏糊糊的手指 ; a sticky situation｜棘手的局面 ; hot and sticky｜湿热的
tip_zh: sticky weather指湿热天气；sticky situation指困境。

meanings_zh: n. 症状 | n. 征兆；问题的表现
definition_en: a physical or mental change that suggests an illness | a sign that an underlying problem exists
example1_en: A sore throat was her first symptom of illness.
example1_zh: 喉咙痛是她生病后出现的第一个症状。
example2_en: High staff turnover can be a symptom of poor management rather than a shortage of skilled workers.
example2_zh: 员工流动率高可能反映管理不善，而非技术工人短缺。
collocations: common symptom｜常见症状 ; symptom of illness｜疾病症状 ; relieve symptoms｜缓解症状
tip_zh: 常用a symptom of；症状缓解用relieve symptoms。

meanings_zh: n. 蜜月；蜜月旅行 | n. 初期的短暂和谐 | v. 度蜜月
definition_en: A holiday taken by a couple just after their wedding. | An early period when a relationship or situation goes well. | To take a holiday together just after getting married.
example1_en: They spent their honeymoon in a quiet seaside village.
example1_zh: 他们在一个安静的海边村庄度过了蜜月。
example2_en: Popular honeymoon destinations can support local economies, but excessive tourism may damage fragile coastal environments.
example2_zh: 热门蜜月目的地能促进当地经济，但过度旅游可能破坏脆弱的沿海环境。
collocations: on honeymoon｜在度蜜月 ; honeymoon destination｜蜜月目的地 ; honeymoon period｜蜜月期
tip_zh: 英式常说on honeymoon，美式常说on a honeymoon。

meanings_zh: v. 翻译 | v. 转化；转变为
definition_en: To express words or writing in another language | To change something into a different form or practical result
example1_en: Could you translate this recipe into English for me?
example1_zh: 你能帮我把这份食谱翻译成英语吗？
example2_en: Governments must translate environmental commitments into practical policies that encourage businesses to reduce emissions.
example2_zh: 政府必须把环保承诺转化为切实的政策，鼓励企业减少排放。
collocations: translate into English｜翻译成英语 ; translate from Chinese｜从中文翻译 ; translate ideas into action｜将想法付诸行动
tip_zh: 从某语言译成另一语言：translate from…into…。

meanings_zh: n. 小木屋；简易小屋 | n. 船舱；机舱
definition_en: A small, simple house, often built from wood. | A room on a ship or passenger space in an aircraft.
example1_en: We spent the weekend in a cabin beside the lake.
example1_zh: 我们在湖边的一间小木屋里度过了周末。
example2_en: Holiday cabins in protected forests should be carefully managed to limit their impact on local wildlife.
example2_zh: 保护林区内的度假小屋应得到妥善管理，以限制其对当地野生动物的影响。
collocations: a log cabin｜原木小屋 ; cabin crew｜客舱乘务员 ; a passenger cabin｜客舱 ; cabin baggage｜随身行李
tip_zh: 既指陆地上的小屋，也指船舱或飞机客舱。

meanings_zh: n. 努力；精力 | n. 尝试；有组织的行动
definition_en: physical or mental energy used to achieve something | an attempt or organised activity intended to achieve a goal
example1_en: It took considerable effort to push the sofa upstairs.
example1_zh: 把沙发推上楼费了好大力气。
example2_en: Reducing household waste requires a joint effort from consumers, manufacturers and local authorities to change everyday practices.
example2_zh: 减少家庭垃圾需要消费者、制造商和地方政府共同努力，改变日常做法。
collocations: make an effort｜作出努力 ; put effort into｜投入精力于 ; a joint effort｜共同努力 ; considerable effort｜相当大的努力
tip_zh: 表示精力时不可数；表示一次尝试时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 拳击运动员
definition_en: A person who competes in boxing.
example1_en: The boxer pulled on her gloves before training.
example1_zh: 这位拳击运动员在训练前戴上了手套。
example2_en: A professional boxer needs disciplined training and adequate recovery time to maintain both performance and long-term health.
example2_zh: 职业拳击运动员需要有规律的训练和充分的恢复时间，以保持竞技状态和长期健康。
collocations: professional boxer｜职业拳击运动员 ; amateur boxer｜业余拳击运动员 ; heavyweight boxer｜重量级拳击运动员
tip_zh: box作动词可表示打拳；boxer是拳击运动员。

meanings_zh: n. 电池；蓄电池 | n. 一系列；一组
definition_en: A device that stores energy and supplies electricity. | A large set of similar things, especially tests or questions.
example1_en: The torch needs a new battery before our trip.
example1_zh: 出发旅行前，这只手电筒需要换一节新电池。
example2_en: Improved battery technology could make electric vehicles more affordable and reduce dependence on fossil fuels.
example2_zh: 电池技术的进步可以降低电动汽车的价格，并减少对化石燃料的依赖。
collocations: a rechargeable battery｜可充电电池 ; battery life｜电池续航时间 ; charge a battery｜给电池充电 ; a battery of tests｜一系列测试
tip_zh: 复数为batteries；a battery of可指一系列测试。

meanings_zh: n. 商品；货物 | n. 个人财物
definition_en: Things produced for sale or transported for trade. | Movable possessions belonging to a person.
example1_en: The shop sells handmade goods from nearby villages.
example1_zh: 这家店出售附近村庄制作的手工商品。
example2_en: Transporting goods by rail rather than road can lower emissions and reduce congestion in urban areas.
example2_zh: 采用铁路而非公路运输货物可以降低排放，缓解城市拥堵。
collocations: consumer goods｜消费品 ; luxury goods｜奢侈品 ; household goods｜家用物品 ; transport goods｜运输货物
tip_zh: goods是复数名词；一件商品可说an item。

meanings_zh: v. 提交；呈递 | v. 屈服；服从
definition_en: To send a document or application for consideration | To accept another person's authority or control
example1_en: Please submit your application before the end of Friday.
example1_zh: 请在周五结束前提交申请。
example2_en: Researchers must submit their findings for independent review before these can be published in reputable academic journals.
example2_zh: 研究人员必须先提交研究结果接受独立评审，之后才能在有良好声誉的学术期刊上发表。
collocations: submit an application｜提交申请 ; submit a report｜提交报告 ; submit something to｜向……提交某物 ; submit to authority｜服从权威
tip_zh: 过去式 submitted；submit sth to sb 表示向某人提交。

meanings_zh: adj. ……岁的 | adj. 年迈的
definition_en: Having reached a particular age. | Very old, especially when describing people.
example1_en: The swimming class welcomes children aged six and above.
example1_zh: 这门游泳课欢迎六岁及以上的儿童参加。
example2_en: Public libraries can support children aged five to twelve by providing free reading activities during school holidays.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆可以在学校假期提供免费阅读活动，为五至十二岁的儿童提供支持。
collocations: children aged five｜五岁的儿童 ; aged eighteen and over｜年满十八岁的 ; aged relatives｜年迈的亲属
tip_zh: 表岁数读/eɪdʒd/；表年迈读/ˈeɪdʒɪd/。

meanings_zh: adj. 当前的；现行的 | n. 水流；气流；电流
definition_en: happening, existing, or being used now | a continuous movement of water, air, or electricity
example1_en: My current flat is much closer to work.
example1_zh: 我现在住的公寓离上班的地方近多了。
example2_en: Current policies may need revision as cities face increasing pressure on housing and transport.
example2_zh: 随着城市住房和交通压力不断增加，现行政策可能需要调整。
collocations: the current situation｜当前形势 ; current affairs｜时事 ; a strong current｜强劲水流 ; electric current｜电流
tip_zh: 形容词指当前的；名词可指水流或电流。

meanings_zh: adj. 震惊的；惊愕的 | adj. 愤慨的；十分反感的
definition_en: Very surprised and upset by something unexpected. | Feeling strong disapproval at something offensive or wrong.
example1_en: I was shocked to find water flooding the kitchen.
example1_zh: 发现厨房里到处是水，我惊呆了。
example2_en: Residents were shocked by the sudden closure of the only hospital serving their rural community.
example2_zh: 当地居民对唯一服务于他们乡村社区的医院突然关闭感到震惊。
collocations: deeply shocked｜深感震惊的 ; shocked by the news｜被消息震惊 ; shocked to hear｜听到后震惊
tip_zh: shocked形容人的感受；shocking形容令人震惊的事物。

meanings_zh: adj. 筋疲力尽的 | adj. 耗尽的；枯竭的
definition_en: extremely tired and lacking energy | completely used up, with nothing remaining
example1_en: After carrying those boxes upstairs, I felt completely exhausted.
example1_zh: 把那些箱子搬上楼后，我感到筋疲力尽。
example2_en: Employees who are constantly exhausted may struggle to concentrate, increasing the risk of mistakes at work.
example2_zh: 长期疲惫不堪的员工可能难以集中注意力，从而增加工作中出错的风险。
collocations: feel exhausted｜感到筋疲力尽 ; physically exhausted｜身体疲惫不堪 ; mentally exhausted｜心力交瘁 ; exhausted resources｜耗尽的资源
tip_zh: 人感到累用exhausted；事情令人累用exhausting。

meanings_zh: n. 享受；乐趣
definition_en: The pleasure you get from doing or experiencing something
example1_en: My grandfather gets great enjoyment from feeding the birds.
example1_zh: 我祖父从喂鸟中获得了很大的乐趣。
example2_en: Schools should encourage reading for enjoyment rather than focusing exclusively on examination performance.
example2_zh: 学校应鼓励学生享受阅读的乐趣，而不是只关注考试成绩。
collocations: get enjoyment from｜从……中获得乐趣 ; for enjoyment｜为了享受乐趣 ; pure enjoyment｜纯粹的享受
tip_zh: 通常不可数；表示从某事获得乐趣可用get enjoyment from。

meanings_zh: n. 相信；信心 | n. 信念；信仰
definition_en: Confidence that something is true or someone is capable. | An idea accepted as true, especially about life or religion.
example1_en: Her belief in me helped me try again.
example1_zh: 她对我的信心让我愿意再试一次。
example2_en: The belief that education improves social mobility influences government spending priorities in many countries.
example2_zh: 教育能促进社会流动的这一信念影响着许多国家的政府支出重点。
collocations: belief in someone｜对某人的信任 ; religious beliefs｜宗教信仰 ; a widely held belief｜普遍持有的看法 ; contrary to popular belief｜与普遍看法相反
tip_zh: belief in表示信任或信仰；belief that后接具体看法。

meanings_zh: v. 爆炸；使爆炸 | v. 激增；迅速扩大 | v. 突然爆发情绪
definition_en: To burst violently, or cause something to burst violently. | To increase extremely quickly in size, amount, or popularity. | To express strong feelings suddenly and forcefully.
example1_en: We watched colourful fireworks explode above the lake.
example1_zh: 我们看着五彩烟花在湖面上空绽放。
example2_en: Demand for online courses has exploded as more adults seek flexible opportunities to develop new skills.
example2_zh: 随着更多成年人寻求灵活的机会来培养新技能，在线课程的需求激增。
collocations: explode into flames｜突然起火 ; explode with anger｜勃然大怒 ; demand explodes｜需求激增 ; a firework explodes｜烟花炸开
tip_zh: 爆炸物作主语常用主动形式，不必用被动。

meanings_zh: n. 社区；当地居民 | n. 群体；共同体
definition_en: people living in the same area | people sharing interests, beliefs, or a particular background
example1_en: Our community gathers every spring to clean the park.
example1_zh: 我们社区的居民每年春天都会一起清理公园。
example2_en: Public libraries strengthen the local community by providing free learning spaces and opportunities for social interaction.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆提供免费的学习空间和社交机会，从而增强当地社区的凝聚力。
collocations: local community｜当地社区 ; community centre｜社区活动中心 ; scientific community｜科学界 ; sense of community｜社区归属感
tip_zh: 既指同地区居民，也指有共同背景或兴趣的群体。

meanings_zh: n. 意图；打算；目的
definition_en: Something that you plan or mean to do.
example1_en: I had no intention of staying out so late.
example1_zh: 我原本没打算在外面待到这么晚。
example2_en: The government announced its intention to expand public transport in order to reduce traffic congestion.
example2_zh: 政府宣布计划扩大公共交通服务，以缓解交通拥堵。
collocations: have no intention of｜无意做… ; with the intention of｜抱着…的目的 ; announce an intention to｜宣布做…的打算 ; good intentions｜善意
tip_zh: 用intention to do或intention of doing。

meanings_zh: adj. 严格的；严厉的 | adj. 严谨的；严格限定的
definition_en: requiring rules to be obeyed and standards to be met | following an exact meaning or limit without exceptions
example1_en: Our coach is strict about arriving on time.
example1_zh: 我们的教练对准时到场要求很严格。
example2_en: Strict environmental regulations can encourage manufacturers to adopt cleaner technologies and reduce harmful industrial emissions.
example2_zh: 严格的环境法规可以促使制造商采用更清洁的技术，减少有害工业排放。
collocations: strict rules｜严格的规定 ; strict about punctuality｜严格要求守时 ; strict with children｜对孩子严格 ; in the strict sense｜严格意义上
tip_zh: 对人严格用with；对事情要求严格用about。

meanings_zh: adj. 令人害怕的；骇人的
definition_en: Making someone feel afraid.
example1_en: The sudden thunder was frightening, but our dog stayed calm.
example1_zh: 突然响起的雷声很吓人，但我们的狗依然很镇定。
example2_en: Experiencing a major flood can be frightening, especially for children who have never faced a natural disaster.
example2_zh: 遭遇大洪水可能令人恐惧，尤其是对从未经历过自然灾害的儿童而言。
collocations: frightening experience｜可怕的经历 ; frightening thought｜令人害怕的想法 ; frightening prospect｜令人担忧的前景
tip_zh: frightening指事物吓人；frightened指人感到害怕。

meanings_zh: n. 小路；跑道；轨道 | v. 追踪；监测 | n. 足迹；车辙
definition_en: A path or course for walking, running, or trains. | To follow movement or monitor changes over time. | A mark left by a person, animal, or vehicle.
example1_en: We followed a narrow track through the pine forest.
example1_zh: 我们沿着一条狭窄的小路穿过松林。
example2_en: Researchers use satellite technology to track animal movements and identify habitats that require greater protection.
example2_zh: 研究人员利用卫星技术追踪动物活动，并确定需要加强保护的栖息地。
collocations: a railway track｜铁路轨道 ; a running track｜跑道 ; track progress｜跟踪进展 ; keep track of｜持续了解；记录
tip_zh: keep track of指持续掌握；lose track of指失去线索。

meanings_zh: adj. 北部的；北方的
definition_en: In, from, or relating to the north.
example1_en: My grandparents live in a quiet northern village.
example1_zh: 我的祖父母住在北方一个安静的村庄。
example2_en: Northern regions often face higher heating costs, making energy efficiency particularly important for local households.
example2_zh: 北部地区的供暖费用往往较高，因此提高能源效率对当地家庭尤其重要。
collocations: northern regions｜北部地区 ; the northern hemisphere｜北半球 ; the northern coast｜北部海岸
tip_zh: northern是形容词，常置于region、coast等名词前。

meanings_zh: conj. 除非；如果不
definition_en: except if; if something does not happen or is untrue
example1_en: We will eat outside unless it starts to rain.
example1_zh: 除非开始下雨，否则我们就在外面吃饭。
example2_en: Public transport will remain unpopular unless local authorities improve its reliability and make fares more affordable.
example2_zh: 除非地方政府提高公共交通的可靠性并降低票价，否则它仍不会受欢迎。
collocations: unless otherwise stated｜除非另有说明 ; unless absolutely necessary｜除非绝对必要 ; unless circumstances change｜除非情况有变
tip_zh: 表将来条件时，unless从句通常用一般现在时。

meanings_zh: adj. 珍贵的；贵重的 | adj. 珍爱的；宝贵的
definition_en: Worth a lot of money or deserving great care. | Deeply valued because of personal importance or limited availability.
example1_en: She keeps her precious necklace in a velvet box.
example1_zh: 她把珍贵的项链放在一个天鹅绒盒子里。
example2_en: Fresh water is a precious resource that requires careful management as populations grow and temperatures rise.
example2_zh: 随着人口增长和气温上升，淡水作为宝贵资源需要得到谨慎管理。
collocations: precious metals｜贵金属 ; precious stones｜宝石 ; precious memories｜珍贵的回忆 ; precious resources｜宝贵的资源
tip_zh: 既可指金钱价值高，也可指感情上珍贵或资源稀缺。

meanings_zh: v. 生产；创作 | v. 产生；引起 | n. 农产品
definition_en: To make, grow, or create something. | To cause a result or effect. | Food grown on farms, especially fruit and vegetables.
example1_en: Our garden produces enough tomatoes for the whole family.
example1_zh: 我们菜园里种出的番茄够全家吃。
example2_en: Investing in renewable energy can produce long-term benefits for both local communities and the environment.
example2_zh: 投资可再生能源可以为当地社区和环境带来长期益处。
collocations: produce electricity｜发电 ; produce results｜产生效果 ; fresh produce｜新鲜农产品
tip_zh: 动词重音在后，名词重音在前；农产品义不可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 经济的；经济学的
definition_en: Relating to trade, industry, money, or the study of these.
example1_en: The news discussed economic problems affecting local shops.
example1_zh: 新闻讨论了影响当地商店的经济问题。
example2_en: Investment in public transport can support economic growth by connecting workers with a wider range of jobs.
example2_zh: 投资公共交通能让劳动者获得更广泛的就业机会，从而促进经济增长。
collocations: economic growth｜经济增长 ; economic development｜经济发展 ; economic policy｜经济政策 ; economic recession｜经济衰退
tip_zh: economic指经济方面的；economical指节约的。

meanings_zh: n. 燃料 | v. 给……加燃料 | v. 加剧；推动
definition_en: material burned or used to produce heat or power | to supply something with fuel | to make a feeling or situation stronger
example1_en: We stopped for fuel before driving into the mountains.
example1_zh: 我们开车进山前停下来加了油。
example2_en: Growing demand for private cars may fuel air pollution unless governments promote cleaner alternatives.
example2_zh: 除非政府推广更清洁的替代出行方式，否则私家车需求的增长可能加剧空气污染。
collocations: fossil fuels｜化石燃料 ; fuel consumption｜燃料消耗 ; fuel prices｜燃料价格 ; fuel speculation｜助长猜测
tip_zh: fuel作动词还可表示助长情绪或推动变化。

meanings_zh: n. 糊状物；浆糊 | v. 用浆糊粘贴 | v. 粘贴电子内容
definition_en: A thick, soft mixture, sometimes used for sticking things together. | To stick something onto a surface using paste. | To insert copied text or images into a digital location.
example1_en: Mix the flour with water to make a paste.
example1_zh: 把面粉和水混合，调成糊状。
example2_en: Students should not simply paste material from websites into assignments without acknowledging the original sources.
example2_zh: 学生不应直接把网站材料粘贴进作业而不注明原始来源。
collocations: tomato paste｜番茄膏 ; wallpaper paste｜壁纸胶 ; paste onto｜粘到……上 ; copy and paste｜复制粘贴
tip_zh: 糊状物通常不可数；电脑操作中指“粘贴”。

meanings_zh: adj. 财务的；财政的；金融的
definition_en: relating to money or how it is managed
example1_en: We asked for financial advice before buying our first home.
example1_zh: 购买第一套住房前，我们咨询了理财建议。
example2_en: Financial support for disadvantaged students can improve access to higher education and reduce long-term inequality.
example2_zh: 为弱势学生提供经济支持可以增加他们接受高等教育的机会，并减少长期存在的不平等。
collocations: financial support｜经济支持 ; financial difficulties｜经济困难 ; financial stability｜金融稳定；财务稳定 ; financial services｜金融服务
tip_zh: financial侧重金钱与财务；economic侧重经济整体。

meanings_zh: n. 下巴
definition_en: The part of your face below your mouth.
example1_en: He rested his chin on his hand and sighed.
example1_zh: 他用手托着下巴，叹了口气。
example2_en: Cyclists should adjust helmet straps beneath the chin to ensure a secure fit during travel.
example2_zh: 骑车者应调节下巴下方的头盔带，确保骑行时头盔佩戴牢固。
collocations: rest your chin on your hand｜用手托着下巴 ; a pointed chin｜尖下巴 ; a double chin｜双下巴
tip_zh: chin指下巴；jaw指颌部，范围更广。

meanings_zh: adv. 部分地；在一定程度上
definition_en: To some extent, but not completely.
example1_en: The path was partly covered with fallen leaves.
example1_zh: 小路上有一部分被落叶覆盖了。
example2_en: The rise in cycling is partly due to improved infrastructure and growing concern about air quality.
example2_zh: 骑自行车的人增多，部分原因是基础设施改善以及人们更加关注空气质量。
collocations: partly because｜部分原因是 ; partly due to｜部分由于 ; partly responsible｜负有部分责任 ; partly cloudy｜局部多云
tip_zh: 表示部分而非全部；常用partly because说明原因。

meanings_zh: adv. 基本上；从根本上说
definition_en: considering only the main facts or most important features
