example1_en: The two recipes are basically the same, except for spices.
example1_zh: 除了香料不同，这两份食谱基本一样。
example2_en: Although delivery methods have changed, the purpose of public education remains basically the same across generations.
example2_zh: 尽管教学方式发生了变化，公共教育的目的在代际之间仍基本相同。
collocations: basically the same｜基本相同 ; basically sound｜基本合理 ; basically means｜基本意思是
tip_zh: 用于概括核心情况；不等于“几乎不”的barely。

meanings_zh: adj. 有毒的 | adj. 恶毒的；充满恶意的
definition_en: Containing a substance that can cause illness or death. | Extremely unkind or harmful to relationships.
example1_en: Some colourful berries are poisonous, so leave them alone.
example1_zh: 有些颜色鲜艳的浆果有毒，所以不要碰。
example2_en: Factories must prevent poisonous substances from entering rivers that supply drinking water to nearby communities.
example2_zh: 工厂必须防止有毒物质流入为周边社区提供饮用水的河流。
collocations: poisonous plants｜有毒植物 ; poisonous gases｜有毒气体 ; poisonous remarks｜恶毒的言论
tip_zh: poisonous指有毒；venomous强调咬刺注毒。

meanings_zh: adj. 老式的；不时兴的 | adj. 守旧的；传统的
definition_en: Belonging to a style that was common in the past. | Following beliefs or customs associated with earlier times.
example1_en: My grandfather still uses an old-fashioned clock with a pendulum.
example1_zh: 我祖父仍然用着一座带钟摆的老式时钟。
example2_en: Although some teaching methods seem old-fashioned, they can still help students develop concentration and independent thinking.
example2_zh: 尽管某些教学方法看似老式，但它们仍能帮助学生培养专注力和独立思考能力。
collocations: old-fashioned clothes｜老式衣服 ; old-fashioned values｜传统价值观 ; old-fashioned manners｜传统礼仪
tip_zh: 可含怀旧赞赏；outdated更强调已不适用。

meanings_zh: n. 香草；香草精 | adj. 香草味的
definition_en: A sweet-smelling substance from tropical plant pods, used to flavour food. | Flavoured with vanilla.
example1_en: Add a little vanilla before you mix the batter.
example1_zh: 搅拌面糊之前，加一点香草精。
example2_en: Demand for natural vanilla can provide valuable income for farmers, but unstable prices create financial risks.
example2_zh: 对天然香草的需求能为农民带来可观收入，但价格不稳定会造成财务风险。
collocations: vanilla extract｜香草精 ; vanilla ice cream｜香草冰淇淋 ; vanilla pod｜香草荚 ; vanilla flavour｜香草味
tip_zh: 食品中的vanilla指特定香料，并非泛指所有香草。

meanings_zh: adj. 回收再制的
definition_en: made from waste materials processed for use again
example1_en: This notebook is made entirely from recycled paper.
example1_zh: 这本笔记本完全由再生纸制成。
example2_en: Using recycled materials in construction can reduce demand for natural resources and limit waste sent to landfill.
example2_zh: 在建筑中使用再生材料，可以减少对自然资源的需求，减少送往垃圾填埋场的废物。
collocations: recycled paper｜再生纸 ; recycled plastic｜再生塑料 ; recycled materials｜再生材料
tip_zh: recycled 指已回收再制；recyclable 指可回收。

meanings_zh: n. 线索；提示
definition_en: Information that helps you solve a problem or understand something.
example1_en: The muddy footprints gave us a clue about the visitor.
example1_zh: 泥脚印为我们了解那位访客提供了线索。
example2_en: Ancient tools provide valuable clues about how early communities adapted to changes in their natural environment.
example2_zh: 古代工具为研究早期群落如何适应自然环境的变化提供了宝贵线索。
collocations: a clue to｜关于…的线索 ; provide clues｜提供线索 ; not have a clue｜完全不知道
tip_zh: a clue to中的to是介词，后接名词等。

meanings_zh: n. 十分硬币（美加）
definition_en: A coin worth ten cents in the US or Canada.
example1_en: A shiny dime rolled out of my jacket pocket.
example1_zh: 一枚亮闪闪的十分硬币从我的夹克口袋里滚了出来。
example2_en: Although a dime has little purchasing power, small cash donations can collectively support valuable community projects.
example2_zh: 虽然一枚十分硬币购买力有限，但小额现金捐款汇集起来也能支持有益的社区项目。
collocations: a dime a dozen｜多得不稀奇 ; not cost a dime｜分文不花 ; on a dime｜骤然；在极小范围内
tip_zh: 一美元等于十个dime；主要用于美加语境。

meanings_zh: n. 事实；真相 | n. 真理
definition_en: what is real or actually happened | a fact or principle generally accepted as true
example1_en: Please tell me the truth about the broken cup.
example1_zh: 请告诉我杯子打碎的真相。
example2_en: Journalists should seek the truth rather than publish stories that simply attract public attention.
example2_zh: 记者应当寻求真相，而不是发表仅仅吸引公众注意的报道。
collocations: tell the truth｜说实话 ; discover the truth｜发现真相 ; the truth about something｜关于某事的真相
tip_zh: 说实话用tell the truth，通常不能省略the。

meanings_zh: n. 喷泉 | n. 饮水器
definition_en: a structure that sends water into the air | a device supplying a stream of water for drinking
example1_en: Children watched the fountain sparkle in the afternoon sunlight.
example1_zh: 孩子们看着喷泉在午后的阳光下闪闪发亮。
example2_en: A fountain can make a public square more attractive, although its maintenance requires water and energy.
example2_zh: 喷泉可以让公共广场更具吸引力，但维护喷泉需要消耗水和能源。
collocations: drinking fountain｜公共饮水器 ; ornamental fountain｜装饰性喷泉 ; fountain pen｜钢笔
tip_zh: drinking fountain是公共饮水器；fountain pen是钢笔。

meanings_zh: n. 海盗 | v. 盗版；非法复制 | n. 盗版者
definition_en: someone who attacks ships and steals from them | to copy or distribute protected material without permission | someone who illegally copies or distributes protected material
example1_en: The pirate in the story sailed a wooden ship.
example1_zh: 故事里的海盗驾驶着一艘木船。
example2_en: When companies pirate educational software, they undermine the income that developers need to improve their products.
example2_zh: 企业盗版教育软件，会损害开发者改进产品所需的收入。
collocations: pirate ship｜海盗船 ; pirated software｜盗版软件 ; pirate films｜盗版电影
tip_zh: pirated强调被非法复制；piracy是对应名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 秃头的；秃的 | adj. 光秃的；磨光的
definition_en: having little or no hair on the head | lacking the usual covering or surface texture
example1_en: My uncle is bald and always wears a hat.
example1_zh: 我叔叔是秃头，总是戴着帽子。
example2_en: Driving with bald tyres increases the risk of accidents, particularly when roads are wet or icy.
example2_zh: 使用磨光的轮胎驾驶会增加事故风险，尤其是在道路湿滑或结冰时。
collocations: go bald｜开始秃顶 ; a bald head｜光头 ; a bald patch｜秃斑 ; bald tyres｜磨光的轮胎
tip_zh: bald指秃头；bold指大胆的，注意拼写和发音。

meanings_zh: adv. 仅仅；只不过 | adv. 简单地；朴素地 | adv. 简直；实在
definition_en: only, with nothing more involved | in an uncomplicated or plain way | used to emphasise how strongly something is true
example1_en: I simply want a quiet evening at home.
example1_zh: 我只想在家安安静静地过个晚上。
example2_en: Improving public health requires more than simply encouraging individuals to exercise; affordable facilities are also essential.
example2_zh: 改善公共健康不仅仅需要鼓励个人锻炼；价格亲民的设施也必不可少。
collocations: simply because｜仅仅因为 ; put simply｜简单来说 ; explain simply｜简单地解释 ; simply impossible｜简直不可能
tip_zh: simply可表示“仅仅”，不一定表示“简单地”。

meanings_zh: adj. 明确的；确定的 | adj. 确实的；明显的
definition_en: Clearly decided or known, without uncertainty. | Clearly noticeable or unquestionably present.
example1_en: We need a definite answer before booking the tickets.
example1_zh: 订票之前，我们需要一个明确的答复。
example2_en: Reliable public transport offers definite advantages for cities seeking to reduce congestion and improve air quality.
example2_zh: 对于寻求缓解拥堵和改善空气质量的城市来说，可靠的公共交通具有明显优势。
collocations: a definite answer｜明确的答复 ; definite plans｜确定的计划 ; a definite advantage｜明显的优势
tip_zh: definite是形容词；definitely是副词，意为肯定地。

meanings_zh: adj. 温柔的；温和的 | adj. 轻柔的；不强烈的 | adj. 坡度平缓的
definition_en: Kind and careful, without roughness or force. | Mild in strength, movement, or effect. | Rising or falling gradually rather than steeply.
example1_en: Be gentle when you pick up the little kitten.
example1_zh: 抱起那只小猫时，动作要轻柔。
example2_en: Gentle exercise, such as walking or swimming, can improve physical health without placing excessive strain on joints.
example2_zh: 散步或游泳等温和运动可以改善身体健康，又不会给关节带来过大负担。
collocations: a gentle breeze｜微风 ; gentle exercise｜温和运动 ; a gentle slope｜缓坡 ; a gentle touch｜轻柔的触碰
tip_zh: 对人温柔用be gentle with sb。

meanings_zh: n. 喜剧演员
definition_en: a performer who entertains people by making them laugh
example1_en: The comedian made everyone laugh with stories about his cat.
example1_zh: 那位喜剧演员讲了自家猫的趣事，逗得大家哈哈大笑。
example2_en: A skilled comedian can encourage audiences to question social habits while providing enjoyable entertainment.
example2_zh: 优秀的喜剧演员既能提供愉快的娱乐，也能促使观众反思社会习惯。
collocations: stand-up comedian｜单口喜剧演员 ; professional comedian｜职业喜剧演员 ; talented comedian｜有才华的喜剧演员
tip_zh: comedian指人，comedy指喜剧或喜剧作品。

meanings_zh: n. 表现；业绩；性能 | n. 表演；演出 | n. 执行；履行
definition_en: How well a person, organisation or machine does something. | An occasion when someone entertains an audience by performing. | The act of carrying out a task or duty.
example1_en: The coach praised our performance after the football match.
example1_zh: 足球赛后，教练表扬了我们的表现。
example2_en: Regular feedback can improve employee performance by helping workers understand expectations and address specific weaknesses.
example2_zh: 定期反馈能帮助员工了解工作要求并改进具体不足，从而提升工作表现。
collocations: academic performance｜学业表现 ; job performance｜工作表现 ; live performance｜现场演出 ; performance of duties｜履行职责
tip_zh: 表示整体表现通常不可数；一场演出用a performance。

meanings_zh: n. 学生宿舍；集体寝室
definition_en: a building or shared room where students sleep
example1_en: My dorm is just five minutes from the library.
example1_zh: 我的宿舍离图书馆只有五分钟路程。
example2_en: Living in a dorm can help first-year students develop social skills and adjust to university life.
example2_zh: 住宿舍可以帮助大一学生培养社交技能，适应大学生活。
collocations: dorm room｜宿舍房间 ; dorm life｜宿舍生活 ; college dorm｜大学宿舍
tip_zh: dorm是dormitory的非正式简称，多见于美式英语。

meanings_zh: n. 趋势；潮流 | v. 成为热门话题
definition_en: a general direction of change or development | to become widely discussed or shared online
example1_en: Growing vegetables at home is a popular trend here.
example1_zh: 在家种菜是这里流行的一种风尚。
example2_en: The growing trend towards remote working may reduce traffic congestion in major cities.
example2_zh: 远程办公日益普及的趋势可能缓解大城市的交通拥堵。
collocations: an upward trend｜上升趋势 ; a growing trend｜日益明显的趋势 ; follow a trend｜追随潮流 ; a trend towards｜朝向……的趋势
tip_zh: 朝向某种趋势常用a trend towards后接名词。

meanings_zh: n. 山谷；河谷
definition_en: Low land between hills or mountains, often containing a river.
example1_en: A narrow river winds through the green valley.
example1_zh: 一条狭窄的河流蜿蜒穿过翠绿的山谷。
example2_en: Farming communities in the valley depend on seasonal rainfall to maintain their crops and support local livelihoods.
example2_zh: 河谷中的农业社区依靠季节性降雨维持作物生长，保障当地居民的生计。
collocations: a river valley｜河谷 ; a deep valley｜深谷 ; the valley floor｜谷底
tip_zh: valley是两侧山地之间的低地，不等同于盆地basin。

meanings_zh: v. 使确信；使信服 | v. 说服
definition_en: to make someone believe something is true | to persuade someone to do something
example1_en: The photos convinced me that the flat was spacious.
example1_zh: 这些照片让我相信那套公寓很宽敞。
example2_en: Governments must convince residents that improved public transport offers a practical alternative to private cars.
example2_zh: 政府必须让居民相信，改善后的公共交通能够切实替代私家车出行。
collocations: convince someone of something｜使某人相信某事 ; convince someone that｜使某人确信 ; convince someone to do something｜说服某人做某事
tip_zh: convince sb of sth表示使某人相信某事。

meanings_zh: n. 走廊；门厅
definition_en: A passage inside a building or space by its entrance
example1_en: Please leave your muddy boots in the hallway.
example1_zh: 请把沾满泥的靴子留在门厅里。
example2_en: Wide hallways and accessible entrances make public buildings easier to navigate for people with limited mobility.
example2_zh: 宽敞的走廊和无障碍入口让行动不便的人更容易在公共建筑内通行。
collocations: narrow hallway｜狭窄的走廊 ; entrance hallway｜入口门厅 ; down the hallway｜沿着走廊
tip_zh: 既可指入口门厅，也可指连接房间的走廊。

meanings_zh: v. 缝；缝纫
definition_en: to join or repair fabric using a needle and thread
example1_en: Can you sew this button back onto my coat?
example1_zh: 你能把这颗纽扣缝回我的外套上吗？
example2_en: Learning to sew enables people to repair damaged clothes rather than discard them, reducing household waste.
example2_zh: 学会缝纫能让人们修补破损衣物而不是将其丢弃，从而减少家庭垃圾。
collocations: sew on a button｜缝上纽扣 ; sew by hand｜手工缝制 ; sew clothes｜缝制衣服 ; sew up a hole｜缝补破洞
tip_zh: 过去式sewed；过去分词sewn或sewed；与so同音。

meanings_zh: v. 减少；降低；缩小
definition_en: To make something smaller or less in amount or degree.
example1_en: We can reduce waste by using our leftovers.
example1_zh: 我们可以利用剩饭剩菜来减少浪费。
example2_en: Governments should invest in renewable energy to reduce carbon emissions and improve long-term energy security.
example2_zh: 政府应投资可再生能源，以减少碳排放并改善长期能源安全。
collocations: reduce costs｜降低成本 ; reduce emissions｜减少排放 ; reduce the risk｜降低风险 ; reduce waste｜减少浪费
tip_zh: reduce by接减少量；reduce to接减少后的量。

meanings_zh: n. 学术期刊；专业杂志 | n. 日记；日志
definition_en: a publication containing articles about a particular subject | a personal record of experiences, thoughts, or events
example1_en: I keep a journal beside my bed every night.
example1_zh: 我每晚都把一本日记放在床边。
example2_en: Researchers publish their findings in academic journals so that other experts can evaluate the evidence.
example2_zh: 研究人员在学术期刊上发表成果，以便其他专家评估相关证据。
collocations: an academic journal｜学术期刊 ; a medical journal｜医学期刊 ; keep a journal｜写日记 ; a journal article｜期刊论文
tip_zh: journal常指专业期刊；表示私人记录时近似diary。

meanings_zh: v. 说服；劝服
definition_en: getting someone to act or believe something by giving reasons
example1_en: She is persuading her brother to try vegetable soup.
example1_zh: 她正在劝弟弟尝尝蔬菜汤。
example2_en: Persuading commuters to use public transport requires reliable services as well as affordable fares and convenient routes.
example2_zh: 说服通勤者使用公共交通，需要可靠的服务、实惠的票价以及便利的线路。
collocations: persuading someone to act｜说服某人采取行动 ; persuading someone of the benefits｜使某人相信其益处 ; persuading someone that｜使某人相信……
tip_zh: persuade的-ing形式；劝某人做某事用to do。

meanings_zh: adj. 活泼的；热闹的 | adj. 生动有趣的；热烈的
definition_en: full of energy, activity, or excitement | interesting and engaging, with enthusiastic activity or discussion
example1_en: The lively puppy chased a ball around the garden.
example1_zh: 那只活泼的小狗在花园里追着球跑。
example2_en: Lively classroom discussions can encourage students to consider different perspectives and develop critical thinking skills.
example2_zh: 热烈的课堂讨论能鼓励学生考虑不同观点，并培养批判性思维能力。
collocations: lively debate｜热烈的辩论 ; lively atmosphere｜热闹的气氛 ; lively imagination｜丰富活跃的想象力
tip_zh: 虽以-ly结尾，却是形容词，不是副词。

meanings_zh: n. 雕塑作品 | n. 雕塑艺术
definition_en: an artwork made by carving, shaping, or assembling materials | the art of creating solid forms from materials
example1_en: A bronze sculpture of a horse stands outside the library.
example1_zh: 图书馆外矗立着一座马的青铜雕塑。
example2_en: Public sculpture can strengthen a city's cultural identity while making art accessible to people outside traditional galleries.
example2_zh: 公共雕塑能增强城市的文化认同，同时让传统美术馆之外的人们也能接触艺术。
collocations: a bronze sculpture｜青铜雕塑 ; public sculpture｜公共雕塑 ; a sculpture garden｜雕塑园 ; abstract sculpture｜抽象雕塑
tip_zh: 指艺术门类不可数；指一件作品可数。

meanings_zh: n. 需求 | n. 坚决要求 | v. 强烈要求；需要
definition_en: the desire or need for particular goods or services | a strong request that someone expects to be obeyed | to insist on receiving something or require something essential
example1_en: Demand for cold drinks rises sharply during hot weather.
example1_zh: 天气炎热时，冷饮的需求量急剧上升。
example2_en: Growing demand for affordable housing has encouraged local authorities to convert unused office buildings into residential accommodation.
example2_zh: 对可负担住房不断增长的需求促使地方政府将闲置办公楼改建为住宅。
collocations: demand for housing｜住房需求 ; meet demand｜满足需求 ; in high demand｜需求旺盛 ; demand an explanation｜要求解释
tip_zh: 要求做某事用demand to do，不用demand sb to do。

meanings_zh: adj. 古典音乐的 | adj. 古希腊罗马的；古典的 | adj. 传统理论的
definition_en: relating to formal Western music, such as symphonies and operas | relating to ancient Greece or Rome and their culture | based on established theories rather than newer approaches
example1_en: My sister listens to classical music while cooking.
example1_zh: 我姐姐做饭时听古典音乐。
example2_en: Studying classical architecture helps students understand how ancient design principles continue to influence modern public buildings.
example2_zh: 研究古典建筑有助于学生理解古代设计原则如何持续影响现代公共建筑。
collocations: classical music｜古典音乐 ; classical architecture｜古典建筑 ; classical civilisation｜古典文明 ; classical mechanics｜经典力学
tip_zh: 古典音乐用classical；经典作品常用classic。

meanings_zh: n. 煤；煤炭
definition_en: A hard black or brown material burned to produce heat.
example1_en: The old stove still burns coal during winter.
example1_zh: 这个旧炉子冬天仍然烧煤取暖。
example2_en: Replacing coal with renewable energy can reduce air pollution and lower greenhouse gas emissions from electricity generation.
example2_zh: 用可再生能源替代煤炭，可以减少空气污染并降低发电产生的温室气体排放。
collocations: coal mine｜煤矿 ; burn coal｜烧煤 ; coal-fired power station｜燃煤发电站
tip_zh: coal指煤，charcoal指木炭；煤通常用作不可数名词。

meanings_zh: v. 承认 | v. 准许进入；接收
definition_en: to accept that something is true, often reluctantly | to allow someone to enter or join a place or institution
example1_en: I admit that I forgot to water your plants.
example1_zh: 我承认我忘了给你的植物浇水。
example2_en: Governments should admit when policies have failed and use reliable evidence to develop more effective alternatives.
example2_zh: 政府应承认政策失败，并依据可靠证据制定更有效的替代方案。
collocations: admit a mistake｜承认错误 ; admit doing something｜承认做过某事 ; admit that｜承认…… ; be admitted to hospital｜被收治入院
tip_zh: 用admit doing，不用admit to do；过去式双写t。

meanings_zh: n. 所含物；容纳的东西 | n. 目录
definition_en: the things held inside a container or space | a list of a publication's sections and their locations
example1_en: She emptied the contents of her bag onto the table.
example1_zh: 她把包里的东西全倒在了桌上。
example2_en: A detailed table of contents helps readers locate relevant information quickly in lengthy academic reports.
example2_zh: 详细的目录能帮助读者在篇幅较长的学术报告中迅速找到相关信息。
collocations: table of contents｜目录 ; contents page｜目录页 ; contents of a bag｜包内物品
tip_zh: contents指所含物或目录；文章内容通常用content。

meanings_zh: adj. 整洁的；整齐的 | adj. 巧妙的；简洁有效的
definition_en: tidy and carefully arranged | clever, simple, and effective
example1_en: She keeps her gardening tools in neat rows.
example1_zh: 她把园艺工具摆放得整整齐齐。
example2_en: Keeping shared workspaces neat can improve efficiency by making essential equipment easier to locate.
example2_zh: 保持共用工作空间整洁，可以让必要设备更容易找到，从而提高效率。
collocations: neat and tidy｜干净整洁的 ; neat handwriting｜工整的字迹 ; a neat solution｜巧妙的解决办法
tip_zh: neat除指整洁，也可形容办法巧妙、简洁。

meanings_zh: v. 交流；沟通 | v. 传达；表达
definition_en: to share information, thoughts, or feelings with others | to make information or feelings known to someone
example1_en: We communicate with our neighbours through a shared online group.
example1_zh: 我们通过一个共同的线上群组与邻居交流。
example2_en: Teachers need to communicate complex ideas clearly so that students with different abilities can understand them.
example2_zh: 教师需要清晰地传达复杂概念，让能力不同的学生都能理解。
collocations: communicate with｜与……交流 ; communicate effectively｜有效沟通 ; communicate ideas｜传达想法
tip_zh: 与某人交流用with；向某人传达某事用某事＋to。

meanings_zh: v. 宣布；公布
definition_en: To make information known publicly or officially.
example1_en: Our teacher announced the winners after lunch today.
example1_zh: 今天午饭后，我们的老师宣布了获奖者。
example2_en: Local authorities should announce major policy changes early so residents have enough time to prepare.
example2_zh: 地方政府应尽早公布重大政策调整，让居民有充足的准备时间。
collocations: announce plans｜宣布计划 ; announce a decision｜宣布决定 ; announce the results｜公布结果
tip_zh: 用announce sth或announce that，不用announce sb sth。

meanings_zh: n. 社会 | n. 协会；社团
definition_en: People living together in an organised community. | An organisation for people who share an interest or purpose.
example1_en: Everyone has a part to play in society.
example1_zh: 每个人都能在社会中发挥作用。
example2_en: An ageing society requires accessible healthcare and policies that support older people's independence.
example2_zh: 老龄化社会需要便捷可及的医疗服务，以及支持老年人独立生活的政策。
collocations: modern society｜现代社会 ; an ageing society｜老龄化社会 ; society as a whole｜整个社会 ; join a society｜加入社团
tip_zh: 泛指社会常不加the；表示协会时是可数名词。

meanings_zh: n. 广告
definition_en: a public message promoting a product, service, or opportunity
example1_en: An ad for cooking classes caught my attention yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天，一则烹饪课广告吸引了我的注意。
example2_en: Online ads can influence consumer choices by presenting products that match users' browsing habits and interests.
example2_zh: 网络广告通过展示符合用户浏览习惯和兴趣的产品，可以影响消费者的选择。
collocations: online ad｜网络广告 ; job ad｜招聘广告 ; place an ad｜刊登广告 ; ad campaign｜广告宣传活动
tip_zh: ad是advertisement的非正式缩写，是可数名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 露天的；户外的
definition_en: taking place or located outside, without a roof
example1_en: We watched a film at an open-air cinema last night.
example1_zh: 昨晚我们在露天电影院看了一部电影。
example2_en: Open-air markets can attract visitors while providing affordable trading spaces for small local businesses.
example2_zh: 露天市场既能吸引游客，也能为当地小商户提供价格实惠的经营场地。
collocations: open-air market｜露天市场 ; open-air concert｜露天音乐会 ; open-air theatre｜露天剧场
tip_zh: 作形容词用连字符；in the open air意为在户外。

meanings_zh: n. 肌肉 | n. 实力；影响力
definition_en: body tissue that tightens and relaxes to produce movement | power or influence used to achieve something
example1_en: I pulled a muscle while lifting a heavy box.
example1_zh: 我搬一个重箱子时拉伤了肌肉。
example2_en: Regular strength training builds muscle and helps older adults maintain balance and independence in daily life.
example2_zh: 规律的力量训练能增强肌肉，帮助老年人在日常生活中保持平衡和独立。
collocations: build muscle｜增强肌肉 ; pull a muscle｜拉伤肌肉 ; muscle strength｜肌肉力量 ; financial muscle｜财力
tip_zh: muscle中的c不发音；pull a muscle指拉伤肌肉。

meanings_zh: n. 特点；特色 | v. 以…为特色；重点展示 | n. 面部特征；五官之一
definition_en: a noticeable or important part of something | to include or present someone or something prominently | a part of the face, such as the nose
example1_en: My favourite feature of this backpack is its hidden pocket.
example1_zh: 这个背包最让我喜欢的特点是它的隐藏口袋。
example2_en: Public parks are an essential feature of cities that prioritise residents' health and wellbeing.
example2_zh: 在重视居民健康与福祉的城市中，公共公园是一项不可或缺的特色。
collocations: a key feature｜关键特点 ; facial features｜面部特征 ; feature prominently｜占据显著地位
tip_zh: 作动词时直接接宾语，不说feature with。

meanings_zh: adv. 专门地；特意地
definition_en: for a particular purpose or person
example1_en: I made this cushion specially for your chair.
example1_zh: 这个靠垫是我特意为你的椅子做的。
example2_en: Schools should provide specially designed learning materials to support students with different educational needs.
example2_zh: 学校应提供专门设计的学习材料，帮助有不同教育需求的学生。
collocations: specially designed｜专门设计的 ; specially trained｜受过专门培训的 ; specially made｜特制的
tip_zh: specially侧重专门目的；especially侧重尤其。

meanings_zh: n. 海豚
definition_en: An intelligent aquatic mammal with a long snout and curved fin.
example1_en: A dolphin leapt beside our boat early this morning.
example1_zh: 今天一大早，一只海豚在我们的船边跃出水面。
example2_en: Underwater noise from shipping can disrupt dolphin communication and make it harder for these animals to find food.
example2_zh: 船运产生的水下噪声会干扰海豚交流，使它们更难找到食物。
collocations: a pod of dolphins｜一群海豚 ; bottlenose dolphin｜宽吻海豚 ; dolphin conservation｜海豚保护
tip_zh: 海豚是哺乳动物；一群海豚可说a pod of dolphins。

meanings_zh: n. 女佣；女清洁服务员
definition_en: a woman employed to clean rooms or do household work
example1_en: The hotel maid brought fresh towels to our room.
example1_zh: 酒店女服务员给我们房间送来了干净毛巾。
example2_en: Hotels should provide every maid with suitable equipment and sufficient time to clean rooms safely.
example2_zh: 酒店应为每位女清洁服务员提供合适的设备和充足的时间，以安全地清扫客房。
collocations: hotel maid｜酒店女清洁服务员 ; work as a maid｜当女佣
tip_zh: 指女性家务或清洁雇员；酒店中常用room attendant。

meanings_zh: v. 道歉
definition_en: To say you are sorry for something you have done.
example1_en: I should apologise for spilling juice on your jacket.
example1_zh: 我把果汁洒在了你的夹克上，应该向你道歉。
example2_en: Companies should apologise publicly when their mistakes cause inconvenience or financial loss to customers.
example2_zh: 当企业的失误给顾客造成不便或经济损失时，企业应该公开道歉。
collocations: apologise to someone｜向某人道歉 ; apologise for something｜为某事道歉 ; apologise sincerely｜真诚道歉
tip_zh: 英式拼写；美式常用apologize，后接to人、for事。

meanings_zh: n. 疾病；患病 | n. 恶心；呕吐
definition_en: the state of being ill | the feeling of needing to vomit, or vomiting itself
example1_en: Several children missed school because of sickness this week.
example1_zh: 这周有几个孩子因病没来上学。
example2_en: Employers can reduce absence due to sickness by improving ventilation and encouraging staff to stay home when unwell.
example2_zh: 雇主可以改善通风，并鼓励身体不适的员工居家休息，以减少病假缺勤。
collocations: travel sickness｜晕车晕船 ; morning sickness｜孕吐 ; altitude sickness｜高原反应 ; sickness absence｜因病缺勤
tip_zh: 通常不可数；英式英语中也常指恶心、呕吐。

meanings_zh: n. 烟花；焰火
definition_en: an object that burns or explodes with bright colours outdoors
example1_en: A single firework burst above the lake, scattering golden sparks.
example1_zh: 一枚烟花在湖面上空绽放，洒下金色火花。
example2_en: Public firework displays can attract visitors, although their noise may disturb local residents and wildlife.
example2_zh: 公共焰火表演可以吸引游客，但其噪声可能打扰当地居民和野生动物。
collocations: firework display｜焰火表演 ; set off fireworks｜燃放烟花 ; watch fireworks｜观看烟花
tip_zh: 单枚烟花可数；泛指烟花或焰火表演常用fireworks。

meanings_zh: n. 政治；政治活动 | n. 政治观点；政治立场
definition_en: activities concerning government and how a country is run | a person's beliefs about government and public affairs
example1_en: My uncle loves discussing politics over dinner with friends.
example1_zh: 我叔叔喜欢在晚餐时和朋友们讨论政治。
example2_en: Greater involvement in politics can help young people influence decisions that affect their future.
example2_zh: 更多地参与政治能帮助年轻人影响关乎自身未来的决策。
collocations: local politics｜地方政治 ; enter politics｜从政 ; discuss politics｜讨论政治 ; party politics｜政党政治
tip_zh: 指政治活动时通常配单数谓语；政治立场可配复数。

meanings_zh: n. 新闻记者；新闻工作者
definition_en: Someone who gathers and reports news for the media.
example1_en: The journalist interviewed our neighbour about the new park.
example1_zh: 那位记者就新公园的事采访了我们的邻居。
example2_en: A responsible journalist should verify information carefully before publishing stories that could influence public opinion.
example2_zh: 负责任的记者在发表可能影响公众舆论的报道前，应仔细核实信息。
collocations: investigative journalist｜调查记者 ; freelance journalist｜自由撰稿记者 ; broadcast journalist｜广播电视记者
tip_zh: journalist泛指新闻工作者，reporter更侧重采访报道。

meanings_zh: v. 警告；提醒
definition_en: tell someone about possible danger or an unpleasant consequence
example1_en: Please warn me if the pan gets too hot.
example1_zh: 如果锅太烫，请提醒我。
example2_en: Scientists warn that continued habitat loss could put many more species at risk of extinction.
example2_zh: 科学家警告说，栖息地持续减少可能使更多物种面临灭绝风险。
collocations: warn someone about something｜提醒某人注意某事 ; warn against doing something｜告诫不要做某事 ; warn someone not to do something｜警告某人不要做某事
tip_zh: warn后可接that从句；warn sb not to do表示告诫。

meanings_zh: v. 擦；拭去 | n. 擦拭 | n. 清洁湿巾
definition_en: Rub a surface to remove dirt, liquid, or marks. | An act of rubbing a surface to clean or dry it. | A small damp cloth used for cleaning, usually thrown away afterwards.
example1_en: Please wipe the table before you put the plates down.
example1_zh: 请先擦一下桌子，再摆盘子。
example2_en: Schools should encourage pupils to wipe shared equipment after use to help maintain a hygienic learning environment.
example2_zh: 学校应鼓励学生在使用共用设备后进行擦拭，以帮助保持卫生的学习环境。
collocations: wipe a surface｜擦拭表面 ; wipe away tears｜擦去眼泪 ; give something a wipe｜把某物擦一下 ; wet wipes｜湿巾
tip_zh: wipe侧重擦拭；wipe out可表示彻底消除。

meanings_zh: n. 会计；会计师
definition_en: Someone whose job is to prepare and check financial records
example1_en: The accountant checked our expenses before we opened the café.
example1_zh: 咖啡馆开业前，会计核查了我们的各项开支。
example2_en: Employing a qualified accountant helps small businesses manage taxes accurately and make better financial decisions.
example2_zh: 聘用合格的会计师有助于小企业准确处理税务，并作出更好的财务决策。
collocations: qualified accountant｜合格的会计师 ; chartered accountant｜特许会计师 ; hire an accountant｜聘用会计师
tip_zh: accountant指人；accounting指会计工作或学科。

meanings_zh: n. 比较；对照
definition_en: Examining things to see how they are similar or different.
example1_en: A quick comparison helped me choose the cheaper bicycle.
example1_zh: 简单比较一下后，我选中了更便宜的自行车。
example2_en: A comparison of public transport systems reveals significant differences in cost, reliability and environmental impact.
example2_zh: 对公共交通系统的比较揭示了成本、可靠性和环境影响方面的显著差异。
collocations: make a comparison｜进行比较 ; in comparison with｜与……相比 ; by comparison｜相比之下 ; a direct comparison｜直接比较
tip_zh: 两者之间的比较用comparison between A and B。

meanings_zh: n. 化学品；化学物质 | adj. 化学的
definition_en: A substance produced or used in a chemical process. | Relating to substances and how they combine or change.
example1_en: Keep cleaning chemicals safely out of children's reach.
example1_zh: 请将清洁用化学品安全存放在儿童接触不到的地方。
example2_en: Farmers can protect nearby rivers by reducing the amount of agricultural chemicals used on their land.
example2_zh: 农民可以通过减少农田中农业化学品的用量来保护附近的河流。
collocations: a chemical reaction｜化学反应 ; harmful chemicals｜有害化学物质 ; the chemical industry｜化学工业 ; chemical waste｜化学废料
tip_zh: chemical作名词可数；化学物质不一定有害。

meanings_zh: n. 范围；幅度；一系列 | v. 在一定范围内变化 | n. 山脉
definition_en: The extent or variety of things within certain limits. | To vary between particular limits. | A connected group of mountains.
example1_en: This shop sells a wide range of fresh fruit.
example1_zh: 这家商店出售种类繁多的新鲜水果。
example2_en: Universities should offer a broader range of courses to meet the changing needs of employers.
example2_zh: 大学应提供更广泛的课程，以满足雇主不断变化的需求。
collocations: a wide range of｜种类繁多的 ; range from A to B｜从A到B不等 ; a mountain range｜一条山脉
tip_zh: range from A to B表示变化范围；山脉用名词。

meanings_zh: n. 谜；无法解释的事 | n. 神秘感 | n. 悬疑故事；推理小说
definition_en: Something that is unknown or cannot be explained | The quality of being strange, secret, or difficult to understand | A story about solving a puzzling event, often a crime
example1_en: Who left these flowers outside remains a mystery.
example1_zh: 是谁把这些花放在外面，至今还是个谜。
example2_en: Despite advances in marine research, the behaviour of many deep ocean species remains a mystery.
example2_zh: 尽管海洋研究取得了进展，许多深海物种的行为仍然是个谜。
collocations: solve a mystery｜解开谜团 ; remain a mystery｜仍然是个谜 ; a sense of mystery｜神秘感 ; mystery novel｜推理小说
tip_zh: 表示一个谜用a mystery；表示神秘感通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 打字员；打字者
definition_en: A person who types, especially as a job.
example1_en: The typist finished the letter before her lunch break.
example1_zh: 打字员在午休前打完了那封信。
example2_en: Although dedicated typist positions are less common today, accurate keyboard skills remain valuable in many workplaces.
example2_zh: 虽然如今专职打字员岗位较少，但准确的键盘输入技能在许多工作场所仍然很有价值。
collocations: a fast typist｜打字快的人 ; a skilled typist｜熟练的打字员 ; a touch typist｜能盲打的人
tip_zh: 指人；typing指打字活动，typewriter指打字机。

meanings_zh: n. 旅行指南；指导手册
definition_en: a book giving information about a place or practical subject
example1_en: Our guidebook recommended a quiet beach near the village.
example1_zh: 我们的旅行指南推荐了村庄附近一处安静的海滩。
example2_en: Although digital maps are convenient, a detailed guidebook can provide valuable cultural context for independent travellers.
example2_zh: 虽然电子地图很方便，但详尽的旅行指南能为自由行旅客提供宝贵的文化背景信息。
collocations: a travel guidebook｜旅行指南 ; a guidebook to｜介绍……的指南 ; consult a guidebook｜查阅指南
tip_zh: 介绍某地的指南常用a guidebook to加地点。

meanings_zh: n. 菠菜
definition_en: A vegetable with dark green leaves eaten raw or cooked.
example1_en: I added fresh spinach to the soup before dinner.
example1_zh: 晚饭前，我往汤里加了新鲜菠菜。
example2_en: Leafy vegetables such as spinach provide nutrients that support a healthy, balanced diet.
example2_zh: 菠菜等绿叶蔬菜提供的营养有助于构建健康、均衡的饮食。
collocations: fresh spinach｜新鲜菠菜 ; spinach leaves｜菠菜叶 ; steamed spinach｜蒸菠菜
tip_zh: 通常不可数；一片菠菜叶说a spinach leaf。

meanings_zh: n. 舒适；安逸 | n. 安慰；慰藉 | v. 安慰；抚慰
definition_en: A pleasant state of physical ease and relaxation. | Relief from sadness or worry, or something providing it. | To help someone feel less sad, worried, or upset.
example1_en: I enjoyed the comfort of a warm bed after camping.
example1_zh: 露营后，我享受着温暖床铺带来的舒适。
example2_en: Support groups can comfort patients by providing opportunities to share experiences and discuss concerns openly.
example2_zh: 互助小组让患者有机会分享经历、坦诚讨论忧虑，从而给予他们安慰。
collocations: in comfort｜舒舒服服地 ; take comfort in｜从……中获得慰藉 ; comfort someone｜安慰某人 ; creature comforts｜物质上的舒适享受
tip_zh: 表示舒适或慰藉时通常不可数；作动词直接接人。

meanings_zh: adj. 对……过敏的 | adj. 过敏引起的
definition_en: Having an allergy to a particular substance | Caused by an allergy
example1_en: I am allergic to cats, so I keep my distance.
example1_zh: 我对猫过敏，所以会和猫保持距离。
example2_en: Restaurants should provide accurate ingredient information to protect customers who are allergic to common foods.
example2_zh: 餐馆应提供准确的配料信息，以保护对常见食物过敏的顾客。
collocations: be allergic to｜对……过敏 ; allergic reaction｜过敏反应 ; allergic to pollen｜对花粉过敏
tip_zh: 说对某物过敏用be allergic to，不用allergic with。

meanings_zh: n. 联系；连接 | n. 链接 | v. 连接；联系起来
definition_en: a connection between people, things, or ideas | a clickable element that opens another webpage or digital resource | to connect things or show a relationship between them
example1_en: The new bridge provides a link between the villages.
example1_zh: 这座新桥连接了这些村庄。
example2_en: Researchers have identified a strong link between regular physical activity and improved mental health.
example2_zh: 研究人员发现，经常运动与心理健康改善之间存在密切联系。
collocations: a link between｜……之间的联系 ; click a link｜点击链接 ; link A to B｜将A与B联系起来 ; transport links｜交通连接
tip_zh: 常用a link between A and B；动词用link A to/with B。

meanings_zh: n. 风味；味道 | v. 给……调味 | n. 特色；风格
definition_en: the particular taste of food or drink | to give food or drink a particular taste | a distinctive quality that gives something its character
example1_en: Fresh basil gives this soup a lovely flavour.
example1_zh: 新鲜罗勒让这道汤有了宜人的风味。
example2_en: School cooking lessons can teach children how to improve flavour without adding excessive salt or sugar.
example2_zh: 学校的烹饪课可以教孩子如何在不过量加盐或糖的情况下提升食物风味。
collocations: rich flavour｜浓郁的味道 ; add flavour｜增添风味 ; flavour with herbs｜用香草调味
tip_zh: 英式拼写flavour，美式拼写flavor。

meanings_zh: n. 鹅 | n. 鹅肉
definition_en: A large waterbird with a long neck and webbed feet. | Meat from a goose, eaten as food.
example1_en: A white goose waddled across the path towards us.
example1_zh: 一只白鹅摇摇摆摆地穿过小路，朝我们走来。
example2_en: Protecting wetlands provides essential feeding grounds for wild geese and many other migratory birds.
example2_zh: 保护湿地能为野鹅及许多其他候鸟提供重要的觅食地。
collocations: wild geese｜野鹅 ; a flock of geese｜一群鹅 ; roast goose｜烤鹅
tip_zh: 复数为geese；表示鹅肉时不可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 非正式的；随意的 | adj. 口语化的；非正式语体的 | adj. 非官方的；非正规的
definition_en: Relaxed and friendly rather than following strict social rules. | Suitable for casual communication rather than formal writing or speech. | Not officially arranged, recognized, or controlled.
example1_en: We had an informal chat over tea this morning.
example1_zh: 今天上午，我们边喝茶边随意聊了聊。
example2_en: Informal learning outside the classroom allows children to develop practical skills through play and everyday experiences.
example2_zh: 课堂外的非正规学习让儿童通过玩耍和日常经历培养实用技能。
collocations: informal chat｜闲聊 ; informal language｜非正式语言 ; informal learning｜非正规学习
tip_zh: 表示不拘礼节，不等于不礼貌或不专业。

meanings_zh: n. 鲑鱼；三文鱼；其鱼肉 | adj. 鲑肉粉红色的
definition_en: a fish with pink flesh, or its flesh as food | having a pink colour with a slight orange shade
example1_en: We watched a salmon leap up the rocky stream.
example1_zh: 我们看着一条鲑鱼在多石的溪流中跃向上游。
example2_en: Dams can disrupt salmon migration, so river management should consider both energy production and wildlife protection.
example2_zh: 水坝可能阻碍鲑鱼洄游，因此河流管理应兼顾能源生产与野生动物保护。
collocations: smoked salmon｜烟熏三文鱼 ; wild salmon｜野生鲑鱼 ; salmon fillet｜去骨鲑鱼片 ; salmon migration｜鲑鱼洄游
tip_zh: l不发音；指鱼时单复数同形，指鱼肉时不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 火鸡 | n. 火鸡肉 | n. 失败之作
definition_en: A large bird often raised for its meat | Meat from a turkey, eaten as food | Something that fails badly, especially a film or play
example1_en: A turkey spread its tail feathers near the farm gate.
example1_zh: 一只火鸡在农场大门旁展开了尾羽。
example2_en: Turkey production provides affordable protein, but intensive farming can raise concerns about animal welfare and environmental damage.
example2_zh: 火鸡养殖提供了价格实惠的蛋白质，但集约化养殖可能引发对动物福利和环境破坏的担忧。
collocations: roast turkey｜烤火鸡 ; turkey breast｜火鸡胸肉 ; wild turkey｜野生火鸡
tip_zh: 鸟可数，肉不可数；表示失败之作时属非正式用法。

meanings_zh: n. 磁带录音
definition_en: sound recorded on magnetic tape
example1_en: We found a tape-recording of our grandfather singing.
example1_zh: 我们找到了一段祖父唱歌的磁带录音。
example2_en: A tape-recording of a traditional song can help researchers understand how local musical styles have changed.
example2_zh: 一段传统歌曲的磁带录音能帮助研究人员了解当地音乐风格的变化。
collocations: make a tape-recording｜制作磁带录音 ; listen to a tape-recording｜听磁带录音 ; a tape-recording of an interview｜访谈的磁带录音
tip_zh: 也常写作 tape recording；数字录音通常用 recording。

meanings_zh: adj. 未知的；不为人知的 | n. 未知因素；无名之辈
definition_en: Not known, identified, or familiar. | Something not yet understood, or a person not widely known.
example1_en: An unknown caller rang while I was cooking dinner.
example1_zh: 我做晚饭时，一个陌生人打来了电话。
example2_en: The long-term effects of some new materials remain unknown, so further research is essential before widespread use.
example2_zh: 某些新材料的长期影响仍不明确，因此在广泛使用前必须进一步研究。
collocations: remain unknown｜仍然未知 ; unknown to someone｜某人不知道的 ; an unknown cause｜不明原因 ; the unknown｜未知事物
tip_zh: the unknown泛指“未知事物或未知领域”。

meanings_zh: n. 口音 | n. 重音；重音符号 | v. 强调；突出
definition_en: a pronunciation style associated with a place or social group | emphasis on a syllable, or a mark indicating pronunciation | to give special emphasis or prominence to something
example1_en: Her accent reminds me of my neighbours back home.
example1_zh: 她的口音让我想起家乡的邻居。
example2_en: Teachers should value different accents while helping learners develop clear pronunciation for effective international communication.
example2_zh: 教师应尊重不同口音，同时帮助学习者练就清晰的发音，以便有效开展国际交流。
collocations: regional accent｜地方口音 ; strong accent｜浓重的口音 ; speak with an accent｜说话带口音 ; accent mark｜重音符号
tip_zh: accent指发音特点；dialect还涉及词汇和语法。

meanings_zh: n. 风车；风力磨坊
definition_en: A structure whose wind-driven sails power machinery, often for grinding grain.
example1_en: We watched the old windmill turn beside the river.
example1_zh: 我们看着河边的老风车转动。
example2_en: Restoring a traditional windmill can preserve local heritage while attracting visitors interested in the history of rural technology.
example2_zh: 修复传统风车既能保护当地遗产，也能吸引对乡村技术史感兴趣的游客。
collocations: a traditional windmill｜传统风车 ; restore a windmill｜修复风车 ; windmill sails｜风车翼板
tip_zh: 现代发电风机通常叫wind turbine。

meanings_zh: n. 百分比；百分率
definition_en: an amount expressed as a fraction of one hundred
example1_en: What percentage of your monthly income goes on rent?
example1_zh: 你每月收入的百分之多少用于付房租？
example2_en: The percentage of households using renewable energy has increased as installation costs have fallen in recent years.
example2_zh: 近年来，随着安装成本下降，使用可再生能源的家庭比例有所上升。
collocations: a high percentage of｜很高比例的 ; a small percentage of｜小部分的 ; percentage point｜百分点 ; percentage increase｜百分比增幅
tip_zh: 数字后用percent；谈比例用percentage。

meanings_zh: adj. 有罪的；有过错的 | adj. 内疚的
definition_en: Responsible for breaking a law or doing something wrong. | Feeling bad because you believe you have done something wrong.
example1_en: I felt guilty about forgetting my sister's birthday.
example1_zh: 我忘了姐姐的生日，感到很内疚。
example2_en: Companies found guilty of illegally dumping waste should face penalties that reflect the environmental damage caused.
example2_zh: 被裁定非法倾倒废物的公司应受到与其造成的环境损害相称的处罚。
collocations: guilty of｜犯有……罪的 ; find someone guilty｜裁定某人有罪 ; plead guilty｜认罪 ; feel guilty about｜因……感到内疚
tip_zh: guilty of接罪行；feel guilty about接内疚的事。

meanings_zh: v. 出口；输出 | n. 出口；出口商品 | v. 导出数据
definition_en: to send goods to another country for sale | selling goods abroad, or goods sold to another country | to save computer data in a format another program uses
example1_en: My aunt's company exports handmade bowls to several countries.
example1_zh: 我姑姑的公司向多个国家出口手工碗。
example2_en: Countries that export mainly raw materials may be vulnerable to sudden changes in global commodity prices.
example2_zh: 主要出口原材料的国家可能容易受到全球大宗商品价格突变的冲击。
collocations: export goods｜出口商品 ; export markets｜出口市场 ; export earnings｜出口收入 ; export data｜导出数据
tip_zh: 动词重音在后；名词重音在前。

meanings_zh: n. 水族箱；养鱼缸 | n. 水族馆
definition_en: A water-filled container for keeping fish and other aquatic animals | A public building where people can see aquatic animals
example1_en: Two orange fish swim among plants in our aquarium.
example1_zh: 两条橙色的鱼在我们鱼缸里的水草间游动。
example2_en: A well-managed aquarium can teach visitors about marine ecosystems and encourage greater concern for ocean conservation.
example2_zh: 管理良好的水族馆可以让游客了解海洋生态系统，并促使他们更加关注海洋保护。
collocations: a freshwater aquarium｜淡水水族箱 ; a public aquarium｜公共水族馆 ; aquarium fish｜水族观赏鱼
tip_zh: 既指家中的鱼缸，也指供公众参观的水族馆。

meanings_zh: n. 竞争对手 | n. 参赛者；选手
definition_en: A person or organisation trying to succeed against others. | Someone taking part in a competition.
example1_en: The new bakery is our biggest competitor for local customers.
example1_zh: 那家新面包店是我们争取本地顾客时最大的竞争对手。
example2_en: A business must understand its competitors before developing strategies to attract customers in an increasingly crowded market.
example2_zh: 企业必须了解竞争对手，才能制定策略，在日益拥挤的市场中吸引顾客。
collocations: a major competitor｜主要竞争对手 ; a direct competitor｜直接竞争对手 ; a strong competitor｜强劲的竞争者
tip_zh: competitor指竞争者；competition指竞争或比赛。

meanings_zh: v. 呼吸
definition_en: take air into your lungs and let it out
example1_en: Sit by the window and breathe slowly for a minute.
example1_zh: 坐在窗边，缓缓呼吸一分钟。
example2_en: People living near busy roads often breathe polluted air, which can increase their risk of respiratory illness.
example2_zh: 住在繁忙道路附近的人经常吸入受污染的空气，这可能增加他们患呼吸系统疾病的风险。
collocations: breathe deeply｜深呼吸 ; breathe in｜吸气 ; breathe out｜呼气 ; breathe fresh air｜呼吸新鲜空气
tip_zh: breathe是动词，末音/ð/；breath是名词，末音/θ/。

meanings_zh: v. 预测；预言
definition_en: To say what will happen, often using evidence.
example1_en: They predict heavy rain, so take your umbrella.
example1_zh: 他们预报有大雨，所以带上你的伞吧。
example2_en: Climate models help scientists predict how rising temperatures may affect agricultural production in different regions.
example2_zh: 气候模型帮助科学家预测气温上升可能如何影响不同地区的农业生产。
collocations: predict the outcome｜预测结果 ; accurately predict｜准确预测 ; difficult to predict｜难以预测
tip_zh: 可接that从句；不要与表示预防的prevent混淆。

meanings_zh: n. 机械修理工；汽车修理工
definition_en: Someone whose job is repairing vehicles or machines.
example1_en: The mechanic found a leak under our car.
example1_zh: 修理工发现我们的汽车底部有一处泄漏。
example2_en: As electric vehicles become more common, mechanics need additional training to maintain their complex systems safely.
example2_zh: 随着电动汽车日益普及，修理工需要接受额外培训，以安全地维护其复杂系统。
collocations: car mechanic｜汽车修理工 ; a qualified mechanic｜合格的机械修理工 ; work as a mechanic｜当机械修理工
tip_zh: mechanic指修理工；mechanics可指力学。

meanings_zh: v. 使娱乐；使开心 | v. 招待；款待 | v. 考虑；心怀
definition_en: to keep someone interested or amused | to welcome guests and provide food, drink, or activities | to consider an idea or hold a thought or feeling
example1_en: My brother entertained the children with funny animal noises.
example1_zh: 我哥哥模仿动物发出滑稽的叫声，逗孩子们开心。
example2_en: Public museums should educate visitors as well as entertain them through engaging displays and interactive activities.
example2_zh: 公共博物馆应通过引人入胜的展览和互动活动，让参观者既获得知识又享受乐趣。
collocations: entertain an audience｜为观众提供娱乐 ; entertain guests｜招待客人 ; entertain the idea of｜考虑……的想法
tip_zh: entertain an idea指考虑某想法，并非已经接受。

meanings_zh: n. 酒；含酒精饮品 | n. 酒精；乙醇
definition_en: drinks containing a substance that can make people drunk | a colourless liquid used in drinks, cleaning products, and fuels
example1_en: This restaurant serves fresh juice but does not sell alcohol.
example1_zh: 这家餐馆供应鲜榨果汁，但不卖酒。
example2_en: Public health campaigns should explain how excessive alcohol consumption can damage both physical and mental health.
example2_zh: 公共卫生宣传应解释过量饮酒如何损害身心健康。
collocations: alcohol consumption｜饮酒量；饮酒 ; alcohol abuse｜酗酒 ; alcohol content｜酒精含量 ; rubbing alcohol｜外用消毒酒精
tip_zh: 泛指酒或酒精时通常不可数；a drink可指一杯酒。

meanings_zh: n. 地下室
definition_en: A room or floor below ground level in a building.
example1_en: We keep our bicycles in the basement during winter.
example1_zh: 冬天我们把自行车放在地下室里。
example2_en: Converting unused basement space into community facilities can help densely populated neighbourhoods accommodate more activities.
example2_zh: 将闲置的地下室空间改造成社区设施，有助于人口密集的街区容纳更多活动。
collocations: in the basement｜在地下室里 ; basement flat｜地下室公寓 ; basement storage｜地下室储物
tip_zh: basement可作居住空间；cellar通常指地下储藏室。

meanings_zh: v. 打喷嚏 | n. 喷嚏
definition_en: To suddenly force air out through your nose and mouth. | A sudden, involuntary burst of air from the nose and mouth.
example1_en: Dust from the old rug made me sneeze.
example1_zh: 旧地毯扬起的灰尘让我打了喷嚏。
example2_en: Covering your mouth and nose when you sneeze helps reduce the spread of respiratory infections.
example2_zh: 打喷嚏时遮住口鼻有助于减少呼吸道感染的传播。
collocations: sneeze into a tissue｜对着纸巾打喷嚏 ; a fit of sneezing｜一阵喷嚏 ; stifle a sneeze｜忍住喷嚏
tip_zh: 动词不及物；“打一个喷嚏”可说give a sneeze。

meanings_zh: n. 治疗；疗法 | n. 对待；待遇 | n. 处理；加工
definition_en: medical care given to improve an illness or injury | the way someone behaves towards a person or group | a process that cleans, protects, or changes a substance
example1_en: After treatment, her injured ankle felt much better.
example1_zh: 经过治疗，她受伤的脚踝感觉好多了。
example2_en: Access to affordable medical treatment is essential for reducing health inequalities between wealthy and disadvantaged communities.
example2_zh: 获得负担得起的医疗服务，对于缩小富裕社区与弱势社区之间的健康差距至关重要。
collocations: receive treatment｜接受治疗 ; medical treatment｜医疗 ; equal treatment｜平等对待 ; wastewater treatment｜废水处理
tip_zh: 泛指治疗通常不可数；指具体疗法时可用a treatment。

meanings_zh: adj. 自助式的 | n. 自助服务
definition_en: Requiring customers to serve themselves rather than wait for staff | A system in which customers serve themselves
example1_en: We carried our trays through the self-service cafeteria.
example1_zh: 我们端着托盘穿过了自助餐厅。
example2_en: Although self-service machines can shorten queues, businesses should retain staff to assist customers who need additional support.
example2_zh: 虽然自助机器能缩短队伍，但企业仍应保留员工，为需要额外帮助的顾客提供服务。
collocations: self-service checkout｜自助结账台 ; self-service cafeteria｜自助餐厅 ; self-service machine｜自助服务机
tip_zh: self-service强调顾客自己操作，不等于机器全自动。

meanings_zh: adj. 诚实的；正直的 | adj. 坦率的；真诚的
definition_en: Telling the truth and not cheating or stealing. | Expressing what you really think or feel.
example1_en: The honest cashier returned the money I had overpaid.
example1_zh: 那位诚实的收银员退还了我多付的钱。
example2_en: Honest communication between teachers and parents can help schools address students' difficulties before they become serious.
example2_zh: 教师与家长之间坦诚的沟通能帮助学校在学生的问题变得严重之前加以解决。
collocations: an honest person｜诚实的人 ; an honest answer｜坦率的回答 ; to be honest｜说实话
tip_zh: h不发音，因此说an honest person。

meanings_zh: n. 拖拉机
definition_en: A powerful farm vehicle used to pull equipment or loads
example1_en: The farmer drove a tractor across the muddy field.
example1_zh: 农民开着拖拉机驶过泥泞的田地。
example2_en: Using a tractor allows farmers to cultivate larger areas with less physical effort and fewer workers.
example2_zh: 使用拖拉机使农民能够以更少的体力和人手耕种更大的面积。
collocations: drive a tractor｜驾驶拖拉机 ; tractor driver｜拖拉机驾驶员 ; tractor tyre｜拖拉机轮胎
tip_zh: tractor是拖拉机；truck是卡车，注意区别。

meanings_zh: v. 大喊；叫喊 | n. 喊叫声
definition_en: to shout loudly, often from excitement, anger, or fear | a loud shout
example1_en: We yelled with excitement when our team finally scored.
example1_zh: 我们的球队终于得分时，我们兴奋地大喊起来。
example2_en: Coaches who yell at young athletes may undermine their confidence rather than improve their performance.
example2_zh: 对年轻运动员大吼大叫的教练可能会打击他们的信心，而不是提高他们的表现。
collocations: yell at someone｜对某人大喊 ; yell for help｜大声呼救 ; let out a yell｜发出一声大喊
tip_zh: yell at常带怒气；yell to侧重喊给对方听。

meanings_zh: n. 受害者；受骗者
definition_en: someone harmed by an accident, crime, or unfair treatment
example1_en: Neighbours brought warm blankets to the flood victims.
example1_zh: 邻居们给洪灾受害者送来了温暖的毯子。
example2_en: Governments should provide practical support for victims of online fraud, including free legal advice.
example2_zh: 政府应为网络诈骗受害者提供实际支持，包括免费的法律咨询。
collocations: victim of crime｜犯罪受害者 ; fall victim to｜成为……的受害者 ; flood victims｜洪灾受害者
tip_zh: 表示某事的受害者，用victim of。

meanings_zh: n. 损坏；损害 | v. 损坏；损害
definition_en: Harm that makes something less useful, valuable, or healthy. | Harm something or make it less effective.
example1_en: The storm caused serious damage to our garden shed.
example1_zh: 暴风雨严重损坏了我们花园里的棚屋。
example2_en: Uncontrolled tourism can damage fragile ecosystems and reduce the quality of life for local residents.
example2_zh: 不受控制的旅游活动可能破坏脆弱的生态系统，并降低当地居民的生活质量。
collocations: cause damage｜造成损害 ; damage to property｜财产损坏 ; environmental damage｜环境破坏 ; damage someone's reputation｜损害某人的声誉
tip_zh: 损害用不可数damage；damages指法律赔偿金。

meanings_zh: n. 海绵；海绵块 | n. 海绵动物 | v. 用海绵擦拭
definition_en: A soft material full of holes that absorbs liquid. | A simple aquatic animal with many pores in its body. | To clean or wipe something using a damp sponge.
example1_en: Use a damp sponge to wipe the kitchen table.
example1_zh: 用湿海绵擦一下厨房的桌子。
example2_en: Urban wetlands act like a sponge, absorbing excess rainwater and reducing the risk of flooding.
example2_zh: 城市湿地就像海绵，能吸收多余的雨水，降低洪涝风险。
collocations: a damp sponge｜湿海绵 ; squeeze out a sponge｜挤干海绵 ; sponge something down｜用湿海绵擦洗某物
tip_zh: 比喻吸收能力强时，常用like a sponge。

meanings_zh: v. 逮捕；拘捕 | n. 逮捕；拘捕 | v. 阻止；使停止
definition_en: to take someone into police custody under legal authority | the act of taking someone into police custody | to stop the progress or development of something
example1_en: Police arrested the suspect outside the station yesterday.
example1_zh: 警方昨天在车站外逮捕了嫌疑人。
example2_en: Early investment in building maintenance can arrest the decline of historic neighbourhoods and preserve their distinctive character.
example2_zh: 尽早投入建筑维护资金可以遏制历史街区的衰落，并保留其独特风貌。
collocations: arrest someone for theft｜因盗窃逮捕某人 ; under arrest｜被捕 ; make an arrest｜实施逮捕 ; arrest the decline｜遏制衰退
tip_zh: 因某事被捕用be arrested for；under arrest表示被捕状态。

meanings_zh: adj. 活着的；有生命的 | n. 生计；谋生收入 | n. 生活；生活方式
definition_en: Alive now, rather than dead or without life. | Money earned to pay for everyday needs. | The way people live and meet their everyday needs.
example1_en: The pond is full of tiny living creatures.
example1_zh: 池塘里满是微小的生物。
example2_en: Rising housing costs make it harder for young adults to earn a decent living in major cities.
example2_zh: 住房成本上涨，使年轻人在大城市更难挣到足以过上体面生活的收入。
collocations: living organisms｜活的有机体 ; earn a living｜谋生 ; cost of living｜生活成本 ; standard of living｜生活水平
tip_zh: living可放名词前；alive通常作表语或后置修饰。

meanings_zh: adj. 逗人发笑的；有趣的
definition_en: funny or entertaining in a pleasant way
example1_en: My cousin told an amusing story about his cat.
example1_zh: 我表哥讲了一个关于他家猫的趣事。
example2_en: Teachers can use amusing examples to maintain students' attention while explaining difficult concepts in science lessons.
example2_zh: 教师可以在科学课上用有趣的例子吸引学生注意，同时解释难懂的概念。
collocations: amusing story｜有趣的故事 ; find something amusing｜觉得某事好笑 ; amusing anecdote｜趣闻
tip_zh: amusing形容事物逗人笑；amused形容人觉得好笑。

meanings_zh: n. 纸盒；纸板箱
definition_en: A container made of cardboard, often used for food or drinks.
example1_en: Please put the milk carton back in the fridge.
example1_zh: 请把牛奶盒放回冰箱。
example2_en: Local recycling schemes should explain how residents can dispose of each type of food carton correctly.
example2_zh: 当地回收项目应说明居民如何正确处理各种食品纸盒。
collocations: a carton of milk｜一盒牛奶 ; egg carton｜鸡蛋盒 ; cardboard carton｜纸板箱
tip_zh: a carton of milk是一盒奶；勿与cartoon混淆。

meanings_zh: adj. 感激的；感谢的
definition_en: Feeling thankful for kindness, help, or something good.
example1_en: I am grateful for your help with the move.
example1_zh: 谢谢你帮我搬家。
example2_en: Many students are grateful for scholarships that allow them to continue their education despite financial difficulties.
example2_zh: 许多学生感谢奖学金让他们即使经济困难也能继续学业。
collocations: grateful to someone｜感激某人 ; grateful for something｜感谢某事 ; deeply grateful｜深表感激
tip_zh: be grateful to某人 for某事；注意不是greatful。

meanings_zh: n. 日出；日出时分
definition_en: The appearance of the sun above the horizon each morning.
example1_en: We woke early to watch the sunrise over the lake.
example1_zh: 我们早早醒来，观看湖上的日出。
example2_en: Outdoor activities scheduled around sunrise allow tourists to enjoy cooler temperatures and observe local wildlife.
example2_zh: 安排在日出前后的户外活动让游客能在较凉爽的气温下观赏当地野生动物。
collocations: at sunrise｜在日出时 ; watch the sunrise｜看日出 ; before sunrise｜日出前
tip_zh: 在日出时用at sunrise；日落是sunset。

meanings_zh: n. 腰；腰部 | n. 衣服的腰部
definition_en: The middle part of your body above your hips. | The part of a garment that fits around your waist.
example1_en: These trousers fit perfectly around my waist now.
example1_zh: 这条裤子的腰围现在正好适合我。
example2_en: Measuring waist size can help health professionals assess certain risks associated with excess body fat.
example2_zh: 测量腰围能帮助医护人员评估与体脂过多相关的某些风险。
collocations: waist size｜腰围 ; around the waist｜围绕腰部 ; from the waist up｜从腰部往上
tip_zh: waist指腰，与表示浪费的waste同音。

meanings_zh: n. 骑自行车的人
definition_en: a person who rides a bicycle
example1_en: The cyclist stopped beside the bridge for water.
example1_zh: 那位骑自行车的人在桥边停下来喝水。
example2_en: Protected cycle lanes can reduce the risk of collisions between cyclists and motor vehicles in busy cities.
example2_zh: 在繁忙的城市中，有隔离设施的自行车道可以降低骑车者与机动车碰撞的风险。
collocations: commuter cyclist｜骑车通勤者 ; professional cyclist｜职业自行车运动员 ; cyclist safety｜骑车者安全
tip_zh: cyclist指骑自行车的人，不指骑摩托车的人。

meanings_zh: n. 字幕 | n. 副标题 | v. 给……配字幕
definition_en: written dialogue or translation displayed on a screen | an additional title explaining a work's main title | to add written dialogue or translation to a film
example1_en: We watched the film with subtitles because the dialogue was quiet.
example1_zh: 因为对白声音很小，我们看电影时开了字幕。
example2_en: Subtitles can support language learning by helping viewers connect spoken expressions with their written forms.
example2_zh: 字幕能帮助观众将口语表达与书面形式联系起来，从而辅助语言学习。
collocations: English subtitles｜英语字幕 ; turn on subtitles｜开启字幕 ; add a subtitle｜添加副标题
tip_zh: 影视字幕通常用复数subtitles；单数也可指副标题。

meanings_zh: v. 康复；恢复 | v. 找回；重新获得
definition_en: return to health or a normal condition after difficulty | get back something lost, stolen, or spent
example1_en: It took several days to recover from the flu.
example1_zh: 流感过后，花了好几天才康复。
example2_en: Local economies often recover more quickly when governments provide timely support for small businesses.
example2_zh: 政府及时为小企业提供支持时，当地经济往往恢复得更快。
collocations: recover from an illness｜病后康复 ; fully recover｜完全恢复 ; recover lost data｜恢复丢失的数据 ; recover costs｜收回成本
tip_zh: 从疾病或挫折中恢复用recover from。

meanings_zh: v. 点头；点头示意 | n. 点头；点头示意
definition_en: to move your head down and up to communicate | a downward and upward head movement expressing a message
example1_en: She nodded when I offered her another cup of tea.
example1_zh: 我问她是否再来杯茶时，她点了点头。
example2_en: During group discussions, participants may nod to show understanding without necessarily agreeing with the speaker's views.
example2_zh: 在小组讨论中，参与者可能通过点头表示理解，但并不一定赞同发言者的观点。
collocations: nod in agreement｜点头同意 ; give a nod｜点一下头 ; nod at someone｜向某人点头 ; nod off｜打瞌睡
tip_zh: 过去式nodded；现在分词nodding，均双写d。

meanings_zh: n. 小号 | v. 大肆宣扬；鼓吹 | v. 发出喇叭般的声音
definition_en: A brass musical instrument with three valves and a bright sound. | To announce or praise something loudly and publicly. | To make a loud sound like an elephant's call.
example1_en: The musician lifted her trumpet and played a cheerful tune.
example1_zh: 那位乐手举起小号，吹奏了一支欢快的曲子。
example2_en: Learning the trumpet in a school orchestra can improve students' concentration and ability to cooperate with others.
example2_zh: 在学校管弦乐队学习小号可以提升学生的专注力及与他人合作的能力。
collocations: play the trumpet｜吹小号 ; trumpet player｜小号手 ; trumpet achievements｜大肆宣扬成就
tip_zh: 乐器义是“小号”；动词可指大肆宣扬。

meanings_zh: adj. 多沙的；铺满沙的 | adj. 沙色的；浅黄褐色的
definition_en: covered with sand or containing a lot of sand | light yellowish brown in colour, especially describing hair
example1_en: We left our shoes beside the sandy path.
example1_zh: 我们把鞋放在了沙地小路旁。
example2_en: Sandy soils often require careful irrigation because they retain less water than soils with more clay.
example2_zh: 沙质土壤通常需要精心灌溉，因为其保水能力弱于黏土含量较高的土壤。
collocations: sandy beach｜沙滩 ; sandy soil｜沙质土壤 ; sandy hair｜浅黄褐色头发
tip_zh: sandy既可形容多沙的地面，也可形容浅黄褐色头发。

meanings_zh: n. 传统；惯例
definition_en: A belief or custom passed down through generations.
example1_en: Making dumplings together is a tradition in our family.
example1_zh: 一起包饺子是我们家的传统。
example2_en: Schools can help preserve local traditions by inviting older residents to share their knowledge and practical skills.
example2_zh: 学校可以邀请年长居民分享知识和实用技能，从而帮助保留当地传统。
collocations: family tradition｜家庭传统 ; preserve a tradition｜保留传统 ; break with tradition｜打破传统 ; oral tradition｜口述传统
tip_zh: 具体习俗可数；泛指传统时可不可数，如break with tradition。

meanings_zh: n. 大西洋 | adj. 大西洋的；沿岸的
definition_en: The ocean between the Americas and Europe and Africa. | Relating to the Atlantic Ocean or its surrounding regions.
example1_en: We watched huge waves roll in from the Atlantic.
example1_zh: 我们看着巨浪从大西洋翻涌而来。
example2_en: Changes in Atlantic ocean currents could influence weather patterns and agricultural production across several continents.
example2_zh: 大西洋洋流的变化可能影响多个大洲的天气模式和农业生产。
collocations: the Atlantic Ocean｜大西洋 ; cross the Atlantic｜横渡大西洋 ; the Atlantic coast｜大西洋沿岸
tip_zh: 首字母大写；作名词通常用the Atlantic。

meanings_zh: v. 吹口哨；鸣哨；呼啸 | n. 哨子 | n. 口哨声；汽笛声
definition_en: to make a high sound with lips or escaping air | a small device blown to produce a high, clear sound | a high, clear sound made by lips, air, or a device
example1_en: My brother whistles cheerful tunes while washing the dishes.
example1_zh: 我哥哥洗碗时会吹欢快的小曲。
example2_en: Lifeguards use whistles to attract swimmers' attention quickly when dangerous conditions develop near the shore.
example2_zh: 岸边出现危险情况时，救生员用哨子迅速引起游泳者的注意。
collocations: blow a whistle｜吹哨 ; whistle a tune｜吹口哨哼曲子 ; final whistle｜终场哨声 ; whistle for help｜吹哨求助
tip_zh: whistle中的t不发音；吹哨子用blow a whistle。

meanings_zh: n. 力气；力量 | n. 长处；优势 | n. 强度；坚固程度
definition_en: Physical power to lift, move, or resist something. | A quality or skill that makes someone or something effective. | How strong, powerful, or resistant to damage something is.
example1_en: I needed all my strength to lift the suitcase.
example1_zh: 我使出全身力气才提起那个手提箱。
example2_en: Schools should help students identify their strengths rather than judge everyone solely through written examinations.
example2_zh: 学校应帮助学生发现自己的长处，而不是仅凭笔试评判所有人。
collocations: physical strength｜体力 ; strengths and weaknesses｜优点与缺点 ; tensile strength｜抗拉强度 ; build strength｜增强力量
tip_zh: 表示力气通常不可数；表示长处可数。

meanings_zh: v. 撕破；扯开 | n. 眼泪 | n. 裂口；破洞
definition_en: To pull something apart or make a hole by pulling. | A drop of liquid that comes from your eye. | A hole or split caused by pulling something apart.
example1_en: Be careful not to tear the paper bag.
example1_zh: 小心别把纸袋撕破了。
example2_en: Thin plastic bags tear easily, making them less suitable for repeated use than durable cloth alternatives.
example2_zh: 薄塑料袋容易撕裂，因此不如耐用的布袋适合反复使用。
collocations: tear up paper｜撕碎纸张 ; burst into tears｜突然哭起来 ; tear apart｜撕开；扯碎
tip_zh: 撕裂读/teə/，眼泪读/tɪə/；动词变化为 tore、torn。

meanings_zh: n. 海军 | n. 深蓝色；藏青色 | adj. 深蓝色的
definition_en: the armed force that operates mainly at sea | a very dark blue colour | having a very dark blue colour
example1_en: My uncle joined the navy after leaving school.
example1_zh: 我叔叔毕业后加入了海军。
example2_en: The navy can support coastal communities by delivering emergency supplies after severe storms damage local roads.
example2_zh: 强风暴破坏当地道路后，海军可以运送应急物资，支援沿海社区。
collocations: join the navy｜加入海军 ; serve in the navy｜在海军服役 ; navy blue｜藏青色
tip_zh: navy指海军整体；具体的一艘军舰用warship。

meanings_zh: adj. 简短的；短暂的 | v. 向……介绍情况 | n. 任务说明；工作要求
definition_en: Lasting a short time or using few words. | To give someone essential information or instructions. | Instructions explaining what a task should achieve.
example1_en: We took a brief break before finishing the puzzle.
example1_zh: 我们短暂休息了一下，然后完成了拼图。
example2_en: Teachers should brief students on safety procedures before allowing them to conduct experiments independently.
example2_zh: 教师应先向学生介绍安全操作规程，再允许他们独立进行实验。
collocations: a brief summary｜简要总结 ; a brief pause｜短暂停顿 ; brief someone on｜向某人介绍……的情况 ; a design brief｜设计任务说明
tip_zh: brief指时间短或内容简洁，本身不表示草率。

meanings_zh: n. 杆；柱；竿 | n. 地极；磁极；电极 | n. 对立的极端
definition_en: A long, narrow stick or post, often used for support. | Either of two opposite ends of Earth, a magnet, or battery. | Either of two completely opposite positions or qualities.
example1_en: We used a long pole to support the tent.
example1_zh: 我们用一根长杆撑起帐篷。
example2_en: Climate change is affecting both poles, although the environmental consequences differ significantly between the two regions.
example2_zh: 气候变化正影响着南北两极，但两个地区面临的环境后果存在显著差异。
collocations: a tent pole｜帐篷撑杆 ; the North Pole｜北极 ; a magnetic pole｜磁极 ; poles apart｜截然不同
tip_zh: pole与poll同音；地理名称the North Pole需大写。

meanings_zh: adj. 独一无二的；独特的 | adj. 特有的；独有的
definition_en: Unlike anything else, or the only one of its kind | Found only in a particular person, place, or thing
example1_en: Each handmade bowl has a unique pattern inside.
example1_zh: 每个手工碗的内侧都有独特的图案。
example2_en: Protecting local crafts helps communities preserve their unique cultural identity in an increasingly globalised world.
example2_zh: 在日益全球化的世界中，保护地方手工艺有助于社区保留独特的文化认同。
collocations: unique opportunity｜难得的机会 ; unique features｜独有的特点 ; unique to the region｜该地区特有的
tip_zh: unique to表示某处特有；严格指唯一时不用very修饰。

meanings_zh: n. 包裹；包装盒 | n. 一整套方案或服务 | v. 包装
definition_en: An object or collection of objects wrapped or boxed together. | A set of services or measures offered together. | To put something into a container for sale or transport.
example1_en: A small package arrived at our door this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早晨，一个小包裹送到了我们家门口。
example2_en: The government introduced a support package to help small businesses invest in cleaner production methods.
example2_zh: 政府推出了一揽子扶持措施，帮助小企业投资更清洁的生产方式。
collocations: deliver a package｜递送包裹 ; a support package｜一揽子扶持措施 ; package holiday｜包价旅游
tip_zh: 指邮寄的包裹时，英式英语也常用parcel。

meanings_zh: n. 贷款；借款 | n. 借用；出借 | v. 借出；贷给
definition_en: money borrowed and expected to be paid back | the temporary use of something belonging to someone else | to give money or something temporarily, expecting its return
example1_en: We took out a loan to repair the roof.
example1_zh: 我们申请了一笔贷款来修屋顶。
example2_en: Affordable student loans can widen access to university, although repayment may create financial pressure after graduation.
example2_zh: 负担得起的学生贷款可以扩大大学入学机会，但毕业后的还款可能带来经济压力。
collocations: take out a loan｜申请贷款 ; repay a loan｜偿还贷款 ; student loan｜学生贷款 ; on loan｜借用中；出借中
tip_zh: loan作动词意为借出，不是借入。

meanings_zh: n. 早午餐
definition_en: A late morning meal combining breakfast and lunch.
example1_en: We enjoyed brunch on the balcony this morning.
example1_zh: 今天上午，我们在阳台上享用了早午餐。
example2_en: Serving brunch allows local cafés to attract customers outside the traditional breakfast and lunch periods.
example2_zh: 供应早午餐能让当地咖啡馆在传统早餐和午餐时段之外吸引顾客。
collocations: have brunch｜吃早午餐 ; weekend brunch｜周末早午餐 ; brunch menu｜早午餐菜单
tip_zh: 由breakfast和lunch合成，指合并两餐的早午餐。

meanings_zh: adj. 被禁止的；不准的
definition_en: not allowed by a rule, law, or authority
example1_en: Taking photos is forbidden inside this small museum.
example1_zh: 这家小博物馆内禁止拍照。
example2_en: In many protected areas, hunting is strictly forbidden to preserve wildlife populations and maintain ecological balance.
example2_zh: 在许多保护区，狩猎被严格禁止，以保护野生动物种群并维持生态平衡。
collocations: strictly forbidden｜严格禁止的 ; forbidden territory｜禁区 ; forbidden by law｜法律禁止的
tip_zh: 也是forbid的过去分词；过去式为forbade。

meanings_zh: adv. 最终；终于
definition_en: in the end, especially after a long time or difficulty
example1_en: After searching every room, we eventually found the missing keys.
example1_zh: 搜遍每个房间后，我们终于找到了丢失的钥匙。
example2_en: Investment in public transport may initially be expensive, but it can eventually reduce congestion and improve urban life.
example2_zh: 公共交通投资起初可能成本高昂，但最终能够缓解拥堵并改善城市生活。
collocations: eventually succeed｜最终成功 ; eventually lead to｜最终导致 ; eventually become｜最终成为
tip_zh: 强调经过时间或困难后的结果，不表示可能。

meanings_zh: n. 缺陷；故障 | n. 过错；责任 | n. 断层
definition_en: Something wrong with an object, system, or person's character | Responsibility for a mistake or something bad that happened | A break in rock where sections have moved apart
example1_en: A small electrical fault stopped the washing machine yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天一个小小的电路故障让洗衣机停止了运转。
example2_en: Regular inspections can identify a structural fault before it threatens the safety of residents.
example2_zh: 定期检查能在结构缺陷危及居民安全之前发现它。
collocations: electrical fault｜电路故障 ; at fault｜有过错 ; find fault with｜挑剔 ; fault line｜断层线
tip_zh: It's my fault表示“是我的错”，不用mistake替换。

meanings_zh: n. 包裹；邮包 | n. 一块土地 | v. 打包；分配
definition_en: an object wrapped for sending by post or delivery | a piece of land considered as a single unit | to wrap something, or divide it into portions for distribution
example1_en: A small parcel arrived for you this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上有个寄给你的小包裹到了。
example2_en: The growing volume of parcel deliveries has encouraged cities to explore cleaner transport options for local distribution.
example2_zh: 包裹配送量不断增长，促使城市探索更环保的本地配送方式。
collocations: send a parcel｜寄包裹 ; a parcel of land｜一块土地 ; parcel something up｜把某物包好 ; parcel something out｜分配某物
tip_zh: 包裹在英式英语中常用parcel，美式英语更常用package。

meanings_zh: n. 泥；泥浆
definition_en: Soft, wet earth made when soil mixes with water.
example1_en: Our boots were covered in mud after the walk.
example1_zh: 散步回来后，我们的靴子上沾满了泥。
example2_en: Heavy rainfall can turn unpaved roads into mud, making rural communities difficult to reach.
example2_zh: 强降雨会使未铺装的道路变得泥泞，导致农村社区交通不便。
collocations: thick mud｜厚厚的泥浆 ; covered in mud｜沾满泥 ; get stuck in the mud｜陷在泥里
tip_zh: mud通常不可数；形容泥泞用muddy。

meanings_zh: n. 短语；词组；惯用语 | v. 措辞；用语言表达
definition_en: a group of words expressing an idea or forming a unit | to express something using particular words
example1_en: I learned a useful phrase in my English class today.
example1_zh: 今天我在英语课上学到了一个实用短语。
example2_en: Researchers must phrase survey questions carefully to avoid influencing participants and reducing the reliability of their findings.
example2_zh: 研究人员必须仔细斟酌调查问题的措辞，以免影响参与者并降低研究结果的可靠性。
collocations: a common phrase｜常见短语 ; a noun phrase｜名词短语 ; phrase a question｜为问题措辞 ; a useful phrase｜实用短语
tip_zh: phrase是短语，不一定构成完整句子。

meanings_zh: adj. 难过的；心烦的 | v. 使难过；使心烦 | v. 打乱；扰乱
definition_en: Unhappy, worried, or disappointed about something. | To make someone feel unhappy or worried. | To disturb the usual arrangement or balance of something.
example1_en: Lena felt upset when she lost her favourite scarf.
example1_zh: 莉娜丢了最喜欢的围巾，心里很难过。
example2_en: Sudden changes to school routines can upset younger children, who often rely on predictable daily activities.
example2_zh: 学校作息突然改变可能让年幼的孩子不安，因为他们往往依赖可预期的日常活动。
collocations: feel upset｜感到难过 ; upset about something｜为某事心烦 ; upset the balance｜打破平衡 ; upset someone's plans｜打乱某人的计划
tip_zh: 动词过去式、过去分词仍是upset；名词重音在前。

meanings_zh: adj. 个人的；单独的 | n. 个人；个体 | adj. 独特的；有个性的
definition_en: Relating to one person or thing rather than a group | One person or living thing considered separately from others | Having qualities that make someone or something different from others
example1_en: The teacher gave each child an individual box of crayons.
example1_zh: 老师给每个孩子单独发了一盒彩色蜡笔。
example2_en: Education systems should recognise individual learning needs rather than expect every student to progress at the same pace.
example2_zh: 教育体系应重视个人的学习需求，而不是指望每个学生都以相同的速度进步。
collocations: individual needs｜个人需求 ; individual responsibility｜个人责任 ; individual differences｜个体差异 ; a talented individual｜有才华的人
tip_zh: 形容词强调单个或个人；作可数名词指一个人或个体。

meanings_zh: adj. 参与的；涉及的 | adj. 复杂难懂的
definition_en: taking part in or connected with something | complicated and difficult to understand
example1_en: Everyone involved in the picnic brought something to share.
example1_zh: 参加野餐的每个人都带了东西与大家分享。
example2_en: Residents should be actively involved in planning decisions that affect the future of their neighbourhoods.
example2_zh: 居民应积极参与影响社区未来的规划决策。
collocations: get involved in｜参与 ; actively involved｜积极参与的 ; an involved process｜复杂的过程
tip_zh: 参与某事用be involved in；修饰名词可后置。

meanings_zh: adv. 完全；彻底
definition_en: completely; in every way or to the fullest degree
example1_en: I totally forgot to bring my swimming costume.
example1_zh: 我完全忘了带泳衣。
example2_en: Online courses cannot totally replace classroom teaching because students also benefit from direct social interaction.
example2_zh: 在线课程无法完全取代课堂教学，因为学生也能从直接的社交互动中受益。
collocations: totally different｜完全不同 ; totally agree｜完全同意 ; totally unacceptable｜完全不可接受
tip_zh: 语气较强；正式写作中常可换用completely或entirely。

meanings_zh: v. 展示；陈列；显示 | n. 展览；陈列 | n. 显示屏
definition_en: Put something where people can see it | An arrangement of things for people to look at | A screen that shows information or images
example1_en: The bakery displays fresh cakes beside the front window.
example1_zh: 面包店把新鲜蛋糕陈列在前窗旁。
example2_en: Museums increasingly display everyday objects to illustrate how ordinary people lived in the past.
example2_zh: 博物馆越来越多地展示日常物品，以呈现过去普通人的生活方式。
collocations: on display｜在展出 ; display information｜显示信息 ; a colourful display｜色彩缤纷的陈列 ; digital display｜数字显示屏
tip_zh: on display意为“在展出”，中间不加冠词。

meanings_zh: prep. 减去；扣除 | adj. 负的；零下的 | n. 缺点；不利因素
definition_en: with a particular amount taken away | below zero | a disadvantage or negative feature
example1_en: Ten minus three leaves enough apples for everyone.
example1_zh: 十个苹果减去三个，剩下的仍够每人分一个。
example2_en: A household's disposable income is its total income minus taxes and other compulsory payments.
example2_zh: 家庭可支配收入是总收入扣除税款及其他强制性支出后剩余的部分。
collocations: minus ten degrees｜零下十度 ; minus sign｜减号；负号 ; pluses and minuses｜优缺点
tip_zh: minus可表减去，也可置于温度前表示零下。

meanings_zh: n. 航空邮件；航空邮递
definition_en: letters and parcels transported by aircraft, or this postal service
example1_en: We sent the parcel by airmail yesterday morning.
example1_zh: 我们昨天上午通过航空邮递寄出了包裹。
example2_en: Although digital communication dominates international business, airmail remains useful for sending original documents overseas.
example2_zh: 尽管数字通信主导着国际商务，航空邮递在向海外寄送文件原件方面仍然有用。
collocations: by airmail｜通过航空邮递 ; send something by airmail｜航空邮寄某物 ; airmail service｜航空邮递服务
tip_zh: 表示寄送方式用by airmail，不加冠词。

meanings_zh: adj. 被偷的；失窃的 | v. 偷窃（steal的过去分词）
definition_en: taken from its owner without permission | taken something without permission, as the past participle of steal
example1_en: The police found my stolen bicycle behind a garage.
example1_zh: 警察在一个车库后面找到了我被偷的自行车。
example2_en: Stolen personal data can expose internet users to financial losses, highlighting the importance of effective online security.
example2_zh: 被盗的个人数据可能使互联网用户遭受经济损失，这凸显了有效网络安全措施的重要性。
collocations: stolen goods｜赃物 ; a stolen vehicle｜被盗车辆 ; stolen data｜被盗数据
tip_zh: 变化为steal—stole—stolen；stolen不能单独作过去式。

meanings_zh: n. 快乐；满足 | n. 乐事；令人愉快的经历
definition_en: A feeling of happiness or enjoyment | An activity or experience that brings enjoyment
example1_en: She takes great pleasure in growing herbs on her balcony.
example1_zh: 她在阳台上种香草，从中获得很大的乐趣。
example2_en: Public libraries encourage reading for pleasure while providing affordable access to knowledge for people of all ages.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆鼓励以阅读为乐，同时让各年龄段的人都能以低廉的成本获取知识。
collocations: take pleasure in｜从……中获得乐趣 ; for pleasure｜为了消遣 ; a great pleasure｜一大乐事 ; with pleasure｜乐意地
tip_zh: 快乐通常不可数；一件乐事可说a pleasure。

meanings_zh: n. 人行道（美式）
definition_en: A paved path beside a street for pedestrians.
example1_en: Please keep your bicycle off the crowded sidewalk.
example1_zh: 请不要把自行车骑上拥挤的人行道。
example2_en: Planting trees along sidewalks can provide shade for pedestrians and reduce summer temperatures in cities.
example2_zh: 沿人行道植树可以为行人遮阴，并降低城市夏季的气温。
collocations: crowded sidewalk｜拥挤的人行道 ; sidewalk café｜路边露天咖啡馆 ; sidewalk repair｜人行道维修
tip_zh: 美式sidewalk对应英式pavement。

meanings_zh: adv. 不久；马上 | adv. 不耐烦地；生硬地
definition_en: After a short amount of time. | In a brief, unfriendly or impatient way.
example1_en: The bus will arrive shortly, so get your bag ready.
example1_zh: 公交车马上就到，把你的包准备好。
example2_en: Shortly after the new railway opened, local businesses reported a significant increase in customer visits.
example2_zh: 新铁路开通后不久，当地商家就报告称到店顾客显著增加。
collocations: arrive shortly｜很快到达 ; shortly after｜在……之后不久 ; shortly before｜在……之前不久
tip_zh: 表示“简要地”通常用briefly，不用shortly。

meanings_zh: adj. 二手的；用过的 | adj. 间接得来的 | adv. 以二手方式；间接地
definition_en: Previously owned or used by someone else. | Learned from others rather than experienced directly. | From a previous owner or through another person.
example1_en: I bought a secondhand bicycle from my neighbour.
example1_zh: 我从邻居那里买了一辆二手自行车。
example2_en: Buying secondhand furniture can reduce household spending and limit the environmental impact of producing new goods.
example2_zh: 购买二手家具可以减少家庭开支，并降低生产新商品对环境的影响。
collocations: secondhand furniture｜二手家具 ; secondhand information｜间接得来的信息 ; buy secondhand｜购买二手物品 ; secondhand smoke｜二手烟
tip_zh: 也常写作second-hand；信息义指非亲身所得。

meanings_zh: n. 进步；进展 | v. 进步；逐步发展
definition_en: improvement or movement towards a goal | to improve or move towards a more advanced stage
example1_en: You have made real progress with your swimming.
example1_zh: 你的游泳水平确实有了进步。
example2_en: Regular feedback helps students monitor their progress and identify areas that require further practice.
example2_zh: 定期反馈有助于学生了解自己的进步，并找出需要进一步练习的方面。
collocations: make progress｜取得进步 ; steady progress｜稳步进展 ; in progress｜进行中
tip_zh: 名词不可数；动词重音后移，英音/prəˈɡres/。

meanings_zh: n. 贫穷；贫困 | n. 匮乏；贫乏
definition_en: The condition of lacking money for basic needs. | A serious lack of something needed or valued.
example1_en: The charity helps local families living in poverty.
example1_zh: 这家慈善机构帮助当地生活贫困的家庭。
example2_en: Improving access to education and stable employment can help reduce poverty across both rural and urban communities.
example2_zh: 改善教育机会和稳定就业机会，有助于减少城乡社区的贫困。
collocations: live in poverty｜生活贫困 ; reduce poverty｜减少贫困 ; extreme poverty｜极端贫困 ; a poverty of ideas｜思想贫乏
tip_zh: 不可数名词；“生活贫困”用live in poverty。

meanings_zh: adj. 官方的；正式的 | n. 官员；高级职员
definition_en: approved or issued by a government or organisation | someone with a position of authority in an organisation
example1_en: We checked the official website before booking our tickets.
example1_zh: 我们订票前查看了官方网站。
example2_en: Official statistics indicate that investment in public transport has increased steadily over the past decade.
example2_zh: 官方统计数据显示，过去十年公共交通投资持续增长。
collocations: official statement｜官方声明 ; official statistics｜官方统计数据 ; government official｜政府官员 ; official language｜官方语言
tip_zh: official强调官方认可；formal强调形式或场合正式。

meanings_zh: n. 登记；注册；挂号 | n. 登记证；注册证明
definition_en: The process of officially recording details or joining something. | An official document showing that something has been registered.
example1_en: Registration for the swimming course opens on Monday.
example1_zh: 游泳课程将于周一开始报名。
example2_en: Online registration can improve access to public services, provided that support remains available for people without internet access.
example2_zh: 网上登记可以让公共服务更易获取，前提是仍为无法上网的人提供帮助。
collocations: online registration｜网上注册 ; registration fee｜报名费 ; vehicle registration｜车辆登记 ; registration form｜登记表
tip_zh: 表示报名或注册某活动，常用registration for。

meanings_zh: adj. 有导游的；有指导的
definition_en: led or supported by someone with knowledge or experience
example1_en: We joined a guided walk through the forest yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天我们参加了一次有向导带领的森林徒步。
example2_en: Guided learning can help students build confidence before they begin working independently on complex tasks.
example2_zh: 有指导的学习可以帮助学生建立信心，为独立完成复杂任务做好准备。
collocations: guided tour｜导览游 ; guided walk｜向导带领的徒步 ; guided learning｜有指导的学习
tip_zh: guided tour指有导游的游览；guided也是guide的过去分词。

meanings_zh: adj. 令人恶心的；令人反感的 | adj. 令人愤慨的；不可接受的
definition_en: extremely unpleasant, making you feel sick or strongly dislike something | so bad or wrong that it causes strong disapproval
example1_en: A disgusting smell came from the forgotten rubbish bag.
example1_zh: 那个被遗忘的垃圾袋散发出一股令人恶心的气味。
example2_en: Residents described the illegal dumping of waste beside their homes as disgusting and demanded immediate action.
example2_zh: 居民称在住宅旁非法倾倒垃圾的行为令人愤慨，并要求立即采取行动。
collocations: a disgusting smell｜令人恶心的气味 ; disgusting behaviour｜令人反感的行为 ; absolutely disgusting｜极其恶心的
tip_zh: disgusting形容事物令人反感；disgusted形容人感到反感。

meanings_zh: v. 齐步行进；坚定地走 | n. 游行；行军 | n. 进行曲
definition_en: Walk with firm, regular steps, often in a group. | An organised walk by a group, often to protest. | Music with a strong regular rhythm suitable for marching.
example1_en: The band marched through the square in bright uniforms.
example1_zh: 乐队身穿鲜艳的制服，齐步走过广场。
example2_en: Residents organised a peaceful march to demand safer roads and better public transport in their neighbourhood.
example2_zh: 居民组织了一场和平游行，要求改善社区道路安全和公共交通。
collocations: march through the streets｜列队穿过街道 ; a protest march｜抗议游行 ; a peaceful march｜和平游行 ; a military march｜军队进行曲
tip_zh: 小写march指行进；大写March指三月。

meanings_zh: conj. 每当；每次 | conj. 无论何时；随时 | adv. 究竟什么时候
definition_en: Every time that something happens. | At any time that something happens or is convenient. | Used in questions to express surprise about when something happened.
example1_en: Whenever I cook soup, my cat waits beside the stove.
example1_zh: 每当我煮汤时，我的猫就守在炉子旁边。
example2_en: Whenever cities expand, planners should consider how new developments will affect existing communities and local wildlife.
example2_zh: 每当城市扩张时，规划者都应考虑新开发项目将如何影响现有社区和当地野生动物。
collocations: whenever possible｜只要有可能 ; whenever necessary｜每当有必要时 ; whenever you like｜随你什么时候
tip_zh: 引导将来时间从句时，通常用一般现在时，不用will。

meanings_zh: v. 预订；保留 | n. 储备；储备量 | n. 自然保护区
definition_en: Arrange to keep something for a particular person or purpose. | A supply kept for use when needed. | An area where wildlife and natural habitats are protected.
example1_en: Could you reserve a table for us tonight?
example1_zh: 你能帮我们预订今晚的餐桌吗？
example2_en: Governments should maintain adequate food reserves to protect vulnerable communities during periods of severe drought.
example2_zh: 政府应保持充足的粮食储备，以便在严重干旱期间保护脆弱群体。
collocations: reserve a table｜预订餐桌 ; reserve something for someone｜为某人保留某物 ; nature reserve｜自然保护区 ; oil reserves｜石油储量
tip_zh: 动词常用 reserve sth for sb；储量常用 reserves。

meanings_zh: n. 印象；感受 | n. 模仿表演 | n. 压痕；印记
definition_en: An idea or feeling formed about someone or something. | A performance copying someone's voice, appearance, or behaviour. | A mark left by pressing something into a surface.
example1_en: Her warm welcome gave me a good first impression.
example1_zh: 她热情的欢迎给我留下了良好的第一印象。
example2_en: The appearance of public spaces can strongly influence visitors' overall impression of a city.
example2_zh: 公共空间的面貌会显著影响游客对城市的整体印象。
collocations: first impression｜第一印象 ; make an impression on｜给……留下印象 ; be under the impression that｜以为…… ; do an impression of｜模仿……
tip_zh: under the impression that表示“以为”，常暗示误解。

meanings_zh: v. 影响 | v. 使感动；使悲伤
definition_en: to cause a change in someone or something | to cause someone to feel a strong emotion
example1_en: Too much coffee can affect how well you sleep.
example1_zh: 喝太多咖啡会影响你的睡眠质量。
example2_en: Rising food prices disproportionately affect poorer households, which spend a larger share of their income on essentials.
example2_zh: 食品价格上涨对较贫困家庭的影响尤为严重，因为必需品支出占其收入的比例更大。
collocations: affect health｜影响健康 ; adversely affect｜产生不利影响 ; deeply affect someone｜深深触动某人 ; affect performance｜影响表现
tip_zh: 表示“影响”时affect是动词，effect通常是名词。

meanings_zh: n. 主教座堂；大教堂
definition_en: The main church of a district led by a bishop.
example1_en: Sunlight streamed through the cathedral's beautiful stained glass windows.
example1_zh: 阳光透过大教堂美丽的彩色玻璃窗洒了进来。
example2_en: Restoring a historic cathedral can preserve traditional craftsmanship while attracting visitors who support the local economy.
example2_zh: 修复历史悠久的大教堂既能保护传统工艺，也能吸引游客，支持当地经济。
collocations: medieval cathedral｜中世纪大教堂 ; cathedral tower｜大教堂塔楼 ; cathedral restoration｜大教堂修复
tip_zh: 严格指主教驻地的教堂，并非所有大型教堂。

meanings_zh: n. 优势；有利条件 | n. 好处；益处
definition_en: Something that makes success more likely than for others. | A useful or positive feature of something.
example1_en: Your long arms give you an advantage in swimming.
example1_zh: 你的长手臂让你在游泳时更有优势。
example2_en: One major advantage of public transport is its ability to reduce traffic congestion in urban areas.
