example2_zh: 公共交通的一大好处是能够缓解城市地区的交通拥堵。
collocations: competitive advantage｜竞争优势 ; have an advantage over｜比……有优势 ; take advantage of｜利用；占……便宜 ; a major advantage｜一大优势
tip_zh: take advantage of可指利用机会，也可指占人便宜。

meanings_zh: adj. 令人不快的；难受的 | adj. 不友善的；粗鲁的
definition_en: Causing discomfort, dislike, or unhappiness. | Behaving in an unfriendly or rude way.
example1_en: An unpleasant smell was coming from the kitchen bin.
example1_zh: 厨房垃圾桶里散发出一股难闻的气味。
example2_en: Although commuting can be unpleasant, reliable public transport can reduce stress and improve the daily experience of workers.
example2_zh: 虽然通勤可能令人不快，但可靠的公共交通能减轻压力，改善上班族的日常体验。
collocations: an unpleasant smell｜难闻的气味 ; an unpleasant experience｜不愉快的经历 ; unpleasant side effects｜令人难受的副作用 ; unpleasant to someone｜对某人不友善
tip_zh: 形容事物表示令人不快；形容人常指态度不友善。

meanings_zh: n. 类别；种类
definition_en: a group of things sharing particular features
example1_en: Put each book into the category that fits best.
example1_zh: 把每本书归入最合适的类别。
example2_en: Researchers divided household spending into several categories to identify changes in consumer behaviour.
example2_zh: 研究人员将家庭支出分成几个类别，以识别消费者行为的变化。
collocations: fall into a category｜属于某类别 ; broad category｜大类 ; age category｜年龄组 ; divide into categories｜分类
tip_zh: 常用fall into a category表示“归入某类别”。

meanings_zh: adv. 热情地；亲切地 | adv. 暖和地
definition_en: in a friendly and welcoming way | in a way that keeps someone comfortably warm
example1_en: The neighbours smiled and greeted us warmly this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上，邻居们微笑着热情地向我们打招呼。
example2_en: When schools welcome new students warmly, they can reduce anxiety and encourage participation in classroom activities.
example2_zh: 学校热情欢迎新生，有助于减轻他们的焦虑，并鼓励他们参与课堂活动。
collocations: greet warmly｜热情地问候 ; welcome warmly｜热烈欢迎 ; dress warmly｜穿得暖和 ; smile warmly｜亲切地微笑
tip_zh: greet warmly指热情问候；dress warmly指穿暖和。

meanings_zh: n. 循环；周期 | v. 骑自行车 | n. 自行车
definition_en: a series of events or stages that repeats | to travel by bicycle | a vehicle with two wheels powered by pedalling
example1_en: I usually cycle to the park on sunny mornings.
example1_zh: 晴朗的早晨，我通常骑自行车去公园。
example2_en: Climate change can disrupt the natural water cycle, increasing the frequency of droughts and floods in some regions.
example2_zh: 气候变化会扰乱自然水循环，使一些地区的干旱和洪水更频繁。
collocations: life cycle｜生命周期 ; water cycle｜水循环 ; vicious cycle｜恶性循环 ; cycle to work｜骑自行车上班
tip_zh: cycle作动词表示骑车；骑车上班用cycle to work。

meanings_zh: n. 首都；首府；省会 | n. 资本；资金 | n. 大写字母
definition_en: the city where a country or region's government is based | money or assets used to start or operate a business | a letter in its large form
example1_en: We visited the capital and explored its busy markets.
example1_zh: 我们游览了首都，逛了那里热闹的市场。
example2_en: Small businesses often struggle to obtain enough capital to invest in new equipment and staff training.
example2_zh: 小企业往往难以筹集足够资金，用于购置新设备和培训员工。
collocations: the capital city｜首都 ; raise capital｜筹集资金 ; a capital letter｜大写字母
tip_zh: 表示资金时通常不可数；表示大写字母时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 教练；指导教师 | n. 大学讲师（美国）
definition_en: Someone who teaches a particular skill or activity. | A teacher at an American college or university.
example1_en: Our swimming instructor showed us how to breathe properly.
example1_zh: 我们的游泳教练教我们如何正确呼吸。
example2_en: A qualified instructor can help older adults exercise safely and develop confidence in their physical abilities.
example2_zh: 合格的教练能帮助老年人安全锻炼，并增强他们对自身体能的信心。
collocations: driving instructor｜驾驶教练 ; qualified instructor｜合格的教练 ; fitness instructor｜健身教练
tip_zh: 常指教授驾驶、游泳等具体技能的人。

meanings_zh: n. 汽车旅馆
definition_en: A roadside hotel with convenient parking for guests.
example1_en: We found a quiet motel just outside the town.
example1_zh: 我们在镇子外找到了一家安静的汽车旅馆。
example2_en: Affordable motels along major roads provide convenient accommodation for travellers exploring rural areas by car.
example2_zh: 主干道沿线价格实惠的汽车旅馆为自驾探索乡村的旅客提供了便利的住宿。
collocations: stay at a motel｜住汽车旅馆 ; roadside motel｜路边汽车旅馆 ; motel room｜汽车旅馆客房
tip_zh: motel主要服务驾车旅客，通常提供便利停车位。

meanings_zh: n. 男运动员；男性运动爱好者
definition_en: a man who plays sports, especially with skill
example1_en: My uncle was a keen sportsman in his youth.
example1_zh: 我叔叔年轻时非常热爱运动。
example2_en: A successful sportsman can encourage young people to exercise regularly and develop confidence through physical activity.
example2_zh: 成功的男运动员可以鼓励年轻人经常锻炼，并通过体育活动培养自信。
collocations: keen sportsman｜热爱运动的男子 ; professional sportsman｜职业男运动员 ; talented sportsman｜有天赋的男运动员
tip_zh: 特指男性；不强调性别时可用athlete。

meanings_zh: n. 负载；装载量 | v. 装载；加载 | n. 工作量；负担
definition_en: something carried, or the amount a vehicle or person carries | to put goods into something or data into computer memory | the amount of work or responsibility someone must manage
example1_en: The donkey carried a heavy load up the hill.
example1_zh: 那头驴驮着沉重的货物上山。
example2_en: Sharing household tasks more equally can reduce the load on parents who also work full time.
example2_zh: 更公平地分担家务可以减轻还需全职工作的父母的负担。
collocations: a heavy load｜沉重的负载 ; load a truck｜给卡车装货 ; load data｜加载数据 ; a load of laundry｜一批待洗衣物
tip_zh: load A with B指把B装进A；卸货用unload。

meanings_zh: n. 送信人；传信者
definition_en: a person who carries a message to someone
example1_en: A messenger arrived with an envelope for the manager.
example1_zh: 一名送信人带着一封给经理的信到了。
example2_en: Before modern telecommunications, governments relied on messengers to carry important information between distant towns and military posts.
example2_zh: 在现代电信出现之前，政府依靠信使在相距遥远的城镇和军事哨所之间传递重要信息。
collocations: send a messenger｜派遣信使 ; bike messenger｜自行车送件员 ; act as a messenger｜充当传话人
tip_zh: message 是信息；messenger 是传递信息的人。

meanings_zh: v. 出版；刊登 | v. 公布；发布
definition_en: to produce books or other writing for public reading | to make information officially available to the public
example1_en: The local magazine published my photograph of the river.
example1_zh: 当地杂志刊登了我拍摄的河流照片。
example2_en: Researchers should publish their findings openly so that policymakers can make decisions based on reliable evidence.
example2_zh: 研究人员应公开发表研究结果，让政策制定者能够依据可靠证据作出决策。
collocations: publish a book｜出版书籍 ; publish an article｜发表文章 ; publish findings｜公布研究结果 ; publish online｜在线发表
tip_zh: publish强调向公众发行或公布，不等于仅仅印刷。

meanings_zh: n. 幽默；幽默感 | n. 心情；情绪 | v. 迁就；顺着
definition_en: The quality of being funny or the ability to appreciate funniness. | A person's mood or state of mind. | To agree with someone's wishes to keep them happy.
example1_en: Her gentle humour made everyone at dinner feel relaxed.
example1_zh: 她温和的幽默让晚餐时的每个人都放松了下来。
example2_en: Teachers can use humour to reduce classroom anxiety and encourage students to participate more confidently.
example2_zh: 教师可以利用幽默缓解课堂焦虑，鼓励学生更自信地参与。
collocations: a sense of humour｜幽默感 ; good humour｜好心情 ; dry humour｜冷面幽默 ; humour someone｜迁就某人
tip_zh: 英式拼写humour，美式humor；作动词表示迁就。

meanings_zh: n. 标签；标牌 | v. 贴标签；添加标记 | n. 捉人游戏
definition_en: a small attached piece giving information about something | to attach a label or identifying marker to something | a chasing game where players touch others to catch them
example1_en: I checked the tag before washing my new jumper.
example1_zh: 洗新毛衣前，我查看了标签。
example2_en: Researchers tag marine animals to track their movements and identify habitats that require stronger environmental protection.
example2_zh: 研究人员给海洋动物加上追踪标记，以追踪其活动并确定需要加强环境保护的栖息地。
collocations: price tag｜价格标签 ; name tag｜姓名牌 ; tag someone in a photo｜在照片中标记某人 ; play tag｜玩捉人游戏
tip_zh: 动词过去式tagged；tag along意为跟着去。

meanings_zh: v. 跳水；潜水 | v. 俯冲；急剧下降 | n. 跳水；潜水；骤降
definition_en: to enter water headfirst or swim beneath its surface | to move downwards suddenly and quickly | an act of diving or a sudden sharp fall
example1_en: We watched a swimmer dive smoothly into the pool.
example1_zh: 我们看着一名游泳者流畅地跃入泳池。
example2_en: Tourists who dive near coral reefs should avoid touching marine organisms to prevent damage to fragile ecosystems.
example2_zh: 在珊瑚礁附近潜水的游客应避免触碰海洋生物，以免破坏脆弱的生态系统。
collocations: dive into the water｜跃入水中 ; scuba dive｜水肺潜水 ; take a dive｜骤降
tip_zh: 过去式英式常用dived，美式也用dove。

meanings_zh: v. 收费；索价 | n. 费用；收费 | v. 给……充电
definition_en: Ask someone to pay a particular amount for something. | An amount of money requested for goods or services. | Put electrical energy into a battery or device.
example1_en: They charge extra if you want breakfast in your room.
example1_zh: 如果你想在房间里吃早餐，他们会额外收费。
example2_en: Museums that charge admission fees should offer discounts to ensure that students can still access cultural resources.
example2_zh: 收取门票的博物馆应提供优惠，以确保学生仍能享用文化资源。
collocations: charge a fee｜收取费用 ; free of charge｜免费 ; charge a battery｜给电池充电 ; in charge of｜负责；掌管
tip_zh: 向某人收取某项费用：charge someone for something。

meanings_zh: n. 悬崖；峭壁
definition_en: A high, very steep rock face, often beside the sea.
example1_en: We watched seabirds nesting halfway up the cliff.
example1_zh: 我们看着海鸟在悬崖半腰筑巢。
example2_en: Coastal erosion can weaken a cliff over time, putting nearby homes and walking routes at risk.
example2_zh: 海岸侵蚀会逐渐削弱悬崖的稳定性，危及附近的住宅和步行路线。
collocations: a cliff edge｜悬崖边缘 ; a sheer cliff｜陡直的悬崖 ; a cliff face｜峭壁表面 ; coastal cliffs｜海岸悬崖
tip_zh: cliff强调陡峭岩壁，不泛指山坡。

meanings_zh: n. 东西；物品；材料 | v. 塞满；填塞
definition_en: Things or materials referred to without naming them specifically. | To fill something tightly or push something into a space.
example1_en: Please move your stuff off the kitchen table.
example1_zh: 请把你的东西从厨房餐桌上拿走。
example2_en: Consumers often buy stuff they rarely use, contributing to household waste and unnecessary resource consumption.
example2_zh: 消费者经常购买很少使用的东西，造成家庭浪费和不必要的资源消耗。
collocations: personal stuff｜私人物品 ; stuff a bag with｜用……塞满袋子 ; stuff into｜把……塞进
tip_zh: 名词stuff不可数且偏口语；正式写作宜用具体名词。

meanings_zh: n. 乱扔的垃圾 | v. 乱扔垃圾；使杂乱 | n. 一窝幼崽
definition_en: Waste left scattered in public places. | To leave rubbish or other objects scattered across a place. | A group of young animals born to one mother together.
example1_en: We picked up litter along the beach before lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭前，我们沿着海滩捡垃圾。
example2_en: Reducing litter in urban parks requires convenient bins as well as sustained public education campaigns.
example2_zh: 减少城市公园里乱扔的垃圾，需要设置便于使用的垃圾桶，并持续开展公众教育活动。
collocations: drop litter｜乱扔垃圾 ; pick up litter｜捡垃圾 ; a litter of puppies｜一窝小狗
tip_zh: 垃圾义不可数；一窝幼崽用a litter of。

meanings_zh: v. 污染
definition_en: to make air, water, or land dirty or harmful
example1_en: Please don't pollute the stream by throwing rubbish into it.
example1_zh: 请不要往小溪里扔垃圾，污染溪水。
example2_en: Factories that pollute local rivers should face stricter penalties to protect ecosystems and public health.
example2_zh: 污染当地河流的工厂应受到更严厉的处罚，以保护生态系统和公众健康。
collocations: pollute the environment｜污染环境 ; pollute the air｜污染空气 ; heavily polluted｜受到严重污染的
tip_zh: 及物动词，直接接被污染的对象，不加介词。

meanings_zh: n. 南瓜
definition_en: A large, round fruit with thick skin, often orange.
example1_en: We roasted a pumpkin and served it with rice.
example1_zh: 我们烤了一个南瓜，配米饭一起吃。
example2_en: Growing crops such as pumpkin in community gardens can improve access to fresh food in urban neighbourhoods.
example2_zh: 在社区菜园种植南瓜等作物，可以让城市社区居民更容易获得新鲜食物。
collocations: pumpkin soup｜南瓜汤 ; pumpkin seeds｜南瓜籽 ; roasted pumpkin｜烤南瓜
tip_zh: 整个南瓜可数；表示作为食材的南瓜时常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 细胞 | n. 牢房；小隔间 | n. 电池单元
definition_en: the smallest living unit of an organism | a small room, especially one in a prison | a unit that produces electricity through chemical reactions
example1_en: Under the microscope, each onion cell looked like a rectangle.
example1_zh: 在显微镜下，每个洋葱细胞看起来都像一个长方形。
example2_en: Scientists study how damaged cells repair themselves to develop more effective treatments for disease.
example2_zh: 科学家研究受损细胞如何自我修复，以开发更有效的疾病治疗方法。
collocations: blood cells｜血细胞 ; stem cells｜干细胞 ; a prison cell｜牢房 ; a fuel cell｜燃料电池
tip_zh: 生物语境常指细胞；prison cell指牢房。

meanings_zh: adv. 轻柔地；温和地 | adv. 平缓地；缓缓地
definition_en: In a soft, careful, or kind way. | With a gradual slope or a small, smooth movement.
example1_en: She gently lifted the kitten out of the basket.
example1_zh: 她轻轻地把小猫从篮子里抱了出来。
example2_en: Health professionals should speak gently to anxious patients to help them feel comfortable during medical examinations.
example2_zh: 医护人员应温和地与焦虑的患者交谈，帮助他们在检查时放松下来。
collocations: gently stir｜轻轻搅拌 ; speak gently｜温和地说话 ; slope gently｜呈缓坡
tip_zh: 由gentle去掉末尾e再加y构成。

meanings_zh: n. 传单；宣传单
definition_en: A small printed sheet giving information or advertising something.
example1_en: A volunteer handed me a leaflet about the new library.
example1_zh: 一位志愿者递给我一张介绍新图书馆的传单。
example2_en: Health centres can distribute a leaflet explaining how regular exercise helps prevent several common diseases.
example2_zh: 医疗中心可以发放宣传单，解释规律运动如何帮助预防几种常见疾病。
collocations: hand out leaflets｜分发传单 ; information leaflet｜信息单 ; promotional leaflet｜宣传单
tip_zh: leaflet通常是单页或折页；brochure通常为小册子。

meanings_zh: adj. 文化的；与文化有关的 | adj. 艺术的；文艺的
definition_en: relating to a group's customs, beliefs, and way of life | relating to activities such as music, literature, and theatre
example1_en: The festival celebrates the town's rich cultural traditions.
example1_zh: 这个节日颂扬小镇丰富的文化传统。
example2_en: Schools can promote cultural understanding by encouraging students to share their family traditions and experiences.
example2_zh: 学校可以鼓励学生分享家庭传统和经历，从而促进文化理解。
collocations: cultural heritage｜文化遗产 ; cultural diversity｜文化多样性 ; cultural differences｜文化差异 ; cultural activities｜文艺活动
tip_zh: cultural指文化相关；cultured形容人有修养。

meanings_zh: adj. 中等大小的；中型的
definition_en: neither large nor small in size
example1_en: A medium-sized suitcase should hold everything for the weekend.
example1_zh: 一个中等大小的行李箱应该能装下周末所需的所有东西。
example2_en: Medium-sized cities can offer diverse employment opportunities while maintaining shorter commuting times than major urban centres.
example2_zh: 中等城市既能提供多样的就业机会，又能保持比大城市更短的通勤时间。
collocations: medium-sized business｜中型企业 ; medium-sized city｜中等城市 ; medium-sized suitcase｜中号行李箱
tip_zh: 表示大小适中，不表示质量或水平普通。

meanings_zh: adj. 南部的；南方的
definition_en: Located in, coming from, or relating to the south.
example1_en: We spent a week exploring the island's southern coast.
example1_zh: 我们花了一周探索这座岛的南部海岸。
example2_en: Southern regions of the country may face longer droughts as rising temperatures increase pressure on water supplies.
example2_zh: 随着气温升高加大供水压力，该国南部地区可能面临更持久的干旱。
collocations: southern coast｜南部海岸 ; southern hemisphere｜南半球 ; southern regions｜南部地区 ; southern border｜南部边界
tip_zh: south中/ou/读/aʊ/，southern中的元音读/ʌ/。

meanings_zh: v. 获得；增加 | n. 增长；收益
definition_en: To obtain something useful or increase in amount. | An increase in something or a benefit received.
example1_en: You will gain confidence after a few lessons.
example1_zh: 上几节课后，你就会更有信心。
example2_en: Students can gain valuable practical experience by volunteering for projects that benefit their local communities.
example2_zh: 学生可以通过志愿参与有益于当地社区的项目，获得宝贵的实践经验。
collocations: gain experience｜积累经验 ; gain access to｜获得使用或进入的机会 ; gain weight｜体重增加 ; financial gain｜经济收益
tip_zh: gain常接经验、信心等；赢比赛通常用win。

meanings_zh: n. 毯子；覆盖层 | adj. 全面的；一概而论的 | v. 覆盖；笼罩
definition_en: A thick bed covering, or a layer covering something. | Applying to everyone or everything without considering individual differences. | To cover something completely with a layer.
example1_en: She wrapped a soft blanket around her cold shoulders.
example1_zh: 她用一条柔软的毯子裹住冰凉的肩膀。
example2_en: A blanket ban on private vehicles may disadvantage residents who cannot easily access public transport.
example2_zh: 全面禁止私家车可能使难以使用公共交通的居民处于不利地位。
collocations: a warm blanket｜温暖的毯子 ; a blanket of snow｜厚厚的一层雪 ; a blanket ban｜全面禁令
tip_zh: blanket作形容词指全面适用，如blanket ban。

meanings_zh: adj. 技术的；工艺的 | adj. 专业的；专门的
definition_en: relating to practical skills, machinery, or scientific methods | using specialist knowledge or language in a particular subject
example1_en: We called an engineer to solve the technical problem.
example1_zh: 我们请了一位工程师来解决这个技术问题。
example2_en: Schools should teach technical skills alongside academic subjects to prepare students for a changing workplace.
example2_zh: 学校应在教授文化课程的同时传授技术技能，帮助学生适应不断变化的职场。
collocations: technical skills｜技术技能 ; technical support｜技术支持 ; technical problem｜技术问题 ; technical terms｜专业术语
tip_zh: technical强调技术或专业知识，不等于高科技。

meanings_zh: n. 交流；沟通；通信 | n. 函件；消息
definition_en: the process of sharing information, ideas, or feelings | a formal message sent to someone
example1_en: Clear communication helps us share the kitchen without arguments.
example1_zh: 清晰的沟通让我们共用厨房时不发生争执。
example2_en: Effective communication between healthcare professionals and patients can improve treatment outcomes and reduce misunderstandings.
example2_zh: 医护人员与患者之间的有效沟通可以改善治疗效果，减少误解。
collocations: communication skills｜沟通技巧 ; effective communication｜有效沟通 ; nonverbal communication｜非言语交流 ; a breakdown in communication｜沟通中断
tip_zh: 表交流通常不可数；表一封正式函件可数。

meanings_zh: n. 黑暗；昏暗
definition_en: the absence of light
example1_en: We searched for the torch in complete darkness.
example1_zh: 我们在一片漆黑中寻找手电筒。
example2_en: Artificial lighting reduces natural darkness in urban areas, potentially disrupting the sleep patterns of residents and wildlife.
example2_zh: 人工照明减少了城市地区的自然黑暗，可能扰乱居民和野生动物的睡眠规律。
collocations: complete darkness｜一片漆黑 ; in the darkness｜在黑暗中 ; under cover of darkness｜在夜色掩护下
tip_zh: 通常为不可数名词；in darkness表示在黑暗中。

meanings_zh: n. 交易；协议 | v. 处理；应付 | v. 分发；发牌
definition_en: an agreement between people or organisations, especially in business | to take action about a problem, usually with with | to give cards or other things to several people
example1_en: We got a good deal on our new sofa.
example1_zh: 我们以很划算的价格买到了新沙发。
example2_en: Governments must deal with housing shortages by supporting affordable construction and improving public transport links.
example2_zh: 政府必须通过支持可负担住房建设和改善公共交通连接来应对住房短缺。
collocations: make a deal｜达成交易 ; deal with a problem｜处理问题 ; a great deal of｜大量的 ; deal cards｜发牌
tip_zh: deal with表示处理；a great deal of后接不可数名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 奇怪的；不寻常的 | adj. 奇数的 | adj. 偶尔的；零星的
definition_en: Strange or different from what is expected. | Not divisible by two without a remainder. | Occasional rather than regular or frequent.
example1_en: There is an odd smell coming from the fridge.
example1_zh: 冰箱里传出一股怪味。
example2_en: It may seem odd that some rapidly growing cities still lack reliable access to clean drinking water.
example2_zh: 一些快速发展的城市仍无法稳定获得清洁饮用水，这可能显得令人费解。
collocations: an odd smell｜怪味 ; an odd number｜奇数 ; the odd occasion｜偶尔的时候 ; odd jobs｜零工；杂活
tip_zh: the odd加单数名词常表示偶尔的某事。

meanings_zh: n. 烟灰缸
definition_en: A small container for cigarette ash and cigarette ends
example1_en: An empty glass ashtray stood on the outdoor table.
example1_zh: 室外的桌子上放着一个空玻璃烟灰缸。
example2_en: Providing ashtrays in designated smoking areas can reduce cigarette litter, although broader measures are needed to protect public health.
example2_zh: 在指定吸烟区设置烟灰缸可以减少烟头垃圾，但保护公众健康还需要更全面的措施。
collocations: a glass ashtray｜玻璃烟灰缸 ; empty an ashtray｜清空烟灰缸 ; a cigarette ashtray｜香烟烟灰缸
tip_zh: 可数名词，由ash（灰）和tray（托盘）组成。

meanings_zh: n. 配料；食材 | n. 要素；因素
definition_en: one of the foods used to prepare a dish | one of the things needed to achieve a particular result
example1_en: Fresh ginger is the main ingredient in this soup.
example1_zh: 鲜姜是这道汤的主要食材。
example2_en: Public trust is an essential ingredient in the successful implementation of environmental policies.
example2_zh: 公众信任是成功实施环境政策的必要因素。
collocations: main ingredient｜主要配料 ; fresh ingredients｜新鲜食材 ; essential ingredient｜必要因素
tip_zh: 是可数名词；既指烹饪配料，也可比喻必要因素。

meanings_zh: n. 道歉；歉意
definition_en: words expressing regret for something wrong or hurtful
example1_en: I sent my neighbour an apology for the noise.
example1_zh: 我为制造噪声向邻居致歉。
example2_en: A sincere public apology can help organisations rebuild trust after mistakes, but practical changes are also necessary.
example2_zh: 犯错后，真诚的公开道歉有助于机构重建信任，但实际改进也不可或缺。
collocations: offer an apology｜表示歉意 ; accept an apology｜接受道歉 ; a sincere apology｜真诚的道歉 ; owe someone an apology｜应该向某人道歉
tip_zh: 向某人道歉用apology to someone for something。

meanings_zh: n. 海港；港湾 | v. 心怀；藏有 | v. 藏匿；庇护
definition_en: A sheltered area of water where boats can stay safely. | To keep a thought or feeling, often secretly. | To hide or shelter someone, especially someone wanted by authorities.
example1_en: Small fishing boats returned to the harbour before sunset.
example1_zh: 小渔船在日落前回到了港湾。
example2_en: Expanding the harbour could increase trade, but construction may damage nearby coastal habitats.
example2_zh: 扩建港口可能促进贸易，但施工可能破坏附近的沿海栖息地。
collocations: a natural harbour｜天然港湾 ; harbour doubts｜心存疑虑 ; harbour a grudge｜怀恨在心
tip_zh: 英式拼写harbour，美式拼写harbor。

meanings_zh: adj. 书面的；成文的 | v. 写（write的过去分词）
definition_en: Expressed in writing rather than speech. | Past participle of write.
example1_en: Please send written instructions so I can follow them.
example1_zh: 请把书面说明发来，方便我照着做。
example2_en: Written feedback allows students to review their mistakes and improve their performance over time.
example2_zh: 书面反馈让学生能够回顾错误，并逐步提高表现。
collocations: written permission｜书面许可 ; written agreement｜书面协议 ; written exam｜笔试 ; written feedback｜书面反馈
tip_zh: write的变化为write–wrote–written。

meanings_zh: adj. 空白的 | adj. 茫然的；无表情的 | n. 空白处
definition_en: having no writing, pictures, or other content | showing no understanding, feeling, or recognition | an empty space where information should be added
example1_en: She handed me a blank sheet and some pencils.
example1_zh: 她递给我一张白纸和几支铅笔。
example2_en: A blank page can encourage creative thinking by allowing learners to organise ideas without a fixed template.
example2_zh: 空白页面让学习者无需固定模板就能组织想法，从而有助于激发创造性思维。
collocations: a blank page｜空白页 ; a blank expression｜茫然的表情 ; fill in the blanks｜填空 ; go blank｜脑中一片空白
tip_zh: go blank可指脑中突然一片空白、想不起来。

meanings_zh: n. 闲暇；空闲时间
definition_en: Time when you are free from work or other duties.
example1_en: She spends most of her leisure time in the garden.
example1_zh: 她把大部分闲暇时间都花在花园里。
example2_en: Public parks provide affordable spaces for leisure, helping urban residents relax and maintain social connections.
example2_zh: 公共公园提供了经济实惠的休闲空间，帮助城市居民放松并维持社交联系。
collocations: leisure time｜闲暇时间 ; leisure activities｜休闲活动 ; leisure centre｜休闲健身中心 ; at your leisure｜在你方便时；从容地
tip_zh: leisure通常不可数；leisure time指闲暇时间。

meanings_zh: adj. 准备好的；有准备的 | adj. 愿意的
definition_en: Ready to deal with something because of previous planning. | Willing to do something, especially something difficult or unpleasant.
example1_en: With spare batteries packed, we were prepared for a blackout.
example1_zh: 备用电池已经备好，我们做好了应对停电的准备。
example2_en: Graduates who gain practical experience are often better prepared for the demands of a competitive labour market.
example2_zh: 有实践经验的毕业生往往更能应对竞争激烈的劳动力市场的要求。
collocations: prepared for emergencies｜做好应急准备的 ; fully prepared｜准备充分的 ; prepared to compromise｜愿意妥协的
tip_zh: prepared for接名词；prepared to do可表愿意。

meanings_zh: n. 进入；进入权 | n. 条目；记录 | n. 参赛作品；参赛者
definition_en: The act of entering, or permission to enter a place. | An individual item in a list, diary, or reference work. | A work or person submitted for a competition.
example1_en: Entry to the swimming pool is free today.
example1_zh: 今天进入游泳池免费。
example2_en: Strict entry requirements may prevent capable students from disadvantaged backgrounds from accessing higher education opportunities.
example2_zh: 严格的入学要求可能使来自弱势背景的优秀学生无法获得高等教育机会。
collocations: entry requirements｜入学要求；准入条件 ; free entry｜免费入场 ; diary entry｜一则日记 ; competition entry｜参赛作品
tip_zh: 进入某处常用entry to；具体入口通常用entrance。

meanings_zh: n. 评论；评价 | n. 审查；回顾 | v. 审查；复习；评论
definition_en: An account giving an opinion of a book, product, or performance. | A careful examination to assess something or consider changes. | To examine, study again, or give an opinion about something.
example1_en: Her review convinced me to read the whole novel.
example1_zh: 她的书评让我决定读完整部小说。
example2_en: Governments should regularly review housing policies to ensure that affordable accommodation remains available to low-income families.
example2_zh: 政府应定期审查住房政策，确保低收入家庭仍能获得负担得起的住所。
collocations: write a review｜写评论 ; a thorough review｜全面审查 ; review a policy｜审查政策 ; review your notes｜复习笔记
tip_zh: 复习在美式英语中常用review，英式常用revise。

meanings_zh: n. 公路；干道
definition_en: a main public road connecting towns or cities
example1_en: We followed the highway along the coast until sunset.
example1_zh: 我们沿着海岸公路一直开到日落。
example2_en: Building a new highway may reduce travel times but also damage nearby wildlife habitats.
example2_zh: 修建一条新公路可能缩短出行时间，但也会破坏附近的野生动物栖息地。
collocations: major highway｜主要公路 ; highway construction｜公路建设 ; highway maintenance｜公路养护
tip_zh: 常见于美式英语；不一定是封闭式高速公路。

meanings_zh: n. 调查；民意调查 | v. 调查 | v. 勘测；测量
definition_en: A study that collects information by asking people questions. | Collect information by asking people questions. | Examine and measure land or buildings in detail.
example1_en: I completed a short survey about our local library.
example1_zh: 我填写了一份关于本地图书馆的简短问卷。
example2_en: A recent survey suggests that many commuters would cycle more often if safer routes were available.
example2_zh: 最近一项调查表明，如果有更安全的路线，许多通勤者会更经常骑自行车。
collocations: conduct a survey｜开展调查 ; survey results｜调查结果 ; survey respondents｜调查受访者 ; survey the land｜勘测土地
tip_zh: 名词重音在首音节，动词重音在末音节。

meanings_zh: v. 需要 | v. 要求；规定
definition_en: To need something for a particular purpose | To make something necessary through a rule or instruction
example1_en: These plants require plenty of sunlight and regular watering.
example1_zh: 这些植物需要充足的阳光和定期浇水。
example2_en: Governments should require manufacturers to provide clear instructions for repairing products rather than replacing them.
example2_zh: 政府应要求制造商提供清晰的产品维修说明，以鼓励维修而非更换。
collocations: require assistance｜需要帮助 ; require attention｜需要关注 ; be required to do something｜被要求做某事 ; require further investigation｜需要进一步调查
tip_zh: require sb to do sth表示要求某人做某事。

meanings_zh: n. 态度；看法
definition_en: how you think or feel about someone or something
example1_en: His cheerful attitude makes even rainy mornings feel brighter.
example1_zh: 他乐观的态度让下雨的早晨也显得明朗起来。
example2_en: Schools can encourage a positive attitude towards learning by giving students constructive feedback rather than constant criticism.
example2_zh: 学校可以给予学生建设性的反馈，而非不断批评，以培养积极的学习态度。
collocations: positive attitude｜积极的态度 ; attitude towards｜对……的态度 ; change of attitude｜态度的转变 ; public attitudes｜公众态度
tip_zh: 对某事的态度常用attitude to或towards。

meanings_zh: v. 往往会；倾向于 | v. 照料；护理
definition_en: To usually behave in a particular way. | To look after someone or something.
example1_en: I tend to feel sleepy after a big lunch.
example1_zh: 我午饭吃得多之后往往会犯困。
example2_en: People tend to use public transport more frequently when services are reliable, affordable, and easy to access.
example2_zh: 当公共交通可靠、价格合理且乘坐方便时，人们往往会更频繁地使用它。
collocations: tend to do something｜往往会做某事 ; tend towards｜趋向于 ; tend a garden｜照料花园 ; tend to the injured｜照料伤者
tip_zh: tend to do表示往往会；tend to someone表示照料。

meanings_zh: n. 海鲜；海产品
definition_en: Sea animals, especially shellfish, eaten as food.
example1_en: We bought fresh seafood at the harbour this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上我们在港口买了新鲜海鲜。
example2_en: Demand for sustainable seafood has encouraged some fishing communities to adopt methods that cause less damage to marine ecosystems.
example2_zh: 对可持续海产品的需求促使一些渔业社区采用对海洋生态系统破坏较小的捕捞方式。
collocations: fresh seafood｜新鲜海鲜 ; a seafood restaurant｜海鲜餐厅 ; sustainable seafood｜可持续海产品
tip_zh: 通常是不可数名词；一盘海鲜可说a plate of seafood。

meanings_zh: n. 品牌；牌子 | v. 给…贴负面标签
definition_en: A product name identifying the company that makes it | To describe someone publicly as having a particular bad quality
example1_en: Which brand of toothpaste do you usually buy?
example1_zh: 你通常买哪个牌子的牙膏？
example2_en: Consumers may choose a familiar brand even when cheaper alternatives offer similar quality.
example2_zh: 即使更便宜的替代品质量相近，消费者也可能选择熟悉的品牌。
collocations: brand loyalty｜品牌忠诚度 ; brand image｜品牌形象 ; a leading brand｜领先品牌 ; brand someone as｜给某人贴上…标签
tip_zh: brand指品牌；trademark强调受法律保护的商标。

meanings_zh: v. 使疲倦；感到疲倦 | v. 厌倦；失去兴趣 | n. 轮胎（美式拼写）
definition_en: To become tired or make someone feel tired | To lose interest in someone or something | A rubber covering fitted around a vehicle's wheel
example1_en: Long walks tire my grandfather, so we stop often.
example1_zh: 长时间走路会让爷爷疲倦，所以我们经常停下来。
example2_en: Students may tire of repetitive exercises unless teachers introduce varied activities that encourage active participation.
example2_zh: 学生可能会厌倦重复的练习，除非教师引入多样化活动，鼓励他们积极参与。
collocations: tire easily｜容易疲倦 ; tire of something｜厌倦某事 ; a flat tire｜瘪了的轮胎
tip_zh: 动词英美均用tire；轮胎的英式拼写为tyre。

meanings_zh: n. 芹菜
definition_en: A vegetable with long, crisp stalks, eaten raw or cooked.
example1_en: I chopped some celery and added it to the soup.
example1_zh: 我切了些芹菜，放进汤里。
example2_en: Growing vegetables such as celery locally can reduce transport costs and provide communities with fresh produce.
example2_zh: 在本地种植芹菜等蔬菜可以降低运输成本，并为社区提供新鲜农产品。
collocations: a stalk of celery｜一根芹菜茎 ; chopped celery｜切碎的芹菜 ; celery soup｜芹菜汤
tip_zh: 通常不可数；一根芹菜茎用a stalk of celery。

meanings_zh: n. 位置；地点 | n. 外景拍摄地
definition_en: The place where something is or where something happens. | A place outside a studio where filming takes place.
example1_en: This cafe has a lovely location beside the river.
example1_zh: 这家咖啡馆坐落在河边，位置很不错。
example2_en: The location of affordable housing strongly influences residents' access to schools, healthcare, and employment opportunities.
example2_zh: 保障性住房的位置会显著影响居民获得教育、医疗服务和就业机会的便利程度。
collocations: central location｜中心位置 ; ideal location｜理想地点 ; on location｜在外景地 ; exact location｜确切位置
tip_zh: on location指在摄影棚外实地拍摄。

meanings_zh: n. 问卷；调查表
definition_en: A set of written questions used to collect information from people.
example1_en: Please complete this short questionnaire before leaving the clinic.
example1_zh: 离开诊所前，请填写这份简短的问卷。
example2_en: Researchers distributed a questionnaire to investigate how commuting time affects workers' wellbeing and satisfaction with their jobs.
example2_zh: 研究人员发放了问卷，调查通勤时间如何影响员工的幸福感和工作满意度。
collocations: complete a questionnaire｜填写问卷 ; design a questionnaire｜设计问卷 ; distribute a questionnaire｜发放问卷 ; questionnaire responses｜问卷回答
tip_zh: 双n，重音在末尾；survey指调查，问卷只是其工具。

meanings_zh: n. 舌头 | n. 语言
definition_en: the soft organ in your mouth used for tasting and speaking | a language used by a particular community
example1_en: I burned my tongue on the hot soup.
example1_zh: 我喝热汤时烫到了舌头。
example2_en: Children who receive early education in their mother tongue may develop stronger foundations for learning other languages.
example2_zh: 用母语接受早期教育的儿童，可能为学习其他语言打下更牢固的基础。
collocations: mother tongue｜母语 ; stick out your tongue｜伸出舌头 ; bite your tongue｜忍住不说 ; on the tip of your tongue｜话到嘴边却想不起来
tip_zh: tongue指语言多见于mother tongue等搭配。

meanings_zh: n. 标签；标牌 | v. 贴标签于；标注 | v. 给…定性；将…归类
definition_en: a small attached piece giving information about something | to attach information to something for identification | to describe someone or something in a particular way
example1_en: Check the label before you wash your new sweater.
example1_zh: 洗新毛衣之前，先看看标签。
example2_en: Schools should avoid labelling children as failures, since this can damage their confidence and motivation.
example2_zh: 学校应避免给孩子贴上失败者的标签，因为这会损害他们的信心和学习动力。
collocations: read the label｜阅读标签 ; food label｜食品标签 ; label someone as｜将某人定性为
tip_zh: 英式过去式labelled，美式常用labeled。

meanings_zh: n. 手推车 | n. 有轨电车（美）
definition_en: A wheeled cart used for carrying shopping or other items. | An electric passenger vehicle that runs on rails in streets.
example1_en: She pushed a trolley full of groceries towards the checkout.
example1_zh: 她推着装满食品杂货的购物车走向收银台。
example2_en: Airports should provide free luggage trolleys to make travelling easier for families and older passengers.
example2_zh: 机场应提供免费行李车，方便家庭和老年乘客出行。
collocations: shopping trolley｜购物车 ; luggage trolley｜行李推车 ; push a trolley｜推手推车
tip_zh: 英式购物车用trolley，美式通常用shopping cart。

meanings_zh: v. 赶紧；匆忙做 | n. 匆忙；繁忙时段 | n. 一阵强烈感受
definition_en: to move or do something very quickly, often without care | a state of hurry or a period of intense activity | a sudden strong feeling or flow of something
example1_en: I rushed downstairs when I heard the doorbell.
example1_zh: 听到门铃声，我赶紧跑下了楼。
example2_en: Governments should not rush major transport projects without first assessing their environmental and financial impacts.
example2_zh: 政府不应在评估环境和财务影响之前仓促推进重大交通项目。
collocations: rush hour｜交通高峰期 ; in a rush｜匆忙地 ; rush into a decision｜仓促作决定 ; a rush of excitement｜一阵兴奋
tip_zh: rush to do表示赶紧做；rush into表示仓促行动。

meanings_zh: n. 住处；住宿 | n. 和解；迁就性安排
definition_en: a place where someone can live or stay | an arrangement that meets different needs or settles a disagreement
example1_en: We found cheap accommodation near the beach last summer.
example1_zh: 去年夏天，我们在海滩附近找到了便宜的住处。
example2_en: Universities should provide affordable accommodation so that students from disadvantaged backgrounds can study without excessive financial pressure.
example2_zh: 大学应提供价格可负担的住宿，让家境困难的学生能够在不过度承受经济压力的情况下学习。
collocations: student accommodation｜学生住宿 ; affordable accommodation｜可负担的住宿 ; temporary accommodation｜临时住处 ; reach an accommodation｜达成和解
tip_zh: 英式英语中表住宿通常不可数；注意双c、双m。

meanings_zh: n. 财宝；珍宝 | n. 珍品；珍贵之物 | v. 珍爱；珍视
definition_en: Gold, jewels, or other highly valuable objects | Something greatly valued for its beauty, importance, or personal meaning | To value something deeply and care for it
example1_en: The children imagined finding treasure inside the old chest.
example1_zh: 孩子们想象着在旧箱子里发现财宝。
example2_en: Museums preserve cultural treasures so that future generations can understand the achievements and traditions of earlier societies.
example2_zh: 博物馆保存文化珍宝，让后代能够了解早期社会的成就和传统。
collocations: buried treasure｜埋藏的财宝 ; national treasure｜国宝 ; treasure memories｜珍视回忆 ; treasure hunt｜寻宝活动
tip_zh: 泛指财宝时不可数；指具体珍品时可数。

meanings_zh: v. 后悔；对……感到遗憾 | n. 后悔；遗憾
definition_en: to feel sorry about something that happened or was done | sadness about a past action, decision, or situation
example1_en: I regret leaving my umbrella at home this morning.
example1_zh: 我后悔今天早上把伞留在了家里。
example2_en: Graduates may regret choosing a career solely for its salary if the work provides little personal satisfaction.
example2_zh: 如果工作难以带来个人满足感，毕业生可能会后悔仅凭薪水选择职业。
collocations: regret doing something｜后悔做过某事 ; deep regret｜深深的遗憾 ; express regret｜表示遗憾 ; regret to inform｜遗憾地告知
tip_zh: regret doing指后悔做过；regret to say指遗憾告知。

meanings_zh: v. 编织；针织 | v. 使紧密结合；愈合
definition_en: to make clothing or fabric by looping yarn with needles | to join closely together or heal into one piece
example1_en: My grandfather knitted a warm scarf for me.
example1_zh: 我爷爷给我织了一条暖和的围巾。
example2_en: Community groups that knit blankets for local shelters combine practical support with opportunities for social interaction.
example2_zh: 为当地收容所编织毯子的社区团体，将实际援助与社交机会结合起来。
collocations: knit a sweater｜织毛衣 ; knit together｜紧密结合；愈合 ; knit your brows｜皱眉
tip_zh: k不发音；过去式和过去分词可用knitted或knit。

meanings_zh: n. 小丑 | n. 爱耍宝的人 | v. 耍宝；逗乐
definition_en: a performer who wears funny clothes and makes people laugh | someone who behaves foolishly to make others laugh | to behave playfully or foolishly to amuse others
example1_en: The clown made a tiny dog from a balloon.
example1_zh: 小丑用一个气球做出了一只小狗。
example2_en: A trained clown can help young patients feel more comfortable during their stay in hospital.
example2_zh: 受过训练的小丑演员能帮助住院儿童放松心情。
collocations: circus clown｜马戏团小丑 ; class clown｜班里的活宝 ; clown around｜耍宝逗乐
tip_zh: clown around意为耍宝；称人clown也可能带贬义。

meanings_zh: n. 蓝莓
definition_en: A small, round, dark blue fruit.
example1_en: A ripe blueberry rolled off my spoon onto the table.
example1_zh: 一颗熟蓝莓从我的勺子上滚到了桌上。
example2_en: Growing blueberries locally can diversify farm income, but suitable soil conditions are essential for successful cultivation.
example2_zh: 在当地种植蓝莓可以使农场收入多样化，但适宜的土壤条件是成功栽培的关键。
collocations: fresh blueberries｜新鲜蓝莓 ; blueberry muffin｜蓝莓松饼 ; blueberry jam｜蓝莓果酱
tip_zh: 可数名词，复数把y变为ies：blueberries。

meanings_zh: n. 善良；体贴 | n. 善举；好意
definition_en: the quality of caring about others and helping them | an act that helps someone or shows care
example1_en: Her kindness made our new neighbour feel welcome.
example1_zh: 她的体贴让新邻居感受到了欢迎。
example2_en: Schools can encourage kindness by giving students opportunities to support classmates who face personal difficulties.
example2_zh: 学校可以让学生有机会帮助遇到个人困难的同学，从而培养他们的善意。
collocations: show kindness｜表现出善意 ; an act of kindness｜善举 ; kindness towards others｜对他人的善意
tip_zh: 指善良品质时不可数；指具体善举时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 瀑布
definition_en: Water falling from a height over a steep rock face
example1_en: We could hear the waterfall long before we saw it.
example1_zh: 还没看见瀑布，我们就远远听到了水声。
example2_en: Tourism near a waterfall can support local businesses, but visitor facilities should protect the surrounding natural habitat.
example2_zh: 瀑布附近的旅游业可以带动当地商业，但游客设施应保护周围的自然栖息地。
collocations: a spectacular waterfall｜壮观的瀑布 ; the base of a waterfall｜瀑布底部 ; a cascading waterfall｜飞流而下的瀑布
tip_zh: 可数名词：一处瀑布用a waterfall。

meanings_zh: adj. 辛辣的；加香料的
definition_en: containing spices, often with a strong, hot flavour
example1_en: The noodles were too spicy, so I ordered rice.
example1_zh: 面条太辣了，所以我点了米饭。
example2_en: Traditional spicy dishes can attract visitors who want to experience the distinctive flavours of a region.
example2_zh: 传统的辛辣菜肴能吸引想要体验当地独特风味的游客。
collocations: spicy food｜辛辣食物 ; spicy sauce｜辣味酱汁 ; mildly spicy｜微辣的
tip_zh: spicy指香料味浓或辣；hot也可指温度高。

meanings_zh: n. 签证
definition_en: Official permission to enter or stay in a foreign country.
example1_en: My student visa arrived just before the flight.
example1_zh: 我的学生签证在起飞前不久才办下来。
example2_en: Simpler visa procedures can encourage international students to study abroad and contribute to local economies.
example2_zh: 简化签证手续可以鼓励国际学生出国留学，并为当地经济作出贡献。
collocations: apply for a visa｜申请签证 ; student visa｜学生签证 ; visa application｜签证申请 ; visa requirements｜签证要求
tip_zh: visa是签证，passport是护照；通常需凭护照申请签证。

meanings_zh: n. 英式橄榄球
definition_en: A team sport involving carrying, passing, and kicking an oval ball
example1_en: My brother plays rugby every Saturday with his friends.
example1_zh: 我哥哥每周六都和朋友们打英式橄榄球。
example2_en: Schools offering rugby should provide suitable coaching and safety equipment to reduce the risk of injuries.
example2_zh: 开设英式橄榄球课程的学校应提供适当的指导和安全装备，以降低受伤风险。
collocations: play rugby｜打英式橄榄球 ; rugby match｜英式橄榄球比赛 ; rugby union｜联合式橄榄球 ; rugby league｜联盟式橄榄球
tip_zh: 通常指英式橄榄球，不等于美式橄榄球。

meanings_zh: n. 电源插头 | n. 塞子 | v. 堵住；塞住
definition_en: A device connecting electrical equipment to a power socket. | An object fitted into a hole to stop liquid escaping. | To fill or block a hole or gap.
example1_en: Pull the plug out before you clean the toaster.
example1_zh: 清洁烤面包机前，先拔掉插头。
example2_en: Households can reduce some unnecessary electricity consumption by removing plugs from sockets when appliances are not in use.
example2_zh: 家电不用时拔掉插头，家庭就能减少一些不必要的耗电。
collocations: pull out the plug｜拔出插头 ; plug something in｜给某物接通电源 ; bath plug｜浴缸塞 ; plug a gap｜填补缺口
tip_zh: 插头是plug，插座是socket；plug in表示插电。

meanings_zh: v. 漂浮；浮动 | v. 提出供考虑 | n. 游行彩车
definition_en: To stay on a liquid's surface or move gently through air. | To suggest an idea for others to consider. | A decorated vehicle used in a parade.
example1_en: A yellow leaf floated gently across the garden pond.
example1_zh: 一片黄叶轻轻漂过花园里的池塘。
example2_en: Researchers have floated the idea of using artificial islands to provide additional housing in crowded coastal cities.
example2_zh: 研究人员提出了利用人工岛为拥挤的沿海城市提供更多住房的想法。
collocations: float on water｜浮在水面上 ; float an idea｜提出一个想法 ; float downstream｜顺流漂下 ; parade float｜游行彩车
tip_zh: float an idea是提出想法供讨论，并非实施。

meanings_zh: n. 小虫；昆虫 | n. 程序错误；故障 | v. 烦扰；使恼火
definition_en: a small insect or similar creature | an error in a computer program that causes problems | to annoy someone, especially repeatedly
example1_en: A tiny green bug landed on my sleeve.
example1_zh: 一只绿色小虫落在了我的袖子上。
example2_en: A software bug can disrupt essential services, highlighting the importance of thorough testing before release.
example2_zh: 软件错误可能导致基本服务中断，这凸显了发布前进行全面测试的重要性。
collocations: a software bug｜软件错误 ; fix a bug｜修复程序错误 ; a tiny bug｜一只小虫
tip_zh: 口语中bug可泛指小虫；技术语境常指程序错误。

meanings_zh: n. 生理性别 | n. 性行为 | v. 辨别性别
definition_en: Biological classification based on reproductive and other physical characteristics. | Physical activity involving sexual intimacy. | To identify the biological sex of an animal.
example1_en: The vet checked the sex of our new kitten.
example1_zh: 兽医检查了我们新养的小猫的性别。
example2_en: Researchers examined whether biological sex influenced participants' responses to the treatment in the clinical study.
example2_zh: 研究人员在临床研究中考察了生理性别是否影响参与者对治疗的反应。
collocations: biological sex｜生理性别 ; sex differences｜性别差异 ; sex education｜性教育 ; determine the sex｜确定性别
tip_zh: sex偏重生理性别；gender常侧重社会性别。

meanings_zh: n. 病毒 | n. 计算机病毒
definition_en: A tiny infectious agent that reproduces inside living cells | Harmful computer code that spreads by infecting files or programs
example1_en: The doctor said a virus was causing my cough.
example1_zh: 医生说我的咳嗽是由病毒引起的。
example2_en: Public health campaigns can limit the spread of a virus by encouraging vaccination and regular handwashing.
example2_zh: 公共卫生宣传可以通过鼓励接种疫苗和经常洗手来限制病毒传播。
collocations: spread a virus｜传播病毒 ; computer virus｜计算机病毒 ; virus infection｜病毒感染
tip_zh: virus是病毒，bacterium是细菌；两者不能混用。

meanings_zh: adj. 朴素的；无装饰的 | adj. 清楚的；明显的 | n. 平原
definition_en: simple, without decoration or a pattern | easy to see or understand | a large area of flat land
example1_en: She chose a plain white shirt for the interview.
example1_zh: 她选了一件朴素的白衬衫去参加面试。
example2_en: Public health advice should use plain language so that everyone can understand essential information.
example2_zh: 公共卫生建议应使用浅显的语言，让每个人都能理解关键信息。
collocations: plain clothes｜便服 ; plain language｜浅显的语言 ; a coastal plain｜沿海平原
tip_zh: plain可指无花纹；平原用名词plain。

meanings_zh: n. 影响；效果 | v. 实现；使发生
definition_en: A change or result caused by something. | To bring about a change or result.
example1_en: The new curtains had a calming effect on the room.
example1_zh: 新窗帘让房间的氛围变得宁静了。
example2_en: Higher parking charges may have little effect on traffic unless reliable public transport is also available.
example2_zh: 如果没有可靠的公共交通，提高停车费对交通状况的影响可能很小。
collocations: have an effect on｜对……有影响 ; side effect｜副作用 ; take effect｜生效；起作用 ; effect change｜促成变革
tip_zh: effect常作名词；affect常作动词，意为影响。

meanings_zh: prep. 尽管；虽然
definition_en: Without being prevented or affected by something.
example1_en: We enjoyed our walk despite the cold wind.
example1_zh: 尽管寒风吹拂，我们还是散步散得很开心。
example2_en: Despite significant investment in public transport, many commuters still prefer driving because services remain unreliable.
example2_zh: 尽管公共交通获得了大量投资，许多通勤者仍更愿意开车，因为公交服务依然不可靠。
collocations: despite the fact that｜尽管事实是 ; despite difficulties｜尽管有困难 ; despite efforts｜尽管付出了努力
tip_zh: 后接名词或动名词，不加of；接从句用the fact that。

meanings_zh: n. 宇宙飞船
definition_en: A vehicle designed to travel through space.
example1_en: The children built a spaceship from cardboard boxes.
example1_zh: 孩子们用纸板箱做了一艘宇宙飞船。
example2_en: Designing a spaceship for long journeys requires careful planning to protect astronauts from radiation and isolation.
example2_zh: 设计用于长途航行的宇宙飞船需要周密规划，以保护宇航员免受辐射和孤独的影响。
collocations: board a spaceship｜登上宇宙飞船 ; launch a spaceship｜发射宇宙飞船 ; aboard a spaceship｜在宇宙飞船上
tip_zh: spaceship可数；spacecraft的单复数形式相同。

meanings_zh: v. 打断；插话；打扰 | v. 使中断；使暂停
definition_en: to stop someone speaking or working by doing something | to stop an activity or process for a time
example1_en: Please don't interrupt me while I explain the rules.
example1_zh: 我讲解规则时，请不要打断我。
example2_en: Frequent phone notifications can interrupt students' concentration and reduce the amount they learn during independent study.
example2_zh: 频繁的手机通知会打断学生的注意力，减少他们在自主学习中的收获。
collocations: interrupt a conversation｜打断谈话 ; interrupt someone｜打断某人 ; interrupt the flow｜打断连贯过程
tip_zh: interrupt指中途打断；disrupt侧重扰乱正常进程。

meanings_zh: n. 诗；诗歌作品
definition_en: A literary work using carefully arranged language, often in lines.
example1_en: Leila read a short poem aloud after dinner.
example1_zh: 莱拉晚饭后朗读了一首短诗。
example2_en: Reading a poem from another culture can help students explore unfamiliar perspectives and develop sensitivity to language.
example2_zh: 阅读来自另一种文化的诗歌，可以帮助学生探索陌生的视角，培养语言敏感度。
collocations: write a poem｜写诗 ; recite a poem｜背诵诗歌 ; a collection of poems｜诗集
tip_zh: poem可数，指一首诗；poetry不可数，统称诗歌。

meanings_zh: adj. 固态的；坚实的 | adj. 可靠的；扎实的 | n. 固体
definition_en: having a firm shape rather than being liquid or gas | strong, dependable, or based on good evidence | a substance that keeps its shape rather than flowing
example1_en: The lake froze solid during the bitterly cold night.
example1_zh: 在那个严寒的夜晚，湖面完全冻住了。
example2_en: Governments need solid evidence before introducing policies that could significantly affect public health and household spending.
example2_zh: 政府在出台可能显著影响公共卫生和家庭开支的政策前，需要可靠的证据。
collocations: solid evidence｜可靠证据 ; solid foundation｜坚实基础 ; solid waste｜固体废物 ; solid wood｜实木
tip_zh: solid作名词指固体；solid evidence表示可靠证据。

meanings_zh: v. 申请 | v. 应用；适用 | v. 涂；敷
definition_en: To formally ask for a job, place, or permission | To use something practically, or be relevant to a situation | To spread a substance onto a surface
example1_en: Apply sunscreen before you go outside on sunny days.
example1_zh: 晴天出门前要涂防晒霜。
example2_en: Universities should encourage students from disadvantaged backgrounds to apply for scholarships that cover tuition and living expenses.
example2_zh: 大学应鼓励家庭条件困难的学生申请涵盖学费和生活费的奖学金。
collocations: apply for a job｜申请工作 ; apply to a university｜向大学提出申请 ; apply knowledge｜应用知识 ; apply sunscreen｜涂防晒霜
tip_zh: apply for接申请事项；apply to接机构或适用对象。

meanings_zh: v. 咬；叮 | n. 一口；咬；叮咬伤
definition_en: To cut or grip with teeth, or wound with mouthparts | An act of biting, its wound, or a mouthful of food
example1_en: She bit into the apple and smiled at its sweetness.
example1_zh: 她咬了一口苹果，被甜得笑了起来。
example2_en: Public health campaigns should explain how travellers can prevent mosquito bites in regions with tropical diseases.
example2_zh: 公共卫生宣传应说明，旅行者在热带疾病流行地区如何预防蚊虫叮咬。
collocations: take a bite｜咬一口 ; bite into an apple｜咬苹果 ; mosquito bite｜蚊子叮咬
tip_zh: 过去式bit，过去分词bitten；一口用a bite。

meanings_zh: adj. 立即的；即时的 | adj. 速溶的；即食的 | n. 瞬间；片刻
definition_en: happening immediately, without any delay | prepared very quickly, usually by adding hot water | an extremely short period of time
example1_en: The warm soup brought instant comfort after our walk.
example1_zh: 散步回来后，热汤立刻让我们感到舒适。
example2_en: Digital platforms provide instant access to educational resources, although reliable internet connections remain essential.
example2_zh: 数字平台让人们即时获取教育资源，但稳定的网络连接仍然必不可少。
collocations: instant access｜即时获取 ; instant results｜即时结果 ; instant coffee｜速溶咖啡 ; in an instant｜转眼间
tip_zh: instant作形容词表示即时的；in an instant表示转眼间。

meanings_zh: n. 结论；推断 | n. 结尾；结束
definition_en: a judgement formed after considering facts or evidence | the final part or ending of something
example1_en: We reached the same conclusion after checking the receipts.
example1_zh: 核对收据后，我们得出了相同的结论。
example2_en: Researchers should consider alternative explanations before drawing a conclusion from a relatively small sample.
example2_zh: 研究人员根据较小的样本得出结论之前，应考虑其他可能的解释。
collocations: reach a conclusion｜得出结论 ; draw a conclusion｜作出推断 ; jump to conclusions｜贸然下结论 ; in conclusion｜总而言之
tip_zh: “得出结论”用reach或draw a conclusion，不用make。

meanings_zh: n. 数量；量
definition_en: the amount or number of something
example1_en: We bought a large quantity of rice yesterday.
example1_zh: 我们昨天买了大量大米。
example2_en: Reducing the quantity of food wasted by households could lower both environmental damage and living costs.
example2_zh: 减少家庭食物浪费量，既能减轻环境损害，也能降低生活成本。
collocations: a large quantity of｜大量的 ; in small quantities｜少量地 ; quality over quantity｜质量优于数量
tip_zh: quantity指数量，quality指质量；a quantity of可接两类名词。

meanings_zh: v. 使受伤
definition_en: to cause physical harm to a person or animal
example1_en: You could injure your back lifting that heavy box.
example1_zh: 搬那个重箱子可能会让你的背部受伤。
example2_en: Employers should provide safety training to reduce the risk of workers injuring themselves while operating machinery.
example2_zh: 雇主应提供安全培训，以降低工人操作机器时受伤的风险。
collocations: injure your knee｜伤到膝盖 ; seriously injured｜严重受伤 ; injure yourself｜使自己受伤
tip_zh: injure通常指身体受伤；损坏物品常用damage。

meanings_zh: n. 钢琴家；钢琴演奏者
definition_en: Someone who plays the piano, especially professionally.
example1_en: The pianist smiled before playing her favourite song.
example1_zh: 那位钢琴演奏者微微一笑，开始弹奏她最喜爱的歌曲。
example2_en: A professional pianist usually needs years of disciplined practice as well as opportunities to perform publicly.
example2_zh: 职业钢琴家通常既需要多年严格的练习，也需要公开演出的机会。
collocations: concert pianist｜音乐会钢琴家 ; professional pianist｜职业钢琴家 ; accompanying pianist｜钢琴伴奏者
tip_zh: pianist指演奏者；乐器钢琴是piano。

meanings_zh: v. 抱怨；投诉
definition_en: To say that something is wrong or unsatisfactory
example1_en: Our neighbours often complain about noise from the traffic.
example1_zh: 我们的邻居经常抱怨交通噪声。
example2_en: Residents may complain to local authorities when construction work repeatedly disrupts their sleep and daily activities.
example2_zh: 当施工反复影响睡眠和日常活动时，居民可能会向地方当局投诉。
collocations: complain about noise｜抱怨噪声 ; complain to the manager｜向经理投诉 ; complain of pain｜诉说疼痛
tip_zh: 向某人投诉某事：complain to sb about sth。

meanings_zh: n. 职业；专业性职业 | n. 某职业的全体从业者 | n. 公开表白；声明
definition_en: A job requiring specialist knowledge and usually advanced training. | All the people working in a particular specialist occupation. | An open statement of a belief, feeling, or intention.
example1_en: Nursing is a demanding profession, but my sister loves it.
example1_zh: 护理是个要求很高的职业，但我姐姐很喜欢。
example2_en: The teaching profession needs greater public support to attract talented graduates and retain experienced staff.
example2_zh: 教师行业需要更多公众支持，以吸引优秀毕业生并留住经验丰富的教师。
collocations: enter a profession｜进入某职业领域 ; by profession｜就职业而言 ; the medical profession｜医学界 ; a profession of faith｜信仰的公开表白
tip_zh: profession通常指需专门训练的职业，比job范围窄。

meanings_zh: n. 瑜伽
definition_en: A practice combining body positions, controlled breathing, and mental focus.
example1_en: She does yoga on a mat beside the window.
example1_zh: 她在窗边的垫子上练瑜伽。
example2_en: Offering yoga classes in community centres may help residents manage stress and maintain flexibility.
example2_zh: 在社区中心开设瑜伽课可能有助于居民缓解压力并保持身体柔韧。
collocations: do yoga｜练瑜伽 ; yoga mat｜瑜伽垫 ; yoga instructor｜瑜伽教练
tip_zh: 练瑜伽用do或practise yoga，不用play。

meanings_zh: n. 环岛；环形交叉路口 | adj. 绕路的；迂回的 | n. 游乐场旋转圆台
definition_en: A circular road junction where traffic travels around a central island. | Not following the most direct route or way of speaking. | A rotating platform that children sit or stand on.
example1_en: Take the second exit at the roundabout near the park.
example1_zh: 在公园附近的环岛从第二个出口驶出。
example2_en: Replacing a busy junction with a roundabout may improve traffic flow and reduce serious collisions.
example2_zh: 将繁忙的交叉路口改为环岛可能改善车流，并减少严重碰撞事故。
collocations: at the roundabout｜在环岛处 ; take a roundabout route｜走迂回路线 ; in a roundabout way｜以迂回的方式
tip_zh: 作形容词指不直接，如a roundabout answer。

meanings_zh: n. 海湾 | n. 专用隔间；停车位
definition_en: An area of sea partly enclosed by land. | A designated space within a building or parking area.
example1_en: Small fishing boats floated in the sheltered bay.
example1_zh: 小渔船漂浮在避风的海湾里。
example2_en: Coastal development around the bay must be carefully managed to protect marine habitats and local livelihoods.
example2_zh: 必须谨慎管理海湾周边的沿海开发，以保护海洋栖息地和当地居民的生计。
collocations: sheltered bay｜避风海湾 ; sandy bay｜沙质海湾 ; parking bay｜停车位 ; loading bay｜装卸区
tip_zh: bay主要指海湾；停车或装卸语境中指专用区域。

meanings_zh: v. 作出反应；回应 | v. 发生化学反应
definition_en: Behave or feel in response to something that happens. | Change chemically when combined with another substance.
example1_en: How did your sister react to the surprise party?
example1_zh: 你姐姐对这场惊喜派对有什么反应？
example2_en: Governments must react quickly to public health emergencies while providing clear information to citizens.
example2_zh: 政府必须迅速应对公共卫生紧急事件，同时向公众提供清晰的信息。
collocations: react to news｜对消息作出反应 ; react quickly｜迅速反应 ; react with oxygen｜与氧气反应
tip_zh: 对某事反应用react to；与物质反应用react with。

meanings_zh: n. 钩；挂钩 | v. 钩住；挂住
definition_en: A curved object used for hanging, holding or catching things. | To attach or catch something with a hook.
example1_en: Hang your wet coat on the hook by the door.
example1_zh: 把你的湿外套挂在门边的挂钩上。
example2_en: Installing a simple hook beside each desk can keep school bags off classroom floors and reduce accidents.
example2_zh: 在每张课桌旁安装一个简单的挂钩，可以避免书包堆在教室地上，减少意外。
collocations: coat hook｜衣帽钩 ; fishing hook｜鱼钩 ; hook onto｜钩在……上
tip_zh: be hooked on意为“迷上”，不指实际挂住。

meanings_zh: adj. 粗糙的；不平的 | adj. 粗略的；大致的 | adj. 艰难的；动荡的；猛烈的
definition_en: Having an uneven surface that is not smooth. | Not exact, detailed, or completely finished. | Difficult to experience, or involving strong, uncontrolled movement or force.
example1_en: The rough wooden bench scratched my bare legs.
example1_zh: 粗糙的木长凳刮到了我裸露的小腿。
example2_en: A rough estimate of construction costs can help local authorities decide whether a housing project is affordable.
example2_zh: 粗略估算建筑成本有助于地方政府判断是否负担得起某个住房项目。
collocations: a rough surface｜粗糙的表面 ; a rough estimate｜粗略估计 ; a rough time｜艰难的时期 ; rough seas｜波涛汹涌的海面
tip_zh: rough estimate是粗略估计；rough中的gh发/f/。

meanings_zh: adj. 错误的；不正确的
definition_en: Not accurate, true, or right.
example1_en: The delivery failed because our address details were incorrect.
example1_zh: 由于我们的地址信息有误，配送未能成功。
example2_en: Incorrect information shared online can undermine public understanding of health issues and influence important personal decisions.
example2_zh: 网上传播的错误信息会妨碍公众理解健康问题，并影响重要的个人决定。
collocations: incorrect information｜错误信息 ; incorrect answer｜错误答案 ; factually incorrect｜事实有误的
tip_zh: incorrect比wrong正式，常用于答案、信息或数据。

meanings_zh: adv. 身体上；体力上 | adv. 实际上；亲身地
definition_en: In a way related to the body or physical effort. | In a real, material way rather than virtually or theoretically.
example1_en: After moving those boxes, I felt physically exhausted.
example1_zh: 搬完那些箱子后，我感觉身体疲惫不堪。
example2_en: Physically active children often develop healthier habits that continue into adulthood, reducing their risk of chronic disease.
example2_zh: 经常运动的儿童通常会养成更健康的习惯，并延续至成年，从而降低患慢性病的风险。
collocations: physically active｜经常运动的 ; physically demanding｜耗费体力的 ; physically present｜亲自在场的
tip_zh: 强调身体层面时，常与mentally形成对比。

meanings_zh: adv. 与此同时；在此期间
definition_en: During the same time or while something else is happening.
example1_en: The soup is simmering; meanwhile, I will prepare dessert.
example1_zh: 汤正在慢炖；趁这会儿，我来准备甜点。
example2_en: New railway lines may take years to complete; meanwhile, cities should improve existing bus services.
example2_zh: 新铁路线可能需要多年才能建成；在此期间，城市应改善现有的公交服务。
collocations: in the meanwhile｜在此期间 ; meanwhile, elsewhere｜与此同时，在别处
tip_zh: 连接两个完整句子时，前面用句号或分号。

meanings_zh: adv. 完全；全然 | adv. 总共 | adv. 总的来说
definition_en: completely or entirely | when everything or everyone is counted | when considering everything
example1_en: We stopped going to that crowded café altogether.
example1_zh: 我们彻底不再去那家拥挤的咖啡馆了。
example2_en: Although online courses improve access, they cannot altogether replace the social benefits of classroom learning.
example2_zh: 虽然在线课程扩大了学习机会，但它们无法完全取代课堂学习带来的社交益处。
collocations: altogether different｜完全不同 ; not altogether clear｜不完全清楚 ; disappear altogether｜彻底消失
tip_zh: altogether是完全或总共；all together是全在一起。

meanings_zh: n. 目的；目标 | v. 力求；旨在 | v. 瞄准；对准
definition_en: something you want or plan to achieve | to intend or try to achieve something | to point something towards a particular target
example1_en: My main aim today is to tidy the kitchen.
example1_zh: 我今天的主要目标是把厨房收拾整齐。
example2_en: The programme aims to reduce youth unemployment by providing practical training and opportunities to gain workplace experience.
example2_zh: 该项目旨在通过提供实践培训和获取职场经验的机会，降低青年失业率。
collocations: the main aim｜主要目标 ; aim to do something｜力求做某事 ; with the aim of｜以……为目的 ; aim at a target｜瞄准目标
tip_zh: aim to do表打算做；aim at doing表力求实现。

meanings_zh: adj. 极好的；出色的 | adj. 极大的；强烈的
definition_en: Extremely good or enjoyable. | Very great in amount, degree, or intensity.
example1_en: You did a terrific job fixing that old bicycle.
example1_zh: 你把那辆旧自行车修得真棒。
example2_en: Community gardens offer a terrific opportunity for residents to exercise outdoors while developing stronger social connections.
example2_zh: 社区花园为居民提供了极好的机会，让他们在户外锻炼的同时建立更紧密的社会联系。
collocations: terrific job｜出色的工作 ; terrific opportunity｜极好的机会 ; terrific speed｜极快的速度 ; terrific noise｜巨大的响声
tip_zh: 常用于口语赞扬；别与terrible“糟糕的”混淆。

meanings_zh: adv. 主要地；大多
definition_en: mostly, or more than anything else
example1_en: This little shop mainly sells fresh bread and cakes.
example1_zh: 这家小店主要卖新鲜面包和蛋糕。
example2_en: Many rural communities depend mainly on agriculture, making them particularly vulnerable to changes in weather patterns.
example2_zh: 许多农村社区主要依赖农业，因此尤其容易受到天气模式变化的影响。
collocations: mainly because｜主要因为 ; mainly due to｜主要由于 ; consist mainly of｜主要由……组成 ; depend mainly on｜主要依靠
tip_zh: 表示“主要而非全部”；常放在实义动词前。

meanings_zh: v. 意识到；明白 | v. 实现；使成为现实
definition_en: to become aware of a fact or understand a situation | to make a hope, ambition, or possibility become real
example1_en: I suddenly realised my keys were still inside the house.
example1_zh: 我突然意识到钥匙还在屋里。
example2_en: Many students realise the importance of time management when they begin balancing academic work with paid employment.
example2_zh: 许多学生开始兼顾学业与有偿工作时，才意识到时间管理的重要性。
collocations: realise that｜意识到…… ; realise the importance of｜认识到……的重要性 ; realise an ambition｜实现志向 ; realise your potential｜发挥你的潜能
tip_zh: 英式常写realise，美式写realize；可接that从句。

meanings_zh: n. 全体员工；工作人员 | v. 为…配备员工
definition_en: The people employed by an organisation. | To provide workers for an organisation or service.
example1_en: The hotel staff helped us carry our heavy bags.
example1_zh: 酒店的工作人员帮我们搬了沉重的行李。
example2_en: Hospitals need sufficient staff to maintain high standards of care during periods of increased demand.
example2_zh: 医院需要充足的人员，才能在需求上升期间保持高水平的护理服务。
collocations: a member of staff｜一名员工 ; staff training｜员工培训 ; teaching staff｜全体教师 ; staff shortage｜人员短缺
tip_zh: 单个员工用a member of staff，不说a staff。

meanings_zh: n. 茶碟；茶托
definition_en: a small shallow dish placed underneath a cup
example1_en: She placed a biscuit on the saucer beside her cup.
example1_zh: 她把一块饼干放在茶托上，紧挨着杯子。
example2_en: Traditional tea sets, including matching cups and saucers, can reflect local craftsmanship and cultural preferences.
example2_zh: 传统茶具，包括配套的茶杯和茶碟，可以体现当地的手工艺和文化偏好。
collocations: cup and saucer｜杯子和茶托 ; matching saucer｜配套茶碟 ; flying saucer｜飞碟
tip_zh: saucer是杯子下的小碟；flying saucer指飞碟。

meanings_zh: n. 自助餐 | n. 车站小餐馆；列车餐柜
definition_en: A meal where people serve themselves from dishes set out. | A small place selling refreshments at a station or on a train.
example1_en: We helped ourselves to fresh fruit at the breakfast buffet.
example1_zh: 我们在自助早餐处自行取用了新鲜水果。
example2_en: Hotels can reduce food waste by offering smaller portions and replenishing buffet dishes more frequently.
example2_zh: 酒店可以通过提供更小的份量并更频繁地补充自助餐菜品来减少食物浪费。
collocations: a buffet breakfast｜自助早餐 ; a buffet lunch｜自助午餐 ; a buffet car｜列车餐车 ; a cold buffet｜冷食自助餐
tip_zh: 作“自助餐”时t不发音；动词“猛击”读/ˈbʌfɪt/。

meanings_zh: n. 阳台 | n. 剧院楼座
definition_en: A raised outdoor platform attached to a building, with a railing. | An upper level of seats in a theatre.
example1_en: She grows herbs in small pots on her balcony.
example1_zh: 她在阳台上的小盆里种香草。
example2_en: Apartments with a balcony offer residents valuable outdoor space, particularly in cities where public gardens are scarce.
example2_zh: 带阳台的公寓为住户提供了宝贵的户外空间，在公共花园稀少的城市尤其如此。
collocations: on the balcony｜在阳台上 ; a private balcony｜私人阳台 ; balcony seats｜楼座座位
tip_zh: 在阳台上用on the balcony，不用in。

meanings_zh: n. 纪录片；纪实节目 | adj. 文件的；文献的
definition_en: A film or programme presenting facts about real subjects. | Consisting of or supported by written documents.
example1_en: We watched a documentary about penguins after dinner.
example1_zh: 晚饭后，我们看了一部关于企鹅的纪录片。
example2_en: A well-researched documentary can raise public awareness of environmental problems without oversimplifying their causes.
example2_zh: 一部经过充分调研的纪录片能够提高公众对环境问题的认识，同时避免过度简化其成因。
collocations: documentary film｜纪录电影 ; documentary evidence｜书面证据 ; documentary about wildlife｜关于野生动物的纪录片
tip_zh: 作名词指纪录片；documentary evidence指书面证据。

meanings_zh: v. 受苦；患病 | v. 遭受；受损
definition_en: To experience physical pain or mental distress. | To experience something harmful or become worse.
example1_en: I suffer from headaches when I skip lunch.
example1_zh: 我不吃午饭时就会头痛。
example2_en: Small businesses often suffer financial losses when major roadworks prevent customers from reaching their premises.
example2_zh: 大型道路施工导致顾客无法到店时，小企业往往会遭受经济损失。
collocations: suffer from headaches｜受头痛困扰 ; suffer a loss｜遭受损失 ; suffer damage｜遭到损坏 ; suffer badly｜遭受严重影响
tip_zh: 疾病常用suffer from；损失、损坏常直接接在suffer后。

meanings_zh: n. 金属丝；电线 | v. 给…接线；安装电线
definition_en: Thin metal drawn into strands, often used to carry electricity. | To install or connect electrical wires in something.
example1_en: A thin wire connects the lamp to its battery.
example1_zh: 一根细电线将灯与电池连接起来。
example2_en: Older buildings often need new electrical wire to meet modern safety standards and support increased energy use.
example2_zh: 老建筑往往需要更换电线，以符合现代安全标准并满足增长的用电需求。
collocations: copper wire｜铜线 ; electrical wire｜电线 ; wire fence｜铁丝围栏 ; wire up a house｜给房屋安装电线
tip_zh: wire可指单根金属丝；cable通常更粗或由多股组成。

meanings_zh: adv. 强烈地；坚定地
definition_en: With great force, intensity, or conviction.
example1_en: I strongly recommend taking a jacket on this walk.
example1_zh: 我强烈建议这次散步带上一件夹克。
example2_en: Many residents strongly oppose the proposed airport expansion because they fear increased noise and air pollution.
example2_zh: 许多居民强烈反对拟议中的机场扩建，因为他们担心噪声和空气污染加剧。
collocations: strongly recommend｜强烈建议 ; strongly oppose｜坚决反对 ; strongly believe｜坚信 ; strongly associated with｜与……密切相关
tip_zh: 常修饰recommend、oppose、believe，强调态度。

meanings_zh: adj. 令人放松的
definition_en: making you feel calm and free from stress
example1_en: A warm bath is wonderfully relaxing after a busy day.
example1_zh: 忙碌一天后，泡个温水澡让人格外放松。
example2_en: Access to relaxing green spaces may improve mental wellbeing among residents of densely populated urban areas.
example2_zh: 能前往令人放松的绿地，可能有助于改善人口密集城区居民的心理健康。
collocations: relaxing atmosphere｜轻松的氛围 ; relaxing music｜令人放松的音乐 ; relaxing holiday｜轻松的假期
tip_zh: relaxing形容事物令人放松；relaxed形容人感到放松。

meanings_zh: adj. 不确定的；无把握的 | adj. 未定的；难以预测的
definition_en: not sure about something | not known, settled, or predictable
example1_en: I felt uncertain about which jacket to buy.
example1_zh: 我拿不定主意该买哪件夹克。
example2_en: The long-term effects of remote working remain uncertain, particularly for younger employees entering the labour market.
example2_zh: 远程工作的长期影响仍不明确，对刚进入劳动力市场的年轻员工而言尤其如此。
collocations: uncertain about｜对……不确定 ; an uncertain future｜未卜的前途 ; remain uncertain｜仍不确定
tip_zh: 人没把握用uncertain about；事情未定用remain uncertain。

meanings_zh: v. 下沉；使沉没 | n. 洗涤槽；水槽 | v. 下降；减弱
definition_en: To move below a surface, or make something do this. | A fixed basin with taps and a drain for washing. | To fall to a lower level or become weaker.
example1_en: The little toy boat sank beneath the bathwater.
example1_zh: 那只小玩具船沉到了洗澡水下面。
example2_en: Coastal communities face increasing risks as land sinks and sea levels rise because of climate change.
example2_zh: 随着地面下沉以及气候变化导致的海平面上升，沿海社区面临日益严峻的风险。
collocations: sink to the bottom｜沉到底部 ; kitchen sink｜厨房水槽 ; sink into debt｜陷入债务
tip_zh: 不规则变化：sink—sank—sunk。

meanings_zh: n. 贸易；交易 | v. 买卖；交换 | n. 手艺；职业
definition_en: the activity of buying and selling goods or services | to buy, sell, or exchange goods or services | a skilled job, especially one involving practical work
example1_en: At lunch, I traded my apple for a pear.
example1_zh: 午饭时，我用自己的苹果换了一个梨。
example2_en: International trade can create employment, but governments must ensure that workers receive fair wages and adequate protection.
example2_zh: 国际贸易可以创造就业，但政府必须确保工人获得公平的工资和充分的保障。
collocations: international trade｜国际贸易 ; trade agreement｜贸易协定 ; trade with｜与……做生意 ; learn a trade｜学一门手艺
tip_zh: trade A for B指用A换B；by trade指职业上。

meanings_zh: adj. 出生地的；母语的 | adj. 本土的；原生的 | n. 本地人；出生于某地者
definition_en: connected with the place or language of someone's early life | living or growing naturally in a particular region | a person born in a particular place
example1_en: After years abroad, Ravi returned to his native city.
example1_zh: 在国外生活多年后，拉维回到了自己的故乡城市。
example2_en: Planting native species in urban gardens can support local wildlife and reduce the need for additional watering.
example2_zh: 在城市花园中种植本土物种可以帮助当地野生动物生存，并减少额外浇水的需要。
collocations: native language｜母语 ; native speaker｜母语使用者 ; native species｜本土物种 ; be native to｜原产于
tip_zh: a native of指某地出生者；the natives可能带贬义。

meanings_zh: n. 监狱 | n. 监禁
definition_en: A place where people are kept as punishment for crimes. | The state of being kept in a prison.
example1_en: The old prison has become a popular local museum.
example1_zh: 这座旧监狱已成为当地一处受欢迎的博物馆。
example2_en: Education programmes in prison can help individuals develop skills that support their successful return to society.
example2_zh: 监狱内的教育项目能帮助服刑人员培养技能，支持他们顺利回归社会。
collocations: in prison｜在服刑 ; go to prison｜入狱服刑 ; prison sentence｜监禁刑期 ; prison reform｜监狱改革
tip_zh: in prison指服刑；in the prison强调在监狱内。

meanings_zh: n. 登机；上船；上车 | n. 寄宿；膳宿 | n. 拼接木板；板材
definition_en: The process of getting onto an aircraft, ship, or other vehicle. | Staying somewhere with meals provided, especially at school. | Wooden boards used together to cover a surface.
example1_en: We bought some sandwiches before boarding began this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上开始登机前，我们买了些三明治。
example2_en: Airports can reduce boarding delays by providing clearer instructions and additional assistance for passengers with limited mobility.
example2_zh: 机场可以通过提供更清晰的指引及为行动不便的旅客增加协助，减少登机延误。
collocations: boarding pass｜登机牌 ; boarding gate｜登机口 ; boarding school｜寄宿学校 ; priority boarding｜优先登机
tip_zh: 作名词指登机等过程；也可作board的现在分词。

meanings_zh: n. 歌剧；歌剧艺术
definition_en: a musical drama in which performers sing most words
example1_en: We watched an opera at the theatre last night.
example1_zh: 我们昨晚在剧院看了一部歌剧。
example2_en: Public funding for opera can preserve artistic traditions while making performances accessible to a wider audience.
example2_zh: 为歌剧提供公共资助既能保护艺术传统，也能让更多观众有机会欣赏演出。
collocations: an opera singer｜歌剧演员 ; an opera house｜歌剧院 ; perform an opera｜演出歌剧
tip_zh: 泛指歌剧艺术时不可数；一部歌剧用an opera。

meanings_zh: adj. 复杂的 | n. 综合建筑群
definition_en: Having many connected parts and being difficult to understand. | A group of buildings used for related activities.
example1_en: This recipe looks complex, but each step is simple.
example1_zh: 这道食谱看起来复杂，但每一步都很简单。
example2_en: Urban poverty is a complex issue that requires cooperation between governments, businesses and local communities.
example2_zh: 城市贫困是一个复杂问题，需要政府、企业和当地社区共同合作。
collocations: complex issue｜复杂问题 ; complex system｜复杂系统 ; sports complex｜综合体育场馆
tip_zh: 作形容词指复杂；作名词可指综合建筑群。

meanings_zh: v. 追逐；追赶 | v. 努力争取；追求 | n. 追逐；追捕
definition_en: to run or move after someone to catch them | to try hard to obtain something you want | an attempt to catch someone by following them
example1_en: Our puppy chased a leaf across the garden.
example1_zh: 我们的小狗追着一片叶子跑过花园。
example2_en: Many young professionals chase higher salaries rather than seek work that offers lasting satisfaction.
example2_zh: 许多年轻的专业人士追求更高的薪水，而不是寻找能带来持久满足感的工作。
collocations: chase after someone｜追赶某人 ; chase a dream｜追逐梦想 ; a high-speed chase｜高速追逐
tip_zh: chase可直接接追赶对象，也可用chase after。

meanings_zh: n. 楼层
definition_en: A level of a building.
example1_en: Their new house has two storeys and a small garden.
example1_zh: 他们的新房有两层，还带一个小花园。
example2_en: Buildings with many storeys can accommodate more residents without requiring additional land in crowded cities.
example2_zh: 在拥挤的城市中，多层建筑无需增加用地就能容纳更多居民。
collocations: a two-storey house｜一栋两层住宅 ; the top storey｜顶层 ; a multi-storey building｜多层建筑
tip_zh: 英式storey复数为storeys；美式拼作story。

meanings_zh: n. 宽度
definition_en: The distance from one side of something to the other.
example1_en: Check the width of the sofa before buying it.
example1_zh: 买沙发前先确认一下它的宽度。
example2_en: Increasing the width of pavements can improve accessibility for wheelchair users and make walking more comfortable.
example2_zh: 加宽人行道可以方便轮椅使用者通行，也能让步行更舒适。
collocations: measure the width｜测量宽度 ; in width｜在宽度上 ; full width｜整个宽度
tip_zh: 形容词wide，名词width，动词widen。

meanings_zh: n. 雇主；用人单位
definition_en: A person or organisation that pays people to work.
example1_en: My employer lets me work from home on Fridays.
example1_zh: 我的雇主允许我每周五在家办公。
example2_en: Employers can improve staff retention by offering fair wages, flexible schedules, and opportunities for professional development.
example2_zh: 雇主可以通过提供公平的薪资、灵活的工作安排和职业发展机会来提高员工留任率。
collocations: a major employer｜大型用人单位 ; a prospective employer｜潜在雇主 ; current employer｜现雇主
tip_zh: employer是雇主；employee是雇员。

meanings_zh: adv. 非常；极其 | adv. 令人难以置信地
definition_en: To an extremely high degree. | In a way that is surprising or hard to believe.
example1_en: The soup was incredibly hot, so I waited.
example1_zh: 汤特别烫，所以我等了一会儿。
example2_en: Reliable public transport can be incredibly valuable to older residents who no longer drive.
example2_zh: 对于不再开车的老年居民来说，可靠的公共交通可能极其重要。
collocations: incredibly difficult｜极其困难 ; incredibly useful｜非常有用 ; incredibly fast｜快得惊人
tip_zh: 常修饰形容词或副词；句首可表示“难以置信的是”。

meanings_zh: n. 香水 | n. 芳香；香气 | v. 使散发香味
definition_en: A pleasant-smelling liquid applied to the body. | A pleasant smell, especially from flowers. | To give something a pleasant smell.
example1_en: She sprayed a little perfume on her wrist.
example1_zh: 她在手腕上喷了一点香水。
example2_en: Some workplaces discourage employees from wearing perfume because strong fragrances can cause discomfort for sensitive colleagues.
example2_zh: 一些工作场所不鼓励员工使用香水，因为浓烈的香味可能让敏感的同事感到不适。
collocations: wear perfume｜使用香水 ; a bottle of perfume｜一瓶香水 ; the perfume of flowers｜花香
tip_zh: 表示身上用了香水常用wear perfume，而非put perfume。

meanings_zh: v. 摆动；摇摆 | n. 秋千 | n. 明显变化；转变
definition_en: To move backwards and forwards or in a curved path. | A hanging seat that moves backwards and forwards. | A noticeable change in an opinion, mood, or situation.
example1_en: Her bag swung gently as she walked down the street.
example1_zh: 她走在街上，包随着步伐轻轻摆动。
example2_en: A sharp swing in public opinion can encourage governments to reconsider policies that previously enjoyed widespread support.
example2_zh: 公众意见的急剧转变可能促使政府重新审视此前获得广泛支持的政策。
collocations: swing back and forth｜来回摆动 ; a playground swing｜游乐场秋千 ; mood swings｜情绪波动 ; a swing in public opinion｜舆论转变
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为swung；不是swinged。

meanings_zh: v. 投资 | v. 投入时间、精力或资金
definition_en: To put money into something hoping to gain financial returns. | To devote resources to something for a future benefit.
example1_en: My aunt plans to invest in a small bakery.
example1_zh: 我姑姑打算投资一家小面包店。
example2_en: Governments should invest in renewable energy to improve energy security and reduce dependence on imported fuels.
example2_zh: 政府应投资可再生能源，以提高能源安全并减少对进口燃料的依赖。
collocations: invest in property｜投资房地产 ; invest heavily in｜大量投资于 ; invest time in｜投入时间于 ; invest wisely｜明智地投资
tip_zh: 常用invest in；投入时间做事可用invest time in doing。

meanings_zh: n. 工程学；工程技术
definition_en: using science to design and build machines, structures, or systems
example1_en: My cousin studies engineering and builds small robots at home.
example1_zh: 我的表哥学工程，平时在家制作小型机器人。
example2_en: Advances in engineering have enabled cities to build bridges that withstand extreme weather and carry heavier traffic.
example2_zh: 工程技术的进步使城市能够建造抵御极端天气、承载更大交通量的桥梁。
collocations: civil engineering｜土木工程 ; mechanical engineering｜机械工程 ; electrical engineering｜电气工程 ; an engineering project｜工程项目
tip_zh: 表示学科或技术领域时不可数；engineer可指工程师。

meanings_zh: adj. 有害健康的 | adj. 不健康的；身体虚弱的 | adj. 不正常的；有害的
definition_en: likely to damage physical or mental health | not in good physical condition | harmful or excessive in a way that causes problems
example1_en: Eating only biscuits for dinner is an unhealthy habit.
example1_zh: 晚餐只吃饼干是个不健康的习惯。
example2_en: Advertising unhealthy foods to children may contribute to poor dietary habits and higher rates of obesity.
example2_zh: 向儿童投放不健康食品广告，可能导致不良饮食习惯和更高的肥胖率。
collocations: an unhealthy diet｜不健康的饮食 ; an unhealthy lifestyle｜不健康的生活方式 ; unhealthy competition｜恶性竞争 ; an unhealthy obsession｜有害的痴迷
tip_zh: unhealthy可指事物伤身，也可指身体状况差。

meanings_zh: adj. 科学的；符合科学方法的
definition_en: relating to science or using methods based on evidence
example1_en: Our class used scientific methods to test the water.
example1_zh: 我们班用科学方法检测了水质。
example2_en: Governments should rely on scientific evidence when developing policies to protect public health.
example2_zh: 政府在制定保护公众健康的政策时，应依据科学证据。
collocations: scientific research｜科学研究 ; scientific evidence｜科学证据 ; scientific method｜科学方法
tip_zh: scientific强调科学依据，不等于仅仅有条理。

meanings_zh: n. 准备；准备工作
definition_en: The work done to get ready for something.
example1_en: Dinner preparation takes longer when the children help.
example1_zh: 孩子们帮忙时，准备晚饭反而要花更长时间。
example2_en: Thorough preparation for job interviews can help graduates communicate their skills and experience more confidently.
example2_zh: 充分准备求职面试能帮助毕业生更自信地介绍自己的技能和经验。
collocations: in preparation for｜为……做准备 ; make preparations｜做准备工作 ; food preparation｜食物准备 ; thorough preparation｜充分准备
tip_zh: 泛指准备时不可数；具体筹备工作常用复数preparations。

meanings_zh: n. 企鹅
definition_en: a flightless seabird with black and white feathers, found mainly south
example1_en: The penguin waddled across the rocks towards the sea.
example1_zh: 那只企鹅摇摇摆摆地走过岩石，朝大海走去。
example2_en: Changes in ocean temperatures can affect penguin populations by altering the availability of fish and other prey.
example2_zh: 海水温度的变化会改变鱼类及其他猎物的供应量，从而影响企鹅种群。
collocations: penguin colony｜企鹅群 ; penguin chick｜企鹅幼鸟 ; penguin species｜企鹅物种
tip_zh: 企鹅是不会飞的鸟；并非全都生活在南极。

meanings_zh: n. 警报；警报器；闹钟 | n. 惊慌；担忧 | v. 使惊慌；使担忧
definition_en: A warning signal or device, or something that wakes you. | A sudden feeling of fear or worry. | To make someone frightened or worried.
example1_en: My alarm rang before sunrise, waking the whole family.
example1_zh: 我的闹钟在日出前响了，把全家人都吵醒了。
example2_en: Every school should test its fire alarm regularly to ensure that pupils receive an immediate warning.
example2_zh: 每所学校都应定期测试火灾警报器，确保学生能立即收到警报。
collocations: set an alarm｜设定闹钟 ; fire alarm｜火灾警报器 ; raise the alarm｜发出警报 ; in alarm｜惊慌地
tip_zh: 警报响起用go off，不是go on。

meanings_zh: n. 证书；证明书
definition_en: An official document proving a fact or qualification.
example1_en: Lena proudly showed her swimming certificate to her grandparents.
example1_zh: 莉娜自豪地向祖父母展示了她的游泳证书。
example2_en: A professional certificate can improve employment prospects, but employers also value practical experience.
example2_zh: 专业资格证书可以改善就业前景，但雇主也重视实践经验。
collocations: a birth certificate｜出生证明 ; a medical certificate｜医生证明 ; a professional certificate｜专业资格证书 ; award a certificate｜颁发证书
tip_zh: certificate泛指证明或资格证书，不一定是学位。

meanings_zh: adj. 枯燥的；无趣的 | adj. 暗淡的；阴沉的 | adj. 钝的；不锋利的
definition_en: Not interesting or exciting. | Not bright or sunny. | Having an edge that does not cut easily.
example1_en: The film was so dull that I nearly fell asleep.
example1_zh: 这部电影太无聊了，我差点睡着。
example2_en: Lessons can seem dull when students have few opportunities to ask questions or explore ideas independently.
example2_zh: 如果学生很少有机会提问或独立探索想法，课堂就可能显得枯燥。
collocations: dull routine｜乏味的日常安排 ; dull weather｜阴沉的天气 ; dull blade｜钝刀刃 ; dull ache｜隐痛
tip_zh: 形容刀刃时指“钝”，形容活动时指“无聊”。

meanings_zh: adj. 电的；电气的
definition_en: Related to electricity or equipment that uses it.
example1_en: An electrical fault left our kitchen in darkness.
example1_zh: 一处电路故障让我们的厨房一片漆黑。
example2_en: Regular inspections of electrical equipment can reduce fire risks in crowded residential buildings and workplaces.
example2_zh: 定期检查电气设备可以降低人口密集的住宅楼和工作场所的火灾风险。
collocations: electrical equipment｜电气设备 ; electrical engineering｜电气工程 ; electrical fault｜电路故障 ; electrical wiring｜电气线路
tip_zh: electrical常指电气领域；electric常指电驱动的。

meanings_zh: n. 解释；说明 | n. 原因；解释理由
definition_en: information that makes something easier to understand | a reason given for why something happened
example1_en: Her simple explanation helped me understand the new game.
example1_zh: 她简单的讲解让我明白了这个新游戏。
example2_en: One possible explanation for declining car ownership is the growing availability of reliable public transport.
example2_zh: 汽车拥有率下降的一个可能原因，是可靠的公共交通越来越普及。
collocations: clear explanation｜清楚的解释 ; give an explanation｜作出解释 ; explanation for｜对……的原因解释 ; explanation of｜对……的说明
tip_zh: explanation of多说明内容，for多解释原因。

meanings_zh: phr. 提前；预先
definition_en: Before a planned event or a particular time.
example1_en: We booked our train tickets two weeks in advance.
example1_zh: 我们提前两周订好了火车票。
example2_en: Publishing consultation dates well in advance allows more residents to participate in local planning decisions.
example2_zh: 早早公布咨询会日期，可以让更多居民参与地方规划决策。
collocations: book in advance｜提前预订 ; pay in advance｜预先付款 ; well in advance｜早早地
tip_zh: in advance可独立用；接事件用in advance of。

meanings_zh: adj. 每月的；每月一次的 | adv. 每月；每月一次 | n. 月刊
definition_en: Happening, produced, or paid once every month. | Once every month. | A magazine published once every month.
example1_en: My monthly bus pass fits neatly inside my wallet.
example1_zh: 我的公交月票正好能放进钱包里。
example2_en: Monthly payments can make essential services more affordable, but households should monitor their total spending carefully.
example2_zh: 按月付款可以减轻基本服务的支付压力，但家庭仍应仔细监控总支出。
collocations: monthly payments｜每月付款 ; monthly income｜月收入 ; monthly subscription｜按月订阅 ; meet monthly｜每月见面
tip_zh: monthly既可作形容词，也可作副词。

meanings_zh: adj. 失望的；沮丧的
definition_en: Unhappy because something was not as good as you hoped.
example1_en: I was disappointed when rain cancelled our beach picnic.
example1_zh: 下雨导致我们的海滩野餐取消，我很失望。
example2_en: Graduates may feel disappointed if their first jobs offer few opportunities to apply the skills they have learned.
example2_zh: 如果第一份工作很少提供运用所学技能的机会，毕业生可能会感到失望。
collocations: disappointed with｜对……失望 ; deeply disappointed｜深感失望 ; disappointed to hear｜听到……感到失望
tip_zh: disappointed形容人的感受；disappointing形容令人失望的事物。

meanings_zh: n. 头盔；安全帽
definition_en: A strong protective covering worn on the head
example1_en: Fasten your helmet before you get on the bicycle.
example1_zh: 骑上自行车前，先扣好头盔。
example2_en: Wearing a helmet can reduce the risk of serious head injuries among cyclists involved in accidents.
example2_zh: 骑车时佩戴头盔，可以降低事故中头部严重受伤的风险。
collocations: wear a helmet｜戴头盔 ; cycle helmet｜自行车头盔 ; safety helmet｜安全帽
tip_zh: 可数名词：戴头盔用wear a helmet。

meanings_zh: n. 海龟；龟（美）
definition_en: A reptile with a protective shell, often living in water.
example1_en: We watched a turtle swimming slowly over the reef.
example1_zh: 我们看着一只海龟在珊瑚礁上方缓缓游动。
example2_en: Reducing plastic pollution in coastal waters is essential for protecting turtle populations and other marine wildlife.
example2_zh: 减少沿海水域的塑料污染，对保护海龟种群及其他海洋野生动物至关重要。
collocations: sea turtle｜海龟 ; freshwater turtle｜淡水龟 ; turtle shell｜龟壳
tip_zh: 英式turtle多指海龟；陆龟通常叫tortoise。

meanings_zh: prep. 在……更远处；在另一边 | prep. 超出；超过 | adv. 在更远处
definition_en: on the farther side of something | outside a particular limit, range, or ability | at or towards a place farther away
example1_en: A narrow path leads to the beach beyond the dunes.
example1_zh: 一条狭窄的小路通向沙丘另一边的海滩。
example2_en: The benefits of university education extend beyond employment prospects to include personal growth and greater social awareness.
example2_zh: 大学教育的益处不仅限于就业前景，还包括个人成长和更强的社会意识。
