example2_zh: 随着更多服务转移到线上，各机构必须加强数据安全，以保护个人信息。
collocations: security measures｜安全措施 ; data security｜数据安全 ; job security｜工作保障 ; security guard｜保安
tip_zh: security侧重防范威胁；safety更广指免受危险。

meanings_zh: n. 文化；习俗 | n. 文化艺术活动 | n. 培养物
definition_en: the shared beliefs, customs and ways of life of a group | activities involving art, music, literature and other creative work | cells or microorganisms grown under controlled conditions
example1_en: Sharing traditional meals helps children learn about their culture.
example1_zh: 分享传统餐食有助于孩子了解自己的文化。
example2_en: Preserving local culture can strengthen community identity while allowing residents to benefit from international exchange.
example2_zh: 保护本土文化可以增强社区认同，同时让居民受益于国际交流。
collocations: local culture｜本土文化 ; cultural exchange｜文化交流 ; popular culture｜流行文化 ; bacterial culture｜细菌培养物
tip_zh: 泛指文化通常不可数；不同文化可用cultures。

meanings_zh: n. 个性；性格 | n. 个人魅力 | n. 名人
definition_en: the qualities that shape how someone thinks, feels, and behaves | lively or appealing qualities that make someone interesting | a well-known person, especially in entertainment or broadcasting
example1_en: Her cheerful personality makes everyone feel welcome at dinner.
example1_zh: 她开朗的性格让每位来吃饭的人都感到受欢迎。
example2_en: Schools should recognise that differences in personality can influence how students participate in group activities.
example2_zh: 学校应认识到，性格差异会影响学生参与集体活动的方式。
collocations: outgoing personality｜外向的性格 ; personality traits｜性格特征 ; strong personality｜鲜明的个性 ; television personality｜电视名人
tip_zh: 指性格时可数；have personality指有个人魅力。

meanings_zh: v. 击败；战胜 | n. 失败；失利 | v. 挫败；使落空
definition_en: to win against someone in a competition or conflict | an occasion when someone loses a competition or conflict | to prevent a plan or aim from succeeding
example1_en: Our team defeated the champions in a thrilling final.
example1_zh: 我们队在一场激动人心的决赛中击败了冠军队。
example2_en: Although electoral defeat can damage a political party, it may also encourage necessary changes in leadership and policy.
example2_zh: 尽管选举失利会对政党造成打击，但也可能促使其对领导层和政策作出必要调整。
collocations: defeat an opponent｜击败对手 ; suffer a defeat｜遭遇失败 ; admit defeat｜承认失败 ; defeat the purpose｜使目的落空
tip_zh: defeat后接对手；win后接比赛、奖项等。

meanings_zh: n. 射击；射门；投篮 | n. 照片；镜头 | n. 尝试
definition_en: an act of firing a weapon or sending a ball | a photograph or a continuous piece of filmed action | an attempt to achieve or do something
example1_en: Her final shot sent the ball into the net.
example1_zh: 她最后一脚射门把球踢进了球网。
example2_en: A carefully chosen shot can communicate the effects of environmental damage more powerfully than statistics.
example2_zh: 一张精心挑选的照片，比统计数据更能有力地传达环境破坏的影响。
collocations: take a shot｜射门；拍照 ; a close-up shot｜特写镜头 ; give it a shot｜试一试 ; a shot at success｜成功的机会
tip_zh: give it a shot表示试一试；shot也是shoot的过去式。

meanings_zh: adj. 职位较低的；初级的 | adj. 青少年的；年少的 | n. 低年级学生；较年幼者
definition_en: Having a lower rank or less experience in an organisation | Intended for younger people or involving them | A younger person, or a student below the final year
example1_en: Our junior chef prepares vegetables before the restaurant opens.
example1_zh: 我们餐厅的初级厨师在开门营业前准备蔬菜。
example2_en: Companies should provide junior employees with structured training and regular opportunities to learn from experienced colleagues.
example2_zh: 公司应为初级员工提供系统培训，并定期安排他们向经验丰富的同事学习。
collocations: junior staff｜初级员工 ; junior position｜初级职位 ; junior championship｜青少年锦标赛
tip_zh: 职位或年龄比较用junior to，不用junior than。

meanings_zh: adj. 全球的；世界性的 | adj. 整体的；全面的
definition_en: Involving or affecting the whole world. | Considering all parts of something rather than individual details.
example1_en: Our teacher showed us a map of global temperatures.
example1_zh: 老师给我们看了一张全球气温分布图。
example2_en: Global cooperation is essential for tackling climate change because environmental damage rarely respects national borders.
example2_zh: 全球合作对于应对气候变化至关重要，因为环境破坏很少受国界限制。
collocations: global warming｜全球变暖 ; global economy｜全球经济 ; global cooperation｜全球合作 ; global perspective｜全球视角
tip_zh: global强调全球范围；international强调国家之间。

meanings_zh: n. 抱怨；投诉 | n. 疾病；不适
definition_en: a statement that something is wrong or unsatisfactory | an illness or physical problem
example1_en: She made a complaint about the cold soup.
example1_zh: 她投诉汤是凉的。
example2_en: Local authorities should investigate residents' complaints about noise before approving new entertainment venues in residential areas.
example2_zh: 地方政府在批准住宅区内的新娱乐场所前，应调查居民关于噪声的投诉。
collocations: make a complaint｜提出投诉 ; a formal complaint｜正式投诉 ; handle complaints｜处理投诉 ; a common complaint｜常见病症；常见抱怨
tip_zh: complaint是名词，complain是动词；投诉某事用about。

meanings_zh: adj. 不断增加的；日益增长的
definition_en: becoming greater in amount, size, number, or degree
example1_en: The increasing noise outside made it hard to sleep.
example1_zh: 外面越来越大的噪声让人难以入睡。
example2_en: Increasing demand for clean energy is encouraging governments to invest more heavily in renewable technologies and infrastructure.
example2_zh: 对清洁能源日益增长的需求正促使各国政府加大对可再生能源技术和基础设施的投资。
collocations: increasing demand｜日益增长的需求 ; increasing pressure｜越来越大的压力 ; an increasing number of｜越来越多的 ; increasing concern｜日益加深的担忧
tip_zh: increasing修饰名词；increasingly修饰形容词等。

meanings_zh: v. 挖；掘 | v. 探究；深入搜寻 | n. 考古发掘
definition_en: Move earth to make a hole or uncover something | Search carefully for hidden information | An organized activity to uncover ancient objects in the ground
example1_en: We dug a deep hole for the young apple tree.
example1_zh: 我们为这棵苹果树苗挖了一个深坑。
example2_en: Researchers dig into historical records to understand how earlier societies responded to periods of rapid environmental change.
example2_zh: 研究人员深入查阅历史记录，以了解过去的社会如何应对环境迅速变化的时期。
collocations: dig a hole｜挖坑 ; dig up｜挖出 ; dig into｜深入探究 ; an archaeological dig｜考古发掘
tip_zh: 过去式、过去分词均为dug；dig into可指深入调查。

meanings_zh: n. 生产；制造 | n. 制作；演出作品
definition_en: the process of making or growing things for use | the making of a film or play, or the resulting work
example1_en: The factory has increased production to meet summer demand.
example1_zh: 工厂已增加产量，以满足夏季需求。
example2_en: Cleaner energy production can reduce air pollution while supporting the development of a modern economy.
example2_zh: 更清洁的能源生产可以减少空气污染，同时支持现代经济的发展。
collocations: mass production｜大规模生产 ; food production｜食品生产 ; production costs｜生产成本 ; film production｜电影制作
tip_zh: production通常不可数；指一部演出作品时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 位置；姿势 | n. 职位；地位；立场 | v. 放置；安置
definition_en: where something is or how a body is arranged | a job, social rank, or opinion on an issue | to put someone or something in a particular place
example1_en: Can you move the lamp to a better position?
example1_zh: 你能把灯挪到一个更合适的位置吗？
example2_en: The report explains the government's position on providing affordable housing for young families.
example2_zh: 这份报告阐明了政府在为年轻家庭提供可负担住房方面的立场。
collocations: sitting position｜坐姿 ; apply for a position｜申请职位 ; take a position on｜对……表明立场 ; position carefully｜小心放置
tip_zh: 表示立场常用position on；表示职位为可数名词。

meanings_zh: n. 自助餐厅；食堂
definition_en: A restaurant where customers collect food and carry it to tables.
example1_en: We carried our lunch trays to the cafeteria window.
example1_zh: 我们端着午餐托盘走到食堂窗边。
example2_en: School cafeterias can promote healthier eating habits by offering affordable meals with fresh vegetables and fruit.
example2_zh: 学校食堂可以提供价格实惠、含新鲜蔬菜水果的餐食，促进更健康的饮食习惯。
collocations: a school cafeteria｜学校食堂 ; a hospital cafeteria｜医院食堂 ; a cafeteria tray｜食堂托盘
tip_zh: 强调自行取餐，不一定是不限量的自助餐。

meanings_zh: n. 蘑菇 | v. 迅速增长；迅速涌现
definition_en: A fungus often shaped like an umbrella; some are edible. | Grow or increase very quickly.
example1_en: I added sliced mushrooms to the soup for lunch.
example1_zh: 我在午餐的汤里加了切片蘑菇。
example2_en: Online learning platforms have mushroomed as demand for flexible and affordable education has increased worldwide.
example2_zh: 随着全球对灵活且价格可负担的教育需求上升，在线学习平台迅速涌现。
collocations: mushroom soup｜蘑菇汤 ; wild mushrooms｜野生蘑菇 ; mushroom into a large business｜迅速发展成大企业
tip_zh: 作动词表示迅速增长，不接直接宾语。

meanings_zh: n. 模式；规律 | n. 图案；花纹
definition_en: A regular or repeated way something happens or is done. | An arrangement of shapes, lines, or colours forming a design.
example1_en: My cat follows the same sleeping pattern every day.
example1_zh: 我的猫每天都遵循相同的睡眠规律。
example2_en: Researchers analyse patterns of energy consumption to identify opportunities for reducing waste in households.
example2_zh: 研究人员分析能源消耗模式，以寻找减少家庭能源浪费的机会。
collocations: a pattern of behaviour｜行为模式 ; sleep patterns｜睡眠规律 ; a floral pattern｜花卉图案 ; follow a pattern｜遵循某种模式
tip_zh: 表示规律常用a pattern of＋名词。

meanings_zh: n. 仆人；佣人
definition_en: Someone employed to do household work in another person's home
example1_en: The servant carried fresh towels into the guest bedroom.
example1_zh: 佣人把干净毛巾拿进了客房。
example2_en: In wealthy households of the past, servants often worked long hours with little legal protection.
example2_zh: 过去，富裕家庭的佣人往往长时间工作，却很少受到法律保护。
collocations: domestic servant｜家佣 ; civil servant｜公务员 ; public servant｜公职人员
tip_zh: 公务员用civil servant，不能只说servant。

meanings_zh: n. 液体 | adj. 液态的 | adj. 易变现的；流动的
definition_en: A substance that flows and takes the shape of its container. | In a form that flows freely rather than remaining solid. | Available as cash or easily converted into cash.
example1_en: She poured the warm liquid carefully into a glass.
example1_zh: 她小心地把温热的液体倒进玻璃杯。
example2_en: Scientists analyse liquid samples from rivers to identify pollutants and assess potential risks to public health.
example2_zh: 科学家分析河流中的液体样本，以识别污染物并评估其对公众健康的潜在风险。
collocations: clear liquid｜透明液体 ; liquid water｜液态水 ; liquid soap｜洗手液 ; liquid assets｜流动资产
tip_zh: liquid作名词指液体；liquid assets指现金或易变现资产。

meanings_zh: n. 曲调；旋律 | v. 为乐器调音 | v. 调节；调谐
definition_en: a series of musical notes forming a recognizable pattern | to adjust an instrument so it produces the correct notes | to adjust a device to work or receive signals correctly
example1_en: My brother whistled a cheerful tune while washing dishes.
example1_zh: 哥哥洗碗时，用口哨吹着一段欢快的曲调。
example2_en: A memorable tune can help young learners retain new vocabulary and develop greater confidence in speaking.
example2_zh: 容易记住的曲调可以帮助低龄学习者记忆新词汇，并增强口语表达的信心。
collocations: catchy tune｜朗朗上口的曲调 ; in tune｜音调准确 ; out of tune｜走调 ; tune a piano｜给钢琴调音
tip_zh: in tune指音调准确；out of tune指走调。

meanings_zh: n. 肉贩；肉类分割工 | v. 屠宰；分割肉类 | v. 把……弄糟
definition_en: someone who prepares and sells meat | to kill animals for meat or cut up their meat | to do something very badly, spoiling the result
example1_en: The butcher wrapped our chicken and suggested a simple recipe.
example1_zh: 肉贩把我们的鸡肉包好，还推荐了一个简单的做法。
example2_en: A local butcher can help customers reduce food waste by recommending suitable cuts and portion sizes.
example2_zh: 当地肉贩可以推荐合适的肉块和分量，帮助顾客减少食物浪费。
collocations: local butcher｜当地肉贩 ; butcher's shop｜肉店 ; butcher a song｜把一首歌唱砸
tip_zh: 肉店常说the butcher's；动词也可指把表演等搞砸。

meanings_zh: n. 种子 | v. 播种
definition_en: A small part of a plant that can grow into another. | Put seeds into soil so that plants will grow.
example1_en: She planted each seed in a small clay pot.
example1_zh: 她把每一粒种子种进一个小陶盆里。
example2_en: Protecting seed diversity helps farmers adapt to changing climates and reduces the risk of widespread crop failure.
example2_zh: 保护种子多样性有助于农民适应气候变化，并降低大范围作物歉收的风险。
collocations: sow seeds｜播种 ; plant a seed｜种下一粒种子 ; sunflower seeds｜葵花籽 ; seed bank｜种子库
tip_zh: sow seeds指播种；seedling指已经发芽的幼苗。

meanings_zh: n. 周年纪念日
definition_en: A date marking another year since an important event.
example1_en: We cooked a special meal for our wedding anniversary.
example1_zh: 我们为结婚纪念日做了一顿特别的饭菜。
example2_en: The museum celebrated its anniversary by offering free admission to encourage more residents to explore local history.
example2_zh: 博物馆在周年纪念日提供免费入场，鼓励更多居民了解当地历史。
collocations: wedding anniversary｜结婚纪念日 ; celebrate an anniversary｜庆祝周年纪念日 ; mark an anniversary｜纪念周年
tip_zh: 指重要事件每年对应的纪念日，不只用于婚礼。

meanings_zh: adj. 向后的；倒退的 | adv. 向后；倒着 | adj. 发展落后的
definition_en: Directed towards the back or away from progress. | Towards the back or in the reverse direction. | Less developed or advanced than expected.
example1_en: He took a backward step to avoid the puddle.
example1_zh: 他向后退了一步，以避开水坑。
example2_en: Reducing investment in public transport would be a backward step for cities seeking to cut emissions.
example2_zh: 对于力求减排的城市而言，减少公共交通投资将是一种倒退。
collocations: a backward step｜倒退的一步 ; a backward glance｜回头一瞥 ; move backward｜向后移动
tip_zh: 英式副词常用 backwards；用来形容人落后可能冒犯。

meanings_zh: n. 典礼；仪式 | n. 礼节；客套
definition_en: A formal event marking an important occasion. | Formal behaviour required by tradition or social rules.
example1_en: We attended a small wedding ceremony by the lake.
example1_zh: 我们参加了湖边一场小型婚礼。
example2_en: A graduation ceremony allows students and families to celebrate educational achievements together as a community.
example2_zh: 毕业典礼让学生和家人齐聚一堂，共同庆祝学业成就。
collocations: opening ceremony｜开幕式 ; graduation ceremony｜毕业典礼 ; without ceremony｜不拘礼节地
tip_zh: 指具体典礼时可数；without ceremony意为不拘礼节。

meanings_zh: n. 呼吸
definition_en: the process of taking air into and out of the lungs
example1_en: After the steep climb, my breathing slowly returned to normal.
example1_zh: 爬完陡坡后，我的呼吸慢慢恢复了正常。
example2_en: Regular breathing exercises may help students manage stress and improve their concentration during demanding periods of study.
example2_zh: 定期进行呼吸练习可能有助于学生缓解压力，并在学习紧张时期提高专注力。
collocations: deep breathing｜深呼吸 ; breathing exercises｜呼吸练习 ; breathing difficulties｜呼吸困难 ; heavy breathing｜粗重的呼吸
tip_zh: breathing可作名词，也是breathe的现在分词。

meanings_zh: n. 名人；明星 | n. 名望；名气
definition_en: A person who is widely known by the public. | The state of being famous.
example1_en: A celebrity stopped outside the theatre to greet fans.
example1_zh: 一位明星在剧院外停下脚步，与粉丝打招呼。
example2_en: Celebrity endorsements can influence young consumers, so advertisements should clearly distinguish personal opinions from paid promotion.
example2_zh: 名人代言可能影响年轻消费者，因此广告应明确区分个人观点与付费推广。
collocations: celebrity endorsement｜名人代言 ; celebrity culture｜名人文化 ; achieve celebrity｜成名
tip_zh: 指名人时可数；指名气时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 相关的；有联系的 | adj. 有亲属关系的
definition_en: connected with something in some way | belonging to the same family
example1_en: These two problems are related to the same broken pipe.
example1_zh: 这两个问题都与同一根破裂的管道有关。
example2_en: Many health problems are closely related to poor housing conditions and limited access to nutritious food.
example2_zh: 许多健康问题与恶劣的住房条件及难以获取营养食物密切相关。
collocations: related to｜与……有关 ; closely related｜密切相关的 ; related issues｜相关问题 ; related by marriage｜有姻亲关系的
tip_zh: 常用be related to；to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 无用的；无效的
definition_en: Not useful or unable to achieve the intended result
example1_en: This broken umbrella is useless in heavy rain.
example1_zh: 这把坏伞在大雨中根本不管用。
example2_en: Collecting environmental data is useless unless governments use the findings to guide effective policies.
example2_zh: 收集环境数据毫无用处，除非政府利用研究结果来指导制定有效政策。
collocations: completely useless｜完全无用的 ; useless at｜不擅长 ; render something useless｜使某物失去作用
tip_zh: useless at后接名词或动名词，表示不擅长。

meanings_zh: n. 狂欢节；嘉年华 | n. 游乐会
definition_en: A public celebration with music, costumes, and street entertainment. | An outdoor event with rides, games, and entertainment.
example1_en: We wore colourful masks and danced at the carnival.
example1_zh: 我们戴着彩色面具，在嘉年华上跳舞。
example2_en: An annual carnival can strengthen community ties while attracting visitors who support local shops and restaurants.
example2_zh: 一年一度的嘉年华可以加强社区联系，同时吸引游客光顾当地商店和餐馆。
collocations: a carnival parade｜嘉年华游行 ; a carnival atmosphere｜狂欢气氛 ; an annual carnival｜年度嘉年华
tip_zh: 美式英语中也可指有游戏和游乐设施的游乐会。

meanings_zh: adj. 平均的；普通的 | n. 平均数；平均水平 | v. 平均为
definition_en: Representing a calculated middle value, or typical rather than exceptional. | A value calculated by dividing a total by the item count. | Have a particular amount as the usual or calculated middle value.
example1_en: The average price of these jackets is quite reasonable.
example1_zh: 这些夹克的平均价格相当合理。
example2_en: Average household spending on energy may fall as better insulation reduces the need for heating.
example2_zh: 随着更好的隔热措施减少供暖需求，家庭能源支出的平均水平可能下降。
collocations: on average｜平均而言 ; above average｜高于平均水平 ; average income｜平均收入 ; average temperature｜平均气温
tip_zh: on average表示“平均而言”，不用in average。

meanings_zh: adj. 上下颠倒的；倒置的
definition_en: Positioned with the usual top at the bottom
example1_en: An upside-down bowl covered the last slice of cake.
example1_zh: 一个倒扣的碗盖住了最后一块蛋糕。
example2_en: In a classroom experiment, students used an upside-down glass of water to explore the effects of air pressure.
example2_zh: 在一次课堂实验中，学生用一杯倒置的水来探究气压的作用。
collocations: an upside-down image｜上下颠倒的图像 ; an upside-down bowl｜倒扣的碗 ; turn something upside down｜把某物倒置
tip_zh: 名词前常加连字符；表语或副词通常写upside down。

meanings_zh: n. 图书馆员
definition_en: A person who manages library resources and helps library users.
example1_en: The librarian helped me find a book about birds.
example1_zh: 图书馆员帮我找到了一本关于鸟类的书。
example2_en: School librarians support independent learning by teaching students how to locate reliable sources and evaluate information.
example2_zh: 学校图书馆员通过教授学生如何寻找可靠来源并评估信息，来支持自主学习。
collocations: school librarian｜学校图书馆员 ; chief librarian｜图书馆馆长 ; ask a librarian｜咨询图书馆员
tip_zh: library指图书馆；librarian指在那里工作的馆员。

meanings_zh: n. 汽油
definition_en: A liquid fuel used in cars and other engines.
example1_en: We stopped to buy gasoline before crossing the desert.
example1_zh: 穿越沙漠之前，我们停车加了汽油。
example2_en: Higher gasoline prices may encourage commuters to share cars or switch to public transport.
example2_zh: 汽油价格上涨可能促使通勤者拼车或改乘公共交通。
collocations: gasoline prices｜汽油价格 ; gasoline engine｜汽油发动机 ; unleaded gasoline｜无铅汽油
tip_zh: 美式英语用gasoline，口语常说gas；英式通常用petrol。

meanings_zh: n. 动物；生物 | n. 虚构生物；怪物
definition_en: a living being, especially an animal | an imaginary being with unusual physical features
example1_en: A tiny creature crawled out from under the leaf.
example1_zh: 一只小生物从叶子底下爬了出来。
example2_en: Even the smallest marine creature can play an important role in maintaining a healthy ocean ecosystem.
example2_zh: 即使是最小的海洋生物，也能在维持健康的海洋生态系统方面发挥重要作用。
collocations: a sea creature｜海洋生物 ; a living creature｜活的生物 ; a mythical creature｜神话生物
tip_zh: creature常指动物，也可指想象中的生物。

meanings_zh: v. 删除
definition_en: To remove written material or stored information.
example1_en: Please delete those blurry photos from my phone.
example1_zh: 请把我手机里那些模糊的照片删掉。
example2_en: Online services should allow users to delete their personal data when they no longer need an account.
example2_zh: 当用户不再需要账户时，网络服务应允许他们删除个人数据。
collocations: delete a file｜删除文件 ; delete an account｜删除账户 ; permanently delete｜永久删除
tip_zh: 常用delete something from...表示从某处删除。

meanings_zh: adj. 起始的；最初的 | n. 开始；启动
definition_en: Relating to the point where something begins | The act of beginning something or making it operate
example1_en: We gathered at the starting point before sunrise.
example1_zh: 日出前，我们在起点集合。
example2_en: A fair starting salary can help employers attract talented graduates and improve long-term staff retention.
example2_zh: 公平的起薪可以帮助雇主吸引优秀毕业生，并提高员工的长期留任率。
collocations: a starting point｜起点 ; a starting salary｜起薪 ; the starting line｜起跑线 ; a starting position｜起始位置
tip_zh: 常见于starting point；也可作start的分词。

meanings_zh: prep. 除……之外还 | adv. 而且；再说
definition_en: In addition to someone or something. | Used to add another fact or supporting reason.
example1_en: Besides apples, we need some bread and fresh milk.
example1_zh: 除了苹果，我们还需要一些面包和鲜奶。
example2_en: Besides reducing air pollution, investment in public transport can make cities more accessible to older residents.
example2_zh: 投资公共交通除了能减少空气污染，还能让老年居民在城市中出行更方便。
collocations: besides that｜除此之外 ; besides being｜除了是……之外 ; besides the fact that｜除了……这一事实之外
tip_zh: besides表示额外包括；beside表示在旁边。

meanings_zh: n. 发明物 | n. 发明；创造 | n. 虚构的事；编造
definition_en: something new that someone has designed or created | the act of creating something that did not exist before | a story or explanation created rather than based on facts
example1_en: Her latest invention waters the plants while she is away.
example1_zh: 她最新的发明能在她外出时给植物浇水。
example2_en: The invention of affordable water filters has improved public health in communities with limited access to clean water.
example2_zh: 价格低廉的滤水器的发明改善了难以获得清洁用水的社区的公共卫生状况。
collocations: a useful invention｜实用的发明 ; the invention of｜……的发明 ; a recent invention｜近期的发明
tip_zh: invention创造原本没有的东西；discovery发现已有事物。

meanings_zh: v. 分开；劈开；分担 | n. 裂缝；分裂；分歧
definition_en: To divide something into parts, or separate into groups | A crack, division, or serious disagreement
example1_en: We split the cake and shared it with our neighbours.
example1_zh: 我们把蛋糕切开，分给了邻居。
example2_en: Schools sometimes split large classes into smaller groups to provide more individual attention and support.
example2_zh: 学校有时会把大班分成小组，以提供更多个别关注和支持。
collocations: split into groups｜分成小组 ; split the cost｜分摊费用 ; split in two｜分成两半 ; a deep split｜严重分歧
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为split；现在分词为splitting。

meanings_zh: n. 金字塔；棱锥体 | n. 金字塔式体系
definition_en: a structure with triangular sides meeting at a point | a system with fewer members at each successively higher level
example1_en: We built a small pyramid out of wooden blocks.
example1_zh: 我们用木块搭了一座小金字塔。
example2_en: The management pyramid in many organisations places a small group of executives above numerous employees.
example2_zh: 许多机构的金字塔式管理结构将少数高管置于众多员工之上。
collocations: ancient pyramid｜古代金字塔 ; square-based pyramid｜四棱锥 ; management pyramid｜管理金字塔
tip_zh: 既指古代金字塔，也指几何中的棱锥体。

meanings_zh: n. 惊险小说；惊悚片
definition_en: An exciting story or film involving danger, suspense, or crime.
example1_en: We watched a thriller and kept guessing the ending.
example1_zh: 我们看了一部惊悚片，一直在猜结局。
example2_en: A well-made thriller can encourage audiences to consider ethical questions while maintaining a strong sense of suspense.
example2_zh: 制作精良的惊悚片能在保持强烈悬念的同时，引导观众思考伦理问题。
collocations: a crime thriller｜犯罪惊悚作品 ; a psychological thriller｜心理惊悚作品 ; a political thriller｜政治惊悚作品
tip_zh: thriller重悬念与紧张感，不等于恐怖片。

meanings_zh: adj. 超重的
definition_en: heavier than is considered healthy, suitable, or officially allowed
example1_en: My suitcase was overweight, so I removed some books.
example1_zh: 我的行李箱超重了，所以我拿出了一些书。
example2_en: People who are overweight may benefit from accessible exercise facilities and practical advice on balanced diets.
example2_zh: 体重超标的人可能受益于便利的健身设施和有关均衡饮食的实用建议。
collocations: be slightly overweight｜略微超重 ; overweight luggage｜超重行李 ; become overweight｜变得超重
tip_zh: 常作形容词；obese指肥胖，程度更重。

meanings_zh: n. 奢华；奢侈的享受 | n. 奢侈品；非必需的享受 | adj. 奢华的；高档的
definition_en: Great comfort and pleasure involving expensive surroundings or possessions. | Something enjoyable or expensive that is not essential. | Providing exceptional comfort and quality, usually at a high price.
example1_en: The hotel offered a taste of luxury for one night.
example1_zh: 这家酒店让我们体验了一晚奢华享受。
example2_en: As household incomes rise, goods once considered a luxury often become part of everyday life.
example2_zh: 随着家庭收入增加，曾被视为奢侈品的商品往往成为日常生活的一部分。
collocations: live in luxury｜过奢华生活 ; luxury goods｜奢侈品 ; luxury hotel｜豪华酒店 ; afford the luxury of｜有条件享受……
tip_zh: 指奢华状态时不可数；指一项享受时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 稻草；麦秆 | n. 吸管
definition_en: Dried cereal stems used for animal bedding and other purposes. | A narrow tube used for drinking liquids.
example1_en: The farmer spread fresh straw across the barn floor.
example1_zh: 农民在谷仓地上铺了一层新鲜的麦秆。
example2_en: Replacing plastic straws with reusable alternatives can reduce waste, although wider changes in consumption remain necessary.
example2_zh: 用可重复使用的替代品取代塑料吸管能减少废物，但仍需更广泛地改变消费方式。
collocations: a bale of straw｜一捆稻草 ; a straw hat｜一顶草帽 ; a drinking straw｜一根饮用吸管 ; the last straw｜令人忍无可忍的最后一击
tip_zh: 作稻草时不可数，作吸管时可数；hay指干草饲料。

meanings_zh: adj. 不能的；无法的
definition_en: Not having the ability or opportunity to do something.
example1_en: I was unable to open the tightly sealed jar.
example1_zh: 我打不开那个封得很紧的罐子。
example2_en: Without affordable internet access, many students are unable to participate fully in online learning programmes.
example2_zh: 如果没有负担得起的网络服务，许多学生就无法充分参与在线学习课程。
collocations: be unable to attend｜无法出席 ; be unable to afford｜负担不起 ; be unable to cope｜无法应付
tip_zh: 用 be unable to do，不用 unable doing。

meanings_zh: n. 祝贺；贺词
definition_en: An expression of pleasure at someone's success or good fortune.
example1_en: We sent our congratulations when she passed her driving test.
example1_zh: 她通过驾驶考试后，我们向她表示祝贺。
example2_en: Offering congratulations to students who achieve personal goals can strengthen their confidence and encourage further learning.
example2_zh: 向实现个人目标的学生表示祝贺，可以增强他们的信心，并鼓励他们继续学习。
collocations: congratulations on｜为……表示祝贺 ; a letter of congratulation｜贺信 ; warm congratulations｜热烈祝贺
tip_zh: 祝贺通常用复数congratulations，后接on加成就。

meanings_zh: n. 十年；十年期
definition_en: a period of ten years
example1_en: They have lived on this street for a decade.
example1_zh: 他们在这条街上已经住了十年。
example2_en: Over the past decade, digital technology has significantly changed how people access education and healthcare.
example2_zh: 过去十年间，数字技术显著改变了人们获取教育和医疗服务的方式。
collocations: over the past decade｜在过去十年间 ; for decades｜数十年来 ; the next decade｜未来十年
tip_zh: a decade是十年；decades常泛指数十年。

meanings_zh: n. 剃须刀；剃刀
definition_en: A tool with a sharp blade used to shave hair.
example1_en: He rinsed his razor and put it beside the sink.
example1_zh: 他冲洗了剃须刀，把它放在洗手池旁。
example2_en: Choosing a reusable razor can reduce the amount of plastic waste generated by daily grooming.
example2_zh: 选择可重复使用的剃须刀，可以减少日常个人护理产生的塑料垃圾。
collocations: electric razor｜电动剃须刀 ; disposable razor｜一次性剃须刀 ; razor blade｜剃须刀片
tip_zh: razor指剃须工具；普通切割用刀叫knife。

meanings_zh: v. 涉及；包含；需要 | v. 使参与
definition_en: to include something as a necessary part | to make someone take part in an activity
example1_en: My new job involves talking to customers all day.
example1_zh: 我的新工作需要整天与顾客交谈。
example2_en: Local authorities should involve residents in planning decisions to ensure that new developments meet community needs.
example2_zh: 地方政府应让居民参与规划决策，确保新的开发项目满足社区需求。
collocations: involve doing something｜需要做某事 ; involve someone in something｜让某人参与某事 ; be closely involved｜密切参与
tip_zh: 表示需要做某事，用involve doing，不用to do。

meanings_zh: n. 影响；影响力 | v. 影响
definition_en: the power to affect how someone thinks or behaves | to affect someone's decisions, behaviour, or development
example1_en: My older sister had a strong influence on me.
example1_zh: 姐姐对我有很大的影响。
example2_en: Advertising can influence children's food preferences, which makes responsible marketing particularly important for public health.
example2_zh: 广告会影响儿童的食物偏好，因此负责任的营销对公众健康尤为重要。
collocations: have an influence on｜对……有影响 ; a positive influence｜积极的影响 ; influence a decision｜影响决定
tip_zh: 名词后常接on；动词直接接宾语。

meanings_zh: n. 材料；原料；布料 | n. 资料；素材 | adj. 物质的；实质性的
definition_en: A substance used to make things, including cloth. | Information or ideas used for study or creative work. | Relating to physical possessions, or significant enough to matter.
example1_en: This bag is made from a strong waterproof material.
example1_zh: 这个包用结实的防水材料制成。
example2_en: Using recycled material in construction can reduce waste and lower demand for newly extracted natural resources.
example2_zh: 在建筑中使用再生材料可以减少废弃物，并降低对新开采自然资源的需求。
collocations: raw materials｜原材料 ; building materials｜建筑材料 ; reading material｜阅读资料 ; material possessions｜物质财富
tip_zh: 资料义通常不可数；多种材料可用materials。

meanings_zh: n. 装饰品 | n. 装饰；装潢 | n. 勋章；奖章
definition_en: An object added to make something look more attractive. | The process or style of making a place look attractive. | An official award worn to honour service or bravery.
example1_en: She hung a bright paper decoration above the kitchen table.
example1_zh: 她在厨房餐桌上方挂了一件鲜艳的纸制装饰品。
example2_en: The decoration of public libraries can create welcoming spaces that encourage residents to spend more time reading.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆的装潢可以营造温馨的空间，鼓励居民花更多时间阅读。
collocations: interior decoration｜室内装饰 ; party decorations｜派对装饰品 ; table decoration｜餐桌装饰品
tip_zh: 指装饰过程时不可数；指单件装饰品时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 拖挂式房车 | n. 结伴旅行的车队或驼队
definition_en: A wheeled home pulled by a car, especially for holidays | A group of people or vehicles travelling together, especially through deserts
example1_en: We parked our caravan beside a quiet lake.
example1_zh: 我们把拖挂式房车停在一个宁静的湖边。
example2_en: Caravan holidays can support rural tourism by bringing visitors to areas without large hotels.
example2_zh: 房车度假可以将游客带到没有大型酒店的地区，从而促进乡村旅游。
collocations: caravan park｜房车营地 ; tow a caravan｜牵引拖挂式房车 ; camel caravan｜骆驼商队
tip_zh: 英式英语指拖挂式房车；美式常用travel trailer。

meanings_zh: n. 管理；经营 | n. 管理层；管理人员
definition_en: The work of organising and controlling activities or resources. | The people responsible for running an organisation.
example1_en: Good time management leaves me free to relax.
example1_zh: 良好的时间管理让我有空放松。
example2_en: Effective waste management requires cooperation between local authorities, businesses, and residents to reduce pollution and conserve resources.
example2_zh: 有效的废物管理需要地方政府、企业和居民合作，以减少污染并节约资源。
collocations: time management｜时间管理 ; waste management｜废物管理 ; senior management｜高层管理人员 ; management skills｜管理技能
tip_zh: 指管理工作时不可数；the management可指管理层。

meanings_zh: adj. 紧的；紧身的 | adj. 紧张的；余地很小的 | adv. 紧紧地；牢牢地
definition_en: Fitting closely or held firmly, with little room to move. | Leaving very little extra time, money, or space. | Firmly and securely, without becoming loose.
example1_en: These shoes are too tight around my toes.
example1_zh: 这双鞋的鞋头太紧，挤着我的脚趾。
example2_en: Schools operating on tight budgets may struggle to provide students with modern equipment and adequate support.
example2_zh: 预算紧张的学校可能难以为学生提供现代化设备和充分的支持。
collocations: tight jeans｜紧身牛仔裤 ; a tight budget｜紧张的预算 ; a tight deadline｜很紧的截止期限 ; hold tight｜紧紧抓住
tip_zh: tight本身可作副词，如hold tight；tightly也表紧紧地。

meanings_zh: n. 水手；海员；帆船运动者
definition_en: Someone who works on ships or sails boats
example1_en: The sailor tied the boat securely to the dock.
example1_zh: 水手把船牢牢地系在码头上。
example2_en: Modern navigation technology helps sailors avoid dangerous waters, but practical experience remains essential for safety at sea.
example2_zh: 现代导航技术帮助海员避开危险水域，但实践经验对海上安全仍至关重要。
collocations: experienced sailor｜经验丰富的海员 ; professional sailor｜职业海员 ; a crew of sailors｜一组船员
tip_zh: 指在船上工作或驾驶帆船的人，不泛指乘客。

meanings_zh: adj. 穿着得体的；衣着考究的
definition_en: Wearing attractive, neat, and appropriate clothes.
example1_en: A well-dressed guest arrived in a neatly pressed suit.
example1_zh: 一位衣着考究的客人穿着熨烫平整的西装到来。
example2_en: Although well-dressed applicants may create positive first impressions, employers should prioritise relevant skills and professional experience.
example2_zh: 尽管衣着得体的求职者可能留下良好的第一印象，雇主仍应优先考虑相关技能和工作经验。
collocations: well-dressed guests｜衣着考究的宾客 ; a well-dressed applicant｜衣着得体的求职者
tip_zh: 强调穿着整洁得体，不一定指衣服昂贵或紧跟潮流。

meanings_zh: n. 成年人；大人 | adj. 成年的；成熟的
definition_en: An adult, especially when described by or to children. | Adult, or behaving in a sensible and responsible way.
example1_en: Ask a grown-up to help you slice the bread.
example1_zh: 请一位大人帮你切面包。
example2_en: Children often develop grown-up attitudes towards responsibility when they participate in age-appropriate household tasks.
example2_zh: 孩子参与适合其年龄的家务时，往往会形成对待责任的成熟态度。
collocations: ask a grown-up｜请教大人 ; grown-up children｜已成年的子女 ; a grown-up attitude｜成熟的态度
tip_zh: 名词多用于儿童语境；正式写作宜用adult。

meanings_zh: adj. 隐藏的；不易察觉的
definition_en: Kept out of sight or not easily noticed.
example1_en: We found a hidden cupboard behind the kitchen door.
example1_zh: 我们在厨房门后发现了一个隐蔽的橱柜。
example2_en: Consumers should consider the hidden costs of online purchases, including delivery fees and charges for returning items.
example2_zh: 消费者应考虑网购的隐性成本，包括运费和退货费用。
collocations: hidden costs｜隐性成本 ; hidden meaning｜隐藏的含义 ; hidden talent｜未显露的才能
tip_zh: 也是hide的过去分词；隐藏不等于肉眼不可见。

meanings_zh: n. 会员身份；成员资格 | n. 全体会员；会员人数
definition_en: the status of belonging to a club or organisation | all members of a group, or the total member count
example1_en: My gym membership includes free swimming lessons every weekend.
example1_zh: 我的健身房会员权益包括每个周末的免费游泳课。
example2_en: Affordable membership fees can encourage more residents to use local sports facilities and improve their health.
example2_zh: 价格合理的会员费可以鼓励更多居民使用当地体育设施，改善健康状况。
collocations: membership fee｜会员费 ; annual membership｜年度会员资格 ; renew your membership｜续办会员资格 ; union membership｜工会会员身份
tip_zh: 表示加入某组织的资格，常用membership of。

meanings_zh: v. 打开行李取出物品 | v. 剖析；详细解释
definition_en: take things out of a bag, box, or other container | examine an idea carefully to explain its different parts
example1_en: I unpacked my suitcase and hung up my shirts.
example1_zh: 我把衣物从行李箱里拿出来，挂好了衬衫。
example2_en: Teachers can help students unpack complex arguments by examining the evidence and assumptions behind each claim.
example2_zh: 教师可以通过审视每个论点背后的证据和假设，帮助学生剖析复杂的论证。
collocations: unpack a suitcase｜取出行李箱中的物品 ; unpack boxes｜打开箱子取出物品 ; unpack an argument｜剖析论证
tip_zh: 既可指取出行李，也可比喻拆解复杂观点。

meanings_zh: n. 工作室；录音室；演播室 | n. 电影制片公司 | n. 单间公寓
definition_en: A room where art, music, or broadcasts are produced | A company that makes films | A flat combining living and sleeping space in one room
example1_en: The artist invited us into her bright upstairs studio.
example1_zh: 那位艺术家邀请我们参观她楼上明亮的工作室。
example2_en: Public funding for affordable studio spaces can help emerging artists contribute to a city's cultural life.
example2_zh: 为价格可负担的工作室提供公共资金，能帮助新兴艺术家丰富城市文化生活。
collocations: recording studio｜录音室 ; art studio｜艺术工作室 ; film studio｜电影制片公司 ; studio flat｜单间公寓
tip_zh: 英式studio flat、美式studio apartment均指单间公寓。

meanings_zh: v. 使害怕；吓唬
definition_en: To make someone feel afraid.
example1_en: Sudden loud noises can frighten our new puppy.
example1_zh: 突然的巨响会吓到我们新养的小狗。
example2_en: Alarming news reports may frighten children, so adults should explain difficult events in an appropriate way.
example2_zh: 令人不安的新闻报道可能吓到儿童，因此成人应以恰当的方式解释复杂事件。
collocations: frighten someone away｜把某人吓跑 ; frighten someone into doing｜吓得某人去做 ; frighten someone to death｜把某人吓坏
tip_zh: frightened指感到害怕的；frightening指令人害怕的。

meanings_zh: n. 摄影；摄影术
definition_en: The activity or skill of taking photographs.
example1_en: My sister enjoys photography and carries her camera everywhere.
example1_zh: 我姐姐喜欢摄影，走到哪儿都带着相机。
example2_en: Digital photography allows researchers to document environmental changes and share visual evidence with a wider audience.
example2_zh: 数码摄影让研究人员能够记录环境变化，并向更广泛的受众分享影像证据。
collocations: digital photography｜数码摄影 ; wildlife photography｜野生动物摄影 ; portrait photography｜人像摄影 ; take up photography｜开始学习摄影
tip_zh: photography不可数；一张照片用a photograph。

meanings_zh: n. 脚后跟 | n. 鞋跟
definition_en: The rounded back part of the foot below the ankle. | The raised part beneath the back of a shoe.
example1_en: These new shoes rub against my left heel.
example1_zh: 这双新鞋磨我的左脚后跟。
example2_en: Shoes that support the heel properly may improve comfort for people who spend long hours standing.
example2_zh: 能适当支撑脚后跟的鞋子，可以让长时间站立的人感觉更舒适。
collocations: heel pain｜足跟疼痛 ; high heels｜高跟鞋 ; low heels｜低跟鞋
tip_zh: heel是脚后跟或鞋跟；heal意为愈合，二者同音。

meanings_zh: n. 买家；购买者 | n. 采购员
definition_en: a person or organisation that purchases something | someone whose job is choosing goods for a business
example1_en: The buyer checked the bicycle before handing over cash.
example1_zh: 买家在付现金前检查了那辆自行车。
example2_en: First-time buyers often struggle to enter the housing market because property prices rise faster than wages.
example2_zh: 由于房价上涨速度超过工资，首次购房者往往难以进入住房市场。
collocations: potential buyer｜潜在买家 ; first-time buyer｜首次购房者 ; a buyer's market｜买方市场
tip_zh: buyer 指买方；customer 更强调店铺或服务的顾客。

meanings_zh: n. 蝙蝠 | n. 球棒；球拍 | v. 用球棒击球
definition_en: A flying mammal usually active at night. | An object used to hit the ball in certain sports. | To hit or try to hit a ball with a bat.
example1_en: A bat flew above our garden at dusk.
example1_zh: 黄昏时，一只蝙蝠从我们花园上方飞过。
example2_en: Protecting bat habitats can benefit agriculture because many species feed on insects that damage crops.
example2_zh: 保护蝙蝠栖息地能使农业受益，因为许多蝙蝠以危害农作物的昆虫为食。
collocations: a cricket bat｜板球拍 ; a baseball bat｜棒球棒 ; bat wings｜蝙蝠翅膀
tip_zh: 网球拍用racket，棒球棒和板球拍用bat。

meanings_zh: v. 识别；辨认 | v. 找出；确定 | v. 产生共鸣；认同
definition_en: To recognize and establish who or what someone or something is. | To discover or establish something through examination. | To feel connected to someone through shared feelings or experiences.
example1_en: Can you identify the bird sitting on our fence?
example1_zh: 你能认出停在我们围栏上的那只鸟吗？
example2_en: Schools should identify learning difficulties early so that students can receive appropriate support before falling behind.
example2_zh: 学校应尽早发现学习困难，让学生在落后之前获得适当的支持。
collocations: identify a problem｜发现问题 ; identify the cause｜确定原因 ; identify someone as｜认出某人是 ; identify with｜与……产生共鸣
tip_zh: identify with某人指产生共鸣，不是辨认对方。

meanings_zh: n. 服务费；学费；酬金
definition_en: Money charged for a service, course, or professional advice.
example1_en: The gym charges a small fee for each class.
example1_zh: 这家健身房每节课收取少量费用。
example2_en: High tuition fees may discourage students from disadvantaged backgrounds from applying to university, even when financial assistance is available.
example2_zh: 高昂的学费可能使家境困难的学生不愿申请大学，即使有经济援助可用。
collocations: tuition fees｜学费 ; entrance fee｜入场费 ; legal fees｜法律服务费 ; pay a fee｜支付费用
tip_zh: fee指服务或入场等费用；小费通常用tip。

meanings_zh: n. 食欲；胃口 | n. 强烈欲望；渴求
definition_en: The desire to eat food. | A strong desire to have or experience something.
example1_en: A long walk always gives me a good appetite.
example1_zh: 走一段长路总能让我胃口大开。
example2_en: The growing public appetite for sustainable products encourages companies to reconsider their materials and manufacturing processes.
example2_zh: 公众对可持续产品日益增长的需求促使企业重新考虑其材料及制造工艺。
collocations: lose your appetite｜失去食欲 ; a healthy appetite｜好胃口 ; work up an appetite｜使胃口大开 ; an appetite for｜对……的渴望
tip_zh: appetite for 除食欲外，也可表示对知识等的渴求。

meanings_zh: n. 新闻标题 | v. 成为头条新闻；领衔演出
definition_en: the title of a news report | to be the main news story or featured performer
example1_en: The headline caught my attention while I ate breakfast.
example1_zh: 我吃早餐时，那个新闻标题吸引了我的注意。
example2_en: Misleading headlines can shape public opinion before readers examine the evidence presented in a news report.
example2_zh: 误导性的标题可能在读者查看新闻报道中的证据之前就影响公众舆论。
collocations: front-page headline｜头版标题 ; make headlines｜成为头条新闻 ; misleading headline｜误导性标题
tip_zh: make headlines指成为新闻焦点，不是制作标题。

meanings_zh: v. 考虑；仔细斟酌 | v. 认为；视为 | v. 顾及；考虑到
definition_en: to think carefully about something before deciding | to have a particular opinion about someone or something | to take someone or something into account
example1_en: We're considering taking the train instead of driving tomorrow.
example1_zh: 我们正在考虑明天坐火车，而不开车。
example2_en: Governments should consider the long-term environmental costs before approving major construction projects in sensitive coastal areas.
example2_zh: 政府在批准生态敏感沿海地区的大型建设项目之前，应考虑其长期环境成本。
collocations: consider doing something｜考虑做某事 ; consider the consequences｜考虑后果 ; consider all options｜考虑所有选择 ; be considered essential｜被认为必不可少
tip_zh: “考虑做”用consider doing，不用consider to do。

meanings_zh: n. 赊购；信贷 | n. 赞扬；认可 | n. 学分
definition_en: An arrangement allowing payment later or borrowing money. | Recognition that someone deserves for an achievement. | A unit earned towards a qualification by completing coursework.
example1_en: We bought our new fridge on credit last month.
example1_zh: 我们上个月赊购了一台新冰箱。
example2_en: Affordable credit can help small businesses invest in equipment and create jobs within local communities.
example2_zh: 成本可负担的信贷能帮助小企业投资设备，并为当地社区创造就业机会。
collocations: buy on credit｜赊购 ; give someone credit｜肯定某人的功劳 ; earn credits｜修得学分 ; credit card｜信用卡
tip_zh: on credit表示赊购；学分义可数，常用复数。

meanings_zh: n. 口罩；面具 | v. 掩盖；掩饰
definition_en: A covering worn over part or all of the face. | To hide something or make it less noticeable.
example1_en: She wore a mask while cleaning the dusty cupboard.
example1_zh: 她清理满是灰尘的橱柜时戴着口罩。
example2_en: Rapid economic growth can mask serious inequalities in access to education and healthcare.
example2_zh: 经济快速增长可能掩盖教育和医疗机会方面的严重不平等。
collocations: wear a mask｜戴口罩；戴面具 ; face mask｜口罩；面膜 ; mask the smell｜掩盖气味 ; mask the problem｜掩盖问题
tip_zh: mask 作动词直接接宾语，表示掩盖问题或感受。

meanings_zh: adj. 王室的；国王或女王的 | n. 王室成员
definition_en: Relating to a king, queen, or their family. | A member of a royal family.
example1_en: We visited the royal palace during our holiday.
example1_zh: 我们度假时参观了王宫。
example2_en: Some royal residences are open to visitors, generating income that helps preserve historic buildings.
example2_zh: 一些王室住所向游客开放，所得收入有助于保护历史建筑。
collocations: the royal family｜王室 ; a royal palace｜王宫 ; royal duties｜王室职责
tip_zh: royal指王室的；loyal指忠诚的，注意首字母。

meanings_zh: n. 气候 | n. 社会环境；风气；氛围
definition_en: The typical weather conditions of a place over many years. | The general attitudes and conditions within a society or organisation.
example1_en: These plants grow well in a warm, dry climate.
example1_zh: 这些植物在温暖干燥的气候中长得很好。
example2_en: A changing climate may force farmers to grow different crops and adopt more efficient irrigation methods.
example2_zh: 气候变化可能迫使农民改种其他作物，并采用更高效的灌溉方法。
collocations: climate change｜气候变化 ; mild climate｜温和的气候 ; political climate｜政治环境
tip_zh: climate指长期气候，weather指具体天气。

meanings_zh: adj. 身体不舒服的；不舒适的 | adj. 不自在的；不安的
definition_en: Causing or feeling physical discomfort. | Feeling worried, embarrassed, or uneasy.
example1_en: These new shoes feel uncomfortable after a long walk.
example1_zh: 走了很久以后，这双新鞋穿着很不舒服。
example2_en: Students may feel uncomfortable asking questions in large classes, which can limit their participation and understanding.
example2_zh: 学生在大班课堂上提问时可能感到不自在，这会影响他们的参与和理解。
collocations: an uncomfortable chair｜不舒服的椅子 ; feel uncomfortable｜感到不适 ; an uncomfortable silence｜令人尴尬的沉默
tip_zh: 既可指身体不适，也可指心理上的不自在。

meanings_zh: n. 洞穴；山洞
definition_en: A large natural hollow inside rock or under the ground.
example1_en: We sheltered from the rain inside a small cave.
example1_zh: 我们躲进一个小山洞里避雨。
example2_en: Ancient paintings found in a cave can reveal how early communities understood their surroundings.
example2_zh: 洞穴中发现的古代绘画可以揭示早期群体如何理解周围环境。
collocations: explore a cave｜探索洞穴 ; cave entrance｜洞口 ; cave paintings｜洞穴壁画
tip_zh: cave指洞穴；动词短语cave in表示坍塌或屈服。

meanings_zh: v. 探索；探访 | v. 探讨；研究
definition_en: Travel around a place to discover what it is like | Examine an idea or issue carefully to learn more
example1_en: We spent the afternoon exploring narrow streets near the harbour.
example1_zh: 我们花了一下午探访港口附近的狭窄街巷。
example2_en: Schools should encourage students to explore different career options before choosing subjects for further study.
example2_zh: 学校应鼓励学生在选择深造科目前探索不同的职业方向。
collocations: explore the area｜探访该地区 ; explore possibilities｜探索各种可能性 ; explore an issue｜探讨问题
tip_zh: 作及物动词时直接接地点或问题，不加about。

meanings_zh: v. 削皮；剥皮 | v. 剥落；脱落 | n. 果皮；蔬菜皮
definition_en: To remove the outer skin of fruit or vegetables. | To come off a surface in thin pieces. | The outer skin of a fruit or vegetable.
example1_en: Could you peel these potatoes while I chop the carrots?
example1_zh: 我切胡萝卜时，你能帮忙削这些土豆吗？
example2_en: Households can compost vegetable peels rather than discard them, reducing the amount of waste sent to landfill.
example2_zh: 家庭可以将蔬菜皮制成堆肥而非丢弃，从而减少送往填埋场的垃圾量。
collocations: peel potatoes｜削土豆皮 ; orange peel｜橙皮 ; peeling paint｜剥落的油漆
tip_zh: peel作动词可指削皮，也可指油漆等剥落。

meanings_zh: n. 小说；虚构文学 | n. 虚构之事；编造
definition_en: Stories about imagined people and events. | Something invented that is presented as true.
example1_en: My sister reads fiction on the train every morning.
example1_zh: 我姐姐每天早上在火车上读小说。
example2_en: Reading fiction can help young people understand unfamiliar perspectives and develop greater empathy for others.
example2_zh: 阅读小说能帮助年轻人理解陌生的视角，并更加体谅他人。
collocations: science fiction｜科幻小说 ; historical fiction｜历史小说 ; a work of fiction｜一部小说作品 ; fact and fiction｜事实与虚构
tip_zh: 统称小说时不可数；一部小说可说a work of fiction。

meanings_zh: v. 编辑；修改；剪辑
definition_en: To improve or prepare writing, images, or recordings by making changes.
example1_en: I need to edit this video before dinner.
example1_zh: 我需要在晚饭前剪辑好这段视频。
example2_en: Students should learn to edit their essays carefully, checking both the structure and the accuracy of their arguments.
example2_zh: 学生应学会仔细修改论文，检查论证的结构与准确性。
collocations: edit an essay｜修改文章 ; edit a video｜剪辑视频 ; edit out｜删去；剪掉
tip_zh: edit强调修改或剪辑，publish才是出版或发布。

meanings_zh: adv. 完全地；充分地
definition_en: Completely or to the greatest possible extent.
example1_en: Make sure your phone is fully charged before leaving.
example1_zh: 出门前确保手机已经充满电。
example2_en: Students benefit most from online learning when they fully understand how to use the available digital tools.
example2_zh: 学生充分了解如何使用现有数字工具时，才能最大程度地从在线学习中受益。
collocations: fully aware｜充分意识到的 ; fully equipped｜设备齐全的 ; fully understand｜充分理解 ; fully booked｜预订已满的
tip_zh: 常修饰分词或形容词，如fully prepared。

meanings_zh: n. 政策；方针；原则 | n. 保险单；保险合同
definition_en: an agreed plan or rule guiding decisions and actions | a contract describing the insurance cover someone has bought
example1_en: Our school has a policy of serving fresh fruit daily.
example1_zh: 我们学校规定每天供应新鲜水果。
example2_en: An effective housing policy should address both rising rents and the shortage of affordable homes.
example2_zh: 有效的住房政策应同时应对租金上涨和可负担住房短缺的问题。
collocations: government policy｜政府政策 ; implement a policy｜实施政策 ; insurance policy｜保险单 ; foreign policy｜外交政策
tip_zh: policy是政策或保险单；politics指政治。

meanings_zh: n. 地点；场所 | n. 斑点；污点 | v. 发现；认出
definition_en: A particular place or position. | A small mark differing in colour from its surroundings. | Notice or recognise someone or something.
example1_en: We found a shady spot beside the river.
example1_zh: 我们在河边找到了一处阴凉的地方。
example2_en: Satellite images help researchers spot changes in forest cover before extensive damage occurs.
example2_zh: 卫星图像帮助研究人员在大面积破坏发生之前发现森林覆盖的变化。
collocations: a quiet spot｜安静的地方 ; on the spot｜当场；在现场 ; spot a mistake｜发现错误 ; a tourist spot｜旅游景点
tip_zh: on the spot可指“当场”或“在现场”，依语境判断。

meanings_zh: v. 应该；应当 | v. 应该会；按理应当
definition_en: Used with to for advice, duty, or the right action. | Used with to to express what is likely or expected.
example1_en: You ought to take an umbrella; those clouds look dark.
example1_zh: 你应该带把伞，那些云看起来很阴沉。
example2_en: Governments ought to ensure that all children have access to quality education, regardless of family income.
example2_zh: 政府应确保所有儿童都能接受优质教育，不受家庭收入影响。
collocations: ought to do｜应该做 ; ought not to do｜不应该做 ; ought to have done｜本应该做
tip_zh: ought是情态动词，后接to do；否定为ought not to。

meanings_zh: n. 餐巾；餐巾纸
definition_en: Cloth or paper used to wipe your mouth while eating
example1_en: He wiped the soup from his chin with a napkin.
example1_zh: 他用餐巾擦掉下巴上的汤。
example2_en: Restaurants can reduce waste by replacing disposable paper napkins with reusable cloth alternatives, provided laundering is managed efficiently.
example2_zh: 只要高效安排洗涤，餐馆就能用可重复使用的布餐巾替代一次性餐巾纸来减少垃圾。
collocations: a paper napkin｜餐巾纸 ; a cloth napkin｜布餐巾 ; fold a napkin｜折餐巾
tip_zh: 现代常指餐巾；“尿布”英式通常用nappy。

meanings_zh: adj. 勇敢的 | v. 勇敢面对；冒着
definition_en: Willing to face danger or difficulty despite feeling afraid. | To face something dangerous or unpleasant with courage.
example1_en: You were brave to speak in front of everyone.
example1_zh: 你敢在大家面前发言，真勇敢。
example2_en: It takes brave leadership to introduce necessary environmental reforms when powerful groups strongly oppose them.
example2_zh: 当强势群体激烈反对时，推行必要的环境改革需要勇敢的领导力。
collocations: a brave decision｜勇敢的决定 ; brave enough to｜有足够勇气做 ; brave the cold｜冒着严寒
tip_zh: brave并非毫不害怕，而是害怕仍敢面对。

meanings_zh: adv. 显然；明显地
definition_en: in a way that is easy to see or understand
example1_en: The puppy was obviously tired after its long walk.
example1_zh: 走了很长一段路后，小狗显然累了。
example2_en: Although renewable energy obviously benefits the environment, its initial costs may discourage investment in poorer regions.
example2_zh: 虽然可再生能源显然有益于环境，但其初期成本可能阻碍较贫困地区的投资。
collocations: obviously pleased｜明显很高兴 ; obviously wrong｜显然错误 ; obviously important｜显然重要
tip_zh: 表示情况显而易见；讨论争议观点时慎用，以免武断。

meanings_zh: n. 燕麦粥；麦片粥
definition_en: A thick breakfast dish made by cooking oats in liquid.
example1_en: I topped my warm porridge with sliced banana.
example1_zh: 我在热燕麦粥上放了些香蕉片。
example2_en: Schools can offer porridge at breakfast to provide pupils with an affordable and nutritious meal.
example2_zh: 学校可以在早餐时提供燕麦粥，让学生吃上价格实惠、营养丰富的一餐。
collocations: a bowl of porridge｜一碗燕麦粥 ; porridge oats｜煮粥用燕麦片 ; make porridge｜煮燕麦粥
tip_zh: 通常为不可数名词；一碗用a bowl of。

meanings_zh: v. 冲浪 | v. 浏览互联网 | n. 拍岸浪花
definition_en: to ride ocean waves while standing or lying on a board | to browse websites, often without a specific purpose | waves and white foam breaking near the shore
example1_en: My cousin learned to surf during our beach holiday.
example1_zh: 我们在海滨度假时，我的表亲学会了冲浪。
example2_en: Students who surf the internet for research need skills to distinguish reliable sources from misleading information.
example2_zh: 上网查找研究资料的学生需要具备辨别可靠来源与误导性信息的能力。
collocations: learn to surf｜学习冲浪 ; surf the internet｜浏览互联网 ; surf the waves｜踏浪冲浪
tip_zh: surf the internet指上网浏览，不一定有明确搜索目标。

meanings_zh: adv. 大约；粗略地 | adv. 粗暴地；粗糙地
definition_en: approximately, rather than exactly | in a forceful, careless, or uneven manner
example1_en: The walk to the lake takes roughly twenty minutes.
example1_zh: 步行到湖边大约需要二十分钟。
example2_en: Roughly half of the residents surveyed supported replacing the old car park with a public garden.
example2_zh: 受访居民中约有一半支持将旧停车场改为公共花园。
collocations: roughly equal｜大致相等 ; roughly speaking｜大体而言 ; treat roughly｜粗暴对待
tip_zh: 表示“大约”时常放在数量前；也可指动作粗暴。

meanings_zh: n. 聚会；联欢会
definition_en: an informal meeting of friends, relatives, or colleagues
example1_en: We're having a small get-together at our flat tonight.
example1_zh: 今晚我们要在公寓里办个小聚会。
example2_en: A regular neighbourhood get-together can strengthen social ties and help new residents feel more welcome.
example2_zh: 定期举办邻里聚会能加强社会联系，让新住户更有归属感。
collocations: family get-together｜家庭聚会 ; informal get-together｜非正式聚会 ; organise a get-together｜组织聚会
tip_zh: 名词带连字符；动词短语get together不带。

meanings_zh: n. 磁盘；计算机存储盘 | n. 圆盘；盘状物
definition_en: a device that stores computer data on a circular surface | a flat, thin, round object
example1_en: My laptop's disk is almost full of holiday photos.
example1_zh: 我的笔记本电脑磁盘里几乎存满了度假照片。
example2_en: Regular backups protect important research data against accidental deletion and unexpected disk failure in university computer systems.
example2_zh: 定期备份可保护重要研究数据，避免其因误删或大学计算机系统的突发磁盘故障而丢失。
collocations: hard disk｜硬盘 ; disk space｜磁盘空间 ; disk drive｜磁盘驱动器 ; disk failure｜磁盘故障
tip_zh: 计算机磁盘用disk；英式圆盘、光盘通常写disc。

meanings_zh: n. 托盘；浅盘
definition_en: A flat container with raised edges for carrying or holding things
example1_en: She carried two cups of tea on a wooden tray.
example1_zh: 她用木托盘端着两杯茶。
example2_en: Replacing disposable food trays with reusable alternatives can significantly reduce waste in school cafeterias.
example2_zh: 用可重复使用的餐盘替代一次性餐盘，可以显著减少学校食堂的垃圾。
collocations: a serving tray｜上菜托盘 ; a baking tray｜烤盘 ; an ice cube tray｜冰块模具 ; a tray of drinks｜一托盘饮料
tip_zh: tray 通常有浅边，可指端餐托盘或烤盘。

meanings_zh: n. 蚊子
definition_en: A small flying insect whose females bite and suck blood.
example1_en: A mosquito landed on my arm during dinner.
example1_zh: 晚饭时，一只蚊子落在了我的胳膊上。
example2_en: Warmer temperatures may allow mosquito populations to spread into regions where they were previously uncommon.
example2_zh: 气温升高可能使蚊子种群扩散到以前蚊子不常见的地区。
collocations: mosquito bite｜蚊子叮咬 ; mosquito net｜蚊帐 ; mosquito repellent｜驱蚊剂
tip_zh: 复数可写mosquitoes或mosquitos。

meanings_zh: adv. 其次；第二
definition_en: Used to introduce the second point in a list or argument.
example1_en: Firstly, the flat is affordable; secondly, it has a balcony.
example1_zh: 首先，这套公寓租金实惠；其次，它还有阳台。
example2_en: Secondly, expanding public transport could reduce traffic congestion and improve access to employment opportunities.
example2_zh: 其次，扩大公共交通覆盖范围可以缓解交通拥堵，并让人们更方便地获得就业机会。
collocations: firstly and secondly｜首先和其次 ; secondly, consider｜其次，考虑
tip_zh: 用于列举第二点，句首使用时后面通常加逗号。

meanings_zh: n. 边；边缘 | n. 优势 | v. 缓慢移动
definition_en: The outer limit of an object, area, or surface. | A quality that makes someone or something more competitive. | To move slowly and carefully in a particular direction.
example1_en: Keep your glass away from the edge of the table.
example1_zh: 别把你的玻璃杯放在桌子边缘。
example2_en: Practical experience can give graduates an edge over other candidates in a competitive job market.
example2_zh: 在竞争激烈的就业市场中，实践经验能让毕业生比其他求职者更有优势。
collocations: on the edge of｜在……边缘 ; a competitive edge｜竞争优势 ; have an edge over｜比……有优势 ; edge towards｜慢慢向……移动
tip_zh: 表示优势时常用an edge over，指胜过某人。

meanings_zh: n. 运输；交通运输系统
definition_en: Moving people or goods, or the systems used for this.
example1_en: We arranged transportation from the airport to our hotel.
example1_zh: 我们安排了从机场到酒店的接送。
example2_en: Reliable public transportation can reduce traffic congestion and make employment opportunities more accessible to people without cars.
example2_zh: 可靠的公共交通能够缓解交通拥堵，让没有汽车的人更容易获得就业机会。
collocations: public transportation｜公共交通 ; transportation costs｜运输费用 ; transportation network｜交通运输网络 ; transportation of goods｜货物运输
tip_zh: 美式常用transportation，英式通常用transport。

meanings_zh: prep. 经由；途经 | prep. 通过；借助
definition_en: travelling through a particular place on the way somewhere | using a particular method, system, or person
example1_en: We travelled to the coast via a small mountain village.
example1_zh: 我们途经一个山间小村庄，前往海岸。
example2_en: Providing medical advice via video calls can improve access to healthcare for people in remote communities.
example2_zh: 通过视频通话提供医疗建议，可以让偏远社区的居民更容易获得医疗服务。
collocations: travel via｜途经 ; via email｜通过电子邮件 ; via satellite｜通过卫星
tip_zh: via后直接接地点或方式，如via email。

meanings_zh: n. 改善；进步 | n. 改进之处
definition_en: The process or result of becoming better. | A change that makes something better.
example1_en: Your latest drawing shows a real improvement in shading.
example1_zh: 你最近这幅画的明暗处理确实有进步。
example2_en: Investment in public transport can bring significant improvements in air quality and reduce travel times for urban residents.
example2_zh: 投资公共交通能显著改善空气质量，并缩短城市居民的出行时间。
collocations: significant improvement｜显著改善 ; room for improvement｜改进空间 ; an improvement on｜比…更好的事物 ; make improvements｜作出改进
tip_zh: 某方面的改善用 in；比原来更好用 an improvement on。

meanings_zh: v. 给…下定义；解释含义 | v. 明确规定；界定 | v. 构成…的特征
definition_en: To state exactly what a word or idea means. | To establish the limits, duties, or nature of something clearly. | To be the quality that makes someone or something distinctive.
example1_en: Can you define this word without using a dictionary?
example1_zh: 你能不用词典解释这个词的含义吗？
example2_en: Governments should clearly define their environmental objectives before introducing policies that affect businesses and local communities.
example2_zh: 政府在推行影响企业和当地社区的政策前，应明确界定其环境目标。
collocations: define a term｜给术语下定义 ; clearly define｜明确界定 ; define the scope｜界定范围 ; define as｜将…定义为
tip_zh: define A as B表示“将A定义为B”。

meanings_zh: n. 铁轨；铁路运输 | n. 栏杆；扶手；横杆 | v. 愤怒抱怨；严厉指责
definition_en: a steel track for trains, or transport by train | a horizontal bar used for support or as a barrier | to complain angrily and strongly about something
example1_en: We travelled by rail through the snowy mountains.
example1_zh: 我们乘火车穿过了白雪覆盖的群山。
example2_en: Investment in rail infrastructure can reduce road congestion and provide a cleaner alternative to domestic flights.
example2_zh: 投资铁路基础设施可以缓解道路拥堵，并提供比国内航班更环保的出行选择。
collocations: travel by rail｜乘火车出行 ; rail network｜铁路网 ; hold onto the rail｜抓住扶手 ; rail against｜愤怒地指责
tip_zh: by rail表示乘火车，不加冠词；动词常接against。

meanings_zh: n. 笨蛋；蠢人（骂人话）
definition_en: An insulting word for someone considered very foolish.
example1_en: I felt like an idiot after losing my keys again.
example1_zh: 再次弄丢钥匙后，我觉得自己真是个笨蛋。
example2_en: Calling a classmate an idiot can damage their confidence and undermine efforts to create a supportive learning environment.
example2_zh: 骂同学是笨蛋会打击其自信，也会破坏营造互助学习环境的努力。
collocations: feel like an idiot｜觉得自己很傻 ; a complete idiot｜十足的笨蛋
tip_zh: 带侮辱性，不是描述智力障碍的医学用语。

meanings_zh: n. 勇气；胆量
definition_en: Ability to face danger or difficulty despite feeling afraid.
example1_en: It took courage to admit my mistake in class.
example1_zh: 在课堂上承认自己的错误需要勇气。
example2_en: Young people need courage to challenge unfair practices, especially when their opinions differ from those of others.
example2_zh: 年轻人需要勇气来质疑不公平的做法，尤其是在自己的观点与他人不同时。
collocations: have the courage to do something｜有勇气做某事 ; show courage｜表现出勇气 ; take courage｜鼓起勇气
tip_zh: 通常不可数；做某事的勇气用courage to do。

meanings_zh: n. 划独木舟运动
definition_en: the activity of travelling in a canoe using a paddle
example1_en: We went canoeing on the lake before lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭前，我们去湖上划了独木舟。
example2_en: Outdoor activities such as canoeing can improve physical fitness while encouraging young people to appreciate natural environments.
example2_zh: 划独木舟等户外活动可以增强体能，同时鼓励年轻人欣赏自然环境。
collocations: go canoeing｜去划独木舟 ; canoeing trip｜独木舟之旅 ; canoeing equipment｜划独木舟装备
tip_zh: 常用go canoeing；canoe加-ing时保留e。

meanings_zh: v. 处理；应付 | v. 拿；触摸；操纵 | n. 把手；柄
definition_en: To deal with a situation, task, or person. | To hold, touch, move, or control something with your hands. | The part of an object used for holding or moving it.
example1_en: Can you handle dinner while I collect the children?
example1_zh: 我去接孩子，你能负责准备晚饭吗？
example2_en: Healthcare workers need effective training to handle stressful situations while maintaining a high standard of care.
example2_zh: 医护人员需要有效的培训，以便应对压力大的情况，同时保持高水平的护理质量。
collocations: handle complaints｜处理投诉 ; handle with care｜小心轻放 ; door handle｜门把手 ; handle pressure｜应对压力
tip_zh: handle作处理讲直接接宾语，不加with。

meanings_zh: v. 交换；兑换 | n. 交换；交流 | n. 交易所
definition_en: to give something and receive something else in return | an act of giving and receiving things, information, or ideas | a market where shares, currencies, or goods are traded
example1_en: Can I exchange this shirt for a smaller size?
example1_zh: 我能把这件衬衫换成小一号的吗？
example2_en: International exchange programmes allow students to experience different cultures and develop greater confidence in communicating.
example2_zh: 国际交流项目让学生体验不同文化，并增强他们沟通时的信心。
collocations: exchange ideas｜交流想法 ; exchange rate｜汇率 ; in exchange for｜作为……的交换 ; stock exchange｜证券交易所
tip_zh: exchange A for B表示用A换B，注意介词for。

meanings_zh: adj. 满意的；满足的 | adj. 确信的；信服的
definition_en: Pleased because something meets your needs or expectations. | Convinced that something is true or has been done properly.
example1_en: I'm satisfied with these shoes; they fit perfectly.
example1_zh: 我对这双鞋很满意，穿着特别合脚。
example2_en: Employees who feel satisfied with their working conditions are more likely to remain with the same organisation.
example2_zh: 对工作条件感到满意的员工更有可能留在同一家机构。
collocations: satisfied with｜对……满意 ; fully satisfied｜完全满意 ; satisfied that｜确信……
tip_zh: 人感到满意用satisfied；事物令人满意用satisfying。

meanings_zh: adj. 有暴风雨的 | adj. 充满争吵的；激烈的
definition_en: Having strong winds and often heavy rain, thunder, or lightning. | Involving strong emotions, arguments, or disagreement.
example1_en: We stayed indoors because the weather was so stormy.
example1_zh: 因为外面风雨交加，我们待在了室内。
example2_en: Increasingly stormy conditions may disrupt shipping routes and threaten the livelihoods of people in coastal communities.
example2_zh: 日益频繁的暴风雨天气可能扰乱航运路线，并威胁沿海社区居民的生计。
collocations: stormy weather｜暴风雨天气 ; stormy seas｜波涛汹涌的海面 ; a stormy relationship｜争吵不断的关系 ; a stormy debate｜激烈的辩论
tip_zh: 既可形容天气，也可形容关系或讨论充满冲突。

meanings_zh: n. 讲义；分发的资料 | n. 救济款物；施舍物
definition_en: A document given to people attending a lesson or meeting. | Money or goods given free to someone in need.
example1_en: Our teacher gave us a handout about healthy eating.
example1_zh: 老师给我们发了一份关于健康饮食的讲义。
example2_en: A well-designed handout can help students review key concepts independently after a lecture has finished.
example2_zh: 一份设计得当的讲义可以帮助学生在讲座结束后独立复习核心概念。
collocations: course handout｜课程讲义 ; distribute handouts｜分发讲义 ; government handouts｜政府救济款物
tip_zh: handout是名词；hand out是动词短语，意为分发。

meanings_zh: adj. 合群的；爱交际的
definition_en: Enjoying meeting people and spending time with them.
example1_en: My sociable neighbour invites everyone over for tea.
example1_zh: 我那位爱交际的邻居邀请大家去喝茶。
example2_en: Shared spaces can encourage residents to become more sociable and develop stronger relationships with their neighbours.
example2_zh: 公共空间可以鼓励居民更多地与人交往，并与邻居建立更紧密的关系。
collocations: a sociable person｜爱交际的人 ; a sociable atmosphere｜友好的社交氛围 ; sociable activities｜社交活动
tip_zh: sociable指爱交际；social多指社会或社交的。

meanings_zh: n. 帮忙；恩惠 | n. 支持；赞同；喜爱 | v. 偏爱；支持；有利于
definition_en: something helpful you do for someone | approval, support, or liking for someone or something | to prefer, support, or give an advantage to
example1_en: Could you do me a favor and water my plants?
example1_zh: 你能帮我个忙，给我的植物浇水吗？
example2_en: Many residents favor investment in public transport because it can reduce congestion and improve access to employment.
example2_zh: 许多居民支持投资公共交通，因为这能缓解拥堵，并让人们更方便地前往工作地点。
collocations: do someone a favor｜帮某人一个忙 ; in favor of｜支持；赞成 ; favor one option over another｜更偏向某个选项 ; win favor｜赢得好感
tip_zh: favor是美式拼写，英式为favour；帮忙用do a favor。

meanings_zh: n. 狼 | v. 狼吞虎咽地吃
definition_en: a wild animal related to dogs, often living in packs | to eat food very quickly and eagerly
example1_en: A grey wolf stood silently at the forest edge.
example1_zh: 一只灰狼静静地站在森林边缘。
example2_en: Protecting wolf populations can help restore ecological balance by controlling the numbers of deer in forest habitats.
example2_zh: 保护狼群有助于控制森林栖息地中的鹿群数量，从而恢复生态平衡。
collocations: a pack of wolves｜一群狼 ; a lone wolf｜独狼；不合群的人 ; wolf down a meal｜狼吞虎咽地吃饭
tip_zh: 复数为wolves；动词常用wolf down，表示快速吃下。

meanings_zh: n. 滑水运动
definition_en: Travelling over water on skis while pulled by a boat.
example1_en: We tried waterskiing on the lake last summer.
example1_zh: 去年夏天，我们在湖上尝试了滑水。
example2_en: Waterskiing can attract tourists to lakeside communities, but motorboats may disturb wildlife and increase water pollution.
example2_zh: 滑水运动能吸引游客前往湖畔社区，但摩托艇可能干扰野生动物并加剧水污染。
collocations: go waterskiing｜去滑水 ; waterskiing lessons｜滑水课程 ; waterskiing equipment｜滑水装备
tip_zh: 作运动名词时不可数；去滑水用go waterskiing。

meanings_zh: n. 奖励；回报；酬金 | v. 奖励；酬谢
definition_en: Something received for good work, helpful behaviour, or achievement. | To give something to someone for their efforts or help.
example1_en: We gave the puppy a treat as a reward.
example1_zh: 我们给了小狗一块零食作为奖励。
example2_en: Schools should reward consistent effort rather than focus exclusively on students who achieve the highest grades.
example2_zh: 学校应奖励持续的努力，而不是只关注成绩最好的学生。
collocations: financial reward｜经济回报 ; reward someone for something｜因某事奖励某人 ; reap the rewards｜收获回报
tip_zh: reward强调付出后的回报；award常指正式授奖。

meanings_zh: n. 全体船员；机组人员 | n. 工作组；团队 | v. 担任船员
definition_en: The people who work together on a ship or aircraft | A group working together on a particular practical task | Work as a member of a boat's crew
example1_en: The crew welcomed us aboard with warm smiles.
example1_zh: 机组人员面带亲切的笑容，欢迎我们登机。
example2_en: Airlines must ensure that every crew member receives regular safety training to protect passengers during emergencies.
example2_zh: 航空公司必须确保每位机组成员定期接受安全培训，以便在紧急情况下保护乘客。
collocations: cabin crew｜客舱乘务组 ; crew member｜机组成员；船员 ; film crew｜摄制组 ; rescue crew｜救援队
tip_zh: crew是集体名词；单个成员说a crew member。

meanings_zh: v. 保护；保卫 | v. 辩护；捍卫 | v. 防守
definition_en: to protect someone or something from attack or harm | to give reasons supporting someone or something being criticised | to prevent opponents from scoring in a sport
example1_en: The mother duck spread her wings to defend her ducklings.
example1_zh: 鸭妈妈张开翅膀保护小鸭。
example2_en: Governments should defend citizens' rights while ensuring that public safety measures remain fair and proportionate.
example2_zh: 政府应捍卫公民权利，同时确保公共安全措施公平且适度。
collocations: defend against attack｜抵御攻击 ; defend human rights｜捍卫人权 ; defend a decision｜为某项决定辩护 ; defend a title｜卫冕
tip_zh: defend ... against/from ...表示保护……免受……。

meanings_zh: n. 观众；听众 | n. 读者群；受众
definition_en: People watching or listening to a performance, speech, or programme | People who read or receive particular content
example1_en: The audience clapped loudly when the dancers finished.
example1_zh: 舞者表演结束时，观众热烈鼓掌。
example2_en: Online platforms enable museums to reach a wider audience, including people who cannot visit their collections in person.
example2_zh: 网络平台使博物馆能够接触更广泛的受众，包括无法亲自参观馆藏的人。
collocations: a large audience｜众多观众 ; a target audience｜目标受众 ; reach a wider audience｜触达更广泛的受众 ; audience participation｜观众参与
tip_zh: 观众多用large audience，不用many audiences。

meanings_zh: n. 紧急情况；突发事件
definition_en: A serious, unexpected situation requiring immediate action.
example1_en: Keep a torch nearby in case of an emergency.
example1_zh: 在手边备好手电筒，以防出现紧急情况。
example2_en: Governments should invest in emergency services to ensure that communities receive rapid assistance during natural disasters.
example2_zh: 政府应投资应急服务，确保社区在自然灾害期间迅速获得援助。
collocations: in an emergency｜在紧急情况下 ; emergency services｜应急救援部门 ; emergency evacuation｜紧急疏散 ; a state of emergency｜紧急状态
tip_zh: 是可数名词；emergency exit中的名词作定语。

meanings_zh: n. 运动服装；休闲运动装
definition_en: Clothes designed for sport or worn in a sporty casual style.
example1_en: She changed into comfortable sportswear before her evening run.
example1_zh: 晚间跑步前，她换上了舒适的运动服。
example2_en: Demand for affordable sportswear may increase as more people participate in regular exercise and community sports.
example2_zh: 随着更多人定期锻炼并参与社区体育活动，对平价运动服装的需求可能会增加。
collocations: comfortable sportswear｜舒适的运动服装 ; a sportswear retailer｜运动服装零售商 ; a range of sportswear｜一系列运动服装
tip_zh: 不可数名词；一件运动服用an item of sportswear。

meanings_zh: v. 复习 | v. 修订；修改
definition_en: To study material again in preparation for an examination. | To change something to correct or improve it.
example1_en: I need to revise for my biology exam tonight.
example1_zh: 今晚我得复习，准备生物考试。
example2_en: Governments should revise outdated housing policies to ensure that affordable homes remain accessible to young families.
example2_zh: 政府应修订过时的住房政策，确保年轻家庭仍能获得负担得起的住房。
collocations: revise for an exam｜复习备考 ; revise a draft｜修改草稿 ; revise an estimate｜修正估算 ; revise a policy｜修订政策
tip_zh: 复习义主要用于英式英语；美式常用review。

meanings_zh: n. 盖子 | n. 眼睑
definition_en: a cover that closes the top of a container | either fold of skin that covers an eye
example1_en: Put the lid on before you shake the jar.
example1_zh: 摇晃罐子之前先把盖子盖上。
example2_en: A tightly fitted lid helps households keep food fresh and reduce unnecessary waste.
example2_zh: 严密贴合的盖子能帮助家庭保持食物新鲜，减少不必要的浪费。
collocations: a tight-fitting lid｜严密贴合的盖子 ; put the lid on｜盖上盖子 ; lift the lid｜揭开盖子 ; keep a lid on costs｜控制成本
tip_zh: 容器的盖子用lid；瓶子的旋盖也常用cap。

meanings_zh: n. 毕业；毕业典礼
definition_en: Completing a course of study, or the ceremony celebrating this.
example1_en: My sister wore a blue gown at her graduation.
example1_zh: 姐姐在毕业典礼上穿了一件蓝色学位袍。
example2_en: Universities should provide career guidance before graduation to help students make a successful transition into employment.
example2_zh: 大学应在学生毕业前提供职业指导，帮助他们顺利过渡到职场。
collocations: graduation ceremony｜毕业典礼 ; after graduation｜毕业后 ; graduation gown｜学位袍
tip_zh: 表示从某校毕业，动词用graduate from。

meanings_zh: n. 收银员
definition_en: Someone who receives customers' payments in a shop or bank
example1_en: The cashier smiled and handed me my change.
example1_zh: 收银员微笑着把零钱递给我。
example2_en: Automated checkouts may reduce demand for cashiers, although many customers still prefer assistance from a person.
example2_zh: 自助结账设备可能减少对收银员的需求，但许多顾客仍更喜欢人工协助。
collocations: work as a cashier｜当收银员 ; supermarket cashier｜超市收银员 ; pay the cashier｜向收银员付款
tip_zh: cashier负责收款，accountant负责会计核算。

meanings_zh: n. 便宜货；划算的买卖 | v. 讨价还价；商谈条件 | n. 协议；约定
definition_en: Something bought for less than its usual price | To discuss prices or conditions to reach an agreement | An agreement about what each person will do
example1_en: This warm winter coat was a real bargain.
example1_zh: 这件暖和的冬季外套买得真划算。
example2_en: Consumers can often bargain with local sellers, although fixed prices are more common in large stores.
example2_zh: 消费者通常可以与当地商贩讨价还价，但大型商店更常采用固定价格。
collocations: a real bargain｜真正的便宜货 ; bargain with someone｜与某人讨价还价 ; strike a bargain｜达成协议 ; keep your side of the bargain｜履行自己约定的义务
tip_zh: 便宜货用可数名词；bargain with sb表示与某人议价。

meanings_zh: adj. 情绪的；情感的 | adj. 情绪激动的；易动情的
definition_en: Related to feelings rather than thoughts or physical needs. | Showing or experiencing strong feelings.
example1_en: Her friends gave her emotional support during the move.
example1_zh: 搬家期间，她的朋友们在情感上给予了她支持。
example2_en: Schools should support children's emotional development alongside academic progress to promote their long-term well-being.
example2_zh: 学校应在促进学业进步的同时支持儿童的情感发展，以增进他们的长期福祉。
collocations: emotional support｜情感支持 ; emotional well-being｜情绪健康 ; emotional development｜情感发展 ; become emotional｜变得激动
tip_zh: emotional不一定指悲伤，也可指喜悦等强烈情绪。

meanings_zh: v. 教育；培养 | v. 使了解；普及知识
definition_en: To teach someone and develop their knowledge or skills. | To give people information about a particular subject.
example1_en: These colourful picture books educate children while keeping them entertained.
example1_zh: 这些色彩鲜艳的图画书寓教于乐，让孩子们学到知识。
example2_en: Public health campaigns should educate people about nutrition rather than simply encourage them to lose weight.
example2_zh: 公共卫生宣传活动应向人们普及营养知识，而不只是鼓励他们减重。
collocations: educate children｜教育儿童 ; educate people about｜向人们普及……知识 ; educate the public｜教育公众
tip_zh: educate强调教育培养；teach也可直接接学科。

meanings_zh: adj. 钦佩的；印象深刻的
definition_en: Feeling admiration because someone or something is particularly good.
example1_en: I was impressed by how quickly you fixed the bike.
example1_zh: 你这么快就修好了自行车，让我很佩服。
example2_en: Visitors are often impressed by museums that combine interactive technology with carefully preserved historical objects.
example2_zh: 将互动技术与精心保存的历史文物相结合的博物馆，常常令参观者印象深刻。
collocations: impressed by｜对……印象深刻 ; impressed with｜对……感到钦佩 ; deeply impressed｜印象极为深刻
tip_zh: impressed描述人的感受；impressive描述令人赞叹的事物。

meanings_zh: v. 服从；遵守
definition_en: to do what someone orders or what a rule requires
example1_en: Our dog will obey simple commands for a treat.
example1_zh: 为了得到零食，我们的狗会听从简单的指令。
example2_en: Drivers who obey speed limits help protect pedestrians and reduce the risk of serious accidents.
example2_zh: 遵守限速规定的司机有助于保护行人，并降低严重事故的风险。
collocations: obey orders｜服从命令 ; obey the law｜遵守法律 ; obey instructions｜遵从指示
tip_zh: 直接接人、命令或规则，不加to：obey the law。

meanings_zh: n. 兴奋；激动 | n. 令人兴奋的事；刺激
definition_en: a feeling of great enthusiasm and eager anticipation | something that creates strong interest or enthusiasm
example1_en: The children jumped with excitement when the puppies arrived.
example1_zh: 小狗到来时，孩子们兴奋得跳了起来。
example2_en: Although international sporting events generate excitement, host cities must carefully assess their long-term financial costs.
example2_zh: 虽然国际体育赛事令人振奋，但主办城市必须仔细评估其长期财务成本。
collocations: with excitement｜兴奋地 ; a sense of excitement｜兴奋感 ; generate excitement｜引发兴奋 ; contain your excitement｜抑制兴奋之情
tip_zh: 表示兴奋情绪通常不可数：with excitement。

meanings_zh: n. 听者；听众
definition_en: someone who listens to a person, programme, or performance
example1_en: My sister is a patient listener when I feel worried.
example1_zh: 我感到担忧时，姐姐总会耐心倾听。
example2_en: A good listener can help colleagues resolve disagreements by understanding different perspectives before offering advice.
example2_zh: 善于倾听的人会先理解不同观点再提出建议，从而帮助同事解决分歧。
collocations: a good listener｜善于倾听的人 ; radio listeners｜广播听众 ; an attentive listener｜专心的听者
tip_zh: listener指听的人；listen后接宾语须用to。

meanings_zh: v. 攻击；猛烈抨击 | n. 攻击；抨击 | n. 疾病发作
definition_en: Try to hurt someone or criticize something strongly | An act of violence or strong criticism | A sudden period of illness or severe symptoms
example1_en: The goose attacked my bag when I approached the pond.
example1_zh: 我走近池塘时，那只鹅突然啄起我的包。
example2_en: Critics attacked the proposal because it offered little support for families living in poverty.
example2_zh: 批评者猛烈抨击这项提案，因为它几乎没有为贫困家庭提供支持。
collocations: come under attack｜遭到攻击或抨击 ; heart attack｜心脏病发作 ; attack a proposal｜抨击一项提案
tip_zh: 动词直接接宾语；名词常用an attack on。

meanings_zh: v. 吹；刮 | n. 打击；不幸事件 | n. 重击；击打
definition_en: to move air, or move because of moving air | an event that causes disappointment, difficulty, or loss | a hard hit with a hand or object
example1_en: A cold wind blew leaves across the empty playground.
example1_zh: 一阵冷风把树叶吹过空荡荡的操场。
example2_en: The closure of the local factory dealt a serious blow to employment opportunities in the region.
example2_zh: 当地工厂的关闭严重打击了该地区的就业机会。
collocations: blow out a candle｜吹灭蜡烛 ; blow your nose｜擤鼻涕 ; a major blow｜重大打击 ; deal a blow to｜给……造成打击
tip_zh: 动词变化为blow–blew–blown。

meanings_zh: n. 储藏室；库房
definition_en: a room used for keeping supplies or unused things
example1_en: The spare chairs are stacked neatly in the storeroom.
example1_zh: 备用椅子整齐地堆放在储藏室里。
example2_en: Schools should keep emergency supplies in a secure storeroom that staff can access quickly when necessary.
example2_zh: 学校应将应急物资存放在安全的储藏室里，确保教职员工在必要时能够迅速取用。
collocations: locked storeroom｜上锁的储藏室 ; storeroom shelves｜储藏室的架子 ; keep something in a storeroom｜把某物存放在储藏室
tip_zh: storeroom是房间；warehouse通常指较大的仓库。

meanings_zh: v. 使摆脱；清除
definition_en: free someone or something from an unwanted thing
example1_en: We finally got rid of the broken garden chairs.
example1_zh: 我们终于处理掉了那些坏掉的花园椅子。
example2_en: Cities can rid their streets of excessive litter by improving waste collection and encouraging responsible behaviour.
example2_zh: 城市可以通过改进垃圾收集并鼓励负责任的行为，清除街道上过多的垃圾。
collocations: get rid of｜摆脱；处理掉 ; rid something of｜清除某物中的 ; be rid of｜摆脱
tip_zh: 牢记get rid of；rid A of B表示清除A中的B。

meanings_zh: adj. 南极地区的 | n. 南极地区
definition_en: Relating to the region around the South Pole. | The region surrounding the South Pole, including Antarctica.
example1_en: We watched a film about penguins on Antarctic ice.
example1_zh: 我们看了一部关于南极冰面上企鹅的影片。
example2_en: Scientists monitor Antarctic ice to understand how rising global temperatures affect sea levels worldwide.
example2_zh: 科学家监测南极冰层，以了解全球气温升高如何影响世界各地的海平面。
collocations: Antarctic ice｜南极冰层 ; the Antarctic｜南极地区 ; Antarctic wildlife｜南极野生动物
tip_zh: 名词用the Antarctic；Antarctica专指南极洲。

meanings_zh: adv. 确实；的确 | adv. 甚至；实际上
definition_en: Used to confirm something or emphasize that it is true. | Used to add information that strengthens a previous statement.
example1_en: The soup was very tasty indeed, so I had more.
example1_zh: 这汤确实非常好喝，所以我又喝了一些。
example2_en: Public transport can reduce congestion; indeed, reliable bus services may persuade many commuters to stop driving.
example2_zh: 公共交通能够缓解拥堵；事实上，可靠的公交服务可能使许多通勤者放弃开车。
collocations: very useful indeed｜确实非常有用 ; indeed the case｜确实如此 ; if indeed｜如果确实
tip_zh: 可用very＋形容词＋indeed加强语气。

meanings_zh: n. 地区；区域 | n. 身体部位
definition_en: an area of a country or the world | a particular area of the body
example1_en: This region is famous for its apples and cheese.
example1_zh: 这个地区以苹果和奶酪闻名。
example2_en: Improved transport links could attract more businesses to the region and create jobs for local residents.
example2_zh: 改善交通联系可以吸引更多企业进入该地区，并为当地居民创造就业机会。
collocations: coastal region｜沿海地区 ; rural region｜乡村地区 ; in the region of｜大约
tip_zh: in the region of接金额等，表示“大约”。

meanings_zh: n. 呼吸的空气；气息 | n. 一次呼吸
definition_en: air moving into or out of your lungs | one act of taking air into your lungs
example1_en: Her breath formed a cloud in the cold air.
example1_zh: 她呼出的气在冷空气中形成了一团白雾。
example2_en: Taking a slow, deep breath can help students manage anxiety before an important examination.
example2_zh: 缓慢地深呼吸一次，有助于学生缓解重要考试前的焦虑。
collocations: take a deep breath｜深吸一口气 ; out of breath｜上气不接下气 ; hold your breath｜屏住呼吸 ; catch your breath｜喘口气
tip_zh: breath是名词；breathe是动词，末尾读/ð/。

meanings_zh: adj. 二手的；用过的 | adj. 间接获得的 | adv. 以二手方式；间接地
definition_en: previously owned or used by someone else | learned from others rather than through direct experience | from a previous owner, or through another person's account
example1_en: My second-hand bicycle still rides smoothly after years of use.
example1_zh: 我的二手自行车用了多年，骑起来仍很顺畅。
example2_en: Buying second-hand furniture can reduce household spending and prevent usable goods from ending up in landfill.
example2_zh: 购买二手家具能减少家庭开支，并避免尚可使用的物品最终被填埋。
collocations: second-hand clothes｜二手衣物 ; second-hand shop｜二手商店 ; buy second-hand｜买二手货 ; second-hand information｜间接获得的信息
tip_zh: 既可指物品用过，也可指信息并非亲身获得。

meanings_zh: n. 私人教师；导师 | v. 辅导；个别指导
definition_en: a teacher who guides individuals or small groups | to teach someone individually or in a small group
example1_en: My tutor helped me understand fractions using paper circles.
example1_zh: 我的辅导老师用圆形纸片帮我理解了分数。
example2_en: A personal tutor can help students develop effective study habits and address specific learning difficulties.
example2_zh: 私人教师可以帮助学生养成有效的学习习惯，并解决具体的学习困难。
collocations: private tutor｜私人教师 ; personal tutor｜个人导师 ; tutor someone in maths｜辅导某人数学
tip_zh: tutor强调个别或小组辅导，不一定是教授。

meanings_zh: n. 过敏；过敏症
definition_en: A condition causing illness after contact with a normally harmless substance
example1_en: My brother has an allergy to peanuts and walnuts.
example1_zh: 我哥哥对花生和核桃过敏。
example2_en: Schools should have clear procedures for helping children who experience a severe food allergy reaction.
example2_zh: 学校应制定明确流程，为出现严重食物过敏反应的儿童提供帮助。
collocations: food allergy｜食物过敏 ; pollen allergy｜花粉过敏 ; have an allergy to｜对……过敏
tip_zh: 常用have an allergy to；to后接引起过敏的物质。

meanings_zh: n. 渡船；轮渡 | v. 运送；摆渡
definition_en: A boat carrying passengers or vehicles across water regularly. | To carry people or goods between places, often repeatedly.
example1_en: We took the ferry across the lake this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上我们乘渡船穿过了湖。
example2_en: Reliable ferry services connect island communities with mainland hospitals, schools, and employment opportunities throughout the year.
example2_zh: 可靠的轮渡服务全年将岛屿社区与大陆的医院、学校和就业机会连接起来。
collocations: take a ferry｜乘渡船 ; ferry terminal｜轮渡码头 ; ferry service｜轮渡服务
tip_zh: 复数为ferries；动词也可指用车反复接送。

meanings_zh: n. 状态；状况 | n. 国家；州；政府 | v. 陈述；明确说明
definition_en: the condition of someone or something at a particular time | a country, its government, or a region within a country | to express something clearly in speech or writing
example1_en: The kitchen was in a terrible state after dinner.
example1_zh: 晚饭后，厨房一片狼藉。
example2_en: The report states that reliable public transport is essential for reducing dependence on private cars.
example2_zh: 报告指出，可靠的公共交通对于减少对私家车的依赖至关重要。
collocations: in a good state｜处于良好状态 ; state of mind｜心理状态 ; state funding｜政府资助 ; state clearly｜明确说明
tip_zh: state作动词较正式，可接that从句；名词可指状态或国家。

meanings_zh: n. 竖列；栏 | n. 专栏 | n. 柱；柱状物
definition_en: a vertical arrangement of items or a printed page section | a regular newspaper or magazine feature on a particular subject | a tall upright structure, often supporting a roof
example1_en: Put the prices in the column beside each item.
example1_zh: 把价格填在每件商品旁边的那一列里。
example2_en: The newspaper's weekly science column helps readers understand how new discoveries may affect everyday life.
example2_zh: 这家报纸每周的科学专栏帮助读者了解新发现可能如何影响日常生活。
collocations: a column of figures｜一列数字 ; a newspaper column｜报纸专栏 ; a stone column｜石柱 ; a column of smoke｜烟柱
tip_zh: column 是竖列，row 是横行；词尾 n 不发音。

meanings_zh: v. 提醒 | v. 使想起
definition_en: Help someone remember something they need to do or know | Make someone think of a similar person, thing, or experience
example1_en: Please remind me to take my umbrella before we leave.
example1_zh: 出门前请提醒我带伞。
