example2_en: Schools should regularly remind students to protect their personal information when using online learning platforms.
example2_zh: 学校应定期提醒学生，在使用在线学习平台时保护个人信息。
collocations: remind someone to do something｜提醒某人做某事 ; remind someone of something｜使某人想起某事 ; gently remind｜轻声提醒
tip_zh: 提醒去做用remind sb to do；使想起用of。

meanings_zh: v. 促进；提倡 | v. 晋升；提拔 | v. 宣传；推销
definition_en: to encourage something to develop or become more widely accepted | to give someone a higher position at work | to attract attention to something to increase interest or sales
example1_en: Our local club promotes cycling through free weekend rides.
example1_zh: 我们当地的俱乐部通过免费的周末骑行活动推广骑车。
example2_en: Schools can promote healthier lifestyles by providing nutritious meals and encouraging students to take regular exercise.
example2_zh: 学校可以通过提供营养餐并鼓励学生定期锻炼来倡导更健康的生活方式。
collocations: promote economic growth｜促进经济增长 ; promote awareness｜提高意识 ; be promoted to manager｜获晋升为经理 ; promote a product｜推销产品
tip_zh: 晋升到某职位用be promoted to＋职位。

meanings_zh: n. 管弦乐队
definition_en: A large group of musicians playing different instruments together.
example1_en: The orchestra began playing as the lights dimmed.
example1_zh: 灯光暗下来时，管弦乐队开始演奏。
example2_en: Public funding helps the local orchestra offer affordable concerts and introduce classical music to younger audiences.
example2_zh: 公共资助帮助当地管弦乐队举办票价亲民的音乐会，并向年轻观众介绍古典音乐。
collocations: symphony orchestra｜交响乐团 ; conduct an orchestra｜指挥管弦乐队 ; play in an orchestra｜在管弦乐队演奏
tip_zh: 指整个乐队；成员通常演奏弦乐、管乐及打击乐器。

meanings_zh: adj. 身体的；体力的 | adj. 物质的；有形的 | adj. 物理的
definition_en: Relating to the body rather than the mind. | Existing as something real that can be touched or measured. | Relating to natural forces, matter, and energy.
example1_en: Gardening gives me plenty of physical exercise every weekend.
example1_zh: 每个周末做园艺活都让我得到充分的身体锻炼。
example2_en: Regular physical activity can improve public health and reduce the financial pressure on national healthcare systems.
example2_zh: 规律的体育活动能够改善公众健康，并减轻国家医疗体系的财政压力。
collocations: physical activity｜身体活动 ; physical health｜身体健康 ; physical properties｜物理性质 ; physical evidence｜实物证据
tip_zh: physical偏身体或物质；physiological指生理的。

meanings_zh: n. 管子；管道 | v. 用管道输送 | n. 烟斗
definition_en: A hollow tube that carries liquid or gas. | To carry liquid or gas through pipes. | A small bowl with a tube used for smoking tobacco.
example1_en: Water dripped from a broken pipe under the sink.
example1_zh: 水从洗涤槽下面一根破裂的管子里滴下来。
example2_en: Replacing damaged water pipes can help cities conserve resources and ensure a reliable supply of clean drinking water.
example2_zh: 更换受损水管可以帮助城市节约资源，并确保清洁饮用水的可靠供应。
collocations: water pipe｜水管 ; a burst pipe｜爆裂的管道 ; pipe water to｜用管道把水输送到
tip_zh: pipe可作动词：pipe water to把水输送到某处。

meanings_zh: num. 十亿 | n. 数十亿；大量
definition_en: one thousand million | an extremely large quantity, usually expressed as billions
example1_en: The science museum displayed a rock a billion years old.
example1_zh: 科学博物馆展出了一块有十亿年历史的岩石。
example2_en: Governments spend billions of dollars on transport infrastructure to support economic growth and connect isolated communities.
example2_zh: 各国政府投入数十亿美元建设交通基础设施，以促进经济增长并连接偏远社区。
collocations: a billion dollars｜十亿美元 ; billions of people｜数十亿人 ; a billion years｜十亿年
tip_zh: 具体数值后不加s；泛指数十亿用billions of。

meanings_zh: adj. 医学的；医疗的 | n. 体格检查
definition_en: Related to medicine or the treatment of illness. | An examination to check a person's health.
example1_en: The hotel called for medical help when a guest fainted.
example1_zh: 一位客人晕倒后，酒店呼叫了医疗救助。
example2_en: Governments should improve access to medical services in rural areas where hospitals are often far away.
example2_zh: 政府应改善农村地区的医疗服务可及性，因为那里的医院往往距离很远。
collocations: medical treatment｜医疗 ; medical research｜医学研究 ; medical care｜医疗护理 ; have a medical｜接受体检
tip_zh: medical作名词多用于英式英语，指体检，不指医生。

meanings_zh: n. 条纹
definition_en: Long narrow bands differing in colour from the surrounding surface
example1_en: My favourite shirt has blue stripes across the front.
example1_zh: 我最喜欢的衬衫正面有蓝色条纹。
example2_en: Researchers investigate how zebra stripes may discourage biting insects, potentially revealing useful strategies for protecting livestock.
example2_zh: 研究人员探究斑马条纹如何阻止叮咬昆虫，这可能为保护牲畜提供有用策略。
collocations: vertical stripes｜竖条纹 ; horizontal stripes｜横条纹 ; narrow stripes｜细条纹 ; black and white stripes｜黑白条纹
tip_zh: stripes是stripe的复数；“条纹的”用striped。

meanings_zh: n. 编辑；主编 | n. 剪辑师 | n. 编辑程序
definition_en: someone who prepares written material or manages a publication | someone who selects and arranges recorded images or sound | software used to change digital content
example1_en: The editor suggested a clearer ending for my story.
example1_zh: 编辑建议我给故事写一个更清楚的结尾。
example2_en: A newspaper editor must balance the public's right to information with respect for individual privacy.
example2_zh: 报纸编辑必须在公众知情权与尊重个人隐私之间取得平衡。
collocations: chief editor｜主编 ; film editor｜电影剪辑师 ; text editor｜文本编辑器 ; editor of a magazine｜杂志编辑
tip_zh: editor可指编辑人员，也可指编辑软件。

meanings_zh: n. 混合物；混合体
definition_en: Something made by combining two or more different things.
example1_en: Stir the mixture until it becomes smooth and creamy.
example1_zh: 搅拌混合物，直到它变得顺滑绵密。
example2_en: Successful cities offer a mixture of affordable housing, reliable transport, and accessible public spaces.
example2_zh: 成功的城市兼具可负担的住房、可靠的交通和方便使用的公共空间。
collocations: a mixture of｜……的混合体 ; stir the mixture｜搅拌混合物 ; a rich mixture｜丰富的组合
tip_zh: a mixture of 后可接物质，也可接情感等抽象事物。

meanings_zh: v. 推迟；使耽搁 | n. 延误；耽搁的时间
definition_en: To make something happen later than expected or planned. | A period of waiting before something happens or continues.
example1_en: Heavy snow delayed our flight until the next morning.
example1_zh: 大雪使我们的航班延误到第二天早上。
example2_en: Delays in public transport can reduce productivity and discourage people from leaving their cars at home.
example2_zh: 公共交通的延误会降低生产效率，并使人们不愿放弃开车出行。
collocations: delay a decision｜推迟决定 ; a lengthy delay｜长时间延误 ; without delay｜立即；毫不耽搁 ; delay doing something｜推迟做某事
tip_zh: 动词后接动名词：delay doing，不用to do。

meanings_zh: n. 笑；笑声
definition_en: The sound or action of laughing
example1_en: Laughter filled the kitchen when the puppy sneezed.
example1_zh: 小狗一打喷嚏，厨房里便充满了笑声。
example2_en: Shared laughter can strengthen social bonds and help people manage stress in demanding work environments.
example2_zh: 一起欢笑可以增进人际联系，帮助人们应对高压工作环境中的压力。
collocations: burst into laughter｜突然大笑 ; roar with laughter｜放声大笑 ; a burst of laughter｜一阵笑声 ; infectious laughter｜有感染力的笑声
tip_zh: laughter不可数；表示“一阵笑声”用a burst of laughter。

meanings_zh: v. 剃；刮去毛发 | v. 削去薄片；少量削减 | n. 剃须；刮脸
definition_en: To remove hair from skin using a razor. | To remove thin pieces or reduce something by a small amount. | An act of removing facial hair with a razor.
example1_en: I shave every morning before leaving for work.
example1_zh: 我每天早晨出门上班前都会刮胡子。
example2_en: Improved transport connections could shave several minutes off daily journeys and encourage more people to commute by train.
example2_zh: 改善交通衔接可以缩短几分钟的日常行程，并鼓励更多人乘火车通勤。
collocations: shave your head｜剃光头 ; have a shave｜刮胡子 ; shave time off｜缩短时间
tip_zh: 过去式shaved；过去分词shaved或shaven。

meanings_zh: v. 弯曲；使弯曲 | v. 弯腰；弯身 | n. 弯道；转弯处
definition_en: To become curved or make something curved. | To move your body downwards or forwards from the waist. | A curved section of a road, river, or other long object.
example1_en: Bend the wire gently to make a small hook.
example1_zh: 轻轻弯曲铁丝，做成一个小钩子。
example2_en: Drivers should reduce their speed before approaching a sharp bend, especially when road conditions are poor.
example2_zh: 驾驶员在接近急弯前应减速，尤其是在路况不佳时。
collocations: bend your knees｜屈膝 ; bend down｜弯下腰 ; a sharp bend｜急弯 ; bend the rules｜通融规则
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为bent；bend down表示弯下腰。

meanings_zh: n. 羔羊；小羊 | n. 羊羔肉
definition_en: a young sheep | meat from a young sheep, eaten as food
example1_en: A small lamb followed its mother across the field.
example1_zh: 一只小羊跟着妈妈穿过田野。
example2_en: Producing lamb requires land and water, so its environmental impact should be considered when planning sustainable diets.
example2_zh: 生产羊羔肉需要土地和水，因此规划可持续饮食时应考虑其环境影响。
collocations: newborn lamb｜新生羔羊 ; roast lamb｜烤羊羔肉 ; lamb chops｜羊排
tip_zh: 词尾b不发音；指小羊可数，指肉不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 自豪；得意 | n. 自尊；自负 | v. 以……为傲
definition_en: Pleasure and satisfaction in achievements, qualities, or people you value. | Respect for yourself, sometimes involving an exaggerated sense of importance. | To feel especially pleased about your own qualities or achievements.
example1_en: Her face shone with pride as she displayed her painting.
example1_zh: 她展示画作时，脸上洋溢着自豪。
example2_en: Schools can foster community pride by encouraging students to participate in projects that improve their local environment.
example2_zh: 学校可以鼓励学生参与改善当地环境的项目，从而培养社区自豪感。
collocations: take pride in｜为……感到自豪 ; a sense of pride｜自豪感 ; hurt someone's pride｜伤害某人的自尊 ; pride yourself on｜以自身的……为傲
tip_zh: 动词用pride oneself on；形容词用proud of。

meanings_zh: n. 便帽；鸭舌帽 | n. 瓶盖；保护盖 | v. 限制上限
definition_en: a soft hat, often with a stiff front part | a cover fitted over the end or opening of something | to set a maximum amount or level for something
example1_en: He pulled on his cap before leaving for practice.
example1_zh: 他戴上帽子后出门去训练。
example2_en: Governments could cap annual rent increases to protect households from sudden rises in housing costs.
example2_zh: 政府可以限制年度租金涨幅，以保护家庭免受住房成本骤增的影响。
collocations: baseball cap｜棒球帽 ; bottle cap｜瓶盖 ; cap spending｜限制支出 ; a cap on fees｜费用上限
tip_zh: cap作动词指设上限；a cap on后接受限项目。

meanings_zh: n. 灾难；灾祸 | n. 彻底的失败；糟糕的事
definition_en: An event causing great damage, suffering, or loss. | Something that goes extremely badly or fails completely.
example1_en: Dinner was a disaster because I burned the rice.
example1_zh: 晚餐糟透了，因为我把米饭烧焦了。
example2_en: Effective early warning systems can reduce the damage caused by natural disasters and help communities recover more quickly.
example2_zh: 有效的预警系统可以减少自然灾害造成的损失，并帮助社区更快恢复。
collocations: natural disaster｜自然灾害 ; disaster relief｜灾害救援 ; avert disaster｜避免灾难 ; a complete disaster｜彻底的失败
tip_zh: 也可夸张形容失败：The party was a disaster。

meanings_zh: n. 桃；桃子 | adj. 桃色的；浅粉橙色的
definition_en: A juicy fruit with fuzzy skin and a large hard stone | Having a pale pinkish orange colour
example1_en: She sliced a ripe peach into her breakfast bowl.
example1_zh: 她把一个熟桃切成片，放进早餐碗里。
example2_en: Peach growers may face reduced harvests when unusually warm winters disrupt the trees' natural flowering cycle.
example2_zh: 冬季异常温暖会扰乱桃树的自然开花周期，桃农可能因此面临减产。
collocations: a ripe peach｜熟桃 ; peach juice｜桃汁 ; a peach tree｜桃树
tip_zh: 桃核英式常说 stone，美式常说 pit。

meanings_zh: n. 入室盗贼
definition_en: someone who enters a building illegally to steal things
example1_en: A burglar climbed through the window while everyone was away.
example1_zh: 大家都不在家时，一名窃贼爬窗而入。
example2_en: Improved street lighting and secure doors may discourage burglars from targeting homes in residential areas.
example2_zh: 改善街道照明并安装牢固的门，可能使窃贼不敢对住宅区的房屋下手。
collocations: burglar alarm｜防盗警报器 ; deter burglars｜震慑入室盗贼 ; catch a burglar｜抓住入室盗贼
tip_zh: burglar指入室盗贼；robber通常指使用威胁的劫匪。

meanings_zh: n. 寄件人；发送者
definition_en: A person who sends a message, letter or package.
example1_en: The sender wrapped the parcel carefully before posting it.
example1_zh: 寄件人在邮寄前仔细包好了包裹。
example2_en: Email users should verify the sender before opening attachments to reduce the risk of digital fraud.
example2_zh: 电子邮件用户应在打开附件前核实发件人，以降低网络诈骗的风险。
collocations: the sender's address｜寄件人地址 ; return to sender｜退回寄件人 ; an unknown sender｜未知发件人
tip_zh: sender是发送者，recipient是接收者。

meanings_zh: n. 庄稼；农作物 | n. 一季的收成 | v. 裁剪；剪短
definition_en: a plant grown in large quantities for food or other uses | the amount of a plant harvested at one time | to remove outer parts of an image or cut hair short
example1_en: The farmer checked his wheat crop after the storm.
example1_zh: 暴风雨过后，农民查看了自己的小麦。
example2_en: Rising temperatures may reduce crop yields, threatening food security in regions that already experience water shortages.
example2_zh: 气温上升可能导致农作物减产，威胁本就缺水地区的粮食安全。
collocations: grow crops｜种植庄稼 ; crop yields｜农作物产量 ; a bumper crop｜大丰收 ; crop a photo｜裁剪照片
tip_zh: crop既指庄稼也指收成；动词可指裁剪照片。

meanings_zh: v. 使钦佩；留下深刻印象 | v. 使铭记；使意识到重要性
definition_en: to make someone admire or respect someone or something | to make someone understand how important something is
example1_en: Her homemade bread impressed everyone at the family dinner.
example1_zh: 她自制的面包让家宴上的每个人都赞不绝口。
example2_en: Applicants can impress potential employers by explaining how their practical experience matches the requirements of the role.
example2_zh: 求职者可以说明自己的实践经验如何符合岗位要求，从而给潜在雇主留下好印象。
collocations: impress someone with｜以……给某人留下好印象 ; be impressed by｜对……印象深刻 ; impress upon someone｜使某人牢记
tip_zh: impressed形容人的感受；impressive形容事物令人赞叹。

meanings_zh: v. 去取来；去接来 | v. 售得；卖得
definition_en: To go somewhere and bring someone or something back. | To be sold for a particular amount of money.
example1_en: Could you fetch my jacket from the bedroom?
example1_zh: 你能去卧室把我的夹克拿来吗？
example2_en: Homes near reliable public transport often fetch higher prices because buyers value convenient access to employment.
example2_zh: 公共交通便利可靠的地段，住宅往往售价更高，因为买家重视通勤的便利性。
collocations: fetch some water｜去取些水 ; fetch someone from school｜去学校接某人 ; fetch a high price｜卖个高价
tip_zh: fetch强调去后取回；bring只强调带来。

meanings_zh: n. 徽章；身份标识
definition_en: A small item worn to show identity, membership, or achievement.
example1_en: She pinned her new badge onto her jacket.
example1_zh: 她把新徽章别在了夹克上。
example2_en: Requiring visitors to wear a visible badge can improve security in schools and other public buildings.
example2_zh: 要求访客佩戴醒目的身份徽章，有助于提高学校及其他公共建筑的安全性。
collocations: wear a badge｜佩戴徽章 ; identity badge｜身份识别牌 ; a badge of honour｜荣誉的象征
tip_zh: 通常指佩戴的小徽章；奖牌一般用medal。

meanings_zh: v. 结冰；冷冻 | v. 冻结；暂停 | v. 突然僵住
definition_en: To become ice or make something extremely cold and solid. | To stop something changing or being used temporarily. | To stop moving suddenly because of fear or surprise.
example1_en: Freeze the leftover soup and eat it next week.
example1_zh: 把剩下的汤冷冻起来，下周再喝。
example2_en: Governments may freeze public transport fares to reduce financial pressure on households during economic downturns.
example2_zh: 在经济低迷时期，政府可能会冻结公共交通票价，以减轻家庭的经济压力。
collocations: freeze food｜冷冻食物 ; freeze wages｜冻结工资 ; freeze with fear｜吓得僵住
tip_zh: 过去式froze，过去分词frozen。

meanings_zh: n. 海关 | n. 关税 | n. 风俗；习俗
definition_en: The authority or place checking goods entering a country | Taxes charged on goods brought into a country | Traditional practices shared by a community or social group
example1_en: We opened our suitcases for inspection at customs.
example1_zh: 我们在海关打开行李箱接受检查。
example2_en: More efficient customs procedures can reduce delays at borders and support international trade without weakening security.
example2_zh: 更高效的海关程序可以减少边境延误，在不削弱安全保障的情况下促进国际贸易。
collocations: go through customs｜过海关 ; customs officer｜海关官员 ; customs duty｜关税 ; local customs｜当地习俗
tip_zh: 表示海关时保留词尾s；custom单数不表示海关。

meanings_zh: n. 药店；药房 | n. 药剂学
definition_en: A shop or hospital department that prepares and supplies medicines. | The study and practice of preparing and supplying medicines.
example1_en: I collected my medicine from the pharmacy after lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭后，我去药店取了药。
example2_en: A community pharmacy can improve access to healthcare by offering professional advice close to people's homes.
example2_zh: 社区药店能在居民家附近提供专业建议，使医疗保健服务更易获得。
collocations: community pharmacy｜社区药店 ; hospital pharmacy｜医院药房 ; study pharmacy｜学习药剂学
tip_zh: 药店可数，药剂学不可数；药剂师是pharmacist。

meanings_zh: n. 男校长
definition_en: A man who is in charge of a school.
example1_en: The headmaster welcomed new pupils at the school gate.
example1_zh: 男校长在校门口迎接新生。
example2_en: The headmaster introduced a mentoring programme to help younger pupils develop confidence and settle into school life.
example2_zh: 男校长推行了一项辅导计划，帮助低年级学生建立信心并适应学校生活。
collocations: school headmaster｜学校男校长 ; deputy headmaster｜男副校长 ; headmaster's office｜校长办公室
tip_zh: 指男性；英式headteacher不分性别，美式常用principal。

meanings_zh: adj. 体贴的；关心他人的 | n. 照护工作
definition_en: kind and concerned about other people's needs | the work of looking after people who need help
example1_en: Our caring neighbour brought soup when I was ill.
example1_zh: 我生病时，体贴的邻居送来了汤。
example2_en: A caring school environment can improve children's confidence and encourage them to seek help when needed.
example2_zh: 充满关怀的学校环境能增强孩子的信心，并鼓励他们在需要时寻求帮助。
collocations: a caring attitude｜关怀的态度 ; a caring profession｜照护类职业 ; a caring environment｜充满关怀的环境
tip_zh: caring指关心别人；careful指做事小心。

meanings_zh: n. 乘法 | n. 大量增加；繁殖
definition_en: Finding a total by adding equal groups together. | An increase in quantity, often through repeated reproduction.
example1_en: We practised multiplication by arranging buttons in equal rows.
example1_zh: 我们把纽扣排成等长的几行来练习乘法。
example2_en: A strong understanding of multiplication helps children develop the mathematical skills needed for science and financial literacy.
example2_zh: 扎实理解乘法有助于儿童发展学习科学和掌握财务知识所需的数学技能。
collocations: multiplication table｜乘法表 ; multiplication sign｜乘号 ; rapid multiplication｜快速繁殖；迅速增加
tip_zh: 乘法用multiplication；乘以可用multiplied by。

meanings_zh: v. 不喜欢；厌恶 | n. 反感；不喜欢
definition_en: To find someone or something unpleasant or not enjoyable. | A feeling of not liking someone or something.
example1_en: I dislike waiting outside when it is raining.
example1_zh: 我不喜欢下雨时在外面等候。
example2_en: Some students dislike group assignments because they feel that individual contributions are not assessed fairly.
example2_zh: 一些学生不喜欢小组作业，因为他们觉得个人贡献没有得到公平评价。
collocations: dislike doing something｜不喜欢做某事 ; a strong dislike of｜对……的强烈反感 ; take a dislike to｜开始讨厌
tip_zh: dislike后接名词或动名词：dislike waiting。

meanings_zh: n. 讲座；大学课堂讲授 | v. 讲课；作讲座 | v. 训斥；说教
definition_en: an educational talk given to an audience, especially university students | to give an educational talk to an audience | to criticize someone at length about their behaviour
example1_en: I stayed after the lecture to ask a question.
example1_zh: 讲座结束后，我留下来问了一个问题。
example2_en: Universities should combine traditional lectures with practical activities that encourage students to apply their knowledge.
example2_zh: 大学应将传统授课与鼓励学生运用知识的实践活动结合起来。
collocations: attend a lecture｜听讲座 ; give a lecture｜作讲座 ; lecture on biology｜讲授生物学 ; lecture someone about｜就某事训斥某人
tip_zh: lecture on讲授某主题；lecture someone可指训斥。

meanings_zh: n. 馅；夹心 | n. 补牙填料 | adj. 容易使人吃饱的
definition_en: Food placed inside a pie, sandwich, or similar item. | Material used to repair a hole in a tooth. | Making you feel full after eating.
example1_en: This pie has a warm apple and cinnamon filling.
example1_zh: 这个派里面是热乎乎的苹果肉桂馅。
example2_en: School lunches should offer filling meals that provide sufficient nutrients to support children's growth and concentration.
example2_zh: 学校午餐应提供有饱腹感且营养充足的饭菜，以支持儿童成长并帮助他们集中注意力。
collocations: a sandwich filling｜三明治夹馅 ; a dental filling｜补牙填料 ; a filling meal｜顶饱的一餐
tip_zh: 作形容词表示食物顶饱，不表示人已经吃饱。

meanings_zh: v. 钦佩；敬佩 | v. 欣赏；赞赏
definition_en: To respect someone for their qualities or achievements | To look at something with pleasure because it is attractive
example1_en: I admire my sister for staying calm under pressure.
example1_zh: 我钦佩姐姐在压力下依然保持冷静。
example2_en: People often admire successful athletes for their determination, but consistent training is equally important.
example2_zh: 人们常因成功运动员的毅力而钦佩他们，但坚持训练同样重要。
collocations: admire someone for something｜因某事钦佩某人 ; greatly admire｜十分钦佩 ; admire the view｜欣赏风景
tip_zh: admire sb for sth：因某事钦佩某人。

meanings_zh: n. 状况；状态 | n. 条件；环境 | n. 疾病；健康问题
definition_en: The physical state of someone or something | A requirement, or circumstances affecting life or activity | A medical problem affecting someone's health
example1_en: Despite its age, this bicycle is in excellent condition.
example1_zh: 这辆自行车虽然年头已久，但状况极佳。
example2_en: Improving working conditions can increase employee satisfaction and reduce the number of people leaving their jobs.
example2_zh: 改善工作条件可以提高员工满意度，并减少离职人数。
collocations: in good condition｜状况良好 ; working conditions｜工作条件 ; on condition that｜条件是 ; medical condition｜疾病；健康问题
tip_zh: 表状态通常不可数；表工作、生活环境常用复数。

meanings_zh: adj. 分开的；各自的 | v. 分开；分离
definition_en: not joined, shared, or considered together | to divide things or move them apart
example1_en: We keep clean towels in a separate cupboard.
example1_zh: 我们把干净毛巾放在一个单独的柜子里。
example2_en: Local authorities should provide separate bins for recyclable materials to make household waste sorting easier.
example2_zh: 地方政府应为可回收材料提供专用垃圾桶，让家庭垃圾分类更方便。
collocations: separate rooms｜分开的房间 ; separate from｜与……分开 ; separate accounts｜独立账户 ; separate waste｜分类垃圾
tip_zh: 形容词词尾读/ət/，动词词尾读/eɪt/。

meanings_zh: adj. 纯的；无杂质的 | adj. 纯粹的；完全的 | adj. 纯理论的
definition_en: not mixed with other substances | complete and containing nothing of a different kind | concerned with theory rather than practical uses
example1_en: This soft scarf is made from pure wool.
example1_zh: 这条柔软的围巾是纯羊毛制成的。
example2_en: Investment in pure science can lead to unexpected discoveries with important practical applications decades later.
example2_zh: 对纯理论科学的投资可能带来意想不到的发现，并在几十年后产生重要的实际应用。
collocations: pure water｜纯净水 ; pure wool｜纯羊毛 ; pure chance｜纯属偶然 ; pure mathematics｜纯数学
tip_zh: pure既可指无杂质，也可加强语气，如pure luck。

meanings_zh: v. 打哈欠 | n. 哈欠
definition_en: Open your mouth widely and breathe deeply from tiredness or boredom. | An involuntary wide opening of the mouth with a deep breath.
example1_en: I yawned twice while waiting for the kettle to boil.
example1_zh: 等水壶里的水烧开时，我打了两次哈欠。
example2_en: Students who regularly yawn during morning lessons may not be getting enough sleep at night.
example2_zh: 经常在早课上打哈欠的学生，可能夜间睡眠不足。
collocations: give a yawn｜打个哈欠 ; stifle a yawn｜忍住哈欠 ; yawn widely｜张大嘴打哈欠
tip_zh: 打哈欠可说yawn或give a yawn。

meanings_zh: n. 辣椒 | n. 辣味肉末豆子炖菜
definition_en: a small pepper with a strong, hot taste | a spicy dish usually made with meat, beans, and tomatoes
example1_en: Add one chopped chilli if you like spicy food.
example1_zh: 如果你喜欢吃辣，就加一根切碎的辣椒。
example2_en: Farmers growing chilli peppers may need reliable irrigation systems as rising temperatures increase water demand.
example2_zh: 随着气温上升导致需水量增加，辣椒种植户可能需要可靠的灌溉系统。
collocations: fresh chilli｜新鲜辣椒 ; chilli powder｜辣椒粉 ; chilli sauce｜辣椒酱
tip_zh: 英式拼写chilli，美式通常写chili。

meanings_zh: adj. 果实成熟的 | adj. 时机成熟的；适宜的
definition_en: Fully grown and ready to eat or harvest | Ready for a particular action or development
example1_en: These ripe peaches smell wonderful and taste very sweet.
example1_zh: 这些熟桃子闻起来很香，吃起来很甜。
example2_en: With public support growing, the time is ripe for governments to invest more in renewable energy.
example2_zh: 随着公众支持度上升，政府加大可再生能源投资的时机已经成熟。
collocations: ripe fruit｜成熟的水果 ; fully ripe｜完全成熟的 ; ripe for change｜变革时机成熟的 ; the time is ripe｜时机已经成熟
tip_zh: 水果成熟用ripe；人心智成熟通常用mature。

meanings_zh: adj. 臭的；难闻的
definition_en: having a strong, unpleasant smell
example1_en: Please leave those stinky shoes outside the front door.
example1_zh: 请把那些臭鞋放在前门外。
example2_en: Residents often describe neglected rubbish bins as stinky, highlighting how poor waste collection affects daily life.
example2_zh: 居民常说无人清理的垃圾桶臭气熏天，这凸显了垃圾清运不力对日常生活的影响。
collocations: stinky socks｜臭袜子 ; stinky shoes｜臭鞋 ; stinky rubbish｜发臭的垃圾
tip_zh: 非正式用语；正式写作可用foul-smelling。

meanings_zh: adj. 有天赋的；有才能的
definition_en: Having a natural ability to do something very well.
example1_en: My talented cousin painted this beautiful picture of our garden.
example1_zh: 我那位有绘画天赋的表亲画了这幅漂亮的花园图。
example2_en: Schools should provide opportunities for talented students to develop their abilities beyond the standard curriculum.
example2_zh: 学校应为有才华的学生提供机会，让他们在标准课程之外发展自己的能力。
collocations: a talented musician｜有天赋的音乐家 ; a talented artist｜有才华的艺术家 ; highly talented｜极具天赋的
tip_zh: talented强调天赋；skilled强调熟练技能。

meanings_zh: adj. 嫉妒的 | adj. 因担心失去爱而吃醋的
definition_en: unhappy because someone has something you want | upset because someone you love shows interest in another person
example1_en: I felt jealous when my cousin got a bicycle.
example1_zh: 表弟得到一辆自行车时，我心里很嫉妒。
example2_en: Social media can make users jealous of others whose lives appear more successful or exciting.
example2_zh: 社交媒体可能让用户嫉妒那些生活看起来更成功或更精彩的人。
collocations: jealous of someone｜嫉妒某人 ; feel jealous｜感到嫉妒 ; a jealous partner｜爱吃醋的伴侣
tip_zh: 常用be jealous of；既可指嫉妒，也可指吃醋。

meanings_zh: n. 花生；花生米 | n. 极少的钱
definition_en: an edible seed that grows underground inside a thin shell | a very small amount of money, expressed as peanuts
example1_en: She cracked the shell and ate the peanut inside.
example1_zh: 她剥开壳，吃掉了里面的花生米。
example2_en: Schools should consider peanut allergies when planning meals to ensure that all children can eat safely.
example2_zh: 学校安排膳食时应考虑花生过敏问题，确保所有儿童都能安全用餐。
collocations: peanut butter｜花生酱 ; peanut allergy｜花生过敏 ; roasted peanuts｜烤花生 ; work for peanuts｜为微薄报酬工作
tip_zh: 表示“极少的钱”时用复数peanuts，属非正式用法。

meanings_zh: adj. 法律的；与法律有关的 | adj. 合法的；法律允许的
definition_en: Relating to laws or the system that applies them | Allowed by the law
example1_en: We sought legal advice before signing the rental agreement.
example1_zh: 签订租赁协议前，我们征求了法律意见。
example2_en: Access to affordable legal services is essential for ensuring that disadvantaged citizens can defend their rights.
example2_zh: 让人们获得负担得起的法律服务，对保障弱势公民维护自身权利至关重要。
collocations: legal advice｜法律意见 ; legal action｜法律诉讼 ; legal rights｜法定权利 ; perfectly legal｜完全合法
tip_zh: legal可指“法律相关的”，不一定指“合法的”。

meanings_zh: n. 成套工具；装备 | n. 组装套件
definition_en: A set of tools or equipment for a particular activity | A set of parts used to build something
example1_en: We keep a first aid kit in the car.
example1_zh: 我们在车里备有一个急救包。
example2_en: Schools should provide basic science kits so that all pupils can take part in practical experiments.
example2_zh: 学校应提供基础科学实验套件，让所有学生都能参与动手实验。
collocations: first aid kit｜急救包 ; tool kit｜成套工具 ; repair kit｜修理工具包 ; kit someone out｜给某人配齐装备
tip_zh: kit指成套用品；kit sb out表示给某人配装备。

meanings_zh: adv. 更远地 | adj. 更远的
definition_en: At or to a greater distance. | Located at a greater distance.
example1_en: We walked farther along the beach before stopping for lunch.
example1_zh: 我们沿海滩又走了一段路才停下来吃午饭。
example2_en: As housing costs rise, many workers move farther from city centres and face longer daily commutes.
example2_zh: 随着住房成本上涨，许多上班族搬到离市中心更远的地方，每天通勤时间也随之增加。
collocations: farther away｜更远处 ; farther north｜更往北 ; farther from home｜离家更远
tip_zh: farther多指实际距离；进一步讨论用further。

meanings_zh: n. 女房东 | n. 酒馆女老板
definition_en: a woman who rents property or rooms to other people | a woman who owns or manages a pub
example1_en: Our landlady came round to fix the kitchen tap.
example1_zh: 我们的女房东过来修厨房水龙头。
example2_en: A responsible landlady should maintain safe housing conditions and respond promptly when tenants report serious problems.
example2_zh: 负责任的女房东应确保住房条件安全，并在租客报告严重问题时及时回应。
collocations: ask the landlady｜询问女房东 ; pay rent to the landlady｜向女房东交租 ; pub landlady｜酒馆女老板
tip_zh: landlady指女性；landlord可泛指房东。

meanings_zh: n. 女主人；女东道主 | n. 餐厅女迎宾员
definition_en: A woman who welcomes and entertains guests. | A woman who welcomes customers and takes them to restaurant tables.
example1_en: Our hostess brought out fresh fruit after dinner.
example1_zh: 晚餐后，女主人端来了新鲜水果。
example2_en: A welcoming hostess can help international visitors feel comfortable and encourage meaningful conversations across cultures.
example2_zh: 热情的女主人能让国际访客感到自在，并促进有意义的跨文化交流。
collocations: a gracious hostess｜亲切周到的女主人 ; the perfect hostess｜无可挑剔的女主人 ; restaurant hostess｜餐厅女迎宾员
tip_zh: hostess特指女性；host如今也可用于任何性别。

meanings_zh: adj. 随和的；不易烦躁的
definition_en: relaxed and not easily upset or worried
example1_en: Our easy-going neighbour never complains when our dog barks.
example1_zh: 我们随和的邻居从不因我们的狗叫而抱怨。
example2_en: Although an easy-going management style can reduce workplace stress, clear expectations remain essential for maintaining productivity.
example2_zh: 虽然随和的管理风格能减轻职场压力，但明确的要求对保持生产力仍然至关重要。
collocations: an easy-going personality｜随和的性格 ; an easy-going attitude｜随和的态度 ; an easy-going manner｜随和的举止
tip_zh: 形容性格随和、不易生气，不表示懒惰。

meanings_zh: adj. 沉默的；不说话的 | adj. 无声的；寂静的 | adj. 不发音的
definition_en: Not speaking or choosing not to speak. | Making no sound or containing no noise. | Written in a word but not pronounced.
example1_en: He remained silent while his sister explained the problem.
example1_zh: 妹妹解释问题时，他一直没有说话。
example2_en: Employees may remain silent about workplace problems if they fear losing their jobs.
example2_zh: 如果员工担心失去工作，就可能对职场问题保持沉默。
collocations: remain silent｜保持沉默 ; fall silent｜安静下来 ; silent film｜无声电影 ; silent letter｜不发音的字母
tip_zh: silent强调不出声；quiet也可表示声音很小。

meanings_zh: adj. 巨大的；极大的
definition_en: extremely large in size, amount, or degree
example1_en: An enormous pumpkin filled the basket on our kitchen table.
example1_zh: 一个巨大的南瓜占满了厨房桌上的篮子。
example2_en: Rapid urban growth places enormous pressure on housing, transport networks, and other essential public services.
example2_zh: 城市的快速发展给住房、交通网络及其他基本公共服务带来巨大压力。
collocations: enormous pressure｜巨大压力 ; an enormous amount of｜大量的 ; enormous potential｜巨大潜力
tip_zh: 既可形容体积，也可形容压力、数量或影响很大。

meanings_zh: n. 安排；筹备 | n. 排列；布置 | n. 商定；协议
definition_en: A plan or preparation for something that will happen. | The way objects are positioned or organised. | An agreement about how something will be done.
example1_en: We made arrangements for someone to feed the cat.
example1_zh: 我们安排了人来喂猫。
example2_en: Flexible working arrangements can help parents balance professional responsibilities with the demands of family life.
example2_zh: 灵活的工作安排可以帮助父母兼顾工作职责与家庭生活的需要。
collocations: make arrangements｜作出安排 ; travel arrangements｜旅行安排 ; flower arrangement｜插花 ; come to an arrangement｜达成协议
tip_zh: 表示具体筹备常用复数：make arrangements for。

meanings_zh: n. 方法；技巧；手法 | n. 技艺；技术水平
definition_en: A particular way of doing something, often requiring skill. | The skill someone shows when performing a particular activity.
example1_en: The coach showed me a better technique for swimming.
example1_zh: 教练向我示范了一种更好的游泳技巧。
example2_en: Teachers can use a range of assessment techniques to identify learning difficulties before students fall behind.
example2_zh: 教师可以运用多种评估方法，在学生落后之前发现他们的学习困难。
collocations: a technique for doing something｜做某事的方法 ; relaxation techniques｜放松技巧 ; improve your technique｜提高技艺 ; teaching techniques｜教学方法
tip_zh: technique重在具体方法；technology指科技。

meanings_zh: v. 放置；铺设 | v. 产卵；下蛋 | adj. 非专业的；非神职的
definition_en: to put something down carefully or arrange it flat | to produce eggs from the body | not professionally trained in a subject or ordained in religion
example1_en: Please lay the clean towels on the bathroom shelf.
example1_zh: 请把干净毛巾放在浴室架子上。
example2_en: Investment in early childhood education can lay the foundations for a more skilled and adaptable workforce.
example2_zh: 投资幼儿教育可以为培养技能更强、适应力更高的劳动力奠定基础。
collocations: lay the foundations｜奠定基础 ; lay eggs｜产卵 ; lay the table｜摆好餐具 ; lay cables｜铺设电缆
tip_zh: 放置用lay–laid–laid；躺下用lie–lay–lain。

meanings_zh: n. 赞美；称赞 | v. 称赞；赞美
definition_en: A remark expressing admiration or approval. | To tell someone that you admire something about them.
example1_en: Her compliment about my cooking made me smile.
example1_zh: 她对我厨艺的称赞让我笑了。
example2_en: Teachers who compliment students on specific improvements can strengthen motivation and encourage continued effort.
example2_zh: 教师若针对学生的具体进步给予表扬，就能增强学习动力，鼓励他们继续努力。
collocations: pay someone a compliment｜称赞某人 ; compliment someone on something｜称赞某人的某方面 ; accept a compliment｜接受赞美 ; a sincere compliment｜真诚的赞美
tip_zh: compliment是赞美；complement是补充、相辅相成。

meanings_zh: n. 退款；退还的金额 | v. 退还款项
definition_en: Money returned after a purchase or an overpayment. | To return money paid for something.
example1_en: The shop gave me a refund for the broken kettle.
example1_zh: 商店把坏水壶的货款退给了我。
example2_en: Airlines should offer passengers a full refund when flights are cancelled without reasonable alternatives.
example2_zh: 航班取消且没有合理的替代方案时，航空公司应向乘客提供全额退款。
collocations: a full refund｜全额退款 ; request a refund｜申请退款 ; refund the cost｜退还费用
tip_zh: 名词重音在前；动词读/rɪˈfʌnd/，重音在后。

meanings_zh: n. 体操
definition_en: A sport involving controlled movements that develop strength, balance, and flexibility.
example1_en: My sister practises gymnastics at the local sports centre.
example1_zh: 我姐姐在当地体育中心练体操。
example2_en: Including gymnastics in school programmes can help children develop coordination, physical confidence, and an interest in exercise.
example2_zh: 将体操纳入学校课程有助于儿童提高协调性、增强身体自信，并培养运动兴趣。
collocations: do gymnastics｜做体操 ; artistic gymnastics｜竞技体操 ; rhythmic gymnastics｜艺术体操
tip_zh: 虽以-s结尾，表示运动时作单数：gymnastics is。

meanings_zh: n. 权力；影响力 | n. 动力；电力 | v. 为…提供动力
definition_en: The ability or authority to control people, events, or decisions. | Energy used to make machines and equipment work. | To supply energy that makes something work.
example1_en: The manager has the power to change our shifts.
example1_zh: 经理有权调整我们的班次。
example2_en: Solar panels can power rural schools while reducing their dependence on expensive and unreliable fuel supplies.
example2_zh: 太阳能板可以为乡村学校供电，同时减少其对昂贵且不稳定的燃料供应的依赖。
collocations: political power｜政治权力 ; renewable power｜可再生能源电力 ; power supply｜电源；电力供应 ; the power to decide｜决定权
tip_zh: 表示有权做某事用have the power to do。

meanings_zh: n. 播客；播客节目 | v. 制作并发布播客
definition_en: An online audio programme available to stream or download. | To produce and distribute an online audio programme.
example1_en: I listen to a cooking podcast while making dinner.
example1_zh: 我做晚饭时会听一档烹饪播客。
example2_en: Educational podcasts allow learners to explore complex subjects while travelling or completing routine household tasks.
example2_zh: 教育类播客让学习者能够在出行或做日常家务时探索复杂的主题。
collocations: listen to a podcast｜收听播客 ; podcast episode｜一期播客 ; host a podcast｜主持播客节目 ; subscribe to a podcast｜订阅播客
tip_zh: 收听播客用listen to a podcast，别漏掉to。

meanings_zh: adv. 大量地；很大程度上 | adv. 沉重地；猛烈地
definition_en: To a great degree or in large amounts. | With great weight, force, or effort.
example1_en: It rained heavily while we waited for the bus.
example1_zh: 我们等公交车时，雨下得很大。
example2_en: Countries that rely heavily on imported fuel are particularly vulnerable to sudden changes in global energy prices.
example2_zh: 严重依赖进口燃料的国家尤其容易受到全球能源价格突变的影响。
collocations: rain heavily｜下大雨 ; rely heavily on｜严重依赖 ; invest heavily in｜大量投资于 ; breathe heavily｜喘粗气
tip_zh: 表示下大雨用rain heavily，不用rain strongly。

meanings_zh: n. 储液罐；水箱 | n. 坦克
definition_en: A large container for holding liquids or gases. | A heavily protected military vehicle that moves on tracks.
example1_en: The fish swam behind a rock in the tank.
example1_zh: 鱼游到了水族箱里的一块石头后面。
example2_en: Installing a rainwater tank allows households to water gardens without relying entirely on treated drinking water.
example2_zh: 安装雨水储水箱能让家庭浇灌花园时不必完全依赖经过处理的饮用水。
collocations: a water tank｜水箱 ; a fuel tank｜燃油箱 ; a fish tank｜水族箱 ; fill the tank｜加满油箱
tip_zh: fish tank是水族箱；汽车的油箱用fuel tank。

meanings_zh: v. 误解；误会
definition_en: to understand someone's words, actions, or intentions incorrectly
example1_en: Please don't misunderstand me; I really want to help.
example1_zh: 请别误会我，我真的想帮忙。
example2_en: Patients may misunderstand medical advice when professionals use technical language rather than clear explanations suited to their audience.
example2_zh: 如果医务人员使用专业术语，而不是适合患者理解的清晰解释，患者可能会误解医嘱。
collocations: misunderstand instructions｜误解指示 ; misunderstand someone's intentions｜误会某人的意图 ; easily misunderstood｜容易被误解
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为misunderstood。

meanings_zh: adj. 基础的；初级的 | adj. 小学的
definition_en: Related to the simplest or first stages of learning. | Relating to the first years of formal school education.
example1_en: This course teaches elementary cooking skills to complete beginners.
example1_zh: 这门课程向零基础学员教授基本烹饪技巧。
example2_en: Elementary education should develop children's curiosity as well as their ability to read and calculate.
example2_zh: 小学教育不仅应培养儿童的阅读和计算能力，还应激发他们的好奇心。
collocations: elementary knowledge｜基础知识 ; elementary school｜小学 ; elementary education｜小学教育 ; elementary level｜初级水平
tip_zh: elementary school主要用于美式英语，英式常用primary school。

meanings_zh: adj. 西部的；西方的 | adj. 西方国家及文化的 | n. 西部电影；西部小说
definition_en: In, from, or relating to the west of an area. | Relating to Europe, North America, and their associated cultures. | A film or story about the historical American West.
example1_en: Our cabin faces the lake on its western shore.
example1_zh: 我们的小屋位于湖的西岸，面朝湖水。
example2_en: Investment in western regions could improve transport links and reduce economic inequalities within the country.
example2_zh: 对西部地区的投资可以改善交通联系，减少国内经济差距。
collocations: the western coast｜西海岸 ; western regions｜西部地区 ; Western culture｜西方文化 ; a western film｜西部电影
tip_zh: 指西方国家或文化时常大写为 Western。

meanings_zh: n. 区域；地带 | v. 划定用途区域
definition_en: An area with a particular purpose, feature, or condition. | Officially assign land to a particular use.
example1_en: Cars are not allowed inside this quiet pedestrian zone.
example1_zh: 汽车不得驶入这片安静的步行区。
example2_en: Creating a low-emission zone can reduce air pollution, provided that affordable public transport is available.
example2_zh: 只要有价格合理的公共交通，设立低排放区就能减少空气污染。
collocations: a pedestrian zone｜步行区 ; a time zone｜时区 ; a residential zone｜住宅区 ; zone land for housing｜将土地划为住宅用地
tip_zh: zone强调特定用途或特征的区域；area含义更宽泛。

meanings_zh: n. 铁；铁元素 | n. 熨斗 | v. 熨烫
definition_en: A strong metal used in construction and needed by the body. | A tool with a heated base for smoothing clothes. | To make clothes smooth using a heated iron.
example1_en: These old iron gates are too heavy to lift.
example1_zh: 这些旧铁门太重，抬不起来。
example2_en: A diet containing sufficient iron can help prevent anaemia, particularly among children and pregnant women.
example2_zh: 摄入足量铁的饮食有助于预防贫血，对儿童和孕妇尤其重要。
collocations: iron deficiency｜缺铁 ; iron ore｜铁矿石 ; cast iron｜铸铁 ; iron a shirt｜熨衬衫
tip_zh: 铁是不可数名词；熨斗可数，用an iron。

meanings_zh: n. 移动；动作 | n. 社会运动 | n. 乐章
definition_en: an act of changing position or moving the body | an organised effort by people seeking shared social change | one main section of a long piece of music
example1_en: A sudden movement in the bushes caught my attention.
example1_zh: 灌木丛里突然有动静，引起了我的注意。
example2_en: The environmental movement has encouraged governments to adopt stronger policies on waste reduction and renewable energy.
example2_zh: 环保运动推动各国政府在减少废物和发展可再生能源方面采取更有力的政策。
collocations: freedom of movement｜行动自由 ; sudden movement｜突然的动作 ; environmental movement｜环保运动 ; social movement｜社会运动
tip_zh: 指具体动作或社会运动时可数；泛指移动可不可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 混合的；各类的 | adj. 好坏参半的；矛盾的
definition_en: containing different types of things or people | including both positive and negative feelings, opinions, or results
example1_en: I bought a bag of mixed nuts for our picnic.
example1_zh: 我买了一袋混合坚果，准备野餐时吃。
example2_en: The introduction of online lessons received mixed reactions from students, parents, and teachers.
example2_zh: 学生、家长和教师对引入网课的反应褒贬不一。
collocations: mixed feelings｜矛盾的心情 ; mixed results｜好坏参半的结果 ; mixed reactions｜褒贬不一的反应 ; mixed nuts｜混合坚果
tip_zh: mixed feelings指心情矛盾；mixed也是mix的过去分词。

meanings_zh: n. 品脱（容量单位）
definition_en: A liquid measure of about half a litre.
example1_en: Please add a pint of milk to the bowl.
example1_zh: 请往碗里加入一品脱牛奶。
example2_en: Consumers comparing international recipes should note that a British pint is larger than an American pint.
example2_zh: 比较不同国家食谱的消费者应注意，英制品脱比美制品脱大。
collocations: a pint of milk｜一品脱牛奶 ; half a pint｜半品脱 ; a pint glass｜品脱杯
tip_zh: 英制品脱约568毫升，美制液量品脱约473毫升。

meanings_zh: adv. 相隔；分开 | adv. 成碎片；散开 | adv. 除外
definition_en: separated by distance or time; not together | into separate pieces | except for something being considered
example1_en: We planted the young trees two metres apart.
example1_zh: 我们把这些小树间隔两米种下。
example2_en: Living apart from their families can make international students more independent, but may also cause loneliness.
example2_zh: 与家人分开生活可以让留学生更加独立，但也可能带来孤独感。
collocations: far apart｜相距很远 ; take apart｜拆开 ; apart from｜除……之外 ; tell apart｜区分
tip_zh: apart from可指“除外”或“除……还”，需看语境。

meanings_zh: n. 专家；行家 | adj. 专业的；熟练的
definition_en: Someone with extensive knowledge or skill in a particular subject. | Having or showing great knowledge or skill.
example1_en: We asked an expert to examine the old painting.
example1_zh: 我们请了一位专家来鉴定这幅旧画。
example2_en: Schools should seek expert advice before introducing new technology into classrooms to support student learning.
example2_zh: 学校在将新技术引入课堂以辅助学生学习之前，应征求专家意见。
collocations: an expert on｜某方面的专家 ; expert advice｜专家建议 ; medical expert｜医学专家
tip_zh: expert on/in表示某领域的专家。

meanings_zh: adj. 相似的；相像的 | adv. 同样地；两者都
definition_en: similar in appearance or character | in the same way, or equally for both groups
example1_en: These two jackets look alike, but one feels warmer.
example1_zh: 这两件夹克看起来很像，但有一件穿着更暖和。
example2_en: Public parks benefit children and adults alike by providing accessible spaces for exercise and relaxation.
example2_zh: 公共公园提供方便使用的运动和休闲空间，让儿童和成人同样受益。
collocations: look alike｜看起来相像 ; think alike｜想法相同 ; treat everyone alike｜一视同仁
tip_zh: 形容词通常放在系动词后，不放在名词前。

meanings_zh: n. 庆祝活动；庆典 | n. 庆祝
definition_en: A special event held to mark a happy occasion. | The act of showing happiness about something special.
example1_en: We decorated the garden for our grandparents' anniversary celebration.
example1_zh: 我们为祖父母的结婚周年庆祝活动布置了花园。
example2_en: Community celebrations can strengthen social bonds by bringing together residents from different cultural backgrounds.
example2_zh: 社区庆祝活动能让不同文化背景的居民相聚，从而加强社会联系。
collocations: hold a celebration｜举办庆祝活动 ; in celebration of｜为庆祝…… ; birthday celebration｜生日庆祝活动
tip_zh: 指具体庆祝活动时可数；指庆祝行为时不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 三角形 | n. 三角铁
definition_en: A flat shape with three straight sides and three angles. | A triangular metal musical instrument struck with a small metal stick.
example1_en: Fold the paper into a triangle before cutting it.
example1_zh: 先把纸折成三角形，再剪。
example2_en: Engineers often use triangles in bridge designs because these shapes provide strength without requiring excessive material.
example2_zh: 工程师常在桥梁设计中采用三角形，因为这种形状无需耗用过多材料就能提供强度。
collocations: right-angled triangle｜直角三角形 ; equilateral triangle｜等边三角形 ; love triangle｜三角恋
tip_zh: 英式说right-angled triangle，美式常说right triangle。

meanings_zh: n. 醋
definition_en: A sour liquid used to flavour or preserve food.
example1_en: Add a little vinegar to the salad dressing.
example1_zh: 往沙拉酱里加一点醋。
example2_en: Traditional food preservation methods often use vinegar to slow bacterial growth and extend the storage life of vegetables.
example2_zh: 传统食品保存方法常用醋来减缓细菌生长，延长蔬菜的储存时间。
collocations: rice vinegar｜米醋 ; wine vinegar｜葡萄酒醋 ; a splash of vinegar｜少量醋 ; pickled in vinegar｜用醋腌制的
tip_zh: 通常不可数，表示数量可用a bottle of vinegar。

meanings_zh: n. 图表 | v. 记录；跟踪；绘制图表 | n. 海图；航图
definition_en: a visual display of information, often showing comparisons or changes | to record or show how something develops over time | a detailed map used for navigation at sea or in air
example1_en: This colourful chart shows how we spend our money.
example1_zh: 这张彩色图表展示了我们把钱花在了哪些方面。
example2_en: The chart compares the proportion of commuters using public transport in three different cities.
example2_zh: 该图表比较了三个不同城市中使用公共交通的通勤者比例。
collocations: bar chart｜条形图 ; pie chart｜饼图 ; chart progress｜记录进展 ; navigation chart｜航海图
tip_zh: 图表用chart；普通地图用map，海图可用chart。

meanings_zh: adj. 寒冷的；有寒意的 | adj. 冷淡的；不友好的
definition_en: Unpleasantly cold, though usually not extremely cold. | Showing little warmth or friendliness towards someone.
example1_en: It felt chilly outside, so I grabbed my jacket.
example1_zh: 外面有些冷，所以我拿上了夹克。
example2_en: Providing warm public spaces during chilly weather can help protect older residents from cold-related illnesses.
example2_zh: 在寒冷天气提供温暖的公共场所，有助于保护老年居民免受寒冷引发的疾病侵害。
collocations: a chilly morning｜寒冷的早晨 ; feel chilly｜觉得冷 ; a chilly reception｜冷淡的接待
tip_zh: chilly比freezing程度轻，也可形容态度冷淡。

meanings_zh: n. 天赋；才能 | n. 人才；有才能的人
definition_en: A natural ability to do something well. | People who have strong abilities in a particular field.
example1_en: My cousin has a real talent for drawing animals.
example1_zh: 我的表亲画动物很有天赋。
example2_en: Schools should nurture creative talent alongside academic skills to help students develop a wider range of abilities.
example2_zh: 学校应在培养学业技能的同时培育创造性才能，帮助学生发展更广泛的能力。
collocations: a talent for｜在某方面的天赋 ; natural talent｜天生的才能 ; nurture talent｜培养人才 ; attract talent｜吸引人才
tip_zh: 表示某方面的天赋，用a talent for加名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: v. 弹起；使弹跳 | n. 弹跳；反弹 | v. 支票遭退票
definition_en: move back up after hitting a surface, or cause this | a movement back up after hitting a surface | be rejected by a bank because funds are insufficient
example1_en: The ball bounced over the fence into our neighbour's garden.
example1_zh: 球弹过篱笆，落进了邻居的花园。
example2_en: Local businesses can bounce back after economic shocks if they receive timely financial support.
example2_zh: 如果及时获得资金支持，当地企业就能在经济冲击后恢复元气。
collocations: bounce a ball｜拍球 ; bounce back｜恢复元气 ; a cheque bounces｜支票遭退票 ; bounce ideas off someone｜与某人交流想法
tip_zh: bounce back既可指弹回，也常指受挫后恢复。

meanings_zh: n. 放松；休息 | n. 肌肉松弛 | n. 规定的放宽
definition_en: Rest or enjoyable activity that reduces stress and tension. | The process of muscles becoming less tight. | The act of making rules or restrictions less strict.
example1_en: After work, I enjoy a warm bath for relaxation.
example1_zh: 下班后，我喜欢泡个热水澡放松一下。
example2_en: Schools should teach relaxation techniques to help students manage anxiety before important examinations.
example2_zh: 学校应教授放松技巧，帮助学生缓解重要考试前的焦虑。
collocations: relaxation techniques｜放松技巧 ; muscle relaxation｜肌肉松弛 ; relaxation of restrictions｜限制的放宽
tip_zh: 表示放松、休息时通常不可数：for relaxation。

meanings_zh: n. 金枪鱼；金枪鱼肉
definition_en: a large sea fish, or its flesh eaten as food
example1_en: I made a tuna sandwich for lunch today.
example1_zh: 我今天做了一个金枪鱼三明治当午餐。
example2_en: International cooperation is essential to prevent overfishing and ensure that tuna populations remain healthy for future generations.
example2_zh: 国际合作对于防止过度捕捞、确保金枪鱼种群为后代保持健康至关重要。
collocations: tuna sandwich｜金枪鱼三明治 ; canned tuna｜罐装金枪鱼 ; bluefin tuna｜蓝鳍金枪鱼 ; tuna stocks｜金枪鱼资源量
tip_zh: 指鱼肉时不可数；指鱼时复数通常仍为tuna。

meanings_zh: n. 着陆；登陆 | n. 楼梯平台
definition_en: The act of reaching the ground or shore. | A flat area at the top of or between stairs.
example1_en: The plane made a smooth landing despite the wind.
example1_zh: 尽管有风，飞机还是平稳着陆了。
example2_en: Improved weather forecasting can help pilots prepare for a safe landing during rapidly changing conditions.
example2_zh: 更准确的天气预报能帮助飞行员在天气快速变化时做好安全着陆的准备。
collocations: emergency landing｜紧急着陆 ; smooth landing｜平稳着陆 ; landing gear｜起落架 ; upstairs landing｜楼上的楼梯平台
tip_zh: 除“着陆”外，也指楼梯顶部或中间的平台。

meanings_zh: adj. 时髦的；有格调的
definition_en: Attractive and fashionable in appearance or design
example1_en: Her stylish green jacket looked great with plain trousers.
example1_zh: 她那件时髦的绿色夹克搭配素色长裤很好看。
example2_en: Affordable, stylish furniture can encourage young consumers to choose recycled materials for their homes.
example2_zh: 价格实惠且设计时尚的家具，可以鼓励年轻消费者为家中选用再生材料。
collocations: stylish clothes｜时髦的衣服 ; a stylish design｜有格调的设计 ; a stylish interior｜雅致的室内空间
tip_zh: stylish强调时尚美观；不等于昂贵或奢华。

meanings_zh: adj. 国家的；全国的 | n. 某国国民
definition_en: relating to a whole country or its people | a person who is a citizen of a particular country
example1_en: My sister hopes to join the national swimming team.
example1_zh: 我姐姐希望加入国家游泳队。
example2_en: National policies can help reduce regional differences in access to healthcare and education.
example2_zh: 国家政策有助于缩小医疗和教育机会方面的地区差异。
collocations: national identity｜国家认同 ; national park｜国家公园 ; national government｜中央政府 ; foreign national｜外国公民
tip_zh: national侧重一国整体；international指国际的。

meanings_zh: n. 长笛
definition_en: A wind instrument held sideways and played by blowing across it.
example1_en: She practises the flute by her bedroom window every afternoon.
example1_zh: 她每天下午都在卧室窗边练习长笛。
example2_en: Learning to play the flute can develop concentration and encourage children to participate in musical ensembles.
example2_zh: 学习吹长笛可以培养专注力，并鼓励儿童参加合奏团体。
collocations: play the flute｜吹长笛 ; a flute solo｜长笛独奏 ; flute lessons｜长笛课
tip_zh: 英式常称演奏者为flautist，美式常用flutist。

meanings_zh: n. 天花板 | n. 上限；最高限额
definition_en: the inside surface at the top of a room | the highest amount or level that is allowed
example1_en: A small spider was crawling across the ceiling.
example1_zh: 一只小蜘蛛正爬过天花板。
example2_en: A ceiling on annual rent increases could protect tenants, although it might discourage investment in housing.
example2_zh: 限制年度租金涨幅可以保护租户，但也可能抑制住房投资。
collocations: high ceiling｜高天花板 ; ceiling fan｜吊扇 ; price ceiling｜价格上限 ; set a ceiling on｜为……设定上限
tip_zh: ceiling是室内天花板；roof是建筑外部的屋顶。

meanings_zh: adj. 宁静的；安详的 | adj. 和平的；非暴力的
definition_en: quiet and calm, without disturbance or worry | not involving war, violence, or fighting
example1_en: The lake looks peaceful in the early morning light.
example1_zh: 晨光中的湖泊显得格外宁静。
example2_en: Creating peaceful public spaces can improve residents' wellbeing and encourage more people to spend time outdoors.
example2_zh: 营造宁静的公共空间可以提升居民的幸福感，并鼓励更多人到户外活动。
collocations: peaceful surroundings｜宁静的周边环境 ; peaceful protest｜和平抗议 ; peaceful solution｜和平解决办法
tip_zh: 可形容环境安静，也可指行动不使用暴力。

meanings_zh: n. 想象力；想象
definition_en: The ability to form mental pictures or invent new ideas.
example1_en: With a little imagination, this box becomes a spaceship.
example1_zh: 只需一点想象力，这个盒子就能变成宇宙飞船。
example2_en: Creative activities encourage children to use their imagination and approach unfamiliar problems from different perspectives.
example2_zh: 创意活动鼓励儿童运用想象力，从不同角度处理陌生的问题。
collocations: use your imagination｜发挥想象力 ; vivid imagination｜丰富的想象力 ; capture the imagination｜引发遐想 ; a figment of the imagination｜凭空想象的事物
tip_zh: imaginative指有想象力的；imaginary指想象中的。

meanings_zh: adj. 不友好的；冷淡的 | adj. 不利的；难以使用的
definition_en: not kind or welcoming towards others | making an activity difficult or causing harm
example1_en: The new neighbour seemed unfriendly but was simply shy.
example1_zh: 新邻居看似冷淡，其实只是害羞。
example2_en: An unfriendly working environment can discourage employees from sharing ideas and seeking support.
example2_zh: 不友好的工作环境可能使员工不愿分享想法或寻求支持。
collocations: unfriendly atmosphere｜冷淡的氛围 ; unfriendly attitude｜不友好的态度 ; environmentally unfriendly｜对环境不利的
tip_zh: 虽以-ly结尾，但通常是形容词，不是副词。

meanings_zh: n. 雷；雷声 | v. 打雷；轰隆作响
definition_en: The loud sound in the sky caused by lightning | Produce thunder or make a similarly loud, deep noise
example1_en: A sudden clap of thunder made the windows shake.
example1_zh: 一声突如其来的雷鸣震得窗户直晃。
example2_en: Outdoor sports events should be suspended when thunder indicates that a storm is dangerously close.
example2_zh: 当雷声表明雷暴已逼近到危险距离时，应暂停户外体育赛事。
collocations: a clap of thunder｜一声雷响 ; a rumble of thunder｜低沉的隆隆雷声 ; thunder and lightning｜雷电
tip_zh: thunder指雷声，通常不可数；lightning指闪电。

meanings_zh: n. 挑战；艰巨任务 | v. 质疑；提出异议 | v. 向…挑战；考验
definition_en: A difficult task or situation that tests someone's abilities. | Question whether something is true, fair, or acceptable. | Invite someone to compete or test their abilities.
example1_en: Cooking dinner for twelve guests was quite a challenge.
example1_zh: 给十二位客人做晚饭真是个不小的挑战。
example2_en: Providing affordable housing remains a major challenge for cities experiencing rapid population growth and rising land prices.
example2_zh: 对于人口快速增长、地价不断上涨的城市而言，提供可负担住房仍是一项重大挑战。
collocations: face a challenge｜面临挑战 ; meet a challenge｜成功应对挑战 ; challenge an assumption｜质疑假设 ; challenge someone to a contest｜向某人发起比赛挑战
tip_zh: challenge作动词可直接接观点，表示质疑。

meanings_zh: n. 茶杯
definition_en: A small cup with a handle, used for drinking tea.
example1_en: She placed a delicate teacup beside the biscuit plate.
example1_zh: 她把一只精致的茶杯放在饼干盘旁。
example2_en: A museum display of decorated teacups can reveal how domestic tastes and manufacturing techniques changed over time.
example2_zh: 博物馆展出的装饰茶杯可以揭示家居审美和制造技术如何随时间变化。
collocations: a china teacup｜瓷茶杯 ; a teacup and saucer｜茶杯和茶托 ; a storm in a teacup｜小题大做
tip_zh: teacup是茶杯；a cup of tea是一杯茶。

meanings_zh: v. 上传 | n. 上传；上传的文件
definition_en: to transfer files from a device to an online system | the transfer of a file online, or the file itself
example1_en: I uploaded our picnic photos to a shared folder.
example1_zh: 我把我们野餐的照片上传到了共享文件夹。
example2_en: Students can upload their assignments to a secure platform, allowing teachers to provide timely feedback.
example2_zh: 学生可以将作业上传至安全平台，方便教师及时提供反馈。
collocations: upload a file｜上传文件 ; upload photos｜上传照片 ; upload to a server｜上传至服务器
tip_zh: 上传用upload，下载用download；上传至某处用to。

meanings_zh: n. 纸巾 | n. 组织
definition_en: A small piece of soft paper used for wiping. | A group of similar cells performing a particular bodily function.
example1_en: She handed me a tissue when I sneezed.
example1_zh: 我打喷嚏时，她递给我一张纸巾。
example2_en: Scientists are developing new treatments that help damaged tissue recover more effectively after an injury.
example2_zh: 科学家正在开发新疗法，帮助受损组织在受伤后更有效地修复。
collocations: a box of tissues｜一盒纸巾 ; muscle tissue｜肌肉组织 ; damaged tissue｜受损组织 ; tissue repair｜组织修复
tip_zh: 纸巾是可数名词；生物组织通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 陈述；说法 | n. 声明 | n. 账单；结算单
definition_en: something said or written to express information or an opinion | a formal public announcement about a particular matter | a record showing financial transactions over a period
example1_en: Her statement about the broken window surprised everyone.
example1_zh: 她关于那扇破窗的说法让所有人都很惊讶。
example2_en: The council issued a statement explaining how the proposed transport scheme would benefit residents with limited mobility.
example2_zh: 市议会发表声明，解释拟议的交通方案将如何惠及行动不便的居民。
collocations: make a statement｜作出陈述 ; issue a statement｜发表声明 ; a bank statement｜银行对账单 ; a witness statement｜证人陈述
tip_zh: 作“陈述”时是可数名词；银行对账单也用statement。

meanings_zh: n. 新娘；准新娘
definition_en: A woman who is getting married or has just married.
example1_en: The bride held fresh flowers as she entered the garden.
example1_zh: 新娘手捧鲜花走进花园。
example2_en: In many cultures, the bride and her family share responsibility for organising the wedding celebration.
example2_zh: 在许多文化中，新娘及其家人共同负责筹办婚礼庆典。
collocations: bride and groom｜新娘与新郎 ; a beautiful bride｜美丽的新娘 ; a bride-to-be｜准新娘
tip_zh: bride指新娘，groom指新郎。

meanings_zh: adj. 困惑的；糊涂的 | adj. 混乱的；难懂的
definition_en: unable to understand something or think clearly | unclear or difficult to follow because of poor organisation
example1_en: I felt confused when both doors led outside.
example1_zh: 两扇门都通向外面，让我感到困惑。
example2_en: Students may become confused if teachers introduce too many unfamiliar concepts in a single lesson.
example2_zh: 如果教师在一堂课中引入太多陌生概念，学生可能会感到困惑。
collocations: confused about｜对……感到困惑 ; look confused｜显得困惑 ; a confused account｜混乱的叙述
tip_zh: confused形容人困惑；confusing形容事物令人困惑。

meanings_zh: adv. 很少；难得
definition_en: Not often; on very few occasions.
example1_en: We rarely eat outside when the weather turns cold.
example1_zh: 天气转冷时，我们很少在户外吃饭。
example2_en: People living in remote villages rarely have easy access to specialist medical services.
example2_zh: 住在偏远村庄的人很少能方便地获得专科医疗服务。
collocations: rarely ever｜极少 ; rarely seen｜罕见的 ; rarely used｜很少使用的
tip_zh: 通常放实义动词前、be动词后；本身有否定意味。

meanings_zh: n. 预约；预订 | n. 疑虑；保留意见
definition_en: An arrangement to keep a room, seat, or table available. | A doubt that prevents complete acceptance of something.
example1_en: I made a reservation for dinner by the window.
example1_zh: 我预订了一个靠窗的位置吃晚饭。
example2_en: Some residents expressed reservations about the proposed airport expansion because of increased noise pollution.
example2_zh: 一些居民担心噪声污染加剧，对拟议中的机场扩建持保留意见。
collocations: make a reservation｜预订 ; cancel a reservation｜取消预订 ; have reservations about｜对……有疑虑 ; without reservation｜毫无保留地
tip_zh: 表示疑虑常用复数：have reservations about。

meanings_zh: n. 最低限度；最小量 | adj. 最低的；最小的
definition_en: The smallest amount or level possible or allowed. | Being the smallest amount or level possible or allowed.
example1_en: Please keep the noise to a minimum tonight.
example1_zh: 今晚请尽量保持安静。
example2_en: A higher minimum wage may improve living standards for workers in low-paid service jobs.
example2_zh: 提高最低工资可能改善低薪服务业劳动者的生活水平。
collocations: a minimum of｜至少 ; keep something to a minimum｜将某事物减至最低程度 ; minimum wage｜最低工资 ; minimum requirements｜最低要求
tip_zh: a minimum of 后接数量，表示“至少”。

meanings_zh: n. 公告；宣布
definition_en: a public statement giving people information or news
example1_en: We heard an announcement about our train being delayed.
example1_zh: 我们听到了一则关于所乘列车晚点的通知。
example2_en: The government's announcement of additional education funding was welcomed by teachers and parents.
example2_zh: 政府宣布追加教育经费，受到教师和家长的欢迎。
collocations: make an announcement｜发布公告 ; official announcement｜官方公告 ; public announcement｜公开声明
tip_zh: 表示发布公告时用make an announcement。

meanings_zh: n. 翅膀；机翼 | n. 建筑物的侧翼 | n. 组织内的派别
definition_en: A body part or aircraft structure that enables flight. | A section extending from the main part of a building. | A group within an organisation sharing particular views or aims.
example1_en: The bird stretched its wings before leaving the branch.
example1_zh: 那只鸟飞离树枝前展开了翅膀。
example2_en: The hospital's new wing will provide additional beds and specialist facilities for the region's growing population.
example2_zh: 医院新建的侧楼将提供更多床位和专科设施，以服务该地区不断增长的人口。
collocations: spread your wings｜展开翅膀；拓展自我 ; aircraft wing｜飞机机翼 ; hospital wing｜医院侧楼 ; left wing｜左翼
tip_zh: 鸟的翅膀和飞机机翼都用wing，通常成对用复数。

meanings_zh: n. 动物的角 | n. 车辆喇叭 | n. 圆号；号角
definition_en: A hard pointed growth on the head of some animals. | A device on a vehicle that makes a loud warning sound. | A musical instrument played by blowing into a tube.
example1_en: The goat caught its horn in the fence.
example1_zh: 那只山羊的角卡在了栅栏里。
example2_en: Frequent use of car horns contributes to noise pollution and reduces residents' quality of life.
example2_zh: 频繁使用汽车喇叭会造成噪声污染，降低居民的生活质量。
collocations: sound the horn｜鸣喇叭 ; blow a horn｜吹号角 ; a pair of horns｜一对角
tip_zh: 动物的角和车辆喇叭都用horn，均为可数名词。

meanings_zh: n. 运河；人工水渠 | n. 身体内的管道
definition_en: an artificial waterway for boats or carrying water | a narrow passage inside the body
example1_en: We watched a narrow boat glide along the canal.
example1_zh: 我们看着一艘窄船沿运河缓缓驶过。
example2_en: Restoring historic canals can attract tourists while providing valuable habitats for wildlife in densely populated urban areas.
example2_zh: 修复历史悠久的运河既能吸引游客，也能为人口密集城区的野生动物提供宝贵的栖息地。
collocations: irrigation canal｜灌溉水渠 ; canal boat｜运河船 ; ear canal｜耳道
tip_zh: canal通常为人工水道；river指天然河流。

meanings_zh: n. 野生动物；野生生物
definition_en: Animals and other living things in their natural surroundings.
example1_en: We watched the wildlife quietly from behind the trees.
example1_zh: 我们躲在树后，静静地观察野生动物。
example2_en: Protecting wildlife requires governments to preserve natural habitats and limit development in environmentally sensitive areas.
example2_zh: 保护野生生物需要政府维护自然栖息地，并限制生态敏感地区的开发。
collocations: protect wildlife｜保护野生生物 ; wildlife conservation｜野生生物保护 ; a wildlife reserve｜野生生物保护区
tip_zh: 不可数名词；wildlife park中作名词定语。

meanings_zh: n. 胸部；胸腔 | n. 大箱子；储物箱
definition_en: The upper front part of the body, enclosing heart and lungs. | A large strong box with a lid, used for storage.
example1_en: She held the sleeping kitten gently against her chest.
example1_zh: 她把熟睡的小猫轻轻抱在胸前。
example2_en: Workers exposed to polluted air may develop chest problems, highlighting the importance of effective workplace ventilation.
example2_zh: 接触污染空气的工人可能出现胸部疾病，这凸显了工作场所有效通风的重要性。
collocations: chest pain｜胸痛 ; a chest infection｜胸部感染 ; a wooden chest｜木箱 ; a chest of drawers｜抽屉柜
tip_zh: chest指胸部或大箱子；chest of drawers才是抽屉柜。

meanings_zh: adv. 自然地；天然地 | adv. 当然；自然会 | adv. 天生地
definition_en: Through natural processes rather than human action | As would normally be expected | Because of qualities someone or something has from birth
example1_en: Let your hair dry naturally after you wash it.
example1_zh: 洗完头后，让头发自然晾干。
example2_en: Some pollutants occur naturally in the environment, but human activities can increase their concentration to harmful levels.
example2_zh: 某些污染物天然存在于环境中，但人类活动会使其浓度上升到有害水平。
collocations: occur naturally｜天然存在 ; naturally curious｜天生好奇的 ; come naturally to someone｜对某人来说轻而易举 ; dry naturally｜自然晾干
tip_zh: 句首Naturally常表示“当然”，不一定指天然。

meanings_zh: adv. 几乎不；几乎没有 | adv. 刚刚；才
definition_en: almost not, or only to a very small degree | only just, before something else happens
example1_en: I could hardly hear you over the heavy rain.
example1_zh: 雨声太大，我几乎听不见你说话。
example2_en: Expanding roads alone is hardly sufficient to solve traffic congestion without improvements to public transport.
example2_zh: 如果不改善公共交通，仅靠拓宽道路几乎不足以解决交通拥堵。
collocations: hardly ever｜几乎从不 ; hardly any｜几乎没有 ; can hardly wait｜迫不及待 ; hardly surprising｜不足为奇
tip_zh: hardly意为几乎不，并非hard的副词形式。

meanings_zh: n. 安全；平安
definition_en: the state of being protected from danger or harm
example1_en: Please wear a helmet for your own safety.
example1_zh: 为了你自身的安全，请戴上头盔。
example2_en: Improving road safety requires better street design as well as stricter enforcement of traffic laws.
example2_zh: 改善道路安全既需要更好的街道设计，也需要更严格地执行交通法规。
collocations: road safety｜道路安全 ; safety standards｜安全标准 ; for safety reasons｜出于安全考虑 ; reach safety｜到达安全地带
tip_zh: 通常不可数；safe是形容词，safety是名词。

meanings_zh: n. 乡间小屋；村舍
definition_en: A small house, usually in the countryside.
example1_en: Their cottage has a tiny garden full of roses.
example1_zh: 他们的乡间小屋有一个种满玫瑰的小花园。
example2_en: Converting an unused cottage into holiday accommodation can provide rural families with an additional source of income.
example2_zh: 将闲置的村舍改为度假住宿，可以为农村家庭增加一项收入来源。
collocations: a country cottage｜乡间小屋 ; a thatched cottage｜茅草顶村舍 ; a holiday cottage｜度假小屋
tip_zh: 通常指乡间小住宅，不等同于豪华的villa。

meanings_zh: adj. 喜欢的；喜爱的 | adj. 深情的；温情的
definition_en: having a liking or affection for someone or something | showing or expressing warmth and affection
example1_en: My grandmother is fond of walking by the river.
example1_zh: 我奶奶喜欢在河边散步。
example2_en: Many adults retain fond memories of teachers who encouraged their curiosity and supported their ambitions.
example2_zh: 许多成年人仍深情地记得那些激发他们好奇心、支持他们志向的老师。
collocations: be fond of｜喜欢 ; fond memories｜温馨的回忆 ; a fond farewell｜深情的告别
tip_zh: be fond of后接名词或动词-ing，不接to do。

meanings_zh: n. 展览；展览会
definition_en: A public display of art, objects, or products.
example1_en: We visited a photography exhibition at the local museum.
example1_zh: 我们参观了当地博物馆的一场摄影展。
example2_en: An interactive exhibition can make scientific discoveries more accessible to children and encourage their interest in research.
example2_zh: 互动展览能让儿童更容易理解科学发现，并激发他们对研究的兴趣。
collocations: art exhibition｜艺术展 ; hold an exhibition｜举办展览 ; on exhibition｜在展出
tip_zh: exhibition指整场展览；exhibit可指一件展品。

meanings_zh: n. 困难；费力 | n. 难题；困境
definition_en: The state of being hard to do or understand. | A problem that makes progress or success harder.
example1_en: I had difficulty opening the jar with wet hands.
example1_zh: 我手湿着，很难打开那个罐子。
example2_en: Students with limited internet access may have difficulty completing assignments that require extensive online research.
example2_zh: 网络使用受限的学生可能难以完成需要大量网上研究的作业。
collocations: have difficulty doing something｜做某事有困难 ; overcome difficulties｜克服困难 ; financial difficulties｜经济困难 ; with difficulty｜费力地
tip_zh: 用have difficulty doing，不用difficulty to do。

meanings_zh: n. 蒸汽；水汽 | v. 蒸；用蒸汽烹调
definition_en: The gas water becomes when heated, often seen as white mist. | To cook food using steam from boiling water.
example1_en: Steam rose from the soup as I lifted the lid.
example1_zh: 我揭开盖子时，汤里升起了热气。
example2_en: Some power stations use heat to produce steam, which drives turbines and generates electricity.
example2_zh: 一些发电站利用热量产生蒸汽，推动涡轮机发电。
collocations: steam engine｜蒸汽机 ; steam vegetables｜蒸蔬菜 ; give off steam｜冒出蒸汽 ; run out of steam｜耗尽精力
tip_zh: steam作名词通常不可数；作动词可表示蒸食物。

meanings_zh: n. 惊恐；震惊；厌恶 | n. 恐怖作品类型
definition_en: a strong feeling of fear, shock, or disgust | a type of fiction intended to frighten its audience
example1_en: She watched in horror as her laptop fell downstairs.
example1_zh: 她惊恐地看着自己的笔记本电脑掉下楼梯。
example2_en: Horror films often use music and lighting to create tension rather than relying entirely on frightening images.
example2_zh: 恐怖电影常用音乐和灯光制造紧张气氛，而非完全依赖吓人的画面。
collocations: in horror｜惊恐地 ; a horror film｜恐怖片 ; a sense of horror｜恐惧感
tip_zh: 情绪义通常不可数；in horror表示惊恐地。

meanings_zh: n. 传记
definition_en: a written account of someone's life by another person
example1_en: I'm reading a biography of an explorer before bed.
example1_zh: 我睡前正在读一本探险家的传记。
example2_en: A well-researched biography can reveal how social conditions influence an individual's choices and achievements.
example2_zh: 一本研究扎实的传记可以揭示社会条件如何影响个人的选择与成就。
collocations: write a biography｜写传记 ; a biography of someone｜某人的传记 ; an authorised biography｜经本人授权的传记
tip_zh: biography是他人为某人写的传记；自传用autobiography。

meanings_zh: v. 打赌；押注 | v. 敢肯定；确信 | n. 赌注；打赌
definition_en: to risk money on the result of an uncertain event | to say confidently that something is true or will happen | an agreement to risk money on an uncertain result
example1_en: I bet you left your keys in the kitchen.
example1_zh: 我敢说你把钥匙落在厨房了。
example2_en: Some investors bet on emerging technologies despite considerable uncertainty about their future commercial success.
example2_zh: 一些投资者押注新兴技术，尽管这些技术未来能否取得商业成功仍很不确定。
collocations: bet on｜押注于 ; place a bet｜下注 ; I bet｜我敢说 ; a safe bet｜稳妥的选择
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词通常仍是bet；I bet常表确信。

meanings_zh: n. 地点；场址；遗址 | n. 网站 | v. 为……选址；设置
definition_en: A place where something is built, happens, or once existed. | A collection of connected web pages. | Place or build something in a particular location.
example1_en: Workers put a fence around the building site.
example1_zh: 工人们在建筑工地周围围起了围栏。
example2_en: The proposed hospital site is close to public transport, making healthcare more accessible to residents.
example2_zh: 拟建医院的选址靠近公共交通，方便居民获得医疗服务。
collocations: building site｜建筑工地 ; historic site｜历史遗址 ; on site｜在现场 ; site a factory｜为工厂选址
tip_zh: site指地点或网站；sight指视力或景象，二者同音。

meanings_zh: v. 回答；回复 | v. 作出反应；响应
definition_en: To say or write something in reply. | To react to something through actions or physical changes.
example1_en: I asked about dinner, but nobody responded to my message.
example1_zh: 我发消息问晚饭怎么安排，却没人回复。
example2_en: Healthcare systems must respond quickly to changing population needs while maintaining high standards of care.
example2_zh: 医疗体系必须迅速回应不断变化的人口需求，同时维持高水平的医疗服务。
collocations: respond to a question｜回答问题 ; respond to treatment｜对治疗产生反应 ; respond promptly｜及时回应 ; respond positively｜积极回应
tip_zh: respond to后接回应对象，不能直接接宾语。

meanings_zh: n. 协议；协定 | n. 同意；意见一致 | n. 语法上的一致关系
definition_en: an arrangement accepted by two or more people or groups | the state of sharing an opinion or accepting a proposal | a grammatical match between related words in a sentence
example1_en: We reached an agreement about sharing the kitchen.
example1_zh: 我们就共用厨房达成了协议。
example2_en: International agreements on carbon emissions are more effective when participating countries establish clear targets and monitor progress.
example2_zh: 当参与国设定明确目标并监督进展时，关于碳排放的国际协定会更加有效。
collocations: reach an agreement｜达成协议 ; sign an agreement｜签署协议 ; be in agreement｜意见一致 ; subject–verb agreement｜主谓一致
tip_zh: 具体协议可数；表示意见一致时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 网络；关系网 | n. 广播网；电视网 | v. 建立人脉
definition_en: A system of connected people, things or places. | A group of broadcasting stations sharing programmes. | To meet people and develop useful professional relationships.
example1_en: Our home network connects three laptops and a printer.
example1_zh: 我们的家庭网络连接着三台笔记本电脑和一台打印机。
example2_en: An efficient public transport network can reduce traffic congestion and improve access to employment.
example2_zh: 高效的公共交通网络可以缓解交通拥堵，并让人们更方便地前往工作地点。
collocations: transport network｜交通网络 ; wireless network｜无线网络 ; support network｜支持网络 ; network with colleagues｜与同行建立联系
tip_zh: network强调多个节点之间相互连接。

meanings_zh: v. 含有；容纳 | v. 控制；遏制
definition_en: to have something inside or as a part | to prevent something from spreading or becoming stronger
example1_en: This small box contains all my sewing supplies.
example1_zh: 这个小盒子里装着我所有的缝纫用品。
example2_en: Processed foods often contain large amounts of salt, which can contribute to serious health problems.
example2_zh: 加工食品往往含有大量盐分，可能导致严重的健康问题。
collocations: contain ingredients｜含有成分 ; contain the spread｜遏制蔓延 ; contain costs｜控制成本 ; contain your excitement｜抑制兴奋
tip_zh: 及物动词，直接接宾语；表示“含有”时通常不用进行时。

meanings_zh: n. 日光；白昼
definition_en: Natural light from the sun, or the time it is available.
example1_en: Let's finish planting these flowers while there's still daylight.
example1_zh: 趁天还亮着，我们把这些花种完吧。
example2_en: Designing classrooms to receive more daylight can reduce electricity use and create a more comfortable learning environment.
example2_zh: 在设计教室时增加自然采光，可以减少用电并营造更舒适的学习环境。
collocations: in broad daylight｜在光天化日之下 ; daylight hours｜白昼时段 ; natural daylight｜自然日光
tip_zh: 通常不可数；in broad daylight意为在光天化日之下。

meanings_zh: n. 信纸；便条纸
definition_en: paper used for writing letters or short messages
example1_en: She took some notepaper from the desk drawer.
example1_zh: 她从书桌抽屉里拿出了一些便条纸。
example2_en: Providing recycled notepaper in offices is a simple measure that can support more sustainable purchasing practices.
example2_zh: 在办公室提供再生便条纸，是支持更可持续采购方式的一项简单措施。
collocations: a sheet of notepaper｜一张信纸 ; a pad of notepaper｜一本便条纸 ; personal notepaper｜私人信纸
tip_zh: 不可数名词；一张用a sheet of notepaper。

meanings_zh: adv. 向后；朝后 | adv. 倒序地；逆向地
definition_en: Towards the back, or with the back facing forwards. | In the opposite order or direction to the usual one.
example1_en: She stepped backwards to let the cyclist pass.
example1_zh: 她向后退了一步，让骑车的人过去。
example2_en: Researchers can work backwards from current pollution levels to identify the likely sources of environmental damage.
example2_zh: 研究人员可以根据当前污染水平反向追溯，找出环境破坏的可能来源。
collocations: walk backwards｜倒着走 ; backwards and forwards｜来回 ; work backwards｜反向推导
tip_zh: backwards是副词；修饰名词通常用backward。

meanings_zh: adj. 苍白的；浅色的 | adj. 暗淡的；微弱的 | v. 变苍白；相形见绌
definition_en: Having little colour, or less colour than usual. | Giving only a weak light. | To lose colour or seem less impressive in comparison.
example1_en: You look pale; sit down and have some water.
example1_zh: 你脸色苍白，坐下来喝点水吧。
example2_en: The financial benefits of tourism may pale in comparison with its long-term environmental costs.
example2_zh: 与旅游业带来的长期环境代价相比，其经济收益可能显得微不足道。
collocations: pale blue｜浅蓝色 ; look pale｜脸色苍白 ; pale in comparison｜相比之下相形见绌
tip_zh: pale可指脸色苍白或颜色浅，不等于白色。

meanings_zh: adj. 艰难的；棘手的 | adj. 坚强的；能吃苦的 | adj. 坚韧的；不易破损的
definition_en: Difficult to do, deal with, or endure | Able to cope with hardship, pain, or difficult conditions | Strong and difficult to break, cut, or damage
example1_en: It was a tough climb, but the view was worth it.
example1_zh: 这段攀登很艰难，但沿途的风景让付出变得值得。
example2_en: Governments face tough choices when balancing economic growth with the need to protect natural resources.
example2_zh: 在平衡经济增长与保护自然资源的需求时，政府面临艰难的抉择。
collocations: tough decision｜艰难的决定 ; tough times｜艰难时期 ; tough competition｜激烈的竞争 ; tough material｜坚韧的材料
tip_zh: 读音与rough押韵；形容肉时指难嚼、老。

meanings_zh: adj. 免关税的 | adv. 免关税地
definition_en: Sold without certain taxes, especially to international travellers. | Without paying certain taxes on goods.
example1_en: She bought some duty-free perfume before boarding her flight.
example1_zh: 登机前，她买了一些免税香水。
example2_en: Duty-free shopping can generate substantial revenue for airports, although travellers may not always find the lowest prices.
example2_zh: 免税购物能为机场带来可观收入，但旅客未必总能买到价格最低的商品。
collocations: duty-free shop｜免税店 ; duty-free goods｜免税商品 ; duty-free allowance｜免税额度
tip_zh: duty此处指关税；免税商品仍受入境额度限制。

meanings_zh: n. 宗教；宗教信仰
definition_en: belief in gods or spiritual powers, with related practices
example1_en: We learned about different religions at school today.
example1_zh: 今天我们在学校了解了不同的宗教。
example2_en: Schools can teach students about religion while encouraging respect for people with different beliefs.
example2_zh: 学校可以教授宗教知识，同时鼓励学生尊重持不同信仰的人。
collocations: freedom of religion｜宗教自由 ; organised religion｜制度化宗教 ; religious beliefs｜宗教信仰
tip_zh: 泛指宗教时不可数；指某一种宗教时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 小睡；打盹 | v. 小睡；打盹
definition_en: a short sleep, usually during the day | to sleep briefly, usually during the day
example1_en: I took a short nap after lunch on Sunday.
example1_zh: 星期天午饭后，我小睡了一会儿。
example2_en: A brief afternoon nap may improve alertness, but it should not replace adequate sleep at night.
example2_zh: 下午短暂小睡可能提高警觉性，但不应代替充足的夜间睡眠。
collocations: take a nap｜小睡一下 ; an afternoon nap｜午后小睡 ; a power nap｜恢复精力的短睡
tip_zh: 动词变化要双写p：napped、napping。

meanings_zh: adv. 稍微；略微
definition_en: by a small amount or to a small degree
example1_en: Please open the window slightly; it feels warm.
example1_zh: 请把窗户稍微打开一点，感觉有些热。
example2_en: Although average incomes rose slightly, many households continued to struggle with higher food and energy costs.
example2_zh: 尽管平均收入略有上升，许多家庭仍难以应付不断上涨的食品和能源费用。
collocations: slightly higher｜略高 ; slightly different｜略有不同 ; slightly more｜稍多一些
tip_zh: 可修饰形容词、比较级或动词，如slightly higher。

meanings_zh: n. 许可证；执照 | n. 自由发挥的许可
definition_en: an official document allowing someone to do something | freedom to depart from usual rules or factual accuracy
example1_en: I keep my driving licence in my wallet.
example1_zh: 我把驾驶执照放在钱包里。
example2_en: Requiring a licence to operate tourist boats can help authorities maintain safety standards on busy waterways.
example2_zh: 要求旅游船持证运营，可以帮助主管部门维持繁忙水道的安全标准。
collocations: driving licence｜驾驶执照 ; apply for a licence｜申请许可证 ; renew a licence｜续办许可证 ; poetic licence｜诗意的自由发挥
tip_zh: 英式名词用licence，动词用license；美式都用license。

meanings_zh: n. 鹰；雕
definition_en: A large hunting bird with powerful claws and sharp eyesight
example1_en: An eagle circled slowly above the rocky valley.
example1_zh: 一只鹰在岩石遍布的山谷上方缓缓盘旋。
example2_en: Protecting mountain forests helps preserve the hunting grounds and nesting sites of the eagle.
example2_zh: 保护山地森林有助于保全鹰的猎食区和筑巢地。
collocations: a golden eagle｜金雕 ; a bald eagle｜白头海雕 ; an eagle's nest｜鹰巢
tip_zh: eagle通常指大型猛禽；eagle-eyed形容眼力敏锐。

meanings_zh: n. 毕业文凭；课程证书
definition_en: an official document showing successful completion of a course
example1_en: She proudly showed her diploma to her grandparents.
example1_zh: 她自豪地向祖父母展示了自己的毕业文凭。
example2_en: A vocational diploma can provide practical skills that help graduates find employment in specialised industries.
example2_zh: 职业教育文凭课程可以提供实用技能，帮助毕业生在专业行业中找到工作。
collocations: earn a diploma｜取得文凭 ; high school diploma｜高中文凭 ; diploma in nursing｜护理专业文凭
tip_zh: diploma多指毕业或课程文凭，不等同于degree学位。

meanings_zh: n. 发现；被发现的事物
definition_en: finding something previously unknown, or the thing that is found
example1_en: We made an exciting discovery behind the old cupboard.
example1_zh: 我们在旧橱柜后有了一个令人兴奋的发现。
example2_en: The discovery of new antibiotics could help health services respond more effectively to drug-resistant infections.
example2_zh: 新抗生素的发现有助于医疗机构更有效地应对耐药性感染。
collocations: make a discovery｜有所发现 ; scientific discovery｜科学发现 ; major discovery｜重大发现 ; accidental discovery｜意外发现
tip_zh: discovery是发现原已存在的事物，不同于invention。

meanings_zh: n. 过程；程序 | v. 处理；加工
definition_en: A series of actions or changes leading to a result. | Treat materials or information through a series of organised steps.
example1_en: Making bread is a slow process, but I enjoy it.
example1_zh: 做面包是个缓慢的过程，但我很享受。
example2_en: The application process should be transparent so that all candidates have an equal opportunity to participate.
example2_zh: 申请程序应当透明，以确保所有申请者都有平等的参与机会。
collocations: a gradual process｜渐进的过程 ; in the process of｜在……过程中 ; process data｜处理数据 ; processed food｜加工食品
tip_zh: in the process of后接名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: n. 娱乐；娱乐活动
definition_en: Performances or activities that people enjoy watching or doing.
example1_en: The hotel provides live entertainment beside the pool every evening.
example1_zh: 酒店每晚都在泳池边提供现场娱乐表演。
example2_en: Affordable entertainment facilities can improve urban life by giving residents opportunities to relax and socialise.
example2_zh: 价格亲民的娱乐设施能让居民有机会放松和社交，从而改善城市生活。
collocations: live entertainment｜现场娱乐表演 ; the entertainment industry｜娱乐业 ; family entertainment｜适合全家的娱乐 ; a form of entertainment｜一种娱乐形式
tip_zh: 通常不可数：提供娱乐用provide entertainment。

meanings_zh: v. 想知道；琢磨 | n. 惊叹；惊奇 | n. 奇观；奇迹
definition_en: to think about something you do not know | a feeling of surprise and admiration | something unusually impressive or surprising
example1_en: I wonder why the cat keeps watching that cupboard.
example1_zh: 我想知道那只猫为什么一直盯着那个橱柜。
example2_en: Many parents wonder whether online lessons can provide the same social benefits as classroom learning.
example2_zh: 许多家长想知道，线上课程能否提供与课堂学习相同的社交益处。
collocations: wonder whether｜想知道是否 ; wonder about｜对……感到好奇 ; in wonder｜惊叹地 ; natural wonders｜自然奇观
tip_zh: wonder后接疑问词从句时，用陈述语序。

meanings_zh: n. 添加；增加 | n. 加法 | n. 新增事物
definition_en: the act of putting something extra into something | the process of finding the total of quantities | something extra that joins an existing group or collection
example1_en: The addition of fresh lemon made the soup delicious.
example1_zh: 加入新鲜柠檬后，汤变得十分美味。
example2_en: The addition of cycle lanes can make urban transport safer and encourage residents to exercise regularly.
example2_zh: 增设自行车道可以提高城市交通的安全性，并鼓励居民经常锻炼。
collocations: in addition to｜除……之外还 ; the addition of｜……的添加 ; a welcome addition｜受欢迎的新事物 ; simple addition｜简单加法
tip_zh: in addition作连接语；in addition to后接名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: v. 递送；送达 | v. 发表；讲授 | v. 兑现；实现
definition_en: to take goods or messages to their intended destination | to give a speech, lecture, or presentation | to produce the results or benefits that were promised
example1_en: The bakery delivers warm bread to our door every morning.
example1_zh: 面包店每天早上把热乎乎的面包送到我们家门口。
example2_en: Public transport projects must deliver clear benefits to local residents if they are to justify substantial investment.
example2_zh: 公共交通项目必须为当地居民带来明确的益处，才能证明大规模投资是合理的。
collocations: deliver a parcel｜递送包裹 ; deliver a speech｜发表演讲 ; deliver results｜取得成效 ; deliver on a promise｜兑现承诺
tip_zh: 递送用deliver sth to sb；兑现承诺可用deliver on。

meanings_zh: adj. 布满灰尘的；多尘的
definition_en: Covered with dust or containing a lot of dust.
example1_en: I wiped the dusty shelf with a damp cloth.
example1_zh: 我用湿布擦了擦落满灰尘的架子。
example2_en: Workers in dusty environments need appropriate protective equipment to reduce their risk of developing respiratory diseases.
example2_zh: 在多尘环境中工作的人员需要适当的防护装备，以降低患呼吸系统疾病的风险。
collocations: a dusty road｜尘土飞扬的道路 ; dusty shelves｜积满灰尘的架子 ; a dusty environment｜多尘的环境
tip_zh: dusty形容有灰尘；dust作动词可表示掸去灰尘。

meanings_zh: adj. 结冰的；冻硬的 | adj. 冷冻保存的 | adj. 冻僵的；冷极了的
definition_en: Turned into ice or made hard by extreme cold. | Kept at very low temperatures to preserve freshness. | Feeling extremely cold.
example1_en: A frozen puddle cracked beneath my boot this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早晨，一处结冰的水洼被我的靴子踩裂了。
example2_en: Frozen vegetables can help households reduce food waste because they remain usable much longer than fresh produce.
example2_zh: 冷冻蔬菜的保存时间比新鲜农产品长得多，因此可以帮助家庭减少食物浪费。
collocations: frozen lake｜结冰的湖 ; frozen food｜冷冻食品 ; frozen solid｜冻得硬邦邦的 ; frozen with fear｜吓得动弹不得
tip_zh: 也是freeze的过去分词；过去式为froze。

meanings_zh: v. 发生 | v. 存在；出现 | v. 被想到；浮现于脑海
definition_en: Happen, especially at a particular time or place. | Exist or be found in a particular place or situation. | Come into someone's mind as an idea or thought.
example1_en: Power cuts often occur here during heavy winter storms.
example1_zh: 冬季强风暴来袭时，这里经常停电。
example2_en: Traffic accidents are more likely to occur when drivers are tired or distracted by mobile phones.
example2_zh: 驾驶员疲劳或因手机分心时，交通事故更容易发生。
collocations: occur naturally｜天然存在 ; occur frequently｜频繁发生 ; occur to someone｜被某人想到
tip_zh: 不用于被动语态；过去式occurred，分词occurring。

meanings_zh: n. 漂流运动
