definition_en: A game or problem that tests your thinking skills. | Something that is difficult to understand or explain. | To make someone feel confused because something is difficult to understand.
example1_en: We finished the puzzle together on the kitchen table.
example1_zh: 我们在厨房桌上一起完成了拼图。
example2_en: The relationship between income and personal happiness remains a puzzle that researchers approach from several different perspectives.
example2_zh: 收入与个人幸福感之间的关系仍是一个谜，研究人员正从多个不同角度探索它。
collocations: solve a puzzle｜解开谜题 ; a jigsaw puzzle｜拼图 ; puzzle over something｜苦思某事 ; a crossword puzzle｜填字游戏
tip_zh: puzzled形容人感到困惑；puzzling形容事物令人困惑。

meanings_zh: v. 破坏；糟蹋 | v. 溺爱；宠坏 | v. 变质；使变质
definition_en: To make something less enjoyable, useful, or attractive. | To give someone excessive attention or everything they want. | To become, or make food become, unfit to eat.
example1_en: Please don't spoil the surprise by telling your sister.
example1_zh: 请别告诉你姐姐，免得破坏这份惊喜。
example2_en: Poorly planned construction can spoil natural landscapes and reduce their appeal to both residents and tourists.
example2_zh: 规划不当的建设会破坏自然景观，降低其对居民和游客的吸引力。
collocations: spoil the surprise｜破坏惊喜 ; spoil a child｜宠坏孩子 ; spoil your appetite｜影响食欲
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均可用spoiled或spoilt。

meanings_zh: v. 流血；出血
definition_en: To lose blood from a wound or inside the body.
example1_en: My finger started to bleed after a small paper cut.
example1_zh: 我的手指被纸轻轻划了一下，开始流血了。
example2_en: First aid courses teach people how to respond safely when minor injuries cause someone to bleed.
example2_zh: 急救课程教人们在轻伤导致出血时如何安全应对。
collocations: bleed heavily｜大量出血 ; bleed internally｜内出血 ; stop the bleeding｜止血
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为bled；blood是名词“血”。

meanings_zh: n. 合唱团；唱诗班
definition_en: An organised group of people who sing together.
example1_en: My sister sings in the choir every Sunday.
example1_zh: 我姐姐每周日都在唱诗班唱歌。
example2_en: Joining a community choir can reduce loneliness and strengthen social connections among older adults.
example2_zh: 加入社区合唱团可以减轻老年人的孤独感，并加强他们的社会联系。
collocations: join a choir｜加入合唱团 ; church choir｜教堂唱诗班 ; choir practice｜合唱排练
tip_zh: 发音近似quire，开头不是常见的/ch/音。

meanings_zh: n. 要素；组成部分 | n. 化学元素 | n. 恶劣天气
definition_en: An important or basic part of something. | A substance that cannot be chemically divided into simpler substances. | Strong wind, rain, or other difficult weather conditions.
example1_en: Fresh herbs are a key element of this soup.
example1_zh: 新鲜香草是这道汤的关键配料。
example2_en: Public trust is an essential element of any successful policy aimed at improving community health.
example2_zh: 公众信任是任何旨在改善社区健康的政策取得成功的必要因素。
collocations: a key element｜关键要素 ; a chemical element｜化学元素 ; exposure to the elements｜暴露于风雨之中
tip_zh: 表示风雨等自然力量时，通常用the elements。

meanings_zh: adj. 有创造力的；创新的
definition_en: Able to produce original ideas, or involving imagination.
example1_en: My creative sister turned old jars into colourful lamps.
example1_zh: 我富有创意的姐姐把旧罐子变成了彩色灯具。
example2_en: Schools should encourage creative thinking by allowing students to explore several solutions to the same problem.
example2_zh: 学校应允许学生探索同一问题的多种解决方案，以鼓励创造性思维。
collocations: creative thinking｜创造性思维 ; creative writing｜创意写作 ; a creative solution｜创新的解决方案
tip_zh: 形容人有创意或方法新颖；名词形式是creativity。

meanings_zh: v. 航行；驾驶帆船 | n. 帆
definition_en: Travel across water in a boat or ship. | A large sheet of material that catches wind to move boats.
example1_en: We sailed across the lake on a sunny afternoon.
example1_zh: 一个晴朗的下午，我们乘船驶过湖面。
example2_en: Ships that sail through sensitive marine habitats should follow strict rules to protect wildlife.
example2_zh: 驶经敏感海洋栖息地的船只应遵守严格规定，以保护野生动物。
collocations: set sail｜启航 ; sail across the ocean｜航行穿越大洋 ; raise the sails｜升帆
tip_zh: 作动词不限于帆船，也可指轮船航行。

meanings_zh: n. 节礼日
definition_en: December 26, a public holiday in Britain and several other countries.
example1_en: We usually eat leftover turkey together on Boxing Day.
example1_zh: 我们通常在节礼日一起吃剩下的火鸡肉。
example2_en: Boxing Day sales can boost retail revenue, but they also raise concerns about unnecessary consumption.
example2_zh: 节礼日促销能增加零售收入，但也引发了对不必要消费的担忧。
collocations: on Boxing Day｜在节礼日 ; Boxing Day sales｜节礼日促销 ; a Boxing Day walk｜节礼日散步
tip_zh: 固定指12月26日；首字母大写，不加连字符。

meanings_zh: n. 谋杀；谋杀案 | v. 谋杀
definition_en: the crime of deliberately and unlawfully killing someone | to deliberately and unlawfully kill someone
example1_en: We watched a film about a detective investigating a murder.
example1_zh: 我们看了一部讲述侦探调查谋杀案的电影。
example2_en: Accurate forensic evidence plays a crucial role in solving murder cases and preventing wrongful convictions.
example2_zh: 准确的法医证据对侦破谋杀案和防止误判起着关键作用。
collocations: commit murder｜实施谋杀 ; attempted murder｜谋杀未遂 ; murder investigation｜谋杀案调查 ; be charged with murder｜被控谋杀
tip_zh: murder强调非法且故意杀人；kill含义更广。

meanings_zh: n. 地区；行政区
definition_en: An area defined by its features or official boundaries.
example1_en: We found a small bakery in the old market district.
example1_zh: 我们在老市场区找到了一家小面包店。
example2_en: Improving public transport in suburban districts can reduce car dependence and widen access to employment.
example2_zh: 改善郊区的公共交通可以减少对汽车的依赖，并增加就业机会。
collocations: residential district｜住宅区 ; business district｜商业区 ; school district｜学区 ; electoral district｜选区
tip_zh: 可指行政划分，也可指具有特定功能的城区。

meanings_zh: v. 不同；有区别 | v. 意见不合
definition_en: To be unlike something else in one or more ways. | To have a different opinion from another person.
example1_en: These jackets differ in price, but both look great.
example1_zh: 这两件夹克价格不同，但都很好看。
example2_en: Educational priorities differ between countries because economic conditions and cultural expectations shape national policies.
example2_zh: 各国的教育重点有所不同，因为经济条件和文化期待会影响国家政策。
collocations: differ from｜与……不同 ; differ in size｜大小不同 ; differ widely｜差异很大 ; differ with someone｜与某人意见不同
tip_zh: from引出比较对象，in引出差异方面。

meanings_zh: adj. 普遍的；总体的 | adj. 大致的；非具体的 | n. 将军
definition_en: affecting or involving most people, things, or situations | describing main points rather than particular details | an officer with a very high rank in the army
example1_en: There was general agreement that the kitchen needed repainting.
example1_zh: 大家普遍同意厨房需要重新刷漆。
example2_en: Although the general standard of education has improved, significant differences remain between urban and rural schools.
example2_zh: 尽管教育总体水平已有提高，城乡学校之间仍存在显著差异。
collocations: in general｜一般来说 ; general public｜公众 ; general knowledge｜常识 ; general overview｜总体概述
tip_zh: in general意为“一般来说”，常用于概括。

meanings_zh: n. 雾 | v. 使蒙上雾气；变模糊
definition_en: a thick cloud near the ground that limits visibility | to become or make a surface covered with fine droplets
example1_en: Thick fog hid the hills behind our house.
example1_zh: 浓雾遮住了我们屋后的山丘。
example2_en: Dense fog can disrupt transport networks, causing flight cancellations and increasing the risk of road accidents.
example2_zh: 浓雾可能扰乱交通网络，导致航班取消，并增加道路事故的风险。
collocations: thick fog｜浓雾 ; dense fog｜浓雾 ; fog lifts｜雾散了 ; fog up｜蒙上雾气
tip_zh: fog比mist更浓；fog up常指玻璃蒙上雾气。

meanings_zh: v. 责怪；归咎于 | n. 责任；责备
definition_en: To consider someone or something responsible for a problem. | Responsibility for something bad that has happened.
example1_en: Don't blame me for the broken kitchen chair.
example1_zh: 别把厨房椅子坏了的事怪到我头上。
example2_en: It is unfair to blame individuals alone for environmental problems caused partly by industrial activity.
example2_zh: 环境问题部分由工业活动造成，仅归咎于个人并不公平。
collocations: blame someone for something｜因某事责怪某人 ; blame something on someone｜把某事归咎于某人 ; take the blame｜承担责任 ; be to blame｜应负责任
tip_zh: 人作宾语用blame sb for；事作宾语用blame sth on。

meanings_zh: adv. 想必；总该 | adv. 必定；确实
definition_en: Used when expecting others to agree that something is true | Certainly, or in a way that will achieve a result
example1_en: Surely you can spare five minutes to help?
example1_zh: 你总能抽出五分钟来帮忙吧？
example2_en: Surely governments should prioritise clean drinking water before investing public money in expensive sports facilities.
example2_zh: 政府在投入公共资金建设昂贵的体育设施之前，总该优先保障清洁饮用水吧。
collocations: surely not｜总不至于吧 ; slowly but surely｜缓慢而稳步地 ; will surely lead to｜必将导致
tip_zh: 是副词；句首常表示期待对方赞同。

meanings_zh: adj. 中等教育的；中学的 | adj. 次要的；辅助的
definition_en: Relating to education after primary school and before higher education. | Less important than something else.
example1_en: My sister starts secondary school after the summer holidays.
example1_zh: 暑假过后，我妹妹就要上中学了。
example2_en: Access to quality secondary education can improve employment prospects for young people in rural communities.
example2_zh: 获得优质中等教育的机会可以改善农村年轻人的就业前景。
collocations: secondary school｜中学 ; secondary education｜中等教育 ; of secondary importance｜次要的 ; secondary to｜次于
tip_zh: 表示“次于”用secondary to，不用secondary than。

meanings_zh: prep. 在……下面 | adv. 在下面；在底下
definition_en: Directly below something, often covered or hidden by it. | In a lower position, often beneath a covering.
example1_en: Your slippers are underneath the chair by the bed.
example1_zh: 你的拖鞋在床边那把椅子下面。
example2_en: Insulation installed underneath floors can reduce heat loss and improve energy efficiency in older homes.
example2_zh: 在地板下面铺设保温材料，可以减少老房屋的热量流失并提高能源效率。
collocations: underneath the bed｜在床下面 ; underneath the surface｜在表面之下 ; hidden underneath｜藏在下面
tip_zh: 后接名词时是介词；单独使用时是副词。

meanings_zh: v. 允许；准许
definition_en: allowed something; the past tense and past participle of permit
example1_en: We were permitted to feed the goats at noon.
example1_zh: 我们获准在中午给山羊喂食。
example2_en: Students should be permitted to use digital tools when these genuinely support learning rather than distract from it.
example2_zh: 当数字工具确实有助于学习而非分散注意力时，应允许学生使用。
collocations: be permitted to do something｜获准做某事 ; not permitted｜不被允许 ; legally permitted｜法律允许的
tip_zh: permit过去式双写t；被动式后接to do。

meanings_zh: adj. 有斑点的；有圆点的
definition_en: Covered with small round marks or patches.
example1_en: A spotted dog was sleeping beside the garden gate.
example1_zh: 一只带斑点的狗正睡在花园门旁。
example2_en: Some spotted animals blend into their surroundings, making them harder for predators to detect.
example2_zh: 一些有斑点的动物能融入周围环境，使捕食者更难发现它们。
collocations: spotted coat｜带斑点的皮毛 ; spotted dress｜圆点连衣裙 ; spotted pattern｜斑点图案
tip_zh: 也可作spot的过去式或过去分词，意为发现。

meanings_zh: n. 纪念碑；纪念建筑 | n. 历史遗迹；古迹
definition_en: A structure built to honour a person or important event. | An old structure valued for its historical importance.
example1_en: We left flowers beside the monument in the town square.
example1_zh: 我们把鲜花放在镇广场的纪念碑旁。
example2_en: Protecting ancient monuments can strengthen cultural identity while attracting visitors and supporting employment in local communities.
example2_zh: 保护古迹既能增强文化认同，又能吸引游客，为当地社区创造就业机会。
collocations: a monument to｜纪念……的建筑 ; an ancient monument｜古迹 ; a historic monument｜历史遗迹 ; erect a monument｜树立纪念碑
tip_zh: 纪念某人或某事用a monument to。

meanings_zh: v. 烤；炙烤 | n. 烤架；烧烤炉 | v. 严厉盘问；追问
definition_en: To cook food using direct heat from above or below. | A cooking device that exposes food to direct heat. | To question someone intensely, often for a long time.
example1_en: We grilled some peppers and ate them with rice.
example1_zh: 我们烤了些甜椒，配米饭吃。
example2_en: Grilling vegetables with little oil can be a practical way to prepare healthier meals at home.
example2_zh: 用少量油烤蔬菜，是在家制作更健康餐食的一种实用方法。
collocations: grilled fish｜烤鱼 ; a charcoal grill｜炭火烤炉 ; under the grill｜在烤架热源下 ; grill someone about something｜就某事盘问某人
tip_zh: 英式grill常指从上方加热；美式常指从下方烤。

meanings_zh: v. 毁坏；毁掉 | n. 废墟；遗迹 | n. 毁灭；破产
definition_en: to damage something so badly that it loses its value | the remains of a building that has been badly damaged | the complete loss of money, success, or good condition
example1_en: Heavy rain ruined the picnic we had planned.
example1_zh: 大雨毁掉了我们计划好的野餐。
example2_en: Uncontrolled tourism can ruin fragile natural habitats unless visitor numbers and construction activities are carefully managed.
example2_zh: 除非严格管理游客数量和建设活动，否则无序旅游可能毁掉脆弱的自然栖息地。
collocations: ruin someone's plans｜打乱某人的计划 ; ancient ruins｜古代遗迹 ; financial ruin｜经济上的破产 ; in ruins｜成为废墟
tip_zh: 表示建筑遗迹常用复数ruins，如ancient ruins。

meanings_zh: n. 实践研讨会；工作坊 | n. 车间；作坊
definition_en: A session where people learn by discussing and practising together. | A room or building where things are made or repaired.
example1_en: I made a clay bowl at a pottery workshop.
example1_zh: 我在陶艺工作坊做了一个陶碗。
example2_en: Schools should offer practical workshops that help students develop communication skills through collaborative activities.
example2_zh: 学校应开设实践工作坊，帮助学生通过合作活动培养沟通能力。
collocations: attend a workshop｜参加工作坊 ; run a workshop｜举办工作坊 ; a training workshop｜培训研讨会 ; a repair workshop｜维修车间
tip_zh: 表示学习活动时，通常强调参与和实践，而非只听讲。

meanings_zh: n. 朋友；伙伴 | n. 动物的配偶 | v. 交配；使交配
definition_en: A friend or someone you share an activity with | An animal's partner for breeding | To breed, or bring animals together to breed
example1_en: I'm meeting a mate for lunch near the station.
example1_zh: 我要在车站附近和一个朋友吃午饭。
example2_en: Some bird species stay with the same mate for years, sharing responsibility for raising their young.
example2_zh: 某些鸟类会与同一配偶相伴多年，共同承担养育幼鸟的责任。
collocations: a close mate｜亲密的朋友 ; find a mate｜寻找配偶 ; mate for life｜终生配对
tip_zh: 表示朋友时属英式非正式用语，正式写作宜用friend。

meanings_zh: n. 食品杂货 | n. 食品杂货店
definition_en: Food and household supplies bought at a shop; usually plural. | A shop selling food and basic household supplies.
example1_en: I carried two bags of groceries into the kitchen.
example1_zh: 我把两袋食品杂货提进了厨房。
example2_en: Rising grocery prices place considerable pressure on households that already spend most of their income on essentials.
example2_zh: 食品杂货价格上涨给那些已将大部分收入用于必需品的家庭带来了巨大压力。
collocations: grocery shopping｜采购食品杂货 ; grocery store｜食品杂货店 ; grocery bill｜食品杂货开销
tip_zh: 食品杂货用复数groceries；作定语用grocery。

meanings_zh: v. 逗乐；使发笑 | v. 使消遣；使不无聊
definition_en: To make someone smile or laugh. | To keep someone pleasantly occupied.
example1_en: His silly dance amused everyone waiting in the kitchen.
example1_zh: 他滑稽的舞蹈逗乐了在厨房等候的每个人。
example2_en: Interactive museum exhibits can amuse young visitors while helping them understand complex scientific ideas.
example2_zh: 博物馆的互动展品既能让小游客玩得开心，也能帮助他们理解复杂的科学概念。
collocations: amuse an audience｜逗乐观众 ; amuse yourself｜自娱自乐 ; keep someone amused｜让某人不无聊
tip_zh: amused形容人的感受；amusing形容有趣的事物。

meanings_zh: n. 公民 | n. 市民；居民
definition_en: A legal member of a country with rights and responsibilities. | A person who lives in a particular town or city.
example1_en: My aunt became a citizen after living here for years.
example1_zh: 我姑妈在这里生活多年后成为了公民。
example2_en: Every citizen should have access to reliable public services, regardless of income or place of residence.
example2_zh: 每位公民都应享有可靠的公共服务，不论收入多少或居住在哪里。
collocations: become a citizen｜成为公民 ; a senior citizen｜老年人 ; a responsible citizen｜负责任的公民
tip_zh: citizen强调公民身份；resident强调居住。

meanings_zh: n. 食谱；烹饪方法 | n. 促成某结果的方法或因素
definition_en: instructions explaining how to prepare and cook a dish | a method or situation likely to produce a particular result
example1_en: This soup recipe needs only a few simple ingredients.
example1_zh: 这个汤的食谱只需要几种简单的食材。
example2_en: Investment in teacher training and accessible learning materials provides a recipe for educational success.
example2_zh: 投资教师培训并提供易于获取的学习材料，是推动教育成功的有效方法。
collocations: follow a recipe｜按照食谱做菜 ; a recipe for success｜成功之道 ; a recipe for disaster｜招致灾难的做法
tip_zh: recipe指做菜方法；menu是菜单，prescription是处方。

meanings_zh: n. 饥饿；食物匮乏 | n. 渴望 | v. 渴望；渴求
definition_en: the need for food or suffering caused by its lack | a strong desire for something | to want something very strongly
example1_en: A bowl of warm soup quickly satisfied my hunger.
example1_zh: 一碗热汤很快就让我不饿了。
example2_en: Reducing global hunger requires reliable food supplies as well as better access to education and employment.
example2_zh: 减少全球饥饿既需要可靠的食物供应，也需要更多受教育和就业的机会。
collocations: satisfy your hunger｜填饱肚子 ; combat hunger｜抗击饥饿 ; a hunger for knowledge｜求知欲 ; hunger for success｜渴望成功
tip_zh: 名词通常不可数；渴望某物用hunger for。

meanings_zh: n. 发烧；发热 | n. 狂热；极度兴奋
definition_en: a body temperature higher than normal, usually caused by illness | intense excitement shared by a person or group
example1_en: He stayed in bed because he had a fever.
example1_zh: 他因为发烧而卧床休息。
example2_en: A persistent fever may indicate an infection and should be assessed by a qualified healthcare professional.
example2_zh: 持续发热可能意味着感染，应由合格的医疗专业人员进行评估。
collocations: have a fever｜发烧 ; a high fever｜高烧 ; a mild fever｜低烧 ; football fever｜足球热
tip_zh: 表示发烧常说have a fever，也可说have a temperature。

meanings_zh: n. 储物柜；带锁小柜
definition_en: a small cupboard for keeping personal belongings secure
example1_en: I left my trainers in a locker at the gym.
example1_zh: 我把运动鞋留在健身房的储物柜里了。
example2_en: Providing each student with a locker can reduce the weight of bags carried around school.
example2_zh: 为每位学生配备储物柜，可以减轻他们在校园内携带的书包重量。
collocations: locker room｜更衣室 ; school locker｜学校储物柜 ; locker key｜储物柜钥匙
tip_zh: locker通常是存放个人物品的小柜，不指上锁的人。

meanings_zh: adj. 全世界的 | adv. 遍及全球
definition_en: Existing or happening in all parts of the world. | In or to all parts of the world.
example1_en: The band's new song became a worldwide hit.
example1_zh: 这个乐队的新歌在全球大受欢迎。
example2_en: Worldwide cooperation is essential for reducing carbon emissions and protecting communities from the effects of climate change.
example2_zh: 全球合作对于减少碳排放、保护社区免受气候变化影响至关重要。
collocations: worldwide demand｜全球需求 ; worldwide recognition｜全球认可 ; available worldwide｜全球均可获取 ; worldwide distribution｜全球分销
tip_zh: 既可作形容词，也可作副词：sell worldwide。

meanings_zh: adv. 最近；近来
definition_en: during the recent period up to the present
example1_en: Have you been sleeping well lately, or feeling tired?
example1_zh: 你最近睡得好吗，还是觉得疲倦？
example2_en: Lately, researchers have paid greater attention to the relationship between access to green spaces and mental health.
example2_zh: 近来，研究人员更加关注绿地可及性与心理健康之间的关系。
collocations: have lately become｜近来已变得 ; until lately｜直到最近 ; more often lately｜最近更频繁
tip_zh: 常与现在完成时连用；不要与表示迟到的late混淆。

meanings_zh: n. 夹子；回形针 | n. 电影或音频片段 | v. 夹住；剪短；修剪
definition_en: A small object that holds things together or in place. | A short section of a film or audio recording. | To fasten with a clip, or cut something shorter.
example1_en: She used a clip to hold her hair back.
example1_zh: 她用夹子把头发固定在后面。
example2_en: Teachers can use a short video clip to introduce complex scientific concepts before a classroom discussion.
example2_zh: 教师可以在课堂讨论前，用一段短视频引入复杂的科学概念。
collocations: paper clip｜回形针 ; video clip｜视频片段 ; clip your nails｜剪指甲 ; clip something onto｜把某物夹在……上
tip_zh: 夹在某物上用clip onto；短视频片段也叫clip。

meanings_zh: adj. 首要的；主要的 | adj. 小学的；初等教育的 | adj. 最初的；直接的
definition_en: more important than anything else | relating to the first stage of formal schooling | original or direct, rather than derived from something else
example1_en: Our primary concern is keeping the children safe.
example1_zh: 我们最关心的是确保孩子们安全。
example2_en: Investment in primary education can reduce inequality by giving children a stronger foundation for future learning.
example2_zh: 投资初等教育可以为儿童今后的学习打下更牢固的基础，从而减少不平等。
collocations: primary concern｜首要关切 ; primary school｜小学 ; primary source｜第一手资料 ; primary objective｜主要目标
tip_zh: primary school指小学；primarily是副词。

meanings_zh: adj. 明显的；显而易见的
definition_en: Easy to notice or understand.
example1_en: The muddy footprints made the dog's hiding place obvious.
example1_zh: 泥脚印让狗的藏身处一目了然。
example2_en: The environmental benefits of cycling are obvious, but safer routes are needed to encourage more people to cycle.
example2_zh: 骑自行车的环境效益显而易见，但还需更安全的路线来鼓励更多人骑行。
collocations: an obvious advantage｜明显的优势 ; for obvious reasons｜出于显而易见的原因 ; obvious to everyone｜人人都看得出来
tip_zh: 常用It is obvious that…表示“显然……”。

meanings_zh: n. 拖把 | v. 拖洗；擦去
definition_en: A long-handled tool for washing floors | To clean a surface or remove liquid with absorbent material
example1_en: I used a mop to clean the muddy kitchen floor.
example1_zh: 我用拖把擦洗了沾满泥的厨房地板。
example2_en: Staff should mop shared floors regularly to maintain hygiene in schools and other public buildings.
example2_zh: 工作人员应定期拖洗公共区域的地面，以保持学校及其他公共建筑的卫生。
collocations: mop the floor｜拖地 ; mop up a spill｜擦净洒出的液体 ; a mop and bucket｜拖把和水桶
tip_zh: 动词过去式mopped，进行式mopping，均双写p。

meanings_zh: n. 临时保姆
definition_en: Someone who temporarily looks after children while their parents are away
example1_en: The baby-sitter read our daughter a story before bed.
example1_zh: 临时保姆在睡前给我们女儿读了一个故事。
example2_en: Hiring a reliable baby-sitter can help parents balance occasional evening work with their family responsibilities.
example2_zh: 雇用可靠的临时保姆，可以帮助父母兼顾偶尔的晚间工作和家庭责任。
collocations: hire a baby-sitter｜雇临时保姆 ; reliable baby-sitter｜可靠的临时保姆 ; experienced baby-sitter｜有经验的临时保姆
tip_zh: 现代更常写babysitter；通常指临时照看孩子的人。

meanings_zh: v. 批准；核准 | v. 赞成；认可
definition_en: To officially accept or allow something. | To think that someone or something is good or acceptable.
example1_en: My manager approved my request for a day off.
example1_zh: 经理批准了我请一天假的申请。
example2_en: Local authorities should approve housing developments only when adequate transport and essential services are available.
example2_zh: 地方政府应仅在交通和基本服务充足的情况下批准住宅开发项目。
collocations: approve a proposal｜批准提案 ; approve of something｜赞成某事 ; approve an application｜批准申请
tip_zh: 批准某事用approve；赞成某事用approve of。

meanings_zh: n. 报告；演示 | n. 呈现方式；外观 | n. 颁发；赠送
definition_en: a talk that explains something to an audience | the way something is arranged, shown, or expressed | the formal act of giving something to someone
example1_en: I practised my presentation in front of my sister.
example1_zh: 我在姐姐面前练习了一遍报告。
example2_en: Giving a group presentation allows students to develop communication skills and learn how to divide responsibilities.
example2_zh: 进行小组报告能让学生培养沟通能力，并学习如何分工。
collocations: give a presentation｜作报告 ; oral presentation｜口头报告 ; food presentation｜菜品摆盘 ; award presentation｜颁奖
tip_zh: 作报告用give a presentation；注意present作动词的重音。

meanings_zh: n. 限度；限制 | v. 限制；限定
definition_en: the greatest amount or level that is allowed or possible | to control how much something can increase or happen
example1_en: There is a limit to what this bag can hold.
example1_zh: 这个包能装的东西是有限的。
example2_en: Governments should limit industrial emissions while providing financial support for businesses adopting cleaner production methods.
example2_zh: 政府应限制工业排放，同时为采用更清洁生产方式的企业提供资金支持。
collocations: speed limit｜速度限制 ; time limit｜时间限制 ; set a limit｜设定限度 ; limit something to｜将某事物限制在
tip_zh: limit A to B意为将A限制在B范围内。

meanings_zh: adj. 有条纹的
definition_en: Having a pattern of long, narrow bands.
example1_en: She wore a striped shirt and dark blue jeans.
example1_zh: 她穿着一件条纹衬衫和深蓝色牛仔裤。
example2_en: The striped coats of certain animals may help them avoid detection in their natural habitats.
example2_zh: 某些动物带条纹的皮毛可能有助于它们在自然栖息地中避免被发现。
collocations: striped shirt｜条纹衬衫 ; striped fabric｜条纹布料 ; striped pattern｜条纹图案
tip_zh: striped意为有条纹的；strip的过去式是stripped。

meanings_zh: n. 砖；砖块
definition_en: A hard rectangular block used for building walls and houses.
example1_en: One loose brick fell out of the garden wall.
example1_zh: 花园围墙上掉下了一块松动的砖。
example2_en: Reusing brick from demolished buildings can reduce construction waste and preserve the character of older neighbourhoods.
example2_zh: 重复利用拆除建筑中的砖可以减少建筑垃圾，并保留老街区的特色。
collocations: brick wall｜砖墙 ; lay bricks｜砌砖 ; red brick｜红砖
tip_zh: 单块砖可数；作建筑材料统称时可不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 建筑师 | n. 缔造者；设计者
definition_en: Someone whose job is to design buildings | Someone who plans and develops an important change or project
example1_en: The architect showed us a model of our future home.
example1_zh: 建筑师给我们看了未来新家的模型。
example2_en: Architects can reduce energy consumption by designing buildings that make better use of natural light.
example2_zh: 建筑师可以通过设计更充分利用自然光的建筑来降低能耗。
collocations: qualified architect｜有资质的建筑师 ; chief architect｜首席建筑师；主要设计者 ; the architect of reform｜改革的设计者
tip_zh: architect指人，architecture指建筑学或建筑风格。

meanings_zh: n. 纪念品
definition_en: An object kept to remember a place, person, or event.
example1_en: We bought a small wooden boat as a souvenir.
example1_zh: 我们买了一只小木船作为纪念品。
example2_en: Buying a locally made souvenir can support traditional crafts and provide income for communities that depend on tourism.
example2_zh: 购买当地制作的纪念品可以支持传统工艺，并为依靠旅游业的社区带来收入。
collocations: souvenir shop｜纪念品商店 ; buy a souvenir｜购买纪念品 ; as a souvenir｜作为纪念品
tip_zh: 常用a souvenir of表示某次旅行或活动的纪念品。

meanings_zh: n. 脸颊 | n. 厚脸皮；无礼
definition_en: either side of the face below the eyes | rude behaviour that shows a lack of respect
example1_en: A cold raindrop landed on my cheek outside.
example1_zh: 在外面，一滴冰凉的雨水落在了我的脸颊上。
example2_en: Protective clothing should cover exposed areas, including the cheeks, when people work in extremely cold environments.
example2_zh: 在极寒环境中工作时，防护服应遮住包括脸颊在内的裸露部位。
collocations: rosy cheeks｜红润的脸颊 ; a kiss on the cheek｜脸颊上的一吻 ; have the cheek to｜竟厚着脸皮做 ; cheek by cheek｜脸贴脸
tip_zh: 脸颊义可数；无礼义通常不可数，多用于英式口语。

meanings_zh: n. 志向；抱负 | n. 进取心；雄心
definition_en: A strong desire to achieve a particular goal. | Determination to become successful, powerful, or highly skilled.
example1_en: Her childhood ambition was to design bridges across rivers.
example1_zh: 她儿时的志向是设计跨河大桥。
example2_en: Schools should nurture students' ambition while helping them set realistic goals and develop practical skills.
example2_zh: 学校应培养学生的进取心，同时帮助他们设定切实可行的目标并发展实用技能。
collocations: achieve an ambition｜实现抱负 ; lifelong ambition｜毕生志向 ; political ambition｜政治抱负 ; ambition to succeed｜追求成功的雄心
tip_zh: 具体志向可数，进取心不可数；常接to do。

meanings_zh: adj. 先进的 | adj. 高级的；高阶的 | adj. 后期的；晚期的
definition_en: using highly developed technology or methods | requiring knowledge or skills beyond a basic level | having reached a late stage of development or progress
example1_en: This advanced camera takes clear pictures even at night.
example1_zh: 这台先进的相机即使在夜间也能拍出清晰的照片。
example2_en: Advanced medical technology can improve patient outcomes, but its high cost may increase inequalities in healthcare access.
example2_zh: 先进的医疗技术可以改善治疗效果，但其高昂成本可能加剧医疗服务获取方面的不平等。
collocations: advanced technology｜先进技术 ; advanced learners｜高阶学习者 ; at an advanced stage｜处于后期阶段 ; advanced level｜高级水平
tip_zh: advanced表示先进或高级；预先通知用advance notice。

meanings_zh: n. 耳机；耳塞式耳机
definition_en: A small device worn in or over an ear for listening
example1_en: One earphone fell out while I was jogging.
example1_zh: 我慢跑时，一只耳机掉了出来。
example2_en: Students using earphones in shared study spaces can listen to educational recordings without disturbing others.
example2_zh: 学生在公共自习空间使用耳机，可以收听教学录音而不打扰他人。
collocations: a pair of earphones｜一副耳机 ; wireless earphones｜无线耳机 ; wear earphones｜戴耳机
tip_zh: 通常用复数earphones；一副耳机用a pair of。

meanings_zh: n. 市长；镇长
definition_en: The official who leads or represents a city or town
example1_en: The mayor opened our new swimming pool yesterday.
example1_zh: 市长昨天为我们的新游泳馆主持了启用仪式。
example2_en: The newly elected mayor has promised to improve public transport and create more affordable housing for residents.
example2_zh: 新当选的市长承诺改善公共交通，并为居民提供更多可负担住房。
collocations: elect a mayor｜选举市长 ; the mayor of a city｜一座城市的市长 ; deputy mayor｜副市长 ; run for mayor｜竞选市长
tip_zh: mayor是市长，别与major（主要的）混淆。

meanings_zh: n. 毒物；毒药 | v. 使中毒；污染 | v. 破坏；毒化
definition_en: A substance that can seriously harm or kill living things. | Harm living things or contaminate something with a toxic substance. | Make a relationship or situation unpleasant or harmful.
example1_en: Some garden plants contain poison, so keep pets away.
example1_zh: 有些园艺植物含有毒素，因此要让宠物远离。
example2_en: Toxic waste from poorly regulated factories can poison rivers, threatening wildlife and the health of nearby communities.
example2_zh: 监管不力的工厂排出的有毒废物可能污染河流，威胁野生动物和附近居民的健康。
collocations: contain poison｜含有毒素 ; poison the water supply｜污染供水 ; poisoning prevention｜中毒预防 ; poison relations｜破坏关系
tip_zh: poison 是名词或动词；“有毒的”用 poisonous。

meanings_zh: n. 代码；密码；编码 | n. 行为准则；规范 | v. 编写程序；编码
definition_en: Symbols or instructions representing information, including instructions for computers | A set of rules governing behaviour or practice | Write computer instructions or convert information into a coded form
example1_en: I forgot the code for my bicycle lock again.
example1_zh: 我又忘了自行车锁的密码。
example2_en: Teaching students to write code can strengthen problem-solving skills and prepare them for a changing job market.
example2_zh: 教学生编写代码可以增强解决问题的能力，帮助他们适应不断变化的就业市场。
collocations: write code｜编写代码 ; access code｜访问密码 ; code of conduct｜行为准则 ; dress code｜着装规定
tip_zh: 程序代码通常不可数；一组密码可说a code。

meanings_zh: v. 滑动；使滑行 | n. 幻灯片 | n. 滑梯
definition_en: to move smoothly across a surface without lifting | a single image or page shown during a presentation | a sloping structure that children slide down
example1_en: She slid the plate across the table towards me.
example1_zh: 她把盘子沿着桌面推滑到我面前。
example2_en: Teachers can use a carefully designed slide to explain complex scientific processes more clearly.
example2_zh: 教师可以用精心设计的幻灯片更清楚地解释复杂的科学过程。
collocations: slide across｜滑过 ; slide into｜滑入 ; presentation slide｜演示幻灯片 ; go down a slide｜滑滑梯
tip_zh: 动词过去式和过去分词均为slid。

meanings_zh: adj. 最大的；最多的；最高的 | n. 最大值；上限
definition_en: being the greatest amount or level possible or allowed | the greatest amount or level possible or allowed
example1_en: This lift has a maximum capacity of eight people.
example1_zh: 这部电梯最多可容纳八人。
example2_en: Governments should set maximum limits on industrial emissions to protect public health and improve air quality.
example2_zh: 政府应对工业排放设定上限，以保护公众健康并改善空气质量。
collocations: maximum capacity｜最大容量 ; maximum speed｜最高速度 ; a maximum of｜最多 ; reach the maximum｜达到上限
tip_zh: a maximum of表示“最多”；反义词是minimum。

meanings_zh: n. 节省；节省的金额 | n. 储蓄；存款
definition_en: a reduction in the money, time, or resources used | money kept rather than spent, usually for future needs
example1_en: Buying a monthly pass gave me a useful saving.
example1_zh: 买月票让我省下了一笔实用的开支。
example2_en: Investing in efficient heating systems can produce significant energy savings for households over the long term.
example2_zh: 从长远来看，投资高效供暖系统能显著降低家庭能耗。
collocations: make a saving｜节省开支 ; energy savings｜节能量 ; life savings｜毕生积蓄 ; savings account｜储蓄账户
tip_zh: 表示积蓄通常用复数savings；节省可用单数。

meanings_zh: n. 冠军 | n. 拥护者；捍卫者 | v. 支持；捍卫
definition_en: a person or team that wins a competition | someone who strongly supports a cause or group | to actively support or defend a cause or person
example1_en: The new champion lifted her trophy with both hands.
example1_zh: 新冠军双手举起了奖杯。
example2_en: Local organisations can champion affordable housing by working with residents and presenting practical proposals to councils.
example2_zh: 地方组织可以与居民合作，向地方议会提交切实可行的提案，推动提供可负担住房。
collocations: world champion｜世界冠军 ; defending champion｜卫冕冠军 ; a champion of equality｜平等的拥护者 ; champion a cause｜支持一项事业
tip_zh: 作动词直接接宾语：champion a cause。

meanings_zh: n. 手电筒 | n. 火把；火炬
definition_en: A small electric light carried in the hand. | A stick with burning material at one end, providing light.
example1_en: I used a torch to find my missing keys.
example1_zh: 我用手电筒寻找丢失的钥匙。
example2_en: Hikers should carry a torch and spare batteries when exploring remote areas after sunset.
example2_zh: 徒步者在日落后探索偏远地区时，应携带手电筒和备用电池。
collocations: switch on a torch｜打开手电筒 ; a torch beam｜手电筒的光束 ; carry a torch｜携带火把 ; a flaming torch｜燃烧的火炬
tip_zh: 手电筒英式叫torch，美式叫flashlight。

meanings_zh: n. 裂缝；裂纹 | v. 裂开；使破裂 | n. 清脆的爆裂声
definition_en: A narrow break in a surface or solid object | Break or cause something to break without completely separating | A sudden sharp sound, like something breaking
example1_en: There's a thin crack across my favourite blue mug.
example1_zh: 我最喜欢的蓝色杯子上有一道细细的裂纹。
example2_en: Engineers discovered a crack in the bridge during a routine inspection and recommended immediate repairs.
example2_zh: 工程师在例行检查中发现桥梁有一道裂缝，并建议立即维修。
collocations: a crack in the wall｜墙上的裂缝 ; crack an egg｜打破鸡蛋 ; a loud crack｜响亮的爆裂声
tip_zh: crack常指裂而未碎；shatter强调碎成许多片。

meanings_zh: n. 付款；支付 | n. 支付的款项
definition_en: the act of giving money for something | an amount of money paid or due to be paid
example1_en: The shop accepts payment by card or cash.
example1_zh: 这家商店接受刷卡或现金付款。
example2_en: Digital payment systems can make everyday transactions more convenient, but they may exclude people without internet access.
example2_zh: 数字支付系统能让日常交易更便捷，但可能将无法上网的人排除在外。
collocations: make a payment｜付款 ; payment in advance｜预付款 ; monthly payment｜每月付款额 ; payment method｜支付方式
tip_zh: 支付行为通常不可数；一笔款项可用a payment。

meanings_zh: adj. 快乐的；乐观的 | adj. 令人愉快的；明快的
definition_en: Feeling or showing happiness and a positive attitude. | Making a place or experience feel bright and pleasant.
example1_en: Our cheerful neighbour waved as we left the house.
example1_zh: 我们出门时，开朗的邻居向我们挥了挥手。
example2_en: A cheerful classroom atmosphere can encourage younger learners to participate more actively in group discussions.
example2_zh: 愉快的课堂氛围能鼓励年幼的学习者更积极地参与小组讨论。
collocations: cheerful smile｜愉快的笑容 ; cheerful mood｜愉悦的心情 ; cheerful atmosphere｜欢快的氛围
tip_zh: 既可形容人心情开朗，也可形容环境明快。

meanings_zh: n. 介词
definition_en: a word showing relationships, such as location, direction, or time
example1_en: Our teacher used a toy rabbit to explain each preposition.
example1_zh: 老师用一只玩具兔来解释每个介词。
example2_en: Choosing the correct preposition helps language learners express relationships between ideas more precisely in academic writing.
example2_zh: 选择正确的介词有助于语言学习者在学术写作中更准确地表达观点之间的关系。
collocations: a preposition of place｜地点介词 ; a preposition of time｜时间介词 ; prepositional phrase｜介词短语
tip_zh: 介词后通常接名词、代词或动名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 极度害怕的；惊恐的
definition_en: Feeling extremely afraid.
example1_en: I was terrified when thunder shook the windows last night.
example1_zh: 昨晚雷声震得窗户发抖时，我吓坏了。
example2_en: Students who are terrified of public speaking may benefit from practising presentations in small, supportive groups.
example2_zh: 极度害怕公开演讲的学生，可以通过在互相支持的小组中练习展示而受益。
collocations: terrified of｜极度害怕 ; terrified at the thought of｜一想到就惊恐 ; absolutely terrified｜吓坏了
tip_zh: 人感到害怕用terrified；事物吓人用terrifying。

meanings_zh: n. 一排；一行 | v. 划船 | n. 争吵；吵闹
definition_en: people or things arranged in a straight line | to move a boat through water using oars | a noisy argument or loud disturbance
example1_en: We found two empty seats in the front row.
example1_zh: 我们在前排找到了两个空座位。
example2_en: Planting a row of trees beside busy roads can help reduce noise and improve local air quality.
example2_zh: 在繁忙道路旁种植一排树木，有助于降低噪声并改善当地空气质量。
collocations: in a row｜排成一排；连续 ; front row｜前排 ; row a boat｜划船 ; have a row｜吵架
tip_zh: “排、划船”读/rəʊ/；“争吵”英美均读/raʊ/。

meanings_zh: n. 地震
definition_en: Sudden shaking of the ground caused by movement beneath Earth's surface.
example1_en: The earthquake made the cups rattle on our kitchen shelf.
example1_zh: 地震使厨房架子上的杯子碰得咯咯作响。
example2_en: Strict building regulations can significantly reduce the risk of injury when an earthquake strikes a densely populated city.
example2_zh: 当地震袭击人口稠密的城市时，严格的建筑法规可以显著降低人员受伤的风险。
collocations: a powerful earthquake｜强烈地震 ; an earthquake strikes｜地震发生 ; earthquake damage｜地震造成的破坏 ; earthquake zone｜地震带
tip_zh: 可数名词；表示发生地震可说an earthquake strikes。

meanings_zh: n. 税；税款 | v. 对……征税 | v. 使负担沉重；使费尽
definition_en: Money paid to the government to fund public services. | Require someone to pay money to the government. | Put heavy demands on someone's strength or abilities.
example1_en: The tax on my monthly salary has gone up.
example1_zh: 我每月工资要缴的税增加了。
example2_en: Governments can use tax revenue to improve public transport and make healthcare more accessible.
example2_zh: 政府可以利用税收改善公共交通，让医疗服务惠及更多人。
collocations: income tax｜所得税 ; pay tax｜缴税 ; tax revenue｜税收收入 ; tax goods｜对商品征税
tip_zh: tax可作名词或动词；taxing常指费力的、累人的。

meanings_zh: n. 庇护；遮蔽 | n. 避难所；遮蔽物 | v. 躲避；庇护
definition_en: Protection from danger or bad weather. | A place that provides safety or protection. | To stay somewhere protected, or protect someone from harm.
example1_en: We found shelter under a bridge during the storm.
example1_zh: 暴风雨中，我们躲到一座桥下避雨。
example2_en: Local authorities should provide temporary shelter for residents whose homes have been damaged by floods.
example2_zh: 地方政府应为房屋遭洪水损坏的居民提供临时住所。
collocations: take shelter｜躲避 ; temporary shelter｜临时住所 ; shelter from the rain｜避雨 ; animal shelter｜动物收容所
tip_zh: 表示庇护通常不可数；指具体避难所时可数。

meanings_zh: adv. 相当；还算 | adv. 公平地；公正地
definition_en: to a moderate degree, but not very | in a way that treats people equally and reasonably
example1_en: The walk home was fairly short and very pleasant.
example1_zh: 走路回家的路程还算短，一路也很惬意。
example2_en: Schools should distribute resources fairly so that students from disadvantaged backgrounds receive the support they need.
example2_zh: 学校应公平分配资源，让背景不利的学生获得所需的支持。
collocations: fairly easy｜还算容易 ; fairly common｜相当常见 ; treat people fairly｜公平待人 ; distribute resources fairly｜公平分配资源
tip_zh: 表程度时弱于very；fairly good是还不错，并非极好。

meanings_zh: n. 感官；感觉能力 | n. 感觉；意识 | v. 察觉；感觉到
definition_en: An ability to perceive through sight, hearing, touch, taste, or smell. | A feeling or awareness of something. | To become aware of something without being directly told.
example1_en: Dogs have a much stronger sense of smell than humans.
example1_zh: 狗的嗅觉比人类灵敏得多。
example2_en: Community gardens can strengthen residents' sense of belonging by creating opportunities for regular social interaction.
example2_zh: 社区花园可以创造日常社交机会，从而增强居民的归属感。
collocations: sense of smell｜嗅觉 ; sense of belonging｜归属感 ; common sense｜常识 ; make sense｜有道理；讲得通
tip_zh: make sense指讲得通；make sense of指理解。

meanings_zh: n. 胶带 | n. 磁带；录音带 | v. 用胶带粘贴或固定
definition_en: A narrow sticky strip used to attach or seal things. | A magnetic strip used to record sound, images, or data. | Attach or secure something using sticky tape.
example1_en: I sealed the parcel with a strip of tape.
example1_zh: 我用一条胶带封好了包裹。
example2_en: Older interviews stored on magnetic tape should be digitised to preserve valuable records for future historical research.
example2_zh: 保存在磁带上的早期访谈应进行数字化处理，为未来的历史研究保存珍贵记录。
collocations: adhesive tape｜胶带 ; magnetic tape｜磁带 ; a roll of tape｜一卷胶带 ; tape measure｜卷尺
tip_zh: 胶带通常不可数；一卷胶带说a roll of tape。

meanings_zh: n. 隧道；地下通道 | v. 挖隧道
definition_en: A passage built underground or through a hill. | To dig a passage underground or through something.
example1_en: The train entered a dark tunnel beneath the hill.
example1_zh: 火车驶入了山下的一条漆黑隧道。
example2_en: Building a tunnel under the river could reduce traffic congestion and improve connections between neighbouring districts.
example2_zh: 在河底修建隧道可以缓解交通拥堵，并改善相邻区域之间的交通联系。
collocations: railway tunnel｜铁路隧道 ; dig a tunnel｜挖隧道 ; tunnel through｜挖隧道穿过
tip_zh: 介词 through 常表示从隧道内部穿过。

meanings_zh: n. 步行小径；人行道
definition_en: A path intended for walking rather than driving.
example1_en: A narrow footpath leads from our village to the lake.
example1_zh: 一条狭窄的小径从我们村通向湖边。
example2_en: Maintaining rural footpaths encourages outdoor recreation while helping visitors avoid damage to surrounding farmland.
example2_zh: 维护乡村步道既能鼓励户外休闲，也能帮助游客避免破坏周围的农田。
collocations: public footpath｜公共步行道 ; narrow footpath｜狭窄的小径 ; follow a footpath｜沿小径走
tip_zh: 常指供步行的小径，不一定紧邻公路。

meanings_zh: n. 金额 | n. 总和；总数 | v. 概括；总结
definition_en: an amount of money | the total obtained by adding amounts together | to state the main points, usually with up
example1_en: She saved a small sum for a new bicycle.
example1_zh: 她为买一辆新自行车攒了一小笔钱。
example2_en: Governments invest large sums in public transport to reduce congestion and improve urban air quality.
example2_zh: 政府在公共交通上投入巨资，以缓解拥堵并改善城市空气质量。
collocations: a large sum of money｜一大笔钱 ; the sum of｜……的总和 ; sum up｜概括；总结
tip_zh: sum up表示总结；一笔钱用a sum of money。

meanings_zh: n. 墙纸；壁纸 | n. 屏幕背景图；桌面壁纸 | v. 给墙贴壁纸
definition_en: decorative paper used to cover interior walls | an image displayed behind icons on a screen | to cover walls with decorative paper
example1_en: We chose pale green wallpaper for our small bedroom.
example1_zh: 我们为小卧室选了浅绿色墙纸。
example2_en: Choosing durable wallpaper can reduce the frequency of interior renovations and limit household material waste.
example2_zh: 选择耐用的墙纸可以减少室内翻新的频率，降低家庭材料浪费。
collocations: patterned wallpaper｜带图案的墙纸 ; a roll of wallpaper｜一卷墙纸 ; hang wallpaper｜贴墙纸 ; desktop wallpaper｜桌面壁纸
tip_zh: wallpaper通常不可数；一卷用a roll of wallpaper。

meanings_zh: v. 传播；蔓延 | v. 展开；摊开；涂抹 | n. 传播；扩散
definition_en: To reach, or make something reach, more people or places | To open something out or cover a surface with something | The process of reaching a wider area or more people
example1_en: She spread a blanket under the tree for our picnic.
example1_zh: 她在树下铺了一条毯子，供我们野餐用。
example2_en: The rapid spread of false information online highlights the importance of teaching critical reading skills in schools.
example2_zh: 虚假信息在网上迅速传播，凸显了学校教授批判性阅读技能的重要性。
collocations: spread awareness｜提高公众意识 ; spread rapidly｜迅速传播 ; spread butter｜涂黄油 ; the spread of disease｜疾病的传播
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为spread。

meanings_zh: v. 脱衣服；给某人脱衣服
definition_en: To take off your own clothes or someone else's clothes.
example1_en: I undressed behind the curtain and put on pyjamas.
example1_zh: 我在帘子后脱下衣服，换上睡衣。
example2_en: Healthcare staff should provide private spaces where patients can undress comfortably before a physical examination.
example2_zh: 医护人员应提供私密空间，让患者在体检前安心脱衣。
collocations: get undressed｜脱掉衣服 ; undress for bed｜脱衣就寝
tip_zh: undress可不接宾语；脱某件衣服用take off。

meanings_zh: n. 场面；景象 | n. 事发现场 | n. 一场戏；片段
definition_en: a view or situation that you see | the place where an event happens | a short part of a play or film
example1_en: The children playing by the lake made a peaceful scene.
example1_zh: 孩子们在湖边玩耍，构成了一幅宁静的画面。
example2_en: The film's opening scene highlights the challenges faced by families living in crowded urban neighbourhoods.
example2_zh: 影片的开场片段突出了居住在拥挤城市社区的家庭面临的挑战。
collocations: a peaceful scene｜宁静的景象 ; at the scene｜在现场 ; opening scene｜开场片段 ; behind the scenes｜在幕后
tip_zh: scene可数；scenery指整体风景，不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 热爱；强烈兴趣 | n. 激情；强烈情感
definition_en: a very strong enthusiasm for an activity or subject | a powerful feeling, especially love or anger
example1_en: Her passion for baking fills our kitchen with delicious smells.
example1_zh: 她对烘焙的热爱让我们的厨房总是香气四溢。
example2_en: Teachers who share their passion for science can inspire students to pursue careers in research.
example2_zh: 教师分享自己对科学的热爱，能够激励学生投身科研事业。
collocations: a passion for music｜对音乐的热爱 ; develop a passion for｜逐渐热爱 ; pursue your passion｜追求热爱之事
tip_zh: 表达对某事的热爱，用a passion for。

meanings_zh: n. 复习；温习 | n. 修改；修订
definition_en: Studying material again to prepare for an examination | The process or result of changing something to improve it
example1_en: I do my revision at the kitchen table.
example1_zh: 我在厨房的餐桌旁复习。
example2_en: Regular revision helps students retain knowledge more effectively than studying intensively just before an examination.
example2_zh: 定期复习比考前突击学习更能帮助学生牢固掌握知识。
collocations: do revision｜进行复习 ; revision timetable｜复习时间表 ; major revision｜重大修订
tip_zh: 复习义主要用于英式英语；美式常用review。

meanings_zh: n. 自动扶梯
definition_en: moving stairs that carry people between floors
example1_en: Hold the handrail while you ride the escalator upstairs.
example1_zh: 乘自动扶梯上楼时，请扶好扶手。
example2_en: Although escalators improve passenger flow in stations, lifts are essential for travellers who use wheelchairs.
example2_zh: 尽管自动扶梯能改善车站的客流通行情况，但对使用轮椅的旅客而言，电梯必不可少。
collocations: take the escalator｜乘自动扶梯 ; an upward escalator｜上行自动扶梯 ; escalator handrail｜自动扶梯扶手
tip_zh: escalator是自动扶梯；lift是厢式电梯。

meanings_zh: adv. 通常；一般地 | adv. 普遍地；广泛地
definition_en: In most cases or at most times. | By most people or across most places.
example1_en: I generally walk to work unless it rains.
example1_zh: 除非下雨，否则我通常步行上班。
example2_en: Public transport is generally more energy-efficient than private cars, especially when services carry large numbers of passengers.
example2_zh: 公共交通通常比私家车更节能，尤其是在载客量较大的情况下。
collocations: generally speaking｜一般来说 ; generally accepted｜普遍接受的 ; generally regarded as｜普遍被视为
tip_zh: generally表示多数情况，并非毫无例外；句首可用generally speaking。

meanings_zh: n. 堆；一堆东西 | v. 堆放；堆积
definition_en: Objects placed together, often one on top of another. | To put things together in a heap.
example1_en: A pile of dirty dishes filled the sink.
example1_zh: 一堆脏餐具塞满了水槽。
example2_en: When waste collection services are inadequate, piles of rubbish can threaten public health in densely populated neighbourhoods.
example2_zh: 垃圾清运服务不足时，成堆的垃圾可能威胁人口密集社区的公共卫生。
collocations: a pile of books｜一堆书 ; pile up｜堆积起来 ; pile plates on a table｜把盘子堆在桌上
tip_zh: a pile of后接所堆之物；pile up表示积聚。

meanings_zh: n. 手电筒
definition_en: A small portable electric light powered by batteries.
example1_en: She used a flashlight to look under the bed.
example1_zh: 她用手电筒照着查看床底。
example2_en: Households should keep a flashlight readily available to improve safety during unexpected power cuts.
example2_zh: 家庭应将手电筒放在随手可取的地方，以提高突发停电时的安全性。
collocations: turn on a flashlight｜打开手电筒 ; shine a flashlight｜用手电筒照射 ; flashlight beam｜手电筒的光束
tip_zh: 手电筒的美式说法；英式通常用torch。

meanings_zh: n. 手帕
definition_en: A small cloth used for wiping your nose or face.
example1_en: She pulled a clean handkerchief from her coat pocket.
example1_zh: 她从外套口袋里掏出一块干净的手帕。
example2_en: Using a washable handkerchief instead of disposable tissues can reduce everyday household waste.
example2_zh: 使用可清洗的手帕代替一次性纸巾，可以减少日常生活垃圾。
collocations: a clean handkerchief｜干净的手帕 ; a cotton handkerchief｜棉手帕 ; a pocket handkerchief｜口袋手帕
tip_zh: 指擦脸、擦鼻子的手帕，一般不指头巾。

meanings_zh: adj. 自动的 | adj. 不自觉的；无意识的 | adj. 必然发生的
definition_en: Working by itself without direct human control. | Done without conscious thought or deliberate effort. | Happening as a direct result without a separate decision.
example1_en: The automatic doors opened as I approached the supermarket.
example1_zh: 我走近超市时，自动门打开了。
example2_en: Automatic lighting systems can reduce energy consumption by switching off when nobody is present in a room.
example2_zh: 自动照明系统能在房间无人时关闭灯光，从而降低能耗。
collocations: automatic doors｜自动门 ; automatic response｜本能反应 ; automatic renewal｜自动续期
tip_zh: 可指机器自动运作，也可指人未经思考的反应。

meanings_zh: adj. 热衷的；渴望的 | adj. 敏锐的 | adj. 激烈的；强烈的
definition_en: very interested in something or eager to do it | quick to notice or understand things | very strong or intense
example1_en: Leila is keen to join our weekend hiking group.
example1_zh: 莱拉很想加入我们的周末徒步小组。
example2_en: Students who are keen on science benefit from practical experiments that connect theory with everyday experience.
example2_zh: 热爱科学的学生能从将理论与日常经验相结合的实践实验中受益。
collocations: keen to learn｜渴望学习 ; keen on sport｜热衷运动 ; a keen eye for detail｜敏锐的细节观察力 ; keen competition｜激烈的竞争
tip_zh: keen on后接名词或动名词；keen to后接动词原形。

meanings_zh: n. 壳；贝壳 | v. 剥壳；去壳 | n. 炮弹
definition_en: A hard outer covering protecting an animal, egg, or nut. | To remove the hard outer covering of something. | An explosive object fired from a large gun.
example1_en: She found a tiny crab inside the empty shell.
example1_zh: 她在空贝壳里发现了一只小螃蟹。
example2_en: Rising ocean acidity can weaken the shells of marine animals, threatening their survival and wider ecosystems.
example2_zh: 海洋酸度上升会削弱海洋动物的外壳，威胁其生存以及更广泛的生态系统。
collocations: a hard shell｜坚硬的外壳 ; an empty shell｜空壳 ; shell peas｜剥豌豆
tip_zh: shell作动词可指剥壳；shell peas是剥豌豆。

meanings_zh: n. 墨水；油墨 | v. 给…上墨
definition_en: coloured liquid used for writing, drawing or printing | to apply ink to a surface
example1_en: Blue ink leaked from my pen onto my sleeve.
example1_zh: 蓝色墨水从钢笔里漏出来，沾到了我的袖子上。
example2_en: Schools can reduce their environmental impact by using less paper and choosing refillable ink cartridges.
example2_zh: 学校可以通过减少纸张用量和选择可填充墨盒来降低对环境的影响。
collocations: in ink｜用墨水 ; ink cartridge｜墨盒 ; printing ink｜印刷油墨 ; run out of ink｜墨水用完
tip_zh: ink作名词通常不可数；“用墨水写”用in ink。

meanings_zh: n. 表达；表示 | n. 表情；神色 | n. 词语；说法
definition_en: The act of showing thoughts or feelings through words or actions. | The look on someone's face that reveals feelings. | A word or phrase with a particular meaning.
example1_en: He sent flowers as an expression of his gratitude.
example1_zh: 他送了花来表达谢意。
example2_en: Schools should encourage creative expression by giving students regular opportunities to explore music, drama, and visual arts.
example2_zh: 学校应定期让学生接触音乐、戏剧和视觉艺术，以鼓励创造性表达。
collocations: freedom of expression｜表达自由 ; facial expression｜面部表情 ; an expression of gratitude｜感谢的表示 ; idiomatic expression｜惯用语
tip_zh: 表示“表情、说法”时可数；表示“表达”时常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 细绳；线 | n. 琴弦 | n. 一串；一连串
definition_en: Thin cord used for tying or fastening things. | A stretched wire or thread that produces musical sounds. | A series of connected things or events.
example1_en: I tied the parcel with a piece of string.
example1_zh: 我用一根细绳把包裹绑好了。
example2_en: A string of successful conservation projects has demonstrated the value of involving local communities in environmental protection.
example2_zh: 一系列成功的自然保护项目证明了让当地社区参与环境保护的价值。
collocations: a piece of string｜一根细绳 ; guitar strings｜吉他弦 ; a string of successes｜一连串成功 ; tie with string｜用细绳捆绑
tip_zh: 绳线通常不可数；琴弦及a string of中的string可数。

meanings_zh: n. 利润；盈利 | v. 获利；受益
definition_en: Money earned after paying the costs of a business. | To gain money or an advantage from something.
example1_en: The bakery made a small profit this month.
example1_zh: 这家面包店这个月赚了一点钱。
example2_en: Companies should invest part of their profit in cleaner technology to reduce environmental damage.
example2_zh: 企业应将部分利润投入更清洁的技术，以减少环境损害。
collocations: make a profit｜盈利 ; net profit｜净利润 ; profit margin｜利润率 ; profit from｜从……中获益
tip_zh: profit是扣除成本后的利润，不等于收入revenue。

meanings_zh: adj. 尴尬的；难为情的
definition_en: Feeling uncomfortable or ashamed about something others notice.
example1_en: I felt embarrassed when my phone rang during dinner.
example1_zh: 吃饭时手机响了，我感到很尴尬。
example2_en: Students may feel embarrassed about making mistakes, so teachers should create a supportive classroom environment.
example2_zh: 学生可能因犯错而感到难为情，因此教师应营造支持性的课堂环境。
collocations: feel embarrassed｜感到尴尬 ; embarrassed about｜因……而难为情 ; too embarrassed to ask｜难为情而不敢问
tip_zh: 人感到尴尬用embarrassed；事令人尴尬用embarrassing。

meanings_zh: v. 使兴奋；使激动 | v. 激起；引发
definition_en: to make someone feel enthusiastic and eager | to cause a particular feeling or reaction
example1_en: Trips to the seaside always excite my younger sister.
example1_zh: 去海边玩总能让我妹妹兴奋不已。
example2_en: Interactive science exhibitions can excite young visitors and encourage them to explore scientific ideas independently.
example2_zh: 互动式科学展览能让年轻参观者兴奋起来，并鼓励他们自主探索科学概念。
collocations: excite interest｜引起兴趣 ; excite curiosity｜激起好奇心 ; excite the imagination｜激发想象力
tip_zh: 人感到兴奋用excited；事物令人兴奋用exciting。

meanings_zh: adj. 残忍的；刻薄的 | adj. 令人痛苦的；无情的
definition_en: Causing suffering without caring about others' feelings. | Causing great suffering or disappointment.
example1_en: It was cruel to laugh at her mistake.
example1_zh: 嘲笑她的错误很刻薄。
example2_en: Schools should address cruel behaviour early to ensure that every child feels safe and respected.
example2_zh: 学校应及早处理伤害他人的行为，确保每个孩子都感到安全并受到尊重。
collocations: be cruel to animals｜虐待动物 ; a cruel remark｜刻薄的话 ; a cruel blow｜沉重的打击
tip_zh: 表示对某人或动物残忍，用be cruel to。

meanings_zh: n. 地图册
definition_en: A book containing maps of the world or particular regions.
example1_en: We opened the atlas to find a mountain range.
example1_zh: 我们打开地图册，寻找一条山脉。
example2_en: Although digital maps are convenient, a printed atlas helps students compare geographical patterns across entire continents.
example2_zh: 虽然电子地图很方便，纸质地图册仍有助于学生比较整个大陆范围内的地理分布特征。
collocations: world atlas｜世界地图册 ; historical atlas｜历史地图集 ; road atlas｜公路地图册
tip_zh: atlas是成册的地图；复数为atlases。

meanings_zh: n. 远足；徒步旅行 | v. 远足；徒步旅行 | n. 大幅上涨
definition_en: A long walk, usually through the countryside or mountains. | To walk a long distance, especially in natural surroundings. | A large increase in a price, cost, or rate.
example1_en: Our weekend hike ended beside a clear mountain lake.
example1_zh: 我们周末的徒步旅行在一片清澈的山间湖泊旁结束。
example2_en: A sharp hike in public transport fares could discourage commuters from choosing buses over private cars.
example2_zh: 公共交通票价大幅上涨可能会降低通勤者选择公交车而非私家车的意愿。
collocations: go for a hike｜去远足 ; mountain hike｜山地徒步 ; price hike｜价格大幅上涨
tip_zh: hike通常指较长的户外步行，也可指价格猛涨。

meanings_zh: n. 小鸡；雏鸟
definition_en: A baby bird, especially a young chicken.
example1_en: A yellow chick followed the hen across the yard.
example1_zh: 一只黄色小鸡跟着母鸡穿过院子。
example2_en: Conservation teams monitor each newly hatched chick to assess whether habitat restoration is improving breeding success.
example2_zh: 保护团队监测每只刚孵化的雏鸟，以评估栖息地修复是否提高了繁殖成功率。
collocations: newly hatched chick｜刚孵化的雏鸟 ; day-old chick｜一日龄雏鸡 ; rear chicks｜饲养雏鸟
tip_zh: 不只指小鸡，也可指其他鸟的幼鸟。

meanings_zh: n. 库存；储备 | n. 股票；股份 | v. 备有；供应；储存
definition_en: Goods available for sale or supplies kept for future use. | Shares representing ownership in a company. | To keep goods available for sale or use.
example1_en: The shop has fresh stock arriving early tomorrow morning.
example1_zh: 这家店明天一早会有新货到店。
example2_en: Small retailers often struggle to maintain sufficient stock when transport disruptions delay deliveries from major suppliers.
example2_zh: 当运输中断导致主要供应商延迟交货时，小型零售商往往难以维持充足库存。
collocations: in stock｜有现货 ; out of stock｜缺货 ; the stock market｜股票市场 ; stock up on food｜囤积食物
tip_zh: 库存通常不可数；表示不同公司的股票时可用stocks。

meanings_zh: n. 陌生人 | n. 初到某地的人；外来者
definition_en: someone you do not know | someone unfamiliar with a particular place or community
example1_en: A kind stranger helped me carry my heavy suitcase.
example1_zh: 一位好心的陌生人帮我提了沉重的行李箱。
example2_en: Community events can encourage residents to interact with strangers and develop a stronger sense of belonging.
example2_zh: 社区活动可以鼓励居民与陌生人交流，增强归属感。
collocations: complete stranger｜完全不认识的人 ; stranger to the area｜初到这一地区的人 ; no stranger to｜对……并不陌生
tip_zh: stranger是陌生人，不等于foreigner外国人。

meanings_zh: n. 选举 | n. 当选
definition_en: a process in which people vote to choose representatives | the act of being chosen for a position by voting
example1_en: Our club is holding an election for its next chair.
example1_zh: 我们俱乐部正在举行选举，选出下一任主席。
example2_en: A fair election requires transparent procedures and equal opportunities for candidates to present their policies.
example2_zh: 公平的选举需要透明的程序，并让候选人有平等机会介绍其政策。
collocations: hold an election｜举行选举 ; general election｜大选 ; election campaign｜竞选活动 ; win an election｜赢得选举
tip_zh: elect强调投票选出；select泛指挑选。

meanings_zh: n. 影子；阴影 | v. 跟随观察；跟岗学习
definition_en: A dark shape or area where something blocks light. | To follow someone closely, often to learn about their work.
example1_en: The cat chased its shadow across the sunny kitchen floor.
example1_zh: 猫在阳光照着的厨房地板上追逐自己的影子。
example2_en: Allowing students to shadow experienced nurses can help them understand the practical demands of a healthcare career.
example2_zh: 让学生跟随经验丰富的护士学习，有助于他们了解医疗职业的实际要求。
collocations: cast a shadow｜投下影子 ; in the shadows｜在暗处 ; job shadowing｜跟岗学习
tip_zh: shadow指具体影子；shade多指遮阳的阴凉处。

meanings_zh: n. 药物 | n. 毒品 | v. 给…下药
definition_en: A substance used to prevent or treat illness. | A substance taken for its effects on mind or body. | To give someone a substance that makes them unconscious or weak.
example1_en: The doctor prescribed a drug to ease her pain.
example1_zh: 医生开了一种药来缓解她的疼痛。
example2_en: New drug development requires extensive testing to ensure that treatments are both safe and effective.
example2_zh: 新药研发需要进行大量测试，以确保治疗既安全又有效。
collocations: prescription drug｜处方药 ; drug development｜药物研发 ; drug abuse｜毒品滥用 ; drug resistance｜耐药性
tip_zh: 可指治病的药，也可指毒品，须看语境。

meanings_zh: adj. 含酒精的 | adj. 酒精依赖的；酒精引起的 | n. 酒精依赖者
definition_en: Containing alcohol. | Affected by alcohol dependence, or caused by alcohol. | A person who is dependent on alcohol.
example1_en: The waiter asked whether we wanted any alcoholic drinks.
example1_zh: 服务员问我们是否需要含酒精的饮品。
example2_en: Clear information about alcoholic beverages can help consumers understand health risks and make more informed choices.
example2_zh: 关于酒精饮品的清晰信息可以帮助消费者了解健康风险，并作出更明智的选择。
collocations: alcoholic drinks｜含酒精饮品 ; alcoholic beverages｜酒精饮料 ; alcoholic liver disease｜酒精性肝病
tip_zh: 指人时宜用person with alcohol dependence，更尊重。

meanings_zh: n. 谷物；粮食 | n. 颗粒；细粒 | n. 木材纹理
definition_en: seeds of crops such as wheat, used as food | a very small hard piece of a substance | the natural pattern of lines in wood
example1_en: The farmer stored the grain in a dry barn.
example1_zh: 农民把粮食存放在干燥的谷仓里。
example2_en: Growing grain requires reliable water supplies, which are increasingly threatened by drought in many agricultural regions.
example2_zh: 种植谷物需要可靠的供水，而许多农业地区的供水正日益受到干旱的威胁。
collocations: whole grain｜全谷物 ; a grain of sand｜一粒沙 ; wood grain｜木纹
tip_zh: grain指粮食通常不可数；指单颗谷粒或细粒可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 不公平的；不公正的
definition_en: not treating people equally or reasonably
example1_en: It seems unfair that I always wash the dishes.
example1_zh: 总是让我洗碗，这似乎不公平。
example2_en: Unfair hiring practices can prevent qualified applicants from accessing employment opportunities and reduce diversity in the workplace.
example2_zh: 不公平的招聘做法可能使合格的求职者失去就业机会，并降低职场的多样性。
collocations: unfair treatment｜不公平待遇 ; unfair advantage｜不公平的优势 ; unfair competition｜不公平竞争 ; unfair to someone｜对某人不公平
tip_zh: 表示“对某人不公平”用unfair to someone。

meanings_zh: adj. 粗心的；不小心的
definition_en: Not giving enough attention to avoid mistakes or damage.
example1_en: I was careless and left my keys in the door.
example1_zh: 我一时粗心，把钥匙留在了门上。
example2_en: Careless disposal of household waste can pollute local waterways and create serious risks for wildlife.
example2_zh: 随意丢弃生活垃圾会污染当地水道，并给野生动物带来严重风险。
collocations: a careless mistake｜粗心造成的错误 ; careless driving｜疏忽驾驶 ; careless with money｜花钱不谨慎
tip_zh: careless是粗心的；carefree才是无忧无虑的。

meanings_zh: n. 警探；私人侦探
definition_en: Someone whose job is to investigate crimes or discover facts
example1_en: The detective found a muddy footprint beside the window.
example1_zh: 警探在窗边发现了一个带泥的脚印。
example2_en: Modern detectives increasingly rely on digital evidence, which raises important questions about privacy and data protection.
example2_zh: 现代警探越来越依赖数字证据，这引发了有关隐私和数据保护的重要问题。
collocations: private detective｜私人侦探 ; detective work｜侦查工作 ; detective novel｜侦探小说
tip_zh: detective novel中detective作名词定语。

meanings_zh: num. 第一百 | n. 百分之一
definition_en: coming after the ninety-ninth in a sequence | one of a hundred equal parts of something
example1_en: Our village celebrated its hundredth anniversary with a picnic.
example1_zh: 我们村举办野餐，庆祝建村一百周年。
example2_en: The athlete missed the qualifying time by just one hundredth of a second, demonstrating the precision required.
example2_zh: 这名运动员仅差百分之一秒便达到资格标准，可见计时精度要求之高。
collocations: the hundredth anniversary｜一百周年 ; one hundredth of a second｜百分之一秒 ; for the hundredth time｜第一百次；无数次
tip_zh: 序数词指第一百；a hundredth指百分之一。

meanings_zh: v. 扫；清扫 | v. 迅速席卷；掠过
definition_en: to clean a surface using a brush or broom | to move quickly and powerfully across an area
example1_en: Please sweep the kitchen floor before our guests arrive.
example1_zh: 请在客人到来前把厨房地板扫干净。
example2_en: Severe storms can sweep across coastal regions, damaging homes and disrupting essential transport services.
example2_zh: 猛烈的风暴可能席卷沿海地区，损坏房屋并扰乱重要的交通服务。
collocations: sweep the floor｜扫地 ; sweep away｜扫除；冲走 ; sweep across｜席卷；掠过
tip_zh: 过去式、过去分词均为 swept。

meanings_zh: n. 证明；确凿证据 | n. 校样 | adj. 能防……的；耐……的
definition_en: Facts or information showing that something is true. | A printed or digital copy checked before final publication. | Able to resist damage or effects from something.
example1_en: Keep your receipt as proof that you paid.
example1_zh: 保留收据，作为你已付款的凭证。
example2_en: Governments should require clear proof of a treatment's effectiveness before allowing it to be widely marketed.
example2_zh: 政府应要求提供治疗方法有效的明确证据，才允许其大范围上市推广。
collocations: proof of identity｜身份证明 ; conclusive proof｜确凿证据 ; burden of proof｜举证责任 ; proof against｜能抵御……的
tip_zh: 表示证据时通常不可数；数学证明可用a proof。

meanings_zh: n. 火箭 | v. 飞涨；迅速上升
definition_en: A vehicle driven forward by powerful gases, often into space | Rise or increase very quickly
example1_en: We watched the rocket rise above the clouds.
example1_zh: 我们看着火箭升到云层上方。
example2_en: As housing demand continues to grow, rents may rocket in cities with limited space for new development.
example2_zh: 随着住房需求持续增长，新开发空间有限的城市可能出现租金飞涨。
collocations: launch a rocket｜发射火箭 ; rocket engine｜火箭发动机 ; prices rocket｜价格飞涨
tip_zh: 作动词常描述价格等猛涨，比increase语气更强。

meanings_zh: v. 暂停；停顿 | n. 暂停；停顿
definition_en: to stop briefly before continuing | a short break in an activity or speech
example1_en: She paused at the door to check her bag.
example1_zh: 她在门口停下来检查了一下包。
example2_en: Teachers should pause after asking questions to give students enough time to develop their answers.
example2_zh: 教师提问后应稍作停顿，让学生有足够的时间组织答案。
collocations: pause for a moment｜稍停片刻 ; a brief pause｜短暂停顿 ; pause a video｜暂停视频
tip_zh: pause指暂时停下，通常暗示还会继续。

meanings_zh: n. 文学；文学作品 | n. 文献；资料
definition_en: Written works valued for their artistic qualities. | Written material about a particular subject.
example1_en: My sister studies literature and always recommends wonderful novels.
example1_zh: 我姐姐学文学，总能推荐很棒的小说。
example2_en: A review of the scientific literature suggests that regular exercise can improve mental health.
example2_zh: 对科学文献的综述表明，经常运动可以改善心理健康。
collocations: English literature｜英国文学；英语文学 ; scientific literature｜科学文献 ; literature review｜文献综述 ; children's literature｜儿童文学
tip_zh: 通常不可数；表示多篇文献时也不用加s。

meanings_zh: n. 翻译 | n. 译文；译本
definition_en: The process of expressing meaning in another language. | A spoken or written version in another language.
example1_en: This translation of the story is easy to understand.
example1_zh: 这个故事的译文很容易理解。
example2_en: Accurate translation allows researchers from different countries to share findings and collaborate more effectively.
example2_zh: 准确的翻译使不同国家的研究人员能够分享研究结果，并更有效地合作。
collocations: accurate translation｜准确的翻译 ; machine translation｜机器翻译 ; literal translation｜直译 ; translation into English｜译成英语
tip_zh: 翻译成某语言用into；从某语言翻译用from。

meanings_zh: adj. 不太可能的 | adj. 出人意料的；非典型的
definition_en: Not expected to happen or be true. | Surprising because someone or something does not seem suitable.
example1_en: With such dark clouds, sunshine seems unlikely this afternoon.
example1_zh: 云层这么黑，今天下午看来不太可能有阳光。
example2_en: Public transport use is unlikely to increase unless services become more reliable and affordable.
example2_zh: 除非服务变得更可靠、票价更实惠，否则公共交通的使用量不太可能增加。
collocations: unlikely to happen｜不太可能发生 ; highly unlikely｜极不可能的 ; an unlikely friendship｜出人意料的友谊
tip_zh: 常用be unlikely to do或It is unlikely that。

meanings_zh: n. 汽车挡风玻璃
definition_en: The front window of a car or other vehicle.
example1_en: Heavy rain splashed against the windscreen throughout our journey.
example1_zh: 一路上，大雨不断拍打着汽车的挡风玻璃。
example2_en: A damaged windscreen can reduce visibility, so regular vehicle inspections are essential for maintaining road safety.
example2_zh: 受损的挡风玻璃会影响视野，因此定期检查车辆对维护道路安全至关重要。
collocations: windscreen wipers｜挡风玻璃雨刷 ; cracked windscreen｜开裂的挡风玻璃 ; heated windscreen｜加热式挡风玻璃
tip_zh: 英式英语用windscreen，美式英语通常用windshield。

meanings_zh: n. 代金券；兑换券 | n. 凭单；凭证
definition_en: A document exchangeable for goods, services, or a discount. | A document supporting a payment or accounting entry.
example1_en: I used my gift voucher to buy new shoes.
example1_zh: 我用礼品券买了新鞋。
example2_en: Governments can provide training vouchers to help unemployed adults develop skills required by local employers.
example2_zh: 政府可以提供培训券，帮助失业成年人掌握当地雇主所需的技能。
collocations: gift voucher｜礼品券 ; travel voucher｜旅行代金券 ; redeem a voucher｜兑换代金券 ; payment voucher｜付款凭证
tip_zh: 常用a voucher for；兑换券用redeem a voucher。

meanings_zh: v. 包裹；缠绕 | n. 披肩；围巾 | n. 卷饼
definition_en: to cover something by folding material around it | a loose piece of clothing worn around the shoulders | a thin flat bread rolled around a filling
example1_en: She wrapped the birthday present in bright yellow paper.
example1_zh: 她用鲜黄色的纸包好了生日礼物。
example2_en: Retailers could reduce packaging waste by encouraging customers to wrap gifts in reusable fabric.
example2_zh: 零售商可以鼓励顾客用可重复使用的布料包装礼物，以减少包装废弃物。
collocations: wrap a present｜包装礼物 ; wrap something in paper｜用纸包住某物 ; wrap up warm｜穿暖和些
tip_zh: 用wrap A in B表示用材料B包住A。

meanings_zh: n. 性格；品质；特色 | n. 角色；人物 | n. 字符；文字
definition_en: the qualities that make someone or something distinctive | a person represented in a story, play, or film | a written or printed symbol, such as a letter
example1_en: Her cheerful character makes even rainy mornings feel brighter.
example1_zh: 她开朗的性格让阴雨的早晨也显得明朗起来。
example2_en: Preserving historic buildings helps cities retain their distinctive character while adapting to modern economic demands.
example2_zh: 保护历史建筑有助于城市在适应现代经济需求的同时，保留自身的独特风貌。
collocations: main character｜主要角色 ; strength of character｜坚强品格 ; distinctive character｜独特风貌 ; Chinese characters｜汉字
tip_zh: 作“人物、字符”可数；作整体品质常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 可能性 | n. 可考虑的选择；可能的事
definition_en: the chance that something might happen or be true | something that might happen or could be chosen
example1_en: There is a possibility of snow later tonight.
example1_zh: 今晚晚些时候可能会下雪。
example2_en: Improved public transport increases the possibility that commuters will leave their cars at home.
example2_zh: 改善公共交通会增加通勤者不开车出行的可能性。
collocations: a real possibility｜确实存在的可能性 ; the possibility of｜……的可能性 ; explore the possibilities｜探索各种可能的选择 ; rule out the possibility｜排除可能性
tip_zh: 常用possibility of doing或possibility that从句。

meanings_zh: det. 两者中无一的 | pron. 两者都不 | adv. 也不
definition_en: not one or the other of two | not either of two people or things | used to add another negative statement
example1_en: Neither jacket fits me, so I will keep looking.
example1_zh: 两件夹克都不合身，所以我会继续挑选。
example2_en: Neither approach can solve traffic congestion alone, so cities need a combination of investment and regulation.
example2_zh: 两种方法都无法单独解决交通拥堵，因此城市需要将投资与监管相结合。
collocations: neither of them｜他们两个都不 ; neither option｜两个选项都不 ; neither ... nor ...｜既不……也不…… ; neither do I｜我也不
tip_zh: neither只用于两者；接单数名词，常与nor搭配。

meanings_zh: v. 拥抱；抱紧 | n. 拥抱
definition_en: Put your arms around someone and hold them close | An act of holding someone close with your arms
example1_en: Lena hugged her grandmother before leaving for school.
example1_zh: 莉娜上学前拥抱了奶奶。
example2_en: A reassuring hug from a parent can help young children manage stress in unfamiliar situations.
example2_zh: 父母一个令人安心的拥抱能帮助幼儿应对陌生环境中的压力。
collocations: give someone a hug｜拥抱某人 ; a warm hug｜温暖的拥抱 ; hug someone tightly｜紧紧拥抱某人
tip_zh: 过去式hugged、现在分词hugging均双写g。

meanings_zh: adj. 有历史意义的；历史著名的
definition_en: Important in history or likely to be remembered in history.
example1_en: We crossed the historic bridge just before sunset.
example1_zh: 我们在日落前走过了那座历史名桥。
example2_en: Protecting historic buildings helps cities preserve their cultural identity while attracting visitors and supporting local businesses.
example2_zh: 保护历史建筑有助于城市保留文化特色，同时吸引游客并支持当地商业。
collocations: historic building｜历史建筑 ; historic event｜历史性事件 ; historic landmark｜历史地标 ; historic agreement｜具有历史意义的协议
tip_zh: historic强调历史意义；historical泛指与历史有关。

meanings_zh: adj. 立即的；即时的 | adj. 最近的；紧邻的 | adj. 直接的
definition_en: Happening or needed now, without any delay. | Closest in space, time, or relationship. | Directly connected to something, without anything coming between.
example1_en: The leaking pipe needs immediate attention before the kitchen floods.
example1_zh: 这根漏水的管子需要立即处理，免得厨房被淹。
example2_en: Governments should take immediate action to protect communities facing severe water shortages during prolonged droughts.
example2_zh: 政府应立即采取行动，保护那些在长期干旱中面临严重缺水的社区。
collocations: immediate action｜立即行动 ; immediate response｜即时回应 ; immediate family｜直系亲属 ; immediate surroundings｜周围环境
tip_zh: immediate是形容词；修饰动词用immediately。

meanings_zh: n. 彩虹 | n. 缤纷的色彩
definition_en: a curved band of colours appearing in the sky after rain | a collection or range of many different colours
example1_en: A bright rainbow appeared above the hills after lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭后，群山上空出现了一道鲜艳的彩虹。
example2_en: Tourists often photograph the rainbow that forms in the spray near the base of the waterfall.
example2_zh: 游客经常拍摄瀑布底部附近水雾中形成的彩虹。
collocations: a rainbow appears｜彩虹出现 ; a rainbow of colours｜缤纷的色彩 ; a double rainbow｜双彩虹
tip_zh: 通常是可数名词；a rainbow of表示色彩缤纷的一系列。

meanings_zh: n. 金属罐；罐装食品 | n. 锡
definition_en: A metal container, especially for food, or its contents. | A soft, silver-coloured metal used to coat other metals.
example1_en: There is a tin of beans in the cupboard.
example1_zh: 橱柜里有一罐豆子。
example2_en: Reusing a metal tin for storage can reduce household waste and the need for new containers.
example2_zh: 重复利用金属罐储物，可以减少生活垃圾以及对新容器的需求。
collocations: a tin of soup｜一罐汤 ; a biscuit tin｜饼干罐 ; a tin opener｜开罐器 ; tin mining｜锡矿开采
tip_zh: 罐子义可数，英式常用tin，美式常用can；锡不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 作业；任务 | n. 分配；指派
definition_en: A piece of work someone is required to complete. | The act of giving someone a task, role, or place.
example1_en: I finished my science assignment before dinner last night.
example1_zh: 昨晚我在晚饭前完成了科学作业。
example2_en: A group assignment can help students develop communication skills and learn to share responsibility.
example2_zh: 小组作业可以帮助学生培养沟通能力，并学会共同承担责任。
collocations: complete an assignment｜完成作业或任务 ; submit an assignment｜提交作业 ; on assignment｜执行任务中 ; assignment of duties｜职责分配
tip_zh: 指具体作业时可数；homework通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 化学家；化学研究人员 | n. 药剂师；药店（英式）
definition_en: A scientist who studies chemicals and how they react. | A pharmacist, or a shop that sells medicines, in British English.
example1_en: The chemist carefully poured the liquid into a glass tube.
example1_zh: 化学研究员小心地把液体倒进玻璃试管。
example2_en: Chemists are developing safer materials that could reduce the environmental impact of industrial production.
example2_zh: 化学家正在研发更安全的材料，以减轻工业生产对环境的影响。
collocations: analytical chemist｜分析化学家 ; research chemist｜化学研究员 ; at the chemist's｜在药店
tip_zh: 英式中还指药剂师；chemist's常指药店。

meanings_zh: n. 元音；元音字母
definition_en: An unrestricted speech sound, or a letter representing such a sound.
example1_en: Our teacher stretched the vowel sound as we listened.
example1_zh: 老师把元音拉长，让我们仔细听。
example2_en: Recognising differences between vowel sounds can help language learners understand unfamiliar accents and communicate more clearly.
example2_zh: 辨别元音之间的差异有助于语言学习者理解陌生口音，并更清晰地交流。
collocations: vowel sound｜元音音素 ; long vowel｜长元音 ; short vowel｜短元音
tip_zh: a或an的选择看后接词的首音是否为元音，不看字母。

meanings_zh: adj. 非常惊讶的
definition_en: Very surprised by something unexpected.
example1_en: I was amazed to find flowers growing through concrete.
example1_zh: 发现花从混凝土缝里长出来，我十分惊讶。
example2_en: Researchers were amazed by how quickly children learned new vocabulary through interactive games.
example2_zh: 研究人员惊讶地发现，孩子们通过互动游戏学习新词汇的速度如此之快。
collocations: be amazed at｜对……感到惊讶 ; be amazed by｜因……而惊讶 ; be amazed to discover｜惊讶地发现
tip_zh: amazed描述人的感受；amazing描述令人惊讶的事物。

meanings_zh: n. 价值；价格；重要性 | v. 重视；珍惜；估价 | n. 价值观；行为准则
definition_en: the worth, price, or importance of something | consider something important or estimate how much it is worth | beliefs about what is right and important in life
example1_en: This sturdy backpack offers excellent value for the price.
example1_zh: 这个结实的背包非常物有所值。
example2_en: Governments should recognise the value of public parks in improving physical health and strengthening community relationships.
example2_zh: 政府应认识到公共公园在改善身体健康和加强社区联系方面的价值。
collocations: value for money｜物有所值 ; place a high value on｜高度重视 ; property value｜房产价值 ; shared values｜共同价值观
tip_zh: 表示“价值观”用复数values。

meanings_zh: n. 雷暴；雷雨
definition_en: A storm with thunder, lightning, and usually heavy rain.
example1_en: We stayed indoors while the thunderstorm shook the windows.
example1_zh: 雷雨震得窗户直响，我们一直待在屋里。
example2_en: Severe thunderstorms can disrupt transport networks and cause sudden flooding, particularly in cities with inadequate drainage.
example2_zh: 强雷暴会扰乱交通网络并引发突发洪水，排水设施不足的城市尤其如此。
collocations: a severe thunderstorm｜强雷暴 ; a thunderstorm warning｜雷暴预警 ; scattered thunderstorms｜局部雷雨
tip_zh: thunder是雷声，lightning是闪电；雷暴用thunderstorm。

meanings_zh: n. 建筑学；建筑设计 | n. 建筑风格 | n. 系统架构
definition_en: The art and practice of designing buildings. | The style and appearance of buildings. | The way a computer system or other complex structure is organised.
example1_en: My brother studies architecture and builds tiny house models.
example1_zh: 我哥哥学建筑设计，还制作小房子模型。
example2_en: Sustainable architecture can reduce energy consumption by making better use of natural light and ventilation.
example2_zh: 可持续建筑设计可以更充分地利用自然采光和通风，从而降低能耗。
collocations: modern architecture｜现代建筑 ; sustainable architecture｜可持续建筑设计 ; software architecture｜软件架构
tip_zh: architecture通常不可数；architect指建筑师。

meanings_zh: adj. 自私的；只顾自己的
definition_en: Caring about your own needs without considering other people
example1_en: It was selfish to take the whole cake.
example1_zh: 把整个蛋糕拿走太自私了。
example2_en: Selfish behaviour in shared housing can create tension and undermine trust among residents over time.
example2_zh: 合租住房中的自私行为会造成矛盾，并逐渐损害住户之间的信任。
collocations: selfish behaviour｜自私的行为 ; selfish motives｜自私的动机 ; selfish of someone｜某人这样做很自私
tip_zh: 评价某人的行为用It is selfish of sb to do。

meanings_zh: n. 办事员；文员 | n. 店员；接待员
definition_en: someone whose job involves records, documents, or routine office tasks | someone serving customers in a shop or at a desk
example1_en: The clerk checked my details and handed me a form.
example1_zh: 办事员核对了我的资料，递给我一张表格。
example2_en: Although digital services are expanding, many residents still prefer discussing complex applications with a trained clerk.
example2_zh: 尽管数字服务不断扩展，许多居民仍更愿意向受过培训的办事员咨询复杂的申请事项。
collocations: office clerk｜办公室文员 ; bank clerk｜银行职员 ; desk clerk｜接待员 ; court clerk｜法院书记员
tip_zh: 英式读音中元音为/ɑː/；美式常指店员。

meanings_zh: n. 装置；设备 | n. 手法；策略
definition_en: an object or machine designed for a particular purpose | a method used to achieve an effect or particular result
example1_en: This tiny device tracks my steps throughout the day.
example1_zh: 这个小装置会记录我一整天的步数。
example2_en: A portable medical device can help patients monitor their health without frequent hospital visits.
example2_zh: 便携式医疗设备能帮助患者监测健康状况，无须频繁去医院。
collocations: an electronic device｜电子设备 ; a medical device｜医疗设备 ; a safety device｜安全装置 ; a literary device｜文学手法
tip_zh: device是名词；devise是动词，意为设计或想出。

meanings_zh: v. 表达；表露 | adj. 快速的；特快的 | adj. 明确的；明示的
definition_en: Show or communicate a thought, feeling, or opinion. | Providing a faster service than usual. | Clearly and directly stated.
example1_en: Leah expressed her thanks with a warm smile.
example1_zh: 莉娅用一个温暖的微笑表达了谢意。
example2_en: Schools should provide opportunities for students to express their opinions on decisions that affect their education.
example2_zh: 学校应让学生有机会对影响其教育的决策发表意见。
collocations: express concern｜表示担忧 ; express an opinion｜表达意见 ; express delivery｜快递服务 ; express permission｜明确许可
tip_zh: express作动词直接接宾语，如express your views。

meanings_zh: n. 优惠券；赠券 | n. 债券息票；票面利息
definition_en: A ticket or code giving a discount or free item. | An interest payment on a bond, or its claiming slip.
example1_en: This coupon gives us a discount on fresh vegetables.
example1_zh: 用这张优惠券买新鲜蔬菜可以打折。
example2_en: Although discount coupons help households save money, they may also encourage consumers to buy unnecessary products.
example2_zh: 虽然优惠券能帮助家庭省钱，但它们也可能促使消费者购买不必要的商品。
collocations: discount coupon｜折扣券 ; coupon code｜优惠码 ; redeem a coupon｜使用优惠券 ; coupon rate｜票面利率
tip_zh: coupon多指折扣券；voucher也常指预付代金券。

meanings_zh: n. 护发素 | n. 衣物柔顺剂
definition_en: A product that makes hair softer and easier to manage. | A liquid added during washing to make fabrics softer.
example1_en: I use conditioner to keep my curly hair soft.
example1_zh: 我用护发素让卷发保持柔软。
example2_en: Consumers can reduce plastic waste by choosing refillable containers for shampoo and conditioner products.
example2_zh: 消费者可以选择可补充装的洗发水和护发素容器，以减少塑料垃圾。
collocations: hair conditioner｜护发素 ; leave-in conditioner｜免洗护发素 ; fabric conditioner｜衣物柔顺剂
tip_zh: 单独用常指护发素；空调要说air conditioner。

meanings_zh: n. 定义；释义 | n. 清晰度
definition_en: A statement explaining exactly what a word or concept means | How clearly the details of an image or sound appear
example1_en: Could you give me a simple definition of gravity?
example1_zh: 你能给我一个简单的重力定义吗？
example2_en: A broader definition of health includes emotional wellbeing and social relationships, not merely the absence of physical illness.
example2_zh: 更广义的健康定义包括情绪状态和社会关系，而不仅仅是没有身体疾病。
collocations: a clear definition｜明确的定义 ; by definition｜按照定义 ; high definition｜高清晰度 ; a broad definition｜广义的定义
tip_zh: definition of引出被定义的概念；高清常缩写为HD。

meanings_zh: n. 标准；水准 | adj. 标准的；通常的
definition_en: A required or achieved level of quality or performance. | Generally accepted, regularly used, or meeting an established requirement.
example1_en: The food here is always of a high standard.
example1_zh: 这里的食物品质一向很高。
example2_en: Governments should enforce strict safety standards to ensure that new housing protects residents from avoidable risks.
example2_zh: 政府应严格执行安全标准，确保新建住房保护居民免受可避免的风险。
collocations: meet a standard｜达到标准 ; standard of living｜生活水平 ; safety standards｜安全标准 ; standard practice｜惯例
tip_zh: 达到标准用meet a standard；生活水平用standard of living。

meanings_zh: prep. 在……之内 | adv. 在内部；在里面
definition_en: Inside a particular area, period, or limit. | Inside something rather than outside it.
example1_en: Your parcel should arrive within the next three days.
example1_zh: 你的包裹应该会在接下来的三天内送达。
example2_en: Local authorities should ensure that essential services are available within walking distance of residential areas.
example2_zh: 地方政府应确保居民区步行可达的范围内有基本服务设施。
collocations: within walking distance｜步行可达 ; within reach｜够得着；可实现 ; within budget｜在预算之内 ; within a week｜一周之内
tip_zh: within强调不超出某范围；within a week指一周内。

meanings_zh: v. 惩罚；处罚
definition_en: make someone face an unpleasant consequence for doing wrong
example1_en: The referee punished the player for breaking the rules.
example1_zh: 裁判因那名球员违反规则而对其作出处罚。
example2_en: Schools should explain why behaviour is unacceptable rather than simply punish students without offering guidance.
example2_zh: 学校应解释为何某种行为不可接受，而不是只惩罚学生却不给予引导。
collocations: punish someone for something｜因某事惩罚某人 ; punish severely｜严厉惩罚 ; punish offenders｜处罚违法者
tip_zh: punish sb for sth表示因某事惩罚某人。

meanings_zh: n. 实验；试验 | v. 做实验；尝试
definition_en: a test designed to discover something or check an idea | test ideas or methods to see what happens
example1_en: Our science experiment showed how roots grow towards water.
example1_zh: 我们的科学实验展示了植物根部如何朝水源生长。
example2_en: Schools should allow students to experiment with different materials before explaining the scientific principles involved.
example2_zh: 学校应让学生先尝试使用不同材料，再讲解其中的科学原理。
collocations: conduct an experiment｜进行实验 ; a controlled experiment｜对照实验 ; experiment with materials｜尝试使用各种材料
tip_zh: 动词接with表示尝试；名词重音在第二音节。

meanings_zh: n. 有礼貌的男士；绅士 | n. 先生；男士
definition_en: A man who behaves politely and considers other people. | A polite or formal way to refer to a man.
example1_en: A gentleman held the door open for us.
example1_zh: 一位绅士为我们扶住了门。
example2_en: The elderly gentleman described how public transport had improved his independence and access to community activities.
example2_zh: 这位年长的先生讲述了公共交通如何增强他的独立生活能力，并让他更方便地参加社区活动。
collocations: a perfect gentleman｜十足的绅士 ; an elderly gentleman｜年长的先生 ; ladies and gentlemen｜女士们、先生们
tip_zh: 复数为gentlemen；正式称呼男性时未必强调品行。

meanings_zh: v. 持续隐痛 | n. 持续的隐痛 | v. 渴望；向往
definition_en: to feel a steady pain that is usually not sharp | a steady pain that lasts for some time | to want something very deeply
example1_en: My legs ache after walking up all those stairs.
example1_zh: 爬完那么多级楼梯后，我的双腿酸痛。
example2_en: Office workers whose backs ache regularly may benefit from adjustable desks and more frequent movement breaks.
example2_zh: 经常背痛的办公室职员可能会受益于可调节办公桌和更频繁的活动休息。
collocations: a dull ache｜隐隐作痛 ; aches and pains｜各种酸痛 ; ache for｜渴望
tip_zh: ache多指持续钝痛；pain可泛指各种疼痛。

meanings_zh: adj. 相等的；平等的 | v. 等于；比得上 | n. 同等的人；匹敌者
