definition_en: The same in amount, value, status, or opportunity. | To be the same in quantity, value, or quality. | Someone with the same status, ability, or rights as another.
example1_en: We divided the cake into equal pieces for everyone.
example1_zh: 我们把蛋糕切成大小相等的小块，分给大家。
example2_en: Governments should ensure that children from all backgrounds have equal access to quality education and essential healthcare.
example2_zh: 政府应确保各种背景的儿童都能平等地获得优质教育和基本医疗服务。
collocations: equal opportunities｜平等机会 ; equal access｜平等的使用机会 ; equal to｜等于；胜任 ; treat as an equal｜平等对待
tip_zh: 形容词常接to；动词equal直接接宾语，不加to。

meanings_zh: v. 捐赠；捐献
definition_en: To give money, goods, or blood to help others
example1_en: We donate our spare blankets to the local shelter.
example1_zh: 我们把多余的毯子捐给当地的收容所。
example2_en: Businesses can reduce food waste by donating surplus products to charities that support vulnerable families.
example2_zh: 企业可以把剩余食品捐给帮助困难家庭的慈善机构，以减少食物浪费。
collocations: donate money to charity｜向慈善机构捐款 ; donate blood｜献血 ; donate organs｜捐献器官
tip_zh: 用donate something to someone，不用双宾语。

meanings_zh: v. 退休；退役 | v. 退出比赛
definition_en: To stop working permanently, usually because of age. | To leave a competition before finishing it.
example1_en: My aunt plans to retire and spend more time gardening.
example1_zh: 我姑姑打算退休，多花些时间种花种菜。
example2_en: As life expectancy increases, some governments encourage people to retire later to reduce pressure on pension systems.
example2_zh: 随着预期寿命延长，一些政府鼓励人们推迟退休，以减轻养老金制度的压力。
collocations: retire early｜提前退休 ; retire from work｜退休 ; retire from a race｜退出比赛
tip_zh: retire是动词；“退休”这一名词用retirement。

meanings_zh: v. 引用；引述 | v. 报价 | n. 引文；报价
definition_en: To repeat someone's exact words in speech or writing. | To state the price you will charge for something. | Repeated words from a source, or a stated price.
example1_en: My sister loves to quote lines from old films.
example1_zh: 我姐姐很喜欢引用老电影里的台词。
example2_en: Students should quote reliable sources accurately and explain how the evidence supports their arguments in academic essays.
example2_zh: 学生在学术论文中应准确引用可靠来源，并解释证据如何支持自己的论点。
collocations: quote a source｜引用来源 ; quote someone a price｜向某人报价 ; a direct quote｜直接引语 ; get a quote｜获取报价
tip_zh: quote引用原话；paraphrase用自己的话转述。

meanings_zh: n. 探险者；勘探者
definition_en: someone who travels through unfamiliar places to discover more about them
example1_en: The explorer carried a compass through the dense forest.
example1_zh: 探险者带着指南针穿过茂密的森林。
example2_en: An explorer can contribute valuable observations, but expeditions should avoid disturbing local wildlife and communities.
example2_zh: 探险者可以提供宝贵的观察资料，但探险活动应避免干扰当地野生动物和社区。
collocations: polar explorer｜极地探险者 ; intrepid explorer｜无畏的探险者 ; early explorers｜早期探险者
tip_zh: explorer指探险的人，exploration指探索活动。

meanings_zh: n. 引语；引用 | n. 报价；报价单
definition_en: words repeated exactly from another person or source | a statement of the expected price of goods or services
example1_en: She opened her speech with a quotation from a poem.
example1_zh: 她引用了一句诗作为演讲的开场白。
example2_en: Before selecting a contractor, local authorities should obtain a detailed quotation for the proposed construction work.
example2_zh: 在选择承包商之前，地方政府应获取拟议建筑工程的详细报价。
collocations: a quotation from｜引自……的话 ; quotation marks｜引号 ; request a quotation｜索取报价 ; provide a quotation｜提供报价
tip_zh: 引语来自某人或作品用from；报价常接for。

meanings_zh: n. 手腕；腕关节
definition_en: The joint connecting your hand to your arm.
example1_en: She wore a silver bracelet around her wrist.
example1_zh: 她的手腕上戴着一条银手链。
example2_en: Office workers should adjust their keyboards to reduce pressure on their wrists during prolonged computer use.
example2_zh: 办公室员工应调整键盘位置，减轻长时间使用电脑时手腕承受的压力。
collocations: a wrist injury｜手腕损伤 ; sprain your wrist｜扭伤手腕 ; a wrist support｜护腕
tip_zh: 开头的w不发音；手腕是wrist，脚踝是ankle。

meanings_zh: n. 副词
definition_en: a word modifying a verb, adjective, adverb, or whole sentence
example1_en: Our teacher asked us to circle every adverb.
example1_zh: 老师让我们把每个副词都圈出来。
example2_en: Understanding how an adverb changes emphasis can help language learners express their opinions more precisely.
example2_zh: 理解副词如何改变强调重点，可以帮助语言学习者更准确地表达观点。
collocations: adverb of frequency｜频率副词 ; adverb of manner｜方式副词 ; adverb placement｜副词的位置
tip_zh: adverb是名词；表示“副词的”用adverbial。

meanings_zh: v. 欠钱；负债 | v. 应给予；欠人情 | v. 把……归功于
definition_en: To have to pay money back to someone. | To have a duty to give someone something. | To have something because of someone's help or another cause.
example1_en: I still owe my sister money for the tickets.
example1_zh: 我还欠姐姐买票的钱。
example2_en: Many successful students owe their progress to consistent practice rather than exceptional natural ability.
example2_zh: 许多优秀学生的进步归功于持续练习，而非非凡的天赋。
collocations: owe someone money｜欠某人钱 ; owe an apology｜应向某人道歉 ; owe a debt of gratitude｜深受恩惠 ; owe success to｜把成功归功于
tip_zh: owe A to B可指欠B东西A，也可指把A归功于B。

meanings_zh: n. 威士忌酒
definition_en: A strong alcoholic drink made from grain and aged in barrels.
example1_en: The guide showed us barrels used for ageing whisky.
example1_zh: 导游向我们展示了用于陈酿威士忌的木桶。
example2_en: Traditional whisky production attracts tourists to rural areas and supports employment in farming, manufacturing, and hospitality.
example2_zh: 传统威士忌生产吸引游客前往乡村地区，并带动农业、制造业和酒店餐饮业的就业。
collocations: Scotch whisky｜苏格兰威士忌 ; malt whisky｜麦芽威士忌 ; whisky distillery｜威士忌酒厂
tip_zh: 苏格兰酒常拼whisky，爱尔兰和美国酒常拼whiskey。

meanings_zh: n. 国家；国民 | n. 民族
definition_en: A country considered together with its people | A people united by shared history, culture, or language
example1_en: Fans across the nation celebrated the team's victory.
example1_zh: 全国各地的球迷都在庆祝这支球队获胜。
example2_en: Wealthier nations should support international efforts to improve access to clean water in poorer regions.
example2_zh: 较富裕的国家应支持国际合作，改善贫困地区的清洁用水条件。
collocations: developing nation｜发展中国家 ; the entire nation｜全国人民 ; host nation｜东道国 ; nation building｜国家建设
tip_zh: nation强调国家及人民，state常强调政权或政治实体。

meanings_zh: v. 表演；演出 | v. 执行；履行 | v. 表现；运转
definition_en: to entertain an audience by acting, singing, or playing music | to carry out a task, action, or duty | to work or achieve results in a particular way
example1_en: Our choir will perform at the community centre tonight.
example1_zh: 我们的合唱团今晚将在社区中心演出。
example2_en: Students often perform better academically when schools provide regular feedback and access to individual support.
example2_zh: 学校提供定期反馈和个别支持时，学生的学业表现往往更好。
collocations: perform on stage｜登台表演 ; perform a task｜执行任务 ; perform well｜表现出色 ; perform surgery｜实施手术
tip_zh: 既可指表演，也可接task、duty表示执行。

meanings_zh: n. 休息室；候机厅 | n. 客厅 | v. 懒洋洋地坐着或躺着
definition_en: a comfortable room for sitting, relaxing, or waiting | a room in a home for sitting and relaxing | to sit or lie in a relaxed, lazy way
example1_en: We waited in the lounge until our room was ready.
example1_zh: 我们在休息室等候，直到房间准备好。
example2_en: Comfortable airport lounges can make long journeys less stressful for passengers travelling with young children.
example2_zh: 舒适的机场休息室可以减轻带幼儿出行的旅客在长途旅行中的压力。
collocations: departure lounge｜候机厅 ; hotel lounge｜酒店休息室 ; lounge around｜懒散地闲待着
tip_zh: 英式英语中可指家中客厅；作动词常接 around。

meanings_zh: n. 鹿
definition_en: a hoofed wild animal whose males usually have branching antlers
example1_en: A deer stood quietly beside the forest path.
example1_zh: 一只鹿静静地站在林间小路旁。
example2_en: Protecting woodland habitats helps maintain healthy deer populations, but careful management is needed to prevent excessive grazing.
example2_zh: 保护林地栖息地有助于维持健康的鹿种群，但仍需谨慎管理，以防过度啃食植被。
collocations: a herd of deer｜一群鹿 ; deer antlers｜鹿角 ; wild deer｜野鹿
tip_zh: deer单复数同形：one deer，several deer。

meanings_zh: n. 重要性
definition_en: The quality of having great value or a strong effect.
example1_en: Losing my keys taught me the importance of a spare.
example1_zh: 丢了钥匙后，我才明白备用钥匙有多重要。
example2_en: Schools should emphasise the importance of critical thinking rather than focusing only on examination results.
example2_zh: 学校应强调批判性思维的重要性，而不是只关注考试成绩。
collocations: attach importance to｜重视 ; of great importance｜非常重要的 ; recognise the importance of｜认识到……的重要性
tip_zh: importance不可数；重视某事用attach importance to。

meanings_zh: v. 打算；计划 | v. 意欲；为某用途而设计
definition_en: To have a plan or purpose in mind. | To mean something or design it for a particular purpose.
example1_en: I intend to finish painting the kitchen this weekend.
example1_zh: 我打算这周末刷完厨房。
example2_en: The council intends to expand public transport services to reduce dependence on private cars.
example2_zh: 地方议会打算扩大公共交通服务，以减少人们对私家车的依赖。
collocations: intend to do something｜打算做某事 ; be intended for｜供……使用 ; be intended to｜旨在
tip_zh: intend to do表示打算做；be intended for表示供……用。

meanings_zh: v. 压扁；挤进 | n. 壁球 | n. 南瓜类蔬菜
definition_en: To crush something flat or squeeze into a small space | An indoor racket sport played by hitting a ball against walls | A vegetable with thick skin and a soft, seed-filled centre
example1_en: Don't squash the bread under those heavy shopping bags.
example1_zh: 别把面包压在那些沉重的购物袋下面。
example2_en: Playing squash regularly can improve cardiovascular fitness, although beginners should increase the intensity of exercise gradually.
example2_zh: 经常打壁球可以增强心肺功能，不过初学者应逐步提高运动强度。
collocations: squash flat｜压扁 ; squash into｜挤进 ; play squash｜打壁球 ; butternut squash｜奶油南瓜
tip_zh: 英式英语中还可指需加水稀释的浓缩果汁饮料。

meanings_zh: adj. 疼痛的；酸痛的 | n. 疮；溃疡 | adj. 恼怒的；不快的
definition_en: painful, especially when touched or moved | a painful damaged area on the skin | upset or annoyed about something unfair or disappointing
example1_en: My legs are sore after yesterday's long walk.
example1_zh: 昨天走了很远的路，我的腿现在酸痛。
example2_en: Office workers may develop sore muscles if they remain seated without taking regular breaks.
example2_zh: 上班族如果久坐而不定时休息，可能会出现肌肉酸痛。
collocations: sore throat｜咽喉痛 ; sore muscles｜肌肉酸痛 ; feel sore｜感到酸痛
tip_zh: sore常修饰身体部位，如a sore throat。

meanings_zh: n. 俯卧撑
definition_en: An exercise raising and lowering your body using your arms.
example1_en: I managed one push-up before my arms started shaking.
example1_zh: 我做了一个俯卧撑，胳膊就开始发抖了。
example2_en: Simple exercises such as push-ups allow people to build strength without paying for expensive gym memberships.
example2_zh: 俯卧撑等简单运动让人们无需支付昂贵的健身房会员费就能增强力量。
collocations: do push-ups｜做俯卧撑 ; a set of push-ups｜一组俯卧撑 ; wall push-up｜靠墙俯卧撑
tip_zh: 可数名词；英式英语也常用press-up。

meanings_zh: n. 预测；预言
definition_en: A statement about what is expected to happen in the future.
example1_en: Your prediction was right: it rained all afternoon.
example1_zh: 你预测对了：整个下午都在下雨。
example2_en: Accurate predictions of future energy demand are essential for planning reliable and sustainable electricity supplies.
example2_zh: 准确预测未来能源需求，对于规划可靠且可持续的电力供应至关重要。
collocations: make a prediction｜作出预测 ; accurate prediction｜准确的预测 ; prediction model｜预测模型 ; prediction comes true｜预测成真
tip_zh: 作出预测用make a prediction，不用do。

meanings_zh: n. 数字；数值 | n. 人物；人影；身形 | v. 认为；估计
definition_en: a number expressing an amount, especially in official information | a person, their outline, or the shape of their body | to think or decide something after considering it
example1_en: She checked the final figure on the bill.
example1_zh: 她核对了账单上的最终金额。
example2_en: Recent employment figures suggest that investment in public transport can create substantial opportunities for local workers.
example2_zh: 近期就业数据显示，投资公共交通能为当地劳动者创造大量机会。
collocations: sales figures｜销售数据 ; a leading figure｜领军人物 ; figure out｜弄清楚 ; a rough figure｜大致数值
tip_zh: 数据常用复数figures；figure out意为弄懂。

meanings_zh: n. 金刚石；钻石 | n. 菱形
definition_en: a very hard mineral used in jewellery and cutting tools | a shape with four equal sides and opposite angles equal
example1_en: A tiny diamond sparkled on her silver ring.
example1_zh: 她的银戒指上，一颗小钻石闪闪发光。
example2_en: The diamond industry faces growing pressure to demonstrate that its mining practices protect workers and local ecosystems.
example2_zh: 钻石行业面临越来越大的压力，需要证明其采矿活动能够保护工人和当地生态系统。
collocations: diamond ring｜钻戒 ; rough diamond｜未加工的钻石 ; diamond mining｜钻石开采 ; diamond shape｜菱形
tip_zh: diamond指金刚石或钻石；菱形的几何术语是rhombus。

meanings_zh: n. 女乘务员；空姐
definition_en: an older term for a female aircraft or ship attendant
example1_en: My grandmother worked as a stewardess before becoming a teacher.
example1_zh: 我祖母当教师之前做过空姐。
example2_en: The replacement of stewardess with flight attendant reflects a broader shift towards gender-neutral language in professional settings.
example2_zh: 用flight attendant替代stewardess，体现了职业场合用语向性别中立转变的更广泛趋势。
collocations: work as a stewardess｜担任女乘务员 ; airline stewardess｜航空公司女乘务员
tip_zh: 较旧且限定女性；现代通常用flight attendant。

meanings_zh: n. 盒式磁带；卡带
definition_en: a plastic case containing magnetic tape for recording sound
example1_en: We found an old cassette of songs in the cupboard.
example1_zh: 我们在柜子里找到了一盒录着歌曲的旧磁带。
example2_en: Before digital streaming became widespread, many language learners used cassette recordings to practise listening at home.
example2_zh: 在数字流媒体普及之前，许多语言学习者用盒式磁带录音在家练习听力。
collocations: cassette tape｜盒式磁带 ; cassette player｜盒式磁带播放器 ; audio cassette｜录音磁带
tip_zh: 注意重音在第二音节；播放器叫cassette player。

meanings_zh: n. 广口瓶；罐子 | v. 使不快；显得不协调 | v. 震动；使震痛
definition_en: A wide-mouthed container, often glass, with a lid. | To feel unpleasant or clash with something. | To shake suddenly and sharply, sometimes causing pain.
example1_en: She keeps homemade jam in a small glass jar.
example1_zh: 她把自制果酱装在一个小玻璃罐里。
example2_en: Reusing glass jars for food storage can help households reduce their reliance on disposable plastic packaging.
example2_zh: 重复使用玻璃罐储存食品可以帮助家庭减少对一次性塑料包装的依赖。
collocations: a jar of honey｜一罐蜂蜜 ; a glass jar｜玻璃罐 ; jar with the surroundings｜与周围环境不协调
tip_zh: jar 常指有盖广口罐；a jar of 后接所装物。

meanings_zh: v. 实现；取得；达到
definition_en: Successfully reach a goal or result through effort.
example1_en: With daily practice, she finally achieved her swimming goal.
example1_zh: 通过每天练习，她终于实现了自己的游泳目标。
example2_en: Governments can achieve significant reductions in air pollution by investing in clean energy and improving public transport.
example2_zh: 政府可以通过投资清洁能源和改善公共交通，大幅减少空气污染。
collocations: achieve success｜取得成功 ; achieve a goal｜实现目标 ; achieve a balance｜达到平衡 ; achieve results｜取得成果
tip_zh: 直接接目标或成果，不说achieve to do。

meanings_zh: adj. 空气潮湿的
definition_en: containing a lot of moisture in the air
example1_en: It feels so humid that my shirt sticks to me.
example1_zh: 天气湿热得我的衬衫都贴在身上了。
example2_en: In humid climates, buildings require effective ventilation to prevent mould growth and protect residents' health.
example2_zh: 在潮湿气候中，建筑物需要有效通风，以防止霉菌滋生并保护居民健康。
collocations: humid climate｜潮湿气候 ; hot and humid｜湿热的 ; humid air｜潮湿的空气
tip_zh: humid主要形容空气或气候潮湿，不用于湿衣服。

meanings_zh: n. 青年时期；青春 | n. 青年群体 | n. 年轻男子
definition_en: the period of life when someone is young | young people considered as a group | a young man, especially a teenager
example1_en: My grandmother spent her youth in a seaside village.
example1_zh: 我祖母的青年时代是在一个海边村庄度过的。
example2_en: Investment in youth services can give young people valuable skills and strengthen their sense of belonging.
example2_zh: 对青年服务的投资能让年轻人掌握实用技能，并增强他们的归属感。
collocations: in one's youth｜在某人年轻时 ; youth unemployment｜青年失业 ; youth centre｜青年活动中心
tip_zh: 表示青春通常不可数；a youth指一名年轻男子。

meanings_zh: n. 风俗；惯例 | adj. 定制的 | n. 惠顾；光顾
definition_en: a traditional or usual way of behaving | made to meet a particular customer's needs | the business customers give to a shop or company
example1_en: Sharing a meal is an important custom in our family.
example1_zh: 一起吃饭是我们家的一项重要惯例。
example2_en: Schools can introduce children to local customs while encouraging respect for traditions from other cultures.
example2_zh: 学校可以向孩子们介绍当地风俗，同时鼓励他们尊重其他文化的传统。
collocations: local customs｜当地风俗 ; an ancient custom｜古老的习俗 ; custom furniture｜定制家具 ; regular custom｜经常光顾
tip_zh: custom指风俗或惯例；customs还可指海关。

meanings_zh: adj. 极有吸引力的；迷人的
definition_en: so interesting that it holds your attention completely
example1_en: The guide told us fascinating stories about the castle.
example1_zh: 导游给我们讲了关于这座城堡的精彩故事。
example2_en: Museum collections offer fascinating insights into how earlier societies adapted to changes in their natural environments.
example2_zh: 博物馆藏品让人们深入了解早期社会如何适应自然环境的变化，令人着迷。
collocations: absolutely fascinating｜极其迷人的 ; fascinating insight｜引人入胜的见解 ; fascinating discovery｜令人着迷的发现
tip_zh: 事物令人着迷用fascinating；人着迷用fascinated。

meanings_zh: n. 白天；日间 | adj. 白天的；日间的
definition_en: The part of the day when there is natural light. | Happening or existing during the day rather than at night.
example1_en: The cat usually sleeps indoors during the daytime.
example1_zh: 这只猫白天通常在屋里睡觉。
example2_en: Higher daytime temperatures may force outdoor workers to adjust their schedules during the summer months.
example2_zh: 夏季白天气温升高，可能迫使户外工作者调整工作时间。
collocations: during the daytime｜在白天 ; daytime temperatures｜白天气温 ; daytime television｜日间电视节目
tip_zh: 常说in the daytime；作定语时不加the。

meanings_zh: conj. 无论哪里；在任何地方 | adv. 究竟在哪里
definition_en: in or to any place, regardless of where | used in questions to express surprise about a place
example1_en: You can sit wherever you feel most comfortable.
example1_zh: 你觉得哪里最舒服，就可以坐在哪里。
example2_en: Governments should ensure that children receive a good education wherever they live, including in remote rural communities.
example2_zh: 政府应确保儿童无论住在哪里，包括偏远农村地区，都能接受良好教育。
collocations: wherever possible｜在任何可能的地方 ; wherever you go｜无论你去哪里 ; wherever you live｜无论你住在哪里
tip_zh: 表示“无论哪里”时，相当于no matter where。

meanings_zh: n. 签名；署名 | adj. 标志性的；招牌的
definition_en: Your name written in your own distinctive way | Distinctive and closely associated with a particular person or place
example1_en: The delivery driver asked for my signature at the door.
example1_zh: 送货司机在门口请我签名。
example2_en: Electronic signatures allow businesses to complete agreements remotely, reducing delays and the need for paper documents.
example2_zh: 电子签名让企业能够远程签订协议，减少延误和纸质文件的使用。
collocations: require a signature｜需要签名 ; electronic signature｜电子签名 ; signature dish｜招牌菜
tip_zh: signature通常指签名；名人纪念签名常用autograph。

meanings_zh: adv. 完全地；绝对地 | adv. 当然；完全同意
definition_en: completely or without any doubt | used to express strong agreement with someone
example1_en: The kitchen was absolutely spotless after we cleaned it.
example1_zh: 我们打扫后，厨房一尘不染。
example2_en: Reliable internet access is absolutely essential for students participating in online courses from remote communities.
example2_zh: 对于偏远社区参加在线课程的学生来说，可靠的网络连接必不可少。
collocations: absolutely essential｜绝对必要的 ; absolutely certain｜完全确定的 ; absolutely right｜完全正确的 ; absolutely not｜绝对不行
tip_zh: 常修饰essential等极限形容词，不常说absolutely good。

meanings_zh: n. 力；力量 | v. 强迫；迫使 | n. 武力；暴力
definition_en: physical power that moves something or changes its shape | to make someone do something against their wishes | physical strength used to control or overpower someone
example1_en: The force of the wind blew my umbrella inside out.
example1_zh: 大风把我的伞吹翻了。
example2_en: Rising housing costs may force essential workers to move further away from the communities they serve.
example2_zh: 不断上涨的住房成本可能迫使必要岗位的工作人员搬离他们服务的社区。
collocations: force someone to do something｜迫使某人做某事 ; by force｜用武力 ; gravitational force｜引力 ; labour force｜劳动力
tip_zh: “迫使某人做某事”用force somebody to do something。

meanings_zh: n. 谋杀犯
definition_en: Someone who deliberately and unlawfully kills another person.
example1_en: The detective finally identified the murderer in the novel.
example1_zh: 小说中的侦探终于查明了谁是谋杀犯。
example2_en: Documentaries about convicted murderers should avoid sensationalism and consider the feelings of victims' families.
example2_zh: 有关已定罪谋杀犯的纪录片应避免煽情，并顾及受害者家属的感受。
collocations: convicted murderer｜已定罪的谋杀犯 ; identify the murderer｜查明谋杀犯身份 ; catch a murderer｜抓获谋杀犯
tip_zh: 指故意非法杀人者；killer的含义更广。

meanings_zh: n. 频道；渠道 | n. 水道；海峡 | v. 引导；将…用于
definition_en: A television service or route for communicating and distributing things | A passage of water connecting areas or allowing boats through | Direct energy, money, or resources towards a particular purpose
example1_en: Could you change the channel before the film starts?
example1_zh: 电影开始前，你能换个频道吗？
example2_en: Governments should channel more funding into public transport to reduce congestion and improve access to employment.
example2_zh: 政府应将更多资金投入公共交通，以缓解拥堵并便利人们上班求职。
collocations: a television channel｜电视频道 ; communication channels｜沟通渠道 ; a shipping channel｜航道 ; channel resources into｜将资源投入
tip_zh: 动词常用channel sth into sth，表示将资源投入某处。

meanings_zh: n. 恋爱；爱情；浪漫情调 | n. 爱情小说；爱情电影
definition_en: a loving relationship or the excitement and affection surrounding love | a story or film mainly about love
example1_en: Their romance began during a walking holiday in the mountains.
example1_zh: 他们的恋情始于一次山间徒步假期。
example2_en: Popular films often portray romance in idealised ways, which may shape young people's expectations of relationships.
example2_zh: 流行电影常以理想化的方式描绘爱情，这可能影响年轻人对恋爱关系的期待。
collocations: a holiday romance｜假日恋情 ; a whirlwind romance｜迅速发展的恋情 ; a sense of romance｜浪漫感
tip_zh: 泛指爱情常不可数；指一段恋情或一部作品可数。

meanings_zh: n. 路线；路径 | v. 按路线发送；安排路线
definition_en: a way taken to get from one place to another | to send someone or something along a particular path
example1_en: We took a different route home to avoid traffic.
example1_zh: 我们换了一条路线回家，以避开拥堵。
example2_en: Expanding bus routes to rural communities would improve access to employment and essential public services.
example2_zh: 将公交线路延伸至农村社区，有助于居民获得就业机会和基本公共服务。
collocations: bus route｜公交线路 ; alternative route｜替代路线 ; trade route｜贸易路线 ; route calls｜转接电话
tip_zh: 美式也读 /raʊt/；route 强调行进路线。

meanings_zh: adj. 有用的；有价值的 | adj. 贵重的；值钱的
definition_en: Very useful or important for a particular purpose. | Worth a large amount of money.
example1_en: My neighbour gave me valuable advice about growing tomatoes.
example1_zh: 邻居给了我一些种番茄的宝贵建议。
example2_en: Work placements provide valuable experience that helps students develop practical skills before entering full-time employment.
example2_zh: 实习提供宝贵经验，帮助学生在正式就业前培养实践技能。
collocations: valuable experience｜宝贵经验 ; valuable advice｜宝贵建议 ; a valuable contribution｜重要贡献 ; valuable jewellery｜贵重珠宝
tip_zh: 贵重物品用复数valuables；invaluable意为极宝贵的。

meanings_zh: adj. 历史的；有关历史的
definition_en: connected with history or events in the past
example1_en: We found historical photographs of our street in the library.
example1_zh: 我们在图书馆找到了这条街过去的照片。
example2_en: Historical records help researchers understand how earlier societies responded to environmental change and economic uncertainty.
example2_zh: 历史记录帮助研究人员了解过去的社会如何应对环境变化和经济不确定性。
collocations: historical records｜历史记录 ; historical evidence｜历史证据 ; historical context｜历史背景 ; historical novel｜历史小说
tip_zh: historical指与历史有关；historic强调具有历史意义。

meanings_zh: n. 手术 | n. 运行；运作；经营 | n. 有组织的行动
definition_en: Medical treatment involving cutting into the body. | The functioning or management of a machine, system, or business. | A planned activity involving several people working together.
example1_en: My aunt is recovering well after her knee operation.
example1_zh: 我姑姑膝盖手术后恢复得很好。
example2_en: The successful operation of public transport systems depends on reliable funding and careful long-term planning.
example2_zh: 公共交通系统的成功运作有赖于可靠的资金支持和周密的长期规划。
collocations: have an operation｜接受手术 ; perform an operation｜做手术 ; in operation｜运行中 ; rescue operation｜救援行动
tip_zh: 手术部位用on连接：an operation on the knee。

meanings_zh: n. 信任；信赖 | v. 信任；相信 | n. 信托；信托机构
definition_en: Belief that someone or something is honest, reliable, or safe. | To believe someone or something is honest, reliable, or safe. | An arrangement or organisation managing money or property for others.
example1_en: I trust my neighbour to feed our cat.
example1_zh: 我信得过邻居，放心让他喂我们的猫。
example2_en: Public trust in scientific advice depends partly on how clearly researchers communicate uncertainty and evidence.
example2_zh: 公众对科学建议的信任，部分取决于研究人员能否清晰地说明不确定性和证据。
collocations: build trust｜建立信任 ; trust someone to do something｜相信某人会做某事 ; mutual trust｜相互信任 ; a charitable trust｜慈善信托机构
tip_zh: trust sb to do sth表示相信某人能可靠地做某事。

meanings_zh: n. 一场；一次活动时间 | n. 会议；开庭期
definition_en: a period spent doing a particular activity | a formal meeting or period when an official body meets
example1_en: Our first swimming session starts early tomorrow morning.
example1_zh: 我们的第一次游泳课明天一早开始。
example2_en: Regular revision sessions help students retain information more effectively than studying intensively just before examinations.
example2_zh: 定期复习比临考前突击学习更能帮助学生有效记住知识。
collocations: a training session｜一次训练 ; a revision session｜一次复习 ; a question-and-answer session｜问答环节 ; in session｜正在开会；正在开庭
tip_zh: session强调一段活动时间；semester才通常指学期。

meanings_zh: n. 小型多座客车 | n. 小型货车
definition_en: A vehicle with several passenger seats, often used by families. | A small van used for transporting goods.
example1_en: Our minivan has enough seats for the whole family.
example1_zh: 我们的小型多座客车有足够的座位，可以坐下全家人。
example2_en: Shared minivan services can improve access to healthcare for rural residents who lack reliable public transport.
example2_zh: 共享小型客车服务可以帮助缺乏可靠公共交通的农村居民更方便地就医。
collocations: family minivan｜家用多座客车 ; rent a minivan｜租一辆小型客车 ; seven-seater minivan｜七座小型客车
tip_zh: 美式常指家庭多座客车，不宜一律译为小货车。

meanings_zh: adj. 意料之外的
definition_en: Happening without being expected or predicted.
example1_en: An unexpected visitor arrived just as we finished lunch.
example1_zh: 我们刚吃完午饭，一位意想不到的客人就来了。
example2_en: Governments need emergency funds to manage unexpected events without reducing essential spending on healthcare and education.
example2_zh: 政府需要应急资金来应对意外事件，避免削减医疗和教育方面的必要支出。
collocations: unexpected result｜意外的结果 ; unexpected visitor｜不速之客 ; unexpected delay｜意外的延误
tip_zh: unexpected强调未料到，不一定表示突然发生。

meanings_zh: v. 投票；表决 | n. 选票；投票；表决
definition_en: To formally express a choice in an election or decision. | A formal expression of choice, or the process of choosing.
example1_en: We voted to hold the picnic in the park.
example1_zh: 我们投票决定在公园里野餐。
example2_en: Allowing residents to vote on local projects may increase public participation in community development.
example2_zh: 允许居民就地方项目投票，可能提高公众参与社区发展的积极性。
collocations: vote for｜投票支持 ; vote against｜投票反对 ; cast a vote｜投票 ; the right to vote｜投票权
tip_zh: vote for表示支持；vote against表示反对。

meanings_zh: n. 牛油果；鳄梨
definition_en: A fruit with creamy green flesh and a large central stone.
example1_en: She spread ripe avocado on her warm toast.
example1_zh: 她把熟透的牛油果抹在热吐司上。
example2_en: Growing demand for avocados can place pressure on water supplies in regions with limited rainfall.
example2_zh: 在降雨有限的地区，牛油果需求增长可能给供水带来压力。
collocations: a ripe avocado｜成熟的牛油果 ; mashed avocado｜牛油果泥 ; avocado toast｜牛油果吐司
tip_zh: 复数为avocados，不加-es。

meanings_zh: v. 原谅；宽恕 | v. 免除债务
definition_en: Stop blaming someone or feeling angry about what they did. | Officially allow someone not to repay a debt.
example1_en: Can you forgive me for breaking your favourite mug?
example1_zh: 我打碎了你最喜欢的杯子，你能原谅我吗？
example2_en: International lenders may forgive some debts to help poorer countries invest more in healthcare and education.
example2_zh: 国际贷款机构可能减免部分债务，帮助较贫困国家增加医疗和教育投入。
collocations: forgive someone for something｜原谅某人某事 ; forgive a mistake｜原谅错误 ; forgive a debt｜免除债务
tip_zh: 用forgive sb for doing sth；过去式forgave，过去分词forgiven。

meanings_zh: n. 飞机；航空器
definition_en: a vehicle that flies, such as a plane or helicopter
example1_en: A small aircraft flew low over the fields.
example1_zh: 一架小型飞机低空飞过田野。
example2_en: Developing more efficient aircraft could reduce fuel consumption, although growing passenger demand may limit the environmental benefits.
example2_zh: 研发效率更高的飞机可以降低燃料消耗，但不断增长的旅客需求可能限制其环境效益。
collocations: commercial aircraft｜商用飞机 ; passenger aircraft｜客机 ; light aircraft｜轻型飞机 ; aircraft maintenance｜航空器维护
tip_zh: aircraft单复数同形，不能加-s。

meanings_zh: n. 行李 | n. 思想包袱；情感负担
definition_en: the bags and suitcases you take when travelling | past experiences or feelings that continue to cause difficulties
example1_en: Our baggage arrived on the next flight this afternoon.
example1_zh: 我们的行李今天下午随下一班飞机到了。
example2_en: Airlines often charge additional fees for checked baggage, increasing the overall cost of travel.
example2_zh: 航空公司常对托运行李额外收费，从而增加旅行的总费用。
collocations: checked baggage｜托运行李 ; baggage allowance｜行李限额 ; baggage claim｜行李领取处 ; emotional baggage｜情感包袱
tip_zh: 不可数；一件行李说a piece of baggage。

meanings_zh: adj. 慷慨的；大方的 | adj. 充足的；大量的
definition_en: willing to give money, time, or help freely | larger or more plentiful than usual or expected
example1_en: Our generous neighbour shared her fresh vegetables with us.
example1_zh: 我们那位大方的邻居把新鲜蔬菜分给了我们。
example2_en: Generous donations from local businesses can help community centres provide affordable activities for children and older residents.
example2_zh: 当地企业的慷慨捐助可以帮助社区中心为儿童和老年居民提供价格实惠的活动。
collocations: generous donation｜慷慨捐助 ; generous portion｜丰盛的一份 ; generous with your time｜不吝惜时间
tip_zh: be generous with sth表示在某方面慷慨。

meanings_zh: n. 洪水；水灾 | v. 淹没；被水淹 | n. 大量涌来的人或事物
definition_en: Water covering land that is normally dry. | To cover with water or become covered with water. | A large amount of something arriving at once.
example1_en: The flood left our garden covered in thick mud.
example1_zh: 洪水退去后，我们的花园覆满了厚厚的淤泥。
example2_en: Restoring wetlands can reduce flood risks by allowing excess rainwater to spread and drain naturally.
example2_zh: 恢复湿地可以让多余雨水自然扩散和排走，从而降低洪灾风险。
collocations: flash flood｜山洪；暴洪 ; flood defences｜防洪设施 ; flood damage｜洪灾损失 ; a flood of complaints｜大量涌来的投诉
tip_zh: 读音与 blood 的元音相同，不与 food 押韵。

meanings_zh: n. 狐狸 | v. 使困惑；难倒
definition_en: A wild animal with pointed ears and a bushy tail. | To confuse someone or make a problem difficult to solve.
example1_en: A fox slipped through the garden before sunrise.
example1_zh: 日出前，一只狐狸悄悄穿过花园。
example2_en: The red fox can adapt to urban environments where food is readily available from human activity.
example2_zh: 赤狐能够适应城市环境，因为人类活动使食物很容易获取。
collocations: a red fox｜赤狐 ; an urban fox｜城市里的狐狸 ; a fox cub｜狐狸幼崽
tip_zh: 作动词表示“难倒”，主要用于英式非正式语境。

meanings_zh: adj. 摄氏的
definition_en: Using the temperature scale with water freezing at zero
example1_en: It was thirty degrees centigrade in the shade today.
example1_zh: 今天阴凉处的气温达到了三十摄氏度。
example2_en: A rise of two degrees centigrade in average temperatures could significantly affect agricultural production in vulnerable regions.
example2_zh: 平均气温上升两摄氏度可能对脆弱地区的农业生产产生显著影响。
collocations: degrees centigrade｜摄氏度 ; centigrade scale｜摄氏温标
tip_zh: 通常说degrees centigrade；现代科学更常用Celsius。

meanings_zh: adj. 典型的；有代表性的 | adj. 一贯的；特有的
definition_en: having the usual features of a particular group or situation | showing the behaviour or qualities usually associated with someone
example1_en: A typical weekday starts with breakfast and a walk.
example1_zh: 平常的工作日都是从吃早餐和散步开始的。
example2_en: Long commuting times are typical of large cities where housing near employment centres is expensive.
example2_zh: 在就业中心附近住房昂贵的大城市，通勤时间长是常见现象。
collocations: a typical example｜典型例子 ; typical of｜是……的典型特征 ; a typical day｜平常的一天
tip_zh: 用typical of表示具有某人或某物的典型特征。

meanings_zh: n. 几何学
definition_en: The study of shapes, angles, sizes, and spatial relationships.
example1_en: We used colourful wooden shapes in geometry class today.
example1_zh: 今天的几何课上，我们使用了彩色的木制图形。
example2_en: Learning geometry helps students develop spatial reasoning skills that are valuable in engineering and architecture.
example2_zh: 学习几何有助于学生培养空间推理能力，这种能力在工程和建筑领域很有价值。
collocations: plane geometry｜平面几何 ; solid geometry｜立体几何 ; study geometry｜学习几何
tip_zh: 学科名，不可数；通常不加冠词。

meanings_zh: adj. 反复发生的；重复的 | v. 重复；重说（过去式、分词）
definition_en: happening or done again and again | said or did something again
example1_en: Repeated phone calls kept interrupting our quiet dinner.
example1_zh: 接连不断的电话打断了我们安静的晚餐。
example2_en: Repeated exposure to new vocabulary helps learners remember words and use them more confidently.
example2_zh: 反复接触新词汇有助于学习者记住单词，并更自信地运用它们。
collocations: repeated attempts｜多次尝试 ; repeated warnings｜反复警告 ; repeated exposure to｜反复接触
tip_zh: repeated强调多次发生；repetitive常暗示单调乏味。

meanings_zh: n. 气氛；氛围 | n. 大气；大气层
definition_en: the feeling or mood of a place or situation | the mixture of gases surrounding a planet
example1_en: Soft lighting gave the little restaurant a relaxed atmosphere.
example1_zh: 柔和的灯光为这家小餐馆营造了轻松的氛围。
example2_en: A supportive classroom atmosphere encourages students to ask questions and participate more actively in discussions.
example2_zh: 相互支持的课堂氛围鼓励学生提问，并更加积极地参与讨论。
collocations: relaxed atmosphere｜轻松的氛围 ; create an atmosphere｜营造氛围 ; Earth's atmosphere｜地球大气层
tip_zh: 表示某种氛围常用an atmosphere；地球大气用the atmosphere。

meanings_zh: n. 地方议会；委员会
definition_en: A group chosen to govern an area or manage affairs.
example1_en: The local council repaired the playground near our house.
example1_zh: 地方议会修好了我们家附近的游乐场。
example2_en: The city council should consult residents before approving developments that could affect public green spaces.
example2_zh: 市议会在批准可能影响公共绿地的开发项目之前，应征询居民意见。
collocations: local council｜地方议会 ; city council｜市议会 ; council member｜议会成员 ; student council｜学生会
tip_zh: council指议会或委员会；counsel指建议或劝告。

meanings_zh: v. 激励；激发积极性 | v. 成为……的动机
definition_en: to make someone eager to do something | to provide the reason for someone's actions
example1_en: Training with a friend motivates me to exercise regularly.
example1_zh: 和朋友一起训练能激励我坚持锻炼。
example2_en: Teachers can motivate students to explore difficult subjects by connecting classroom lessons with everyday experiences.
example2_zh: 教师可以把课堂内容与日常经历联系起来，激励学生探索难学的科目。
collocations: motivate someone to do something｜激励某人做某事 ; highly motivated｜积极性很高的 ; be motivated by｜出于……的动机
tip_zh: 常用motivate sb to do；by后可接动机。

meanings_zh: n. 恼怒；烦躁 | n. 刺激；发炎不适
definition_en: the feeling of being annoyed | soreness or discomfort in a part of the body
example1_en: He sighed with irritation when the phone rang again.
example1_zh: 电话又响了，他烦躁地叹了口气。
example2_en: Exposure to household cleaning products may cause skin irritation, especially among people with sensitive skin.
example2_zh: 接触家用清洁产品可能引起皮肤刺激，皮肤敏感者尤其如此。
collocations: skin irritation｜皮肤刺激 ; eye irritation｜眼部刺激 ; a source of irritation｜令人恼火的事物
tip_zh: 既可指情绪上的恼怒，也可指皮肤等受到刺激。

meanings_zh: n. 坑；深洞 | n. 赛车维修区 | n. 果核
definition_en: A large hole in the ground | An area where racing cars stop for servicing | The hard central part of certain fruits
example1_en: We dug a shallow pit for the new tree.
example1_zh: 我们挖了一个浅坑，准备栽这棵新树。
example2_en: Abandoned mining pits can threaten local ecosystems unless restoration projects stabilise the soil and improve water quality.
example2_zh: 废弃矿坑可能威胁当地生态系统，除非修复项目能稳固土壤并改善水质。
collocations: dig a pit｜挖坑 ; a deep pit｜深坑 ; a pit stop｜赛车进站检修 ; a peach pit｜桃核
tip_zh: 维修区常用the pits；果核义主要用于美式英语。

meanings_zh: n. 哲学 | n. 人生观；指导理念
definition_en: The study of knowledge, existence, reality, and moral values | A set of beliefs that guides actions and decisions
example1_en: My sister studies philosophy and enjoys discussing difficult questions.
example1_zh: 我姐姐学习哲学，喜欢讨论难解的问题。
example2_en: Studying philosophy can help students question assumptions and develop stronger arguments about complex ethical issues.
example2_zh: 学习哲学有助于学生质疑既有假设，并就复杂的伦理问题提出更有力的论证。
collocations: study philosophy｜学习哲学 ; moral philosophy｜道德哲学 ; personal philosophy｜个人处世哲学 ; philosophy of education｜教育哲学
tip_zh: 指学科通常不可数；指某套理念可用a philosophy。

meanings_zh: n. 跑腿的差事
definition_en: A short trip to buy, collect, or deliver something
example1_en: I ran an errand before meeting you for lunch.
example1_zh: 和你见面吃午饭前，我出去办了点事。
example2_en: Reliable neighbourhood transport helps older residents run errands independently and maintain regular contact with their communities.
example2_zh: 可靠的社区交通能帮助老年居民独立外出办事，并与社区保持日常联系。
collocations: run errands｜外出办事 ; send someone on an errand｜派某人跑腿 ; a quick errand｜很快能办完的差事
tip_zh: 通常指外出办小事；常搭配run errands。

meanings_zh: adj. 美极的；令人惊艳的 | adj. 令人震惊的
definition_en: extremely beautiful or impressive | causing great surprise or shock
example1_en: We enjoyed a stunning view from the hilltop.
example1_zh: 我们在山顶欣赏了绝美的景色。
example2_en: The region's stunning coastal scenery attracts visitors, but increased tourism places pressure on fragile ecosystems.
example2_zh: 该地区绝美的海岸风光吸引着游客，但旅游业增长也给脆弱的生态系统带来压力。
collocations: stunning scenery｜绝美的风景 ; a stunning achievement｜惊人的成就 ; a stunning victory｜令人震惊的胜利 ; look stunning｜看起来美极了
tip_zh: stunning形容事物令人惊叹；stunned形容人惊呆了。

meanings_zh: n. 糖浆 | n. 糖浆剂
definition_en: a thick sweet liquid made from dissolved sugar | a sweet thick liquid containing medicine
example1_en: She poured a little syrup over her warm pancakes.
example1_zh: 她在热乎乎的煎饼上浇了一点糖浆。
example2_en: Fruit preserved in syrup often contains more added sugar than fresh fruit, which may concern health-conscious consumers.
example2_zh: 糖浆保存的水果通常比新鲜水果含有更多添加糖，这可能让注重健康的消费者担忧。
collocations: maple syrup｜枫糖浆 ; cough syrup｜止咳糖浆 ; fruit in syrup｜糖水水果 ; sugar syrup｜糖浆
tip_zh: 通常不可数；止咳糖浆说cough syrup。

meanings_zh: n. 预测；预报 | v. 预测；预报
definition_en: A statement about what is likely to happen in the future. | To say what will probably happen, using available information.
example1_en: The weather forecast says we should expect snow tonight.
example1_zh: 天气预报说今晚可能会下雪。
example2_en: Economists forecast slower growth next year as rising energy costs place greater pressure on businesses.
example2_zh: 经济学家预测，随着能源成本上涨给企业带来更大压力，明年的经济增长将放缓。
collocations: weather forecast｜天气预报 ; economic forecast｜经济预测 ; forecast growth｜预测增长 ; forecast demand｜预测需求
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词通常用forecast，也可用forecasted。

meanings_zh: n. 一小团气烟；一阵气流 | v. 喘粗气 | v. 喷出气烟；鼓起
definition_en: A small amount of air, smoke, or steam released suddenly. | To breathe quickly and noisily after physical effort. | To release air or smoke, or swell with air.
example1_en: A puff of steam escaped from the kettle.
example1_zh: 一小团蒸汽从水壶里冒了出来。
example2_en: Older buses release puffs of dark smoke, highlighting the need for cleaner public transport in cities.
example2_zh: 老旧公交车排出一团团黑烟，凸显了城市发展更清洁公共交通的必要性。
collocations: a puff of smoke｜一团烟 ; huff and puff｜气喘吁吁 ; puff up｜膨胀；鼓起 ; puff out your cheeks｜鼓起腮帮子
tip_zh: 一团烟用a puff of smoke；puff也可表示喘粗气。

meanings_zh: n. 商标 | n. 标志性特征 | v. 将……注册为商标
definition_en: A legally protected name or symbol identifying a company's products. | A distinctive feature strongly associated with someone or something. | To register a name or symbol for legal protection.
example1_en: The bakery's trademark is a tiny golden wheat stalk.
example1_zh: 这家面包店的商标是一株小小的金色麦穗。
example2_en: Registering a trademark helps small businesses protect their identity and distinguish their products from those of competitors.
example2_zh: 注册商标有助于小企业保护自身品牌形象，并使其产品区别于竞争对手的产品。
collocations: registered trademark｜注册商标 ; trademark protection｜商标保护 ; trademark infringement｜商标侵权 ; trademark smile｜标志性笑容
tip_zh: 商标用trademark；版权用copyright，保护对象不同。

meanings_zh: n. 化妆品
definition_en: Products applied to the face or body to improve appearance.
example1_en: She keeps her cosmetics in a small bathroom drawer.
example1_zh: 她把化妆品放在浴室的一个小抽屉里。
example2_en: Consumers increasingly expect cosmetics manufacturers to disclose ingredients clearly and reduce unnecessary packaging to limit environmental damage.
example2_zh: 消费者越来越希望化妆品制造商明确公开成分，并减少不必要的包装以降低环境危害。
collocations: cosmetics industry｜化妆品行业 ; cosmetics manufacturer｜化妆品制造商 ; buy cosmetics｜购买化妆品
tip_zh: 通常用复数；cosmetic作形容词也指表面的。

meanings_zh: adj. 亲切友善的；易于交谈的 | adj. 易懂的；容易欣赏的
definition_en: friendly and easy to talk to | easy to understand or enjoy without special knowledge
example1_en: Our new teacher seems approachable, so I asked for help.
example1_zh: 我们的新老师看起来很亲切，所以我向老师求助了。
example2_en: Approachable healthcare professionals may encourage patients to discuss sensitive concerns before their conditions become more serious.
example2_zh: 亲切的医护人员可能促使患者在病情加重前谈及难以启齿的顾虑。
collocations: an approachable teacher｜亲切的老师 ; friendly and approachable｜友善且平易近人的 ; an approachable style｜浅显易懂的风格
tip_zh: 形容人时重在容易交谈、让人敢于求助。

meanings_zh: v. 释放；放出 | v. 发布；发行 | n. 释放；发布；发行物
definition_en: To let someone or something go free or escape. | To make information or a product available to the public. | The act of freeing or publishing; something newly made available.
example1_en: We released the butterfly outside after checking its wings.
example1_zh: 检查过蝴蝶的翅膀后，我们把它放到了室外。
example2_en: Governments should release reliable environmental data so that citizens can evaluate the effectiveness of climate policies.
example2_zh: 政府应公布可靠的环境数据，让公民能够评估气候政策的成效。
collocations: release a report｜发布报告 ; release a prisoner｜释放囚犯 ; release gases｜释放气体 ; a press release｜新闻稿
tip_zh: release可指释放，也可指公开发布报告或产品。

meanings_zh: adj. 感人的；动人的 | v. 触摸；碰（现在分词）
definition_en: making you feel affection, sympathy, or gentle sadness | putting a hand or another body part against something
example1_en: Her touching farewell brought tears to my eyes.
example1_zh: 她感人的道别让我热泪盈眶。
example2_en: The documentary offers a touching account of volunteers helping older residents overcome loneliness in urban communities.
example2_zh: 这部纪录片动人地讲述了志愿者帮助城市社区的老年居民克服孤独的故事。
collocations: a touching story｜感人的故事 ; a touching gesture｜暖心的举动 ; a touching tribute｜感人的致敬
tip_zh: touching形容事情感人；touched形容人受到感动。

meanings_zh: n. 新手；初学者
definition_en: someone with little experience in a particular activity
example1_en: As a gardening novice, I often forget to water seedlings.
example1_zh: 作为园艺新手，我常常忘记给幼苗浇水。
example2_en: Structured mentoring can help a novice develop the confidence needed to manage a classroom effectively.
example2_zh: 有系统的指导能帮助新手建立有效管理课堂所需的信心。
collocations: a complete novice｜完全的新手 ; a novice driver｜新手司机 ; a novice at｜……方面的新手
tip_zh: 表示某方面的新手，常用a novice at/in。

meanings_zh: adj. 尚好的；像样的 | adj. 正派的；得体的
definition_en: of a satisfactory or reasonably good standard | honest, kind, or socially acceptable
example1_en: We finally found a decent flat near the station.
example1_zh: 我们终于在车站附近找到了一套像样的公寓。
example2_en: Every worker should earn enough to afford decent housing and meet their basic needs.
example2_zh: 每位劳动者都应有足够的收入，住上像样的住房并满足基本需求。
collocations: decent housing｜像样的住房 ; a decent salary｜不错的薪水 ; a decent person｜正派的人
tip_zh: 表示质量时是“还不错”，不等于“极好”。

meanings_zh: n. 托儿所；幼儿园 | n. 苗圃 | n. 婴儿室；儿童房
definition_en: a place where young children are cared for | a place where young plants are grown for sale | a room in a home for a baby or young child
example1_en: My daughter painted a bright yellow duck at nursery.
example1_zh: 我女儿在幼儿园画了一只鲜黄色的鸭子。
example2_en: Affordable nursery places allow more parents to return to work while their children receive professional care.
example2_zh: 价格可负担的托幼名额能让更多父母重返职场，同时让孩子得到专业照护。
collocations: nursery school｜幼儿园 ; nursery staff｜托幼工作人员 ; plant nursery｜苗圃 ; nursery rhyme｜童谣
tip_zh: 英式英语中at nursery常指在托儿所。

meanings_zh: n. 学者 | n. 奖学金获得者
definition_en: A person with deep knowledge of an academic subject. | A student awarded money to study because of their abilities.
example1_en: The scholar carefully examined an old book in the library.
example1_zh: 这位学者在图书馆仔细研究一本古书。
example2_en: Scholars increasingly argue that access to early education can reduce social inequality over the long term.
example2_zh: 越来越多学者认为，获得早期教育的机会能够长期减少社会不平等。
collocations: a leading scholar｜杰出学者 ; a visiting scholar｜访问学者 ; a distinguished scholar｜著名学者
tip_zh: scholar通常指学者，不是普通学生。

meanings_zh: n. 公众集会 | v. 集结；团结支持 | v. 恢复；振作；回升
definition_en: A large public meeting supporting a cause or expressing opinions. | To gather people together to support someone or something. | To regain strength or improve after a difficult period.
example1_en: Hundreds attended a peaceful rally in the town square.
example1_zh: 数百人参加了镇广场上的和平集会。
example2_en: Community leaders rallied support for a public library, arguing that free access to information benefits everyone.
example2_zh: 社区领袖争取大家支持建设公共图书馆，认为免费获取信息能让所有人受益。
collocations: hold a rally｜举行集会 ; rally support｜争取支持 ; rally around someone｜团结起来支持某人
tip_zh: rally support for表示“为……争取支持”。

meanings_zh: n. 一致性；稳定性 | n. 稠度；黏稠度
definition_en: The quality of staying similar in behaviour, standards, or results. | How thick, firm, or smooth a substance is.
example1_en: Our coach values consistency more than occasional brilliant performances.
example1_zh: 我们的教练更看重稳定发挥，而不是偶尔的出色表现。
example2_en: Greater consistency in marking standards would help ensure that students receive fair results across different examination centres.
example2_zh: 提高评分标准的一致性，有助于确保不同考点的学生获得公平的成绩。
collocations: consistency in quality｜质量的稳定性 ; maintain consistency｜保持一致性 ; a smooth consistency｜细腻均匀的质地
tip_zh: 表示某方面的一致性用 consistency in。

meanings_zh: n. 提及；涉及 | n. 参考；引文出处 | n. 推荐信；证明人
definition_en: a mention of someone or something | consultation for information, or a source used in writing | a recommendation or someone who recommends you for work
example1_en: Her speech included a warm reference to her grandmother.
example1_zh: 她在演讲中温情地提到了祖母。
example2_en: Academic essays should include accurate references so readers can locate the original sources of information.
example2_zh: 学术文章应包含准确的引文出处，以便读者找到信息的原始来源。
collocations: make reference to｜提及 ; for future reference｜供日后参考 ; provide a reference｜提供推荐信
tip_zh: reference to表示提及；for reference表示供参考。

meanings_zh: n. 乐观；乐观态度
definition_en: The belief that good things will happen.
example1_en: Her optimism helped us stay cheerful during the storm.
example1_zh: 暴风雨期间，她的乐观让我们保持了好心情。
example2_en: Despite economic uncertainty, many graduates express optimism about their chances of finding meaningful employment.
example2_zh: 尽管经济形势不明朗，许多毕业生仍对找到有意义的工作持乐观态度。
collocations: cautious optimism｜谨慎乐观 ; optimism about the future｜对未来的乐观态度 ; grounds for optimism｜乐观的理由
tip_zh: 不可数名词；对某事乐观常用optimism about。

meanings_zh: n. 原则；行为准则 | n. 原理；基本法则
definition_en: A belief or rule that guides decisions and behaviour. | A basic truth explaining how something works.
example1_en: I refused the extra money as a matter of principle.
example1_zh: 出于原则，我拒绝了那笔额外的钱。
example2_en: The principle of equal opportunity should guide policies designed to improve access to higher education.
example2_zh: 旨在改善高等教育入学机会的政策应以机会平等原则为指导。
collocations: basic principle｜基本原则；基本原理 ; in principle｜原则上；理论上 ; on principle｜出于原则 ; guiding principle｜指导原则
tip_zh: 勿混principal：它可指“主要的”或“校长”。

meanings_zh: n. 花束 | n. 酒香
definition_en: A group of flowers arranged together, usually as a gift. | The characteristic pleasant smell of a wine.
example1_en: She brought a bright bouquet to her grandmother's birthday dinner.
example1_zh: 她带着一束鲜艳的花来参加祖母的生日晚餐。
example2_en: Choosing a bouquet of locally grown flowers can reduce the environmental impact associated with long-distance transport.
example2_zh: 选择一束本地种植的鲜花，可以减少长途运输带来的环境影响。
collocations: a bouquet of flowers｜一束鲜花 ; bridal bouquet｜新娘捧花 ; a bouquet of roses｜一束玫瑰
tip_zh: 末尾t不发音；一束花用a bouquet of flowers。

meanings_zh: v. 实施；执行 | n. 工具；器具
definition_en: to put a plan or decision into action | a tool used for a particular task
example1_en: Our team will implement the new schedule next week.
example1_zh: 我们团队下周将实行新的时间表。
example2_en: Governments should implement policies that make public transport more affordable for people on low incomes.
example2_zh: 政府应实施相关政策，让低收入人群更负担得起公共交通。
collocations: implement a policy｜实施政策 ; implement a plan｜执行计划 ; agricultural implements｜农具
tip_zh: 动词重音在首音节；名词末音节读/mənt/。

meanings_zh: v. 确保；保证
definition_en: To make certain that something happens or is true
example1_en: Please ensure that all windows are closed before leaving.
example1_zh: 离开前请确保所有窗户都已关好。
example2_en: Governments should ensure that affordable public transport is available to residents in both urban and rural areas.
example2_zh: 政府应确保城市和农村居民都能享有价格实惠的公共交通。
collocations: ensure safety｜确保安全 ; ensure access｜确保能够获得 ; ensure that｜确保
tip_zh: ensure接名词或that从句；insure指投保。

meanings_zh: n. 物种
definition_en: A biological group whose members can usually breed with one another.
example1_en: Several species of butterfly visit our garden each summer.
example1_zh: 每年夏天都有几种蝴蝶来到我们的花园。
example2_en: Protecting natural habitats is essential for preventing the extinction of species threatened by human activity.
example2_zh: 保护自然栖息地对于防止受人类活动威胁的物种灭绝至关重要。
collocations: endangered species｜濒危物种 ; native species｜本地物种 ; invasive species｜入侵物种 ; species diversity｜物种多样性
tip_zh: 单复数同形：one species，many species。

meanings_zh: n. 程度；范围
definition_en: How much something happens or how far it reaches.
example1_en: We only discovered the extent of the leak yesterday.
example1_zh: 我们昨天才发现漏水有多严重。
example2_en: The extent to which public transport reduces pollution depends on passenger numbers and energy sources.
example2_zh: 公共交通能在多大程度上减少污染，取决于乘客数量和能源来源。
collocations: to some extent｜在某种程度上 ; the full extent of｜……的全部程度或范围 ; to a large extent｜在很大程度上
tip_zh: 表示“在某种程度上”用to some extent。

meanings_zh: n. 爪；爪子 | n. 螯；钳 | v. 用爪抓；用力抓挠
definition_en: a sharp, curved nail on an animal's foot | a jointed gripping part on a crab or similar animal | to scratch or pull at something with claws or fingers
example1_en: The cat caught my sleeve with one sharp claw.
example1_zh: 猫用一只尖爪钩住了我的袖子。
example2_en: Sharp claws help many predators catch prey, while other animals use them to climb or dig.
example2_zh: 锋利的爪子帮助许多捕食者捕获猎物，而其他动物则用爪子攀爬或挖掘。
collocations: sharp claws｜锋利的爪子 ; crab claws｜蟹螯 ; claw at something｜使劲抓挠某物
tip_zh: claw是尖爪；paw指猫狗等动物的整个脚掌。

meanings_zh: n. 黎明；拂晓 | n. 开端；萌芽 | v. 开始明白；破晓
definition_en: the early morning when daylight first appears | the beginning of a new period or development | to become understood, or to begin growing light
example1_en: We left at dawn to avoid the heavy traffic.
example1_zh: 我们黎明时就出发了，以避开拥堵的交通。
example2_en: The dawn of digital communication has transformed how people maintain relationships across national borders.
example2_zh: 数字通信时代的到来改变了人们跨国维系人际关系的方式。
collocations: at dawn｜在黎明时分 ; from dawn to dusk｜从早到晚 ; the dawn of a new era｜新时代的开端 ; dawn on someone｜使某人开始明白
tip_zh: It dawned on me that…表示“我开始明白……”。

meanings_zh: adj. 透明的 | adj. 公开透明的 | adj. 显而易见的；易识破的
definition_en: Allowing light through so objects behind can be seen clearly. | Open and clear about decisions, actions, or methods. | Easy to recognise or understand, especially as false.
example1_en: She keeps her buttons in a transparent plastic box.
example1_zh: 她把纽扣放在一个透明塑料盒里。
example2_en: Public institutions need transparent recruitment procedures to ensure fairness and maintain the trust of local communities.
example2_zh: 公共机构需要公开透明的招聘程序，以确保公平并维持当地社区的信任。
collocations: transparent glass｜透明玻璃 ; transparent process｜透明的流程 ; transparent excuse｜一眼就能识破的借口
tip_zh: 透明强调看得清；translucent指透光但看不清。

meanings_zh: n. 抚育；家庭教养
definition_en: The way parents care for and teach a child
example1_en: Her upbringing taught her to share with others.
example1_zh: 她从小受到的家庭教育让她懂得与人分享。
example2_en: A supportive upbringing can help children develop confidence and cope more effectively with challenges at school.
example2_zh: 充满支持的家庭养育有助于孩子建立自信，更有效地应对学校里的挑战。
collocations: a strict upbringing｜严格的家庭教育 ; a sheltered upbringing｜备受呵护的成长经历 ; a privileged upbringing｜优越的成长环境
tip_zh: 指童年养育及家庭教育，不等同于学校教育。

meanings_zh: n. 心理学 | n. 心理特点；心理状态
definition_en: The scientific study of the mind and behaviour. | The characteristic ways a person or group thinks and behaves.
example1_en: My sister studies psychology and hopes to help children.
example1_zh: 我姐姐学习心理学，希望将来帮助儿童。
example2_en: Research in psychology suggests that regular social interaction can support emotional wellbeing among older adults.
example2_zh: 心理学研究表明，经常进行社交互动有助于维护老年人的情绪健康。
collocations: clinical psychology｜临床心理学 ; educational psychology｜教育心理学 ; consumer psychology｜消费者心理 ; study psychology｜学习心理学
tip_zh: 开头的p不发音；psychologist指心理学家。

meanings_zh: n. 卡路里；热量单位
definition_en: A unit measuring heat energy or energy supplied by food.
example1_en: I do not count every calory in my lunch.
example1_zh: 我不会计算午餐里的每一卡路里。
example2_en: Although calory intake matters, public health advice should also consider nutritional quality and access to fresh food.
example2_zh: 虽然热量摄入很重要，但公共卫生建议也应考虑营养质量以及新鲜食物的可获得性。
collocations: calory intake｜热量摄入 ; calory content｜热量含量
tip_zh: calory是罕用变体；现代写作请用calorie。

meanings_zh: n. 小标题；分标题
definition_en: a title introducing a section within a longer piece
example1_en: This subheading helps me find the recipe's cooking instructions.
example1_zh: 这个小标题帮我找到了食谱中的烹饪步骤。
example2_en: Each subheading in a research report should clearly indicate the focus of the following section.
example2_zh: 研究报告中的每个小标题都应明确指出其后部分的重点。
collocations: clear subheading｜清晰的小标题 ; descriptive subheading｜说明性小标题 ; add a subheading｜添加小标题
tip_zh: 指文章内部的分标题，不指影视字幕。

meanings_zh: n. 一把；一手之量 | n. 少数；少量 | n. 难管的人；棘手的事物
definition_en: An amount that can be held in one hand. | A small number of people or things. | Someone or something that is difficult to manage.
example1_en: He sprinkled a handful of nuts over his breakfast.
example1_zh: 他在早餐上撒了一把坚果。
example2_en: Only a handful of rural communities have reliable public transport, limiting residents' access to employment and healthcare.
example2_zh: 只有少数农村社区拥有可靠的公共交通，这限制了居民获得就业机会和医疗服务。
collocations: a handful of rice｜一把米 ; a handful of people｜少数人 ; be a handful｜难以管束
tip_zh: a handful of可接不可数名词或复数名词。

meanings_zh: v. 获得；得到 | v. 源于；来自
definition_en: to obtain something from a particular source | to come or develop from something else
example1_en: I derive great pleasure from growing vegetables on my balcony.
example1_zh: 在阳台上种菜让我获得很大的乐趣。
example2_en: Many coastal communities derive a significant proportion of their income from tourism and fishing.
example2_zh: 许多沿海社区的收入有很大一部分来自旅游业和渔业。
collocations: derive pleasure from｜从……获得乐趣 ; derive income from｜从……获得收入 ; derive from｜源于 ; be derived from｜由……衍生而来
tip_zh: derive A from B指从B获得A；derive from指源于。

meanings_zh: adj. 同伴的；同类的 | n. 男子；家伙 | n. 学会会员；学院研究员
definition_en: Sharing a situation, activity, or status with someone | A man or boy, referred to informally | A member of a learned society or certain academic institutions
example1_en: I shared my umbrella with a fellow passenger.
example1_zh: 我和一位同行的乘客共撑了一把伞。
example2_en: Students who regularly exchange ideas with fellow learners often develop greater confidence and stronger communication skills.
example2_zh: 经常与同学交流想法的学生往往能增强自信，提高沟通能力。
collocations: fellow students｜同学 ; fellow passengers｜同行乘客 ; research fellow｜研究员 ; a friendly fellow｜友善的男子
tip_zh: 形容词只放名词前，如my fellow students。

meanings_zh: v. 滴下；滴水 | n. 水滴；滴水声 | n. 静脉滴注
definition_en: To fall or let liquid fall in separate drops. | A small drop of liquid, or the sound it makes. | Equipment that slowly delivers liquid into a patient's vein.
example1_en: Water dripped from my umbrella onto the kitchen floor.
example1_zh: 水从我的伞上滴到了厨房地板上。
example2_en: Leaking pipes can drip continuously, wasting substantial amounts of water in cities with ageing infrastructure.
example2_zh: 漏水的管道可能不断滴水，使基础设施老化的城市浪费大量水资源。
collocations: drip from｜从……滴下 ; a dripping tap｜滴水的水龙头 ; put someone on a drip｜给某人输液
tip_zh: 英式英语用 on a drip 表示正在输液。

meanings_zh: adj. 浅的 | adj. 肤浅的；浅薄的 | adj. 呼吸浅的
definition_en: Having little depth from the surface to the bottom | Lacking serious thought, understanding, or emotional depth | Taking only a small amount of air into the lungs
example1_en: The children splashed happily in the shallow end of the pool.
example1_zh: 孩子们在泳池浅水区开心地戏水。
example2_en: Shallow coastal waters provide important habitats for young fish, making their protection essential for sustainable fisheries.
example2_zh: 浅海沿岸水域为幼鱼提供重要栖息地，因此保护这些水域对渔业的可持续发展至关重要。
collocations: shallow water｜浅水 ; a shallow dish｜浅盘 ; shallow breathing｜浅呼吸 ; a shallow understanding｜肤浅的理解
tip_zh: 水浅或思想肤浅都可用shallow，反义词为deep。

meanings_zh: v. 眨一只眼示意 | n. 眨眼示意
definition_en: to close and open one eye quickly as a signal | a quick closing and opening of one eye as a signal
example1_en: My sister winked at me across the dinner table.
example1_zh: 姐姐隔着餐桌朝我眨了一只眼。
example2_en: A friendly wink may communicate shared understanding, although its meaning can vary considerably across different cultures.
example2_zh: 友善的眨眼可能传达彼此的默契，但其含义在不同文化间可能有很大差异。
collocations: wink at someone｜朝某人眨眼 ; give someone a wink｜向某人眨眼示意 ; not sleep a wink｜一夜没合眼
tip_zh: wink常指单眼示意；blink指自然眨眼。

meanings_zh: v. 吃草；放牧 | v. 擦伤；擦过 | n. 擦伤
definition_en: to eat growing grass, or let animals feed on it | to scrape skin slightly or touch something while passing | a small injury where skin has been scraped off
example1_en: Sheep graze quietly beside the river every summer morning.
example1_zh: 每个夏日清晨，羊群都在河边安静地吃草。
example2_en: Allowing cattle to graze too intensively can damage vegetation and increase the risk of soil erosion.
example2_zh: 让牛群过度放牧会破坏植被，并增加水土流失的风险。
collocations: graze on grass｜吃草 ; graze cattle｜放牛 ; graze your knee｜擦伤膝盖
tip_zh: 动物吃草可说graze on grass；graze cattle指放牛。

meanings_zh: v. 出现；显露 | v. 逐渐形成；崭露头角
definition_en: To become visible or known after being hidden. | To develop or become important and noticeable.
example1_en: A small rabbit emerged from beneath the garden shed.
example1_zh: 一只小兔子从花园棚屋底下钻了出来。
example2_en: New employment opportunities may emerge as governments invest more heavily in renewable energy infrastructure.
example2_zh: 随着政府加大对可再生能源基础设施的投资，新的就业机会可能会出现。
collocations: emerge from｜从……中出现 ; emerge as a leader｜崭露头角成为领导者 ; evidence emerges｜证据浮现
tip_zh: 不及物动词；常用emerge from或emerge as。

meanings_zh: adj. 谦逊的 | adj. 简陋的；地位低微的 | v. 使谦逊；使认识到不足
definition_en: Not believing or acting as though you are better than others. | Simple or low in social position, wealth, or importance. | To make someone feel less proud or important.
example1_en: Despite winning the prize, she remained humble and thanked everyone.
example1_zh: 尽管获了奖，她依然谦逊，并向所有人表示感谢。
example2_en: Effective leaders remain humble enough to acknowledge mistakes and learn from colleagues with different backgrounds and experiences.
example2_zh: 优秀的领导者保持谦逊，愿意承认错误，并向背景和经历不同的同事学习。
collocations: remain humble｜保持谦逊 ; humble origins｜卑微的出身 ; a humble home｜简陋的家 ; in my humble opinion｜依我拙见
tip_zh: 谦逊是humble；不要与“羞辱”humiliate混淆。

meanings_zh: n. 管理；行政工作 | n. 政府；行政管理层 | n. 施用；给予
definition_en: The work of organising and running an institution or business. | The people responsible for managing a government or organisation. | The act of giving medicine or treatment to someone.
example1_en: She handles the administration for our local sports club.
example1_zh: 她负责我们当地体育俱乐部的行政工作。
example2_en: Efficient administration allows public hospitals to allocate resources fairly and respond more quickly to patients' needs.
example2_zh: 高效的行政管理使公立医院能够公平分配资源，更快地回应患者需求。
collocations: public administration｜公共行政 ; business administration｜工商管理 ; school administration｜学校行政管理 ; administration of medication｜给药
tip_zh: 指管理工作时通常不可数；指一届政府时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 酒精依赖；酒瘾
definition_en: a condition involving dependence on alcohol and difficulty controlling drinking
example1_en: The clinic offers confidential support for people with alcoholism.
example1_zh: 这家诊所为有酒精依赖问题的人提供保密的支持服务。
example2_en: Effective treatment for alcoholism often combines medical care, psychological support, and help from family members.
example2_zh: 有效治疗酒精依赖通常需要结合医疗护理、心理支持和家人的帮助。
collocations: treatment for alcoholism｜酒精依赖的治疗 ; recover from alcoholism｜从酒精依赖中康复 ; chronic alcoholism｜慢性酒精依赖
tip_zh: 指酒精依赖这一疾病，不指嗜酒的人。

meanings_zh: adj. 满怀希望的 | adj. 有希望的；有望成功的 | n. 有望成功的人；竞争者
definition_en: feeling that something good is likely to happen | suggesting that a good result is likely | someone hoping to succeed in a competition or particular career
example1_en: She felt hopeful after her first successful driving lesson.
example1_zh: 第一次驾驶课上得很顺利，她感到充满希望。
example2_en: Scientists remain hopeful that improved battery technology will make renewable energy more reliable and affordable.
example2_zh: 科学家仍抱有希望，认为电池技术的改进将使可再生能源更加可靠且价格更亲民。
collocations: hopeful about the future｜对未来充满希望 ; hopeful that｜希望…… ; a hopeful sign｜令人看到希望的迹象
tip_zh: 人满怀希望用hopeful；事物有前景常用promising。

meanings_zh: n. 单簧管；黑管
definition_en: A woodwind instrument with a single reed and finger-operated keys.
example1_en: My sister practises the clarinet quietly after dinner.
example1_zh: 我姐姐晚饭后轻声练习单簧管。
example2_en: Learning to play the clarinet can help children develop concentration while encouraging participation in school orchestras.
example2_zh: 学习吹奏单簧管能帮助儿童培养专注力，同时鼓励他们参加学校管弦乐团。
collocations: play the clarinet｜吹单簧管 ; a clarinet solo｜单簧管独奏 ; a clarinet player｜单簧管演奏者
tip_zh: 演奏乐器通常说play the clarinet，注意加the。

meanings_zh: n. 鸽子 | n. 主和派人士
definition_en: a bird often associated with peace | someone who favours peaceful solutions rather than military action
example1_en: A white dove landed gently on our garden wall.
example1_zh: 一只白鸽轻轻落在我们花园的围墙上。
example2_en: Political doves argue that international disputes should be resolved through negotiation rather than military intervention.
example2_zh: 政治上的主和派认为，国际争端应通过谈判而非军事干预解决。
collocations: a white dove｜白鸽 ; a symbol of peace｜和平的象征 ; a political dove｜政治上的主和派人士
tip_zh: 指主和派时，与主张强硬手段的hawk相对。

meanings_zh: adj. 有意义的；令人满足的 | adj. 回报丰厚的
definition_en: giving satisfaction or a sense of achievement | providing substantial financial benefits
example1_en: Teaching my little cousin to swim was surprisingly rewarding.
example1_zh: 教我的小表弟游泳，出乎意料地让我很有成就感。
example2_en: Volunteering can be a rewarding experience that develops practical skills and strengthens connections within local communities.
example2_zh: 志愿服务可以是一段有意义的经历，既能培养实用技能，也能加强当地社区内部的联系。
collocations: rewarding experience｜有意义的经历 ; rewarding career｜有成就感的职业 ; financially rewarding｜经济回报丰厚的
tip_zh: 多指带来满足感；强调赚钱可加financially。

meanings_zh: v. 禁止；不准
definition_en: To order someone not to do something or disallow it
example1_en: Our building rules forbid leaving bicycles in the hallway.
example1_zh: 我们楼的规定禁止将自行车停放在走廊里。
example2_en: Governments should forbid companies from releasing untreated waste into rivers to protect public health and aquatic ecosystems.
example2_zh: 政府应禁止企业将未经处理的废弃物排入河流，以保护公众健康和水生生态系统。
collocations: forbid someone to do something｜禁止某人做某事 ; forbid someone from doing something｜禁止某人做某事 ; strictly forbidden｜严禁的
tip_zh: 过去式forbade，过去分词forbidden；可接动名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 更好的；更优质的 | n. 上级；上司 | adj. 自以为优越的；高傲的
definition_en: Better in quality or performance than another | Someone with a higher position or rank than you | Behaving as though you are better than other people
example1_en: These boots offer superior grip on wet paths.
example1_zh: 这双靴子在湿滑小路上的防滑性能更好。
example2_en: Public transport can provide a superior alternative to private cars when services are frequent and reliable.
example2_zh: 当班次密集且服务可靠时，公共交通可以成为比私家车更好的出行选择。
collocations: superior quality｜更优的质量 ; superior to｜优于 ; immediate superior｜直属上司 ; a superior attitude｜高傲的态度
tip_zh: 比较时用superior to，不用superior than。

meanings_zh: n. 惊讶；震惊
definition_en: a feeling of very great surprise
example1_en: He stared in astonishment as the tiny seedling flowered.
example1_zh: 看到小小的幼苗开花了，他惊讶地瞪大了眼睛。
example2_en: The speed of technological change often causes astonishment, particularly among people who remember life before widespread internet access.
example2_zh: 技术变革的速度常令人惊叹，尤其是那些还记得互联网普及前生活的人。
collocations: in astonishment｜惊讶地 ; to someone's astonishment｜令某人惊讶的是 ; express astonishment｜表示惊讶
tip_zh: 通常不可数；to one's astonishment表示令某人惊讶的是。

meanings_zh: n. 泄漏；漏处 | v. 漏出；泄漏 | v. 泄露秘密
definition_en: An escape of liquid or gas, or an opening allowing it. | To let liquid or gas escape through a hole or crack. | To reveal private information without permission.
example1_en: A leak under the sink soaked all our cleaning cloths.
example1_zh: 水槽下方的漏水把我们所有的清洁布都浸湿了。
example2_en: Water companies should repair leaks promptly to conserve resources and reduce unnecessary pressure on local supplies.
example2_zh: 供水公司应及时修复漏水处，以节约资源并减轻当地供水的不必要压力。
collocations: a gas leak｜燃气泄漏 ; repair a leak｜修复漏处 ; leak confidential information｜泄露机密信息 ; a leaking pipe｜漏水的管道
tip_zh: leak 可作名词或动词，也可指秘密信息泄露。

meanings_zh: n. 修改；改进
definition_en: A change made to improve something or suit a purpose.
example1_en: This small modification makes the chair much more comfortable.
example1_zh: 这处小改动让椅子舒服多了。
example2_en: Modification of existing buildings can reduce energy consumption without the environmental costs of new construction.
example2_zh: 改造现有建筑可以降低能耗，同时避免新建工程带来的环境代价。
collocations: make a modification｜作出修改 ; minor modification｜小幅修改 ; genetic modification｜基因改造
tip_zh: 可数时指具体改动，不可数时指修改过程。

meanings_zh: n. 拍卖 | v. 拍卖出售
definition_en: a sale where an item goes to the highest bidder | to sell something to the person offering the most money
example1_en: My aunt bought this old clock at an auction.
example1_zh: 我姑姑在一次拍卖会上买下了这座旧钟。
example2_en: Charities often auction donated artwork to raise funds for educational programmes in communities with limited resources.
example2_zh: 慈善机构常拍卖获捐的艺术品，为资源匮乏社区的教育项目筹款。
collocations: at auction｜通过拍卖 ; hold an auction｜举行拍卖 ; auction off｜拍卖掉 ; online auction｜网上拍卖
tip_zh: at auction可不加冠词；auction off表示拍卖掉。

meanings_zh: n. 刀片；刀身 | n. 桨叶；叶片 | n. 草叶
definition_en: The flat cutting part of a knife or tool. | A flat part that rotates to move air or water. | A long narrow leaf of grass.
example1_en: The knife's blade was too blunt to slice tomatoes.
example1_zh: 这把刀的刀刃太钝，切不动番茄。
example2_en: Each blade of a wind turbine is designed to capture energy efficiently from moving air.
example2_zh: 风力涡轮机的每片叶片都经过专门设计，以高效获取流动空气中的能量。
collocations: a sharp blade｜锋利的刀刃 ; a razor blade｜剃须刀片 ; a turbine blade｜涡轮叶片 ; a blade of grass｜一片草叶
tip_zh: blade指刀的切割部分，knife指整把刀。

meanings_zh: adj. 固执的；顽固的 | adj. 难以去除或解决的
definition_en: Unwilling to change your opinion or behaviour. | Difficult to remove, treat, or deal with.
example1_en: My stubborn brother refused to wear a coat outside.
example1_zh: 我那固执的弟弟不肯穿外套出门。
example2_en: Stubborn resistance to change can prevent organisations from adopting more efficient and environmentally responsible practices.
example2_zh: 顽固地抵制变革可能使机构无法采用更高效、更环保的做法。
collocations: stubborn refusal｜坚决拒绝 ; stubborn resistance｜顽固抵抗 ; stubborn stain｜顽渍
tip_zh: 形容人多含贬义；也可形容顽渍或难治的病。

meanings_zh: n. 盔甲；装甲 | n. 装甲车辆；装甲部队
definition_en: Strong protective covering worn in battle or fitted to vehicles. | Military vehicles with protective covering, considered as a group.
example1_en: The museum displayed a knight's armour beside a wooden shield.
example1_zh: 博物馆在一面木盾旁展出了一套骑士盔甲。
example2_en: Surviving examples of medieval armour reveal how metalworking skills developed in response to changing military needs.
example2_zh: 现存的中世纪盔甲展示了金属加工技术如何随着军事需求的变化而发展。
collocations: a suit of armour｜一套盔甲 ; body armour｜防护甲 ; heavy armour｜重型装甲
tip_zh: 英式armour，美式armor；通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 美元；块钱 | n. 雄鹿；雄兔 | v. 尥蹶子；弓背跳跃
definition_en: An informal word for a dollar. | A male deer, rabbit, or certain other animals. | For a horse to jump with its back arched.
example1_en: I bought this warm scarf for just five bucks.
example1_zh: 我只花了五美元就买到了这条暖和的围巾。
example2_en: Although shoppers may save a few bucks online, local retailers often provide more personalised advice and support.
example2_zh: 虽然网上购物可能让顾客省下几美元，但本地零售商往往提供更贴心的建议和帮助。
collocations: a few bucks｜几美元 ; make a quick buck｜快速捞钱 ; pass the buck｜推卸责任 ; buck the trend｜逆势而行
tip_zh: 表示美元时属口语；pass the buck意为推卸责任。

meanings_zh: n. 酷刑；折磨 | v. 拷打；使受折磨
definition_en: deliberately inflicted severe pain, or an extremely distressing experience | to deliberately cause severe physical or mental suffering
example1_en: Waiting all afternoon for the results was pure torture.
example1_zh: 整个下午都在等结果，真是煎熬。
example2_en: International agreements prohibit torture and require governments to protect the basic rights of all prisoners.
example2_zh: 国际协议禁止酷刑，并要求各国政府保护所有囚犯的基本权利。
collocations: psychological torture｜精神折磨 ; pure torture｜十足的煎熬 ; prohibit torture｜禁止酷刑 ; subject someone to torture｜使某人遭受酷刑
tip_zh: 语气很强；日常可夸张表达煎熬，不只是普通不适。

meanings_zh: adj. 足够的；充分的
definition_en: enough to meet a need or achieve a purpose
example1_en: We have sufficient food for everyone at the picnic.
example1_zh: 我们准备了足够的食物，供参加野餐的每个人享用。
example2_en: Without sufficient funding, local authorities may struggle to maintain essential services for their growing populations.
example2_zh: 如果资金不足，地方政府可能难以为不断增长的人口维持基本服务。
collocations: sufficient evidence｜充分的证据 ; sufficient funds｜充足的资金 ; sufficient time｜足够的时间 ; sufficient for｜足以满足
tip_zh: 常用sufficient for或sufficient to do，语气较正式。

meanings_zh: n. 胶囊 | n. 太空舱；密闭小舱
definition_en: a small soluble case containing medicine that you swallow | a small enclosed compartment carrying people or equipment in space
example1_en: The pharmacist told me to swallow the capsule with water.
example1_zh: 药剂师告诉我要用水吞服这粒胶囊。
example2_en: The space capsule was designed to protect its crew from extreme temperatures during their return to Earth.
example2_zh: 这艘太空舱的设计旨在保护乘员，使其返回地球时免受极端高温的伤害。
collocations: swallow a capsule｜吞服胶囊 ; space capsule｜太空舱 ; time capsule｜时间胶囊
tip_zh: 药物capsule有外壳；tablet通常是压制成的药片。

meanings_zh: n. 理解；理解力
definition_en: The ability to understand something, especially language or ideas.
example1_en: Drawing a simple diagram helped my comprehension of the instructions.
example1_zh: 画一张简单的图帮助我理解了操作说明。
example2_en: Regular exposure to varied reading materials can improve students' comprehension and expand their academic vocabulary.
example2_zh: 经常接触多样的阅读材料可以提高学生的理解力，并扩充其学术词汇。
collocations: reading comprehension｜阅读理解 ; listening comprehension｜听力理解 ; beyond comprehension｜无法理解
tip_zh: 通常不可数；comprehensive意为“全面的”。

meanings_zh: n. 口号；标语
definition_en: a short memorable phrase promoting an idea, group, or product
example1_en: Our club chose a catchy slogan for its recycling campaign.
example1_zh: 我们社团为回收利用活动选了一句朗朗上口的口号。
example2_en: An effective environmental slogan can attract attention, but lasting behavioural change usually requires practical support.
example2_zh: 有效的环保口号能够吸引注意，但持久的行为改变通常需要实际支持。
collocations: catchy slogan｜朗朗上口的口号 ; advertising slogan｜广告语 ; campaign slogan｜宣传活动口号 ; chant slogans｜反复高呼口号
tip_zh: slogan用于宣传；motto多指座右铭或行为准则。

meanings_zh: adj. 贪婪的；贪心的 | adj. 贪吃的
definition_en: wanting more money or possessions than one needs | wanting to eat more food than one needs
example1_en: Don't be greedy; leave some biscuits for your sister.
example1_zh: 别贪吃，给你妹妹留些饼干。
example2_en: Greedy investors may prioritise immediate profits over the long-term environmental consequences of their business decisions.
example2_zh: 贪婪的投资者可能优先考虑眼前利润，而忽视商业决策的长期环境后果。
collocations: greedy for money｜贪财的 ; greedy for power｜贪恋权力的 ; a greedy investor｜贪婪的投资者
tip_zh: 常含贬义；greedy for后接金钱、权力等所贪之物。

meanings_zh: n. 住宅；住所 | n. 居住；居留
definition_en: A house or other place where someone lives. | The state or period of living in a particular place.
example1_en: Their new residence overlooks a quiet garden near the river.
example1_zh: 他们的新居俯瞰着河边一座安静的花园。
example2_en: Applicants may need to provide proof of residence before they can access certain local services.
example2_zh: 申请人可能需要提供居住证明，才能使用某些地方服务。
collocations: place of residence｜居住地 ; proof of residence｜居住证明 ; permanent residence｜永久居留 ; take up residence｜定居；入住
tip_zh: residence较正式；居民是resident，住宅区用residential。

meanings_zh: n. 舞厅
definition_en: A large room used for formal social dancing
example1_en: Couples glided across the ballroom beneath a sparkling chandelier.
example1_zh: 一对对舞伴在闪亮的枝形吊灯下滑过舞厅。
example2_en: Restoring the historic ballroom could attract visitors while providing local residents with a valuable space for cultural events.
example2_zh: 修复这座历史悠久的舞厅可以吸引游客，同时为当地居民提供宝贵的文化活动场所。
collocations: ballroom dancing｜交谊舞 ; a hotel ballroom｜酒店舞厅 ; a grand ballroom｜豪华大舞厅
tip_zh: ballroom dancing 指交谊舞，不是夜店蹦迪。

meanings_zh: adj. 有遮阴的；背阴的 | adj. 涂有阴影的
definition_en: Protected from direct sunlight. | Made darker with colour or drawn marks.
example1_en: We found a shaded bench beneath an old tree.
example1_zh: 我们在一棵老树下找到了一张背阴的长椅。
example2_en: Providing shaded areas in public parks encourages outdoor activity during hot weather and reduces heat exposure.
example2_zh: 在公园提供遮阴区域，有助于鼓励人们在炎热天气进行户外活动，并减少高温暴露。
collocations: shaded area｜遮阴区域；阴影区域 ; shaded path｜林荫小路 ; shaded seating｜有遮阴的座位区
tip_zh: 也可作shade的过去式或过去分词，表示遮挡阳光。

meanings_zh: n. 大袋；麻袋 | v. 解雇 | n. 解雇
definition_en: A large, strong bag used for storing or carrying things. | To dismiss someone from their job. | Dismissal from a job, used in the phrase the sack.
example1_en: We carried a heavy sack of potatoes into the kitchen.
example1_zh: 我们把一大袋沉甸甸的土豆搬进厨房。
example2_en: Employers should not sack workers without explaining the reasons and allowing them to challenge the decision.
example2_zh: 雇主不应在未说明理由、未允许员工提出异议的情况下解雇他们。
collocations: a sack of potatoes｜一大袋土豆 ; get the sack｜被解雇 ; sack someone for misconduct｜因行为不当解雇某人
tip_zh: 表示解雇时常用于英式口语；正式用dismiss。

meanings_zh: n. 灵魂；心灵 | n. 人 | n. 灵魂乐
definition_en: The spiritual part of a person, separate from the body. | A person, especially when describing their character. | Expressive popular music combining gospel and rhythm and blues.
example1_en: Walking beside the sea always seems to soothe my soul.
example1_zh: 在海边散步似乎总能抚慰我的心灵。
example2_en: Many cultural traditions view the soul as something that continues to exist after the body dies.
example2_zh: 许多文化传统认为，灵魂在肉体死亡后仍然存在。
collocations: heart and soul｜全心全意 ; a kind soul｜心地善良的人 ; not a soul｜一个人也没有 ; soul music｜灵魂乐
tip_zh: not a soul意为一个人也没有，不是没有灵魂。

meanings_zh: n. 晶体；结晶 | n. 水晶 | n. 水晶玻璃；水晶玻璃制品
definition_en: A solid whose particles form a regular, repeating pattern. | Clear quartz used in jewellery and decorative objects. | High-quality glass, or objects made from it.
example1_en: We examined a salt crystal under the classroom microscope.
example1_zh: 我们用教室里的显微镜观察了一颗盐晶体。
example2_en: The structure of a crystal influences its physical properties and determines its suitability for various industrial applications.
example2_zh: 晶体结构影响其物理性质，并决定它是否适合各种工业用途。
collocations: salt crystals｜盐晶体 ; crystal structure｜晶体结构 ; crystal glass｜水晶玻璃 ; crystal clear｜清澈透明的；十分清楚的
tip_zh: crystal clear既可形容水清澈，也可表示意思十分清楚。

meanings_zh: v. 选举；推选 | v. 选择；决定
definition_en: to choose someone for a position by voting | to choose to do something
example1_en: Our club elected a new captain last night.
example1_zh: 我们俱乐部昨晚选出了一位新队长。
example2_en: Citizens should elect representatives who are willing to address long-term environmental challenges rather than seek immediate popularity.
example2_zh: 公民应当选举愿意应对长期环境挑战的代表，而不是追求眼前人气的人。
collocations: elect a president｜选举总统 ; elect someone to office｜选举某人任职 ; elect to do something｜选择做某事
tip_zh: elect sb chair 中职务前常不加冠词。

meanings_zh: adj. 丰富的；充裕的
definition_en: Available in large amounts, often more than needed.
example1_en: Fresh fruit is abundant here during the summer.
example1_zh: 这里夏天有充足的新鲜水果。
example2_en: Regions with abundant sunlight have considerable potential to generate affordable electricity from solar energy.
example2_zh: 阳光充足的地区具有利用太阳能生产廉价电力的巨大潜力。
collocations: abundant resources｜丰富的资源 ; abundant evidence｜充分的证据 ; abundant wildlife｜丰富的野生动植物
tip_zh: abundant强调数量充足；名词搭配an abundance of。

meanings_zh: prep. 在……下面 | prep. 有失身份；不值得 | adv. 在下方
definition_en: In or to a position directly below something. | Considered too low in status or value for someone. | In or to a lower position.
example1_en: Our cat slept beneath the table during dinner.
example1_zh: 我们吃晚饭时，猫在桌子下面睡觉。
example2_en: Beneath the city's busy streets, an extensive railway network allows residents to travel efficiently.
example2_zh: 在这座城市繁忙的街道下，庞大的铁路网络让居民能够高效出行。
collocations: beneath the surface｜在表面之下 ; beneath your dignity｜有失身份 ; beneath the waves｜在海浪之下
tip_zh: 比under更正式；beneath也可表示有失身份。

meanings_zh: v. 使超载；使负担过重 | v. 使电路过载
definition_en: To put more weight or work on something than manageable. | To make an electrical circuit carry more current than safe.
example1_en: Don't overload your backpack with things you won't use.
example1_zh: 别把用不上的东西塞进背包，让它变得太重。
example2_en: Schools should avoid overloading students with homework, as excessive pressure can undermine motivation and wellbeing.
example2_zh: 学校应避免让学生承担过重的作业负担，因为过度的压力会削弱学习动力并损害身心健康。
collocations: overload a vehicle｜使车辆超载 ; overload someone with work｜给某人过多工作 ; overload a circuit｜使电路过载
tip_zh: 常用overload someone with something。

meanings_zh: v. 忍受；承受；承担 | n. 熊 | v. 带有；具有
definition_en: to tolerate something unpleasant or carry a heavy responsibility | a large, heavily built mammal with thick fur | to have or display a particular feature or mark
example1_en: I can't bear the noise of that old fan.
example1_zh: 我受不了那台旧风扇的噪声。
example2_en: Low-income households often bear the greatest burden when the cost of essential goods rises.
example2_zh: 生活必需品价格上涨时，低收入家庭往往承受最沉重的负担。
collocations: can't bear｜无法忍受 ; bear responsibility｜承担责任 ; bear in mind｜牢记 ; bear a resemblance to｜与……相似
tip_zh: 过去式bore；过去分词通常borne；出生用born。

meanings_zh: adj. 谦虚的；不自夸的 | adj. 适度的；不大的 | adj. 穿着端庄的
definition_en: not boasting about your abilities or achievements | not large in size, amount, or cost | wearing clothes that do not reveal much of the body
example1_en: Despite winning the race, she remained modest about her success.
example1_zh: 尽管赢了比赛，她谈起自己的成功时仍很谦虚。
example2_en: Even a modest increase in public transport funding could improve services in rural communities.
example2_zh: 即使公共交通拨款只小幅增加，也可能改善农村社区的服务。
collocations: modest about one's achievements｜对自己的成就谦虚 ; a modest increase｜小幅增长 ; a modest income｜不高的收入
tip_zh: 形容人常指谦虚；形容数量常指不大。

meanings_zh: v. 使启动；使激活 | adj. 活化的；经活性处理的
definition_en: Made a device or process start working. | Treated to increase chemical activity or ability to absorb substances.
example1_en: The moving cat activated the light above our door.
example1_zh: 那只走动的猫触发了我们门上的感应灯。
example2_en: The emergency warning system was activated immediately after sensors detected unusual movement beneath the ocean.
example2_zh: 传感器检测到海底异常运动后，紧急预警系统立即启动。
collocations: activated carbon｜活性炭 ; activated charcoal｜活性炭 ; voice-activated device｜声控设备
tip_zh: 是activate的过去式和过去分词；不表示性格活泼。

meanings_zh: n. 风景；地貌 | n. 局面；格局 | v. 对……进行景观美化
definition_en: The visible features of an area of land. | The overall conditions and features of a particular field. | To improve land by arranging plants and other outdoor features.
example1_en: Snow covered the landscape beyond our small wooden cabin.
example1_zh: 白雪覆盖了我们小木屋外的山野。
example2_en: Large wind farms can alter the rural landscape, although they provide an important source of clean energy.
example2_zh: 大型风电场虽然是重要的清洁能源来源，却可能改变乡村景观。
collocations: rural landscape｜乡村景观 ; natural landscape｜自然景观 ; political landscape｜政治格局 ; landscape design｜景观设计
tip_zh: landscape可数，指一片景观；scenery通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 录像带 | v. 用录像带录制
definition_en: Magnetic tape used to record moving images and sound. | To record moving images and sound onto magnetic tape.
example1_en: We found an old videotape of our family picnic.
example1_zh: 我们找到了一盘记录家庭野餐的旧录像带。
example2_en: Libraries can preserve recordings stored on videotape by converting them into digital formats for future generations.
example2_zh: 图书馆可以将录像带上的影像转成数字格式，为后代保存这些记录。
collocations: an old videotape｜一盘旧录像带 ; on videotape｜以录像带形式 ; videotape a performance｜用录像带录制演出
tip_zh: 指磁带录像；现代数字录像通常用video或record。

meanings_zh: n. 居住船；船屋
definition_en: A boat designed or adapted for people to live in.
example1_en: We spent the weekend on a houseboat beside the riverbank.
example1_zh: 我们在河岸边的一艘船屋上度过了周末。
example2_en: Living on a houseboat may offer affordable accommodation, although maintenance costs and mooring fees can be substantial.
example2_zh: 住在船屋上或许能降低居住开支，但维护成本和停泊费可能相当高。
collocations: live on a houseboat｜住在船屋上 ; rent a houseboat｜租一艘居住船 ; houseboat holiday｜船屋度假
tip_zh: 指供人居住的船，不等于用于娱乐的游艇。

meanings_zh: n. 轻便摩托车
definition_en: A small motorcycle with a low-powered engine, sometimes with pedals
example1_en: She parked her moped beside the bakery this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上，她把轻便摩托车停在面包店旁边。
example2_en: A moped can offer affordable transport for short journeys, although riders remain vulnerable on busy urban roads.
example2_zh: 轻便摩托车可以为短途出行提供经济的交通方式，不过骑行者在繁忙的城市道路上仍易受伤害。
