example2_en: Although student feedback is valuable, subjective opinions should not be the sole basis for evaluating teaching quality.
example2_zh: 虽然学生反馈很有价值，但主观意见不应成为评估教学质量的唯一依据。
collocations: subjective judgement｜主观判断 ; subjective experience｜主观体验 ; highly subjective｜非常主观的
tip_zh: subjective强调个人感受；objective强调客观事实。

meanings_zh: n. 不可能性；不可能的事
definition_en: the state of being impossible, or something that cannot happen
example1_en: Carrying this sofa upstairs alone is an impossibility.
example1_zh: 独自把这张沙发搬上楼是不可能的。
example2_en: The impossibility of predicting every natural disaster highlights the importance of resilient infrastructure and emergency planning.
example2_zh: 无法预测每一次自然灾害，这凸显了韧性基础设施和应急规划的重要性。
collocations: a practical impossibility｜实际上不可能的事 ; a physical impossibility｜客观条件下不可能的事 ; the impossibility of doing something｜做某事的不可能性
tip_zh: 指不可能性时不可数；指一件不可能的事时可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 闲置的；未运转的 | adj. 懒散的；无所事事的 | v. 发动机空转
definition_en: Not being used or doing any work. | Avoiding work or spending time doing nothing. | For an engine to run while the vehicle remains still.
example1_en: The sewing machine has sat idle since last winter.
example1_zh: 这台缝纫机从去年冬天起就一直闲置着。
example2_en: Leaving delivery vehicles idling outside schools contributes to air pollution and exposes children to unnecessary health risks.
example2_zh: 让送货车辆在学校外空转会加重空气污染，使儿童面临不必要的健康风险。
collocations: stand idle｜闲置着 ; idle machinery｜闲置的机器 ; an idling engine｜空转的发动机 ; idle gossip｜无聊的闲言碎语
tip_zh: idle可指人闲着、设备闲置，也可指发动机空转。

meanings_zh: n. 机构；院校 | n. 制度；惯例
definition_en: An established organisation serving an educational, financial, or public purpose. | An established custom or system within a society.
example1_en: My sister works at a respected institution near home.
example1_zh: 我姐姐在家附近一家备受尊重的机构工作。
example2_en: Every educational institution should provide accessible facilities and appropriate support for students with disabilities.
example2_zh: 每所教育机构都应提供无障碍设施，并为残障学生提供适当支持。
collocations: educational institution｜教育机构 ; financial institution｜金融机构 ; the institution of marriage｜婚姻制度
tip_zh: 可指具体机构，也可指婚姻等社会制度。

meanings_zh: n. 洗脸盆；盆 | n. 流域 | n. 盆地
definition_en: A wide, open container for water or washing. | The land drained by a river and its smaller rivers. | A broad area of low land surrounded by higher ground.
example1_en: She filled the basin with water to wash her face.
example1_zh: 她往盆里倒满水，准备洗脸。
example2_en: Agricultural expansion across the river basin has increased pressure on freshwater supplies and damaged natural habitats.
example2_zh: 整个流域内的农业扩张加大了淡水供应压力，并破坏了自然栖息地。
collocations: wash basin｜洗脸盆 ; river basin｜河流流域 ; drainage basin｜集水区
tip_zh: river basin指整个流域，不只是河道。

meanings_zh: adj. 垂直的；竖直的 | n. 垂直线；竖直位置
definition_en: pointing straight up or down, perpendicular to a horizontal surface | a vertical line, direction, or position
example1_en: The curtains have vertical stripes that make the room look taller.
example1_zh: 窗帘上的竖条纹让房间显得更高。
example2_en: Vertical farming could help cities produce fresh vegetables locally while using less land than conventional agricultural methods.
example2_zh: 垂直农业可以帮助城市就地生产新鲜蔬菜，同时比传统农业方式占用更少的土地。
collocations: a vertical line｜垂直线 ; vertical stripes｜竖条纹 ; vertical farming｜垂直农业 ; a vertical axis｜纵轴
tip_zh: vertical指竖直方向；horizontal指水平方向。

meanings_zh: adv. 向东；朝东 | adj. 向东的；朝东的
definition_en: Towards the east. | Moving, facing, or directed towards the east.
example1_en: We drove eastward until the morning sun warmed our faces.
example1_zh: 我们开车向东行驶，直到晨光暖暖地照在脸上。
example2_en: The city's eastward expansion has increased demand for public transport and placed pressure on surrounding farmland.
example2_zh: 这座城市向东扩张，增加了公共交通需求，也给周边农田带来了压力。
collocations: move eastward｜向东移动 ; travel eastward｜向东行进 ; eastward expansion｜向东扩张
tip_zh: eastwards也可作副词；作形容词用eastward。

meanings_zh: n. 商业；贸易
definition_en: The activity of buying and selling goods and services.
example1_en: The new bridge has brought more commerce to town.
example1_zh: 这座新桥给镇上带来了更多商贸活动。
example2_en: Online commerce enables small businesses to reach international customers without opening physical shops abroad.
example2_zh: 网上贸易让小企业无需在海外开设实体店，也能接触国际客户。
collocations: international commerce｜国际贸易 ; electronic commerce｜电子商务 ; chamber of commerce｜商会
tip_zh: commerce通常不可数，侧重商品和服务的买卖活动。

meanings_zh: v. 任命；委派 | v. 指定；约定
definition_en: to officially choose someone for a job or responsibility | to officially decide a time or place for something
example1_en: The club appointed my sister as its new captain.
example1_zh: 俱乐部任命我姐姐为新队长。
example2_en: Schools should appoint qualified counsellors to help students manage stress and make informed career choices.
example2_zh: 学校应聘任合格的辅导员，帮助学生应对压力并作出明智的职业选择。
collocations: appoint someone as｜任命某人为 ; appoint a committee｜任命委员会成员 ; at the appointed time｜在约定的时间
tip_zh: 任命某人可用appoint sb as或appoint sb to职位。

meanings_zh: adj. 视听的
definition_en: Using both sound and images to communicate information
example1_en: We tested the audio-visual equipment before the film started.
example1_zh: 电影开始前，我们测试了视听设备。
example2_en: Audio-visual materials can support language learning by connecting spoken words with meaningful images and situations.
example2_zh: 视听材料将口语词句与有意义的图像和情境联系起来，有助于语言学习。
collocations: audio-visual equipment｜视听设备 ; audio-visual aids｜视听教具 ; audio-visual materials｜视听材料
tip_zh: 也写作audiovisual，常缩写为AV。

meanings_zh: v. 忽略；未注意到 | v. 俯瞰；面向 | v. 宽容；不追究
definition_en: To fail to notice or consider something. | To have a view of somewhere from above. | To deliberately ignore a mistake or fault.
example1_en: I overlooked a small crack in the bowl.
example1_zh: 我没注意到碗上有一道小裂纹。
example2_en: Urban planners sometimes overlook the needs of older residents when designing new public transport systems.
example2_zh: 城市规划者在设计新的公共交通系统时，有时会忽略老年居民的需求。
collocations: overlook a detail｜忽略细节 ; overlook the fact that｜忽略这一事实 ; overlook the sea｜俯瞰大海 ; overlook a mistake｜不追究错误
tip_zh: overlook可指忽略或俯瞰；不要与监督的oversee混淆。

meanings_zh: v. 使精疲力竭 | v. 耗尽；用完 | n. 废气；排气管
definition_en: To make someone extremely tired. | To use all of something, leaving none remaining. | Waste gases from an engine, or the pipe releasing them.
example1_en: Carrying those heavy boxes upstairs completely exhausted me.
example1_zh: 把那些沉重的箱子搬上楼让我筋疲力尽。
example2_en: Intensive farming can exhaust soil nutrients, reducing agricultural productivity and increasing dependence on artificial fertilisers.
example2_zh: 集约化耕作可能耗尽土壤养分，降低农业生产力，并增加对化肥的依赖。
collocations: exhaust natural resources｜耗尽自然资源 ; exhaust all possibilities｜尝试所有可能的办法 ; exhaust fumes｜废气 ; an exhaust pipe｜排气管
tip_zh: exhausted 指人累极了；exhausting 指事物令人疲惫。

meanings_zh: n. 目录；商品目录册 | v. 编入目录；分类记录 | n. 一连串坏事
definition_en: An organised list of items, often with descriptions or pictures | Make an organised record of items and their details | A series of unpleasant events or failures
example1_en: I found the perfect desk in a furniture catalogue.
example1_zh: 我在一本家具目录册里找到了理想的书桌。
example2_en: A digital catalogue enables researchers to locate historical documents without visiting the archive in person.
example2_zh: 数字目录让研究人员无须亲自前往档案馆就能查找历史文献。
collocations: library catalogue｜图书馆目录 ; product catalogue｜产品目录 ; catalogue a collection｜为藏品编目 ; a catalogue of errors｜一连串错误
tip_zh: 英式拼写catalogue；美式常写catalog。

meanings_zh: adj. 幼稚的；不成熟的 | adj. 孩子的；孩子气的
definition_en: Behaving immaturely in a way unsuitable for an adult. | Typical of or connected with children.
example1_en: Hiding my shoes was a childish thing to do.
example1_zh: 把我的鞋藏起来，这种做法很幼稚。
example2_en: Dismissing young people's concerns as childish can discourage them from participating in discussions about their communities.
example2_zh: 将年轻人的关切斥为幼稚，可能会使他们不愿参与有关社区事务的讨论。
collocations: childish behaviour｜幼稚的行为 ; childish argument｜幼稚的争论 ; childish delight｜孩子般的喜悦
tip_zh: childish 常含贬义；childlike 多指天真无邪。

meanings_zh: n. 树篱 | n. 防范损失的手段 | v. 回避明确表态；含糊其辞
definition_en: a row of closely planted bushes forming a boundary | something that reduces the risk of financial loss | to avoid giving a clear or definite answer
example1_en: A thick hedge separates our garden from the pavement.
example1_zh: 一道茂密的树篱将我们的花园与人行道隔开。
example2_en: Some investors purchase gold as a hedge against inflation, although its value can also fluctuate.
example2_zh: 一些投资者购买黄金以防范通货膨胀，尽管黄金的价值也可能波动。
collocations: trim a hedge｜修剪树篱 ; a hedge against inflation｜对冲通胀的手段 ; hedge your bets｜多方下注以分散风险
tip_zh: 金融义常用 a hedge against，表示防范某种风险。

meanings_zh: n. 扒手
definition_en: Someone who steals from people's pockets or bags in public.
example1_en: A pickpocket took her wallet on the crowded bus.
example1_zh: 一名扒手在拥挤的公交车上偷走了她的钱包。
example2_en: Tourists can reduce their risk of encountering pickpockets by keeping valuables secure in crowded public spaces.
example2_zh: 游客在人群密集的公共场所妥善保管贵重物品，可以降低遭扒窃的风险。
collocations: watch out for pickpockets｜提防扒手 ; a gang of pickpockets｜一伙扒手 ; catch a pickpocket｜抓住扒手
tip_zh: 特指从衣袋或随身包里偷东西的人，比thief具体。

meanings_zh: n. 市郊；城镇边缘
definition_en: the areas around the outer edge of a town or city
example1_en: Their new house is on the outskirts of town.
example1_zh: 他们的新房子在镇子边上。
example2_en: Building affordable homes on the outskirts may reduce housing costs but increase residents' dependence on private cars.
example2_zh: 在市郊建设可负担住房可能降低住房成本，却会增加居民对私家车的依赖。
collocations: on the outskirts of｜在……的边缘地带 ; the outskirts of town｜城镇郊区 ; the northern outskirts｜北郊
tip_zh: 固定用复数，常说on the outskirts of a city。

meanings_zh: adj. 令人不安的
definition_en: Making someone feel worried, upset, or uncomfortable.
example1_en: We heard some disturbing news about the nearby forest.
example1_zh: 我们听到了一些有关附近森林的令人不安的消息。
example2_en: The survey revealed a disturbing increase in the number of young people experiencing severe stress.
example2_zh: 调查显示，承受严重压力的年轻人数量出现了令人担忧的增长。
collocations: disturbing news｜令人不安的消息 ; a disturbing trend｜令人担忧的趋势 ; deeply disturbing｜极其令人不安的
tip_zh: disturbing指事物令人不安；disturbed指人感到不安。

meanings_zh: n. 器官 | n. 管风琴；风琴
definition_en: A body part that performs a particular function. | A keyboard instrument producing sound through pipes or electronic equipment.
example1_en: The heart is an organ that pumps blood.
example1_zh: 心脏是输送血液的器官。
example2_en: Public awareness campaigns can encourage organ donation and help reduce waiting times for patients needing transplants.
example2_zh: 公众宣传活动能够鼓励器官捐献，帮助缩短需要移植的患者的等待时间。
collocations: internal organs｜内脏器官 ; organ donation｜器官捐献 ; organ transplant｜器官移植 ; play the organ｜弹风琴
tip_zh: organ指器官；organism指完整的生物体。

meanings_zh: n. 交响曲
definition_en: a long orchestral composition, usually divided into several movements
example1_en: We listened to a symphony while cooking dinner.
example1_zh: 我们做晚饭时听了一首交响曲。
example2_en: Performing a symphony requires close cooperation among musicians, demonstrating the importance of teamwork in the arts.
example2_zh: 演奏交响曲需要音乐家之间密切合作，体现了团队协作在艺术中的重要性。
collocations: compose a symphony｜创作交响曲 ; perform a symphony｜演奏交响曲 ; symphony orchestra｜交响乐团
tip_zh: symphony指交响曲；交响乐团用symphony orchestra。

meanings_zh: n. 缺陷；瑕疵 | v. 叛离；投奔另一方
definition_en: A fault that makes something imperfect or unable to work properly. | To leave a country or group and join an opposing one.
example1_en: A small defect in the kettle caused it to leak.
example1_zh: 水壶上的一处小缺陷导致它漏水。
example2_en: Manufacturers should identify any design defect before a product reaches consumers, particularly when safety is at risk.
example2_zh: 制造商应在产品到达消费者手中前发现设计缺陷，尤其是在涉及安全风险时。
collocations: a design defect｜设计缺陷 ; a manufacturing defect｜制造缺陷 ; a birth defect｜先天缺陷 ; defect to the opposition｜转投反对派
tip_zh: 名词重音在前；动词读/dɪˈfekt/。

meanings_zh: n. 变化；差异 | n. 变体；变种
definition_en: A difference or change in amount, level, form, or quality. | A version of something that differs from its usual form.
example1_en: This soup is a spicy variation on my grandmother's recipe.
example1_zh: 这道汤是在我祖母的食谱基础上改成的辣味版本。
example2_en: Seasonal variation in rainfall can significantly affect agricultural productivity, particularly in regions with limited irrigation infrastructure.
example2_zh: 降雨量的季节性变化会显著影响农业生产力，尤其是在灌溉设施有限的地区。
collocations: seasonal variation｜季节性变化 ; variation in temperature｜温度变化 ; genetic variation｜遗传变异 ; a variation on a theme｜同一主题的变体
tip_zh: variation in指某方面的差异；variation on指变体。

meanings_zh: n. 荣誉；尊敬；荣幸 | v. 尊敬；表彰 | v. 履行承诺；遵守协议
definition_en: Great respect, or something that brings pride and privilege. | To show deep respect or publicly recognize someone's achievements. | To do what a promise or agreement requires.
example1_en: It was an honour to represent my local team.
example1_zh: 能代表本地球队出场，我感到很荣幸。
example2_en: Companies must honour their commitments to workers if they hope to maintain trust and reduce staff turnover.
example2_zh: 企业若想维持信任并减少员工流失，就必须履行对员工的承诺。
collocations: a great honour｜莫大的荣幸 ; in honour of｜为纪念；向……致敬 ; honour a commitment｜履行承诺 ; a guest of honour｜贵宾
tip_zh: 英式honour，美式honor；h不发音，用an。

meanings_zh: v. 否认 | v. 拒绝给予；不准
definition_en: Say that something is not true or did not happen. | Refuse to give or allow someone something.
example1_en: She denied eating the last piece of cake.
example1_zh: 她否认吃了最后一块蛋糕。
example2_en: No child should be denied access to education because their family cannot afford school fees.
example2_zh: 任何孩子都不应因为家庭付不起学费而被剥夺受教育的机会。
collocations: deny doing something｜否认做过某事 ; deny an allegation｜否认指控 ; deny access to｜不准使用或进入
tip_zh: 否认做某事用 deny doing，不用 deny to do。

meanings_zh: n. 纽带；亲密关系 | n. 债券 | v. 建立亲密关系；黏合
definition_en: a close connection between people or groups | an investment representing a loan with promised repayment and interest | to develop a close relationship or join things firmly together
example1_en: Caring for the puppy strengthened the bond between the sisters.
example1_zh: 照顾小狗加深了姐妹之间的感情。
example2_en: Governments often issue bonds to finance major infrastructure projects without immediately increasing taxes on households.
example2_zh: 政府经常发行债券，为大型基础设施项目筹资，而不立即提高家庭税负。
collocations: a strong bond｜牢固的纽带 ; form a bond｜建立亲密关系 ; government bonds｜政府债券 ; bond with｜与……建立亲密关系
tip_zh: bond with sb指增进感情；issue bonds指发行债券。

meanings_zh: n. 地球仪 | n. 地球；世界 | n. 球体；球状物
definition_en: A ball-shaped model of Earth showing its land and oceans. | The Earth, especially when considering all its regions. | An object shaped like a ball.
example1_en: She spun the globe and pointed to a tiny island.
example1_zh: 她转动地球仪，指向一座小岛。
example2_en: Researchers across the globe are sharing climate data to improve predictions of extreme weather events.
example2_zh: 世界各地的研究人员正在共享气候数据，以提高对极端天气事件的预测能力。
collocations: across the globe｜遍及全球 ; around the globe｜世界各地 ; a glass globe｜玻璃球
tip_zh: a globe常指地球仪；the globe常指整个世界。

meanings_zh: adv. 不断地；频繁地
definition_en: All the time, or repeatedly with very little interruption.
example1_en: My phone constantly buzzes while I am cooking dinner.
example1_zh: 我做晚饭时，手机不停地振动。
example2_en: Workers must constantly update their skills to remain competitive in a rapidly changing labour market.
example2_zh: 劳动者必须不断更新技能，才能在快速变化的劳动力市场中保持竞争力。
collocations: constantly changing｜不断变化的 ; constantly monitor｜持续监测 ; constantly remind｜反复提醒
tip_zh: 比often语气强，强调不停或反复发生。

meanings_zh: n. 栖息地；生存环境
definition_en: the natural environment where an animal or plant lives
example1_en: This pond provides a perfect habitat for frogs.
example1_zh: 这个池塘为青蛙提供了理想的栖息地。
example2_en: Urban expansion destroys natural habitats, making it harder for native species to find food and shelter.
example2_zh: 城市扩张破坏了自然栖息地，使本地物种更难找到食物和庇护所。
collocations: natural habitat｜自然栖息地 ; habitat loss｜栖息地丧失 ; habitat destruction｜栖息地破坏 ; protect habitats｜保护栖息地
tip_zh: habit 是习惯，habitat 是动植物的栖息地。

meanings_zh: n. 评估；评价 | n. 学习考核
definition_en: A judgement about something based on careful examination. | A task or process used to measure a learner's progress.
example1_en: The mechanic's assessment was that the brakes needed replacing.
example1_zh: 修理工的判断是刹车需要更换。
example2_en: Continuous assessment can provide a broader picture of student progress than a single final examination.
example2_zh: 与单次期末考试相比，持续性考核能够更全面地反映学生的进步。
collocations: risk assessment｜风险评估 ; continuous assessment｜持续性考核 ; carry out an assessment｜进行评估
tip_zh: 评估某事用assessment of；动词形式是assess。

meanings_zh: n. 环；圈；环形线路 | v. 绕成圈；使循环 | n. 循环
definition_en: a curved shape or route that returns to its starting point | to form a loop or repeat something continuously | a sequence of actions or instructions that repeats
example1_en: She made a loop in the rope for hanging plants.
example1_zh: 她把绳子打成一个圈，用来悬挂盆栽。
example2_en: A bus route forming a loop can connect residential areas with schools and local health centres.
example2_zh: 环形公交线路可以将住宅区与学校和当地医疗中心连接起来。
collocations: a loop of rope｜一个绳圈 ; on a loop｜循环播放 ; feedback loop｜反馈循环 ; loop around｜绕着转
tip_zh: on a loop指不断重复，如音乐循环播放。

meanings_zh: n. 耻辱；丢脸 | n. 可耻的人或事 | v. 使蒙羞
definition_en: loss of respect caused by unacceptable behaviour | a person or thing deserving strong disapproval | to cause someone or something to lose respect
example1_en: The captain left in disgrace after cheating during the match.
example1_zh: 队长在比赛中作弊后，蒙羞离开了。
example2_en: Officials who misuse public funds bring disgrace on their institutions and weaken public trust in government.
example2_zh: 滥用公款的官员使其所在机构蒙羞，并削弱公众对政府的信任。
collocations: in disgrace｜蒙羞地 ; bring disgrace on｜使……蒙羞 ; a disgrace to｜给……丢脸的人或事 ; disgrace yourself｜使自己丢脸
tip_zh: 泛指耻辱时不可数；a disgrace指可耻的人或事。

meanings_zh: v. 起诉；提起诉讼
definition_en: To take legal action against someone, usually seeking compensation.
example1_en: Our neighbour plans to sue the builder over faulty repairs.
example1_zh: 我们的邻居打算因维修质量问题起诉那名建筑工人。
example2_en: Consumers should have the right to sue companies that knowingly sell unsafe products or conceal serious defects.
example2_zh: 消费者应有权起诉明知产品不安全仍销售，或隐瞒严重缺陷的公司。
collocations: sue for damages｜起诉要求损害赔偿 ; sue a company｜起诉公司 ; sue for negligence｜因过失提起诉讼
tip_zh: sue someone for something：因某事起诉某人。

meanings_zh: n. 电子学；电子技术 | n. 电子设备
definition_en: the study and use of electronic circuits and devices | devices that operate using electronic circuits
example1_en: My sister studies electronics and repairs radios at home.
example1_zh: 姐姐学习电子技术，在家修理收音机。
example2_en: Advances in electronics have enabled hospitals to monitor patients more accurately and provide faster treatment.
example2_zh: 电子技术的进步使医院能够更准确地监测患者状况，并更快地提供治疗。
collocations: consumer electronics｜消费类电子产品 ; electronics industry｜电子工业 ; study electronics｜学习电子学
tip_zh: 指电子学时虽以s结尾，谓语仍用单数。

meanings_zh: v. 组织；实施；进行 | v. 传导热或电 | n. 行为；举止
definition_en: to organize and carry out an activity | to allow heat or electricity to pass through | the way a person behaves, especially towards others
example1_en: Our teacher conducted a quick survey about favourite snacks.
example1_zh: 老师就大家最喜欢的零食做了一次简短调查。
example2_en: Researchers should conduct thorough trials before recommending new treatments for widespread use in public hospitals.
example2_zh: 研究人员在建议公立医院广泛采用新疗法之前，应开展充分的试验。
collocations: conduct research｜开展研究 ; conduct a survey｜进行调查 ; conduct electricity｜导电 ; code of conduct｜行为准则
tip_zh: 动词重音在后；名词重音在前，英音/ˈkɒndʌkt/。

meanings_zh: adv. 新近；最近
definition_en: Recently, especially when describing something just done or begun.
example1_en: We ate lunch in the newly opened corner café.
example1_zh: 我们在街角新开的咖啡馆吃了午饭。
example2_en: Newly qualified teachers often need additional support to manage diverse classrooms effectively during their first year.
example2_zh: 新取得资格的教师在第一年通常需要额外支持，才能有效管理学生背景多样的课堂。
collocations: newly built｜新建的 ; newly qualified｜刚取得资格的 ; newly elected｜新当选的 ; newly discovered｜新发现的
tip_zh: 常放在过去分词前，如newly built，表示新近完成。

meanings_zh: n. 确信；确定性 | n. 必然发生的事；确定的事
definition_en: The state of being completely sure about something. | Something that is definitely true or sure to happen.
example1_en: I cannot say with certainty where I left my keys.
example1_zh: 我说不准把钥匙放在哪里了。
example2_en: Although climate models continue to improve, scientists cannot predict every regional change with absolute certainty.
example2_zh: 尽管气候模型不断改进，科学家仍无法完全确定地预测每一项区域变化。
collocations: with certainty｜确定地 ; absolute certainty｜绝对确定 ; a degree of certainty｜一定程度的把握
tip_zh: 表确信通常不可数；a certainty指确定的事。

meanings_zh: v. 严厉谴责；强烈批评 | int. 该死；可恶 | adj. 可恶的；讨厌的
definition_en: To criticize someone or something very strongly. | An expression of anger, frustration, or disappointment. | Used to emphasize annoyance about something.
example1_en: The critics damned the play for its weak ending.
example1_zh: 评论家们因这部剧结尾乏力而对其大加批评。
example2_en: Campaigners damned the proposal because it offered little protection for wildlife threatened by further industrial development.
example2_zh: 倡议者严厉批评了该提案，因为它几乎没有保护受到进一步工业开发威胁的野生动物。
collocations: damn with faint praise｜用敷衍的赞扬暗贬 ; damn it｜真该死 ; a damn nuisance｜真讨厌的麻烦事
tip_zh: 带轻度粗俗色彩；正式写作宜用 condemn。

meanings_zh: n. 心理咨询师；辅导员 | n. 顾问
definition_en: Someone trained to help people discuss and manage personal problems. | Someone who gives professional advice on a particular subject.
example1_en: The school counsellor helped me talk about my worries.
example1_zh: 学校辅导员帮助我说出了自己的烦恼。
example2_en: Access to a trained counsellor can help university students manage stress and adjust to independent living.
example2_zh: 获得专业咨询师的帮助，能让大学生更好地应对压力并适应独立生活。
collocations: a school counsellor｜学校辅导员 ; a marriage counsellor｜婚姻咨询师 ; a careers counsellor｜职业顾问
tip_zh: 英式counsellor，美式counselor；勿混councillor议员。

meanings_zh: adj. 海洋的；海生的 | adj. 海运的；船舶的 | n. 海军陆战队员
definition_en: Relating to the sea or organisms living in it | Relating to ships and transport by sea | A soldier trained to serve on land and at sea
example1_en: We watched a documentary about marine life last night.
example1_zh: 我们昨晚看了一部关于海洋生物的纪录片。
example2_en: Plastic pollution threatens marine ecosystems and reduces the income of communities that depend on fishing.
example2_zh: 塑料污染威胁海洋生态系统，并减少依靠捕鱼为生的社区的收入。
collocations: marine life｜海洋生物 ; marine ecosystem｜海洋生态系统 ; marine pollution｜海洋污染 ; marine transport｜海上运输
tip_zh: marine侧重海洋；海军的通常用naval。

meanings_zh: n. 疗法；药物 | n. 解决办法；补救措施 | v. 补救；纠正
definition_en: A treatment or medicine used to relieve an illness. | A way of correcting a problem or improving a situation. | To correct a problem or improve an unsatisfactory situation.
example1_en: Warm lemon water is her favourite remedy for colds.
example1_zh: 温柠檬水是她最喜欢的缓解感冒的方法。
example2_en: Improving access to affordable training could help remedy the shortage of skilled workers in rural areas.
example2_zh: 让更多人获得负担得起的培训，有助于缓解农村地区技术工人短缺的问题。
collocations: home remedy｜家庭疗法 ; a remedy for｜针对……的疗法或办法 ; remedy a problem｜纠正问题 ; remedy the situation｜改善局面
tip_zh: 名词常接for；动词直接接问题，不加for。

meanings_zh: n. 认出；识别 | n. 认可；赞赏 | n. 承认；正式认可
definition_en: The act of identifying someone or something encountered before. | Public appreciation of someone's achievements or value. | Acceptance that something exists, is true, or has official status.
example1_en: His face lit up with recognition when I waved.
example1_zh: 我挥手时，他认出了我，脸上顿时露出喜色。
example2_en: Greater recognition of unpaid care work could lead to fairer social policies and stronger support for families.
example2_zh: 更加认可无偿照护工作的价值，可以推动更公平的社会政策，并加强对家庭的支持。
collocations: facial recognition｜人脸识别 ; gain recognition｜获得认可 ; in recognition of｜为表彰；为肯定 ; official recognition｜正式承认
tip_zh: 通常不可数；in recognition of常用于表彰贡献。

meanings_zh: adj. 额外的；附加的
definition_en: Added to what already exists or is available.
example1_en: We need an additional chair for our guest tonight.
example1_zh: 今晚有客人来，我们需要再加一把椅子。
example2_en: Universities should provide additional financial support for students who cannot afford essential learning materials.
example2_zh: 大学应为无力购买必要学习资料的学生提供额外的经济支持。
collocations: additional costs｜额外费用 ; additional information｜补充信息 ; additional support｜额外支持 ; an additional charge｜附加费用
tip_zh: 通常放在名词前；additional costs指额外费用。

meanings_zh: v. 合作；配合
definition_en: working together or helping by doing what is requested
example1_en: The neighbours are cooperating to repair the shared fence.
example1_zh: 邻居们正合作修理共用的围栏。
example2_en: By cooperating on clean energy research, countries can reduce costs and accelerate the development of sustainable technologies.
example2_zh: 各国通过合作开展清洁能源研究，可以降低成本并加快可持续技术的发展。
collocations: cooperating with colleagues｜与同事合作 ; cooperating on research｜合作开展研究 ; cooperating closely｜密切合作
tip_zh: cooperate的-ing形式；与某人合作用with。

meanings_zh: n. 药物过量 | v. 过量服药
definition_en: an amount of a drug taken that exceeds safe limits | to take a dangerously large amount of a drug
example1_en: The pharmacist explained how to avoid an accidental overdose.
example1_zh: 药剂师解释了如何避免意外服药过量。
example2_en: Clear packaging and professional advice can reduce the risk of accidental overdose among patients taking several medicines.
example2_zh: 清晰的包装说明和专业建议可以降低同时服用多种药物的患者意外用药过量的风险。
collocations: an accidental overdose｜意外用药过量 ; a drug overdose｜药物过量 ; overdose on medication｜过量服用药物
tip_zh: 动词用 overdose on sth；名词用 an overdose of sth。

meanings_zh: adj. 负担得起的
definition_en: Not too expensive for someone to pay for.
example1_en: This small flat is affordable on my current salary.
example1_zh: 以我目前的工资，租得起这套小公寓。
example2_en: Governments should provide affordable housing so that essential workers can live close to their workplaces.
example2_zh: 政府应提供可负担的住房，让必要服务岗位的工作人员能住在工作地点附近。
collocations: affordable housing｜可负担的住房 ; affordable prices｜可承受的价格 ; affordable healthcare｜负担得起的医疗服务
tip_zh: 强调价格在承受范围内，不一定意味着绝对便宜。

meanings_zh: n. 布局；版面设计
definition_en: the way parts of a space or page are arranged
example1_en: We changed the kitchen layout to create more space.
example1_zh: 我们调整了厨房布局，腾出了更多空间。
example2_en: A clear website layout helps users find essential information quickly and improves access to public services.
example2_zh: 清晰的网站布局有助于用户快速找到关键信息，并更方便地使用公共服务。
collocations: page layout｜页面布局 ; room layout｜房间布局 ; an open-plan layout｜开放式布局
tip_zh: 名词layout写成一词；动词lay out分开写。

meanings_zh: adj. 轻微的；少量的 | adj. 纤瘦的 | v. 怠慢；轻视
definition_en: small in amount, degree, or importance | thin and delicately built | to insult someone by ignoring them or showing little respect
example1_en: There is a slight scratch on my new phone.
example1_zh: 我的新手机上有一道轻微的划痕。
example2_en: Even a slight increase in average temperatures can have significant consequences for fragile ecosystems worldwide.
example2_zh: 即使平均气温仅略微上升，也可能给全球脆弱的生态系统带来重大影响。
collocations: a slight increase｜小幅增长 ; a slight difference｜细微差别 ; a slight delay｜短暂延误 ; a slight chance｜微小的可能性
tip_zh: slight是形容词；修饰动词或比较级用slightly。

meanings_zh: v. 转变；改造；转换 | v. 改变宗教信仰；皈依 | n. 皈依者；新拥护者
definition_en: to change something into a different form, purpose, or system | to adopt a different religion or persuade someone to do so | someone who has adopted a new religion, belief, or practice
example1_en: We converted the spare bedroom into a small office.
example1_zh: 我们把空闲的卧室改成了一间小办公室。
example2_en: Solar panels convert sunlight into electricity, allowing households to reduce their dependence on fossil fuels.
example2_zh: 太阳能电池板将阳光转化为电能，使家庭能够减少对化石燃料的依赖。
collocations: convert into｜转变为 ; convert to｜改用；皈依 ; convert energy｜转换能量 ; convert a building｜改造建筑
tip_zh: 动词重音在后；名词重音在前。

meanings_zh: n. 运输；海运；装运 | n. 运费 | n. 船舶总称
definition_en: the business or process of transporting goods | the charge for delivering goods | ships considered together as a group
example1_en: Shipping these boxes overseas will take about a month.
example1_zh: 把这些箱子运到海外大约需要一个月。
example2_en: International shipping supports global trade, but its environmental impact has prompted demands for cleaner fuels.
example2_zh: 国际航运支撑着全球贸易，但其环境影响也引发了使用更清洁燃料的诉求。
collocations: shipping costs｜运输费用 ; free shipping｜免运费 ; shipping industry｜航运业 ; shipping lanes｜航道
tip_zh: 通常不可数；网购中的shipping也可指非海运配送。

meanings_zh: n. 蚱蜢；蚂蚱
definition_en: An insect with long back legs used for jumping.
example1_en: A green grasshopper landed on my sleeve in the garden.
example1_zh: 花园里，一只绿色蚱蜢落在了我的袖子上。
example2_en: Grasshoppers provide food for many birds and play an important role in maintaining healthy grassland ecosystems.
example2_zh: 蚱蜢为许多鸟类提供食物，在维持健康草原生态系统方面发挥着重要作用。
collocations: a green grasshopper｜一只绿色蚱蜢 ; a grasshopper leaps｜蚱蜢跳跃 ; grasshopper species｜蚱蜢种类
tip_zh: locust指能形成迁飞群的某些蝗虫。

meanings_zh: v. 到期；失效
definition_en: Reach the end of an officially allowed or valid period.
example1_en: My passport expires next month, so I must renew it.
example1_zh: 我的护照下个月到期，所以必须换发。
example2_en: When temporary work permits expire, employees may face uncertainty about their future employment and residence.
example2_zh: 临时工作许可到期时，雇员的未来就业和居留可能面临不确定性。
collocations: a passport expires｜护照到期 ; a contract expires｜合同到期 ; expire at midnight｜于午夜到期
tip_zh: 是不及物动词：合同到期用expires，不用is expired。

meanings_zh: n. 模具；铸模 | v. 塑造；使成形 | n. 霉；霉菌
definition_en: a shaped container in which a material sets into shape | to shape a material or influence someone's character | a fungus growing on damp surfaces or old food
example1_en: Pour the melted chocolate into the mold carefully.
example1_zh: 把融化的巧克力小心倒入模具中。
example2_en: Early experiences can mold children's attitudes towards education and influence their confidence throughout their school years.
example2_zh: 早期经历能够塑造儿童对教育的态度，并影响他们整个求学阶段的自信心。
collocations: silicone mold｜硅胶模具 ; mold into shape｜塑造成形 ; mold growth｜霉菌生长 ; break the mold｜打破常规
tip_zh: 美式拼写mold，英式通常写mould；也指霉菌。

meanings_zh: n. 海湾 | n. 巨大差距；严重分歧
definition_en: A large area of sea partly surrounded by land. | A major difference separating people, groups, or ideas.
example1_en: Fishing boats crossed the gulf as the sun rose.
example1_zh: 太阳升起时，渔船驶过海湾。
example2_en: Unequal access to digital technology can widen the gulf between wealthy communities and poorer ones.
example2_zh: 数字技术获取机会不平等可能扩大富裕社区与贫困社区之间的差距。
collocations: a wide gulf｜巨大差距 ; bridge the gulf｜弥合差距 ; the gulf between rich and poor｜贫富差距
tip_zh: gulf可指海湾，也常用gulf between表示巨大差距。

meanings_zh: adj. 永恒的；永久的 | adj. 无休止的；没完没了的
definition_en: Lasting forever, without an end. | Seeming to continue endlessly, often in an annoying way.
example1_en: The couple promised eternal love beneath the flowering tree.
example1_zh: 那对情侣在开花的树下许下了永恒相爱的诺言。
example2_en: Many ancient cultures used monumental architecture to express hopes for eternal life and preserve collective memories.
example2_zh: 许多古代文化通过宏伟建筑表达对永生的期盼，并保存集体记忆。
collocations: eternal life｜永生 ; eternal love｜永恒的爱 ; eternal optimism｜始终不灭的乐观
tip_zh: eternal强调无终点；eternal complaints可夸张指抱怨不断。

meanings_zh: adj. 不同的；有区别的 | adj. 明显的；清晰的
definition_en: clearly different or separate from something else | easy to notice, hear, see, or recognize
example1_en: The twins have similar faces but distinct personalities.
example1_zh: 这对双胞胎长相相似，性格却不同。
example2_en: Public transport and private cars serve distinct needs, so urban planners should consider both.
example2_zh: 公共交通和私家车满足不同的需求，因此城市规划者应兼顾两者。
collocations: distinct from｜与……不同 ; two distinct groups｜两个不同的群体 ; distinct advantage｜明显优势
tip_zh: distinct from表示“与……不同”；勿混淆为distant。

meanings_zh: v. 推测；猜测 | v. 投机买卖
definition_en: Form ideas about something without having enough evidence. | Buy and sell assets hoping to profit from price changes.
example1_en: We can only speculate about what caused the delay.
example1_zh: 我们只能猜测延误的原因。
example2_en: Researchers speculate that changing work patterns could reduce traffic congestion in major urban centres.
example2_zh: 研究人员推测，工作模式的改变可能缓解大城市中心的交通拥堵。
collocations: speculate about the cause｜推测原因 ; speculate that｜推测…… ; speculate in property｜炒作房地产
tip_zh: 推测常接about或that从句；投机领域用in。

meanings_zh: n. 存在 | n. 生活；生存状态
definition_en: the state of being real or present | a person's way of living, especially under particular conditions
example1_en: I never knew of this tiny island's existence.
example1_zh: 我以前根本不知道有这座小岛。
example2_en: The existence of affordable housing can significantly improve the quality of life in growing cities.
example2_zh: 在不断发展的城市中，有经济适用住房可以显著提升生活质量。
collocations: come into existence｜开始存在；形成 ; in existence｜现存的 ; the existence of｜……的存在 ; a peaceful existence｜平静的生活
tip_zh: 表示“存在”通常不可数；a quiet existence指平静生活。

meanings_zh: v. 面对；正视 | v. 当面对质；质问
definition_en: To face and deal with a difficult situation or problem. | To challenge someone directly about something they have done.
example1_en: She finally confronted her fear and entered the swimming pool.
example1_zh: 她终于直面恐惧，走进了游泳池。
example2_en: Cities must confront the challenges of an ageing population by improving housing, healthcare, and public transport.
example2_zh: 城市必须通过改善住房、医疗和公共交通来应对人口老龄化的挑战。
collocations: confront a problem｜正视问题 ; be confronted with｜面临 ; confront someone about something｜就某事质问某人
tip_zh: 直接接问题；be confronted with表示面临。

meanings_zh: adj. 实验的；基于实验的 | adj. 试验性的；尝试性的
definition_en: Relating to scientific tests or based on their results | Using new ideas or methods whose success is not yet established
example1_en: We compared the experimental results over lunch today.
example1_zh: 今天午饭时，我们比较了实验结果。
example2_en: Experimental evidence suggests that improved classroom ventilation can help students maintain concentration during longer lessons.
example2_zh: 实验证据表明，改善教室通风有助于学生在较长的课堂中保持专注。
collocations: experimental evidence｜实验证据 ; experimental design｜实验设计 ; experimental method｜实验方法 ; experimental treatment｜试验性治疗
tip_zh: experimental指实验的或试验性的，不是“有经验的”。

meanings_zh: n. 违法行为；犯规 | n. 冒犯；被冒犯的感受
definition_en: An act that breaks a law or rule. | Hurt or anger caused by something rude or disrespectful.
example1_en: Parking here is an offence, so let's move the car.
example1_zh: 在这里停车是违法的，我们把车挪走吧。
example2_en: Community service may be more effective than imprisonment for people who commit a minor offence.
example2_zh: 对于轻微违法者，社区服务可能比监禁更有效。
collocations: commit an offence｜违法；犯罪 ; a criminal offence｜刑事犯罪 ; take offence｜感到被冒犯 ; cause offence｜引起反感
tip_zh: 英式拼写offence，美式offense；take offence表示生气。

meanings_zh: adj. 弄错的；误解的
definition_en: Wrong about something or based on an incorrect belief.
example1_en: I was mistaken about the time of our appointment.
example1_zh: 我把我们约定的时间记错了。
example2_en: The mistaken belief that all bacteria are harmful can prevent people from understanding their ecological importance.
example2_zh: 认为所有细菌都有害的错误观念会妨碍人们理解它们在生态中的重要性。
collocations: be mistaken about｜对……弄错 ; mistaken belief｜错误观念 ; mistaken identity｜身份误认 ; if I am not mistaken｜如果我没弄错
tip_zh: 人作主语时常用be mistaken about，表示对某事弄错。

meanings_zh: n. 电报
definition_en: a message sent by telegraph and delivered in written form
example1_en: Grandmother kept the telegram announcing her brother's safe arrival.
example1_zh: 祖母保存着那封告知她哥哥平安抵达的电报。
example2_en: Before telephone services became widely available, sending a telegram was an important way to communicate urgent news.
example2_zh: 在电话服务广泛普及之前，发电报是传递紧急消息的重要方式。
collocations: send a telegram｜发电报 ; receive a telegram｜收到电报 ; deliver a telegram｜递送电报
tip_zh: telegram是电报消息；telegraph指电报通信系统。

meanings_zh: adj. 看得见的 | adj. 明显的；显而易见的
definition_en: Able to be seen. | Clear enough to be noticed or recognised.
example1_en: The mountains were barely visible through the morning mist.
example1_zh: 晨雾中，群山依稀可见。
example2_en: Investment in public transport has brought visible improvements to air quality in several major cities.
example2_zh: 公共交通投资已使几个大城市的空气质量得到明显改善。
collocations: clearly visible｜清晰可见的 ; visible to the naked eye｜肉眼可见的 ; visible improvement｜明显的改善
tip_zh: visible to表示对谁可见；别与visual（视觉的）混淆。

meanings_zh: adj. 负担不起的
definition_en: Too expensive for someone to pay for.
example1_en: The larger flat was unaffordable on my salary.
example1_zh: 以我的工资，负担不起那套更大的公寓。
example2_en: When housing becomes unaffordable, essential workers may be forced to move far from their workplaces.
example2_zh: 当住房变得难以负担时，关键岗位工作人员可能被迫搬到离工作地点很远的地方。
collocations: unaffordable housing｜难以负担的住房 ; unaffordable rents｜负担不起的租金 ; become unaffordable｜变得难以负担
tip_zh: 强调超出支付能力，不只是价格高。

meanings_zh: adj. 自雇的；个体经营的
definition_en: Working for yourself rather than being employed by an organisation.
example1_en: My aunt is a self-employed electrician with her own van.
example1_zh: 我姑姑是个体电工，有自己的货车。
example2_en: Self-employed workers often enjoy flexible schedules but may lack paid holidays and a stable monthly income.
example2_zh: 自雇者通常享有灵活的工作时间，但可能没有带薪假期和稳定的月收入。
collocations: self-employed workers｜自雇劳动者 ; become self-employed｜开始自主经营 ; self-employed consultant｜独立执业顾问
tip_zh: 指为自己工作，不等于失业；注意保留连字符。

meanings_zh: n. 筹款；募捐活动
definition_en: The activity of collecting money for an organization or cause.
example1_en: Our fund-raising dinner helped buy books for the library.
example1_zh: 我们的筹款晚宴为图书馆购书提供了帮助。
example2_en: Community fund-raising can support local services, but essential healthcare should not depend entirely on charitable donations.
example2_zh: 社区筹款可以支持当地公共服务，但基本医疗不应完全依赖慈善捐赠。
collocations: fund-raising event｜筹款活动 ; fund-raising campaign｜筹款行动 ; fund-raising target｜筹款目标
tip_zh: 也常拼作fundraising；raise funds意为筹款。

meanings_zh: v. 砰地关上；用力摔放 | v. 猛烈抨击 | n. 砰的一声；猛烈撞击
definition_en: to shut or put something down with force and noise | to criticize someone or something very strongly | a loud noise caused by something closing or hitting hard
example1_en: The wind slammed the window shut during breakfast.
example1_zh: 吃早饭时，风把窗户砰地吹关了。
example2_en: Environmental groups slammed the proposal because it would allow further construction in protected coastal areas.
example2_zh: 环保组织猛烈抨击该提案，因为它将允许在受保护的沿海地区继续施工。
collocations: slam the door｜砰地关门 ; slam shut｜砰地关上 ; slam a proposal｜猛烈抨击提案
tip_zh: 过去式slammed，进行式slamming，均双写m。

meanings_zh: v. 批准；发许可证给 | n. 执照；许可证
definition_en: to give official permission for an activity | an official document permitting an activity or ownership
example1_en: You need a license to drive on public roads.
example1_zh: 你需要有驾驶执照才能在公共道路上开车。
example2_en: Authorities should license childcare providers carefully to ensure that facilities meet appropriate safety and quality standards.
example2_zh: 主管部门应审慎审批托育机构的经营许可，确保设施符合相应的安全和质量标准。
collocations: license someone to do something｜许可某人做某事 ; a driving license｜驾驶执照 ; apply for a license｜申请许可证 ; a licensed operator｜持牌经营者
tip_zh: 英式名词写 licence、动词写 license；美式均用 license。

meanings_zh: n. 长途艰苦跋涉 | v. 长途跋涉；徒步远行
definition_en: a long, difficult journey on foot | to walk a long distance, often across difficult terrain
example1_en: Our trek through the forest ended beside a waterfall.
example1_zh: 我们穿越森林的徒步旅程在一处瀑布旁结束。
example2_en: Visitors who trek through remote mountain regions can support local economies by hiring guides and purchasing local supplies.
example2_zh: 在偏远山区徒步的游客可以通过雇用向导和购买当地物资来支持当地经济。
collocations: a mountain trek｜山地徒步旅行 ; trek through the forest｜徒步穿越森林 ; go on a trek｜去长途徒步
tip_zh: 现代常指艰苦徒步；trekked、trekking要双写k。

meanings_zh: n. 甲虫
definition_en: An insect with hard outer wings covering its flying wings.
example1_en: A shiny beetle crawled slowly across the garden path.
example1_zh: 一只发亮的甲虫缓缓爬过花园小径。
example2_en: Some beetle species help maintain healthy forests by breaking down dead wood and recycling nutrients.
example2_zh: 一些甲虫通过分解枯木和循环利用养分，帮助维持森林健康。
collocations: dung beetle｜蜣螂 ; stag beetle｜锹甲 ; beetle species｜甲虫种类
tip_zh: 指甲虫；不要用它表示“近视的人”。

meanings_zh: n. 带子；背带 | v. 用带子固定；捆扎
definition_en: a narrow strip used to carry, hold, or fasten something | to secure someone or something with a strap
example1_en: The strap on my backpack broke near the bus stop.
example1_zh: 快到公交站时，我背包的肩带断了。
example2_en: Passengers should strap their luggage securely to prevent injuries when vehicles stop suddenly or travel over uneven roads.
example2_zh: 乘客应把行李绑牢，以免车辆急停或驶过不平路面时造成伤害。
collocations: shoulder strap｜肩带 ; adjustable strap｜可调节带子 ; strap something down｜用带子固定某物
tip_zh: strap作动词时，过去式为strapped，现在分词为strapping。

meanings_zh: n. 氢；氢气
definition_en: the lightest chemical element, a colourless gas that burns easily
example1_en: Our science teacher showed us how hydrogen burns.
example1_zh: 科学老师向我们演示了氢气如何燃烧。
example2_en: Hydrogen produced using renewable electricity could help reduce emissions from industries that currently depend on fossil fuels.
example2_zh: 利用可再生电力生产的氢气，可帮助目前依赖化石燃料的行业减少排放。
collocations: hydrogen fuel｜氢燃料 ; hydrogen gas｜氢气 ; hydrogen fuel cell｜氢燃料电池
tip_zh: hydrogen是不可数名词，表示化学元素氢或氢气。

meanings_zh: n. 加仑（容量单位）
definition_en: A liquid measure, about 4.55 litres British or 3.79 litres American
example1_en: We bought a gallon of paint for the kitchen.
example1_zh: 我们买了一加仑油漆来刷厨房。
example2_en: Comparing how far vehicles travel per gallon of fuel helps consumers assess running costs and fuel efficiency.
example2_zh: 比较车辆每消耗一加仑燃料能行驶多远，有助于消费者评估使用成本和燃油效率。
collocations: a gallon of petrol｜一加仑汽油 ; miles per gallon｜每加仑行驶英里数 ; an imperial gallon｜一英制加仑 ; a US gallon｜一美制加仑
tip_zh: 英制约4.55升，美制约3.79升，注意区分。

meanings_zh: n. 研究结果；调查发现
definition_en: information or conclusions obtained through research or investigation
example1_en: We shared our findings with the rest of the class.
example1_zh: 我们向班上其他同学分享了调查结果。
example2_en: The findings suggest that access to green spaces is associated with better mental health among urban residents.
example2_zh: 研究结果表明，能够接触绿地与城市居民较好的心理健康状况有关。
collocations: research findings｜研究结果 ; key findings｜主要发现 ; publish findings｜公布研究结果 ; preliminary findings｜初步结果
tip_zh: 常用复数：the findings suggest，谓语不用单数。

meanings_zh: adj. 嫩的；易嚼的 | adj. 温柔的；慈爱的 | adj. 触痛的；一碰就疼的
definition_en: Soft and easy to cut or chew. | Showing gentle care and affection. | Painful when touched.
example1_en: The carrots were tender enough to mash with a fork.
example1_zh: 胡萝卜很软嫩，用叉子就能压成泥。
example2_en: Slow cooking makes tougher cuts of meat tender, allowing households to use less expensive ingredients.
example2_zh: 慢炖能使较韧的肉块变嫩，让家庭可以选用价格较低的食材。
collocations: tender meat｜嫩肉 ; tender care｜温柔的呵护 ; tender to the touch｜一碰就疼
tip_zh: 形容食物指嫩；形容身体部位可指一碰就疼。

meanings_zh: adj. 畅销的
definition_en: selling in very large quantities compared with similar products
example1_en: I borrowed her best-selling cookbook and tried the soup.
example1_zh: 我借来她那本畅销食谱，试做了里面的汤。
example2_en: Best-selling novels can encourage wider reading, although commercial success does not necessarily indicate literary quality.
example2_zh: 畅销小说能够推动更广泛的阅读，但商业成功并不一定代表文学品质。
collocations: best-selling novel｜畅销小说 ; best-selling author｜畅销书作家 ; best-selling product｜畅销产品
tip_zh: best-selling作形容词；bestseller是畅销书或商品。

meanings_zh: adj. 行政的；管理的
definition_en: Related to organising and running an institution or business.
example1_en: My sister handles administrative tasks at a local clinic.
example1_zh: 我姐姐在当地一家诊所处理行政事务。
example2_en: Reducing administrative costs could allow schools to spend more money on teaching materials and student support.
example2_zh: 降低行政成本可以让学校将更多资金用于教材和学生支持服务。
collocations: administrative staff｜行政人员 ; administrative costs｜行政成本 ; administrative tasks｜行政事务
tip_zh: 指机构的行政管理，不等于政府本身。

meanings_zh: n. 思想家；善于思考的人
definition_en: someone who thinks deeply or develops important ideas
example1_en: My grandfather is a quiet thinker who enjoys difficult questions.
example1_zh: 我爷爷是个沉静、爱思考的人，喜欢琢磨难题。
example2_en: Education should encourage students to become independent thinkers rather than simply accept established ideas without question.
example2_zh: 教育应鼓励学生成为独立思考者，而不是不加质疑地接受既有观点。
collocations: independent thinker｜独立思考者 ; critical thinker｜善于批判性思考的人 ; influential thinker｜有影响力的思想家 ; original thinker｜有独创思想的人
tip_zh: thinker指人；thinking指思考过程或思维方式。

meanings_zh: adj. 完全的；彻底的 | v. 说出；发出声音
definition_en: Complete or total, used to emphasise something | To say something or make a sound with your voice
example1_en: The kitchen was in utter chaos after we baked.
example1_zh: 我们烘焙完后，厨房彻底乱成了一团。
example2_en: Without adequate planning, rapid urban expansion can result in utter confusion over land ownership and infrastructure responsibilities.
example2_zh: 如果缺乏充分规划，快速的城市扩张可能导致土地所有权与基础设施责任划分完全混乱。
collocations: utter chaos｜彻底混乱 ; utter disbelief｜完全不敢相信 ; utter a word｜说一个字 ; utter a sound｜发出声音
tip_zh: 形容词utter只放名词前；副词用utterly。

meanings_zh: n. 庄园；大片私有土地 | n. 住宅区；工业区 | n. 个人全部财产；遗产
definition_en: A large area of owned land, often with a large house. | An area of buildings developed together for a particular purpose. | Everything a person owns, especially after their death.
example1_en: We walked past the lake on the old country estate.
example1_zh: 我们步行经过那座古老乡间庄园里的湖泊。
example2_en: New housing estates should include green spaces and reliable transport links to nearby employment centres.
example2_zh: 新建住宅区应配备绿地，以及通往附近就业中心的可靠交通连接。
collocations: a country estate｜乡间庄园 ; a housing estate｜住宅区 ; an industrial estate｜工业区 ; real estate｜房地产
tip_zh: real estate指房地产；housing estate指住宅区。

meanings_zh: n. 感激；感恩
definition_en: A feeling of thankfulness for help or kindness received.
example1_en: She brought fresh flowers to express her gratitude.
example1_zh: 她带来鲜花表达感激之情。
example2_en: Schools can encourage gratitude by helping students recognise the contributions that others make to their daily lives.
example2_zh: 学校可以帮助学生认识到他人对自己日常生活的贡献，从而培养感恩之心。
collocations: express gratitude｜表达感激 ; gratitude to someone｜对某人的感激 ; gratitude for something｜对某事的感激 ; a token of gratitude｜一点谢意
tip_zh: 对人感激用to，对某事感激用for；通常不可数。

meanings_zh: v. 蒸发；使蒸发 | v. 逐渐消失；消散
definition_en: to change from liquid into gas, or cause this change | to disappear, especially gradually
example1_en: The puddles evaporated quickly in the warm afternoon sun.
example1_zh: 水洼里的水在温暖的午后阳光下很快蒸发了。
example2_en: As temperatures rise, water evaporates more rapidly from reservoirs, increasing pressure on supplies in drought-prone regions.
example2_zh: 随着气温升高，水库中的水蒸发得更快，加剧了易旱地区的供水压力。
collocations: water evaporates｜水蒸发 ; evaporate rapidly｜迅速蒸发 ; moisture evaporates｜水分蒸发 ; hopes evaporate｜希望逐渐破灭
tip_zh: 蒸发不一定要沸腾；evaporate也可比喻希望等消失。

meanings_zh: adj. 可预测的；意料之中的 | adj. 老套的；缺乏新意的
definition_en: Happening or behaving in a way that can be expected. | Boring because nothing surprising or original happens.
example1_en: The film's predictable ending made us laugh rather than cry.
example1_zh: 这部电影老套的结局让我们笑了，而不是哭了。
example2_en: A predictable income helps families plan their spending and reduces the stress associated with financial uncertainty.
example2_zh: 可预期的收入有助于家庭规划支出，并减轻财务不确定性带来的压力。
collocations: predictable outcome｜可预料的结果 ; predictable pattern｜可预测的模式 ; highly predictable｜十分容易预测的
tip_zh: 既可表示结果可预料，也可贬指情节老套。

meanings_zh: v. 发现；揭露 | v. 揭开覆盖物
definition_en: to discover something previously hidden or unknown | to remove something covering an object or surface
example1_en: Our kitchen repairs helped uncover a hidden water leak.
example1_zh: 维修厨房时，我们发现了一处隐蔽的漏水点。
example2_en: Independent research can uncover environmental risks that are overlooked during the early stages of industrial development.
example2_zh: 独立研究能够发现工业发展初期被忽视的环境风险。
collocations: uncover evidence｜发现证据 ; uncover the truth｜揭示真相 ; uncover a problem｜发现问题
tip_zh: 既可指揭去实物覆盖，也可指发现隐藏事实。

meanings_zh: adj. 严厉的；苛刻的 | adj. 严酷的；恶劣的 | adj. 刺耳的；刺眼的；刺激的
definition_en: unkind or excessively severe in judging or treating others | very difficult or unpleasant to live in or experience | unpleasantly strong and uncomfortable to the senses
example1_en: His harsh criticism upset everyone at the dinner table.
example1_zh: 他苛刻的批评让餐桌旁的每个人都很难过。
example2_en: Farmers in regions with harsh climates need reliable irrigation systems to maintain stable food production.
example2_zh: 气候恶劣地区的农民需要可靠的灌溉系统来维持稳定的粮食生产。
collocations: harsh criticism｜苛刻的批评 ; harsh conditions｜恶劣的条件 ; harsh punishment｜严厉的惩罚 ; harsh light｜刺眼的光
tip_zh: 比strict更强调严厉得令人不快或难以承受。

meanings_zh: v. 像；与……相似
definition_en: To look like or be similar to someone or something
example1_en: These clouds resemble small boats floating across the sky.
example1_zh: 这些云朵像小船一样飘过天空。
example2_en: Modern learning spaces increasingly resemble collaborative workplaces rather than traditional classrooms with fixed rows of desks.
example2_zh: 现代学习空间越来越像协作型工作场所，而非课桌排列固定的传统教室。
collocations: closely resemble｜与……非常相似 ; strongly resemble｜与……极为相像 ; resemble each other｜彼此相像
tip_zh: 直接接宾语：resemble someone，不加to或with。

meanings_zh: n. 马鞍；自行车座 | v. 给马装鞍 | v. 使承担重担
definition_en: a seat on a horse or bicycle | to put a saddle on a horse | to give someone an unwanted responsibility or burden
example1_en: I lowered the saddle before riding my new bicycle.
example1_zh: 骑新自行车之前，我把车座调低了。
example2_en: Excessive university fees can saddle graduates with debts that limit their career choices for many years.
example2_zh: 过高的大学学费可能让毕业生背负债务，多年来限制他们的职业选择。
collocations: adjust the saddle｜调整车座 ; saddle a horse｜给马装鞍 ; be saddled with debt｜背负债务
tip_zh: saddle someone with指使某人承担不想要的负担。

meanings_zh: n. 命运；天意 | n. 结局；遭遇
definition_en: a power believed to control what happens in people's lives | what eventually happens to someone or something, often something bad
example1_en: It felt like fate when we met again.
example1_zh: 我们再次相遇时，感觉就像命中注定一样。
example2_en: The fate of many endangered species depends on whether governments protect their habitats from further destruction.
example2_zh: 许多濒危物种的命运取决于各国政府是否保护其栖息地免遭进一步破坏。
collocations: leave something to fate｜让某事听天由命 ; seal someone's fate｜决定某人的命运 ; suffer the same fate｜遭遇同样的结局
tip_zh: 表示天意时通常不可数；a terrible fate指悲惨结局。

meanings_zh: adj. 绝望的；不顾一切的 | adj. 极度渴望的；急需的 | adj. 危急的；极严重的
definition_en: Feeling nearly hopeless and ready to try anything. | Wanting or needing something very badly. | Extremely serious or dangerous and needing immediate action.
example1_en: Desperate to find her cat, Aisha searched every nearby garden.
example1_zh: 艾莎急切地想找到她的猫，搜遍了附近每个花园。
example2_en: After prolonged drought, farming communities face desperate conditions and require urgent support to restore their livelihoods.
example2_zh: 长期干旱后，农业社区面临危急处境，急需援助以恢复生计。
collocations: desperate for help｜急需帮助 ; desperate to escape｜拼命想逃脱 ; a desperate attempt｜孤注一掷的尝试 ; desperate measures｜不得已的极端措施
tip_zh: 渴望某物用desperate for；急切做某事用to do。

meanings_zh: n. 骨骼；骨架 | n. 基本框架；梗概
definition_en: The framework of bones supporting a human or animal body. | A basic structure to which more details can be added.
example1_en: We saw a huge dinosaur skeleton at the museum.
example1_zh: 我们在博物馆看到了一具巨大的恐龙骨架。
example2_en: Studying the skeleton of an ancient animal can reveal how it moved and adapted to its environment.
example2_zh: 研究古代动物的骨骼可以揭示它的运动方式以及它如何适应环境。
collocations: human skeleton｜人体骨骼 ; dinosaur skeleton｜恐龙骨架 ; skeleton staff｜最低限度的工作人员
tip_zh: skeleton staff指维持运转所需的最少人员。

meanings_zh: n. 预防措施；防范措施
definition_en: an action taken to prevent danger, damage, or problems
example1_en: We packed an extra torch as a precaution.
example1_zh: 我们多带了一个手电筒，以防万一。
example2_en: Taking basic safety precautions in laboratories can prevent accidents and protect both students and teaching staff.
example2_zh: 在实验室采取基本安全防范措施，可以预防事故并保护师生。
collocations: take precautions｜采取预防措施 ; as a precaution｜作为预防措施 ; safety precautions｜安全防范措施 ; a precaution against fire｜防火措施
tip_zh: 常用 take precautions；as a precaution 表示以防万一。

meanings_zh: n. 候选人；求职者 | n. 应试者
definition_en: Someone competing for a job or an elected position. | Someone taking an examination.
example1_en: Each candidate waited outside the office before their interview.
example1_zh: 每位求职者都在面试前等候在办公室外。
example2_en: Employers should assess each candidate fairly rather than rely on assumptions about their educational or cultural background.
example2_zh: 雇主应公平评估每位求职者，而不是依赖对其教育或文化背景的主观推断。
collocations: candidate for a position｜某职位的候选人 ; suitable candidate｜合适的人选 ; election candidate｜竞选候选人 ; exam candidate｜考生
tip_zh: candidate for后接所竞聘的职位或所竞选的职务。

meanings_zh: n. 百科全书
definition_en: A book or website explaining many subjects or one field.
example1_en: I found a fascinating dinosaur picture in this encyclopedia.
example1_zh: 我在这本百科全书里找到了一幅很有趣的恐龙图片。
example2_en: An online encyclopedia offers convenient background information, but students should verify important claims using reliable academic sources.
example2_zh: 在线百科全书便于查询背景信息，但学生应使用可靠的学术来源核实重要论断。
collocations: online encyclopedia｜在线百科全书 ; encyclopedia entry｜百科全书条目 ; consult an encyclopedia｜查阅百科全书
tip_zh: 英式英语也常拼作encyclopaedia。

meanings_zh: adj. 肿胀的 | adj. 水位上涨的
definition_en: larger than normal because of injury or illness | carrying more water than usual after heavy rain
example1_en: My ankle was swollen after I fell during practice.
example1_zh: 训练时摔倒后，我的脚踝肿了起来。
example2_en: After several days of heavy rain, the swollen river threatened homes built close to its banks.
example2_zh: 连续数日的大雨过后，水位上涨的河流威胁着沿岸的住宅。
collocations: a swollen ankle｜肿胀的脚踝 ; swollen glands｜肿大的腺体 ; a swollen river｜水位上涨的河流
tip_zh: 也作swell的过去分词；过去式是swelled。

meanings_zh: n. 名声；声誉
definition_en: The general opinion people have about someone or something.
example1_en: This little bakery has a reputation for excellent bread.
example1_zh: 这家小面包店以出色的面包闻名。
example2_en: Companies that respond honestly to customer complaints are more likely to maintain a good reputation.
example2_zh: 诚实回应顾客投诉的企业更有可能保持良好的声誉。
collocations: build a reputation｜建立声誉 ; damage someone's reputation｜损害某人的声誉 ; a reputation for quality｜品质优良的口碑
tip_zh: 用reputation for接特点；名声可好可坏。

meanings_zh: v. 使恢复精神；使清爽 | v. 刷新；更新 | v. 唤起；重温
definition_en: To make someone feel less tired or more comfortable. | To load the latest version of displayed information. | To help someone remember something learned or experienced before.
example1_en: A cool shower refreshed me after the long walk.
example1_zh: 走了很远的路后，冲个凉让我恢复了精神。
example2_en: Regular breaks can refresh employees and help them maintain concentration during tasks that require sustained mental effort.
example2_zh: 定时休息能让员工恢复精神，帮助他们在需要持续脑力投入的任务中保持专注。
collocations: feel refreshed｜感到精神焕发 ; refresh a page｜刷新页面 ; refresh your memory｜唤起记忆 ; refresh your skills｜温习技能
tip_zh: 人感觉精神恢复用refreshed；令人清爽用refreshing。

meanings_zh: adj. 丝般柔滑的 | adj. 声音柔和悦耳的
definition_en: soft, smooth, and often shiny like silk | pleasantly smooth and gentle in sound
example1_en: This conditioner leaves my hair feeling soft and silky.
example1_zh: 这款护发素让我的头发柔软顺滑。
example2_en: Consumers often prefer fabrics with a silky texture, although their production may require substantial chemical processing.
example2_zh: 消费者通常偏爱质地丝滑的面料，尽管其生产可能需要大量化学加工。
collocations: silky hair｜柔顺光亮的头发 ; silky texture｜丝滑的质地 ; silky smooth｜如丝般顺滑 ; silky voice｜柔和悦耳的嗓音
tip_zh: silky强调像丝一样柔滑，不一定由真丝制成。

meanings_zh: n. 家政服务员；客房服务员
definition_en: Someone employed to clean and look after homes or hotel rooms.
example1_en: The housekeeper left fresh towels beside the bathroom sink.
example1_zh: 客房服务员把干净毛巾放在了浴室洗手池旁。
example2_en: Hotels should provide housekeepers with suitable equipment and sufficient time to clean each room safely.
example2_zh: 酒店应为客房服务员提供合适的设备和充足的时间，确保每间客房都能安全清洁。
collocations: hotel housekeeper｜酒店客房服务员 ; live-in housekeeper｜住家家政服务员 ; hire a housekeeper｜雇用家政服务员
tip_zh: 指受雇打理家务或客房的人，不限性别。

meanings_zh: n. 压力；负担 | v. 拉伤；使过度用力 | n. 品种；菌株；毒株
definition_en: pressure or difficulty that tests someone's strength or resources | to injure or overwork a muscle or body part | a particular type of plant, animal, or microorganism
example1_en: I strained my back while lifting that heavy box.
example1_zh: 我搬那个沉重的箱子时拉伤了背部。
example2_en: Rapid population growth puts considerable strain on public services, particularly housing and healthcare in large cities.
example2_zh: 人口快速增长给公共服务带来巨大压力，尤其是大城市的住房和医疗服务。
collocations: put a strain on｜给……造成压力 ; under strain｜承受压力 ; strain a muscle｜拉伤肌肉 ; a strain of virus｜一种病毒株
tip_zh: strain可指拉伤；sprain主要指关节扭伤。

meanings_zh: v. 弄直；变直 | v. 挺直身体
definition_en: Make something straight, or become straight. | Move your body into an upright position.
example1_en: She paused to straighten her tie before the interview.
example1_zh: 面试前，她停下来把领带理正。
example2_en: Regular stretching can help office workers straighten their backs and reduce discomfort caused by prolonged sitting.
example2_zh: 定期做伸展运动有助于办公室职员挺直背部，减轻久坐引起的不适。
collocations: straighten your back｜挺直背部 ; straighten up｜挺直身体；收拾整齐 ; straighten out a problem｜解决问题
tip_zh: straighten up可指挺直身体，也可指收拾整齐。

meanings_zh: n. 准确性；精确度
definition_en: the quality of being correct or free from errors
example1_en: Please check the accuracy of these measurements before cutting.
example1_zh: 裁剪之前，请检查这些测量数据是否准确。
example2_en: The accuracy of climate predictions depends partly on the quality of data collected over long periods.
example2_zh: 气候预测的准确性部分取决于长期收集的数据质量。
collocations: check the accuracy of｜核查……的准确性 ; improve accuracy｜提高准确性 ; a high degree of accuracy｜高度准确 ; historical accuracy｜史实准确性
tip_zh: 通常为不可数名词；形容词是accurate。

meanings_zh: n. 辩论；讨论 | v. 辩论；讨论 | v. 仔细考虑；权衡
definition_en: A discussion in which people express different views. | To discuss a subject by considering different views. | To think carefully about options before making a decision.
example1_en: We had a lively debate about keeping pets indoors.
example1_zh: 我们就把宠物养在室内的问题展开了热烈讨论。
example2_en: The debate over free public transport centres on its environmental benefits and the cost to taxpayers.
example2_zh: 关于免费公共交通的争论集中在其环境效益和纳税人需要承担的费用上。
collocations: public debate｜公开讨论 ; heated debate｜激烈的辩论 ; debate an issue｜讨论一个问题 ; debate whether to｜斟酌是否要
tip_zh: 动词可直接接议题；debate whether to表示权衡。

meanings_zh: n. 门廊
definition_en: A covered area immediately outside a building's entrance.
example1_en: We left our muddy boots on the porch overnight.
example1_zh: 我们把沾满泥的靴子放在门廊上过了一夜。
example2_en: A shaded porch can reduce indoor temperatures while providing residents with a comfortable outdoor meeting space.
example2_zh: 带遮阴的门廊既能降低室内温度，也能为住户提供舒适的户外交流空间。
collocations: front porch｜前门廊 ; covered porch｜有顶门廊 ; sit on the porch｜坐在门廊上
tip_zh: 指入口外的有顶空间，不是室内走廊。

meanings_zh: n. 收割；收成 | v. 收割；采收
definition_en: the gathering of crops, or the crops gathered | to gather crops when they are ready
example1_en: We celebrated the apple harvest with a homemade pie.
example1_zh: 我们做了一个自制苹果派，庆祝苹果丰收。
example2_en: Unpredictable rainfall can reduce the annual harvest, threatening rural incomes and increasing food prices in cities.
example2_zh: 难以预测的降雨可能减少年度收成，威胁农村收入并推高城市食品价格。
collocations: a good harvest｜好收成 ; harvest season｜收获季节 ; harvest crops｜收割庄稼
tip_zh: 作名词可指收割活动，也可指收获的作物或产量。

meanings_zh: v. 创立；建立 | v. 找到（find的过去式及分词）
definition_en: to establish an organization, institution, or settlement | past tense and past participle of find
example1_en: My aunt founded a small charity last winter.
example1_zh: 去年冬天，我姑姑创办了一家小型慈善机构。
example2_en: Graduates who found new businesses can create employment opportunities and introduce innovative services to local communities.
example2_zh: 创办新企业的毕业生可以创造就业机会，并为当地社区引入创新服务。
collocations: found a company｜创办公司 ; found a school｜创办学校 ; found a charity｜创办慈善机构
tip_zh: “创立”的过去式是founded；“找到”的原形是find。

meanings_zh: n. 钙
definition_en: A chemical element needed for strong bones and teeth
example1_en: This yoghurt provides calcium for healthy bones and teeth.
example1_zh: 这种酸奶提供有益于骨骼和牙齿健康的钙。
example2_en: School meals should include adequate sources of calcium to support children's bone development during periods of rapid growth.
example2_zh: 学校膳食应包含充足的钙来源，以支持儿童快速生长期的骨骼发育。
collocations: calcium intake｜钙摄入量 ; calcium deficiency｜缺钙 ; calcium supplements｜钙补充剂 ; a source of calcium｜钙的来源
tip_zh: 不可数名词；化学符号为Ca。

meanings_zh: adv. 在经济上 | adv. 节约地；经济实惠地
definition_en: in a way relating to money, trade, or the economy | using little money, fuel, or other resources
example1_en: The town depends economically on its busy fishing harbour.
example1_zh: 这个小镇在经济上依赖其繁忙的渔港。
example2_en: Renewable energy projects are becoming economically viable as production costs fall and demand for cleaner electricity rises.
example2_zh: 随着生产成本下降及清洁电力需求上升，可再生能源项目正变得在经济上可行。
collocations: economically viable｜经济上可行的 ; economically disadvantaged｜经济条件不利的 ; economically dependent｜经济上依赖的 ; live economically｜节俭度日
tip_zh: 兼有economic的“经济上”和economical的“节约地”之意。

meanings_zh: n. 堡垒；要塞
definition_en: A strong building or enclosed place built for military defence.
example1_en: We climbed the hill to explore the old fort.
example1_zh: 我们爬上山去探索那座古老的堡垒。
example2_en: Restoring the coastal fort could attract tourists while preserving an important part of the region's military history.
example2_zh: 修复这座海岸堡垒既能吸引游客，也能保留该地区重要的军事历史遗产。
collocations: build a fort｜建造堡垒 ; coastal fort｜海岸要塞 ; abandoned fort｜废弃的堡垒
tip_zh: fort侧重军事防御；castle常兼作贵族住所。

meanings_zh: n. 灌木
definition_en: A woody plant with several stems, usually smaller than a tree
example1_en: A small bird was hiding beneath the flowering shrub.
example1_zh: 一只小鸟躲在开花的灌木下面。
example2_en: Planting native shrubs in urban parks provides shelter for wildlife and can reduce the need for irrigation.
example2_zh: 在城市公园种植本地灌木能为野生动物提供栖息处，还能减少灌溉需求。
collocations: flowering shrub｜开花灌木 ; evergreen shrub｜常绿灌木 ; native shrubs｜本地灌木 ; plant shrubs｜种植灌木
tip_zh: 可数名词，指灌木植株；一片灌木可用shrubbery。

meanings_zh: adj. 学业的；学术的 | n. 大学教师；学者 | adj. 纯理论的；无实际意义的
definition_en: related to education, study, or research | someone who teaches or researches at a university | theoretical rather than useful in a practical situation
example1_en: The school praised her academic progress this year.
example1_zh: 学校表扬了她今年在学业上的进步。
example2_en: Universities should support students' emotional wellbeing rather than focusing exclusively on academic achievement and examination results.
example2_zh: 大学应关注学生的心理健康，而不是只重视学业成就和考试成绩。
collocations: academic achievement｜学业成就 ; academic research｜学术研究 ; academic year｜学年 ; academic qualifications｜学历
tip_zh: 作名词指大学教师或研究者，通常不指大学生。

meanings_zh: v. 擦亮；磨光 | v. 润色；改进 | n. 擦亮剂；上光剂
definition_en: To rub a surface until it becomes smooth and shiny. | To improve something by making small, careful changes. | A substance used to make a surface smooth and shiny.
example1_en: I polish my shoes before every important meeting.
example1_zh: 每次参加重要会议前，我都会把鞋擦亮。
example2_en: University students should learn to polish their writing by removing unnecessary words and organising arguments logically.
example2_zh: 大学生应学会通过删去多余词语和有条理地组织论点来润色文章。
collocations: polish shoes｜擦亮鞋子 ; polish an essay｜润色文章 ; furniture polish｜家具上光剂
tip_zh: 小写polish指擦亮；大写Polish指波兰的，读音不同。

meanings_zh: n. 垃圾填埋场 | n. 垃圾填埋
definition_en: A place where waste is buried in the ground. | The disposal of waste by burying it in the ground.
example1_en: The truck carried our rubbish to a nearby landfill.
example1_zh: 卡车把我们的垃圾运到了附近的填埋场。
example2_en: Expanding recycling services could reduce the amount of household waste sent to landfill each year.
example2_zh: 扩大回收服务范围可以减少每年送去填埋的生活垃圾量。
collocations: landfill site｜垃圾填埋场 ; send waste to landfill｜将垃圾送去填埋 ; landfill capacity｜填埋场容量
tip_zh: 指填埋场时可数；指填埋处理时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 经销商；商人 | n. 发牌者
definition_en: A person or business that buys and sells particular goods. | The person who gives out cards in a card game.
example1_en: The dealer showed us three reliable used cars.
example1_zh: 经销商给我们看了三辆性能可靠的二手车。
example2_en: Consumers should choose a reputable dealer when purchasing secondhand vehicles to reduce the risk of hidden defects.
example2_zh: 消费者购买二手车时应选择信誉良好的经销商，以降低遇到隐蔽缺陷的风险。
collocations: a car dealer｜汽车经销商 ; an art dealer｜艺术品商人 ; a reputable dealer｜信誉良好的经销商
tip_zh: 常在前面加商品类别，如car dealer，明确经营范围。

meanings_zh: n. 诗；韵文 | n. 诗节；歌词的一段
definition_en: Writing arranged with rhythm, often using rhyme. | A group of lines forming part of a poem or song.
example1_en: We sang the first verse together around the piano.
example1_zh: 我们围在钢琴旁，一起唱了第一段歌词。
example2_en: Studying verse can help language learners recognise rhythm and explore how writers convey complex emotions.
example2_zh: 学习诗歌可以帮助语言学习者辨识韵律，并探索作家如何传达复杂情感。
collocations: free verse｜自由诗 ; blank verse｜无韵诗 ; in verse｜以韵文形式 ; the opening verse｜开篇诗节
tip_zh: 泛指韵文时不可数；指某一诗节时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 偏爱；偏好 | n. 优先待遇；优先权
definition_en: a greater liking for one thing than for another | an advantage given to someone or something over others
example1_en: My preference is tea, but coffee is fine too.
example1_zh: 我更喜欢茶，不过咖啡也可以。
example2_en: Consumer preference for locally grown food can encourage sustainable farming and reduce transport emissions.
example2_zh: 消费者对本地种植食品的偏好可以促进可持续农业，并减少运输排放。
collocations: a preference for｜对……的偏好 ; personal preference｜个人偏好 ; give preference to｜优先考虑 ; in preference to｜优先于；而不是
tip_zh: 对某物的偏好用preference for，不用to。

meanings_zh: n. 时代；历史时期
definition_en: A period distinguished by particular events, developments, or ways of life.
example1_en: These old photographs remind us of a different era.
example1_zh: 这些老照片让我们想起一个不同的时代。
example2_en: The digital era has transformed how people access information, creating both educational opportunities and new inequalities.
example2_zh: 数字时代改变了人们获取信息的方式，既创造了教育机会，也带来了新的不平等。
collocations: digital era｜数字时代 ; a new era｜新时代 ; the end of an era｜一个时代的终结
tip_zh: era强调具有共同特征的时代，不指固定年数。

meanings_zh: n. 特征；性格特点
definition_en: A particular quality in someone's character or an organism's nature.
example1_en: Patience is the trait I admire most in my sister.
example1_zh: 耐心是姐姐身上最让我欣赏的品质。
example2_en: Although some personality traits are inherited, social experiences also influence how individuals behave in different situations.
example2_zh: 虽然某些性格特征来自遗传，但社会经历也会影响个人在不同情境下的行为。
collocations: personality trait｜性格特征 ; inherited trait｜遗传特征 ; distinctive trait｜独特特征
tip_zh: trait是可数名词，常指性格或遗传特征。

meanings_zh: adj. 同性恋的 | adj. 与同性恋者相关的
definition_en: Romantically or sexually attracted to people of the same sex. | Relating to gay people, their lives, or their culture.
example1_en: My uncle is gay and lives with his husband.
example1_zh: 我叔叔是同性恋者，和他的丈夫住在一起。
example2_en: Schools can promote inclusion by ensuring that gay students receive the same respect and support as their peers.
example2_zh: 学校可以确保同性恋学生获得与同龄人同等的尊重和支持，从而促进包容。
collocations: gay couple｜同性伴侣 ; gay rights｜同性恋者权利 ; openly gay｜公开同性恋身份的
tip_zh: 通常作形容词；“快乐的”义现已少用。

meanings_zh: adj. 同情的；体谅的 | adj. 赞同的；支持的
definition_en: showing understanding and care for someone's difficulties | showing approval or support for an idea or proposal
example1_en: My manager was sympathetic when I explained my difficulties.
example1_zh: 我说明困难后，经理表示理解。
example2_en: Employers who are sympathetic to carers' needs can improve staff wellbeing by offering flexible working arrangements.
example2_zh: 体谅照护者需求的雇主可以通过提供灵活的工作安排来改善员工福祉。
collocations: a sympathetic listener｜体贴的倾听者 ; a sympathetic attitude｜体谅的态度 ; sympathetic to a proposal｜赞同一项提议
tip_zh: 常接to或towards；不表示“讨人喜欢的”。

meanings_zh: n. 青少年 | adj. 青春期的；青少年的
definition_en: a young person developing from a child into an adult | relating to the stage between childhood and adulthood
example1_en: The club offers cooking classes for adolescents after school.
example1_zh: 这个俱乐部为青少年开设课后烹饪班。
example2_en: Regular physical activity can improve adolescent mental health and support the development of lasting social connections.
example2_zh: 定期运动可以改善青少年的心理健康，并帮助他们建立持久的社会联系。
collocations: adolescent development｜青少年发育 ; adolescent behaviour｜青少年行为 ; adolescent mental health｜青少年心理健康
tip_zh: 既可作名词也可作形容词；比 teenager 更正式。

meanings_zh: n. 雄孔雀
definition_en: a male peafowl with long, colourful feathers it spreads out
example1_en: The peacock spread its brilliant feathers beside the pond.
example1_zh: 那只雄孔雀在池塘边展开了鲜艳的羽毛。
example2_en: The elaborate display of a peacock illustrates how mate selection can influence the evolution of animal appearance.
example2_zh: 雄孔雀华丽的开屏展示说明，配偶选择能够影响动物外形的进化。
collocations: peacock feathers｜孔雀羽毛 ; a peacock's tail｜雄孔雀的尾羽 ; as proud as a peacock｜像孔雀般得意
tip_zh: 严格说peacock指雄孔雀，雌孔雀叫peahen。

meanings_zh: adv. 完全地；全部地
definition_en: Completely, with nothing left out.
example1_en: I entirely forgot about the soup on the stove.
example1_zh: 我把炉子上煮着的汤忘得一干二净。
example2_en: A transport system powered entirely by renewable energy could significantly reduce a city's carbon emissions.
example2_zh: 完全由可再生能源驱动的交通系统可以显著减少城市的碳排放。
collocations: entirely different｜完全不同 ; entirely dependent on｜完全依赖于 ; not entirely｜不完全
tip_zh: not entirely表示不完全，并非完全不。

meanings_zh: n. 游行；列队表演 | v. 列队行进；游行 | v. 炫耀；展示
definition_en: An organised procession of people or vehicles watched by spectators. | To walk together in an organised public procession. | To show something publicly, often to attract admiration.
example1_en: Children waved flags as the parade passed our balcony.
example1_zh: 游行队伍经过我们的阳台时，孩子们挥动着旗帜。
example2_en: A cultural parade allows communities to celebrate their traditions and share them with people from different backgrounds.
example2_zh: 文化游行让各社区能够庆祝自身传统，并与不同背景的人分享这些传统。
collocations: a street parade｜街头游行 ; a carnival parade｜嘉年华游行 ; parade through the streets｜列队穿过街道
tip_zh: parade重在列队展示；抗议游行常用march。

meanings_zh: adj. 有益的；有利的
definition_en: Having a helpful or positive effect.
example1_en: A short walk after lunch is beneficial for digestion.
example1_zh: 午饭后散一小会儿步有助于消化。
example2_en: Access to green spaces is particularly beneficial to urban residents who have limited opportunities for outdoor exercise.
example2_zh: 对于户外锻炼机会有限的城市居民来说，能够使用绿地尤其有益。
collocations: beneficial effect｜有益影响 ; beneficial to health｜有益健康 ; mutually beneficial｜互利的
tip_zh: 常接to或for，说明对谁或哪方面有益。

meanings_zh: adj. 经典的；公认优秀的 | adj. 典型的 | n. 经典作品
definition_en: Widely admired for lasting quality and value. | Showing the most recognizable features of a particular kind. | A work admired over time for its excellent quality.
example1_en: We watched a classic film together after dinner.
example1_zh: 晚饭后，我们一起看了一部经典电影。
example2_en: This housing project is a classic example of how thoughtful design can improve urban life.
example2_zh: 这个住宅项目是精心设计如何改善城市生活的典型例子。
collocations: classic example｜典型例子 ; classic novel｜经典小说 ; timeless classic｜永恒的经典
tip_zh: classic指经典或典型；古典音乐用classical。

meanings_zh: v. 打鼾；打呼噜 | n. 鼾声
definition_en: to breathe noisily through your nose and throat while sleeping | a noisy breath made by someone who is sleeping
example1_en: My brother snores so loudly that the dog leaves.
example1_zh: 我哥哥打呼噜太响，连狗都走开了。
example2_en: People who snore regularly may benefit from medical advice, particularly if their breathing stops briefly during sleep.
example2_zh: 经常打鼾的人可能需要咨询医生，尤其是在睡眠中出现短暂呼吸暂停时。
collocations: snore loudly｜大声打鼾 ; start snoring｜开始打鼾 ; a loud snore｜一声响亮的鼾声
tip_zh: 作动词通常不及物；snoring可指打鼾这一现象。

meanings_zh: v. 消化 | v. 理解；吸收信息 | n. 摘要；文摘
definition_en: Break down food inside the body so it can be used. | Think about information until you understand it. | A short collection of the main points from longer material.
example1_en: My stomach finds heavy meals difficult to digest.
example1_zh: 我的胃很难消化油腻丰盛的饭菜。
example2_en: Students need sufficient time to digest complex information before applying it to unfamiliar problems.
example2_zh: 学生需要充足的时间理解复杂信息，然后才能将其用于解决陌生的问题。
collocations: digest food｜消化食物 ; digest information｜理解信息 ; a monthly digest｜月刊文摘
tip_zh: 名词重音在首音节，读 /ˈdaɪdʒest/。

meanings_zh: n. 座右铭；格言
definition_en: A short phrase expressing someone's guiding belief or purpose.
example1_en: My grandmother's motto was always to help others first.
example1_zh: 我祖母的座右铭是始终先帮助别人。
example2_en: A school's motto can express shared values, but daily teaching practices must also reflect those principles.
example2_zh: 学校的校训可以表达共同价值观，但日常教学实践也必须体现这些原则。
collocations: a personal motto｜个人座右铭 ; a school motto｜校训 ; adopt a motto｜采用一句格言
tip_zh: motto强调指导信念；slogan更常指宣传口号。

meanings_zh: v. 忍受；承受 | v. 持续；长存
definition_en: To suffer something difficult or unpleasant without giving up. | To continue existing despite difficulties or the passage of time.
example1_en: We endured hours of noise while workers repaired the roof.
example1_zh: 工人修理屋顶时，我们忍受了几个小时的噪声。
example2_en: Communities in dry regions must endure prolonged water shortages as climate patterns become less predictable.
example2_zh: 随着气候模式变得更难预测，干旱地区的社区不得不承受长期缺水。
collocations: endure hardship｜忍受艰苦 ; endure pain｜忍受疼痛 ; endure for centuries｜延续数世纪
tip_zh: 表“忍受”直接接宾语；表“持续”可不接宾语。

meanings_zh: n. 水坝 | v. 在……筑坝；拦水
definition_en: A barrier across a river that holds back water. | To block a river or stream with a barrier.
example1_en: We watched water rushing through the gates of the dam.
example1_zh: 我们看着水从大坝的闸门中奔涌而出。
example2_en: Building a dam can provide renewable electricity, but it may also disrupt river ecosystems and displace communities.
example2_zh: 修建水坝可以提供可再生电力，但也可能扰乱河流生态系统并迫使居民搬迁。
collocations: build a dam｜修建水坝 ; a hydroelectric dam｜水电站大坝 ; dam a river｜在河上筑坝
tip_zh: dam是拦水的坝；reservoir是蓄水的水库。

meanings_zh: n. 利益；目的；缘故
definition_en: Someone's benefit or the purpose behind an action.
example1_en: We kept our voices down for the baby's sake.
example1_zh: 为了不打扰宝宝，我们压低了声音。
example2_en: Governments should protect natural habitats for the sake of future generations rather than prioritising short-term profits.
example2_zh: 政府应为子孙后代保护自然栖息地，而不是优先考虑短期利润。
collocations: for someone's sake｜为了某人 ; for the sake of｜为了…… ; for the sake of clarity｜为表达清楚起见
tip_zh: 常用于for the sake of或for someone's sake。

meanings_zh: v. 梳洗；梳理毛发 | n. 新郎 | v. 培养；使做好准备
definition_en: To clean and brush an animal or make yourself neat. | A man who is getting married or has just married. | To prepare someone for a particular role or responsibility.
example1_en: We groom our pony every morning before riding.
example1_zh: 我们每天早上骑马前都会给小马梳毛。
example2_en: Some organisations groom promising employees for leadership roles through structured training and regular mentoring.
example2_zh: 一些机构通过系统培训和定期指导，培养有潜力的员工担任领导职务。
collocations: groom a horse｜给马梳洗 ; bride and groom｜新娘与新郎 ; groom someone for leadership｜培养某人担任领导
tip_zh: 培养某人任职用groom someone for a role。

meanings_zh: adj. 极地的 | adj. 完全相反的
definition_en: Relating to the regions around the Earth's poles. | Completely opposite in character, direction, or opinion.
example1_en: We watched a film about animals in polar regions.
example1_zh: 我们看了一部关于极地动物的影片。
example2_en: Rising global temperatures threaten polar ecosystems by reducing the sea ice that many species depend on.
example2_zh: 全球气温升高使许多物种赖以生存的海冰减少，威胁着极地生态系统。
collocations: polar regions｜极地地区 ; polar ice caps｜极地冰盖 ; polar bear｜北极熊 ; polar opposites｜截然相反的人或事物
tip_zh: polar指两极地区；polar opposites表示截然相反。

meanings_zh: n. 欣喜；快乐 | v. 使欣喜；使高兴 | n. 令人愉快的事物
definition_en: a feeling of great pleasure or happiness | to give someone great pleasure | something or someone that gives great pleasure
example1_en: The children squealed with delight when the puppy arrived.
example1_zh: 小狗一来，孩子们就高兴得尖叫起来。
example2_en: Public gardens can bring delight to city residents while providing valuable spaces for relaxation and social interaction.
example2_zh: 公共花园能给城市居民带来快乐，同时提供宝贵的休闲和社交空间。
collocations: with delight｜欣喜地 ; to someone's delight｜令某人高兴的是 ; take delight in｜以…为乐 ; delight in doing something｜乐于做某事
tip_zh: delighted形容人感到高兴；delightful形容事物令人愉快。

meanings_zh: n. 不确定；无把握 | n. 不确定的因素
definition_en: a state of not knowing what is true or will happen | something that is unknown or cannot be predicted
example1_en: The delayed flight left us facing hours of uncertainty.
example1_zh: 航班延误让我们好几个小时都不知道接下来会怎样。
example2_en: Economic uncertainty can discourage businesses from investing in new equipment or hiring additional staff.
example2_zh: 经济的不确定性可能使企业不愿投资新设备或增聘员工。
collocations: economic uncertainty｜经济不确定性 ; a period of uncertainty｜不确定的时期 ; reduce uncertainty｜减少不确定性 ; uncertainty about the future｜对未来的不确定
tip_zh: 泛指不确定状态通常不可数；具体未知因素可用复数。

meanings_zh: int. 好哇；万岁
definition_en: Used to express happiness, excitement, or approval.
example1_en: Hurrah, the rain has stopped and we can play outside!
example1_zh: 好哇，雨停了，我们可以出去玩了！
example2_en: The volunteers shouted hurrah when they learned that their campaign had saved the local park.
example2_zh: 得知他们的行动保住了当地公园，志愿者们高声欢呼。
collocations: shout hurrah｜高声欢呼 ; a final hurrah｜最后一次精彩表现
tip_zh: 与hooray意思相同；常独立使用，后接感叹号。

meanings_zh: adj. （能源、资源）可再生的 | adj. 可续期的
definition_en: Naturally replaced and therefore available for continued use. | Able to be extended for another period of time.
example1_en: Our new solar panels provide renewable energy for the house.
example1_zh: 我们新装的太阳能板为房子提供可再生能源。
example2_en: Investment in renewable energy can create jobs while reducing a country's dependence on imported fossil fuels.
example2_zh: 投资可再生能源可以创造就业机会，同时减少一个国家对进口化石燃料的依赖。
collocations: renewable energy｜可再生能源 ; renewable resources｜可再生资源 ; renewable sources｜可再生来源 ; renewable contract｜可续期合同
tip_zh: 名词renewables用复数，指可再生能源。

meanings_zh: n. 遮阳伞；遮阳篷
definition_en: an object that blocks sunlight to provide shade
example1_en: We opened the sunshade above our garden table.
example1_zh: 我们撑开了花园桌子上方的遮阳伞。
example2_en: Installing a sunshade over each outdoor seating area can make public spaces more comfortable in summer.
example2_zh: 在每处户外座椅区上方安装遮阳设施，可以让公共空间在夏季更加舒适。
collocations: beach sunshade｜沙滩遮阳伞 ; car sunshade｜汽车遮阳挡 ; under a sunshade｜在遮阳伞下
tip_zh: sunshade用于遮阳；umbrella通常指雨伞。

meanings_zh: n. 移除；清除 | n. 免职；撤职 | n. 搬家；搬迁
definition_en: The act of taking something away from a place. | The act of dismissing someone from an official position. | The process of moving belongings to a new home.
example1_en: Stain removal is easier if you act quickly.
example1_zh: 污渍如果及时处理，就更容易去除。
example2_en: The removal of unnecessary packaging could significantly reduce the amount of household waste sent to landfill.
example2_zh: 去掉不必要的包装可以显著减少送往垃圾填埋场的生活垃圾。
collocations: waste removal｜垃圾清运 ; stain removal｜去除污渍 ; removal from office｜免职 ; removal company｜搬家公司
tip_zh: 搬家义主要用于英式英语；搬家公司为removal company。

meanings_zh: v. 旋转；使转动 | v. 轮换；轮流
definition_en: to turn around a central point or axis | to change positions or duties in a regular order
example1_en: Rotate the pot so each side gets some sunlight.
example1_zh: 转动花盆，让每一面都能晒到阳光。
example2_en: Some hospitals rotate staff between departments to broaden their experience and improve cooperation across medical teams.
example2_zh: 一些医院让员工在不同科室轮岗，以拓宽经验并改善医疗团队之间的合作。
collocations: rotate clockwise｜顺时针旋转 ; rotate crops｜轮作 ; rotate duties｜轮换职责
tip_zh: 既可及物也可不及物：rotate the wheel；the wheel rotates。

meanings_zh: n. 热情；积极性
definition_en: Strong interest and excitement about something you enjoy or value.
example1_en: The children showed real enthusiasm for planting their own vegetables.
example1_zh: 孩子们对亲手种菜表现出了真切的热情。
example2_en: Teachers who demonstrate enthusiasm for their subjects can motivate students to explore ideas beyond the classroom.
example2_zh: 教师对所教学科展现热情，能够激励学生在课堂之外探索新想法。
collocations: enthusiasm for｜对……的热情 ; with enthusiasm｜热情地 ; generate enthusiasm｜激发热情 ; lose enthusiasm｜失去热情
tip_zh: 对某事的热情用enthusiasm for，通常不可数。

meanings_zh: v. 偷偷溜行；潜行 | v. 偷偷拿取；偷偷做
definition_en: move quietly and secretly to avoid being noticed | take or do something secretly without permission
example1_en: I sneaked downstairs for water while everyone was asleep.
example1_zh: 大家都睡着时，我悄悄下楼去喝水。
example2_en: Some students sneak phones into examinations, highlighting the need for clearer rules and stronger supervision.
example2_zh: 一些学生把手机偷偷带进考场，凸显了制定更明确规则和加强监督的必要性。
collocations: sneak out｜偷偷溜出去 ; sneak into｜偷偷进入 ; sneak a look｜偷看一眼 ; sneak something past someone｜偷偷带某物瞒过某人
tip_zh: 过去式常用sneaked；美式英语也常用snuck。

meanings_zh: n. 王座；宝座 | n. 王位；王权
definition_en: A special chair used by a king or queen. | The position or power of a king or queen.
example1_en: The queen sat on a throne beside the window.
example1_zh: 女王坐在窗边的王座上。
example2_en: Her accession to the throne marked a significant change in the country's political relationship with its neighbours.
example2_zh: 她登基标志着该国与邻国的政治关系发生了重大变化。
collocations: sit on a throne｜坐在王座上 ; ascend the throne｜登基 ; heir to the throne｜王位继承人
tip_zh: the throne可指王位，不一定指实体座椅。

meanings_zh: n. 缺点；不利方面
definition_en: a disadvantage or negative aspect of something
example1_en: The only downside of this flat is the noise.
example1_zh: 这套公寓唯一的缺点就是噪音。
example2_en: One downside of remote working is that employees may have fewer opportunities to build strong professional relationships.
example2_zh: 远程办公的一个弊端是，员工建立稳固职业关系的机会可能减少。
collocations: the downside of｜……的弊端 ; a potential downside｜潜在的不利之处 ; on the downside｜从不利方面看
tip_zh: 常用the downside of/to sth，表示某事的弊端。

meanings_zh: v. 护送；陪同 | n. 护送者；陪同人员
