definition_en: To accompany someone to guide or protect them | A person or group accompanying someone for protection or guidance
example1_en: A staff member escorted us to the waiting room.
example1_zh: 一名工作人员陪同我们去了候诊室。
example2_en: Trained volunteers can escort elderly residents to medical appointments, improving access to essential healthcare services.
example2_zh: 受过培训的志愿者可以陪同老年居民就医，从而改善他们获得基本医疗服务的机会。
collocations: escort someone to｜陪同某人前往 ; a police escort｜警方护送人员 ; under escort｜在护送下
tip_zh: 动词重音在后；名词英/ˈeskɔːt/，美/ˈeskɔːrt/。

meanings_zh: v. 传输；发送 | v. 传播；传染
definition_en: to send signals, information, or energy between places | to pass a disease from one living thing to another
example1_en: These tiny sensors transmit temperature readings to my phone.
example1_zh: 这些微型传感器把温度读数传送到我的手机上。
example2_en: Improved satellite networks can transmit vital information to remote communities during floods and other natural disasters.
example2_zh: 洪灾及其他自然灾害发生时，改进后的卫星网络能向偏远社区传送重要信息。
collocations: transmit data｜传输数据 ; transmit a signal｜发送信号 ; transmit a virus｜传播病毒
tip_zh: 过去式transmitted，进行式transmitting，均双写t。

meanings_zh: n. 识别；鉴定 | n. 身份证明 | n. 认同；共鸣
definition_en: the process of establishing who or what someone or something is | a document that proves who you are | a feeling of connection with another person or group
example1_en: The receptionist asked me to show some identification.
example1_zh: 接待员请我出示身份证明。
example2_en: Early identification of learning difficulties allows schools to provide appropriate support before students fall behind.
example2_zh: 及早识别学习困难，能让学校在学生掉队之前提供适当的支持。
collocations: proof of identification｜身份证明 ; species identification｜物种鉴定 ; early identification｜早期识别 ; identification with｜对……的认同
tip_zh: 表示身份证明时通常不可数，可简称 ID。

meanings_zh: n. 运动；移动 | n. 动议；正式提议 | v. 用动作示意
definition_en: the act or process of moving | a formal proposal discussed and voted on at a meeting | to signal something using a movement of your hand or head
example1_en: The gentle motion of the boat made me sleepy.
example1_zh: 小船轻轻摇晃，让我昏昏欲睡。
example2_en: The council passed a motion to improve public transport and reduce traffic in residential areas.
example2_zh: 议会通过了一项动议，旨在改善公共交通并减少住宅区的车流。
collocations: in motion｜运动中 ; set in motion｜使启动 ; pass a motion｜通过动议 ; motion to someone｜向某人示意
tip_zh: 动议可用pass或reject；in motion表示在运动中。

meanings_zh: n. 疯狂；极其愚蠢的行为 | n. 精神失常
definition_en: Extremely foolish, unreasonable, or dangerous behaviour. | An old-fashioned term for severe mental illness.
example1_en: Driving through this thick fog would be absolute madness.
example1_zh: 在这么浓的雾里开车简直是胡来。
example2_en: Critics described the destruction of healthy forests for temporary economic gains as environmental madness.
example2_zh: 批评者认为，为短期经济利益而破坏健康森林是环境领域的疯狂之举。
collocations: absolute madness｜完全是胡闹 ; sheer madness｜极其愚蠢 ; a moment of madness｜一时冲动
tip_zh: 指精神疾病的用法陈旧且可能冒犯，避免用于诊断。

meanings_zh: adj. 不知道的；未察觉的
definition_en: Not knowing or noticing that something exists or is happening.
example1_en: I was unaware that my umbrella was still outside.
example1_zh: 我没意识到自己的伞还在外面。
example2_en: Many consumers remain unaware of the environmental damage caused by the production of cheap clothing.
example2_zh: 许多消费者仍不了解廉价服装生产造成的环境破坏。
collocations: unaware of｜未察觉到 ; completely unaware｜完全不知情 ; remain unaware｜仍不知情
tip_zh: 常用be unaware of或be unaware that从句。

meanings_zh: n. 同龄人；同等地位者 | v. 仔细看；费力地看 | n. 英国贵族
definition_en: Someone of similar age, status, or ability | To look carefully, especially when something is difficult to see | A person holding a British noble title
example1_en: She peered through the window to see the kitten.
example1_zh: 她透过窗户仔细看，想看清那只小猫。
example2_en: Students often gain confidence when they receive constructive feedback from their peers during collaborative classroom activities.
example2_zh: 学生在课堂合作活动中得到同伴的建设性反馈时，往往会增强信心。
collocations: peer pressure｜同伴压力 ; peer review｜同行评审 ; peer group｜同龄群体 ; peer through｜透过……仔细看
tip_zh: 名词常用复数peers；动词常接through、at或into。

meanings_zh: n. 防御；保护 | n. 辩护；答辩 | n. 防守；防守队员
definition_en: Action taken to protect someone or something from attack or harm. | An argument or explanation supporting someone accused or criticized. | Players or actions that stop opponents from scoring in sport.
example1_en: The thick walls provided a strong defence against attackers.
example1_zh: 厚实的城墙为抵御进攻者提供了坚固的屏障。
example2_en: Restoring coastal wetlands offers a natural defence against flooding while creating valuable habitats for wildlife.
example2_zh: 恢复沿海湿地既能形成防洪的天然屏障，也能为野生动物创造宝贵的栖息地。
collocations: defence against｜对……的防御 ; in defence of｜为……辩护 ; self-defence｜自卫 ; defence spending｜国防开支
tip_zh: 英式拼写 defence；美式拼写 defense。

meanings_zh: n. 直径
definition_en: a straight line through a circle's centre joining opposite edges
example1_en: The round cake measures thirty centimetres in diameter.
example1_zh: 这个圆蛋糕的直径是三十厘米。
example2_en: Engineers must calculate the diameter of water pipes carefully to ensure an adequate supply to growing cities.
example2_zh: 工程师必须仔细计算水管直径，以确保不断扩张的城市有充足的供水。
collocations: in diameter｜直径为 ; measure the diameter｜测量直径 ; internal diameter｜内径 ; external diameter｜外径
tip_zh: 直径是diameter，半径是radius；尺寸后常接in diameter。

meanings_zh: adj. 高级的；资深的 | adj. 年长的；老年人的 | n. 毕业班学生；老年人
definition_en: Having a higher rank or more experience within an organisation. | Older than someone else, or relating to older people. | A final-year school or college student, or an older adult.
example1_en: A senior nurse showed me how to change the bandage.
example1_zh: 一位资深护士教我如何更换绷带。
example2_en: Senior managers should consult employees before introducing policies that significantly affect working conditions across the organisation.
example2_zh: 高层管理人员在推行显著影响整个机构工作条件的政策前，应征求员工意见。
collocations: senior management｜高级管理层 ; a senior position｜高级职位 ; senior citizen｜老年人 ; senior to someone｜级别高于某人
tip_zh: 比较级别用senior to，不用senior than。

meanings_zh: v. 激活；启动
definition_en: Make a device, system, or process start working.
example1_en: Press this button to activate the outdoor lights.
example1_zh: 按这个按钮就能打开室外的灯。
example2_en: Smart sensors can activate ventilation systems automatically when indoor air quality falls below acceptable levels.
example2_zh: 当室内空气质量降至可接受水平以下时，智能传感器可以自动启动通风系统。
collocations: activate an account｜激活账户 ; activate an alarm｜触发警报 ; activate a system｜启动系统
tip_zh: 强调使设备或系统开始运作；反义词为deactivate。

meanings_zh: v. 把…归因于；认为是…所作 | n. 特征；属性
definition_en: To regard something as caused or created by someone or something. | A quality or feature of a person or thing.
example1_en: She attributes her good health to daily walks.
example1_zh: 她把自己的健康归功于每天散步。
example2_en: Researchers attribute the decline in local air pollution to stricter controls on industrial emissions.
example2_zh: 研究人员将当地空气污染的减少归因于对工业排放更严格的管控。
collocations: attribute success to｜把成功归因于 ; be attributed to｜被归因于 ; a key attribute｜一个关键特征
tip_zh: attribute A to B指把A归因于B；名词重音在首音节。

meanings_zh: adj. 多功能的
definition_en: Designed to perform several different tasks.
example1_en: Our multifunction printer can scan documents and make copies.
example1_zh: 我们的多功能打印机可以扫描文件和复印。
example2_en: Multifunction devices can help small businesses save office space by combining several essential services in one machine.
example2_zh: 多功能设备将几种必要功能集于一机，可以帮助小企业节省办公空间。
collocations: a multifunction printer｜多功能打印机 ; a multifunction device｜多功能设备 ; a multifunction display｜多功能显示屏
tip_zh: 作形容词，常放设备名词前；也可用multifunctional。

meanings_zh: v. 同情；体谅 | v. 赞同；支持
definition_en: To understand and care about someone's suffering or difficulties. | To agree with someone's ideas, aims, or position.
example1_en: I sympathize with you; losing a pet is painful.
example1_zh: 我很理解你的感受；失去宠物确实令人难过。
example2_en: Many residents sympathize with workers demanding better conditions, although they find the transport strike inconvenient.
example2_zh: 许多居民支持工人改善工作条件的诉求，尽管他们觉得交通罢工带来了不便。
collocations: sympathize with someone｜同情某人 ; sympathize with a cause｜支持某项事业
tip_zh: 不直接接宾语：用 sympathize with；英式也拼 sympathise。

meanings_zh: adv. 持续而平稳地 | adv. 稳稳地
definition_en: At a regular rate, without sudden changes or interruptions. | In a controlled way, without shaking or losing balance.
example1_en: Rain fell steadily as we walked back from the station.
example1_zh: 我们从车站走回来时，雨一直不停地下着。
example2_en: The proportion of households using renewable electricity has risen steadily over the past decade.
example2_zh: 过去十年间，使用可再生能源电力的家庭比例持续平稳上升。
collocations: rise steadily｜稳步上升 ; decline steadily｜持续下降 ; grow steadily｜稳步增长 ; work steadily｜持续有条不紊地工作
tip_zh: 图表写作常用rise steadily，指平稳上升而非猛增。

meanings_zh: n. 蛋白质
definition_en: A nutrient needed for growth and repair of body tissues.
example1_en: These beans add protein to our vegetable soup.
example1_zh: 这些豆子为我们的蔬菜汤增添了蛋白质。
example2_en: A balanced plant-based diet can provide sufficient protein when it includes varied sources such as beans and nuts.
example2_zh: 均衡的植物性饮食如果包含豆类和坚果等多样化来源，就能提供充足的蛋白质。
collocations: high in protein｜富含蛋白质 ; a source of protein｜蛋白质来源 ; plant protein｜植物蛋白 ; protein intake｜蛋白质摄入量
tip_zh: 作营养物质通常不可数；指不同种类时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 逻辑；推理方式 | n. 逻辑学
definition_en: Reasoning that connects ideas in a clear, consistent way. | The study of rules for reasoning correctly.
example1_en: I understand the logic behind your plan to save money.
example1_zh: 我理解你这个省钱计划背后的思路。
example2_en: The logic behind investing in public transport is that fewer cars can reduce urban congestion.
example2_zh: 投资公共交通的逻辑是，减少汽车数量可以缓解城市拥堵。
collocations: the logic behind something｜某事背后的逻辑 ; sound logic｜严密的逻辑 ; flawed logic｜有缺陷的逻辑 ; formal logic｜形式逻辑
tip_zh: 通常不可数；the logic behind表示背后的道理。

meanings_zh: n. 辐射；辐射能 | n. 放射治疗
definition_en: Energy travelling through space or matter as waves or particles. | Medical treatment using radiation to destroy cancer cells.
example1_en: This special glass blocks much of the sun's ultraviolet radiation.
example1_zh: 这种特殊玻璃能阻挡大部分太阳紫外线辐射。
example2_en: Workers in nuclear facilities require protective equipment and regular monitoring to limit their exposure to radiation.
example2_zh: 核设施工作人员需要防护装备和定期监测，以限制其受到的辐射照射。
collocations: ultraviolet radiation｜紫外线辐射 ; exposure to radiation｜受到辐射照射 ; radiation therapy｜放射治疗 ; solar radiation｜太阳辐射
tip_zh: 通常不可数；辐射不只指核辐射，也包括阳光。

meanings_zh: adj. 专业的；专用的
definition_en: Designed for a particular purpose or requiring specific expert knowledge.
example1_en: The mechanic used specialised tools to repair my bicycle.
example1_zh: 修理工用专用工具修好了我的自行车。
example2_en: Hospitals need specialised equipment and trained staff to provide effective treatment for patients with complex conditions.
example2_zh: 医院需要专用设备和受过训练的人员，才能为病情复杂的患者提供有效治疗。
collocations: specialised equipment｜专用设备 ; specialised knowledge｜专业知识 ; specialised training｜专业培训 ; highly specialised｜高度专业化的
tip_zh: 英式常用specialised，美式常用specialized。

meanings_zh: n. 松树；松木 | v. 苦苦思念；憔悴
definition_en: An evergreen tree with needles, or the wood it produces. | Long deeply for someone or something, sometimes becoming weak.
example1_en: We rested beneath a tall pine after lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭后，我们在一棵高大的松树下休息。
example2_en: Planting pine trees can support timber production, but diverse native forests generally provide richer wildlife habitats.
example2_zh: 种植松树可以支持木材生产，但树种多样的原生森林通常能提供更丰富的野生动物栖息地。
collocations: pine forest｜松林 ; pine cone｜松果 ; pine for someone｜苦苦思念某人 ; pine away｜因思念而日渐憔悴
tip_zh: pine for表示渴望或思念；pine away指日渐憔悴。

meanings_zh: n. 人们 | adj. 民间的；传统的 | n. 民间音乐；民谣
definition_en: People, especially those belonging to a particular group. | Connected with the traditional culture of ordinary people. | Music rooted in the traditions of a community.
example1_en: Local folk gather here to chat every evening.
example1_zh: 当地人每晚都聚在这里聊天。
example2_en: Traditional folk music can help younger generations understand the cultural heritage of their communities.
example2_zh: 传统民间音乐能帮助年轻一代理解自己社区的文化遗产。
collocations: local folk｜当地人 ; folk music｜民间音乐 ; folk tale｜民间故事 ; folk dance｜民间舞蹈
tip_zh: 指人们时用复数动词；my folks口语指父母。

meanings_zh: n. 纪律；自律 | n. 学科 | v. 惩戒；训练自律
definition_en: Controlled behaviour achieved by following rules or managing yourself. | A particular field of study or knowledge. | To punish misconduct or train someone to follow rules.
example1_en: Practising the piano every morning takes patience and discipline.
example1_zh: 每天早晨练钢琴需要耐心和自律。
example2_en: Universities increasingly encourage collaboration between researchers from different disciplines to address complex environmental challenges.
example2_zh: 大学越来越鼓励不同学科的研究人员开展合作，以应对复杂的环境挑战。
collocations: self-discipline｜自律 ; maintain discipline｜维持纪律 ; academic discipline｜学科 ; discipline yourself to do something｜约束自己做某事
tip_zh: 表示纪律通常不可数；表示学科时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 露台；室外平台 | n. 梯田；阶地 | n. 一排连栋房屋
definition_en: a flat outdoor area beside a building for sitting | a flat strip of land cut into a slope | a row of houses joined by shared side walls
example1_en: We had breakfast on the terrace overlooking the garden.
example1_zh: 我们在俯瞰花园的露台上吃了早餐。
example2_en: Farmers maintain each terrace carefully to reduce soil erosion and grow crops on steep mountain slopes.
example2_zh: 农民精心维护每一级梯田，以减少水土流失，并在陡峭的山坡上种植作物。
collocations: a roof terrace｜屋顶露台 ; a sunny terrace｜阳光充足的露台 ; rice terraces｜水稻梯田 ; a terrace of houses｜一排连栋房屋
tip_zh: 露台通常是较大的室外平台，不等同于balcony。

meanings_zh: n. 食指
definition_en: The finger next to the thumb.
example1_en: She pressed the doorbell gently with her forefinger.
example1_zh: 她用食指轻轻按了门铃。
example2_en: Participants used their forefinger to press a button whenever they noticed a change on the screen.
example2_zh: 参与者每当注意到屏幕上出现变化时，就用食指按下按钮。
collocations: thumb and forefinger｜拇指和食指 ; right forefinger｜右手食指 ; tip of the forefinger｜食指尖
tip_zh: 与index finger同义，都是紧挨拇指的食指。

meanings_zh: adv. 焦虑地；担忧地 | adv. 急切地
definition_en: In a worried or nervous way. | With a strong desire for something to happen.
example1_en: He waited anxiously outside while the vet examined his cat.
example1_zh: 兽医检查他的猫时，他在外面焦急地等候。
example2_en: Many graduates anxiously await job offers as competition for entry-level positions continues to increase.
example2_zh: 随着初级岗位的竞争持续加剧，许多毕业生焦急地等待录用通知。
collocations: wait anxiously｜焦急地等待 ; look anxiously at｜担忧地看着 ; anxiously await｜急切地等候
tip_zh: 常含担忧色彩；纯粹高兴地期待多用eagerly。

meanings_zh: n. 边界；分界线 | n. 界限；限度
definition_en: A line marking where one area ends and another begins | A limit defining acceptable behaviour or the scope of something
example1_en: A low stone wall marks the boundary of our garden.
example1_zh: 一道低矮的石墙标出了我们花园的边界。
example2_en: Clear boundaries between work and personal life can protect employees' mental health and reduce long-term stress.
example2_zh: 明确工作与个人生活的界限，可以保护员工的心理健康并减轻长期压力。
collocations: a national boundary｜国界 ; set boundaries｜设定界限 ; cross a boundary｜越过边界 ; push the boundaries｜突破界限
tip_zh: boundary 强调分界；border 常用于国家或地区边界。

meanings_zh: v. 重建；重新建造 | v. 恢复；重建关系或信心
definition_en: to build something again after damage or destruction | to make something strong or successful again
example1_en: We plan to rebuild the garden wall this weekend.
example1_zh: 我们打算这周末重建花园围墙。
example2_en: After severe flooding, local authorities must rebuild essential infrastructure and help affected communities recover.
example2_zh: 严重洪灾过后，地方政府必须重建重要基础设施，帮助受灾社区恢复。
collocations: rebuild a house｜重建房屋 ; rebuild trust｜重建信任 ; rebuild the economy｜重振经济
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为 rebuilt。

meanings_zh: n. 洗涤剂；去污剂
definition_en: a substance used with water to clean clothes or surfaces
example1_en: I added detergent before starting the washing machine.
example1_zh: 我在启动洗衣机之前加入了洗涤剂。
example2_en: Using excessive detergent wastes money and may increase the amount of chemicals entering local waterways.
example2_zh: 使用过量洗涤剂既浪费钱，也可能增加进入当地水道的化学物质。
collocations: laundry detergent｜洗衣剂 ; liquid detergent｜液体洗涤剂 ; mild detergent｜温和洗涤剂
tip_zh: 泛指洗涤剂时通常不可数；指种类时可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 自由职业的 | adv. 以自由职业方式 | v. 从事自由职业
definition_en: Working independently for different clients rather than one employer | Independently, for different clients rather than one employer | To work independently, offering services to different clients
example1_en: My sister is a freelance designer who works from home.
example1_zh: 我姐姐是一名在家工作的自由设计师。
example2_en: Freelance work offers flexibility, but workers may struggle to maintain a stable income without regular contracts.
example2_zh: 自由职业提供了灵活性，但没有固定合同，从业者可能难以维持稳定收入。
collocations: freelance writer｜自由撰稿人 ; work freelance｜从事自由职业 ; freelance work｜自由职业工作
tip_zh: work freelance中作副词；freelancer是自由职业者。

meanings_zh: n. 地平线 | n. 眼界；见识范围
definition_en: The line where the sky seems to meet land or sea. | The limits of someone's knowledge, experience, or interests.
example1_en: We watched a small boat disappear beyond the horizon.
example1_zh: 我们看着一条小船消失在地平线之外。
example2_en: Studying abroad can broaden students' horizons by exposing them to unfamiliar customs and different approaches to learning.
example2_zh: 留学能让学生接触陌生的习俗和不同的学习方式，从而拓宽眼界。
collocations: on the horizon｜在地平线上；即将发生 ; broaden your horizons｜拓宽眼界 ; beyond the horizon｜在地平线之外
tip_zh: 表示眼界通常用复数：broaden your horizons。

meanings_zh: n. 方面；层面 | n. 尺寸；大小 | n. 维；维度
definition_en: A particular aspect of a situation, problem, or experience. | A measurement of something, such as its length or width. | An independent direction of measurement, such as length, width, or height.
example1_en: Cooking together added a new dimension to our friendship.
example1_zh: 一起做饭让我们的友谊有了新的层面。
example2_en: Urban planning has a social dimension, since the design of neighbourhoods can influence how frequently residents interact.
example2_zh: 城市规划具有社会层面，因为社区设计会影响居民互动的频率。
collocations: a social dimension｜社会层面 ; add a new dimension｜增添新层面 ; physical dimensions｜实际尺寸 ; in three dimensions｜以三维形式
tip_zh: 表示长宽高等具体尺寸时，通常用复数dimensions。

meanings_zh: adv. 因此；从而 | adv. 如此；以这种方式
definition_en: As a result of what has just been stated | In this way
example1_en: The road was flooded; thus, we took another route.
example1_zh: 道路被淹了，因此我们改走了另一条路。
example2_en: Improved public transport can reduce dependence on private cars, thus lowering emissions and easing urban congestion.
example2_zh: 改善公共交通可以减少对私家车的依赖，从而降低排放并缓解城市拥堵。
collocations: thus reducing costs｜从而降低成本 ; thus enabling｜从而使……成为可能 ; thus far｜迄今为止
tip_zh: thus是副词，不能仅用逗号连接两个独立句。

meanings_zh: n. 纺织品；织物 | adj. 纺织的
definition_en: cloth made by weaving, knitting, or other fibre processing | relating to cloth or its production
example1_en: The market stall sells colourful textiles for making curtains.
example1_zh: 这个市场摊位出售用来做窗帘的彩色织物。
example2_en: The textile industry can reduce water pollution by adopting cleaner production methods and treating wastewater effectively.
example2_zh: 纺织业可以采用更清洁的生产方式并有效处理废水，从而减少水污染。
collocations: textile industry｜纺织业 ; textile production｜纺织品生产 ; textile waste｜纺织废料 ; textile factory｜纺织厂
tip_zh: 表示各类纺织品时常用复数textiles。

meanings_zh: n. 工匠；手艺人
definition_en: A skilled person, especially a man, who makes things by hand.
example1_en: The craftsman carved a wooden bird for the display.
example1_zh: 那位工匠雕了一只木鸟用于展示。
example2_en: Supporting local craftsmen can preserve traditional skills while providing communities with sustainable sources of income.
example2_zh: 支持当地手艺人既能保护传统技艺，也能为社区提供可持续的收入来源。
collocations: a skilled craftsman｜技艺娴熟的工匠 ; a master craftsman｜工艺大师 ; a traditional craftsman｜传统手艺人
tip_zh: 复数为craftsmen；性别中性表达可用craftsperson。

meanings_zh: v. 排放；发出
definition_en: to release gas, heat, light, or sound
example1_en: These small lamps emit a soft, warm light.
example1_zh: 这些小灯发出柔和温暖的光。
example2_en: Factories that emit harmful gases should install cleaner technology to reduce their impact on public health.
example2_zh: 排放有害气体的工厂应安装更清洁的技术设备，以减少对公众健康的影响。
collocations: emit light｜发光 ; emit radiation｜释放辐射 ; emit greenhouse gases｜排放温室气体
tip_zh: 过去式 emitted，进行式 emitting，均双写 t。

meanings_zh: n. 不耐烦；焦躁 | n. 急切；迫不及待
definition_en: annoyance caused by waiting, delays, or other people's behaviour | a strong desire for something to happen soon
example1_en: She tapped her foot with impatience as the queue stalled.
example1_zh: 队伍停滞不前，她不耐烦地用脚轻敲地面。
example2_en: Growing impatience with unreliable public transport may encourage commuters to use private cars, increasing urban congestion.
example2_zh: 人们对不可靠的公共交通日益不耐烦，可能促使通勤者转而使用私家车，加剧城市拥堵。
collocations: impatience with delays｜对延误的不耐烦 ; show impatience｜显出不耐烦 ; growing impatience｜日益强烈的焦躁 ; with impatience｜急切地；不耐烦地
tip_zh: 通常不可数；对某人或事不耐烦常接with。

meanings_zh: adj. 有机种植的；有机的 | adj. 有机物的；生物体的 | adj. 自然发展的
definition_en: produced without artificial fertilizers or most synthetic pesticides | relating to living things or carbon-based substances | developing gradually and naturally rather than through outside intervention
example1_en: She buys organic carrots from a nearby farm.
example1_zh: 她从附近的农场购买有机胡萝卜。
example2_en: Organic farming can support biodiversity, although its lower yields may require more land for food production.
example2_zh: 有机农业有助于维持生物多样性，但其较低的产量可能意味着粮食生产需要更多土地。
collocations: organic food｜有机食品 ; organic farming｜有机农业 ; organic matter｜有机物 ; organic growth｜自然增长
tip_zh: 食品语境指有机生产；化学语境通常指含碳化合物。

meanings_zh: v. 不予考虑；不理会 | v. 解雇；开除 | v. 让离开；解散
definition_en: to decide something is not worth considering | to officially remove someone from their job | to tell someone or a group they may leave
example1_en: Don't dismiss her idea before you hear the details.
example1_zh: 听完细节之前，别急着否定她的想法。
example2_en: Governments should not dismiss public concerns about the long-term environmental effects of industrial expansion.
example2_zh: 政府不应忽视公众对工业扩张长期环境影响的担忧。
collocations: dismiss concerns｜不理会担忧 ; dismiss an idea｜否定想法 ; dismiss someone from a job｜解雇某人 ; dismiss something as irrelevant｜认为某事无关而不予考虑
tip_zh: dismiss A as B：认为A是B而不予考虑。

meanings_zh: n. 移民入境；移居 | n. 入境检查；入境检查处
definition_en: The process of entering another country to live there. | The official checks or checkpoint for people entering a country.
example1_en: We showed our passports at immigration after the flight.
example1_zh: 下飞机后，我们在入境检查处出示了护照。
example2_en: Immigration can help address labour shortages, particularly when newcomers receive language training and employment support.
example2_zh: 移民可以帮助缓解劳动力短缺，尤其是在新移民获得语言培训和就业支持的情况下。
collocations: immigration policy｜移民政策 ; immigration control｜入境管制 ; immigration officer｜入境事务官员 ; go through immigration｜接受入境检查
tip_zh: immigration强调迁入；emigration强调迁出。

meanings_zh: n. 利益关系；股份 | n. 桩；尖头木棍 | v. 以……冒险；押上
definition_en: a financial share or personal interest in something | a pointed post driven into the ground | to risk money or something valuable on an outcome
example1_en: She bought a small stake in her sister's bakery.
example1_zh: 她购买了姐姐那家面包店的一小部分股份。
example2_en: Residents have a stake in urban planning because development decisions directly affect their quality of life.
example2_zh: 居民与城市规划有切身利益关系，因为开发决策会直接影响他们的生活质量。
collocations: a stake in｜在……中的权益 ; at stake｜处于危险中 ; stake a claim｜主张权利 ; stake your reputation on｜以声誉赌……
tip_zh: have a stake in指有利益关系；at stake指面临风险。

meanings_zh: adv. 向前；向外
definition_en: Forward or out from a place.
example1_en: The kitten ran back and forth across the kitchen.
example1_zh: 小猫在厨房里来回跑。
example2_en: Residents put forth several practical proposals to improve public transport without increasing costs significantly.
example2_zh: 居民提出了几项切实可行的建议，以在不大幅增加成本的情况下改善公共交通。
collocations: back and forth｜来回地 ; put forth a proposal｜提出建议 ; set forth｜阐述；出发 ; and so forth｜等等
tip_zh: 常见于固定搭配；勿与表示“第四”的fourth混淆。

meanings_zh: n. 伏特（电压单位）
definition_en: A unit used to measure electrical potential difference
example1_en: This small battery supplies just one and a half volts.
example1_zh: 这节小电池只能提供一点五伏的电压。
example2_en: Engineers measure electrical potential difference in volts when designing safe and efficient systems for homes and factories.
example2_zh: 工程师为住宅和工厂设计安全高效的系统时，用伏特来计量电势差。
collocations: measure in volts｜以伏特计量 ; a twelve-volt battery｜十二伏电池 ; a voltage of five volts｜五伏电压
tip_zh: 伏特衡量电压；瓦特 watt 衡量功率。

meanings_zh: n. 肥料
definition_en: a substance added to soil to help plants grow
example1_en: We added fertilizer to help the tomato plants grow.
example1_zh: 我们施了肥，帮助番茄植株生长。
example2_en: Excessive use of chemical fertilizer can pollute nearby rivers and damage the ecosystems that depend on them.
example2_zh: 过量使用化肥会污染附近河流，破坏依赖这些河流的生态系统。
collocations: chemical fertilizer｜化肥 ; organic fertilizer｜有机肥 ; apply fertilizer｜施肥
tip_zh: 英式也拼作fertiliser；泛指肥料时常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 出版；发表 | n. 出版物
definition_en: The process of making written material available to the public. | A book, magazine, or other work made available to readers.
example1_en: Her first cookbook is ready for publication next month.
example1_zh: 她的第一本食谱已准备好，将于下月出版。
example2_en: The publication of research findings allows other scientists to evaluate the evidence and develop new theories.
example2_zh: 研究成果的发表让其他科学家能够评估证据并提出新理论。
collocations: publication date｜出版日期 ; publication of findings｜研究结果的发表 ; academic publication｜学术出版物
tip_zh: 指出版行为时不可数；指具体出版物时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 光束；射束 | n. 梁；横梁 | v. 笑容满面
definition_en: a narrow stream of light or other energy | a long, strong piece supporting a roof or floor | to smile with obvious happiness
example1_en: A beam of sunlight fell across the kitchen table.
example1_zh: 一束阳光洒在厨房的桌子上。
example2_en: Engineers used steel beams to strengthen the old bridge and improve safety for local residents.
example2_zh: 工程师用钢梁加固旧桥，提高当地居民的通行安全。
collocations: a beam of light｜一束光 ; steel beam｜钢梁 ; beam with pride｜自豪地满面笑容
tip_zh: 光束和横梁都可数；beam at sb指对某人笑容满面。

meanings_zh: v. 等待；期待 | v. 即将发生于；等待着
definition_en: To wait for someone or something | To be ready or likely to happen to someone
example1_en: We eagerly await the arrival of our new puppy.
example1_zh: 我们热切地等待着新来的小狗到家。
example2_en: Many graduates await job offers while developing additional skills through voluntary work and online courses.
example2_zh: 许多毕业生在等待录用通知期间，通过志愿工作和在线课程学习更多技能。
collocations: await a decision｜等待决定 ; eagerly await｜热切期待 ; await confirmation｜等待确认 ; challenges await｜挑战在前方等待
tip_zh: 较正式，直接接宾语；不要写await for。

meanings_zh: n. 弱点；不足 | n. 虚弱；无力 | n. 特别喜爱；嗜好
definition_en: a feature that makes someone or something less effective | a lack of physical strength or energy | a strong liking that is difficult to resist
example1_en: My main weakness in cooking is getting the timing right.
example1_zh: 我做饭的主要短板是掌握不好时间。
example2_en: The recent transport disruption exposed a serious weakness in the city's emergency planning system.
example2_zh: 最近的交通中断暴露了该市应急规划体系中的一个严重弱点。
collocations: strengths and weaknesses｜优点与缺点 ; muscle weakness｜肌肉无力 ; a weakness for chocolate｜对巧克力的特别喜爱
tip_zh: 弱点通常可数；虚弱不可数；偏爱用a weakness for。

meanings_zh: n. 掌声；鼓掌 | n. 赞许；赞扬
definition_en: the sound of people clapping to show approval | strong approval or praise for someone or something
example1_en: The audience burst into applause as the curtain fell.
example1_zh: 幕布落下时，观众爆发出热烈的掌声。
example2_en: The proposal received widespread applause for making public transport more accessible to passengers with disabilities.
example2_zh: 这项提案因让残障乘客更方便地使用公共交通而广受赞誉。
collocations: a round of applause｜一阵掌声 ; thunderous applause｜雷鸣般的掌声 ; burst into applause｜突然鼓起掌来
tip_zh: 不可数；“一阵掌声”用 a round of applause。

meanings_zh: adj. 中世纪的
definition_en: relating to European history from about AD 500 to 1500
example1_en: We explored a medieval castle during our weekend trip.
example1_zh: 我们在周末旅行中游览了一座中世纪城堡。
example2_en: Preserving medieval buildings allows modern communities to understand how earlier generations lived, worked, and organised their societies.
example2_zh: 保护中世纪建筑能让现代社区了解前人如何生活、工作及组织社会。
collocations: medieval architecture｜中世纪建筑风格 ; a medieval castle｜中世纪城堡 ; medieval history｜中世纪史 ; medieval Europe｜中世纪欧洲
tip_zh: 通常指欧洲约公元500至1500年的中世纪。

meanings_zh: n. 指导；指引
definition_en: help or advice about what to do or how to proceed
example1_en: With your guidance, I finally planted the seeds correctly.
example1_zh: 在你的指导下，我终于把种子种对了。
example2_en: Schools should provide career guidance to help students make informed decisions about further education and employment.
example2_zh: 学校应提供职业指导，帮助学生在升学和就业方面作出明智的决定。
collocations: career guidance｜职业指导 ; provide guidance｜提供指导 ; seek guidance｜寻求指导 ; under someone's guidance｜在某人的指导下
tip_zh: 不可数名词；说some guidance，不说a guidance。

meanings_zh: n. 创业者；企业家
definition_en: someone who starts a business and takes financial risks
example1_en: The young entrepreneur opened a bakery near our station.
example1_zh: 那位年轻创业者在我们车站附近开了一家面包店。
example2_en: Local governments can support entrepreneurs by simplifying regulations and improving access to affordable loans.
example2_zh: 地方政府可以通过简化规定、便利获取低息贷款来支持创业者。
collocations: a successful entrepreneur｜成功的企业家 ; a young entrepreneur｜年轻创业者 ; a social entrepreneur｜社会企业家
tip_zh: 强调创办企业并承担风险，不泛指经理。

meanings_zh: v. 向……行贿 | n. 贿赂；贿赂物
definition_en: Offer rewards to make someone act dishonestly in your favour. | Money or gifts offered to influence someone dishonestly.
example1_en: The driver tried to bribe the officer with cash.
example1_zh: 那名司机试图用现金贿赂警察。
example2_en: Strict penalties for companies that bribe public officials can help restore trust in government institutions.
example2_zh: 严惩向公职人员行贿的公司，有助于恢复公众对政府机构的信任。
collocations: offer a bribe｜行贿 ; accept a bribe｜受贿 ; bribe an official｜贿赂官员 ; bribe someone into doing something｜贿赂某人做某事
tip_zh: bribe的宾语是受贿者；bribery指行贿受贿行为。

meanings_zh: adj. 非凡的；引人注目的
definition_en: unusual or impressive enough to deserve special attention
example1_en: The injured bird made a remarkable recovery within weeks.
example1_zh: 这只受伤的鸟在几周内恢复得出奇地好。
example2_en: Recent advances in renewable energy demonstrate the remarkable potential of technology to reduce dependence on fossil fuels.
example2_zh: 可再生能源领域的近期进展表明，技术在减少对化石燃料的依赖方面具有非凡潜力。
collocations: remarkable achievement｜非凡的成就 ; remarkable recovery｜惊人的康复 ; remarkable progress｜显著的进步 ; remarkable ability｜非凡的能力
tip_zh: 表示值得注意，常含赞赏，但不一定只描述好事。

meanings_zh: n. 制作；制造 | n. 成功的促成因素 | n. 所需素质；必要条件
definition_en: The process of producing or creating something. | Something that causes someone or something to become successful. | The qualities or materials needed for something to develop.
example1_en: We spent the afternoon learning the basics of bread making.
example1_zh: 我们花了一下午学习制作面包的基础方法。
example2_en: Involving residents in the making of local policy can increase public trust and improve community outcomes.
example2_zh: 让居民参与地方政策的制定，可以增强公众信任并改善社区发展成效。
collocations: the making of a film｜电影的制作 ; in the making｜在形成中 ; be the making of someone｜促成某人的成功 ; have the makings of｜具备成为……的素质
tip_zh: 表“潜质”用复数makings：have the makings of。

meanings_zh: adj. 钝的；不锋利的 | adj. 直言不讳的；生硬的 | v. 使变钝；削弱
definition_en: Having an edge or point that does not cut easily. | Speaking directly without trying to avoid upsetting people. | To make something less sharp, powerful, or effective.
example1_en: This blunt knife cannot even cut a ripe tomato.
example1_zh: 这把钝刀连熟透的番茄都切不开。
example2_en: Although blunt feedback can feel uncomfortable, it sometimes helps students identify weaknesses in their work.
example2_zh: 虽然直白的反馈可能让人不舒服，但有时能帮助学生发现作业中的不足。
collocations: a blunt knife｜钝刀 ; a blunt answer｜生硬的回答 ; blunt the impact｜减弱冲击
tip_zh: 形容言语时指直接甚至冒犯，不一定是褒义。

meanings_zh: n. 亚麻布 | n. 床单、桌布等家用织物
definition_en: strong cloth made from fibres of the flax plant | household cloth items such as sheets, pillowcases, and tablecloths
example1_en: I wore a linen shirt on the hot afternoon.
example1_zh: 那个炎热的下午，我穿了一件亚麻衬衫。
example2_en: Hotels can reduce water consumption by encouraging guests to reuse towels and change bed linen less frequently.
example2_zh: 酒店可以鼓励住客重复使用毛巾并降低床上用品的更换频率，以减少用水量。
collocations: a linen shirt｜亚麻衬衫 ; bed linen｜床上用品 ; table linen｜餐桌用织物 ; fresh linen｜干净的床单等织物
tip_zh: 通常不可数；bed linen不一定由亚麻制成。

meanings_zh: n. 切割工具；切割机
definition_en: A tool or machine used to cut materials.
example1_en: Use this pastry cutter to make round biscuits.
example1_zh: 用这个面点切模做圆形饼干。
example2_en: A modern laser cutter can reduce material waste and improve precision in furniture production.
example2_zh: 现代激光切割机可以减少材料浪费，提高家具生产的精度。
collocations: laser cutter｜激光切割机 ; pastry cutter｜面点切模 ; wire cutters｜剪线钳
tip_zh: 常与材料或技术名连用；wire cutters通常用复数。

meanings_zh: adj. 费力的；要求高的 | adj. 苛求的；难以满足的
definition_en: Requiring considerable effort, skill, time, or attention. | Expecting a great deal of attention or effort from others.
example1_en: After a demanding shift, I fell asleep on the bus.
example1_zh: 忙完一班累人的工作后，我在公交车上睡着了。
example2_en: Physically demanding jobs may require additional safety measures to protect workers from injuries and long-term health problems.
example2_zh: 体力要求高的工作可能需要额外的安全措施，以保护劳动者免受伤害和长期健康问题的影响。
collocations: physically demanding｜耗费体力的 ; mentally demanding｜耗费脑力的 ; demanding job｜要求高的工作 ; demanding customer｜苛求的顾客
tip_zh: 修饰任务指费力；修饰人指要求高、难满足。

meanings_zh: adv. 据说；据信
definition_en: according to what people say, though it may be untrue
example1_en: This shortcut is supposedly quicker, but we keep getting lost.
example1_zh: 据说这条近路更快，可我们一直迷路。
example2_en: Some supposedly environmentally friendly products still require substantial energy to manufacture and transport to consumers.
example2_zh: 一些号称环保的产品在生产和运送到消费者手中的过程中，仍需消耗大量能源。
collocations: supposedly true｜据说属实的 ; supposedly harmless｜据称无害的 ; supposedly independent｜号称独立的
tip_zh: 常暗示对说法存疑，不表示自己凭空想象。

meanings_zh: v. 雕刻 | v. 切成片
definition_en: to shape wood or stone by cutting away material | to cut cooked meat into slices for serving
example1_en: My grandfather carved a little bird from soft wood.
example1_zh: 我祖父用软木雕了一只小鸟。
example2_en: Local artisans carve traditional patterns into wooden furniture, preserving cultural skills while creating products for modern homes.
example2_zh: 当地工匠在木制家具上雕刻传统图案，既保留文化技艺，也为现代家庭制作产品。
collocations: carve wood｜雕刻木头 ; carve a statue｜雕刻雕像 ; carve meat｜把肉切片 ; carve out a career｜开创事业
tip_zh: carve强调削刻成形；carve out a career指开创事业。

meanings_zh: v. 隐藏；遮住 | v. 隐瞒；掩饰
definition_en: To keep something from being seen | To prevent facts or feelings from becoming known
example1_en: She concealed the birthday present behind a large cushion.
example1_zh: 她把生日礼物藏在一个大靠垫后面。
example2_en: Companies that conceal environmental damage from the public risk losing consumer trust when the truth emerges.
example2_zh: 企业若向公众隐瞒环境破坏情况，真相曝光时就可能失去消费者的信任。
collocations: conceal evidence｜隐藏证据 ; conceal the truth｜隐瞒真相 ; conceal feelings｜掩饰情绪 ; conceal something from someone｜对某人隐瞒某事
tip_zh: conceal比hide正式；常用conceal sth from sb。

meanings_zh: adj. 水平的；横向的
definition_en: Flat or level, running parallel to the ground
example1_en: Keep the shelf horizontal while I tighten the screws.
example1_zh: 我拧紧螺丝时，请让架板保持水平。
example2_en: The horizontal axis shows time, allowing readers to compare changes in employment across the period.
example2_zh: 横轴表示时间，方便读者比较该时期内的就业变化。
collocations: horizontal axis｜横轴 ; horizontal line｜水平线 ; horizontal position｜水平位置
tip_zh: horizontal是水平的，vertical是垂直的。

meanings_zh: n. 策略；战略
definition_en: a planned approach for achieving a particular goal
example1_en: Our strategy was to save a little every week.
example1_zh: 我们的策略是每周存一点钱。
example2_en: An effective transport strategy should improve public services while reducing dependence on private cars.
example2_zh: 有效的交通策略应在改善公共服务的同时减少对私家车的依赖。
collocations: develop a strategy｜制定策略 ; implement a strategy｜实施策略 ; long-term strategy｜长期战略 ; a strategy for growth｜增长策略
tip_zh: 常用a strategy for doing sth表示做某事的策略。

meanings_zh: n. 马达；电动机 | adj. 机动车的 | adj. 肌肉运动的
definition_en: A machine that supplies power to move or operate something. | Relating to vehicles powered by engines or motors. | Relating to muscles, movement, or the nerves controlling them.
example1_en: The fan stopped because its motor had become too hot.
example1_zh: 风扇停了，因为它的电动机过热了。
example2_en: Activities such as drawing and building with blocks help young children develop fine motor skills.
example2_zh: 画画和搭积木等活动有助于幼儿发展精细动作技能。
collocations: an electric motor｜电动机 ; motor vehicles｜机动车 ; the motor industry｜汽车工业 ; fine motor skills｜精细动作技能
tip_zh: motor skills指身体动作技能，与汽车无关。

meanings_zh: v. 漫步；闲逛；游荡 | v. 走神；偏离话题
definition_en: to move around without a fixed route or purpose | to stop concentrating or move away from the main subject
example1_en: We wandered through the market and bought some peaches.
example1_zh: 我们在市场里闲逛，买了些桃子。
example2_en: Visitors who wander beyond popular tourist areas often discover local businesses that benefit from additional spending.
example2_zh: 走出热门旅游区随意逛逛的游客，常能发现一些因额外消费而受益的当地商家。
collocations: wander around｜四处闲逛 ; wander off｜走开；走失 ; let your mind wander｜任思绪游走 ; wander off the subject｜偏离话题
tip_zh: wander指漫游；wonder指想知道，注意拼写。

meanings_zh: v. 溅；泼洒 | n. 溅起的水花；泼水声 | n. 少量液体；一抹色彩
definition_en: To make liquid scatter in drops or hit something. | Scattered drops of liquid, or the sound they make. | A small amount of liquid or a noticeable patch of colour.
example1_en: The dog splashed water all over my trousers.
example1_zh: 那只狗把水溅得我裤子上到处都是。
example2_en: Vehicles travelling through flooded streets can splash dirty water onto pedestrians and damage nearby shop displays.
example2_zh: 车辆驶过积水街道时，可能把污水溅到行人身上，并损坏附近商店的陈列品。
collocations: splash water on｜把水溅到……上 ; a splash of colour｜一抹亮色 ; make a splash｜引起轰动 ; splash out on｜在……上大笔花钱
tip_zh: splash out on是英式口语，指大手笔花钱买某物。

meanings_zh: n. 灭绝；消亡
definition_en: the complete disappearance of a species or type of thing
example1_en: These rare birds face extinction if their forest disappears.
example1_zh: 如果这片森林消失，这些珍稀鸟类就会面临灭绝。
example2_en: Protecting natural habitats is essential to preventing the extinction of species threatened by intensive farming and urban expansion.
example2_zh: 保护自然栖息地对于防止受集约化农业和城市扩张威胁的物种灭绝至关重要。
collocations: face extinction｜面临灭绝 ; on the brink of extinction｜濒临灭绝 ; mass extinction｜大规模灭绝 ; prevent extinction｜防止灭绝
tip_zh: extinct是形容词；extinction是通常不可数的名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 衣服宽松下垂的
definition_en: Loose and hanging away from the body.
example1_en: These baggy trousers feel comfortable on long train journeys.
example1_zh: 长途坐火车时，穿这条宽松的裤子很舒服。
example2_en: Some young people choose baggy clothing to express their identity rather than follow traditional expectations.
example2_zh: 一些年轻人选择宽松的衣服来表达自我，而非遵循传统期待。
collocations: baggy trousers｜宽松的裤子 ; baggy jeans｜宽松牛仔裤 ; a baggy sweater｜宽大的毛衣
tip_zh: baggy形容衣服宽大松垮，不是泛指袋子的形状。

meanings_zh: adj. 暴力的；凶暴的 | adj. 猛烈的；剧烈的
definition_en: Using physical force to hurt people or damage things. | Extremely strong, sudden, or forceful.
example1_en: A violent storm shook the windows throughout the night.
example1_zh: 一场猛烈的暴风雨整夜震得窗户直响。
example2_en: Reducing children's exposure to violent content is a common concern among parents and educators.
example2_zh: 减少儿童接触暴力内容，是家长和教育工作者共同关注的问题。
collocations: violent behaviour｜暴力行为 ; violent crime｜暴力犯罪 ; a violent storm｜猛烈的暴风雨
tip_zh: 既可指行为有暴力，也可形容风暴、震动猛烈。

meanings_zh: adj. 机密的；保密的
definition_en: Intended to remain private and not be shared without permission.
example1_en: Please keep this confidential until I tell my family.
example1_zh: 在我告诉家人之前，请对此保密。
example2_en: Hospitals must protect confidential patient information to maintain public trust in the healthcare system.
example2_zh: 医院必须保护患者的保密信息，以维持公众对医疗体系的信任。
collocations: confidential information｜机密信息 ; keep something confidential｜对某事保密 ; strictly confidential｜绝密的
tip_zh: confidential指保密的；confident指有信心的。

meanings_zh: n. 优先事项；首要任务 | n. 优先权；优先地位
definition_en: something considered more important than other things | the right to receive attention or action before others
example1_en: Finding a warm home is our main priority now.
example1_zh: 找到一个温暖的家是我们现在的首要任务。
example2_en: Governments should give priority to preventive healthcare rather than focus exclusively on treating existing illnesses.
example2_zh: 政府应优先重视预防性医疗，而不是只关注治疗已有疾病。
collocations: top priority｜首要任务 ; give priority to｜优先考虑 ; take priority over｜比……优先 ; set priorities｜确定优先次序
tip_zh: give priority to后接优先考虑的事物。

meanings_zh: n. 大理石 | n. 弹珠
definition_en: a hard stone with patterns, used for buildings and sculptures | a small glass ball used in children's games
example1_en: The cool marble floor felt smooth under my feet.
example1_zh: 凉凉的大理石地板踩在脚下很光滑。
example2_en: Although marble enhances the appearance of public buildings, extracting it can damage surrounding landscapes and habitats.
example2_zh: 虽然大理石能提升公共建筑的外观，但开采它可能破坏周围景观和栖息地。
collocations: marble floor｜大理石地板 ; marble statue｜大理石雕像 ; play marbles｜玩弹珠
tip_zh: 指大理石时不可数；指弹珠时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 勇敢；勇气
definition_en: The courage to face danger, pain, or difficult situations.
example1_en: The little girl showed bravery during her first injection.
example1_zh: 那个小女孩第一次打针时表现得很勇敢。
example2_en: Emergency workers demonstrate remarkable bravery when they enter dangerous areas to rescue people after natural disasters.
example2_zh: 自然灾害发生后，应急救援人员进入危险地区营救民众，展现出非凡的勇气。
collocations: show bravery｜表现出勇气 ; remarkable bravery｜非凡的勇气 ; an act of bravery｜英勇之举
tip_zh: 不可数名词；一次英勇行为用an act of bravery。

meanings_zh: n. 组成部分；零部件 | adj. 组成的；构成的
definition_en: One of the parts that together form a whole. | Forming part of a larger whole.
example1_en: The technician replaced a broken component inside my laptop.
example1_zh: 技术员更换了我笔记本电脑里的一个损坏零件。
example2_en: Reliable public transport is a key component of urban planning that aims to reduce traffic congestion.
example2_zh: 可靠的公共交通是旨在缓解交通拥堵的城市规划的重要组成部分。
collocations: a key component｜关键组成部分 ; electronic components｜电子元件 ; component parts｜组成部件
tip_zh: a component of表示“……的组成部分”。

meanings_zh: n. 节日或重大事件的前夕 | n. 夏娃
definition_en: The day or evening before a special day or event. | The first woman in the biblical account of creation.
example1_en: We cooked a special dinner together on New Year's Eve.
example1_zh: 我们在除夕夜一起做了一顿特别的晚餐。
example2_en: On New Year's Eve, cities often extend public transport services to help large crowds travel home safely.
example2_zh: 在除夕夜，城市往往延长公共交通的运营时间，帮助大批人群安全返家。
collocations: New Year's Eve｜新年前夜 ; Christmas Eve｜圣诞前夜 ; on the eve of｜在……前夕
tip_zh: 普通名词eve通常小写；节日名称中大写，Eve也指夏娃。

meanings_zh: adv. 以前；从前
definition_en: in the past, but not now
example1_en: This bright café was formerly a small bicycle shop.
example1_zh: 这家明亮的咖啡馆以前是一家小自行车店。
example2_en: Buildings formerly used for manufacturing can be converted into affordable housing while preserving their distinctive architectural features.
example2_zh: 以前用于制造业的建筑可以改建成经济适用住房，同时保留其独特的建筑特色。
collocations: formerly known as｜以前称为 ; formerly owned by｜以前归……所有 ; formerly used for｜以前用于
tip_zh: formerly指“以前”；formally指“正式地”。

meanings_zh: v. 猛推；乱塞 | n. 猛推
definition_en: to push roughly or put something somewhere carelessly | a strong, rough push
example1_en: I shoved my gloves into my bag and hurried outside.
example1_zh: 我把手套塞进包里，匆匆走了出去。
example2_en: Passengers may shove one another when overcrowded stations lack effective systems for managing queues during peak hours.
example2_zh: 在高峰时段，拥挤的车站若缺乏有效的排队管理措施，乘客可能会互相推搡。
collocations: shove something into a bag｜把某物塞进包里 ; give something a shove｜猛推某物一下 ; shove past someone｜从某人身边挤过去
tip_zh: 比push更强调用力或粗鲁；塞东西也可用。

meanings_zh: n. 陶艺；陶瓷制作 | n. 陶瓷制品
definition_en: the art and process of making objects from fired clay | objects made from clay and hardened by heat
example1_en: I started learning ceramics at a local studio.
example1_zh: 我开始在当地一家工作室学习陶艺。
example2_en: Traditional ceramics can attract tourists while providing a reliable source of income for local craftspeople.
example2_zh: 传统陶瓷制品既能吸引游客，也能为当地手艺人提供可靠的收入来源。
collocations: ceramics class｜陶艺课 ; traditional ceramics｜传统陶瓷制品 ; ceramics studio｜陶艺工作室
tip_zh: 指陶艺时作单数；指多件陶瓷制品时作复数。

meanings_zh: n. 自然环境保护 | n. 节约；资源保护 | n. 文物保护；保存
definition_en: the protection of wildlife and natural environments | careful use of resources to avoid waste | the protection and repair of valuable old objects or buildings
example1_en: Our class joined a conservation project to protect local frogs.
example1_zh: 我们班参加了一个保护当地青蛙的自然保护项目。
example2_en: Successful wildlife conservation requires cooperation between local communities, researchers, and governments over many years.
example2_zh: 成功的野生动物保护需要当地社区、研究人员和政府长期合作。
collocations: wildlife conservation｜野生动物保护 ; energy conservation｜节能 ; water conservation｜节约用水 ; conservation efforts｜保护工作
tip_zh: 通常不可数；可指保护自然，也可指节约能源。

meanings_zh: v. 移居国外
definition_en: To leave your country to live permanently in another
example1_en: Her grandparents emigrated to Canada when they were young.
example1_zh: 她的祖父母年轻时移居到了加拿大。
example2_en: Skilled workers may emigrate when their home countries offer limited opportunities for professional development.
example2_zh: 当本国提供的职业发展机会有限时，技术人才可能会移居国外。
collocations: emigrate from｜从……移居国外 ; emigrate to｜移居到 ; emigrate permanently｜永久移居国外
tip_zh: emigrate强调迁出，immigrate强调迁入；搭配from或to。

meanings_zh: n. 听力；听觉 | n. 听证会；庭审
definition_en: The ability to notice sounds through your ears. | An official meeting to consider evidence or arguments.
example1_en: My grandfather's hearing improved after he received a hearing aid.
example1_zh: 祖父配了助听器后，听得更清楚了。
example2_en: A public hearing allows residents to express concerns before major construction projects receive official approval.
example2_zh: 公开听证会让居民能在大型建设项目获得正式批准前表达关切。
collocations: hearing loss｜听力损失 ; a hearing aid｜助听器 ; a public hearing｜公开听证会 ; a court hearing｜庭审
tip_zh: 指听力时不可数；指听证会时可数。

meanings_zh: v. 整合；使结合 | v. 融入；使融入
definition_en: To combine separate parts so they work together effectively. | To join, or help someone join, a group or society.
example1_en: This app integrates my calendar with my shopping list.
example1_zh: 这个应用将我的日历和购物清单整合在一起。
example2_en: Schools should integrate digital tools into classroom activities while ensuring that all students have equal access.
example2_zh: 学校应将数字工具融入课堂活动，同时确保所有学生都能平等使用。
collocations: integrate A into B｜将A融入B ; integrate with｜与……结合 ; integrate into society｜融入社会
tip_zh: 常用integrate A into B，也可用integrate A with B。

meanings_zh: adj. 弯曲的；弧形的
definition_en: Having a smoothly bending shape rather than a straight one.
example1_en: A curved path leads from our gate to the pond.
example1_zh: 一条弯曲的小路从我们的大门通向池塘。
example2_en: Curved building designs can create distinctive urban landmarks, although they may require more complex construction techniques.
example2_zh: 弧形建筑设计能打造独特的城市地标，但可能需要更复杂的施工技术。
collocations: curved surface｜曲面 ; curved line｜曲线 ; curved roof｜弧形屋顶
tip_zh: curved强调平滑弧度；bent也可指折弯。

meanings_zh: n. 窗板；百叶窗 | n. 相机快门 | v. 关闭；停业
definition_en: A movable panel that covers and protects a window | A camera mechanism controlling how long light enters | To close a building or business, temporarily or permanently
example1_en: I closed the wooden shutters before the storm arrived.
example1_zh: 暴风雨来临前，我关上了木制窗板。
example2_en: Photographers use a fast shutter speed to capture moving wildlife clearly without disturbing its natural behaviour.
example2_zh: 摄影师使用较快的快门速度，在不干扰野生动物自然行为的情况下清晰捕捉其动态。
collocations: close the shutters｜关上窗板 ; wooden shutters｜木制窗板 ; shutter speed｜快门速度 ; shutter a factory｜关闭工厂
tip_zh: 窗板常用复数shutters；快门速度用shutter speed。

meanings_zh: n. 批改；评分 | n. 斑纹；标线
definition_en: The work of checking and grading students' answers. | A visible pattern or line on an animal or surface.
example1_en: The teacher finished her marking before cooking dinner.
example1_zh: 老师在做晚饭前完成了批改工作。
example2_en: Clear marking guidelines help ensure that students receive fair grades regardless of who assesses their work.
example2_zh: 明确的评分指南有助于确保无论由谁评阅，学生都能获得公平的成绩。
collocations: marking scheme｜评分细则 ; road markings｜道路标线 ; distinctive markings｜独特的斑纹
tip_zh: 批改义通常不可数；斑纹、道路标线常用复数。

meanings_zh: n. 准许进入；录取 | n. 入场费 | n. 承认；供认
definition_en: Permission to enter a place or join an institution | The money paid to enter a place | A statement accepting that something is true, often something unpleasant
example1_en: Admission to the museum is free on Sundays.
example1_zh: 这家博物馆周日免费开放。
example2_en: University admission should reflect academic potential rather than simply rewarding access to expensive private education.
example2_zh: 大学录取应看重学术潜力，而非仅仅让能接受昂贵私立教育的人获益。
collocations: admission to university｜大学录取 ; admission fee｜入场费 ; free admission｜免费入场 ; admission of guilt｜认罪
tip_zh: 进入某处用admission to；承认某事用admission of。

meanings_zh: adj. 独有的；专用的 | adj. 高档的；仅限少数人的 | n. 独家新闻
definition_en: Available only to a particular person or group. | Expensive and available mainly to wealthy or privileged people. | A news story published by only one media organisation.
example1_en: Guests have exclusive use of the pool this afternoon.
example1_zh: 今天下午泳池仅供住客使用。
example2_en: Giving one company exclusive rights to public data may restrict competition and discourage innovation.
example2_zh: 授予一家公司公共数据的独家使用权，可能限制竞争并阻碍创新。
collocations: exclusive access｜专享使用权 ; exclusive rights｜独家权利 ; exclusive interview｜独家采访 ; mutually exclusive｜互不相容的
tip_zh: exclusive to表示“为……独有”；exclusive of指不含。

meanings_zh: n. 尊严 | n. 庄重；自尊的仪态
definition_en: A person's worth and right to be treated with respect. | Calm, controlled behaviour that earns respect.
example1_en: The nurse protected his dignity by closing the curtain.
example1_zh: 护士拉上帘子，维护了他的尊严。
example2_en: Care services should preserve the dignity of older people by respecting their privacy and personal choices.
example2_zh: 护理服务应尊重老年人的隐私和个人选择，维护他们的尊严。
collocations: human dignity｜人的尊严 ; preserve someone's dignity｜维护某人的尊严 ; treat someone with dignity｜有尊严地对待某人 ; a sense of dignity｜尊严感
tip_zh: 通常不可数；with dignity可表示有尊严地。

meanings_zh: n. 策略；手段；战术
definition_en: Specific methods used to achieve a goal or gain an advantage.
example1_en: Our coach changed tactics halfway through the football match.
example1_zh: 足球比赛进行到一半时，我们的教练改变了战术。
example2_en: Companies increasingly use digital marketing tactics to attract younger consumers and compete in crowded markets.
example2_zh: 企业越来越多地采用数字营销策略来吸引年轻消费者，并在竞争激烈的市场中争得优势。
collocations: change tactics｜改变战术 ; marketing tactics｜营销策略 ; negotiating tactics｜谈判策略 ; delaying tactics｜拖延手段
tip_zh: strategy侧重整体战略，tactics侧重具体手段。

meanings_zh: v. 抱怨；发牢骚 | n. 牢骚；抱怨 | v. 发出低沉轰鸣声
definition_en: to complain in an annoyed, often quiet way | a complaint about something that annoys you | to make a low, deep rumbling sound
example1_en: My brother grumbled about washing the dishes again.
example1_zh: 我哥哥抱怨又要洗碗。
example2_en: Although commuters often grumble about delays, many still prefer public transport because it reduces travel costs.
example2_zh: 尽管通勤者经常抱怨延误，许多人仍更愿意乘坐公共交通，因为这能降低出行成本。
collocations: grumble about delays｜抱怨延误 ; grumble at someone｜向某人发牢骚 ; a common grumble｜常见的抱怨
tip_zh: 常用grumble about sth，表示抱怨某事。

meanings_zh: n. 肉；肌肉组织 | n. 果肉
definition_en: The soft tissue between the skin and bones. | The soft inner part of a fruit or vegetable.
example1_en: The ripe peach had sweet flesh and a small stone.
example1_zh: 这颗熟桃果肉香甜，果核很小。
example2_en: Fruits with brightly coloured flesh often contain nutrients that contribute to a healthy, balanced diet.
example2_zh: 果肉颜色鲜艳的水果通常含有有助于健康均衡饮食的营养成分。
collocations: soft flesh｜柔软的肉 ; fruit flesh｜果肉 ; in the flesh｜本人；亲身 ; flesh and blood｜血肉之躯；亲骨肉
tip_zh: 一般不可数；食用的肉通常用meat，不用flesh。

meanings_zh: n. 显微镜
definition_en: An instrument that makes very small objects appear much larger.
example1_en: We examined a drop of pond water under the microscope.
example1_zh: 我们用显微镜观察了一滴池塘水。
example2_en: Using a microscope allows students to observe cell structures that are invisible to the naked eye.
example2_zh: 使用显微镜能让学生观察到肉眼无法看见的细胞结构。
collocations: under a microscope｜在显微镜下 ; electron microscope｜电子显微镜 ; light microscope｜光学显微镜
tip_zh: microscope看微小物体；telescope看远处物体。

meanings_zh: adj. 宽慰的；放心的
definition_en: No longer worried because something unpleasant has ended or been avoided
example1_en: I felt relieved when I finally found my keys.
example1_zh: 终于找到钥匙时，我松了一口气。
example2_en: Residents were relieved to hear that the local hospital would remain open despite proposed budget cuts.
example2_zh: 尽管有人提议削减预算，居民听说当地医院仍将继续运营，都松了一口气。
collocations: feel relieved｜感到宽慰 ; relieved to hear｜听到后感到放心 ; visibly relieved｜明显松了一口气
tip_zh: 常用be relieved to do或be relieved that从句。

meanings_zh: adj. 入门的；介绍性的 | adj. 首次推出时优惠的
definition_en: Providing basic information or presenting something for the first time. | Offered at a special price when something first becomes available.
example1_en: I joined an introductory pottery class last weekend.
example1_zh: 我上周末参加了一堂陶艺入门课。
example2_en: Universities should offer introductory courses in data analysis to students from all academic disciplines.
example2_zh: 大学应面向所有学科的学生开设数据分析入门课程。
collocations: introductory course｜入门课程 ; introductory remarks｜开场白 ; introductory offer｜新品推广优惠
tip_zh: introductory course指入门课，通常面向初学者。

meanings_zh: v. 继续进行 | v. 前往；行进
definition_en: Continue an activity or move to its next stage. | Move forward or travel towards a particular place.
example1_en: We can proceed with dinner once everyone arrives.
example1_zh: 等大家都到了，我们就可以继续安排晚餐了。
example2_en: Local authorities should consult residents before they proceed with major changes to public transport.
example2_zh: 地方政府在继续推进公共交通重大调整前，应征询居民意见。
collocations: proceed with a plan｜继续实施计划 ; proceed to the next stage｜进入下一阶段 ; proceed cautiously｜谨慎推进
tip_zh: proceed是动词；表示收入的名词是proceeds。

meanings_zh: v. 怀疑；猜想 | n. 嫌疑人 | adj. 可疑的；不可靠的
definition_en: To think something is likely true without being certain. | A person believed to have possibly committed a crime. | Not trustworthy or possibly wrong, unsafe, or dishonest.
example1_en: I suspect the cat knocked the cup off the table.
example1_zh: 我怀疑是猫把杯子从桌上碰掉了。
example2_en: Researchers suspect that prolonged screen use may affect sleep quality, although further evidence is needed.
example2_zh: 研究人员推测，长时间使用屏幕可能影响睡眠质量，不过仍需更多证据。
collocations: suspect that｜怀疑…… ; suspect someone of something｜怀疑某人有某种行为 ; a prime suspect｜主要嫌疑人 ; suspect evidence｜可疑的证据
tip_zh: 动词重音在后；名词、形容词读/ˈsʌspekt/。

meanings_zh: adj. 主要的；最重要的 | n. 校长；学院院长 | n. 本金
definition_en: most important among several things | the person in charge of a school or college | money borrowed or invested, excluding interest
example1_en: Our principal reason for moving was the noisy traffic.
example1_zh: 我们搬家的主要原因是交通噪声太大。
example2_en: The principal challenge facing urban planners is providing affordable housing without reducing access to green spaces.
example2_zh: 城市规划者面临的主要挑战是提供经济适用的住房，同时不减少居民享用绿地的机会。
collocations: the principal reason｜主要原因 ; a principal aim｜主要目标 ; a school principal｜校长 ; repay the principal｜偿还本金
tip_zh: principal指“主要的”或“校长”；principle指“原则”。

meanings_zh: v. 反对；抵制
definition_en: Disagree with something and try to prevent or change it.
example1_en: Our neighbours oppose building a road through the park.
example1_zh: 我们的邻居反对修建一条穿过公园的道路。
example2_en: Many residents oppose airport expansion because they fear increased noise and damage to local wildlife habitats.
example2_zh: 许多居民反对机场扩建，因为他们担心噪声增加以及当地野生动物栖息地受损。
collocations: strongly oppose｜强烈反对 ; oppose a proposal｜反对一项提议 ; oppose doing something｜反对做某事
tip_zh: oppose 后直接接名词或动名词，不加 to。

meanings_zh: adv. 同样地；也
definition_en: In the same way, or also.
example1_en: I folded my umbrella, and my sister did likewise.
example1_zh: 我收起雨伞，姐姐也照做了。
example2_en: Public libraries provide free internet access; likewise, community centres help residents develop essential digital skills.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆提供免费上网服务；同样，社区中心也帮助居民培养必要的数字技能。
collocations: do likewise｜照样做 ; likewise important｜同样重要 ; be likewise affected｜同样受到影响
tip_zh: 较正式，常用于连接相似情况；do likewise意为照做。

meanings_zh: adj. 所谓的；号称的 | adj. 通常称作的
definition_en: Described a certain way, though that description may be doubtful. | Known by a particular name or term.
example1_en: This so-called waterproof jacket let the rain straight through.
example1_zh: 这件号称防水的夹克竟让雨水直接渗了进来。
example2_en: Consumers should examine whether so-called green products actually reduce environmental harm throughout their life cycle.
example2_zh: 消费者应审视所谓的绿色产品是否确实在整个生命周期内减少环境危害。
collocations: so-called experts｜所谓的专家 ; so-called benefits｜所谓的好处 ; so-called green products｜号称环保的产品
tip_zh: 置于名词前，常含质疑，但也可中性引出名称。

meanings_zh: adj. 图形的；视觉艺术的 | adj. 生动详尽的 | n. 图形；图像
definition_en: Relating to pictures, drawings, or visual design. | Describing something very clearly, often with unpleasant details. | An image or diagram used to present information.
example1_en: My cousin studies graphic design and makes colourful posters.
example1_zh: 我表姐学习平面设计，还制作色彩鲜艳的海报。
example2_en: Effective graphic design can make complex health information easier for the general public to understand.
example2_zh: 有效的平面设计可以让公众更容易理解复杂的健康信息。
collocations: graphic design｜平面设计 ; a graphic designer｜平面设计师 ; a graphic description｜生动详尽的描述
tip_zh: graphic description常指令人不适的详细描述。

meanings_zh: n. 人造卫星 | n. 天然卫星
definition_en: A device orbiting Earth or another body, collecting or transmitting information. | A natural object that moves around a planet.
example1_en: The satellite sent back clear pictures of the storm.
example1_zh: 这颗卫星传回了风暴的清晰图像。
example2_en: Satellite observations allow scientists to monitor changes in forest cover across remote regions over time.
example2_zh: 卫星观测使科学家能够长期监测偏远地区森林覆盖的变化。
collocations: launch a satellite｜发射卫星 ; communications satellite｜通信卫星 ; satellite imagery｜卫星影像 ; natural satellite｜天然卫星
tip_zh: 可指人造或天然卫星；月球是地球的天然卫星。

meanings_zh: v. 投降；屈服 | v. 交出；放弃 | n. 投降；屈服
definition_en: to stop resisting and accept another side's control | to give up something, often because officially required | the act of stopping resistance and accepting another side's control
example1_en: The soldiers surrendered and walked forward with empty hands.
example1_zh: 士兵们投降了，空着双手向前走来。
example2_en: Users should not have to surrender control of their personal information to access essential online services.
example2_zh: 用户不应为了使用必要的在线服务而被迫放弃对个人信息的控制权。
collocations: surrender to｜向……投降 ; surrender control｜交出控制权 ; unconditional surrender｜无条件投降
tip_zh: surrender to sb指向某人投降；交出物品直接接宾语。

meanings_zh: n. 分析；解析
definition_en: Careful examination of something to understand its parts or meaning
example1_en: A soil analysis showed why my plants were struggling.
example1_zh: 土壤分析揭示了我的植物长势不佳的原因。
example2_en: Careful analysis of travel patterns can help planners design more efficient public transport networks.
example2_zh: 仔细分析出行模式可以帮助规划人员设计更高效的公共交通网络。
collocations: data analysis｜数据分析 ; detailed analysis｜详细分析 ; carry out an analysis｜进行分析 ; critical analysis｜批判性分析
tip_zh: 复数为analyses；英式动词为analyse。

meanings_zh: adv. 几乎不；勉强 | adv. 刚刚；才
definition_en: Almost not, or only just | Only a very short time before something else happens
example1_en: We could scarcely hear each other above the music.
example1_zh: 音乐声太大，我们几乎听不清彼此说话。
example2_en: Some rural communities have scarcely enough medical staff to provide basic healthcare for their growing populations.
example2_zh: 一些农村社区的医务人员仅勉强够为日益增长的人口提供基本医疗服务。
collocations: scarcely any｜几乎没有 ; scarcely enough｜勉强足够 ; scarcely ever｜几乎从不
tip_zh: 本身含否定意义，不再加not；scarcely…when指刚…就…。

meanings_zh: v. 评估；评价
definition_en: Carefully judge the quality, value or effectiveness of something
example1_en: We evaluated three cameras before choosing one for our trip.
example1_zh: 我们评估了三款相机，才选定一款用于旅行。
example2_en: Governments should evaluate the long-term environmental effects of major construction projects before approving them.
example2_zh: 政府应在批准大型建设项目之前评估其长期环境影响。
collocations: evaluate the impact｜评估影响 ; evaluate effectiveness｜评估有效性 ; evaluate performance｜评估表现 ; critically evaluate｜批判性地评估
tip_zh: 强调依据标准作判断；不只是描述事物。

meanings_zh: n. 凳子 | n. 粪便；大便
definition_en: a seat without a back or arms | solid waste passed from the body, especially in medical contexts
example1_en: She pulled up a stool beside the kitchen counter.
example1_zh: 她把一张凳子拉到厨房台面旁。
example2_en: Doctors may examine a stool sample to identify infections that cannot be diagnosed through symptoms alone.
example2_zh: 医生可能会检查粪便样本，以识别仅凭症状无法确诊的感染。
collocations: bar stool｜吧台凳 ; wooden stool｜木凳 ; stool sample｜粪便样本
tip_zh: 医疗语境中指大便，可用单数或复数，并非只用复数。

meanings_zh: v. 巡逻；巡查 | n. 巡逻；巡逻队
definition_en: To move around an area regularly to maintain safety. | An activity or group that checks an area for danger.
example1_en: Two guards patrol the park after dark each evening.
example1_zh: 每天傍晚天黑后，两名警卫都会在公园巡逻。
example2_en: Rangers patrol protected forests to prevent illegal logging and monitor threats to endangered wildlife.
example2_zh: 护林员在受保护的森林中巡逻，以防止非法伐木并监测濒危野生动物面临的威胁。
collocations: on patrol｜在巡逻 ; patrol the streets｜巡逻街道 ; border patrol｜边境巡逻；边境巡逻队 ; regular patrols｜定期巡逻
tip_zh: 过去式patrolled，进行式patrolling，均双写l。

meanings_zh: n. 辅音；辅音字母 | adj. 一致的；相符的
definition_en: a speech sound involving blocked airflow, or its written symbol | agreeing with or matching something
example1_en: Try saying the final consonant slowly and clearly.
example1_zh: 试着把最后一个辅音发得缓慢而清晰。
example2_en: Learners may struggle to pronounce consonant clusters that do not occur in their first language.
example2_zh: 学习者可能难以发出母语中不存在的辅音群。
collocations: consonant sound｜辅音 ; consonant cluster｜辅音群 ; final consonant｜末尾辅音 ; consonant with｜与……一致
tip_zh: 作形容词较正式，常用consonant with表示相符。

meanings_zh: n. 横幅；旗帜 | n. 网页横幅广告
definition_en: a long piece of cloth displaying a message or design | a wide advertisement displayed across part of a webpage
example1_en: We hung a colourful banner above the garden gate.
example1_zh: 我们在花园大门上方挂了一条彩色横幅。
example2_en: Many news websites rely on banner advertising to provide free access to their articles.
example2_zh: 许多新闻网站依靠横幅广告收入向读者免费提供文章。
collocations: hang a banner｜挂横幅 ; carry a banner｜举横幅 ; banner advertising｜横幅广告
tip_zh: 网页上的横幅广告常称banner ad。

meanings_zh: adj. 在前的；前面的
definition_en: Happening or appearing before the thing being discussed.
example1_en: I slept badly on the night preceding my interview.
example1_zh: 面试前一晚，我睡得很不好。
example2_en: The survey revealed that household energy consumption had fallen significantly compared with the preceding year.
example2_zh: 调查显示，与前一年相比，家庭能源消耗已显著下降。
collocations: the preceding year｜前一年 ; the preceding paragraph｜上一段 ; the immediately preceding period｜紧接此前的时期
tip_zh: preceding指所谈时间或事物之前的，不等于现在之前。

meanings_zh: n. 确认；确认通知 | n. 证实；佐证
definition_en: An assurance or message that an arrangement is definite. | Evidence showing that something is true or correct.
example1_en: The hotel sent confirmation of our booking this morning.
example1_zh: 酒店今天早上发来了我们的预订确认通知。
example2_en: Independent confirmation of research findings is essential before governments use them to guide public health policy.
example2_zh: 政府利用研究结果指导公共卫生政策之前，必须先对这些结果进行独立验证。
collocations: booking confirmation｜预订确认 ; written confirmation｜书面确认 ; confirmation of receipt｜收讫确认 ; independent confirmation｜独立验证
tip_zh: 常用confirmation of sth；确认某事属实可接that从句。

meanings_zh: adj. 合乎逻辑的；合理的 | adj. 逻辑学的
definition_en: Based on clear reasoning, with ideas that fit together sensibly. | Relating to the formal rules of correct reasoning.
example1_en: Taking the bus seemed logical because parking was expensive.
example1_zh: 停车费很贵，所以乘公交车似乎很合理。
example2_en: Students should learn to construct logical arguments rather than simply memorise facts for examinations.
example2_zh: 学生应该学习如何构建合乎逻辑的论证，而不是仅仅为考试背诵事实。
collocations: logical conclusion｜合乎逻辑的结论 ; logical reasoning｜逻辑推理 ; logical sequence｜逻辑顺序 ; logical argument｜合乎逻辑的论证
tip_zh: logical强调推理合理，不表示事实一定正确。

meanings_zh: n. 尝试；努力 | v. 尝试；试图
definition_en: An effort to do something, especially something difficult. | To try to do something, especially something difficult.
example1_en: My first attempt at baking bread was surprisingly successful.
example1_zh: 我第一次尝试烤面包，结果出乎意料地成功。
example2_en: Many cities are attempting to reduce air pollution by improving public transport and expanding cycling networks.
example2_zh: 许多城市正通过改善公共交通和扩展自行车道网络来尝试减少空气污染。
collocations: make an attempt｜作出尝试 ; attempt to do something｜尝试做某事 ; a successful attempt｜成功的尝试 ; in an attempt to｜为了尝试
tip_zh: 动词后接to do；名词常用an attempt at doing。

meanings_zh: n. 炉头；燃烧器
definition_en: The part of a cooker or heater that produces heat
example1_en: She turned off the burner after the soup boiled.
example1_zh: 汤煮开后，她关掉了炉头。
example2_en: Replacing inefficient gas burners with cleaner cooking technology can reduce indoor air pollution and improve health.
example2_zh: 用更清洁的烹饪技术替代低效燃气炉头，可以减少室内空气污染并改善健康。
collocations: gas burner｜燃气炉头 ; oil burner｜燃油燃烧器 ; put something on the back burner｜暂缓处理某事
tip_zh: on the back burner比喻暂缓处理、搁置。

meanings_zh: n. 山坡；山腰
definition_en: The sloping surface of a hill.
example1_en: Small white houses dotted the hillside above the village.
example1_zh: 村庄上方的山坡上散落着白色的小房子。
example2_en: Planting native trees on a bare hillside can reduce soil erosion and provide habitats for wildlife.
example2_zh: 在光秃的山坡上种植本土树木，可以减少水土流失并为野生动物提供栖息地。
collocations: a steep hillside｜陡峭的山坡 ; a wooded hillside｜林木覆盖的山坡 ; on the hillside｜在山坡上
tip_zh: 指山的斜坡部分；在山坡上用 on the hillside。

meanings_zh: n. 判断力 | n. 看法；评价 | n. 判决；裁决
definition_en: the ability to make sensible decisions after considering information | an opinion formed after considering something carefully | an official decision made by a court
example1_en: I trust your judgement when choosing a reliable bicycle.
example1_zh: 挑选可靠的自行车时，我相信你的判断力。
example2_en: Schools should teach students to exercise independent judgement when evaluating information from unfamiliar online sources.
example2_zh: 学校应教导学生在评估陌生网络来源的信息时作出独立判断。
collocations: sound judgement｜明智的判断力 ; make a judgement｜作出判断 ; exercise judgement｜运用判断力 ; court judgement｜法院判决
tip_zh: 英式可写judgement或judgment；美式通常用后者。

meanings_zh: adj. 不道德的
definition_en: Contrary to accepted principles of right and wrong.
example1_en: She thought keeping the lost wallet would be immoral.
example1_zh: 她认为把捡到的钱包据为己有是不道德的。
example2_en: Many consumers consider it immoral for companies to exploit vulnerable workers in pursuit of higher profits.
example2_zh: 许多消费者认为，企业为了追求更高利润而剥削弱势劳动者是不道德的。
collocations: immoral behaviour｜不道德的行为 ; immoral practices｜不道德的做法 ; consider something immoral｜认为某事不道德
tip_zh: immoral指违背道德；amoral指无道德观念。

meanings_zh: n. 全体演员 | v. 投；抛；投射 | v. 选派角色
definition_en: All the actors appearing in a film or play. | To throw something or send light or shadow onto something. | To choose an actor for a particular role.
example1_en: The entire cast came outside to greet the audience.
example1_zh: 全体演员都走到外面向观众问好。
example2_en: Directors who cast actors from diverse backgrounds can help challenge stereotypes and broaden audiences' understanding of society.
example2_zh: 导演选用不同背景的演员，有助于打破刻板印象并拓宽观众对社会的认识。
collocations: a supporting cast｜配角阵容 ; cast a shadow｜投下阴影 ; cast doubt on｜使人怀疑 ; cast someone as｜选某人扮演
tip_zh: 过去式、过去分词均为cast；全体演员用单数形式。

meanings_zh: n. 刹车；制动器 | v. 刹车；制动
definition_en: a device that slows or stops a moving vehicle | to slow or stop a vehicle using its brakes
example1_en: I squeezed the brakes as my bicycle reached the corner.
example1_zh: 自行车骑到拐角时，我捏紧了刹车。
example2_en: Drivers should brake gently on wet roads to reduce the risk of losing control.
example2_zh: 驾驶员在湿滑路面上应轻踩刹车，以降低车辆失控的风险。
collocations: apply the brakes｜踩刹车 ; brake sharply｜急刹车 ; brake pedal｜刹车踏板 ; emergency brake｜紧急制动器
tip_zh: brake指刹车；同音词break指打破或休息。

meanings_zh: v. 开药；开处方 | v. 规定；指定
definition_en: officially recommend a medicine or treatment as a medical professional | state officially what must be done or how
example1_en: The doctor prescribed eye drops for my sore eyes.
example1_zh: 医生给我开了眼药水，治疗眼睛疼痛。
example2_en: Doctors should prescribe antibiotics only when necessary to reduce the risk of bacteria developing resistance.
example2_zh: 医生应仅在必要时开抗生素，以降低细菌产生耐药性的风险。
collocations: prescribe medication｜开药 ; prescribe treatment｜指定治疗方案 ; prescribe antibiotics｜开抗生素 ; prescribed by law｜法律规定的
tip_zh: prescribe是开药；describe是描述，注意区分。

meanings_zh: n. 房东；出租土地者 | n. 酒馆老板
definition_en: someone who rents out property or land to others | a man who owns or manages a pub
example1_en: Our landlord came over to fix the leaking tap.
example1_zh: 我们的房东过来修漏水的水龙头。
example2_en: Local authorities should require landlords to maintain safe living conditions for all their tenants.
example2_zh: 地方政府应要求房东为所有租客维持安全的居住条件。
collocations: private landlord｜私人房东 ; landlord and tenant｜房东与租客 ; ask the landlord｜询问房东
tip_zh: 房东是landlord，租客是tenant；第二义常见于英国。

meanings_zh: adj. 微弱的；隐约的 | adj. 头晕欲倒的 | v. 昏倒；晕厥
definition_en: not strong, clear or easy to notice | feeling weak and close to losing consciousness | to suddenly lose consciousness for a short time
example1_en: A faint light shone through the bedroom curtains.
example1_zh: 一丝微弱的光透过卧室窗帘照了进来。
example2_en: Astronomers use powerful telescopes to detect faint objects that cannot be seen with the naked eye.
example2_zh: 天文学家使用高性能望远镜探测肉眼看不见的暗弱天体。
collocations: faint light｜微弱的光 ; faint smell｜淡淡的气味 ; feel faint｜感到头晕欲倒 ; faint hope｜渺茫的希望
tip_zh: feel faint是快要晕倒；faint作动词才表示昏倒。

meanings_zh: adj. 极不理智的；荒唐的 | adj. 精神失常的
definition_en: Extremely foolish, unreasonable, or dangerous. | Severely mentally ill; an outdated term except in legal contexts.
example1_en: Driving through that storm would be an insane risk.
example1_zh: 在那场暴风雨中开车会是极不理智的冒险。
example2_en: Critics described the proposal as insane because its enormous costs would outweigh any potential benefits.
example2_zh: 批评者认为这项提案荒唐至极，因为其巨大成本会超过任何潜在收益。
collocations: an insane idea｜荒唐的想法 ; an insane risk｜极不理智的冒险 ; drive someone insane｜把某人逼疯
tip_zh: 口语可指荒唐；用于精神疾病已过时且可能冒犯。

meanings_zh: n. 费用；开支 | n. 代价；损害
definition_en: money spent or needed for a particular purpose | harm or disadvantage caused while benefiting someone or something else
example1_en: Rent is our biggest expense every single month.
example1_zh: 房租是我们每个月最大的一笔开支。
example2_en: Cities should improve public transport without placing the entire expense on residents who already face financial difficulties.
example2_zh: 城市应改善公共交通，而不应让已经面临经济困难的居民承担全部费用。
collocations: living expenses｜生活开支 ; cover the expense｜支付费用 ; at the expense of｜以…为代价 ; spare no expense｜不惜费用
tip_zh: 日常各项开支常用复数expenses；expensive是形容词。

meanings_zh: adj. 数字的；用数字表示的
definition_en: Relating to numbers or expressed using numbers.
example1_en: Please arrange these raffle tickets in numerical order.
example1_zh: 请把这些抽奖券按号码顺序排列。
example2_en: Researchers need reliable numerical data to assess whether public transport investments have reduced traffic congestion.
example2_zh: 研究人员需要可靠的数值数据，以评估公共交通投资是否缓解了交通拥堵。
collocations: numerical data｜数值数据 ; numerical order｜数字顺序 ; numerical value｜数值 ; numerical analysis｜数值分析
tip_zh: numerical指数字相关；numerous指数量多。

meanings_zh: n. 决心；毅力 | n. 确定；测定；裁定
definition_en: the firm intention to continue despite difficulties | the process of establishing a fact or making an official decision
example1_en: Despite the rain, she finished the race with determination.
example1_zh: 尽管下着雨，她仍凭借毅力跑完了比赛。
example2_en: Students who show determination are often better able to overcome academic setbacks and achieve their goals.
example2_zh: 有决心的学生往往更能克服学业挫折，实现自己的目标。
collocations: sheer determination｜坚定不移的决心 ; determination to succeed｜成功的决心 ; determination of eligibility｜资格的认定
tip_zh: 表决心常接to do；表确定常接of。

meanings_zh: adj. 差劲的；令人鄙夷的 | adj. 可怜的；令人怜悯的
definition_en: so poor or ineffective that it deserves strong criticism | making you feel pity because of suffering or helplessness
example1_en: The broken shower produced only a pathetic trickle.
example1_zh: 坏掉的淋浴器只能流出少得可怜的一点水。
example2_en: Residents described the council's response to repeated flooding as pathetic, demanding immediate investment in better drainage.
example2_zh: 居民认为市政委员会应对反复洪灾的表现差劲，要求立即投资改善排水设施。
collocations: a pathetic excuse｜蹩脚的借口 ; a pathetic attempt｜差劲的尝试 ; a pathetic sight｜可怜的景象
tip_zh: 常带强烈贬义，不宜随意用来形容他人。

meanings_zh: adj. 位于…的 | adj. 处于某种境况的
definition_en: located in a particular place | in a particular set of circumstances
example1_en: Our hotel is situated beside a quiet mountain lake.
example1_zh: 我们的酒店坐落在一处宁静的高山湖泊旁。
example2_en: Schools situated near busy roads may need additional measures to protect pupils from air pollution.
example2_zh: 位于繁忙道路附近的学校可能需要采取额外措施，保护学生免受空气污染的影响。
collocations: conveniently situated｜位置便利的 ; centrally situated｜位于中心的 ; situated near｜位于…附近
tip_zh: 常用be situated in/near，描述位置，较正式。

meanings_zh: n. 租约；租赁合同 | v. 租用；出租
definition_en: a legal agreement to use property for payment | to use or let someone use property for regular payment
example1_en: We signed a lease for a sunny upstairs flat.
example1_zh: 我们签下了楼上一套阳光充足的公寓的租约。
example2_en: Small businesses often lease equipment rather than purchase it outright, allowing them to manage initial costs more effectively.
example2_zh: 小企业往往租用设备而非一次性买下，从而更有效地控制初期成本。
collocations: sign a lease｜签订租约 ; renew a lease｜续租 ; a long-term lease｜长期租约 ; lease equipment｜租用设备
tip_zh: lease from指租入；lease to指租给别人。

meanings_zh: v. 爬行；匍匐前进 | v. 缓慢行进 | n. 爬泳；自由泳泳姿
definition_en: To move close to the ground using hands and knees. | To move extremely slowly. | A swimming style using alternating arm strokes and kicking legs.
example1_en: The baby crawled across the rug towards her toy.
example1_zh: 宝宝爬过地毯，朝她的玩具爬去。
example2_en: During peak hours, traffic crawls through the city centre, increasing journey times and vehicle emissions.
example2_zh: 高峰时段，车辆在市中心缓慢行驶，增加了出行时间和尾气排放。
collocations: crawl on hands and knees｜手脚并用地爬 ; crawl along｜缓慢前行 ; slow to a crawl｜慢至蜗行 ; front crawl｜爬泳
tip_zh: 车辆crawl指行驶极慢；爬泳常说front crawl。

meanings_zh: n. 破产
definition_en: The legal state of being unable to pay your debts
example1_en: The small bakery faced bankruptcy after months of losses.
example1_zh: 这家小面包店连续亏损数月后面临破产。
example2_en: Access to affordable loans may help small businesses avoid bankruptcy during periods of economic uncertainty.
example2_zh: 在经济不确定时期，获得低成本贷款可能帮助小企业避免破产。
collocations: file for bankruptcy｜申请破产 ; declare bankruptcy｜宣布破产 ; face bankruptcy｜面临破产 ; bankruptcy protection｜破产保护
tip_zh: 通常不可数；多起破产事件可用复数bankruptcies。

meanings_zh: adj. 昏昏欲睡的
definition_en: Feeling sleepy and finding it hard to stay awake
example1_en: The warm room made me drowsy after lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭后，温暖的房间让我昏昏欲睡。
example2_en: Drivers who feel drowsy should stop somewhere safe, as fatigue significantly increases the risk of accidents.
example2_zh: 感到困倦的司机应在安全地点停车，因为疲劳会显著增加事故风险。
collocations: feel drowsy｜感到困倦 ; make someone drowsy｜使某人昏昏欲睡 ; drowsy driving｜疲劳驾驶
tip_zh: 常描述人困倦；药物使人困倦可用make someone drowsy。

meanings_zh: adj. 智力的；思维的 | n. 知识分子
definition_en: Relating to thinking, reasoning, and understanding complex ideas | Someone who studies and discusses complex ideas seriously
example1_en: She enjoys the intellectual challenge of learning a new language.
example1_zh: 她喜欢学习新语言带来的智力挑战。
example2_en: Schools should support intellectual development through activities that encourage students to question assumptions and evaluate evidence.
example2_zh: 学校应通过鼓励学生质疑假设、评估证据的活动来促进智力发展。
collocations: intellectual development｜智力发展 ; intellectual challenge｜智力挑战 ; intellectual property｜知识产权 ; intellectual curiosity｜求知欲
tip_zh: intellectual强调思维活动；intelligent强调聪明。

meanings_zh: n. 评级；等级 | n. 收视率；收听率 | n. 额定值
definition_en: a judgement of quality, performance, or suitability on a scale | a measure of audience size for a broadcast programme | the maximum power or load equipment is designed to handle
example1_en: The hotel received a high rating for its friendly service.
example1_zh: 这家酒店因服务热情而获得了很高的评价。
example2_en: A clear energy rating helps consumers compare household appliances and choose models with lower running costs.
example2_zh: 清晰的能效评级帮助消费者比较家用电器，选择使用成本更低的型号。
collocations: a high rating｜高评分 ; an energy rating｜能效等级 ; audience ratings｜收视率；收听率 ; a power rating｜额定功率
tip_zh: 表示收视率通常用复数ratings；也可作rate的现在分词。

meanings_zh: adj. 故意的；有意的 | adj. 从容谨慎的 | v. 仔细考虑；商议
definition_en: Done intentionally rather than by accident. | Slow and careful, rather than hurried. | To consider something carefully before making a decision.
example1_en: Leaving my phone at home was a deliberate choice.
example1_zh: 把手机留在家里是我有意做出的选择。
example2_en: Local authorities should deliberate carefully before approving developments that could permanently damage natural habitats.
example2_zh: 地方政府在批准可能永久破坏自然栖息地的开发项目之前，应仔细斟酌。
collocations: a deliberate attempt｜有意的尝试 ; deliberate damage｜故意损坏 ; deliberate movements｜从容谨慎的动作 ; deliberate on a proposal｜仔细考虑提案
tip_zh: 形容词末尾读/ət/，动词末尾读/eɪt/。

meanings_zh: n. 高潮；最精彩的部分 | v. 达到高潮
definition_en: The most exciting or important point of an event | Reach the most exciting or important point
example1_en: The concert reached its climax when the whole choir joined.
example1_zh: 整个合唱团加入演唱时，音乐会达到了高潮。
example2_en: The film reaches its climax when the community unites to protect the forest from destruction.
example2_zh: 当社区居民团结起来保护森林免遭破坏时，影片达到了高潮。
collocations: reach a climax｜达到高潮 ; a dramatic climax｜扣人心弦的高潮 ; climax with｜以……达到高潮
tip_zh: climactic指高潮的；别与climatic（气候的）混淆。

meanings_zh: adj. 圆形的；环形的 | adj. 循环的 | n. 通知；通函
definition_en: Shaped like a circle or following a round path. | Returning to the starting point rather than progressing. | A printed message distributed to many people.
example1_en: We placed a circular rug under the coffee table.
example1_zh: 我们在茶几下面铺了一块圆形地毯。
example2_en: A circular economy aims to reduce waste by keeping materials in use for as long as possible.
example2_zh: 循环经济旨在通过尽可能延长材料的使用时间来减少浪费。
collocations: a circular table｜圆桌 ; a circular route｜环形路线 ; a circular economy｜循环经济 ; a circular argument｜循环论证
tip_zh: circular argument指用结论证明自身的循环论证。

meanings_zh: n. 道路或桥梁通行费 | n. 伤亡人数；严重损害 | v. 缓慢而有规律地鸣钟
definition_en: money paid to use a road or bridge | the number harmed, or damage caused by something | to ring a large bell slowly and repeatedly
example1_en: We paid a toll before driving across the bridge.
example1_zh: 我们缴了通行费才开车过桥。
example2_en: Long working hours can take a heavy toll on employees' physical health and family relationships.
example2_zh: 长时间工作会严重损害员工的身体健康和家庭关系。
collocations: pay a toll｜支付通行费 ; death toll｜死亡人数 ; take a toll on｜对……造成损害 ; a bell tolls｜钟缓缓鸣响
tip_zh: take a toll on表示造成损害；death toll指死亡人数。

meanings_zh: adj. 与性有关的 | adj. 有性生殖的
definition_en: Relating to sex or physical attraction between people. | Involving reproduction through the joining of male and female cells.
example1_en: The clinic offers confidential advice about sexual health.
example1_zh: 这家诊所提供保密的性健康咨询。
example2_en: Schools can provide age-appropriate sexual health education to help young people make informed decisions.
example2_zh: 学校可以提供适龄的性健康教育，帮助年轻人作出明智决定。
collocations: sexual health｜性健康 ; sexual reproduction｜有性生殖 ; sexual attraction｜性吸引
tip_zh: sexual指与性有关；sexy才常表示性感的。

meanings_zh: n. 参与；参加
definition_en: the act of taking part in an activity or event
example1_en: Your participation made our neighbourhood clean-up much more enjoyable.
example1_zh: 有你参与，我们这次社区清扫活动开心多了。
example2_en: Active participation in community projects can strengthen social connections and give residents a greater sense of belonging.
example2_zh: 积极参与社区项目可以加强社会联系，让居民更有归属感。
collocations: participation in｜参与…… ; active participation｜积极参与 ; public participation｜公众参与 ; encourage participation｜鼓励参与
tip_zh: 通常不可数；表示参与某活动，用participation in。

meanings_zh: v. 使着迷；深深吸引
definition_en: to attract and hold someone's attention very strongly
example1_en: The colourful fish fascinated the children at the aquarium.
example1_zh: 水族馆里色彩斑斓的鱼让孩子们看得入迷。
example2_en: Ancient civilisations continue to fascinate researchers because their achievements reveal remarkable solutions to complex practical problems.
example2_zh: 古代文明仍然令研究者着迷，因为其成就展现了解决复杂实际问题的非凡方法。
collocations: fascinate an audience｜深深吸引观众 ; be fascinated by｜对……着迷 ; never cease to fascinate｜始终令人着迷
tip_zh: 事物令人着迷用fascinating；人感到着迷用fascinated。

meanings_zh: n. 轴；旋转轴线 | n. 坐标轴
definition_en: a real or imaginary line around which something turns | a reference line used to locate points on a graph
example1_en: The globe spins smoothly around its tilted axis.
example1_zh: 这个地球仪绕着倾斜的轴平稳转动。
example2_en: The horizontal axis represents time, while the vertical axis shows changes in average household energy consumption.
