collocations: sudden disappearance｜突然消失 ; mysterious disappearance｜神秘失踪 ; gradual disappearance｜逐渐消亡
tip_zh: 常接of说明消失的人或物；动词为disappear。

meanings_zh: n. 陶工；制陶者 | v. 悠闲地做琐事
definition_en: someone who makes pots and other objects from clay | to spend time doing small tasks without hurrying
example1_en: The potter shaped a bowl with her wet hands.
example1_zh: 陶工用湿润的双手捏出了一个碗。
example2_en: Local potters can preserve traditional skills while attracting visitors interested in the region's cultural heritage.
example2_zh: 当地陶工既能保护传统技艺，也能吸引对该地区文化遗产感兴趣的游客。
collocations: a skilled potter｜熟练的陶工 ; a potter's wheel｜陶轮 ; potter about the garden｜在花园里悠闲地忙活
tip_zh: 作动词常用potter about/around，表示悠闲忙活。

meanings_zh: n. 套房；套间 | n. 一套软件或家具 | n. 组曲
definition_en: Connected rooms used together, especially in a hotel | A set of software programs or furniture used together | A musical work consisting of several related pieces
example1_en: Our hotel suite has a balcony overlooking the sea.
example1_zh: 我们住的酒店套房有一个面朝大海的阳台。
example2_en: The university provides a software suite that enables students to analyse data and prepare research presentations.
example2_zh: 该大学提供一套软件，帮助学生分析数据并制作研究报告演示文稿。
collocations: a hotel suite｜酒店套房 ; a software suite｜软件套装 ; a three-piece suite｜三件套沙发
tip_zh: 读音同sweet；suit意为西装，读音不同。

meanings_zh: adj. 色盲的
definition_en: unable to distinguish some colours from others
example1_en: My color-blind uncle sometimes confuses red apples with green ones.
example1_zh: 我叔叔有色盲，有时分不清红苹果和青苹果。
example2_en: Designers should use distinct shapes alongside colours to make public information accessible to color-blind users.
example2_zh: 设计师应在使用颜色的同时采用不同形状，让色盲用户也能获取公共信息。
collocations: red-green color-blind｜红绿色盲的 ; color-blind users｜色盲用户
tip_zh: 英式通常拼作colour-blind；不一定完全看不见颜色。

meanings_zh: n. 大学的院；系 | n. 全体教员 | n. 官能；能力
definition_en: A university division covering a particular group of subjects. | The teaching staff of a university, college, or school. | A natural mental or physical ability.
example1_en: The science faculty has moved into a new building.
example1_zh: 理学院已搬进一栋新楼。
example2_en: Cooperation between the faculty of engineering and local industries can help students develop skills relevant to employment.
example2_zh: 工程学院与当地产业的合作可以帮助学生培养与就业相关的技能。
collocations: the faculty of science｜理学院 ; faculty members｜教职人员 ; mental faculties｜心智能力
tip_zh: 英式常指大学院系，美式常指全体教员。

meanings_zh: v. 成熟；使成熟
definition_en: to become ripe or make fruit or crops ripe
example1_en: Leave these green tomatoes on the windowsill to ripen.
example1_zh: 把这些青番茄放在窗台上，让它们慢慢成熟。
example2_en: Warmer temperatures can cause fruit to ripen earlier, forcing farmers to adjust their harvesting schedules.
example2_zh: 气温升高会使水果提早成熟，迫使农民调整采收时间。
collocations: ripen naturally｜自然成熟 ; ripen on the vine｜在藤上成熟 ; ripen in the sun｜在阳光下成熟
tip_zh: ripe是形容词；ripen是动词，可及物也可不及物。

meanings_zh: v. 挤在一起；蜷缩 | n. 挤在一起的人群 | n. 私下短会
definition_en: To gather closely together or curl up for warmth or protection. | A group of people standing or sitting close together. | A brief close gathering to discuss something privately.
example1_en: We huddled under one umbrella until the rain stopped.
example1_zh: 我们挤在同一把伞下，直到雨停。
example2_en: Without adequate shelter, displaced families may huddle together outdoors, increasing their exposure to cold and illness.
example2_zh: 缺乏足够住所时，流离失所的家庭可能只好在户外挤作一团，更容易受寒和生病。
collocations: huddle together｜挤在一起 ; huddle for warmth｜挤在一起取暖 ; huddle around a fire｜围着火堆挤在一起 ; a team huddle｜团队碰头会
tip_zh: huddle强调紧靠，常为取暖、避险或私下商议。

meanings_zh: v. 满足需求；提供服务 | v. 提供餐饮服务
definition_en: to provide what a particular person or group needs | to supply food and drinks for an event
example1_en: These weekend classes cater for children of all ages.
example1_zh: 这些周末课程面向各个年龄段的儿童。
example2_en: Public transport systems should cater for passengers with limited mobility by providing accessible vehicles and stations.
example2_zh: 公共交通系统应提供无障碍车辆和车站，满足行动不便乘客的需求。
collocations: cater for different needs｜满足不同需求 ; cater to individual tastes｜迎合个人喜好 ; cater for a wedding｜为婚礼提供餐饮
tip_zh: cater for指满足需求或供餐；cater to常指迎合。

meanings_zh: n. 例外 | n. 异议；反对
definition_en: someone or something not included in a general rule or pattern | an objection, especially in the phrase take exception to
example1_en: Everyone enjoyed the soup, with the exception of my brother.
example1_zh: 除了我哥哥，大家都很喜欢这道汤。
example2_en: Although public transport is generally affordable, rural communities often represent an exception because services are limited.
example2_zh: 虽然公共交通通常价格低廉，但农村社区往往是例外，因为可用的服务有限。
collocations: an exception to the rule｜规则的例外 ; with the exception of｜除……之外 ; make an exception｜破例 ; take exception to｜对……表示不满
tip_zh: 规则的例外用exception to，不用exception of。

meanings_zh: n. 侧面；侧面轮廓 | n. 简介；概况 | n. 公众关注度
definition_en: The outline of a face or object seen from the side. | A short description of someone's life, work, or characteristics. | The amount of public attention someone or something receives.
example1_en: She drew her grandfather's profile with a soft pencil.
example1_zh: 她用软铅笔画出了祖父的侧面轮廓。
example2_en: Public exhibitions can raise the profile of local artists and attract visitors to smaller towns.
example2_zh: 公共展览能提高当地艺术家的知名度，并吸引游客前往小城镇。
collocations: in profile｜从侧面看 ; a detailed profile｜详细简介 ; raise the profile of｜提高……的知名度 ; keep a low profile｜保持低调
tip_zh: in profile指呈侧面；a high profile指高关注度。

meanings_zh: adj. 异国情调的；奇异的 | adj. 外来的；非本土的
definition_en: Unusual and interesting, especially because of a connection with distant countries. | Originating outside the region where something is now found.
example1_en: The market sells exotic fruits I have never tasted.
example1_zh: 市场里卖着我从未尝过的异国水果。
example2_en: Introducing exotic plants into local gardens can threaten native species if their spread is not controlled.
example2_zh: 将外来植物引入当地花园后，若不控制其蔓延，可能会威胁本土物种。
collocations: exotic fruit｜异国水果 ; exotic destination｜富有异国情调的目的地 ; exotic species｜外来物种
tip_zh: 生态语境中指非本土的，不一定具有入侵性。

meanings_zh: v. 侵蚀；风化 | v. 逐渐削弱；损害
definition_en: To gradually wear away soil or rock through natural forces. | To gradually reduce strength, value, or confidence.
example1_en: Strong waves have eroded the cliffs near our village.
example1_zh: 强劲的海浪侵蚀了我们村庄附近的悬崖。
example2_en: Persistent inflation can erode household savings, making it harder for families to afford essential goods.
example2_zh: 持续的通货膨胀会削弱家庭储蓄的购买力，使家庭更难负担生活必需品。
collocations: erode the soil｜侵蚀土壤 ; erode public trust｜削弱公众信任 ; erode purchasing power｜削弱购买力 ; coastal erosion｜海岸侵蚀
tip_zh: 可指自然侵蚀，也可指信任、价值等逐渐受损。

meanings_zh: n. 裁缝 | v. 量身定制；使适合
definition_en: someone who makes or alters clothes, especially suits | to make or adapt something for particular needs
example1_en: The tailor shortened my trousers while I waited nearby.
example1_zh: 我在旁边等着，裁缝把我的裤子改短了。
example2_en: Teachers should tailor their lessons to students' abilities rather than follow a single approach for everyone.
example2_zh: 教师应根据学生的能力调整课程，而不是对所有人采用同一种方法。
collocations: tailor a suit｜定做西装 ; tailor something to individual needs｜按个人需求调整 ; tailor-made clothes｜定制衣服
tip_zh: tailor A to B表示“根据B调整或定制A”。

meanings_zh: adj. 紧张的；绷紧的 | n. 时态 | v. 使绷紧；变得紧绷
definition_en: Nervous and unable to relax, or stretched tightly. | A verb form that indicates time. | To tighten muscles or become physically stiff.
example1_en: She looked tense while waiting outside the interview room.
example1_zh: 她在面试室外等候时显得很紧张。
example2_en: A tense working environment can reduce productivity and discourage employees from sharing creative ideas.
example2_zh: 紧张的工作环境可能降低生产效率，并使员工不愿分享创新想法。
collocations: feel tense｜感到紧张 ; a tense atmosphere｜紧张的气氛 ; past tense｜过去时 ; tense your muscles｜绷紧肌肉
tip_zh: 作名词指语法“时态”；作形容词指紧张或绷紧。

meanings_zh: n. 文明社会；文明 | n. 文明生活；现代便利
definition_en: an organized society with developed institutions, culture, and technology | the comforts and services associated with modern society
example1_en: We explored the ruins of an ancient civilization yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天我们探访了一处古代文明的遗址。
example2_en: Reliable water supplies played a crucial role in the development of civilization by supporting agriculture and permanent settlements.
example2_zh: 可靠的水源支持了农业和固定聚落的发展，在文明形成过程中发挥了关键作用。
collocations: ancient civilization｜古代文明 ; the rise of civilization｜文明的兴起 ; human civilization｜人类文明
tip_zh: 英式也拼作 civilisation；某个文明可用 a civilization。

meanings_zh: n. 考虑；斟酌 | n. 体谅；关心 | n. 需要考虑的因素
definition_en: Careful thought about something before making a decision. | Care for other people's feelings, needs, or comfort. | Something important to think about when making a decision.
example1_en: After careful consideration, we chose the smaller flat.
example1_zh: 经过仔细考虑，我们选择了那套较小的公寓。
example2_en: Urban planners should take the needs of older residents into consideration when designing public transport systems.
example2_zh: 城市规划者在设计公共交通系统时，应考虑老年居民的需求。
collocations: careful consideration｜仔细考虑 ; take into consideration｜将……考虑在内 ; under consideration｜正在考虑中 ; show consideration for｜体谅
tip_zh: 表考虑或体谅通常不可数；表考虑因素时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 起重机；吊车 | n. 鹤 | v. 伸长脖子看
definition_en: A machine for lifting and moving heavy objects. | A large bird with long legs and a long neck. | To stretch your neck to see something better.
example1_en: A crane lifted the heavy beam above the roof.
example1_zh: 一台起重机把沉重的横梁吊到了屋顶上方。
example2_en: Construction companies use cranes to assemble tall buildings efficiently, but strict safety procedures remain essential.
example2_zh: 建筑公司利用起重机高效建造高层建筑，但严格的安全规程仍然必不可少。
collocations: a tower crane｜塔式起重机 ; operate a crane｜操作起重机 ; crane your neck｜伸长脖子
tip_zh: 动词常用crane your neck，表示伸长脖子看。

meanings_zh: n. 调查；探究 | n. 询问；咨询
definition_en: a process of investigating facts or seeking knowledge | a request for information about something
example1_en: My inquiry about the missing parcel received a quick reply.
example1_zh: 我询问了丢失包裹的情况，很快就收到了回复。
example2_en: An independent inquiry into river pollution revealed serious weaknesses in the current system of environmental monitoring.
example2_zh: 一项针对河流污染的独立调查揭示了现行环境监测体系的严重缺陷。
collocations: public inquiry｜公开调查 ; inquiry into｜对……的调查 ; make an inquiry｜进行咨询 ; scientific inquiry｜科学探究
tip_zh: 调查某事用inquiry into；英式enquiry也常指咨询。

meanings_zh: n. 钥匙孔
definition_en: a hole in a lock into which a key fits
example1_en: I struggled to find the keyhole in the dark.
example1_zh: 黑暗中，我费了好大劲才找到钥匙孔。
example2_en: Modern electronic locks remove the need for a traditional keyhole, although they may create new security risks.
example2_zh: 现代电子锁不再需要传统的钥匙孔，不过也可能带来新的安全风险。
collocations: put a key in the keyhole｜把钥匙插入锁孔 ; look through the keyhole｜透过钥匙孔看 ; keyhole surgery｜微创手术
tip_zh: keyhole surgery指小切口手术，不是钥匙孔手术。

meanings_zh: v. 联合；团结；使统一
definition_en: To join together or bring people together for a shared purpose.
example1_en: The whole village united to repair the damaged bridge.
example1_zh: 全村人团结起来修复受损的桥。
example2_en: Shared environmental goals can unite communities that otherwise have very different economic and political interests.
example2_zh: 共同的环境目标能让经济和政治利益原本大不相同的社区团结起来。
collocations: unite against｜联合起来反对 ; unite behind a leader｜团结支持一位领袖 ; unite efforts｜汇聚力量
tip_zh: unite可及物也可不及物，强调为共同目标联合。

meanings_zh: n. 界面；接口 | n. 交界面；接触点 | v. 连接；相互对接
definition_en: a system through which users or devices interact | a boundary or connection between two things | connect and work together with another system or group
example1_en: The app's simple interface makes booking tickets much easier.
example1_zh: 这款应用的简洁界面让订票方便多了。
example2_en: An accessible user interface enables people with limited technical experience to benefit from digital public services.
example2_zh: 易于使用的用户界面能让技术经验有限的人也享受到数字公共服务。
collocations: user interface｜用户界面 ; graphical interface｜图形界面 ; interface design｜界面设计 ; interface with｜与……对接
tip_zh: 计算机语境常指界面；作动词常接with。

meanings_zh: n. 大使馆
definition_en: An official office representing a country in another country.
example1_en: I contacted the embassy after losing my passport abroad.
example1_zh: 在国外丢失护照后，我联系了大使馆。
example2_en: An embassy provides assistance to citizens overseas and helps maintain diplomatic relations between the two countries.
example2_zh: 大使馆为海外公民提供援助，并帮助维持两国间的外交关系。
collocations: contact the embassy｜联系大使馆 ; embassy staff｜大使馆工作人员 ; foreign embassy｜外国大使馆
tip_zh: embassy指大使馆；consulate指领事馆。

meanings_zh: n. 其间；等待期间 | adv. 在此期间；与此同时
definition_en: the period before something happens, especially in 'in the meantime' | during the time before another event happens
example1_en: Dinner is cooking; in the meantime, let's set the table.
example1_zh: 饭还在做，我们趁这会儿摆好餐具吧。
example2_en: The new railway will take years to complete; in the meantime, cities should improve existing bus services.
example2_zh: 新铁路还需要数年才能建成；在此期间，城市应改善现有公交服务。
collocations: in the meantime｜在此期间 ; meantime, continue working｜其间继续工作
tip_zh: 最常用in the meantime；meanwhile可直接作副词。

meanings_zh: v. 蹑手蹑脚地走；缓慢移动 | v. 逐渐蔓延；悄然变化
definition_en: to move slowly and quietly, often to avoid being noticed | to spread or change slowly and almost unnoticed
example1_en: I crept upstairs to avoid waking the sleeping baby.
example1_zh: 我蹑手蹑脚地上楼，以免吵醒熟睡的宝宝。
example2_en: Housing costs can creep up gradually, placing increasing financial pressure on families with limited incomes.
example2_zh: 住房成本可能逐渐上涨，给收入有限的家庭带来越来越大的经济压力。
collocations: creep upstairs｜蹑手蹑脚地上楼 ; creep up｜悄然上升 ; creep into｜悄然进入 ; give someone the creeps｜使某人毛骨悚然
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为crept；不一定指爬行。

meanings_zh: n. 积极性；动力 | n. 动机；原因
definition_en: The desire and energy that make you want to act. | A reason for doing something or behaving in a particular way.
example1_en: Training with a friend gives me motivation to keep running.
example1_zh: 和朋友一起训练让我有动力坚持跑步。
example2_en: Giving students meaningful choices can increase their motivation and encourage them to take responsibility for learning.
example2_zh: 给予学生有意义的选择，可以提高他们的积极性，并鼓励他们对学习负责。
collocations: lack of motivation｜缺乏动力 ; intrinsic motivation｜内在动力 ; motivation to learn｜学习动力 ; motivation behind a decision｜决定背后的动机
tip_zh: 动力常不可数；具体动机可数，常接for或behind。

meanings_zh: n. 谨慎；小心 | n. 警告；告诫 | v. 警告；告诫
definition_en: care taken to avoid danger or mistakes | a warning about danger or unacceptable behaviour | to warn someone about a risk or problem
example1_en: We walked with caution across the wet kitchen floor.
example1_zh: 我们小心地走过湿漉漉的厨房地板。
example2_en: Researchers caution that small studies may not provide reliable evidence for major changes in public health policy.
example2_zh: 研究人员提醒，小规模研究可能无法为公共卫生政策的重大调整提供可靠证据。
collocations: with caution｜谨慎地 ; exercise caution｜保持谨慎 ; caution against｜告诫不要
tip_zh: caution against doing表示告诫不要做某事。

meanings_zh: adj. 无色的 | adj. 平淡无趣的
definition_en: having no colour | lacking interesting or distinctive qualities
example1_en: The bottle contained a colorless liquid that looked like water.
example1_zh: 瓶子里装着一种看起来像水的无色液体。
example2_en: Some harmful gases are colorless, making reliable detection equipment essential for maintaining safety in industrial workplaces.
example2_zh: 某些有害气体是无色的，因此可靠的检测设备对保障工业场所安全至关重要。
collocations: colorless liquid｜无色液体 ; colorless gas｜无色气体 ; colorless personality｜乏味的个性
tip_zh: 美式拼写；英式为colourless。无色不等于透明。

meanings_zh: n. 悲痛；忧虑 | n. 危难；困境 | v. 使悲痛；使忧虑
definition_en: great emotional pain, worry, or unhappiness | a situation involving danger or serious difficulty | to cause someone great worry or unhappiness
example1_en: Her neighbour noticed her distress and offered to help.
example1_zh: 邻居看出她很难过，便主动提出帮忙。
example2_en: Sudden unemployment can cause considerable distress, particularly for households with limited savings and high housing costs.
example2_zh: 突然失业会引发严重的焦虑，对储蓄有限且住房开支高的家庭尤其如此。
collocations: emotional distress｜情绪上的痛苦 ; in distress｜处于危难中 ; cause distress｜造成痛苦 ; a distress signal｜求救信号
tip_zh: distress比一般sadness强烈，也可指危难。

meanings_zh: n. 暴乱；骚乱 | v. 聚众闹事；发生暴乱
definition_en: Violent public disorder involving a crowd of people. | To behave violently as part of a crowd in public.
example1_en: The shop closed early because a riot broke out nearby.
example1_zh: 附近发生了骚乱，这家店提前关门了。
example2_en: Effective communication between communities and local authorities may help prevent peaceful demonstrations from turning into riots.
example2_zh: 社区与地方政府之间的有效沟通可能有助于防止和平示威演变为暴乱。
collocations: a riot breaks out｜骚乱爆发 ; riot police｜防暴警察 ; spark a riot｜引发暴乱
tip_zh: riot涉及暴力骚乱，不等于和平的protest。

meanings_zh: v. 提议；提出 | v. 求婚 | v. 打算；计划
definition_en: Suggest an idea or plan for others to consider. | Ask someone to marry you. | Intend or plan to do something.
example1_en: I proposed sharing a taxi to save us money.
example1_zh: 我提议合乘一辆出租车，给大家省点钱。
example2_en: Researchers propose expanding urban green spaces to improve air quality and encourage residents to exercise more regularly.
example2_zh: 研究人员提议扩大城市绿地，以改善空气质量并鼓励居民更经常地锻炼。
collocations: propose a solution｜提出解决方案 ; propose doing something｜提议做某事 ; propose to someone｜向某人求婚 ; propose a motion｜提出动议
tip_zh: propose doing是提议；propose to do通常是打算。

meanings_zh: v. 吐唾沫；吐出 | n. 唾液；口水
definition_en: To force saliva or something else out of your mouth. | The liquid produced naturally inside your mouth.
example1_en: He spat the bitter seed into a tissue.
example1_zh: 他把那颗苦涩的种子吐进了纸巾里。
example2_en: Public health campaigns discourage people from spitting in shared spaces because this behaviour can contribute to disease transmission.
example2_zh: 公共卫生宣传劝阻人们在公共场所吐痰，因为这种行为可能传播疾病。
collocations: spit out｜吐出 ; spit into a tissue｜吐进纸巾 ; spit it out｜有话直说
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词英式常用spat，美式也用spit。

meanings_zh: n. 规模；程度 | n. 刻度；等级；比例尺 | n. 鳞；鳞片
definition_en: The size or extent of something | A measurement system or ratio representing relative size | One of the small hard plates covering a fish or reptile
example1_en: I hadn't realised the scale of your vegetable garden.
example1_zh: 我之前没意识到你的菜园有这么大。
example2_en: The scale of plastic pollution demands coordinated action from governments, manufacturers, and consumers worldwide.
example2_zh: 塑料污染的规模要求世界各地的政府、制造商和消费者协调行动。
collocations: on a large scale｜大规模地 ; the scale of the problem｜问题的严重程度 ; a scale model｜比例模型 ; fish scales｜鱼鳞
tip_zh: 表示规模用on a large scale；表示秤通常用复数scales。

meanings_zh: n. 犁 | v. 犁地；耕地
definition_en: A farm tool that turns soil before crops are planted | To turn soil with a plough before planting
example1_en: The farmer pulled an old plough from the shed.
example1_zh: 农民从棚里拖出了一把旧犁。
example2_en: Farmers who plough steep slopes too frequently may increase soil erosion and reduce long-term agricultural productivity.
example2_zh: 过于频繁地耕作陡坡的农民可能会加剧水土流失，并降低长期农业生产力。
collocations: plough a field｜犁田 ; a horse-drawn plough｜马拉犁 ; plough through｜费力地完成或穿过
tip_zh: 美式拼作plow；两种拼写都读/plaʊ/。

meanings_zh: v. 啪地折断；绷断 | v. 厉声说；没好气地说 | v. 拍照；抓拍
definition_en: To break suddenly with a short, sharp sound. | To speak suddenly in an angry or impatient way. | To take a photograph quickly.
example1_en: The dry twig snapped when I stepped on it.
example1_zh: 我踩到那根干树枝时，它啪的一声断了。
example2_en: Under constant workplace pressure, employees may snap at colleagues, damaging cooperation and reducing overall team productivity.
example2_zh: 在持续的工作压力下，员工可能会对同事厉声说话，损害合作并降低团队整体效率。
collocations: snap in half｜啪地断成两半 ; snap at someone｜对某人厉声说话 ; snap a photo｜拍张照片
tip_zh: snap at someone常指厉声说话，也可指猛咬某人。

meanings_zh: adj. 动作笨拙的 | adj. 不得体的；处理笨拙的
definition_en: moving awkwardly and often dropping or breaking things | done without skill, care, or sensitivity
example1_en: My clumsy puppy knocked a flowerpot off the shelf.
example1_zh: 我那只笨手笨脚的小狗把架子上的一个花盆撞了下来。
example2_en: A clumsy attempt to explain new regulations can reduce public confidence in local government.
example2_zh: 对新规定的解释若处理不当，可能会削弱公众对地方政府的信任。
collocations: clumsy movements｜笨拙的动作 ; a clumsy attempt｜笨拙的尝试 ; a clumsy apology｜不得体的道歉
tip_zh: 主要指动作或处理方式笨拙，不等于智力低下。

meanings_zh: v. 松开；使变松 | v. 放宽；放松限制
definition_en: to make or become less tight or firmly attached | to make rules or control less strict
example1_en: He loosened his scarf as the room grew warmer.
example1_zh: 房间渐渐暖和起来，他松了松围巾。
example2_en: Governments may loosen restrictions on foreign investment to encourage business growth and create more employment opportunities.
example2_zh: 政府可能放宽对外国投资的限制，以促进企业发展并创造更多就业机会。
collocations: loosen a knot｜松开绳结 ; loosen your grip｜松开手 ; loosen restrictions｜放宽限制
tip_zh: loosen是动词；loose是形容词，勿混淆lose。

meanings_zh: n. 计算机硬件 | n. 五金器具
definition_en: the physical parts of a computer or electronic system | tools and metal goods used for building and household repairs
example1_en: The technician replaced some old hardware inside my computer.
example1_zh: 技术员更换了我电脑里的一些旧硬件。
example2_en: Schools need reliable hardware and regular technical support to make digital learning accessible to all students.
example2_zh: 学校需要可靠的硬件和定期的技术支持，让所有学生都能参与数字化学习。
collocations: computer hardware｜计算机硬件 ; hardware store｜五金店 ; hardware upgrade｜硬件升级 ; hardware failure｜硬件故障
tip_zh: 不可数名词；hardware指硬件，software指软件。

meanings_zh: adj. 被禁止的
definition_en: Not allowed by a law or rule.
example1_en: Feeding the animals is prohibited at this wildlife park.
example1_zh: 这个野生动物园禁止给动物喂食。
example2_en: Private vehicles are prohibited in certain urban areas to improve air quality and protect pedestrians.
example2_zh: 某些城区禁止私家车通行，以改善空气质量并保护行人。
collocations: strictly prohibited｜严格禁止的 ; prohibited by law｜法律禁止的 ; prohibited items｜违禁物品
tip_zh: 也是prohibit的过去式和过去分词；禁止做某事用prohibit doing。

meanings_zh: v. 刮；刮去 | v. 擦伤；刮坏 | n. 擦伤；刮痕
definition_en: rub a hard edge across a surface, often removing something | damage skin or a surface by rubbing against something rough | a shallow injury or mark caused by rubbing
example1_en: I scraped the ice off the car window.
example1_zh: 我刮掉了车窗上的冰。
example2_en: Restoration workers carefully scrape away damaged paint to reveal the original surfaces of historic buildings.
example2_zh: 修复人员小心刮去破损的油漆，露出历史建筑原有的表面。
collocations: scrape off paint｜刮掉油漆 ; scrape your knee｜擦伤膝盖 ; scrape through an exam｜勉强通过考试 ; scrape together money｜勉强凑钱
tip_zh: scrape off指刮掉；scrape through指勉强通过。

meanings_zh: n. 愤怒；怒气 | v. 激怒；使生气
definition_en: a strong feeling of displeasure about something wrong or unfair | to make someone feel angry
example1_en: He took a deep breath to control his anger.
example1_zh: 他深吸了一口气来控制自己的怒气。
example2_en: Public anger over rising transport costs can encourage local authorities to reconsider their pricing policies.
example2_zh: 公众对交通费用上涨的愤怒，可能促使地方政府重新考虑定价政策。
collocations: control your anger｜控制怒气 ; express anger｜表达愤怒 ; public anger｜公众的愤怒 ; anger management｜愤怒情绪管理
tip_zh: anger作名词通常不可数；形容词是angry。

meanings_zh: n. 宽慰；焦虑消除 | n. 疼痛等的缓解 | n. 救济；救援物资
definition_en: Comfort felt when worry or fear ends | A reduction in pain or discomfort | Help given to people suffering from disaster or poverty
example1_en: I sighed with relief when my missing cat returned.
example1_zh: 走失的猫回来时，我松了一口气。
example2_en: Rapid delivery of emergency relief can prevent further suffering in communities affected by severe flooding.
example2_zh: 迅速运送紧急救援物资可以避免遭受严重洪灾的社区承受更多苦难。
collocations: a sigh of relief｜如释重负的一声叹息 ; pain relief｜缓解疼痛 ; disaster relief｜灾害救援 ; to someone's relief｜令某人宽慰的是
tip_zh: relief是名词，relieve是动词；疼痛缓解用pain relief。

meanings_zh: adj. 逐渐的；渐进的 | adj. 坡度平缓的
definition_en: Happening slowly through small changes over time | Rising or falling gently rather than steeply
example1_en: There was a gradual improvement in her sleep.
example1_zh: 她的睡眠逐渐改善了。
example2_en: A gradual transition to renewable energy can help communities adapt without causing sudden job losses.
example2_zh: 逐步转向可再生能源有助于社区适应变化，避免就业岗位骤减。
collocations: gradual improvement｜逐步改善 ; gradual change｜渐进的变化 ; a gradual slope｜平缓的斜坡
tip_zh: 强调变化缓慢、分阶段；副词形式为gradually。

meanings_zh: v. 铺设路面
definition_en: To cover ground with stone, concrete, or another hard surface.
example1_en: Workers are paving the narrow path behind our house.
example1_zh: 工人们正在给我们屋后的小路铺设路面。
example2_en: Local authorities should pave busy pedestrian routes with durable materials that remain safe in wet weather.
example2_zh: 地方政府应使用耐用且在雨天仍能确保安全的材料铺设繁忙的步行通道。
collocations: pave a road｜铺路 ; pave with stone｜用石料铺设 ; pave the way for｜为……铺平道路
tip_zh: pave the way for比喻“为……创造条件”。

meanings_zh: v. 分类；归类 | v. 将…列为机密
definition_en: To arrange things in groups according to shared characteristics. | To officially restrict access to sensitive information.
example1_en: We classify our books by subject on separate shelves.
example1_zh: 我们按主题把书分类，放在不同的书架上。
example2_en: Researchers classify household waste into several categories to identify which materials could be recycled more effectively.
example2_zh: 研究人员将生活垃圾分成几类，以确定哪些材料可以得到更有效的回收利用。
collocations: classify as｜归类为 ; classify according to｜按照…分类 ; classify information｜将信息列为机密
tip_zh: classify A as B表示“将A归类为B”。

meanings_zh: n. 询问；咨询 | n. 调查；查究
definition_en: A question or request for information. | An organised attempt to discover facts about a matter.
example1_en: The receptionist answered my enquiry about the opening hours.
example1_zh: 接待员回答了我关于营业时间的询问。
example2_en: A public enquiry into the transport project could help explain why construction costs rose so sharply.
example2_zh: 对该交通项目开展公开调查，有助于解释建设成本为何大幅上涨。
collocations: make an enquiry｜进行咨询 ; enquiry about｜关于……的询问 ; public enquiry｜公开调查 ; enquiry desk｜问讯处
tip_zh: 可数名词，复数enquiries；美式通常写inquiry。

meanings_zh: adj. 有男性特征的 | adj. 语法上阳性的
definition_en: Having qualities or appearances traditionally associated with men | Belonging to a grammatical gender category in some languages
example1_en: The jacket gives the outfit a traditionally masculine look.
example1_zh: 这件夹克让整套穿搭呈现出传统的男性风格。
example2_en: Ideas about masculine behaviour vary across cultures and can influence the career choices available to young people.
example2_zh: 不同文化对男性行为的观念各异，并可能影响年轻人可选择的职业道路。
collocations: masculine appearance｜男性化的外表 ; masculine identity｜男性身份认同 ; masculine noun｜阳性名词
tip_zh: male表示生理性别；masculine多指特征或语法性别。

meanings_zh: v. 挠痒；使发痒 | v. 逗乐；使感兴趣 | n. 痒感
definition_en: touch someone lightly, causing laughter or an itchy feeling | amuse someone or pleasantly interest them | a slight itchy feeling in part of the body
example1_en: The kitten's whiskers tickled my wrist as it sniffed.
example1_zh: 小猫凑过来闻时，胡须弄得我的手腕痒痒的。
example2_en: Humorous advertisements often tickle viewers while making ordinary household products seem more appealing to potential buyers.
example2_zh: 幽默广告常常逗乐观众，同时让普通家居用品对潜在买家更有吸引力。
collocations: tickle someone's feet｜挠某人的脚 ; tickle someone's fancy｜引起某人的兴趣 ; a tickle in the throat｜喉咙发痒
tip_zh: tickle指挠痒；scratch多指用指甲抓挠。

meanings_zh: n. 肾；肾脏
definition_en: Either of two organs that filter blood and produce urine.
example1_en: The doctor checked his kidneys during a routine examination.
example1_zh: 医生在常规检查中检查了他的肾脏。
example2_en: Public health campaigns should explain how managing blood pressure can help prevent kidney disease.
example2_zh: 公共卫生宣传应说明控制血压如何有助于预防肾病。
collocations: kidney disease｜肾病 ; kidney function｜肾功能 ; kidney stone｜肾结石 ; kidney transplant｜肾移植
tip_zh: kidney是可数名词；医学形容词renal表示“肾的”。

meanings_zh: v. 预见；预料
definition_en: to know or expect something before it happens
example1_en: We didn't foresee such a long queue outside.
example1_zh: 我们没料到外面会排这么长的队。
example2_en: Urban planners must foresee future transport needs before approving major housing developments on the city's outskirts.
example2_zh: 城市规划者在批准城郊的大型住宅开发项目之前，必须预见未来的交通需求。
collocations: foresee problems｜预见问题 ; foresee consequences｜预见后果 ; difficult to foresee｜难以预料
tip_zh: 过去式foresaw，过去分词foreseen。

meanings_zh: adj. 已登记的；已注册的
definition_en: Officially recorded on a list or in a system.
example1_en: Only registered members can borrow books from this library.
example1_zh: 只有已登记的会员才能从这家图书馆借书。
example2_en: Employing registered nurses in community clinics can improve access to reliable healthcare in rural areas.
example2_zh: 在社区诊所聘用注册护士可以让农村居民更容易获得可靠的医疗服务。
collocations: registered nurse｜注册护士 ; registered charity｜注册慈善机构 ; registered owner｜登记所有人 ; registered post｜挂号邮寄
tip_zh: registered nurse指具备正式执业资格的护士。

meanings_zh: adv. 向岸上；在岸上
definition_en: onto or on land beside a sea, lake, or river
example1_en: We went ashore to buy fresh bread and fruit.
example1_zh: 我们上岸去买新鲜面包和水果。
example2_en: Plastic waste washed ashore can damage coastal ecosystems and reduce the appeal of beaches to tourists.
example2_zh: 被冲上岸的塑料垃圾会破坏沿海生态系统，并降低海滩对游客的吸引力。
collocations: go ashore｜上岸 ; come ashore｜来到岸上 ; wash ashore｜冲上岸
tip_zh: ashore是副词，go ashore前不加to。

meanings_zh: v. 分析；仔细研究
definition_en: Examine something carefully to understand its parts or meaning.
example1_en: We analyzed our spending before planning the next holiday.
example1_zh: 我们先分析了自己的开销，再计划下一次假期。
example2_en: Researchers analyze traffic patterns to identify areas where improved public transport could reduce congestion.
example2_zh: 研究人员分析交通流动规律，找出改善公共交通可能缓解拥堵的区域。
collocations: analyze data｜分析数据 ; analyze results｜分析结果 ; analyze a problem｜分析问题
tip_zh: 美式拼写为analyze，英式通常写analyse。

meanings_zh: n. 视力；视觉 | n. 愿景；远见 | n. 幻象
definition_en: the ability to see | an imagined future or the ability to plan for it | an image experienced as real but not physically present
example1_en: My new glasses have made my vision much clearer.
example1_zh: 我的新眼镜让我看东西清楚多了。
example2_en: Urban planners need a clear vision of how expanding cities can remain both liveable and environmentally sustainable.
example2_zh: 城市规划者需要明确的愿景，使不断扩张的城市既宜居又能保持环境可持续性。
collocations: blurred vision｜视力模糊 ; peripheral vision｜周边视觉 ; a clear vision｜明确的愿景 ; a vision for the future｜未来愿景
tip_zh: 表示视力通常不可数；具体愿景可用a vision。

meanings_zh: n. 过量；过剩 | adj. 过量的；多余的
definition_en: an amount greater than what is needed or allowed | more than is needed, usual, or allowed
example1_en: Wipe away the excess paint with a clean cloth.
example1_zh: 用干净的布擦去多余的油漆。
example2_en: Consuming sugar in excess can increase the risk of obesity and other health problems.
example2_zh: 摄入过量糖分会增加肥胖及其他健康问题的风险。
collocations: in excess｜过量地 ; excess baggage｜超重行李 ; excess demand｜超额需求 ; an excess of｜过多的
tip_zh: in excess指过量；in excess of指超过某数量。

meanings_zh: n. 大公司；法人企业 | n. 市政当局
definition_en: A legally established company, especially a large one. | A governing body responsible for a town or city.
example1_en: My sister works for a corporation that makes furniture.
example1_zh: 我姐姐在一家生产家具的大公司工作。
example2_en: A multinational corporation can create local jobs, but its profits may largely flow back to overseas shareholders.
example2_zh: 跨国公司能够创造本地就业机会，但其利润可能大多流向海外股东。
collocations: multinational corporation｜跨国公司 ; large corporation｜大型公司 ; municipal corporation｜市政法人机构
tip_zh: 常指大型公司；勿与cooperation（合作）混淆。

meanings_zh: adj. 体贴的；替他人着想的
definition_en: Careful not to upset or inconvenience other people.
example1_en: Our considerate neighbour turns down the music after dinner.
example1_zh: 我们那位体贴的邻居晚饭后会把音乐音量调低。
example2_en: Being considerate towards other passengers can make public transport more comfortable and accessible for everyone.
example2_zh: 体谅其他乘客能让公共交通对所有人而言都更舒适、更便于使用。
collocations: considerate of others｜为他人着想 ; considerate behaviour｜体贴的行为 ; considerate neighbour｜体贴的邻居
tip_zh: considerate是体贴的；considerable是相当大的。

meanings_zh: n. 脚印；足迹 | n. 占用空间 | n. 环境影响程度
definition_en: A mark left by a foot on a surface. | The amount of ground or space something occupies. | The environmental impact of a person, product, or activity.
example1_en: A muddy footprint covered the clean kitchen floor.
example1_zh: 干净的厨房地板上留下了一个泥脚印。
example2_en: Choosing locally grown food can sometimes reduce the carbon footprint associated with transporting agricultural products.
example2_zh: 选择本地种植的食物有时可以减少运输农产品产生的碳足迹。
collocations: leave footprints｜留下脚印 ; carbon footprint｜碳足迹 ; a small footprint｜占地面积小
tip_zh: carbon footprint指碳排放影响，不是实际脚印。

meanings_zh: n. 牲畜；家畜
definition_en: farm animals kept for food, materials, or work
example1_en: The farmer moved the livestock into a sheltered field.
example1_zh: 农民把牲畜赶进了一块有遮蔽的田地。
example2_en: Raising livestock requires substantial land and water resources, which can increase pressure on ecosystems in dry regions.
example2_zh: 饲养牲畜需要大量土地和水资源，这可能加剧干旱地区生态系统的压力。
collocations: raise livestock｜饲养牲畜 ; livestock farming｜畜牧业 ; livestock feed｜牲畜饲料 ; livestock production｜畜牧生产
tip_zh: 集合名词，不加-s；表示活的农场动物。

meanings_zh: adj. 不公正的；不公平的
definition_en: not fair or morally right
example1_en: It seemed unjust to blame her for everyone's mistakes.
example1_zh: 把大家的错误都归咎于她，似乎很不公平。
example2_en: An unjust legal system can weaken public trust and discourage citizens from seeking help through official channels.
example2_zh: 不公正的法律制度会削弱公众信任，并使公民不愿通过官方渠道寻求帮助。
collocations: unjust treatment｜不公正待遇 ; an unjust law｜不公正的法律 ; an unjust punishment｜不公正的惩罚
tip_zh: unjust强调违背公正原则；unfair使用范围更广。

meanings_zh: v. 坦白；供认 | v. 承认难以启齿的事
definition_en: to admit doing something wrong or illegal | to admit something personal that you feel embarrassed about
example1_en: I confessed to eating the last slice of cake.
example1_zh: 我坦白自己吃掉了最后一块蛋糕。
example2_en: Students may be more willing to confess their mistakes when teachers respond calmly and offer constructive guidance.
example2_zh: 如果教师冷静回应并给予建设性指导，学生可能更愿意坦白自己的错误。
collocations: confess to doing something｜坦白做过某事 ; confess a crime｜供认罪行 ; confess that｜承认……
tip_zh: confess to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: n. 社会主义
definition_en: A political and economic system favouring public ownership of productive resources
example1_en: Our history teacher explained socialism during today's lively class discussion.
example1_zh: 在今天热烈的课堂讨论中，我们的历史老师讲解了社会主义。
example2_en: Debates about socialism often focus on public ownership, economic equality, and the appropriate role of government.
example2_zh: 关于社会主义的讨论往往聚焦于公有制、经济平等以及政府应发挥的作用。
collocations: democratic socialism｜民主社会主义 ; socialism and capitalism｜社会主义与资本主义 ; principles of socialism｜社会主义原则
tip_zh: 通常为不可数名词；socialist可指社会主义者。

meanings_zh: n. 一段时间；持续时间 | n. 跨度；跨距 | v. 持续；横跨；涵盖
definition_en: The period during which something lasts or happens | The distance from one end of something to the other | To extend across a period, area, or range
example1_en: Our dog has a surprisingly short attention span.
example1_zh: 我们家狗狗能集中注意力的时间短得出奇。
example2_en: The research project will span several decades, allowing scientists to track long-term changes in coastal ecosystems.
example2_zh: 该研究项目将持续数十年，使科学家能够追踪沿海生态系统的长期变化。
collocations: attention span｜注意力持续时间 ; a short time span｜短暂的一段时间 ; span several decades｜持续数十年 ; a bridge span｜桥梁跨度
tip_zh: span作动词直接接时间或范围，无需加介词。

meanings_zh: n. 肺
definition_en: Either of the two chest organs used for breathing.
example1_en: The doctor listened to my lungs through a stethoscope.
example1_zh: 医生用听诊器听了听我的肺部。
example2_en: Long periods of exposure to polluted air can damage the lungs and increase the risk of respiratory disease.
example2_zh: 长期接触受污染的空气可能损伤肺部，并增加患呼吸系统疾病的风险。
collocations: lung disease｜肺病 ; lung capacity｜肺活量 ; lung cancer｜肺癌
tip_zh: 单个肺用lung；谈双肺或肺部通常用lungs。

meanings_zh: adj. 现存的；已有的
definition_en: Already present or in use at a particular time.
example1_en: We kept the existing shelves and painted them blue.
example1_zh: 我们保留了原有的架子，并把它们刷成蓝色。
example2_en: Governments should improve existing transport networks before investing public money in entirely new infrastructure projects.
example2_zh: 政府应先改善现有交通网络，再将公共资金投入全新的基础设施项目。
collocations: existing infrastructure｜现有基础设施 ; existing customers｜现有客户 ; existing conditions｜现有条件
tip_zh: 通常放在名词前，强调已经存在而非新建或新增。

meanings_zh: adj. 重大的；显著的 | adj. 意味深长的
definition_en: large or important enough to deserve attention | expressing a meaning that is not directly stated
example1_en: Moving closer to work made a significant difference to me.
example1_zh: 搬到工作地点附近对我的生活产生了很大的影响。
example2_en: Access to reliable internet services has a significant impact on educational opportunities in remote communities.
example2_zh: 能否获得可靠的互联网服务，对偏远社区的教育机会有重大影响。
collocations: a significant increase｜显著增长 ; a significant impact｜重大影响 ; statistically significant｜统计上显著的 ; a significant glance｜意味深长的一瞥
tip_zh: 统计上significant指达到显著性标准，不等于实际影响很大。

meanings_zh: adj. 总体的；全部的 | adv. 总体上；总的来说
definition_en: considering or including every part of something | when everything is considered together
example1_en: The overall cost includes breakfast and a train ticket.
example1_zh: 总费用包括早餐和一张火车票。
example2_en: Overall, investment in public transport can reduce urban congestion while improving access to employment opportunities.
example2_zh: 总体而言，投资公共交通可以缓解城市拥堵，同时让人们更方便地获得就业机会。
collocations: overall cost｜总费用 ; overall performance｜整体表现 ; overall impact｜总体影响 ; overall improvement｜整体改善
tip_zh: 形容词放名词前；副词可放句首概括整体情况。

meanings_zh: adv. 部分地；不完全地
definition_en: to some extent, but not completely
example1_en: The curtains were partially open, letting in sunlight.
example1_zh: 窗帘开了一部分，让阳光透了进来。
example2_en: Although recycling can partially reduce waste, changes in production and consumption are also necessary.
example2_zh: 虽然回收利用能在一定程度上减少废弃物，但生产和消费方式也需要改变。
collocations: partially open｜部分敞开的 ; partially completed｜部分完成的 ; partially responsible｜负有部分责任的
tip_zh: partially表示不完全地；不要误解为偏心地。

meanings_zh: v. 组装；装配 | v. 集合；召集
definition_en: to join separate parts together to make something | to gather together or bring people or things together
example1_en: We assembled the bookshelf before putting our books away.
example1_zh: 我们先组装好书架，再把书收好。
example2_en: Manufacturers increasingly use robots to assemble electronic devices, improving consistency while reducing demand for some manual jobs.
example2_zh: 制造商越来越多地使用机器人组装电子设备，在提高一致性的同时减少了对某些体力岗位的需求。
collocations: assemble furniture｜组装家具 ; assemble a team｜组建团队 ; assemble evidence｜汇集证据 ; assemble in the hall｜在大厅集合
tip_zh: 组装物品时及物；表示人集合时也可不及物。

meanings_zh: adv. 无疑；毫无疑问地
definition_en: Certainly true, with no reasonable doubt.
example1_en: This is undoubtedly the warmest coat I have ever owned.
example1_zh: 这无疑是我穿过的最暖和的外套。
example2_en: Access to clean drinking water undoubtedly improves public health, particularly in communities with limited medical services.
example2_zh: 获得清洁饮用水无疑能改善公共健康，尤其是在医疗服务有限的社区。
collocations: undoubtedly true｜无疑属实 ; undoubtedly important｜无疑很重要 ; will undoubtedly benefit｜无疑会受益
tip_zh: 语气很肯定；证据不足时宜用probably等弱化表达。

meanings_zh: n. 常态；通常标准 | n. 行为规范
definition_en: a usual situation or accepted standard | an accepted rule for behaviour within a group
example1_en: Working from home is now the norm in our team.
example1_zh: 居家办公如今已成为我们团队的常态。
example2_en: Social norms influence how people interact, although acceptable behaviour can vary significantly across cultures.
example2_zh: 社会规范影响人们的交往方式，但不同文化所接受的行为可能差异很大。
collocations: the norm｜常态 ; social norms｜社会规范 ; cultural norms｜文化规范 ; become the norm｜成为常态
tip_zh: 表示“常态”常用the norm；行为规范常用复数。

meanings_zh: v. 蜇；刺痛 | n. 蜇伤；刺痛 | v. 刺伤感情；使难受
definition_en: Cause sharp pain with a pointed body part or irritating substance | A painful insect injury or a sudden sharp pain | Make someone feel suddenly upset or hurt
example1_en: A bee stung my ankle while I watered the flowers.
example1_zh: 我浇花时，一只蜜蜂蜇了我的脚踝。
example2_en: Harsh criticism can sting young learners and discourage them from participating in classroom discussions.
example2_zh: 严厉的批评会伤害年幼学习者的感情，使他们不愿参与课堂讨论。
collocations: a bee sting｜蜜蜂蜇伤 ; a wasp sting｜黄蜂蜇伤 ; stinging criticism｜尖刻的批评
tip_zh: 过去式、过去分词均为stung；蜇用sting，咬用bite。

meanings_zh: adj. 不情愿的；勉强的
definition_en: Unwilling or hesitant to do something.
example1_en: He was reluctant to leave his warm bed.
example1_zh: 他不情愿离开温暖的被窝。
example2_en: Many commuters remain reluctant to use public transport when services are infrequent or unreliable.
example2_zh: 当班次稀少或服务不可靠时，许多通勤者仍不愿乘坐公共交通。
collocations: reluctant to admit｜不愿承认 ; reluctant to change｜不愿改变 ; reluctant agreement｜勉强同意
tip_zh: 常用be reluctant to do，表示不愿做某事。

meanings_zh: n. 可能性；预期 | n. 前景；成功机会 | v. 勘探矿藏
definition_en: The possibility or expectation that something will happen. | Chances of future success or improvement. | To search an area for valuable minerals or fuels.
example1_en: The prospect of a beach holiday cheered us up.
example1_zh: 想到即将去海边度假，我们的心情好了起来。
example2_en: Access to vocational training can improve employment prospects for young people in economically disadvantaged regions.
example2_zh: 获得职业培训的机会能改善经济欠发达地区年轻人的就业前景。
collocations: the prospect of｜……的可能性 ; employment prospects｜就业前景 ; a realistic prospect｜切实的可能性 ; prospect for gold｜勘探金矿
tip_zh: 前景常用复数prospects；of后可接动名词。

meanings_zh: v. 鼓舞；激励 | v. 赋予灵感；启发 | v. 激起；唤起
definition_en: to make someone feel eager and able to do something | to give someone an idea for something creative | to cause a particular feeling in someone
example1_en: Our coach inspired us to try again after losing.
example1_zh: 输掉比赛后，教练鼓励我们再试一次。
example2_en: Teachers who connect lessons with real problems can inspire students to pursue careers in science.
example2_zh: 将课程与实际问题联系起来的教师能够激励学生投身科学事业。
collocations: inspire someone to act｜激励某人行动 ; inspire confidence｜激发信心 ; inspire creativity｜激发创造力 ; be inspired by nature｜从自然中获得灵感
tip_zh: 常用 inspire sb to do sth，表示激励某人做某事。

meanings_zh: n. 犯罪团伙；帮派 | n. 一群伙伴；一队工人
definition_en: A group of people involved in crime or violence. | A group of friends or people working together.
example1_en: Our whole gang meets at the park on Saturdays.
example1_zh: 我们这群伙伴每周六都在公园碰面。
example2_en: Community programmes can reduce gang membership by offering young people educational support and meaningful employment opportunities.
example2_zh: 社区项目可以通过提供教育支持和有意义的就业机会，减少青少年加入帮派的现象。
collocations: a criminal gang｜犯罪团伙 ; gang violence｜帮派暴力 ; a gang of workers｜一队工人 ; gang up on someone｜结伙欺负某人
tip_zh: 指朋友群体时较口语化；正式语境常指犯罪团伙。

meanings_zh: n. 怀孕；妊娠期
definition_en: The condition or period of carrying a developing baby.
example1_en: She enjoyed gentle walks throughout her pregnancy last year.
example1_zh: 去年怀孕期间，她一直喜欢轻松地散步。
example2_en: Access to reliable healthcare during pregnancy improves health outcomes for both mothers and their babies.
example2_zh: 孕期获得可靠的医疗服务，有助于改善母亲和婴儿的健康状况。
collocations: during pregnancy｜在怀孕期间 ; early pregnancy｜孕早期 ; pregnancy test｜妊娠检测
tip_zh: during pregnancy意为孕期；形容词是pregnant。

meanings_zh: n. 理论；学说 | n. 推测；看法 | n. 理论知识
definition_en: an organized explanation of facts or how something works | an idea offered to explain something, not yet proved | the principles of a subject rather than their practical application
example1_en: My theory is that the cat knocked the cup over.
example1_zh: 我猜是猫把杯子碰倒了。
example2_en: Students benefit from courses that connect scientific theory with practical experiments and problems from everyday life.
example2_zh: 将科学理论与实践实验及日常问题相结合的课程能让学生受益。
collocations: in theory｜理论上 ; support a theory｜支持一种理论 ; test a theory｜检验一种理论 ; theory and practice｜理论与实践
tip_zh: in theory意为“理论上”，常与in practice对比。

meanings_zh: n. 研讨课；研讨会
definition_en: A meeting where a group studies or discusses a subject.
example1_en: We discussed our research ideas during the afternoon seminar.
example1_zh: 我们在下午的研讨课上讨论了各自的研究想法。
example2_en: University seminars encourage students to evaluate different perspectives rather than simply memorise information presented by lecturers.
example2_zh: 大学研讨课鼓励学生评估不同观点，而不是仅仅记忆讲师提供的信息。
collocations: attend a seminar｜参加研讨会 ; lead a seminar｜主持研讨课 ; a seminar on education｜关于教育的研讨会
tip_zh: seminar强调讨论交流；lecture通常以教师讲授为主。

meanings_zh: n. 适应；适应性变化 | n. 改编作品 | n. 改装；调整
definition_en: The process of changing to suit new conditions. | A work changed into another form, such as a film. | A change made to something to suit a particular purpose.
example1_en: Our adaptation to the colder weather took several weeks.
example1_zh: 我们花了几个星期才适应较冷的天气。
example2_en: Climate adaptation requires governments to improve flood defences and support communities facing increasingly frequent extreme weather.
example2_zh: 适应气候变化需要政府改善防洪设施，并支持面临日益频繁的极端天气的社区。
collocations: adaptation to change｜对变化的适应 ; climate adaptation｜气候适应 ; a film adaptation｜电影改编作品 ; evolutionary adaptation｜进化适应
tip_zh: 适应某事用adaptation to；改编自用adaptation of。

meanings_zh: adj. 好斗的；挑衅的 | adj. 强势进取的；积极有力的
definition_en: Ready to argue, threaten, or attack. | Using forceful, determined methods to achieve a goal.
example1_en: The aggressive dog growled whenever anyone approached its gate.
example1_zh: 每当有人靠近大门，那只凶悍的狗就会低吼。
example2_en: Aggressive marketing campaigns may increase sales, but they can also encourage unnecessary consumption and household debt.
example2_zh: 强势营销活动可能提高销量，但也可能助长不必要的消费和家庭负债。
collocations: aggressive behaviour｜攻击性行为 ; aggressive marketing｜强势营销 ; an aggressive approach｜强硬的做法
tip_zh: 形容行为常含贬义；商业语境可指强势进取。

meanings_zh: n. 蜡 | v. 给……上蜡 | v. 月亮渐盈
definition_en: A substance that melts easily, used for candles and protective coatings. | To cover or polish something with wax. | For the moon's visible lit surface to gradually increase.
example1_en: Warm wax dripped from the candle onto the table.
example1_zh: 温热的蜡从蜡烛上滴到了桌子上。
example2_en: A thin layer of wax can protect fresh fruit and reduce moisture loss during transport.
example2_zh: 一层薄蜡可以保护新鲜水果，并减少运输过程中的水分流失。
collocations: candle wax｜烛蜡 ; a layer of wax｜一层蜡 ; wax the floor｜给地板打蜡 ; wax and wane｜盛衰变化
tip_zh: wax作蜡时通常不可数；月亮渐盈与wane相反。

meanings_zh: v. 呻吟 | v. 抱怨；发牢骚 | n. 呻吟声；抱怨
definition_en: To make a low sound expressing pain or unhappiness. | To complain, especially in an annoying or repeated way. | A low sound of pain, or an expression of complaint.
example1_en: He moaned softly as the nurse examined his ankle.
example1_zh: 护士检查他的脚踝时，他轻轻呻吟着。
example2_en: Rather than moan about unreliable buses, residents could ask local authorities to improve public transport.
example2_zh: 居民与其抱怨公交车不准时，不如向地方政府提出改善公共交通的诉求。
collocations: moan in pain｜痛苦地呻吟 ; moan about something｜抱怨某事 ; let out a moan｜发出一声呻吟
tip_zh: 表示抱怨时较口语化，常用moan about。

meanings_zh: n. 续订；续期 | n. 更新；复兴
definition_en: the extension of an agreement or service for another period | the process of making something fresh, strong, or effective again
example1_en: My gym membership is due for renewal next month.
example1_zh: 我的健身房会员资格下个月该续期了。
example2_en: Urban renewal projects should improve public spaces without forcing existing residents to leave their neighbourhoods.
example2_zh: 城市更新项目应改善公共空间，同时避免迫使现有居民搬离所在社区。
collocations: membership renewal｜会员续期 ; licence renewal｜执照续期 ; urban renewal｜城市更新 ; up for renewal｜即将需要续期
tip_zh: renewal是名词；renew a subscription表示“续订”。

meanings_zh: n. 插图；图解 | n. 例证；说明
definition_en: A picture that accompanies or explains something. | An example that makes an idea clearer.
example1_en: The book has a beautiful illustration of a whale.
example1_zh: 这本书里有一幅漂亮的鲸鱼插图。
example2_en: The rapid recovery of this forest provides a clear illustration of the benefits of long-term conservation.
example2_zh: 这片森林的迅速恢复清楚地说明了长期保护的益处。
collocations: a clear illustration of｜对……的清楚说明 ; book illustration｜书籍插图 ; by way of illustration｜举例说明
tip_zh: 插图或例证可数；表示举例说明这一行为时常不可数。

meanings_zh: v. 获得；购得 | v. 学到；习得
definition_en: Get or become the owner of something. | Develop knowledge or skills through learning or experience.
example1_en: We acquired a secondhand table for our tiny kitchen.
example1_zh: 我们为狭小的厨房添置了一张二手桌子。
example2_en: Work placements allow students to acquire practical skills that are difficult to develop through classroom learning alone.
example2_zh: 实习让学生获得仅靠课堂学习难以培养的实用技能。
collocations: acquire skills｜习得技能 ; acquire knowledge｜获取知识 ; acquire a company｜收购公司 ; an acquired taste｜后天养成的喜好
tip_zh: 比get正式；可接资产，也可接知识、技能。

meanings_zh: adj. 空中的；从空中进行的 | n. 天线
definition_en: Happening in the air or done from above the ground. | A device that receives or sends radio or television signals.
example1_en: The aerial photograph showed our house beside the river.
example1_zh: 这张航拍照片拍出了我们河边的房子。
example2_en: Aerial surveys allow researchers to monitor forest loss across remote regions without disturbing wildlife.
example2_zh: 航空调查让研究人员能够监测偏远地区的森林流失，而不惊扰野生动物。
collocations: aerial photography｜航空摄影 ; an aerial view｜鸟瞰景象 ; an aerial survey｜航空调查 ; a television aerial｜电视天线
tip_zh: 作“天线”主要用于英式英语；美式常用antenna。

meanings_zh: adj. 基于事实的；事实性的
definition_en: Based on facts rather than opinions or invented details.
example1_en: Her account of the accident was brief and factual.
example1_zh: 她对事故的叙述简短且符合事实。
example2_en: Students should learn to distinguish factual information from personal opinion when evaluating sources for academic assignments.
example2_zh: 学生在评估学术作业所用的资料来源时，应学会区分事实信息与个人观点。
collocations: factual information｜事实信息 ; factual accuracy｜事实准确性 ; a factual error｜事实性错误 ; a factual account｜如实的叙述
tip_zh: 强调依据事实，不等于actual所指的实际存在。

meanings_zh: n. 活动中心；枢纽 | n. 轮毂 | n. 网络集线器
definition_en: A central place for a particular activity or transport network. | The central part of a wheel, where the spokes meet. | A device that connects several computers within a network.
example1_en: The kitchen is the hub of our family life.
example1_zh: 厨房是我们家庭生活的中心。
example2_en: Investment in reliable rail connections could transform this coastal city into a major regional transport hub.
example2_zh: 投资建设可靠的铁路交通，可以将这座沿海城市转变为重要的区域交通枢纽。
collocations: transport hub｜交通枢纽 ; commercial hub｜商业中心 ; hub of activity｜活动中心 ; network hub｜网络集线器
tip_zh: 中心义常用a hub for或the hub of。

meanings_zh: adj. 特定的 | adj. 明确的；具体的 | adj. 特有的
definition_en: relating to one particular thing rather than things in general | giving exact details rather than general information | found only in a particular person, place, or thing
example1_en: Is there a specific colour you would prefer?
example1_zh: 你有没有特别想要的颜色？
example2_en: Governments should set specific targets for reducing air pollution so that progress can be measured accurately.
example2_zh: 政府应制定具体的空气污染减排目标，以便准确衡量进展。
collocations: specific needs｜特定需求 ; specific details｜具体细节 ; specific targets｜明确的目标 ; specific to｜为……所特有
tip_zh: specific to表示“为……所特有”。

meanings_zh: v. 假定；想当然地认为 | v. 承担；就任 | v. 呈现；具有
definition_en: To accept something as true without having proof. | To take on a duty, responsibility, or position. | To begin to have a particular appearance or quality.
example1_en: Don't assume the shop is open on Sundays.
example1_zh: 别想当然地以为这家店周日营业。
example2_en: Policymakers should not assume that all households have reliable internet access or adequate digital skills.
example2_zh: 政策制定者不应假定所有家庭都有稳定的网络连接或足够的数字技能。
collocations: assume that｜假定…… ; assume responsibility｜承担责任 ; assume office｜就任
tip_zh: assume常接that从句，强调未经证实便认为。

meanings_zh: adj. 不幸的；倒霉的 | adj. 令人遗憾的；不妥的
definition_en: Experiencing bad luck or caused by bad luck. | Regrettable or likely to cause problems or embarrassment.
example1_en: An unfortunate accident left my bicycle wheel badly bent.
example1_zh: 一次不幸的意外把我的自行车车轮撞得严重变形。
example2_en: It is unfortunate that many rural communities still lack reliable access to essential healthcare services.
example2_zh: 令人遗憾的是，许多农村社区仍无法稳定获得基本医疗服务。
collocations: an unfortunate accident｜不幸的意外 ; unfortunate circumstances｜不幸的境况 ; an unfortunate choice of words｜不妥的措辞
tip_zh: It is unfortunate that…可表示“令人遗憾的是……”。

meanings_zh: n. 平房；单层住宅
definition_en: A house usually built on one floor.
example1_en: They bought a bungalow with a small sunny garden.
example1_zh: 他们买了一栋带有阳光充足的小花园的平房。
example2_en: Bungalows can suit older residents because their single-storey design removes the need to climb stairs.
example2_zh: 平房适合老年居民居住，因为单层设计让他们无需爬楼梯。
collocations: detached bungalow｜独立平房 ; single-storey bungalow｜单层平房 ; seaside bungalow｜海滨平房
tip_zh: 重点是通常只有一层，不一定简陋或面积小。

meanings_zh: v. 采用；采取 | v. 收养 | v. 正式通过；采纳
definition_en: To start using a method, idea, or approach. | To legally take someone else's child into your family. | To formally approve a proposal, policy, or rule.
example1_en: We adopted a simpler way to organise our shopping.
example1_zh: 我们采用了一种更简单的方法来安排购物。
example2_en: Governments should adopt long-term strategies that improve public transport rather than simply building more roads.
example2_zh: 政府应采取改善公共交通的长期策略，而不是一味增建道路。
collocations: adopt an approach｜采用一种方法 ; adopt a policy｜采纳一项政策 ; adopt a child｜收养孩子 ; adopt a resolution｜通过决议
tip_zh: adopt是采用或收养；adapt是适应或改编。

meanings_zh: adj. 唯一的；独自的 | n. 脚底；鞋底 | n. 鳎鱼
definition_en: Being the only one, with nobody or nothing else involved. | The bottom surface of a foot or shoe. | A flat sea fish commonly eaten as food.
example1_en: She is the sole owner of this little bakery.
example1_zh: 她是这家小面包店的唯一所有者。
example2_en: Economic growth should not be the sole measure of a country's progress or public wellbeing.
example2_zh: 经济增长不应成为衡量国家进步或公众福祉的唯一标准。
collocations: the sole reason｜唯一原因 ; sole responsibility｜全部责任 ; the sole of a shoe｜鞋底
tip_zh: 表示“唯一的”时通常放名词前；与 soul 同音。

meanings_zh: n. 恼怒；烦躁 | n. 烦人的事物
definition_en: The feeling of being slightly angry or irritated. | Something or someone that makes you feel irritated.
example1_en: She sighed in annoyance when the doorbell rang again.
example1_zh: 门铃再次响起时，她烦躁地叹了口气。
example2_en: Although traffic noise may seem a minor annoyance, prolonged exposure can negatively affect residents' wellbeing.
example2_zh: 交通噪声虽然可能只是小困扰，但长期接触会对居民的身心健康产生不利影响。
collocations: to my annoyance｜令我恼火的是 ; a minor annoyance｜小困扰 ; a source of annoyance｜令人烦恼的根源
tip_zh: 指情绪时不可数；指具体烦人事物时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 专注；专心 | n. 浓度 | n. 集中；聚集
definition_en: The ability to keep your attention on one activity. | The amount of a substance present in a mixture. | A large amount of something gathered in one place.
example1_en: The constant noise outside made concentration difficult for me.
example1_zh: 外面持续不断的噪声让我难以集中注意力。
example2_en: High concentrations of air pollutants near busy roads can pose serious health risks to residents.
example2_zh: 繁忙道路附近高浓度的空气污染物可能严重危害居民健康。
collocations: lose concentration｜注意力分散 ; improve concentration｜提高专注力 ; a high concentration of｜高浓度的；大量集中的 ; a concentration of wealth｜财富集中
tip_zh: 专注通常不可数；某物的浓度用concentration of。

meanings_zh: n. 权力；职权 | n. 当局；主管机构 | n. 权威人士；专家
definition_en: the power or right to make decisions and enforce rules | an official body responsible for a particular area or service | a person with extensive knowledge of a particular subject
example1_en: Only the manager has authority to approve this refund.
example1_zh: 只有经理有权批准这笔退款。
example2_en: Local authorities should consult residents before introducing policies that significantly affect access to public services.
example2_zh: 地方当局在推出显著影响公共服务获取的政策前，应征求居民意见。
collocations: have authority to do something｜有权做某事 ; local authorities｜地方当局 ; an authority on｜某方面的权威 ; abuse of authority｜滥用职权
tip_zh: 表权力通常不可数；the authorities常指当局。

meanings_zh: n. 总部；指挥部
definition_en: The main place from which an organisation is directed.
example1_en: She works at the company's headquarters near the river.
example1_zh: 她在河边的公司总部工作。
example2_en: Moving corporate headquarters to smaller cities can create jobs and reduce pressure on major urban centres.
example2_zh: 将企业总部迁往较小的城市可以创造就业机会，减轻大城市的压力。
collocations: corporate headquarters｜企业总部 ; regional headquarters｜地区总部 ; headquarters staff｜总部员工
tip_zh: 单复数同形，词尾始终保留s。

meanings_zh: v. 倒吸气；喘气 | n. 一声喘息；一声惊叹
definition_en: breathe in suddenly or struggle to breathe | a sudden, short intake of breath
example1_en: We gasped as the whale rose beside our boat.
example1_zh: 鲸鱼在船旁浮出水面时，我们惊得倒吸一口气。
example2_en: Runners may gasp for breath when exercising at high altitudes, where less oxygen is available.
example2_zh: 跑步者在高海拔地区运动时可能会大口喘气，因为那里的氧气较少。
collocations: gasp for breath｜大口喘气 ; gasp in surprise｜惊得倒吸气 ; let out a gasp｜发出一声惊叹
tip_zh: gasp强调突然吸气；pant多指连续急促喘气。

meanings_zh: adj. 不规则的；不整齐的 | adj. 不定时的；无规律的 | adj. 不规则变化的
definition_en: Not having an even shape or a regular pattern. | Not happening at fixed or predictable times. | Not following the usual rules for changing grammatical forms.
example1_en: The path was made from stones of irregular shapes.
example1_zh: 这条小路由形状不规则的石头铺成。
example2_en: Working irregular hours can disrupt sleep patterns and make it harder for employees to maintain healthy routines.
example2_zh: 工作时间不固定可能扰乱睡眠规律，使员工更难保持健康的作息。
collocations: irregular shapes｜不规则形状 ; irregular hours｜不固定的时间 ; irregular verbs｜不规则动词 ; an irregular heartbeat｜心律不齐
tip_zh: 既可形容形状，也可形容时间；不规则动词也用它。

meanings_zh: adj. 松动的；未固定的 | adj. 宽松的 | adj. 不严密的；不严格的
definition_en: not firmly attached or held in place | not fitting closely around the body | not exact or strictly controlled
example1_en: One loose screw made the whole chair feel shaky.
example1_zh: 一颗松动的螺丝让整把椅子都摇晃起来。
example2_en: Loose regulations on industrial waste can allow harmful substances to enter rivers and damage local ecosystems.
example2_zh: 对工业废物监管不严，可能导致有害物质进入河流，破坏当地生态系统。
collocations: loose screw｜松动的螺丝 ; loose clothing｜宽松的衣服 ; loose connection｜松动的连接 ; break loose｜挣脱
tip_zh: loose是形容词，尾音/s/；lose是动词，尾音/z/。

meanings_zh: n. 曲线；弯道 | v. 弯曲；使弯曲
definition_en: a line or shape that bends smoothly | to bend smoothly, or make something bend smoothly
example1_en: The driver slowed down as we approached a sharp curve.
example1_zh: 我们接近一个急弯时，司机放慢了车速。
example2_en: Roads that curve around existing woodland can reduce habitat destruction, although they may increase construction costs.
example2_zh: 绕着现有林地修建的弯曲道路可以减少栖息地破坏，但可能增加建设成本。
collocations: a sharp curve｜急弯 ; a gentle curve｜平缓的弯曲 ; a learning curve｜学习曲线 ; curve around｜绕着弯曲延伸
tip_zh: curve可作名词或动词；“弯曲的”用curved。

meanings_zh: n. 工会 | n. 联合；联盟
definition_en: an organisation that protects workers' rights and interests | the joining of people or groups, or the resulting organisation
example1_en: The union helped staff negotiate better working hours.
example1_zh: 工会帮助员工协商争取到了更合理的工作时间。
example2_en: Joining a union can give employees greater influence over decisions concerning workplace safety and fair pay.
example2_zh: 加入工会能让员工在涉及工作场所安全和公平薪酬的决策中拥有更大的影响力。
collocations: join a union｜加入工会 ; trade union｜工会 ; union representative｜工会代表 ; political union｜政治联盟
tip_zh: union以辅音/j/开头，因此说a union而非an union。

meanings_zh: v. 绊脚；踉跄 | v. 结结巴巴地说
definition_en: To trip or briefly lose balance while walking or running | To hesitate or make mistakes while speaking
example1_en: I stumbled over a loose stone on the garden path.
example1_zh: 我在花园小路上被一块松动的石头绊了一下。
example2_en: Students may stumble over unfamiliar words during presentations, but regular practice can improve their confidence.
example2_zh: 学生做展示时可能会在不熟悉的词上卡壳，但经常练习能增强他们的信心。
collocations: stumble over a stone｜被石头绊一下 ; stumble over words｜说话磕磕巴巴 ; stumble across something｜偶然发现某物
tip_zh: stumble不一定摔倒；stumble across指偶然发现。

meanings_zh: n. 海港；海港城市
definition_en: A coastal harbour or town where ships load and unload.
example1_en: Huge ships arrive at the seaport every morning.
example1_zh: 每天早晨都有巨轮抵达这个海港。
example2_en: Investment in modern seaports can strengthen international trade and create employment in coastal regions.
example2_zh: 投资建设现代化海港可以促进国际贸易，并在沿海地区创造就业机会。
collocations: major seaport｜主要海港 ; busy seaport｜繁忙的海港 ; seaport development｜海港开发
tip_zh: seaport强调海港，区别于内河港和机场。

meanings_zh: adj. 自发的；未经安排的 | adj. 随性的；自然率真的
definition_en: Happening naturally without being planned or deliberately caused | Acting freely on feelings rather than following plans
example1_en: We made a spontaneous trip to the beach yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天我们临时起意，去了一趟海边。
example2_en: Spontaneous conversations between colleagues can generate creative ideas that formal meetings sometimes fail to produce.
example2_zh: 同事间自发的交谈可以激发创意，而正式会议有时反倒做不到。
collocations: spontaneous reaction｜自发反应 ; spontaneous applause｜自发的掌声 ; spontaneous decision｜即兴决定
tip_zh: 强调非预先安排，不等于“无意识的”。

meanings_zh: n. 盎司（重量单位） | n. 少量；一点点
definition_en: A unit of weight equal to approximately 28.35 grams. | A very small amount of something.
example1_en: I added an ounce of butter to the pan.
example1_zh: 我往锅里加了一盎司黄油。
example2_en: Athletes often need every ounce of determination to maintain demanding training schedules alongside their studies.
example2_zh: 运动员往往需要倾尽意志力，才能在兼顾学业的同时坚持高强度训练。
collocations: an ounce of｜一盎司的；一点点的 ; every ounce of strength｜全部力气 ; not an ounce of｜一点也没有
tip_zh: 重量盎司约28.35克；fluid ounce是容量单位。

meanings_zh: n. 饵；诱饵 | v. 给……放饵 | v. 故意激怒；挑衅
definition_en: food or another attraction used to lure animals or people | to put food on a hook or in a trap | to deliberately annoy someone to provoke a reaction
example1_en: We used small pieces of bread as bait.
example1_zh: 我们用小块面包作鱼饵。
example2_en: Some online advertisements use free gifts as bait to encourage consumers to share their personal information.
example2_zh: 一些网络广告用免费礼品作诱饵，诱使消费者分享个人信息。
collocations: live bait｜活饵 ; take the bait｜上钩；中计 ; bait a hook｜给鱼钩装饵
tip_zh: take the bait既可指鱼咬钩，也可比喻中计。

meanings_zh: n. 烟雾；雾霾
definition_en: Polluted air forming a thick cloud over an area.
example1_en: Thick smog hid the hills beyond our apartment.
example1_zh: 浓重的雾霾遮住了我们公寓远处的山丘。
example2_en: Reducing vehicle emissions can help cities tackle smog and protect residents from respiratory diseases.
example2_zh: 减少机动车排放有助于城市治理雾霾，保护居民免受呼吸系统疾病的侵害。
collocations: thick smog｜浓重的雾霾 ; smog levels｜雾霾程度 ; photochemical smog｜光化学烟雾
tip_zh: 通常不可数；smog指污染性烟雾，不是普通雾。

meanings_zh: adj. 残暴的；残忍的 | adj. 严酷的；毫不留情的
definition_en: Extremely cruel or violent | Extremely harsh, difficult, or direct
example1_en: The brutal winter left our garden bare and frozen.
example1_zh: 严酷的冬天让我们的花园光秃秃的，冻成一片。
example2_en: Brutal treatment of prisoners violates human rights and undermines public trust in the justice system.
example2_zh: 残暴对待囚犯侵犯人权，也损害公众对司法制度的信任。
collocations: brutal treatment｜残暴的对待 ; brutal attack｜残暴的袭击 ; brutal honesty｜毫不留情的坦诚 ; brutal winter｜严酷的冬天
tip_zh: brutal honesty指直言不讳到令人难以接受。

meanings_zh: adj. 耐用的 | adj. 持久的
definition_en: Able to last a long time without breaking or wearing out. | Likely to continue or remain effective for a long time.
example1_en: These durable boots have survived years of muddy walks.
example1_zh: 这双耐用的靴子陪我在泥路上走了多年，至今还没坏。
example2_en: Choosing durable products rather than disposable alternatives can reduce household waste and conserve valuable natural resources.
example2_zh: 选择耐用品而非一次性替代品，可以减少家庭垃圾并节约宝贵的自然资源。
collocations: durable materials｜耐用材料 ; durable goods｜耐用品 ; durable solution｜长久有效的解决办法
tip_zh: 耐用品通常用复数名词durables或durable goods。

meanings_zh: n. 葬礼
definition_en: a ceremony held to remember and honour someone who has died
example1_en: We brought white flowers to our neighbour's funeral yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天我们带着白花参加了邻居的葬礼。
example2_en: Funeral traditions vary across cultures, but they often provide families with emotional support during bereavement.
example2_zh: 不同文化的葬礼传统各异，但它们往往能在亲人离世时为家属提供情感支持。
collocations: attend a funeral｜参加葬礼 ; funeral service｜葬礼仪式 ; funeral procession｜送葬队伍 ; funeral arrangements｜葬礼安排
tip_zh: 通常是可数名词：attend a funeral参加葬礼。

meanings_zh: v. 怒目而视 | n. 刺眼的强光 | n. 怒视
definition_en: Look at someone angrily for a sustained moment. | A strong, bright light that makes seeing difficult. | An angry, fixed look directed at someone.
example1_en: She glared at me when I interrupted her story.
example1_zh: 我打断她讲故事时，她怒视着我。
example2_en: Careful placement of street lighting can reduce glare and improve visibility for both drivers and pedestrians.
example2_zh: 合理布置路灯可以减少眩光，改善驾驶员和行人的视野。
collocations: glare at someone｜怒视某人 ; give someone a glare｜瞪某人一眼 ; reduce glare｜减少眩光 ; the glare of the sun｜刺眼的阳光
tip_zh: glare at是怒视；stare at只是盯着看。

meanings_zh: n. 好客；热情款待 | n. 酒店餐饮服务业
definition_en: Friendly and generous treatment of guests or visitors. | The business of providing accommodation, food, and services to guests.
example1_en: Their warm hospitality made us feel completely at home.
example1_zh: 他们的热情款待让我们感到十分自在。
example2_en: The hospitality industry creates employment opportunities, but seasonal demand can make workers' incomes less predictable.
example2_zh: 酒店餐饮服务业创造了就业机会，但季节性需求会使从业者的收入更不稳定。
collocations: warm hospitality｜热情款待 ; extend hospitality to｜款待 ; hospitality industry｜酒店餐饮服务业
tip_zh: 通常不可数；hospitality industry指酒店餐饮服务业。

meanings_zh: adv. 不顾；无论如何
definition_en: Despite difficulties, objections, or other circumstances.
example1_en: Rain was forecast, but we went hiking regardless.
example1_zh: 预报说会下雨，但我们还是去徒步了。
example2_en: Public libraries should provide access to reliable information for everyone, regardless of income or educational background.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆应让所有人都能获取可靠信息，无论其收入或教育背景如何。
collocations: regardless of age｜不论年龄 ; regardless of cost｜不计成本 ; carry on regardless｜不顾困难继续
tip_zh: regardless是副词；接名词时用regardless of。

meanings_zh: adj. 很瘦的；皮包骨的 | adj. 紧身的
definition_en: very thin, often in a way considered unattractive | fitting closely around the body, especially the legs
example1_en: The skinny kitten curled up beside a warm blanket.
example1_zh: 那只瘦小的猫蜷缩在一条暖和的毯子旁。
example2_en: Media images that idealise skinny bodies can create unrealistic expectations and negatively affect young people's confidence.
example2_zh: 将过瘦身材理想化的媒体形象可能制造不切实际的期待，并损害年轻人的自信。
collocations: skinny jeans｜紧身牛仔裤 ; skinny legs｜纤瘦的双腿 ; look skinny｜看起来很瘦
tip_zh: 形容人时常含负面评价；slim通常带赞美意味。

meanings_zh: adj. 忠诚的；忠实的
definition_en: Continuing to support someone or something, even during difficulties.
example1_en: Our loyal dog waits by the door every evening.
example1_zh: 我们忠实的狗每天傍晚都在门边等候。
example2_en: Companies that treat their employees fairly are more likely to retain a loyal and productive workforce.
example2_zh: 公平对待员工的公司更有可能留住忠诚且高效的员工队伍。
collocations: loyal to｜忠于 ; a loyal customer｜忠实顾客 ; remain loyal｜保持忠诚 ; a loyal supporter｜忠实支持者
tip_zh: 表示忠于某人或组织，用loyal to，不用loyal with。

meanings_zh: n. 堵塞；堵塞物
definition_en: Something that prevents movement through a passage, or the resulting obstruction.
example1_en: A blockage in the pipe stopped the water flowing.
example1_zh: 管道里有堵塞物，水流不出来了。
example2_en: Regular maintenance of urban drainage systems can prevent blockages that increase the risk of flooding.
example2_zh: 定期维护城市排水系统可以防止堵塞，从而降低洪涝风险。
collocations: clear a blockage｜清除堵塞物 ; a blockage in a pipe｜管道内的堵塞 ; intestinal blockage｜肠梗阻
tip_zh: 指通道堵塞；军事或经济“封锁”通常用blockade。

meanings_zh: n. 顾问；指导教师
definition_en: someone whose job is to give guidance or expert advice
example1_en: My advisor helped me choose courses for next term.
example1_zh: 我的指导老师帮我选了下学期的课程。
example2_en: A qualified financial advisor can help households plan for retirement and manage the risks of long-term investments.
example2_zh: 合格的财务顾问能帮助家庭规划退休生活，并管理长期投资的风险。
collocations: financial advisor｜财务顾问 ; academic advisor｜学业指导教师 ; careers advisor｜职业顾问
tip_zh: advisor与adviser均正确；英式英语常用后者。

meanings_zh: adv. 最终；最后 | adv. 归根结底；根本上
definition_en: in the end, after a series of events | when considering the most important underlying fact
example1_en: We explored several flats but ultimately chose this small house.
example1_zh: 我们看了好几套公寓，但最终选了这栋小房子。
example2_en: Although technology can support classroom learning, educational success ultimately depends on effective teaching and student engagement.
example2_zh: 虽然技术可以辅助课堂学习，但教育成效归根结底取决于有效教学和学生参与。
collocations: ultimately depend on｜归根结底取决于 ; ultimately lead to｜最终导致 ; ultimately responsible｜负最终责任的
tip_zh: 强调最终结果或根本因素，不用于列举中的最后一项。

meanings_zh: adv. 通常；普遍地
definition_en: often or among many people or in many places
example1_en: This spice is commonly used in soups and stews.
example1_zh: 这种香料常用于汤和炖菜。
example2_en: Although online learning is commonly viewed as convenient, its effectiveness depends on student motivation and access to reliable technology.
example2_zh: 尽管在线学习普遍被认为很方便，其效果仍取决于学生的学习动力和可靠的技术条件。
collocations: commonly used｜常用的 ; commonly known as｜通常称为 ; commonly found｜常见的 ; commonly believed｜普遍认为的
tip_zh: 常置于实义动词前、be动词后，如is commonly used。

meanings_zh: n. 叛乱；起义 | n. 反抗；叛逆
definition_en: Organized resistance, often violent, against a government or ruler. | Refusal to accept authority, rules, or expected behaviour.
example1_en: Refusing to tidy his room was his small rebellion.
example1_zh: 拒绝整理房间是他小小的反抗。
example2_en: Historians often examine how economic hardship and political exclusion contribute to rebellion against established authority.
example2_zh: 历史学家常研究经济困境和政治排斥如何促成对既有权威的反抗。
collocations: armed rebellion｜武装叛乱 ; teenage rebellion｜青少年叛逆 ; rebellion against authority｜对权威的反抗 ; crush a rebellion｜镇压叛乱
tip_zh: 常接against，说明反抗的对象。

meanings_zh: adj. 极度的；极端的 | adj. 偏激的；过激的 | n. 极端；极限
definition_en: very great in degree or far beyond what is usual | far beyond what most people consider reasonable or acceptable | either end of a range of conditions or behaviour
example1_en: We kept the curtains closed during the extreme heat.
example1_zh: 酷热期间，我们一直拉着窗帘。
example2_en: Extreme weather events can damage infrastructure and place considerable pressure on emergency services in vulnerable communities.
example2_zh: 极端天气事件会破坏基础设施，并给脆弱社区的应急服务带来巨大压力。
collocations: extreme weather｜极端天气 ; extreme poverty｜极度贫困 ; extreme views｜偏激的观点 ; go to extremes｜走极端
tip_zh: 副词用extremely；名词常见go to extremes。

meanings_zh: n. 乘务员；活动服务人员 | n. 管理人；守护者 | v. 管理；妥善照管
definition_en: Someone who assists passengers or people attending an event. | Someone responsible for caring for property or resources. | To manage or protect resources responsibly.
example1_en: A steward helped us find our seats before the concert.
example1_zh: 音乐会开始前，一位工作人员帮我们找到了座位。
example2_en: Local communities can act as stewards of natural habitats when they receive adequate funding and decision-making powers.
example2_zh: 当地社区若获得充足资金和决策权，就能成为自然栖息地的守护者。
collocations: a ship's steward｜船上乘务员 ; a steward of natural resources｜自然资源守护者 ; steward resources｜妥善管理资源
tip_zh: 不只指乘务员；a steward of也可指资源守护者。

meanings_zh: n. 援助；救助 | v. 帮助；促进 | n. 辅助工具
definition_en: Help provided through money, supplies, services, or practical support. | To help someone or make a process easier. | An object or device that helps someone do something.
example1_en: Volunteers brought food and medical aid to the village.
example1_zh: 志愿者为村子送来了食物和医疗援助。
example2_en: International aid can improve access to clean water, but lasting progress also requires investment in local infrastructure.
example2_zh: 国际援助可以改善清洁用水的获取条件，但持久进步还需要对当地基础设施进行投资。
collocations: humanitarian aid｜人道主义援助 ; financial aid｜经济援助 ; first aid｜急救 ; hearing aid｜助听器
tip_zh: 援助义通常不可数；辅助工具义可数，如a hearing aid。

meanings_zh: n. 抹布；破布 | n. 破旧衣服
definition_en: A piece of old cloth, often used for cleaning. | Old, badly torn clothes, usually described in the plural.
example1_en: He wiped the oily tools with an old rag.
example1_zh: 他用一块旧抹布擦拭沾满油污的工具。
example2_en: Reusing worn clothing as cleaning rags can reduce household waste and demand for disposable products.
example2_zh: 把旧衣服改作清洁抹布，可以减少家庭垃圾及对一次性用品的需求。
collocations: an old rag｜一块旧抹布 ; a cleaning rag｜清洁抹布 ; in rags｜衣衫褴褛 ; from rags to riches｜从贫穷到富有
tip_zh: 单数常指一块破布；in rags表示衣衫褴褛。

meanings_zh: adj. 相反的；相违背的 | n. 相反的情况
definition_en: opposite to something or inconsistent with it | the opposite of what has been said or suggested
example1_en: Contrary to the forecast, sunshine filled our garden.
example1_zh: 与天气预报相反，阳光洒满了我们的花园。
example2_en: Contrary to popular belief, expanding road networks does not always reduce traffic congestion in major cities.
example2_zh: 与普遍看法相反，扩大道路网络并不总能缓解大城市的交通拥堵。
collocations: contrary to expectations｜出乎预料 ; contrary evidence｜相反证据 ; on the contrary｜恰恰相反 ; to the contrary｜表明相反情况的
tip_zh: on the contrary用于纠正前述观点，意为恰恰相反。

meanings_zh: n. 橱柜；储物柜 | n. 内阁
definition_en: a cupboard with shelves or drawers for storing things | the group of senior ministers who make major government decisions
example1_en: The clean cups are in the cabinet above the sink.
example1_zh: 干净杯子放在水槽上方的橱柜里。
example2_en: The cabinet approved a national programme to improve access to affordable housing in rapidly growing cities.
example2_zh: 内阁批准了一项全国性计划，以增加快速发展城市中可负担住房的供应。
collocations: kitchen cabinet｜厨房橱柜 ; filing cabinet｜文件柜 ; cabinet minister｜内阁大臣 ; cabinet meeting｜内阁会议
tip_zh: 可指家具或内阁；内阁由政府高级部长组成。

meanings_zh: n. 完美；尽善尽美
definition_en: The state of being completely without faults or weaknesses
example1_en: The bread was baked to perfection, with a crisp crust.
example1_zh: 这面包烤得恰到好处，外皮酥脆。
example2_en: An excessive desire for perfection can increase students' anxiety and discourage them from experimenting with new ideas.
example2_zh: 过度追求完美会加重学生的焦虑，并使他们不愿尝试新想法。
collocations: strive for perfection｜力求完美 ; achieve perfection｜达到完美 ; to perfection｜完美地；恰到好处 ; pursuit of perfection｜对完美的追求
tip_zh: 通常为不可数名词；to perfection指做得恰到好处。

meanings_zh: v. 搭便车旅行
definition_en: Travel by getting free rides in passing vehicles.
example1_en: We hitchhiked to the coast with our backpacks.
example1_zh: 我们背着背包搭便车去了海边。
example2_en: Although some tourists hitchhike to reduce travel costs, limited transport services can make such journeys unpredictable.
example2_zh: 虽然一些游客为节省交通费用而搭便车，但交通服务有限可能使这类旅程难以预测。
collocations: hitchhike across a country｜搭便车穿越一个国家 ; hitchhike to the coast｜搭便车去海边
tip_zh: 通常作不及物动词；目的地前用to。

meanings_zh: n. 顶峰；山峰；最高点 | v. 达到最高点 | adj. 最高的；高峰期的
definition_en: A mountain's top or the highest level of something. | To reach the highest level or amount. | At the highest level of activity, demand, or achievement.
example1_en: Snow still covered the mountain peak in June.
example1_zh: 六月时，山顶仍覆盖着积雪。
example2_en: Electricity demand usually peaks in the early evening, when households use several appliances at once.
example2_zh: 电力需求通常在傍晚达到高峰，因为那时许多家庭会同时使用多种电器。
collocations: reach a peak｜达到顶峰 ; peak demand｜需求高峰 ; mountain peak｜山峰 ; peak season｜旺季
tip_zh: peak at后接峰值；peak season表示旺季。

meanings_zh: n. 芳香；香气
definition_en: a noticeable pleasant smell, especially from food or drink
example1_en: The aroma of fresh bread filled the kitchen.
example1_zh: 新鲜面包的香气弥漫了整个厨房。
example2_en: The aroma of freshly prepared food can enhance customers' dining experiences and influence their perception of quality.
example2_zh: 现做食物的香气能够提升顾客的用餐体验，并影响他们对品质的判断。
collocations: the aroma of coffee｜咖啡的香气 ; rich aroma｜浓郁的香气 ; release an aroma｜散发香气
tip_zh: 通常指令人愉悦的气味，尤用于食物和饮品。

meanings_zh: v. 给……接种疫苗
definition_en: To give a vaccine that helps protect against a disease.
example1_en: The vet will vaccinate our puppy during today's appointment.
example1_zh: 兽医会在今天的就诊中给我们的小狗接种疫苗。
example2_en: Public health programmes aim to vaccinate vulnerable populations and reduce the spread of infectious diseases.
example2_zh: 公共卫生项目旨在为易感人群接种疫苗，并减少传染病的传播。
collocations: vaccinate against measles｜接种麻疹疫苗 ; vaccinate children｜给儿童接种疫苗 ; get vaccinated｜接种疫苗
tip_zh: 用vaccinate someone against某疾病。

meanings_zh: n. 贡献；促成作用 | n. 捐款；捐赠物 | n. 投稿；稿件
definition_en: Something done or provided to help achieve a shared result. | Money or goods given to support a person or cause. | A piece of writing supplied for a publication.
example1_en: Your contribution helped us finish the garden before sunset.
example1_zh: 有了你的帮助，我们在日落前完成了花园的整理工作。
example2_en: Public libraries make a valuable contribution to lifelong learning by providing free access to information.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆通过免费提供信息资源，为终身学习作出了宝贵贡献。
collocations: make a contribution to｜为…作出贡献 ; a significant contribution｜重大贡献 ; a voluntary contribution｜自愿捐款
tip_zh: 常用make a contribution to；to后接名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 海面下的；海底的
definition_en: Located or happening below the surface of the sea
example1_en: The documentary showed colourful fish around an undersea cave.
example1_zh: 这部纪录片展示了海底洞穴周围色彩斑斓的鱼。
example2_en: Undersea cables connect continents and provide essential infrastructure for global communication and international trade.
example2_zh: 海底电缆连接各大洲，为全球通信和国际贸易提供重要基础设施。
collocations: undersea cable｜海底电缆 ; undersea exploration｜海底勘探 ; undersea tunnel｜海底隧道
tip_zh: 常放在名词前；强调海面以下，而非所有水下环境。

meanings_zh: n. 暴风雪
definition_en: A severe snowstorm with strong winds.
example1_en: We stayed indoors while the blizzard shook our windows.
example1_zh: 暴风雪吹得窗户直响，我们一直待在屋里。
example2_en: A severe blizzard can disrupt public transport and leave rural communities without electricity for several days.
example2_zh: 严重的暴风雪可能扰乱公共交通，并使农村社区连续数天断电。
collocations: a severe blizzard｜猛烈的暴风雪 ; blizzard conditions｜暴风雪天气
tip_zh: 比普通snowstorm更强调强风和恶劣天气。

meanings_zh: n. 一户；同住的一家人 | adj. 家庭的；家用的
definition_en: all the people who live together in one home | relating to a home and its everyday needs
example1_en: Everyone in our household takes turns washing the dishes.
example1_zh: 我们家每个人都轮流洗碗。
example2_en: Rising energy prices place considerable pressure on household budgets, particularly among families with lower incomes.
example2_zh: 能源价格上涨给家庭预算带来了很大压力，低收入家庭尤其如此。
collocations: household income｜家庭收入 ; household appliances｜家用电器 ; household chores｜家务 ; single-person household｜独居户
tip_zh: household强调同住一户，不一定有亲属关系。

meanings_zh: v. 相符；相对应 | v. 通信
definition_en: To match something or have an equivalent role or position. | To exchange letters or messages with someone.
example1_en: The colours on these lids correspond to the containers.
example1_zh: 这些盖子的颜色与各自的容器相对应。
example2_en: University courses should correspond more closely to the skills that employers need in a changing economy.
example2_zh: 在不断变化的经济中，大学课程应与雇主所需的技能更加契合。
collocations: correspond to｜对应于 ; correspond with someone｜与某人通信 ; correspond closely｜高度相符
tip_zh: 对应常用correspond to；与人通信接with。

meanings_zh: adj. 广阔的；巨大的
definition_en: Extremely large in area, size, amount, or degree.
example1_en: A vast desert stretched beyond the small village.
example1_zh: 小村庄外是一片绵延的广阔沙漠。
example2_en: Digital libraries give students access to vast amounts of information, although evaluating its reliability remains essential.
example2_zh: 数字图书馆让学生能够获取海量信息，但评估信息的可靠性仍然至关重要。
collocations: the vast majority｜绝大多数 ; vast amounts of｜大量的 ; a vast area｜广阔的区域 ; vast resources｜巨大的资源储备
tip_zh: the vast majority of表示……中的绝大多数。

meanings_zh: n. 部分；片段；瓣 | v. 分割；划分
definition_en: one part of something divided into separate sections | to divide something into separate parts or groups
example1_en: He offered me a juicy segment of orange.
example1_zh: 他递给我一瓣多汁的橙子。
example2_en: Companies often segment their customers by age to develop more effective advertising strategies.
example2_zh: 企业常按年龄划分顾客群体，以制定更有效的广告策略。
collocations: market segment｜细分市场 ; orange segment｜一瓣橙子 ; segment customers｜划分顾客群体
tip_zh: 名词重音在前；动词读/seɡˈment/。

meanings_zh: n. 侦察员；球探；星探 | v. 搜寻；侦察 | n. 童子军成员
definition_en: Someone sent to gather information or discover talented people. | To search an area for something or gather information. | A member of a youth group learning outdoor skills.
example1_en: A scout watched our team practise after school.
example1_zh: 放学后，一位球探观看了我们队的训练。
example2_en: Sports clubs often scout for talented young players in communities that lack access to professional training facilities.
example2_zh: 体育俱乐部经常到缺乏专业训练设施的社区寻找有天赋的年轻球员。
collocations: a talent scout｜星探；人才发掘者 ; a football scout｜足球球探 ; scout for talent｜寻找人才 ; scout out a location｜勘察地点
tip_zh: scout for后接寻找的对象；童子军成员常写作Scout。

meanings_zh: n. 替代品；替补者 | v. 替代；用……代替
definition_en: A person or thing used in place of another. | Use someone or something instead of another person or thing.
example1_en: Yoghurt makes a good substitute for cream in this soup.
example1_zh: 做这道汤时，酸奶可以很好地代替奶油。
example2_en: Online lessons can support independent learning, but they are not always an adequate substitute for classroom interaction.
example2_zh: 线上课程能支持自主学习，但并不总能充分替代课堂互动。
collocations: a substitute for｜……的替代品 ; substitute A for B｜用A代替B ; a suitable substitute｜合适的替代品 ; a substitute teacher｜代课教师
tip_zh: substitute A for B＝用A代替B，勿颠倒。

meanings_zh: v. 撒；洒 | n. 少量；少许
definition_en: To scatter small drops or pieces over something. | A small amount scattered over a surface.
example1_en: Sprinkle some cinnamon over your porridge before eating.
example1_zh: 吃燕麦粥前，在上面撒些肉桂粉。
example2_en: Rather than adding excessive salt, consumers can sprinkle herbs over meals to enhance flavour more healthily.
example2_zh: 消费者可以在饭菜上撒些香草，以更健康的方式增添风味，而不是加入过多盐。
collocations: sprinkle sugar over｜把糖撒在……上 ; sprinkle with herbs｜撒上香草 ; a sprinkle of salt｜少许盐
tip_zh: 可说sprinkle A over B，也可说sprinkle B with A。

meanings_zh: n. 孤独；寂寞
definition_en: Sadness caused by feeling alone or lacking close relationships
example1_en: Calling an old friend helped ease my loneliness.
example1_zh: 给一位老朋友打电话缓解了我的孤独感。
