example2_zh: 在地下挖洞的动物能让空气和水进入更深的土层，从而改善土壤质量。
collocations: a rabbit burrow｜兔子洞 ; burrow into the ground｜钻入地下 ; burrow under a blanket｜钻到毯子下面
tip_zh: burrow指挖洞或地洞；别与borrow（借入）混淆。

meanings_zh: adj. 防护的；保护性的 | adj. 关切保护的
definition_en: Intended to prevent injury, damage, or other harm | Wanting to keep someone safe from harm or trouble
example1_en: Wear protective gloves before handling those sharp metal pieces.
example1_zh: 拿那些锋利的金属片之前，要戴上防护手套。
example2_en: Employers should provide protective equipment and regular training to reduce injuries in dangerous workplaces.
example2_zh: 雇主应提供防护装备和定期培训，以减少危险工作场所中的伤害事故。
collocations: protective clothing｜防护服 ; protective equipment｜防护装备 ; protective measures｜保护措施 ; protective of someone｜关切保护某人
tip_zh: 表示关切保护某人，用be protective of。

meanings_zh: n. 厚度 | n. 浓稠度
definition_en: The distance between two opposite surfaces of something. | The degree to which a liquid is thick.
example1_en: Check the thickness of the wood before buying it.
example1_zh: 购买木材前先检查它的厚度。
example2_en: The thickness of insulation affects how much energy a building requires for heating during winter.
example2_zh: 保温层的厚度会影响建筑物冬季供暖所需的能源量。
collocations: wall thickness｜墙体厚度 ; a thickness of｜厚度为 ; uniform thickness｜均匀的厚度
tip_zh: 表示厚度时常用a thickness of＋具体尺寸。

meanings_zh: n. 数据；资料
definition_en: facts or information collected for analysis or computer use
example1_en: My watch collects data about how far I walk.
example1_zh: 我的手表会收集有关我步行距离的数据。
example2_en: Reliable data allows policymakers to assess whether environmental regulations are reducing pollution in urban areas.
example2_zh: 可靠的数据能让政策制定者评估环境法规是否正在减少城市污染。
collocations: collect data｜收集数据 ; analyse data｜分析数据 ; personal data｜个人数据 ; data protection｜数据保护
tip_zh: 日常常作不可数名词；学术语境也用复数谓语。

meanings_zh: adv. 本质上；基本上
definition_en: When considering the most important features or facts.
example1_en: These two phones are essentially the same, apart from colour.
example1_zh: 这两部手机除了颜色不同，基本上是一样的。
example2_en: Although teaching methods have changed, the purpose of education remains essentially the same across generations.
example2_zh: 尽管教学方法有所改变，教育的目的在不同世代之间仍基本一致。
collocations: essentially the same｜基本相同 ; essentially different｜本质上不同 ; essentially a matter of｜本质上是……的问题
tip_zh: 是副词，不是形容词；常用于概括核心事实。

meanings_zh: v. 仔细检查 | v. 视察；正式检查
definition_en: To examine something carefully for faults or other details. | To visit officially to check that required standards are met.
example1_en: Please inspect the bicycle's brakes before you ride it.
example1_zh: 骑自行车前，请仔细检查刹车。
example2_en: Local authorities should inspect rental properties regularly to ensure that tenants have safe and healthy living conditions.
example2_zh: 地方政府应定期检查出租房屋，确保租客拥有安全、健康的居住条件。
collocations: inspect for damage｜检查有无损坏 ; inspect the premises｜检查场所 ; inspect thoroughly｜彻底检查
tip_zh: 及物动词，直接接检查对象，不加at。

meanings_zh: n. 饮料
definition_en: A drink, such as tea, juice, or coffee.
example1_en: Would you like a hot beverage with your sandwich?
example1_zh: 你想来杯热饮配三明治吗？
example2_en: Reducing the consumption of sugary beverages could help lower obesity rates among young people.
example2_zh: 减少含糖饮料的摄入可能有助于降低年轻人的肥胖率。
collocations: hot beverage｜热饮 ; alcoholic beverage｜酒精饮料 ; sugary beverage｜含糖饮料 ; food and beverages｜食品与饮料
tip_zh: beverage较正式，多用于餐饮或学术语境；日常用drink。

meanings_zh: adj. 口头的；非书面的 | adj. 言语的；与词语有关的
definition_en: spoken rather than written | relating to words or the use of language
example1_en: We made a verbal agreement to share the garden.
example1_zh: 我们口头约定共用这个花园。
example2_en: Employers should confirm verbal agreements in writing to prevent misunderstandings about working hours and responsibilities.
example2_zh: 雇主应以书面形式确认口头协议，以防对工作时间和职责产生误解。
collocations: a verbal agreement｜口头协议 ; verbal communication｜言语交流 ; verbal skills｜语言能力 ; a verbal warning｜口头警告
tip_zh: verbal也指用词语表达，不总与written对立。

meanings_zh: n. 金融；资金管理 | n. 资金 | v. 为…提供资金
definition_en: the management of money by people, businesses, or governments | money needed to support an activity or project | to provide money for something
example1_en: The bank agreed to finance our new bakery.
example1_zh: 银行同意为我们的新面包店提供资金。
example2_en: Access to affordable finance allows small businesses to invest in equipment and create more local jobs.
example2_zh: 获得成本可承受的资金使小企业能够投资设备并创造更多本地就业机会。
collocations: public finance｜公共财政 ; raise finance｜筹集资金 ; finance a project｜为项目提供资金 ; personal finances｜个人财务状况
tip_zh: finance可指资金或金融；个人财务常用finances。

meanings_zh: n. 破坏；毁灭
definition_en: Damage so severe that something no longer exists or works.
example1_en: The storm left a trail of destruction along the coast.
example1_zh: 风暴沿海岸留下了一片破坏的痕迹。
example2_en: The destruction of natural habitats threatens biodiversity and reduces the resources available to local communities.
example2_zh: 自然栖息地的破坏威胁生物多样性，也减少了当地社区可利用的资源。
collocations: habitat destruction｜栖息地破坏 ; widespread destruction｜大范围破坏 ; a trail of destruction｜沿途的破坏痕迹
tip_zh: 通常不可数；动词是destroy，不是destruct。

meanings_zh: n. 情感；情绪
definition_en: a strong feeling such as joy, fear, or sadness
example1_en: Her voice shook with emotion when she saw her brother.
example1_zh: 见到哥哥时，她激动得声音都颤抖了。
example2_en: Teaching children to recognise and manage emotion can improve their relationships and support long-term mental health.
example2_zh: 教孩子识别和管理情绪，可以改善他们的人际关系，并促进长期心理健康。
collocations: express emotion｜表达情感 ; strong emotions｜强烈的情绪 ; mixed emotions｜复杂的情绪 ; control your emotions｜控制自己的情绪
tip_zh: 泛指情感时可不可数；具体的各种情绪常用emotions。

meanings_zh: n. 进化 | n. 演变；逐步发展
definition_en: Gradual changes in living things over many generations. | The gradual development of something over time.
example1_en: The museum uses bird skeletons to explain evolution.
example1_zh: 这家博物馆用鸟类骨骼来解释进化。
example2_en: The evolution of digital technology has transformed how people communicate, study and access public services.
example2_zh: 数字技术的演变改变了人们交流、学习和获取公共服务的方式。
collocations: the theory of evolution｜进化论 ; human evolution｜人类进化 ; biological evolution｜生物进化 ; the evolution of technology｜技术的演变
tip_zh: evolution指进化；进化论用the theory of evolution。

meanings_zh: v. 监督；指导；照看
definition_en: watch and guide people to ensure work or activities go properly
example1_en: An adult must supervise the children near the pool.
example1_zh: 孩子们在泳池附近时，必须有成人照看。
example2_en: Experienced nurses should supervise new staff to ensure that patients receive safe and effective care.
example2_zh: 经验丰富的护士应指导新员工，确保患者获得安全有效的护理。
collocations: supervise staff｜监督员工 ; supervise children｜照看儿童 ; supervise a project｜监管项目
tip_zh: 及物动词，直接接人或活动：supervise staff。

meanings_zh: v. 咧嘴笑；露齿笑 | n. 咧嘴笑；露齿笑
definition_en: To smile widely, usually showing your teeth. | A broad smile that usually shows the teeth.
example1_en: She grinned when her puppy brought back the ball.
example1_zh: 小狗把球叼回来时，她咧嘴笑了。
example2_en: A friendly grin from a teacher may help nervous students feel more comfortable participating in classroom discussions.
example2_zh: 老师一个友善的笑容，可能让紧张的学生更自在地参与课堂讨论。
collocations: grin broadly｜咧嘴大笑 ; a cheeky grin｜调皮的笑容 ; grin at someone｜朝某人咧嘴笑
tip_zh: grin比smile更强调咧嘴露齿；过去式为grinned。

meanings_zh: v. 插入；放入 | v. 添加；插入内容 | n. 插页；插入物
definition_en: to put something into something else | to add something within a document, recording, or piece of writing | something designed to be placed inside another thing
example1_en: Insert the key gently, then turn it to the left.
example1_zh: 轻轻插入钥匙，然后向左转动。
example2_en: Students should insert relevant examples into their essays to support arguments about complex social issues.
example2_zh: 学生应在作文中加入相关例子，以支持关于复杂社会问题的论点。
collocations: insert into｜插入……中 ; insert a card｜插卡 ; insert an image｜插入图像
tip_zh: 动词重音在后，名词重音在前。

meanings_zh: n. 市场营销
definition_en: activities that identify customers' needs and promote products or services
example1_en: My sister handles marketing for a small local bakery.
example1_zh: 我姐姐负责一家本地小面包店的营销工作。
example2_en: Effective marketing helps small businesses reach new customers without necessarily spending large amounts on advertising.
example2_zh: 有效的营销能帮助小企业接触新客户，而不一定需要投入大量广告费。
collocations: marketing strategy｜营销策略 ; digital marketing｜数字营销 ; marketing campaign｜营销活动 ; market research｜市场调研
tip_zh: marketing通常不可数，范围比advertising更广。

meanings_zh: v. 重新开始；继续
definition_en: To start again after stopping or being interrupted.
example1_en: We will resume our walk when the rain stops.
example1_zh: 雨停后，我们会继续散步。
example2_en: Schools can resume normal teaching once damaged buildings have been repaired and essential safety checks are complete.
example2_zh: 受损建筑修复且必要的安全检查完成后，学校便可恢复正常教学。
collocations: resume work｜恢复工作 ; resume talks｜重启谈判 ; resume normal service｜恢复正常服务
tip_zh: 后接名词或动名词；名词résumé意为简历。

meanings_zh: n. 铝
definition_en: A light, silvery metal used for cans, foil, and aircraft.
example1_en: This aluminum ladder is light enough to carry alone.
example1_zh: 这把铝梯很轻，一个人就能搬动。
example2_en: Recycling aluminum requires substantially less energy than producing new metal from ore, reducing the environmental impact of manufacturing.
example2_zh: 回收铝所需的能源远少于从矿石中提炼新铝，因此能减少制造业对环境的影响。
collocations: aluminum foil｜铝箔 ; aluminum cans｜铝罐 ; aluminum alloy｜铝合金
tip_zh: 美式拼写；英式通常写aluminium，读音也不同。

meanings_zh: n. 团队合作
definition_en: People working together effectively to achieve a shared goal
example1_en: Good teamwork helped us finish painting before lunch.
example1_zh: 良好的团队合作让我们在午饭前刷完了漆。
example2_en: Group projects can develop teamwork skills that students will need in their future careers.
example2_zh: 小组项目可以培养学生未来工作所需的团队合作能力。
collocations: effective teamwork｜有效的团队合作 ; teamwork skills｜团队合作技能 ; encourage teamwork｜鼓励团队合作
tip_zh: 不可数名词；强调团队成员共同协作。

meanings_zh: adj. 静止的；不变的 | adj. 静电的 | n. 静电干扰；静电
definition_en: not moving, changing, or developing | relating to electric charges that build up on surfaces | electrical interference or an electric charge collected on a surface
example1_en: The television picture stayed static while the sound continued.
example1_zh: 电视画面停住不动了，但声音还在继续。
example2_en: Wages have remained static for several years, while housing costs have risen steadily in major cities.
example2_zh: 工资多年来一直没有变化，而大城市的住房成本却持续上涨。
collocations: remain static｜保持不变 ; static electricity｜静电 ; static image｜静态图像
tip_zh: static强调不动或不变；静电用static electricity。

meanings_zh: n. 氧；氧气
definition_en: A gas needed by most living things for life.
example1_en: The nurse gave him oxygen through a clear plastic mask.
example1_zh: 护士通过透明塑料面罩给他输氧。
example2_en: Pollution can reduce oxygen levels in rivers, making it difficult for fish and other aquatic organisms to survive.
example2_zh: 污染会降低河流中的含氧量，使鱼类和其他水生生物难以生存。
collocations: oxygen supply｜氧气供应 ; oxygen levels｜含氧量 ; lack of oxygen｜缺氧 ; oxygen mask｜氧气面罩
tip_zh: oxygen是不可数名词，不说an oxygen。

meanings_zh: n. 商人；交易员
definition_en: Someone who buys and sells goods or financial assets.
example1_en: A market trader arranged fresh oranges outside his stall.
example1_zh: 一位市场商贩在摊位外摆放新鲜橙子。
example2_en: Small traders often struggle to compete with larger retailers that can negotiate lower prices from suppliers.
example2_zh: 小商贩往往难以与能向供应商争取更低价格的大型零售商竞争。
collocations: market trader｜市场商贩 ; currency trader｜外汇交易员 ; independent trader｜独立商户 ; stock trader｜股票交易员
tip_zh: 可指实物买卖者，也可指金融市场交易员。

meanings_zh: adv. 容易地；轻易地 | adv. 欣然地；乐意地
definition_en: Easily and without difficulty or delay. | Willingly and without hesitation.
example1_en: My sister readily agreed to water the plants.
example1_zh: 姐姐欣然答应帮忙给植物浇水。
example2_en: Reliable health information should be readily available to all citizens, regardless of their income or location.
example2_zh: 所有公民都应能方便地获取可靠的健康信息，不受收入或居住地点限制。
collocations: readily available｜易于获取的 ; readily accessible｜容易接触或使用的 ; readily agree｜欣然同意 ; readily admit｜坦然承认
tip_zh: readily available指容易获得，不是“乐意提供”。

meanings_zh: n. 传说；传奇故事 | n. 传奇人物 | n. 图例
definition_en: an old popular story that may not be historically true | someone greatly admired for exceptional achievements | a guide explaining the symbols used on a map or chart
example1_en: Grandma told us a legend about a sleeping dragon.
example1_zh: 奶奶给我们讲了一个关于沉睡巨龙的传说。
example2_en: Local legends can strengthen cultural identity while attracting visitors interested in the history of a region.
example2_zh: 地方传说既能增强文化认同，也能吸引对当地历史感兴趣的游客。
collocations: according to legend｜据传说 ; local legend｜地方传说 ; a living legend｜当世传奇人物 ; map legend｜地图图例
tip_zh: legend可能有历史原型，不等于已证实的历史。

meanings_zh: n. 情况；条件；环境 | n. 经济状况；境遇
definition_en: a fact or condition that affects a situation | the conditions of someone's life, especially their financial situation
example1_en: Under no circumstances should you leave the front door unlocked.
example1_zh: 无论什么情况下，你都不该让前门不上锁。
example2_en: Schools should consider each student's personal circumstances when developing policies on attendance and access to learning resources.
example2_zh: 学校制定出勤和学习资源获取政策时，应考虑每位学生的个人情况。
collocations: under the circumstances｜在这种情况下 ; personal circumstances｜个人情况 ; unforeseen circumstances｜意外情况 ; under no circumstances｜绝不
tip_zh: 常用复数；under no circumstances置句首须倒装。

meanings_zh: adj. 随机的；无规律的
definition_en: Chosen or happening without a fixed pattern or deliberate plan.
example1_en: I opened the cookbook at a random page.
example1_zh: 我随手翻开了食谱中的一页。
example2_en: Researchers selected a random sample of households to assess public attitudes towards renewable energy.
example2_zh: 研究人员随机抽取了一些家庭，以评估公众对可再生能源的态度。
collocations: random sample｜随机样本 ; random selection｜随机选择 ; at random｜随机地
tip_zh: random是形容词；作状语用randomly或at random。

meanings_zh: n. 腌菜；泡菜 | v. 腌制
definition_en: A vegetable preserved in vinegar or salty water. | To preserve food in vinegar or salty water.
example1_en: She added a crunchy pickle to her sandwich.
example1_zh: 她在三明治里加了一根脆腌黄瓜。
example2_en: Many communities pickle seasonal vegetables to extend their shelf life and reduce household food waste.
example2_zh: 许多社区的居民会腌制时令蔬菜，以延长保存期并减少家庭食物浪费。
collocations: pickled vegetables｜腌制蔬菜 ; a jar of pickles｜一罐腌菜 ; in a pickle｜陷入困境
tip_zh: 美式英语中a pickle常指一根腌黄瓜。

meanings_zh: adv. 自愿地；乐意地
definition_en: By choice and without needing to be forced or persuaded.
example1_en: My neighbour willingly watered the plants while I was away.
example1_zh: 我不在家时，邻居欣然帮我给植物浇水。
example2_en: Residents are more likely to participate willingly in recycling schemes when collection services are convenient and reliable.
example2_zh: 当回收服务便利且可靠时，居民更可能自愿参与回收计划。
collocations: willingly agree｜欣然同意 ; participate willingly｜自愿参与 ; willingly accept｜欣然接受
tip_zh: 强调自愿而非被迫；不等于单纯“开心地”。

meanings_zh: n. 大猩猩
definition_en: A large African ape with dark hair and powerful arms.
example1_en: The young gorilla clung tightly to its mother's back.
example1_zh: 那只年幼的大猩猩紧紧趴在妈妈背上。
example2_en: Protecting gorilla habitats also preserves tropical forests that support numerous other species and store carbon.
example2_zh: 保护大猩猩的栖息地，也能保存为众多其他物种提供生存空间并储存碳的热带森林。
collocations: a mountain gorilla｜山地大猩猩 ; a silverback gorilla｜银背大猩猩 ; gorilla conservation｜大猩猩保护
tip_zh: gorilla是大猩猩；chimpanzee是黑猩猩。

meanings_zh: adj. 全面的；详尽的
definition_en: Covering all or nearly all important parts of something.
example1_en: This comprehensive guide covers every trail in the park.
example1_zh: 这本详尽的指南涵盖了公园里的每条步道。
example2_en: Schools should provide comprehensive health education to help students make informed decisions about their lifestyles.
example2_zh: 学校应提供全面的健康教育，帮助学生对自己的生活方式作出明智决定。
collocations: comprehensive guide｜详尽指南 ; comprehensive review｜全面审查 ; comprehensive assessment｜综合评估
tip_zh: 强调涵盖范围全面，不是指容易理解。

meanings_zh: adv. 越来越；日益
definition_en: More and more as time passes
example1_en: The bus has become increasingly crowded since last month.
example1_zh: 从上个月起，这趟公交车变得越来越拥挤。
example2_en: As cities expand, governments are increasingly investing in public transport to reduce congestion and improve air quality.
example2_zh: 随着城市扩张，政府正加大公共交通投入，以缓解拥堵并改善空气质量。
collocations: increasingly important｜日益重要 ; increasingly common｜越来越普遍 ; increasingly concerned｜越来越担忧 ; increasingly difficult｜越来越困难
tip_zh: 直接修饰原级形容词：increasingly popular。

meanings_zh: v. 拖；拉 | v. 缓慢进行；拖沓 | n. 阻力；拖累
definition_en: To pull something along a surface, often with effort. | To pass or progress so slowly that it feels boring. | A force or influence that slows movement or progress.
example1_en: We dragged the heavy rug across the floor.
example1_zh: 我们拖着沉重的地毯穿过房间。
example2_en: Complicated approval procedures can drag on for months, delaying essential improvements to public transport.
example2_zh: 复杂的审批程序可能拖延数月，耽误公共交通的必要改善。
collocations: drag a chair｜拖动椅子 ; drag on｜拖延下去 ; drag and drop｜拖放 ; a drag on growth｜增长的拖累
tip_zh: drag过去式为dragged；drag on指拖延下去。

meanings_zh: adj. 不新鲜的 | adj. 陈旧乏味的
definition_en: No longer fresh, especially when describing bread or air. | No longer interesting or original because of repeated use.
example1_en: This bread is stale, so I'll use it for breadcrumbs.
example1_zh: 这面包不新鲜了，我就拿它做面包屑吧。
example2_en: Teaching methods can become stale when educators lack opportunities to exchange ideas and develop new skills.
example2_zh: 如果教育工作者缺乏交流想法和培养新技能的机会，教学方法就可能变得陈旧乏味。
collocations: stale bread｜不新鲜的面包 ; stale air｜污浊的空气 ; stale jokes｜老掉牙的笑话
tip_zh: stale指失去新鲜感；rotten指已腐烂。

meanings_zh: adj. 统计的；统计学的
definition_en: relating to collecting, studying, or interpreting numerical data
example1_en: She used statistical software to compare the survey results.
example1_zh: 她用统计软件比较了调查结果。
example2_en: Reliable statistical evidence helps governments identify communities that need better access to healthcare.
example2_zh: 可靠的统计证据有助于政府确定哪些社区需要更便利的医疗服务。
collocations: statistical analysis｜统计分析 ; statistical data｜统计数据 ; statistical significance｜统计显著性
tip_zh: statistical指与统计有关，不等于“显著的”。

meanings_zh: adj. 有能力的；能…的 | adj. 能干的；有才干的
definition_en: Having the ability or qualities needed to do something. | Skilled and effective at handling tasks or responsibilities.
example1_en: This little printer is capable of producing excellent colour photos.
example1_zh: 这台小打印机能打印出色彩出众的照片。
example2_en: With appropriate training and support, young employees are capable of taking on substantial responsibilities within an organisation.
example2_zh: 经过适当培训并获得支持，年轻员工有能力在组织内承担重要职责。
collocations: capable of doing something｜有能力做某事 ; highly capable｜非常能干的 ; a capable leader｜能干的领导者
tip_zh: 用capable of doing，不用capable to do。

meanings_zh: adj. 相应的；对应的
definition_en: Matching or directly related to something else
example1_en: Put each coloured lid on its corresponding container.
example1_zh: 把每个彩色盖子盖在对应的容器上。
example2_en: A rise in urban population often creates a corresponding increase in demand for public transport.
example2_zh: 城市人口增长往往会使公共交通需求相应增加。
collocations: corresponding increase｜相应的增长 ; corresponding period｜同期 ; corresponding figures｜对应的数据
tip_zh: 强调相互对应；correspond to表示与……相对应。

meanings_zh: n. 实况解说 | n. 评论；评述
definition_en: a spoken description of an event as it happens | an explanation or discussion expressing opinions about something
example1_en: We listened to the football commentary while cooking dinner.
example1_zh: 我们一边做晚饭，一边听足球比赛的实况解说。
example2_en: Political commentary can help citizens understand complex policies, but it should be clearly distinguished from factual reporting.
example2_zh: 政治评论可以帮助公民理解复杂政策，但应与事实报道明确区分。
collocations: live commentary｜现场直播解说 ; running commentary｜连续解说 ; political commentary｜政治评论 ; commentary on｜对……的评论
tip_zh: commentary常指持续解说或深入评述，不只是单条评论。

meanings_zh: adj. 渴望的；热切的
definition_en: very interested and excited about doing or having something
example1_en: The children were eager to open their presents.
example1_zh: 孩子们迫不及待地想拆开礼物。
example2_en: Many graduates are eager to gain practical experience before committing to a particular career path.
example2_zh: 许多毕业生渴望先积累实践经验，再决定具体的职业道路。
collocations: eager to learn｜渴望学习 ; eager for success｜渴望成功 ; eager anticipation｜热切期待
tip_zh: 常用eager to do或eager for＋名词。

meanings_zh: n. 一件衣服；服装
definition_en: a single item of clothing
example1_en: This delicate garment needs to be washed by hand.
example1_zh: 这件质地娇贵的衣服需要手洗。
example2_en: Improving working conditions in the garment industry requires cooperation between manufacturers, retailers, and national governments.
example2_zh: 改善服装业的工作条件需要制造商、零售商和各国政府共同合作。
collocations: a woollen garment｜一件羊毛衣物 ; the garment industry｜服装业 ; garment workers｜制衣工人
tip_zh: 可数名词，指一件衣服；clothing通常不可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 易碎的；娇弱的 | adj. 微妙的；需谨慎处理的 | adj. 精巧的；柔和的
definition_en: Easily damaged or harmed. | Requiring careful handling to avoid problems or offence. | Fine, subtle, or gentle in appearance, flavour, or smell.
example1_en: Please wrap these delicate glass bowls in soft paper.
example1_zh: 请用柔软的纸包好这些易碎的玻璃碗。
example2_en: Tourism in coastal regions must be carefully managed to protect delicate ecosystems from lasting damage.
example2_zh: 沿海地区的旅游业必须得到妥善管理，以保护脆弱的生态系统免遭长期破坏。
collocations: delicate balance｜微妙的平衡 ; delicate fabric｜易损面料 ; delicate flavour｜清淡的风味 ; delicate negotiations｜需谨慎进行的谈判
tip_zh: 既可形容易损物品，也可形容需谨慎处理的问题。

meanings_zh: n. 地狱 | n. 极其痛苦的处境
definition_en: A place of punishment after death in some religious beliefs. | An extremely unpleasant experience, situation, or place.
example1_en: The old painting showed flames rising from hell.
example1_zh: 那幅旧画描绘了从地狱升起的火焰。
example2_en: For residents exposed to constant construction noise, daily life can become hell unless effective regulations are enforced.
example2_zh: 对持续受到施工噪声影响的居民来说，除非有效执行监管规定，否则日常生活可能变得极其痛苦。
collocations: go through hell｜经历极大痛苦 ; make someone's life hell｜使某人的生活苦不堪言 ; a living hell｜人间地狱
tip_zh: 比喻义语气强烈；作咒骂或强调语时可能冒犯他人。

meanings_zh: v. 使现代化；实现现代化
definition_en: To update something using newer methods, equipment, or designs.
example1_en: We plan to modernize our kitchen with new appliances.
example1_zh: 我们打算添置新电器，让厨房更现代化。
example2_en: Governments should modernize railway infrastructure to improve reliability and reduce dependence on private cars.
example2_zh: 政府应推动铁路基础设施现代化，提高运行可靠性并减少对私家车的依赖。
collocations: modernize infrastructure｜推动基础设施现代化 ; modernize the economy｜推动经济现代化 ; modernize production｜实现生产现代化
tip_zh: 英式英语也常拼作modernise。

meanings_zh: n. 声明；宣言；宣布 | n. 申报；申报单
definition_en: An official or public statement expressing a decision, belief, or intention. | An official statement of goods, income, or other required information.
example1_en: Her declaration that she would quit surprised the whole family.
example1_zh: 她宣布要辞职，让全家都吃了一惊。
example2_en: The government's declaration of a climate emergency should be followed by clear policies and measurable environmental targets.
example2_zh: 政府宣布进入气候紧急状态后，应制定明确的政策和可衡量的环境目标。
collocations: joint declaration｜联合声明 ; declaration of independence｜独立宣言 ; customs declaration｜海关申报 ; make a declaration｜作出声明
tip_zh: declare是动词；海关申报用customs declaration。

meanings_zh: n. 多样性；差异性
definition_en: The presence of many different types of people or things.
example1_en: Our garden attracts a surprising diversity of colourful birds.
example1_zh: 我们的花园吸引了种类多得惊人的彩色鸟儿。
example2_en: Cultural diversity can enrich urban life by introducing residents to different traditions, languages, and perspectives.
example2_zh: 文化多样性能让居民接触不同的传统、语言和观点，从而丰富城市生活。
collocations: cultural diversity｜文化多样性 ; biological diversity｜生物多样性 ; promote diversity｜促进多样性
tip_zh: 通常为不可数名词；a diversity of表示多种多样的。

meanings_zh: n. 创新；革新 | n. 新方法；新事物
definition_en: the introduction of new ideas, methods, or products | a new idea, method, or product that improves something
example1_en: Our kitchen encourages innovation, so we often try unusual recipes.
example1_zh: 我们家的厨房鼓励创新，所以我们经常尝试新奇的食谱。
example2_en: Public investment in research can encourage innovation and help businesses develop more sustainable production methods.
example2_zh: 公共科研投入可以鼓励创新，帮助企业开发更可持续的生产方法。
collocations: technological innovation｜技术创新 ; encourage innovation｜鼓励创新 ; product innovation｜产品创新 ; a major innovation｜一项重大创新
tip_zh: 表示创新过程时不可数；表示具体新成果时可数。

meanings_zh: v. 出价；投标 | n. 出价；投标 | n. 努力；尝试争取
definition_en: To offer a price or compete formally for a contract. | An offer of money or a proposal to do work. | An attempt to achieve or obtain something.
example1_en: I bid twenty pounds for the old wooden chair.
example1_zh: 我出价二十英镑竞买那把旧木椅。
example2_en: Several local companies submitted a bid to build affordable housing near the city's main railway station.
example2_zh: 几家本地公司提交了投标书，争取在该市主要火车站附近建造经济适用住房。
collocations: bid for a contract｜投标争取合同 ; submit a bid｜提交投标书 ; the highest bid｜最高出价 ; in a bid to｜为了争取
tip_zh: 表示出价时，过去式和过去分词均为bid。

meanings_zh: adj. 不确定的；怀疑的 | adj. 不大可能的；未必的 | adj. 可疑的；不可靠的
definition_en: Feeling unsure whether something is true or will happen. | Unlikely to happen or be true. | Not clearly good, honest, or reliable.
example1_en: I was doubtful about buying a second-hand bicycle online.
example1_zh: 我对在网上买二手自行车有些犹豫。
example2_en: It is doubtful whether expanding roads alone can solve traffic congestion in rapidly growing cities.
example2_zh: 仅靠拓宽道路能否解决快速发展城市的交通拥堵问题，尚存疑问。
collocations: doubtful about｜对……不确定 ; doubtful whether｜是否……尚不确定 ; of doubtful value｜价值存疑的
tip_zh: 人作主语常用 doubtful about；也可用 doubtful whether。

meanings_zh: v. 区分；辨别 | v. 成为…的特征；使有别于 | v. 看清；听出
definition_en: to recognize the difference between people or things | to make someone or something different from others | to see or hear something clearly enough to recognize it
example1_en: I can distinguish the twins by their voices.
example1_zh: 我能通过声音分辨这对双胞胎。
example2_en: Students should learn to distinguish reliable evidence from personal opinion when evaluating information online.
example2_zh: 学生在评估网络信息时，应学会区分可靠证据与个人观点。
collocations: distinguish between｜区分两者 ; distinguish A from B｜把A与B区分开 ; distinguish yourself｜使自己出众
tip_zh: 常用distinguish A from B或between A and B。

meanings_zh: n. 土星
definition_en: the sixth planet from the Sun, surrounded by prominent rings
example1_en: We saw Saturn through a telescope last night.
example1_zh: 昨晚我们通过望远镜看到了土星。
example2_en: Studying the rings of Saturn helps scientists understand how particles interact in space over time.
example2_zh: 研究土星环有助于科学家了解太空中的粒子如何随时间相互作用。
collocations: the rings of Saturn｜土星环 ; Saturn's moons｜土星的卫星 ; orbit Saturn｜绕土星运行
tip_zh: 行星名称首字母大写，通常不加冠词。

meanings_zh: n. 药物；药物治疗
definition_en: Medicine used to treat illness, or treatment using medicine.
example1_en: She takes her medication with breakfast every morning.
example1_zh: 她每天早上吃早餐时服药。
example2_en: Affordable medication is essential for improving public health, particularly in communities with limited medical services.
example2_zh: 价格可负担的药物对于改善公共健康至关重要，尤其是在医疗服务有限的社区。
collocations: take medication｜服药 ; prescribe medication｜开药 ; be on medication｜正在接受药物治疗
tip_zh: 泛指药物多不可数；具体多种药可用medications。

meanings_zh: n. 杂草 | v. 除草
definition_en: A plant growing where it is not wanted. | To remove unwanted plants from an area.
example1_en: A stubborn weed has grown between the paving stones.
example1_zh: 铺路石的缝隙间长出了一株顽强的杂草。
example2_en: Farmers can control weeds without chemicals by rotating crops and covering exposed soil with organic material.
example2_zh: 农民可以通过轮作和用有机材料覆盖裸露土壤，在不使用化学药剂的情况下控制杂草。
collocations: pull up weeds｜拔除杂草 ; weed the garden｜给花园除草 ; weed control｜杂草防治 ; weed out｜剔除
tip_zh: weed out可比喻剔除不合适的人或事物。

meanings_zh: v. 吞下；咽下 | v. 轻信；勉强接受 | n. 燕子
definition_en: make food or liquid pass from your mouth into your stomach | believe something too easily or accept something unpleasant | a small bird with pointed wings and a forked tail
example1_en: Please swallow your food before you start talking again.
example1_zh: 请先把食物咽下去再说话。
example2_en: Consumers should not simply swallow advertising claims without examining the evidence behind promises of better health.
example2_zh: 消费者不应不加审查就轻信广告中改善健康的承诺，而应考察背后的证据。
collocations: swallow a tablet｜吞服药片 ; swallow your pride｜放下自尊 ; hard to swallow｜难以接受
tip_zh: swallow your pride指放下自尊，接受不情愿的事。

meanings_zh: adv. 专门地；特意地 | adv. 明确地 | adv. 具体而言
definition_en: for one particular purpose, person, or group | in a clear and exact way | used to introduce more precise details
example1_en: I bought this small brush specifically for cleaning bottles.
example1_zh: 我买这把小刷子是专门用来清洗瓶子的。
example2_en: Public libraries should offer programmes specifically designed to help older adults develop essential digital skills.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆应提供专为老年人设计的课程，帮助他们掌握必备的数字技能。
collocations: specifically designed for｜专为……设计 ; specifically mention｜明确提及 ; more specifically｜更具体地说
tip_zh: specifically for强调专门用途；更具体地说用more specifically。

meanings_zh: n. 烹饪风格；菜系
definition_en: A style of cooking associated with a place or culture.
example1_en: This little restaurant serves delicious cuisine from southern India.
example1_zh: 这家小餐馆供应美味的印度南部菜肴。
example2_en: Traditional cuisine can attract international tourists while helping local communities preserve their cultural identity.
example2_zh: 传统菜系既能吸引国际游客，也能帮助当地社区保留文化特色。
collocations: local cuisine｜当地菜肴 ; traditional cuisine｜传统菜系 ; international cuisine｜国际美食
tip_zh: cuisine指菜系或烹饪风格，不指一道菜。

meanings_zh: n. 烟蒂 | n. 屁股 | n. 大桶；雨水桶
definition_en: the short part left after a cigarette has been smoked | the part of the body that you sit on | a large barrel used for storing water or other liquids
example1_en: He swept a cigarette butt off the front step.
example1_zh: 他把门前台阶上的一个烟蒂扫掉了。
example2_en: Discarded cigarette butts contribute to urban litter and can release harmful substances into rivers and coastal waters.
example2_zh: 随意丢弃的烟蒂增加了城市垃圾，还可能向河流和近岸水域释放有害物质。
collocations: cigarette butt｜烟蒂 ; water butt｜雨水桶 ; the butt of a joke｜笑话的取笑对象
tip_zh: 指屁股时属非正式美语；water butt是英式雨水桶。

meanings_zh: n. 偶像；崇拜对象 | n. 神像
definition_en: someone greatly admired and often imitated | an image or object worshipped as a god
example1_en: Lina finally met her sporting idol after the match.
example1_zh: 莉娜终于在比赛结束后见到了自己的体育偶像。
example2_en: Young people may adopt unhealthy habits when their idols promote unrealistic standards of physical appearance.
example2_zh: 当偶像宣扬不切实际的外貌标准时，年轻人可能养成不健康的习惯。
collocations: a sporting idol｜体育偶像 ; a pop idol｜流行乐偶像 ; worship an idol｜崇拜神像
tip_zh: idol是偶像；idle是空闲的，两词发音相同。

meanings_zh: n. 州长；总督 | n. 机构主管；学校董事
definition_en: the official leader of a state or territory | someone who manages an institution or helps direct its policies
example1_en: The governor visited our town after the river flooded.
example1_zh: 河流泛滥后，州长来我们镇视察。
example2_en: The governor proposed additional funding for public schools to reduce educational inequalities across the state.
example2_zh: 州长提议增加公立学校拨款，以缩小全州的教育差距。
collocations: state governor｜州长 ; school governor｜学校董事 ; prison governor｜监狱长 ; central bank governor｜中央银行行长
tip_zh: 具体职位看搭配：school governor指学校董事。

meanings_zh: n. 有孔小珠；珠子 | n. 小滴；水珠
definition_en: A small pierced ball used in jewellery or decoration. | A small round drop of liquid.
example1_en: She threaded a blue bead onto the silver wire.
example1_zh: 她把一颗蓝色珠子穿到银色金属线上。
example2_en: Traditional bead jewellery can provide income for local craftspeople while preserving skills passed down through generations.
example2_zh: 传统珠饰既能为当地手艺人带来收入，也能保留代代相传的技艺。
collocations: glass beads｜玻璃珠 ; string beads｜把珠子串起来 ; a bead of sweat｜一滴汗珠
tip_zh: 液滴义常用a bead of sweat，指一滴汗。

meanings_zh: v. 旋转；使旋转 | v. 纺纱；吐丝 | n. 旋转；带倾向性的解读
definition_en: turn quickly around a central point | make thread from fibres or produce silk | a turning movement, or a deliberately favourable interpretation
example1_en: The wheel kept spinning after I lifted the bicycle.
example1_zh: 我把自行车抬起来后，车轮还在转。
example2_en: News organisations should examine official claims carefully rather than simply repeat the political spin surrounding them.
example2_zh: 新闻机构应仔细审视官方说法，而不是简单重复围绕这些说法的政治性包装。
collocations: spin round｜转圈 ; spin wool｜纺羊毛 ; political spin｜政治性包装 ; go for a spin｜兜风
tip_zh: 过去式、过去分词均为 spun；现在分词为 spinning。

meanings_zh: prep. 对阵；与……相对
definition_en: against an opponent, or compared with another option
example1_en: Tonight's match is our school versus the local college.
example1_zh: 今晚的比赛是我们学校对阵本地学院。
example2_en: The debate over public versus private transport often centres on cost, convenience, and environmental impact.
example2_zh: 关于公共交通与私人交通的讨论往往围绕成本、便利性和环境影响展开。
collocations: public versus private｜公共与私人之比较 ; the case of A versus B｜A诉B的案件 ; the benefits versus the costs｜收益与成本之比较
tip_zh: 常缩写为vs或v，用于比赛、诉讼或两者比较。

meanings_zh: n. 反义词
definition_en: a word whose meaning is opposite to another word's
example1_en: Our teacher asked us for an antonym of generous.
example1_zh: 老师让我们说出一个generous的反义词。
example2_en: Learning an antonym alongside each new adjective can help language students understand contrasts and expand their vocabulary.
example2_zh: 语言学习者每学一个新形容词时同时学习其反义词，有助于理解对比关系并扩大词汇量。
collocations: an antonym of｜……的反义词 ; a pair of antonyms｜一对反义词
tip_zh: 常用an antonym of；synonym表示同义词。

meanings_zh: adj. 明显的；显著的
definition_en: Easy to see or recognize.
example1_en: There is a noticeable scratch on my new table.
example1_zh: 我的新桌子上有一道明显的划痕。
example2_en: The introduction of electric buses has led to a noticeable reduction in noise near busy roads.
example2_zh: 引入电动公交车后，繁忙道路附近的噪声明显减少了。
collocations: a noticeable difference｜明显的差异 ; a noticeable improvement｜显著的改善 ; a noticeable increase｜明显的增加
tip_zh: noticeable指容易察觉；notable侧重值得关注。

meanings_zh: adj. 依赖的；依靠的 | adj. 取决于…的
definition_en: Needing someone or something for support or survival. | Decided or affected by a particular condition or factor.
example1_en: The young birds are still dependent on their parents.
example1_zh: 这些幼鸟仍然依赖亲鸟。
example2_en: Rural communities are often dependent on reliable bus services for access to healthcare, employment, and further education.
example2_zh: 农村社区往往依靠可靠的公交服务来获得医疗、就业和继续教育的机会。
collocations: dependent on｜依赖；取决于 ; financially dependent｜经济上依赖的 ; heavily dependent on｜严重依赖 ; dependent children｜需抚养的子女
tip_zh: 常接on；英式名词“受抚养者”通常拼作dependant。

meanings_zh: n. 空气湿度
definition_en: The amount of water vapour in the air
example1_en: The high humidity made my shirt feel damp.
example1_zh: 空气湿度很高，我的衬衫摸起来潮潮的。
example2_en: High humidity can reduce comfort in classrooms, making effective ventilation particularly important during warmer months.
example2_zh: 高湿度会降低教室的舒适度，因此在较热的月份，有效通风尤为重要。
collocations: high humidity｜高湿度 ; relative humidity｜相对湿度 ; humidity levels｜湿度水平 ; low humidity｜低湿度
tip_zh: 通常不可数；湿度高低用high或low。

meanings_zh: n. 柱子；支柱 | n. 栋梁；核心支撑
definition_en: A strong upright structure that supports part of a building. | A person or principle providing essential support.
example1_en: We sheltered from the rain behind a stone pillar.
example1_zh: 我们躲在一根石柱后面避雨。
example2_en: Accessible education is a central pillar of social development because it expands opportunities across generations.
example2_zh: 普及教育是社会发展的核心支柱，因为它能为一代又一代人拓展机会。
collocations: a stone pillar｜石柱 ; a central pillar of｜……的核心支柱 ; a pillar of the community｜社区的中坚人物
tip_zh: pillar of可比喻某体系的支柱或群体的中坚。

meanings_zh: n. 可能性；概率
definition_en: how likely something is to happen
example1_en: Dark clouds suggest a high probability of rain tonight.
example1_zh: 乌云表明今晚下雨的可能性很大。
example2_en: Improved weather models allow scientists to estimate the probability of extreme rainfall with greater accuracy.
example2_zh: 改进后的天气模型使科学家能够更准确地估算极端降雨的概率。
collocations: high probability｜很大的可能性 ; probability of success｜成功的概率 ; in all probability｜十有八九 ; probability theory｜概率论
tip_zh: 常接of加名词或动名词；也可接that从句。

meanings_zh: v. 减半 | v. 把…分成两半
definition_en: To reduce something to half its original amount. | To divide something into two equal parts.
example1_en: Sharing a taxi would halve the cost for each person.
example1_zh: 两人合乘一辆出租车，每人的费用就能减半。
example2_en: The city aims to halve household food waste by expanding composting services and promoting more careful shopping.
example2_zh: 该市计划通过扩大堆肥服务和提倡更审慎的购物，将家庭食物浪费减半。
collocations: halve the cost｜将成本减半 ; halve emissions｜将排放量减半 ; halve a lemon｜把柠檬切成两半
tip_zh: halve是动词，half可作名词；halve中的l不发音。

meanings_zh: n. 治疗；疗法
definition_en: Treatment intended to improve physical or mental health.
example1_en: After her injury, regular therapy helped her walk comfortably again.
example1_zh: 受伤后，定期治疗帮助她重新自如地行走。
example2_en: Schools that provide access to psychological therapy may better support students experiencing persistent anxiety.
example2_zh: 提供心理治疗服务的学校可能更好地支持长期感到焦虑的学生。
collocations: speech therapy｜言语治疗 ; physical therapy｜物理治疗 ; undergo therapy｜接受治疗 ; psychological therapy｜心理治疗
tip_zh: 泛指治疗通常不可数；具体疗法可用复数。

meanings_zh: n. 麻雀
definition_en: A small brownish bird often found near people's homes
example1_en: A sparrow landed beside my cup on the balcony.
example1_zh: 一只麻雀落在阳台上我的杯子旁边。
example2_en: Urban gardens provide food and shelter for sparrows, helping maintain bird populations in densely populated areas.
example2_zh: 城市花园为麻雀提供食物和栖息处，有助于维持人口密集地区的鸟类数量。
collocations: a flock of sparrows｜一群麻雀 ; house sparrow｜家麻雀 ; tree sparrow｜树麻雀
tip_zh: 可数名词，复数直接加s；不泛指所有小鸟。

meanings_zh: n. 护理；护理职业
definition_en: The work of caring for people who are ill or injured.
example1_en: My sister chose nursing because she enjoys helping people.
example1_zh: 我姐姐选择了护理职业，因为她喜欢帮助别人。
example2_en: Investment in nursing education is essential to meet the growing healthcare needs of an ageing population.
example2_zh: 投资护理教育对于满足老龄化人口日益增长的医疗需求至关重要。
collocations: nursing care｜护理服务 ; a nursing home｜养老护理院 ; nursing staff｜护理人员 ; a nursing degree｜护理学学位
tip_zh: nursing作护理专业或职业名时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 说服；劝说 | n. 信仰；派别
definition_en: The process of getting someone to agree or do something. | A particular religious or political belief or group.
example1_en: After some persuasion, my brother joined our evening walk.
example1_zh: 经过一番劝说，我弟弟加入了我们的晚间散步。
example2_en: Public health campaigns often rely on persuasion rather than legal restrictions to encourage healthier habits.
example2_zh: 公共卫生宣传活动往往依靠劝导而非法律限制来鼓励更健康的习惯。
collocations: powers of persuasion｜说服能力 ; gentle persuasion｜温和的劝说 ; political persuasion｜政治信仰
tip_zh: 表示劝说时通常不可数；动词是persuade。

meanings_zh: n. 机制；运作方式 | n. 机械装置；机械结构
definition_en: a process or system through which something works or happens | a set of connected parts that performs a particular function
example1_en: The club needs a fair mechanism for resolving disputes.
example1_zh: 俱乐部需要一个公平的争议解决机制。
example2_en: Governments should establish effective monitoring mechanisms to ensure that environmental regulations are consistently enforced across industries.
example2_zh: 政府应建立有效的监督机制，确保各行业始终贯彻执行环境法规。
collocations: coping mechanism｜应对机制 ; defence mechanism｜防御机制 ; monitoring mechanism｜监督机制 ; locking mechanism｜锁定装置
tip_zh: mechanism for doing表示“做某事的机制或办法”。

meanings_zh: n. 影响；作用 | n. 撞击；冲击 | v. 影响
definition_en: a strong effect on someone or something | the force or action of one object hitting another | to affect someone or something, often strongly
example1_en: The new playground had a positive impact on our neighbourhood.
example1_zh: 新游乐场给我们社区带来了积极影响。
example2_en: Governments should assess the environmental impact of major construction projects before allowing work to begin.
example2_zh: 政府应在批准开工之前评估大型建设项目对环境的影响。
collocations: have an impact on｜对……有影响 ; environmental impact｜环境影响 ; on impact｜在撞击时 ; impact on communities｜影响社区
tip_zh: 名词重音在前；动词通常读/ɪmˈpækt/。

meanings_zh: adj. 正在进行的；持续的
definition_en: Continuing to happen or develop, rather than being finished.
example1_en: The ongoing repairs mean we cannot use the kitchen.
example1_zh: 维修仍在进行，所以我们没法使用厨房。
example2_en: Ongoing research into renewable energy is essential for reducing dependence on fossil fuels and limiting environmental damage.
example2_zh: 持续开展可再生能源研究，对减少化石燃料依赖和限制环境损害至关重要。
collocations: ongoing research｜持续进行的研究 ; an ongoing process｜持续的过程 ; ongoing support｜持续的支持 ; an ongoing investigation｜正在进行的调查
tip_zh: 强调尚在持续，不等于即将发生的upcoming。

meanings_zh: v. 使模糊；变模糊 | n. 模糊的影像；模糊的记忆
definition_en: to make or become difficult to see or distinguish clearly | something that cannot be seen or remembered clearly
example1_en: Tears blurred my vision as the train pulled away.
example1_zh: 火车驶离时，泪水模糊了我的视线。
example2_en: Working from home can blur the boundary between professional responsibilities and personal life, increasing stress.
example2_zh: 居家办公可能模糊工作职责与个人生活之间的界限，增加压力。
collocations: blur the distinction｜模糊区别 ; blur the boundaries｜模糊界限 ; a blur of colour｜一片模糊的色彩
tip_zh: 常指视线或界限模糊；不是“污点”的常用译法。

meanings_zh: n. 哲学家
definition_en: Someone who studies fundamental questions about existence, knowledge, and values.
example1_en: The philosopher asked us what makes a life meaningful.
example1_zh: 那位哲学家问我们，什么使人生有意义。
example2_en: A philosopher might question whether economic growth should be the main measure of a society's progress.
example2_zh: 哲学家可能会质疑，经济增长是否应当成为衡量社会进步的主要标准。
collocations: moral philosopher｜伦理哲学家 ; political philosopher｜政治哲学家 ; ancient philosopher｜古代哲学家
tip_zh: philosopher指人，philosophy指哲学或理念。

meanings_zh: pron. 任何…的人；无论谁 | pron. 究竟是谁
definition_en: any person who, or no matter which person | used in questions to express surprise about someone's identity
example1_en: Whoever finishes first can choose the next game.
example1_zh: 谁先完成，谁就可以选择下一个游戏。
example2_en: Public libraries should welcome whoever needs access to reliable information, regardless of their income or educational background.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆应欢迎任何需要获取可靠信息的人，不论其收入或教育背景如何。
collocations: whoever you are｜无论你是谁 ; whoever wants to｜任何想要…的人 ; whoever is responsible｜任何负有责任的人
tip_zh: 可引导名词性或让步从句；并非所有场合都能换成no matter who。

meanings_zh: adj. 真正的；正宗的 | adj. 真实可信的
definition_en: Genuine or traditional, rather than copied or invented | Accurately representing real events, experiences, or conditions
example1_en: This small restaurant serves authentic dishes from the region.
example1_zh: 这家小餐馆供应这个地区的正宗菜肴。
example2_en: Museums should preserve authentic objects while using digital tools to make local history more accessible.
example2_zh: 博物馆应保存真品，同时利用数字工具让公众更容易了解当地历史。
collocations: authentic cuisine｜正宗菜肴 ; authentic experience｜真实体验 ; authentic account｜真实可信的叙述
tip_zh: authentic强调真品或正宗，不只表示事实正确。

meanings_zh: n. 观点；视角 | n. 透视法 | n. 客观判断力
definition_en: A particular way of considering a situation or issue. | A drawing technique that makes objects appear realistically distant. | The ability to judge the relative importance of things.
example1_en: Hearing her story gave me a completely different perspective.
example1_zh: 听了她的故事，我对事情有了完全不同的看法。
example2_en: Examining urban development from residents' perspective can help planners create more inclusive and accessible public spaces.
example2_zh: 从居民的视角审视城市发展，有助于规划者打造更具包容性、更加便利的公共空间。
collocations: from a different perspective｜从不同视角 ; broaden your perspective｜拓宽视野 ; put things into perspective｜客观看待事物 ; a sense of perspective｜透视感；分寸感
tip_zh: 从某一视角用from a perspective，不用in。

meanings_zh: v. 使烦躁；惹恼 | v. 刺激；使不适
definition_en: To make someone feel annoyed or impatient. | To make skin or another body part sore or uncomfortable.
example1_en: The constant dripping from the tap really irritates me.
example1_zh: 水龙头不停滴水，真让我烦躁。
example2_en: Some household cleaning products contain chemicals that can irritate the skin and cause breathing difficulties.
example2_zh: 某些家用清洁产品含有会刺激皮肤并导致呼吸困难的化学物质。
collocations: irritate the skin｜刺激皮肤 ; irritate the eyes｜刺激眼睛 ; really irritate someone｜着实惹恼某人
tip_zh: irritated形容人感到烦躁；irritating形容事物烦人。

meanings_zh: n. 真空；空缺 | n. 真空吸尘器 | v. 用吸尘器清扫
definition_en: A space without air, or a gap left by something missing. | An electric machine that sucks up dust and dirt. | To clean something using a vacuum cleaner.
example1_en: I vacuum the carpet while my brother dusts the shelves.
example1_zh: 我用吸尘器清扫地毯，弟弟则擦去架子上的灰尘。
example2_en: Sound cannot travel through a vacuum because it needs a medium such as air or water.
example2_zh: 声音无法在真空中传播，因为它需要空气或水等介质。
collocations: vacuum cleaner｜真空吸尘器 ; a political vacuum｜政治真空 ; vacuum the carpet｜用吸尘器清扫地毯
tip_zh: 表示清扫时可直接作动词：vacuum the floor。

meanings_zh: adj. 担心的；忧虑的 | adj. 有关的；涉及的 | adj. 关注的；以…为内容的
definition_en: Worried about someone or something. | Involved in or affected by a particular matter. | Interested in or dealing with a particular subject.
example1_en: I was concerned when you missed the last bus.
example1_zh: 你没赶上末班公交车时，我很担心。
example2_en: Residents are increasingly concerned about air pollution and want local authorities to improve public transport.
example2_zh: 居民越来越担心空气污染，希望地方政府改善公共交通。
collocations: concerned about｜担心 ; the people concerned｜相关人员 ; concerned with｜涉及；关注 ; as far as I am concerned｜就我而言
tip_zh: about常接担忧对象；with常接涉及的主题。

meanings_zh: adv. 真诚地；由衷地
definition_en: In a way that expresses what you genuinely feel.
example1_en: I sincerely hope you feel better very soon.
example1_zh: 我由衷地希望你很快好起来。
example2_en: Organisations should listen sincerely to residents' concerns before introducing changes that affect the local community.
example2_zh: 机构在推行影响当地社区的变革之前，应真诚倾听居民的关切。
collocations: sincerely hope｜由衷希望 ; sincerely apologise｜真诚道歉 ; sincerely believe｜真心相信 ; Yours sincerely｜谨上
tip_zh: 英式书信称呼已知姓名者，结尾常用Yours sincerely。

meanings_zh: n. 范围；涉及面 | n. 机会；发挥余地
definition_en: The range of subjects or activities that something covers. | The opportunity or freedom to do or develop something.
example1_en: Kitchen repairs fall outside the scope of this job.
example1_zh: 厨房维修不属于这项工作的范围。
example2_en: The scope of the study was limited to urban schools, so its findings may not apply to rural communities.
example2_zh: 该研究仅涉及城市学校，因此其结论未必适用于农村社区。
collocations: scope of the study｜研究范围 ; beyond the scope of｜超出……的范围 ; scope for improvement｜改进空间 ; broaden the scope｜扩大范围
tip_zh: 范围用scope of；做某事的余地用scope for。

meanings_zh: n. 物理学家
definition_en: A scientist who studies matter, energy, and their interactions.
example1_en: A physicist showed our class how magnets work.
example1_zh: 一位物理学家向我们班演示了磁铁的工作原理。
example2_en: Physicists contribute to medical progress by developing imaging technologies that help doctors examine the human body.
example2_zh: 物理学家通过开发帮助医生检查人体的成像技术，推动医学进步。
collocations: theoretical physicist｜理论物理学家 ; nuclear physicist｜核物理学家 ; experimental physicist｜实验物理学家
tip_zh: physicist是物理学家；physician是医生。

meanings_zh: n. 观众；旁观者
definition_en: Someone who watches an event, especially a sporting event.
example1_en: A spectator caught the ball near the fence.
example1_zh: 一名观众在围栏附近接住了球。
example2_en: Major sporting events attract thousands of spectators and can generate substantial income for local businesses.
example2_zh: 大型体育赛事吸引成千上万的观众，并能为当地商家带来可观收入。
collocations: spectator sport｜观赏性体育运动 ; spectator safety｜观众安全 ; attract spectators｜吸引观众
tip_zh: 常指体育赛事现场观众；演出观众多用audience。

meanings_zh: n. 赞助者；赞助机构 | v. 赞助；资助
definition_en: A person or organisation providing support, often in return for publicity. | To support a person, event, or activity financially.
example1_en: Our swimming club needs a sponsor for new equipment.
example1_zh: 我们的游泳俱乐部需要赞助者资助购置新器材。
example2_en: Local businesses can sponsor community sports programmes to improve public health and strengthen relationships with residents.
example2_zh: 当地企业可以赞助社区体育项目，以改善公众健康并加强与居民的联系。
collocations: a corporate sponsor｜企业赞助商 ; the main sponsor｜主要赞助方 ; sponsor an event｜赞助活动 ; sponsor a team｜赞助队伍
tip_zh: sponsor可作名词或动词；赞助行为用sponsorship。

meanings_zh: n. 偏见；成见 | v. 使有偏见；损害
definition_en: An unfair opinion formed without enough knowledge or experience. | To unfairly influence someone's judgement or harm their chances.
example1_en: Her neighbours welcomed her warmly, without any prejudice.
example1_zh: 邻居们热情地欢迎她，没有任何偏见。
example2_en: Schools can challenge prejudice by encouraging students to learn about cultures different from their own.
example2_zh: 学校可以鼓励学生了解不同于自身的文化，从而消除偏见。
collocations: racial prejudice｜种族偏见 ; prejudice against｜对……的偏见 ; challenge prejudice｜质疑并反对偏见 ; prejudice someone's chances｜损害某人的机会
tip_zh: 表示对某群体的偏见，常用prejudice against。

meanings_zh: adj. 可耻的；丢脸的
definition_en: So bad or unacceptable that it deserves strong disapproval.
example1_en: Leaving rubbish all over this beautiful park is disgraceful.
example1_zh: 在这么美的公园里到处乱扔垃圾，真是可耻。
example2_en: The report exposed disgraceful working conditions and called for stronger protection of employees across the industry.
example2_zh: 报告揭露了恶劣得令人不齿的工作条件，并呼吁加强对全行业雇员的保护。
collocations: disgraceful behaviour｜可耻的行为 ; disgraceful treatment｜令人愤慨的对待 ; absolutely disgraceful｜极其可耻
tip_zh: 表示强烈谴责；“名誉扫地的”常用disgraced。

meanings_zh: adj. 悲惨的；令人悲痛的 | adj. 悲剧的
definition_en: Causing deep sadness, especially through death or serious suffering. | Relating to a serious play or story with an unhappy ending.
example1_en: The film tells a tragic story of lost friendship.
example1_zh: 这部电影讲述了一个关于友谊破裂的悲伤故事。
example2_en: Tragic accidents on busy roads highlight the need for safer crossings and stricter enforcement of speed limits.
example2_zh: 繁忙道路上的惨痛事故凸显了设置更安全的过街设施及严格执行限速规定的必要性。
collocations: a tragic accident｜惨痛的事故 ; a tragic loss｜令人悲痛的损失 ; a tragic ending｜悲剧结局 ; a tragic hero｜悲剧主角
tip_zh: 比sad程度更重，常涉及死亡或严重不幸。

meanings_zh: n. 缺点；不利因素
definition_en: A disadvantage that makes something less useful or attractive
example1_en: The flat's only drawback is its tiny kitchen.
example1_zh: 这套公寓唯一的缺点是厨房太小。
example2_en: A major drawback of working remotely is the reduced opportunity for informal communication with colleagues.
example2_zh: 远程办公的一大弊端是与同事非正式交流的机会减少了。
collocations: a major drawback｜主要缺点 ; the main drawback｜最大的弊端 ; a drawback of｜……的缺点
tip_zh: 可数名词，常用a drawback of加名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: v. 专门从事；专攻
definition_en: to focus on a particular subject, activity, or service
example1_en: The bakery near our house specializes in fresh sourdough bread.
example1_zh: 我们家附近的面包店专做新鲜的酸面包。
example2_en: Students who specialize too early may miss opportunities to develop knowledge across a broader range of subjects.
example2_zh: 过早确定专业方向的学生可能错过拓宽学科知识的机会。
collocations: specialize in medicine｜专攻医学 ; specialize in repairing cars｜专门修理汽车 ; highly specialized skills｜高度专业化的技能
tip_zh: 常用specialize in；英式也常拼作specialise。

meanings_zh: v. 撕裂；扯破 | n. 裂口；破洞
definition_en: To tear something quickly or forcefully, or become torn. | A long hole caused by tearing material.
example1_en: I ripped my sleeve on a sharp branch yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天我的袖子被一根尖树枝扯破了。
example2_en: Repairing a small rip in clothing instead of replacing it can reduce household waste.
example2_zh: 修补衣物上的小裂口而非换掉整件衣物，可以减少家庭垃圾。
collocations: rip open｜撕开 ; rip apart｜撕碎；扯开 ; a rip in｜……上的裂口
tip_zh: rip的过去式和过去分词均为ripped。

meanings_zh: adj. 灵活的；可调整的 | adj. 柔韧的；易弯曲的
definition_en: able to change to suit different needs or situations | able to bend easily without breaking
example1_en: My flexible schedule lets me collect the children after school.
example1_zh: 我的时间安排很灵活，可以在放学后接孩子。
example2_en: Flexible working arrangements can help employees balance professional responsibilities with their family commitments.
example2_zh: 灵活的工作安排能帮助员工兼顾工作职责与家庭责任。
collocations: flexible working hours｜弹性工作时间 ; a flexible approach｜灵活的方法 ; flexible materials｜柔性材料
tip_zh: 既可形容安排灵活，也可形容材料易弯曲。

meanings_zh: n. 芽；花蕾 | v. 发芽；长出花蕾
definition_en: a small growth that develops into a leaf or flower | to produce new buds
example1_en: A tiny green bud appeared on the bare branch.
example1_zh: 光秃秃的树枝上冒出了一个小小的绿芽。
example2_en: Warmer spring temperatures can cause trees to bud earlier, leaving new growth vulnerable to sudden frost.
example2_zh: 春季气温升高会使树木提前发芽，导致新芽容易受到突发霜冻的损害。
collocations: a flower bud｜花蕾 ; a leaf bud｜叶芽 ; in bud｜含苞待放 ; nip something in the bud｜将某事扼杀在萌芽中
tip_zh: 动词过去式budded，现在分词budding，双写d。

meanings_zh: v. 低估；小看 | n. 偏低的估计
definition_en: To judge something as less important, capable, or large than reality | An estimate that is lower than the actual amount
example1_en: We underestimated the traffic and arrived half an hour late.
example1_zh: 我们低估了交通拥堵程度，结果迟到了半小时。
example2_en: Policymakers should not underestimate the long-term effects of poor housing on children's health and educational achievement.
example2_zh: 政策制定者不应低估恶劣住房条件对儿童健康和学业表现的长期影响。
collocations: underestimate the cost｜低估成本 ; underestimate the importance of｜低估……的重要性 ; seriously underestimate｜严重低估
tip_zh: 动词末尾读/ meɪt /，名词末尾读/ mət /。

meanings_zh: n. 旋转；转动 | n. 轮换；轮作
definition_en: Movement around a central point or axis | The regular replacement of one thing or person by another
example1_en: The wheel completed one rotation before stopping in the mud.
example1_zh: 车轮转了一圈后便停在了泥里。
example2_en: Crop rotation helps farmers maintain soil fertility and reduce their reliance on chemical pesticides.
example2_zh: 作物轮作有助于农民保持土壤肥力，并减少对化学农药的依赖。
collocations: the Earth's rotation｜地球自转 ; crop rotation｜作物轮作 ; job rotation｜岗位轮换 ; in rotation｜轮流
tip_zh: rotation 可指绕轴旋转，也可指按顺序轮换。

meanings_zh: n. 满意；满足 | n. 满足；履行
definition_en: Pleasure felt when needs, wishes, or expectations are fulfilled. | The act of meeting a need, demand, or requirement.
example1_en: He smiled with satisfaction after fixing the broken chair.
example1_zh: 修好那把坏椅子后，他满意地笑了。
example2_en: Greater job satisfaction can reduce staff turnover and encourage employees to contribute more actively to their organisations.
example2_zh: 更高的工作满意度可以减少人员流失，并鼓励员工更积极地为所在机构作贡献。
collocations: job satisfaction｜工作满意度 ; customer satisfaction｜顾客满意度 ; a sense of satisfaction｜满足感 ; the satisfaction of basic needs｜基本需求的满足
tip_zh: 通常不可数；满意某事常说satisfaction with。

meanings_zh: n. 杂技演员
definition_en: A performer who does difficult balancing, jumping, or gymnastic movements.
example1_en: The acrobat balanced on one hand above the soft mat.
example1_zh: 杂技演员在软垫上方用单手支撑身体，保持平衡。
example2_en: Training as an acrobat requires sustained physical discipline, making injury prevention an essential part of professional education.
example2_zh: 杂技演员的训练需要长期严格的身体训练，因此伤害预防是专业教育中不可或缺的一部分。
collocations: skilled acrobat｜技艺娴熟的杂技演员 ; circus acrobat｜马戏团杂技演员 ; professional acrobat｜职业杂技演员
tip_zh: acrobat指演员；acrobatics指杂技表演或技巧。

meanings_zh: n. 焦虑；担忧
definition_en: Worry or nervousness about something uncertain or threatening.
example1_en: Her anxiety faded when she heard the good news.
example1_zh: 听到好消息后，她的焦虑消退了。
example2_en: Regular physical activity can reduce anxiety among students facing demanding examinations and uncertain career prospects.
example2_zh: 经常锻炼可以减轻学生面对高难度考试和不确定就业前景时的焦虑。
collocations: anxiety about｜对……的焦虑 ; reduce anxiety｜减轻焦虑 ; severe anxiety｜严重焦虑
tip_zh: anxiety about后接担忧的事情；形容词是anxious。

meanings_zh: n. 投入；奉献精神 | n. 承诺；保证 | n. 必须履行的责任
definition_en: A strong willingness to give time and effort to something. | A firm promise to do something. | A duty or arrangement requiring your time, money, or attention.
example1_en: Her commitment to gardening keeps the flowers blooming.
example1_zh: 她用心打理花园，让鲜花一直盛开。
example2_en: Improving public transport requires sustained political commitment and reliable funding rather than occasional investment in isolated projects.
example2_zh: 改善公共交通需要持续的政治决心和可靠的资金，而非偶尔投资零散项目。
collocations: commitment to a cause｜对事业的投入 ; make a commitment｜作出承诺 ; family commitments｜家庭责任 ; long-term commitment｜长期投入
tip_zh: commitment to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: n. 女主席；女董事长
definition_en: A woman who leads a meeting, committee, or organisation.
example1_en: The chairwoman invited everyone to share their ideas.
example1_zh: 女主席邀请大家分享各自的想法。
example2_en: The chairwoman proposed new training programmes to improve employees' skills and support equal opportunities.
example2_zh: 女董事长提议开展新的培训项目，以提升员工技能并促进机会平等。
collocations: chairwoman of the board｜董事会女主席 ; committee chairwoman｜委员会女主席 ; appoint a chairwoman｜任命女主席
tip_zh: 复数为chairwomen；不强调性别可用chair。

meanings_zh: adv. 相当；还算 | adv. 通情达理地；合理地 | adv. 价格公道地
definition_en: to a fairly good or satisfactory degree | in a sensible, fair, or logical way | at a fair and affordable price
example1_en: The kitchen is reasonably clean, but the floor needs sweeping.
example1_zh: 厨房还算干净，不过地板需要扫一扫。
example2_en: Public transport must be reasonably priced if cities want more residents to leave their cars at home.
example2_zh: 如果城市希望更多居民不开车出门，公共交通就必须定价合理。
collocations: reasonably good｜相当不错 ; reasonably priced｜价格公道的 ; reasonably expect｜合理预期
tip_zh: 表示程度时近于 fairly，并非 very。

meanings_zh: n. 导航；航行 | n. 网站或应用的浏览操作
definition_en: Finding and following a route to a destination. | Moving between pages or sections of a website or application.
example1_en: We used a compass for navigation during our hike.
example1_zh: 徒步时，我们用指南针辨别方向。
example2_en: Clear website navigation helps users find essential information quickly, making online public services more accessible to everyone.
example2_zh: 清晰的网站导航能帮助用户快速找到重要信息，让所有人都更方便地使用在线公共服务。
collocations: satellite navigation｜卫星导航 ; a navigation system｜导航系统 ; website navigation｜网站导航
tip_zh: 不仅指航海，也用于道路导航和网页浏览。

meanings_zh: adj. 更可取的；更合意的
definition_en: Better or more suitable than another option.
example1_en: A quiet evening at home is preferable to another party.
example1_zh: 比起再参加一场聚会，在家度过安静的夜晚更合心意。
example2_en: Investing in reliable public transport is often preferable to building more roads in densely populated cities.
example2_zh: 在人口稠密的城市，投资可靠的公共交通通常比修建更多道路更可取。
collocations: preferable to｜比……更可取 ; far preferable｜好得多的 ; a preferable alternative｜更可取的替代方案
tip_zh: 用A is preferable to B，不用than；通常不加more。

meanings_zh: v. 联想；联系 | n. 同事；业务伙伴 | adj. 副的；准的
definition_en: to connect people or things in your mind | someone connected with you through work or business | having a related position, often below the main or full rank
example1_en: I always associate the smell of cinnamon with home.
example1_zh: 我总是一闻到肉桂的气味就想起家。
example2_en: Many consumers associate higher prices with better quality, although research suggests this connection is not always reliable.
example2_zh: 许多消费者把较高价格与较好品质联系起来，但研究表明，这种联系并非总是可靠。
collocations: associate A with B｜把A与B联系起来 ; be associated with｜与……有关 ; business associate｜业务伙伴 ; associate professor｜副教授
tip_zh: 动词尾音/eɪt/；名词、形容词尾音/ət/。

meanings_zh: adj. 过量的；过度的
definition_en: Greater than is necessary, reasonable, or acceptable.
example1_en: The excessive heat made our afternoon walk uncomfortable.
example1_zh: 酷热让我们下午的散步变得很不舒服。
example2_en: Excessive use of private cars contributes to urban air pollution and places pressure on existing roads.
example2_zh: 过度使用私家车加剧了城市空气污染，也给现有道路带来压力。
collocations: excessive consumption｜过度消费 ; excessive pressure｜过大压力 ; excessive noise｜过大噪声 ; excessive use of｜过度使用
tip_zh: 含超过合理限度之意，不等于extra（额外的）。

meanings_zh: v. 明确说明；具体指定
definition_en: To state exactly what is required or meant.
example1_en: Please specify which colour you want for the curtains.
example1_zh: 请明确说明你想要哪种颜色的窗帘。
example2_en: Governments should specify clear safety standards that all manufacturers must meet before selling products to consumers.
example2_zh: 政府应明确规定所有制造商向消费者出售产品前必须达到的安全标准。
collocations: specify requirements｜明确要求 ; specify a date｜指定日期 ; specify conditions｜明确条件
tip_zh: 可接名词、that从句或疑问词引导的从句。

meanings_zh: n. 加班时间；加班费 | adv. 加班地 | n. 加时赛
definition_en: Extra working hours, or the money paid for them. | For longer than the usual working hours. | Additional playing time used to decide a tied game.
example1_en: I worked overtime yesterday to finish the kitchen repairs.
example1_zh: 我昨天加班完成了厨房的维修。
example2_en: Regular overtime may increase short-term productivity, but it can also undermine employees' health and reduce job satisfaction.
example2_zh: 经常加班可能提高短期生产力，但也会损害员工健康，降低工作满意度。
collocations: work overtime｜加班 ; overtime pay｜加班费 ; unpaid overtime｜无偿加班 ; mandatory overtime｜强制加班
tip_zh: 加班用work overtime；over time意为随着时间推移。

meanings_zh: v. 欺骗；蒙骗
definition_en: to deliberately make someone believe something that is not true
example1_en: The seller deceived me about the bicycle's condition.
example1_zh: 卖家在自行车的状况上欺骗了我。
example2_en: Misleading advertisements can deceive consumers into purchasing products that offer little benefit to their health.
example2_zh: 误导性广告可能诱使消费者购买对健康益处甚微的产品。
collocations: deceive someone into doing something｜骗某人做某事 ; deceive yourself｜自欺 ; deliberately deceive｜故意欺骗
tip_zh: deceive sb into doing sth表示骗某人做某事。

meanings_zh: n. 局限；不足 | n. 限制；限额
definition_en: a weakness that prevents someone or something from being fully effective | a rule or condition that controls how much is allowed
example1_en: The main limitation of this camera is its battery life.
example1_zh: 这台相机的主要不足是电池续航时间短。
example2_en: Researchers should acknowledge the limitations of small samples before drawing conclusions about the wider population.
example2_zh: 研究人员在对更广泛人群作出结论前，应承认小样本的局限性。
collocations: limitations of a study｜研究的局限性 ; place limitations on｜对……加以限制 ; budget limitations｜预算限制 ; recognise your limitations｜认识自身的局限
tip_zh: “局限性”常用复数；对……的限制用limitation on。

meanings_zh: n. 冲突；争执 | n. 矛盾；抵触 | v. 相冲突；相抵触
definition_en: A serious disagreement or struggle between people or groups. | A situation where different needs or ideas cannot agree. | To disagree with or be incompatible with something.
example1_en: Sharing a bedroom sometimes causes conflict between the brothers.
example1_zh: 共用一间卧室有时会让兄弟俩发生争执。
example2_en: Economic growth can conflict with environmental protection when industries rely heavily on fossil fuels.
example2_zh: 当工业高度依赖化石燃料时，经济增长可能与环境保护相冲突。
collocations: resolve a conflict｜解决冲突 ; conflict with｜与……相抵触 ; a conflict of interest｜利益冲突
tip_zh: 名词重音在首音节，动词重音在第二音节。

meanings_zh: adj. 准时的；守时的
definition_en: Arriving or happening at the agreed or expected time
example1_en: Please be punctual; the bus cannot wait for everyone.
example1_zh: 请准时到达，公交车不能等每一个人。
example2_en: Punctual employees help organisations operate efficiently by ensuring that meetings and daily tasks begin on time.
example2_zh: 守时的员工确保会议和日常任务按时开始，从而帮助机构高效运作。
collocations: be punctual for｜准时参加 ; a punctual arrival｜准时到达 ; punctual service｜准点服务
tip_zh: 表示准时参加会议，用be punctual for a meeting。

meanings_zh: n. 挂钩；短桩；固定钉 | n. 晾衣夹 | v. 使价格或汇率挂钩
definition_en: a small pin or post used to hang or secure things | a clip that holds clothes on a washing line | to fix a price or rate in relation to another
example1_en: Hang your wet coat on the peg by the door.
example1_zh: 把你的湿外套挂在门边的挂钩上。
example2_en: Some governments peg their currencies to a major foreign currency to reduce exchange rate uncertainty.
example2_zh: 一些政府将本国货币与某种主要外币挂钩，以降低汇率的不确定性。
collocations: tent peg｜帐篷桩 ; clothes peg｜晾衣夹 ; peg a currency to｜将货币与……挂钩
tip_zh: 动词常用peg A to B；晾衣夹在美式中叫clothespin。

meanings_zh: n. 混凝土 | adj. 具体的；确实的 | adj. 混凝土制的
definition_en: A building material made from cement, water, sand, and stones. | Specific and based on facts rather than general ideas. | Made of concrete.
example1_en: The workers poured wet concrete into the wooden frame.
example1_zh: 工人们把湿混凝土倒入木框中。
example2_en: Governments need concrete evidence before investing public money in expensive solutions to environmental problems.
example2_zh: 政府在投入公共资金采用昂贵的环境问题解决方案之前，需要确实的证据。
collocations: reinforced concrete｜钢筋混凝土 ; concrete evidence｜确实的证据 ; concrete steps｜具体措施 ; concrete example｜具体例子
tip_zh: cement是水泥，是制作concrete（混凝土）的原料之一。

meanings_zh: adj. 喜悦的；令人高兴的
definition_en: Feeling, expressing, or causing great happiness.
example1_en: We heard joyful laughter coming from the kitchen.
example1_zh: 我们听到厨房里传来欢快的笑声。
example2_en: Community festivals create joyful shared experiences that can strengthen social connections among residents of different backgrounds.
example2_zh: 社区节庆活动创造共同的欢乐体验，有助于加强不同背景居民之间的社会联系。
collocations: a joyful occasion｜喜庆的场合 ; joyful laughter｜欢快的笑声 ; a joyful reunion｜欢乐的重聚
tip_zh: 比happy更强调强烈喜悦，也可形容场合。

meanings_zh: adj. 虚拟的；通过网络进行的 | adj. 事实上的；几乎完全的
definition_en: Created by computers or experienced through an online connection. | Almost complete or effectively true, though not officially so.
example1_en: We took a virtual tour of the museum yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天我们在线上虚拟参观了那座博物馆。
example2_en: Virtual classrooms can widen access to education, although reliable internet connections remain essential for effective participation.
example2_zh: 虚拟课堂能够扩大教育覆盖面，但可靠的网络连接仍是有效参与的必要条件。
collocations: virtual reality｜虚拟现实 ; virtual classroom｜虚拟课堂 ; virtual tour｜虚拟游览 ; a virtual monopoly｜事实上的垄断
tip_zh: virtual不只指电脑虚拟，也可表示事实上的、近乎的。

meanings_zh: n. 处理；管理；应对 | n. 搬运；用手操作 | n. 车辆操控性能
definition_en: The way someone deals with a situation, task, or person. | The act of moving, holding, or touching something. | How easily a vehicle responds to its driver's control.
example1_en: Her calm handling of the complaint impressed everyone.
example1_zh: 她冷静处理投诉的表现给大家留下了深刻印象。
example2_en: Effective handling of household waste requires cooperation between local authorities, recycling companies, and residents throughout the community.
example2_zh: 有效处理生活垃圾需要地方政府、回收企业和整个社区的居民共同合作。
collocations: handling of complaints｜投诉处理 ; safe handling｜安全操作 ; manual handling｜人工搬运 ; handling charges｜手续费
tip_zh: 表示处理方式时，常用handling of加所处理的事物。

meanings_zh: adv. 因此；由此 | adv. 从现在起；之后
definition_en: For this reason; as a result | After a stated period measured from now
example1_en: The oven broke, hence our cold dinner tonight.
example1_zh: 烤箱坏了，所以今晚我们吃冷餐。
example2_en: Urban populations are growing rapidly; hence, governments need to invest more in reliable public transport.
example2_zh: 城市人口正在迅速增长，因此政府需要加大对可靠公共交通的投入。
collocations: hence the need for｜因此需要 ; hence the importance of｜由此可见……的重要性 ; years hence｜若干年后
tip_zh: 正式用语；表示“因此”时，后面也可直接接名词短语。

meanings_zh: v. 深爱；非常喜爱
definition_en: to love someone or like something very much
example1_en: My grandparents adore spending quiet afternoons in their garden.
example1_zh: 我的祖父母非常喜欢在花园里度过宁静的下午。
example2_en: Although many visitors adore historic neighbourhoods, excessive tourism can disrupt the daily lives of residents.
example2_zh: 虽然许多游客非常喜爱历史街区，但过度旅游可能扰乱居民的日常生活。
collocations: absolutely adore｜极其喜爱 ; adore doing something｜非常喜欢做某事 ; adore someone｜深爱某人
tip_zh: 语气比like强；后接名词或动名词，不接不定式。

meanings_zh: v. 使沮丧；使懊恼 | v. 阻挠；挫败
definition_en: Make someone annoyed because they cannot achieve what they want. | Prevent a plan or effort from succeeding.
example1_en: These constant delays frustrate everyone waiting for the bus.
example1_zh: 这样一再延误，让所有等公交车的人都很烦躁。
example2_en: Complicated application procedures can frustrate small business owners who need financial support to expand their operations.
example2_zh: 繁琐的申请程序会让需要资金支持来扩大经营的小企业主感到沮丧。
collocations: frustrate efforts｜阻挠努力 ; frustrate a plan｜挫败计划 ; deeply frustrated｜极度沮丧的
tip_zh: 人感到沮丧用 frustrated；事情令人沮丧用 frustrating。

meanings_zh: n. 感染；传染病
definition_en: a condition caused by harmful organisms entering the body
example1_en: The doctor checked my sore throat for signs of infection.
example1_zh: 医生检查了我疼痛的喉咙，看是否有感染迹象。
example2_en: Improved sanitation can reduce the risk of infection, particularly in communities with limited access to clean water.
example2_zh: 改善卫生条件可以降低感染风险，尤其是在难以获得洁净水的社区。
collocations: prevent infection｜预防感染 ; risk of infection｜感染风险 ; bacterial infection｜细菌感染 ; spread of infection｜感染的传播
tip_zh: infection既可指感染过程，也可指一次具体感染。

meanings_zh: v. 合作；协作 | v. 配合；协助
definition_en: to work together to achieve a shared aim | to help by doing what someone asks
example1_en: We cooperated with our neighbours to clean the shared garden.
example1_zh: 我们和邻居一起清理了共用花园。
example2_en: Countries must cooperate on climate policy because pollution crosses borders and affects communities far from its source.
example2_zh: 各国必须在气候政策上合作，因为污染会跨越国界，影响远离污染源的社区。
collocations: cooperate with｜与……合作；配合…… ; cooperate on a project｜在项目上合作 ; cooperate closely｜密切合作
tip_zh: 不及物：与人合作用with，就某事合作用on。

meanings_zh: n. 罢工 | v. 击打；撞击 | v. 突然想到；给……印象
definition_en: a refusal to work to demand better employment conditions | hit someone or something with force | occur suddenly to someone or create a strong impression
example1_en: The drivers are on strike, so we walked home.
example1_zh: 司机们正在罢工，所以我们走路回了家。
example2_en: Workers may go on strike when negotiations over pay and working conditions fail.
example2_zh: 当有关薪酬和工作条件的谈判失败时，工人可能会举行罢工。
collocations: go on strike｜举行罢工 ; be on strike｜正在罢工 ; strike a balance｜取得平衡 ; strike someone as unusual｜让某人觉得不寻常
tip_zh: 过去式struck；过去分词通常也用struck。

meanings_zh: v. 建造；构筑 | v. 构思；组织
definition_en: to build something by putting parts or materials together | to carefully develop an argument, theory, or explanation
example1_en: Workers are constructing a wooden bridge across the stream.
example1_zh: 工人们正在小溪上建造一座木桥。
example2_en: Students should learn to construct clear arguments supported by reliable evidence rather than personal assumptions.
example2_zh: 学生应学会用可靠证据而非个人臆断来构建清晰的论证。
collocations: construct a bridge｜建造桥梁 ; construct an argument｜构建论证 ; construct a model｜建立模型
tip_zh: 动词重音在后；名词construct重音在前。

meanings_zh: n. 性别 | n. 语法性
definition_en: Being male, female, or another identity, especially socially and culturally. | A grammatical class of nouns affecting related word forms.
example1_en: The club welcomes everyone, regardless of age or gender.
example1_zh: 这个俱乐部欢迎所有人加入，不论年龄或性别。
example2_en: Policies promoting gender equality can improve access to education and expand employment opportunities across society.
example2_zh: 促进性别平等的政策可以改善受教育机会，并扩大整个社会的就业机会。
collocations: gender equality｜性别平等 ; gender roles｜性别角色 ; gender identity｜性别认同 ; gender gap｜性别差距
tip_zh: gender常侧重社会性别；sex常侧重生理性别。

meanings_zh: n. 弹力绳；蹦极绳
definition_en: A strong stretchy cord used for securing objects or bungee jumping.
example1_en: We secured the sleeping bags with a strong bungee.
example1_zh: 我们用一根结实的弹力绳固定住了睡袋。
example2_en: Adventure tourism operators must inspect every bungee cord regularly to ensure that essential safety standards are maintained.
example2_zh: 探险旅游经营者必须定期检查每根蹦极绳，以确保符合基本安全标准。
collocations: bungee cord｜弹力绳；蹦极绳 ; bungee jumping｜蹦极运动 ; a bungee jump｜一次蹦极
tip_zh: bungee主要指弹力绳；蹦极运动通常说bungee jumping。

meanings_zh: v. 缩小；缩水；减少 | v. 退缩；畏缩
definition_en: To become smaller, or make something smaller. | To move back or avoid something through fear or discomfort.
example1_en: My wool jumper shrank after I washed it badly.
example1_zh: 我的羊毛套头衫因洗涤不当而缩水了。
example2_en: As rural populations shrink, maintaining affordable public transport becomes increasingly difficult for local authorities with limited budgets.
example2_zh: 随着农村人口减少，预算有限的地方政府越来越难以维持价格合理的公共交通服务。
collocations: shrink in size｜体积缩小 ; a shrinking population｜不断减少的人口 ; shrink from responsibility｜逃避责任
tip_zh: 过去式shrank，过去分词shrunk；shrink from指退缩。

meanings_zh: n. 航天器；宇宙飞船
definition_en: A vehicle designed to travel or operate in space.
example1_en: We watched the spacecraft launch from our garden.
example1_zh: 我们在花园里观看了航天器发射。
example2_en: Unmanned spacecraft allow scientists to explore distant planets without putting human lives at risk.
example2_zh: 无人航天器让科学家能够探索遥远的行星，而不危及人的生命。
collocations: launch a spacecraft｜发射航天器 ; unmanned spacecraft｜无人航天器 ; reusable spacecraft｜可重复使用的航天器
tip_zh: 单复数同形：one spacecraft，two spacecraft。

meanings_zh: adj. 背阴的；成荫的 | adj. 可疑的；不正当的
definition_en: Protected from direct sunlight by trees or other objects. | Seeming dishonest or possibly involved in illegal activities.
example1_en: We found a shady spot beneath the old oak.
example1_zh: 我们在老橡树下找到了一处阴凉的地方。
example2_en: Planting trees along busy streets creates shady spaces that encourage walking during hot weather.
example2_zh: 在繁忙街道两旁种树可以创造阴凉空间，鼓励人们在炎热天气里步行。
collocations: shady spot｜阴凉处 ; shady dealings｜不正当交易 ; shady character｜可疑人物
tip_zh: shady指背阴或可疑；shadowy多指昏暗、模糊。

meanings_zh: n. 学士 | n. 未婚男子；单身汉
definition_en: Someone awarded a first university degree | A man who has never married
example1_en: My cousin earned a bachelor's degree in engineering.
example1_zh: 我的表哥获得了工程学学士学位。
example2_en: A bachelor's degree can improve employment prospects, although practical experience remains important in many industries.
example2_zh: 学士学位可以改善就业前景，但在许多行业中，实践经验仍然重要。
collocations: bachelor's degree｜学士学位 ; Bachelor of Arts｜文学学士 ; Bachelor of Science｜理学学士 ; eligible bachelor｜条件优越的未婚男子
tip_zh: 学士学位写作bachelor's degree，注意所有格。

meanings_zh: n. 疫苗接种
definition_en: Giving a vaccine to help protect someone against disease
example1_en: The nurse asked me to relax before my vaccination.
example1_zh: 接种疫苗前，护士让我放松。
example2_en: Accessible vaccination programmes help prevent infectious diseases and reduce pressure on public healthcare services.
example2_zh: 便捷可及的疫苗接种计划有助于预防传染病，并减轻公共医疗服务的压力。
collocations: a vaccination programme｜疫苗接种计划 ; vaccination against flu｜流感疫苗接种 ; vaccination coverage｜疫苗接种覆盖率
tip_zh: 接种以预防某病用vaccination against。

meanings_zh: n. 自卫；正当防卫
definition_en: protecting yourself from attack or physical harm
example1_en: My sister attends a self-defence class every Saturday.
example1_zh: 我姐姐每周六都上自卫术课。
example2_en: Self-defence courses can build confidence, although avoiding dangerous situations should remain the primary focus of personal safety.
example2_zh: 自卫课程能增强信心，但人身安全仍应以避免危险处境为首要重点。
collocations: in self-defence｜出于自卫 ; self-defence class｜自卫术课 ; self-defence techniques｜自卫技巧
tip_zh: 通常不可数；美式拼写为self-defense。

meanings_zh: n. 乘船游览；邮轮旅行 | v. 巡航；悠然行驶
definition_en: a holiday travelling by ship and visiting different places | to travel smoothly at a steady speed
example1_en: We took a cruise around the islands last summer.
example1_zh: 去年夏天，我们乘船游览了那些岛屿。
example2_en: The growing popularity of cruise holidays has raised concerns about air pollution in coastal cities.
example2_zh: 邮轮度假日益流行，引发了人们对沿海城市空气污染的担忧。
collocations: go on a cruise｜乘邮轮旅行 ; cruise ship｜邮轮 ; cruise along｜平稳前行
tip_zh: 作名词指一次邮轮旅行时可数：a cruise。

meanings_zh: adv. 每个；每人；各
definition_en: For each person or thing separately.
example1_en: We bought fresh peaches for fifty cents apiece.
example1_zh: 我们买了新鲜桃子，每个五十分。
example2_en: Reusable containers may cost more apiece initially, but they can reduce packaging expenses over the long term.
example2_zh: 可重复使用的容器起初单价可能较高，但长期而言能够降低包装费用。
collocations: cost ten dollars apiece｜每个售价十美元 ; two apiece｜每人两个 ; one apiece｜每人一个
tip_zh: 常放在价格或数量之后，不用于名词前作限定词。

meanings_zh: adv. 相当大程度地；显著地
definition_en: by a large amount or to a large degree
example1_en: Our new flat is considerably warmer than the old one.
example1_zh: 我们的新公寓比旧公寓暖和多了。
example2_en: Improved public transport could considerably reduce traffic congestion and air pollution in major cities.
example2_zh: 改善公共交通可以显著减少大城市的交通拥堵和空气污染。
collocations: considerably higher｜高出很多 ; vary considerably｜差异很大 ; reduce considerably｜大幅减少
tip_zh: 常修饰比较级或变化动词，表示差异或变化很大。

meanings_zh: n. 记笔记
definition_en: the activity of writing down important information while listening or reading
example1_en: Note-taking helps me remember what happens during meetings.
example1_zh: 记笔记有助于我记住会议中的内容。
example2_en: Effective note-taking allows students to identify key arguments and review complex material more efficiently after lectures.
example2_zh: 有效记笔记能帮助学生识别关键论点，并在课后更高效地复习复杂内容。
collocations: note-taking skills｜记笔记的技巧 ; effective note-taking｜有效记笔记 ; note-taking strategies｜记笔记的策略
tip_zh: 通常不可数；动词短语用take notes。

meanings_zh: n. 民主；民主政体 | n. 民主国家
definition_en: A system of government in which people choose their leaders. | A country governed through representatives elected by its people.
example1_en: Our teacher explained democracy through a classroom vote.
example1_zh: 老师通过一次班级投票向我们解释了民主。
example2_en: A healthy democracy depends on informed citizens who can access reliable information and participate freely in public debate.
example2_zh: 健全的民主制度依赖于知情的公民，他们能够获取可靠信息并自由参与公共讨论。
collocations: parliamentary democracy｜议会民主制 ; representative democracy｜代议民主制 ; strengthen democracy｜加强民主制度
tip_zh: 指制度通常不可数；指民主国家可数。

meanings_zh: n. 混乱；无秩序状态
definition_en: a state of complete confusion and lack of order
example1_en: The kitchen was in chaos after we baked together.
example1_zh: 我们一起烘焙后，厨房里一片狼藉。
example2_en: Unexpected road closures caused chaos across the city, highlighting the need for better emergency planning.
example2_zh: 突如其来的道路封闭使全市陷入混乱，凸显了完善应急规划的必要性。
collocations: in chaos｜处于混乱中 ; cause chaos｜造成混乱 ; complete chaos｜彻底混乱 ; traffic chaos｜交通混乱
tip_zh: 不可数名词；ch发/k/，不是/tʃ/。

meanings_zh: n. 磁铁；磁体 | n. 有吸引力的人或事物
definition_en: an object that attracts iron and certain other metals | a person or thing that strongly attracts people or attention
example1_en: A small magnet holds our shopping list on the fridge.
example1_zh: 一块小磁铁把我们的购物清单固定在冰箱上。
example2_en: Well-funded universities can act as a magnet for talented researchers, supporting innovation across the wider economy.
example2_zh: 资金充足的大学能够吸引优秀研究人员，从而推动更广泛经济领域的创新。
collocations: fridge magnet｜冰箱贴 ; a powerful magnet｜强力磁铁 ; a magnet for tourists｜吸引游客的地方
tip_zh: 比喻吸引某类人时常用a magnet for。

meanings_zh: n. 整齐的一堆 | v. 堆放；码放 | n. 大量
definition_en: a pile of things arranged on top of each other | to arrange things in a pile | a large amount of something
example1_en: A stack of clean plates stood beside the sink.
example1_zh: 水槽旁放着一摞干净的盘子。
example2_en: Libraries increasingly store stacks of older journals off site to create more space for collaborative learning.
example2_zh: 图书馆越来越多地将成摞的旧期刊存放在馆外，为协作学习腾出更多空间。
collocations: a stack of books｜一摞书 ; stack up｜堆积起来 ; stacks of work｜大量工作
tip_zh: stacks of表示“大量”，属非正式用法。

meanings_zh: adj. 复杂精密的；先进的 | adj. 见多识广的；品位高雅的
definition_en: highly developed and involving complex methods or technology | knowledgeable about culture and confident in social situations
example1_en: This sophisticated camera adjusts its settings automatically in low light.
example1_zh: 这台先进的相机会在光线不足时自动调整设置。
example2_en: Sophisticated monitoring systems allow researchers to detect small changes in air quality across densely populated cities.
example2_zh: 先进的监测系统使研究人员能够发现人口密集城市中空气质量的细微变化。
collocations: sophisticated technology｜先进技术 ; sophisticated equipment｜精密设备 ; sophisticated analysis｜精细深入的分析
tip_zh: 形容设备指精密先进；形容人可指见多识广。

meanings_zh: adj. 药草的；香草制的
definition_en: Relating to herbs or made from them.
example1_en: I usually drink herbal tea before going to bed.
example1_zh: 我通常在睡前喝花草茶。
example2_en: Although herbal remedies are widely used, their safety and effectiveness should be assessed through reliable scientific research.
example2_zh: 尽管草药疗法应用广泛，其安全性和有效性仍应通过可靠的科学研究来评估。
collocations: herbal tea｜花草茶 ; herbal medicine｜草药 ; herbal remedy｜草药疗法
tip_zh: 英式发音读出h，美式通常不读h。

meanings_zh: n. 房客；承租人
definition_en: someone who pays rent to use property or land
example1_en: The new tenant brought plants for the balcony.
example1_zh: 新房客带来了几盆植物，准备放在阳台上。
example2_en: Clear rental agreements protect both the tenant and the landlord by defining their responsibilities.
example2_zh: 明确的租赁协议通过界定双方责任，保障房客和房东的权益。
collocations: new tenant｜新房客 ; prospective tenant｜有意承租者 ; tenant rights｜租客权利
tip_zh: tenant是租客，landlord是房东，二者是对应角色。

meanings_zh: adj. 手工的；手动的 | adj. 体力劳动的 | n. 使用手册；指南
definition_en: Done by hand or operated by a person, not automatically. | Involving physical work rather than mainly mental work. | A book giving instructions for using or doing something.
example1_en: This manual coffee grinder takes some effort to turn.
example1_zh: 这个手动咖啡研磨器转起来有些费力。
example2_en: Although automation increases productivity, many industries still rely on manual labour for complex tasks.
example2_zh: 尽管自动化提高了生产率，许多行业仍依靠体力劳动来完成复杂任务。
collocations: manual labour｜体力劳动 ; manual control｜手动控制 ; instruction manual｜使用说明书 ; user manual｜用户手册
tip_zh: 作形容词指手动或体力的；作名词指手册。

meanings_zh: n. 专业知识；专门技能
definition_en: Specialist knowledge or skills gained through training and experience.
example1_en: We need your expertise to repair this old clock.
example1_zh: 修理这座旧钟需要你的专业技能。
example2_en: Universities can support local businesses by sharing their expertise in renewable energy and sustainable manufacturing.
example2_zh: 大学可以通过分享可再生能源和可持续制造领域的专业知识来支持当地企业。
collocations: technical expertise｜技术专长 ; expertise in｜在某方面的专长 ; develop expertise｜培养专业技能 ; draw on expertise｜利用专业知识
tip_zh: 不可数；某领域的专长用expertise in。

meanings_zh: adj. 竞争激烈的；竞争性的 | adj. 好胜的 | adj. 有竞争力的
definition_en: Involving people or organisations trying to outperform each other. | Strongly wanting to win or be better than others. | As good as or better than what others offer.
example1_en: Our weekend football league has become surprisingly competitive.
example1_zh: 我们的周末足球联赛变得格外激烈，真让人意外。
example2_en: In a competitive job market, graduates need practical experience as well as strong academic qualifications.
