example2_zh: 在竞争激烈的就业市场中，毕业生既需要实践经验，也需要过硬的学历资质。
collocations: a competitive market｜竞争激烈的市场 ; competitive prices｜有竞争力的价格 ; a competitive advantage｜竞争优势 ; highly competitive｜竞争非常激烈的
tip_zh: 形容人常指好胜；形容价格指有竞争力。

meanings_zh: n. 山顶；顶峰 | n. 峰会；首脑会议
definition_en: The highest point of a mountain. | A meeting between national leaders or other senior officials.
example1_en: We reached the snowy summit just before sunrise.
example1_zh: 我们在日出前刚好登上了白雪覆盖的山顶。
example2_en: At the climate summit, national leaders discussed practical measures to reduce emissions and support vulnerable communities.
example2_zh: 在气候峰会上，各国领导人讨论了减少排放和支持脆弱社区的实际措施。
collocations: reach the summit｜登上山顶 ; a climate summit｜气候峰会 ; hold a summit｜举行峰会 ; summit talks｜首脑会谈
tip_zh: 山顶常用the summit of；峰会可用a summit。

meanings_zh: n. 精神；意志；气概 | n. 灵魂；幽灵 | n. 烈酒
definition_en: Inner strength, courage, or enthusiasm | A person's soul or a being without a physical body | A strong alcoholic drink made by distillation
example1_en: Even after losing, our team showed great spirit.
example1_zh: 即使输了比赛，我们队仍展现出昂扬的斗志。
example2_en: Community projects can strengthen a spirit of cooperation and encourage residents to take pride in their neighbourhoods.
example2_zh: 社区项目能够增强合作精神，并鼓励居民为自己的社区感到自豪。
collocations: team spirit｜团队精神 ; fighting spirit｜斗志 ; in good spirits｜心情愉快 ; a spirit of cooperation｜合作精神
tip_zh: 表示“情绪”或泛指“烈酒”时，常用复数spirits。

meanings_zh: n. 财富；富有 | n. 大量；丰富
definition_en: a large amount of money and valuable possessions | a large supply of something useful or valuable
example1_en: His wealth allowed him to buy a spacious house.
example1_zh: 他的财富使他能够买下一栋宽敞的房子。
example2_en: A fairer distribution of wealth could improve access to education and reduce inequality across society.
example2_zh: 更公平地分配财富可以改善受教育机会，并减少社会不平等。
collocations: accumulate wealth｜积累财富 ; distribution of wealth｜财富分配 ; a wealth of experience｜丰富的经验
tip_zh: wealth通常不可数；a wealth of表示大量有价值的事物。

meanings_zh: n. 减少；降低；缩小
definition_en: a decrease in the amount, size, or level of something
example1_en: The shop offered a generous reduction on winter coats.
example1_zh: 这家店的冬季大衣大幅降价了。
example2_en: A substantial reduction in food waste could lower household costs and reduce pressure on landfill sites.
example2_zh: 大幅减少食物浪费可以降低家庭开支，并减轻垃圾填埋场的压力。
collocations: a reduction in costs｜成本的降低 ; a significant reduction｜显著减少 ; emission reductions｜排放量的减少 ; price reduction｜降价
tip_zh: reduction in接减少的项目，of可接减少的幅度。

meanings_zh: v. 有差异；变化 | v. 改变；使多样化
definition_en: To differ or change depending on circumstances. | To change something or introduce different kinds.
example1_en: Bus fares vary depending on how far you travel.
example1_zh: 公交车费会随乘车距离而变化。
example2_en: Access to affordable housing can vary considerably between regions, affecting where young professionals choose to live.
example2_zh: 各地区获得可负担住房的机会可能差别很大，从而影响年轻职场人士的居住选择。
collocations: vary considerably｜差异很大 ; vary from place to place｜因地而异 ; vary according to｜随……而变化 ; vary your diet｜使饮食多样化
tip_zh: vary from A to B表示范围；vary in表示某方面不同。

meanings_zh: adj. 期中的；任期中段的 | n. 期中考试
definition_en: Happening halfway through an academic term or period in office. | An examination taken halfway through an academic term.
example1_en: Our mid-term exams start after the spring holiday.
example1_zh: 我们的期中考试在春假之后开始。
example2_en: Mid-term assessments can help teachers identify learning difficulties before students take their final examinations.
example2_zh: 期中测评有助于教师在学生参加期末考试之前发现学习困难。
collocations: mid-term exam｜期中考试 ; mid-term assessment｜期中测评 ; mid-term elections｜中期选举
tip_zh: 也常写作midterm；作名词指期中考试，多见于美语。

meanings_zh: n. 义务；责任
definition_en: Something you must do for legal or moral reasons
example1_en: You have no obligation to buy anything here.
example1_zh: 你没有义务在这里购买任何东西。
example2_en: Employers have a legal obligation to provide safe working conditions and protect employees from preventable harm.
example2_zh: 雇主有法律义务提供安全的工作条件，并保护员工免受可预防的伤害。
collocations: legal obligation｜法律义务 ; moral obligation｜道德义务 ; fulfil an obligation｜履行义务 ; under no obligation｜没有义务
tip_zh: 常用have an obligation to do，表示有义务做。

meanings_zh: v. 认为；把……看作 | n. 尊重；关注 | n. 问候；致意
definition_en: To think of someone or something in a particular way. | Respect for someone or attention to something. | Friendly greetings sent to someone, expressed in the plural.
example1_en: I regard this little café as my second home.
example1_zh: 我把这家小咖啡馆当作自己的第二个家。
example2_en: Policymakers increasingly regard access to reliable internet services as essential for equal participation in modern education.
example2_zh: 政策制定者日益认为，获得可靠的互联网服务对平等参与现代教育至关重要。
collocations: regard as｜把……看作 ; high regard for｜对……的高度尊重 ; with regard to｜关于 ; send my regards｜代我问好
tip_zh: “把A看作B”用regard A as B，不用to be。

meanings_zh: n. 水分；湿气
definition_en: Small amounts of water in the air or a material
example1_en: Keep the lid on so the rice retains its moisture.
example1_zh: 盖好盖子，让米饭保留水分。
example2_en: Planting ground cover helps soil retain moisture and reduces the need for irrigation in dry regions.
example2_zh: 种植地被植物有助于土壤保持水分，减少干旱地区对灌溉的需求。
collocations: retain moisture｜保持水分 ; absorb moisture｜吸收水分 ; soil moisture｜土壤水分 ; moisture content｜含水量
tip_zh: 不可数；moisture指水分，不等于降雨量。

meanings_zh: adj. 多变的；可变的 | n. 变量；可变因素
definition_en: Likely or able to change rather than remain the same. | A quantity or factor that can take different values.
example1_en: The weather here is too variable for outdoor plans.
example1_zh: 这里天气太多变，不好安排户外活动。
example2_en: Researchers must control other variables when investigating how class size affects students' progress in primary education.
example2_zh: 研究班级规模如何影响小学生的学习进步时，研究人员必须控制其他变量。
collocations: variable costs｜可变成本 ; variable weather｜多变的天气 ; independent variable｜自变量 ; dependent variable｜因变量
tip_zh: 作形容词指可变的；作可数名词指变量。

meanings_zh: n. 一项统计数据
definition_en: A numerical fact obtained by collecting and examining information.
example1_en: That surprising statistic made us check the survey again.
example1_zh: 那项令人惊讶的统计数据让我们再次核查了调查结果。
example2_en: A single statistic rarely captures the full impact of unemployment on families and their communities.
example2_zh: 单项统计数据很难完整反映失业对家庭及其社区的影响。
collocations: revealing statistic｜说明问题的统计数据 ; alarming statistic｜令人担忧的统计数据 ; official statistics｜官方统计数据 ; unemployment statistics｜失业统计数据
tip_zh: statistics表数据用复数谓语，表统计学用单数谓语。

meanings_zh: adj. 体贴的；考虑周到的 | adj. 深思的；沉思的
definition_en: showing care for other people's needs and feelings | thinking carefully, or showing careful consideration
example1_en: It was thoughtful of you to bring an umbrella.
example1_zh: 你带了伞来，真是考虑周到。
example2_en: Thoughtful urban planning can create public spaces that meet the needs of residents with limited mobility.
example2_zh: 周到的城市规划能够打造满足行动不便居民需求的公共空间。
collocations: thoughtful gesture｜体贴的举动 ; thoughtful of someone｜某人很体贴 ; thoughtful consideration｜深思熟虑 ; thoughtful expression｜沉思的神情
tip_zh: 体贴用thoughtful of someone；thoughtful不一定表示忧虑。

meanings_zh: v. 使极度害怕
definition_en: To make someone feel extremely frightened.
example1_en: Sudden thunder can terrify our dog during summer storms.
example1_zh: 夏季暴风雨中突如其来的雷声会让我们家的狗非常害怕。
example2_en: Extreme weather events can terrify young children, making clear explanations and reassurance from adults especially important.
example2_zh: 极端天气事件可能让幼童十分恐惧，因此成人的清楚解释和安慰尤为重要。
collocations: terrify someone｜使某人极度害怕 ; be terrified of｜非常害怕 ; be terrified by｜被……吓坏
tip_zh: 及物动词；terrified形容人，terrifying形容吓人的事物。

meanings_zh: n. 地中海 | adj. 地中海地区的
definition_en: The sea between southern Europe, northern Africa, and western Asia. | Relating to the Mediterranean Sea or the countries around it.
example1_en: We sailed across the Mediterranean on a small boat.
example1_zh: 我们乘一艘小船横渡了地中海。
example2_en: The Mediterranean region faces increasing water shortages as rising temperatures place pressure on agriculture and tourism.
example2_zh: 随着气温上升给农业和旅游业带来压力，地中海地区面临日益严重的缺水问题。
collocations: the Mediterranean Sea｜地中海 ; Mediterranean climate｜地中海气候 ; Mediterranean diet｜地中海饮食
tip_zh: 作海域名称时通常用the Mediterranean，首字母大写。

meanings_zh: n. 前缀
definition_en: A word part added at the beginning to change meaning.
example1_en: Adding the prefix un turns happy into its opposite.
example1_zh: 加上前缀un，就能把happy变成它的反义词。
example2_en: Learning common prefixes can help students infer the meanings of unfamiliar words when reading academic texts.
example2_zh: 学习常见前缀可以帮助学生在阅读学术文本时推断生词的含义。
collocations: negative prefix｜否定前缀 ; add a prefix｜添加前缀 ; common prefixes｜常见前缀
tip_zh: prefix放词首，suffix放词尾；两者统称affix。

meanings_zh: n. 可能性
definition_en: the chance that something will happen
example1_en: Dark clouds increased the likelihood of rain this afternoon.
example1_zh: 乌云增加了今天下午下雨的可能性。
example2_en: Regular physical activity can reduce the likelihood of developing certain health conditions later in life.
example2_zh: 经常进行体育活动可以降低晚年患上某些疾病的可能性。
collocations: the likelihood of｜……的可能性 ; increase the likelihood｜增加可能性 ; reduce the likelihood｜降低可能性 ; in all likelihood｜十有八九
tip_zh: 常用likelihood of doing或likelihood that从句。

meanings_zh: v. 广播；播送 | n. 广播节目；播出
definition_en: To transmit programmes through radio, television, or the internet. | A programme transmitted through radio, television, or the internet.
example1_en: The station broadcasts local news every morning before breakfast.
example1_zh: 这家电台每天早晨早餐前播报本地新闻。
example2_en: Public television should broadcast educational programmes that help children understand science and develop an interest in learning.
example2_zh: 公共电视台应播出教育节目，帮助儿童理解科学并培养学习兴趣。
collocations: broadcast live｜现场直播 ; news broadcast｜新闻广播 ; broadcast a programme｜播出节目
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词通常都为broadcast。

meanings_zh: n. 俚语
definition_en: very informal words used by particular groups of people
example1_en: My younger cousin uses slang I cannot understand.
example1_zh: 我年纪较小的表弟会用一些我听不懂的俚语。
example2_en: Although slang can strengthen group identity, excessive use may create barriers between speakers from different generations.
example2_zh: 虽然俚语能增强群体认同，但过度使用可能造成不同代际说话者之间的沟通障碍。
collocations: use slang｜使用俚语 ; a slang term｜一个俚语词 ; internet slang｜网络俚语
tip_zh: 通常不可数；一个俚语表达用a slang term。

meanings_zh: v. 获得；取得
definition_en: To get something, especially through effort or a formal process.
example1_en: You can obtain a replacement key from the landlord.
example1_zh: 你可以从房东那里拿到一把替换钥匙。
example2_en: Researchers must obtain informed consent from participants before collecting personal data for a scientific study.
example2_zh: 研究人员在为科学研究收集个人数据之前，必须取得参与者的知情同意。
collocations: obtain permission｜获得许可 ; obtain information｜获取信息 ; obtain a qualification｜取得资格 ; obtain consent｜取得同意
tip_zh: 比get正式；常用obtain sth from sb或某机构。

meanings_zh: n. 排放物；排放量 | n. 排放；发出
definition_en: A substance released into the environment, especially a polluting gas. | The process of releasing gas, heat, light, or other energy.
example1_en: The mechanic checked my car's emissions this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上，修理工检查了我汽车的尾气排放。
example2_en: Governments can reduce carbon emissions by investing in renewable energy and improving public transport networks.
example2_zh: 政府可以通过投资可再生能源和改善公共交通网络来减少碳排放。
collocations: carbon emissions｜碳排放 ; exhaust emissions｜尾气排放 ; reduce emissions｜减少排放 ; emission standards｜排放标准
tip_zh: 指废气或排放量常用复数emissions；动词是emit。

meanings_zh: adj. 杰出的；出色的 | adj. 尚未处理的；未偿付的
definition_en: Extremely good and much better than average. | Not yet completed, settled, or paid.
example1_en: The young pianist gave an outstanding performance last night.
example1_zh: 那位年轻钢琴家昨晚的演奏十分出色。
example2_en: Universities should recognise outstanding teaching as well as research when deciding which staff members to promote.
example2_zh: 大学决定晋升哪些教职员工时，应同时认可出色的教学和科研表现。
collocations: outstanding achievement｜杰出成就 ; outstanding performance｜出色表现 ; outstanding debt｜未偿债务 ; outstanding issues｜尚未解决的问题
tip_zh: outstanding debt指未偿债务，不是“出色的债务”。

meanings_zh: adj. 邪恶的；恶毒的 | n. 邪恶；罪恶；祸害
definition_en: morally very bad and deliberately causing harm | serious moral wrongdoing or something that causes great harm
example1_en: In the story, an evil wizard steals everyone's dreams.
example1_zh: 故事里，一个邪恶的巫师偷走了所有人的梦。
example2_en: Literature often explores the conflict between good and evil through characters who face difficult moral choices.
example2_zh: 文学作品常通过面临艰难道德选择的人物，探讨善与恶的冲突。
collocations: good and evil｜善与恶 ; an evil intention｜恶意 ; a necessary evil｜不得已接受的坏事
tip_zh: 比bad语气强得多，通常涉及严重的道德恶行。

meanings_zh: n. 扑克游戏 | n. 拨火棍
definition_en: A card game involving bets on the strength of players' hands. | A metal rod used to move fuel in a fire.
example1_en: We played poker with plastic counters after dinner.
example1_zh: 晚饭后，我们用塑料筹码玩扑克。
example2_en: Researchers study poker to understand how people make decisions when information is incomplete and outcomes are uncertain.
example2_zh: 研究人员通过研究扑克，了解人们在信息不完整、结果不确定时如何作出决策。
collocations: play poker｜玩扑克 ; poker face｜不露声色的面孔 ; a fireplace poker｜壁炉拨火棍
tip_zh: poker是特定扑克游戏，不泛指所有纸牌。

meanings_zh: n. 自杀；自杀行为
definition_en: The act of intentionally causing one's own death.
example1_en: Our local centre offers free workshops on suicide prevention.
example1_zh: 我们当地的中心提供免费的自杀预防讲习班。
example2_en: Suicide prevention requires accessible mental health services, supportive communities, and responsible reporting in the media.
example2_zh: 自杀预防需要便捷可及的心理健康服务、相互支持的社区以及负责任的媒体报道。
collocations: suicide prevention｜自杀预防 ; suicide risk｜自杀风险 ; die by suicide｜死于自杀
tip_zh: 中性表达常用die by suicide，避免污名化。

meanings_zh: n. 调查；查明 | n. 研究；探究
definition_en: a careful effort to discover facts about an event or problem | a systematic study intended to increase knowledge about a subject
example1_en: An investigation revealed why the kitchen ceiling was leaking.
example1_zh: 一项调查查明了厨房天花板漏水的原因。
example2_en: An independent investigation into river pollution could help authorities identify its causes and prevent further environmental damage.
example2_zh: 对河流污染开展独立调查，可帮助有关部门查明原因并防止环境进一步受损。
collocations: conduct an investigation｜开展调查 ; launch an investigation｜启动调查 ; an investigation into｜对……的调查 ; under investigation｜正在接受调查
tip_zh: 调查某事用investigation into；under investigation指正被调查。

meanings_zh: adj. 令人愉快的；宜人的 | adj. 愿意同意的
definition_en: pleasant and enjoyable | willing to accept or agree to something
example1_en: We spent an agreeable afternoon chatting in the garden.
example1_zh: 我们在花园里聊天，度过了一个愉快的下午。
example2_en: Employees may be more agreeable to organisational changes when managers explain the benefits and address their concerns.
example2_zh: 如果管理者解释好处并回应员工的顾虑，员工可能会更愿意接受组织变革。
collocations: agreeable weather｜宜人的天气 ; agreeable company｜令人愉快的陪伴 ; agreeable to a proposal｜赞同某项提议
tip_zh: be agreeable to sth表示愿意接受某事，语气较正式。

meanings_zh: n. 百科全书
definition_en: A reference work containing information about many subjects or one field
example1_en: We found a dinosaur picture in the encyclopaedia.
example1_zh: 我们在百科全书里找到了一张恐龙图片。
example2_en: An online encyclopaedia provides a useful starting point for research, but students should verify information using reliable sources.
example2_zh: 在线百科全书为研究提供了有用的起点，但学生应通过可靠来源核实信息。
collocations: online encyclopaedia｜在线百科全书 ; an encyclopaedia entry｜一篇百科全书条目 ; consult an encyclopaedia｜查阅百科全书
tip_zh: 英式拼写；美式通常写作encyclopedia。

meanings_zh: v. 用自己的话改述 | n. 改述；释义
definition_en: Express the same meaning using different words. | A version expressing the same meaning in different words.
example1_en: Could you paraphrase that explanation so I can understand?
example1_zh: 你能换种说法解释一下，让我听懂吗？
example2_en: Students should learn to paraphrase sources accurately while acknowledging the original authors in their academic writing.
example2_zh: 学生应学会在学术写作中准确改述资料内容，同时注明原作者。
collocations: paraphrase a passage｜改述一段文字 ; accurate paraphrase｜准确的改述 ; paraphrase in your own words｜用自己的话改述
tip_zh: 改述须保留原意；summarize则侧重概括要点。

meanings_zh: n. 联盟；同盟
definition_en: A partnership between groups or countries pursuing shared goals.
example1_en: The two clubs formed an alliance to save the pool.
example1_zh: 这两家俱乐部结成联盟，力图保住游泳池。
example2_en: An international alliance can help countries coordinate their responses to environmental threats that cross national borders.
example2_zh: 国际联盟可以帮助各国协调应对跨越国界的环境威胁。
collocations: form an alliance｜结成联盟 ; strategic alliance｜战略联盟 ; military alliance｜军事同盟
tip_zh: 常用form an alliance with，表示“与……结盟”。

meanings_zh: n. 生态学 | n. 生态；生态关系
definition_en: The study of relationships between living things and their environment. | The relationships between living things and their environment.
example1_en: My sister studies ecology and often visits local wetlands.
example1_zh: 我姐姐学习生态学，经常去当地湿地考察。
example2_en: Understanding forest ecology can help governments protect wildlife while managing natural resources more effectively.
example2_zh: 了解森林生态有助于政府在更有效地管理自然资源的同时保护野生动物。
collocations: marine ecology｜海洋生态学 ; forest ecology｜森林生态学 ; study ecology｜研究生态学
tip_zh: ecology指生态学或生态关系，不等于environment。

meanings_zh: n. 鱼鳍；鳍状物 | n. 潜水脚蹼
definition_en: a flat body part or structure aiding movement or stability | a flat rubber covering worn on a foot for swimming
example1_en: We spotted a shark's fin just above the water.
example1_zh: 我们看见一个鲨鱼鳍刚刚露出水面。
example2_en: Changes in fin shape can affect how efficiently fish move through different aquatic environments.
example2_zh: 鱼鳍形状的变化会影响鱼类在不同水生环境中的游动效率。
collocations: dorsal fin｜背鳍 ; tail fin｜尾鳍；尾翼 ; shark fin｜鲨鱼鳍 ; diving fins｜潜水脚蹼
tip_zh: 指潜水脚蹼时常用复数fins。

meanings_zh: adj. 邮政的；邮递的
definition_en: Relating to the system of collecting and delivering mail.
example1_en: The postal worker left a parcel by our door.
example1_zh: 邮递员把一个包裹放在了我们门边。
example2_en: Reliable postal services remain essential for rural communities where internet access is limited or unavailable.
example2_zh: 对于互联网接入有限或无法联网的农村社区，可靠的邮政服务仍然至关重要。
collocations: postal services｜邮政服务 ; a postal worker｜邮政工作人员 ; a postal address｜邮寄地址 ; a postal code｜邮政编码
tip_zh: postal是形容词；邮费用名词postage。

meanings_zh: adv. 到一旁；在旁边 | adv. 暂且不论；留着备用 | n. 旁白；低声插话；题外话
definition_en: to or at one side, away from the main position | away from current consideration or use | a quiet remark or comment outside the main conversation
example1_en: She stepped aside to let the cyclist pass.
example1_zh: 她走到一旁，让骑自行车的人过去。
example2_en: Governments should set aside sufficient funds for maintaining public parks, rather than focusing solely on new construction.
example2_zh: 政府应留出足够的资金维护公园，而不是只关注新建项目。
collocations: step aside｜让到一旁 ; set aside funds｜留出资金 ; put differences aside｜暂时搁置分歧 ; aside from｜除……以外
tip_zh: aside通常是副词；“除……以外”用aside from。

meanings_zh: adj. 不令人满意的；不合格的
definition_en: Not good enough to meet expectations or requirements.
example1_en: The repair was unsatisfactory, so I called the mechanic again.
example1_zh: 维修效果不理想，所以我又给修理工打了电话。
example2_en: Unsatisfactory housing conditions can negatively affect children's health and their ability to concentrate at school.
example2_zh: 不良的居住条件可能损害儿童健康，并影响他们在学校集中注意力的能力。
collocations: unsatisfactory results｜不理想的结果 ; unsatisfactory performance｜不合格的表现 ; unsatisfactory conditions｜不良条件
tip_zh: 形容事物不够好；人的不满用dissatisfied。

meanings_zh: v. 装备；配备 | v. 使具备知识或能力
definition_en: To provide someone or something with necessary tools or equipment | To give someone the skills or knowledge they need
example1_en: We equipped our bikes with lights before riding home.
example1_zh: 骑车回家前，我们给自行车装上了车灯。
example2_en: Schools should equip students with practical financial skills so they can manage their money confidently as adults.
example2_zh: 学校应让学生掌握实用的理财技能，以便他们成年后能够自信地管理财务。
collocations: equip something with｜为某物配备 ; equip students with skills｜使学生掌握技能 ; fully equipped kitchen｜设备齐全的厨房
tip_zh: 常用equip A with B；过去式equipped双写p。

meanings_zh: n. 贫民窟
definition_en: a poor urban area with overcrowded housing in bad condition
example1_en: Their family shared a small room in a crowded slum.
example1_zh: 他们一家挤住在拥挤贫民窟里的一间小屋中。
example2_en: Improving sanitation and access to clean water can significantly reduce disease in densely populated slums.
example2_zh: 改善卫生设施和清洁水源的获取条件，可以显著减少人口密集的贫民窟中的疾病。
collocations: slum housing｜贫民窟住房 ; slum residents｜贫民窟居民 ; slum clearance｜贫民窟清拆
tip_zh: 指居住条件差的城区，不等于所有低收入社区。

meanings_zh: adj. 过时的；陈旧的
definition_en: No longer useful or suitable because things have changed.
example1_en: This outdated map doesn't show the new train station.
example1_zh: 这张过时的地图没有标出新火车站。
example2_en: Hospitals need adequate funding to replace outdated equipment and provide safer, more effective treatment for patients.
example2_zh: 医院需要充足的资金来更换陈旧设备，为患者提供更安全、更有效的治疗。
collocations: outdated equipment｜陈旧设备 ; outdated information｜过时的信息 ; outdated attitudes｜陈旧观念
tip_zh: 强调因时代变化而不再适用，不只是年代久远。

meanings_zh: n. 树木的花；花簇 | v. 开花 | v. 发展；兴盛
definition_en: a flower or mass of flowers on a tree or bush | to produce flowers | to develop successfully or become more confident
example1_en: Pink blossom covered the cherry tree outside our kitchen.
example1_zh: 厨房外的樱桃树开满了粉红色的花。
example2_en: Creative talent can blossom when schools provide supportive teaching and regular opportunities for artistic expression.
example2_zh: 学校提供支持性的教学和经常性的艺术表达机会时，创造性才能便能蓬勃发展。
collocations: cherry blossom｜樱花 ; in blossom｜正在开花 ; blossom into｜发展成为
tip_zh: 多指树木的花；blossom into可比喻成长为。

meanings_zh: adj. 有抱负的；雄心勃勃的 | adj. 宏大的；艰巨的
definition_en: strongly wanting to achieve success | requiring considerable effort or resources to succeed
example1_en: My ambitious sister hopes to run her own bakery.
example1_zh: 我那有抱负的姐姐希望经营自己的面包店。
example2_en: The city has announced an ambitious plan to replace all diesel buses with electric vehicles within a decade.
example2_zh: 该市宣布了一项宏大的计划，要在十年内将所有柴油公交车更换为电动车。
collocations: ambitious goals｜宏大的目标 ; ambitious plan｜雄心勃勃的计划 ; highly ambitious｜极有抱负的 ; ambitious young people｜有抱负的年轻人
tip_zh: 形容人指有抱负；形容计划则强调目标宏大、难度高。

meanings_zh: v. 履行；完成 | v. 满足；符合 | v. 实现
definition_en: to do what a duty, promise, or agreement requires | to provide what is needed or meet a requirement | to achieve something hoped for or develop an ability fully
example1_en: She fulfilled her promise and repaired my bicycle.
example1_zh: 她履行了承诺，修好了我的自行车。
example2_en: Public libraries fulfil an important social role by providing free access to information and learning resources.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆通过免费提供信息和学习资源，发挥着重要的社会作用。
collocations: fulfil a promise｜履行承诺 ; fulfil requirements｜满足要求 ; fulfil your potential｜发挥潜能 ; fulfil a dream｜实现梦想
tip_zh: 英式fulfil，美式fulfill；过去式均为fulfilled。

meanings_zh: n. 专家；专科医生 | adj. 专业的；专门的
definition_en: Someone with detailed knowledge or training in a particular field. | Connected with a particular field requiring special knowledge.
example1_en: My doctor sent me to a skin specialist.
example1_zh: 我的医生让我去看皮肤科专科医生。
example2_en: Schools should employ a specialist to support children who have difficulties with language development.
example2_zh: 学校应聘请专家，为语言发展有困难的儿童提供支持。
collocations: a specialist in｜某领域的专家 ; see a specialist｜看专科医生 ; specialist knowledge｜专业知识 ; specialist training｜专业培训
tip_zh: 名词后接in表示专长领域；形容词常修饰knowledge。

meanings_zh: adj. 致命的 | adj. 毁灭性的；导致失败的
definition_en: Causing someone's death. | Causing something to fail completely.
example1_en: These wild mushrooms can be fatal if you eat them.
example1_zh: 这些野生蘑菇吃了可能会致命。
example2_en: Lower speed limits near schools can reduce the risk of fatal accidents involving pedestrians and cyclists.
example2_zh: 降低学校附近的限速可以减少涉及行人和骑车人的致命事故风险。
collocations: fatal accident｜致命事故 ; fatal injury｜致命伤 ; fatal flaw｜致命缺陷 ; prove fatal｜最终致命
tip_zh: fatal强调致死或导致失败；fateful指影响重大的。

meanings_zh: n. 小说家
definition_en: A person who writes novels.
example1_en: The novelist spends every morning writing at her kitchen table.
example1_zh: 这位小说家每天上午都在厨房的桌边写作。
example2_en: A skilled novelist can reveal social inequalities through characters whose experiences differ greatly from those of readers.
example2_zh: 技艺娴熟的小说家可以通过经历与读者大不相同的人物，揭示社会不平等。
collocations: historical novelist｜历史小说家 ; bestselling novelist｜畅销小说作家 ; aspiring novelist｜立志成为小说家的人
tip_zh: novelist通常指长篇小说作家，novel是长篇小说。

meanings_zh: n. 化石
definition_en: Ancient remains or traces of living things preserved in rock.
example1_en: We found a tiny shell fossil inside the rock.
example1_zh: 我们在岩石里发现了一枚小小的贝壳化石。
example2_en: Fossil evidence helps scientists understand how animals adapted to environmental changes over millions of years.
example2_zh: 化石证据帮助科学家了解动物在数百万年间如何适应环境变化。
collocations: fossil fuels｜化石燃料 ; fossil record｜化石记录 ; fossil evidence｜化石证据
tip_zh: fossil fuels指煤、石油、天然气等化石燃料。

meanings_zh: n. 视力
definition_en: The ability to see
example1_en: My grandfather still has excellent eyesight without wearing glasses.
example1_zh: 我祖父不戴眼镜，视力仍然很好。
example2_en: Regular eye examinations can identify conditions that may damage eyesight if they are left untreated.
example2_zh: 定期眼科检查能发现一些疾病，这些疾病若不治疗，可能会损害视力。
collocations: poor eyesight｜视力差 ; good eyesight｜视力好 ; damage your eyesight｜损害视力
tip_zh: eyesight是不可数名词，不说an eyesight。

meanings_zh: n. 缺陷；瑕疵 | v. 使有缺陷；损害
definition_en: a fault that makes something imperfect or less effective | to damage something or make it imperfect
example1_en: I noticed a tiny flaw in the glass bowl.
example1_zh: 我发现玻璃碗上有一处小瑕疵。
example2_en: A major flaw in the research design makes its conclusions about student performance less reliable.
example2_zh: 研究设计中的一项重大缺陷降低了其关于学生表现的结论的可靠性。
collocations: a fundamental flaw｜根本缺陷 ; a design flaw｜设计缺陷 ; a fatal flaw｜致命缺陷 ; a flaw in the argument｜论证中的漏洞
tip_zh: 可数名词；某物的缺陷常用a flaw in sth。

meanings_zh: adj. 逾期的；延误的 | adj. 早该发生的
definition_en: Not paid, returned, or completed by the expected time. | Needed or deserved much earlier than now.
example1_en: I found an overdue library book under my bed.
example1_zh: 我在床底下发现了一本逾期未还的图书馆藏书。
example2_en: Investment in rural public transport is long overdue, as many residents still lack reliable services.
example2_zh: 农村公共交通早就该得到投资，因为许多居民至今仍缺乏可靠的交通服务。
collocations: an overdue payment｜逾期款项 ; an overdue library book｜逾期未还的图书馆书籍 ; long overdue｜早就该有的
tip_zh: long overdue强调“早就该有或该做”，不只是迟到。

meanings_zh: v. 指示；命令 | v. 教授；指导
definition_en: formally tell someone to do something | teach someone a skill or explain how to do something
example1_en: The guide instructed us to stay on the path.
example1_zh: 导游指示我们不要离开小路。
example2_en: Schools should instruct students in basic first aid so they can respond safely during emergencies.
example2_zh: 学校应教授学生基本急救知识，让他们能在紧急情况下安全应对。
collocations: instruct someone to do something｜指示某人做某事 ; instruct someone in something｜教授某人某方面知识 ; instruct staff｜向员工下达指示
tip_zh: instruct sb to do是指示；instruct sb in是教授。

meanings_zh: adj. 城市的；城镇的
definition_en: Relating to cities or towns rather than the countryside.
example1_en: Our urban garden sits between two tall apartment buildings.
example1_zh: 我们的城市花园位于两栋高层公寓楼之间。
example2_en: Rapid urban growth can increase pressure on public transport, housing, and essential services.
example2_zh: 城市的快速发展可能加重公共交通、住房及基本服务的压力。
collocations: urban development｜城市发展 ; urban areas｜城市地区 ; urban planning｜城市规划 ; urban population｜城市人口
tip_zh: urban指城镇的，rural指乡村的。

meanings_zh: n. 播音员；现场广播员
definition_en: Someone who presents information on broadcasts or at public events
example1_en: The announcer reminded passengers to keep their bags nearby.
example1_zh: 广播员提醒乘客把行李放在身边。
example2_en: A skilled announcer can make emergency broadcasts clearer, helping the public respond calmly and appropriately.
example2_zh: 训练有素的播音员能让紧急广播更加清晰，帮助公众冷静、恰当地应对。
collocations: radio announcer｜电台播音员 ; television announcer｜电视播音员 ; stadium announcer｜体育场现场广播员
tip_zh: announcer负责播报；journalist侧重新闻采访。

meanings_zh: v. 弄平；变平 | v. 摧毁；夷为平地
definition_en: to make something flat or become flat | to destroy something so that it falls to the ground
example1_en: Flatten the dough gently with the palm of your hand.
example1_zh: 用手掌轻轻把面团压平。
example2_en: Developers sometimes flatten existing buildings rather than renovate them, increasing construction waste and destroying local heritage.
example2_zh: 开发商有时会拆平现有建筑而非翻修，增加建筑垃圾并破坏当地遗产。
collocations: flatten the dough｜压平面团 ; flatten a building｜夷平建筑 ; flatten out｜趋于平稳
tip_zh: flatten out也可指价格、曲线等趋于平稳。

meanings_zh: n. 发票；付款清单 | v. 向……开具发票
definition_en: a document listing goods or services and the payment required | to send someone a document requesting payment for goods or services
example1_en: The plumber emailed an invoice after fixing our sink.
example1_zh: 水管工修好我们的水槽后，通过电子邮件发来了付款清单。
example2_en: Small businesses benefit from digital systems that track each invoice and remind customers when payments are due.
example2_zh: 小企业可以从追踪每张发票并提醒客户按时付款的数字系统中受益。
collocations: issue an invoice｜开具发票 ; pay an invoice｜支付发票款项 ; an outstanding invoice｜尚未结清的发票 ; invoice someone for something｜就某项费用向某人开票
tip_zh: invoice 通常用于要求付款；receipt 是已付款的收据。

meanings_zh: n. 奖学金 | n. 学术研究；学问
definition_en: Money awarded to help someone pay for their studies. | Serious academic study or the knowledge gained through it.
example1_en: A scholarship helped Ravi pay for his university course.
example1_zh: 一笔奖学金帮助拉维支付了大学课程的费用。
example2_en: Universities should offer more scholarships to talented applicants from families with limited financial resources.
example2_zh: 大学应为经济条件有限的家庭中有才华的申请者提供更多奖学金。
collocations: win a scholarship｜获得奖学金 ; full scholarship｜全额奖学金 ; academic scholarship｜学术研究
tip_zh: 指奖学金时可数；指学问或学术研究时不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 大众传播媒介；媒体
definition_en: Organisations and channels that provide news and information publicly.
example1_en: The local media reported on our neighbourhood festival.
example1_zh: 当地媒体报道了我们社区的节日活动。
example2_en: The media can influence public attitudes by deciding which environmental issues receive the most attention.
example2_zh: 媒体可以通过决定重点关注哪些环境问题来影响公众态度。
collocations: mass media｜大众传媒 ; media coverage｜媒体报道 ; social media｜社交媒体 ; the media｜新闻媒体
tip_zh: 统称新闻媒体常用the media；单一媒介用medium。

meanings_zh: n. 指挥官
definition_en: an officer responsible for directing a military unit or operation
example1_en: The commander asked the crew to check their equipment.
example1_zh: 指挥官要求队员检查装备。
example2_en: During disaster relief operations, the military commander coordinated transport to deliver essential supplies to isolated communities.
example2_zh: 在救灾行动中，军事指挥官协调运输，向与外界隔绝的社区运送必需物资。
collocations: military commander｜军事指挥官 ; naval commander｜海军指挥官 ; commander-in-chief｜总司令
tip_zh: 泛指指挥官；作具体军衔时，级别因国家而异。

meanings_zh: n. 狂怒；暴怒 | n. 猛烈；狂暴
definition_en: An extremely strong feeling of anger. | Extreme force or violence, especially in weather.
example1_en: He shook with fury when he discovered the damage.
example1_zh: 发现东西遭到损坏时，他气得浑身发抖。
example2_en: The sudden closure of the local hospital provoked fury among residents who depended on its services.
example2_zh: 当地医院突然关闭，激起了依赖其服务的居民的强烈愤怒。
collocations: shake with fury｜气得发抖 ; provoke fury｜激起暴怒 ; the fury of the storm｜风暴的猛烈
tip_zh: 比anger语气强；in a fury表示“勃然大怒”。

meanings_zh: adj. 便携式的；轻便的
definition_en: Easy to carry or move from place to place
example1_en: We took a portable speaker to the picnic.
example1_zh: 我们带了一个便携式音箱去野餐。
example2_en: Portable medical equipment enables healthcare workers to provide essential services in remote rural communities.
example2_zh: 便携式医疗设备使医护人员能够在偏远农村社区提供基本服务。
collocations: portable device｜便携设备 ; portable charger｜便携式充电器 ; portable equipment｜便携式设备
tip_zh: 强调容易携带或移动，不一定能放进口袋。

meanings_zh: n. 君主统治时期 | v. 当政；统治 | v. 盛行；占主导地位
definition_en: the period when a king or queen rules | to rule as a king or queen | to be the strongest or most noticeable condition
example1_en: This castle was built during a young queen's reign.
example1_zh: 这座城堡建于一位年轻女王在位期间。
example2_en: During the king's reign, investment in public libraries made education more accessible to ordinary citizens.
example2_zh: 在这位国王统治期间，对公共图书馆的投入让普通民众更容易获得教育。
collocations: during the reign of｜在……统治期间 ; a long reign｜漫长的统治时期 ; reign supreme｜占绝对优势 ; chaos reigns｜混乱笼罩
tip_zh: 与rain同音；reign指统治，rein指缰绳。

meanings_zh: n. 淤青；挫伤 | v. 使淤青；碰伤
definition_en: A dark mark caused by bleeding under the skin. | To injure skin or fruit without breaking its surface.
example1_en: I have a purple bruise on my knee.
example1_zh: 我的膝盖上有一块紫色的淤青。
example2_en: Soft fruit can bruise during transport, so producers need packaging that provides adequate protection.
example2_zh: 软质水果在运输中容易碰伤，因此生产者需要使用能提供充分保护的包装。
collocations: a nasty bruise｜严重的淤青 ; bruise easily｜容易淤青 ; a bruised knee｜淤青的膝盖
tip_zh: bruise通常不破皮；cut指割破皮肤的伤口。

meanings_zh: n. 使情况复杂的因素；难题 | n. 并发症
definition_en: An extra problem that makes a situation harder to manage | An additional medical problem arising during an illness or treatment
example1_en: A delayed train added another complication to our journey.
example1_zh: 火车晚点又给我们的旅程添了一个麻烦。
example2_en: Regular medical checkups can help detect complications early and improve outcomes for patients with chronic conditions.
example2_zh: 定期体检有助于及早发现并发症，并改善慢性病患者的治疗效果。
collocations: an unexpected complication｜意外的麻烦 ; a serious complication｜严重并发症 ; avoid complications｜避免麻烦或并发症 ; postoperative complications｜术后并发症
tip_zh: 可指数额外难题，也可指疾病或治疗引起的并发症。

meanings_zh: n. 动物的爪；脚掌 | v. 用爪抓挠；用蹄刨
definition_en: the foot of an animal such as a cat or dog | to scratch or touch something repeatedly with a paw or hoof
example1_en: The puppy rested one muddy paw on my knee.
example1_zh: 小狗把一只沾满泥的爪子搭在我的膝盖上。
example2_en: Urban wildlife may suffer paw injuries from broken glass and other waste left in public spaces.
example2_zh: 城市野生动物可能因公共场所遗留的碎玻璃和其他垃圾而导致脚掌受伤。
collocations: front paw｜前爪 ; paw print｜爪印 ; paw at the door｜用爪子挠门
tip_zh: paw指整个脚掌；claw指尖锐的爪或爪甲。

meanings_zh: v. 戳；捅 | v. 伸出；探出 | n. 戳；捅
definition_en: to push a finger or pointed object into something | to move or stick out through an opening | a quick push with a finger or pointed object
example1_en: She poked the dough gently to check its softness.
example1_zh: 她轻轻戳了戳面团，检查它是否柔软。
example2_en: Museum visitors can poke virtual objects on interactive screens to explore scientific concepts through play.
example2_zh: 博物馆游客可以戳点互动屏幕上的虚拟物体，在玩乐中探索科学概念。
collocations: poke a hole in｜在……上戳洞 ; poke your head out｜探出头 ; poke fun at｜取笑
tip_zh: poke fun at是“取笑”，不是“戳”。

meanings_zh: v. 拆下；使分离 | v. 使超然；使摆脱影响
definition_en: to remove or separate something from what it is attached to | to separate yourself emotionally from a situation or experience
example1_en: You can detach the hood when the rain stops.
example1_zh: 雨停后，你可以把帽兜拆下来。
example2_en: Researchers must detach themselves from personal preferences when evaluating evidence to ensure that their conclusions remain reliable.
example2_zh: 研究人员评估证据时必须摆脱个人偏好的影响，以确保结论可靠。
collocations: detach from｜从……分离 ; detach the cable｜拔下连接线 ; detach yourself from｜使自己超脱于
tip_zh: 常用 detach A from B；detachable 指可拆卸的。

meanings_zh: n. 接力赛 | v. 转达；转播 | n. 继电器
definition_en: a race in which teammates take turns completing sections | to pass information or broadcast signals to another person or place | an electrical switch controlled by another electrical circuit
example1_en: Our team dropped the baton during the school relay.
example1_zh: 我们队在学校接力赛中掉了接力棒。
example2_en: Emergency services relay weather warnings to remote communities through local radio stations and mobile networks.
example2_zh: 应急部门通过地方广播电台和移动网络向偏远社区传达天气警报。
collocations: relay race｜接力赛 ; relay a message｜传达信息 ; relay information｜转达信息 ; electrical relay｜继电器
tip_zh: 动词也读/rɪˈleɪ/；relay a message指转达消息。

meanings_zh: n. 基因
definition_en: A unit of inherited information that influences an organism's characteristics
example1_en: This gene can influence the colour of a cat's fur.
example1_zh: 这种基因会影响猫的毛色。
example2_en: Identifying a gene linked to an inherited disease may help researchers develop more effective treatments.
example2_zh: 识别出与某种遗传病相关的基因，可能有助于研究人员开发更有效的治疗方法。
collocations: gene expression｜基因表达 ; gene therapy｜基因治疗 ; inherit a gene｜遗传某个基因
tip_zh: gene是可数名词；genetics指遗传学。

meanings_zh: v. 盯着看；凝视 | n. 凝视；注视
definition_en: to look at someone or something steadily for a while | a long, fixed look at someone or something
example1_en: The cat stared at a bird outside the window.
example1_zh: 猫盯着窗外的一只鸟。
example2_en: Children who stare at screens for long periods may have fewer opportunities for physical activity.
example2_zh: 长时间盯着屏幕的儿童可能较少有机会进行身体活动。
collocations: stare at｜盯着看 ; stare into space｜出神地望着 ; a blank stare｜茫然的目光
tip_zh: stare at强调长时间盯看；glance at指瞥一眼。

meanings_zh: n. 人类
definition_en: all human beings considered as one group
example1_en: This museum explores how mankind learned to grow food.
example1_zh: 这座博物馆展示人类如何学会种植粮食。
example2_en: Climate change presents a challenge to mankind that requires sustained cooperation across national borders.
example2_zh: 气候变化给人类带来了挑战，需要各国持续开展跨境合作。
collocations: the future of mankind｜人类的未来 ; the history of mankind｜人类历史 ; for the benefit of mankind｜为了人类的福祉
tip_zh: 指全人类，不指男性；包容性表达可用humankind。

meanings_zh: adj. 优雅的；姿态优美的
definition_en: Moving or shaped in a smooth, attractive way.
example1_en: The swan made a graceful turn across the pond.
example1_zh: 天鹅在池塘水面上优雅地转了个弯。
example2_en: The bridge combines graceful curves with practical engineering, creating an attractive landmark for the city.
example2_zh: 这座桥将优美的曲线与实用的工程设计结合起来，成为城市一道亮丽的地标。
collocations: graceful movements｜优雅的动作 ; graceful curves｜优美的曲线 ; a graceful dancer｜舞姿优美的舞者
tip_zh: graceful多形容姿态优美；gracious多指亲切有礼。

meanings_zh: adv. 仔细地；严密地 | adv. 紧密地；密切地 | adv. 近距离地
definition_en: with careful attention to details or changes | with a strong connection or much cooperation | with little space between people or things
example1_en: Look closely at this leaf and notice its tiny veins.
example1_zh: 仔细看看这片叶子，留意它细小的叶脉。
example2_en: Governments should closely monitor air quality near schools to protect children from the harmful effects of pollution.
example2_zh: 政府应密切监测学校附近的空气质量，保护儿童免受污染的危害。
collocations: closely monitor｜密切监测 ; closely related｜密切相关的 ; work closely with｜与……密切合作 ; look closely｜仔细看
tip_zh: look closely指仔细看；stand close指站得近。

meanings_zh: n. 公式 | n. 方法；配方 | n. 婴儿配方奶
definition_en: a mathematical rule expressed using symbols | a particular method or mixture used to achieve something | specially prepared milk used to feed babies
example1_en: Our teacher showed us a formula for calculating area.
example1_zh: 老师给我们讲解了一个计算面积的公式。
example2_en: There is no single formula for reducing urban poverty, since local economic conditions vary considerably.
example2_zh: 减少城市贫困没有统一的方法，因为各地经济状况差异很大。
collocations: mathematical formula｜数学公式 ; formula for success｜成功之道 ; infant formula｜婴儿配方奶
tip_zh: 复数可用formulas或formulae；方法常接for。

meanings_zh: adj. 不合理的；不讲理的 | adj. 过分的；过高的
definition_en: Not fair, sensible, or willing to accept good reasons. | Greater than is fair or acceptable.
example1_en: It seems unreasonable to blame you for the weather.
example1_zh: 因为天气不好而责怪你，似乎很不讲理。
example2_en: Expecting employees to answer messages throughout their holidays places unreasonable demands on their time and harms wellbeing.
example2_zh: 要求员工整个假期都回复消息，是对其时间的过分索取，也会损害身心健康。
collocations: unreasonable demands｜过分的要求 ; unreasonable behaviour｜不讲理的行为 ; unreasonable expectations｜不合理的期望
tip_zh: 可形容人不讲理，也可形容要求或价格过分。

meanings_zh: n. 磨坊；磨粉机 | n. 工厂；制造厂 | v. 碾磨；磨成粉
definition_en: a building or machine where grain is ground into flour | a factory that processes materials such as paper or steel | to crush grain or other material into small particles
example1_en: We watched wheat being ground at the old mill.
example1_zh: 我们在那座老磨坊看了小麦磨粉的过程。
example2_en: Converting abandoned textile mills into housing can preserve industrial heritage while meeting demand for urban accommodation.
example2_zh: 将废弃纺织厂改建为住房，可以在满足城市居住需求的同时保护工业遗产。
collocations: flour mill｜面粉厂；磨坊 ; steel mill｜钢铁厂 ; paper mill｜造纸厂 ; mill grain｜碾磨谷物
tip_zh: mill多指加工原料的工厂；普通工厂常用factory。

meanings_zh: adj. 压倒性的；极大的 | adj. 令人难以承受的
definition_en: So great or strong that little can oppose it | Too intense or difficult to deal with
example1_en: The proposal received overwhelming support from our neighbours.
example1_zh: 这项提议获得了邻居们的压倒性支持。
example2_en: An overwhelming majority of residents support investment in reliable public transport rather than wider roads.
example2_zh: 绝大多数居民支持投资建设可靠的公共交通，而不是拓宽道路。
collocations: overwhelming majority｜绝大多数 ; overwhelming evidence｜确凿有力的证据 ; overwhelming support｜压倒性的支持 ; overwhelming pressure｜难以承受的压力
tip_zh: 强调程度极大；既可形容支持，也可形容压力。

meanings_zh: n. 部长；大臣 | n. 牧师 | v. 照料；帮助
definition_en: A senior government official responsible for a particular area. | A religious leader in certain Christian churches. | To care for someone or attend to their needs.
example1_en: The minister visited our school to meet the teachers.
example1_zh: 部长来到我们学校与教师们见面。
example2_en: Trained volunteers minister to the needs of older residents who lack access to regular medical care.
example2_zh: 受过培训的志愿者照料无法定期获得医疗服务的老年居民。
collocations: education minister｜教育部长 ; prime minister｜首相；总理 ; a church minister｜教会牧师 ; minister to someone's needs｜照顾某人的需要
tip_zh: 动词义较正式，常用minister to表示照料。

meanings_zh: adj. 有效的；正式认可的 | adj. 有根据的；合理的
definition_en: officially acceptable and able to be used | based on sound reasons or evidence
example1_en: Your ticket is still valid for the return journey.
example1_zh: 你的票在返程时仍然有效。
example2_en: Although online learning offers flexibility, students have valid concerns about limited interaction with their teachers.
example2_zh: 虽然在线学习灵活方便，但学生对师生互动不足的担忧是合理的。
collocations: valid ticket｜有效票据 ; valid reason｜正当理由 ; valid for｜有效期为；适用于 ; valid concern｜合理的担忧
tip_zh: valid for可接有效时长；valid until接到期时间。

meanings_zh: v. 正式禁止 | v. 阻止；使不可能
definition_en: To officially forbid an action through rules or laws. | To prevent something by making it impossible or impractical.
example1_en: The pool rules prohibit running on the wet floor.
example1_zh: 泳池规定禁止在湿滑的地面上奔跑。
example2_en: Governments should prohibit the dumping of untreated industrial waste into rivers to protect public health.
example2_zh: 政府应禁止将未经处理的工业废物倾倒入河，以保护公众健康。
collocations: strictly prohibit｜严格禁止 ; prohibit someone from doing something｜禁止某人做某事 ; prohibit the use of｜禁止使用
tip_zh: 用prohibit doing或prohibit sb from doing。

meanings_zh: n. 水母
definition_en: a soft sea animal with hanging tentacles that can sting
example1_en: A translucent jellyfish drifted past our boat this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上，一只半透明的水母从我们船边漂过。
example2_en: Rising ocean temperatures may encourage jellyfish populations to grow, potentially disrupting marine ecosystems and coastal tourism.
example2_zh: 海洋温度上升可能促使水母数量增加，进而扰乱海洋生态系统并影响沿海旅游业。
collocations: a jellyfish sting｜水母蜇伤 ; a swarm of jellyfish｜一大群水母 ; jellyfish populations｜水母种群
tip_zh: 复数通常仍用 jellyfish；它不是鱼类。

meanings_zh: n. 奇迹；不可思议的事
definition_en: An extraordinary event that seems impossible or beyond natural explanation.
example1_en: It was a miracle that the vase survived.
example1_zh: 那个花瓶竟然没碎，真是个奇迹。
example2_en: Although new technology can appear to work miracles, lasting environmental progress also requires changes in public behaviour.
example2_zh: 虽然新技术似乎能创造奇迹，但持久的环境改善也需要公众行为的改变。
collocations: work miracles｜创造奇迹 ; a medical miracle｜医学奇迹 ; a miracle cure｜神奇疗法
tip_zh: work miracles指创造奇迹，也可夸张表示效果惊人。

meanings_zh: v. 建立；创立 | v. 确立；使获认可 | v. 查明；证实
definition_en: to start an organisation, system, or lasting arrangement | to make a position or reputation widely accepted | to discover or prove that something is true
example1_en: Our neighbours established a gardening club last spring.
example1_zh: 我们的邻居去年春天成立了一个园艺俱乐部。
example2_en: Governments should establish clear standards to ensure that new housing is both safe and energy efficient.
example2_zh: 政府应制定明确的标准，确保新建住房既安全又节能。
collocations: establish a business｜创办企业 ; establish a reputation｜树立声誉 ; establish the facts｜查明事实 ; establish a link｜确立联系
tip_zh: establish是及物动词，后接机构、制度或事实等。

meanings_zh: n. 标准；准则（复数）
definition_en: Standards used to judge something or make a decision.
example1_en: This flat meets all our criteria for a home.
example1_zh: 这套公寓符合我们对住房的所有要求。
example2_en: Scholarships should be awarded according to clear criteria that consider both academic achievement and financial need.
example2_zh: 奖学金应依据明确的标准颁发，同时考虑学业成绩和经济需求。
collocations: meet the criteria｜符合标准 ; selection criteria｜筛选标准 ; assessment criteria｜评估标准
tip_zh: criteria是复数，单数为criterion；用criteria are。

meanings_zh: v. 交流；互动 | v. 相互作用；相互影响
definition_en: To communicate or do things with other people. | To affect one another when combined or brought together.
example1_en: Our neighbours often interact while their children play outside.
example1_zh: 孩子们在外面玩耍时，我们的邻居常常互相交流。
example2_en: Group projects encourage students to interact with classmates whose experiences and perspectives differ from their own.
example2_zh: 小组项目鼓励学生与经历和观点不同于自己的同学互动。
collocations: interact with｜与……互动 ; interact socially｜进行社交互动 ; interact with each other｜相互交流
tip_zh: 不及物动词：与某人互动用interact with someone。

meanings_zh: adj. 迷信的
definition_en: believing certain actions or objects bring good or bad luck
example1_en: My superstitious cousin always carries a lucky stone.
example1_zh: 我那迷信的表亲总是带着一块幸运石。
example2_en: Superstitious beliefs may influence financial decisions when people rely on lucky objects rather than reliable evidence.
example2_zh: 当人们依赖幸运物而非可靠证据时，迷信观念可能影响财务决策。
collocations: superstitious beliefs｜迷信观念 ; superstitious about｜对……迷信 ; superstitious practices｜迷信做法
tip_zh: 常用be superstitious about表示对某事迷信。

meanings_zh: n. 国会；议会 | n. 代表大会；专题会议
definition_en: A national body of representatives that makes laws. | A large formal meeting of representatives or specialists.
example1_en: The congress debated the new law late into the night.
example1_zh: 国会就这项新法律辩论到深夜。
example2_en: Delegates at the international congress discussed practical ways to improve access to healthcare in rural communities.
example2_zh: 国际大会的代表们讨论了改善农村社区医疗可及性的切实办法。
collocations: a national congress｜全国代表大会 ; an international congress｜国际大会 ; a member of Congress｜国会议员
tip_zh: 特指美国等国家的国会时，通常大写Congress。

meanings_zh: n. 恐慌；惊慌 | v. 惊慌失措；使恐慌
definition_en: sudden strong fear that makes clear thinking difficult | to feel or cause sudden fear and lose calm
example1_en: I felt a moment of panic when my keys disappeared.
example1_zh: 发现钥匙不见时，我一时惊慌起来。
example2_en: Clear communication during emergencies can reduce public panic and help people follow safety instructions more effectively.
example2_zh: 紧急情况下清晰的沟通能减少公众恐慌，帮助人们更有效地遵循安全指示。
collocations: in a panic｜惊慌失措地 ; panic attack｜惊恐发作 ; cause panic｜引发恐慌 ; panic buying｜恐慌性抢购
tip_zh: 过去式panicked、进行式panicking均须在c后加k。

meanings_zh: n. 水泥 | v. 巩固；加强
definition_en: Powder mixed with water to bind building materials together. | To make a relationship or agreement stronger.
example1_en: The builder mixed cement and water in a bucket.
example1_zh: 建筑工人在桶里搅拌水泥和水。
example2_en: Joint research projects can cement relationships between universities and encourage the exchange of scientific knowledge.
example2_zh: 联合研究项目可以巩固大学之间的关系，并促进科学知识的交流。
collocations: a bag of cement｜一袋水泥 ; mix cement｜搅拌水泥 ; cement a relationship｜巩固关系
tip_zh: cement是水泥；concrete是含水泥、砂石的混凝土。

meanings_zh: adj. 严重的；剧烈的 | adj. 严厉的；苛刻的
definition_en: Very bad, intense, or damaging. | Very strict or harsh in treatment or judgment.
example1_en: Severe storms knocked down several trees near our house.
example1_zh: 猛烈的暴风雨刮倒了我们家附近的几棵树。
example2_en: Severe water shortages can undermine agricultural production, forcing governments to invest in more efficient irrigation systems.
example2_zh: 严重缺水会削弱农业生产，迫使政府投资建设效率更高的灌溉系统。
collocations: severe pain｜剧痛 ; severe weather｜恶劣天气 ; a severe shortage｜严重短缺 ; severe punishment｜严厉惩罚
tip_zh: 可修饰疼痛、天气、短缺或惩罚，表示程度重。

meanings_zh: n. 功能；作用 | v. 运转；发挥作用 | n. 函数
definition_en: The purpose or job of something or someone. | To work or operate in the intended way. | A mathematical relationship assigning each input exactly one output.
example1_en: What is the function of this small red button?
example1_zh: 这个红色小按钮有什么作用？
example2_en: Urban parks serve an important function by providing space for exercise, relaxation, and social interaction.
example2_zh: 城市公园提供运动、休闲和社交的空间，发挥着重要作用。
collocations: perform a function｜发挥作用 ; function properly｜正常运转 ; function as｜起……作用 ; basic function｜基本功能
tip_zh: function as后接名词，表示起……作用。

meanings_zh: adv. 想必；据推测
definition_en: Probably true, based on what is known or reasonably expected.
example1_en: Her coat is gone, so presumably she has left.
example1_zh: 她的外套不见了，想必她已经离开了。
example2_en: More frequent bus services would presumably encourage commuters to leave their cars at home, reducing urban traffic.
example2_zh: 更频繁的公交班次想必会鼓励通勤者不开车出门，从而缓解城市交通拥堵。
collocations: presumably because｜大概是因为 ; presumably intended to｜想必是为了 ; presumably true｜据推测属实
tip_zh: 表示有依据的推测，不等于certainly的确定语气。

meanings_zh: n. 协调；配合 | n. 身体协调能力
definition_en: Organising people or activities so they work effectively together | The ability to move different body parts smoothly together
example1_en: Moving this sofa upstairs will take some coordination.
example1_zh: 把这张沙发搬上楼需要大家配合一下。
example2_en: Effective coordination between schools and health services can improve support for children with additional needs.
example2_zh: 学校与医疗卫生服务机构之间的有效协调，能改善对有额外需求儿童的支持。
collocations: close coordination｜密切协调 ; coordination between departments｜部门之间的协调 ; hand-eye coordination｜手眼协调能力
tip_zh: 通常不可数；between引出需要协调的双方或多方。

meanings_zh: v. 使感染；传染 | v. 感染；影响情绪
definition_en: to cause a person or organism to develop an infection | to spread a feeling or attitude to others
example1_en: One sick rabbit can infect the others in its cage.
example1_zh: 一只生病的兔子可能传染同笼的其他兔子。
example2_en: Viruses can infect vulnerable patients more easily when hospitals lack effective hygiene measures and adequate ventilation.
example2_zh: 如果医院缺乏有效的卫生措施和充分的通风，病毒就更容易感染身体脆弱的患者。
collocations: infect someone with a virus｜使某人感染病毒 ; become infected｜受到感染 ; infect a wound｜使伤口感染
tip_zh: 常用infect someone with a virus，表示使某人感染病毒。

meanings_zh: n. 线；细线 | n. 思路；讨论串 | v. 穿线；穿过
definition_en: a long, thin fibre used for sewing | a connected sequence of ideas or online messages | to pass thread or another thin object through an opening
example1_en: I need some blue thread to mend this shirt.
example1_zh: 我需要一些蓝线来补这件衬衫。
example2_en: Clear transitions help readers follow the thread of an argument in a complex academic essay.
example2_zh: 清晰的过渡能帮助读者理解复杂学术文章中的论证思路。
collocations: sewing thread｜缝纫线 ; thread a needle｜穿针 ; lose the thread｜跟不上思路 ; discussion thread｜讨论串
tip_zh: lose the thread指跟不上谈话或文章的思路。

meanings_zh: adj. 深爱的；深受喜爱的 | n. 心爱的人
definition_en: deeply loved by someone or many people | a person whom someone loves deeply
example1_en: He carefully repaired his daughter's beloved wooden toy.
example1_zh: 他小心地修好了女儿心爱的木玩具。
example2_en: Public libraries remain beloved community spaces because they offer opportunities for learning and social connection.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆依然是深受喜爱的社区空间，因为它们提供学习和社交的机会。
collocations: a beloved friend｜挚爱的朋友 ; a beloved pet｜心爱的宠物 ; a beloved institution｜深受喜爱的机构
tip_zh: 通常作形容词；作名词指爱人，语气较文学化。

meanings_zh: n. 木工活；木工技艺
definition_en: The work or skill of making and repairing wooden structures.
example1_en: I learned basic carpentry by building a small bookshelf.
example1_zh: 我通过制作一个小书架学会了基础木工技艺。
example2_en: Schools that offer carpentry courses can help students develop practical skills and explore careers in construction.
example2_zh: 开设木工课程的学校可以帮助学生培养实用技能，并探索建筑行业的职业方向。
collocations: carpentry skills｜木工技能 ; carpentry workshop｜木工车间 ; basic carpentry｜基础木工 ; carpentry tools｜木工工具
tip_zh: carpentry指技艺或工作；carpenter指木匠。

meanings_zh: adj. 不切实际的；不可行的 | adj. 不善处理实际事务的
definition_en: Unlikely to work well or be useful in practice | Not skilled at handling everyday practical tasks
example1_en: These white shoes are impractical for a muddy walk.
example1_zh: 穿这双白鞋走泥泞的路不太实用。
example2_en: Building underground railways may be impractical in smaller cities because construction costs often exceed available budgets.
example2_zh: 在较小的城市修建地铁可能不可行，因为建设成本往往超过可用预算。
collocations: an impractical solution｜不切实际的解决办法 ; highly impractical｜极不实用的 ; impractical for everyday use｜不适合日常使用
tip_zh: 是形容词，不是动词；不实用不一定是不可能。

meanings_zh: adj. 机械的；机器的 | adj. 机械呆板的；无意识的
definition_en: relating to machines or their moving parts | done without thought, interest, or feeling
example1_en: A mechanical fault stopped our car outside the village.
example1_zh: 一处机械故障让我们的车停在了村外。
example2_en: Regular inspections can identify mechanical problems before they cause serious disruptions to public transport services.
example2_zh: 定期检查可以在机械问题严重影响公共交通服务之前将其发现。
collocations: mechanical engineering｜机械工程 ; mechanical failure｜机械故障 ; mechanical parts｜机械零件 ; a mechanical response｜机械式的回应
tip_zh: mechanical指机器相关；mechanic指机械修理工。

meanings_zh: n. 化合物 | n. 围墙内的场地或建筑群 | v. 加重；使恶化
definition_en: A substance formed from chemically joined elements. | An enclosed area containing buildings. | To make an existing problem or difficulty worse.
example1_en: Water is a compound made from hydrogen and oxygen.
example1_zh: 水是由氢和氧组成的化合物。
example2_en: Poor public transport can compound the difficulties faced by people seeking employment in rural areas.
example2_zh: 公共交通不便会加重农村地区求职者面临的困难。
collocations: chemical compound｜化合物 ; compound a problem｜使问题恶化 ; residential compound｜住宅院区 ; compound interest｜复利
tip_zh: 名词重音在首音节；动词重音在第二音节。

meanings_zh: v. 绑架；劫持
definition_en: To take someone away illegally and hold them captive
example1_en: In the film, criminals kidnap a wealthy businessman.
example1_zh: 电影中，犯罪分子绑架了一位富商。
example2_en: International cooperation helps police investigate criminal groups that kidnap people and demand money for their release.
example2_zh: 国际合作有助于警方调查绑架他人并索要赎金的犯罪团伙。
collocations: kidnap someone for ransom｜绑架某人索取赎金 ; a kidnapping victim｜绑架受害者 ; a kidnapping attempt｜绑架企图
tip_zh: 不限于儿童；常用过去式kidnapped，分词kidnapping。

meanings_zh: n. 庭院；院子；天井
definition_en: an outdoor area partly or completely enclosed by walls or buildings
example1_en: We ate breakfast in the courtyard beside a fountain.
example1_zh: 我们在庭院的喷泉旁吃了早餐。
example2_en: Traditional houses with a central courtyard can provide natural ventilation while offering residents a private outdoor space.
example2_zh: 带有中央庭院的传统住宅既能自然通风，又能为住户提供私密的户外空间。
collocations: central courtyard｜中央庭院 ; enclosed courtyard｜围合式庭院 ; courtyard garden｜庭院花园
tip_zh: 强调由建筑或墙围合的露天空间，不等同于花园。

meanings_zh: adj. 语法的 | adj. 符合语法的
definition_en: relating to the rules for forming words and sentences | following the accepted grammar rules of a language
example1_en: Our teacher explained the grammatical rules using simple examples.
example1_zh: 老师用简单的例子解释了这些语法规则。
example2_en: Although grammatical accuracy matters in language learning, students also need opportunities to develop confidence through conversation.
example2_zh: 尽管语法准确性对语言学习很重要，学生也需要通过对话建立自信的机会。
collocations: grammatical accuracy｜语法准确性 ; grammatical errors｜语法错误 ; grammatical structure｜语法结构
tip_zh: 可指“语法方面的”，也可指句子“符合语法的”。

meanings_zh: v. 碰撞；相撞 | v. 冲突；抵触
definition_en: to crash into something or each other | to strongly disagree or be impossible to combine
example1_en: Two shopping trolleys collided near the busy supermarket entrance.
example1_zh: 两辆购物车在繁忙的超市入口附近撞到了一起。
example2_en: Economic ambitions often collide with environmental priorities when governments consider approving major infrastructure projects.
example2_zh: 政府考虑批准大型基础设施项目时，经济目标往往与环保重点发生冲突。
collocations: collide with｜与……相撞；冲突 ; collide head-on｜迎头相撞 ; colliding interests｜相互冲突的利益
tip_zh: 通常是不及物动词；与某物相撞用with。

meanings_zh: n. 商品；货品 | v. 推销；促销
definition_en: goods available for sale | to promote goods and encourage people to buy them
example1_en: The shop displays its new merchandise near the entrance.
example1_zh: 这家店在入口附近陈列新商品。
example2_en: Selling locally produced merchandise can support small businesses and reduce the environmental impact of transport.
example2_zh: 销售本地生产的商品可以扶持小企业，并减少运输对环境的影响。
collocations: sell merchandise｜销售商品 ; branded merchandise｜品牌商品 ; display merchandise｜陈列商品
tip_zh: 名词不可数；动词词尾常读作/daɪz/。

meanings_zh: adj. 可食用的
definition_en: Safe or suitable to eat.
example1_en: These edible flowers make the salad look especially colourful.
example1_zh: 这些可食用的花让沙拉显得格外缤纷。
example2_en: Redistributing edible food that shops would otherwise discard could reduce waste and support families on low incomes.
example2_zh: 将商店原本会丢弃的可食用食物重新分配，可以减少浪费并帮助低收入家庭。
collocations: edible plants｜可食用植物 ; edible flowers｜可食用花卉 ; edible oil｜食用油
tip_zh: edible表示能吃，不表示美味；勿凭外观判断野生植物。

meanings_zh: v. 扰乱；使中断
definition_en: Prevent an activity or system from continuing normally.
example1_en: Heavy snow could disrupt our train journey tomorrow.
example1_zh: 大雪可能会影响我们明天的火车行程。
example2_en: Frequent power cuts disrupt online learning, particularly in rural communities where reliable internet access is already limited.
example2_zh: 频繁停电扰乱了在线学习，在本就缺乏可靠网络的农村社区尤其如此。
collocations: disrupt traffic｜扰乱交通 ; disrupt services｜使服务中断 ; disrupt sleep｜干扰睡眠 ; disrupt learning｜扰乱学习
tip_zh: 及物动词，直接接活动或系统；不是形容词。

meanings_zh: n. 例子；事例；情况
definition_en: A particular example or occurrence of something.
example1_en: Some fruits freeze well; berries, for instance, keep their flavour.
example1_zh: 有些水果适合冷冻，比如浆果就能保留风味。
example2_en: This project provides an instance of successful cooperation between local businesses and environmental research groups.
example2_zh: 这个项目提供了当地企业与环境研究团体成功合作的实例。
collocations: for instance｜例如 ; in this instance｜在这种情况下 ; an isolated instance｜个别事例
tip_zh: for instance意为“例如”，作用类似for example。

meanings_zh: adj. 受威胁的；濒危的 | adj. 感到受威胁的
definition_en: At risk of harm, loss, or extinction. | Feeling that someone or something may cause harm or loss.
example1_en: The rescue centre cares for several threatened bird species.
example1_zh: 这家救助中心照料着几种受威胁的鸟类。
example2_en: Protecting threatened species requires governments to preserve natural habitats and address the underlying causes of biodiversity loss.
example2_zh: 保护受威胁物种需要政府保全天然栖息地，并解决生物多样性丧失的根本原因。
collocations: threatened species｜受威胁物种 ; feel threatened｜感到受威胁 ; threatened with extinction｜面临灭绝威胁
tip_zh: threatened指受到威胁；threatening指构成威胁。

meanings_zh: v. 嚎叫；呼啸 | n. 嚎叫声；怒吼声
definition_en: Make a long, loud cry or a similar rushing sound. | A long, loud cry expressing pain, anger, or another strong feeling.
example1_en: Our dog howled when the ambulance passed the house.
example1_zh: 救护车经过家门时，我们的狗嚎叫起来。
example2_en: Residents complained that wind howled through poorly insulated windows, making their homes uncomfortable during winter.
example2_zh: 居民抱怨寒风从隔热不良的窗户灌入并发出呼啸声，导致冬天家里很不舒适。
collocations: howl at the moon｜对月长嚎 ; howl with laughter｜放声大笑 ; howls of protest｜愤怒的抗议声 ; the wind howls｜风呼啸
tip_zh: 既用于动物长嚎，也用于风声或人的强烈反应。

meanings_zh: adj. 令人满意的；合格的
definition_en: Good enough to meet a particular need or standard
example1_en: The mechanic confirmed that the brakes were satisfactory.
example1_zh: 修理工确认刹车状况合格。
example2_en: Providing satisfactory public transport is essential if cities want residents to rely less on private cars.
example2_zh: 城市若希望居民减少对私家车的依赖，就必须提供令人满意的公共交通服务。
collocations: satisfactory results｜令人满意的结果 ; satisfactory explanation｜令人满意的解释 ; satisfactory progress｜符合预期的进展
tip_zh: 强调达到要求，不一定出色；人的满意感用satisfied。

meanings_zh: adj. 主要的；首要的 | adj. 首席的；最高级别的 | n. 首领；负责人
definition_en: Most important among several things. | Having the highest rank in an organisation or profession. | The person who leads a group or organisation.
example1_en: My chief concern is getting everyone home safely.
example1_zh: 我最关心的是让大家安全到家。
example2_en: The chief advantage of public transport is its ability to move large crowds while using less road space.
example2_zh: 公共交通的主要优势在于能用较少的道路空间运送大量乘客。
collocations: chief concern｜首要关切 ; chief executive｜首席执行官 ; chief reason｜主要原因 ; police chief｜警察局长
tip_zh: chief可作形容词或名词；副词用chiefly。

meanings_zh: adv. 间接地 | adv. 含蓄地；拐弯抹角地
definition_en: Through another person, thing, or stage rather than directly | Without expressing something clearly or openly
example1_en: I heard about the empty flat indirectly through a colleague.
example1_zh: 我是通过一位同事间接得知那套空置公寓的消息的。
example2_en: Higher fuel prices indirectly affect food costs because transporting agricultural products becomes more expensive for suppliers.
example2_zh: 燃油价格上涨会间接影响食品价格，因为供应商运输农产品的成本会增加。
collocations: indirectly affect｜间接影响 ; indirectly responsible for｜对……负有间接责任 ; refer indirectly to｜含蓄地提及 ; directly or indirectly｜直接或间接地
tip_zh: 是副词，不是形容词；修饰动词时用indirectly。

meanings_zh: v. 停止；使停止 | n. 停止；中止
definition_en: to stop moving or happening, or make something stop | a stop in movement, activity, or progress
example1_en: The bus halted suddenly when a sheep crossed.
example1_zh: 一只羊横穿道路时，公交车突然停了下来。
example2_en: Urgent international cooperation is needed to halt the destruction of habitats and protect species at risk of extinction.
example2_zh: 迫切需要开展国际合作，以阻止栖息地遭到破坏，并保护面临灭绝风险的物种。
collocations: come to a halt｜停下来 ; bring to a halt｜使停止 ; halt production｜停止生产 ; halt the decline｜遏制衰退
tip_zh: 比stop正式；come to a halt表示停下来。

meanings_zh: adj. 人造的；人为的
definition_en: made or caused by people rather than occurring naturally
example1_en: We walked around a man-made lake near the airport.
example1_zh: 我们绕着机场附近的一个人工湖散步。
example2_en: Man-made barriers such as dams can disrupt river ecosystems by preventing fish from reaching their breeding grounds.
example2_zh: 水坝等人工屏障会阻碍鱼类到达繁殖地，从而破坏河流生态系统。
collocations: man-made lake｜人工湖 ; man-made materials｜人造材料 ; man-made disaster｜人为灾难 ; man-made fibres｜人造纤维
tip_zh: 强调由人制造或造成；也可用human-made。

meanings_zh: adj. 荒谬的；不合理的
definition_en: Completely unreasonable or silly.
example1_en: It seems absurd to drive when the shop is so close.
example1_zh: 商店这么近还要开车去，似乎太不合理了。
example2_en: It is absurd to expect public transport use to increase without improving service quality or affordability.
example2_zh: 不提高服务质量或降低出行成本，却指望公共交通使用量增加，这是不合理的。
collocations: an absurd idea｜荒谬的想法 ; an absurd claim｜荒谬的说法 ; completely absurd｜完全荒谬的
tip_zh: 常用句式：It is absurd to do sth.。

meanings_zh: n. 繁荣；迅速增长 | n. 隆隆声；轰鸣声 | v. 迅速发展；发出轰鸣
definition_en: a period of rapid growth or economic success | a loud, deep sound | to grow rapidly or make a loud, deep sound
example1_en: The tourism boom has filled every hotel in town.
example1_zh: 旅游业的繁荣让镇上的每家酒店都住满了。
example2_en: A housing boom can create jobs, but it may also make homes less affordable for local residents.
example2_zh: 住房市场的繁荣可以创造就业机会，但也可能让当地居民更难负担住房。
collocations: economic boom｜经济繁荣 ; a boom in tourism｜旅游业的迅猛发展 ; a booming industry｜蓬勃发展的行业
tip_zh: 表示某领域的迅速增长，常用a boom in。

meanings_zh: n. 人口迁移；移居 | n. 动物迁徙 | n. 数据或系统迁移
definition_en: The movement of people to live in another place. | The regular movement of animals between regions, often with the seasons. | The transfer of data or software to another computer system.
example1_en: We watched the birds during their annual autumn migration.
example1_zh: 我们观察了正在进行一年一度秋季迁徙的鸟儿。
example2_en: Migration from rural areas to cities can increase pressure on housing while providing workers for expanding industries.
example2_zh: 农村人口向城市迁移可能加大住房压力，同时为不断扩张的行业提供劳动力。
collocations: rural-to-urban migration｜农村向城市的人口迁移 ; seasonal migration｜季节性迁徙 ; bird migration｜鸟类迁徙 ; data migration｜数据迁移
tip_zh: migration泛指迁移；immigration侧重迁入。

meanings_zh: adj. 火山的；火山形成的 | adj. 猛烈爆发的
definition_en: Related to volcanoes or produced by their activity. | Sudden and extremely powerful, especially when describing anger.
example1_en: We walked across dark volcanic rock near the coast.
example1_zh: 我们在海岸附近的深色火山岩上行走。
example2_en: Although volcanic eruptions threaten nearby settlements, the resulting soils can support highly productive agriculture over time.
example2_zh: 虽然火山喷发威胁附近的居民区，但其形成的土壤经过一段时间后可支撑高产农业。
collocations: volcanic eruption｜火山喷发 ; volcanic ash｜火山灰 ; volcanic activity｜火山活动 ; volcanic rock｜火山岩
tip_zh: 通常作形容词；“火山岩”用volcanic rock。

meanings_zh: adj. 公制的 | n. 衡量指标
definition_en: Using measurement units such as metres, litres, and grams. | A measurement used to judge performance, quality, or progress.
example1_en: This kitchen scale uses metric units for every ingredient.
example1_zh: 这个厨房秤用公制单位称量每种食材。
example2_en: Although income is a useful metric, it cannot fully capture a population's quality of life.
example2_zh: 尽管收入是一项有用的衡量指标，但它无法全面反映人口的生活质量。
collocations: metric system｜公制 ; metric units｜公制单位 ; performance metric｜绩效指标
tip_zh: 形容词指公制的；名词指指标，常用复数。

meanings_zh: adj. 肥胖的
definition_en: having excessive body fat that may harm health
example1_en: The vet said our cat was obese and needed exercise.
example1_zh: 兽医说我们家的猫过于肥胖，需要运动。
example2_en: People who are obese should have access to supportive healthcare without facing discrimination or blame.
example2_zh: 肥胖人群应能获得支持性的医疗服务，而不受歧视或责备。
collocations: clinically obese｜临床诊断为肥胖的 ; become obese｜变得肥胖 ; obese patients｜肥胖患者
tip_zh: 属医学用语，程度通常重于overweight；避免随意评价他人。

meanings_zh: n. 刺猬
definition_en: A small mammal with spines that curls into a ball.
example1_en: A hedgehog shuffled through the leaves beside our fence.
example1_zh: 一只刺猬在我们围栏旁的落叶间缓缓爬行。
example2_en: Leaving small gaps beneath garden fences allows hedgehogs to move safely between feeding areas.
example2_zh: 在花园围栏下留出小缝隙，可以让刺猬在觅食区域之间安全通行。
collocations: a hedgehog's spines｜刺猬的刺 ; hedgehog habitat｜刺猬栖息地 ; a baby hedgehog｜刺猬幼崽
tip_zh: hedgehog是刺猬；porcupine是豪猪，两者不是同一种动物。

meanings_zh: n. 备忘录；内部通知
definition_en: A short written message, especially between people at work.
example1_en: Our manager sent a memo about the new opening hours.
example1_zh: 经理发了一份关于新营业时间的内部通知。
example2_en: A clear internal memo can help employees understand changes to workplace policies and avoid unnecessary confusion.
example2_zh: 清晰的内部通知能帮助员工理解工作场所政策的变化，避免不必要的困惑。
collocations: send a memo｜发送备忘录 ; internal memo｜内部通知 ; a memo about something｜关于某事的备忘录
tip_zh: memo常指工作中的简短内部通知，复数为memos。

meanings_zh: n. 担忧；关切 | n. 令人担忧的事；关注事项 | v. 涉及；使担忧
definition_en: A feeling of worry about something important | An issue that matters or causes worry | To relate to someone or something, or cause worry
example1_en: Her main concern is getting home before the storm.
example1_zh: 她最担心的是能否在暴风雨前到家。
example2_en: Growing concern about air pollution has encouraged many cities to invest in cleaner public transport systems.
example2_zh: 人们对空气污染日益担忧，促使许多城市投资建设更清洁的公共交通系统。
collocations: concern about safety｜对安全的担忧 ; raise concerns｜引发担忧 ; a major concern｜一个主要问题 ; concern for others｜对他人的关心
tip_zh: concern about多指对事情的担忧；for常指关心某人。

meanings_zh: v. 分析；细察
definition_en: to examine something carefully to understand its parts or causes
example1_en: We analysed our spending and cancelled two unused subscriptions.
example1_zh: 我们分析了开销，取消了两项没在用的订阅。
example2_en: Researchers analyse survey responses to identify the main barriers preventing adults from returning to education.
example2_zh: 研究人员分析问卷回答，以找出阻碍成年人重返教育体系的主要因素。
collocations: analyse data｜分析数据 ; analyse the results｜分析结果 ; analyse a problem｜分析问题
tip_zh: 英式拼写analyse，美式通常写analyze。

meanings_zh: adj. 技术的；科技的
definition_en: relating to technology and its practical development
example1_en: My grandfather enjoys learning about the latest technological advances.
example1_zh: 我祖父喜欢了解最新的科技进展。
example2_en: Technological innovation can improve agricultural productivity while reducing the amount of water required for irrigation.
example2_zh: 技术创新能够提高农业生产力，同时减少灌溉所需的水量。
collocations: technological advances｜科技进步 ; technological innovation｜技术创新 ; technological development｜技术发展
tip_zh: technological侧重科技发展，technical侧重具体技术。

meanings_zh: n. 使用；使用量 | n. 词语用法；惯用法
definition_en: The way or amount that something is used. | The customary way words or phrases are used in language.
example1_en: My phone tracks my daily data usage automatically.
example1_zh: 我的手机会自动记录我每天的数据使用量。
example2_en: Installing efficient appliances can reduce household energy usage without requiring major changes to everyday routines.
example2_zh: 安装高效电器可以减少家庭能源使用量，而无需大幅改变日常习惯。
collocations: energy usage｜能源使用量 ; data usage｜数据使用量 ; common usage｜常见用法 ; usage patterns｜使用模式
tip_zh: usage重在使用量、使用方式或语言惯用法。

meanings_zh: adj. 强制的；必修的
definition_en: required by a law or rule, rather than optional
example1_en: Wearing a helmet is compulsory at this climbing centre.
example1_zh: 在这家攀岩中心必须戴头盔。
example2_en: Compulsory education helps ensure that all children acquire basic skills regardless of their family income.
example2_zh: 义务教育有助于确保所有儿童都能掌握基本技能，不受家庭收入影响。
collocations: compulsory education｜义务教育 ; compulsory subject｜必修科目 ; compulsory attendance｜强制出席
tip_zh: compulsory强调规定必须做，与optional相对。

meanings_zh: n. 大众传媒
definition_en: communication channels that deliver information to very large audiences
example1_en: My grandparents relied on mass media for their daily news.
example1_zh: 我的祖父母过去依靠大众传媒获取每日新闻。
example2_en: Mass media can shape public attitudes towards environmental issues by deciding which stories receive widespread attention.
example2_zh: 大众传媒可以通过决定哪些报道受到广泛关注，来影响公众对环境问题的态度。
collocations: the mass media｜大众传媒 ; mass media coverage｜大众媒体报道 ; mass media influence｜大众传媒的影响
tip_zh: 泛指大众传媒常用the mass media，通常接复数谓语。

meanings_zh: n. 芯片；集成电路 | n. 碎屑；缺口 | v. 碰掉一小块；使缺损
definition_en: a tiny electronic component containing many connected circuits | a small broken piece or the mark it leaves | to break a small piece off something
example1_en: The repairer replaced a damaged chip inside my laptop.
example1_zh: 维修人员更换了我笔记本电脑内部一块损坏的芯片。
example2_en: Demand for advanced chips is increasing as more industries adopt artificial intelligence and automated production systems.
example2_zh: 随着更多行业采用人工智能和自动化生产系统，对先进芯片的需求正在增长。
collocations: computer chip｜计算机芯片 ; silicon chip｜硅芯片 ; a chip in a cup｜杯子上的缺口 ; chip a tooth｜磕掉一小块牙齿
tip_zh: 食物中的chips：英式指薯条，美式通常指薯片。

meanings_zh: adj. 神圣的；宗教上重要的
definition_en: Connected with a religion and treated with deep respect
example1_en: Visitors remove their shoes before entering this holy place.
example1_zh: 游客进入这处圣地前会脱鞋。
example2_en: Protecting holy sites requires governments to balance public access with respect for local religious traditions.
example2_zh: 保护宗教圣地需要政府兼顾公众参访需求与对当地宗教传统的尊重。
collocations: holy place｜圣地 ; holy book｜宗教经典 ; holy day｜宗教节日
tip_zh: holy强调宗教上的神圣，与wholly发音相同。

meanings_zh: n. 尴尬；窘迫 | n. 令人尴尬的人或事
definition_en: an uncomfortable feeling caused by awkwardness or fear of others' judgment | a person or thing that causes shame or awkwardness
example1_en: I blushed with embarrassment when I forgot my neighbour's name.
example1_zh: 我忘了邻居的名字，尴尬得脸都红了。
example2_en: Fear of embarrassment may prevent language learners from practising their speaking skills in front of others.
example2_zh: 害怕尴尬可能使语言学习者不敢在他人面前练习口语。
collocations: to my embarrassment｜令我尴尬的是 ; blush with embarrassment｜尴尬得脸红 ; avoid embarrassment｜避免尴尬 ; a source of embarrassment｜令人尴尬的根源
tip_zh: 情绪义不可数；指令人尴尬的人或事时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 分发；分配 | n. 分布
definition_en: the process of giving or delivering things to different people | the way something is spread across an area or group
example1_en: Volunteers organised the distribution of warm blankets after the storm.
example1_zh: 暴风雨过后，志愿者组织发放了保暖毯。
example2_en: The uneven distribution of medical services leaves many rural communities without adequate access to healthcare.
example2_zh: 医疗服务分布不均，导致许多农村社区无法获得充分的医疗保障。
collocations: distribution of resources｜资源分配 ; population distribution｜人口分布 ; distribution network｜配送网络 ; uneven distribution｜分布不均
tip_zh: 既指分发过程，也指人口等的分布状态。

meanings_zh: adv. 迅速地；快速地
definition_en: At a fast speed or within a short time.
example1_en: Dark clouds spread rapidly across the sky before lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭前，乌云迅速布满天空。
example2_en: As urban populations grow rapidly, public transport systems must expand to meet increasing demand.
example2_zh: 随着城市人口迅速增长，公共交通系统必须扩展，以满足不断增加的需求。
collocations: grow rapidly｜迅速增长 ; change rapidly｜迅速变化 ; spread rapidly｜迅速蔓延
tip_zh: 表示速度快，不等于表示立刻的immediately。

meanings_zh: adj. 含脂肪多的；脂肪的
definition_en: Containing much fat, or consisting of fat.
example1_en: This soup tastes rich because the meat is fatty.
example1_zh: 这汤味道浓厚，因为用的肉脂肪较多。
example2_en: Although some fatty foods provide essential nutrients, excessive consumption of saturated fat may increase cardiovascular health risks.
example2_zh: 虽然某些高脂肪食物提供必需营养素，但摄入过多饱和脂肪可能增加心血管健康风险。
collocations: fatty foods｜高脂肪食物 ; fatty tissue｜脂肪组织 ; fatty acids｜脂肪酸 ; fatty fish｜富含脂肪的鱼
tip_zh: 作名词称呼人有侮辱性，应避免使用。

meanings_zh: n. 陪审团 | n. 评审团
definition_en: a group that decides facts in a court case | a group that judges entries in a competition
example1_en: The jury listened carefully as the witness described the accident.
example1_zh: 证人描述事故经过时，陪审团认真聆听。
example2_en: Serving on a jury allows ordinary citizens to participate directly in the administration of justice.
example2_zh: 担任陪审员让普通公民能够直接参与司法工作。
collocations: serve on a jury｜担任陪审员 ; jury verdict｜陪审团裁决 ; jury member｜陪审团成员
tip_zh: jury指整个陪审团；单个陪审员叫juror。

meanings_zh: adj. 有挑战性的；困难的 | adj. 挑衅的；表示质疑的
definition_en: Difficult in a way that tests skills or determination. | Expressing doubt or inviting disagreement or competition.
example1_en: This challenging puzzle kept us busy all afternoon.
example1_zh: 这道有难度的谜题让我们忙了整整一下午。
example2_en: Providing affordable healthcare in remote communities remains challenging because trained medical staff and essential equipment are often scarce.
example2_zh: 由于受过培训的医护人员和必要设备往往短缺，在偏远社区提供可负担的医疗服务仍然困难。
collocations: challenging task｜艰巨的任务 ; challenging environment｜充满挑战的环境 ; intellectually challenging｜考验智力的
tip_zh: 形容任务有难度用challenging，不用challenged。

meanings_zh: v. 闪烁；闪耀 | n. 闪光；活力
definition_en: to shine with small, bright flashes of light | bright flashes of light, or a lively, exciting quality
example1_en: The tiny crystals sparkle whenever sunlight enters the room.
example1_zh: 每当阳光照进房间，那些小水晶就闪闪发亮。
example2_en: Although the river sparkles in the sunlight, regular testing is necessary to assess its water quality.
example2_zh: 尽管河水在阳光下波光粼粼，仍需定期检测以评估水质。
collocations: sparkle in the sunlight｜在阳光下闪耀 ; eyes sparkle｜眼睛闪闪发亮 ; add sparkle to｜为……增添活力
tip_zh: sparkle强调点点闪光；shine泛指发光。

meanings_zh: v. 当心；提防
definition_en: to be careful about a possible danger or problem
example1_en: Beware of slippery rocks when you cross the stream.
example1_zh: 过溪流时要当心湿滑的石头。
example2_en: Consumers should beware of online offers that promise expensive products at unusually low prices.
example2_zh: 消费者应提防声称以异常低价出售昂贵商品的网络优惠。
collocations: beware of scams｜提防骗局 ; beware of imitations｜谨防仿冒品 ; let the buyer beware｜买方须自行谨慎
tip_zh: 常用于警告：beware of＋名词；不用作普通过去式。

meanings_zh: n. 金星 | n. 维纳斯，罗马爱与美之神
definition_en: The planet second closest to the Sun. | The goddess of love and beauty in Roman mythology.
example1_en: We spotted Venus shining brightly just after sunset.
example1_zh: 日落后不久，我们看到了明亮的金星。
example2_en: Studying the thick atmosphere of Venus helps scientists understand how greenhouse gases influence planetary temperatures.
example2_zh: 研究金星浓厚的大气层有助于科学家理解温室气体如何影响行星温度。
collocations: the atmosphere of Venus｜金星的大气层 ; the surface of Venus｜金星表面 ; a mission to Venus｜金星探测任务
tip_zh: 专有名词，首字母大写；金星通常不加冠词。

meanings_zh: v. 欣然接受；采纳 | v. 拥抱 | n. 拥抱
definition_en: to willingly accept an idea, change, or opportunity | to hold someone closely in your arms | an act of holding someone closely in your arms
example1_en: My grandparents have embraced video calls to stay connected.
example1_zh: 我的祖父母欣然接受了用视频通话保持联系的方式。
example2_en: Schools that embrace new technology should also ensure that all students have equal access to digital resources.
example2_zh: 欣然采用新技术的学校也应确保所有学生都能平等获取数字资源。
collocations: embrace change｜欣然接受变化 ; embrace an opportunity｜欣然把握机会 ; a warm embrace｜热情的拥抱
tip_zh: 表示接受时，常接change、idea等抽象名词。

meanings_zh: adv. 此外；而且
definition_en: In addition, introducing another point supporting what was said
example1_en: The flat is spacious; furthermore, it has a balcony.
example1_zh: 这套公寓很宽敞，而且还有一个阳台。
example2_en: Public transport reduces traffic congestion; furthermore, it can make cities more accessible to residents without cars.
example2_zh: 公共交通能缓解交通拥堵，此外还能让没有汽车的居民更方便地在城市中出行。
collocations: furthermore, it is important｜此外，重要的是 ; furthermore, evidence suggests｜此外，证据表明
tip_zh: 正式递进副词；连接完整句时，前面用句号或分号。

meanings_zh: n. 情况介绍；简报会
definition_en: a meeting or explanation giving essential information or instructions
example1_en: Our guide gave us a briefing before the hike.
example1_zh: 徒步出发前，向导向我们简要介绍了注意事项。
example2_en: A clear safety briefing helps construction workers understand potential hazards before they begin unfamiliar tasks.
example2_zh: 清晰的安全说明有助于建筑工人在开始不熟悉的任务前了解潜在危险。
collocations: safety briefing｜安全说明会 ; press briefing｜新闻简报会 ; attend a briefing｜参加简报会 ; briefing paper｜情况简介文件
tip_zh: 不只是书面简报，也常指口头说明或简报会。

meanings_zh: adj. 密集的；浓密的 | adj. 晦涩难懂的 | adj. 愚钝的
definition_en: Containing many things packed closely together | Difficult to understand because information is tightly packed | Slow to understand things
example1_en: Dense fog hid the bridge from our kitchen window.
example1_zh: 浓雾遮住了从我们厨房窗口能看到的那座桥。
example2_en: Dense urban development can reduce travel distances, but it requires careful planning to preserve green spaces.
example2_zh: 高密度城市开发可以缩短出行距离，但需要精心规划以保留绿地。
collocations: dense fog｜浓雾 ; dense forest｜茂密的森林 ; dense population｜密集的人口 ; dense prose｜晦涩的散文
tip_zh: 形容人愚钝时有冒犯意味；密集地用densely。

meanings_zh: adj. 值得拥有的；可取的
definition_en: Worth having or doing because it offers benefits.
example1_en: A balcony makes this small flat much more desirable.
example1_zh: 阳台让这套小公寓更令人向往。
example2_en: Although economic growth is desirable, governments should also consider its effects on public health and the environment.
example2_zh: 虽然经济增长值得追求，但政府也应考虑其对公众健康和环境的影响。
collocations: highly desirable｜非常理想的 ; desirable outcome｜理想的结果 ; desirable qualities｜优秀的品质
tip_zh: desirable指值得拥有；desirous指渴望的。

meanings_zh: adj. 无助的；无力应对的
definition_en: Unable to protect yourself or change a difficult situation
example1_en: I felt helpless when the lift suddenly stopped moving.
example1_zh: 电梯突然停止运行时，我感到很无助。
example2_en: Without accessible support services, elderly people may feel helpless when trying to manage increasingly complex digital systems.
example2_zh: 如果缺乏易于获得的支持服务，老年人在尝试操作日益复杂的数字系统时可能会感到无助。
collocations: feel helpless｜感到无助 ; a helpless victim｜无助的受害者 ; helpless against｜面对……无能为力
tip_zh: helpless是无助的；unhelpful是不肯帮忙或无用的。

meanings_zh: adj. 不可避免的；必然的
definition_en: Certain to happen and impossible to prevent
example1_en: With traffic this heavy, a delay seems inevitable.
example1_zh: 交通这么拥堵，延误似乎不可避免。
example2_en: Some job losses may be inevitable as factories introduce machines that perform routine tasks more efficiently.
example2_zh: 随着工厂引入能更高效完成常规任务的机器，一些岗位流失可能难以避免。
collocations: inevitable consequences｜不可避免的后果 ; inevitable change｜必然的变化 ; almost inevitable｜几乎不可避免的
tip_zh: 常用it is inevitable that…表示“……不可避免”。

meanings_zh: v. 使明亮；变亮 | v. 使高兴；变得愉快
definition_en: To become lighter or make something lighter or more colourful. | To become happier or make someone feel happier.
example1_en: These yellow curtains really brighten our small kitchen.
example1_zh: 这些黄色窗帘确实让我们的小厨房明亮了许多。
example2_en: Planting colourful flowers can brighten neglected public spaces and encourage residents to take greater pride in their neighbourhood.
example2_zh: 种植色彩鲜艳的花卉可以让无人照管的公共空间焕发生机，并增强居民对社区的自豪感。
collocations: brighten a room｜使房间明亮 ; brighten someone's day｜让某人一天心情愉快 ; brighten up｜变明亮；振作起来
tip_zh: 可及物也可不及物；brighten up也指心情好转。

meanings_zh: n. 部落；部族
definition_en: a social group sharing ancestry, traditions, and community ties
example1_en: The guide belongs to a tribe from this valley.
example1_zh: 这位向导属于这个山谷中的一个部族。
example2_en: Development projects should respect the land rights and cultural traditions of local tribes.
example2_zh: 开发项目应尊重当地部族的土地权利和文化传统。
collocations: tribal traditions｜部族传统 ; a nomadic tribe｜游牧部落 ; members of a tribe｜部落成员
tip_zh: 指特定社群时，宜尊重其自称，避免泛称。

meanings_zh: v. 突出；强调 | n. 最精彩或最重要的部分 | v. 用荧光笔标出
definition_en: Draw attention to something important or especially noticeable. | The best or most memorable part of an experience. | Mark words with bright colour to make them noticeable.
example1_en: The boat ride was the highlight of our holiday.
example1_zh: 乘船游览是我们假期中最精彩的部分。
