example2_en: Recent studies highlight the importance of accessible green spaces for the physical and mental health of urban residents.
example2_zh: 近期研究强调，方便到达的绿地对城市居民的身心健康十分重要。
collocations: highlight a problem｜突出一个问题 ; highlight the importance of｜强调……的重要性 ; the highlight of the trip｜旅途中最精彩的部分
tip_zh: 作动词直接接宾语：highlight the problem。

meanings_zh: adj. 大胆的；勇敢的 | adj. 醒目的；鲜明的 | adj. 粗体的
definition_en: Willing to take risks or act with confidence. | Strong and easily noticed in colour, shape, or design. | Printed with thicker, darker lines than ordinary type.
example1_en: She made a bold decision to open her own bakery.
example1_zh: 她大胆决定开一家自己的面包店。
example2_en: Governments need bold policies to address housing shortages while protecting green spaces and supporting affordable development.
example2_zh: 政府需要大胆的政策来解决住房短缺，同时保护绿地并支持可负担住房的开发。
collocations: bold decision｜大胆的决定 ; bold colours｜鲜明的色彩 ; bold type｜粗体字 ; bold approach｜大胆的做法
tip_zh: in bold表示“用粗体”，常用于排版说明。

meanings_zh: n. 可能性；机会 | n. 投注赔率
definition_en: The likelihood that something will happen. | The ratio determining how much a successful bet pays.
example1_en: The odds of finding my keys here are low.
example1_zh: 在这里找到我钥匙的可能性很小。
example2_en: Access to affordable healthcare can improve the odds of recovery for patients with chronic illnesses.
example2_zh: 获得负担得起的医疗服务可以提高慢性病患者康复的可能性。
collocations: the odds of success｜成功的可能性 ; against all odds｜尽管困难重重 ; at odds with｜与……不一致 ; improve the odds｜提高成功机会
tip_zh: odds用复数形式，常接of或that从句。

meanings_zh: n. 合作；协作 | n. 配合；协助
definition_en: the act of working together towards a shared goal | willingness to help or do what someone requests
example1_en: Cleaning the shared kitchen requires cooperation from everyone.
example1_zh: 清洁共用厨房需要大家的配合。
example2_en: International cooperation is essential for addressing environmental problems that extend beyond the borders of individual countries.
example2_zh: 应对跨越单个国家边界的环境问题，国际合作至关重要。
collocations: international cooperation｜国际合作 ; close cooperation｜密切合作 ; in cooperation with｜与……合作 ; full cooperation｜充分配合
tip_zh: 通常不可数；与……合作用in cooperation with。

meanings_zh: n. 小部分；少量 | n. 分数
definition_en: a small part or amount of something | a mathematical quantity representing part of a whole
example1_en: This jacket costs a fraction of the original price.
example1_zh: 这件夹克的售价只是原价的一小部分。
example2_en: Only a small fraction of household waste is recycled in some rapidly growing cities.
example2_zh: 在一些快速发展的城市，只有少量生活垃圾得到回收利用。
collocations: a fraction of｜……的一小部分 ; a small fraction｜很小一部分 ; a fraction of a second｜极短的一瞬 ; simple fraction｜简单分数
tip_zh: a fraction of常强调占比极小，不只是一般部分。

meanings_zh: n. 灵活性；变通能力 | n. 柔韧性
definition_en: the ability to change or adapt to different needs | the ability to bend or stretch easily
example1_en: This job gives me flexibility to collect my daughter.
example1_zh: 这份工作时间灵活，方便我去接女儿。
example2_en: Greater flexibility in working hours can help employees balance professional responsibilities with family commitments.
example2_zh: 更灵活的工作时间能帮助员工平衡工作职责与家庭义务。
collocations: offer flexibility｜提供灵活性 ; greater flexibility｜更大的灵活性 ; improve flexibility｜提高柔韧性 ; flexibility in working hours｜工作时间的灵活性
tip_zh: 既可指安排可变通，也可指身体或材料的柔韧性。

meanings_zh: n. 鞭子 | v. 鞭打；迅速抽动 | v. 搅打（奶油等）
definition_en: A flexible strip attached to a handle, used for striking. | To strike with a whip or move something suddenly. | To beat food quickly to make it light and thick.
example1_en: An old leather whip hung beside the stable door.
example1_zh: 马厩门旁挂着一根旧皮鞭。
example2_en: During practical lessons, culinary students learn to whip cream and prepare healthier alternatives to commercial desserts.
example2_zh: 在实操课上，烹饪专业学生学习打发奶油，并制作比市售甜点更健康的替代品。
collocations: a leather whip｜皮鞭 ; whip cream｜打发奶油 ; whip out｜迅速拿出 ; whip up a meal｜迅速做顿饭
tip_zh: whip cream是打发奶油；双写p加-ed或-ing。

meanings_zh: v. 批评；指责
definition_en: express disapproval of someone or something
example1_en: Please don't criticize my cooking before you taste it.
example1_zh: 请别还没尝就批评我的厨艺。
example2_en: Many residents criticize the council for prioritizing road construction over improvements to public transport.
example2_zh: 许多居民批评地方议会优先修建道路，而非改善公共交通。
collocations: strongly criticize｜强烈批评 ; criticize someone for something｜因某事批评某人 ; widely criticized｜受到广泛批评
tip_zh: criticize sb for sth；英式也常拼作criticise。

meanings_zh: n. 完成；竣工
definition_en: The act or state of finishing something.
example1_en: Our kitchen renovation is finally nearing completion this week.
example1_zh: 我们的厨房翻修这周终于接近完工了。
example2_en: The completion of the new railway is expected to improve access to employment in rural communities.
example2_zh: 新铁路的竣工预计将改善农村居民的就业机会。
collocations: on completion｜完成时 ; near completion｜接近完工 ; successful completion｜顺利完成 ; completion date｜完工日期
tip_zh: 常用on completion of表示“在……完成时”。

meanings_zh: n. 胡说；无意义的话 | n. 愚蠢行为；胡闹
definition_en: words or ideas that are absurd or have no meaning | silly or unacceptable behaviour
example1_en: That story about a flying bicycle is complete nonsense.
example1_zh: 那个关于会飞的自行车的故事完全是胡说。
example2_en: Schools should teach students to distinguish reliable evidence from nonsense circulated through social media platforms.
example2_zh: 学校应教学生区分可靠证据和社交媒体平台上传播的无稽之谈。
collocations: talk nonsense｜胡说八道 ; complete nonsense｜一派胡言 ; a load of nonsense｜一堆废话 ; put up with nonsense｜容忍胡闹
tip_zh: 通常不可数；说一派胡言可用 complete nonsense。

meanings_zh: n. 专门学校；学院 | n. 学会；研究院
definition_en: A school providing training in a particular subject or skill. | An organization promoting scholarship, science, or the arts.
example1_en: She attends a dance academy near the station.
example1_zh: 她在车站附近的一所舞蹈学校上学。
example2_en: A well-funded arts academy can provide talented young people with training they could not otherwise afford.
example2_zh: 一所资金充足的艺术学院可以为有才华的年轻人提供他们原本负担不起的培训。
collocations: a music academy｜音乐学院 ; a military academy｜军事学院 ; an academy of sciences｜科学院
tip_zh: 常指专业培训院校或学术机构，不一定是大学。

meanings_zh: v. 估计；估算 | n. 估计；估价
definition_en: To judge an approximate amount, value, or size. | An approximate calculation of an amount, value, or cost.
example1_en: We estimate the repairs will take about three days.
example1_zh: 我们估计维修大约需要三天。
example2_en: Researchers estimate that improved public transport could significantly reduce the number of cars entering city centres.
example2_zh: 研究人员估计，改善公共交通可显著减少进入市中心的汽车数量。
collocations: estimate the cost｜估算费用 ; a rough estimate｜粗略估计 ; a conservative estimate｜保守估计 ; be estimated at｜估计为
tip_zh: 动词末尾读/eɪt/；名词末尾读/ət/。

meanings_zh: n. 评论家；评论员 | n. 批评者；反对者
definition_en: Someone who judges and discusses artistic works professionally. | Someone who expresses disapproval of a person, policy, or idea.
example1_en: The film critic praised the young actor's performance.
example1_zh: 那位影评人赞扬了年轻演员的表演。
example2_en: Critics of urban expansion argue that new developments often destroy valuable habitats and increase car dependence.
example2_zh: 城市扩张的批评者认为，新开发项目往往破坏宝贵的栖息地，并增加人们对汽车的依赖。
collocations: film critic｜影评人 ; literary critic｜文学评论家 ; an outspoken critic｜直言不讳的批评者
tip_zh: critic指人，criticism指批评或评论。

meanings_zh: adj. 显著的；值得注意的 | n. 名人；要人
definition_en: important or unusual enough to deserve attention | a famous or important person, especially in a particular community
example1_en: Her balcony is notable for its bright yellow flowers.
example1_zh: 她家的阳台因鲜艳的黄色花朵而引人注目。
example2_en: The city has achieved a notable reduction in air pollution since introducing stricter vehicle standards.
example2_zh: 自实施更严格的车辆标准以来，该市的空气污染已显著减少。
collocations: a notable achievement｜显著成就 ; a notable exception｜值得注意的例外 ; notable for｜以……而引人注目
tip_zh: notable for表示因……而出名或引人注意。

meanings_zh: n. 硫；硫磺
definition_en: a yellow chemical element used in industry and agriculture
example1_en: The guide showed us yellow sulphur near the volcano.
example1_zh: 导游给我们看了火山附近黄色的硫磺。
example2_en: Burning fuels containing sulphur releases gases that contribute to acid rain and damage natural ecosystems.
example2_zh: 燃烧含硫燃料会释放促成酸雨的气体，破坏自然生态系统。
collocations: sulphur dioxide｜二氧化硫 ; sulphur content｜含硫量 ; sulphur deposits｜硫磺矿床
tip_zh: sulphur是传统英式拼写；科学文献常用sulfur。

meanings_zh: v. 承担；着手进行 | v. 承诺；答应
definition_en: Accept responsibility for a task and begin doing it | Promise to do something
example1_en: We undertook the repairs ourselves to save money.
example1_zh: 我们自己动手维修，以节省开支。
example2_en: Universities should undertake further research before recommending major changes to national education policy.
example2_zh: 大学应在建议对国家教育政策作重大调整之前开展进一步研究。
collocations: undertake research｜开展研究 ; undertake a task｜承担任务 ; undertake to do something｜承诺做某事
tip_zh: 过去式undertook，过去分词undertaken。

meanings_zh: v. 孵化；孵出 | n. 舱口；小开口 | v. 秘密策划
definition_en: to emerge from an egg, or cause this to happen | an opening in a floor, ceiling, or wall | to develop a plan, often secretly
example1_en: We watched three chicks hatch on the farm yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天我们在农场看着三只小鸡破壳而出。
example2_en: Rising temperatures can affect when turtle eggs hatch, potentially reducing the survival chances of young turtles.
example2_zh: 气温上升会影响海龟卵的孵化时间，可能降低幼龟的存活机会。
collocations: hatch an egg｜孵蛋 ; hatch a plan｜秘密策划 ; escape hatch｜逃生舱口
tip_zh: 表示孵化用动词；名词常指舱口或小开口。

meanings_zh: n. 酸橙；青柠 | n. 石灰 | n. 黄绿色；青柠绿
definition_en: A small citrus fruit with green skin and sour juice. | A white calcium compound used in building and soil treatment. | A bright, pale colour between green and yellow.
example1_en: She squeezed a lime over the warm rice.
example1_zh: 她往热米饭上挤了些青柠汁。
example2_en: Farmers may apply lime to acidic soils to improve growing conditions and increase crop productivity.
example2_zh: 农民可以向酸性土壤施用石灰，以改善生长条件并提高作物产量。
collocations: lime juice｜青柠汁 ; a slice of lime｜一片青柠 ; agricultural lime｜农用石灰 ; lime green｜青柠绿
tip_zh: 水果义可数，石灰义不可数；lemon是柠檬。

meanings_zh: adv. 在海外；到国外 | adj. 海外的；国外的
definition_en: in or to a foreign country | located in, coming from, or relating to foreign countries
example1_en: My cousin moved overseas and calls us every weekend.
example1_zh: 我表亲搬到了国外，每个周末都给我们打电话。
example2_en: Studying overseas can broaden students' perspectives, although adapting to a different culture often takes time.
example2_zh: 出国留学能拓宽学生的视野，不过适应不同文化往往需要时间。
collocations: study overseas｜出国留学 ; work overseas｜在海外工作 ; overseas markets｜海外市场 ; overseas students｜海外留学生
tip_zh: 作副词前不加to：go overseas；也可修饰名词。

meanings_zh: v. 移民入境；移居
definition_en: To move to another country to live there permanently.
example1_en: Her grandparents immigrated to Canada and opened a bakery.
example1_zh: 她的祖父母移居加拿大，开了一家面包店。
example2_en: People who immigrate often contribute valuable skills to their host countries while adapting to unfamiliar social customs.
example2_zh: 移民在适应陌生社会习俗的同时，往往也为移入国贡献宝贵的技能。
collocations: immigrate to a country｜移居某国 ; immigrate from abroad｜从国外移入
tip_zh: immigrate to强调移入；emigrate from强调移出。

meanings_zh: v. 吠叫 | n. 狗叫声 | n. 树皮
definition_en: to make the short, loud sound of a dog | a short, loud sound made by a dog | the outer protective layer of a tree trunk or branch
example1_en: Our dog barks whenever someone knocks on the door.
example1_zh: 每当有人敲门，我们的狗就会叫。
example2_en: The bark of mature trees provides shelter for insects and helps protect the trunk from damage.
example2_zh: 成年树木的树皮为昆虫提供庇护，也有助于保护树干免受损伤。
collocations: bark at someone｜冲某人吠叫 ; a loud bark｜一声响亮的狗叫 ; tree bark｜树皮
tip_zh: 狗叫声可数；树皮通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 森林砍伐；毁林
definition_en: The clearing of forests by cutting down trees.
example1_en: Deforestation has left the hillside bare and dusty.
example1_zh: 森林砍伐使山坡变得光秃秃、尘土飞扬。
example2_en: Reducing deforestation can protect wildlife habitats and help limit the effects of climate change.
example2_zh: 减少森林砍伐可以保护野生动物栖息地，并有助于减轻气候变化的影响。
collocations: prevent deforestation｜防止毁林 ; widespread deforestation｜大规模毁林 ; tropical deforestation｜热带森林砍伐
tip_zh: 不可数名词；常用于栖息地丧失和气候变化话题。

meanings_zh: n. 服务员；工作人员 | adj. 伴随的；随之而来的
definition_en: Someone employed to help people in a public place. | Occurring together with something, often as a consequence.
example1_en: The flight attendant brought an extra blanket for my daughter.
example1_zh: 乘务员给我女儿又拿来了一条毯子。
example2_en: Cities must consider population growth and its attendant pressures when planning new public transport networks.
example2_zh: 城市在规划新的公共交通网络时，必须考虑人口增长及其带来的压力。
collocations: flight attendant｜航空乘务员 ; car park attendant｜停车场管理员 ; attendant risks｜随之而来的风险
tip_zh: attendant常指服务人员；参会者通常用attendee。

meanings_zh: n. 悲伤；悲痛
definition_en: deep sadness caused by loss or disappointment
example1_en: She felt deep sorrow when her closest friend moved away.
example1_zh: 最亲密的朋友搬走时，她感到深深的悲伤。
example2_en: Community support can help people cope with sorrow after the loss of a loved one.
example2_zh: 社区支持可以帮助人们应对失去亲人后的悲痛。
collocations: deep sorrow｜深切的悲痛 ; express sorrow｜表达悲伤 ; in sorrow｜悲伤地
tip_zh: 表示悲伤情绪通常不可数；具体伤心事可数。

meanings_zh: n. 短途旅行；远足
definition_en: A short journey made for pleasure, often with a group.
example1_en: We packed sandwiches for our excursion to the lake.
example1_zh: 我们为去湖边的短途旅行准备了三明治。
example2_en: School excursions to nature reserves can deepen students' understanding of local wildlife and conservation.
example2_zh: 学校组织的自然保护区游览能加深学生对当地野生生物及其保护的理解。
collocations: go on an excursion｜去短途旅行 ; a day excursion｜一日游 ; a school excursion｜学校组织的游览
tip_zh: 常指集体休闲短途旅行，搭配go on。

meanings_zh: v. 禁用；使停止运作 | v. 使伤残；使丧失能力
definition_en: to prevent a device or feature from working | to cause a condition that limits someone's activities
example1_en: I disabled notifications so my phone stayed quiet during dinner.
example1_zh: 我关闭了通知，让手机在吃晚饭时保持安静。
example2_en: Users should be able to disable location tracking without losing access to essential digital services.
example2_zh: 用户应当能够禁用位置追踪，而不失去使用基本数字服务的权限。
collocations: disable notifications｜禁用通知 ; disable an alarm｜关闭警报器 ; disable location tracking｜禁用位置追踪
tip_zh: 技术语境常指“禁用”，不表示删除或损坏。

meanings_zh: v. 回想起；记得 | v. 召回；收回 | n. 记忆力；产品召回
definition_en: to remember something from the past | to order someone back or request the return of products | the ability to remember, or an official request for returns
example1_en: I still recall the smell of my grandmother's kitchen.
example1_zh: 我仍然记得祖母厨房里的气味。
example2_en: Manufacturers should recall faulty products promptly to protect consumers and maintain public trust in safety standards.
example2_zh: 制造商应及时召回有缺陷的产品，以保护消费者并维持公众对安全标准的信任。
collocations: recall a detail｜回想起一个细节 ; recall doing something｜记得做过某事 ; product recall｜产品召回 ; total recall｜完整的记忆能力
tip_zh: 表示记得做过某事用 recall doing，不用 to do。

meanings_zh: adj. 壮丽的；宏伟的 | adj. 极出色的
definition_en: Extremely beautiful, grand, or impressive. | Exceptionally good or skilfully done.
example1_en: The balcony offers a magnificent view of snowy mountains.
example1_zh: 从阳台可以欣赏到壮丽的雪山景色。
example2_en: Preserving magnificent historic buildings can strengthen local identity and attract visitors from other regions.
example2_zh: 保护宏伟的历史建筑能增强当地认同感，并吸引其他地区的游客。
collocations: magnificent scenery｜壮丽的景色 ; a magnificent building｜宏伟的建筑 ; a magnificent achievement｜卓越的成就
tip_zh: 多形容景色、建筑或成就，不表示品德高尚。

meanings_zh: n. 感激；感谢 | n. 欣赏；理解 | n. 升值；增值
definition_en: A feeling of gratitude for someone's help or kindness. | Recognition and understanding of something's value, quality, or importance. | An increase in the financial value of something.
example1_en: We baked our neighbour a cake to show our appreciation.
example1_zh: 我们为邻居烤了一个蛋糕，以表达感谢。
example2_en: Arts education can develop students' appreciation of cultural traditions that differ from their own.
example2_zh: 艺术教育能培养学生对不同于自身文化的传统的欣赏能力。
collocations: show appreciation｜表达感激 ; in appreciation of｜为感谢 ; an appreciation of art｜对艺术的欣赏 ; currency appreciation｜货币升值
tip_zh: 通常不可数；an appreciation of可指对某事的理解。

meanings_zh: n. 负担；重担 | v. 使负担；使烦恼
definition_en: a heavy load, difficult duty, or source of worry | to give someone a heavy responsibility or worry
example1_en: Sharing the housework eased the burden on my father.
example1_zh: 分担家务减轻了父亲的负担。
example2_en: Affordable childcare can reduce the financial burden on families and help parents return to work.
example2_zh: 价格可负担的托育服务可以减轻家庭的经济负担，帮助父母重返职场。
collocations: financial burden｜经济负担 ; ease the burden｜减轻负担 ; bear the burden｜承担重担 ; be burdened with debt｜背负债务
tip_zh: 负担落在某人身上用a burden on someone。

meanings_zh: adv. 足够地；充分地
definition_en: to the degree needed for a particular purpose
example1_en: The soup had cooled sufficiently for us to eat.
example1_zh: 汤已经凉到我们可以喝的程度了。
example2_en: Public transport must be sufficiently reliable to persuade commuters to leave their cars at home.
example2_zh: 公共交通必须足够可靠，才能说服通勤者不开私家车出行。
collocations: sufficiently clear｜足够清楚 ; sufficiently prepared｜准备充分 ; sufficiently large｜足够大
tip_zh: 修饰形容词时放在其前；enough则放在其后。

meanings_zh: v. 振动；使振动
definition_en: To shake rapidly with small movements, or cause this movement.
example1_en: My phone vibrated against the keys in my pocket.
example1_zh: 手机在口袋里振动，碰得钥匙直响。
example2_en: Heavy traffic can cause nearby buildings to vibrate, affecting residents' comfort and potentially damaging older structures.
example2_zh: 繁忙的交通会使附近建筑物振动，影响居民的舒适度，并可能损坏老旧建筑。
collocations: vibrate gently｜轻轻振动 ; vibrate rapidly｜快速振动 ; vibrate mode｜振动模式
tip_zh: 指快速、小幅度振动，不等于大幅摇摆。

meanings_zh: n. 扁桃仁；扁桃树
definition_en: an edible oval nut, or the tree that produces it
example1_en: She sprinkled chopped almonds over her bowl of porridge.
example1_zh: 她在那碗燕麦粥上撒了些切碎的扁桃仁。
example2_en: Almond production requires substantial irrigation in some regions, raising concerns about the sustainability of local water supplies.
example2_zh: 一些地区的扁桃种植需要大量灌溉，引发了对当地供水可持续性的担忧。
collocations: roasted almonds｜烤扁桃仁 ; almond milk｜扁桃仁奶 ; ground almonds｜扁桃仁粉 ; almond blossom｜扁桃花
tip_zh: 通常指扁桃仁（巴旦木），并非杏核中的杏仁。

meanings_zh: n. 男孩；小伙子
definition_en: A boy or young man, especially in informal British English.
example1_en: A friendly lad helped us carry the bags.
example1_zh: 一个友善的小伙子帮我们提了袋子。
example2_en: As a young lad, the novelist experienced rural poverty, which later became a central theme in his work.
example2_zh: 这位小说家年少时经历过乡村贫困，这后来成为他作品的核心主题。
collocations: a young lad｜小伙子 ; a local lad｜本地小伙子 ; a teenage lad｜十几岁的男孩
tip_zh: 偏英式口语；正式写作宜用boy或young man。

meanings_zh: n. 疾病；身心失调 | n. 混乱；杂乱 | n. 骚乱
definition_en: a condition that disrupts normal physical or mental functioning | a state in which things are not properly arranged | uncontrolled public behaviour that disturbs peace or safety
example1_en: A sleep disorder kept him awake most nights.
example1_zh: 睡眠障碍让他大多数夜晚都无法入睡。
example2_en: Early treatment of anxiety disorders can improve students' wellbeing and help them participate more fully in education.
example2_zh: 尽早治疗焦虑障碍能改善学生的身心状态，帮助他们更充分地参与学习。
collocations: sleep disorder｜睡眠障碍 ; eating disorder｜进食障碍 ; in disorder｜杂乱无章 ; public disorder｜公共秩序混乱
tip_zh: 疾病义可数；杂乱或骚乱义通常不可数。

meanings_zh: v. 迁徙；移居 | v. 迁移数据或系统
definition_en: to move to another region, seasonally or to live there | to move data or software to a different computer system
example1_en: These birds migrate south when the weather turns cold.
example1_zh: 天气转冷时，这些鸟会向南迁徙。
example2_en: Many young adults migrate to urban areas because employment opportunities are often limited in rural communities.
example2_zh: 许多年轻人迁居城市，因为农村地区的就业机会往往有限。
collocations: migrate south｜向南迁徙 ; migrate to cities｜迁居城市 ; migrate data｜迁移数据
tip_zh: migrate强调迁移；immigrate移入，emigrate移出。

meanings_zh: adj. 社会主义的 | n. 社会主义者
definition_en: relating to collective ownership and more equal distribution of wealth | someone who supports socialism
example1_en: Our reading group discussed socialist ideas over tea.
example1_zh: 我们读书小组边喝茶边讨论社会主义思想。
example2_en: Socialist policies often seek to reduce economic inequality through public ownership and the redistribution of wealth.
example2_zh: 社会主义政策通常力图通过公有制和财富再分配来减少经济不平等。
collocations: socialist policies｜社会主义政策 ; socialist movement｜社会主义运动 ; socialist economy｜社会主义经济
tip_zh: socialist指社会主义的；social仅指社会的或社交的。

meanings_zh: n. 龙虾；龙虾肉
definition_en: A large sea animal with a hard shell and claws.
example1_en: We watched a lobster crawl across the rocky seabed.
example1_zh: 我们看着一只龙虾爬过多石的海床。
example2_en: Restrictions on lobster fishing can protect marine ecosystems while supporting the long-term livelihoods of coastal communities.
example2_zh: 限制龙虾捕捞既能保护海洋生态系统，也能保障沿海社区的长远生计。
collocations: lobster fishing｜龙虾捕捞 ; lobster tail｜龙虾尾 ; lobster pot｜捕龙虾笼
tip_zh: 指动物时可数；指作为食物的虾肉时不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 行业；部门；领域 | n. 区域；地段 | n. 扇形
definition_en: A particular part of an economy or area of activity. | A particular section of a larger area. | A circle's part enclosed by two radii and an arc.
example1_en: My sister works in the banking sector now.
example1_zh: 我姐姐现在在银行业工作。
example2_en: Investment in the renewable energy sector can create jobs while reducing dependence on imported fossil fuels.
example2_zh: 投资可再生能源行业可以创造就业，同时减少对进口化石燃料的依赖。
collocations: the public sector｜公共部门 ; the private sector｜私营部门 ; the manufacturing sector｜制造业 ; the service sector｜服务业
tip_zh: sector常指经济中的某个行业，不一定是公司部门。

meanings_zh: n. 埋葬；葬礼
definition_en: the act or ceremony of placing a dead body underground
example1_en: The family gathered quietly for the burial yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天，一家人静静地聚在一起参加葬礼。
example2_en: Ancient burial sites provide valuable evidence about the beliefs and social structures of past communities.
example2_zh: 古代墓葬遗址为了解过去社会的信仰和社会结构提供了宝贵证据。
collocations: burial site｜墓葬遗址 ; burial ground｜墓地 ; burial customs｜丧葬习俗
tip_zh: burial重在入土安葬；funeral泛指葬礼仪式。

meanings_zh: n. 温暖；暖和 | n. 热情；亲切
definition_en: A comfortable level of heat. | Friendly affection shown in someone's behaviour or manner.
example1_en: We enjoyed the warmth of the fire after our walk.
example1_zh: 散步回来后，我们享受着炉火的温暖。
example2_en: The warmth of community relationships can help older residents feel supported and reduce their sense of isolation.
example2_zh: 社区人际关系中的温情能让老年居民感受到支持，减少他们的孤独感。
collocations: for warmth｜为了取暖 ; the warmth of the sun｜阳光的温暖 ; human warmth｜人情温暖 ; warmth and kindness｜热情与友善
tip_zh: 通常不可数；既指温度舒适，也指待人亲切。

meanings_zh: n. 瓦特（功率单位）
definition_en: a unit used to measure power
example1_en: This small lamp uses only five watts of power.
example1_zh: 这盏小灯的功率只有五瓦。
example2_en: Comparing the watts required by different appliances helps consumers choose models that use less electricity.
example2_zh: 比较不同电器所需的瓦数，有助于消费者选择更省电的型号。
collocations: power in watts｜以瓦特表示的功率 ; a ten-watt bulb｜十瓦灯泡 ; rated at fifty watts｜额定功率为五十瓦
tip_zh: 瓦特衡量功率；千瓦时衡量用电量。

meanings_zh: adj. 受限制的；有限的 | adj. 仅限特定人员使用的
definition_en: limited in amount, range, or freedom | available or open only to people with permission
example1_en: Parking is restricted here during the busy morning hours.
example1_zh: 早晨繁忙时段，这里限制停车。
example2_en: Restricted access to affordable healthcare can worsen existing inequalities between wealthy communities and disadvantaged rural populations.
example2_zh: 获得平价医疗服务的机会受限，会加剧富裕社区与弱势农村人口之间已有的不平等。
collocations: restricted access｜受限的使用权限 ; a restricted area｜限制进入的区域 ; restricted movement｜受限的活动 ; restricted to members｜仅限会员
tip_zh: restricted to表示“仅限于”；也是restrict过去分词。

meanings_zh: n. 分心的事物；干扰 | n. 分心；注意力分散 | n. 消遣；解闷的活动
definition_en: Something that takes your attention away from your main activity | The state of being unable to give something full attention | An activity that helps you forget worries or boredom
example1_en: The television is a distraction when I do homework.
example1_zh: 我做作业时，电视会让我分心。
example2_en: Reducing digital distractions in classrooms may help students concentrate and engage more deeply with challenging material.
example2_zh: 减少课堂上的数字设备干扰，可能有助于学生集中注意力，更深入地学习有难度的内容。
collocations: avoid distractions｜避免干扰 ; a welcome distraction｜令人愉快的消遣 ; a major distraction｜严重干扰
tip_zh: 具体干扰物可数；表示分心状态时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 调整；改动 | n. 适应
definition_en: A small change made to improve something. | The process of becoming comfortable with a new situation.
example1_en: A small adjustment to the seat made cycling easier.
example1_zh: 稍微调整座椅后，骑车变得更轻松了。
example2_en: Moving to a new country often requires considerable adjustment to unfamiliar social customs and daily routines.
example2_zh: 移居国外往往需要花不少功夫适应陌生的社会习俗和日常生活方式。
collocations: make an adjustment｜作出调整 ; minor adjustment｜小幅调整 ; adjustment period｜适应期
tip_zh: 表示改动或适应时，常用 adjustment to。

meanings_zh: n. 抢劫；抢劫案
definition_en: Stealing from a person or place using force or threats.
example1_en: The shop closed early after a robbery yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天发生抢劫后，这家商店提前关门了。
example2_en: Better street lighting may reduce the risk of robbery and help residents feel safer after dark.
example2_zh: 改善街道照明可能降低抢劫风险，让居民在天黑后更有安全感。
collocations: commit a robbery｜实施抢劫 ; armed robbery｜持械抢劫 ; bank robbery｜银行抢劫案 ; attempted robbery｜抢劫未遂
tip_zh: robbery涉及暴力或威胁；theft泛指盗窃。

meanings_zh: n. 礁；暗礁
definition_en: A ridge of rock or coral near the sea's surface.
example1_en: We watched colourful fish swimming around the coral reef.
example1_zh: 我们看着色彩斑斓的鱼在珊瑚礁周围游动。
example2_en: Protecting coral reefs is essential because they support marine biodiversity and help shield coastlines from powerful waves.
example2_zh: 保护珊瑚礁至关重要，因为它们维持海洋生物多样性，并帮助海岸抵御强浪。
collocations: coral reef｜珊瑚礁 ; barrier reef｜堡礁 ; reef ecosystem｜珊瑚礁生态系统
tip_zh: reef指接近海面的礁体，不是海边的悬崖cliff。

meanings_zh: v. 咯咯地笑 | n. 咯咯的笑声
definition_en: laugh in a light, often nervous or silly way | a light laugh caused by amusement or nervousness
example1_en: The children giggled when the puppy chased its tail.
example1_zh: 小狗追着自己的尾巴转，孩子们咯咯地笑了起来。
example2_en: Young learners may giggle during unfamiliar activities, but this reaction does not necessarily indicate a lack of interest.
example2_zh: 年幼的学习者进行不熟悉的活动时可能会咯咯笑，但这种反应不一定表明他们缺乏兴趣。
collocations: giggle at a joke｜听到笑话咯咯笑 ; nervous giggle｜紧张的咯咯笑声 ; suppress a giggle｜忍住笑
tip_zh: 强调轻轻咯咯笑，可因好玩或紧张；笑某事用at。

meanings_zh: n. 争端；争执 | v. 质疑；对……提出异议 | v. 争论；争夺
definition_en: a serious disagreement between people or groups | to question whether something is true or correct | to argue about something or compete to control it
example1_en: Our neighbours settled their dispute over the garden fence.
example1_zh: 邻居们解决了他们关于花园围栏的争执。
example2_en: Independent experts dispute the claim that building more roads will permanently reduce traffic congestion.
example2_zh: 独立专家质疑修建更多道路能永久缓解交通拥堵这一说法。
collocations: settle a dispute｜解决争端 ; a dispute over pay｜薪酬争议 ; dispute a claim｜质疑某项说法 ; in dispute｜存在争议
tip_zh: dispute a claim是质疑说法，不是讨论说法。

meanings_zh: n. 困惑；不明白 | n. 混淆；混乱
definition_en: A state of not understanding something clearly | A situation where things are mixed up or poorly organised
example1_en: He stared at the unfamiliar controls in confusion.
example1_zh: 他困惑地盯着那些陌生的控制装置。
example2_en: Clear instructions can reduce confusion among patients and help them take their medication safely.
example2_zh: 清晰的说明能减少患者的困惑，帮助他们安全服药。
collocations: cause confusion｜引起困惑 ; avoid confusion｜避免混淆 ; clear up confusion｜消除困惑 ; confusion over｜对……的困惑
tip_zh: 人感到困惑用confused；事物令人困惑用confusing。

meanings_zh: adv. 轻轻地；轻柔地 | adv. 少量地；轻微地 | adv. 轻率地；不严肃地
definition_en: With little force, pressure, or weight. | To a small degree or in a small amount. | Without treating something as serious or important.
example1_en: He tapped lightly on the door before coming inside.
example1_zh: 他轻轻敲了敲门才进来。
example2_en: Decisions about closing rural schools should not be taken lightly, as they can affect entire communities.
example2_zh: 关闭乡村学校的决定不应轻率作出，因为这可能影响整个社区。
collocations: tap lightly｜轻轻敲击 ; lightly salted｜加少量盐的 ; take something lightly｜轻视某事 ; lightly armed｜配备轻武器的
tip_zh: take something lightly意为不认真对待某事。

meanings_zh: adj. 安全的；稳固的 | v. 获得；争取到 | v. 固定；使安全
definition_en: Protected from danger, or firmly fixed in place. | To successfully obtain something important. | To fasten something firmly or protect it from harm.
example1_en: Check that the ladder is secure before climbing up.
example1_zh: 爬上去之前，检查梯子是否稳固。
example2_en: Governments should ensure that citizens have secure access to clean water during periods of drought.
example2_zh: 政府应确保公民在干旱期间能可靠地获得清洁用水。
collocations: secure a job｜获得一份工作 ; secure funding｜争取到资金 ; feel secure｜感到安全 ; secure firmly｜牢牢固定
tip_zh: secure可作形容词，也可作及物动词表示争取到。

meanings_zh: adj. 工业的；产业的
definition_en: Relating to factories and the production of goods.
example1_en: My uncle repairs industrial machines at a nearby factory.
example1_zh: 我叔叔在附近的一家工厂维修工业机器。
example2_en: Stricter controls on industrial waste can protect rivers and improve the health of nearby communities.
example2_zh: 加强对工业废物的管控可以保护河流，并改善附近社区居民的健康。
collocations: industrial production｜工业生产 ; industrial waste｜工业废物 ; industrial area｜工业区 ; industrial development｜工业发展
tip_zh: industrial指工业的；industrious才指勤劳的。

meanings_zh: n. 程序；手续；步骤 | n. 医疗操作；手术
definition_en: an established series of actions for completing a task | a medical action performed to diagnose or treat a condition
example1_en: The receptionist explained the procedure for joining the gym.
example1_zh: 接待员说明了办理健身房会员的手续。
example2_en: Every laboratory should establish a clear procedure for handling chemicals safely and disposing of waste responsibly.
example2_zh: 每个实验室都应制定明确规程，以安全处理化学品并妥善处置废物。
collocations: follow a procedure｜遵循程序 ; standard procedure｜标准程序 ; a surgical procedure｜外科手术
tip_zh: procedure 强调规定步骤；process 更侧重整个过程。

meanings_zh: v. 应付；妥善处理
definition_en: To manage a difficult situation successfully.
example1_en: I cope with busy mornings by preparing breakfast ahead.
example1_zh: 我会提前准备早餐，来应付忙碌的早晨。
example2_en: Schools should teach practical strategies that help students cope with examination stress and maintain their mental wellbeing.
example2_zh: 学校应教授实用方法，帮助学生应对考试压力并保持心理健康。
collocations: cope with stress｜应对压力 ; cope with change｜应对变化 ; cope well｜应付得当
tip_zh: cope是不及物动词，接困难或压力时用with。

meanings_zh: n. 建议 | n. 推荐；推荐信
definition_en: advice about the best thing to do | a statement supporting someone's or something's suitability or quality
example1_en: On your recommendation, I started taking short evening walks.
example1_zh: 听了你的建议，我开始在傍晚散一小会儿步。
example2_en: The committee's main recommendation was to improve public transport before introducing higher parking charges in the city centre.
example2_zh: 委员会的主要建议是先改善公共交通，再提高市中心的停车费。
collocations: make a recommendation｜提出建议 ; follow a recommendation｜采纳建议 ; on someone's recommendation｜经某人推荐 ; letter of recommendation｜推荐信
tip_zh: recommendation后的that从句常用should或动词原形。

meanings_zh: n. 聪明；机灵；巧妙
definition_en: the ability to understand quickly or find effective, inventive solutions
example1_en: Her cleverness helped us fix the tent before sunset.
example1_zh: 她的机智让我们在日落前修好了帐篷。
example2_en: The cleverness of a design lies in solving practical problems without introducing unnecessary complexity.
example2_zh: 设计的巧妙之处在于解决实际问题，而不增加不必要的复杂性。
collocations: remarkable cleverness｜非凡的才智 ; the cleverness of a design｜设计的巧妙 ; show cleverness｜表现出机智
tip_zh: 不可数名词；既可指人的聪明，也可指设计巧妙。

meanings_zh: n. 装备；用具 | n. 齿轮；挡位 | v. 使适合；使面向
definition_en: equipment or clothing needed for a particular activity | a toothed wheel, or a setting controlling vehicle speed | to design or organise something for a particular purpose
example1_en: We packed our camping gear into the car.
example1_zh: 我们把露营装备装进了车里。
example2_en: Schools should gear their career guidance towards the changing needs of students and the wider labour market.
example2_zh: 学校应使就业指导适应学生及整个劳动力市场不断变化的需求。
collocations: camping gear｜露营装备 ; protective gear｜防护装备 ; change gear｜换挡 ; be geared towards｜以……为导向
tip_zh: 表示装备时不可数；表示挡位或单个齿轮时可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 连续不断的
definition_en: Continuing without a break or interruption.
example1_en: Continuous rain kept us indoors for the whole weekend.
example1_zh: 雨一直下，整个周末我们都待在室内。
example2_en: Continuous monitoring of air quality helps local authorities identify pollution sources and protect public health.
example2_zh: 持续监测空气质量有助于地方政府发现污染源并保护公众健康。
collocations: continuous improvement｜持续改进 ; continuous monitoring｜持续监测 ; continuous flow｜连续流动
tip_zh: continuous强调不中断；continual常指反复发生。

meanings_zh: n. 缠结的一团 | v. 使缠结；缠在一起 | n. 混乱复杂的局面
definition_en: A twisted mass of threads, hair, or similar things | Become twisted together, or make things twist together | A confused situation that is difficult to resolve
example1_en: My headphones were buried in a tangle of cables.
example1_zh: 我的耳机埋在一团缠结的线缆里。
example2_en: Small businesses often face a tangle of regulations that makes expansion costly and time-consuming.
example2_zh: 小企业常面临错综复杂的法规，使业务扩张既费钱又费时。
collocations: a tangle of wires｜缠成一团的电线 ; get tangled｜缠在一起 ; a tangle of regulations｜错综复杂的法规
tip_zh: a tangle of既可指实物缠结，也可指复杂困局。

meanings_zh: v. 追查；追溯 | n. 痕迹；微量 | v. 描摹；沿轮廓描画
definition_en: find something's origin or location by following evidence | a small sign, mark, or amount left behind | copy a picture by drawing over its lines
example1_en: The plumber traced the leak to a cracked pipe.
example1_zh: 水管工查出漏水源于一根开裂的管道。
example2_en: Researchers can trace changes in regional diets by examining food remains discovered at ancient settlements.
example2_zh: 研究人员可以通过检验古代聚落遗址中发现的食物残留，追溯区域饮食的变化。
collocations: trace the source｜追查来源 ; trace back to｜追溯到 ; without a trace｜不留痕迹 ; traces of｜微量的；……的痕迹
tip_zh: trace A back to B表示“追溯A至B”。

meanings_zh: v. 找到；确定位置 | v. 设于；把…安置在
definition_en: To find the exact position of someone or something. | To place something or establish a business somewhere.
example1_en: We finally located the missing keys behind the sofa.
example1_zh: 我们终于在沙发后面找到了丢失的钥匙。
example2_en: Local authorities should locate new health centres near public transport routes to improve access for elderly residents.
example2_zh: 地方政府应将新的医疗中心设在公共交通线路附近，以方便老年居民就医。
collocations: locate a fault｜查明故障位置 ; locate the source｜找到源头 ; be located in｜位于 ; centrally located｜位于中心位置的
tip_zh: 表示“位于”常用be located in/near，不直接用locate。

meanings_zh: n. 碳水化合物
definition_en: A substance such as sugar or starch that provides energy.
example1_en: Rice provides carbohydrate, which gives you energy for daily activities.
example1_zh: 米饭提供碳水化合物，为日常活动供给能量。
example2_en: Although carbohydrates are an important energy source, public health guidance should distinguish wholegrain foods from products containing added sugars.
example2_zh: 虽然碳水化合物是重要的能量来源，但公共健康指南应区分全谷物食品和含添加糖的产品。
collocations: complex carbohydrates｜复合碳水化合物 ; carbohydrate intake｜碳水化合物摄入量 ; low-carbohydrate diet｜低碳水化合物饮食
tip_zh: 泛指营养成分可不可数；谈种类或总称常用复数。

meanings_zh: adj. 熟练的；有技能的 | adj. 需要专门技能的
definition_en: Having the training and ability to do something well. | Requiring special training or practical ability.
example1_en: A skilled mechanic fixed my bicycle in minutes.
example1_zh: 一位技术熟练的修车师傅几分钟就修好了我的自行车。
example2_en: Investment in vocational education can help countries develop a skilled workforce and reduce unemployment.
example2_zh: 投资职业教育可以帮助各国培养技术熟练的劳动力，并降低失业率。
collocations: skilled worker｜技术工人 ; highly skilled｜技艺高超的 ; skilled at｜擅长 ; skilled labour｜技术劳动力
tip_zh: skilled at/in后接名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: n. 纱；纱线 | n. 奇谈；夸张的故事
definition_en: Thread used for knitting or weaving cloth. | An entertaining story, often exaggerated or invented.
example1_en: She chose soft blue yarn for the baby's blanket.
example1_zh: 她挑了柔软的蓝色毛线来织婴儿毯。
example2_en: Using yarn made from recycled materials can reduce waste in the textile industry.
example2_zh: 使用再生材料制成的纱线可以减少纺织业的废弃物。
collocations: a ball of yarn｜一团毛线 ; woollen yarn｜毛纱 ; spin a yarn｜讲奇闻故事
tip_zh: 作“纱线”通常不可数；作“故事”可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 稀缺的；不足的
definition_en: not available in large enough amounts to meet demand
example1_en: Fresh vegetables became scarce after snow blocked the roads.
example1_zh: 大雪封路后，新鲜蔬菜变得紧缺。
example2_en: As clean water becomes increasingly scarce, governments must invest in efficient irrigation and better water management systems.
example2_zh: 随着清洁水源日益短缺，政府必须投资于高效灌溉和更完善的水资源管理系统。
collocations: scarce resources｜稀缺资源 ; become scarce｜变得紧缺 ; increasingly scarce｜日益稀缺
tip_zh: scarce指供应不足；rare强调少见，不一定短缺。

meanings_zh: v. 鼓掌；喝彩 | v. 称赞；赞许
definition_en: Clap your hands to show enjoyment or approval. | Express strong approval of someone or something.
example1_en: Everyone applauded when the young dancer finished her performance.
example1_zh: 年轻舞者表演结束时，所有人都鼓起了掌。
example2_en: Environmental groups applauded the council's decision to protect urban wetlands from further commercial development.
example2_zh: 环保团体赞许市政委员会保护城市湿地、避免其受到进一步商业开发影响的决定。
collocations: applaud a performance｜为表演鼓掌 ; applaud a decision｜赞许决定 ; applaud someone's efforts｜称赞某人的努力
tip_zh: 可直接接人或事；applause是不可数名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 忙乱的；忙碌紧张的
definition_en: extremely busy and full of activity, often causing stress
example1_en: After a hectic morning, I finally sat down for lunch.
example1_zh: 忙乱了一上午后，我终于坐下来吃午饭。
example2_en: A hectic urban lifestyle can leave residents with little time for exercise, relaxation, or meaningful social interaction.
example2_zh: 忙碌紧张的城市生活可能让居民无暇锻炼、放松或进行有意义的社交。
collocations: a hectic schedule｜紧凑忙碌的日程 ; a hectic lifestyle｜忙碌紧张的生活方式 ; a hectic day｜忙乱的一天
tip_zh: 现代常用义是忙乱的，不是兴奋的或发热的。

meanings_zh: n. 薄雾 | v. 蒙上水汽；使模糊
definition_en: tiny water drops in the air that reduce visibility | to become or make something covered with tiny water drops
example1_en: A thin mist floated above the lake this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早晨，湖面上飘着一层薄雾。
example2_en: Drivers should reduce their speed when mist limits visibility on rural roads during the early morning.
example2_zh: 清晨薄雾使乡村道路能见度降低时，驾驶员应减速行驶。
collocations: thick mist｜浓雾 ; morning mist｜晨雾 ; mist over｜蒙上水汽
tip_zh: mist通常比fog稀薄；玻璃起雾可说mist over。

meanings_zh: n. 经度
definition_en: a place's angular distance east or west of the prime meridian
example1_en: Our guide checked our longitude before steering the boat east.
example1_zh: 向导在把船驶向东边之前查看了我们所在位置的经度。
example2_en: Accurate measurements of longitude and latitude allow navigation systems to determine a vehicle's position on Earth.
example2_zh: 准确测量经纬度能让导航系统确定车辆在地球上的位置。
collocations: latitude and longitude｜纬度和经度 ; degrees of longitude｜经度的度数 ; east longitude｜东经 ; west longitude｜西经
tip_zh: longitude是经度，分东西；latitude是纬度，分南北。

meanings_zh: n. 目标；目的 | adj. 客观的；不偏不倚的
definition_en: Something you aim to achieve. | Based on facts rather than personal feelings or opinions.
example1_en: My main objective is to finish the race.
example1_zh: 我的主要目标是跑完全程。
example2_en: Researchers should remain objective when evaluating evidence about the effects of homework on student achievement.
example2_zh: 研究人员在评估家庭作业对学生成绩影响的证据时，应保持客观。
collocations: achieve an objective｜实现目标 ; primary objective｜首要目标 ; objective assessment｜客观评估 ; remain objective｜保持客观
tip_zh: 名词指目标；形容词指客观的，反义词为subjective。

meanings_zh: v. 耸肩 | n. 耸肩的动作
definition_en: To raise your shoulders to show uncertainty or indifference | A shoulder movement expressing uncertainty or lack of concern
example1_en: He shrugged when I asked where the keys were.
example1_zh: 我问钥匙在哪儿时，他耸了耸肩。
example2_en: Governments should not shrug off public concerns about air pollution, as these directly affect community health.
example2_zh: 政府不应轻视公众对空气污染的担忧，因为这些问题直接影响社区健康。
collocations: shrug your shoulders｜耸肩 ; give a shrug｜耸一下肩 ; shrug off criticism｜不把批评当回事
tip_zh: 过去式shrugged；shrug off表示不予理会。

meanings_zh: v. 用手掌拍打 | n. 拍打；掌击
definition_en: Hit someone or something with an open hand. | A hit made with an open hand.
example1_en: She slapped her knee and laughed at the joke.
example1_zh: 她听了这个笑话，拍着膝盖笑了起来。
example2_en: The coach slapped the player's back in celebration, highlighting the supportive atmosphere within the team.
example2_zh: 教练拍了拍球员的背以示庆祝，体现了队内相互支持的氛围。
collocations: slap someone on the back｜拍某人的背 ; a slap on the wrist｜轻微的惩罚 ; slap something down｜啪地放下某物
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词为slapped，须双写p。

meanings_zh: n. 商品陈列室；展厅
definition_en: A room where goods are displayed for customers to examine.
example1_en: We tried several comfortable sofas in the furniture showroom.
example1_zh: 我们在家具展厅试坐了几张舒适的沙发。
example2_en: A physical showroom allows customers to assess product quality before making purchases through online platforms.
example2_zh: 实体展厅让顾客在通过网络平台购买之前评估产品质量。
collocations: furniture showroom｜家具展厅 ; car showroom｜汽车展厅 ; showroom display｜展厅陈列
tip_zh: 可数名词；showrooming指先在实体店看货再网购。

meanings_zh: n. 山体滑坡 | n. 压倒性胜利
definition_en: a mass of earth and rocks sliding down a slope | an election victory by a very large margin
example1_en: A landslide blocked the road after last night's rain.
example1_zh: 昨晚下雨后，一场山体滑坡堵住了道路。
example2_en: Removing trees from steep hillsides can increase the risk of landslides during periods of heavy rainfall.
example2_zh: 砍伐陡峭山坡上的树木，会增加强降雨期间发生山体滑坡的风险。
collocations: trigger a landslide｜引发山体滑坡 ; landslide risk｜滑坡风险 ; landslide victory｜压倒性胜利 ; win by a landslide｜以压倒性优势获胜
tip_zh: 政治语境中常指选举中的压倒性胜利。

meanings_zh: n. 公司；商行 | adj. 坚固的；结实的 | adj. 坚定的；严格的
definition_en: a business that provides goods or professional services | solid and not easily moved or pressed out of shape | unlikely to change a decision or allow rules to be broken
example1_en: My sister works for a small engineering firm.
example1_zh: 我姐姐在一家小型工程公司工作。
example2_en: Each firm should provide regular training to help employees adapt to technological change.
example2_zh: 每家公司都应提供定期培训，帮助员工适应技术变革。
collocations: a law firm｜律师事务所 ; a firm belief｜坚定的信念 ; firm ground｜坚实的地面 ; take a firm stand｜采取坚定立场
tip_zh: 作名词指公司；作形容词可指物体结实或态度坚定。

meanings_zh: v. 下降；下去
definition_en: to move down or go to a lower position
example1_en: We descended the narrow stairs into a cool cellar.
example1_zh: 我们沿着狭窄的楼梯走下去，进入凉爽的地窖。
example2_en: As aircraft descend towards urban airports, their noise can significantly affect the quality of life in nearby communities.
example2_zh: 飞机向城市机场下降时，产生的噪声会显著影响周边社区的生活质量。
collocations: descend the stairs｜走下楼梯 ; descend into a valley｜下到山谷 ; be descended from｜是……的后裔
tip_zh: 可直接接stairs；表示是……的后裔用be descended from。

meanings_zh: v. 购买 | n. 购买；所购之物
definition_en: to obtain something by paying money for it | the act of buying something, or the thing bought
example1_en: You can purchase fresh bread at the corner shop.
example1_zh: 你可以在街角的小店买到新鲜面包。
example2_en: Consumers should consider repair costs and energy efficiency before they purchase new household appliances.
example2_zh: 消费者购买新家电前，应考虑维修成本和能源效率。
collocations: purchase goods｜购买商品 ; make a purchase｜购买 ; purchase price｜购买价格 ; proof of purchase｜购买凭证
tip_zh: purchase比buy正式；名词可指购买行为或买到的东西。

meanings_zh: v. 处理；丢弃 | v. 使倾向于；使愿意
definition_en: to get rid of something, used with of | to make someone likely or willing to do something
example1_en: Where can I dispose of these old batteries safely?
example1_zh: 我可以在哪里安全地处理这些旧电池？
example2_en: Local authorities should provide convenient facilities so residents can dispose of household waste responsibly.
example2_zh: 地方政府应提供便利的设施，让居民能够负责任地处理生活垃圾。
collocations: dispose of waste｜处理废物 ; dispose of unwanted items｜处理不需要的物品 ; be disposed to agree｜倾向于同意
tip_zh: 表示丢弃必须用dispose of，不能直接接物品。

meanings_zh: n. 体积；总量 | n. 音量 | n. 卷；册
definition_en: The space something occupies, or the total amount of something. | The level of loudness of a sound. | A book, especially one belonging to a larger set.
example1_en: Please turn the volume down while the baby sleeps.
example1_zh: 宝宝睡觉时请把音量调低。
example2_en: The growing volume of household waste highlights the need for better recycling facilities in urban areas.
example2_zh: 不断增加的生活垃圾量凸显了城市地区改善回收设施的必要性。
collocations: a high volume of traffic｜很大的交通流量 ; turn down the volume｜调低音量 ; calculate the volume｜计算体积 ; a companion volume｜配套的一卷
tip_zh: volume可指体积、总量或音量；面积用area。

meanings_zh: v. 轻抛；扔 | v. 翻动；拌匀 | n. 抛；投掷
definition_en: To throw something lightly or without much care. | To turn food over gently to mix or coat it. | An act of throwing something lightly.
example1_en: Could you toss me that cushion from the sofa?
example1_zh: 你能把沙发上的那个靠垫扔给我吗？
example2_en: Consumers often toss usable items into the bin, increasing waste that could be avoided through repair.
example2_zh: 消费者常把还能用的物品扔进垃圾桶，增加了本可通过维修避免的废弃物。
collocations: toss a coin｜抛硬币 ; toss a salad｜拌沙拉 ; toss and turn｜辗转反侧
tip_zh: toss常指轻抛；toss and turn指辗转反侧。

meanings_zh: n. 缺席；不在 | n. 缺乏；不存在
definition_en: a situation in which someone is not present | a situation in which something does not exist or occur
example1_en: Her absence from dinner worried the whole family.
example1_zh: 她没来吃晚饭，让全家人都很担心。
example2_en: In the absence of reliable public transport, many residents have little choice but to drive.
example2_zh: 在缺乏可靠公共交通的情况下，许多居民别无选择，只能开车。
collocations: absence from work｜缺勤 ; in someone's absence｜在某人不在时 ; in the absence of｜在缺乏……的情况下 ; leave of absence｜获准休假
tip_zh: 缺席某活动用absence from；缺乏某物用absence of。

meanings_zh: adj. 昂贵的；费用高的 | adj. 造成重大损失的
definition_en: requiring a large amount of money | causing serious loss, harm or disadvantage
example1_en: Replacing the broken roof proved more costly than expected.
example1_zh: 更换破损的屋顶比预想的花费更高。
example2_en: Delaying investment in flood protection could prove costly for communities exposed to increasingly severe storms.
example2_zh: 对于面临日益猛烈风暴的社区，推迟防洪投资可能会造成重大损失。
collocations: costly repairs｜昂贵的维修 ; a costly mistake｜代价高昂的错误 ; prove costly｜结果代价高昂
tip_zh: 虽以-ly结尾，却是形容词；也可指损失惨重。

meanings_zh: adj. 完全相同的
definition_en: exactly the same in every relevant detail
example1_en: We bought identical jackets without knowing about each other's choice.
example1_zh: 我们在不知道对方选择的情况下，买了完全一样的夹克。
example2_en: Providing identical resources to every school may not address differences in students' needs or local circumstances.
example2_zh: 向每所学校提供完全相同的资源，未必能解决学生需求或当地情况的差异。
collocations: identical twins｜同卵双胞胎 ; identical to｜与……完全相同 ; virtually identical｜几乎完全相同
tip_zh: 常用 identical to；比 similar 的相似程度更强。

meanings_zh: adj. 热情好客的 | adj. 适宜居住或生长的
definition_en: Friendly and generous towards guests or visitors. | Providing suitable conditions for people, animals, or plants to live.
example1_en: Our hospitable neighbours invited us in for warm soup.
example1_zh: 热情好客的邻居邀请我们进屋喝热汤。
example2_en: A hospitable climate and reliable water supplies have encouraged human settlement in this region for centuries.
example2_zh: 数百年来，宜人的气候和可靠的供水一直吸引着人们在这一地区定居。
collocations: a hospitable host｜热情好客的主人 ; hospitable to visitors｜热情接待访客 ; a hospitable environment｜适宜生存的环境
tip_zh: 形容人时指好客；形容环境时指适宜生存。

meanings_zh: adj. 不感兴趣的
definition_en: not wanting to learn about or take part in something
example1_en: Leo seemed uninterested in the game and went outside.
example1_zh: 利奥似乎对游戏不感兴趣，便出去了。
example2_en: Students may appear uninterested in science when lessons offer few opportunities for practical experiments.
example2_zh: 如果课堂很少提供动手实验的机会，学生可能会显得对科学不感兴趣。
collocations: uninterested in politics｜对政治不感兴趣 ; seem uninterested｜显得不感兴趣 ; remain uninterested｜仍然不感兴趣
tip_zh: 接in；勿与表示“公正无私”的disinterested混淆。

meanings_zh: v. 来回摇摆 | n. 摇摆；摆动 | n. 爱说笑的人
definition_en: move repeatedly from side to side | a movement from side to side | someone who often makes clever or amusing remarks
example1_en: The puppy wagged its tail when I came home.
example1_zh: 我回家时，小狗摇起了尾巴。
example2_en: Although dogs often wag their tails during friendly encounters, this movement does not always indicate happiness.
example2_zh: 虽然狗在友好互动时经常摇尾巴，但这一动作并不总是表示开心。
collocations: wag its tail｜摇尾巴 ; wag a finger at someone｜向某人摇手指 ; a wag of the tail｜尾巴的一摆
tip_zh: 过去式wagged，现在分词wagging，均双写g。

meanings_zh: adj. 等值的；相当的 | n. 对应物；等值物
definition_en: Equal in value, amount, meaning, or function. | Something equal to another thing in value, meaning, or function.
example1_en: This small heater produces heat equivalent to that larger one.
example1_zh: 这台小取暖器产生的热量与那台较大的相当。
example2_en: Employers should recognise overseas qualifications when they are equivalent to those awarded by domestic institutions.
example2_zh: 当海外学历与本国院校颁发的学历相当时，雇主应予以认可。
collocations: equivalent to｜与……相当 ; an equivalent qualification｜同等学历 ; the equivalent of｜相当于……的事物
tip_zh: 常用equivalent to；相当不代表完全相同。

meanings_zh: n. 区别；差别 | n. 卓越；杰出 | n. 优等成绩；荣誉
definition_en: A difference that separates one thing or group from another | The quality of being excellent and deserving respect | A special award or high grade recognizing excellent achievement
example1_en: I never understood the distinction between those two sports.
example1_zh: 我一直不明白那两项运动有什么区别。
example2_en: Policymakers should draw a clear distinction between temporary unemployment and long-term exclusion from the labour market.
example2_zh: 政策制定者应明确区分暂时失业与长期被排除在劳动力市场之外的情况。
collocations: draw a distinction between｜区分……与…… ; a clear distinction｜明显的区别 ; with distinction｜以优异成绩 ; a person of distinction｜杰出人士
tip_zh: 表示两者区别，常用distinction between A and B。

meanings_zh: v. 使稳定；变得稳定
definition_en: make or become steady and less likely to change
example1_en: We used a wooden block to stabilize the table.
example1_zh: 我们用一块木块让桌子保持平稳。
example2_en: Governments may need to stabilize food prices to protect vulnerable households during periods of economic uncertainty.
example2_zh: 在经济不确定时期，政府可能需要稳定食品价格，以保护弱势家庭。
collocations: stabilize prices｜稳定价格 ; stabilize the economy｜稳定经济 ; stabilize a patient's condition｜稳定患者病情
tip_zh: 可及物也可不及物；英式英语也常拼作stabilise。

meanings_zh: n. 实习岗位；实习期
definition_en: A temporary job providing practical experience in a particular field.
example1_en: Leila started a summer internship at a local museum.
example1_zh: 莱拉开始在当地一家博物馆进行暑期实习。
example2_en: Paid internships can help students gain professional experience without placing additional financial pressure on their families.
example2_zh: 带薪实习能帮助学生积累专业经验，同时不增加家庭的经济压力。
collocations: paid internship｜带薪实习 ; summer internship｜暑期实习 ; apply for an internship｜申请实习岗位
tip_zh: intern指实习生；internship指实习岗位或实习期。

meanings_zh: n. 役用牛；阉牛
definition_en: a large bovine, often a castrated male, used for work
example1_en: The ox pulled a wooden cart along the path.
example1_zh: 那头役牛沿着小路拉着一辆木车。
example2_en: Before agricultural machinery became widespread, farmers in many regions relied on oxen to plough their fields.
example2_zh: 农业机械普及之前，许多地区的农民依靠役牛犁地。
collocations: a pair of oxen｜一对役牛 ; an ox cart｜牛车 ; as strong as an ox｜健壮如牛
tip_zh: 复数是oxen；多指役牛，不等同于未阉割公牛bull。

meanings_zh: v. 洗澡；给……洗澡 | v. 清洗；浸洗 | v. 游泳；戏水
definition_en: To wash yourself or another person in a bath | To gently wash a body part with liquid | To swim or spend time in the sea or a lake
example1_en: Gently bathe your sore feet in warm water.
example1_zh: 把酸痛的双脚放在温水中轻轻浸洗。
example2_en: Residents need reliable access to clean water to bathe safely and maintain good personal hygiene.
example2_zh: 居民需要可靠的清洁用水供应，才能安全洗澡并保持良好的个人卫生。
collocations: bathe a baby｜给婴儿洗澡 ; bathe a wound｜清洗伤口 ; bathe in the sea｜在海里游泳
tip_zh: bathe读/beɪð/，勿与bath混淆；英式还可指海泳。

meanings_zh: adj. 向下的；下降的 | adv. 向下；往低处
definition_en: Moving or pointing towards a lower place, level, or amount. | Towards a lower place, level, or amount.
example1_en: The bird began its downward flight towards the lake.
example1_zh: 那只鸟开始朝湖面向下飞去。
example2_en: A downward trend in household energy consumption may reflect better insulation and greater public awareness.
example2_zh: 家庭能源消耗的下降趋势可能反映了保温措施的改善和公众意识的提高。
collocations: a downward trend｜下降趋势 ; downward pressure｜下行压力 ; a downward spiral｜持续恶化 ; move downward｜向下移动
tip_zh: downward可作形容词和副词；downwards只作副词。

meanings_zh: n. 捆；束；包 | v. 捆扎；打包 | v. 匆忙塞入；匆忙推送
definition_en: A group of things tied or wrapped together. | To tie or wrap things together. | To put or move someone or something somewhere hurriedly.
example1_en: He carried a bundle of blankets into the house.
example1_zh: 他抱着一捆毯子走进了屋里。
example2_en: Offering internet and telephone services as a bundle may reduce costs, but consumers should compare contracts carefully.
example2_zh: 将网络和电话服务捆绑提供可能降低费用，但消费者应仔细比较合同。
collocations: a bundle of clothes｜一包衣服 ; tie into bundles｜扎成捆 ; bundle up｜包裹起来；穿暖和 ; bundle into a car｜匆忙塞进车里
tip_zh: a bundle of后接复数名词；bundle up也指穿暖。

meanings_zh: n. 合同；契约 | v. 收缩；缩小 | v. 感染；患上
definition_en: A legally binding agreement between people or organisations. | To become smaller or make something smaller. | To catch or develop a disease.
example1_en: Read the contract carefully before you agree to sign it.
example1_zh: 同意签字之前，要仔细阅读合同。
example2_en: A clear employment contract protects both workers and employers by defining responsibilities, working hours and payment terms.
example2_zh: 明确的劳动合同通过规定职责、工作时间和薪酬条款，保护员工和雇主双方的权益。
collocations: sign a contract｜签订合同 ; employment contract｜劳动合同 ; breach of contract｜违约 ; contract a disease｜感染疾病
tip_zh: 名词重音在前；动词英/kənˈtrækt/，美同。

meanings_zh: n. 坟墓；陵墓
definition_en: A structure or underground chamber where a dead person is buried.
example1_en: We visited an ancient stone tomb outside the village.
example1_zh: 我们参观了村外的一座古老石墓。
example2_en: Objects discovered inside the royal tomb provide valuable evidence about ancient beliefs, craftsmanship, and social organisation.
example2_zh: 王陵中发现的物品为研究古代信仰、工艺和社会组织提供了宝贵证据。
collocations: ancient tomb｜古墓 ; royal tomb｜王陵 ; burial tomb｜墓穴
tip_zh: b不发音，与room押韵；常指有建筑结构的墓。

meanings_zh: adj. 公民的；民用的 | adj. 民事的 | adj. 有礼貌的；客气的
definition_en: Relating to citizens or ordinary society rather than the military. | Relating to private legal disputes rather than criminal offences. | Polite and respectful, though not necessarily friendly.
example1_en: The airport handles both military and civil aircraft.
example1_zh: 这座机场既接待军用飞机，也接待民用飞机。
example2_en: Protecting civil rights requires accessible legal services and public institutions that treat all citizens fairly.
example2_zh: 保护公民权利需要便捷可及的法律服务，以及公平对待所有公民的公共机构。
collocations: civil rights｜公民权利 ; civil aviation｜民用航空 ; civil law｜民法 ; remain civil｜保持礼貌
tip_zh: civil law指民法；civil war则指内战。

meanings_zh: adj. 很可能的
definition_en: Likely to happen or be true.
example1_en: The mechanic explained the probable cause of the noise.
example1_zh: 机修工解释了噪声最可能的原因。
example2_en: Given current population trends, it is probable that demand for affordable housing will continue to rise.
example2_zh: 考虑到目前的人口趋势，对可负担住房的需求很可能会继续增长。
collocations: probable cause｜很可能的原因 ; probable outcome｜很可能的结果 ; highly probable｜极有可能的
tip_zh: 常用it is probable that；不用某人is probable to do。

meanings_zh: n. 法兰绒 | n. 洗脸巾；浴用小毛巾
definition_en: soft cotton or wool cloth used for warm clothing | a small cloth used for washing your face or body
example1_en: She wore a soft flannel shirt over her T-shirt.
example1_zh: 她在T恤外穿了一件柔软的法兰绒衬衫。
example2_en: In colder climates, flannel clothing provides practical warmth and can reduce reliance on intensive indoor heating.
example2_zh: 在较寒冷的气候中，法兰绒衣物能有效保暖，并可减少对高强度室内供暖的依赖。
collocations: flannel shirt｜法兰绒衬衫 ; flannel pyjamas｜法兰绒睡衣 ; cotton flannel｜棉法兰绒 ; a damp flannel｜湿洗脸巾
tip_zh: 布料义不可数；英式英语中a flannel指一块洗脸巾。

meanings_zh: n. 排练；预演
definition_en: A practice session before a performance or important event.
example1_en: Our final rehearsal finished just before the audience arrived.
example1_zh: 我们的最后一次排练在观众到来前刚刚结束。
example2_en: Regular rehearsal helps students develop confidence and teamwork skills before they perform in front of an audience.
example2_zh: 定期排练有助于学生在登台表演前培养信心和团队合作能力。
collocations: dress rehearsal｜彩排 ; in rehearsal｜在排练中 ; rehearsal room｜排练室
tip_zh: 一次排练可数；in rehearsal表示正在排练。

meanings_zh: n. 环境；场所；背景 | n. 设置；档位 | n. 宝石镶座
definition_en: The place and conditions in which something happens. | A position or option controlling how a device works. | The metal structure that holds a gemstone in jewellery.
example1_en: The lakeside garden provides a peaceful setting for lunch.
example1_zh: 湖边的花园为午餐提供了宁静的环境。
example2_en: Children often develop stronger communication skills in a supportive educational setting that encourages cooperation rather than competition.
example2_zh: 在鼓励合作而非竞争的支持性教育环境中，儿童通常能培养出更强的沟通能力。
collocations: a rural setting｜乡村环境 ; an educational setting｜教育环境 ; privacy settings｜隐私设置 ; a heat setting｜温度档位
tip_zh: 环境义常用in a setting；设备设置常用复数settings。

meanings_zh: n. 股；缕；细丝 | n. 组成部分；方面 | v. 使滞留；使无法离开
definition_en: A single thin length of hair, thread, or similar material. | One element within a larger argument, story, or activity. | To leave someone somewhere without a way to leave.
example1_en: A strand of hair fell across her face.
example1_zh: 一缕头发垂到了她的脸上。
example2_en: Improving public transport is one strand of a broader strategy to reduce urban air pollution.
example2_zh: 改善公共交通是减少城市空气污染这一整体策略的一个方面。
collocations: a strand of hair｜一缕头发 ; a strand of an argument｜论证的一个方面 ; leave passengers stranded｜使乘客滞留
tip_zh: 一缕头发用a strand of hair；滞留常用be stranded。

meanings_zh: adj. 谨慎的；小心的
definition_en: Careful to avoid danger, mistakes, or unnecessary risks.
example1_en: The cautious driver slowed down before the icy bridge.
example1_zh: 谨慎的司机在结冰的桥前减了速。
example2_en: Consumers should be cautious about sharing personal information with unfamiliar websites, particularly when making online payments.
example2_zh: 消费者应谨慎向陌生网站提供个人信息，尤其是在网上付款时。
collocations: cautious approach｜谨慎的方法 ; cautious about｜对……谨慎 ; cautious optimism｜谨慎乐观
tip_zh: 常用be cautious about doing，表示谨慎做某事。

meanings_zh: n. 饥荒
definition_en: a severe shortage of food affecting many people
example1_en: Our community sent food to families affected by famine.
example1_zh: 我们社区向遭受饥荒的家庭运送了食物。
example2_en: Prolonged drought can lead to famine when farming communities lack reliable irrigation systems and emergency food reserves.
example2_zh: 当农业社区缺乏可靠的灌溉系统和应急粮食储备时，长期干旱可能导致饥荒。
collocations: widespread famine｜大范围饥荒 ; famine relief｜饥荒救济 ; prevent famine｜预防饥荒
tip_zh: famine指大范围粮食匮乏；个人饥饿用hunger。

meanings_zh: adv. 专心地；留意地 | adv. 体贴地；周到地
definition_en: with careful attention to what is happening | with care for another person's needs
example1_en: The children listened attentively as their grandmother told a story.
example1_zh: 祖母讲故事时，孩子们听得很专心。
example2_en: Students who listen attentively during group discussions are more likely to understand perspectives different from their own.
example2_zh: 在小组讨论中认真倾听的学生更有可能理解与自己不同的观点。
collocations: listen attentively｜专心听 ; watch attentively｜仔细观看 ; care attentively for｜悉心照料
tip_zh: 最常见于listen attentively，重在专心而非关心。

meanings_zh: n. 智慧；明智 | n. 智慧之言；公认看法
definition_en: The ability to judge well using knowledge and experience | Ideas or advice considered sensible and valuable
example1_en: My grandmother shared her wisdom while we cooked together.
example1_zh: 我和祖母一起做饭时，她分享了自己的人生智慧。
example2_en: The wisdom of expanding road networks is increasingly questioned as cities seek more sustainable transport solutions.
example2_zh: 随着城市寻求更可持续的交通方案，扩建道路网络是否明智越来越受到质疑。
collocations: conventional wisdom｜普遍接受的看法 ; words of wisdom｜智慧之言 ; question the wisdom of｜质疑……是否明智 ; the wisdom to do something｜做某事的智慧
tip_zh: 不可数；knowledge重知识，wisdom重判断与运用。

meanings_zh: n. 分期付款的一期款项 | n. 连载的一期；系列的一部
definition_en: One of several payments made over time for something. | One part of a story or series released separately.
example1_en: I paid the final installment on my bicycle today.
example1_zh: 我今天付清了自行车的最后一期款项。
example2_en: Paying tuition fees in installments can make higher education more accessible to students from poorer households.
example2_zh: 分期支付学费可以让低收入家庭的学生更容易获得高等教育机会。
collocations: pay in installments｜分期付款 ; monthly installment｜每月分期款 ; the next installment｜下一期；下一部
tip_zh: 美式拼写；英式为instalment，分期用in。

meanings_zh: v. 展出；展览 | v. 表现出；显示 | n. 展品；证物
definition_en: to display objects or artworks for people to see | to show a particular quality, feeling or behaviour | an object displayed publicly or presented as evidence in court
example1_en: The local gallery exhibits pottery made by young artists.
example1_zh: 当地画廊展出年轻艺术家制作的陶器。
example2_en: Children who regularly engage in creative activities often exhibit greater confidence when solving unfamiliar problems.
example2_zh: 经常参加创造性活动的儿童在解决陌生问题时往往表现得更自信。
collocations: exhibit artwork｜展出艺术作品 ; exhibit symptoms｜显现症状 ; a museum exhibit｜博物馆展品
tip_zh: 英式英语中，exhibit 通常指单件展品，展览用 exhibition。

meanings_zh: n. 王国 | n. 生物分类中的界
definition_en: a country ruled by a king or queen | one of the largest groups used to classify living things
example1_en: The old castle once guarded the entrance to the kingdom.
example1_zh: 这座古堡曾经守卫着王国的入口。
example2_en: Tourism in the small kingdom provides employment, but increasing visitor numbers place pressure on historic buildings.
example2_zh: 旅游业为这个小王国提供了就业机会，但游客数量增长也给历史建筑带来了压力。
collocations: animal kingdom｜动物界 ; plant kingdom｜植物界 ; rule a kingdom｜统治王国
tip_zh: 政治语境指王国；animal kingdom指动物界。

meanings_zh: adj. 脆的；酥脆的 | adj. 清爽凉快的 | n. 炸薯片
definition_en: firm or dry enough to break with a sharp sound | pleasantly cool and fresh, describing air or weather | a thin fried potato slice, usually eaten as a snack
example1_en: The apple was crisp and sweet with every bite.
example1_zh: 这个苹果每咬一口都又脆又甜。
example2_en: Packaging helps keep snacks crisp, but excessive use of plastic creates significant environmental problems.
example2_zh: 包装有助于保持零食酥脆，但过度使用塑料会造成严重的环境问题。
collocations: crisp lettuce｜脆嫩的生菜 ; crisp air｜清爽的空气 ; a packet of crisps｜一包薯片
tip_zh: 薯片英式常用复数crisps，美式说potato chips。

meanings_zh: n. 氮；氮气
definition_en: A chemical element forming most of the gas in Earth's air.
example1_en: These beans help add nitrogen to our garden soil.
example1_zh: 这些豆类植物有助于增加我们花园土壤中的氮。
example2_en: Excess nitrogen from agricultural fertilisers can enter rivers, encouraging rapid algae growth and damaging aquatic ecosystems.
example2_zh: 农业肥料中过量的氮可能进入河流，促使藻类迅速生长，破坏水生生态系统。
collocations: liquid nitrogen｜液氮 ; nitrogen gas｜氮气 ; nitrogen cycle｜氮循环 ; nitrogen fixation｜固氮
tip_zh: nitrogen是不可数名词，化学符号为N。

meanings_zh: adj. 持续的；经常发生的 | adj. 恒定的；不变的 | n. 常数；恒量
definition_en: continuing or happening repeatedly | remaining the same over time | a value or quantity that does not change
example1_en: The constant noise outside kept me awake all night.
example1_zh: 外面持续不断的噪声让我整夜无法入睡。
example2_en: Maintaining a constant temperature in public buildings can improve comfort but may increase energy consumption.
example2_zh: 公共建筑保持恒温可以提高舒适度，但可能增加能源消耗。
collocations: constant pressure｜持续的压力 ; constant temperature｜恒温 ; remain constant｜保持不变
tip_zh: 可指持续发生，也可指数值不变，须看语境。

meanings_zh: v. 拧；扭；扭转 | n. 意外转折 | v. 歪曲；曲解
definition_en: turn something so its parts rotate in different directions | an unexpected change in a story or situation | change the meaning of something to mislead people
example1_en: She twisted the wet towel over the sink.
example1_zh: 她在水槽上方拧干湿毛巾。
example2_en: Online reports sometimes twist scientific findings, making it difficult for readers to judge health risks accurately.
example2_zh: 网络报道有时会歪曲科学研究结果，使读者难以准确判断健康风险。
collocations: twist your ankle｜扭伤脚踝 ; a plot twist｜情节的意外转折 ; twist the facts｜歪曲事实
tip_zh: twist既可指实际扭转，也可指歪曲事实。

meanings_zh: n. 一匙的量
definition_en: The amount that a spoon can hold
example1_en: She stirred a spoonful of honey into her tea.
example1_zh: 她把一匙蜂蜜搅进茶里。
example2_en: Adding several spoonfuls of sugar to drinks each day can substantially increase a person's daily calorie intake.
example2_zh: 每天往饮料里加几匙糖，会显著增加一个人的每日热量摄入。
collocations: a spoonful of sugar｜一匙糖 ; a heaped spoonful｜满满一匙 ; a level spoonful｜平平一匙
tip_zh: 是名词而非形容词；复数通常为spoonfuls。

meanings_zh: n. 亮度；明亮 | n. 鲜艳；鲜亮 | n. 聪明；机敏
definition_en: The amount of light something gives off or reflects. | The quality of having strong, vivid colours. | The ability to understand and learn things quickly.
example1_en: I lowered the screen's brightness before watching a film.
example1_zh: 看电影前，我调低了屏幕亮度。
example2_en: Reducing the brightness of outdoor lighting at night can save energy and limit disruption to wildlife.
example2_zh: 夜间降低户外照明亮度可以节约能源，并减少对野生动物的干扰。
collocations: adjust the brightness｜调节亮度 ; screen brightness｜屏幕亮度 ; the brightness of colours｜色彩的鲜艳程度
tip_zh: 不可数；屏幕的“亮度”用brightness，不用lightness。

meanings_zh: n. 剩余部分；其余的人 | n. 余数
definition_en: what is left after other parts are removed or used | the amount left when division does not produce a whole number
example1_en: We ate half the cake and refrigerated the remainder.
example1_zh: 我们吃了半个蛋糕，把剩下的放进了冰箱。
example2_en: After funding essential services, the council allocated the remainder of its budget to improving public parks.
example2_zh: 在为基本服务拨款后，地方议会将剩余预算用于改善公共公园。
collocations: the remainder of｜……的剩余部分 ; for the remainder of｜在……余下的时间里 ; leave a remainder｜留下余数
tip_zh: 常用the remainder of；谓语单复数取决于所指内容。

meanings_zh: v. 播种 | v. 散布；埋下祸根
definition_en: To put seeds in soil so they can grow. | To cause feelings or problems to begin and spread.
example1_en: We sowed carrot seeds in the garden this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上，我们在花园里播下了胡萝卜种子。
example2_en: Misleading online reports can sow distrust among communities and weaken confidence in public institutions.
example2_zh: 误导性的网络报道可能在社区间散布不信任，削弱公众对公共机构的信心。
collocations: sow seeds｜播种 ; sow doubt｜引起怀疑 ; sow discord｜挑拨离间
tip_zh: 过去式sowed，分词sown或sowed；母猪读/saʊ/。

meanings_zh: adj. 人造的；仿造的 | adj. 不自然的；做作的
definition_en: Made by people rather than occurring naturally | Not sincere or natural in appearance or behaviour
example1_en: The artificial flowers looked surprisingly fresh on the table.
example1_zh: 桌上的仿真花看起来竟然像鲜花一样。
example2_en: Excessive artificial lighting in urban areas can disrupt wildlife behaviour and reduce the visibility of stars.
example2_zh: 城市中过量的人工照明会扰乱野生动物的行为，并使星星难以看清。
collocations: artificial intelligence｜人工智能 ; artificial lighting｜人工照明 ; artificial sweeteners｜人工甜味剂 ; an artificial smile｜做作的微笑
tip_zh: artificial指人造的；artistic才是艺术的。

meanings_zh: adj. 有吸引力的；令人喜欢的 | adj. 恳求的
definition_en: attractive or interesting enough to make people want it | showing a strong wish for help or sympathy
example1_en: The sunny balcony makes this small flat especially appealing.
example1_zh: 阳光充足的阳台让这套小公寓格外有吸引力。
example2_en: Flexible working arrangements are particularly appealing to parents who need to balance employment with childcare responsibilities.
example2_zh: 灵活的工作安排对需要兼顾工作与育儿责任的父母尤其有吸引力。
collocations: appealing prospect｜诱人的前景 ; visually appealing｜视觉上吸引人的 ; appealing to consumers｜吸引消费者的 ; an appealing look｜恳求的眼神
tip_zh: 表示“对某人有吸引力”用appealing to sb。

meanings_zh: adj. 光的；光学的 | adj. 视觉的；视力的
definition_en: Relating to light or devices that use light. | Relating to sight or the way the eyes work.
example1_en: This optical illusion makes the flat drawing look three-dimensional.
example1_zh: 这种视错觉让平面的图画看起来像立体的。
example2_en: Optical fibres enable rapid data transmission, supporting the expansion of reliable internet access in remote communities.
example2_zh: 光纤能实现快速数据传输，帮助可靠的互联网服务覆盖偏远社区。
collocations: optical illusion｜视错觉 ; optical fibre｜光纤 ; optical instrument｜光学仪器
tip_zh: optical涉及光或视觉；optical illusion指视错觉。

meanings_zh: v. 分发；分配 | v. 使分布；使散布
definition_en: to give or deliver something to several people or places | to spread something over an area
example1_en: Volunteers distribute fresh fruit outside the community centre every Friday.
example1_zh: 志愿者每周五在社区中心外分发新鲜水果。
example2_en: Governments must distribute healthcare resources fairly so that rural communities receive the same quality of care as urban residents.
example2_zh: 政府必须公平分配医疗资源，让农村社区享有与城市居民同等质量的医疗服务。
collocations: distribute food｜分发食物 ; distribute resources｜分配资源 ; evenly distributed｜均匀分布的 ; widely distributed｜广泛分布的
tip_zh: distribute A to B 表示“把A分发给B”。

meanings_zh: n. 礼貌；谦恭 | n. 好意；礼貌之举 | adj. 免费提供的
definition_en: polite behaviour showing respect and consideration for others | a polite or helpful act | provided free to customers as a service
example1_en: She treated every guest with courtesy, even when tired.
example1_zh: 即使很累，她也对每位客人彬彬有礼。
example2_en: Showing courtesy towards fellow passengers can make public transport more pleasant and accessible for everyone.
example2_zh: 礼貌对待其他乘客能让公共交通更加舒适，也更方便所有人使用。
collocations: common courtesy｜基本礼貌 ; as a courtesy｜出于礼貌 ; courtesy bus｜免费接送巴士 ; courtesy of｜承蒙……提供
tip_zh: courtesy of表示承蒙某方提供或允许使用。

meanings_zh: n. 降落伞 | v. 跳伞；空投
definition_en: Equipment that slows a fall through the air | To jump or drop something from aircraft using a parachute
example1_en: Her parachute opened smoothly above the green fields.
example1_zh: 她的降落伞在绿色田野上空顺利张开。
example2_en: Rescue teams used parachutes to deliver essential supplies to villages isolated by severe flooding.
example2_zh: 救援队利用降落伞向被严重洪灾隔绝的村庄投送必需物资。
collocations: open a parachute｜打开降落伞 ; parachute jump｜跳伞 ; parachute supplies into｜向……空投物资
tip_zh: 作动词时，既可指人跳伞，也可指空投物资。

meanings_zh: adj. 总的；毛的 | adj. 严重的；极其恶劣的 | adj. 恶心的；令人厌恶的
definition_en: Calculated before taxes, costs, or other amounts are taken away. | Extremely serious and clearly unacceptable. | Very unpleasant or disgusting.
example1_en: My gross pay looks much better than my take-home pay.
example1_zh: 我的税前工资看起来比实发工资高多了。
example2_en: Gross domestic product measures economic output, but it does not fully reflect citizens' quality of life.
example2_zh: 国内生产总值衡量经济产出，却不能全面反映公民的生活质量。
collocations: gross income｜总收入 ; gross domestic product｜国内生产总值 ; gross negligence｜重大过失 ; gross profit｜毛利润
tip_zh: 财务中gross为扣除前总额，net为净额。

meanings_zh: v. 贡献；捐助 | v. 促成；是原因之一 | v. 投稿；撰稿
definition_en: To give money, time, or effort towards a shared purpose | To help cause a particular result | To write material for a publication or website
example1_en: Everyone contributed a dish to our shared evening meal.
example1_zh: 每个人都为我们的聚餐带来了一道菜。
example2_en: Limited access to affordable housing can contribute to social inequality and force workers to accept longer commutes.
example2_zh: 难以获得可负担住房可能加剧社会不平等，并迫使劳动者接受更长的通勤时间。
collocations: contribute to a discussion｜参与讨论 ; contribute to economic growth｜促进经济增长 ; contribute funds｜捐助资金 ; contribute an article｜撰写稿件
tip_zh: contribute to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: n. 眼睑；眼皮
definition_en: a fold of skin that closes over the eye
example1_en: A tiny grain of sand irritated my eyelid.
example1_zh: 一粒细沙刺激了我的眼皮。
example2_en: The eyelids help protect the eyes from dust and spread moisture across their surface during blinking.
example2_zh: 眼睑有助于阻挡灰尘，并在眨眼时将水分均匀分布在眼球表面。
collocations: upper eyelid｜上眼睑 ; lower eyelid｜下眼睑 ; swollen eyelid｜肿胀的眼皮
tip_zh: eyelid是眼皮；eyelash是睫毛。

meanings_zh: n. 橡树；栎树 | n. 橡木；栎木
definition_en: a large tree that produces acorns | the strong, hard wood of an oak tree
example1_en: We spread our picnic blanket beneath a huge oak.
example1_zh: 我们在一棵巨大的橡树下铺开野餐毯。
example2_en: Protecting mature oak trees helps preserve woodland habitats and supports a wide variety of native wildlife.
example2_zh: 保护成熟的橡树有助于维护林地栖息地，并支持多种本地野生动植物生存。
collocations: oak tree｜橡树 ; solid oak｜实心橡木 ; oak furniture｜橡木家具 ; oak woodland｜橡树林
tip_zh: 指树时可数，指木材时不可数；oak table中作定语。

meanings_zh: adj. 毛茸茸的；轻软的 | adj. 松软的
definition_en: covered with soft hair or having a soft, airy texture | light and soft because of air inside
example1_en: Our kitten curled up on a fluffy white blanket.
example1_zh: 我们的小猫蜷缩在一条毛茸茸的白色毯子上。
example2_en: Hotels often provide fluffy towels and comfortable bedding to improve guest satisfaction and encourage repeat visits.
example2_zh: 酒店通常提供柔软蓬松的毛巾和舒适的床上用品，以提高客人满意度并吸引回头客。
collocations: fluffy towel｜蓬松柔软的毛巾 ; fluffy clouds｜棉絮般的云朵 ; fluffy pancakes｜松软的煎饼
tip_zh: 形容毛发时指毛茸茸；形容食物时指松软。

meanings_zh: v. 征服；攻占 | v. 克服；战胜
definition_en: Take control of a country or place by force. | Successfully deal with a fear, difficulty, or challenge.
example1_en: She conquered her fear and climbed onto the diving board.
example1_zh: 她克服了恐惧，爬上了跳板。
example2_en: Throughout history, powerful states have sought to conquer neighbouring territories to gain resources and expand their influence.
example2_zh: 纵观历史，强大的国家一直试图征服邻近领土，以获取资源并扩大影响力。
collocations: conquer a territory｜征服一片领土 ; conquer a fear｜克服恐惧 ; conquer a mountain｜征服一座高山
tip_zh: 及物动词，直接接宾语：conquer a fear。

meanings_zh: n. 电子
definition_en: A tiny particle carrying a negative electric charge.
example1_en: Our teacher used coloured beads to represent each electron.
example1_zh: 老师用彩色珠子来表示每个电子。
example2_en: Understanding how electrons move through materials is essential for developing more efficient batteries and electronic devices.
example2_zh: 了解电子如何在材料中移动，对开发效率更高的电池和电子设备至关重要。
collocations: electron microscope｜电子显微镜 ; electron flow｜电子流 ; electron beam｜电子束
tip_zh: electron是粒子；electronic意为电子的。

meanings_zh: n. 茶点；饮料和小吃 | n. 恢复精神；消除疲劳
definition_en: small amounts of food and drink, usually served during breaks | the feeling of renewed energy after rest, food, or drink
example1_en: They served refreshments in the garden after the meeting.
example1_zh: 会后，他们在花园里提供了茶点。
example2_en: Providing free refreshments during community events can create a welcoming atmosphere and encourage informal conversations among residents.
example2_zh: 在社区活动中免费提供茶点可以营造友好氛围，促进居民之间的轻松交流。
collocations: light refreshments｜简单茶点 ; serve refreshments｜供应茶点 ; refreshment break｜茶歇
tip_zh: 指茶点时通常用复数refreshments；指恢复精神时不可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 完全的；彻底的 | adj. 绝对的；不受限制的
definition_en: complete or total | not limited by conditions, rules, or other authorities
example1_en: The room fell into absolute silence when she entered.
example1_zh: 她一进来，房间里就变得鸦雀无声。
example2_en: Giving any single institution absolute power can weaken accountability and reduce public trust in government.
example2_zh: 赋予任何单一机构不受限制的权力，都可能削弱问责机制并降低公众对政府的信任。
collocations: absolute silence｜鸦雀无声 ; absolute certainty｜绝对肯定 ; absolute power｜绝对权力 ; an absolute necessity｜绝对必需的事物
tip_zh: 常表示程度已达极限，通常不用 very 修饰。

meanings_zh: n. 追踪；跟踪监测
definition_en: The process of following movements or monitoring changes over time.
example1_en: Parcel tracking showed that my package had arrived nearby.
example1_zh: 包裹追踪信息显示，我的包裹已经到附近了。
example2_en: Satellite tracking enables researchers to study animal migration and identify habitats that require stronger protection.
example2_zh: 卫星追踪使研究人员能够研究动物迁徙，并识别需要加强保护的栖息地。
collocations: satellite tracking｜卫星追踪 ; parcel tracking｜包裹追踪 ; tracking device｜追踪装置 ; real-time tracking｜实时追踪
tip_zh: 作名词通常不可数；也是track的现在分词。

meanings_zh: adj. 普遍的；全体适用的 | adj. 通用的
definition_en: Existing everywhere or applying to everyone in a group. | Suitable for use with many different devices or situations.
example1_en: The new playground won universal approval from local families.
example1_zh: 新游乐场得到了当地家庭的一致认可。
example2_en: Universal access to affordable healthcare can reduce inequality and improve the overall wellbeing of a population.
example2_zh: 人人都能获得负担得起的医疗服务，可以减少不平等并改善全民的整体福祉。
collocations: universal access｜普遍享有使用机会 ; universal healthcare｜全民医疗 ; universal appeal｜普遍吸引力 ; universal charger｜通用充电器
tip_zh: 指全体适用或普遍存在，语气通常强于common。

meanings_zh: adj. 共同的；联合的 | n. 关节；接合处
definition_en: Shared, owned, or done by two or more people or groups. | A place where bones or separate parts meet.
example1_en: Buying the sofa was a joint decision with my flatmate.
example1_zh: 买这张沙发是我和室友共同作出的决定。
example2_en: Joint research projects allow universities to share resources and address environmental problems more effectively.
example2_zh: 联合研究项目使大学能够共享资源，更有效地应对环境问题。
collocations: joint effort｜共同努力 ; joint venture｜合资企业 ; joint decision｜共同决定 ; joint pain｜关节疼痛
tip_zh: joint作形容词指共同参与；作名词可指关节。

meanings_zh: n. 耽搁；延误 | n. 持械抢劫
definition_en: A delay that prevents something from continuing as planned | A robbery involving threats with a weapon
example1_en: A hold-up on the bridge made us miss lunch.
example1_zh: 桥上的堵塞让我们错过了午饭。
example2_en: Even a brief hold-up in the supply chain can significantly increase costs for small manufacturers.
example2_zh: 供应链中即使出现短暂延误，也可能显著增加小型制造商的成本。
collocations: traffic hold-up｜交通堵塞 ; a lengthy hold-up｜长时间延误 ; an armed hold-up｜持械抢劫
tip_zh: 名词有连字符；动词短语写作hold up。

meanings_zh: n. 男发言人
definition_en: A man who speaks officially for a group or organisation
example1_en: A spokesman explained why the swimming pool was closed.
example1_zh: 一位男发言人解释了游泳池关闭的原因。
example2_en: The government spokesman announced that additional funding would support public transport improvements in rural communities.
example2_zh: 政府男发言人宣布，将追加资金支持农村地区的公共交通改善。
collocations: a government spokesman｜政府男发言人 ; a company spokesman｜公司男发言人 ; a spokesman for｜……的男发言人
tip_zh: 特指男性；不强调性别时用spokesperson。

meanings_zh: n. 天体或卫星运行轨道 | v. 绕轨道运行；环绕
definition_en: the curved path of an object moving around another in space | to move around a planet, star, or other object in space
example1_en: We watched an animation showing the satellite's orbit.
example1_zh: 我们观看了一段展示卫星运行轨道的动画。
example2_en: Satellites that orbit the Earth provide essential data for weather forecasting, disaster monitoring, and climate research.
example2_zh: 绕地球运行的卫星为天气预报、灾害监测和气候研究提供必要数据。
collocations: in orbit｜在轨道上运行 ; enter orbit｜进入轨道 ; a stable orbit｜稳定的轨道 ; orbit the Earth｜绕地球运行
tip_zh: 动词可直接接天体：orbit the Earth，无须加 around。

meanings_zh: n. 细菌
definition_en: A microscopic single-celled organism, sometimes responsible for disease.
example1_en: Under the microscope, a single bacterium moved slowly.
example1_zh: 显微镜下，一个细菌缓缓移动。
example2_en: Scientists identified a bacterium that could help remove harmful chemicals from polluted soil without damaging nearby plants.
example2_zh: 科学家发现了一种细菌，可帮助去除受污染土壤中的有害化学物质，同时不伤害附近的植物。
collocations: a harmful bacterium｜有害细菌 ; disease-causing bacteria｜致病细菌 ; beneficial bacteria｜有益细菌
tip_zh: 单数bacterium，复数bacteria；复数作主语用are。

meanings_zh: n. 爆发；突然发生
definition_en: The sudden start of a disease or other harmful event.
example1_en: The flu outbreak kept several children home from school.
example1_zh: 流感爆发让几个孩子待在家里，未能上学。
example2_en: Rapid access to reliable health information can help communities respond effectively to an outbreak of infectious disease.
example2_zh: 及时获取可靠的健康信息有助于社区有效应对传染病暴发。
collocations: a disease outbreak｜疾病暴发 ; the outbreak of war｜战争爆发 ; contain an outbreak｜控制疫情
tip_zh: 名词outbreak写成一词；动词用break out。

meanings_zh: adj. 繁荣的；富裕的
definition_en: Financially successful and enjoying wealth or economic growth
example1_en: The once quiet village is now a prosperous market town.
example1_zh: 这个曾经安静的村庄如今已成为繁荣的集镇。
example2_en: A prosperous economy can generate the resources needed to improve education, healthcare, and public infrastructure.
example2_zh: 繁荣的经济能够创造改善教育、医疗和公共基础设施所需的资源。
collocations: prosperous economy｜繁荣的经济 ; prosperous nation｜富裕的国家 ; prosperous future｜富足的未来
tip_zh: 常修饰国家、地区或经济，强调经济上的兴旺。

meanings_zh: v. 移动；转变 | n. 转变；变化 | n. 轮班；轮班工作时间
definition_en: To move or change position, direction, or focus. | A change in position, direction, or emphasis. | A scheduled period of work in a rotating system.
example1_en: We shifted the sofa closer to the window.
example1_zh: 我们把沙发往窗边挪了挪。
example2_en: Governments should shift investment towards public transport to reduce traffic congestion and urban air pollution.
example2_zh: 政府应将投资转向公共交通，以缓解交通拥堵和城市空气污染。
collocations: shift the focus｜转移重点 ; a shift in attitudes｜态度的转变 ; work a night shift｜上夜班 ; shift responsibility｜推卸责任
tip_zh: shift作名词可指变化，也可指工作班次。

meanings_zh: n. 奴隶制度；奴役状态
definition_en: a system where people are owned and forced to work
example1_en: We learned about slavery during our museum visit yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天参观博物馆时，我们了解了奴隶制度。
example2_en: Although slavery has been legally abolished worldwide, forced labour remains a serious challenge for governments and international organisations.
example2_zh: 尽管奴隶制度已在全球范围内被依法废除，强迫劳动仍是各国政府和国际组织面临的严峻挑战。
collocations: abolish slavery｜废除奴隶制 ; modern slavery｜现代奴役 ; the abolition of slavery｜奴隶制的废除
tip_zh: slavery为不可数名词；abolish slavery指废除奴隶制。

meanings_zh: adj. 易爆的；爆炸的 | adj. 爆发性的；激增的 | n. 炸药；爆炸物
definition_en: able or likely to burst violently | increasing very rapidly or appearing with sudden force | a substance that can cause a violent burst of energy
example1_en: These explosive materials must be kept away from heat.
example1_zh: 这些易爆材料必须远离热源存放。
example2_en: The explosive growth of online shopping has increased demand for delivery services and created new challenges for urban planners.
example2_zh: 网络购物的爆发式增长增加了对配送服务的需求，也给城市规划者带来了新的挑战。
collocations: explosive materials｜易爆材料 ; explosive growth｜爆发式增长 ; explosive force｜爆炸力
tip_zh: explosive growth形容激增，并非真正发生爆炸。

meanings_zh: n. 植物的根 | n. 根源；起因 | v. 生根；使生根
definition_en: the part of a plant that absorbs water from soil | the basic cause or origin of something | to grow roots or cause a plant to grow roots
example1_en: Thick roots from the oak have cracked our garden path.
