example1_zh: 橡树粗壮的根把我们花园的小路撑裂了。
example2_en: Effective policies should address the root of poverty rather than simply provide temporary financial assistance.
example2_zh: 有效的政策应解决贫困的根源，而不只是提供临时的经济援助。
collocations: root cause｜根本原因 ; take root｜生根；扎根 ; at the root of｜是……的根源 ; plant roots｜植物根部
tip_zh: root本身不表示根除；root out才表示根除。

meanings_zh: n. 订阅；订购 | n. 订阅费；会员费
definition_en: An arrangement to receive a service or publication regularly. | Money paid regularly for a publication, service, or membership.
example1_en: I cancelled my magazine subscription before moving abroad.
example1_zh: 我在搬到国外之前取消了杂志订阅。
example2_en: Subscription services can widen access to educational resources, although recurring fees may exclude lower-income households.
example2_zh: 订阅服务可以扩大教育资源的获取渠道，但持续收费可能将低收入家庭排除在外。
collocations: an annual subscription｜年度订阅 ; subscription fee｜订阅费 ; renew a subscription｜续订 ; cancel a subscription｜取消订阅
tip_zh: subscription是订阅或费用；用户是subscriber。

meanings_zh: adj. 迅速的；快速的 | n. 急流；险滩
definition_en: Happening or moving very quickly. | A fast, turbulent stretch of river, usually called rapids.
example1_en: Her rapid recovery surprised everyone in the family.
example1_zh: 她恢复得如此迅速，让全家人都感到惊讶。
example2_en: Rapid urban growth often places considerable pressure on public transport, housing, and essential services.
example2_zh: 城市的快速发展往往给公共交通、住房和基本服务带来相当大的压力。
collocations: rapid growth｜快速增长 ; rapid change｜迅速变化 ; rapid recovery｜迅速恢复 ; white-water rapids｜激流险滩
tip_zh: rapid常修饰变化或增长；急流通常用rapids。

meanings_zh: n. 女神
definition_en: A female deity worshipped in a religion or described in mythology.
example1_en: The museum displayed a stone statue of a goddess.
example1_zh: 博物馆展出了一尊女神石像。
example2_en: Ancient sculptures of a harvest goddess reveal how closely religious beliefs were connected to agriculture.
example2_zh: 古代丰收女神雕像揭示了宗教信仰与农业之间的紧密联系。
collocations: goddess of wisdom｜智慧女神 ; harvest goddess｜丰收女神 ; worship a goddess｜崇拜女神
tip_zh: goddess指女神，对应男性神祇通常用god。

meanings_zh: n. 警报器；警报声
definition_en: a device producing a loud warning sound, or that sound
example1_en: An ambulance siren woke me early this morning.
example1_zh: 今天一大早，救护车的警报声把我吵醒了。
example2_en: Emergency sirens can help coastal communities respond quickly when severe storms threaten their safety.
example2_zh: 当强风暴威胁沿海社区的安全时，应急警报器能帮助居民迅速作出反应。
collocations: sound a siren｜拉响警报器 ; ambulance siren｜救护车警报声 ; warning siren｜警报器
tip_zh: 可指发声的警报器，也可指其发出的警报声。

meanings_zh: v. 背诵；朗诵 | v. 逐一叙述；列举
definition_en: Say a poem or passage aloud, often from memory | Say a series of facts or details aloud
example1_en: My sister recited a short poem after dinner.
example1_zh: 晚饭后，我妹妹背诵了一首短诗。
example2_en: Students who merely recite facts may struggle to apply their knowledge to unfamiliar problems.
example2_zh: 只会背诵事实的学生可能难以运用知识解决陌生的问题。
collocations: recite a poem｜背诵诗歌 ; recite from memory｜凭记忆背诵 ; recite a list｜逐一念出清单
tip_zh: recite强调出声背诵；memorise强调记住。

meanings_zh: adj. 悲观的
definition_en: Expecting bad results or focusing on possible problems.
example1_en: He felt pessimistic about the picnic when clouds gathered.
example1_zh: 乌云聚拢时，他觉得野餐恐怕办不成了。
example2_en: Young people may become pessimistic about their career prospects when stable employment opportunities remain limited.
example2_zh: 当稳定的就业机会持续不足时，年轻人可能对职业前景感到悲观。
collocations: pessimistic about the future｜对未来悲观 ; a pessimistic outlook｜悲观的看法 ; a pessimistic forecast｜悲观的预测
tip_zh: 常用be pessimistic about；反义词是optimistic。

meanings_zh: n. 课程作业
definition_en: Work completed during a course, often contributing to final assessment.
example1_en: I finished my coursework before meeting friends for lunch.
example1_zh: 我先完成了课程作业，然后去和朋友吃午饭。
example2_en: Assessing students through coursework can provide a broader picture of their abilities than relying solely on examinations.
example2_zh: 与只依靠考试相比，通过课程作业评估学生能更全面地反映他们的能力。
collocations: submit coursework｜提交课程作业 ; complete coursework｜完成课程作业 ; coursework assessment｜课程作业考核
tip_zh: 不可数，不说 a coursework；一份用 a piece of。

meanings_zh: adj. 至关重要的；关键的
definition_en: extremely important to the success or outcome of something
example1_en: Your spare key was crucial when I locked myself out.
example1_zh: 我把自己锁在门外时，你的备用钥匙派上了关键用场。
example2_en: Access to reliable public transport is crucial for people seeking employment beyond their immediate neighbourhoods.
example2_zh: 对于想在居住地附近以外寻找工作的人来说，可靠的公共交通至关重要。
collocations: a crucial role｜关键作用 ; a crucial factor｜关键因素 ; crucial to success｜对成功至关重要 ; a crucial decision｜关键决定
tip_zh: 比important语气强；常用be crucial to。

meanings_zh: v. 拆毁；拆除 | v. 彻底驳倒
definition_en: To completely destroy a building or other structure. | To show clearly that an argument or theory is wrong.
example1_en: Workers demolished the old garage behind our house.
example1_zh: 工人拆除了我们房子后面的旧车库。
example2_en: Cities should consider restoring historic buildings rather than demolishing them to make space for new developments.
example2_zh: 城市应考虑修复历史建筑，而不是将其拆除以腾出空间进行新开发。
collocations: demolish a building｜拆除建筑 ; demolish an argument｜彻底驳倒论点 ; demolish completely｜彻底拆毁
tip_zh: 及物动词，直接接宾语；也可指彻底驳倒论点。

meanings_zh: n. 顾问；咨询专家 | n. 高级专科医生
definition_en: An expert paid to provide specialist advice. | A senior hospital doctor specialising in a particular medical field.
example1_en: We hired a consultant to help improve our small business.
example1_zh: 我们聘请了一位顾问，帮助改善小公司的经营。
example2_en: An environmental consultant can help companies reduce waste while ensuring that their operations comply with national regulations.
example2_zh: 环境顾问可以帮助企业减少废弃物，同时确保其运营符合国家法规。
collocations: a management consultant｜管理顾问 ; an environmental consultant｜环境顾问 ; hire a consultant｜聘请顾问 ; a consultant surgeon｜高级外科医生
tip_zh: 医疗语境中，英国的consultant指高级专科医生。

meanings_zh: v. 操作；运转 | v. 经营；运营 | v. 做手术
definition_en: to control equipment, or to work as a machine | to run a business or provide a service | to perform surgery on a patient
example1_en: Can you show me how to operate this printer?
example1_zh: 你能教我怎么操作这台打印机吗？
example2_en: Companies that operate in rural areas often face higher transport costs and limited access to skilled workers.
example2_zh: 在农村地区经营的公司往往面临较高的运输成本，而且难以找到技术熟练的员工。
collocations: operate machinery｜操作机器 ; operate a business｜经营企业 ; operate on a patient｜给病人做手术 ; operate efficiently｜高效运转
tip_zh: 操作机器直接接宾语；给某人做手术用operate on。

meanings_zh: n. 同伴；伴侣 | n. 参考指南；手册
definition_en: a person or animal that spends time with someone | a book providing useful information about a particular subject
example1_en: My dog has been a loyal companion for years.
example1_zh: 多年来，我的狗一直是忠实的伙伴。
example2_en: For older adults living alone, a companion can reduce loneliness and encourage regular participation in community activities.
example2_zh: 对于独居老人来说，同伴可以减轻孤独感，并鼓励他们定期参加社区活动。
collocations: a travelling companion｜旅伴 ; a loyal companion｜忠实的伙伴 ; a companion to literature｜文学指南
tip_zh: companion强调陪伴，不一定是好友，也可指动物。

meanings_zh: adj. 极其愤怒的 | adj. 猛烈的；激烈的
definition_en: Feeling or showing extreme anger. | Done with great force, energy, or speed.
example1_en: Lena was furious when someone scratched her new bicycle.
example1_zh: 有人刮花了莉娜的新自行车，她气坏了。
example2_en: Residents were furious about the sudden closure of a public park without any community consultation.
example2_zh: 一座公园未经任何社区协商就突然关闭，居民对此十分愤怒。
collocations: furious with someone｜对某人大发雷霆 ; furious about something｜因某事极其愤怒 ; a furious debate｜激烈的辩论
tip_zh: 对某人生气用with，因某事生气用about。

meanings_zh: v. 刺穿；扎破 | v. 穿透；划破
definition_en: to make a hole through something with a sharp object | to pass sharply through darkness, silence, or another barrier
example1_en: Use a fork to pierce the potato before baking.
example1_zh: 烘烤前，用叉子在土豆上扎几个孔。
example2_en: Powerful artificial lights pierce the darkness around coastal developments, potentially disturbing the behaviour of nesting birds.
example2_zh: 沿海开发区周围的强烈人造光穿透黑暗，可能干扰筑巢鸟类的行为。
collocations: pierce a hole｜刺出一个孔 ; have your ears pierced｜打耳洞 ; pierce the darkness｜穿透黑暗
tip_zh: 打耳洞常说have/get your ears pierced。

meanings_zh: n. 脚步；脚步声
definition_en: a step taken when walking, or the sound it makes
example1_en: I heard footsteps outside my bedroom and opened the door.
example1_zh: 我听见卧室外有脚步声，便打开了门。
example2_en: In shared housing, footsteps from upstairs can disturb residents and highlight the need for better sound insulation.
example2_zh: 在合住房屋中，楼上的脚步声可能打扰住户，凸显改善隔音的必要性。
collocations: hear footsteps｜听见脚步声 ; heavy footsteps｜沉重的脚步声 ; follow in someone's footsteps｜追随某人的足迹
tip_zh: 常用复数；footprint指留下的脚印。

meanings_zh: n. 黏土；陶土
definition_en: Heavy earth that can be shaped when wet and baked hard.
example1_en: The children shaped wet clay into tiny bowls.
example1_zh: 孩子们把湿陶土捏成了小碗。
example2_en: Traditional clay buildings can provide effective insulation, helping communities maintain comfortable indoor temperatures with less energy.
example2_zh: 传统黏土建筑能有效隔热，帮助社区以更少的能源维持舒适的室内温度。
collocations: wet clay｜湿黏土 ; clay soil｜黏土土壤 ; a clay pot｜陶罐 ; shape clay｜塑造陶土
tip_zh: 通常不可数；a piece of clay表示一块黏土。

meanings_zh: v. 延长；扩大 | v. 伸出；伸展 | v. 给予；表示
definition_en: To make something longer, larger, or wider in scope | To stretch out a hand, arm, or other body part | To offer someone help, an invitation, or a welcome
example1_en: We extended our holiday because the weather was so lovely.
example1_zh: 天气实在太好了，我们便延长了假期。
example2_en: Governments should extend public transport networks to ensure that residents of outer suburbs can access employment opportunities.
example2_zh: 政府应扩大公共交通网络，确保远郊居民能够获得就业机会。
collocations: extend a deadline｜延长截止期限 ; extend a network｜扩展网络 ; extend your hand｜伸出手 ; extend a warm welcome｜表示热烈欢迎
tip_zh: extend by接增加量；extend to接新的终点或期限。

meanings_zh: n. 摩擦；摩擦力 | n. 不和；冲突
definition_en: Resistance when one surface moves or rubs against another. | Disagreement or tension between people or groups.
example1_en: Rubbing your hands together creates friction and warms them.
example1_zh: 双手搓动会产生摩擦，让手暖和起来。
example2_en: Competition for limited housing can create friction between established residents and people moving into a city.
example2_zh: 对有限住房的争夺可能导致原有居民与新迁入城市的人之间产生摩擦。
collocations: reduce friction｜减小摩擦 ; friction between surfaces｜表面之间的摩擦 ; cause friction｜引起不和 ; a source of friction｜冲突的根源
tip_zh: 物理摩擦与人际不和两义均通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 经济衰退 | n. 退缩；消退
definition_en: A period when economic activity falls and many businesses struggle. | The gradual movement of something backwards from its previous position.
example1_en: During the recession, my uncle struggled to find work.
example1_zh: 经济衰退期间，我叔叔很难找到工作。
example2_en: Governments may increase public investment during a recession to protect jobs and stimulate consumer demand.
example2_zh: 政府可能在经济衰退期间增加公共投资，以保障就业并刺激消费需求。
collocations: economic recession｜经济衰退 ; deep recession｜严重衰退 ; enter a recession｜进入衰退期 ; gum recession｜牙龈萎缩
tip_zh: 通常指整体经济衰退，不等于单纯价格下跌。

meanings_zh: n. 害虫；有害动物 | n. 讨厌的人；烦人精
definition_en: An insect or animal that damages crops, food, or property. | Someone who annoys others, especially repeatedly.
example1_en: These tiny pests have eaten holes in my cabbage leaves.
example1_zh: 这些小害虫把我的卷心菜叶咬出了洞。
example2_en: Farmers can control pests through biological methods that reduce reliance on chemicals and protect beneficial insects.
example2_zh: 农民可以采用生物方法防治害虫，减少对化学品的依赖并保护益虫。
collocations: pest control｜害虫防治 ; crop pests｜作物害虫 ; a garden pest｜花园害虫
tip_zh: pest不限于昆虫，也可指老鼠等有害动物。

meanings_zh: v. 给……投保；投保
definition_en: Arrange financial protection against loss, damage, illness, or injury.
example1_en: We insured our bicycles before taking them abroad.
example1_zh: 我们带自行车出国前，先给它们买了保险。
example2_en: Small businesses should insure their premises against fire to avoid potentially devastating financial losses.
example2_zh: 小企业应为经营场所投保火险，以避免可能造成毁灭性打击的经济损失。
collocations: insure against theft｜投保盗窃险 ; insure a vehicle｜给车辆投保 ; fully insured｜已足额投保
tip_zh: insure主要指投保；表示确保通常用ensure。

meanings_zh: n. 失事船只；严重损毁的车辆 | v. 毁坏；破坏
definition_en: A ship or vehicle that has been badly damaged. | To badly damage something or ruin a plan.
example1_en: Divers found a shipwreck beside the wreck of a submarine.
example1_zh: 潜水员在一艘潜艇残骸旁发现了一艘沉船。
example2_en: Poorly planned construction can wreck historic neighbourhoods and permanently reduce their cultural value for future generations.
example2_zh: 规划不当的建设会毁坏历史街区，并永久削弱其对后代的文化价值。
collocations: a shipwreck's wreck｜沉船残骸 ; a car wreck｜汽车残骸 ; wreck someone's plans｜打乱某人的计划
tip_zh: wreck可指一艘失事船；wreckage泛指残骸。

meanings_zh: v. 查明；确定 | v. 决定；影响结果 | v. 决定；下决心
definition_en: To discover or establish something through examination. | To control or strongly influence what happens. | To make a firm decision to do something.
example1_en: The mechanic determined why my bicycle brakes were sticking.
example1_zh: 修车师傅查明了我的自行车刹车卡住的原因。
example2_en: Researchers must determine whether smaller classes improve learning outcomes before governments invest heavily in additional teaching staff.
example2_zh: 在政府投入大量资金增聘教师之前，研究人员必须确定小班教学是否能改善学习成果。
collocations: determine the cause｜查明原因 ; determine whether｜确定是否 ; determine the outcome｜决定结果 ; be determined to｜决心做……
tip_zh: determine whether 意为查明是否；后接从句。

meanings_zh: n. 结果；成果
definition_en: The final result of an action, event, or process.
example1_en: We were pleased with the outcome of the meeting.
example1_zh: 我们对会议的结果很满意。
example2_en: Early access to medical care can improve health outcomes for children in disadvantaged communities.
example2_zh: 尽早获得医疗服务可以改善弱势社区儿童的健康状况。
collocations: positive outcome｜积极的结果 ; learning outcomes｜学习成果 ; health outcomes｜健康结果 ; likely outcome｜可能的结果
tip_zh: 可数名词，常用the outcome of表示某事的结果。

meanings_zh: n. 兽群；畜群 | v. 驱赶；使聚集
definition_en: a group of large animals living or moving together | to guide animals or people together in a particular direction
example1_en: A herd of cows blocked the narrow country road.
example1_zh: 一群奶牛堵住了狭窄的乡间道路。
example2_en: Protecting migration routes allows herds of wild animals to reach essential sources of food and water.
example2_zh: 保护迁徙路线能让野生动物群到达重要的食物和水源所在地。
collocations: a herd of cattle｜一群牛 ; herd animals｜群居动物 ; herd cattle｜驱赶牛群 ; herd instinct｜从众本能
tip_zh: 牛、象等成群用herd；羊群、鸟群通常用flock。

meanings_zh: n. 小器具；小装置
definition_en: A small device designed to perform a particular useful task
example1_en: This handy gadget removes apple cores in seconds.
example1_zh: 这个方便的小器具几秒钟就能去掉苹果核。
example2_en: Although a new electronic gadget may offer convenience, frequent replacement contributes to growing amounts of electronic waste.
example2_zh: 虽然新的电子小装置可能带来便利，但频繁更换会导致电子垃圾不断增加。
collocations: electronic gadget｜电子小装置 ; kitchen gadget｜厨房小器具 ; handy gadget｜实用的小器具
tip_zh: 指有特定用途的小装置，不一定是电子产品。

meanings_zh: n. 清醒状态；知觉 | n. 意识；认识
definition_en: The state of being awake and aware of your surroundings | Awareness or understanding of a particular issue or situation
example1_en: He regained consciousness shortly after the ambulance arrived.
example1_zh: 救护车到达后不久，他就恢复了知觉。
example2_en: Environmental education can raise public consciousness of how everyday consumption affects natural resources and biodiversity.
example2_zh: 环境教育可以提高公众对日常消费如何影响自然资源和生物多样性的认识。
collocations: lose consciousness｜失去知觉 ; regain consciousness｜恢复知觉 ; environmental consciousness｜环保意识
tip_zh: consciousness指意识或知觉；conscience指良心。

meanings_zh: n. 礼仪；礼节
definition_en: Accepted rules of polite behaviour in particular social situations.
example1_en: My aunt taught me basic table etiquette before dinner.
example1_zh: 晚饭前，姑姑教了我基本的餐桌礼仪。
example2_en: Learning local etiquette can help international students avoid misunderstandings and build stronger relationships with their hosts.
example2_zh: 学习当地礼仪可以帮助留学生避免误会，并与接待他们的人建立更好的关系。
collocations: table etiquette｜餐桌礼仪 ; business etiquette｜商务礼仪 ; social etiquette｜社交礼仪 ; rules of etiquette｜礼仪规范
tip_zh: 通常不可数；表示礼仪规范，不指单个动作。

meanings_zh: v. 吼叫；轰鸣 | n. 吼声；轰鸣声
definition_en: to make a very loud, deep sound | a very loud, deep sound
example1_en: The lion roared, and its cubs huddled closer together.
example1_zh: 狮子吼了一声，幼狮们挤得更紧了。
example2_en: Aircraft engines roar above nearby homes, exposing residents to noise pollution that can affect sleep quality.
example2_zh: 飞机发动机在附近住宅上空轰鸣，使居民遭受可能影响睡眠质量的噪声污染。
collocations: roar with laughter｜放声大笑 ; a roar of applause｜雷鸣般的掌声 ; the roar of an engine｜发动机的轰鸣声
tip_zh: 既可指狮子吼叫，也可指引擎轰鸣或人群欢呼。

meanings_zh: n. 纤维 | n. 膳食纤维
definition_en: a thin thread forming part of a material or tissue | plant material in food that helps digestion
example1_en: A loose fibre was sticking out of my scarf.
example1_zh: 我的围巾上有一根松脱的纤维伸了出来。
example2_en: A diet rich in fibre can support digestive health and help people feel full for longer.
example2_zh: 富含膳食纤维的饮食有助于消化健康，并能延长饱腹感。
collocations: natural fibres｜天然纤维 ; dietary fibre｜膳食纤维 ; optical fibre｜光纤
tip_zh: 美式拼写为 fiber；膳食纤维义通常不可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 比较的；对比的 | adj. 相对的；比较而言的 | n. 比较级
definition_en: Examining similarities or differences between two or more things. | True to some degree when compared with something else. | An adjective or adverb form expressing a higher or lower degree.
example1_en: We enjoyed the comparative quiet of the village.
example1_zh: 我们很享受村里相对宁静的环境。
example2_en: A comparative study of transport systems can help cities identify effective ways to reduce congestion.
example2_zh: 对交通系统进行比较研究可以帮助城市找到缓解拥堵的有效方法。
collocations: comparative study｜比较研究 ; comparative advantage｜比较优势 ; comparative analysis｜对比分析 ; comparative form｜比较级形式
tip_zh: comparative还可指语法比较级，如better。

meanings_zh: v. 恢复；使复原 | v. 修复；整修 | v. 归还；交还
definition_en: To bring back a previous condition, ability, or situation. | To repair something old or damaged to its earlier condition. | To return something to its rightful owner or place.
example1_en: The engineers restored power before our food went bad.
example1_zh: 工程师们在我们的食物变质之前恢复了供电。
example2_en: Planting native trees can help restore damaged ecosystems and provide essential habitats for local wildlife.
example2_zh: 种植本土树木有助于修复受损的生态系统，并为当地野生动物提供必要的栖息地。
collocations: restore confidence｜恢复信心 ; restore power｜恢复供电 ; restore a historic building｜修复历史建筑 ; restore something to its owner｜将某物归还原主
tip_zh: restore A to B：使A恢复到B状态或归还给B。

meanings_zh: pron. 后者 | adj. 后半的；末尾的
definition_en: the second of two people or things already mentioned | closer to the end of a period or sequence
example1_en: We tried swimming and cycling, but preferred the latter.
example1_zh: 我们尝试了游泳和骑车，但更喜欢后者。
example2_en: Although both prevention and treatment deserve funding, healthcare budgets often devote more resources to the latter.
example2_zh: 尽管预防和治疗都值得投入资金，医疗预算往往将更多资源用于后者。
collocations: the former and the latter｜前者与后者 ; the latter half｜后半部分 ; the latter stages｜后期阶段
tip_zh: the latter指两者中的后者，不等于later。

meanings_zh: n. 货物；船货
definition_en: goods carried by a ship, aircraft, or other large vehicle
example1_en: The crane lifted the cargo onto the waiting ship.
example1_zh: 起重机把货物吊上了等候的船。
example2_en: Moving cargo by rail rather than road can reduce emissions and ease congestion on major highways.
example2_zh: 用铁路而非公路运输货物，可以减少排放并缓解主要公路的拥堵。
collocations: cargo ship｜货船 ; air cargo｜空运货物 ; load cargo｜装载货物 ; cargo hold｜货舱
tip_zh: cargo通常指运输的货物，不指旅客的随身行李。

meanings_zh: adj. 强烈的；剧烈的 | adj. 投入的；情感强烈的
definition_en: very strong or extreme in degree | showing very strong feelings or serious concentration
example1_en: The intense heat made us search for shade.
example1_zh: 酷热让我们四处寻找阴凉处。
example2_en: Intense competition for university places can place considerable psychological pressure on students during their final school year.
example2_zh: 大学入学名额的激烈竞争，可能给毕业年级学生带来相当大的心理压力。
collocations: intense heat｜酷热 ; intense pressure｜巨大压力 ; intense competition｜激烈竞争 ; intense concentration｜高度专注
tip_zh: intense 强调程度强烈；intensive 强调密集投入。

meanings_zh: adj. 无辜的；无罪的 | adj. 天真的；单纯的 | adj. 无恶意的；无害的
definition_en: Not responsible for a crime or wrongdoing. | Lacking experience or knowledge of unpleasant aspects of life. | Not intended to hurt, offend, or cause trouble.
example1_en: The broken vase was not his fault; he was innocent.
example1_zh: 花瓶打碎不是他的错，他是无辜的。
example2_en: A fair legal system must protect innocent people while ensuring that those responsible for crimes face justice.
example2_zh: 公平的法律制度必须保护无辜者，同时确保犯罪者受到法律制裁。
collocations: innocent of a crime｜未犯某罪 ; innocent victims｜无辜的受害者 ; an innocent mistake｜无心之失
tip_zh: 表示未犯某罪用innocent of，不用innocent from。

meanings_zh: v. 腐烂；使腐烂 | n. 腐烂；腐朽
definition_en: to break down naturally, or cause something to do so | the process or condition of decaying
example1_en: The peaches will rot if you leave them outside.
example1_zh: 如果把桃子放在外面，它们会烂掉。
example2_en: Poor ventilation allows moisture to accumulate in older buildings, increasing the risk of rot in wooden structures.
example2_zh: 通风不良会使老建筑内积聚湿气，增加木质结构腐朽的风险。
collocations: wood rot｜木材腐朽 ; rot away｜逐渐腐烂 ; dry rot｜干腐病
tip_zh: rot与decay都可指腐烂；rotting须双写t。

meanings_zh: n. 账户扣款；借记 | v. 从账户扣款；借记
definition_en: An amount recorded as money taken from a bank account. | To record money as taken from a bank account.
example1_en: The bank debited my account twice for the same purchase.
example1_zh: 同一笔消费，银行从我的账户扣了两次款。
example2_en: Consumers should check bank statements regularly to identify any unexpected debits and report potential errors.
example2_zh: 消费者应定期查看银行对账单，发现任何意外扣款并报告可能的错误。
collocations: debit card｜借记卡 ; direct debit｜自动扣款 ; debit an account｜从账户扣款
tip_zh: 借记卡用账户余额；信用卡使用授信额度。

meanings_zh: n. 市郊；城镇边缘
definition_en: The outer parts of a town or city; usually plural
example1_en: My aunt lives on the outskirts near a farm.
example1_zh: 我姑妈住在市郊，附近有个农场。
example2_en: Building affordable housing on the outskirts can reduce costs but may increase residents' dependence on cars.
example2_zh: 在市郊建设经济适用房可以降低成本，但可能增加居民对汽车的依赖。
collocations: on the outskirts of｜在……的市郊 ; the outskirts of town｜城镇边缘
tip_zh: 通常用复数 outskirts，搭配 on 而非 in。

meanings_zh: n. 露台；庭院铺地区
definition_en: a paved outdoor area beside a house for sitting or eating
example1_en: We ate breakfast on the patio beside the roses.
example1_zh: 我们在玫瑰花旁的露台上吃了早餐。
example2_en: A shaded patio can provide residents with a comfortable outdoor space during the warmer months.
example2_zh: 有遮阴的露台可以在较暖的月份为居民提供舒适的户外空间。
collocations: patio furniture｜露台家具 ; on the patio｜在露台上 ; a shaded patio｜有遮阴的露台
tip_zh: 通常指房屋旁铺地的户外休憩区，不一定有围墙。

meanings_zh: n. 簿记员；记账员
definition_en: Someone whose job is recording a business's financial transactions.
example1_en: Our bookkeeper checks the receipts every Friday afternoon.
example1_zh: 我们的记账员每周五下午核对收据。
example2_en: Small businesses often employ a bookkeeper to maintain accurate financial records and track daily expenses.
example2_zh: 小企业经常雇用记账员，以保持财务记录准确并追踪日常开支。
collocations: employ a bookkeeper｜雇用记账员 ; part-time bookkeeper｜兼职记账员 ; experienced bookkeeper｜经验丰富的记账员
tip_zh: 主要负责日常记账；accountant职责通常更广。

meanings_zh: adj. 无限的；不限量的
definition_en: not restricted in amount, number, or extent
example1_en: Our hotel offers unlimited coffee with breakfast each morning.
example1_zh: 我们住的酒店每天早餐都提供不限量的咖啡。
example2_en: Economic growth cannot rely on unlimited consumption of natural resources without causing serious environmental damage.
example2_zh: 经济增长若依赖无限消耗自然资源，就必然会造成严重的环境破坏。
collocations: unlimited access｜无限制使用权 ; unlimited potential｜无限潜力 ; unlimited resources｜无限资源
tip_zh: 表示没有限制；不等于 uncertain（不确定的）。

meanings_zh: v. 帮助；协助
definition_en: To help someone do something.
example1_en: A friendly librarian assisted me with the printer.
example1_zh: 一位友善的图书管理员帮我使用了打印机。
example2_en: Local volunteers can assist older residents with online services, making essential information more accessible.
example2_zh: 当地志愿者可以帮助老年居民使用在线服务，让他们更容易获取重要信息。
collocations: assist someone with something｜帮助某人处理某事 ; assist in doing something｜协助做某事 ; assist someone to do something｜帮助某人做某事
tip_zh: 比help正式；常用assist someone with something。

meanings_zh: n. 茎；梗 | v. 源于；由…造成 | v. 遏制；阻止
definition_en: the main plant part supporting leaves, flowers, or fruit | originate or result from something | stop or reduce an unwanted flow or increase
example1_en: She cut the rose stem before filling the vase.
example1_zh: 她先修剪了玫瑰的花茎，再给花瓶加水。
example2_en: Many urban transport problems stem from poor planning rather than a simple shortage of road space.
example2_zh: 许多城市交通问题源于规划不善，而不只是道路空间不足。
collocations: plant stem｜植物茎 ; stem from｜源于 ; stem the flow of｜遏制…的流动 ; stem the tide of｜遏制…的势头
tip_zh: “源于”用stem from；大写STEM指理工科。

meanings_zh: v. 简化；使易懂
definition_en: To make something less complicated or easier to understand.
example1_en: Could you simplify these instructions before I start cooking?
example1_zh: 我开始做饭之前，你能把这些步骤说得简单些吗？
example2_en: Governments should simplify application procedures so that small businesses can access financial support more easily.
example2_zh: 政府应简化申请流程，让小企业更容易获得资金支持。
collocations: simplify a process｜简化流程 ; simplify procedures｜简化手续 ; simplify an explanation｜使解释更易懂
tip_zh: simplify强调减少复杂性；simple是形容词。

meanings_zh: n. 安装；设置 | n. 大型设备；设施 | n. 装置艺术作品
definition_en: the process of putting equipment or software in place for use | equipment or buildings arranged for a particular purpose | an artwork made by arranging objects within a space
example1_en: Installation of our new dishwasher took less than an hour.
example1_zh: 我们的新洗碗机不到一小时就装好了。
example2_en: The installation of solar panels on public buildings can lower energy costs and reduce carbon emissions.
example2_zh: 在公共建筑上安装太阳能电池板可以降低能源成本并减少碳排放。
collocations: installation costs｜安装费用 ; software installation｜软件安装 ; electrical installation｜电气设备安装 ; art installation｜装置艺术作品
tip_zh: 表示安装过程通常不可数；具体设施或作品可数。

meanings_zh: n. 偏见；偏向 | n. 偏差 | v. 使产生偏见；使偏向
definition_en: an unfair preference for or against a person or group | a systematic distortion that makes research results less accurate | to unfairly influence someone's judgement or a study's results
example1_en: The referee showed clear bias towards the home team.
example1_zh: 裁判明显偏袒主队。
example2_en: Researchers should select participants carefully to minimise bias and ensure that their findings represent the wider population.
example2_zh: 研究人员应谨慎选择参与者，以尽量减少偏差，确保研究结果能够代表更广泛的人群。
collocations: bias against｜对……的偏见 ; gender bias｜性别偏见 ; sampling bias｜抽样偏差 ; unconscious bias｜无意识偏见
tip_zh: bias against 指对……有偏见；in favour of 指偏袒。

meanings_zh: v. 复制；再现 | v. 繁殖；生育
definition_en: To make a copy or create the same result again. | To produce young animals, plants, or other living organisms.
example1_en: This printer reproduces every detail of my pencil drawings.
example1_zh: 这台打印机能复制出我铅笔画中的每一处细节。
example2_en: Researchers must describe their methods clearly so that other teams can reproduce their results independently.
example2_zh: 研究人员必须清楚描述研究方法，以便其他团队独立复现其结果。
collocations: reproduce results｜复现结果 ; reproduce an image｜复制图像 ; reproduce sexually｜进行有性生殖
tip_zh: 复制某物时及物；表示繁殖时常不及物。

meanings_zh: n. 大腿
definition_en: The upper part of the leg, above the knee.
example1_en: My thighs ached after cycling up the steep hill.
example1_zh: 骑车爬上陡坡后，我的大腿酸痛。
example2_en: Regular cycling strengthens the thigh muscles and can improve overall fitness without excessive joint strain.
example2_zh: 经常骑自行车能增强大腿肌肉、改善整体体能，又不会给关节带来过大负担。
collocations: thigh muscles｜大腿肌肉 ; inner thigh｜大腿内侧 ; thigh injury｜大腿受伤
tip_zh: 指髋部到膝盖之间；小腿通常用lower leg。

meanings_zh: n. 截止日期；最后期限
definition_en: The latest time by which something must be completed
example1_en: I stayed up late to meet the application deadline.
example1_zh: 我熬夜赶在截止日期前完成了申请。
example2_en: Setting a realistic deadline allows researchers to maintain quality without delaying the publication of important findings.
example2_zh: 设定合理的截止日期能让研究人员保证质量，同时不耽误重要发现的发表。
collocations: meet a deadline｜按期完成 ; miss a deadline｜错过截止期限 ; extend a deadline｜延长截止期限 ; a tight deadline｜紧迫的截止期限
tip_zh: 按期完成用meet a deadline，不用catch。

meanings_zh: n. 奴隶 | v. 苦干；辛苦工作
definition_en: a person owned by another and forced to work | to work extremely hard for a long time
example1_en: The museum tells the story of a slave who escaped.
example1_zh: 这家博物馆讲述了一名奴隶逃离奴役的故事。
example2_en: Studying the experiences of slaves helps students understand the human consequences of historical systems of exploitation.
example2_zh: 研究奴隶的经历有助于学生理解历史上剥削制度给人带来的影响。
collocations: the slave trade｜奴隶贸易 ; free slaves｜解放奴隶 ; slave away｜拼命干活
tip_zh: 历史语境可用enslaved person，强调其人的身份。

meanings_zh: n. 抑郁症；抑郁 | n. 经济萧条 | n. 洼地；凹陷
definition_en: a condition involving persistent sadness and loss of interest | a long period of severely reduced economic activity | an area lower than the surface around it
example1_en: Her doctor recommended regular counselling to help manage depression.
example1_zh: 她的医生建议定期接受心理咨询，以帮助缓解抑郁症。
example2_en: Improving access to mental health services can help people with depression receive timely support and appropriate treatment.
example2_zh: 改善心理健康服务的可及性，可以帮助抑郁症患者及时获得支持和适当治疗。
collocations: suffer from depression｜患抑郁症 ; severe depression｜重度抑郁症 ; economic depression｜经济萧条 ; treat depression｜治疗抑郁症
tip_zh: 抑郁症不等于短暂心情低落；经济萧条常用a depression。

meanings_zh: v. 促进；激发 | v. 刺激生理活动
definition_en: to encourage something to develop or become more active | to make a body part or biological process more active
example1_en: These colourful puzzles stimulate my daughter's curiosity every morning.
example1_zh: 这些色彩鲜艳的拼图每天早上都能激发我女儿的好奇心。
example2_en: Lower borrowing costs can stimulate economic growth by encouraging businesses to invest in new equipment.
example2_zh: 降低借贷成本可以鼓励企业投资新设备，从而促进经济增长。
collocations: stimulate growth｜促进增长 ; stimulate interest｜激发兴趣 ; stimulate demand｜刺激需求 ; stimulate the brain｜刺激大脑活动
tip_zh: 直接接宾语：stimulate interest表示激发兴趣。

meanings_zh: adj. 公司的；企业的 | adj. 集体的；全体的
definition_en: Relating to a company or businesses in general. | Shared by a group acting together as one body.
example1_en: My sister handles corporate travel for a small company.
example1_zh: 我姐姐为一家小公司安排商务差旅。
example2_en: Greater corporate transparency allows consumers to assess whether businesses genuinely meet their environmental and social commitments.
example2_zh: 提高企业透明度能让消费者判断企业是否真正履行了环境和社会承诺。
collocations: corporate culture｜企业文化 ; corporate responsibility｜企业责任 ; corporate profits｜企业利润 ; corporate identity｜企业形象
tip_zh: corporate指企业的；cooperative指合作的。

meanings_zh: n. 供应商；供应者
definition_en: a person or company that provides goods or services
example1_en: Our bakery gets fresh flour from a local supplier.
example1_zh: 我们面包店从一家本地供应商那里购买新鲜面粉。
example2_en: Businesses should assess each supplier carefully to ensure that materials are produced under fair working conditions.
example2_zh: 企业应仔细评估每一家供应商，确保原材料在公平的劳动条件下生产。
collocations: local supplier｜本地供应商 ; reliable supplier｜可靠的供应商 ; energy supplier｜能源供应商 ; major supplier｜主要供应商
tip_zh: supplier of后接所供物品；supply为其动词形式。

meanings_zh: n. 研究结果；调查发现 | n. 裁定；判决
definition_en: Information discovered through research or an investigation. | An official decision made by a court after considering evidence.
example1_en: The doctor's findings explained why I felt so tired.
example1_zh: 医生的检查结果解释了我为什么这么疲倦。
example2_en: The findings indicate that affordable public transport can significantly improve access to employment in disadvantaged areas.
example2_zh: 研究结果表明，价格实惠的公共交通能显著改善弱势地区居民的就业机会。
collocations: research findings｜研究结果 ; key findings｜主要发现 ; publish the findings｜公布调查结果 ; a finding of fact｜事实认定
tip_zh: 表示研究或调查结果时，常用复数findings。

meanings_zh: adj. 各自的；分别的
definition_en: Belonging separately to each person or thing already mentioned.
example1_en: After dinner, the children returned to their respective rooms.
example1_zh: 晚饭后，孩子们各自回了自己的房间。
example2_en: Schools and families should understand their respective responsibilities in supporting children's emotional development and academic progress.
example2_zh: 学校和家庭应了解各自在支持儿童情感发展和学业进步方面的责任。
collocations: respective roles｜各自的角色 ; respective responsibilities｜各自的责任 ; respective countries｜各自的国家
tip_zh: 通常放在复数名词前；勿与respectful混淆。

meanings_zh: n. 基金；专用资金 | n. 资金；财力 | v. 为……提供资金
definition_en: money saved or collected for a particular purpose | money available to spend, usually expressed in the plural | to provide money for an activity, organisation, or project
example1_en: We started a small fund to repair the playground.
example1_zh: 我们设立了一笔小额专款，用来修缮游乐场。
example2_en: Governments should fund research into renewable energy to reduce dependence on fossil fuels and improve energy security.
example2_zh: 政府应资助可再生能源研究，以减少对化石燃料的依赖并提高能源安全。
collocations: raise funds｜筹集资金 ; a pension fund｜养老基金 ; public funds｜公共资金 ; fund research｜资助研究
tip_zh: 专用基金可说 a fund；泛指可用资金常用 funds。

meanings_zh: n. 拉丁语 | adj. 拉丁语的；古罗马的 | adj. 拉丁美洲的
definition_en: The language of ancient Rome. | Relating to Latin or ancient Rome. | Relating to Latin America, its people, or its culture.
example1_en: My sister studies Latin at school twice a week.
example1_zh: 我妹妹在学校每周学两次拉丁语。
example2_en: Studying Latin can help students understand the origins of scientific terms and the development of European languages.
example2_zh: 学习拉丁语可以帮助学生理解科学术语的起源及欧洲语言的发展。
collocations: study Latin｜学习拉丁语 ; classical Latin｜古典拉丁语 ; Latin alphabet｜拉丁字母表 ; Latin music｜拉丁音乐
tip_zh: 首字母大写；Latin America指拉丁美洲。

meanings_zh: v. 修改；调整 | v. 修饰（词语）
definition_en: To change something slightly to improve it or suit a purpose. | To describe or limit another word's meaning in grammar.
example1_en: We modified the recipe to use less sugar.
example1_zh: 我们调整了食谱，减少糖的用量。
example2_en: Schools may need to modify their teaching methods to support students with different learning needs.
example2_zh: 学校可能需要调整教学方法，以支持有不同学习需求的学生。
collocations: modify a design｜修改设计 ; modify behaviour｜调整行为 ; modify a plan｜调整计划
tip_zh: 通常指局部调整，不一定是彻底改变。

meanings_zh: n. 推测；猜测 | n. 投机买卖
definition_en: Ideas about something without enough evidence to be certain. | Risky buying and selling intended to produce quick profits.
example1_en: The empty shop has sparked speculation among our neighbours.
example1_zh: 那间空置店铺引发了邻居们的种种猜测。
example2_en: Property speculation can drive housing prices beyond local incomes, making it harder for young adults to buy homes.
example2_zh: 房地产投机可能推动房价涨至当地收入难以负担的水平，使年轻人更难买房。
collocations: pure speculation｜纯属猜测 ; fuel speculation｜加剧猜测 ; speculation about｜关于……的猜测 ; property speculation｜房地产投机
tip_zh: 猜测内容常接about或that从句；也可指金融投机。

meanings_zh: n. 哮喘
definition_en: A condition that can narrow airways and make breathing difficult
example1_en: My brother carries an inhaler to manage his asthma.
example1_zh: 我哥哥随身带着吸入器来控制哮喘。
example2_en: Reducing urban air pollution can help prevent asthma attacks and improve the quality of life for residents.
example2_zh: 减少城市空气污染有助于预防哮喘发作，提高居民的生活质量。
collocations: asthma attack｜哮喘发作 ; severe asthma｜重度哮喘 ; manage asthma｜控制哮喘 ; childhood asthma｜儿童哮喘
tip_zh: 不可数名词；th不发音，英美中间辅音不同。

meanings_zh: prep. 关于；有关
definition_en: On the subject of someone or something.
example1_en: I called the hotel regarding our missing suitcase.
example1_zh: 我给酒店打了电话，询问我们丢失的行李箱一事。
example2_en: Schools should consult parents before making major decisions regarding changes to the curriculum or assessment methods.
example2_zh: 学校在就课程或评估方式的调整作出重大决定之前，应征求家长意见。
collocations: information regarding｜关于……的信息 ; questions regarding｜有关……的问题 ; concerns regarding｜对……的担忧
tip_zh: regarding直接接名词，不加to；比about正式。

meanings_zh: n. 汽车
definition_en: a road vehicle with an engine, usually carrying few passengers
example1_en: My grandfather keeps a vintage automobile in his garage.
example1_zh: 我祖父的车库里收藏着一辆老式汽车。
example2_en: Growth in automobile ownership has increased pressure on road networks and contributed to urban air pollution.
example2_zh: 汽车保有量的增长加重了道路网络的压力，也加剧了城市空气污染。
collocations: automobile industry｜汽车工业 ; automobile manufacturer｜汽车制造商 ; automobile ownership｜汽车拥有情况
tip_zh: 主要用于美式英语，较正式；日常表达通常用car。

meanings_zh: v. 编织 | v. 穿梭；迂回行进 | v. 编排；将…编入
definition_en: Make fabric or baskets by crossing threads or strips. | Move by repeatedly changing direction around obstacles. | Combine different elements into a connected story or whole.
example1_en: My aunt taught me to weave a small basket.
example1_zh: 姑姑教我编了一个小篮子。
example2_en: Effective documentaries weave personal stories into broader discussions of social change and public policy.
example2_zh: 优秀的纪录片将个人故事融入对社会变迁和公共政策的更广泛讨论中。
collocations: weave a basket｜编篮子 ; weave through traffic｜在车流中穿梭 ; weave into a story｜编入故事
tip_zh: 编织义过去式 wove，过去分词 woven。

meanings_zh: n. 测量 | n. 测量值；尺寸
definition_en: The process of finding the size, amount, or degree of something. | A size or quantity found by measuring something.
example1_en: We took careful measurements before buying the new curtains.
example1_zh: 买新窗帘之前，我们仔细量了尺寸。
example2_en: Accurate measurement of air pollution helps governments assess whether environmental policies are protecting public health.
example2_zh: 准确测量空气污染程度有助于政府评估环境政策是否在保护公众健康。
collocations: take measurements｜测量尺寸 ; accurate measurement｜准确测量 ; a unit of measurement｜计量单位
tip_zh: 指测量过程常不可数；指具体尺寸时可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 极好的；卓越的
definition_en: Extremely good in quality or performance.
example1_en: We enjoyed a superb meal overlooking the quiet harbour.
example1_zh: 我们一边俯瞰宁静的港湾，一边享用了一顿极棒的饭菜。
example2_en: The museum offers superb educational facilities, allowing visitors of all ages to explore scientific ideas through practical activities.
example2_zh: 这家博物馆提供一流的教育设施，让各年龄段的参观者通过实践活动探索科学概念。
collocations: superb performance｜精彩绝伦的表演 ; superb quality｜卓越的品质 ; superb view｜绝佳的景色
tip_zh: 本身已含程度很高之意，通常不说very superb。

meanings_zh: conj. 假如；假使
definition_en: used to introduce an imagined situation or possibility
example1_en: Supposing the bus is late, can we walk instead?
example1_zh: 假如公交车晚点，我们能改为步行吗？
example2_en: Supposing that university education became free, how would governments cover the additional costs without reducing other essential services?
example2_zh: 假如大学教育免费，政府如何在不削减其他基本服务的情况下承担额外费用？
collocations: supposing that｜假如 ; supposing we could｜假如我们能够 ; supposing you were｜假如你是
tip_zh: 相当于if，可接that从句，常用来提出假设。

meanings_zh: v. 保证；确保 | n. 保证；担保 | n. 保修承诺
definition_en: to promise something firmly or make an outcome certain | a firm promise that something will happen or be done | a promise to repair or replace a faulty product
example1_en: The shop guarantees to replace the kettle if it breaks.
example1_zh: 商店保证水壶坏了就给换新的。
example2_en: Higher education does not guarantee employment, but it can significantly improve a person's long-term career prospects.
example2_zh: 高等教育并不保证就业，但能显著改善一个人的长期职业前景。
collocations: guarantee that｜保证…… ; guarantee access｜确保获得使用机会 ; under guarantee｜在保修期内 ; money-back guarantee｜退款保证
tip_zh: 可接to do或that从句；保修期内用under guarantee。

meanings_zh: n. 巧合
definition_en: an unexpected connection between events that have no apparent cause
example1_en: By coincidence, we both wore green jackets to lunch.
example1_zh: 真巧，我们俩午餐时都穿了绿色夹克。
example2_en: Researchers must distinguish between coincidence and genuine causal relationships when interpreting changes in public health data.
example2_zh: 研究人员解读公共卫生数据的变化时，必须区分巧合与真正的因果关系。
collocations: by coincidence｜碰巧 ; pure coincidence｜纯属巧合 ; a remarkable coincidence｜惊人的巧合 ; a strange coincidence｜奇怪的巧合
tip_zh: 碰巧用by coincidence；纯属巧合用pure coincidence。

meanings_zh: n. 木材；建筑用木料 | n. 用材林；用材树木
definition_en: wood prepared for building or making things | trees grown for wood used in construction or manufacturing
example1_en: The carpenter stacked the timber beside the workshop.
example1_zh: 木匠把木料堆在了工坊旁边。
example2_en: Using responsibly sourced timber in construction can reduce environmental damage while supporting sustainable forest management.
example2_zh: 在建筑中使用来源负责任的木材，既能减少环境破坏，也能支持可持续森林管理。
collocations: timber industry｜木材产业 ; timber frame｜木构架 ; sustainably sourced timber｜可持续来源的木材
tip_zh: 指木材时通常不可数；美式英语常用lumber指加工木料。

meanings_zh: adj. 不适合的；不合格的 | adj. 体能差的；不健康的
definition_en: not suitable or good enough for a particular purpose | not physically healthy or strong, often through lack of exercise
example1_en: The rusty bicycle was unfit for the long journey.
example1_zh: 那辆生锈的自行车不适合用来长途骑行。
example2_en: Poor maintenance can make public housing unfit for occupation, putting additional pressure on local authorities.
example2_zh: 维护不善可能使公共住房不宜居住，给地方政府带来额外压力。
collocations: unfit for purpose｜不符合用途要求 ; unfit for human consumption｜不宜供人食用 ; physically unfit｜体能差 ; unfit to drive｜不宜驾驶
tip_zh: 常用unfit for sth或unfit to do sth。

meanings_zh: v. 冲洗；冲（马桶） | v. 脸红；发红 | adj. 齐平的
definition_en: clean or clear something by sending water through it | become red in the face from emotion, heat, or illness | level with another surface, without sticking out
example1_en: Please flush the toilet before you leave the bathroom.
example1_zh: 离开卫生间之前，请冲一下马桶。
example2_en: Modern buildings can reduce water consumption by using collected rainwater to flush toilets instead of drinking water.
example2_zh: 现代建筑可以使用收集的雨水而非饮用水冲厕所，从而减少用水量。
collocations: flush the toilet｜冲马桶 ; flush with embarrassment｜羞得脸红 ; flush with the wall｜与墙面齐平 ; a flush of colour｜一阵红晕
tip_zh: flush with可指与表面齐平，也可指钱充裕。

meanings_zh: n. 维生素
definition_en: A substance needed in small amounts for healthy growth and functioning.
example1_en: These fresh oranges are a good source of vitamin C.
example1_zh: 这些新鲜橙子富含维生素C。
example2_en: A varied diet usually provides the vitamins people need without requiring them to take supplements.
example2_zh: 多样化饮食通常能够提供人体所需的维生素，无须服用补充剂。
collocations: vitamin deficiency｜维生素缺乏 ; vitamin supplements｜维生素补充剂 ; rich in vitamins｜富含维生素
tip_zh: 英音首音节读/vɪ/，美音读/vaɪ/。

meanings_zh: n. 海拔；高度
definition_en: Height above sea level or above the ground.
example1_en: We felt breathless because of the high altitude.
example1_zh: 由于海拔高，我们感到喘不过气来。
example2_en: At higher altitudes, reduced oxygen levels can affect physical performance and require a period of adjustment.
example2_zh: 海拔较高时，氧气含量降低会影响身体表现，需要一段适应期。
collocations: at high altitude｜在高海拔地区 ; gain altitude｜升高 ; cruising altitude｜巡航高度
tip_zh: altitude指高度；attitude指态度，注意拼写区别。

meanings_zh: v. 提取；取出；获取 | n. 摘录；节选 | n. 提取物；浓缩物
definition_en: to remove or obtain something from a larger source | a short passage taken from a longer piece of writing | a substance obtained by removing it from its original source
example1_en: The dentist carefully extracted the damaged tooth this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上，牙医小心地拔掉了那颗坏牙。
example2_en: Researchers extract useful information from large datasets to identify patterns in household energy consumption.
example2_zh: 研究人员从大型数据集中提取有用信息，以识别家庭能源消耗的规律。
collocations: extract information from｜从……获取信息 ; extract a tooth｜拔牙 ; an extract from a novel｜小说节选 ; vanilla extract｜香草精
tip_zh: 动词重音在后；名词读/ˈekstrækt/。

meanings_zh: adj. 有女性气质的 | adj. 阴性的（语法）
definition_en: Having qualities or styles traditionally associated with women. | Belonging to a grammatical gender class often associated with females.
example1_en: She chose a feminine blouse with delicate lace sleeves.
example1_zh: 她选了一件带有精致蕾丝袖子的柔美衬衫。
example2_en: Advertising often reinforces narrow ideas about feminine appearance, which can influence how young people perceive themselves.
example2_zh: 广告往往强化对女性外表的狭隘观念，这可能影响年轻人对自我的看法。
collocations: feminine style｜柔美的风格 ; feminine appearance｜女性化的外表 ; feminine noun｜阴性名词
tip_zh: feminine强调气质或语法性；female强调性别。

meanings_zh: n. 债务；欠款 | n. 人情债；恩情
definition_en: Money owed to a person, bank, or other organisation. | A feeling of owing gratitude for help someone has given.
example1_en: She took an extra shift to pay off her debt.
example1_zh: 她多上了一个班来还清欠款。
example2_en: High levels of household debt can reduce consumer spending and make an economy more vulnerable to recession.
example2_zh: 家庭债务水平过高会抑制消费支出，使经济更容易受到衰退冲击。
collocations: pay off a debt｜还清债务 ; be in debt｜负债 ; national debt｜国债 ; a debt of gratitude｜感激之情
tip_zh: b不发音；in debt表示负债。

meanings_zh: n. 外交官 | n. 善于交际的人
definition_en: An official who represents their country in relations with other countries. | Someone skilled at handling people and difficult situations tactfully.
example1_en: The diplomat welcomed visitors at the embassy this morning.
example1_zh: 这位外交官今天上午在大使馆接待了来访者。
example2_en: Experienced diplomats can help countries resolve disagreements through negotiation rather than allowing tensions to escalate.
example2_zh: 经验丰富的外交官能帮助各国通过谈判解决分歧，避免紧张局势升级。
collocations: a senior diplomat｜高级外交官 ; a career diplomat｜职业外交官 ; a foreign diplomat｜外国外交官
tip_zh: diplomatic既可指外交的，也可指说话圆通的。

meanings_zh: n. 杠杆；操纵杆 | v. 用杠杆撬动 | n. 施加影响的手段
definition_en: A bar used to move something or control a machine | To move something using a bar as a lever | A means of influencing people or changing a situation
example1_en: Pull this lever to raise the seat a little.
example1_zh: 拉这个操纵杆，把座位稍微升高一点。
example2_en: Tax policy can serve as a powerful lever for encouraging businesses to invest in cleaner technologies.
example2_zh: 税收政策可以成为鼓励企业投资更清洁技术的有力手段。
collocations: pull a lever｜拉动操纵杆 ; lever something open｜撬开某物 ; a lever for change｜推动变革的手段
tip_zh: 英式首音节读/liː/，美式通常读/lev/。

meanings_zh: n. 面包皮；酥皮 | n. 地壳 | n. 坚硬表层；硬壳
definition_en: The firm outer layer of bread or pastry. | The solid outer layer of the Earth. | A hard layer that forms on a surface.
example1_en: This fresh bread has a wonderfully crisp crust.
example1_zh: 这条新鲜面包的外皮特别酥脆。
example2_en: Movements within the Earth's crust can cause earthquakes that severely damage buildings and transport networks.
example2_zh: 地壳内部的运动可能引发地震，严重破坏建筑物和交通网络。
collocations: bread crust｜面包皮 ; the Earth's crust｜地壳 ; a thin crust｜薄薄的硬皮
tip_zh: 地壳用the Earth's crust；面包皮也用crust。

meanings_zh: n. 概要；大纲 | v. 概述；列出要点 | n. 轮廓；外形
definition_en: a short description covering the main points | to describe the main points without giving full details | the line showing the outer shape of something
example1_en: I wrote a quick outline before starting my essay.
example1_zh: 开始写作文之前，我先快速列了一个提纲。
example2_en: The report outlines several practical measures that schools can adopt to support students with learning difficulties.
example2_zh: 这份报告概述了学校可以采取的几项切实措施，以帮助有学习困难的学生。
collocations: essay outline｜作文提纲 ; outline a plan｜概述计划 ; a brief outline｜简要概述 ; the outline of｜……的轮廓
tip_zh: 表示概要时强调主要内容，不包含详细论述。

meanings_zh: n. 图片说明；字幕 | v. 为图片配说明；加字幕
definition_en: Words accompanying an image or showing speech on a screen | To add explanatory words to an image or video
example1_en: The caption explains where the mountain photo was taken.
example1_zh: 图片说明交代了这张山景照片的拍摄地点。
example2_en: Accurate captions make online educational videos more accessible to learners who are deaf or hard of hearing.
example2_zh: 准确的字幕让失聪或听力障碍学习者更容易理解在线教学视频。
collocations: a photo caption｜照片说明 ; write a caption｜撰写图片说明 ; closed captions｜可开关字幕
tip_zh: caption配图片或视频；新闻报道标题通常用headline。

meanings_zh: v. 猛地跳入；猛地插入 | v. 骤降；暴跌 | n. 跳入；骤降
definition_en: To move or push something suddenly and forcefully into something. | To decrease suddenly and sharply. | A sudden dive, fall, or sharp decrease.
example1_en: He plunged his muddy boots into a bucket of water.
example1_zh: 他把沾满泥的靴子猛地浸进一桶水里。
example2_en: Tourism revenue may plunge when extreme weather forces popular coastal resorts to close during peak season.
example2_zh: 当极端天气迫使热门海滨度假区在旺季关闭时，旅游收入可能骤降。
collocations: plunge into water｜猛地跳入水中 ; plunge sharply｜急剧下降 ; take the plunge｜下决心冒险尝试 ; plunge into debt｜陷入债务
tip_zh: plunge into可指跳入，也可指突然陷入某种状态。

meanings_zh: adj. 有系统的；有条理的
definition_en: Following an organised plan or method rather than acting randomly.
example1_en: Her systematic packing made everything easy to find later.
example1_zh: 她收拾行李很有条理，之后什么都很容易找到。
example2_en: A systematic review of existing research can help governments develop more effective public health policies.
example2_zh: 对现有研究进行系统综述，有助于政府制定更有效的公共卫生政策。
collocations: a systematic approach｜系统的方法 ; a systematic review｜系统综述 ; systematic analysis｜系统分析
tip_zh: systematic指有条理；systemic指系统整体的。

meanings_zh: n. 射箭；射箭运动
definition_en: the sport or skill of shooting arrows with a bow
example1_en: We tried archery at a supervised outdoor activity centre.
example1_zh: 我们在一家户外活动中心的指导下尝试了射箭。
example2_en: Offering archery in schools could introduce students to a sport that develops concentration and physical coordination.
example2_zh: 学校开设射箭课程，可以让学生接触一项培养专注力和身体协调能力的运动。
collocations: practise archery｜练习射箭 ; an archery club｜射箭俱乐部 ; an archery range｜射箭场
tip_zh: archery 是不可数名词；射箭运动员叫 archer。

meanings_zh: n. 大笔财富 | n. 运气；命运
definition_en: A very large amount of money | Luck or the events that shape someone's life
example1_en: That tiny flat near the station costs a fortune.
example1_zh: 车站附近那套小公寓贵得惊人。
example2_en: Some entrepreneurs build a fortune by developing affordable products that meet previously overlooked needs.
example2_zh: 一些创业者通过开发满足以往被忽视需求的平价产品，积累了巨额财富。
collocations: make a fortune｜赚大钱 ; cost a fortune｜花费巨款 ; good fortune｜好运 ; tell someone's fortune｜给某人算命
tip_zh: 表示大笔财富时用a fortune；表示运气时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 考古学
definition_en: The study of past societies through objects and remains.
example1_en: Studying archaeology taught her to recognise ancient pottery fragments.
example1_zh: 学习考古学让她学会了辨认古代陶器碎片。
example2_en: Archaeology provides valuable evidence of how earlier societies adapted to environmental change and developed trading networks.
example2_zh: 考古学为了解早期社会如何适应环境变化、发展贸易网络提供了宝贵证据。
collocations: study archaeology｜学习考古学 ; an archaeology degree｜考古学学位 ; an archaeology museum｜考古博物馆
tip_zh: 通常不可数；研究恐龙化石属于古生物学。

meanings_zh: n. 爆炸 | n. 激增；突增 | n. 情感的突然爆发
definition_en: a sudden violent release of energy, usually with a bang | a sudden and very large increase | a sudden strong expression of emotion
example1_en: We heard a distant explosion and saw smoke rising.
example1_zh: 我们听到远处传来爆炸声，看见烟雾升起。
example2_en: The explosion in online shopping has increased demand for delivery services and created new challenges for urban transport.
example2_zh: 网上购物的激增提高了配送服务需求，也给城市交通带来了新挑战。
collocations: a gas explosion｜燃气爆炸 ; a population explosion｜人口激增 ; an explosion of anger｜怒气爆发
tip_zh: 表示数量激增时，常用an explosion in加名词。

meanings_zh: n. 紧张局势；紧张关系 | n. 紧张；焦虑 | n. 张力；拉力
definition_en: Strained relations between people or groups that may cause conflict | A feeling of worry that makes relaxation difficult | A force that stretches or pulls something tight
example1_en: Tension grew between the neighbours over the shared driveway.
example1_zh: 邻居们因共用车道问题，关系越来越紧张。
example2_en: Competition for limited water supplies can increase tension between farming communities and nearby cities.
example2_zh: 争夺有限的水资源可能加剧农业社区与附近城市之间的紧张关系。
collocations: ease tension｜缓解紧张 ; political tension｜政治紧张局势 ; muscle tension｜肌肉紧绷 ; surface tension｜表面张力
tip_zh: 关系紧张常用tension between；多方矛盾可用复数。

meanings_zh: v. 大量制造；生产 | n. 制造；生产
definition_en: to produce goods, usually in large quantities using machinery | the process of producing goods, especially in factories
example1_en: The factory manufactures bicycles that fold into small bags.
example1_zh: 这家工厂生产可折叠后装入小包的自行车。
example2_en: Companies that manufacture electronic devices should take greater responsibility for recycling their products at the end of use.
example2_zh: 制造电子设备的企业应承担更多责任，回收使用寿命结束的产品。
collocations: manufacture goods｜制造商品 ; the manufacture of｜……的制造 ; manufacturing industry｜制造业 ; manufacturing costs｜制造成本
tip_zh: 多指工厂批量生产；名词制造商是manufacturer。

meanings_zh: adj. 巨大的；极大的 | adj. 极好的；精彩的
definition_en: Very great in amount, strength, or degree. | Extremely good or enjoyable.
example1_en: Moving that heavy sofa upstairs took a tremendous effort.
example1_zh: 把那张沉重的沙发搬上楼费了极大的力气。
example2_en: Rapid urban growth places tremendous pressure on housing, transport networks and essential public services.
example2_zh: 城市的快速发展给住房、交通网络和基本公共服务带来了巨大压力。
collocations: tremendous pressure｜巨大压力 ; a tremendous effort｜极大的努力 ; tremendous growth｜大幅增长 ; a tremendous achievement｜了不起的成就
tip_zh: 常强调程度或数量极大，不只指体积大。

meanings_zh: n. 捕捉器；陷阱 | v. 困住；使无法逃脱 | n. 圈套；困境
definition_en: A device or concealed danger designed to catch someone or something | To catch or keep someone somewhere they cannot escape | A situation that deceives people or is difficult to escape
example1_en: We found a mouse inside the humane trap this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上，我们在活捕鼠笼里发现了一只老鼠。
example2_en: High housing costs can trap families in poverty by leaving little money for education or training.
example2_zh: 高昂的住房成本使家庭几乎无钱支付教育或培训费用，从而令其陷入贫困。
collocations: set a trap｜设下陷阱 ; fall into a trap｜落入圈套 ; be trapped in｜被困在 ; poverty trap｜贫困陷阱
tip_zh: 动词过去式trapped、现在分词trapping都双写p。

meanings_zh: v. 强制实行；征收 | v. 把…强加于 | v. 给人添麻烦；占用
definition_en: Officially introduce a rule, tax, punishment, or restriction | Force someone to accept something they do not want | Expect help or attention that causes someone inconvenience
example1_en: The library imposed a small fine for my overdue books.
example1_zh: 图书馆因我逾期还书收取了一小笔罚款。
example2_en: Governments may impose higher taxes on sugary drinks to encourage healthier choices and reduce public healthcare costs.
example2_zh: 政府可能对含糖饮料征收更高的税，以鼓励更健康的选择并降低公共医疗开支。
collocations: impose restrictions on｜对…施加限制 ; impose a tax on｜对…征税 ; impose one's views on｜把自己的观点强加于 ; impose on someone's time｜占用某人的时间
tip_zh: 常用 impose A on B，表示把A强加于B。

meanings_zh: n. 命运；天命
definition_en: A future believed to be fixed by forces beyond personal control.
example1_en: She believed it was her destiny to become a musician.
example1_zh: 她相信自己命中注定会成为音乐家。
example2_en: Although family circumstances influence opportunities, education can help individuals shape their own destiny rather than accept existing limitations.
example2_zh: 尽管家庭条件会影响机会，教育仍能帮助个人塑造自己的命运，而非接受现有的限制。
collocations: shape your own destiny｜塑造自己的命运 ; fulfil your destiny｜实现命中注定的使命 ; a sense of destiny｜使命感
tip_zh: 常指注定的未来；shape your destiny强调主动掌握命运。

meanings_zh: n. 稳定；稳固性
definition_en: The ability to remain steady and resist unwanted change
example1_en: These wider legs give the table much better stability.
example1_zh: 这些更宽的桌腿让桌子稳固了许多。
example2_en: Economic stability encourages businesses to invest in new projects and gives households greater confidence about their financial future.
example2_zh: 经济稳定能鼓励企业投资新项目，也让家庭对未来的财务状况更有信心。
collocations: economic stability｜经济稳定 ; political stability｜政治稳定 ; financial stability｜财务稳定 ; maintain stability｜维持稳定
tip_zh: 通常不可数；形容词为stable，反义词为instability。

meanings_zh: v. 紧握；抓牢 | n. 紧握；抓握力 | n. 控制；支配
definition_en: to hold something firmly | a firm hold on something | power or control over someone or something
example1_en: She gripped the railing as the boat rocked gently.
example1_zh: 船轻轻摇晃时，她紧紧抓住栏杆。
example2_en: Large companies maintain a strong grip on the market, making it difficult for smaller businesses to compete.
example2_zh: 大公司牢牢控制着市场，使小企业难以参与竞争。
collocations: grip tightly｜紧紧抓住 ; a firm grip｜牢固的抓握 ; lose your grip｜松手；失去控制 ; a grip on power｜对权力的掌控
tip_zh: 过去式gripped、现在分词gripping均双写p。

meanings_zh: n. 职位空缺 | n. 空房；可用客房
definition_en: A job or position available for someone to fill. | A room available for someone to stay in.
example1_en: The local library has a vacancy for an assistant.
example1_zh: 当地的图书馆有一个助理职位空缺。
example2_en: Despite rising unemployment, many employers report difficulty filling vacancies that require advanced technical skills.
example2_zh: 尽管失业率上升，许多雇主仍表示难以填补需要高级技术技能的职位空缺。
collocations: job vacancy｜职位空缺 ; fill a vacancy｜填补空缺 ; a vacancy for｜……的职位空缺 ; no vacancies｜客房已满
tip_zh: 职位、客房空缺均可数；复数为vacancies。

meanings_zh: n. 方式；方法 | n. 运行模式
definition_en: A particular way of doing something. | A setting that controls how a device or system operates.
example1_en: I switched my phone to silent mode before dinner.
example1_zh: 晚饭前，我把手机调成了静音模式。
example2_en: Cycling is an environmentally friendly mode of transport that can also improve public health in urban areas.
example2_zh: 骑行是一种环保的交通方式，也能改善城市居民的健康。
collocations: mode of transport｜交通方式 ; mode of communication｜交流方式 ; silent mode｜静音模式 ; sleep mode｜睡眠模式
tip_zh: 方式常用mode of；设备处于某模式用in ... mode。

meanings_zh: v. 概括；总结
definition_en: to state the main points briefly
example1_en: Could you summarize the story before we discuss it?
example1_zh: 我们讨论之前，你能概括一下这个故事吗？
example2_en: Students should learn to summarize research findings accurately rather than reproduce every detail from their sources.
example2_zh: 学生应学会准确概括研究结果，而不是复述资料中的每个细节。
collocations: summarize the findings｜概括研究结果 ; summarize the main points｜总结要点 ; summarize an argument｜概述论点
tip_zh: 英式也常拼作summarise；总结时保留要点。

meanings_zh: adj. 中立的；不偏不倚的 | adj. 中性色的；素净的 | n. 空挡
definition_en: not supporting either side in a disagreement or conflict | having a colour that is not bright or strong | a gear position in which the engine does not drive wheels
example1_en: I stayed neutral while my friends argued about the rules.
example1_zh: 朋友们为规则争论时，我保持了中立。
example2_en: Journalists should remain neutral when reporting political debates so that audiences can form their own opinions.
example2_zh: 记者报道政治辩论时应保持中立，让受众能够形成自己的看法。
collocations: remain neutral｜保持中立 ; a neutral observer｜中立观察者 ; neutral colours｜中性色 ; in neutral｜处于空挡
tip_zh: 保持中立用remain neutral；车辆挂空挡用in neutral。

meanings_zh: adv. 主要地；首要地
definition_en: Mainly, or more than anything else
example1_en: I use my tablet primarily for reading books.
example1_zh: 我的平板电脑主要用来看书。
example2_en: Public transport policies should focus primarily on improving reliability rather than simply reducing ticket prices.
example2_zh: 公共交通政策应主要着眼于提高可靠性，而非仅仅降低票价。
collocations: primarily responsible for｜对……负主要责任 ; primarily concerned with｜主要关注…… ; primarily due to｜主要由于
tip_zh: 通常表示“主要”，不是表示先后顺序的“首先”。

meanings_zh: n. 国歌；颂歌 | n. 宗教合唱曲；赞美诗
definition_en: A song expressing loyalty to a country or group | A religious song sung by a choir
example1_en: The crowd stood proudly as the national anthem began.
example1_zh: 国歌响起时，人群自豪地站了起来。
example2_en: Singing a national anthem at international sporting events can strengthen a shared sense of identity.
example2_zh: 在国际体育赛事上唱国歌可以增强共同的身份认同感。
collocations: national anthem｜国歌 ; sing an anthem｜唱颂歌 ; the national anthem plays｜国歌奏响
tip_zh: national anthem指国歌；宗教语境中可指合唱赞美诗。

meanings_zh: n. 乌鸦 | v. 鸡啼；打鸣 | v. 得意地夸耀
definition_en: A large black bird with a loud, rough call. | Make the loud call typical of a male chicken. | Talk proudly and annoyingly about your own success.
example1_en: A crow landed on the fence beside our garden.
example1_zh: 一只乌鸦落在我们花园旁的围栏上。
example2_en: Studies of crow behaviour suggest that some birds can solve complex problems and use simple tools.
example2_zh: 对乌鸦行为的研究表明，有些鸟类能够解决复杂问题并使用简单工具。
collocations: a flock of crows｜一群乌鸦 ; a rooster crows｜公鸡打鸣 ; crow about a victory｜得意地夸耀胜利
tip_zh: 名词指乌鸦，动词却可指公鸡打鸣。

meanings_zh: n. 附录 | n. 阑尾
definition_en: An extra section containing supporting information at a book's end | A small tube attached to the beginning of the large intestine
example1_en: You'll find the full recipe in the appendix.
example1_zh: 你可以在附录里找到完整的食谱。
example2_en: The report includes an appendix explaining how researchers collected and analysed the survey data.
example2_zh: 报告附有一份附录，说明研究人员如何收集和分析调查数据。
collocations: in the appendix｜在附录中 ; an appendix to a report｜报告的附录 ; a ruptured appendix｜破裂的阑尾
tip_zh: 附录复数可用appendices；阑尾常用appendixes。

meanings_zh: n. 咨询师；辅导员 | n. 顾问 | n. 律师；法律顾问
definition_en: Someone trained to help people with personal or emotional problems. | Someone who gives advice on a particular subject. | A lawyer, especially in American English.
example1_en: The school counselor helped me manage my exam worries.
example1_zh: 学校辅导员帮助我缓解了对考试的焦虑。
example2_en: Employing a trained counselor can help schools support students facing emotional difficulties or challenging family circumstances.
example2_zh: 聘用受过培训的咨询师能帮助学校支持面临情绪困扰或家庭困境的学生。
collocations: school counselor｜学校辅导员 ; mental health counselor｜心理健康咨询师 ; career counselor｜职业顾问
tip_zh: 美式拼写；英式通常写作 counsellor。

meanings_zh: n. 生物；生命个体 | n. 存在；本质
definition_en: a living creature, especially a person | existence or the essential nature of a person or thing
example1_en: Every living being in this pond needs clean water.
example1_zh: 这个池塘里的每一个生物都需要干净的水。
example2_en: Respect for every human being should guide the development of public services and social welfare policies.
example2_zh: 对每个人的尊重都应成为公共服务和社会福利政策制定的指导原则。
collocations: human being｜人 ; living being｜生物 ; come into being｜形成；产生
tip_zh: 指生物时可数；表示“存在”时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: adv. 向西；朝西 | adj. 向西的；朝西的
definition_en: towards the west | moving or pointing towards the west
example1_en: We drove westward as the sun began to set.
example1_zh: 太阳开始落山时，我们驾车向西行驶。
example2_en: The westward expansion of the city has increased pressure on farmland and created demand for new infrastructure.
example2_zh: 城市向西扩张加大了农田面临的压力，也带来了对新基础设施的需求。
collocations: travel westward｜向西行进 ; westward expansion｜向西扩张 ; westward migration｜向西迁移
tip_zh: westward可作形容词或副词；westwards只作副词。

meanings_zh: v. 保护；保存；维持 | v. 保藏食物 | n. 保护区
definition_en: Keep something safe, unchanged, or in good condition | Treat food so it stays safe to eat longer | An area where wildlife and natural habitats are protected
example1_en: We preserve old family photographs in a special album.
example1_zh: 我们把家里的老照片保存在一本专用相册里。
example2_en: Local authorities should preserve historic buildings while adapting them to meet the needs of modern communities.
example2_zh: 地方政府应保护历史建筑，同时改造它们以满足现代社区的需求。
collocations: preserve cultural heritage｜保护文化遗产 ; preserve biodiversity｜保护生物多样性 ; preserve food｜保藏食物
tip_zh: preserve强调保持原状；保藏食物也用它。

meanings_zh: v. 评估；评定 | v. 估价；核定金额
definition_en: Judge the quality, importance, or condition of something. | Calculate the value of something or the amount owed.
example1_en: The mechanic assessed the damage before repairing my bicycle.
example1_zh: 修理工先评估了损坏情况，然后才修我的自行车。
example2_en: Schools should assess students through varied tasks rather than relying entirely on final examinations.
example2_zh: 学校应通过多样化的任务评定学生，而不是完全依赖期末考试。
collocations: assess the impact｜评估影响 ; assess the risk｜评估风险 ; assess performance｜评定表现 ; assess the damage｜评估损失
tip_zh: assess后直接接宾语；名词形式是assessment。

meanings_zh: n. 软木 | n. 软木塞 | v. 用软木塞封住
definition_en: a light material from tree bark, used for sealing bottles | a piece of cork used to close a bottle | to close a bottle with a cork
example1_en: The cork popped out and rolled under the table.
example1_zh: 软木塞砰地弹出，滚到了桌子底下。
example2_en: Cork is a renewable material that can be harvested without cutting down the entire tree.
example2_zh: 软木是一种可再生材料，采收时无需砍倒整棵树。
collocations: a cork stopper｜软木塞 ; cork flooring｜软木地板 ; remove the cork｜拔出软木塞
tip_zh: 表示软木材料时不可数；表示软木塞时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 组成；成分 | n. 作文；乐曲 | n. 创作；作曲
definition_en: The parts or substances that something consists of | A piece of writing or music | The activity of creating music or written work
example1_en: We tested the composition of soil in our garden.
example1_zh: 我们检测了自家花园土壤的成分。
example2_en: Changes in the composition of household waste can reveal how consumer habits develop over time.
example2_zh: 生活垃圾构成的变化可以反映消费习惯如何随时间演变。
collocations: chemical composition｜化学成分 ; soil composition｜土壤成分 ; musical composition｜音乐作品 ; write a composition｜写作文
tip_zh: 指构成或创作过程通常不可数；指作品可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 广泛的；大量的 | adj. 辽阔的；大面积的
definition_en: covering many subjects or involving a large amount | covering a large physical area
example1_en: The storm caused extensive damage to our roof.
example1_zh: 暴风雨使我们家的屋顶大面积受损。
example2_en: Extensive research is needed before governments introduce major changes to the national education system.
example2_zh: 政府对国家教育制度进行重大改革之前，需要开展广泛研究。
collocations: extensive research｜广泛研究 ; extensive damage｜大面积损坏 ; extensive experience｜丰富经验 ; extensive network｜庞大的网络
tip_zh: 强调范围广或数量多；intensive强调集中、强度高。

meanings_zh: v. 诱惑；引诱；吸引
definition_en: To make someone want something or want to do something.
example1_en: The fresh pastries tempted me to enter the bakery.
example1_zh: 新鲜的酥点诱使我走进了面包店。
example2_en: Heavy discounts may tempt consumers to purchase products they neither need nor originally intended to buy.
example2_zh: 大幅折扣可能诱使消费者购买既不需要、也原本无意购买的产品。
collocations: tempt someone into doing something｜诱使某人做某事 ; be tempted to do something｜很想做某事 ; tempt fate｜冒不必要的风险
tip_zh: 常用tempt sb to do或tempt sb into doing。

meanings_zh: n. 电缆；线缆 | n. 钢缆；缆绳
definition_en: covered wires carrying electricity or electronic signals | a thick strong rope, usually made of metal wires
example1_en: The charging cable was tangled beneath my desk.
example1_zh: 充电线在我的书桌下面缠成了一团。
example2_en: Undersea cable networks carry vast amounts of data, making them essential infrastructure for international communication and trade.
example2_zh: 海底电缆网络传输大量数据，是国际通信和贸易不可或缺的基础设施。
collocations: power cable｜电源线 ; fibre-optic cable｜光缆 ; undersea cable｜海底电缆 ; steel cable｜钢缆
tip_zh: 既可传电或信号，也可指承重用的钢缆。

meanings_zh: adj. 耗时的
definition_en: taking a lot of time to do or complete
example1_en: Sorting all these old photos is surprisingly time-consuming.
example1_zh: 整理这些旧照片竟然这么费时间。
example2_en: Applying for multiple permits can be time-consuming, discouraging small businesses from expanding their operations.
example2_zh: 申请多项许可可能很耗时，使小企业不愿扩大经营规模。
collocations: time-consuming task｜耗时的任务 ; time-consuming process｜耗时的过程 ; costly and time-consuming｜费钱又费时
tip_zh: 强调花费大量时间，不一定表示浪费时间。

meanings_zh: n. 女主角 | n. 女英雄；杰出女性
definition_en: the main female character in a story | a woman admired for courage or remarkable achievements
example1_en: The heroine of this novel sails across the ocean.
example1_zh: 这部小说的女主角驾船横渡大洋。
example2_en: A confident heroine in children's literature can challenge stereotypes and broaden young readers' expectations.
example2_zh: 儿童文学中自信的女主角能够挑战刻板印象，拓宽小读者对未来的期待。
collocations: the heroine of a novel｜小说的女主角 ; a national heroine｜民族女英雄 ; a tragic heroine｜悲剧女主角
tip_zh: 与heroin（海洛因）同音，注意末尾的e。

meanings_zh: n. 捕食者；食肉动物 | n. 掠夺者；剥削者
definition_en: An animal that hunts and eats other animals. | A person or organisation that exploits others for personal gain.
example1_en: The rabbit froze when it noticed a predator nearby.
example1_zh: 兔子发现附近有捕食者时，一动也不敢动。
example2_en: Protecting natural predators can help farmers control pests without relying heavily on chemical pesticides.
example2_zh: 保护天敌可以帮助农民防治害虫，减少对化学农药的依赖。
collocations: natural predator｜天敌 ; apex predator｜顶级捕食者 ; predator population｜捕食者种群
tip_zh: predator是捕食者，prey是被捕食的猎物。

meanings_zh: n. 必要性；需要 | n. 必需品
definition_en: the need for something or for something to happen | something essential for everyday life
example1_en: Living far from town makes a car a necessity.
example1_zh: 住得离城镇很远，汽车就成了必需品。
example2_en: The rising cost of housing highlights the necessity of providing affordable homes for low-income families.
example2_zh: 住房成本上涨凸显了为低收入家庭提供可负担住房的必要性。
collocations: basic necessities｜基本生活必需品 ; a necessity for｜对……而言的必需品 ; out of necessity｜出于需要
tip_zh: 表必要性常不可数；表必需品可数，常用复数。

meanings_zh: adj. 无尽的；没完没了的
definition_en: Having no end, or seeming to continue forever.
example1_en: The queue outside the swimming pool seemed endless today.
example1_zh: 今天游泳池外的队伍似乎怎么也排不到头。
example2_en: Although online platforms offer endless entertainment, excessive screen time may reduce opportunities for meaningful social interaction.
example2_zh: 虽然网络平台提供无穷无尽的娱乐，但过多的屏幕时间可能减少有意义的社交机会。
collocations: endless possibilities｜无限可能 ; an endless stream of｜源源不断的…… ; endless debate｜无休止的争论
tip_zh: 常为夸张，表示似乎没完没了，不一定真无终点。

meanings_zh: n. 投资；投资款 | n. 时间或精力的投入
definition_en: Money put into something with the aim of future profit. | Time or effort spent on something expected to bring benefits.
example1_en: Buying better tools was a good investment for our bakery.
example1_zh: 购买更好的工具对我们面包店来说是一笔不错的投资。
example2_en: Greater public investment in renewable energy could create jobs while reducing dependence on fossil fuels.
example2_zh: 加大对可再生能源的公共投资可以创造就业机会，同时减少对化石燃料的依赖。
collocations: investment in infrastructure｜基础设施投资 ; foreign investment｜外国投资 ; return on investment｜投资回报 ; an investment of time｜时间投入
tip_zh: 通常搭配in；表示投资行为时常作不可数名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 首要的；主要的 | adj. 最优质的；绝佳的 | n. 鼎盛时期；壮年
definition_en: most important or central | of the best quality or in the best position | the period of greatest strength, success, or ability
example1_en: Our prime concern is getting everyone home safely tonight.
example1_zh: 我们最关心的是今晚让所有人安全到家。
example2_en: Reliable public transport is a prime requirement for cities seeking to reduce dependence on private cars.
example2_zh: 对于希望减少私家车依赖的城市而言，可靠的公共交通是一项首要需求。
collocations: prime concern｜首要关切 ; prime example｜典型例子 ; prime location｜绝佳地段 ; in your prime｜处于鼎盛时期
tip_zh: a prime example指典型例子，不是第一个例子。

meanings_zh: adj. 不愿意的；不情愿的
definition_en: not wanting or agreeing to do something
example1_en: He was unwilling to lend his new bicycle.
example1_zh: 他不愿意把自己的新自行车借出去。
example2_en: Some commuters are unwilling to cycle to work because busy roads lack safe lanes and secure bicycle parking.
example2_zh: 一些通勤者不愿骑车上班，因为繁忙的道路缺乏安全的车道和可靠的自行车停放设施。
collocations: unwilling to accept｜不愿接受 ; unwilling to cooperate｜不愿合作 ; an unwilling participant｜不情愿的参与者
tip_zh: 常用be unwilling to do；不愿做不等于unable不能做。

meanings_zh: v. 维持；保持 | v. 保养；维护 | v. 坚持声称
definition_en: To keep something at the same level or in existence. | To keep something working well through regular care and repairs. | To firmly state that something is true.
example1_en: Regular walks help me maintain a healthy weight.
example1_zh: 经常散步帮助我保持健康的体重。
example2_en: Governments must maintain essential public services while responding to growing pressure on national budgets.
example2_zh: 政府必须在应对国家预算压力不断增大的同时，维持基本公共服务。
collocations: maintain a balance｜保持平衡 ; maintain standards｜维持标准 ; maintain equipment｜保养设备 ; maintain that｜坚持声称
tip_zh: maintain后直接接宾语；表示坚持声称时可接that从句。

meanings_zh: adj. 年老的；上了年纪的
definition_en: old, especially when describing people
example1_en: An elderly neighbour showed me how to grow tomatoes.
example1_zh: 一位年长的邻居教我如何种番茄。
example2_en: Cities should provide accessible public transport so that elderly residents can remain active and independent.
example2_zh: 城市应提供无障碍公共交通，让老年居民能够保持活跃并独立生活。
collocations: elderly people｜老年人 ; elderly residents｜老年居民 ; elderly care｜老年护理
tip_zh: 指人年老，不指中年；older people通常更中性。

meanings_zh: v. 隔离；使孤立 | v. 分离；单独确定
definition_en: Separate someone or something from others. | Separate or identify one substance, factor, or problem for examination.
example1_en: Heavy snow isolated the village from the nearest town.
example1_zh: 大雪使这个村庄与最近的城镇隔绝了。
example2_en: Researchers must isolate the effects of income before drawing conclusions about the relationship between education and health.
example2_zh: 研究人员必须单独厘清收入的影响，才能对教育与健康的关系下结论。
collocations: isolate someone from｜使某人与……隔离 ; isolate a variable｜单独考察一个变量 ; isolate the cause｜确定原因
tip_zh: 常用isolate A from B；形容词是isolated。

meanings_zh: v. 撤退；退避 | n. 撤退；退却 | n. 静养处；僻静住所
definition_en: To move back or away from danger or difficulty. | An act of moving back or away from something. | A quiet place where people go to rest.
example1_en: We retreated indoors when the rain began falling heavily.
example1_zh: 大雨开始倾盆而下时，我们退回了室内。
example2_en: As glaciers retreat due to rising temperatures, communities downstream face increasing uncertainty about their future water supplies.
example2_zh: 随着气温上升导致冰川退缩，下游社区未来的供水面临越来越大的不确定性。
collocations: retreat from｜从……撤退 ; beat a retreat｜匆忙退走 ; mountain retreat｜山中静养处
tip_zh: retreat强调向后撤离；静养处这一名词义也常见。

meanings_zh: v. 肿胀；膨胀 | v. 增加；增强 | n. 海面涌浪
definition_en: To become larger or rounder, or make something do so. | To increase in amount or strength, or cause this. | The movement of long, smooth waves across the sea.
example1_en: My ankle began to swell after I twisted it.
example1_zh: 我扭伤脚踝后，脚踝开始肿起来。
example2_en: Seasonal tourism can swell the population of coastal towns, placing additional pressure on local water supplies.
example2_zh: 季节性旅游会使沿海城镇人口增加，给当地供水带来额外压力。
collocations: swell up｜肿起来 ; swell with pride｜内心充满自豪 ; a heavy swell｜汹涌的涌浪
tip_zh: 过去式swelled；过去分词常用swollen。

meanings_zh: adj. 摄影的；照片的 | adj. 记忆极精确的
definition_en: relating to photography or photographs | able to remember visual details with great accuracy
example1_en: She packed her photographic equipment before the sunrise walk.
example1_zh: 她在出发晨走看日出前收好了摄影器材。
example2_en: Photographic evidence allows researchers to document changes in glacier size and communicate climate trends to the public.
example2_zh: 照片证据使研究人员能够记录冰川大小的变化，并向公众传达气候趋势。
collocations: photographic equipment｜摄影器材 ; photographic evidence｜照片证据 ; a photographic memory｜过目不忘的记忆力
tip_zh: photographic memory指记忆极精确，并非照片存储。

meanings_zh: n. 幻想；想象 | n. 奇幻文学；奇幻作品
definition_en: An imagined situation that is unlikely to happen | Stories featuring magic, imaginary worlds, or impossible events
example1_en: Living in a castle was my favourite childhood fantasy.
example1_zh: 住在城堡里是我童年时最喜欢的幻想。
example2_en: Fantasy literature can encourage young readers to explore moral questions through imaginary worlds and unusual characters.
example2_zh: 奇幻文学可以鼓励年轻读者通过虚构世界和不同寻常的角色探索道德问题。
collocations: a childhood fantasy｜童年的幻想 ; fantasy fiction｜奇幻小说 ; a fantasy world｜幻想世界 ; indulge in fantasy｜沉浸于幻想
tip_zh: 具体幻想可数；表示奇幻文学类型时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 背景；具体环境 | n. 上下文；语境
definition_en: The circumstances surrounding an event that help explain it. | The surrounding words that help explain a word or statement.
example1_en: Her silence made sense once I understood the context.
example1_zh: 了解背景后，我就明白她为什么沉默了。
example2_en: Historical events should be examined in their social context rather than judged solely by contemporary standards.
example2_zh: 研究历史事件应结合其社会背景，而非仅以当代标准评判。
collocations: in context｜结合背景；在语境中 ; out of context｜脱离上下文 ; historical context｜历史背景 ; social context｜社会背景
tip_zh: out of context指脱离语境，常用于断章取义。

meanings_zh: adj. 金色的 | adj. 绝佳的；珍贵的
definition_en: Having the warm yellow colour of gold. | Especially valuable, favourable, or successful.
example1_en: The bread turned golden after twenty minutes in the oven.
example1_zh: 面包在烤箱里烤了二十分钟后变成了金黄色。
example2_en: International exchange programmes offer students a golden opportunity to develop language skills and understand different cultures.
example2_zh: 国际交流项目为学生提供了提高语言能力、了解不同文化的绝佳机会。
collocations: golden brown｜金黄偏褐色的 ; golden opportunity｜绝佳机会 ; golden age｜黄金时代 ; golden rule｜重要准则
tip_zh: golden多形容颜色；表示金制的通常用gold。

meanings_zh: adj. 抽象的 | adj. 抽象艺术的 | n. 摘要
definition_en: relating to ideas rather than physical objects or specific examples | using shapes and colours rather than realistic images | a short summary of a research paper or other document
example1_en: She uses toys to explain abstract ideas to children.
example1_zh: 她用玩具向孩子们解释抽象概念。
example2_en: Reading the abstract helps researchers decide whether a study is relevant to their own work.
example2_zh: 阅读摘要有助于研究人员判断一项研究是否与自己的工作相关。
collocations: an abstract concept｜抽象概念 ; abstract art｜抽象艺术 ; abstract thinking｜抽象思维 ; a research abstract｜研究摘要
tip_zh: 形容词和名词重音在首音节；动词重音在后。

meanings_zh: n. 大多数；过半数 | n. 超出对方的票数
definition_en: the larger part of a group, exceeding half its members | the extra votes by which one candidate or side wins
example1_en: The majority of our neighbours have dogs or cats.
example1_zh: 我们的邻居大多数都养狗或猫。
example2_en: The majority of respondents supported greater investment in public transport rather than the construction of new roads.
example2_zh: 大多数受访者支持增加公共交通投资，而非修建新道路。
collocations: the vast majority of｜……的绝大多数 ; a clear majority｜明显多数 ; win a majority｜赢得多数票
tip_zh: the majority of接复数名词时，谓语通常用复数。

meanings_zh: n. 叙述者；旁白者
definition_en: The person or voice telling a story
example1_en: The narrator's gentle voice helped me fall asleep.
example1_zh: 旁白者轻柔的声音帮助我入睡。
example2_en: An unreliable narrator encourages readers to question events and consider how personal perspectives shape their understanding of reality.
example2_zh: 不可靠的叙述者促使读者质疑事件，并思考个人视角如何塑造对现实的理解。
collocations: first-person narrator｜第一人称叙述者 ; unreliable narrator｜不可靠的叙述者 ; documentary narrator｜纪录片旁白者
tip_zh: 叙述者不一定是作者；小说中可由虚构人物担任。

meanings_zh: n. 后缀
definition_en: A word part added at the end to change meaning or grammar.
example1_en: Our teacher showed us how a suffix changes a word.
example1_zh: 老师向我们展示了后缀如何改变一个词。
example2_en: Learning common suffixes helps students recognise word classes and understand unfamiliar vocabulary in academic texts.
example2_zh: 学习常见后缀有助于学生识别词性，并理解学术文章中的陌生词汇。
collocations: add a suffix｜添加后缀 ; a noun suffix｜名词后缀 ; a plural suffix｜复数后缀
tip_zh: suffix加在词尾；prefix加在词首。

meanings_zh: adj. 团结的；一致的 | adj. 联合的；统一的
definition_en: Working together or sharing the same aims and opinions. | Joined together to form a single group or whole.
example1_en: Our neighbours remained united despite disagreements about the garden.
example1_zh: 尽管对花园有不同意见，我们的邻居们仍然保持团结。
example2_en: A united response from governments and communities is essential for addressing the long-term challenges of climate change.
example2_zh: 政府与社区一致行动，对于应对气候变化带来的长期挑战至关重要。
collocations: a united front｜统一战线 ; a united response｜一致的回应 ; united in opposition｜一致反对 ; remain united｜保持团结
tip_zh: be united in后接共同立场；united front指一致阵线。

meanings_zh: n. 语言学
definition_en: The scientific study of language and how it works.
example1_en: My sister studies linguistics and loves comparing different accents.
example1_zh: 我姐姐学习语言学，喜欢比较不同的口音。
example2_en: Research in linguistics can help teachers develop more effective methods for teaching foreign languages.
example2_zh: 语言学研究可以帮助教师开发更有效的外语教学方法。
collocations: applied linguistics｜应用语言学 ; historical linguistics｜历史语言学 ; study linguistics｜学习语言学
tip_zh: 虽以s结尾，作为学科名通常接单数谓语。

meanings_zh: n. 谜语 | n. 谜；难解之事
definition_en: a puzzling question with a clever or unexpected answer | something mysterious that is difficult to understand or explain
example1_en: My cousin asked a riddle that nobody could solve.
example1_zh: 我的表亲出了一个谁也解不开的谜语。
example2_en: The sudden disappearance of this ancient settlement remains a riddle despite decades of archaeological research.
example2_zh: 尽管经过数十年的考古研究，这座古代聚落的突然消失仍是一个谜。
collocations: solve a riddle｜解开谜语 ; pose a riddle｜出谜语 ; remain a riddle｜仍是一个谜
tip_zh: 谜语的答案用answer；解谜可用solve a riddle。

meanings_zh: n. 工作狂
definition_en: Someone who works excessively and finds it hard to stop
example1_en: My brother is a workaholic who rarely takes holidays.
example1_zh: 我哥哥是个工作狂，几乎不休假。
example2_en: A workaholic may achieve short-term career success while neglecting personal relationships and long-term health.
example2_zh: 工作狂可能取得短期的职业成功，却忽视了人际关系和长期健康。
collocations: a self-confessed workaholic｜自认的工作狂 ; become a workaholic｜成为工作狂 ; a workaholic culture｜过度工作的文化
tip_zh: 强调工作过度、难以停下，不等于单纯勤奋。

meanings_zh: adj. 军事的；军队的 | n. 军队；武装力量
definition_en: relating to armed forces or their activities | a country's armed forces, considered as a group
example1_en: We watched military helicopters carry supplies to the island.
example1_zh: 我们看着军用直升机把物资运往岛上。
example2_en: Governments must balance military spending with investment in essential public services such as healthcare and education.
example2_zh: 政府必须平衡军事开支与医疗、教育等基本公共服务的投入。
collocations: military service｜兵役 ; military spending｜军事开支 ; military personnel｜军人 ; the military｜军队
tip_zh: 作名词指整体军队时，通常用the military。

meanings_zh: v. 使复杂化；使更难处理
definition_en: to make something harder to understand or deal with
example1_en: Changing the date now would only complicate our plans.
example1_zh: 现在改日期只会让我们的计划更难安排。
example2_en: Unclear regulations can complicate efforts to establish small businesses, particularly in rapidly developing urban areas.
example2_zh: 不明确的法规会增加创办小企业的难度，在快速发展的城市地区尤其如此。
collocations: complicate matters｜使事情复杂化 ; complicate the situation｜使局势复杂化 ; complicate the process｜使过程复杂化
tip_zh: 及物动词，后接被弄复杂的事物。

meanings_zh: n. 畅销书；畅销商品
definition_en: a book or product that sells in very large quantities
example1_en: That cookbook became a best-seller within a month.
example1_zh: 那本食谱不到一个月就成了畅销书。
example2_en: A best-seller can encourage wider public interest in scientific issues that previously attracted little attention.
example2_zh: 一本畅销书能够激发公众对以往鲜受关注的科学议题的广泛兴趣。
collocations: an international best-seller｜国际畅销书 ; become a best-seller｜成为畅销书 ; a best-seller list｜畅销书排行榜
tip_zh: 也常写作bestseller；形容词用best-selling。

meanings_zh: n. 困倦；睡意
definition_en: The feeling of being tired and wanting to sleep.
