collocations: tree-lined avenue｜林荫大道 ; avenue of research｜研究途径 ; explore every avenue｜探索一切途径
tip_zh: 比喻义常见avenue for/of，表示途径。

meanings_zh: adv. 通常；一般 | adv. 典型地；具有代表性地
definition_en: In most cases or on most occasions. | In a way that shows the usual qualities of something.
example1_en: Our neighbours typically walk their dog before breakfast.
example1_zh: 我们的邻居通常在早餐前遛狗。
example2_en: Cities with reliable public transport typically experience less traffic congestion than those dependent on private cars.
example2_zh: 公共交通可靠的城市通常比依赖私家车的城市交通拥堵更少。
collocations: typically require｜通常需要 ; typically involve｜通常涉及 ; typically found in｜通常见于
tip_zh: 通常放在实义动词前、be动词后。

meanings_zh: n. 优雅；优美 | n. 宽限；恩惠 | v. 为…增色；使优美
definition_en: smooth, attractive movement or behaviour | extra time or kindness freely given | make a place or occasion more attractive by being present
example1_en: The dancer moved across the stage with effortless grace.
example1_zh: 那位舞者轻盈优雅地穿过舞台。
example2_en: A short grace period can help households manage unexpected delays in receiving their income.
example2_zh: 短暂的宽限期可以帮助家庭应对收入意外延迟到账的情况。
collocations: with grace｜优雅地 ; a grace period｜宽限期 ; grace the occasion｜为活动增色
tip_zh: grace 表优雅通常不可数；grace period 指宽限期。

meanings_zh: adj. 不稳固的 | adj. 不稳定的；易变的
definition_en: Likely to move, fall, or collapse. | Likely to change suddenly and unpredictably.
example1_en: This unstable chair wobbles whenever I sit on it.
example1_zh: 这把椅子不稳，我一坐上去就晃。
example2_en: An unstable economy can discourage investment and make long-term planning difficult for small businesses.
example2_zh: 经济不稳定会抑制投资，并使小企业难以制定长期计划。
collocations: unstable economy｜不稳定的经济 ; politically unstable｜政治上不稳定的 ; unstable structure｜不稳固的结构
tip_zh: 可指物体不稳，也可指经济、局势等易变。

meanings_zh: adj. 有影响力的
definition_en: Able to strongly affect people's opinions, decisions, or actions.
example1_en: Her grandfather was an influential teacher in their village.
example1_zh: 她的祖父曾是村里一位很有影响力的教师。
example2_en: Scientific advisers can be influential in shaping government policies on public health and environmental protection.
example2_zh: 科学顾问可以在制定公共卫生和环境保护政策方面发挥重要影响。
collocations: influential figure｜有影响力的人物 ; highly influential｜极具影响力的 ; influential in shaping policy｜对政策制定有影响力
tip_zh: 常用be influential in doing，表示对某事有影响。

meanings_zh: n. 慷慨；大方 | n. 宽宏大量
definition_en: Willingness to give money, time, or help freely. | Willingness to be kind and forgiving towards others.
example1_en: Thanks to your generosity, everyone has a warm coat.
example1_zh: 多亏你的慷慨相助，每个人都有了一件暖和的外套。
example2_en: Community projects often depend on the generosity of residents who contribute both money and valuable practical skills.
example2_zh: 社区项目往往依靠居民的慷慨支持，他们既捐款，也贡献宝贵的实用技能。
collocations: show generosity｜表现出慷慨 ; an act of generosity｜慷慨之举 ; generosity towards others｜对他人的慷慨
tip_zh: 通常不可数；一次慷慨之举用an act of generosity。

meanings_zh: n. 百合；百合花
definition_en: A plant with large, often trumpet-shaped flowers.
example1_en: A white lily opened beside our kitchen window this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早晨，我们厨房窗边的一朵白百合开了。
example2_en: Urban gardens planted with lilies and other flowering species can provide attractive spaces for local residents.
example2_zh: 种有百合和其他开花植物的城市花园能为当地居民提供宜人的空间。
collocations: white lily｜白百合 ; lily bulb｜百合鳞茎 ; water lily｜睡莲
tip_zh: 复数为lilies；water lily指睡莲。

meanings_zh: adj. 肌肉发达的；强壮的 | adj. 肌肉的
definition_en: Having large, strong muscles. | Relating to the muscles of the body.
example1_en: The muscular swimmer lifted the heavy box easily.
example1_zh: 那位肌肉发达的游泳运动员轻松举起了沉重的箱子。
example2_en: Regular resistance training can improve muscular strength and help older adults maintain their independence.
example2_zh: 定期进行抗阻训练可以增强肌肉力量，帮助老年人保持独立生活的能力。
collocations: muscular strength｜肌肉力量 ; muscular pain｜肌肉疼痛 ; muscular build｜健壮的体格
tip_zh: 既可指肌肉发达，也可仅表示与肌肉有关。

meanings_zh: n. 孩子；年轻人
definition_en: A child or young person.
example1_en: A cheerful youngster helped me pick up the apples.
example1_zh: 一个开朗的孩子帮我捡起了那些苹果。
example2_en: Community sports programmes give youngsters opportunities to develop teamwork skills and build friendships outside school.
example2_zh: 社区体育项目让青少年有机会培养团队协作能力，并在校外建立友谊。
collocations: local youngsters｜当地青少年 ; talented youngsters｜有天赋的年轻人 ; a group of youngsters｜一群孩子
tip_zh: 男女皆可指，语气较随意；正式写作可用young people。

meanings_zh: n. 着迷；强烈兴趣
definition_en: a very strong interest in someone or something
example1_en: She watched the tiny fish with fascination for hours.
example1_zh: 她着迷地看着那些小鱼，一看就是几个小时。
example2_en: Children's fascination with wildlife can provide a valuable starting point for environmental education in primary schools.
example2_zh: 孩子们对野生动物的浓厚兴趣，可以为小学环境教育提供宝贵的切入点。
collocations: fascination with｜对……的着迷 ; watch with fascination｜看得入迷 ; hold a fascination for｜对……有吸引力
tip_zh: 对某物着迷用 fascination with；看得入迷用 with fascination。

meanings_zh: n. 幼儿园；学前班
definition_en: A school or class for children beginning their education
example1_en: My daughter painted a bright yellow bird at kindergarten.
example1_zh: 我女儿在幼儿园画了一只鲜黄色的小鸟。
example2_en: High-quality kindergarten education can develop children's social skills and prepare them for more structured learning.
example2_zh: 优质的学前教育能培养儿童的社交能力，为更系统的学习做好准备。
collocations: kindergarten teacher｜幼儿园教师 ; attend kindergarten｜上幼儿园 ; kindergarten classroom｜幼儿园教室
tip_zh: 美式常指小学前的一年；英式幼儿园常用nursery。

meanings_zh: n. 阶段；时期 | n. 月相 | v. 分阶段进行
definition_en: A distinct period in a process of change or development. | One of the changing shapes of the moon as seen. | To introduce or remove something gradually in planned stages.
example1_en: The kitchen repairs have entered their final phase.
example1_zh: 厨房维修已进入最后阶段。
example2_en: During the initial phase of urban development, planners should prioritise affordable housing and reliable public transport.
example2_zh: 在城市发展的初期阶段，规划者应优先考虑可负担住房和可靠的公共交通。
collocations: an initial phase｜初始阶段 ; a phase of development｜发展阶段 ; phase out｜逐步淘汰 ; phase in｜逐步引入
tip_zh: phase in指逐步引入，phase out指逐步淘汰。

meanings_zh: n. 操作员 | n. 经营者；运营商 | n. 电话接线员
definition_en: a person who controls a machine or piece of equipment | a person or company that runs a business or service | a person who connects calls or provides telephone assistance
example1_en: The crane operator carefully lowered the beam into place.
example1_zh: 起重机操作员小心地把横梁降到指定位置。
example2_en: Every public transport operator should ensure that its services remain accessible to passengers with limited mobility.
example2_zh: 每家公共交通运营商都应确保行动不便的乘客能够使用其服务。
collocations: machine operator｜机器操作员 ; tour operator｜旅游经营商 ; mobile network operator｜移动网络运营商 ; telephone operator｜电话接线员
tip_zh: 既指操作设备的人，也指经营服务的公司。

meanings_zh: n. 令人惊叹的人或事物 | v. 感到惊叹
definition_en: Someone or something that causes great admiration or surprise | To feel great surprise or admiration
example1_en: We marvelled at the tiny bird's beautifully woven nest.
example1_zh: 那只小鸟精巧编织的巢让我们惊叹不已。
example2_en: The new bridge is an engineering marvel that connects isolated communities and improves access to essential services.
example2_zh: 这座新桥是一项工程奇迹，连接了偏远社区，并让居民更方便地获得基本服务。
collocations: an engineering marvel｜工程奇迹 ; a technological marvel｜技术奇迹 ; marvel at｜对……感到惊叹 ; a marvel of nature｜自然奇观
tip_zh: 动词常接at；英式过去式marvelled，美式marveled。

meanings_zh: v. 说脏话；咒骂 | v. 发誓；郑重保证
definition_en: to use rude or offensive words | to make a serious promise or insist something is true
example1_en: Please don't swear when the game goes wrong.
example1_zh: 玩游戏不顺利时，请不要说脏话。
example2_en: Witnesses must swear to tell the truth before giving evidence in many legal systems.
example2_zh: 在许多法律体系中，证人作证前必须宣誓如实陈述。
collocations: swear at someone｜咒骂某人 ; swear to do something｜发誓做某事 ; swear an oath｜宣誓
tip_zh: 过去式swore，过去分词sworn；swear at指咒骂。

meanings_zh: n. 概述；综述
definition_en: A short account presenting the main features of a subject.
example1_en: Our guide gave us an overview of the tour.
example1_zh: 导游向我们简要介绍了游览安排。
example2_en: The opening section provides an overview of the main challenges facing renewable energy development.
example2_zh: 开篇部分概述了可再生能源发展面临的主要挑战。
collocations: provide an overview｜提供概述 ; a brief overview｜简要概述 ; a general overview｜总体概述 ; an overview of｜对……的概述
tip_zh: 通常作可数名词；搭配an overview of。

meanings_zh: n. 招聘；招募
definition_en: the process of finding people to join an organisation
example1_en: Our cafe handles recruitment before the busy summer season.
example1_zh: 我们咖啡馆会在繁忙的夏季到来之前招聘员工。
example2_en: Fair recruitment practices help employers attract talented applicants from a wide range of social backgrounds.
example2_zh: 公平的招聘方式有助于雇主吸引来自不同社会背景的优秀求职者。
collocations: recruitment process｜招聘流程 ; recruitment agency｜招聘中介 ; recruitment campaign｜招聘活动 ; staff recruitment｜员工招聘
tip_zh: 通常不可数；招聘某类人员用recruitment of。

meanings_zh: adj. 较小的；次要的；轻微的 | n. 未成年人 | adj. 小调的
definition_en: Not very serious, important, or large. | A person younger than the legal age of adulthood. | Using a musical scale often associated with a sad sound.
example1_en: The bike only needs a few minor repairs.
example1_zh: 这辆自行车只需要稍作修理。
example2_en: Minor changes to daily travel habits can collectively reduce pollution in densely populated urban areas.
example2_zh: 日常出行习惯的小改变，累积起来可以减少人口密集城区的污染。
collocations: minor injury｜轻伤 ; minor changes｜小幅改动 ; minor issue｜次要问题 ; minor key｜小调
tip_zh: minor injury指轻伤；名词a minor指未成年人。

meanings_zh: v. 调查；查明 | v. 研究；探究
definition_en: To examine facts carefully to discover what happened or why. | To study a subject carefully to learn more about it.
example1_en: A plumber came to investigate the strange noise upstairs.
example1_zh: 一位水管工来查明楼上怪声的原因。
example2_en: Researchers are investigating how access to green spaces affects the mental health of urban residents.
example2_zh: 研究人员正在探究接触绿地如何影响城市居民的心理健康。
collocations: investigate a complaint｜调查投诉 ; investigate the cause｜调查原因 ; investigate a link｜探究关联
tip_zh: 直接接调查对象：investigate the problem，不加into。

meanings_zh: v. 说明；举例阐明 | v. 为……配插图
definition_en: To make something clear through examples or evidence. | To provide pictures for a book or other publication.
example1_en: She used two jars to illustrate the difference.
example1_zh: 她用两个罐子来说明其中的区别。
example2_en: These findings illustrate how access to public transport can improve employment opportunities in disadvantaged communities.
example2_zh: 这些研究结果说明，公共交通的可及性如何改善弱势社区的就业机会。
collocations: illustrate a point｜说明一个观点 ; illustrate the importance of｜说明……的重要性 ; illustrate a book｜为书配插图
tip_zh: illustrate可用例子说明，不一定涉及图片。

meanings_zh: adj. 辉煌的；光荣的 | adj. 极其美好的；壮丽的
definition_en: Deserving great admiration or bringing honour and pride. | Extremely beautiful, enjoyable, or pleasant.
example1_en: We spent a glorious afternoon swimming in the lake.
example1_zh: 我们在湖里游泳，度过了一个美好的下午。
example2_en: Museums should examine difficult historical events as carefully as they celebrate a nation's glorious achievements.
example2_zh: 博物馆应像颂扬一个国家的辉煌成就一样，认真审视艰难的历史事件。
collocations: glorious victory｜辉煌的胜利 ; glorious sunshine｜明媚的阳光 ; glorious past｜辉煌的过去
tip_zh: glorious既可指值得荣耀，也可赞美天气或景色。

meanings_zh: n. 核对清单；检查表
definition_en: A list of things to check or do
example1_en: I use a checklist when packing for a trip.
example1_zh: 旅行收拾行李时，我会用一份核对清单。
example2_en: A standard safety checklist can help hospital staff reduce avoidable errors during routine medical procedures.
example2_zh: 标准安全检查表能帮助医院工作人员减少常规医疗操作中可避免的错误。
collocations: safety checklist｜安全检查表 ; packing checklist｜行李清单 ; complete a checklist｜完成检查表
tip_zh: 可数名词；强调逐项核对，不只是罗列物品。

meanings_zh: adj. 简单易懂的；易做的 | adj. 坦率的；直截了当的
definition_en: easy to understand or do, without complications | honest and direct in expressing thoughts or intentions
example1_en: The recipe is straightforward, even for a beginner.
example1_zh: 这道食谱很简单，即使初学者也能照着做。
example2_en: Governments should make recycling procedures straightforward so that more households can participate without unnecessary confusion.
example2_zh: 政府应简化回收流程，让更多家庭能够参与，避免不必要的困惑。
collocations: a straightforward process｜简单的流程 ; a straightforward answer｜直截了当的回答 ; relatively straightforward｜相对简单的 ; straightforward advice｜明确易懂的建议
tip_zh: 既可形容事情简单，也可形容人坦率。

meanings_zh: v. 挠；搔 | v. 刮伤；划伤 | n. 划痕；抓伤
definition_en: To rub skin with fingernails, often to relieve itching. | To damage a surface with something sharp or rough. | A thin mark or shallow injury caused by something sharp.
example1_en: Please don't scratch that bite; it will get worse.
example1_zh: 别挠那个被叮的包，会越挠越严重。
example2_en: Even a small scratch on a reusable container can make it harder to clean effectively.
example2_zh: 即使是可重复使用容器上的一道小划痕，也可能让它更难被彻底清洁。
collocations: scratch your head｜挠头 ; a deep scratch｜一道深划痕 ; from scratch｜从零开始 ; scratch the surface｜仅触及表面
tip_zh: from scratch表示从零开始，与“抓挠”无关。

meanings_zh: n. 温室；暖房
definition_en: a glass or plastic building that keeps growing plants warm
example1_en: We grow tomatoes in the greenhouse throughout the winter.
example1_zh: 整个冬天，我们都在温室里种番茄。
example2_en: Greenhouse cultivation can extend growing seasons, although heating these structures may require considerable amounts of energy.
example2_zh: 温室种植可以延长生长季，但为这些设施供暖可能需要消耗大量能源。
collocations: grow plants in a greenhouse｜在温室里种植物 ; greenhouse gas emissions｜温室气体排放 ; the greenhouse effect｜温室效应
tip_zh: greenhouse是名词，也可作定语，如greenhouse gases。

meanings_zh: n. 效率；效能
definition_en: The ability to achieve results without wasting time, energy, or resources
example1_en: Organising my tools improved the efficiency of my work.
example1_zh: 把工具整理好提高了我的工作效率。
example2_en: Improving energy efficiency in public buildings can reduce government spending and lower greenhouse gas emissions.
example2_zh: 提高公共建筑的能源利用效率，可以减少政府开支并降低温室气体排放。
collocations: energy efficiency｜能源利用效率 ; improve efficiency｜提高效率 ; operational efficiency｜运营效率 ; fuel efficiency｜燃油效率
tip_zh: efficiency强调少浪费；effectiveness强调达到效果。

meanings_zh: adj. 有凝聚力的；紧密结合的
definition_en: united or closely connected as a whole
example1_en: Regular practice helped us become a more cohesive team.
example1_zh: 定期练习帮助我们成为一支更有凝聚力的队伍。
example2_en: Shared public spaces can help build cohesive communities by encouraging interaction among people from different backgrounds.
example2_zh: 共享公共空间可以促进不同背景的人交流，从而帮助建设有凝聚力的社区。
collocations: cohesive team｜有凝聚力的团队 ; cohesive society｜团结的社会 ; cohesive argument｜衔接紧密的论证
tip_zh: cohesive强调紧密结合；coherent强调条理清楚。

meanings_zh: n. 船体 | n. 谷壳；果实外壳 | v. 去壳；去果蒂
definition_en: The main outer body of a ship or boat. | The outer covering of a seed or fruit. | To remove the outer covering or leafy top of food.
example1_en: We painted the boat's hull blue before launching it.
example1_zh: 我们把船体漆成蓝色，然后才将船下水。
example2_en: Improved hull designs can reduce fuel consumption by allowing ships to move through water with less resistance.
example2_zh: 改进船体设计可以减小船舶在水中航行的阻力，从而降低燃料消耗。
collocations: a ship's hull｜船体 ; a steel hull｜钢制船体 ; rice hulls｜稻壳 ; hull strawberries｜去除草莓果蒂
tip_zh: 船体是hull；整艘船用ship或boat。

meanings_zh: n. 招生简章 | n. 招股说明书；项目介绍书
definition_en: a document describing a school or university for potential students | a document explaining an investment or business opportunity
example1_en: I checked the college prospectus for photography courses.
example1_zh: 我查看了学院的招生简章，寻找摄影课程。
example2_en: A university prospectus should provide accurate information about tuition fees, course content, and available student support.
example2_zh: 大学招生简章应准确介绍学费、课程内容及可获得的学生支持服务。
collocations: university prospectus｜大学招生简章 ; request a prospectus｜索取招生简章 ; issue a prospectus｜发布招股说明书
tip_zh: 教育语境常指招生简章，金融语境可指招股说明书。

meanings_zh: n. 十四行诗
definition_en: A fourteen-line poem following a particular rhyme and rhythm pattern.
example1_en: She read a sonnet aloud beside the open window.
example1_zh: 她在敞开的窗边朗读了一首十四行诗。
example2_en: Studying a sonnet helps students understand how formal constraints can encourage creative expression in literature.
example2_zh: 学习十四行诗有助于学生理解形式上的限制如何促进文学中的创造性表达。
collocations: write a sonnet｜写十四行诗 ; sonnet sequence｜十四行组诗 ; sonnet form｜十四行诗体
tip_zh: sonnet固定为十四行，但押韵格式不只一种。

meanings_zh: n. 男女同校教育
definition_en: The education of boys and girls together in the same institution.
example1_en: My grandparents first experienced coeducation at their village school.
example1_zh: 我的祖父母在村里的学校首次接受了男女同校教育。
example2_en: Supporters of coeducation argue that learning together helps boys and girls develop mutual respect.
example2_zh: 支持男女同校教育的人认为，共同学习有助于男孩和女孩培养相互尊重的态度。
collocations: benefits of coeducation｜男女同校教育的益处 ; support coeducation｜支持男女同校教育 ; introduce coeducation｜实行男女同校教育
tip_zh: 不可数名词；形容词形式为coeducational。

meanings_zh: n. 领事
definition_en: An official abroad who assists citizens and represents national interests
example1_en: The consul helped us after we lost our passports.
example1_zh: 我们丢失护照后，领事给我们提供了帮助。
example2_en: A consul may support citizens facing difficulties overseas and help strengthen commercial links between countries.
example2_zh: 领事可以为在海外遇到困难的本国公民提供支持，并帮助加强国家间的商业联系。
collocations: consul general｜总领事 ; honorary consul｜名誉领事 ; vice consul｜副领事
tip_zh: consul是领事；consulate是领事馆，勿混淆。

meanings_zh: n. 操纵；控制 | n. 操作；处理
definition_en: Controlling people or situations unfairly for personal advantage. | Moving or adjusting something carefully, often using hands or tools.
example1_en: She recognised his emotional manipulation and refused to feel guilty.
example1_zh: 她识破了他的情感操控，拒绝为此感到内疚。
example2_en: The manipulation of survey results can mislead policymakers and reduce public trust in scientific research.
example2_zh: 操纵调查结果可能误导政策制定者，并降低公众对科学研究的信任。
collocations: emotional manipulation｜情感操控 ; data manipulation｜数据处理；数据篡改 ; market manipulation｜市场操纵
tip_zh: 指操控人时常含贬义；指操作工具时可中性。

meanings_zh: adj. 同时发生的；并行的
definition_en: Happening or existing at the same time
example1_en: Two concurrent meetings meant I had to choose one.
example1_zh: 两个会议同时举行，我只能选择参加其中一个。
example2_en: Concurrent improvements in housing and public transport can make urban development more inclusive and sustainable.
example2_zh: 同步改善住房和公共交通，可以使城市发展更具包容性和可持续性。
collocations: concurrent events｜同时发生的事件 ; concurrent sessions｜同期举行的分会 ; concurrent with｜与…同时发生
tip_zh: 强调时间重叠；表示“与…同时”可用concurrent with。

meanings_zh: v. 奉承；讨好 | v. 使感到荣幸或高兴 | v. 使显得更好看
definition_en: Praise someone, often insincerely, to gain their favour. | Make someone feel pleased or honoured through attention or praise. | Make someone look more attractive than they otherwise would.
example1_en: That blue jacket really flatters you in this light.
example1_zh: 在这样的光线下，那件蓝色夹克真的很衬你。
example2_en: Advertisements often flatter consumers by suggesting that choosing a particular product demonstrates intelligence or good taste.
example2_zh: 广告常常暗示选择某种产品代表聪明或品位好，以此讨好消费者。
collocations: flatter someone's ego｜满足某人的虚荣心 ; feel flattered｜感到荣幸 ; flatter yourself｜自以为是
tip_zh: be flattered常指受宠若惊，不一定含贬义。

meanings_zh: v. 干涉；管闲事
definition_en: Interfere in other people's affairs without being invited.
example1_en: Please don't meddle in how I arrange my room.
example1_zh: 请别干涉我如何布置自己的房间。
example2_en: Parents who constantly meddle in their children's decisions may prevent them from developing confidence and independence.
example2_zh: 不断干涉孩子决定的父母可能会阻碍他们培养自信和独立性。
collocations: meddle in someone's affairs｜干涉某人的私事 ; meddle with something｜擅自摆弄某物
tip_zh: 常接in表示干涉事务；接with表示擅自摆弄。

meanings_zh: n. 沉思；深思 | n. 考虑；打算
definition_en: the act of thinking deeply and quietly about something | the act of considering a possible future action
example1_en: He sat by the lake in quiet contemplation.
example1_zh: 他坐在湖边，静静地沉思。
example2_en: Public gardens offer urban residents valuable opportunities for quiet contemplation away from the pressures of daily life.
example2_zh: 公共花园为城市居民提供宝贵的机会，让他们远离日常生活的压力，静心沉思。
collocations: quiet contemplation｜静静的沉思 ; deep contemplation｜深思 ; in contemplation｜在沉思中
tip_zh: 通常不可数；强调安静深思，不一定是痛苦思索。

meanings_zh: n. 阈值；界限 | n. 门槛 | n. 开端；起点
definition_en: the level at which something starts happening or changes | the bottom edge of a doorway | the point just before a new experience or period begins
example1_en: My brother has a much higher pain threshold than me.
example1_zh: 我哥哥比我耐疼得多。
example2_en: Raising the income threshold for financial assistance would allow more low-paid workers to receive support.
example2_zh: 提高经济援助的收入门槛，将使更多低薪劳动者能够获得支持。
collocations: pain threshold｜痛觉阈值 ; income threshold｜收入门槛 ; cross the threshold｜跨过门槛 ; on the threshold of｜即将进入
tip_zh: on the threshold of表示即将进入某个新阶段。

meanings_zh: v. 组成；构成 | v. 算作；构成 | v. 正式设立
definition_en: To be the parts that form a whole | To be considered a particular thing | To formally establish an organisation or governing body
example1_en: Vegetables constitute most of the food in our fridge.
example1_zh: 我们冰箱里的食物大部分是蔬菜。
example2_en: Rising housing costs constitute a major barrier to financial independence for young adults in large cities.
example2_zh: 不断上涨的住房成本构成了大城市年轻人实现经济独立的一大障碍。
collocations: constitute a majority｜占多数 ; constitute a threat｜构成威胁 ; constitute a breach｜构成违反 ; constitute a committee｜正式成立委员会
tip_zh: 表组成时通常以部分作主语，整体作宾语。

meanings_zh: adj. 手术前的
definition_en: Happening or provided before a surgical operation.
example1_en: The nurse explained my preoperative checks before tomorrow's surgery.
example1_zh: 护士向我解释了明天手术前要做的检查。
example2_en: Thorough preoperative assessment helps medical teams identify potential risks and plan appropriate care for each patient.
example2_zh: 全面的术前评估帮助医疗团队识别潜在风险，并为每位患者制定适当的护理计划。
collocations: preoperative assessment｜术前评估 ; preoperative care｜术前护理 ; preoperative preparation｜术前准备
tip_zh: pre- 表示之前；postoperative 则表示手术后的。

meanings_zh: adj. 固有的；内在的
definition_en: Existing as a natural or essential part of something.
example1_en: Even simple home repairs come with some inherent risks.
example1_zh: 即使是简单的家居维修也有一些固有风险。
example2_en: Policymakers must recognise the inherent limitations of economic growth as a measure of social progress and wellbeing.
example2_zh: 政策制定者必须认识到，用经济增长衡量社会进步和福祉存在固有局限。
collocations: inherent risks｜固有风险 ; inherent limitations｜固有局限 ; inherent in｜内在于；固有于 ; inherent value｜内在价值
tip_zh: 常用inherent in；强调本身具有，而非后来获得。

meanings_zh: adj. 实证的；基于观察的
definition_en: based on observation or experiments rather than theory alone
example1_en: Our garden trial provided empirical evidence that compost helps plants.
example1_zh: 我们的花园试验提供了堆肥有益植物的实证依据。
example2_en: Education policies should be supported by empirical research rather than assumptions about how children learn.
example2_zh: 教育政策应以实证研究为依据，而不是依赖对儿童学习方式的假设。
collocations: empirical evidence｜实证证据 ; empirical research｜实证研究 ; empirical data｜实证数据
tip_zh: 强调观察或实验依据，不等于个人经验之谈。

meanings_zh: n. 滨水区；水岸地带
definition_en: An area beside a sea, lake, or river, especially in towns.
example1_en: We walked along the waterfront after an early dinner.
example1_zh: 我们早早吃完晚饭后沿着水岸散步。
example2_en: Redeveloping the waterfront can create attractive public spaces, provided that existing residents are not forced to leave.
example2_zh: 滨水区改造可以创造宜人的公共空间，前提是不迫使原有居民搬离。
collocations: along the waterfront｜沿着水岸 ; waterfront development｜滨水区开发 ; a waterfront restaurant｜水边餐厅
tip_zh: 指城镇临水地带，不一定是沙滩或海边。

meanings_zh: v. 重新分配；重新分布
definition_en: To share out or spread something again in a different way.
example1_en: We redistributed the blankets so everyone had one.
example1_zh: 我们重新分配了毯子，让每个人都有一条。
example2_en: Progressive taxation can redistribute wealth and help governments fund essential services for disadvantaged communities.
example2_zh: 累进税制能够重新分配财富，并帮助政府为弱势社区的基本服务提供资金。
collocations: redistribute wealth｜重新分配财富 ; redistribute income｜重新分配收入 ; redistribute resources｜重新分配资源
tip_zh: 强调改变原有分配，不一定意味着平均分配。

meanings_zh: n. 遵守；服从
definition_en: the act of following a rule, law, or request
example1_en: The inspector checked our kitchen for compliance with hygiene rules.
example1_zh: 检查员查看了我们的厨房是否符合卫生规定。
example2_en: Regular inspections can improve compliance with environmental regulations and reduce pollution from industrial facilities.
example2_zh: 定期检查可以促进企业遵守环境法规，减少工业设施造成的污染。
collocations: compliance with regulations｜遵守规定 ; ensure compliance｜确保合规 ; in compliance with｜按照；遵照
tip_zh: 通常不可数；表示遵守某规定时用compliance with。

meanings_zh: adj. 假的；虚伪的 | n. 骗子；虚伪的人
definition_en: Not genuine, or intended to deceive people | Someone who pretends to be something they are not
example1_en: His phony smile disappeared as soon as we left.
example1_zh: 我们一走，他那虚假的笑容就消失了。
example2_en: Consumers should be cautious about phony online reviews that exaggerate the benefits of health products.
example2_zh: 消费者应警惕夸大保健产品功效的虚假网络评论。
collocations: phony smile｜假笑 ; phony excuse｜虚假的借口 ; phony claims｜虚假说法
tip_zh: 偏口语；英式英语也常拼作phoney。

meanings_zh: adv. 一丝不苟地；细致地
definition_en: with great care and attention to every detail
example1_en: She meticulously cleaned each tiny part of the watch.
example1_zh: 她一丝不苟地清洁手表的每个微小零件。
example2_en: Researchers must meticulously record their procedures so that other teams can reproduce and verify the results.
example2_zh: 研究人员必须细致记录操作步骤，以便其他团队复现并验证结果。
collocations: meticulously planned｜精心规划的 ; meticulously documented｜详尽记录的 ; meticulously examine｜仔细检查
tip_zh: 强调关注每个细节，不表示“胆小地”。

meanings_zh: adj. 球形的；球状的
definition_en: shaped like a ball
example1_en: A spherical lamp hung above the dining table.
example1_zh: 餐桌上方挂着一盏球形灯。
example2_en: Researchers use spherical particles of different sizes to investigate how pollutants move through water filtration systems.
example2_zh: 研究人员使用大小不同的球形颗粒，研究污染物如何通过水过滤系统。
collocations: spherical shape｜球形 ; spherical particles｜球形颗粒 ; spherical surface｜球面
tip_zh: spherical指立体球形；circular指平面圆形。

meanings_zh: n. 规格；技术要求
definition_en: A detailed description of how something must be designed or made.
example1_en: Check the specifications before buying a new laptop.
example1_zh: 买新笔记本电脑前，先查看规格参数。
example2_en: Clear building specifications help ensure that new housing meets safety standards and uses energy efficiently.
example2_zh: 明确的建筑技术要求有助于确保新住房符合安全标准并高效利用能源。
collocations: technical specifications｜技术规格 ; meet specifications｜符合规格要求 ; design specification｜设计规范 ; to specification｜按规定规格
tip_zh: 谈产品各项参数常用复数specifications，可简称specs。

meanings_zh: adj. 严重的；强烈的 | adj. 急性的 | adj. 敏锐的
definition_en: Very serious or intense. | Starting suddenly and lasting a short time, often severely. | Quick to notice or understand things.
example1_en: The village faced an acute water shortage last summer.
example1_zh: 去年夏天，这个村庄面临严重缺水。
example2_en: An acute shortage of affordable housing forces many young workers to live far from their workplaces.
example2_zh: 经济适用住房的严重短缺迫使许多年轻劳动者住在远离工作地点的地方。
collocations: acute shortage｜严重短缺 ; acute pain｜剧痛 ; acute illness｜急性疾病 ; acute awareness｜敏锐的意识
tip_zh: 疾病中acute与chronic（慢性的）相对。

meanings_zh: v. 使通风 | v. 公开表达；公开讨论
definition_en: To allow fresh air to enter and circulate through somewhere. | To express or discuss opinions and concerns openly.
example1_en: Open both windows to ventilate the kitchen after cooking.
example1_zh: 做完饭后打开两扇窗，给厨房通风。
example2_en: Schools should ventilate classrooms regularly to improve indoor air quality and create healthier learning environments.
example2_zh: 学校应定期给教室通风，以改善室内空气质量，创造更健康的学习环境。
collocations: ventilate a room｜给房间通风 ; well-ventilated buildings｜通风良好的建筑 ; ventilate grievances｜公开表达不满
tip_zh: 使通风是常用义；表示公开讨论时较正式。

meanings_zh: n. 缩影；微型世界
definition_en: A small system showing the features of a larger one.
example1_en: Our busy kitchen is a microcosm of family life.
example1_zh: 我们忙碌的厨房是家庭生活的一个缩影。
example2_en: A diverse urban neighbourhood can serve as a microcosm of the wider society's opportunities and challenges.
example2_zh: 一个多元化的城市社区可以成为整个社会所面临的机遇与挑战的缩影。
collocations: a microcosm of society｜社会的缩影 ; in microcosm｜以缩影形式 ; serve as a microcosm｜充当缩影
tip_zh: 常用a microcosm of，指缩影，不只是微小事物。

meanings_zh: n. 回顾；回想
definition_en: Consideration of past events, often with a changed understanding.
example1_en: In retrospect, packing extra socks was a brilliant idea.
example1_zh: 现在回想起来，多带几双袜子真是个好主意。
example2_en: In retrospect, investing earlier in public transport could have prevented many of the city's current traffic problems.
example2_zh: 回过头看，如果早点投资公共交通，本可以避免这座城市目前的许多交通问题。
collocations: in retrospect｜回过头看 ; only in retrospect｜只有事后回想才
tip_zh: 通常用于固定短语in retrospect，表示事后回想。

meanings_zh: v. 促进；使便利
definition_en: make an action or process easier
example1_en: These sliding doors facilitate access for people using wheelchairs.
example1_zh: 这些推拉门方便使用轮椅的人进出。
example2_en: Digital platforms can facilitate collaboration between students in different countries, allowing them to exchange ideas more easily.
example2_zh: 数字平台可以促进不同国家学生之间的合作，让他们更容易交流想法。
collocations: facilitate communication｜促进沟通 ; facilitate learning｜促进学习 ; facilitate access｜方便进入或使用
tip_zh: 后接名词或动名词，不用facilitate somebody to do。

meanings_zh: v. 再次发生；反复出现
definition_en: to happen again, especially repeatedly or after an interval
example1_en: If these headaches recur, please speak to your doctor.
example1_zh: 如果这些头痛再次出现，请咨询医生。
example2_en: Traffic congestion will continue to recur unless cities address the underlying causes of excessive car use.
example2_zh: 除非城市解决汽车使用过度的根本原因，否则交通拥堵将继续反复出现。
collocations: a recurring problem｜反复出现的问题 ; a recurring theme｜反复出现的主题 ; symptoms recur｜症状复发
tip_zh: 不及物动词；过去式recurred，分词recurring。

meanings_zh: v. 推翻；颠覆 | n. 推翻；政权覆灭
definition_en: to remove a ruler or government from power | the removal of a ruler or government from power
example1_en: The film follows citizens who overthrow an unfair ruler.
example1_zh: 这部电影讲述民众推翻不公正统治者的故事。
example2_en: Economic hardship can weaken public support for a government and encourage attempts to overthrow it.
example2_zh: 经济困难可能削弱公众对政府的支持，并促使人们尝试推翻它。
collocations: overthrow a government｜推翻政府 ; overthrow a regime｜推翻政权 ; the overthrow of a ruler｜统治者被推翻
tip_zh: 过去式overthrew，过去分词overthrown。

meanings_zh: n. 香；熏香
definition_en: a substance burned to produce a pleasant smell
example1_en: A thin trail of smoke rose from the incense.
example1_zh: 一缕轻烟从熏香上缓缓升起。
example2_en: Burning incense indoors can affect air quality, particularly in small rooms with inadequate ventilation.
example2_zh: 在室内焚香可能影响空气质量，尤其是在通风不足的小房间里。
collocations: burn incense｜焚香 ; incense sticks｜线香 ; incense burner｜香炉
tip_zh: 名词重音在前；同形动词重音在后，意为激怒。

meanings_zh: adj. 异常的；罕见的 | n. 狂热爱好者 | v. 惊慌；吓坏
definition_en: Very unusual and unexpected | Someone extremely interested in a particular activity or subject | To become very frightened or upset, or make someone so
example1_en: A freak hailstorm covered our garden in white ice.
example1_zh: 一场罕见的冰雹把我们的花园盖上了一层白冰。
example2_en: A freak weather event can expose weaknesses in urban infrastructure and disrupt essential public services.
example2_zh: 异常天气事件可能暴露城市基础设施的薄弱环节，并扰乱基本公共服务。
collocations: a freak accident｜离奇的意外事故 ; a freak storm｜罕见的风暴 ; a fitness freak｜健身狂热爱好者 ; freak out｜惊慌失措
tip_zh: 形容词通常置于名词前；动词常用freak out。

meanings_zh: n. 伪造；伪造品
definition_en: Making illegal copies of documents or artworks; such a copy.
example1_en: The painting in the shop was a forgery.
example1_zh: 商店里的那幅画是一件赝品。
example2_en: Museums employ specialists to detect forgery and protect the public from misleading claims about historical objects.
example2_zh: 博物馆聘请专家识别伪造品，避免公众被有关历史文物的不实说法误导。
collocations: document forgery｜文件伪造 ; art forgery｜艺术品伪造 ; detect a forgery｜识别伪造品 ; a convincing forgery｜足以乱真的赝品
tip_zh: forgery是伪造或赝品；锻造作坊是forge。

meanings_zh: n. 容器上缘；口沿 | n. 帽檐 | v. 充满；满溢
definition_en: the upper edge of a cup, bowl, or other container | the part of a hat extending outward around its base | to be full of liquid or a strong feeling
example1_en: She filled my cup to the brim with tea.
example1_zh: 她把我的杯子倒满了茶。
example2_en: Community centres brimming with activity can strengthen social connections and reduce isolation among older residents.
example2_zh: 活动丰富的社区中心能够加强社会联系，减少老年居民的孤独感。
collocations: to the brim｜到满沿；满满地 ; a wide brim｜宽帽檐 ; brim with confidence｜充满信心
tip_zh: 满到杯沿用to the brim；充满用brim with。

meanings_zh: adj. 很可能遭受…的 | adj. 负有法律责任的
definition_en: Likely to experience something, especially something unpleasant. | Legally responsible for something, especially damage or payment.
example1_en: These old pipes are liable to burst in winter.
example1_zh: 这些旧水管在冬天很容易爆裂。
example2_en: Employers may be held liable for injuries caused by unsafe conditions in the workplace.
example2_zh: 雇主可能须对工作场所不安全条件造成的伤害承担法律责任。
collocations: liable to do something｜很可能做某事 ; liable for damages｜负有损害赔偿责任 ; be held liable｜被认定负有法律责任
tip_zh: liable to后接动词表可能；liable for表责任。

meanings_zh: v. 派遣；发送 | n. 发送；派遣 | n. 新闻报道；公文
definition_en: To send someone or something to a particular destination. | The act of sending goods, messages, or people somewhere. | An official message or a report sent by a journalist.
example1_en: The shop dispatched my new shoes this morning.
example1_zh: 商店今天早上寄出了我的新鞋。
example2_en: Local authorities should dispatch emergency teams quickly when severe flooding threatens homes and essential infrastructure.
example2_zh: 当严重洪灾威胁住宅和关键基础设施时，地方政府应迅速派出应急队伍。
collocations: dispatch goods｜发货 ; dispatch a team｜派出队伍 ; ready for dispatch｜备妥待发 ; a news dispatch｜新闻报道
tip_zh: despatch也是正确拼写，但dispatch更常见。

meanings_zh: n. 对齐；排列成直线 | n. 一致；协调 | n. 结盟；政治联合
definition_en: The arrangement of objects in a straight line or correct position. | Agreement between ideas, aims, or actions. | An association between groups sharing political aims or interests.
example1_en: The mechanic checked the alignment of my front wheels.
example1_zh: 修理工检查了我的前轮定位。
example2_en: Closer alignment between school curricula and workplace needs could improve employment prospects for young graduates.
example2_zh: 学校课程与职场需求更加协调，有助于改善年轻毕业生的就业前景。
collocations: wheel alignment｜车轮定位 ; in alignment with｜与……一致 ; political alignment｜政治结盟
tip_zh: in alignment with可指位置对齐或目标一致。

meanings_zh: n. 民主主义者 | n. 美国民主党党员或支持者
definition_en: Someone who supports government based on the people's choices | A member or supporter of the Democratic Party in America
example1_en: As a democrat, she wants everyone to have a vote.
example1_zh: 作为民主主义者，她希望人人都有投票权。
example2_en: A committed democrat should defend fair elections even when the results favour a competing political party.
example2_zh: 坚定的民主主义者即使面对有利于竞争政党的结果，也应捍卫公正的选举。
collocations: committed democrat｜坚定的民主主义者 ; lifelong democrat｜终身信奉民主的人 ; liberal democrat｜自由民主主义者
tip_zh: 泛指民主主义者用小写；美国民主党人写作Democrat。

meanings_zh: n. 恶意；害人之心
definition_en: a desire to hurt someone or cause them trouble
example1_en: There was no malice in his teasing smile.
example1_zh: 他打趣的笑容里并没有恶意。
example2_en: Schools should distinguish between careless remarks and comments made with malice when addressing conflicts among students.
example2_zh: 学校在处理学生之间的冲突时，应区分无心之言和恶意评论。
collocations: with malice｜怀着恶意 ; bear no malice｜不怀恶意 ; out of malice｜出于恶意
tip_zh: 通常不可数；with malice 表示“怀着恶意”。

meanings_zh: n. 认证；资格证明
definition_en: Official confirmation that someone or something meets required standards.
example1_en: The swimming instructor proudly showed us her new certification.
example1_zh: 游泳教练自豪地向我们展示了她新取得的资格证明。
example2_en: Independent certification helps consumers identify products that meet recognised environmental standards throughout the production process.
example2_zh: 独立认证帮助消费者识别在整个生产过程中符合公认环保标准的产品。
collocations: professional certification｜专业资格认证 ; obtain certification｜获得认证 ; certification body｜认证机构 ; certification process｜认证流程
tip_zh: certification重认证；certificate常指证书本身。

meanings_zh: adj. 必需的；必要的 | n. 必需品；必要条件
definition_en: needed for a particular purpose | something necessary for a particular purpose
example1_en: She has the requisite skills to repair this bicycle.
example1_zh: 她具备修理这辆自行车所必需的技能。
example2_en: Applicants without the requisite qualifications may benefit from training programmes designed to improve access to skilled employment.
example2_zh: 不具备必要资历的申请者或可受益于旨在帮助人们进入技术岗位的培训项目。
collocations: requisite skills｜必备技能 ; requisite qualifications｜必要资历 ; a requisite for success｜成功的必要条件
tip_zh: 较正式；requisite 指必需，prerequisite 强调先决。

meanings_zh: n. 欺骗；欺诈
definition_en: Dishonest behaviour intended to make someone believe something false.
example1_en: His deceit became clear when we opened the empty box.
example1_zh: 我们打开空盒子时，他的骗局就暴露了。
example2_en: Deceit in advertising can damage consumer trust and create unfair advantages for companies that misrepresent their products.
example2_zh: 广告中的欺骗行为会损害消费者信任，并让虚假宣传产品的企业获得不公平的优势。
collocations: deliberate deceit｜蓄意欺骗 ; an act of deceit｜欺骗行为 ; lies and deceit｜谎言与欺骗
tip_zh: deceit通常不可数；一次欺骗可用an act of deceit。

meanings_zh: n. 暂停；停职；停学 | n. 车辆悬架 | n. 悬浮液；悬浮状态
definition_en: A temporary stop to an activity or someone's participation | Vehicle parts that reduce shaking on uneven roads | A liquid containing undissolved particles, or their state within it
example1_en: The storm caused the suspension of all ferry services.
example1_zh: 暴风雨导致所有渡轮服务暂停。
example2_en: The temporary suspension of construction work allowed researchers to assess the project's impact on local wildlife.
example2_zh: 建筑工程的暂时停工让研究人员得以评估该项目对当地野生动物的影响。
collocations: suspension of services｜服务暂停 ; school suspension｜停学处分 ; suspension system｜悬架系统 ; in suspension｜处于悬浮状态
tip_zh: 表示暂时中止；车辆语境中指悬架。

meanings_zh: v. 侵占；大量充斥 | v. 超出时间或费用限度 | n. 超时；超支
definition_en: To spread through or occupy a place in unwanted numbers. | To continue beyond an agreed time or cost limit. | An amount by which planned time or costs are exceeded.
example1_en: Weeds have overrun the garden since our neighbours moved away.
example1_zh: 邻居搬走后，花园里就长满了杂草。
example2_en: Major infrastructure projects often overrun their budgets when planners underestimate material costs and construction delays.
example2_zh: 规划者低估材料成本和施工延误时，大型基础设施项目往往会超支。
collocations: be overrun with weeds｜杂草丛生 ; overrun the budget｜超出预算 ; cost overrun｜成本超支
tip_zh: 变化为overran、overrun；名词重音在首音节。

meanings_zh: adj. 起重要作用的 | adj. 器乐的 | n. 器乐曲
definition_en: playing an important part in making something happen | performed with musical instruments rather than voices | a piece of music performed without singing
example1_en: Your advice was instrumental in helping me find work.
example1_zh: 你的建议对我找到工作起了重要作用。
example2_en: Investment in public transport has been instrumental in reducing traffic congestion in several major cities.
example2_zh: 对公共交通的投资在缓解多个大城市的交通拥堵方面起了重要作用。
collocations: be instrumental in｜在……中起重要作用 ; instrumental music｜器乐 ; instrumental version｜器乐版
tip_zh: 表示“起重要作用”时，用 be instrumental in doing。

meanings_zh: n. 剥削；压榨 | n. 开发；利用
definition_en: Unfair treatment of people to gain benefits from their work | Using resources or opportunities to gain an advantage
example1_en: The workers demanded fair wages and protection from exploitation.
example1_zh: 工人们要求合理的工资，并要求得到保护免受剥削。
example2_en: The uncontrolled exploitation of natural resources can damage ecosystems and undermine the livelihoods of communities that depend on them.
example2_zh: 对自然资源的无节制开发会破坏生态系统，并损害依赖这些资源的社区居民的生计。
collocations: labour exploitation｜劳工剥削 ; commercial exploitation｜商业开发 ; exploitation of natural resources｜自然资源的开发利用
tip_zh: 用于人常指剥削；用于资源指开发利用，需看语境。

meanings_zh: n. 镇静药；安定药
definition_en: A drug used to calm people or animals and reduce anxiety.
example1_en: The vet gave the frightened horse a tranquilizer.
example1_zh: 兽医给受惊的马用了一剂镇静药。
example2_en: Doctors should carefully assess the risks before prescribing a tranquilizer to a patient with persistent anxiety.
example2_zh: 医生在给持续焦虑的患者开镇静药之前，应仔细评估风险。
collocations: prescribe a tranquilizer｜开镇静药 ; take a tranquilizer｜服用镇静药 ; tranquilizer dart｜麻醉飞镖
tip_zh: 美式常拼tranquilizer，英式常拼tranquilliser。

meanings_zh: adj. 普遍的；占主导的
definition_en: Most common or influential at a particular time or place.
example1_en: The prevailing mood at dinner was one of relief.
example1_zh: 晚餐时，大家普遍都松了一口气。
example2_en: The prevailing view among urban planners is that reliable public transport can reduce dependence on private cars.
example2_zh: 城市规划者普遍认为，可靠的公共交通能减少人们对私家车的依赖。
collocations: prevailing view｜主流观点 ; prevailing conditions｜当前普遍状况 ; prevailing wind｜盛行风 ; prevailing attitude｜普遍态度
tip_zh: 常置于名词前；prevailing wind指盛行风。

meanings_zh: n. 暂时平静；间歇 | v. 使平静；哄入睡 | v. 使放松警惕
definition_en: A short period when activity or noise becomes less intense. | To calm someone or gently help them fall asleep. | To make someone feel safe when danger may still exist.
example1_en: We stepped outside during a lull in the rain.
example1_zh: 趁雨暂时停歇，我们走到了外面。
example2_en: A temporary lull in economic activity may give businesses time to review their long-term strategies.
example2_zh: 经济活动的暂时放缓可能让企业有时间重新审视其长期战略。
collocations: a lull in activity｜活动的暂时停歇 ; lull someone to sleep｜哄某人入睡 ; lull someone into a false sense of security｜使某人产生虚假的安全感
tip_zh: lull强调暂时平静，不表示彻底结束。

meanings_zh: adj. 极讨厌的；令人反感的
definition_en: extremely unpleasant or offensive
example1_en: An obnoxious passenger played loud music throughout the journey.
example1_zh: 一个讨厌的乘客一路都在大声播放音乐。
example2_en: Obnoxious behaviour on public transport can discourage commuters from using otherwise convenient and affordable services.
example2_zh: 公共交通上的恶劣行为可能让通勤者不愿使用原本便捷又实惠的服务。
collocations: obnoxious behaviour｜令人反感的行为 ; obnoxious remark｜令人厌恶的言论 ; obnoxious person｜讨厌的人
tip_zh: 语气比annoying强，常形容无礼的人或行为。

meanings_zh: v. 下垂；低垂
definition_en: Hang or bend down, often from weakness or tiredness.
example1_en: The flowers began to droop in the afternoon heat.
example1_zh: 鲜花在午后的高温下开始低垂。
example2_en: During prolonged droughts, leaves often droop as plants lose water and struggle to maintain their structure.
example2_zh: 长期干旱期间，植物因失水而难以维持形态，叶片往往会下垂。
collocations: drooping eyelids｜耷拉的眼皮 ; flowers droop｜花朵低垂 ; shoulders droop｜肩膀耷拉下来
tip_zh: 常形容花叶、眼皮或肩膀因缺水、疲倦而下垂。

meanings_zh: n. 匆忙；仓促
definition_en: Speed in acting, often without enough care or thought.
example1_en: In my haste, I left my keys on the table.
example1_zh: 我匆忙之中把钥匙落在了桌上。
example2_en: Policies developed in haste may overlook the needs of vulnerable groups and create additional social problems.
example2_zh: 仓促制定的政策可能忽视弱势群体的需求，并引发更多社会问题。
collocations: in haste｜匆忙地 ; undue haste｜过度仓促 ; make haste｜赶快
tip_zh: 通常为不可数名词；in haste意为匆忙地。

meanings_zh: v. 出汗；流汗
definition_en: to release sweat through your skin, especially when hot
example1_en: I began to perspire while carrying the heavy boxes.
example1_zh: 搬那些沉重的箱子时，我开始出汗了。
example2_en: People perspire more during intense exercise because the body needs to release excess heat.
example2_zh: 剧烈运动时人会出更多汗，因为身体需要散发多余的热量。
collocations: perspire heavily｜大量出汗 ; perspire freely｜汗流不止
tip_zh: 比sweat正式；通常作不及物动词。

meanings_zh: n. 灌溉
definition_en: The supply of water to land so crops can grow.
example1_en: The farm's irrigation system keeps these vegetables growing.
example1_zh: 农场的灌溉系统让这些蔬菜持续生长。
example2_en: Efficient irrigation can increase crop yields while reducing water consumption in regions affected by drought.
example2_zh: 在受干旱影响的地区，高效灌溉可以提高作物产量，同时减少用水量。
collocations: irrigation system｜灌溉系统 ; drip irrigation｜滴灌 ; irrigation canal｜灌溉渠 ; irrigation water｜灌溉用水
tip_zh: 通常为不可数名词；动词形式是irrigate。

meanings_zh: v. 指定；指派 | v. 标明；命名
definition_en: To officially choose someone or something for a particular purpose. | To give something an official name or identifying description.
example1_en: We designated one cupboard for all our cleaning supplies.
example1_zh: 我们指定了一个橱柜专门存放所有清洁用品。
example2_en: Local authorities should designate more urban land as protected green space to improve residents' quality of life.
example2_zh: 地方政府应将更多城市土地划为受保护的绿地，以改善居民的生活质量。
collocations: designate someone as｜指定某人为 ; designate an area for｜划定区域用于 ; designated parking spaces｜指定停车位
tip_zh: designate A as B表示指定或认定A为B。

meanings_zh: v. 减少；减弱；降低 | v. 贬低；轻视
definition_en: to become smaller or weaker, or make something so | to make someone or something seem less important or valuable
example1_en: The pain in my ankle gradually diminished overnight.
example1_zh: 一夜之间，我脚踝的疼痛逐渐减轻了。
example2_en: Investment in reliable public transport can diminish dependence on private cars and improve air quality in crowded cities.
example2_zh: 投资建设可靠的公共交通可以减少对私家车的依赖，改善拥挤城市的空气质量。
collocations: diminish significantly｜显著减少 ; diminish in importance｜重要性降低 ; diminish the impact｜减轻影响 ; diminishing returns｜递减的收益
tip_zh: 既可及物也可不及物：信心可diminish，也可被削弱。

meanings_zh: n. 中间；当中
definition_en: The middle of a place, group, activity, or situation.
example1_en: We found a quiet garden in the midst of town.
example1_zh: 我们在镇中心找到了一座安静的花园。
example2_en: In the midst of rapid urban growth, planners must preserve accessible green spaces for residents.
example2_zh: 在城市快速发展的过程中，规划者必须为居民保留便于到达的绿地。
collocations: in the midst of｜在……之中 ; in our midst｜在我们中间
tip_zh: 通常用于in the midst of，表示身处其中或正值某时。

meanings_zh: n. 宇宙
definition_en: The universe considered as a complete, ordered system.
example1_en: Looking through the telescope made me curious about the cosmos.
example1_zh: 透过望远镜观察让我对宇宙产生了好奇。
example2_en: Studying the cosmos helps scientists investigate how galaxies formed and how the universe has changed over time.
example2_zh: 研究宇宙有助于科学家探究星系如何形成，以及宇宙如何随时间演变。
collocations: explore the cosmos｜探索宇宙 ; the origins of the cosmos｜宇宙的起源 ; the vastness of the cosmos｜宇宙的浩瀚
tip_zh: 表示宇宙时通常用the cosmos。

meanings_zh: v. 潜伏；鬼祟地躲藏 | v. 暗藏；潜在
definition_en: stay hidden, often waiting to do something | exist unnoticed and potentially cause trouble
example1_en: A cat lurked behind the sofa, watching my shoelaces.
example1_zh: 一只猫躲在沙发后面，盯着我的鞋带。
example2_en: Security risks may lurk in outdated software, making regular system updates essential for protecting personal information.
example2_zh: 过时的软件中可能暗藏安全风险，因此定期更新系统对保护个人信息至关重要。
collocations: lurk in the shadows｜潜伏在暗处 ; lurk behind｜潜藏在……背后 ; danger lurks｜危险潜伏
tip_zh: 通常作不及物动词；可用危险等抽象事物作主语。

meanings_zh: v. 执行；强制实施
definition_en: Make sure that people obey a law or rule.
example1_en: The pool staff enforce strict rules about running indoors.
example1_zh: 泳池工作人员严格执行禁止在室内奔跑的规定。
example2_en: Governments must enforce environmental regulations consistently if they want industries to reduce pollution and protect public health.
example2_zh: 政府若希望各行业减少污染、保护公众健康，就必须始终如一地执行环境法规。
collocations: enforce the law｜执法 ; enforce regulations｜执行法规 ; strictly enforce｜严格执行
tip_zh: enforce后接法律或规定；迫使某人做事用force。

meanings_zh: adj. 含蓄的；未明说的 | adj. 内含的；固有的 | adj. 完全的；无疑问的
definition_en: Suggested or understood without being directly stated. | Present as a necessary part of something. | Complete and without doubt, especially describing trust or confidence.
example1_en: Her welcoming smile was an implicit invitation to join.
example1_zh: 她热情的笑容是在默默邀请我们加入。
example2_en: Many workplaces have implicit expectations about overtime, which can make employees reluctant to leave on time.
example2_zh: 许多工作场所对加班有不成文的期待，这可能让员工不敢准时下班。
collocations: implicit agreement｜默契；未明说的协议 ; implicit in｜内含于…… ; implicit trust｜完全的信任 ; implicit assumption｜隐含的假设
tip_zh: implicit指未明说；explicit指清楚明确。

meanings_zh: n. 调解人；调停者
definition_en: Someone who helps opposing sides reach an agreement
example1_en: A mediator helped our neighbours settle their garden fence dispute.
example1_zh: 一位调解人帮助我们的邻居解决了花园围栏纠纷。
example2_en: An independent mediator can help employers and workers negotiate fair conditions without resorting to lengthy legal proceedings.
example2_zh: 独立调解人可以帮助雇主和员工协商公平的工作条件，而不必诉诸漫长的法律程序。
collocations: independent mediator｜独立调解人 ; act as a mediator｜担任调解人 ; appoint a mediator｜任命调解人
tip_zh: 调解人促成双方协议，通常不直接作出裁决。

meanings_zh: n. 中间商；中介人
definition_en: Someone arranging deals or buying goods to sell to others.
example1_en: We bought directly from the farmer, avoiding the middleman.
example1_zh: 我们直接向农民购买，绕过了中间商。
example2_en: Online platforms allow small producers to reach consumers directly, reducing their dependence on a traditional middleman.
example2_zh: 网络平台让小生产者能够直接接触消费者，减少对传统中间商的依赖。
collocations: cut out the middleman｜绕过中间商 ; act as a middleman｜充当中介人
tip_zh: 复数为 middlemen；中性表达可用 intermediary。

meanings_zh: n. 制裁；处罚 | v. 正式批准；许可 | v. 制裁；处罚
definition_en: An official penalty intended to enforce rules or change behaviour. | To officially approve or permit an action. | To impose an official penalty on someone or something.
example1_en: The club imposed a sanction for breaking its rules.
example1_zh: 俱乐部对违反规定的行为作出了处罚。
example2_en: Economic sanctions may influence government policy, but they can also create hardship for ordinary citizens.
example2_zh: 经济制裁可能影响政府政策，但也可能给普通民众带来困苦。
collocations: impose sanctions on｜对……实施制裁 ; lift sanctions｜解除制裁 ; economic sanctions｜经济制裁 ; sanction a proposal｜批准提案
tip_zh: 可指“制裁”或“批准”，含义相反，须看语境。

meanings_zh: n. 匕首；短剑
definition_en: A short pointed knife, usually with two sharp edges.
example1_en: An ancient dagger lay inside the museum's glass case.
example1_zh: 一把古代匕首陈列在博物馆的玻璃展柜里。
example2_en: The discovery of a decorated dagger provides evidence of advanced metalworking skills in this ancient settlement.
example2_zh: 一把带装饰的匕首的发现，证明了这个古代聚居地具备先进的金属加工技艺。
collocations: a ceremonial dagger｜仪式用匕首 ; a sheathed dagger｜入鞘的匕首 ; look daggers at someone｜怒视某人
tip_zh: look daggers at someone是习语，意为怒视某人。

meanings_zh: adj. 水力发电的
definition_en: Relating to electricity produced by the movement of water.
example1_en: We visited a hydroelectric dam during our mountain holiday.
example1_zh: 我们在山区度假时参观了一座水电大坝。
example2_en: Hydroelectric power can reduce dependence on fossil fuels, although large dams may disrupt river ecosystems.
example2_zh: 水力发电可以减少对化石燃料的依赖，但大型水坝可能扰乱河流生态系统。
collocations: hydroelectric power｜水力发电 ; hydroelectric dam｜水电大坝 ; hydroelectric power station｜水力发电站
tip_zh: 常修饰power或power station；名词为hydroelectricity。

meanings_zh: n. 坚持不懈；毅力 | n. 持续存在；存留
definition_en: continued effort despite difficulties or delays | the fact of continuing to exist over time
example1_en: After weeks of practice, his persistence finally paid off.
example1_zh: 经过几周练习，他的坚持终于有了回报。
example2_en: The persistence of poverty suggests that economic growth alone cannot guarantee better living conditions for every household.
example2_zh: 贫困的持续存在表明，仅靠经济增长无法保证每个家庭的生活条件都得到改善。
collocations: show persistence｜表现出毅力 ; persistence pays off｜坚持终有回报 ; the persistence of poverty｜贫困的持续存在
tip_zh: 既可指人的毅力，也可指问题或现象持续存在。

meanings_zh: adv. 通常；在一般情况下
definition_en: Usually, or when conditions are normal.
example1_en: We ordinarily eat outside, but today it is raining.
example1_zh: 我们通常在户外吃饭，但今天下雨了。
example2_en: Public libraries ordinarily provide free internet access, helping residents who cannot afford a connection at home.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆通常提供免费网络，帮助那些无力负担家庭网络费用的居民。
collocations: would ordinarily｜通常会 ; ordinarily available｜通常可获得的 ; ordinarily resident｜通常居住的
tip_zh: 表示“通常”，不表示推测性的“大概”。

meanings_zh: adj. 瞬间发生的；即时的
definition_en: Happening immediately, with no noticeable delay.
example1_en: The relief was almost instantaneous when I removed my shoes.
example1_zh: 我一脱下鞋，几乎立刻就感觉轻松了。
example2_en: Modern communication networks allow almost instantaneous exchanges of information between researchers working on different continents.
example2_zh: 现代通信网络让不同大洲的研究人员几乎能够即时交换信息。
collocations: an instantaneous response｜即时反应 ; instantaneous communication｜即时通信 ; almost instantaneous｜几乎瞬间发生的
tip_zh: 强调几乎没有时间间隔，不等于同时发生。

meanings_zh: n. 日食；月食 | v. 使黯然失色；超越
definition_en: an event when one celestial body blocks another's light | make something seem less important or impressive by comparison
example1_en: We watched the lunar eclipse from our garden last night.
example1_zh: 昨晚我们在花园里观看了月食。
example2_en: Investment in digital services may eclipse spending on traditional infrastructure as economies become increasingly dependent on technology.
example2_zh: 随着经济日益依赖科技，数字服务投资可能超过传统基础设施支出。
collocations: solar eclipse｜日食 ; lunar eclipse｜月食 ; total eclipse｜全食 ; eclipse previous achievements｜使以往成就黯然失色
tip_zh: 日食用solar eclipse，月食用lunar eclipse。

meanings_zh: v. 取回；收回 | v. 开垦；使土地可用 | v. 回收利用
definition_en: Get back something that belongs or previously belonged to you | Make damaged or submerged land suitable for use | Recover useful materials from waste for reuse
example1_en: I returned to the station to reclaim my suitcase.
example1_zh: 我回到车站取回自己的行李箱。
example2_en: Coastal cities sometimes reclaim land from the sea to create space for housing and transport.
example2_zh: 沿海城市有时通过填海造地，为住房和交通设施腾出空间。
collocations: reclaim lost property｜领回失物 ; reclaim land｜开垦土地；填海造地 ; reclaim materials｜回收材料
tip_zh: reclaim强调收回或恢复利用，不只是收集。

meanings_zh: adj. 相关的；切题的
definition_en: directly related to the matter being discussed
example1_en: Lena asked a pertinent question about the repair costs.
example1_zh: 莉娜问了一个关于维修费用的切题问题。
example2_en: Evidence about local air quality is particularly pertinent to discussions of expanding public transport networks.
example2_zh: 有关当地空气质量的证据与扩大公共交通网络的讨论尤其相关。
collocations: pertinent question｜切题的问题 ; pertinent information｜相关信息 ; pertinent to｜与……相关
tip_zh: 常用pertinent to表示与某事相关，语体较正式。

meanings_zh: n. 动物突出的口鼻部
definition_en: the projecting nose and mouth of an animal
example1_en: The pig pushed its snout through the wooden fence.
example1_zh: 那头猪把口鼻部伸过了木栅栏。
example2_en: A pig's sensitive snout helps it locate food beneath the soil, supporting its natural foraging behaviour.
example2_zh: 猪灵敏的口鼻部帮助它找到土壤下的食物，满足其自然觅食的需要。
collocations: a pig's snout｜猪的口鼻部 ; a long snout｜长口鼻部 ; a pointed snout｜尖口鼻部
tip_zh: 不只指猪嘴，也指其他动物突出的口鼻部。

meanings_zh: adj. 轻信的；易受骗的
definition_en: Too willing to believe what others say, even when untrue
example1_en: I was gullible enough to believe his ridiculous story.
example1_zh: 我太轻信了，竟然相信了他那荒唐的故事。
example2_en: Teaching media literacy can help gullible consumers recognise misleading advertisements and make better informed purchasing decisions.
example2_zh: 教授媒介素养可以帮助容易受骗的消费者识别误导性广告，作出更明智的购买决定。
collocations: gullible consumers｜容易受骗的消费者 ; gullible enough to believe｜轻信到竟然相信 ; seem gullible｜显得容易受骗
tip_zh: 带贬义，强调容易相信假话，不等于善良。

meanings_zh: n. 手术刀；解剖刀
definition_en: A small, very sharp knife used in surgery or dissection.
example1_en: The surgeon placed the scalpel on a clean tray.
example1_zh: 外科医生把手术刀放在干净的托盘上。
example2_en: Medical students practise using a scalpel on artificial tissue before developing more advanced surgical skills.
example2_zh: 医学生先在人工组织上练习使用手术刀，再学习更高级的外科技能。
collocations: surgical scalpel｜外科手术刀 ; scalpel blade｜手术刀刀片 ; disposable scalpel｜一次性手术刀
tip_zh: 可数名词，指精细切割用的手术刀或解剖刀。

meanings_zh: n. 布道；讲道 | n. 说教；训诫
definition_en: a religious talk given during a service | a long talk telling someone how they should behave
example1_en: The sermon encouraged everyone to help their neighbours.
example1_zh: 这场布道鼓励大家帮助邻居。
example2_en: A sermon can strengthen community ties by encouraging listeners to support vulnerable people and participate in local projects.
example2_zh: 布道可以鼓励听众帮助弱势群体、参与本地项目，从而加强社区联系。
collocations: deliver a sermon｜进行布道 ; a sermon on kindness｜关于善意的布道 ; preach a sermon｜讲道
tip_zh: 本义为宗教讲道；比喻“说教”时常带不满。

meanings_zh: adv. 借以；通过这种方式
definition_en: By which a particular result is achieved.
example1_en: We have an arrangement whereby we share the cooking.
example1_zh: 我们有个安排，轮流负责做饭。
example2_en: Schools could introduce a system whereby older students provide academic support to younger pupils after lessons.
example2_zh: 学校可以引入一种制度，让高年级学生在课后为低年级学生提供学业帮助。
collocations: a system whereby｜借以实现某事的制度 ; a process whereby｜借以实现某事的过程 ; an arrangement whereby｜据此实行的安排
tip_zh: 正式关系副词，常接在system等词后，相当于by which。

meanings_zh: v. 控制；抑制 | n. 限制；约束 | n. 路缘石（美式）
definition_en: to limit or control something unwanted | a limit on an activity or behaviour | the raised edge between a road and pavement
example1_en: I try to curb my spending by cooking at home.
example1_zh: 我尽量在家做饭，以控制开支。
example2_en: Cities can curb air pollution by improving public transport and encouraging residents to cycle.
example2_zh: 城市可以通过改善公共交通和鼓励居民骑车来抑制空气污染。
collocations: curb spending｜控制开支 ; curb inflation｜抑制通货膨胀 ; a curb on emissions｜对排放的限制
tip_zh: 作动词指抑制；路缘石在英式英语中拼作kerb。

meanings_zh: n. 无穷；无限 | n. 无穷大
definition_en: The state of having no end or limit. | A mathematical concept greater than any finite quantity.
example1_en: The desert seemed to stretch away into infinity.
example1_zh: 沙漠仿佛一直延伸到无穷远处。
example2_en: The concept of infinity allows mathematicians to explore quantities beyond the limits of ordinary measurement.
example2_zh: 无穷的概念使数学家能够研究超出常规测量范围的量。
collocations: stretch into infinity｜延伸至无穷远 ; approach infinity｜趋于无穷大 ; an infinity of possibilities｜无穷的可能性
tip_zh: 不是一般的“大量”；数学中常用趋于无穷大。

meanings_zh: v. 推断；推论
definition_en: to reach a conclusion using evidence rather than direct statements
example1_en: From her muddy shoes, I inferred she had been gardening.
example1_zh: 从她沾满泥土的鞋子，我推断她刚才在做园艺活。
example2_en: Researchers cannot infer that smaller classes improve learning without examining other factors affecting student performance.
example2_zh: 研究人员如果不考察影响学生表现的其他因素，就不能推断小班教学能改善学习效果。
collocations: infer from evidence｜根据证据推断 ; infer that｜推断…… ; reasonably infer｜合理推断
tip_zh: infer是听者推断，imply是说者暗示。

meanings_zh: adj. 兴高采烈的；欣喜若狂的
definition_en: Extremely happy and excited, especially after success or good news.
example1_en: Lina was elated when she finally passed her driving test.
example1_zh: 莉娜终于通过驾照考试时，欣喜万分。
example2_en: Graduates may feel elated after securing their first job, although adjusting to workplace expectations can be challenging.
example2_zh: 毕业生找到第一份工作后可能欣喜万分，尽管适应职场要求并不容易。
collocations: feel elated｜感到欣喜万分 ; elated at the news｜听到消息欣喜万分 ; elated by success｜因成功而欢欣鼓舞
tip_zh: 比happy语气更强，常用于成功或获悉好消息后。

meanings_zh: n. 偿付能力
definition_en: The ability to pay all the debts you owe.
example1_en: The accountant checked the firm's solvency before approving the purchase.
example1_zh: 会计在批准这笔采购前检查了公司的偿付能力。
example2_en: Stricter financial regulation can protect bank solvency and reduce the risk of a wider economic crisis.
example2_zh: 更严格的金融监管能够保障银行的偿付能力，降低更大范围经济危机的风险。
collocations: maintain solvency｜维持偿付能力 ; financial solvency｜财务偿付能力 ; solvency requirements｜偿付能力要求
tip_zh: solvency指偿债能力，不等于盈利能力。

meanings_zh: adj. 高山的；阿尔卑斯山的
definition_en: relating to high mountains, especially the Alps
example1_en: Tiny alpine flowers grew between rocks beside the trail.
example1_zh: 小小的高山花朵生长在小径旁的岩石缝中。
example2_en: Rising temperatures threaten alpine ecosystems by reducing snow cover and forcing mountain species to move higher.
example2_zh: 气温上升使积雪覆盖减少，并迫使山地物种向更高处迁移，从而威胁高山生态系统。
collocations: alpine plants｜高山植物 ; alpine meadows｜高山草甸 ; alpine skiing｜高山滑雪 ; alpine ecosystem｜高山生态系统
tip_zh: 泛指高山环境用小写；专指阿尔卑斯山常大写。

meanings_zh: n. 一批运送的货物 | n. 寄售；委托代销
definition_en: A batch of goods sent to a person or place. | An arrangement where sellers pay suppliers only after goods sell.
example1_en: A consignment of fresh oranges arrived at the shop.
example1_zh: 一批新鲜橙子运到了店里。
example2_en: Delays in inspecting a consignment of medical equipment can disrupt essential services in remote communities.
example2_zh: 一批医疗设备的检验延误，可能会影响偏远社区的基本服务。
collocations: a consignment of goods｜一批货物 ; receive a consignment｜收到一批货物 ; on consignment｜以寄售方式
tip_zh: on consignment指寄售，卖出后再向供货方付款。

meanings_zh: n. 灵长类动物
definition_en: a mammal belonging to the group including humans, monkeys, and apes
example1_en: The guide pointed to a primate swinging between branches.
example1_zh: 导游指着一只在树枝间荡来荡去的灵长类动物。
example2_en: Protecting tropical forests is essential for the survival of many primate species threatened by habitat loss.
example2_zh: 保护热带森林对许多因栖息地丧失而受到威胁的灵长类物种的生存至关重要。
collocations: primate species｜灵长类物种 ; primate behaviour｜灵长类动物的行为 ; non-human primates｜非人灵长类动物
tip_zh: 包括人、猿和猴；并非只指猴子。

meanings_zh: adj. 使人想起的；类似的
definition_en: Reminding you of something because of a similarity.
example1_en: The soup's flavour was reminiscent of my grandmother's cooking.
example1_zh: 这汤的味道让我想起了祖母做的饭菜。
example2_en: The proposed station design is reminiscent of traditional architecture, helping the building blend into its historic surroundings.
example2_zh: 拟建车站的设计令人联想到传统建筑，有助于其融入周围的历史环境。
collocations: reminiscent of childhood｜令人想起童年的 ; strongly reminiscent of｜令人强烈联想到 ; vaguely reminiscent of｜隐约使人想起
tip_zh: 固定搭配be reminiscent of，介词不用about。

meanings_zh: adj. 深远的；强烈的 | adj. 深刻的；深邃的
definition_en: Very great in effect, degree, or intensity. | Showing deep thought, understanding, or insight.
example1_en: Meeting my childhood teacher filled me with profound gratitude.
example1_zh: 见到儿时的老师让我心中充满了深深的感激。
example2_en: Access to reliable internet has had a profound impact on educational opportunities in remote communities.
example2_zh: 可靠的互联网接入对偏远社区的教育机会产生了深远影响。
collocations: a profound impact｜深远的影响 ; profound changes｜深刻的变化 ; profound understanding｜深刻的理解 ; profound sadness｜深切的悲伤
tip_zh: 常修饰impact、change、understanding，不指物理深度。

meanings_zh: adj. 违法的；有不良行为的 | adj. 逾期未付的；拖欠的 | n. 违法者；少年犯
definition_en: Behaving illegally or antisocially, especially while young. | Not paid on time, or failing to pay on time. | A person, usually young, who breaks the law.
example1_en: The youth centre helps teenagers change their delinquent behaviour.
example1_zh: 这家青少年中心帮助青少年改正违法行为。
example2_en: Early support for vulnerable families may reduce delinquent behaviour more effectively than harsher punishments alone.
example2_zh: 及早扶助弱势家庭，可能比单纯加重惩罚更有效地减少违法行为。
collocations: delinquent behaviour｜违法行为 ; a juvenile delinquent｜少年犯 ; delinquent payments｜逾期款项 ; a delinquent borrower｜拖欠还款的借款人
tip_zh: 金融语境中指逾期未付；日常多指青少年违法。

meanings_zh: v. 大步走 | n. 大步；步幅 | n. 显著进展
definition_en: Walk with long, confident steps. | A long step taken while walking or running. | Important progress towards a goal, usually expressed in the plural.
example1_en: Leila strode across the platform to catch her train.
example1_zh: 莱拉大步穿过站台去赶火车。
example2_en: Many countries have made significant strides in improving access to primary education over recent decades.
example2_zh: 近几十年来，许多国家在扩大初等教育机会方面取得了显著进展。
collocations: stride across a room｜大步穿过房间 ; make great strides｜取得巨大进展 ; take something in your stride｜从容应对某事
tip_zh: 过去式strode，过去分词stridden；进展常用strides。

meanings_zh: n. 独家权；专有性 | n. 排他性；仅限少数人享有
definition_en: the right to provide or use something without competitors | the quality of being available only to a select group
example1_en: The bakery secured exclusivity to sell bread at the festival.
example1_zh: 这家面包店取得了在该节庆活动中独家销售面包的权利。
example2_en: Although exclusivity agreements can encourage investment, they may also limit competition and raise prices for consumers.
example2_zh: 虽然独家协议能够鼓励投资，但也可能限制竞争并推高消费者支付的价格。
collocations: an exclusivity agreement｜独家协议 ; grant exclusivity｜授予独家权 ; a sense of exclusivity｜专属感
tip_zh: 既可指商业独家权，也可指仅少数人享有的特性。

meanings_zh: n. 动物学
definition_en: the scientific study of animals
example1_en: My cousin studies zoology and spends weekends watching birds.
example1_zh: 我的表亲学习动物学，周末常去观察鸟类。
example2_en: Research in zoology helps scientists understand animal behaviour and design more effective strategies for protecting endangered species.
example2_zh: 动物学研究帮助科学家理解动物行为，并制定更有效的濒危物种保护策略。
collocations: study zoology｜学习动物学 ; a degree in zoology｜动物学学位 ; a zoology department｜动物学系
tip_zh: 通常为不可数名词；研究植物的学科是botany。

meanings_zh: n. 变体；变种 | adj. 变异的；不同的
definition_en: A form that differs slightly from other related forms. | Differing in some way from the usual or related form.
example1_en: This local variant of the soup includes fresh beans.
example1_zh: 这种汤的本地做法加入了新鲜豆子。
example2_en: A genetic variant may affect how individuals respond to certain medicines, making personalised treatment increasingly important.
example2_zh: 某种基因变异可能影响个体对特定药物的反应，因此个性化治疗日益重要。
collocations: a variant of｜……的一种变体 ; genetic variant｜基因变异 ; regional variant｜地区变体 ; variant spelling｜异体拼写
tip_zh: 名词常用a variant of；形容词可修饰spelling等。

meanings_zh: n. 公社；共同生活群体
definition_en: a group living together and sharing possessions and responsibilities
example1_en: They live in a commune and grow vegetables together.
example1_zh: 他们住在一个共同生活的群体中，一起种菜。
example2_en: Living in a commune can reduce individual expenses, but shared decision-making requires patience and effective communication.
example2_zh: 公社生活可以减少个人开支，但共同决策需要耐心和有效沟通。
collocations: live in a commune｜在公社生活 ; farming commune｜农业公社 ; establish a commune｜建立公社
tip_zh: 名词指共同生活群体；动词 commune with 指心灵交流。

meanings_zh: v. 十分恼怒；生闷气 | n. 有害或刺鼻的烟气
definition_en: To feel or express strong anger. | Strong, unpleasant or harmful gas or smoke, usually plural.
example1_en: He fumed when muddy shoes stained his clean carpet.
example1_zh: 泥鞋弄脏了他干净的地毯，他气坏了。
example2_en: Exposure to exhaust fumes can worsen respiratory conditions, particularly among children living near busy roads.
example2_zh: 接触汽车尾气可能加重呼吸系统疾病，尤其会影响住在繁忙道路附近的儿童。
collocations: fume over something｜为某事大发脾气 ; exhaust fumes｜汽车尾气 ; toxic fumes｜有毒烟气
tip_zh: 表示烟气通常用复数fumes；动词常指十分恼怒。

meanings_zh: adv. 从今以后
definition_en: from this time onwards
example1_en: Henceforth, we will keep spare keys in this drawer.
example1_zh: 从今以后，我们会把备用钥匙放在这个抽屉里。
example2_en: The university announced that all new buildings would henceforth meet stricter environmental standards.
example2_zh: 大学宣布，今后所有新建建筑都将达到更严格的环保标准。
collocations: shall henceforth｜今后将 ; be henceforth known as｜从此被称为
tip_zh: 正式用语；日常交流多用 from now on。

meanings_zh: adj. 装满的；负载的 | adj. 充满某种情绪的
definition_en: Carrying or holding a large amount of something. | Full of a particular feeling, especially an unpleasant one.
example1_en: She arrived at the picnic laden with bags of food.
example1_zh: 她带着大包小包的食物来到野餐地点。
example2_en: Trucks laden with construction materials contribute to congestion and increase road maintenance costs in rapidly expanding cities.
example2_zh: 在迅速扩张的城市中，满载建筑材料的卡车加剧了拥堵，并增加了道路维护成本。
collocations: laden with｜装满；充满 ; heavily laden｜满载的 ; a laden truck｜满载的卡车
tip_zh: 常用laden with；也可构成sugar-laden等复合形容词。

meanings_zh: adj. 最大的；极度的 | n. 最大努力；极限
definition_en: greatest in degree, amount, or intensity | the greatest effort or amount someone can achieve
example1_en: Please handle this delicate glass bowl with utmost care.
example1_zh: 请极其小心地拿放这只易碎的玻璃碗。
example2_en: Protecting patient privacy is of the utmost importance when hospitals introduce digital systems for storing medical records.
example2_zh: 医院引入电子病历存储系统时，保护患者隐私至关重要。
collocations: of the utmost importance｜极为重要 ; with utmost care｜极其小心地 ; do your utmost｜尽最大努力 ; utmost respect｜最高敬意
tip_zh: do one's utmost意为尽最大努力，常接to do。

meanings_zh: adj. 辅助的；备用的 | n. 助动词
definition_en: providing extra help or support when needed | a verb used with another verb to form grammatical structures
example1_en: The boat has an auxiliary engine for emergencies.
example1_zh: 这艘船装有一台应急用的备用发动机。
example2_en: Hospitals require auxiliary power systems to maintain essential medical services during unexpected electricity failures.
example2_zh: 医院需要备用供电系统，以便在意外停电时维持必要的医疗服务。
collocations: auxiliary power｜备用电力 ; auxiliary engine｜备用发动机 ; auxiliary verb｜助动词
tip_zh: 语法中 auxiliary verb 指助动词，如 be、have、do。

meanings_zh: v. 确定方位；熟悉环境 | v. 使朝向；使以…为导向
definition_en: Find your position or become familiar with your surroundings. | Position something towards a direction or focus it on something.
example1_en: I used the river to orientate myself in town.
example1_zh: 我借助河流来确定自己在城里的方位。
example2_en: Universities should orientate their support services towards the needs of students adjusting to life away from home.
example2_zh: 大学应以适应离家生活的学生的需求为导向，提供支持服务。
collocations: orientate yourself｜确定自己的方位 ; orientate something towards｜使某事物面向
tip_zh: 多用于英式英语；常用orientate oneself，不专指向东。

meanings_zh: n. 手艺；精湛工艺
definition_en: Skill in making things, especially carefully by hand.
example1_en: The handmade chair shows beautiful craftsmanship in every joint.
example1_zh: 这把手工椅子的每一处接合都展现出精湛工艺。
example2_en: Preserving traditional craftsmanship can support local economies while protecting cultural knowledge passed down through generations.
example2_zh: 保护传统手艺既能支持地方经济，也能保护代代相传的文化知识。
collocations: fine craftsmanship｜精湛工艺 ; traditional craftsmanship｜传统手艺 ; quality craftsmanship｜优质工艺
tip_zh: 不可数名词，强调制作技艺或成品的工艺水平。

meanings_zh: n. 凿子 | v. 凿；雕刻
definition_en: A tool with a sharp edge for cutting wood or stone. | To cut or shape wood or stone with a chisel.
example1_en: She used a chisel to shape the wooden bowl.
example1_zh: 她用凿子给木碗塑形。
example2_en: Traditional craftspeople use a chisel to create detailed patterns that preserve local artistic traditions.
example2_zh: 传统手艺人用凿子雕出精细图案，传承当地的艺术传统。
collocations: a wood chisel｜木工凿 ; a hammer and chisel｜锤子和凿子 ; chisel away｜逐渐凿去
tip_zh: 动词过去式英式常写chiselled，美式常写chiseled。

meanings_zh: adj. 松弛的；不绷紧的 | adj. 萧条的；懈怠的 | n. 松弛部分；富余量
definition_en: loose rather than tightly stretched | less busy, active, or careful than expected | looseness in a rope, or unused capacity
example1_en: The tent rope was slack after the heavy rain.
example1_zh: 大雨过后，帐篷的绳子松了。
example2_en: When demand is slack, manufacturers may reduce working hours rather than dismiss experienced employees immediately.
example2_zh: 需求疲软时，制造商可能会缩短工作时间，而不是立即解雇有经验的员工。
collocations: slack rope｜松弛的绳子 ; slack demand｜疲软的需求 ; take up the slack｜收紧松弛部分；补位 ; slack off｜松懈；偷懒
tip_zh: slack指松弛或懈怠；slacks是宽松长裤。

meanings_zh: n. 居住者；使用者；乘员
definition_en: Someone who lives in or uses a room, building, or vehicle.
example1_en: The previous occupant left some curtains in the flat.
example1_zh: 上一位住户在公寓里留下了一些窗帘。
example2_en: Building regulations should ensure that every occupant can leave safely in the event of a fire.
example2_zh: 建筑法规应确保每位使用者都能在发生火灾时安全撤离。
collocations: previous occupant｜前一位住户 ; building occupants｜楼内人员 ; vehicle occupants｜车内人员
tip_zh: 强调实际居住或使用，不一定是owner（所有者）。

meanings_zh: n. 后裔；子孙 | n. 衍生事物；后继形式
definition_en: Someone related to a person who lived in an earlier generation. | Something developed from an earlier form of something similar.
example1_en: Her descendants still live in the old family farmhouse.
example1_zh: 她的后代仍住在家族的老农舍里。
example2_en: Preserving traditional crafts allows descendants of local communities to maintain meaningful connections with their cultural heritage.
example2_zh: 保护传统工艺能让当地社区的后代与自身文化遗产保持有意义的联系。
collocations: direct descendant｜直系后裔 ; descendant of｜……的后代 ; descendants of immigrants｜移民的后代
tip_zh: descendant是后代；ancestor是祖先。

meanings_zh: v. 主张；认为 | v. 应对；与……斗争 | v. 竞争；争夺
definition_en: To argue that something is true. | To struggle with a difficulty or challenging situation. | To compete for something against other people.
example1_en: I contend that our kitchen needs a bigger table.
example1_zh: 我认为我们的厨房需要一张更大的桌子。
example2_en: Some researchers contend that affordable public transport is more effective than road expansion in reducing urban congestion.
example2_zh: 一些研究者认为，在缓解城市拥堵方面，价格合理的公共交通比扩建道路更有效。
collocations: contend that｜主张…… ; contend with difficulties｜应对困难 ; contend for the title｜争夺冠军
tip_zh: contend that表主张；with接困难；for接争夺目标。

meanings_zh: n. 保管人；守护者 | n. 楼宇管理员
definition_en: A person or organisation responsible for protecting or managing something. | Someone employed to clean and maintain a building, especially in America.
example1_en: The custodian carefully locked the cabinet containing ancient coins.
example1_zh: 保管人小心地锁好了存放古钱币的柜子。
example2_en: Museums act as custodians of cultural heritage, preserving valuable objects for research and future generations.
example2_zh: 博物馆充当文化遗产的守护者，为研究和后代保存珍贵物品。
collocations: custodian of cultural heritage｜文化遗产守护者 ; school custodian｜学校楼宇管理员 ; legal custodian｜法定监护人
tip_zh: custodian of后接所保管或守护的对象。

meanings_zh: adj. 细微的；不易察觉的 | adj. 巧妙的；含蓄的
definition_en: Small or delicate enough to be difficult to notice | Expressed or achieved indirectly and skilfully
example1_en: The soup has a subtle hint of lemon.
example1_zh: 这汤带有一丝淡淡的柠檬味。
example2_en: Advertising can exert a subtle influence on consumers by associating products with desirable lifestyles.
example2_zh: 广告将产品与令人向往的生活方式联系起来，从而潜移默化地影响消费者。
collocations: a subtle difference｜细微差别 ; a subtle hint｜含蓄的暗示 ; subtle influence｜潜移默化的影响 ; a subtle flavour｜淡雅的味道
tip_zh: b不发音；常形容难以察觉的差别或影响。

meanings_zh: v. 暴跌；骤降 | v. 急速坠落
definition_en: To decrease very quickly and sharply. | To fall suddenly and quickly from a high position.
example1_en: Temperatures plummeted overnight, leaving ice on the garden pond.
example1_zh: 气温一夜间骤降，花园池塘结了冰。
example2_en: Demand for private cars could plummet if cities offered reliable, affordable public transport throughout the day.
example2_zh: 如果城市全天提供可靠且价格合理的公共交通，私家车需求可能会大幅下降。
collocations: prices plummet｜价格暴跌 ; temperatures plummet｜气温骤降 ; plummet to a record low｜跌至历史最低点
tip_zh: 常作不及物动词；to接终值，by接降幅。

meanings_zh: n. 刻板印象；成见 | v. 对……抱有刻板印象
definition_en: a fixed, oversimplified belief about a group of people | to judge people using fixed beliefs about their group
example1_en: My grandmother challenges the stereotype that older people dislike technology.
example1_zh: 我的祖母打破了老年人不喜欢科技的刻板印象。
example2_en: Schools should challenge gender stereotypes so that all students feel free to pursue their interests.
example2_zh: 学校应挑战性别刻板印象，让所有学生都能自由追求自己的兴趣。
collocations: gender stereotypes｜性别刻板印象 ; challenge a stereotype｜挑战刻板印象 ; reinforce stereotypes｜强化刻板印象
tip_zh: 常指对某类人的简单化看法，不等同于事实。

meanings_zh: adj. 持续的；反复出现的 | adj. 坚持不懈的；执着的
definition_en: continuing for a long time or happening repeatedly | continuing to try despite difficulty or opposition
example1_en: A persistent cough kept me awake throughout the night.
example1_zh: 持续的咳嗽让我整夜都睡不着。
example2_en: Persistent shortages of affordable housing can force young adults to delay leaving their family homes.
example2_zh: 经济适用住房持续短缺，可能迫使年轻人推迟搬离父母家的计划。
collocations: a persistent cough｜持续的咳嗽 ; a persistent problem｜长期存在的问题 ; persistent efforts｜不懈努力 ; persistent shortages｜持续短缺
tip_zh: 修饰问题常含负面意味；修饰人可表示坚持不懈。

meanings_zh: n. 沟槽；凹槽 | n. 音乐的律动 | v. 在…上开槽
definition_en: A long, narrow cut or hollow in a surface. | A strong, steady rhythm that makes music feel engaging. | To cut long, narrow hollows into a surface.
example1_en: Dust had collected in every groove of the wooden door.
example1_zh: 木门的每一道凹槽里都积了灰。
example2_en: The grooves in vehicle tyres channel water away, improving grip and reducing accident risks on wet roads.
example2_zh: 汽车轮胎上的沟槽能够排水，增强抓地力，降低湿滑路面上的事故风险。
collocations: cut a groove｜开一道槽 ; a deep groove｜深槽 ; tyre grooves｜轮胎沟槽 ; get into a groove｜进入顺畅状态
tip_zh: 具体指表面的长凹槽；音乐中可指鲜明的律动。

meanings_zh: n. 厚木板 | n. 政纲要点；政策核心 | n. 平板支撑
definition_en: A long, flat, thick piece of wood. | An important principle or proposal in a political programme. | An exercise holding the body straight above the floor.
example1_en: We laid a plank across the muddy ditch.
example1_zh: 我们在泥泞的沟上架了一块厚木板。
example2_en: Investment in affordable housing should be a central plank of any strategy to reduce urban inequality.
example2_zh: 投资可负担住房应成为任何缩小城市不平等的战略的核心内容。
collocations: a wooden plank｜一块厚木板 ; a central plank of policy｜政策的核心内容 ; hold a plank｜保持平板支撑
tip_zh: a central plank of可比喻政策的核心内容。

meanings_zh: n. 政治共同体；共和国 | n. 英联邦
definition_en: A politically organised community, especially one governed for public benefit. | An association of independent countries, mostly formerly under British rule.
example1_en: The islanders established a commonwealth with an elected council.
example1_zh: 岛民建立了一个由民选议会治理的政治共同体。
example2_en: Members of the Commonwealth cooperate on education and development while maintaining their own independent governments.
example2_zh: 英联邦成员在教育和发展领域开展合作，同时保有各自独立的政府。
collocations: the Commonwealth｜英联邦 ; Commonwealth countries｜英联邦国家 ; Commonwealth membership｜英联邦成员资格
tip_zh: 指英联邦时首字母大写，通常与the连用。

meanings_zh: v. 搭建；竖立 | adj. 直立的；挺直的
definition_en: to build something or put it in an upright position | standing straight up rather than bending or lying down
example1_en: We erected our tent beside the lake before sunset.
example1_zh: 日落前，我们在湖边搭好了帐篷。
example2_en: Local authorities plan to erect temporary shelters for families whose homes were damaged by severe flooding.
example2_zh: 地方政府计划搭建临时住所，安置房屋因严重洪灾受损的家庭。
collocations: erect a tent｜搭帐篷 ; erect a monument｜立纪念碑 ; stand erect｜挺直站立
tip_zh: 动词比 build 正式；形容词常见于 stand erect。

meanings_zh: v. 享受；期待并乐于做 | n. 乐趣；享受 | n. 佐餐调味酱
definition_en: To enjoy something greatly or eagerly anticipate doing it. | Great enjoyment or enthusiasm when doing something. | A sauce of chopped vegetables or fruit eaten with food.
example1_en: I relish quiet mornings with tea and a book.
example1_zh: 我很享受喝着茶、读着书的宁静早晨。
example2_en: Many students relish the opportunity to study abroad because it exposes them to different cultures and perspectives.
example2_zh: 许多学生非常珍惜出国学习的机会，因为这能让他们接触不同的文化和观点。
collocations: relish a challenge｜乐于接受挑战 ; relish the opportunity｜欣然把握机会 ; with relish｜津津有味地 ; tomato relish｜番茄调味酱
tip_zh: 动词后接名词或动名词，不接to do。

meanings_zh: v. 抑制；阻碍 | v. 使拘谨；使不敢表达
definition_en: To slow down or prevent a process or activity. | To make someone feel unable to act or speak freely.
example1_en: Cold weather can inhibit the growth of these plants.
example1_zh: 寒冷天气会抑制这些植物的生长。
example2_en: Fear of making mistakes can inhibit students from participating actively in classroom discussions and collaborative tasks.
example2_zh: 害怕犯错可能使学生不敢积极参与课堂讨论和合作任务。
collocations: inhibit growth｜抑制生长 ; inhibit development｜阻碍发展 ; inhibit enzyme activity｜抑制酶活性
tip_zh: inhibit侧重抑制或阻碍；prohibit指明令禁止。

meanings_zh: n. 国际象棋中的兵 | n. 被人利用的小人物；棋子 | v. 典当
definition_en: A chess piece of the smallest size and lowest value. | A person controlled by others for their own purposes. | To leave something valuable with a pawnbroker for a loan.
example1_en: She moved a pawn forward and studied the chessboard.
example1_zh: 她把一个兵向前走了一步，然后仔细观察棋盘。
example2_en: Workers should not become pawns in disputes between powerful companies competing for control of essential services.
example2_zh: 在争夺基本服务控制权的大公司之间的纠纷中，劳动者不应成为被利用的棋子。
collocations: move a pawn｜走一步兵 ; a pawn in a power struggle｜权力斗争中的棋子 ; pawn jewellery｜典当珠宝
tip_zh: 典当是以物换借款，可赎回，不等于直接出售。

meanings_zh: n. 帝国主义；帝国扩张政策
definition_en: A policy of extending a country's power over other countries.
example1_en: We discussed imperialism after visiting the history museum yesterday.
example1_zh: 昨天参观历史博物馆后，我们讨论了帝国主义。
example2_en: The legacy of imperialism continues to influence economic relationships and debates about cultural identity in many societies.
example2_zh: 帝国主义的遗留影响仍在塑造许多社会的经济关系及有关文化认同的讨论。
collocations: cultural imperialism｜文化帝国主义 ; economic imperialism｜经济帝国主义 ; the legacy of imperialism｜帝国主义的遗留影响
tip_zh: 通常不可数；强调一国向外扩张统治或影响力。

meanings_zh: n. 散文作家；随笔作家
definition_en: a writer of short pieces exploring particular subjects
example1_en: The essayist described her childhood with warmth and humour.
example1_zh: 这位散文作家温暖而幽默地描写了自己的童年。
example2_en: An influential essayist can encourage readers to question social assumptions through personal reflection and careful argument.
example2_zh: 有影响力的随笔作家可以通过个人反思和严谨论证，促使读者质疑社会中的惯常观念。
collocations: a literary essayist｜文学散文作家 ; a celebrated essayist｜著名随笔作家 ; a novelist and essayist｜小说家兼散文作家
tip_zh: 指以散文或随笔创作为业者，不泛指写作文的学生。

meanings_zh: v. 使相形见绌 | n. 矮小动植物；传说中矮人 | adj. 矮生的；小型的
definition_en: To make something seem small by comparison. | An unusually small organism, or a small humanlike fantasy creature. | Much smaller than the usual size of its kind.
example1_en: The new tower dwarfs every house on our street.
example1_zh: 新建的高塔让我们街上所有房屋都显得很矮小。
example2_en: The long-term costs of environmental damage may dwarf the immediate profits generated by industrial expansion.
example2_zh: 环境破坏的长期成本可能远远超过工业扩张带来的眼前利润。
collocations: be dwarfed by｜与……相比显得渺小 ; dwarf tree｜矮生树 ; dwarf planet｜矮行星
tip_zh: 动词常表对比悬殊；名词指人可能冒犯，应谨慎。

meanings_zh: n. 专员；委员会委员
definition_en: an official responsible for a public service or commission
example1_en: The commissioner visited our neighbourhood to discuss road safety.
example1_zh: 这位专员来到我们社区讨论道路安全问题。
example2_en: An independent commissioner should investigate public complaints and ensure that government agencies treat citizens fairly.
example2_zh: 独立专员应调查公众投诉，并确保政府机构公平对待公民。
collocations: police commissioner｜警务专员 ; high commissioner｜高级专员 ; appoint a commissioner｜任命专员
tip_zh: 通常指负有特定公共职责的官员，不泛指所有委员。

meanings_zh: n. 大毁灭；大屠杀 | n. 纳粹对犹太人的大屠杀
definition_en: Destruction or killing on a very large scale. | The Nazi murder of six million Jews during World War Two.
