example1_en: This spare cable is redundant now we use wireless speakers.
example1_zh: 既然我们用无线音箱了，这根备用线就多余了。
example2_en: Factory workers may be made redundant when automated systems take over tasks previously performed by people.
example2_zh: 当自动化系统接手原先由人完成的任务时，工厂工人可能会被裁员。
collocations: make someone redundant｜裁掉某人 ; redundant information｜多余信息 ; become redundant｜变得不再需要
tip_zh: 英式英语中be made redundant指岗位取消而被裁员。

meanings_zh: adj. 正直的；正义的 | adj. 义愤的；自以为正当的
definition_en: morally right or acting according to strong moral principles | arising from a belief that you are morally right
example1_en: She believed returning the wallet was the righteous choice.
example1_zh: 她认为归还钱包才是正直的选择。
example2_en: Righteous anger at social injustice can encourage citizens to demand meaningful changes in public policy.
example2_zh: 对社会不公的义愤可以促使公民要求公共政策作出实质性改变。
collocations: righteous anger｜义愤 ; righteous indignation｜义愤 ; a righteous cause｜正义的事业
tip_zh: 语气较庄重；self-righteous指自以为正直。

meanings_zh: adj. 宽大的；不严厉的
definition_en: less strict or severe when enforcing rules or giving punishment
example1_en: Our teacher was lenient when I submitted homework late.
example1_zh: 我迟交作业时，老师宽容地处理了。
example2_en: Some argue that lenient penalties for illegal dumping fail to discourage companies from damaging the environment.
example2_zh: 有人认为，对非法倾倒垃圾的宽松处罚无法阻止企业破坏环境。
collocations: lenient with someone｜对某人宽容 ; a lenient sentence｜从轻的判刑 ; lenient treatment｜宽大处理
tip_zh: 对人宽容用lenient with；常涉及规则或处罚。

meanings_zh: adj. 长方形的 | n. 长方形
definition_en: having a rectangular shape with unequal adjacent sides | a rectangle with two sides longer than the other two
example1_en: She served the sandwiches on an oblong wooden plate.
example1_zh: 她用一个长方形木盘盛三明治。
example2_en: The architect chose an oblong layout to maximise usable space within the small community centre.
example2_zh: 建筑师选择了长方形布局，以最大限度地利用这个小型社区中心的空间。
collocations: oblong table｜长方形桌子 ; oblong shape｜长方形 ; oblong tray｜长方形托盘
tip_zh: 强调长宽不等的长方形；不指正方形。

meanings_zh: v. 危及；损害
definition_en: To put something at risk of harm, loss, or failure.
example1_en: Skipping practice could jeopardise your place on the team.
example1_zh: 缺席训练可能会危及你在队中的位置。
example2_en: Reducing investment in public transport could jeopardise efforts to cut urban air pollution and traffic congestion.
example2_zh: 减少公共交通投资可能会妨碍减少城市空气污染和交通拥堵的努力。
collocations: jeopardise safety｜危及安全 ; jeopardise a career｜损害职业前途 ; jeopardise chances｜损害成功机会
tip_zh: 及物动词，直接接宾语；美式通常拼作jeopardize。

meanings_zh: v. 波动；涨落
definition_en: Rise and fall irregularly in level, amount, or value.
example1_en: Vegetable prices fluctuate sharply at our local market.
example1_zh: 我们当地市场的蔬菜价格波动很大。
example2_en: Demand for electricity tends to fluctuate throughout the day, creating challenges for energy suppliers.
example2_zh: 电力需求往往在一天之内不断波动，给能源供应商带来挑战。
collocations: fluctuate widely｜大幅波动 ; fluctuate between｜在……之间波动 ; fluctuate with demand｜随需求波动
tip_zh: 通常是不及物动词；在两值间波动用between。

meanings_zh: n. 遵守；奉行 | n. 宗教或传统仪式
definition_en: The practice of following a rule, law, or custom | A ceremony performed as part of religion or tradition
example1_en: Strict observance of kitchen hygiene keeps our food safe.
example1_zh: 严格遵守厨房卫生规范能保障我们的食品安全。
example2_en: Consistent observance of workplace safety regulations can prevent accidents and improve employees' confidence in their employers.
example2_zh: 始终遵守工作场所安全规定能够预防事故，并增强员工对雇主的信心。
collocations: observance of the law｜守法 ; strict observance｜严格遵守 ; religious observances｜宗教仪式
tip_zh: observance指遵守或仪式；observation指观察。

meanings_zh: adj. 反讽的；说反话的 | adj. 出乎意料而讽刺的
definition_en: expressing a meaning opposite to the words used | strangely opposite to what would normally be expected
example1_en: His ironical praise made it clear he disliked dinner.
example1_zh: 他那番反话式的称赞，明显是在表示他不喜欢这顿晚餐。
example2_en: It is ironical that technologies designed to save time can leave workers feeling busier than ever.
example2_zh: 旨在节省时间的技术却可能让劳动者感到前所未有的忙碌，这颇具讽刺意味。
collocations: an ironical remark｜反讽的话 ; an ironical tone｜反讽的语气 ; an ironical twist｜讽刺性的转折
tip_zh: 与ironic基本同义，但ironic更常用；不一定含恶意。

meanings_zh: adj. 外表的；表面上的 | adj. 向外的；外出的 | adv. 向外
definition_en: visible on the outside rather than reflecting inner feelings | moving or directed away from the centre or starting point | towards the outside or away from the centre
example1_en: Despite her outward confidence, Leila felt nervous inside.
example1_zh: 尽管外表自信，莱拉内心却很紧张。
example2_en: A city's outward appearance may improve through redevelopment, while underlying social inequalities remain largely unchanged.
example2_zh: 城市的外观可能因改造而改善，但深层的社会不平等却基本没有改变。
collocations: outward appearance｜外表 ; outward signs｜外在迹象 ; outward journey｜去程 ; outward movement｜向外移动
tip_zh: 作副词时英式英语更常用outwards。

meanings_zh: v. 散开；驱散
definition_en: To spread out or make people or things spread out
example1_en: The crowd began to disperse when the rain started.
example1_zh: 雨一下起来，人群就开始散去。
example2_en: Planting trees can help disperse strong winds and protect exposed farmland from soil erosion.
example2_zh: 植树有助于分散强风，保护无遮挡的农田免受土壤侵蚀。
collocations: disperse a crowd｜驱散人群 ; disperse seeds｜传播种子 ; disperse rapidly｜迅速散开
tip_zh: 既可及物也可不及物：驱散人群或人群散去。

meanings_zh: n. 真菌
definition_en: an organism such as a mushroom, mould, or yeast
example1_en: A strange orange fungus was growing on the fallen tree.
example1_zh: 倒下的树上长着一种奇怪的橙色真菌。
example2_en: Some types of fungus help maintain healthy forests by breaking down dead wood and recycling nutrients.
example2_zh: 某些真菌通过分解枯木、循环利用养分，帮助维持森林健康。
collocations: soil fungus｜土壤真菌 ; fungus growth｜真菌生长 ; edible fungi｜食用真菌
tip_zh: 复数常用fungi；真菌不属于植物。

meanings_zh: n. 前提；假定 | n. 房屋及附属场地
definition_en: an idea accepted as the basis for reasoning or action | the buildings and land used by a business or organization
example1_en: Your plan rests on the premise that everyone agrees.
example1_zh: 你的计划建立在所有人都同意这一前提上。
example2_en: The policy is based on the premise that affordable education improves both individual prospects and national productivity.
example2_zh: 这项政策的前提是，负担得起的教育能改善个人前景并提高国家生产力。
collocations: basic premise｜基本前提 ; on the premise that｜以……为前提 ; business premises｜营业场所 ; on the premises｜在该场所内
tip_zh: 表示房屋及场地时用复数premises。

meanings_zh: n. 纯净；纯度 | n. 纯洁；纯粹
definition_en: the state of containing no unwanted or harmful substances | the quality of being morally good or unmixed in character
example1_en: The jeweller checked the purity of my gold ring.
example1_zh: 珠宝匠检测了我那枚金戒指的纯度。
example2_en: Regular monitoring of water purity is essential for preventing disease and maintaining public confidence in local supplies.
example2_zh: 定期监测水的纯净程度，对于预防疾病和维持公众对当地供水的信心至关重要。
collocations: water purity｜水的纯净度 ; high purity｜高纯度 ; purity of gold｜黄金纯度
tip_zh: 不可数名词；表示具体纯度常用the purity of。

meanings_zh: n. 自主权；自治权
definition_en: The freedom or right to make decisions independently.
example1_en: My new manager gives me more autonomy at work.
example1_zh: 我的新经理给了我更多工作自主权。
example2_en: Giving schools greater autonomy may help teachers adapt their lessons to the specific needs of local communities.
example2_zh: 赋予学校更大的自主权，可能有助于教师根据当地社区的具体需求调整课程。
collocations: greater autonomy｜更大的自主权 ; regional autonomy｜区域自治 ; individual autonomy｜个人自主权 ; grant autonomy｜给予自主权
tip_zh: 通常不可数；既指地区自治，也指个人或机构自主。

meanings_zh: n. 实用技能；专门知识
definition_en: Practical knowledge and skills needed to do something successfully
example1_en: My uncle has the know-how to repair old bicycles.
example1_zh: 我叔叔掌握修理旧自行车的技术。
example2_en: Sharing technical know-how can help small businesses adopt cleaner production methods without relying entirely on outside consultants.
example2_zh: 分享技术知识可以帮助小企业采用更清洁的生产方式，而不必完全依赖外部顾问。
collocations: technical know-how｜技术知识 ; practical know-how｜实用技能 ; transfer know-how｜传授专门技术
tip_zh: 不可数名词，强调实际操作能力，拼写保留连字符。

meanings_zh: adj. 轻快的；迅速有力的 | adj. 生意兴隆的；交易活跃的 | adj. 凉爽清新的
definition_en: Quick and energetic. | Involving a lot of buying and selling. | Cold and fresh in a pleasant, energising way.
example1_en: A brisk walk before breakfast always wakes me up.
example1_zh: 早餐前快步走一走，总能让我清醒起来。
example2_en: Regular brisk walking can improve cardiovascular health without requiring expensive equipment or access to specialist facilities.
example2_zh: 经常快步走能改善心血管健康，无需昂贵的器材或专业设施。
collocations: a brisk walk｜快步行走 ; brisk trade｜兴隆的生意 ; a brisk breeze｜清凉的微风
tip_zh: brisk walk指轻快有力的快走，不是跑步。

meanings_zh: n. 聚合物；高分子
definition_en: A substance made of large molecules containing repeated smaller units.
example1_en: This flexible polymer keeps my phone case light and durable.
example1_zh: 这种柔韧的聚合物让我的手机壳既轻便又耐用。
example2_en: Researchers are developing biodegradable polymers to reduce the environmental impact of packaging and other disposable products.
example2_zh: 研究人员正在开发可生物降解的聚合物，以减少包装及其他一次性产品对环境的影响。
collocations: synthetic polymer｜合成聚合物 ; biodegradable polymer｜可生物降解聚合物 ; polymer chain｜聚合物链
tip_zh: 聚合物不只包括塑料，也包括淀粉等天然物质。

meanings_zh: adj. 地道的；符合语言习惯的 | adj. 习语的；含习语的
definition_en: natural and typical of how fluent speakers use a language | containing or relating to expressions with nonliteral meanings
example1_en: Your sentence is correct, but this version sounds more idiomatic.
example1_zh: 你的句子没错，不过这个说法听起来更地道。
example2_en: Regular exposure to authentic conversations helps language learners develop more idiomatic speech and greater confidence.
example2_zh: 经常接触真实对话有助于语言学习者说得更地道，也更有自信。
collocations: idiomatic English｜地道的英语 ; an idiomatic expression｜习语表达 ; idiomatic usage｜惯用法
tip_zh: 地道不等于堆砌习语；自然搭配也体现idiomatic。

meanings_zh: v. 取代；替代
definition_en: To replace something older or no longer useful.
example1_en: This new timetable supersedes the one on our fridge.
example1_zh: 这份新时刻表取代了我们冰箱上的旧时刻表。
example2_en: Digital payment systems may eventually supersede cash in many settings, although accessibility concerns must first be addressed.
example2_zh: 数字支付系统最终可能在许多场景中取代现金，但必须先解决使用便利性方面的问题。
collocations: supersede existing rules｜取代现有规则 ; be superseded by｜被……取代 ; supersede earlier versions｜取代早期版本
tip_zh: 注意拼写结尾是-sede，不是-cede；常用被动式。

meanings_zh: n. 人口普查
definition_en: an official count of people that collects information about them
example1_en: We completed the census form at our kitchen table.
example1_zh: 我们在厨房餐桌旁填好了人口普查表。
example2_en: Census data help governments plan housing, schools and healthcare services according to changing population needs.
example2_zh: 人口普查数据帮助政府根据不断变化的人口需求规划住房、学校和医疗服务。
collocations: conduct a census｜开展人口普查 ; census data｜人口普查数据 ; a national census｜全国人口普查 ; a census form｜人口普查表
tip_zh: census调查全部人口，sample survey只抽样。

meanings_zh: n. 镍 | n. 美加五分硬币
definition_en: A hard, silvery metal used in alloys and batteries. | A coin worth five cents in the US or Canada.
example1_en: My skin reacts badly to jewellery containing nickel.
example1_zh: 我的皮肤对含镍的首饰有严重的过敏反应。
example2_en: Growing demand for electric vehicles has increased interest in nickel mining, raising concerns about environmental damage.
example2_zh: 电动汽车需求的增长提高了人们对镍矿开采的关注，也引发了对环境破坏的担忧。
collocations: nickel mining｜镍矿开采 ; nickel alloy｜镍合金 ; nickel allergy｜镍过敏
tip_zh: 指金属时不可数；指五分硬币时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 侵犯；违反
definition_en: An action that breaks a law or violates someone's rights.
example1_en: Copying that photograph without permission could be copyright infringement.
example1_zh: 未经许可复制那张照片可能侵犯版权。
example2_en: Governments should protect creative workers by imposing appropriate penalties for the infringement of intellectual property rights.
example2_zh: 政府应对侵犯知识产权的行为施以适当处罚，以保护创作者。
collocations: copyright infringement｜侵犯版权 ; patent infringement｜侵犯专利权 ; infringement of rights｜侵犯权利
tip_zh: 常接of；infringement of rights指侵犯权利。

meanings_zh: v. 丰富；充实 | v. 使富有 | v. 增加养分；使肥沃
definition_en: To improve something by adding value, interest, or experience. | To make someone wealthier. | To improve food or soil by adding useful substances.
example1_en: These weekend painting classes really enrich my daily life.
example1_zh: 这些周末绘画课确实丰富了我的日常生活。
example2_en: International exchange programmes can enrich students' education by exposing them to different perspectives and teaching methods.
example2_zh: 国际交流项目能让学生接触不同观点和教学方法，从而丰富他们的教育体验。
collocations: enrich people's lives｜丰富人们的生活 ; enrich understanding｜加深理解 ; enrich the soil｜使土壤肥沃
tip_zh: enrich是及物动词，常接life、experience或soil。

meanings_zh: adj. 极其巨大的；天文数字的 | adj. 天文学的
definition_en: Extremely large, especially when describing prices, costs, or amounts. | Relating to the scientific study of stars, planets, and space.
example1_en: The hotel charged an astronomical price for one night.
example1_zh: 这家酒店一晚的收费高得惊人。
example2_en: The astronomical cost of housing in major cities can prevent young adults from achieving financial independence.
example2_zh: 大城市高得惊人的住房成本可能使年轻人无法实现经济独立。
collocations: astronomical costs｜巨额成本 ; astronomical sums｜天文数字般的金额 ; astronomical observations｜天文观测
tip_zh: 谈费用时常表示高得惊人；也可表示天文学的。

meanings_zh: adj. 名声不佳的；不可信的 | adj. 邋遢的；破旧的
definition_en: Having a bad reputation and not deserving trust or respect. | Looking untidy, worn, or unsuitable for respectable company.
example1_en: We avoided that disreputable garage after several neighbours complained.
example1_zh: 几位邻居投诉后，我们就避开了那家名声不好的修车厂。
example2_en: Stronger consumer protection laws could prevent disreputable companies from exploiting customers who lack detailed financial knowledge.
example2_zh: 加强消费者保护法规，可以防止不良企业利用缺乏金融知识的顾客牟利。
collocations: disreputable company｜名声不佳的公司 ; disreputable behaviour｜不光彩的行为 ; disreputable character｜名声不好的人
tip_zh: 通常指名声或行为不佳，不只是外表破旧。

meanings_zh: adj. 凶猛的；残暴的 | adj. 恶毒的；恶意的
definition_en: likely to attack or cause serious harm | deliberately cruel and intended to hurt someone
example1_en: A vicious dog growled behind the tall metal fence.
example1_zh: 一只凶猛的狗在高高的金属围栏后低吼。
example2_en: Vicious comments on social media can damage young people's confidence and discourage participation in online discussions.
example2_zh: 社交媒体上的恶毒评论可能损害年轻人的自信，使他们不愿参与网上讨论。
collocations: vicious attack｜凶残的袭击 ; vicious circle｜恶性循环 ; vicious rumour｜恶意谣言 ; vicious comments｜恶毒评论
tip_zh: vicious circle指问题互相加剧的“恶性循环”。

meanings_zh: v. 苦苦思索；焦虑不已
definition_en: Worry intensely while trying to make a difficult decision
example1_en: I agonized over which course to choose all weekend.
example1_zh: 整个周末，我都在为选哪门课而纠结。
example2_en: Many graduates agonize over whether to pursue further education or enter an increasingly competitive job market.
example2_zh: 许多毕业生为继续深造还是进入竞争日益激烈的就业市场而苦恼。
collocations: agonize over a decision｜为决定而苦恼 ; agonize about the future｜为未来焦虑
tip_zh: 常用agonize over/about；英式也拼作agonise。

meanings_zh: n. 推进；推进力
definition_en: The force or process that moves something forward
example1_en: This small boat relies on electric propulsion to move quietly.
example1_zh: 这艘小船靠电力推进，行驶时很安静。
example2_en: Advances in electric propulsion could reduce both noise pollution and fuel consumption in coastal shipping.
example2_zh: 电力推进技术的进步有望减少沿海航运的噪声污染和燃料消耗。
collocations: propulsion system｜推进系统 ; electric propulsion｜电力推进 ; jet propulsion｜喷气推进
tip_zh: 通常为不可数名词，常用于船舶、飞机和航天器。

meanings_zh: adj. 和睦的；融洽的 | adj. 协调的；和谐悦耳的
definition_en: friendly and peaceful, without conflict | having parts that look or sound pleasing together
example1_en: Sharing the chores helps keep our home harmonious.
example1_zh: 分担家务有助于保持家庭和睦。
example2_en: Schools can promote harmonious relationships by teaching students to resolve disagreements through respectful discussion.
example2_zh: 学校可以教学生通过相互尊重的讨论解决分歧，从而促进融洽的人际关系。
collocations: harmonious relationship｜融洽的关系 ; harmonious society｜和谐社会 ; harmonious blend｜协调的融合
tip_zh: 既可形容人际关系融洽，也可形容色彩、声音协调。

meanings_zh: adj. 通用的；非特定的 | adj. 无品牌的；非专利的
definition_en: Relating to a whole group rather than one particular example. | Sold without a brand name or no longer protected by patent.
example1_en: The website sent me a generic reply about delivery.
example1_zh: 网站就配送问题给我发了一封千篇一律的回复。
example2_en: Generic medicines can reduce healthcare costs while providing the same active ingredients as their branded equivalents.
example2_zh: 仿制药可以降低医疗费用，同时提供与对应品牌药相同的活性成分。
collocations: generic term｜统称 ; generic advice｜笼统的建议 ; generic medicine｜仿制药 ; generic version｜无品牌版本
tip_zh: generic强调非特定；generic medicine通常指仿制药。

meanings_zh: adj. 听觉的；听力的
definition_en: Relating to hearing or the sense of hearing
example1_en: Our music teacher uses games to develop aural skills.
example1_zh: 我们的音乐老师通过游戏培养听辨能力。
example2_en: Language courses should include regular aural practice so that learners can understand different accents in everyday communication.
example2_zh: 语言课程应安排定期的听力练习，使学习者能在日常交流中听懂不同口音。
collocations: aural skills｜听辨能力 ; aural training｜听力训练 ; aural comprehension｜听力理解 ; aural test｜听力测试
tip_zh: aural指听觉的；oral指口头的或口腔的。

meanings_zh: n. 机车；火车头
definition_en: A railway engine that pulls or pushes a train.
example1_en: A steam locomotive pulled the carriages slowly past our platform.
example1_zh: 一台蒸汽机车拉着车厢，缓缓驶过我们所在的站台。
example2_en: Replacing diesel locomotives with electric models can reduce local air pollution, especially along busy urban railway routes.
example2_zh: 用电力机车替代柴油机车可以减少当地空气污染，尤其是在繁忙的城市铁路沿线。
collocations: a steam locomotive｜蒸汽机车 ; a diesel locomotive｜柴油机车 ; an electric locomotive｜电力机车
tip_zh: 指提供动力的机车，不是包含所有车厢的整列火车。

meanings_zh: v. 嘲笑；嘲弄 | adj. 模拟的；仿制的 | n. 模拟考试
definition_en: To make someone seem foolish by laughing at or imitating them. | Made to imitate something real, often for practice. | A practice examination taken before the real one.
example1_en: Please don't mock my dancing; I'm still learning.
example1_zh: 请别嘲笑我的舞姿，我还在学呢。
example2_en: Mock interviews allow students to practise explaining their skills before they apply for their first professional positions.
example2_zh: 模拟面试让学生在申请第一份专业工作前，练习如何介绍自己的技能。
collocations: mock someone's accent｜嘲笑某人的口音 ; mock exam｜模拟考试 ; mock interview｜模拟面试
tip_zh: mock作动词直接接宾语，不加at。

meanings_zh: n. 费力；体力或脑力消耗
definition_en: Physical or mental effort, especially when it makes you tired.
example1_en: He was breathless from the exertion of climbing upstairs.
example1_zh: 他费力爬上楼梯后，累得气喘吁吁。
example2_en: Regular physical activity benefits health, but excessive exertion without adequate recovery can increase the risk of injury.
example2_zh: 经常进行身体活动有益健康，但过度用力且恢复不足可能增加受伤风险。
collocations: physical exertion｜体力消耗 ; mental exertion｜脑力消耗 ; strenuous exertion｜高强度体力消耗 ; excessive exertion｜过度用力
tip_zh: 多指消耗体力或脑力，不等同于表示尽力的try hard。

meanings_zh: n. 种族灭绝
definition_en: Acts intended to destroy a national, ethnic, racial, or religious group.
example1_en: We visited a memorial to the victims of genocide.
example1_zh: 我们参观了一处种族灭绝遇难者纪念地。
example2_en: Education about past acts of genocide can help societies recognise prejudice and strengthen their commitment to human rights.
example2_zh: 有关历史上种族灭绝行为的教育，有助于社会识别偏见并加强对人权的维护。
collocations: commit genocide｜实施种族灭绝 ; prevent genocide｜防止种族灭绝 ; victims of genocide｜种族灭绝的受害者
tip_zh: 不泛指大规模杀戮，核心是蓄意毁灭特定群体。

meanings_zh: adj. 会犯错的；不完全可靠的
definition_en: Capable of making mistakes or being wrong
example1_en: Even experienced drivers are fallible, so please stay alert.
example1_zh: 即使经验丰富的司机也会犯错，所以请保持警觉。
example2_en: Human memory is fallible, which raises concerns about relying solely on eyewitness accounts in court.
example2_zh: 人的记忆可能出错，因此在法庭上仅依赖目击者陈述令人担忧。
collocations: fallible human judgement｜可能出错的人类判断 ; a fallible system｜不完全可靠的系统
tip_zh: 强调可能犯错，并非一定错误；反义词为infallible。

meanings_zh: v. 办理业务；进行交易
definition_en: to conduct business or carry out a business deal
example1_en: We transact most of our business through the bank.
example1_zh: 我们的大部分业务都通过银行办理。
example2_en: Digital platforms allow small companies to transact business internationally without maintaining expensive offices in foreign markets.
example2_zh: 数字平台让小企业无需在海外市场维持昂贵的办事处，也能开展国际业务。
collocations: transact business｜办理业务 ; transact business with｜与……开展业务 ; transact online｜在线交易
tip_zh: 正式用语，常用transact business表示开展业务。

meanings_zh: v. 巩固；加强 | v. 合并；整合
definition_en: To make an achievement, position, or skill stronger. | To combine separate things into a single effective whole.
example1_en: I review my notes each evening to consolidate my learning.
example1_zh: 我每晚复习笔记，以巩固所学内容。
example2_en: Regular practical exercises help students consolidate their knowledge and apply theoretical concepts to unfamiliar situations.
example2_zh: 定期的实践练习有助于学生巩固知识，并将理论概念应用于陌生情境。
collocations: consolidate knowledge｜巩固知识 ; consolidate power｜巩固权力 ; consolidate gains｜巩固成果 ; consolidate debts｜合并债务
tip_zh: 既可指巩固已有成果，也可指合并多个部分。

meanings_zh: n. 粪肥 | v. 给土地施粪肥
definition_en: Animal waste used to improve soil and help plants grow. | To spread animal waste on land as fertilizer.
example1_en: The farmer spread manure around the young apple trees.
example1_zh: 农民在幼小的苹果树周围撒上粪肥。
example2_en: Using manure can improve soil fertility, but excessive application may pollute nearby rivers and groundwater.
example2_zh: 施用粪肥可以提高土壤肥力，但过量施用可能污染附近河流和地下水。
collocations: animal manure｜动物粪肥 ; spread manure｜撒施粪肥 ; well-rotted manure｜充分腐熟的粪肥
tip_zh: 名词通常不可数；fertilizer泛指肥料，范围更广。

meanings_zh: n. 边缘；临界点 | n. 路边草地 | v. 接近；近乎
definition_en: The point just before something happens. | A strip of grass beside a road. | To come close to a particular state or quality.
example1_en: She was on the verge of tears after losing her ring.
example1_zh: 她丢了戒指，几乎要哭出来了。
example2_en: Several native species are on the verge of extinction because their habitats have been severely damaged.
example2_zh: 几种本地物种因栖息地遭到严重破坏而濒临灭绝。
collocations: on the verge of extinction｜濒临灭绝 ; on the verge of doing something｜即将做某事 ; a grass verge｜路边草地 ; verge on the absurd｜近乎荒谬
tip_zh: on the verge of后接名词或动名词；动词常接on。

meanings_zh: adj. 最佳的；最适宜的
definition_en: Best or most effective for a particular purpose.
example1_en: This sunny windowsill provides optimal conditions for my herbs.
example1_zh: 这个阳光充足的窗台为我的香草提供了最适宜的生长条件。
example2_en: Urban planners must balance housing density and green space to achieve optimal living conditions for residents.
example2_zh: 城市规划者必须平衡住房密度与绿地面积，为居民创造最佳居住条件。
collocations: optimal conditions｜最佳条件 ; optimal performance｜最佳表现 ; optimal solution｜最优解决方案
tip_zh: 已含“最佳”之意，通常不再用 most 修饰。

meanings_zh: adv. 坚决地；坚定地
definition_en: In a determined way, without giving up or changing course
example1_en: Despite the rain, she walked resolutely towards the shelter.
example1_zh: 尽管下着雨，她仍坚定地朝避雨处走去。
example2_en: Governments must act resolutely to protect endangered habitats, even when conservation measures face strong opposition.
example2_zh: 即使保护措施遭遇强烈反对，政府也必须坚决行动，保护濒危生境。
collocations: act resolutely｜坚决行动 ; resolutely oppose｜坚决反对 ; resolutely refuse｜断然拒绝
tip_zh: 这是副词；形容词形式为resolute。

meanings_zh: n. 保养；维修；维护费用
definition_en: work or money needed to keep something in good condition
example1_en: This old house needs regular upkeep throughout the year.
example1_zh: 这栋老房子一年到头都需要定期维护。
example2_en: Local authorities must budget for the upkeep of public parks to ensure they remain safe and accessible.
example2_zh: 地方政府必须为公园维护编列预算，确保公园保持安全并方便公众使用。
collocations: regular upkeep｜定期保养 ; cost of upkeep｜维护费用 ; property upkeep｜房产维护
tip_zh: 不可数名词，既指维护工作，也指维护费用。

meanings_zh: v. 使萦绕心头；不断困扰 | v. 鬼魂出没于 | n. 常去的地方
definition_en: to keep returning to someone's mind and causing distress | for a ghost to appear repeatedly in a place | a place someone visits frequently
example1_en: That embarrassing mistake still haunts me before every presentation.
example1_zh: 每次做报告前，那个令人尴尬的错误仍会困扰我。
example2_en: The consequences of poor urban planning can haunt communities long after the original decisions are made.
example2_zh: 糟糕的城市规划所带来的后果，可能在最初决策作出很久之后仍困扰社区。
collocations: be haunted by memories｜被回忆困扰 ; haunt an old house｜在老房子里出没 ; a favourite haunt｜最爱常去的地方
tip_zh: 作动词直接接宾语；be haunted by表示受困扰。

meanings_zh: v. 由…组成；包括 | v. 组成；构成
definition_en: to have particular people or things as parts | to be the parts or members that form something
example1_en: The gift set comprises soap, lotion, and a towel.
example1_zh: 这套礼盒包含香皂、乳液和一条毛巾。
example2_en: The proposed transport network will comprise bus routes and cycle lanes connecting residential areas with employment centres.
example2_zh: 拟建的交通网络将由连接住宅区与就业中心的公交线路和自行车道组成。
collocations: comprise several sections｜包含几个部分 ; comprise a range of services｜涵盖一系列服务 ; comprise the majority｜占多数
tip_zh: 最稳妥结构：整体comprises部分，不加of。

meanings_zh: n. 王室成员；王族 | n. 版税；特许权使用费
definition_en: people who belong to a royal family | a payment for using someone's work, invention, or property
example1_en: The palace once served as a home for royalty.
example1_zh: 这座宫殿曾是王室成员的住所。
example2_en: Authors often rely on royalties from book sales to support themselves while developing new creative projects.
example2_zh: 作家在开展新的创作项目时，往往依靠图书销售的版税维持生活。
collocations: a member of royalty｜王室成员 ; pay royalties｜支付版税 ; royalty payments｜版税款项
tip_zh: 指王族时不可数；指版税收入时常用复数royalties。

meanings_zh: v. 死亡；毁灭 | v. 老化；腐坏
definition_en: To die or be destroyed, especially in harsh conditions. | To decay or lose strength and flexibility over time.
example1_en: These delicate plants will perish if left outside tonight.
example1_zh: 这些娇嫩的植物如果今晚放在外面，就会冻死。
example2_en: Without effective habitat protection, many vulnerable species may perish as temperatures rise and food sources disappear.
example2_zh: 如果没有有效的栖息地保护，随着气温上升和食物来源消失，许多脆弱物种可能灭绝。
collocations: perish from cold｜冻死 ; perish in a fire｜在火灾中丧生 ; rubber perishes｜橡胶老化
tip_zh: 通常是不及物动词；英式英语也用于橡胶等老化。

meanings_zh: adj. 可转让的；可转移的 | adj. 可用于不同情境的
definition_en: able to be moved or passed to another person or place | useful in different jobs or situations
example1_en: These tickets are transferable, so your sister can use mine.
example1_zh: 这些票可以转让，所以你姐姐可以用我的。
example2_en: Universities should help students develop transferable skills that remain valuable across different industries and careers.
example2_zh: 大学应帮助学生培养在不同行业和职业中都具有价值的通用技能。
collocations: transferable skills｜可迁移技能 ; transferable ticket｜可转让的票 ; transferable knowledge｜可迁移的知识
tip_zh: transferable skills 指换岗位或行业仍适用的技能。

meanings_zh: n. 恶习；不道德行为 | n. 台钳；老虎钳
definition_en: a bad habit or morally wrong behaviour | a tool that holds an object firmly between two jaws
example1_en: Eating too much chocolate is my only vice.
example1_zh: 吃太多巧克力是我唯一的坏习惯。
example2_en: Excessive consumption is sometimes viewed as a personal vice rather than a consequence of social pressures.
example2_zh: 过度消费有时被视为个人恶习，而非社会压力造成的结果。
collocations: a minor vice｜小恶习 ; vice and virtue｜恶与善 ; a bench vice｜台钳
tip_zh: 台钳在美式英语中拼作vise；副主席中的vice-是前缀。

meanings_zh: n. 呼吸道；气道 | n. 航路；航线
definition_en: a passage through which air reaches the lungs | an established route used by aircraft
example1_en: The nurse checked that the patient's airway was clear.
example1_zh: 护士检查了病人的气道是否通畅。
example2_en: Heavy traffic along a major airway requires careful coordination to keep aircraft safely separated.
example2_zh: 主要航路上的繁忙交通需要精心协调，以确保飞机保持安全间距。
collocations: keep the airway clear｜保持气道通畅 ; airway obstruction｜气道阻塞 ; upper airway｜上呼吸道
tip_zh: 常指呼吸道；航线义较专业，勿与airline混淆。

meanings_zh: v. 迫使；强迫
definition_en: to force someone to do something
example1_en: Heavy rain compelled us to cancel our picnic.
example1_zh: 大雨迫使我们取消了野餐。
example2_en: Stricter environmental laws could compel manufacturers to reduce waste and adopt cleaner production methods.
example2_zh: 更严格的环境法规可能迫使制造商减少废弃物并采用更清洁的生产方式。
collocations: compel someone to act｜迫使某人行动 ; feel compelled to｜觉得不得不 ; be compelled by circumstances｜为形势所迫
tip_zh: 常用compel sb to do，语气强且较正式。

meanings_zh: v. 迫使离开家园 | v. 取代；替代 | v. 移开；排开
definition_en: Force people to leave their homes or usual surroundings. | Take the position or role previously held by something else. | Move something from its position, especially by occupying its space.
example1_en: The flood displaced several families living near the river.
example1_zh: 洪水使住在河边的几户人家被迫离开家园。
example2_en: Although automation may displace some workers, investment in retraining can help them find alternative employment.
example2_zh: 虽然自动化可能取代部分工人，但投资再培训可以帮助他们找到其他工作。
collocations: displaced people｜流离失所的人 ; displace workers｜取代工人 ; displace water｜排开水
tip_zh: displace常指被迫迁离；也可指新事物取代旧事物。

meanings_zh: v. 引诱；诱惑 | n. 诱惑力；诱饵
definition_en: To attract someone by offering something appealing, sometimes deceptively. | An attraction or object used to draw someone or something closer.
example1_en: We used some cheese to lure the mouse outside.
example1_zh: 我们用一些奶酪把老鼠引到了外面。
example2_en: Large cities often lure young graduates with higher salaries, leaving rural communities with a shortage of skilled workers.
example2_zh: 大城市常以较高薪资吸引年轻毕业生，导致乡村社区缺乏技术人才。
collocations: lure someone into doing something｜诱使某人做某事 ; lure customers｜吸引顾客 ; the lure of wealth｜财富的诱惑 ; a fishing lure｜钓鱼假饵
tip_zh: 常用lure sb into doing，往往暗含诱骗意味。

meanings_zh: n. 舱式游艇 | n. 巡洋舰 | n. 巡逻警车（美式）
definition_en: A powered leisure boat with space for sleeping. | A large, fast military ship. | A police car used to patrol an area.
example1_en: We spent the weekend aboard a small cabin cruiser.
example1_zh: 我们在一艘小型舱式游艇上度过了周末。
example2_en: The growing popularity of holidays aboard a cruiser has increased demand for moorings along inland waterways.
example2_zh: 乘坐舱式游艇度假日益流行，使内陆水道沿线的泊位需求有所增加。
collocations: a cabin cruiser｜舱式游艇 ; a police cruiser｜巡逻警车 ; a naval cruiser｜海军巡洋舰
tip_zh: 大型邮轮通常叫cruise ship，不叫cruiser。

meanings_zh: n. 陆军中尉；海军上尉 | n. 副手；得力助手
definition_en: An officer holding a junior rank in the armed forces | A trusted assistant who helps a leader manage important work
example1_en: The lieutenant helped the new soldiers organise their equipment.
example1_zh: 中尉帮助新兵整理装备。
example2_en: During disaster relief operations, a lieutenant may coordinate military teams delivering essential supplies to isolated communities.
example2_zh: 在救灾行动中，中尉可能负责协调向偏远社区运送必需物资的军方队伍。
collocations: army lieutenant｜陆军中尉 ; naval lieutenant｜海军上尉 ; trusted lieutenant｜可信赖的副手
tip_zh: 英式开头读/lef/，美式读/luː/；军衔译名因军种而异。

meanings_zh: n. 积累；堆积；积聚物
definition_en: The gradual gathering of something, or the amount gathered.
example1_en: An accumulation of dust covered the old wooden shelves.
example1_zh: 一层积灰覆盖了那些旧木架。
example2_en: The accumulation of plastic waste in oceans threatens marine wildlife and creates lasting challenges for coastal communities.
example2_zh: 海洋中塑料垃圾的积聚威胁着海洋野生动物，也给沿海社区带来长期挑战。
collocations: accumulation of wealth｜财富积累 ; accumulation of waste｜废物堆积 ; gradual accumulation｜逐渐积累 ; capital accumulation｜资本积累
tip_zh: 常接of，强调随时间逐渐增多。

meanings_zh: n. 预言 | n. 预言能力
definition_en: a statement about the future, often claiming supernatural knowledge | the supposed ability to know and describe future events
example1_en: In the story, an ancient prophecy finally came true.
example1_zh: 故事中，一个古老的预言终于应验了。
example2_en: Low expectations can become a self-fulfilling prophecy when students receive less encouragement and fewer opportunities to improve.
example2_zh: 当学生得到的鼓励和进步机会更少时，低期望可能成为自我实现的预言。
collocations: a self-fulfilling prophecy｜自我实现的预言 ; fulfil a prophecy｜使预言应验 ; the gift of prophecy｜预言天赋
tip_zh: prophecy是名词；动词prophesy词尾读/saɪ/。

meanings_zh: adj. 迅速的；敏捷的 | n. 雨燕
definition_en: Moving quickly or happening after very little delay. | A small bird with long curved wings that flies fast.
example1_en: Her swift reaction stopped the glass from falling.
example1_zh: 她反应敏捷，接住了快要掉下去的玻璃杯。
example2_en: A swift response to disease outbreaks can reduce pressure on hospitals and protect vulnerable communities.
example2_zh: 迅速应对疾病暴发可以减轻医院压力，并保护脆弱群体。
collocations: swift action｜迅速的行动 ; swift response｜迅速的回应 ; swift recovery｜迅速康复
tip_zh: 常修饰action、response；副词形式是swiftly。

meanings_zh: n. 教义；学说；信条
definition_en: A belief or set of principles taught by a group.
example1_en: The guide explained the doctrine behind the temple's daily rituals.
example1_zh: 导游解释了这座寺庙日常仪式背后的教义。
example2_en: Economic doctrine should be evaluated against practical evidence rather than accepted simply because it has influential supporters.
example2_zh: 经济学说应该依据实际证据来评估，而不应仅因其支持者有影响力就被接受。
collocations: religious doctrine｜宗教教义 ; economic doctrine｜经济学说 ; political doctrine｜政治信条
tip_zh: 不一定含贬义；可指宗教教义或政治、经济学说。

meanings_zh: v. 抬高；举起 | v. 提升地位；提高水平 | v. 使情绪高昂
definition_en: To move something to a higher physical position | To raise someone's status or improve the quality of something | To make someone feel happier or more hopeful
example1_en: The nurse used a pillow to elevate my ankle.
example1_zh: 护士用枕头垫高了我的脚踝。
example2_en: Access to advanced training can elevate professional standards and improve the quality of public services.
example2_zh: 获得进阶培训的机会能够提升专业标准，并改善公共服务质量。
collocations: elevate a limb｜抬高肢体 ; elevate standards｜提高标准 ; elevate someone to a position｜将某人提拔至某职位 ; elevate mood｜改善情绪
tip_zh: 及物动词；elevate A to B可表示将A提升至B。

meanings_zh: adj. 宁静的；平静的
definition_en: calm and peaceful, without noise or disturbance
example1_en: We enjoyed a tranquil morning beside the still lake.
example1_zh: 我们在平静的湖边度过了一个宁静的早晨。
example2_en: Urban parks offer tranquil spaces where residents can escape traffic noise and recover from daily stress.
example2_zh: 城市公园提供宁静的空间，让居民远离交通噪声，缓解日常压力。
collocations: a tranquil setting｜宁静的环境 ; tranquil waters｜平静的水面 ; a tranquil atmosphere｜宁静的氛围
tip_zh: 常描写环境或水面，比 quiet 更强调安宁感。

meanings_zh: v. 茁壮成长；兴旺发展
definition_en: To grow strongly or become successful.
example1_en: These herbs thrive on our sunny kitchen windowsill.
example1_zh: 这些香草在我们厨房阳光充足的窗台上长得很旺。
example2_en: Small businesses are more likely to thrive when local governments provide reliable infrastructure and accessible financial support.
example2_zh: 地方政府提供可靠的基础设施和便利的资金支持时，小企业更有可能蓬勃发展。
collocations: thrive in warm conditions｜在温暖环境中茁壮成长 ; thrive on challenges｜遇到挑战更有干劲 ; a thriving business｜生意兴隆的企业
tip_zh: 不及物动词；thrive on表示因某事而更有活力。

meanings_zh: n. 促进因素；刺激 | n. 刺激物；刺激因素
definition_en: Something that encourages activity, growth, or change. | Something that causes a physical or mental response.
example1_en: The prize provided a stimulus for her daily practice.
example1_zh: 这个奖项激励她每天练习。
example2_en: Investment in renewable energy can provide a powerful stimulus to economic growth while reducing emissions.
example2_zh: 投资可再生能源可以在减少排放的同时，有力地促进经济增长。
collocations: a stimulus to growth｜促进增长的因素 ; economic stimulus｜经济刺激 ; respond to a stimulus｜对刺激作出反应
tip_zh: 复数是stimuli；stimulus to中的to是介词。

meanings_zh: adj. 灵巧熟练的
definition_en: Skilful, quick, and controlled in movement or action.
example1_en: With a deft movement, she caught the falling cup.
example1_zh: 她动作敏捷，一把接住了掉落的杯子。
example2_en: Effective classroom management requires deft handling of disagreements between students from different backgrounds.
example2_zh: 有效的课堂管理需要巧妙处理不同背景学生之间的分歧。
collocations: deft touch｜娴熟的手法 ; deft handling｜巧妙的处理 ; deft movement｜灵巧的动作
tip_zh: 既可形容手部动作灵巧，也可指处理问题巧妙。

meanings_zh: v. 最终以……告终；达到高潮
definition_en: To reach a final result or highest point after gradual development
example1_en: Weeks of rehearsals culminated in a wonderful evening performance.
example1_zh: 经过数周排练，大家最终献上了一场精彩的晚间演出。
example2_en: Years of public consultation culminated in a comprehensive transport plan designed to reduce congestion and improve accessibility.
example2_zh: 多年的公众咨询最终促成了一项旨在缓解拥堵、改善交通可达性的综合交通规划。
collocations: culminate in success｜最终取得成功 ; culminate in an agreement｜最终达成协议 ; culminate in a celebration｜以庆祝活动达到高潮
tip_zh: 常用 culminate in＋结果，强调发展后的终点或高潮。

meanings_zh: adj. 易生气的；敏感的 | adj. 敏感难处理的
definition_en: Easily upset or offended, especially by criticism. | Likely to cause upset or disagreement unless handled carefully.
example1_en: My brother gets touchy when anyone criticises his cooking.
example1_zh: 只要有人批评哥哥的厨艺，他就容易生气。
example2_en: Pay differences remain a touchy subject in many workplaces, making open discussions about fairness particularly difficult.
example2_zh: 薪酬差异在许多工作场所仍是敏感话题，使公开讨论公平问题变得尤为困难。
collocations: touchy about criticism｜对批评很敏感 ; a touchy subject｜敏感话题 ; a touchy issue｜棘手的敏感问题
tip_zh: touchy指易生气；touched指受感动。

meanings_zh: n. 做工；工艺水平
definition_en: The skill and quality shown in making something.
example1_en: The smooth wooden joints reveal the chair's excellent workmanship.
example1_zh: 平滑的木质接合处体现了这把椅子精良的做工。
example2_en: Consumers may accept higher prices when products demonstrate superior workmanship and offer a longer useful life.
example2_zh: 如果产品做工更精良、使用寿命更长，消费者可能会接受更高的价格。
collocations: fine workmanship｜精细的做工 ; poor workmanship｜粗劣的做工 ; quality workmanship｜优质工艺
tip_zh: 不可数名词，强调成品的做工，而非工作态度。

meanings_zh: v. 组织；调集；整理 | n. 活动秩序员 | n. 元帅
definition_en: to gather and arrange people, resources, or ideas effectively | someone who directs people and maintains order at an event | a military officer holding a very high rank
example1_en: A volunteer marshalled the runners into a neat line.
example1_zh: 一名志愿者把跑步者组织成了整齐的一队。
example2_en: Governments must marshal resources effectively to provide emergency housing for communities affected by severe flooding.
example2_zh: 政府必须有效调集资源，为遭受严重洪灾的社区提供应急住房。
collocations: marshal resources｜调集资源 ; marshal the evidence｜整理证据 ; race marshal｜赛事秩序员 ; field marshal｜陆军元帅
tip_zh: 英式过去式marshalled，美式marshaled；勿混淆martial。

meanings_zh: adj. 制药的；药物的 | n. 药品
definition_en: relating to medicines or their production | a drug used as medicine
example1_en: My sister works in a pharmaceutical research laboratory.
example1_zh: 我姐姐在一家药物研究实验室工作。
example2_en: Pharmaceutical companies should ensure that essential medicines remain affordable for patients in poorer communities.
example2_zh: 制药公司应确保较贫困社区的患者仍能负担得起基本药物。
collocations: pharmaceutical industry｜制药业 ; pharmaceutical company｜制药公司 ; pharmaceutical research｜药物研究
tip_zh: 作名词常用复数 pharmaceuticals，泛指药品。

meanings_zh: adj. 黯淡的；无望的 | adj. 荒凉的；阴冷的
definition_en: offering little hope of improvement or success | cold, bare, and unwelcoming
example1_en: Without enough rain, the farm faces a bleak future.
example1_zh: 如果雨水不足，这座农场的前景就很黯淡。
example2_en: Employment prospects remain bleak in rural areas where traditional industries have declined and investment is limited.
example2_zh: 在传统产业衰退且投资有限的农村地区，就业前景依然黯淡。
collocations: bleak future｜黯淡的未来 ; bleak outlook｜悲观的前景 ; bleak landscape｜荒凉的景色
tip_zh: 既可描述荒凉阴冷的环境，也可描述无望的前景。

meanings_zh: adj. 疲惫的；疲倦的 | adj. 厌倦的；不耐烦的 | v. 使疲倦；感到厌倦
definition_en: Very tired, especially after prolonged effort | No longer interested in something because it continues too long | To make someone tired or become tired of something
example1_en: The weary hikers rested beside a stream before sunset.
example1_zh: 日落前，疲惫的徒步者们在溪边休息。
example2_en: Commuters who endure long journeys often arrive home too weary to exercise or spend quality time with family.
example2_zh: 通勤路途漫长的人到家后往往疲惫不堪，无力锻炼或好好陪伴家人。
collocations: weary travellers｜疲惫的旅人 ; weary of｜厌倦 ; grow weary｜渐感疲倦
tip_zh: weary是疲倦的；wary是警惕的，注意拼写。

meanings_zh: n. 覆盖层；覆盖物 | n. 地幔 | n. 职责；衣钵
definition_en: A layer that covers a surface or area | The thick layer of Earth between its crust and core | An important role or responsibility passed to someone
example1_en: A mantle of snow covered the garden overnight.
example1_zh: 一夜之间，花园披上了一层白雪。
example2_en: Younger researchers must take on the mantle of leadership as experienced scientists retire from their positions.
example2_zh: 随着资深科学家退休，年轻研究人员必须承担起领导职责。
collocations: a mantle of snow｜一层积雪 ; Earth's mantle｜地幔 ; assume the mantle of｜承担……的职责
tip_zh: mantle也可指披风；壁炉架通常拼作mantel。

meanings_zh: adj. 仪式的；礼仪性的
definition_en: used in or connected with a formal public ceremony
example1_en: The mayor wore a ceremonial robe for the opening.
example1_zh: 市长穿着礼袍出席了开幕仪式。
example2_en: Traditional ceremonial clothing can strengthen cultural identity and connect younger generations with their community's history.
example2_zh: 传统礼仪服饰能够增强文化认同，并让年轻一代与本社区的历史建立联系。
collocations: ceremonial dress｜礼仪服饰 ; ceremonial role｜礼仪性职务 ; ceremonial occasion｜礼仪场合
tip_zh: ceremonial重在仪式用途；ceremonious指礼节隆重。

meanings_zh: adj. 月球的；月亮的 | adj. 按月相制定的；阴历的
definition_en: Relating to the moon. | Based on the changing phases of the moon.
example1_en: We watched the lunar eclipse from our garden.
example1_zh: 我们在花园里观看了月食。
example2_en: Research on lunar rocks helps scientists understand how the moon and the early solar system developed.
example2_zh: 对月球岩石的研究有助于科学家了解月球及早期太阳系的演变。
collocations: lunar eclipse｜月食 ; lunar surface｜月球表面 ; lunar calendar｜阴历 ; lunar mission｜探月任务
tip_zh: lunar指月亮的；solar指太阳的。

meanings_zh: v. 管理；执行 | v. 给予药物；施行治疗
definition_en: to manage an organization or put a system into operation | to give someone medicine or medical treatment
example1_en: The nurse administered the medicine before I went home.
example1_zh: 我回家前，护士给我用了药。
example2_en: Local authorities administer housing programmes designed to provide affordable accommodation for families on low incomes.
example2_zh: 地方政府负责管理住房项目，为低收入家庭提供负担得起的住所。
collocations: administer a programme｜管理项目 ; administer medication｜给药 ; administer first aid｜实施急救 ; administer a test｜组织测验
tip_zh: 给某人用药可说administer medicine to someone。

meanings_zh: n. 燃烧
definition_en: The chemical process of burning, which releases heat.
example1_en: The stove needs enough air for efficient combustion.
example1_zh: 炉子需要充足的空气才能高效燃烧。
example2_en: The combustion of fossil fuels releases carbon dioxide, contributing significantly to the rise in global temperatures.
example2_zh: 化石燃料燃烧会释放二氧化碳，是全球气温上升的重要原因之一。
collocations: fuel combustion｜燃料燃烧 ; complete combustion｜完全燃烧 ; internal combustion engine｜内燃机 ; spontaneous combustion｜自燃
tip_zh: 通常不可数，是burning的科技语体表达。

meanings_zh: adj. 无名的；未透露姓名的 | adj. 难以形容的
definition_en: Having no name, or having a name that remains unknown | Too difficult to identify or describe clearly
example1_en: A nameless donor left fresh flowers outside the shelter.
example1_zh: 一位未透露姓名的捐赠者在收容所外留下了鲜花。
example2_en: Many nameless workers contributed to the construction of monuments that now attract tourists worldwide.
example2_zh: 许多无名工人参与建造了如今吸引世界各地游客的纪念性建筑。
collocations: remain nameless｜不透露姓名 ; nameless fear｜莫名的恐惧 ; nameless workers｜无名工人
tip_zh: remain nameless指不透露姓名，不一定真的没名字。

meanings_zh: n. 灾难；大祸
definition_en: an event causing extremely serious damage or suffering
example1_en: The flood was a catastrophe for our small village.
example1_zh: 那场洪水给我们的小村庄带来了一场灾难。
example2_en: Investing in stronger coastal defences could prevent a natural hazard from becoming a humanitarian catastrophe.
example2_zh: 投资建设更坚固的海岸防护设施，可以防止自然灾害演变为人道主义灾难。
collocations: environmental catastrophe｜环境灾难 ; humanitarian catastrophe｜人道主义灾难 ; avert a catastrophe｜避免一场灾难
tip_zh: 比一般problem严重，常指损失惨重的灾难。

meanings_zh: n. 花环；花圈
definition_en: a ring of flowers or leaves used decoratively or ceremonially
example1_en: She hung a wreath of leaves on the door.
example1_zh: 她在门上挂了一个叶子编成的花环。
example2_en: Laying a wreath at a memorial allows communities to express shared grief and honour the past.
example2_zh: 在纪念碑前敬献花圈，让社区成员能够表达共同的哀思并缅怀过去。
collocations: lay a wreath｜敬献花圈 ; a wreath of flowers｜鲜花编成的花环 ; laurel wreath｜月桂花冠
tip_zh: w不发音；复数wreaths；动词另用wreathe。

meanings_zh: adj. 字迹清楚的；易辨认的
definition_en: Clear enough for written or printed words to be read.
example1_en: Your handwriting is much more legible with this pen.
example1_zh: 用这支笔写字，你的字迹清楚多了。
example2_en: Public information should be presented in a legible format so that older residents can access essential services independently.
example2_zh: 公共信息应以清晰易读的形式呈现，让老年居民能够独立获取基本服务。
collocations: legible handwriting｜清楚的字迹 ; clearly legible｜清晰可辨的 ; barely legible｜几乎无法辨认的
tip_zh: legible强调字形可辨；readable也可指内容易读。

meanings_zh: adj. 亲切有礼的；宽厚的 | adj. 优雅舒适的
definition_en: kind and polite, especially when treating others generously | elegant, comfortable, and associated with wealth
example1_en: Our gracious host brought extra blankets for everyone.
example1_zh: 热情周到的主人给每个人都拿来了额外的毯子。
example2_en: Public figures who remain gracious towards their critics can encourage more respectful discussion within society.
example2_zh: 公众人物若能对批评者保持宽厚有礼的态度，就能促进社会中更相互尊重的讨论。
collocations: a gracious host｜热情有礼的主人 ; gracious in defeat｜落败仍有风度 ; gracious living｜优雅舒适的生活
tip_zh: gracious重待人有礼；graceful重动作优美。

meanings_zh: n. 海员；水手
definition_en: A person who works on a ship at sea.
example1_en: The experienced seaman checked the ropes before the ship departed.
example1_zh: 这位经验丰富的水手在船出发前检查了绳索。
example2_en: Every seaman should receive practical safety training before joining a crew on an international shipping route.
example2_zh: 每位海员在加入国际航线船舶的船员队伍前，都应接受实用的安全培训。
collocations: an experienced seaman｜经验丰富的海员 ; a merchant seaman｜商船海员 ; an able seaman｜一等水手
tip_zh: 复数为seamen；seafarer是常用的性别中性称呼。

meanings_zh: adj. 艰巨的；艰苦的
definition_en: requiring considerable effort and sustained hard work
example1_en: The arduous climb left us exhausted but deeply satisfied.
example1_zh: 这段艰苦的攀登让我们筋疲力尽，却也十分满足。
example2_en: Restoring damaged ecosystems is an arduous process that requires sustained investment and cooperation between scientists and local communities.
example2_zh: 修复受损生态系统是一个艰巨的过程，需要持续投资以及科学家与当地社区的合作。
collocations: an arduous task｜艰巨的任务 ; an arduous journey｜艰苦的旅程 ; an arduous process｜艰难的过程
tip_zh: 强调长期费力，常修饰task、journey、process。

meanings_zh: adv. 明确地 | adv. 专门地；特意地
definition_en: in a clear and direct way that leaves no doubt | for a particular purpose
example1_en: I expressly asked for a room away from the lift.
example1_zh: 我明确要求安排一个远离电梯的房间。
example2_en: Public funds allocated expressly for environmental protection should not be diverted to projects that increase industrial pollution.
example2_zh: 专门用于环境保护的公共资金，不应被挪用于加剧工业污染的项目。
collocations: expressly prohibit｜明令禁止 ; expressly state｜明确说明 ; expressly for｜专门为了
tip_zh: 勿与expressively混淆，后者指富有表现力地。

meanings_zh: n. 推测；假定
definition_en: an idea accepted as true without enough evidence
example1_en: Your supposition about the missing keys turned out wrong.
example1_zh: 你对钥匙丢失原因的猜测结果是错的。
example2_en: Education policies should be based on reliable evidence rather than supposition about how children learn.
example2_zh: 教育政策应以可靠证据为基础，而不是凭借对儿童学习方式的推测。
collocations: on the supposition that｜假定…… ; mere supposition｜纯属推测 ; based on supposition｜基于推测
tip_zh: 可指一个假设，也可泛指推测；不等于已证实的事实。

meanings_zh: adj. 热的；与热量有关的 | adj. 保暖的；保温的 | n. 上升热气流
definition_en: Relating to heat | Designed to keep heat from escaping | A rising current of warm air
example1_en: Our thermal camera shows where heat escapes the house.
example1_zh: 我们的热成像相机能显示房屋哪些地方在散热。
example2_en: Improving thermal insulation in older buildings can reduce energy consumption and make homes more comfortable during winter.
example2_zh: 改善老旧建筑的隔热性能可以减少能源消耗，让住宅在冬季更加舒适。
collocations: thermal energy｜热能 ; thermal insulation｜隔热；保温 ; thermal imaging｜热成像 ; thermal underwear｜保暖内衣
tip_zh: thermal可指与热有关，也可指衣物保暖。

meanings_zh: v. 区分；辨别 | v. 使有别于
definition_en: To recognize or explain the differences between things | To make something different from other similar things
example1_en: Can you differentiate these two birds by their songs?
example1_zh: 你能根据鸣叫声分辨这两种鸟吗？
example2_en: Schools should teach students to differentiate between reliable evidence and unsupported claims in online media.
example2_zh: 学校应教学生区分网络媒体中可靠的证据和缺乏依据的说法。
collocations: differentiate between｜区分两者 ; differentiate A from B｜区分甲与乙 ; differentiate products｜使产品差异化
tip_zh: 常用differentiate between A and B。

meanings_zh: adj. 行动迟缓的；无精打采的 | adj. 发展缓慢的；不景气的
definition_en: moving or responding slowly, often from lack of energy | growing or operating more slowly than expected
example1_en: I felt sluggish after eating such a large lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭吃得太多，我感觉懒洋洋的。
example2_en: Sluggish economic growth can discourage investment and limit employment opportunities for recent university graduates.
example2_zh: 经济增长乏力会抑制投资，并限制大学应届毕业生的就业机会。
collocations: feel sluggish｜感觉无精打采 ; sluggish growth｜增长乏力 ; sluggish response｜反应迟缓
tip_zh: 既形容人没精神，也形容经济或系统运转慢。

meanings_zh: v. 刺绣；绣上图案 | v. 添油加醋地讲述
definition_en: To decorate cloth by sewing patterns with thread. | To make a story more interesting by adding invented details.
example1_en: My aunt embroidered tiny flowers around the pillow's edge.
example1_zh: 我姑姑在枕头边缘绣了一圈小花。
example2_en: Local artisans embroider traditional patterns on clothing, preserving cultural knowledge while creating products that appeal to visitors.
example2_zh: 当地工匠在衣物上绣上传统图案，在保存文化知识的同时制作吸引游客的产品。
collocations: embroider a pattern｜绣图案 ; embroider flowers on cloth｜在布上绣花 ; embroider with silk thread｜用丝线刺绣 ; embroider a story｜给故事添油加醋
tip_zh: embroider是在布上绣花，不是用毛线织物的knit。

meanings_zh: n. 剪纸作品；刻纸作品
definition_en: A decorative picture made by cutting shapes from paper
example1_en: She framed a delicate papercut of birds and flowers.
example1_zh: 她把一幅精巧的花鸟剪纸装进了画框。
example2_en: Displaying traditional papercuts in community museums can help younger generations appreciate local craft skills and cultural heritage.
example2_zh: 在社区博物馆展示传统剪纸，有助于年轻一代欣赏当地手工技艺和文化遗产。
collocations: a traditional papercut｜传统剪纸作品 ; an intricate papercut｜精细的剪纸作品 ; papercut art｜剪纸艺术
tip_zh: 剪纸艺术常用papercutting；纸划伤通常写paper cut。

meanings_zh: adj. 同质的；均匀一致的
definition_en: Consisting of parts or people that are all similar
example1_en: Stir the sauce until the mixture is completely homogeneous.
example1_zh: 搅拌酱汁，直到混合物完全均匀。
example2_en: Treating urban populations as homogeneous can lead planners to overlook important differences in residents' needs.
example2_zh: 将城市人口视为同质群体，可能导致规划者忽视居民需求的重要差异。
collocations: homogeneous mixture｜均匀混合物 ; homogeneous group｜同质群体 ; relatively homogeneous｜相对同质的
tip_zh: 强调组成部分相似或一致，反义词为heterogeneous。

meanings_zh: n. 道德；道德准则 | n. 道德性；是否合乎道德
definition_en: Beliefs and principles about what is right and wrong | The degree to which an action is right or wrong
example1_en: Our family discussed morality after finding a lost wallet.
example1_zh: 捡到一个钱包后，我们一家讨论了道德问题。
example2_en: The morality of animal testing remains controversial, particularly when potential medical benefits conflict with concerns about animal welfare.
example2_zh: 动物实验是否合乎道德仍有争议，尤其是在潜在医疗益处与动物福利考量发生冲突时。
collocations: public morality｜社会公德 ; personal morality｜个人道德观 ; the morality of an action｜某一行为的道德性
tip_zh: moral是形容词；morality是名词，常为不可数。

meanings_zh: v. 取下盖子
definition_en: To remove the cap from a container or pen.
example1_en: She uncapped the bottle and poured everyone some juice.
example1_zh: 她打开瓶盖，给大家倒了些果汁。
example2_en: Laboratory staff should uncap sample containers carefully to prevent contamination and maintain reliable research results.
example2_zh: 实验室工作人员应小心打开样本容器的盖子，以防污染并确保研究结果可靠。
collocations: uncap a bottle｜打开瓶盖 ; uncap a pen｜拔下笔帽 ; uncap a container｜取下容器盖
tip_zh: 特指取下盖子；过去式uncapped，进行式uncapping。

meanings_zh: n. 共识；普遍一致的意见
definition_en: General agreement among members of a group.
example1_en: We finally reached a consensus on where to eat.
example1_zh: 我们终于就去哪里吃饭达成了共识。
example2_en: There is a broad consensus among researchers that early childhood education can improve children's future learning outcomes.
example2_zh: 研究人员普遍认为，幼儿教育能改善儿童未来的学习成效。
collocations: reach a consensus｜达成共识 ; broad consensus｜广泛共识 ; consensus on｜关于……的共识 ; build consensus｜凝聚共识
tip_zh: 常用reach a consensus on；共识未必全票一致。

meanings_zh: n. 情妇；婚外女伴 | n. 女主人 | n. 女能手；女专家
definition_en: A woman having a relationship with someone married to another person. | A woman who owns or controls a household, in older usage. | A woman highly skilled in a particular activity.
example1_en: In the novel, he buys his mistress a necklace.
example1_zh: 在这部小说中，他给情妇买了一条项链。
example2_en: Historical novels often portray a wealthy man's mistress as financially dependent, reflecting unequal opportunities for women.
example2_zh: 历史小说常把富人的情妇描写为经济上依附他人的女性，反映出女性机会的不平等。
collocations: have a mistress｜有情妇 ; mistress of the house｜一家之女主人 ; mistress of her craft｜精通技艺的女性
tip_zh: 不可当作妻子或普通女友；女主人义较陈旧。

meanings_zh: adj. 极丑的；令人厌恶的 | adj. 骇人的；可怕的
definition_en: extremely ugly or unpleasant | extremely shocking or terrible
example1_en: That hideous carpet clashes with everything in the room.
example1_zh: 那块难看的地毯与房间里的一切都不搭。
example2_en: Poorly planned developments can create hideous buildings that damage the visual character of historic neighbourhoods.
example2_zh: 规划不当的开发项目可能造出极其难看的建筑，破坏历史街区的视觉风貌。
collocations: a hideous building｜极丑的建筑 ; a hideous mistake｜可怕的错误 ; hideous noise｜令人难受的噪声
tip_zh: 语气很强，常形容极丑的外观或可怕的事。

meanings_zh: n. 氨；氨水
definition_en: A strong-smelling gas also dissolved in water for cleaning.
example1_en: This cleaning liquid contains ammonia, so keep the window open.
example1_zh: 这种清洁液含有氨，所以要开着窗户。
example2_en: Ammonia emissions from agriculture can contribute to air pollution and damage sensitive natural habitats.
example2_zh: 农业产生的氨排放会加剧空气污染，并破坏脆弱的自然栖息地。
collocations: ammonia solution｜氨水 ; ammonia emissions｜氨排放 ; ammonia production｜氨生产
tip_zh: 不可数名词；既可指氨气，也可指氨水。

meanings_zh: n. 建造；竖立 | n. 勃起
definition_en: the act of building or putting a structure upright | a state in which the penis becomes firm and enlarged
example1_en: The erection of our garden shed took all afternoon.
example1_zh: 搭建我们的花园棚屋花了整整一个下午。
example2_en: The erection of temporary flood barriers can protect vulnerable homes while permanent defences are being constructed.
example2_zh: 在永久防洪设施施工期间，搭建临时防洪屏障可以保护易受灾的住宅。
collocations: erection of scaffolding｜脚手架搭设 ; erection of a monument｜纪念碑的竖立 ; steel erection｜钢结构安装
tip_zh: 建造义较正式，常接of；也有生理含义，须看语境。

meanings_zh: n. 忠诚；效忠
definition_en: Loyalty and support given to a country, group, or leader.
example1_en: Despite moving abroad, he kept his allegiance to his hometown club.
example1_zh: 尽管移居国外，他仍忠于家乡的俱乐部。
example2_en: Political allegiance can influence how voters interpret economic policies and assess the performance of elected officials.
example2_zh: 政治立场上的忠诚会影响选民如何解读经济政策，以及如何评价当选官员的表现。
collocations: pledge allegiance to｜宣誓效忠于 ; political allegiance｜政治上的效忠 ; switch allegiance｜转而效忠
tip_zh: 效忠对象用to引出：allegiance to a country。

meanings_zh: n. 疲劳；疲乏 | n. 材料疲劳
definition_en: extreme tiredness caused by effort, stress, or illness | weakening of a material after repeated stress
example1_en: After the long hike, fatigue made my legs shake.
example1_zh: 长途徒步后，我累得双腿发抖。
example2_en: Persistent fatigue can reduce employees' concentration and increase the likelihood of accidents in the workplace.
example2_zh: 持续疲劳会降低员工的注意力，并增加工作场所发生事故的可能性。
collocations: chronic fatigue｜慢性疲劳 ; mental fatigue｜精神疲劳 ; muscle fatigue｜肌肉疲劳 ; metal fatigue｜金属疲劳
tip_zh: 通常为不可数名词，比tiredness更正式。

meanings_zh: adj. 稀奇古怪的；荒诞的
definition_en: extremely unusual or strange, often seeming unreasonable
example1_en: He arrived wearing an outlandish hat shaped like a pineapple.
example1_zh: 他戴着一顶形似菠萝的古怪帽子来了。
example2_en: Although some environmental proposals initially seem outlandish, they may eventually inspire practical solutions to urban pollution.
example2_zh: 虽然一些环保提议起初看似荒诞，却可能最终为解决城市污染提供切实可行的思路。
collocations: an outlandish idea｜荒诞的想法 ; outlandish clothes｜奇装异服 ; an outlandish claim｜离谱的说法
tip_zh: 强调异乎寻常，常带惊讶或不赞同的语气。

meanings_zh: adj. 解释性的；说明的
definition_en: Giving information that makes something easier to understand.
example1_en: The recipe includes explanatory pictures for each tricky step.
example1_zh: 这份食谱为每个难操作的步骤都配上了说明图片。
example2_en: Public health campaigns should provide explanatory materials that help people understand both the benefits and limitations of medical screening.
example2_zh: 公共卫生宣传应提供说明材料，帮助人们了解医学筛查的益处和局限。
collocations: explanatory notes｜说明性注释 ; explanatory material｜说明材料 ; explanatory power｜解释力
tip_zh: 常修饰notes、material；self-explanatory指不言自明的。

meanings_zh: v. 开始；着手
definition_en: to begin something or start happening
example1_en: The evening concert will commence after a short welcome.
example1_zh: 简短的欢迎致辞后，晚间音乐会将开始。
example2_en: Construction of the new railway will commence once the environmental assessment has been completed.
example2_zh: 环境评估完成后，新铁路的建设将启动。
collocations: commence work｜开始工作 ; commence proceedings｜开始诉讼程序 ; commence with｜以……开始
tip_zh: 比start正式；可接名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: n. 空洞的辞藻；花言巧语 | n. 修辞；修辞学
definition_en: Impressive language that may lack sincerity or practical substance. | The skill or study of using language to persuade.
example1_en: We need real help, not more rhetoric about teamwork.
example1_zh: 我们需要实际帮助，而不是更多关于团队合作的空话。
example2_en: Governments must move beyond environmental rhetoric and introduce measurable policies to reduce industrial pollution.
example2_zh: 政府必须超越环保空谈，推出成效可衡量的政策来减少工业污染。
collocations: empty rhetoric｜空洞的言辞 ; political rhetoric｜政治辞令 ; the art of rhetoric｜修辞艺术
tip_zh: 是名词；形容词为rhetorical，可含贬义。

meanings_zh: n. 借口；托辞
definition_en: A stated reason that hides someone's real purpose.
example1_en: He used a headache as a pretext to leave.
example1_zh: 他以头痛为借口离开了。
example2_en: Companies should not use economic uncertainty as a pretext for abandoning their environmental commitments.
example2_zh: 企业不应以经济不确定性为借口，放弃其环保承诺。
collocations: under the pretext of｜以……为借口 ; a pretext for doing something｜做某事的借口 ; on some pretext｜以某种借口
tip_zh: 强调掩盖真实目的的借口；常接for或of。

meanings_zh: v. 猛扑；突然袭击 | v. 立即抓住机会或错误 | n. 猛扑；突袭
definition_en: To jump suddenly towards something to catch or attack it. | To seize an opportunity or criticise a mistake immediately. | A sudden jump towards something to catch or attack it.
example1_en: Our kitten pounced on a leaf blowing across the garden.
example1_zh: 我们的小猫猛扑向一片被风吹过花园的叶子。
example2_en: News outlets often pounce on minor errors, distracting audiences from more important policy debates.
example2_zh: 新闻媒体常常抓住小错误不放，使受众忽略更重要的政策讨论。
collocations: pounce on prey｜猛扑向猎物 ; pounce on an opportunity｜立即抓住机会 ; pounce on a mistake｜揪住错误不放
tip_zh: 常接on，既可指猛扑，也可指抓住机会或错误。

meanings_zh: adj. 开创性的；先驱性的
definition_en: Introducing important new ideas or methods before others.
example1_en: Her pioneering design lets wheelchair users reach every shelf.
example1_zh: 她的开创性设计让轮椅使用者能够够到每一层架子。
example2_en: Pioneering research into energy storage could make renewable electricity more reliable and reduce dependence on fossil fuels.
example2_zh: 储能领域的开创性研究可能提高可再生电力的可靠性，并减少对化石燃料的依赖。
collocations: pioneering research｜开创性研究 ; pioneering work｜开创性工作 ; pioneering approach｜创新方法
tip_zh: 通常作形容词；指先驱人物用名词pioneer。

meanings_zh: n. 重大任务；事业 | n. 正式承诺；保证
definition_en: A task or project, especially one requiring considerable effort. | A formal promise to do something.
example1_en: Renovating this old house is a much bigger undertaking.
example1_zh: 翻修这栋老房子是一项艰巨得多的任务。
example2_en: Building a nationwide railway network is a major undertaking that requires sustained investment and careful planning.
example2_zh: 建设全国性铁路网是一项重大工程，需要持续投资和周密规划。
collocations: a major undertaking｜重大任务 ; a joint undertaking｜共同承担的项目 ; give an undertaking｜作出正式承诺
tip_zh: 作“承诺”时常用give an undertaking to do。

meanings_zh: v. 抵消；使失效 | v. 使中和
definition_en: to stop something from having an effect | to make an acid or alkali chemically neutral
example1_en: This spray helps neutralize unpleasant smells in the kitchen.
example1_zh: 这种喷雾有助于消除厨房里的异味。
example2_en: Farmers sometimes add lime to acidic soil to neutralize excess acidity and improve conditions for crop growth.
example2_zh: 农民有时会向酸性土壤中施加石灰，中和过多的酸性，改善作物生长条件。
collocations: neutralize an acid｜中和酸 ; neutralize a threat｜消除威胁 ; neutralize the effects｜抵消影响 ; neutralize odours｜消除异味
tip_zh: 英式也拼neutralise；强调抵消作用，不一定移除物体。

meanings_zh: n. 抱负；志向 | n. 送气
definition_en: A strong hope or ambition to achieve something. | A breath of air released when pronouncing certain speech sounds.
example1_en: Her greatest aspiration is to open a small bakery.
example1_zh: 她最大的愿望是开一家小面包店。
example2_en: Access to affordable higher education can help young people fulfil their aspirations, regardless of their family income.
example2_zh: 无论家庭收入如何，获得负担得起的高等教育都能帮助年轻人实现抱负。
collocations: career aspirations｜职业抱负 ; fulfil an aspiration｜实现抱负 ; aspiration to succeed｜成功的志向
tip_zh: 抱负义常用复数；aspiration to do表示做某事的志向。

meanings_zh: n. 概念；理解；构想 | n. 受孕 | n. 构思；创始
definition_en: an idea or understanding of what something is like | the process in which an egg is fertilised, beginning pregnancy | the formation of a plan or idea
example1_en: His conception of a perfect holiday involves no phones.
example1_zh: 在他看来，完美的假期是不碰手机的假期。
example2_en: Access to green spaces can broaden children's conception of nature beyond what they learn in classrooms.
example2_zh: 接触绿地能拓宽儿童对自然的认识，使其不局限于课堂所学。
collocations: conception of｜对……的理解 ; from conception to completion｜从构思到完成 ; a broad conception｜宽泛的理解 ; the moment of conception｜受孕时刻
tip_zh: conception of指对事物的理解；也可表示受孕。

meanings_zh: adv. 认真负责地；尽职地
definition_en: With care and a strong sense of responsibility.
example1_en: The nurse conscientiously checked every item in the kit.
example1_zh: 护士认真负责地检查了工具包里的每件物品。
example2_en: Teachers who conscientiously review individual progress can identify learning difficulties before students fall significantly behind.
example2_zh: 认真评估每个学生进步情况的教师，能够在学生明显落后之前发现学习困难。
collocations: work conscientiously｜尽职尽责地工作 ; conscientiously carry out duties｜认真履行职责
tip_zh: 强调责任心与认真态度，不只是动作小心。

meanings_zh: n. 派别；派系
definition_en: A subgroup whose views conflict with others in a larger group.
example1_en: One faction of our club wants a new leader.
example1_zh: 我们俱乐部中的一个派别想换一位新负责人。
example2_en: A powerful faction within the ruling party opposed the proposed reforms to the national education system.
example2_zh: 执政党内一个强大的派系反对拟议中的国家教育体制改革。
collocations: rival factions｜对立派系 ; political faction｜政治派别 ; a faction within the party｜党内派系
tip_zh: 常指大组织内意见对立的小集团，尤用于政治。

meanings_zh: adj. 原住民的；土著的 | adj. 澳大利亚原住民的
definition_en: Relating to the earliest known inhabitants of a region | Relating to Australia's Aboriginal peoples, cultures, or languages
example1_en: The exhibition celebrates aboriginal cultures from several different regions.
example1_zh: 这个展览展示并赞颂了几个不同地区的原住民文化。
example2_en: Protecting aboriginal languages requires sustained funding and close cooperation with the communities that speak them.
example2_zh: 保护原住民语言需要持续的资金支持，并与使用这些语言的社区密切合作。
collocations: aboriginal peoples｜原住民族 ; Aboriginal culture｜澳大利亚原住民文化 ; Aboriginal communities｜澳大利亚原住民社区
tip_zh: 指澳大利亚原住民时首字母大写；避免单独作名词称人。

meanings_zh: v. 抵消；补偿
definition_en: to balance or reduce the effect of something
example1_en: My shorter commute offsets the higher rent here.
example1_zh: 通勤时间缩短弥补了这里租金较高的不足。
example2_en: Planting trees can offset some carbon emissions, but reducing fossil fuel consumption remains essential.
example2_zh: 植树可以抵消一部分碳排放，但减少化石燃料消耗仍然至关重要。
collocations: offset the cost｜抵消成本 ; offset carbon emissions｜抵消碳排放 ; offset the impact｜抵消影响
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词仍为offset；现在分词为offsetting。

meanings_zh: adj. 可耕的；种植作物的
definition_en: Suitable for or used for growing crops.
example1_en: The family grows potatoes on a small arable field.
example1_zh: 这家人在一小块耕地上种土豆。
example2_en: Rapid urban expansion is reducing the amount of arable land available for food production in many regions.
example2_zh: 在许多地区，城市的快速扩张正在减少可用于粮食生产的耕地面积。
collocations: arable land｜耕地 ; arable farming｜种植业 ; arable crops｜大田作物
tip_zh: 常修饰land；强调可种作物，不指单纯放牧用地。

meanings_zh: n. 停战；休战协议
definition_en: An agreement to stop fighting or arguing for a time
example1_en: After arguing all morning, the neighbours called a truce.
example1_zh: 争吵了一上午后，邻居们暂时休战了。
example2_en: A temporary truce can allow aid workers to deliver essential supplies to communities affected by conflict.
example2_zh: 临时停战可以让援助人员向受冲突影响的社区运送必需物资。
collocations: call a truce｜宣布休战 ; agree to a truce｜同意停战 ; a temporary truce｜临时停战 ; break a truce｜破坏休战协议
tip_zh: 通常指暂时停止冲突，不等于永久和平。

meanings_zh: adj. 兴高采烈的；热情洋溢的 | adj. 繁茂的；丰富华丽的
definition_en: full of energy, excitement, and happiness | growing abundantly or richly decorated and imaginative
example1_en: The exuberant puppy bounced around the garden all morning.
example1_zh: 那只活力十足的小狗整个上午都在花园里蹦来蹦去。
example2_en: Exuberant celebrations at international sporting events can create a powerful sense of shared identity among spectators.
example2_zh: 国际体育赛事中热情洋溢的庆祝活动能让观众产生强烈的共同认同感。
collocations: exuberant enthusiasm｜高涨的热情 ; an exuberant personality｜热情奔放的性格 ; exuberant growth｜繁茂的生长
tip_zh: 核心是活力或丰富程度高，不等于“华而不实”。

meanings_zh: n. 氧化物
definition_en: A compound consisting of oxygen and another chemical element.
example1_en: This sunscreen contains zinc oxide to protect your skin.
example1_zh: 这款防晒霜含有氧化锌，可以保护皮肤。
example2_en: Nitrogen oxides released by vehicle engines contribute to air pollution and can damage human health.
example2_zh: 汽车发动机排放的氮氧化物会造成空气污染，并可能损害人体健康。
collocations: zinc oxide｜氧化锌 ; iron oxide｜氧化铁 ; nitrogen oxides｜氮氧化物
tip_zh: oxide为氧化物统称，dioxide指二氧化物。

meanings_zh: v. 题写；刻写
definition_en: write or carve words on an object, often permanently
example1_en: The jeweller inscribed our initials inside the silver ring.
example1_zh: 珠宝匠把我们姓名的首字母刻在了银戒指内侧。
example2_en: Communities often inscribe memorial stones with personal stories to preserve local history for future generations.
example2_zh: 社区常在纪念石上刻下个人故事，为后代保存地方历史。
collocations: inscribe a name on｜把名字刻在……上 ; be inscribed with｜刻有；题有 ; inscribe a dedication｜题写献词
tip_zh: 常用inscribe A on B或inscribe B with A，非普通记笔记。

meanings_zh: n. 不利条件；障碍 | v. 妨碍；使处于不利地位 | n. 让分；差点
definition_en: A disadvantage that makes success or progress more difficult. | To make it harder for someone to succeed. | A scoring adjustment allowing players of different abilities to compete fairly.
example1_en: Without a car, the distance became a real handicap.
example1_zh: 没有车，这段距离成了实实在在的障碍。
example2_en: Limited access to reliable internet can be a serious handicap for students in remote communities.
example2_zh: 对于偏远社区的学生来说，难以获得可靠的网络连接可能是一个严重的不利条件。
collocations: a serious handicap｜严重的不利条件 ; a golf handicap｜高尔夫差点 ; be handicapped by｜受……妨碍
tip_zh: 指残疾或残疾人士时已过时，宜用disability。

meanings_zh: n. 概括；笼统论断 | n. 概括过程；归纳
definition_en: A broad statement based on particular cases, sometimes without enough evidence. | The process of forming general conclusions from particular examples.
example1_en: Calling all teenagers lazy is an unfair generalization.
example1_zh: 说所有青少年都懒惰，是一种不公平的笼统论断。
example2_en: Researchers should avoid making a generalization about an entire population from a small, unrepresentative sample.
example2_zh: 研究人员应避免根据规模小且缺乏代表性的样本，对整个群体作出概括。
collocations: make a generalization｜作出概括 ; sweeping generalization｜过于笼统的论断 ; broad generalization｜宽泛的概括 ; hasty generalization｜草率的概括
tip_zh: 英式也写 generalisation；概括未必可靠。

meanings_zh: v. 移植器官；移栽 | n. 移植手术；移植器官
definition_en: To move an organ or plant into a new location. | An operation transferring an organ, or the organ transferred.
example1_en: We transplant the seedlings once their roots are strong.
example1_zh: 等幼苗的根长壮了，我们就进行移栽。
example2_en: Advances in medicine have made it possible to transplant organs successfully and improve patients' quality of life.
example2_zh: 医学进步使成功移植器官成为可能，并改善了患者的生活质量。
collocations: transplant seedlings｜移栽幼苗 ; a kidney transplant｜肾移植 ; an organ transplant｜器官移植 ; transplant surgery｜移植手术
tip_zh: 动词重音在后，名词重音在前；既可指器官也可指植物。

meanings_zh: v. 维护；捍卫 | v. 维持原判；确认有效
definition_en: To support and maintain a principle, right, or standard | To confirm that an earlier decision remains valid
example1_en: Our coach always tries to uphold fair play.
example1_zh: 我们的教练总是努力维护公平竞赛的原则。
example2_en: Independent courts help uphold citizens' rights by ensuring that public authorities act within the law.
example2_zh: 独立的法院通过确保公共机构依法行事，帮助维护公民权利。
collocations: uphold the law｜维护法律 ; uphold human rights｜维护人权 ; uphold a decision｜维持决定 ; uphold standards｜维护标准
tip_zh: 过去式、过去分词均为upheld；常接权利或裁决。

meanings_zh: n. 到期；期满
definition_en: the end of the period when something remains valid
example1_en: Check the expiration date before you buy the yoghurt.
example1_zh: 买酸奶前检查一下到期日期。
example2_en: The expiration of temporary work permits can create uncertainty for both employees and local businesses.
example2_zh: 临时工作许可到期会给雇员和当地企业带来不确定性。
collocations: expiration date｜到期日期 ; expiration of a contract｜合同期满 ; before expiration｜到期之前
tip_zh: 表示到期时，美式常用expiration，英式常用expiry。

meanings_zh: n. 遵从；从众
definition_en: Behaviour that follows accepted rules, standards, or group expectations.
example1_en: Our art teacher encourages creativity rather than strict conformity.
example1_zh: 我们的美术老师鼓励创造，而不是一味墨守成规。
example2_en: Strong pressure for conformity in schools may discourage students from questioning established ideas and developing independent judgement.
example2_zh: 学校里强烈的从众压力可能阻碍学生质疑既有观念和培养独立判断力。
collocations: social conformity｜社会从众 ; conformity to standards｜遵守标准 ; in conformity with｜符合；遵照 ; pressure for conformity｜要求一致的压力
tip_zh: in conformity with表示符合或遵照某规则。

meanings_zh: n. 例行手续；必要程序 | n. 正式；拘谨
definition_en: A required procedure, often unlikely to change the outcome. | The quality of following official rules or social conventions.
example1_en: Signing this final document is just a formality.
example1_zh: 签署这份最后的文件只是走个手续。
example2_en: Excessive formality in classroom discussions may discourage students from expressing their opinions openly and confidently.
example2_zh: 课堂讨论中过于拘谨，可能会让学生不愿坦率、自信地表达观点。
collocations: a mere formality｜纯粹的例行手续 ; complete the formalities｜办完手续 ; legal formalities｜法律手续
tip_zh: 手续常用复数formalities；正式、拘谨为不可数义。

meanings_zh: adj. 冗长乏味的；单调的
definition_en: boring because it continues too long or involves repeated actions
example1_en: Sorting all these old receipts is a tedious job.
example1_zh: 整理这些旧收据是一件单调乏味的差事。
example2_en: Automation can free employees from tedious tasks, allowing them to focus on more creative and rewarding work.
example2_zh: 自动化可以让员工摆脱单调的任务，专注于更有创意和成就感的工作。
collocations: tedious task｜乏味的任务 ; tedious process｜冗长乏味的过程 ; tedious paperwork｜繁琐的文书工作
tip_zh: 常形容因耗时长或反复重复而乏味的任务。

meanings_zh: n. 支出；开支
definition_en: Money spent on a particular purpose, especially when starting something.
example1_en: Our initial outlay included tools and a sturdy workbench.
example1_zh: 我们的初期开支包括工具和一张结实的工作台。
example2_en: Although solar panels require a substantial initial outlay, they can reduce household energy costs over time.
example2_zh: 虽然安装太阳能板需要一笔可观的前期支出，但长远来看能降低家庭能源费用。
collocations: initial outlay｜初期支出 ; capital outlay｜资本支出 ; a substantial outlay｜大笔开支
tip_zh: 常指启动项目时的开支，常搭配initial或capital。

meanings_zh: adj. 有棱角的；尖角的 | adj. 瘦削的；骨感的
definition_en: Having sharp corners or clearly defined angles. | Thin, with bones and joints that appear prominent.
example1_en: The angular table looked striking beside our curved sofa.
example1_zh: 那张棱角分明的桌子放在我们的弧形沙发旁格外醒目。
example2_en: The museum's angular design contrasts sharply with the rounded forms commonly found in the surrounding landscape.
example2_zh: 这座博物馆棱角分明的设计与周围景观中常见的圆润形态形成鲜明对比。
collocations: angular shape｜有棱角的形状 ; angular features｜棱角分明的五官 ; angular design｜棱角分明的设计
tip_zh: 形容外形棱角分明，也可形容人瘦削。

meanings_zh: v. 补充存货；重新进货
definition_en: To replace goods that have been sold or used.
example1_en: We need to restock the fridge before our guests arrive.
example1_zh: 客人到来之前，我们得给冰箱补些食物。
example2_en: Retailers increasingly use digital systems to predict demand and restock shelves before products sell out.
example2_zh: 零售商越来越多地使用数字系统预测需求，并在商品售罄前补充货架库存。
collocations: restock shelves｜补充货架商品 ; restock the fridge｜补充冰箱食品 ; restock with fresh supplies｜补充新物资
tip_zh: 常用restock A with B，表示用B补充A的存货。

meanings_zh: n. 长期不和；世仇 | v. 长期争斗；结怨
definition_en: A bitter disagreement continuing for a long time. | To remain in a bitter, continuing conflict with someone.
example1_en: The neighbours ended their feud over the garden fence.
example1_zh: 邻居们结束了围绕花园围栏的长期争执。
example2_en: A long-running feud between community leaders can prevent cooperation on projects that would benefit local residents.
example2_zh: 社区领导人之间的长期不和可能阻碍那些有益于当地居民的项目合作。
collocations: family feud｜家族纷争 ; long-running feud｜长期争端 ; feud with someone｜与某人长期不和
tip_zh: 强调持续很久的敌对或争执，而非一次口角。

meanings_zh: n. 魔法药水；药剂
definition_en: A drink believed to have magical or medicinal effects.
example1_en: In the story, a potion turns the prince invisible.
example1_zh: 故事里，一种魔法药水让王子隐了身。
example2_en: The magical potion remains a familiar device in children's literature, allowing authors to explore transformation and identity.
example2_zh: 魔法药水仍是儿童文学中常见的叙事手段，让作者能够探讨变化与身份认同。
collocations: a magic potion｜魔法药水 ; a healing potion｜治疗药水 ; brew a potion｜熬制药水
tip_zh: 常见于奇幻故事；普通药物的一剂用dose。

meanings_zh: v. 评估；评价 | v. 估价
definition_en: to judge the quality, condition, or performance of something | to estimate how much money something is worth
example1_en: The coach appraised my technique and suggested some changes.
example1_zh: 教练评估了我的动作技巧，并提出了一些改进建议。
example2_en: Local authorities must appraise the environmental impact of major construction projects before granting planning permission.
example2_zh: 地方政府在批准规划许可之前，必须评估大型建设项目对环境的影响。
collocations: appraise performance｜评估表现 ; appraise a property｜评估房产价值 ; critically appraise｜批判性评估
tip_zh: appraise是评估；不要与apprise（告知）混淆。

meanings_zh: n. 关税 | n. 收费标准；价目表
definition_en: a tax charged on goods entering or leaving a country | a set of charges for a service
example1_en: The new tariff made imported cheese much more expensive.
example1_zh: 新关税使进口奶酪贵了很多。
example2_en: Although tariffs may protect domestic manufacturers, they can also raise consumer prices and provoke trade disputes.
example2_zh: 关税虽然可能保护国内制造商，但也可能推高消费价格并引发贸易争端。
collocations: impose tariffs on｜对……征收关税 ; import tariff｜进口关税 ; reduce tariffs｜降低关税 ; electricity tariff｜电价标准
tip_zh: 关税用tariff on goods；复数tariffs常指多项关税。

meanings_zh: adj. 讥讽的；挖苦的
definition_en: using mocking words, often meaning the opposite, to criticize
example1_en: His sarcastic comment about my cooking hurt my feelings.
example1_zh: 他挖苦我厨艺的话让我很难过。
example2_en: Sarcastic remarks in online discussions can discourage participation and make constructive debate more difficult.
example2_zh: 网络讨论中的讥讽言论可能降低参与意愿，使建设性的辩论更难开展。
collocations: a sarcastic remark｜挖苦的话 ; a sarcastic tone｜讥讽的语气 ; a sarcastic comment｜讥讽的评论
tip_zh: 常用反话挖苦人；ironic不一定含攻击或嘲弄。

meanings_zh: adj. 毁灭性的；破坏极大的 | adj. 令人极度悲痛的
definition_en: Causing extremely serious damage or destruction. | Causing overwhelming sadness or emotional shock.
example1_en: A devastating storm tore the roof off our garage.
example1_zh: 一场破坏力极强的暴风雨掀掉了我们车库的屋顶。
example2_en: Prolonged drought can have devastating effects on agriculture, threatening food supplies and the livelihoods of rural communities.
example2_zh: 长期干旱会对农业造成毁灭性影响，威胁粮食供应和农村社区的生计。
collocations: devastating consequences｜灾难性后果 ; devastating impact｜毁灭性影响 ; devastating news｜令人悲痛欲绝的消息 ; devastating earthquake｜破坏力极强的地震
tip_zh: 事物令人悲痛用devastating；人感到悲痛用devastated。

meanings_zh: adj. 同时发生的；同步的
definition_en: happening or existing at exactly the same time
example1_en: Simultaneous cheers erupted from both sides of the street.
example1_zh: 街道两边同时爆发出欢呼声。
example2_en: Simultaneous investment in public transport and cycling infrastructure can reduce congestion more effectively than isolated measures.
example2_zh: 同时投资公共交通和自行车基础设施，比采取单一措施更能有效缓解交通拥堵。
collocations: simultaneous events｜同时发生的事件 ; simultaneous interpretation｜同声传译 ; simultaneous access｜同时访问
tip_zh: 强调时间重合；副词simultaneously表示同时地。

meanings_zh: adj. 荒凉的；无人居住的 | adj. 孤独凄凉的
definition_en: Empty of people and lacking signs of life | Feeling completely alone and deeply unhappy
example1_en: We crossed a desolate valley before reaching the village.
example1_zh: 我们穿过一片荒凉的山谷，才到达村庄。
example2_en: Former industrial sites often remain desolate until public investment brings new housing and green spaces.
example2_zh: 昔日的工业用地往往一直荒凉，直到公共投资带来新住房和绿地。
collocations: a desolate landscape｜荒凉的景观 ; a desolate village｜荒无人烟的村庄 ; feel desolate｜感到孤独凄凉
tip_zh: 形容地方指荒凉，形容人则指孤独凄凉。

meanings_zh: n. 啮齿类动物
definition_en: a mammal with strong front teeth that grow continuously
example1_en: A small rodent was nibbling seeds beside the shed.
example1_zh: 一只小啮齿动物正在棚屋旁啃食种子。
example2_en: Improved food storage can reduce rodent populations without introducing harmful chemicals into the local environment.
example2_zh: 改善食物储存方式可以减少啮齿动物数量，而不必向当地环境中引入有害化学物质。
collocations: rodent population｜啮齿动物种群 ; rodent control｜啮齿动物防治 ; rodent infestation｜鼠患
tip_zh: 老鼠、松鼠和河狸都属啮齿动物。

meanings_zh: n. 正常化；恢复正常 | n. 标准化；归一化
definition_en: The process of making conditions normal or usual. | Adjusting data or values to a common standard.
example1_en: The normalization of bus services made commuting easier again.
example1_zh: 公交服务恢复正常后，通勤又方便起来了。
example2_en: The normalization of diplomatic relations can encourage trade and strengthen cooperation on shared environmental challenges.
example2_zh: 外交关系正常化能够促进贸易，并加强应对共同环境挑战的合作。
collocations: normalization of relations｜关系正常化 ; data normalization｜数据归一化 ; normalization process｜正常化进程
tip_zh: 英式也拼normalisation；数据语境常指归一化。

meanings_zh: n. 领事馆
definition_en: an office representing a country and helping its citizens abroad
example1_en: She contacted the consulate after losing her passport abroad.
example1_zh: 她在国外丢失护照后联系了领事馆。
example2_en: A consulate can provide essential assistance to citizens who encounter legal or administrative difficulties while travelling abroad.
example2_zh: 公民在国外旅行期间遇到法律或行政方面的困难时，领事馆可以提供必要的协助。
collocations: contact the consulate｜联系领事馆 ; consulate general｜总领事馆 ; nearest consulate｜最近的领事馆
tip_zh: consulate是领事馆；embassy是大使馆，职能不同。

meanings_zh: adv. 徒劳地；白费力气地
definition_en: Without achieving the desired result despite effort
example1_en: I searched vainly for my keys under the sofa.
example1_zh: 我在沙发下面找钥匙，却一无所获。
example2_en: Residents have vainly requested better bus services for years, leaving many dependent on private cars.
example2_zh: 居民多年来要求改善公交服务，却始终未果，致使许多人仍然依赖私家车。
collocations: try vainly to do something｜徒劳地试图做某事 ; search vainly for｜徒劳地寻找 ; struggle vainly｜徒劳地挣扎
tip_zh: vainly侧重努力无果，常可换成in vain。

meanings_zh: v. 截肢；切除肢体
definition_en: To surgically remove all or part of a limb.
example1_en: The vet had to amputate the cat's badly injured leg.
example1_zh: 兽医不得不截去这只猫受伤严重的腿。
example2_en: Early treatment of severe infections can reduce the need to amputate limbs and improve patients' quality of life.
example2_zh: 及早治疗严重感染能够减少截肢的必要性，并改善患者的生活质量。
collocations: amputate a limb｜截肢 ; amputate a leg｜截去一条腿 ; amputate below the knee｜进行膝下截肢
tip_zh: 主要用于手术切除肢体，不能泛指切除所有器官。

meanings_zh: adj. 可行的；行得通的
definition_en: possible and practical to achieve with available resources
example1_en: Cycling to work is feasible now that I live nearby.
example1_zh: 现在我住得近，骑车上班行得通了。
example2_en: Solar power becomes more economically feasible when installation costs fall and reliable energy storage is available.
example2_zh: 当安装成本下降且可靠的储能设施可用时，太阳能在经济上就更可行。
collocations: a feasible solution｜可行的解决办法 ; economically feasible｜经济上可行的 ; technically feasible｜技术上可行的 ; a feasible alternative｜可行的替代方案
tip_zh: 指条件允许、实际可行，不等于“可信”。

meanings_zh: n. 钻井设备；钻井平台 | v. 操纵；作弊 | v. 装配；安装
definition_en: a large structure or machine used for drilling | to dishonestly arrange a process to obtain a desired result | to fit equipment into place for use
example1_en: We could see an oil rig from the beach.
example1_zh: 我们从海滩上能看到一座石油钻井平台。
example2_en: Independent observers can help prevent powerful groups from attempting to rig elections in their favour.
example2_zh: 独立观察员有助于防止强势团体试图操纵选举，使结果对自己有利。
collocations: an oil rig｜石油钻井平台 ; a drilling rig｜钻井设备 ; rig an election｜操纵选举 ; rig up equipment｜临时搭建设备
tip_zh: rig作动词既可指装配，也可指作弊操纵；注意语境。

meanings_zh: n. 侵蚀；风化剥蚀 | n. 逐渐削弱；损耗
definition_en: The gradual removal of soil or rock by natural forces. | The gradual loss of strength, value, or confidence.
example1_en: Heavy rain caused erosion along the muddy river bank.
example1_zh: 大雨使泥泞的河岸遭到了侵蚀。
example2_en: Planting trees can reduce soil erosion because their roots help hold the ground together during heavy rainfall.
example2_zh: 植树可以减少水土流失，因为树根有助于在强降雨时固住土壤。
collocations: soil erosion｜土壤侵蚀 ; coastal erosion｜海岸侵蚀 ; prevent erosion｜防止侵蚀 ; erosion of trust｜信任的逐渐削弱
tip_zh: 通常不可数；也可比喻信任、权利等逐渐受损。

meanings_zh: adj. 轻蔑的；鄙视的
definition_en: showing that you think someone or something deserves no respect
example1_en: He gave my handmade kite a scornful look.
example1_zh: 他轻蔑地看了一眼我手工制作的风筝。
example2_en: Scornful responses from teachers can discourage students from asking questions and reduce their confidence in class.
example2_zh: 教师轻蔑的回应可能使学生不敢提问，并削弱他们在课堂上的自信。
