tip_zh: 通常为不可数名词，强调缺少变化带来的乏味。

meanings_zh: n. 螺旋桨
definition_en: a rotating device with blades that drives boats or aircraft
example1_en: The boat's propeller churned the water into white foam.
example1_zh: 船的螺旋桨把水搅成了白色泡沫。
example2_en: Engineers are developing quieter propeller designs to reduce the impact of shipping noise on marine wildlife.
example2_zh: 工程师正在开发更安静的螺旋桨设计，以减少航运噪声对海洋野生动物的影响。
collocations: aircraft propeller｜飞机螺旋桨 ; ship's propeller｜船用螺旋桨 ; propeller blade｜螺旋桨叶片
tip_zh: propel是推进；propeller是提供推力的螺旋桨。

meanings_zh: n. 马力（功率单位）
definition_en: A unit used to measure the power of an engine.
example1_en: This tractor has enough horsepower to pull the heavy trailer.
example1_zh: 这辆拖拉机的马力足以拉动那辆沉重的拖车。
example2_en: Although greater horsepower can improve vehicle performance, fuel efficiency remains a major consideration for many consumers.
example2_zh: 虽然更大的马力可以提升车辆性能，但燃油效率仍是许多消费者的重要考量。
collocations: engine horsepower｜发动机马力 ; brake horsepower｜制动马力 ; high horsepower｜大马力
tip_zh: 数量后horsepower不加s；它衡量功率而非速度。

meanings_zh: n. 差异；不一致 | n. 方差
definition_en: A difference or disagreement between things. | A statistical measure of how widely values differ from their mean.
example1_en: His cheerful smile was at variance with his complaints.
example1_zh: 他愉快的笑容与他的抱怨很不相称。
example2_en: The proposed housing policy is at variance with the government's commitment to protecting green spaces.
example2_zh: 拟议的住房政策与政府保护绿地的承诺相矛盾。
collocations: at variance with｜与……不一致 ; variance between groups｜组间差异 ; population variance｜总体方差
tip_zh: at variance with 表示不一致；统计学中指方差。

meanings_zh: n. 民兵组织
definition_en: A military group whose members are not full-time professional soldiers.
example1_en: The museum displayed uniforms once worn by the local militia.
example1_zh: 博物馆展出了当地民兵曾经穿过的制服。
example2_en: Historical records show that the militia consisted mainly of farmers who trained alongside their regular work.
example2_zh: 历史记录显示，这支民兵主要由农民组成，他们在日常劳作之余参加训练。
collocations: a local militia｜地方民兵组织 ; form a militia｜组建民兵组织 ; militia members｜民兵成员
tip_zh: 指组织；单个成员用a militia member。

meanings_zh: n. 忠告；建议 | v. 提供咨询；劝告 | n. 律师；法律顾问
definition_en: advice, especially from someone experienced or knowledgeable | to give someone advice or professional support | a lawyer or lawyers representing someone in a legal case
example1_en: I sought my aunt's counsel before accepting the job.
example1_zh: 接受这份工作前，我征求了姑姑的意见。
example2_en: Schools should employ trained professionals to counsel students who experience anxiety about examinations or future careers.
example2_zh: 学校应聘用受过培训的专业人士，为因考试或未来职业而焦虑的学生提供咨询。
collocations: seek counsel｜征求意见 ; legal counsel｜法律顾问 ; counsel someone against something｜劝某人不要做某事 ; wise counsel｜明智的忠告
tip_zh: counsel指忠告或律师；council指委员会。

meanings_zh: n. 丰富；充裕；大量
definition_en: a very large quantity of something
example1_en: Our garden produces an abundance of tomatoes every summer.
example1_zh: 我们的花园每年夏天都结出大量番茄。
example2_en: An abundance of natural resources does not necessarily guarantee sustainable economic growth or improved living standards.
example2_zh: 丰富的自然资源并不一定能保证可持续的经济增长或生活水平的提高。
collocations: an abundance of｜大量的 ; in abundance｜大量；充裕地 ; an abundance of wildlife｜丰富的野生动物
tip_zh: 常用an abundance of＋名词，或in abundance。

meanings_zh: n. 竖井；升降机井 | n. 杆；轴；柄 | n. 一束光
definition_en: A vertical passage through a building or into the ground. | A long narrow part of a tool or machine. | A narrow beam of light.
example1_en: The lift stopped halfway up the narrow shaft.
example1_zh: 电梯在狭窄井道的中途停了下来。
example2_en: Engineers installed a ventilation shaft to improve air quality throughout the underground transport station.
example2_zh: 工程师安装了通风井，以改善整个地下交通站点的空气质量。
collocations: lift shaft｜电梯井 ; ventilation shaft｜通风井 ; drive shaft｜传动轴 ; a shaft of sunlight｜一束阳光
tip_zh: 井道用shaft；英式lift shaft对应美式elevator shaft。

meanings_zh: adv. 相应地 | adv. 因此；于是
definition_en: in a way that suits the particular situation | as a result of something
example1_en: The forecast predicted rain, so we dressed accordingly.
example1_zh: 天气预报说有雨，所以我们相应地穿好了衣服。
example2_en: Schools should identify individual learning needs and adjust their teaching methods accordingly to support every student.
example2_zh: 学校应识别每个学生的学习需求，并相应调整教学方法，以支持所有学生。
collocations: adjust accordingly｜相应调整 ; act accordingly｜据此行事 ; plan accordingly｜据此规划
tip_zh: 表“相应地”常放句末；表“因此”较正式。

meanings_zh: n. 步行商业区（英） | n. 警区；选区（美） | n. 建筑物周围的区域
definition_en: A shopping area where vehicles are usually not allowed. | A district used for policing or elections. | The grounds surrounding a building, especially a religious building.
example1_en: We met outside the bakery in the shopping precinct.
example1_zh: 我们在步行商业区的面包店外碰面。
example2_en: Creating a pedestrian precinct can encourage local shopping while reducing traffic pollution in city centres.
example2_zh: 设立步行商业区既能鼓励本地消费，又能减少市中心的交通污染。
collocations: shopping precinct｜步行商业区 ; pedestrian precinct｜步行区 ; police precinct｜警区 ; cathedral precincts｜大教堂周围区域
tip_zh: 指建筑物周围的区域时，通常用复数precincts。

meanings_zh: n. 获得；习得 | n. 收购；购得物
definition_en: the process of obtaining something or developing knowledge and skills | the purchase of a business, or something that has been obtained
example1_en: Daily conversations helped with her acquisition of new vocabulary.
example1_zh: 日常交谈帮助她掌握了新词汇。
example2_en: Early exposure to varied speech can support language acquisition and strengthen children's ability to communicate effectively.
example2_zh: 尽早接触多样的语言表达能促进语言习得，增强儿童有效沟通的能力。
collocations: language acquisition｜语言习得 ; acquisition of skills｜技能的掌握 ; mergers and acquisitions｜企业并购 ; make an acquisition｜进行收购
tip_zh: 习得过程通常不可数；收购交易或购得物可数。

meanings_zh: v. 减轻；缓和
definition_en: To make something harmful, unpleasant, or serious less severe
example1_en: Thick curtains helped mitigate the noise from the street.
example1_zh: 厚窗帘帮助减轻了街上传来的噪声。
example2_en: Planting trees in urban areas can mitigate the effects of extreme heat and improve residents' quality of life.
example2_zh: 在城市地区植树可以减轻酷热的影响，并改善居民的生活质量。
collocations: mitigate the effects of｜减轻……的影响 ; mitigate risks｜降低风险 ; mitigate climate change｜缓解气候变化 ; mitigating circumstances｜可减轻处罚的情节
tip_zh: 正式用词，直接接风险、损害或影响，不表示彻底消除。

meanings_zh: n. 心智成熟；稳重 | n. 发育成熟 | n. 金融产品到期
definition_en: The ability to behave responsibly and make sensible judgments. | The state of being fully grown or developed. | The time when an investment or debt becomes repayable.
example1_en: Lena showed maturity by calmly admitting her mistake.
example1_zh: 莉娜冷静地承认自己的错误，表现得很成熟。
example2_en: Schools can foster emotional maturity by encouraging students to resolve disagreements respectfully and consider different perspectives.
example2_zh: 学校可以鼓励学生尊重他人地解决分歧并考虑不同观点，从而促进其情绪成熟。
collocations: emotional maturity｜情绪成熟 ; reach maturity｜达到成熟期 ; a maturity date｜到期日 ; show maturity｜表现出成熟稳重
tip_zh: 通常不可数；金融语境中at maturity表示到期时。

meanings_zh: v. 妥善存放；收好
definition_en: put something safely away, especially for a journey
example1_en: Please stow your bag under the seat in front.
example1_zh: 请把包放好，置于前方座位下。
example2_en: Passengers must stow their luggage securely so that loose items do not cause injuries during unexpected turbulence.
example2_zh: 乘客必须妥善放好行李，以免松散物品在突发颠簸中造成人员受伤。
collocations: stow luggage｜放好行李 ; stow something away｜把某物收好 ; stow securely｜牢固存放
tip_zh: stow away可指收好；人作主语时也可指藏匿偷乘。

meanings_zh: n. 入职培训；正式就任 | n. 归纳推理 | n. 电磁感应
definition_en: training or formal introduction when someone joins an organisation | forming general conclusions from particular observations | production of electrical effects by a changing magnetic field
example1_en: Our induction included a tour of the whole office.
example1_zh: 我们的入职培训包括参观整个办公室。
example2_en: A structured induction programme can help new employees understand workplace expectations and adapt to their roles.
example2_zh: 系统的入职培训可以帮助新员工了解工作要求并适应岗位。
collocations: induction programme｜入职培训计划 ; induction into office｜正式就任 ; electromagnetic induction｜电磁感应 ; inductive reasoning｜归纳推理
tip_zh: 入职常用induction；归纳与deduction演绎相对。

meanings_zh: n. 歌手；演唱者
definition_en: A singer, especially one performing with a musical group.
example1_en: The band's vocalist sang softly while the guitarist played.
example1_zh: 吉他手弹奏时，乐队的歌手轻声演唱。
example2_en: A skilled vocalist can help traditional music reach younger audiences without losing its distinctive cultural character.
example2_zh: 技艺娴熟的歌手能让传统音乐吸引年轻听众，同时保留其独特的文化特色。
collocations: lead vocalist｜主唱 ; backing vocalist｜伴唱歌手 ; jazz vocalist｜爵士歌手
tip_zh: 常指乐队中的歌手；lead vocalist意为主唱。

meanings_zh: adj. 不严格的；松懈的 | adj. 松弛的；不紧的
definition_en: Not strict or careful enough about rules or responsibilities. | Not firm, tight, or tense.
example1_en: The club is lax about checking membership cards.
example1_zh: 这家俱乐部对会员卡的检查很松懈。
example2_en: Lax enforcement of environmental regulations allows some factories to discharge untreated waste into nearby rivers.
example2_zh: 环境法规执行不严，使一些工厂得以向附近河流排放未经处理的废物。
collocations: lax security｜松懈的安保 ; lax enforcement｜执法不严 ; lax standards｜宽松的标准 ; lax about rules｜对规则要求不严
tip_zh: 常指规则执行不严；不要用它表示日常的腹泻。

meanings_zh: adj. 易于遭受的；有倾向的 | adj. 俯卧的
definition_en: Likely to experience something undesirable or behave a certain way | Lying flat with the face pointing downwards
example1_en: My skin is prone to dryness in cold weather.
example1_zh: 我的皮肤在寒冷天气里容易干燥。
example2_en: Coastal settlements are increasingly prone to flooding as sea levels rise and extreme storms become more frequent.
example2_zh: 随着海平面上升和极端风暴日益频繁，沿海居民区越来越容易遭受洪灾。
collocations: prone to injury｜容易受伤 ; prone to flooding｜易遭洪灾 ; accident-prone｜易出事故的 ; lie prone｜俯卧
tip_zh: prone to后接名词或动名词，通常指不好的情况。

meanings_zh: v. 使习惯于
definition_en: To make someone familiar or comfortable with something through experience.
example1_en: I slowly accustomed myself to sleeping with the window open.
example1_zh: 我慢慢让自己习惯了开窗睡觉。
example2_en: Schools can accustom students to collaborative work by regularly assigning tasks that require shared responsibility.
example2_zh: 学校可以定期布置需要共同承担责任的任务，让学生习惯合作。
collocations: accustom yourself to｜使自己习惯于 ; become accustomed to｜逐渐习惯于 ; be accustomed to｜习惯于
tip_zh: accustom oneself to中to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: n. 独立实体；机构
definition_en: something that exists independently, especially an organization
example1_en: Our small bakery now operates as a separate entity.
example1_zh: 我们的小面包店现在作为独立实体运营。
example2_en: Each university should remain an independent entity while cooperating with other institutions on important research projects.
example2_zh: 各大学在与其他机构合作开展重要研究项目的同时，应保持独立。
collocations: a separate entity｜独立的实体 ; a legal entity｜法律实体 ; a commercial entity｜商业实体
tip_zh: 强调独立存在的单位，常用于机构、法律或商业语境。

meanings_zh: adj. 繁重的；造成负担的
definition_en: causing difficulty through excessive work, worry, or expense
example1_en: The extra paperwork became burdensome during our busiest week.
example1_zh: 在我们最忙的那一周，额外的文书工作成了沉重负担。
example2_en: Overly burdensome regulations may discourage small businesses from expanding, even when demand for their products is strong.
example2_zh: 过于繁重的监管规定可能阻碍小企业扩张，即使其产品需求旺盛也是如此。
collocations: burdensome regulations｜繁重的监管规定 ; burdensome task｜繁重的任务 ; financially burdensome｜造成经济负担的
tip_zh: 多形容任务、费用或规定，不指物体重量。

meanings_zh: n. 事件的时间顺序；年表 | n. 年代学
definition_en: The order of events in time, or a record showing it. | The study of when past events happened.
example1_en: These family photos helped us establish the chronology.
example1_zh: 这些家庭照片帮助我们确定了事情发生的先后顺序。
example2_en: Establishing an accurate chronology allows historians to examine how environmental changes influenced the development of early settlements.
example2_zh: 建立准确的事件时间序列，有助于历史学家研究环境变化如何影响早期聚落的发展。
collocations: establish a chronology｜确定时间顺序 ; a chronology of events｜事件年表 ; an accurate chronology｜准确的时间序列
tip_zh: chronology是名词；按时间顺序用chronologically。

meanings_zh: n. 奢侈；挥霍 | n. 奢侈品；奢侈之举
definition_en: Spending more money than is necessary or sensible. | Something expensive bought or done for pleasure rather than necessity.
example1_en: Buying fresh flowers every week is my only extravagance.
example1_zh: 每周买鲜花是我唯一的奢侈享受。
example2_en: Public criticism of government extravagance often increases when essential services face severe budget cuts.
example2_zh: 当基本公共服务面临大幅预算削减时，公众对政府铺张浪费的批评往往会增加。
collocations: personal extravagance｜个人挥霍 ; an unnecessary extravagance｜不必要的奢侈之举 ; a taste for extravagance｜对奢华的偏爱
tip_zh: 指挥霍行为通常不可数；指某项奢侈享受时可数。

meanings_zh: n. 开除；驱逐 | n. 排出；喷出
definition_en: The act of officially forcing someone to leave a place. | The process of forcing something out of a space or body.
example1_en: Repeated cheating led to his expulsion from the club.
example1_zh: 反复作弊导致他被俱乐部开除。
example2_en: Schools should consider supportive interventions before expulsion, as exclusion can seriously damage a young person's educational prospects.
example2_zh: 学校在开除学生之前应考虑采取支持性干预措施，因为排斥可能严重损害年轻人的教育前景。
collocations: expulsion from school｜被学校开除 ; face expulsion｜面临开除 ; expulsion of air｜空气的排出
tip_zh: 常用expulsion from；对应动词为expel。

meanings_zh: n. 标准；正常水平 | n. 票面价值 | n. 高尔夫标准杆数
definition_en: The usual or expected standard of quality or performance. | The stated value of a share or bond. | The expected strokes needed for a golf hole or course.
example1_en: I'm feeling below par, so I'll stay home tonight.
example1_zh: 我感觉状态不佳，所以今晚会待在家里。
example2_en: Investment in teacher training could bring educational outcomes in disadvantaged areas up to par with wealthier districts.
example2_zh: 投资教师培训可使弱势地区的教育成效达到较富裕地区的水平。
collocations: below par｜低于正常水平 ; on a par with｜与……不相上下 ; at par｜按票面价值 ; par value｜票面价值
tip_zh: on a par with表示不相上下；below par指状态欠佳。

meanings_zh: adv. 不论；不顾
definition_en: Without considering or being affected by something, used with of.
example1_en: Everyone can join the walk, irrespective of their age.
example1_zh: 无论年龄大小，人人都可以参加这次步行活动。
example2_en: Quality education should be available to all children, irrespective of their family income or social background.
example2_zh: 所有儿童都应能获得优质教育，无论其家庭收入或社会背景如何。
collocations: irrespective of age｜不论年龄 ; irrespective of income｜不论收入 ; irrespective of the outcome｜不论结果如何
tip_zh: 通常用irrespective of＋名词，意为“不论”。

meanings_zh: v. 招致；产生费用或损失
definition_en: to experience costs or something unpleasant because of your actions
example1_en: Late returns may incur an extra charge at this library.
example1_zh: 在这家图书馆，逾期归还可能产生额外费用。
example2_en: Businesses may incur substantial costs when replacing outdated equipment, but modern technology can improve productivity over time.
example2_zh: 企业更换过时设备时可能产生大量费用，但现代技术能逐步提高生产效率。
collocations: incur costs｜产生费用 ; incur losses｜遭受损失 ; incur debt｜背上债务 ; incur a penalty｜招致处罚
tip_zh: 过去式 incurred，现在分词 incurring，均双写 r。

meanings_zh: v. 筛；筛分 | v. 仔细检查；筛选
definition_en: To pass material through a sieve to separate its parts. | To examine material carefully to find what is useful.
example1_en: Sift the flour before adding it to the bowl.
example1_zh: 把面粉筛过后再加入碗中。
example2_en: Researchers must sift through large amounts of evidence before drawing reliable conclusions about the causes of unemployment.
example2_zh: 研究人员必须仔细筛查大量证据，才能对失业原因得出可靠的结论。
collocations: sift flour｜筛面粉 ; sift through evidence｜仔细审查证据 ; sift out｜筛除；筛选出
tip_zh: sift through表示仔细查看，寻找有用信息。

meanings_zh: n. 木材；锯好的木料 | v. 笨重地缓慢移动
definition_en: Wood cut into pieces for building, especially in American English. | To move slowly and awkwardly because of weight or size.
example1_en: We bought some lumber to build a garden bench.
example1_zh: 我们买了些木料，准备做一张花园长椅。
example2_en: Demand for sustainably sourced lumber can encourage forest owners to adopt more responsible management practices.
example2_zh: 对可持续来源木材的需求可以促使林场主采取更负责任的管理方式。
collocations: a lumber yard｜木材场 ; a stack of lumber｜一堆木料 ; lumber along｜笨重地缓慢前行
tip_zh: 木材义多用于美式英语，英式通常用timber。

meanings_zh: n. 红树；红树林
definition_en: A tropical coastal tree with roots growing in salty water
example1_en: Small fish sheltered among the roots of a mangrove.
example1_zh: 小鱼躲在一棵红树的根部之间。
example2_en: Mangrove forests protect coastal communities from storms while providing essential habitats for numerous marine species.
example2_zh: 红树林既能保护沿海社区免受风暴侵袭，也为众多海洋物种提供重要栖息地。
collocations: mangrove forest｜红树林 ; mangrove roots｜红树根系 ; mangrove conservation｜红树林保护
tip_zh: 可指一棵红树；红树林常说mangrove forest。

meanings_zh: v. 喷射；使喷出 | n. 一股喷出的液体
definition_en: Force liquid out through a small opening in a narrow stream. | A small amount of liquid released in a narrow stream.
example1_en: She squirted some lemon juice over the grilled fish.
example1_zh: 她往烤鱼上挤了些柠檬汁。
example2_en: Water-saving irrigation systems squirt small amounts of water directly onto roots, reducing waste in dry regions.
example2_zh: 节水灌溉系统将少量水直接喷向根部，减少干旱地区的水资源浪费。
collocations: squirt water｜喷水 ; squirt juice over something｜往某物上挤果汁 ; a squirt of sauce｜挤出的一点酱汁
tip_zh: 常用squirt液体onto/into某处，强调细流喷出。

meanings_zh: adj. 依赖的；依靠的
definition_en: needing someone or something for support or success
example1_en: Without a car, we are reliant on local buses.
example1_zh: 没有汽车，我们只能依靠当地公交车。
example2_en: Countries heavily reliant on imported fuel are particularly vulnerable to sudden changes in global energy prices.
example2_zh: 严重依赖进口燃料的国家尤其容易受到全球能源价格突变的影响。
collocations: reliant on｜依赖于 ; heavily reliant on｜严重依赖 ; increasingly reliant on｜越来越依赖
tip_zh: 固定搭配reliant on；“自立的”是self-reliant。

meanings_zh: v. 无视；不理会 | n. 漠视；不顾
definition_en: To ignore something or treat it as unimportant. | A lack of attention or respect for something.
example1_en: Please disregard my earlier message; the picnic is still happening.
example1_zh: 请忽略我之前的消息，野餐仍会照常举行。
example2_en: Companies that disregard environmental regulations may reduce short-term costs but create lasting damage to local ecosystems.
example2_zh: 无视环保法规的企业可能降低短期成本，却会对当地生态系统造成持久损害。
collocations: disregard advice｜不理会建议 ; disregard the rules｜无视规则 ; complete disregard for｜对……的完全漠视 ; disregard for safety｜对安全的漠视
tip_zh: 动词直接接宾语；名词常用disregard for。

meanings_zh: n. 正式讨论；论述 | n. 话语；语篇
definition_en: Serious spoken or written discussion of a particular subject. | Spoken or written language studied in its social context.
example1_en: Her lecture encouraged thoughtful discourse about local history.
example1_zh: 她的讲座引发了对当地历史的深入讨论。
example2_en: Public discourse on climate change increasingly focuses on practical solutions rather than distant predictions.
example2_zh: 关于气候变化的公共讨论越来越关注实际解决方案，而非遥远的预测。
collocations: public discourse｜公共讨论 ; political discourse｜政治话语 ; discourse analysis｜话语分析
tip_zh: 语体正式；语言学中指话语或语篇，不等于论文。

meanings_zh: v. 紧邻；与……毗连
definition_en: to be directly next to or share a boundary with something
example1_en: Our garden adjoins a quiet park with tall oak trees.
example1_zh: 我们的花园紧挨着一座长着高大橡树的安静公园。
example2_en: Residential areas that adjoin industrial sites may require additional measures to protect residents from noise and pollution.
example2_zh: 与工业区相邻的住宅区可能需要额外措施，以保护居民免受噪声和污染影响。
collocations: adjoin a park｜紧邻公园 ; adjoining rooms｜相邻的房间 ; adjoining properties｜毗连的房产
tip_zh: adjoin后直接接地点，不加to；强调直接相邻。

meanings_zh: n. 巅峰；顶点 | n. 尖峰；尖塔
definition_en: The highest level of success, achievement or development. | A tall pointed rock or pointed structure on a building.
example1_en: Winning the tournament was the pinnacle of her career.
example1_zh: 赢得那场锦标赛是她职业生涯的巅峰。
example2_en: For many researchers, international recognition represents the pinnacle of a career devoted to scientific discovery.
example2_zh: 对许多研究人员而言，获得国际认可代表着献身科学探索的职业生涯达到顶峰。
collocations: the pinnacle of success｜成功的巅峰 ; reach the pinnacle｜达到巅峰 ; a rocky pinnacle｜岩石尖峰
tip_zh: 比喻义常用the pinnacle of，表示成就的顶峰。

meanings_zh: v. 消散；使消散 | v. 挥霍；浪费
definition_en: To gradually disappear or cause something to spread and disappear. | To waste money, energy, or resources through careless use.
example1_en: The morning mist began to dissipate as sunlight warmed the valley.
example1_zh: 阳光温暖了山谷，晨雾开始消散。
example2_en: Urban green spaces help dissipate heat, reducing the discomfort caused by high temperatures in densely populated areas.
example2_zh: 城市绿地有助于散热，减轻人口密集地区高温带来的不适。
collocations: dissipate heat｜散热 ; tension dissipates｜紧张气氛消散 ; dissipate energy｜耗散能量
tip_zh: 可及物也可不及物：雾自行消散或风使雾消散。

meanings_zh: n. 严重危险；险境
definition_en: serious danger or a situation involving serious danger
example1_en: The sudden storm put the small boat in peril.
example1_zh: 突如其来的暴风雨使小船陷入险境。
example2_en: Coastal communities face increasing peril as rising sea levels threaten their homes and essential infrastructure.
example2_zh: 随着海平面上升威胁到住宅和关键基础设施，沿海社区面临的危险日益加剧。
collocations: in peril｜处于险境 ; put someone in peril｜使某人陷入险境 ; the perils of｜……的种种危险
tip_zh: 比danger更正式，常用in peril表示身处险境。

meanings_zh: adj. 审美的；美感的 | n. 美学风格；审美理念
definition_en: Relating to beauty or the appreciation of beautiful things. | A particular style or set of ideas about beauty.
example1_en: The wooden shelves give this room greater aesthetic appeal.
example1_zh: 这些木架让这个房间更有美感。
example2_en: Urban planners should consider both the practical function and aesthetic quality of public spaces.
example2_zh: 城市规划者应同时考虑公共空间的实用功能和审美品质。
collocations: aesthetic appeal｜美感吸引力 ; aesthetic value｜审美价值 ; aesthetic considerations｜审美方面的考量
tip_zh: aesthetic指审美的；aesthetics常指美学。

meanings_zh: n. 开始；开端 | n. 毕业典礼（美式）
definition_en: The beginning of something, especially an official activity | A ceremony celebrating students completing their studies in the United States
example1_en: We heard a whistle at the commencement of play.
example1_zh: 比赛开始时，我们听到了一声哨响。
example2_en: Environmental assessments should be completed before the commencement of construction to minimise potential damage to local ecosystems.
example2_zh: 施工开始前应完成环境评估，以尽量减少对当地生态系统的潜在破坏。
collocations: the commencement of work｜工作的开始 ; a commencement date｜开始日期 ; a commencement ceremony｜毕业典礼
tip_zh: 表示“开始”较正式；美式英语中也指毕业典礼。

meanings_zh: adj. 一流的；极好的
definition_en: Of excellent quality or exceptionally high ability.
example1_en: The small restaurant serves first-rate food at reasonable prices.
example1_zh: 这家小餐馆的菜品一流，价格也合理。
example2_en: Access to first-rate training enables young workers to develop skills that employers increasingly value.
example2_zh: 获得一流培训的机会能让年轻劳动者培养雇主日益看重的技能。
collocations: first-rate service｜一流的服务 ; a first-rate education｜一流的教育 ; a first-rate performance｜精彩的表现
tip_zh: first-rate表示质量一流，不是“第一次评价”。

meanings_zh: adj. 后部的；后面的 | n. 雌鹿
definition_en: At the back of an animal's body, especially its legs. | An adult female deer, especially a red deer.
example1_en: The rabbit pushed off with its powerful hind legs.
example1_zh: 兔子用有力的后腿一蹬，跳了出去。
example2_en: Kangaroos rely on their strong hind legs to travel efficiently across large areas in search of food.
example2_zh: 袋鼠依靠强壮的后腿高效穿越广阔区域，寻找食物。
collocations: hind legs｜后腿 ; hind feet｜后脚 ; hind limbs｜后肢
tip_zh: 作形容词主要修饰动物后肢，不泛指后面的事物。

meanings_zh: adj. 最适宜的；最佳的 | n. 最佳状态；最适量
definition_en: best suited to achieving a particular result | the most favourable level or condition for a particular purpose
example1_en: This sunny windowsill provides optimum conditions for my herbs.
example1_zh: 这个阳光充足的窗台为我种的香草提供了最适宜的条件。
example2_en: Maintaining the optimum classroom temperature can help students concentrate and reduce the energy required for heating.
example2_zh: 保持最适宜的教室温度有助于学生集中注意力，并减少供暖能耗。
collocations: optimum conditions｜最佳条件 ; optimum temperature｜最适温度 ; optimum performance｜最佳表现
tip_zh: 强调最适合目标，并非越多越好；通常不用most修饰。

meanings_zh: adj. 心情矛盾的；态度摇摆的
definition_en: having conflicting feelings about someone or something
example1_en: I feel ambivalent about moving away from my family.
example1_zh: 对于搬离家人这件事，我的心情很矛盾。
example2_en: Many consumers remain ambivalent about online shopping because convenience must be balanced against concerns about privacy.
example2_zh: 许多消费者对网购仍持矛盾态度，因为便利与隐私方面的担忧需要权衡。
collocations: feel ambivalent about｜对……心情矛盾 ; ambivalent attitude｜矛盾的态度 ; remain ambivalent｜仍然举棋不定
tip_zh: 常接about；指好坏感受并存，不是毫不在意。

meanings_zh: n. 竞争力 | n. 好胜心
definition_en: The ability to succeed against others in a market or activity. | A strong desire to win or outperform others.
example1_en: Fresh ingredients help our bakery maintain its competitiveness locally.
example1_zh: 新鲜食材帮助我们这家面包店保持本地竞争力。
example2_en: Investment in workforce training can improve national competitiveness by increasing productivity and encouraging innovation across industries.
example2_zh: 投资员工培训可以提高生产率并促进各行业创新，从而增强国家竞争力。
collocations: international competitiveness｜国际竞争力 ; enhance competitiveness｜增强竞争力 ; price competitiveness｜价格竞争力 ; economic competitiveness｜经济竞争力
tip_zh: 不可数；既可指市场竞争力，也可指个人好胜心。

meanings_zh: adj. 完整无损的；未改变的
definition_en: Complete and not damaged, altered, or missing any parts
example1_en: The box was crushed, but the cups remained intact.
example1_zh: 盒子被压坏了，但杯子依然完好无损。
example2_en: Careful restoration allows historic buildings to remain intact while meeting the safety requirements of modern urban life.
example2_zh: 精心修复可以使历史建筑保持完整，同时满足现代城市生活的安全要求。
collocations: remain intact｜保持完整 ; leave intact｜保留原状 ; fully intact｜完好无损
tip_zh: 常用于remain或leave之后，强调完整且未受损。

meanings_zh: adj. 易受影响的；易患病的
definition_en: easily affected or harmed by something
example1_en: These young plants are particularly susceptible to frost damage.
example1_zh: 这些幼苗特别容易遭受霜冻损害。
example2_en: Children may be more susceptible to online advertising because they lack experience in evaluating commercial claims.
example2_zh: 儿童可能更容易受到网络广告影响，因为他们缺乏评估商业宣传的经验。
collocations: susceptible to infection｜容易感染的 ; susceptible to influence｜易受影响的 ; highly susceptible｜极易受影响的
tip_zh: 常用susceptible to，to后接名词。

meanings_zh: v. 突然转向；急转弯 | n. 突然转向；急转弯
definition_en: To change direction suddenly, especially to avoid hitting something. | A sudden change of direction by a vehicle or person.
example1_en: The cyclist swerved to avoid a branch on the road.
example1_zh: 骑车人突然转向，避开了路上的树枝。
example2_en: Poorly maintained roads may force drivers to swerve unexpectedly, increasing the risk of collisions with other vehicles.
example2_zh: 养护不善的道路可能迫使司机突然转向，增加与其他车辆相撞的风险。
collocations: swerve to avoid something｜突然转向避开某物 ; swerve off the road｜突然偏离道路 ; a sudden swerve｜突然转向
tip_zh: 强调突然改变方向；普通转弯通常用turn。

meanings_zh: adj. 较小的；较不重要的
definition_en: Smaller in amount, degree, or importance
example1_en: We chose the lesser expense of repairing our sofa.
example1_zh: 我们选择了费用较低的方案，把沙发修好。
example2_en: Although funding matters, class size also influences educational outcomes, but usually to a lesser degree.
example2_zh: 虽然资金很重要，但班级规模也会影响教育成效，只是影响程度通常较小。
collocations: to a lesser extent｜在较小程度上 ; of lesser importance｜较不重要的 ; the lesser of two evils｜两害相权取其轻
tip_zh: 通常放在名词前；不用于直接表示物体尺寸更小。

meanings_zh: v. 犯错；判断失误
definition_en: To make a mistake or an incorrect judgement.
example1_en: I erred by leaving the cake in too long.
example1_zh: 我把蛋糕烤得太久，失误了。
example2_en: Policymakers may err when they assume that economic growth automatically improves everyone's quality of life.
example2_zh: 政策制定者若认为经济增长会自动改善所有人的生活质量，可能会判断失误。
collocations: err in judgement｜判断失误 ; err on the side of caution｜宁可谨慎一些 ; err in assuming｜错误地假定
tip_zh: 较正式的不及物动词；常用err on the side of caution。

meanings_zh: adj. 下级的；次要的 | n. 下属；部下
definition_en: Lower in rank, authority, or importance. | Someone with a lower position under another person's authority.
example1_en: She accepted a subordinate role on the project.
example1_zh: 她接受了在这个项目中担任辅助角色。
example2_en: In effective organisations, subordinate staff should feel comfortable raising concerns with senior managers without fear.
example2_zh: 在运作良好的组织中，下级员工应能放心地向高级管理人员提出疑虑。
collocations: subordinate to｜从属于；次于 ; a subordinate role｜次要角色 ; subordinate staff｜下级员工 ; a subordinate clause｜从句
tip_zh: 表示“从属于”用subordinate to，不用than。

meanings_zh: adj. 衷心的；真挚的
definition_en: Deeply and sincerely felt.
example1_en: She gave her neighbour a heartfelt hug before leaving.
example1_zh: 离开前，她真挚地拥抱了邻居。
example2_en: A heartfelt apology can help restore public trust, but institutions must also demonstrate a genuine commitment to change.
example2_zh: 真诚的道歉有助于恢复公众信任，但机构还必须展现真正致力于改变的决心。
collocations: heartfelt thanks｜衷心的感谢 ; a heartfelt apology｜真诚的道歉 ; heartfelt sympathy｜由衷的同情
tip_zh: 常修饰thanks、apology、sympathy，强调发自内心。

meanings_zh: v. 罢黜；赶下台；驱逐
definition_en: To force someone out of a position or place.
example1_en: Club members voted to oust their unpopular chair.
example1_zh: 俱乐部成员投票罢免了不受欢迎的主席。
example2_en: Shareholders may seek to oust company directors who repeatedly fail to meet environmental commitments or financial targets.
example2_zh: 股东可能寻求罢免那些屡次未能履行环保承诺或实现财务目标的公司董事。
collocations: oust a leader｜罢黜领导人 ; oust someone from office｜将某人赶下台 ; be ousted as chair｜被罢免主席职务
tip_zh: 常用oust someone from office，强调被迫离职。

meanings_zh: n. 评价；评估 | n. 估价
definition_en: a careful judgment of quality, performance, or a situation | an expert estimate of how much something is worth
example1_en: My manager praised my progress during today's performance appraisal.
example1_zh: 经理在今天的绩效评估中表扬了我的进步。
example2_en: A thorough appraisal of environmental risks should take place before any major construction project begins.
example2_zh: 任何大型建设项目启动之前，都应对环境风险进行全面评估。
collocations: performance appraisal｜绩效评估 ; critical appraisal｜审慎评估 ; property appraisal｜房产估价 ; appraisal process｜评估流程
tip_zh: appraisal是评估；别与approval（批准）混淆。

meanings_zh: adj. 兼容的；可并存的 | adj. 合得来的
definition_en: Able to work or exist together without problems | Having personalities or interests that allow a good relationship
example1_en: This charger is compatible with both of our tablets.
example1_zh: 这个充电器兼容我们的两台平板电脑。
example2_en: Economic growth can be compatible with environmental protection if governments encourage cleaner production and responsible resource use.
example2_zh: 如果政府鼓励更清洁的生产方式和负责任的资源利用，经济增长就能与环境保护并行。
collocations: compatible with｜与……兼容 ; fully compatible｜完全兼容 ; compatible software｜兼容的软件
tip_zh: 固定搭配是compatible with，不用compatible to。

meanings_zh: adj. 反复发生的；频繁的 | adj. 持续不断的
definition_en: Happening repeatedly, often with short breaks. | Continuing over a period without stopping.
example1_en: The continual interruptions made it hard to finish cooking.
example1_zh: 接二连三的打扰让人很难把饭做好。
example2_en: Continual changes in education policy can prevent teachers from developing effective long-term approaches to classroom learning.
example2_zh: 教育政策频繁变动可能妨碍教师制定有效的长期课堂教学方法。
collocations: continual interruptions｜频繁的打扰 ; continual improvement｜持续改进 ; continual changes｜不断的变化
tip_zh: continual常指反复发生；continuous强调不中断。

meanings_zh: n. 物品清单；财产清册 | n. 库存；存货 | v. 为……编制清单
definition_en: A detailed list of items owned or stored somewhere. | The goods a business keeps available for sale. | To make a detailed list of items.
example1_en: We made an inventory of everything in the garage.
example1_zh: 我们把车库里的所有东西列成了清单。
example2_en: Digital systems help retailers manage inventory more efficiently, reducing waste and preventing shortages of essential products.
example2_zh: 数字系统帮助零售商更高效地管理库存，减少浪费并防止必需品短缺。
collocations: make an inventory｜编制清单 ; inventory management｜库存管理 ; inventory levels｜库存水平
tip_zh: 表示库存时多见于美式英语，英式常用stock。

meanings_zh: n. 蚯蚓
definition_en: a long, soft worm that lives in soil
example1_en: An earthworm wriggled out of the wet garden soil.
example1_zh: 一条蚯蚓从花园湿润的泥土中蠕动着钻了出来。
example2_en: Earthworms improve soil structure by creating tunnels that allow air and water to move more freely.
example2_zh: 蚯蚓通过挖掘通道，让空气和水更自由地流动，从而改善土壤结构。
collocations: earthworm populations｜蚯蚓种群 ; earthworm activity｜蚯蚓活动 ; earthworm castings｜蚯蚓粪
tip_zh: 可数名词；earth在这里指土壤。

meanings_zh: adj. 残留的；剩余的
definition_en: remaining after most of something has gone or been removed
example1_en: Residual heat kept the kitchen warm after dinner.
example1_zh: 晚饭后，余热让厨房仍然暖和。
example2_en: Residual chemicals in agricultural soil may affect water quality long after farmers stop using them.
example2_zh: 即使农民停止使用化学品很久，农田土壤中的残留物仍可能影响水质。
collocations: residual heat｜余热 ; residual chemicals｜残留化学物质 ; residual effects｜残余影响 ; residual income｜持续性后续收入
tip_zh: 常用于技术语境，强调处理后仍残留。

meanings_zh: n. 文字记录；转写稿 | n. 成绩单
definition_en: a written record of words spoken in a conversation or recording | an official record of a student's courses and grades
example1_en: I read the transcript while listening to the interview.
example1_zh: 我一边听访谈，一边阅读文字记录。
example2_en: Researchers checked each interview transcript carefully before analysing participants' views on public transport services.
example2_zh: 研究人员仔细核对每份访谈记录后，才分析参与者对公共交通服务的看法。
collocations: interview transcript｜访谈文字记录 ; academic transcript｜学业成绩单 ; a full transcript｜完整文字记录
tip_zh: transcript可指录音转写稿，也可指学校成绩单。

meanings_zh: n. 配偶
definition_en: The person someone is married to.
example1_en: Each employee can bring their spouse to dinner.
example1_zh: 每位员工都可以带配偶参加晚宴。
example2_en: Flexible working arrangements can help employees share childcare responsibilities more equally with their spouses.
example2_zh: 灵活的工作安排有助于员工与配偶更平等地分担育儿责任。
collocations: surviving spouse｜尚健在的配偶 ; accompanying spouse｜随行配偶 ; spouse's income｜配偶的收入
tip_zh: 正式用语，指丈夫或妻子，不限定性别。

meanings_zh: n. 假说；假设
definition_en: A proposed explanation that can be tested through research
example1_en: Our experiment tested the hypothesis that plants prefer sunlight.
example1_zh: 我们的实验检验了植物更喜欢阳光这一假设。
example2_en: Researchers tested the hypothesis that regular physical activity improves concentration among children in primary education.
example2_zh: 研究人员检验了定期体育活动能改善小学生注意力这一假设。
collocations: test a hypothesis｜检验假设 ; formulate a hypothesis｜提出假说 ; support a hypothesis｜支持假说 ; reject a hypothesis｜否定假说
tip_zh: 复数为hypotheses；假说须经证据检验。

meanings_zh: n. 卧室兼起居室的出租房
definition_en: A rented room used for both living and sleeping.
example1_en: He rented a small bedsit close to the station.
example1_zh: 他在车站附近租了一间卧室兼起居室的小房间。
example2_en: For students with limited budgets, a bedsit may provide affordable accommodation near a university campus.
example2_zh: 对于预算有限的学生，卧室兼起居室的出租房可以提供靠近大学校园的经济住所。
collocations: rent a bedsit｜租一间单间住房 ; a furnished bedsit｜带家具的单间住房 ; a cramped bedsit｜狭小的单间住房
tip_zh: 英国用语，卧室兼起居室，浴室常与他人共用。

meanings_zh: adj. 猖獗的；泛滥的 | adj. 疯长的；蔓生的
definition_en: Spreading widely and uncontrollably, especially when harmful. | Growing quickly and spreading without control.
example1_en: Rampant weeds have taken over our vegetable patch.
example1_zh: 疯长的杂草已经占据了我们的菜地。
example2_en: Where oversight is weak, rampant corruption can undermine public trust and divert resources away from essential services.
example2_zh: 在监管薄弱的地方，猖獗的腐败会损害公众信任，并使资源偏离基本公共服务。
collocations: rampant corruption｜猖獗的腐败 ; run rampant｜肆虐；泛滥 ; rampant inflation｜失控的通货膨胀 ; rampant growth｜疯长
tip_zh: 常形容腐败、疾病等失控蔓延；run rampant指肆虐。

meanings_zh: v. 改进；完善 | v. 精炼；提纯
definition_en: Improve something by making small, careful changes | Remove unwanted substances from a raw material
example1_en: I refined my recipe by adding less sugar.
example1_zh: 我减少了糖的用量，改进了自己的食谱。
example2_en: Schools can refine their teaching methods by collecting regular feedback from students with different learning needs.
example2_zh: 学校可以定期收集有不同学习需求的学生的反馈，以改进教学方法。
collocations: refine a technique｜改进技巧 ; refine a proposal｜完善提案 ; refine crude oil｜精炼原油
tip_zh: 既可指完善方法，也可指提纯原材料。

meanings_zh: v. 使着迷；使困扰 | v. 念念不忘；过分纠结
definition_en: to fill someone's mind so they cannot think of anything else | to think about something constantly and excessively
example1_en: Don't obsess over every tiny mark on your shoes.
example1_zh: 别总纠结鞋子上的每一处小污痕。
example2_en: Some students obsess over examination results, neglecting the broader skills that education should develop.
example2_zh: 一些学生过分关注考试成绩，忽视了教育应当培养的更广泛的能力。
collocations: obsess over details｜过分纠结细节 ; be obsessed with success｜痴迷于成功 ; obsess about appearance｜过分在意外表
tip_zh: 常用be obsessed with；主动式常接over或about。

meanings_zh: n. 执业人员；从业者 | n. 实践者
definition_en: someone who works in a profession, especially medicine | someone who regularly uses a particular skill or method
example1_en: The nurse suggested speaking to a qualified medical practitioner.
example1_zh: 护士建议咨询有资质的执业医师。
example2_en: Experienced practitioners should help design training programmes so that graduates develop skills relevant to their profession.
example2_zh: 经验丰富的从业者应参与设计培训课程，让毕业生掌握与职业相关的技能。
collocations: general practitioner｜全科医生 ; medical practitioner｜执业医师 ; experienced practitioner｜经验丰富的从业者
tip_zh: general practitioner指全科医生，常缩写为GP。

meanings_zh: adj. 凶猛的；凶狠的 | adj. 猛烈的；激烈的
definition_en: very fierce, violent, or aggressive | extremely strong or intense
example1_en: The ferocious dog growled from behind the locked gate.
example1_zh: 那只凶猛的狗在锁着的大门后低吼。
example2_en: Ferocious competition in the technology sector can encourage innovation but also threaten the survival of smaller firms.
example2_zh: 科技行业的激烈竞争能够促进创新，但也可能威胁较小企业的生存。
collocations: a ferocious animal｜凶猛的动物 ; ferocious competition｜激烈的竞争 ; a ferocious storm｜猛烈的暴风雨
tip_zh: 既可形容动物凶猛，也可形容竞争或风暴猛烈。

meanings_zh: adj. 动荡的；混乱的 | adj. 湍急的；气流紊乱的
definition_en: Full of conflict, uncertainty, or sudden disruptive changes. | Moving violently and irregularly, especially air or water.
example1_en: After a turbulent week, our family needed a quiet evening.
example1_zh: 经历了动荡的一周后，我们一家需要一个安静的夜晚。
example2_en: During turbulent economic periods, governments may increase public spending to protect jobs and support vulnerable households.
example2_zh: 在经济动荡时期，政府可能增加公共支出，以保障就业并支持脆弱家庭。
collocations: turbulent times｜动荡时期 ; turbulent waters｜湍急的水流 ; turbulent airflow｜紊乱气流
tip_zh: 既形容社会局势动荡，也形容水流或气流紊乱。

meanings_zh: v. 抵消；使无效 | v. 否定；否认
definition_en: Cancel the effect or value of something. | State or show that something is not true.
example1_en: The delivery fee negated the savings on our groceries.
example1_zh: 配送费抵消了我们买食品省下的钱。
example2_en: Increased energy consumption may negate the environmental benefits of replacing older appliances with more efficient models.
example2_zh: 增加的能源消耗可能抵消用更高效型号替换旧电器所带来的环境效益。
collocations: negate the benefits｜抵消益处 ; negate the effects｜抵消影响 ; negate an argument｜否定一个论点
tip_zh: 正式用词；常表示抵消效果，不只表示口头否认。

meanings_zh: adj. 全体一致同意的
definition_en: agreed on by every person in a group
example1_en: Our family was unanimous about adopting the little cat.
example1_zh: 我们全家一致同意收养那只小猫。
example2_en: The committee reached a unanimous decision to improve public transport rather than expand the existing road network.
example2_zh: 委员会一致决定改善公共交通，而不是扩建现有道路网。
collocations: unanimous decision｜一致通过的决定 ; unanimous support｜全体一致支持 ; unanimous agreement｜全体一致同意 ; unanimous vote｜全票通过
tip_zh: 强调所有人都同意，不是仅指多数人赞成。

meanings_zh: n. 代币；专用券 | n. 象征；心意的表示 | adj. 象征性的；敷衍的
definition_en: A special disc or voucher used instead of money. | Something given or done to express a feeling. | Done merely to appear helpful or compliant, with little effect.
example1_en: I dropped a token into the machine and played.
example1_zh: 我往机器里投了一枚代币，开始玩了起来。
example2_en: Critics argue that token environmental measures cannot address the scale of pollution in rapidly expanding cities.
example2_zh: 批评者认为，象征性的环保措施无法应对快速扩张的城市中如此严重的污染。
collocations: a token of appreciation｜表达谢意的心意 ; a token gesture｜象征性的举动 ; a token payment｜象征性的付款
tip_zh: a token of后接情感名词，表示某种心意。

meanings_zh: v. 发出嘶嘶声 | n. 嘶嘶声
definition_en: To make a long, sharp sound like escaping steam. | A long, sharp sound made by escaping air or steam.
example1_en: The cat hissed when the puppy came too close.
example1_zh: 小狗靠得太近时，猫发出了嘶嘶声。
example2_en: Engineers investigated a persistent hiss from the heating system to identify possible leaks and prevent energy waste.
example2_zh: 工程师检查了供暖系统持续发出的嘶嘶声，以查明可能的泄漏并防止能源浪费。
collocations: hiss at someone｜冲某人发出嘶嘶声 ; a faint hiss｜微弱的嘶嘶声 ; a hiss of steam｜蒸汽的嘶嘶声
tip_zh: hiss at可表示冲人嘶叫或发嘘声。

meanings_zh: n. 归因；归属认定 | n. 注明出处；署名
definition_en: the act of identifying something's cause, creator, or source | acknowledgement of the person who created or supplied something
example1_en: Please include an attribution when you share my photograph.
example1_zh: 分享我的照片时，请注明作者。
example2_en: Accurate attribution of environmental damage to specific industries is essential for developing fair and effective regulations.
example2_zh: 准确判定环境损害应归因于哪些行业，是制定公平有效的法规的关键。
collocations: attribution of responsibility｜责任归属 ; causal attribution｜因果归因 ; source attribution｜注明来源
tip_zh: 不是普通的“属于”；常指认定原因、作者或来源。

meanings_zh: n. 可卡因；古柯碱
definition_en: A powerful, addictive stimulant drug derived from coca leaves.
example1_en: The nurse explained why cocaine can seriously harm the heart.
example1_zh: 护士解释了可卡因为何会严重损害心脏。
example2_en: Public health programmes should combine education about cocaine with accessible treatment for people experiencing addiction.
example2_zh: 公共卫生项目应将可卡因危害教育与便捷可及的成瘾治疗相结合。
collocations: cocaine addiction｜可卡因成瘾 ; cocaine use｜使用可卡因 ; cocaine dependence｜可卡因依赖
tip_zh: 通常为不可数名词，指一种强效成瘾性毒品。

meanings_zh: n. 蛤蜊；蛤
definition_en: A shellfish with two joined shells, often living buried in sand.
example1_en: We found a clam buried in the wet sand.
example1_zh: 我们在湿沙里发现了一只蛤蜊。
example2_en: Clam farming can support coastal economies, but poor water quality may threaten both shellfish and consumers.
example2_zh: 蛤蜊养殖可以支撑沿海经济，但水质不佳可能同时威胁贝类和消费者。
collocations: clam shell｜蛤蜊壳 ; clam chowder｜蛤蜊浓汤 ; clam farming｜蛤蜊养殖
tip_zh: clam是蛤蜊；不要与calm（平静的）混淆。

meanings_zh: n. 行为疯狂鲁莽的人 | n. 狂热爱好者
definition_en: someone behaving in an extremely wild or reckless way | someone extremely enthusiastic about a particular activity
example1_en: That driver is a maniac, speeding around every corner.
example1_zh: 那个司机开车太疯狂了，每个弯道都飞速驶过。
example2_en: Calling a reckless driver a maniac expresses anger but does little to explain the causes of dangerous driving.
example2_zh: 把鲁莽的司机称为疯子虽然表达了愤怒，却无助于解释危险驾驶的原因。
collocations: drive like a maniac｜疯狂地开车 ; a fitness maniac｜健身狂热者
tip_zh: 属非正式用语，可能冒犯他人；勿作精神疾病诊断词。

meanings_zh: adj. 供自主选用学习的 | n. 自主选材学习
definition_en: allowing learners to choose and use materials independently | independent learning using materials chosen by the learner
example1_en: Our library has a quiet self-access learning area.
example1_zh: 我们图书馆有一个安静的自主学习区。
example2_en: Self-access centres encourage students to take responsibility for their progress by selecting materials suited to their needs.
example2_zh: 自主学习中心鼓励学生选择适合自身需求的材料，对自己的学习进度负责。
collocations: self-access centre｜自主学习中心 ; self-access materials｜自主学习材料 ; self-access learning｜自主选材学习
tip_zh: 主要用于教育，强调自主选择并使用学习资源。

meanings_zh: adj. 淫秽的；猥亵的 | adj. 多得离谱的；令人愤慨的
definition_en: offensively sexual in a way considered unacceptable | so excessive or unfair that it causes moral outrage
example1_en: The moderator removed an obscene comment from the chat.
example1_zh: 管理员从聊天中删除了一条淫秽评论。
example2_en: Critics argue that obscene executive bonuses are difficult to justify when ordinary workers face wage cuts.
example2_zh: 批评者认为，普通工人面临降薪时，高管高得离谱的奖金难以合理解释。
collocations: obscene language｜淫秽语言 ; obscene material｜淫秽内容 ; an obscene amount of money｜多得离谱的一笔钱
tip_zh: 比rude语气强；也可批评金钱或数量多得离谱。

meanings_zh: v. 猛扔；猛推 | n. 短暂的尽情享乐
definition_en: To throw or move something suddenly and forcefully. | A short period of freely enjoying an activity.
example1_en: He flung his muddy boots into the empty bucket.
example1_zh: 他把沾满泥的靴子猛地扔进了空桶。
example2_en: During severe storms, powerful winds can fling loose debris across roads, creating serious hazards for drivers and pedestrians.
example2_zh: 在强风暴中，狂风可能将散落的碎物刮到道路上，给司机和行人带来严重危险。
collocations: fling open a door｜猛地推开门 ; fling your arms around someone｜张开双臂抱住某人 ; fling yourself into something｜全身心投入某事 ; a final fling｜最后一次尽情享乐
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为flung，强调动作猛烈。

meanings_zh: v. 使有能力；增强自主权 | v. 授权
definition_en: Give someone confidence or control over their own life. | Give someone official authority to take particular action.
example1_en: Learning to cook empowered him to live independently.
example1_zh: 学会做饭让他能够独立生活。
example2_en: Access to reliable information can empower citizens to make informed decisions about their health.
example2_zh: 获取可靠信息可以使公民有能力对自身健康作出明智决定。
collocations: empower women｜增强女性自主权 ; empower communities｜增强社区自主能力 ; empower someone to act｜授权某人采取行动
tip_zh: 常用empower sb to do sth，表示赋能或授权。

meanings_zh: v. 逐步侵占；侵犯
definition_en: To gradually take over another's space, time, or rights.
example1_en: The neighbour's bushes are beginning to encroach on our garden.
example1_zh: 邻居家的灌木开始长到我们花园里来了。
example2_en: As new housing developments encroach on wetlands, local wildlife loses essential breeding grounds and sources of food.
example2_zh: 随着新住宅开发项目逐步侵占湿地，当地野生动物失去了重要的繁殖地和食物来源。
collocations: encroach on land｜侵占土地 ; encroach on privacy｜侵犯隐私 ; encroach on leisure time｜侵占休闲时间
tip_zh: 不及物动词，常用encroach on/upon，强调逐步侵占。

meanings_zh: n. 请愿书 | v. 向…请愿；正式请求
definition_en: A formal written request, often supported by many people's signatures. | To formally ask an authority to do something.
example1_en: Our neighbours signed a petition to save the playground.
example1_zh: 邻居们在请愿书上签名，希望保住这座游乐场。
example2_en: Residents submitted a petition asking the council to improve public transport in areas outside the city centre.
example2_zh: 居民提交了请愿书，要求市政委员会改善市中心以外地区的公共交通。
collocations: sign a petition｜在请愿书上签名 ; submit a petition｜提交请愿书 ; petition for reform｜请愿要求改革
tip_zh: 动词常用petition somebody to do something。

meanings_zh: n. 喧闹声；强烈呼声 | v. 大声要求；喧嚷
definition_en: Loud noise or strong public demands | To demand something loudly or insistently
example1_en: The children clamored for another story before bedtime.
example1_zh: 睡觉前，孩子们吵着要再听一个故事。
example2_en: Public clamor for cleaner air has encouraged local authorities to invest in more reliable public transport.
example2_zh: 公众要求改善空气质量的强烈呼声，推动地方政府投资建设更可靠的公共交通。
collocations: clamor for change｜强烈要求变革 ; public clamor｜公众的强烈呼声 ; clamor to be heard｜吵着要求被听见
tip_zh: 美式拼写；英式为clamour。要求某物用clamor for。

meanings_zh: adj. 和蔼可亲的；友善的
definition_en: Friendly, pleasant, and easy to get along with.
example1_en: Our amiable neighbour always stops to chat by the gate.
example1_zh: 我们那位和蔼的邻居总会在门口停下来聊几句。
example2_en: An amiable manner can help healthcare professionals build trust with patients from diverse cultural backgrounds.
example2_zh: 亲切的态度能帮助医护人员与来自不同文化背景的患者建立信任。
collocations: amiable manner｜亲切的态度 ; amiable personality｜随和的性格 ; amiable smile｜友善的微笑
tip_zh: amiable多形容人；amicable多形容关系或协议。

meanings_zh: adj. 字迹难以辨认的
definition_en: impossible or very difficult to read because of unclear writing
example1_en: Rain had made the address on the envelope illegible.
example1_zh: 雨水把信封上的地址弄得无法辨认了。
example2_en: Illegible handwriting on medical forms can cause errors that put patient safety at risk.
example2_zh: 医疗表格上难以辨认的字迹可能引发错误，危及患者安全。
collocations: illegible handwriting｜难以辨认的笔迹 ; almost illegible｜几乎无法辨认 ; render something illegible｜使某物字迹无法辨认
tip_zh: illegible指字迹看不清，不是文章内容难懂。

meanings_zh: n. 公证人
definition_en: An official authorised to witness signatures and certify documents.
example1_en: We signed the property documents in front of a notary.
example1_zh: 我们在公证人面前签署了房产文件。
example2_en: A notary can verify signatures on legal documents, helping reduce the risk of fraud in property transactions.
example2_zh: 公证人可以核验法律文件上的签名，帮助降低房产交易中的欺诈风险。
collocations: notary public｜公证人 ; consult a notary｜咨询公证人 ; before a notary｜在公证人面前
tip_zh: 也称notary public；具体职权因国家而异。

meanings_zh: n. 无所事事；懒散
definition_en: The state of not working or doing anything.
example1_en: After weeks of idleness, I finally cleaned the garage.
example1_zh: 闲了几个星期后，我终于打扫了车库。
example2_en: Long periods of enforced idleness during unemployment can damage confidence and make returning to work more difficult.
example2_zh: 失业期间长期被迫无事可做，会损害自信，使重返职场变得更加困难。
collocations: enforced idleness｜被迫闲着 ; a life of idleness｜无所事事的生活 ; sheer idleness｜纯粹的懒惰
tip_zh: 不可数；既可指懒散，也可指被迫闲着。

meanings_zh: adj. 气候温和的 | adj. 克制的；适度的
definition_en: Having weather that is neither very hot nor very cold | Showing restraint rather than extreme behaviour or feelings
example1_en: We enjoy walking outdoors in this temperate climate.
example1_zh: 这里气候温和，我们喜欢在户外散步。
example2_en: Temperate regions may experience significant changes in rainfall patterns as global temperatures continue to rise.
example2_zh: 随着全球气温持续上升，温带地区的降雨模式可能发生显著变化。
collocations: temperate climate｜温和的气候 ; temperate zone｜温带 ; temperate language｜克制的措辞
tip_zh: 气候义指不太冷也不太热；不等于热带的。

meanings_zh: adj. 食草的；以植物为食的
definition_en: feeding on plants rather than other animals
example1_en: These herbivorous lizards enjoy fresh leaves from our garden.
example1_zh: 这些食草蜥蜴喜欢吃我们花园里的新鲜叶子。
example2_en: Herbivorous animals influence forest growth by consuming young plants and spreading seeds through their droppings.
example2_zh: 食草动物通过吃掉幼苗和利用粪便传播种子来影响森林生长。
collocations: herbivorous animals｜食草动物 ; herbivorous mammals｜食草哺乳动物 ; herbivorous species｜食草物种
tip_zh: 不仅指吃草，也包括以树叶、果实等植物为食。

meanings_zh: n. 谷仓；粮仓
definition_en: A building where harvested grain is stored.
example1_en: The farmer carried another sack of wheat into the granary.
example1_zh: 农夫又把一袋小麦搬进谷仓。
example2_en: A well-maintained granary can protect harvested crops from moisture and reduce food losses in rural communities.
example2_zh: 维护良好的谷仓可以防止收获的作物受潮，并减少农村社区的粮食损失。
collocations: store grain in a granary｜把谷物储存在粮仓里 ; wooden granary｜木制谷仓 ; communal granary｜公共粮仓
tip_zh: 指储存谷物的建筑；barn用途更广，也可养牲畜。

meanings_zh: n. 荒谬；荒唐 | n. 荒唐事；荒谬言论
definition_en: the quality of being unreasonable, ridiculous, or illogical | an action, situation, or statement that makes no sense
example1_en: We laughed at the absurdity of wearing coats indoors.
example1_zh: 我们对在室内穿大衣这件荒唐事笑了起来。
example2_en: Critics highlighted the absurdity of building more roads while claiming to reduce dependence on private cars.
example2_zh: 批评者指出，一边修建更多道路，一边声称要减少对私家车的依赖，这很荒谬。
collocations: the absurdity of｜……的荒谬之处 ; sheer absurdity｜完全荒谬 ; expose an absurdity｜揭露荒唐之处
tip_zh: 表示荒谬性质时不可数；指具体荒唐事时可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 无害的；无伤大雅的
definition_en: Not likely to cause harm or offend anyone.
example1_en: Her question seemed innocuous, so I answered without hesitation.
example1_zh: 她的问题似乎无伤大雅，所以我毫不犹豫地回答了。
example2_en: Seemingly innocuous household products can damage aquatic ecosystems when large quantities enter rivers through wastewater.
example2_zh: 看似无害的家用产品如果随废水大量进入河流，也可能破坏水生生态系统。
collocations: innocuous remark｜无伤大雅的话 ; seemingly innocuous｜看似无害的 ; innocuous substance｜无害物质
tip_zh: 可形容物质无害，也可形容言论不冒犯人。

meanings_zh: n. 球体；球形 | n. 领域；范围
definition_en: A perfectly round solid shape, like a ball. | An area of activity, knowledge, or influence.
example1_en: She rolled the clay into a smooth sphere.
example1_zh: 她把黏土揉成了一个光滑的球体。
example2_en: Digital technology has expanded the sphere of education beyond classrooms, allowing students to learn almost anywhere.
example2_zh: 数字技术将教育领域拓展到课堂之外，让学生几乎可以在任何地方学习。
collocations: a perfect sphere｜完美球体 ; sphere of influence｜影响范围 ; the public sphere｜公共领域
tip_zh: 球体用sphere，平面上的圆用circle。

meanings_zh: adj. 燃烧着的；明亮的 | v. 下车；降落
definition_en: Burning or shining brightly. | To get off a vehicle or land on a surface.
example1_en: The candles were still alight when we arrived.
example1_zh: 我们到达时，蜡烛还燃着。
example2_en: Passengers should wait until the bus has stopped completely before they alight from the vehicle.
example2_zh: 乘客应等公交车完全停稳后再下车。
collocations: set something alight｜点燃某物 ; alight from a train｜下火车 ; alight on a branch｜落在树枝上
tip_zh: 形容词通常作表语；下车用alight from。

meanings_zh: adj. 琐碎的；不重要的
definition_en: having little importance or seriousness
example1_en: We wasted the afternoon arguing over a trivial detail.
example1_zh: 我们为一个无关紧要的细节争论，浪费了整个下午。
example2_en: Public debates sometimes focus on trivial disagreements rather than the urgent environmental problems affecting future generations.
example2_zh: 公众讨论有时聚焦于琐碎的分歧，而非影响子孙后代的紧迫环境问题。
collocations: trivial matter｜小事 ; trivial detail｜无关紧要的细节 ; trivial complaint｜对小事的抱怨
tip_zh: 指重要性低，不等于容易；trivial matters指琐事。

meanings_zh: n. 保证；担保 | n. 自信；把握
definition_en: A promise intended to remove doubt or worry. | Confidence in your abilities or in what you believe.
example1_en: She gave me her assurance that dinner was ready.
example1_zh: 她向我保证晚餐已经准备好了。
example2_en: Residents sought an assurance from the council that the new development would not reduce access to public parks.
example2_zh: 居民要求地方议会保证，新开发项目不会影响公众前往公园。
collocations: give an assurance｜作出保证 ; quality assurance｜质量保证 ; speak with assurance｜自信地说 ; life assurance｜人寿保险
tip_zh: 表示具体保证时可数；表示自信时通常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 汞；水银
definition_en: A poisonous, silver-coloured metal that is liquid at room temperature.
example1_en: This old thermometer contains mercury, so handle it carefully.
example1_zh: 这支旧温度计含有水银，因此要小心拿放。
example2_en: Industrial mercury pollution can accumulate in fish and pose serious risks to human health.
example2_zh: 工业汞污染可导致汞在鱼体内积累，对人类健康构成严重风险。
collocations: mercury poisoning｜汞中毒 ; mercury pollution｜汞污染 ; mercury thermometer｜水银温度计
tip_zh: mercury指汞，不可数；大写Mercury可指水星。

meanings_zh: adj. 潜在的；潜伏的
definition_en: Present but not yet active, visible, or fully developed.
example1_en: Her first pottery class revealed a latent artistic talent.
example1_zh: 第一堂陶艺课显露了她潜在的艺术天赋。
example2_en: Supportive teaching can help students develop latent abilities that conventional examinations may fail to identify.
example2_zh: 支持性的教学能帮助学生发展传统考试可能无法识别的潜在能力。
collocations: latent talent｜潜在天赋 ; latent potential｜潜能 ; latent infection｜潜伏感染 ; latent demand｜潜在需求
tip_zh: 指已经存在但尚未显现或发挥作用。

meanings_zh: v. 激励；促进 | n. 刺激；推动力 | n. 马刺
definition_en: To encourage action or cause something to develop faster | Something that encourages action or further progress | A metal device on a rider's boot for urging a horse
example1_en: Her friend's encouragement spurred her to finish the race.
example1_zh: 朋友的鼓励激励她跑完了比赛。
example2_en: Investment in reliable public transport can spur economic growth by connecting workers with a wider range of jobs.
example2_zh: 投资可靠的公共交通可以让劳动者接触到更多就业机会，从而促进经济增长。
collocations: spur economic growth｜促进经济增长 ; spur someone into action｜促使某人行动 ; a spur to innovation｜创新的推动力 ; on the spur of the moment｜一时兴起
tip_zh: 常用spur sb to do；过去式spurred双写r。

meanings_zh: n. 剧烈痛苦；折磨 | v. 使痛苦；折磨；烦扰
definition_en: severe physical pain or mental suffering | to cause someone severe suffering or repeated distress
example1_en: The constant itching was a torment all night.
example1_zh: 持续的瘙痒折磨了我整整一夜。
example2_en: Persistent uncertainty about employment can torment workers and undermine their mental health over time.
example2_zh: 就业状况长期不确定会折磨劳动者，并逐渐损害他们的心理健康。
collocations: mental torment｜精神折磨 ; in torment｜处于极度痛苦中 ; tormented by guilt｜受内疚折磨
tip_zh: 名词重音在首音节；动词重音在第二音节。

meanings_zh: adj. 有歧义的；含糊的
definition_en: Having more than one possible meaning or interpretation
example1_en: His ambiguous reply left us unsure whether to come.
example1_zh: 他的回答含糊不清，让我们拿不准该不该来。
example2_en: Ambiguous wording in public health advice can confuse readers and reduce their confidence in official guidance.
example2_zh: 公共卫生建议中的含糊措辞可能让读者困惑，并降低他们对官方指导的信任。
collocations: ambiguous wording｜含糊的措辞 ; ambiguous statement｜有歧义的陈述 ; remain ambiguous｜仍不明确
tip_zh: 侧重可作多种解读；vague侧重细节不清。

meanings_zh: n. 怪癖；独特之处 | n. 偶然的怪事
definition_en: an unusual habit or feature of someone or something | a strange event caused by chance
example1_en: One of her quirks is sorting socks by colour.
example1_zh: 她的一个小怪癖是按颜色整理袜子。
example2_en: A quirk of the housing market has left some coastal villages cheaper than nearby inland towns.
example2_zh: 住房市场的一个反常现象是，有些沿海村庄的房价竟低于附近的内陆城镇。
collocations: a personality quirk｜性格上的小怪癖 ; a quirk of fate｜命运的巧合 ; individual quirks｜个人独特之处
tip_zh: 通常指无伤大雅的小怪癖或特点，不一定含贬义。

meanings_zh: v. 遵守；服从 | v. 容忍；忍受
definition_en: to follow a rule, agreement, or decision | to tolerate something, usually used with cannot
example1_en: Everyone using the pool must abide by its rules.
example1_zh: 所有使用泳池的人都必须遵守泳池规定。
example2_en: Companies should abide by environmental regulations even when doing so increases their production costs.
example2_zh: 企业应遵守环保法规，即使这样做会增加生产成本。
collocations: abide by the rules｜遵守规则 ; abide by an agreement｜遵守协议 ; cannot abide｜无法忍受
tip_zh: 表示遵守用abide by；表示忍受常用cannot abide。

meanings_zh: n. 电报通信系统；电报机 | v. 发电报 | v. 无意中流露；提前暴露
definition_en: A system or device sending messages electrically along wires. | To send a message using a telegraph. | To reveal intentions or feelings, often without meaning to.
example1_en: The museum guide demonstrated how the old telegraph worked.
example1_zh: 博物馆讲解员演示了这台老式电报机的工作原理。
example2_en: The telegraph transformed international communication by allowing information to travel much faster than physical mail.
example2_zh: 电报使信息传递远快于实物邮件，从而改变了国际通信。
collocations: telegraph operator｜电报员 ; telegraph wire｜电报线 ; telegraph your intentions｜提前暴露意图
tip_zh: telegraph 指通信系统或设备；telegram 指电报消息。

meanings_zh: v. 量化；确定数量
definition_en: to measure or express the amount of something
example1_en: This app helps me quantify how much water I drink.
example1_zh: 这个应用帮我量化每天的饮水量。
example2_en: Researchers find it difficult to quantify the long-term social benefits of investing in public libraries.
example2_zh: 研究人员发现，投资公共图书馆的长期社会效益很难量化。
collocations: quantify the impact｜量化影响 ; quantify the benefits｜量化效益 ; difficult to quantify｜难以量化
tip_zh: 及物动词，直接接宾语：quantify the impact。

meanings_zh: n. 芦苇；苇秆 | n. 簧片
definition_en: A tall grass with stiff stems growing near water | A thin strip that vibrates to produce sound in certain instruments
example1_en: A small bird balanced on a reed beside the pond.
example1_zh: 一只小鸟稳稳地停在池塘边的一根芦苇上。
example2_en: Reed beds provide shelter for wetland wildlife and can help remove pollutants from water flowing through them.
example2_zh: 芦苇丛为湿地野生动物提供庇护，还能帮助去除流经其中的水里的污染物。
collocations: reed bed｜芦苇丛 ; reed warbler｜苇莺 ; clarinet reed｜单簧管簧片
tip_zh: 与read的原形同音；也指乐器中振动发声的簧片。

meanings_zh: adj. 勤劳的；勤奋的
definition_en: working hard and carefully over a sustained period
example1_en: My industrious neighbour grows vegetables and repairs furniture every weekend.
example1_zh: 我勤劳的邻居每个周末都种菜、修家具。
example2_en: Although industrious employees contribute greatly to productivity, employers must also provide adequate training and reasonable working conditions.
example2_zh: 尽管勤奋的员工对生产效率贡献很大，雇主也必须提供充分的培训和合理的工作条件。
collocations: an industrious worker｜勤劳的工人 ; an industrious student｜勤奋的学生
tip_zh: industrious 指勤奋的；industrial 指工业的。

meanings_zh: v. 促进；培养 | v. 寄养；代养 | adj. 寄养的；代养的
definition_en: to encourage something to develop or grow | to care for another person's child, usually temporarily | involving care for a child by someone other than their parents
example1_en: Shared meals foster closer friendships among our neighbours.
example1_zh: 一起吃饭让我们邻里之间的友谊更加深厚。
example2_en: Schools can foster creativity by allowing students to explore problems without prescribing a single solution.
example2_zh: 学校可以让学生探索问题而不限定唯一解法，以培养创造力。
collocations: foster creativity｜培养创造力 ; foster cooperation｜促进合作 ; foster a child｜寄养孩子 ; foster parents｜寄养父母
tip_zh: foster常指暂时代养；adopt指依法收养。

meanings_zh: n. 轻微地震；震动 | n. 颤抖；战栗
definition_en: A small earthquake or a brief shaking movement. | An involuntary shaking of the body or voice.
example1_en: A slight tremor made the cups rattle on their hooks.
example1_zh: 一次轻微震动使挂钩上的杯子碰得叮当响。
example2_en: Sensitive monitoring equipment can detect a minor tremor that people living nearby may not notice.
example2_zh: 灵敏的监测设备能够探测到附近居民可能察觉不到的轻微地震。
collocations: earth tremor｜轻微地震 ; hand tremor｜手部颤抖 ; a tremor in her voice｜她声音中的颤抖
tip_zh: 通常作名词；声音中的颤抖用a tremor in the voice。

meanings_zh: n. 医生；内科医生
definition_en: A medical doctor, especially one treating illness without surgery.
example1_en: The physician listened carefully as I described my symptoms.
example1_zh: 我描述症状时，医生认真地听着。
example2_en: Access to a qualified physician remains limited in remote areas, contributing to significant inequalities in healthcare.
example2_zh: 偏远地区获得合格医生诊治的机会仍然有限，这加剧了医疗服务方面的显著不平等。
collocations: consult a physician｜咨询医生 ; qualified physician｜合格的医生 ; primary care physician｜初级保健医生
tip_zh: 美式常泛指医生；英式常指内科医生。

meanings_zh: v. 危及；使陷入危险
definition_en: To put something valuable at risk of harm or loss.
example1_en: Skipping these safety checks could jeopardize the whole trip.
example1_zh: 省略这些安全检查可能危及整个行程。
example2_en: Excessive use of groundwater could jeopardize future food production in regions already affected by drought.
example2_zh: 过度开采地下水可能危及已受干旱影响地区未来的粮食生产。
collocations: jeopardize safety｜危及安全 ; jeopardize prospects｜损害前景 ; jeopardize a relationship｜危及关系
tip_zh: 直接接宾语；英式英语也常拼作jeopardise。

meanings_zh: n. 澄清；进一步说明
definition_en: an explanation that makes something clearer or easier to understand
example1_en: I asked for clarification before signing the rental agreement.
example1_zh: 签租房合同前，我要求对方进一步说明。
example2_en: Students benefit from clarification of assessment criteria before they begin complex research assignments at university.
example2_zh: 大学生在开始复杂的研究作业前，若评分标准得到明确说明，会更有帮助。
collocations: ask for clarification｜请求说明 ; provide clarification｜作出说明 ; clarification of the rules｜对规则的澄清 ; seek clarification on｜就……寻求解释
tip_zh: 常用clarification of或on；通常作不可数名词。

meanings_zh: n. 热情；热忱
definition_en: great energy and enthusiasm for an activity or cause
example1_en: She tackled the garden cleanup with remarkable zeal.
example1_zh: 她以极大的热情投入到花园清理工作中。
example2_en: Volunteers' zeal can strengthen community projects, but sustained progress also requires reliable funding and professional support.
example2_zh: 志愿者的热忱能推动社区项目，但持续进展也需要稳定的资金和专业支持。
collocations: zeal for learning｜学习热情 ; with great zeal｜满怀热忱地 ; missionary zeal｜传教士般的热忱
tip_zh: 不可数名词；常用zeal for表示对某事的热情。

meanings_zh: n. 期货；期货合约
definition_en: Contracts to trade assets later at prices agreed now.
example1_en: My cousin trades wheat futures from her home office.
example1_zh: 我表姐在家中的办公室交易小麦期货。
example2_en: Farmers can use futures to protect themselves against falling crop prices, although these contracts also involve financial risks.
example2_zh: 农民可以利用期货防范农作物价格下跌，但这些合约也涉及金融风险。
collocations: futures market｜期货市场 ; futures contract｜期货合约 ; trade futures｜交易期货 ; oil futures｜石油期货
tip_zh: 金融义用复数形式；futures contract指期货合约。

meanings_zh: n. 惊人的发现；被揭露的事 | n. 揭露；披露
definition_en: A surprising fact that becomes known. | The act of making previously hidden information known.
example1_en: His revelation about the hidden garden surprised us all.
example1_zh: 他透露的那个隐秘花园让我们都很惊讶。
example2_en: Recent revelations about industrial pollution have increased public pressure for stricter environmental regulations and greater corporate transparency.
example2_zh: 近期披露的工业污染问题加大了公众压力，要求加强环境监管并提高企业透明度。
collocations: a startling revelation｜惊人的发现 ; revelations about｜关于……的披露 ; come as a revelation｜令人恍然大悟
tip_zh: 具体的新发现可数；指披露这一行为时常不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 多付的款项；超额支付
definition_en: Money paid beyond the amount owed, or paying too much
example1_en: The cashier returned my overpayment before I left.
example1_zh: 我离开前，收银员退还了我多付的钱。
example2_en: Clear payroll procedures can prevent accidental overpayment and reduce disputes between employers and their staff.
example2_zh: 清晰的工资发放流程可以防止意外多付款，并减少雇主与员工之间的纠纷。
collocations: an overpayment of wages｜多发的工资 ; recover an overpayment｜追回多付款项 ; refund an overpayment｜退还多付款项
tip_zh: 款项用of引出：an overpayment of wages。

meanings_zh: adj. 喜气洋洋的；容光焕发的 | adj. 光芒四射的 | adj. 辐射的
definition_en: Showing great happiness through your face or appearance. | Shining brightly with light. | Transmitted as waves, especially heat or light.
example1_en: She looked radiant as she held her newborn baby.
example1_zh: 她抱着刚出生的宝宝，脸上洋溢着幸福。
example2_en: Buildings can use radiant heating systems to maintain comfortable indoor temperatures during the winter months.
example2_zh: 建筑物可以利用辐射供暖系统，在冬季保持舒适的室内温度。
collocations: a radiant smile｜灿烂的笑容 ; radiant heat｜辐射热 ; radiant energy｜辐射能
tip_zh: 形容人常指幸福得容光焕发；radiant heat 指辐射热。

meanings_zh: adj. 连续的；接连的
definition_en: following one after another without a break
example1_en: Heavy rain kept us indoors for three successive days.
example1_zh: 大雨连续三天让我们只能待在室内。
example2_en: Successive governments have invested in public transport, but rural communities still lack reliable bus services.
example2_zh: 历届政府都投资了公共交通，但农村社区仍缺乏可靠的公交服务。
collocations: successive generations｜一代又一代 ; successive governments｜历届政府 ; successive years｜连续多年
tip_zh: successive指接连的；successful才是成功的。

meanings_zh: adj. 独立的；分离的
definition_en: Separate and distinct rather than joined or continuous.
example1_en: We divided the project into three discrete tasks.
example1_zh: 我们把这个项目分成了三项独立的任务。
example2_en: Researchers classified participants into discrete groups to compare the effects of different teaching methods.
example2_zh: 研究人员将参与者分成不同的组，以比较不同教学方法的效果。
collocations: discrete categories｜独立类别 ; discrete units｜独立单元 ; discrete data｜离散数据
tip_zh: 勿混 discreet（谨慎的）；两词读音相同。

meanings_zh: v. 迫害 | v. 纠缠；不断困扰
definition_en: To treat people cruelly because of their beliefs or identity. | To repeatedly trouble someone or treat them unfairly.
example1_en: Her grandparents were persecuted because of their religious beliefs.
example1_zh: 她的祖父母曾因宗教信仰受到迫害。
example2_en: Governments must protect minority communities and ensure that nobody is persecuted for peacefully expressing their beliefs.
example2_zh: 政府必须保护少数群体，确保没有人因和平表达信念而遭受迫害。
collocations: religiously persecuted｜因宗教而受迫害 ; persecute minorities｜迫害少数群体 ; persecuted for their beliefs｜因信仰而受迫害
tip_zh: persecute指迫害；prosecute指依法起诉。

meanings_zh: n. 融合；结合 | n. 核聚变
definition_en: the joining of different things into a single whole | the joining of light atomic nuclei, releasing energy
example1_en: Her cooking is a fusion of different regional styles.
example1_zh: 她的烹饪融合了不同地区的风格。
example2_en: Scientists are investigating nuclear fusion as a potential source of abundant energy with low carbon emissions.
example2_zh: 科学家正在研究核聚变，将其视为一种潜在的、供应充足且碳排放低的能源。
collocations: a fusion of styles｜多种风格的融合 ; fusion cuisine｜融合菜 ; nuclear fusion｜核聚变
tip_zh: 核聚变用fusion；核裂变用fission，注意区分。

meanings_zh: n. 广度；范围 | n. 宽度
definition_en: The wide range of things something includes. | The distance from one side of something to the other.
example1_en: The breadth of her interests always surprises her friends.
example1_zh: 她的兴趣之广总让朋友们感到惊讶。
example2_en: Universities should balance breadth of knowledge with opportunities for students to develop expertise in a chosen field.
example2_zh: 大学应兼顾知识的广度，并为学生提供在所选领域发展专长的机会。
collocations: breadth of knowledge｜知识的广度 ; breadth of experience｜阅历的丰富程度 ; breadth and depth｜广度与深度
tip_zh: breadth强调广度；depth强调深度，二者常并列。

meanings_zh: v. 稀释；冲淡 | v. 削弱；减弱 | adj. 稀释的；浓度低的
definition_en: To make a liquid weaker by adding water or another liquid. | To reduce the strength, quality, or influence of something. | Containing a relatively small amount of a substance in liquid.
example1_en: Dilute the juice with water before giving it to children.
example1_zh: 给孩子喝果汁前，先加水稀释。
example2_en: Excessive commercial involvement may dilute the educational value of programmes designed for young television viewers.
example2_zh: 过多的商业介入可能削弱面向青少年观众的电视节目的教育价值。
collocations: dilute with water｜用水稀释 ; a dilute solution｜稀溶液 ; dilute the impact｜削弱影响
tip_zh: dilute A with B表示用液体B稀释A。

meanings_zh: n. 囚犯；服刑人员
definition_en: A person who is kept in a prison.
example1_en: Each inmate can borrow books from the prison library.
example1_zh: 每位服刑人员都可以从监狱图书馆借书。
example2_en: Providing inmates with vocational training may improve their employment prospects and reduce the risk of reoffending.
example2_zh: 为服刑人员提供职业培训可能改善其就业前景，降低再次犯罪的风险。
collocations: prison inmate｜监狱服刑人员 ; inmate rehabilitation｜服刑人员改造 ; former inmate｜曾服刑者
tip_zh: 现代通常指囚犯，不可用来泛指室友或居民。

meanings_zh: n. 轻蔑；鄙视 | n. 藐视法庭
definition_en: A strong feeling that someone or something deserves no respect | Behaviour that disobeys a court or disrespects its authority
example1_en: He showed contempt for my suggestion by laughing.
example1_zh: 他用嘲笑来表示对我建议的轻蔑。
example2_en: When officials treat public concerns with contempt, trust in democratic institutions can decline significantly.
example2_zh: 当官员轻视公众的关切时，人们对民主制度的信任可能显著下降。
collocations: contempt for｜对……的鄙视 ; treat someone with contempt｜轻蔑地对待某人 ; contempt of court｜藐视法庭
tip_zh: contempt for指鄙视某人或某事；通常不可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 诱人得难以抗拒的 | adj. 无法抵挡的
definition_en: so attractive that you cannot refuse or avoid it | too strong or powerful to resist
example1_en: The smell of freshly baked bread was irresistible.
example1_zh: 刚烤好的面包香气让人无法抗拒。
example2_en: Online retailers use personalised recommendations to make certain products seem irresistible to potential customers.
example2_zh: 网络零售商利用个性化推荐，让某些商品对潜在顾客显得极具吸引力。
collocations: irresistible temptation｜无法抗拒的诱惑 ; irresistible urge｜难以抑制的冲动 ; irresistible charm｜难以抗拒的魅力
tip_zh: 常形容魅力、诱惑或冲动强烈得令人无法抗拒。

meanings_zh: n. 效率低下；低效现象
definition_en: failure to use time, money, or resources well
example1_en: The kitchen's inefficiency left everyone waiting for dinner.
example1_zh: 厨房效率低下，让大家一直等着吃晚饭。
example2_en: Investment in modern equipment can reduce inefficiency and improve productivity across the manufacturing sector.
example2_zh: 投资现代化设备能够减少低效现象，提高整个制造业的生产率。
collocations: operational inefficiency｜运营效率低下 ; reduce inefficiency｜减少低效现象 ; administrative inefficiency｜行政效率低下
tip_zh: 指浪费时间或资源，不等于个人完全无能。

meanings_zh: n. 通信；往来信件 | n. 一致；对应关系
definition_en: Written communication between people, or the messages they exchange. | A close similarity or connection between two things.
example1_en: She keeps her correspondence with her cousin in a drawer.
example1_zh: 她把与表亲的往来信件放在抽屉里。
example2_en: Historical correspondence can reveal how ordinary families experienced social changes that official records describe only briefly.
example2_zh: 历史上的往来信件能揭示普通家庭如何经历官方记录仅简略提及的社会变迁。
collocations: correspondence with someone｜与某人的通信 ; business correspondence｜商务信函 ; correspondence between｜……之间的对应关系
tip_zh: 表示往来信件时不可数；与某人通信用with。

meanings_zh: v. 厌恶；憎恨
definition_en: to dislike someone or something very strongly
example1_en: I detest waiting outside in the freezing rain.
example1_zh: 我非常讨厌在冰冷的雨中站在外面等候。
example2_en: Many commuters detest overcrowded trains, yet they have few affordable alternatives for travelling to work.
example2_zh: 许多通勤者十分厌恶拥挤的列车，却很少有其他负担得起的上班出行方式。
collocations: detest doing something｜厌恶做某事 ; detest violence｜憎恶暴力 ; absolutely detest｜极其厌恶
tip_zh: 后接名词或动名词：detest doing，不接to do。

meanings_zh: n. 背叛；出卖
definition_en: An act that breaks someone's trust or loyalty.
example1_en: Sharing my private diary felt like a terrible betrayal.
example1_zh: 把我的私人日记给别人看，让我觉得遭到了严重的背叛。
example2_en: Many voters regard broken election promises as a betrayal of the trust they place in political leaders.
example2_zh: 许多选民把不兑现竞选承诺视为对他们给予政治领导人的信任的背叛。
collocations: a betrayal of trust｜辜负信任 ; a sense of betrayal｜被背叛的感觉 ; an act of betrayal｜背叛行为
tip_zh: 通常指辜负信任；并非一般意义上的“暴露”。

meanings_zh: n. 摇篮 | n. 发源地；发祥地 | v. 轻轻抱着；托住
definition_en: A small bed for a baby that can rock. | The place where something important first developed. | Hold someone or something gently and protectively.
example1_en: The baby slept peacefully in a wooden cradle.
example1_zh: 宝宝在木摇篮里安静地睡着。
example2_en: The region is often described as a cradle of agriculture because of its early farming settlements.
example2_zh: 由于拥有早期的农耕聚落，这一地区常被称为农业的发源地。
collocations: rock a cradle｜摇动摇篮 ; the cradle of civilisation｜文明的发源地 ; cradle a baby｜轻轻抱着婴儿
tip_zh: the cradle of 可比喻某种文明或活动的发源地。

meanings_zh: v. 发出尖叫；发出刺耳声 | n. 尖叫声；刺耳长声 | v. 告密
definition_en: to make a long, high, sharp sound | a long, high, sharp cry or noise | to tell an authority about someone else's wrongdoing
example1_en: The children squealed with delight as the puppy appeared.
example1_zh: 小狗一出现，孩子们就高兴得尖叫起来。
example2_en: Residents reported that train wheels often squeal on sharp bends, causing noise disturbance in nearby homes.
example2_zh: 居民反映，火车车轮在急弯处经常发出刺耳声响，干扰附近住户的生活。
collocations: squeal with delight｜高兴得尖叫 ; a squeal of excitement｜兴奋的尖叫声 ; squeal on someone｜告发某人
tip_zh: 表示“告密”属非正式用法，常用squeal on sb。

meanings_zh: adj. 爱国的
definition_en: Showing love for and pride in your country.
example1_en: My grandfather enjoys singing patriotic songs during national celebrations.
example1_zh: 祖父喜欢在全国性庆典期间唱爱国歌曲。
example2_en: Patriotic feeling can encourage community service, but it should not prevent citizens from questioning government policies.
example2_zh: 爱国情怀可以鼓励社区服务，但不应妨碍公民质疑政府政策。
collocations: patriotic pride｜爱国自豪感 ; patriotic songs｜爱国歌曲 ; patriotic duty｜爱国责任
tip_zh: patriotic强调爱国，不必然含排斥他国之意。

meanings_zh: adj. 粗俗的；下流的 | adj. 俗气的；庸俗的
definition_en: Rude or offensive, especially in language or behaviour. | Lacking good taste, especially through excessive display.
example1_en: His vulgar joke made everyone at dinner uncomfortable.
example1_zh: 他的粗俗笑话让餐桌上的每个人都感到不自在。
example2_en: Some viewers argue that vulgar humour on television can encourage disrespectful behaviour among younger audiences.
example2_zh: 一些观众认为，电视上的粗俗幽默可能会助长年轻观众不尊重他人的行为。
collocations: vulgar language｜粗俗的语言 ; vulgar joke｜下流的笑话 ; vulgar display of wealth｜俗气的炫富行为
tip_zh: 现代常用义带贬义，不宜用来表示“普通的”。

meanings_zh: adj. 不识字的；文盲的 | adj. 缺乏某领域知识的
definition_en: Unable to read or write. | Lacking basic knowledge or skills in a particular area.
example1_en: Her grandfather was illiterate but told wonderful bedtime stories.
example1_zh: 她的祖父虽然不识字，却很会讲睡前故事。
example2_en: Free adult education can help illiterate citizens develop essential skills and participate more fully in society.
example2_zh: 免费的成人教育能够帮助不识字的公民掌握基本技能，更充分地参与社会生活。
collocations: illiterate adults｜不识字的成年人 ; computer illiterate｜不懂电脑的 ; financially illiterate｜缺乏金融常识的
tip_zh: 名词用法易显贬义，宜用形容词客观描述。

meanings_zh: adj. 过度痴迷的；执念的
definition_en: Thinking about something constantly and finding it difficult to stop.
example1_en: His obsessive checking of the weather delayed our picnic.
example1_zh: 他没完没了地查看天气，耽误了我们的野餐。
example2_en: Obsessive concern about academic performance can prevent students from maintaining healthy friendships and enjoying leisure activities.
example2_zh: 过度关注学业表现可能会妨碍学生维持健康的友谊和享受休闲活动。
collocations: obsessive behaviour｜执念行为 ; obsessive concern｜过度关注 ; obsessive about details｜过度纠结细节
tip_zh: 比interested强得多，常含过度、难以自控之意。

meanings_zh: n. 否定；否认 | n. 否定表达
definition_en: the act of denying something or stating its opposite | the grammatical expression that something is not true or present
example1_en: His firm headshake was a clear negation of my suggestion.
example1_zh: 他坚决地摇了摇头，明确否定了我的建议。
example2_en: In language teaching, understanding negation helps learners distinguish between statements that affirm facts and those that deny them.
example2_zh: 在语言教学中，理解否定表达有助于学习者区分肯定事实与否认事实的陈述。
collocations: complete negation｜彻底否定 ; negation of a claim｜对某说法的否定 ; double negation｜双重否定
tip_zh: 偏正式；语法中指否定，日常说拒绝多用refusal。

meanings_zh: n. 发酵
definition_en: Microbial breakdown of sugars into substances such as acids or alcohol.
example1_en: Tiny bubbles appeared in the jar as fermentation began.
example1_zh: 发酵开始时，罐子里出现了细小的气泡。
example2_en: Fermentation can extend the shelf life of certain foods while also changing their flavour and texture.
example2_zh: 发酵可以延长某些食品的保质期，同时改变其风味和质地。
collocations: the fermentation process｜发酵过程 ; lactic acid fermentation｜乳酸发酵 ; controlled fermentation｜受控发酵
tip_zh: 通常为不可数名词；动词是ferment。

meanings_zh: n. 消除；排除 | n. 淘汰
definition_en: the complete removal of something unwanted or unnecessary | the removal of a competitor from a competition
example1_en: Regular cleaning helps with the elimination of unpleasant kitchen smells.
example1_zh: 定期清洁有助于消除厨房里的难闻气味。
example2_en: The elimination of unnecessary packaging could significantly reduce household waste and lower the environmental impact of shopping.
example2_zh: 消除不必要的包装可以显著减少生活垃圾，降低购物对环境的影响。
collocations: elimination of waste｜消除浪费 ; process of elimination｜排除法 ; face elimination｜面临淘汰 ; complete elimination｜彻底消除
tip_zh: 动词是eliminate；by elimination表示“用排除法”。

meanings_zh: v. 使疏远；使失去支持
definition_en: Make someone feel unwelcome or unwilling to support you
example1_en: His constant complaints alienated even his closest friends.
example1_zh: 他不停地抱怨，连最亲近的朋友都疏远了他。
example2_en: Public transport policies may alienate residents if local authorities fail to explain their benefits clearly.
example2_zh: 如果地方政府未能清楚解释公共交通政策的好处，这些政策可能会失去居民的支持。
collocations: alienate voters｜失去选民的支持 ; alienate customers｜使顾客疏远 ; alienate someone from｜使某人与……疏远
tip_zh: 常指使人疏远或失去支持，不表示挪用。

meanings_zh: v. 悬停；盘旋 | v. 在附近徘徊 | v. 在某水平上下浮动
definition_en: Stay in one place in the air. | Stay nearby, often waiting or watching. | Remain close to a particular level or amount.
example1_en: A small helicopter hovered above the empty field.
example1_zh: 一架小型直升机悬停在空旷的田野上方。
example2_en: When unemployment rates hover around current levels, governments may need to invest more in vocational training.
example2_zh: 当失业率在当前水平附近徘徊时，政府可能需要加大职业培训投入。
collocations: hover overhead｜在头顶悬停 ; hover nearby｜在附近徘徊 ; hover around a level｜在某水平附近波动
tip_zh: 核心是停留不去，不等于soar（翱翔）。

meanings_zh: n. 熟练；精通
definition_en: A high level of skill or ability in something.
example1_en: Her proficiency in French helped us order dinner easily.
example1_zh: 她熟练掌握法语，让我们轻松点好了晚餐。
example2_en: Universities often require evidence of English proficiency to ensure students can participate fully in academic discussions.
example2_zh: 大学通常要求提供英语能力证明，以确保学生能够充分参与学术讨论。
collocations: proficiency in English｜英语熟练程度 ; language proficiency｜语言能力 ; proficiency test｜水平测试 ; demonstrate proficiency｜展示熟练技能
tip_zh: 常用proficiency in接语言、学科或技能。

meanings_zh: adj. 由此产生的 | n. 合力；合向量
definition_en: Happening or existing as a result of something else. | A single vector equivalent to two or more combined vectors.
example1_en: A pipe burst, and the resultant flood ruined our carpet.
example1_zh: 一根水管爆裂，由此造成的积水毁了我们的地毯。
example2_en: Rapid urban growth and the resultant demand for housing have placed considerable pressure on local infrastructure.
example2_zh: 城市快速发展及其带来的住房需求，给当地基础设施造成了巨大压力。
collocations: the resultant damage｜由此造成的损害 ; the resultant increase｜由此产生的增长 ; resultant force｜合力
tip_zh: 较正式，常置于名词前；日常更常用resulting。

meanings_zh: adj. 结构的；构造的
definition_en: Relating to how something is built or its parts are arranged.
example1_en: The builder found structural damage beneath the kitchen floor.
example1_zh: 建筑工人在厨房地板下面发现了结构性损坏。
example2_en: Reducing long-term unemployment requires structural changes to the economy rather than temporary financial support alone.
example2_zh: 减少长期失业需要对经济进行结构性调整，而不能仅靠临时资金支持。
collocations: structural damage｜结构性损坏 ; structural change｜结构性变化 ; structural engineering｜结构工程 ; structural reform｜结构性改革
tip_zh: 既可指建筑结构，也可指经济、制度等的结构。

meanings_zh: v. 隔离；实行种族隔离 | v. 分开；分类存放
definition_en: To keep people apart based on race or other characteristics. | To separate things into different groups or locations.
example1_en: The club refused to segregate children by family income.
example1_zh: 这家俱乐部拒绝按家庭收入将孩子分开。
example2_en: Schools that segregate pupils by social background may reinforce inequality rather than promote mutual understanding.
example2_zh: 按社会背景隔离学生的学校可能会加剧不平等，而非促进相互理解。
collocations: segregate by race｜按种族隔离 ; segregate waste｜将废物分类 ; racially segregated schools｜实行种族隔离的学校
tip_zh: segregate A from B指把A与B隔离。

meanings_zh: n. 一时的狂热；风靡
definition_en: an activity or fashion that becomes extremely popular briefly
example1_en: The latest dance craze has everyone moving at parties.
example1_zh: 最新的舞蹈热潮让大家在聚会上都跳了起来。
example2_en: Social media can turn a local fashion into a global craze within a remarkably short period.
example2_zh: 社交媒体能在极短的时间内将一种地方时尚变成全球热潮。
collocations: the latest craze｜最新热潮 ; a craze for something｜对某事物的狂热 ; a fitness craze｜健身热潮
tip_zh: 强调短期风靡；常用a craze for加名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 严峻的；令人担忧的 | adj. 严肃冷峻的 | adj. 阴冷难受的；糟糕的
definition_en: very serious and giving little reason for hope | looking very serious, worried, or determined | unpleasant, depressing, or uncomfortable
example1_en: The flood left a grim scene outside our house.
example1_zh: 洪水过后，我们屋外一片惨淡。
example2_en: Without urgent investment in water infrastructure, the outlook for communities facing prolonged drought remains grim.
example2_zh: 如果不紧急投资供水基础设施，长期受干旱影响的社区前景仍然严峻。
