collocations: a grim outlook｜严峻的前景 ; a grim reality｜残酷的现实 ; a grim expression｜冷峻的表情 ; a grim reminder｜令人警醒的提醒
tip_zh: 常形容前景、现实或表情，强调沉重而非普通的不悦。

meanings_zh: n. 先驱；前身 | n. 前兆
definition_en: Someone or something that comes before and influences a later development. | Something that signals the arrival of a later event.
example1_en: This bulky machine was a forerunner of today's laptops.
example1_zh: 这台笨重的机器是如今笔记本电脑的前身。
example2_en: Early public libraries were forerunners of modern community centres, offering shared spaces for learning and discussion.
example2_zh: 早期公共图书馆是现代社区中心的前身，为学习和讨论提供了公共空间。
collocations: a forerunner of｜……的前身 ; a forerunner to｜……的先驱 ; an early forerunner｜早期先驱
tip_zh: 常用a forerunner of；不指比赛中领先的人。

meanings_zh: n. 一千年 | n. 千禧年；千年之交
definition_en: A period of one thousand years. | The point when one thousand-year period ends and another begins.
example1_en: This ancient tree has survived for over a millennium.
example1_zh: 这棵古树已经存活了一千多年。
example2_en: Over the past millennium, advances in agriculture have transformed how societies produce food and support growing populations.
example2_zh: 在过去的一千年里，农业进步改变了社会生产粮食和养活不断增长的人口的方式。
collocations: the past millennium｜过去的一千年 ; the turn of the millennium｜千年之交 ; millennium celebrations｜千禧年庆祝活动
tip_zh: 注意双写l和n；复数常用millennia。

meanings_zh: adj. 陈旧过时的
definition_en: too old or outdated to be suitable for modern use
example1_en: The office still relies on an antiquated heating system.
example1_zh: 这间办公室仍然依赖一套陈旧过时的供暖系统。
example2_en: Replacing antiquated railway infrastructure could improve passenger safety and reduce delays across the national transport network.
example2_zh: 更换陈旧的铁路基础设施，可以提高乘客安全水平，并减少全国交通网络的延误。
collocations: antiquated equipment｜陈旧的设备 ; antiquated system｜过时的系统 ; antiquated laws｜过时的法律
tip_zh: 含贬义，强调旧到不合时宜；antique可指珍贵古物。

meanings_zh: n. 军团；兵种部队 | n. 专业工作团体
definition_en: a large military unit or branch with particular duties | an organized group of people doing the same specialized work
example1_en: My cousin joined the medical corps after finishing university.
example1_zh: 我表亲大学毕业后加入了军队医疗部队。
example2_en: The diplomatic corps can support international cooperation by maintaining communication between governments during periods of tension.
example2_zh: 外交使团可以在紧张时期维持政府之间的沟通，从而支持国际合作。
collocations: medical corps｜军队医疗部队 ; diplomatic corps｜外交使团 ; press corps｜记者团
tip_zh: 单复数拼写相同；单数不读ps，复数词尾读/z/。

meanings_zh: n. 楔子；楔形物 | v. 楔住；塞入
definition_en: An object thick at one end and thin at the other. | To push something tightly into a narrow space.
example1_en: He slid a wooden wedge under the heavy door.
example1_zh: 他把一个木楔塞到沉重的门下面。
example2_en: Disagreements over resource allocation can drive a wedge between neighbouring communities and weaken regional cooperation.
example2_zh: 资源分配上的分歧可能导致相邻社区失和，并削弱区域合作。
collocations: a wooden wedge｜木楔 ; a wedge of cheese｜一块楔形奶酪 ; wedge the door open｜用楔子撑住门 ; drive a wedge between｜使……之间产生隔阂
tip_zh: drive a wedge between 比喻挑起隔阂或分裂。

meanings_zh: n. 啤酒厂
definition_en: A place where beer is produced commercially.
example1_en: The old brewery has become a popular local museum.
example1_zh: 那座旧啤酒厂已成为当地一座受欢迎的博物馆。
example2_en: Converting a historic brewery into a cultural centre can preserve industrial heritage while creating new employment opportunities.
example2_zh: 将历史悠久的啤酒厂改建为文化中心，既能保护工业遗产，也能创造新的就业机会。
collocations: local brewery｜当地啤酒厂 ; craft brewery｜精酿啤酒厂 ; brewery tour｜啤酒厂参观
tip_zh: 通常指啤酒厂；葡萄酒庄是winery。

meanings_zh: v. 发起；启动 | v. 使入门；接纳入会
definition_en: To cause a process or activity to begin. | To introduce someone to an activity or admit them to a group.
example1_en: Someone needs to initiate a conversation about the noise.
example1_zh: 得有人先开口谈谈噪声问题。
example2_en: Local authorities should initiate programmes that encourage residents to recycle household waste more effectively.
example2_zh: 地方政府应启动相关项目，鼓励居民更有效地回收生活垃圾。
collocations: initiate negotiations｜发起谈判 ; initiate a project｜启动项目 ; initiate someone into｜使某人入门
tip_zh: 作动词较正式；initiate sb into指使入门。

meanings_zh: n. 学位论文；专题论文
definition_en: A long research paper written as part of a university degree
example1_en: My sister is writing her dissertation at the library.
example1_zh: 我姐姐正在图书馆写学位论文。
example2_en: Writing a dissertation requires students to evaluate existing research and develop a clear argument supported by evidence.
example2_zh: 撰写学位论文要求学生评估已有研究，并提出有证据支持的清晰论点。
collocations: write a dissertation｜撰写学位论文 ; submit a dissertation｜提交学位论文 ; a doctoral dissertation｜博士论文 ; a dissertation on education｜关于教育的学位论文
tip_zh: 主题用on引出；美式常指博士论文，英式范围较广。

meanings_zh: v. 哀悼；为失去而悲痛
definition_en: To feel or express deep sadness after a death or loss.
example1_en: Neighbours gathered quietly to mourn their much-loved friend.
example1_zh: 邻居们静静地聚在一起，悼念他们深爱的朋友。
example2_en: Public memorials provide spaces where communities can mourn those they have lost and reflect on shared history.
example2_zh: 公共纪念场所让社区居民得以悼念逝者，并回顾共同的历史。
collocations: mourn someone's death｜哀悼某人的去世 ; mourn the loss of｜为失去……而悲痛 ; mourn for someone｜悼念某人
tip_zh: 可直接接逝者或损失，也可用mourn for sb。

meanings_zh: n. 局；处；办事机构 | n. 翻盖书桌；五斗柜
definition_en: an office or organisation providing information or managing particular activities | a desk with a folding cover, or an American chest of drawers
example1_en: The tourist bureau gave us a free city map.
example1_zh: 旅游咨询处给了我们一张免费的城市地图。
example2_en: A national statistics bureau collects reliable data that governments use to plan public services.
example2_zh: 国家统计局收集可靠数据，供政府规划公共服务之用。
collocations: tourist bureau｜旅游咨询处 ; statistics bureau｜统计局 ; news bureau｜新闻分社
tip_zh: 复数可用bureaux或bureaus；家具义有英美差异。

meanings_zh: n. 航空；航空业
definition_en: The activity or industry of flying and operating aircraft.
example1_en: Her interest in aviation began with a flying lesson.
example1_zh: 她对航空的兴趣始于一堂飞行课。
example2_en: The aviation industry faces pressure to reduce emissions while meeting growing demand for international travel.
example2_zh: 航空业面临着既要减少排放，又要满足不断增长的国际旅行需求的压力。
collocations: civil aviation｜民用航空 ; aviation industry｜航空业 ; aviation safety｜航空安全
tip_zh: 不可数名词，常指飞行活动或整个航空业。

meanings_zh: n. 退款；退税；返还款
definition_en: Money returned after you pay for something or pay tax
example1_en: We received a rebate after buying our new fridge.
example1_zh: 我们买了新冰箱后收到了一笔返款。
example2_en: Governments can offer a tax rebate to encourage households to install insulation and reduce energy consumption.
example2_zh: 政府可以通过退税，鼓励家庭安装隔热材料并减少能源消耗。
collocations: a tax rebate｜退税 ; claim a rebate｜申请退款 ; receive a rebate｜收到返款 ; offer a rebate｜提供返款优惠
tip_zh: rebate通常是付款后返还，discount通常是付款时减价。

meanings_zh: n. 阀；阀门 | n. 瓣膜
definition_en: a device controlling the flow of liquid or gas | a body structure keeping fluid moving in one direction
example1_en: Turn this valve to stop water entering the tank.
example1_zh: 转动这个阀门，阻止水流入水箱。
example2_en: Replacing damaged heart valves can improve patients' quality of life and reduce the risk of serious complications.
example2_zh: 更换受损的心脏瓣膜可以改善患者的生活质量，并降低严重并发症的风险。
collocations: open a valve｜打开阀门 ; a safety valve｜安全阀 ; a heart valve｜心脏瓣膜 ; a pressure relief valve｜泄压阀
tip_zh: 工程中指阀门，人体中可指心脏等部位的瓣膜。

meanings_zh: n. 铰链；合页 | v. 取决于
definition_en: a joint that allows a door or lid to swing | to depend entirely on something, used with on or upon
example1_en: The rusty hinge squeaks whenever I open the cupboard.
example1_zh: 每次我打开橱柜，生锈的合页都会吱吱作响。
example2_en: The success of public transport reforms may hinge on reliable funding and sustained support from local residents.
example2_zh: 公共交通改革的成功可能取决于可靠的资金来源和当地居民的持续支持。
collocations: door hinge｜门合页 ; rusty hinge｜生锈的铰链 ; hinge on｜取决于
tip_zh: hinge on 后接名词或从句，表示“取决于”。

meanings_zh: v. 飘动；振翅；颤动 | n. 颤动；心悸
definition_en: Move with quick, light movements, especially through air | A quick, light movement or brief uneven heartbeat
example1_en: The curtains fluttered gently beside the open kitchen window.
example1_zh: 窗帘在敞开的厨房窗边轻轻飘动。
example2_en: Butterflies flutter among native flowers in urban gardens, demonstrating how small green spaces can support biodiversity.
example2_zh: 蝴蝶在城市花园的本土花卉间翩翩飞舞，展示了小型绿地如何支持生物多样性。
collocations: flutter in the breeze｜在微风中飘动 ; flutter its wings｜振动翅膀 ; a flutter of excitement｜一阵激动
tip_zh: 强调轻而快的反复运动，可用于翅膀、布料或心跳。

meanings_zh: n. 等级制度；层级结构 | n. 统治集团；领导层
definition_en: A system arranging people or things by rank or importance | The people holding the highest positions in an organisation
example1_en: There is a clear hierarchy among the restaurant staff.
example1_zh: 这家餐厅的员工之间有明确的等级关系。
example2_en: A rigid workplace hierarchy may discourage junior employees from sharing ideas that could improve organisational performance.
example2_zh: 僵化的职场等级制度可能使基层员工不愿分享有助于改善组织绩效的想法。
collocations: a rigid hierarchy｜严格的等级制度 ; organisational hierarchy｜组织层级结构 ; a hierarchy of needs｜需求层次 ; the top of the hierarchy｜等级体系的顶层
tip_zh: 既可指等级结构，也可指组织的最高领导层。

meanings_zh: adj. 放射状的；径向的
definition_en: Arranged along lines spreading out from a central point.
example1_en: The wheel's radial spokes gleamed in the afternoon sun.
example1_zh: 车轮上呈放射状的辐条在午后的阳光下闪闪发亮。
example2_en: A radial road network connects outer residential districts directly to the city centre.
example2_zh: 放射状道路网将外围住宅区直接连接到市中心。
collocations: radial pattern｜放射状图案 ; radial symmetry｜辐射对称 ; radial road network｜放射状道路网
tip_zh: 强调从中心向外延伸，不泛指与光线有关。

meanings_zh: v. 放大声音或信号 | v. 增强；扩大影响 | v. 详述；补充说明
definition_en: to make a sound or electrical signal stronger | to increase the strength or effect of something | to explain something further by adding details
example1_en: This small speaker amplifies music from my phone.
example1_zh: 这个小音箱把我手机播放的音乐放大了。
example2_en: Social media can amplify public concerns about pollution, encouraging local authorities to respond more quickly.
example2_zh: 社交媒体能够放大公众对污染的担忧，促使地方政府更迅速地回应。
collocations: amplify sound｜放大声音 ; amplify a signal｜放大信号 ; amplify the effect｜增强效果
tip_zh: 既可放大实际声音，也可增强影响或情绪。

meanings_zh: n. 积压的工作；待处理订单
definition_en: work or orders waiting to be dealt with
example1_en: I stayed late to clear a backlog of emails.
example1_zh: 我加班到很晚，清理积压的邮件。
example2_en: Hiring additional staff could help hospitals reduce the backlog of patients waiting for routine operations.
example2_zh: 增聘工作人员可以帮助医院减少等候常规手术的积压患者人数。
collocations: clear a backlog｜清理积压 ; a backlog of orders｜积压的订单 ; reduce the backlog｜减少积压 ; a growing backlog｜不断增加的积压
tip_zh: 常用a backlog of，指本应处理却积压的事项。

meanings_zh: n. 清除；清理 | n. 正式许可；批准 | n. 清仓甩卖
definition_en: The removal of unwanted objects or material from a place | Official permission to do something or enter a place | The sale of remaining goods at reduced prices
example1_en: The garden clearance took us most of Saturday.
example1_zh: 清理花园花了我们周六大半天的时间。
example2_en: Large-scale forest clearance can destroy wildlife habitats and increase the risk of soil erosion.
example2_zh: 大规模森林清除会破坏野生动物栖息地，并增加水土流失的风险。
collocations: forest clearance｜森林清除 ; security clearance｜安全审查许可 ; customs clearance｜清关 ; clearance sale｜清仓甩卖
tip_zh: clearance sale是清仓促销；清关用customs clearance。

meanings_zh: n. 起义；暴动
definition_en: An organised attempt by a population to resist those in power.
example1_en: The museum displays objects from a local uprising.
example1_zh: 博物馆展出了当地一次起义留下的物品。
example2_en: Historians argue that food shortages and political exclusion contributed to the uprising against the ruling authorities.
example2_zh: 历史学家认为，粮食短缺和政治排斥促成了反抗统治当局的起义。
collocations: a popular uprising｜民众起义 ; an armed uprising｜武装起义 ; suppress an uprising｜镇压起义
tip_zh: 通常指反抗统治者的起义，不用于日常的起床或上升。

meanings_zh: adj. 温馨舒适的；家常的 | adj. 相貌平平的；不好看的
definition_en: simple and comfortable in a way that feels like home | not physically attractive, especially in American English
example1_en: The little café felt homely, with cushions on every chair.
example1_zh: 这家小咖啡馆很温馨，每把椅子上都有软垫。
example2_en: A homely atmosphere in residential care facilities may help older people feel more comfortable and secure.
example2_zh: 养老照护机构中温馨的氛围可能让老年人感到更舒适、更安心。
collocations: homely atmosphere｜温馨的氛围 ; homely surroundings｜舒适如家的环境 ; homely face｜平凡的面容
tip_zh: 英式常指温馨；美式常指不好看，形容人要谨慎。

meanings_zh: n. 精密；复杂程度 | n. 老练；世故；高雅
definition_en: the quality of being advanced or carefully developed | knowledge of social situations, culture, and fashionable tastes
example1_en: I was surprised by the sophistication of her camera.
example1_zh: 她的相机如此精密，让我很惊讶。
example2_en: The growing sophistication of medical equipment allows doctors to identify certain diseases at an earlier stage.
example2_zh: 医疗设备日益精密，使医生能够在更早阶段发现某些疾病。
collocations: technological sophistication｜技术先进程度 ; a high degree of sophistication｜高度精密 ; social sophistication｜社交上的老练
tip_zh: 不可数名词；既指技术精密，也指处世老练。

meanings_zh: v. 为……报仇；雪耻
definition_en: to punish someone for harm done to yourself or others
example1_en: Our team hopes to avenge last year's defeat.
example1_zh: 我们队希望一雪去年败北之耻。
example2_en: Historical narratives often portray leaders seeking to avenge past defeats rather than negotiate lasting peace.
example2_zh: 历史叙事常描写领导者寻求报复过去的失败，而非通过谈判实现持久和平。
collocations: avenge a defeat｜一雪败北之耻 ; avenge a wrong｜报复不公待遇
tip_zh: avenge是动词，常接所受伤害；revenge常作名词。

meanings_zh: v. 授予；赐予
definition_en: To formally give someone an honour, gift, or benefit.
example1_en: The club bestowed a special award on our coach.
example1_zh: 俱乐部向我们的教练颁发了一项特别奖。
example2_en: Universities often bestow honorary degrees on individuals who have made outstanding contributions to society.
example2_zh: 大学常向为社会作出杰出贡献的人士授予荣誉学位。
collocations: bestow an honour on｜授予……荣誉 ; bestow a gift on｜向……赠礼 ; bestow a title upon｜授予……称号
tip_zh: 正式用语：bestow sth on/upon sb。

meanings_zh: v. 强烈谴责；痛惜
definition_en: To strongly disapprove of something or deeply regret it
example1_en: Our neighbours deplore the dumping of rubbish beside the river.
example1_zh: 邻居们强烈谴责在河边倾倒垃圾的行为。
example2_en: Many educators deplore funding cuts that limit access to music and art lessons in public schools.
example2_zh: 许多教育工作者强烈反对削减经费，因为这限制了公立学校学生接受音乐和美术教育的机会。
collocations: deplore violence｜强烈谴责暴力 ; deplore the lack of｜对缺乏……深感遗憾 ; deplore the decision｜强烈反对该决定
tip_zh: 正式及物动词，后直接接所谴责或痛惜的事。

meanings_zh: n. 固定伤肢的夹板 | v. 用夹板固定
definition_en: A rigid support that keeps an injured body part still. | To support an injured body part with a splint.
example1_en: The nurse fitted a splint to my injured finger.
example1_zh: 护士给我受伤的手指装上了夹板。
example2_en: Using a splint to stabilise an injured limb can prevent further damage while patients await medical treatment.
example2_zh: 在患者等待医疗救治时，用夹板固定受伤的肢体可以防止进一步损伤。
collocations: wear a splint｜戴夹板 ; apply a splint｜上夹板 ; a wrist splint｜腕部夹板
tip_zh: 指固定伤处的夹板；不同于石膏固定用的cast。

meanings_zh: n. 步兵；步兵部队
definition_en: soldiers trained to fight on foot
example1_en: The infantry marched past our village early this morning.
example1_zh: 今天一大早，步兵部队行军经过了我们的村庄。
example2_en: Although military technology has changed considerably, infantry still play an important role in many countries' defence forces.
example2_zh: 尽管军事技术发生了巨大变化，步兵在许多国家的国防力量中仍发挥着重要作用。
collocations: infantry unit｜步兵分队 ; infantry division｜步兵师 ; infantry training｜步兵训练
tip_zh: 集合名词，指步兵整体，不用an infantry指一个人。

meanings_zh: n. 葡萄球菌
definition_en: A round bacterium forming clusters, sometimes causing infections.
example1_en: The laboratory found staphylococcus in the skin sample.
example1_zh: 实验室在皮肤样本中发现了葡萄球菌。
example2_en: Some strains of staphylococcus resist common antibiotics, making hospital infections more difficult to treat.
example2_zh: 某些葡萄球菌菌株对常用抗生素具有耐药性，使医院感染更难治疗。
collocations: staphylococcus infection｜葡萄球菌感染 ; strains of staphylococcus｜葡萄球菌菌株 ; antibiotic-resistant staphylococcus｜耐抗生素葡萄球菌
tip_zh: 复数为staphylococci；常见简称为staph。

meanings_zh: v. 委派；授权
definition_en: to appoint someone to act or perform a task for you
example1_en: The manager deputed her assistant to attend the meeting.
example1_zh: 经理委派她的助理去参加会议。
example2_en: Local authorities may depute trained officers to inspect buildings and ensure compliance with safety regulations.
example2_zh: 地方政府可以委派受过培训的官员检查建筑，确保其符合安全规定。
collocations: depute someone to do something｜委派某人做某事 ; depute a representative｜委派代表
tip_zh: 正式用词，常用depute sb to do sth。

meanings_zh: v. 环绕；笼罩
definition_en: to surround or cover something, especially with smoke or mist
example1_en: Thin wisps of steam wreathed her face above the bowl.
example1_zh: 碗里升起的缕缕蒸汽缭绕在她脸庞周围。
example2_en: Smoke from nearby factories can wreathe residential buildings, highlighting the need for stricter industrial emission controls.
example2_zh: 附近工厂排出的烟雾可能笼罩住宅楼，凸显加强工业排放管控的必要性。
collocations: be wreathed in smoke｜被烟雾笼罩 ; mist wreathes the hills｜薄雾环绕山丘 ; a face wreathed in smiles｜满面笑容
tip_zh: 偏文学用语；wreathe尾音/ð/，wreath尾音/θ/。

meanings_zh: n. 旋涡；涡流 | n. 困境的旋涡
definition_en: A spinning mass of fluid drawing things towards its centre | A situation that pulls people into increasing confusion or difficulty
example1_en: Leaves spun in a vortex beside the riverbank.
example1_zh: 树叶在河岸旁的旋涡中打转。
example2_en: Without access to affordable credit, some households become trapped in a vortex of debt and financial insecurity.
example2_zh: 如果无法获得利率可负担的贷款，一些家庭就会陷入债务与财务不稳定的旋涡。
collocations: a swirling vortex｜盘旋的涡流 ; a vortex of debt｜债务旋涡 ; be sucked into a vortex｜被卷入旋涡
tip_zh: 复数可用vortices或vortexes；也可比喻困境。

meanings_zh: v. 使不可能；阻止；排除
definition_en: to prevent something or make it impossible
example1_en: The heavy rain precluded our planned picnic by the lake.
example1_zh: 大雨让我们原定的湖边野餐无法进行。
example2_en: High tuition fees may preclude students from disadvantaged backgrounds from accessing higher education without financial support.
example2_zh: 高昂的学费可能使弱势家庭的学生在没有经济资助的情况下无法接受高等教育。
collocations: preclude the possibility｜排除可能性 ; preclude someone from doing something｜使某人无法做某事 ; preclude further discussion｜使进一步讨论无法进行
tip_zh: 正式用词；可用preclude sb from doing sth。

meanings_zh: adj. 大量的；过多的
definition_en: Produced or expressed in very large amounts
example1_en: He offered profuse apologies for spilling my tea.
example1_zh: 他打翻了我的茶，连声道歉。
example2_en: Profuse sweating during outdoor exercise can increase fluid loss, making regular water intake particularly important.
example2_zh: 户外运动时大量出汗会增加水分流失，因此定期补水尤为重要。
collocations: profuse apologies｜再三道歉 ; profuse sweating｜大量出汗 ; profuse thanks｜再三感谢
tip_zh: 常修饰出汗、道歉或感谢，强调量大或反复。

meanings_zh: v. 使烦恼；使恼怒
definition_en: To make someone annoyed, worried, or frustrated.
example1_en: The constant dripping from the tap began to vex him.
example1_zh: 水龙头不停滴水，开始让他心烦。
example2_en: Disagreements over how to fund public transport continue to vex policymakers in many growing cities.
example2_zh: 在许多不断发展的城市，公共交通资金来源的分歧仍困扰着政策制定者。
collocations: vex policymakers｜困扰政策制定者 ; a vexed question｜争议难题 ; be vexed by delays｜因延误而烦恼
tip_zh: 较正式的及物动词，日常多用annoy。

meanings_zh: n. 微妙细节；细微差别 | n. 礼节；礼仪细节
definition_en: A small detail or distinction requiring careful understanding | A small convention of polite social behaviour
example1_en: I am still learning the niceties of formal dining.
example1_zh: 我还在学习正式用餐的礼仪细节。
example2_en: Understanding the niceties of legal language is essential when translating international agreements that affect trade and environmental protection.
example2_zh: 翻译涉及贸易和环境保护的国际协议时，理解法律语言的细微差别至关重要。
collocations: the niceties of｜…的微妙细节 ; social niceties｜社交礼节 ; legal niceties｜法律上的细微区别 ; to a nicety｜恰到好处地
tip_zh: 多用复数 niceties，勿直接理解为“美好”。

meanings_zh: v. 歪曲；败坏
definition_en: to distort something good or proper for harmful purposes
example1_en: The coach perverted fair competition by secretly changing the rules.
example1_zh: 教练暗中修改规则，破坏了公平竞争。
example2_en: Political pressure can pervert scientific research when funding depends on producing results that support existing policies.
example2_zh: 当资助取决于研究结果是否支持现行政策时，政治压力可能使科研偏离正轨。
collocations: pervert the course of justice｜妨碍司法公正 ; pervert the truth｜歪曲事实
tip_zh: 动词重音在后；名词重音在前且常含贬义。

meanings_zh: n. 小量偷窃；小额失窃
definition_en: The theft of small amounts or items, especially from workplaces.
example1_en: The shop now locks its stockroom to prevent pilferage.
example1_zh: 这家商店现在把库房锁起来，以防东西被顺手偷走。
example2_en: Retailers can reduce losses from pilferage by improving stock monitoring and providing secure storage for valuable goods.
example2_zh: 零售商可以通过加强库存监控并为贵重商品提供安全储存空间，减少小额失窃造成的损失。
collocations: prevent pilferage｜防止小额偷窃 ; losses from pilferage｜小额失窃造成的损失 ; employee pilferage｜员工小额偷窃
tip_zh: pilferage是不可数名词，不是动词；动词为pilfer。

meanings_zh: adj. 有阳刚之气的；强健的
definition_en: showing strength and energy traditionally associated with men
example1_en: The sculpture portrays a virile athlete lifting a discus.
example1_zh: 这座雕塑刻画了一位举起铁饼、充满阳刚之气的运动员。
example2_en: Advertisements often present a virile male ideal, which may reinforce narrow expectations about men's appearance and behaviour.
example2_zh: 广告常常展示阳刚的理想男性形象，这可能强化对男性外貌和行为的狭隘期待。
collocations: virile image｜阳刚形象 ; virile young man｜强健的年轻男子 ; virile masculinity｜阳刚气概
tip_zh: 不只是“男性的”；强调传统观念中的男性力量与活力。

meanings_zh: n. 专题论著；专论
definition_en: a long, detailed piece of writing about a particular subject
example1_en: I found a dusty treatise on gardening upstairs.
example1_zh: 我在楼上找到了一本落满灰尘的园艺专著。
example2_en: The philosopher's treatise on education argues that practical experience should play a central role in learning.
example2_zh: 这位哲学家的教育论著主张，实践经验应在学习中发挥核心作用。
collocations: a treatise on｜关于……的专论 ; write a treatise｜撰写专论 ; a philosophical treatise｜哲学论著
tip_zh: 常用a treatise on，指系统详尽的专论而非短文。

meanings_zh: v. 推测；猜想 | n. 推测；猜想
definition_en: Form an opinion using limited evidence | An opinion formed without enough evidence to be certain
example1_en: Seeing wet umbrellas, I surmised that it was raining.
example1_zh: 看到湿漉漉的雨伞，我猜外面正在下雨。
example2_en: Researchers surmise that flexible schedules improve employee wellbeing, although stronger evidence is needed to confirm this.
example2_zh: 研究人员推测弹性工作时间能改善员工身心状况，但仍需更有力的证据加以确认。
collocations: surmise that｜推测…… ; surmise from｜根据……推测 ; pure surmise｜纯属猜测
tip_zh: 较正式，强调证据不足；动词常接that从句。

meanings_zh: adj. 可终止的
definition_en: Able to be ended, especially under agreed conditions
example1_en: My rental agreement is terminable with one month's notice.
example1_zh: 我的租约可以提前一个月通知后终止。
example2_en: Employment contracts should be terminable by either party, provided that reasonable notice is given.
example2_zh: 只要给予合理的提前通知，雇佣合同应允许任何一方终止。
collocations: terminable contract｜可终止的合同 ; terminable on notice｜通知后可终止的 ; terminable by either party｜任何一方均可终止的
tip_zh: 正式法律用语，常形容合同；不等于terminal。

meanings_zh: v. 预言；预告
definition_en: say what will happen, especially through claimed spiritual knowledge
example1_en: The old storyteller prophesied that the kingdom would prosper.
example1_zh: 那位年老的说书人预言这个王国会繁荣兴盛。
example2_en: Some early commentators prophesied that television would replace books, but reading has remained an important cultural activity.
example2_zh: 一些早期评论者曾预言电视会取代书籍，但阅读始终是一项重要的文化活动。
collocations: prophesy that｜预言…… ; prophesy disaster｜预言灾难 ; prophesy the future｜预言未来
tip_zh: prophesy是动词，词尾读/saɪ/；名词为prophecy。

meanings_zh: n. 暗示；间接透露
definition_en: An indirect suggestion or indication of something.
example1_en: His sudden silence gave us an intimation of trouble.
example1_zh: 他突然沉默，让我们隐约感到出了问题。
example2_en: The minister's remarks offered the first intimation that funding for public transport might increase.
example2_zh: 部长的讲话首次暗示，公共交通资金可能会增加。
collocations: an intimation of trouble｜麻烦的征兆 ; the first intimation｜最初的暗示 ; give an intimation｜作出暗示
tip_zh: 别与intimacy（亲密）混淆；常接of或that从句。

meanings_zh: adj. 黏的；胶状的
definition_en: Thick and sticky, especially when cooked
example1_en: The glutinous rice stuck firmly to my wooden spoon.
example1_zh: 糯米牢牢地粘在了我的木勺上。
example2_en: Glutinous rice is used in many traditional dishes, reflecting the importance of texture in regional cuisines.
example2_zh: 许多传统菜肴使用糯米，体现了口感在地方饮食中的重要性。
collocations: glutinous rice｜糯米 ; a glutinous texture｜黏稠的质地
tip_zh: glutinous指黏性；糯米本身不含麸质gluten。

meanings_zh: n. 炫耀；摆阔
definition_en: An excessive display of wealth or importance to impress others.
example1_en: Their wedding was warm and cheerful, without any ostentation.
example1_zh: 他们的婚礼温馨愉快，没有丝毫铺张炫耀。
example2_en: The ostentation associated with luxury consumption can intensify social pressure to display wealth rather than save responsibly.
example2_zh: 奢侈消费中的炫富行为可能加剧社会压力，促使人们展示财富而非理性储蓄。
collocations: without ostentation｜毫不铺张炫耀 ; an air of ostentation｜炫耀的气派 ; wealth and ostentation｜财富与摆阔
tip_zh: 不可数名词，通常含贬义，强调故意展示以引人注目。

meanings_zh: n. 子宫颈
definition_en: The narrow lower part of the uterus opening into the vagina.
example1_en: The nurse explained where the cervix is on the model.
example1_zh: 护士在模型上讲解了子宫颈的位置。
example2_en: Regular screening can detect abnormal cells in the cervix before they develop into a serious health problem.
example2_zh: 定期筛查可以在子宫颈异常细胞发展成严重健康问题之前发现它们。
collocations: the cervix of the uterus｜子宫颈 ; cells of the cervix｜子宫颈细胞 ; cancer of the cervix｜子宫颈癌
tip_zh: 通常指子宫颈；cervical 也可表示颈部的。

meanings_zh: n. 暗杀者
definition_en: Someone who murders an important person, often for political reasons.
example1_en: The film's assassinator hid behind a heavy curtain.
example1_zh: 电影中的暗杀者藏在厚重的窗帘后面。
example2_en: The historical account examines the assassinator's motives and the political instability that followed the killing.
example2_zh: 这份历史记述探讨了暗杀者的动机，以及暗杀事件随后引发的政治动荡。
collocations: a would-be assassinator｜企图行刺者 ; the assassinator's motives｜暗杀者的动机
tip_zh: 此词罕见；通常用assassin表示暗杀者。

meanings_zh: n. 蒲式耳（干量单位）
definition_en: A unit of dry volume used especially for grain.
example1_en: The farmer measured out a bushel of wheat.
example1_zh: 农民量出了一蒲式耳小麦。
example2_en: Reporting grain prices per bushel allows farmers to compare market conditions before deciding when to sell their crops.
example2_zh: 按每蒲式耳报告谷物价格，便于农民比较市场行情，再决定何时出售作物。
collocations: a bushel of wheat｜一蒲式耳小麦 ; per bushel｜每蒲式耳 ; a bushel basket｜蒲式耳量篮
tip_zh: 是干量单位；英美容量不同，不能直接等同固定重量。

meanings_zh: adj. 必要的；必需的
definition_en: necessary for a particular purpose
example1_en: They packed everything needful for the long winter journey.
example1_zh: 他们装好了漫长冬日旅途所需的一切物品。
example2_en: Reliable access to clean water is needful for maintaining public health in isolated rural communities.
example2_zh: 可靠的清洁用水供应是偏远农村社区维持公共卫生的必要条件。
collocations: needful supplies｜必需的物资 ; everything needful｜一切必需品 ; do the needful｜采取必要行动
tip_zh: 较古旧或正式；雅思写作通常用 necessary。

meanings_zh: adj. 俯卧的；伏地的 | adj. 精疲力竭的；悲痛难支的 | v. 使俯伏；使衰弱
definition_en: lying flat with your face towards the ground | overwhelmed by exhaustion, illness, or strong emotion | to make someone lie face down or become extremely weak
example1_en: After crawling under the fence, he lay prostrate on the grass.
example1_zh: 从围栏下爬过去后，他俯卧在草地上。
example2_en: Extreme heat can leave outdoor workers prostrate with exhaustion, highlighting the importance of regular breaks.
example2_zh: 酷热会使户外工作者疲惫不堪，凸显了定时休息的重要性。
collocations: lie prostrate｜俯卧 ; prostrate with exhaustion｜疲惫得无法动弹 ; prostrate oneself｜俯伏在地
tip_zh: 勿与prostate（前列腺）混淆；注意多一个r。

meanings_zh: adj. 特有的；典型的
definition_en: Showing the distinctive qualities of a person or thing.
example1_en: The old guide describes the village's characteristical stone cottages.
example1_zh: 那本旧指南描述了这个村庄独具特色的石屋。
example2_en: The historical account highlights the characteristical features of rural architecture, including local stone and steep roofs.
example2_zh: 这份历史记述突出介绍了乡村建筑的典型特征，包括当地石材和陡峭屋顶。
collocations: characteristical features｜典型特征 ; characteristical qualities｜特有品质
tip_zh: 罕见旧式形式；现代写作应优先用characteristic。

meanings_zh: n. 赤贫；一贫如洗
definition_en: extreme poverty, with too little money for basic needs
example1_en: After years of penury, she could finally afford heating.
example1_zh: 经历多年赤贫之后，她终于付得起取暖费了。
example2_en: Without adequate social protection, prolonged unemployment can push vulnerable households into penury and damage their health.
example2_zh: 如果没有充分的社会保障，长期失业可能使弱势家庭陷入赤贫，并损害他们的健康。
collocations: live in penury｜生活在赤贫中 ; die in penury｜在贫困中去世 ; reduce someone to penury｜使某人陷入赤贫
tip_zh: 正式或文学用词，程度重于poverty，通常不可数。

meanings_zh: v. 迅速增长；蓬勃发展
definition_en: To grow or develop rapidly.
example1_en: Her interest in gardening burgeoned after she moved here.
example1_zh: 搬到这里后，她对园艺的兴趣迅速增长。
example2_en: Demand for online courses has burgeoned as more adults seek flexible opportunities to develop professional skills.
example2_zh: 随着越来越多成年人寻求灵活提升职业技能的机会，在线课程的需求迅速增长。
collocations: burgeoning demand｜迅速增长的需求 ; a burgeoning industry｜蓬勃发展的行业 ; a burgeoning population｜迅速增长的人口
tip_zh: 现代常作不及物动词；burgeoning常用于名词前。

meanings_zh: n. 绞肉机
definition_en: A machine that cuts meat into very small pieces.
example1_en: We used a mincer to prepare meat for dumplings.
example1_zh: 我们用绞肉机处理肉，准备包饺子。
example2_en: Small food businesses can improve efficiency by using an electric mincer rather than chopping meat by hand.
example2_zh: 小型食品企业可以使用电动绞肉机代替手工剁肉，以提高效率。
collocations: electric mincer｜电动绞肉机 ; meat mincer｜绞肉机 ; manual mincer｜手动绞肉机
tip_zh: 英式英语常用mincer，美式常用meat grinder。

meanings_zh: adj. 反动的；极端保守的 | n. 反动派；极端保守者
definition_en: opposing social progress and wanting older political arrangements restored | someone who opposes progress and favours restoring older political arrangements
example1_en: My uncle called the proposal reactionary and unfair.
example1_zh: 我叔叔认为这项提议极端保守，而且不公平。
example2_en: Critics argue that reactionary policies can reverse social progress by restoring outdated restrictions on individual freedom.
example2_zh: 批评者认为，反动政策可能通过恢复对个人自由的过时限制，使社会进步倒退。
collocations: reactionary policies｜反动政策 ; reactionary views｜极端保守的观点 ; reactionary forces｜反动势力
tip_zh: 常含贬义，强调恢复旧制度；不等于reactive。

meanings_zh: v. 使极为恼怒；使发狂
definition_en: to make someone extremely angry or frustrated
example1_en: The constant buzzing of that broken fan maddens me.
example1_zh: 那台坏风扇不停的嗡嗡声让我烦透了。
example2_en: Repeated delays and unclear explanations can madden commuters who depend on reliable public transport.
example2_zh: 反复延误和含糊的解释会让依赖可靠公共交通的通勤者极为恼火。
collocations: madden someone｜使某人极为恼怒 ; be maddened by delays｜因延误而抓狂
tip_zh: 通常是及物动词，表示使某人恼怒到抓狂。

meanings_zh: v. 彻底击败；征服 | v. 克服；战胜
definition_en: to defeat an opponent completely | to overcome a fear, problem, or other difficulty
example1_en: Our chess club finally vanquished its strongest rival yesterday.
example1_zh: 我们的国际象棋俱乐部昨天终于彻底击败了最强的对手。
example2_en: Public health campaigns cannot vanquish widespread misinformation without sustained cooperation between educators, researchers, and local communities.
example2_zh: 没有教育工作者、研究人员和当地社区的持续合作，公共卫生宣传就无法战胜广泛传播的错误信息。
collocations: vanquish an enemy｜彻底击败敌人 ; vanquish an opponent｜战胜对手 ; vanquish your fears｜克服恐惧
tip_zh: 语气强且偏文学；普通比赛中用defeat更自然。

meanings_zh: n. 词典编纂者
definition_en: someone who writes or edits dictionaries
example1_en: My aunt works as a lexicographer for a small publisher.
example1_zh: 我姑姑在一家小出版社做词典编纂工作。
example2_en: A lexicographer examines authentic language use to ensure that dictionary definitions reflect contemporary meanings accurately.
example2_zh: 词典编纂者研究真实的语言使用情况，以确保词典释义准确反映当代词义。
collocations: work as a lexicographer｜担任词典编纂者 ; a team of lexicographers｜词典编纂团队 ; a bilingual lexicographer｜双语词典编纂者
tip_zh: 指编写或修订词典的人，不泛指语言学家。

meanings_zh: adj. 傲慢无礼的
definition_en: Rude and disrespectful, especially towards someone in authority.
example1_en: The waiter remained calm despite the customer's insolent tone.
example1_zh: 尽管顾客语气傲慢无礼，服务员仍保持冷静。
example2_en: Schools should address insolent behaviour firmly while helping students learn respectful ways to express disagreement.
example2_zh: 学校应坚决处理无礼行为，同时帮助学生学会以尊重他人的方式表达异议。
collocations: insolent behaviour｜傲慢无礼的行为 ; insolent tone｜无礼的语气 ; insolent reply｜傲慢的答复
tip_zh: 现代常用作形容词；对应名词是insolence。

meanings_zh: v. 裁决；裁定 | v. 担任评判；评定
definition_en: To make an official decision about a dispute | To judge performances or entries in a competition
example1_en: An independent expert will adjudicate our dispute over the repairs.
example1_zh: 一位独立专家将裁决我们在维修问题上的争议。
example2_en: Independent bodies should adjudicate disputes between consumers and businesses to ensure that complaints receive fair and consistent treatment.
example2_zh: 独立机构应裁决消费者与企业之间的纠纷，确保投诉得到公平且一致的处理。
collocations: adjudicate a dispute｜裁决纠纷 ; adjudicate on a claim｜就索赔作出裁决 ; adjudicate a competition｜担任比赛评委
tip_zh: 可直接接争议，也可用adjudicate on；不专指宣判刑罚。

meanings_zh: v. 嘲笑；讥讽 | n. 嘲笑声；讥讽的话
definition_en: To shout or laugh at someone in an unkind way. | An unkind shout or remark intended to ridicule someone.
example1_en: A few spectators jeered when the player missed again.
example1_zh: 那名球员再次失误时，几名观众发出了嘲笑声。
example2_en: When spectators jeer at inexperienced players, they create an atmosphere that discourages participation in community sport.
example2_zh: 当观众嘲笑缺乏经验的球员时，他们会营造出一种让人不愿参加社区体育活动的氛围。
collocations: jeer at someone｜嘲笑某人 ; jeers from the crowd｜人群中的嘲笑声 ; a chorus of jeers｜一片嘲笑声
tip_zh: 动词常用 jeer at someone；名词常用复数。

meanings_zh: adj. 不情愿的；不愿意的
definition_en: Unwilling or reluctant to do something.
example1_en: I was loth to leave the warm kitchen.
example1_zh: 我不愿离开温暖的厨房。
example2_en: Some residents are loth to support redevelopment because they fear losing their neighbourhood's distinctive character.
example2_zh: 一些居民不愿支持重建，因为他们担心失去社区独有的特色。
collocations: loth to admit｜不愿承认 ; loth to leave｜不愿离开 ; loth to accept｜不愿接受
tip_zh: loath的较少见变体；常用be loth to do。

meanings_zh: adj. 有害的；有毒的
definition_en: harmful or poisonous to people or other living things
example1_en: Noxious fumes from the spill forced everyone to leave.
example1_zh: 泄漏物产生的有毒烟气迫使所有人离开。
example2_en: Stricter controls on industrial emissions are needed to protect nearby communities from exposure to noxious gases.
example2_zh: 需要更严格地控制工业排放，以保护附近社区免受有毒气体侵害。
collocations: noxious fumes｜有毒烟气 ; noxious gases｜有毒气体 ; noxious substances｜有害物质
tip_zh: 常形容气体或物质；不只是气味难闻。

meanings_zh: n. 传真；传真机 | v. 发传真
definition_en: A system or machine sending document copies over telephone lines. | To send a document using a fax machine.
example1_en: The office still has a telefax beside the printer.
example1_zh: 办公室的打印机旁边还放着一台传真机。
example2_en: Before email became widespread, companies relied on telefax to exchange documents quickly across national borders.
example2_zh: 在电子邮件普及之前，公司依靠传真来快速跨国交换文件。
collocations: send by telefax｜通过传真发送 ; telefax machine｜传真机 ; telefax number｜传真号码
tip_zh: 较旧的说法；现代英语通常直接用fax。

meanings_zh: adj. 宽宏大量的
definition_en: generous and forgiving, especially towards a rival or weaker person
example1_en: She was magnanimous and congratulated her rival warmly.
example1_zh: 她很有雅量，热情地向对手表示祝贺。
example2_en: A magnanimous response to criticism can help leaders build trust and encourage constructive public debate.
example2_zh: 领导者宽宏大量地回应批评，有助于建立信任并促进建设性的公共讨论。
collocations: magnanimous in victory｜胜而有雅量 ; a magnanimous gesture｜宽宏大量的举动 ; a magnanimous response｜宽容的回应
tip_zh: 较正式，常形容对对手或冒犯者宽容大度。

meanings_zh: v. 违反；越过界限
definition_en: to break a law, rule, or moral boundary
example1_en: Players who transgress the rules may leave the game.
example1_zh: 违反规则的选手可能离场。
example2_en: Companies that transgress environmental laws should face penalties proportionate to the damage they cause.
example2_zh: 违反环境法律的企业应受到与其造成的损害相称的处罚。
collocations: transgress the law｜违法 ; transgress moral boundaries｜逾越道德界限 ; transgress social norms｜违反社会规范
tip_zh: 正式用词，可直接接law、rules等宾语。

meanings_zh: v. 分枝；分叉；形成分支
definition_en: To divide or spread into branches or connected parts.
example1_en: The tree's roots ramify beneath the old garden wall.
example1_zh: 这棵树的根在花园旧围墙下分叉延伸。
example2_en: As transport networks ramify across rural regions, previously isolated communities gain better access to essential services.
example2_zh: 随着交通网络在农村地区不断延伸，原本偏远的社区更容易获得基本服务。
collocations: roots ramify｜根部分叉 ; ramify into branches｜分成枝杈
tip_zh: 正式且少见，常指根系、血管或网络分叉延伸。

meanings_zh: n. 办公位预约共享制
definition_en: a system where employees reserve shared workspaces instead of permanent desks
example1_en: With hotelling, I book a desk before coming in.
example1_zh: 采用工位预约共享制后，我来上班前会先预订工位。
example2_en: Hotelling can reduce office costs, although employees may miss having a permanent space for their belongings.
example2_zh: 工位预约共享制可以降低办公成本，不过员工可能会怀念拥有固定空间存放个人物品的日子。
collocations: office hotelling｜办公位预约共享制 ; hotelling system｜工位预约共享系统 ; desk hotelling｜工位预约共享
tip_zh: 通常指预约共享工位；旅馆业用hotel industry。

meanings_zh: adv. 迄今；此前一直
definition_en: Until now or until the time being discussed.
example1_en: The repair revealed a hitherto hidden cupboard upstairs.
example1_zh: 这次维修让楼上一个此前一直隐藏着的壁橱显露了出来。
example2_en: Recent archaeological discoveries have revealed hitherto unknown details about trade between ancient coastal communities.
example2_zh: 近期的考古发现揭示了此前未知的古代沿海社区间贸易的细节。
collocations: hitherto unknown｜此前未知的 ; hitherto unseen｜此前未见的 ; hitherto neglected｜此前被忽视的
tip_zh: 正式用语，常见于hitherto unknown等搭配。

meanings_zh: adj. 前述的；上述的
definition_en: Mentioned or presented earlier in a piece of writing.
example1_en: The foregoing advice helped me fix my bike.
example1_zh: 前面提到的建议帮我修好了自行车。
example2_en: The foregoing analysis suggests that investment in early education can reduce social inequality over time.
example2_zh: 上述分析表明，对早期教育的投资能逐步减少社会不平等。
collocations: the foregoing discussion｜上述讨论 ; the foregoing analysis｜上述分析 ; the foregoing remarks｜前述评论
tip_zh: 正式书面语，常用the foregoing修饰名词。

meanings_zh: v. 支付；拨付
definition_en: to pay out money, especially from an official fund
example1_en: The charity will disburse the funds early next week.
example1_zh: 这家慈善机构将在下周初拨付这笔资金。
example2_en: Governments should disburse emergency funds quickly to help communities recover from natural disasters.
example2_zh: 政府应迅速拨付应急资金，帮助社区从自然灾害中恢复。
collocations: disburse funds｜拨付资金 ; disburse money｜支付款项 ; disburse a loan｜发放贷款
tip_zh: 正式用词，常以funds或money作宾语。

meanings_zh: n. 公愤；骚动；轰动
definition_en: A strong public reaction of anger or excitement.
example1_en: The sudden closure of the playground caused a furor.
example1_zh: 游乐场突然关闭，引起了强烈不满。
example2_en: The proposed increase in university fees sparked a furor among students and their families.
example2_zh: 拟议中的大学学费上涨引发了学生及其家庭的强烈不满。
collocations: cause a furor｜引起轩然大波 ; spark a furor｜激起公愤 ; a furor over something｜因某事引发的风波
tip_zh: 美式常用furor，英式常用furore；多指公众强烈反应。

meanings_zh: v. 支付；负担费用
definition_en: to pay all or part of a cost
example1_en: The club helped defray the cost of my trip.
example1_zh: 俱乐部帮我支付了部分旅行费用。
example2_en: Universities could offer additional grants to defray accommodation expenses for students from low-income households.
example2_zh: 大学可以提供额外补助，帮助低收入家庭的学生支付住宿费用。
collocations: defray costs｜支付成本 ; defray expenses｜负担费用
tip_zh: 正式用词，宾语通常是costs或expenses，不是人。

meanings_zh: v. 引逗；使可望不可即
definition_en: To excite desire for something that remains out of reach.
example1_en: The smell of fresh bread tantalized us outside the bakery.
example1_zh: 面包店外，新鲜面包的香气馋得我们直流口水。
example2_en: Early discoveries tantalize researchers with the possibility of finding affordable treatments for currently incurable diseases.
example2_zh: 早期发现让研究人员对找到价格可负担的疗法、治疗目前尚无法治愈的疾病充满期待。
collocations: tantalize someone with｜用某物引逗某人 ; tantalizing glimpse｜勾起渴望的短暂一瞥 ; tantalizing prospect｜诱人却未实现的前景
tip_zh: 英式也写tantalise；强调勾起欲望却暂时得不到。

meanings_zh: v. 以某货币计价 | v. 命名；称作
definition_en: express a financial amount in a particular currency | give a particular name to something
example1_en: The bank denominated our overseas loan in euros.
example1_zh: 银行将我们的海外贷款以欧元计价。
example2_en: Loans denominated in foreign currencies can become more expensive when the domestic currency loses value.
example2_zh: 本国货币贬值时，以外币计价的贷款可能变得更加昂贵。
collocations: denominated in dollars｜以美元计价 ; foreign-currency-denominated debt｜外币计价债务
tip_zh: 金融中常用be denominated in＋货币；命名义较罕见。

meanings_zh: v. 弥漫；遍及
definition_en: to spread throughout a place or affect every part
example1_en: The smell of fresh bread pervaded the kitchen.
example1_zh: 新鲜面包的香味弥漫了整个厨房。
example2_en: Digital technology now pervades everyday life, changing how people communicate, study, and access public services.
example2_zh: 数字技术如今渗透日常生活，改变着人们交流、学习和获取公共服务的方式。
collocations: pervade society｜遍及社会 ; pervade the atmosphere｜弥漫在气氛中 ; a sense of unease pervades｜不安感弥漫
tip_zh: 及物动词，直接接场所或领域，不加介词。

meanings_zh: adj. 可锻的；易成形的 | adj. 易受影响的；可塑的
definition_en: Able to be hammered or pressed into a different shape. | Easily influenced or changed by other people or circumstances.
example1_en: The warm metal was malleable enough to bend easily.
example1_zh: 这块温热的金属可塑性足够好，很容易弯曲。
example2_en: Young people's attitudes are often malleable, making schools important environments for developing respect and social responsibility.
example2_zh: 年轻人的态度往往具有可塑性，因此学校是培养尊重意识与社会责任感的重要环境。
collocations: malleable metal｜可锻金属 ; highly malleable｜可塑性很强的 ; malleable minds｜易受影响的心智
tip_zh: 金属义强调锻压成形；ductile强调可拉成丝。

meanings_zh: n. 适销性；可销售性
definition_en: The degree to which something can be sold easily.
example1_en: Fresh paint improved the salability of our old house.
example1_zh: 重新刷漆让我们的旧房子更容易卖出。
example2_en: Manufacturers often adjust packaging to improve the salability of products in highly competitive markets.
example2_zh: 制造商经常调整包装，以提高产品在竞争激烈市场中的适销性。
collocations: improve salability｜提高适销性 ; product salability｜产品适销性 ; affect salability｜影响适销性
tip_zh: 美式拼写；英式通常写作saleability。

meanings_zh: n. 新闻报道；报道写作
definition_en: News reporting, especially detailed accounts based on direct observation
example1_en: Her vivid reportage brought the remote village to life.
example1_zh: 她生动的报道让那个偏远村庄跃然眼前。
example2_en: Independent reportage can reveal environmental damage that might otherwise escape public attention and government scrutiny.
example2_zh: 独立报道可以揭露那些原本可能逃过公众关注和政府审查的环境破坏。
collocations: investigative reportage｜调查报道 ; literary reportage｜报告文学 ; first-hand reportage｜第一手报道
tip_zh: 通常不可数，比reporting正式，常强调现场记录。

meanings_zh: adj. 陈腐的；老套的
definition_en: Overused and therefore no longer interesting or original
example1_en: The film ends with a trite speech about friendship.
example1_zh: 影片以一段关于友谊的老套演说结束。
example2_en: Public awareness campaigns may fail when they rely on trite slogans rather than practical advice and convincing evidence.
example2_zh: 公众宣传活动如果依赖老套的口号，而非实用建议和有说服力的证据，就可能失败。
collocations: trite remark｜老套的话 ; trite phrase｜陈腐的措辞 ; sound trite｜听起来很老套
tip_zh: 强调因反复使用而失去新意，不只是年代久远。

meanings_zh: n. 本地话；日常用语 | adj. 本地语言的；本土风格的
definition_en: The everyday language spoken by people in a particular place. | Using local everyday language or traditional local building styles.
example1_en: Our guide chatted with market traders in the local vernacular.
example1_zh: 导游用当地话与市场里的商贩闲聊。
example2_en: Teaching in the vernacular can help young children understand lessons while maintaining connections with their cultural heritage.
example2_zh: 用本地语言教学能帮助幼童理解课程，同时保持与自身文化传统的联系。
collocations: the local vernacular｜当地日常用语 ; in the vernacular｜用本地话 ; vernacular architecture｜乡土建筑
tip_zh: 强调当地日常语言，不等同于“本国的”。

meanings_zh: v. 使兴奋；使振奋
definition_en: To make someone feel excited, energetic, and very happy
example1_en: The fast boat ride exhilarated everyone on board.
example1_zh: 快艇飞驰让船上的每个人都兴奋不已。
example2_en: Outdoor adventures can exhilarate participants while helping them develop confidence and a stronger connection with nature.
example2_zh: 户外探险能让参与者精神振奋，同时帮助他们增强自信，加深与自然的联系。
collocations: feel exhilarated｜感到兴奋 ; exhilarated by the experience｜因这次经历而振奋 ; an exhilarating experience｜令人兴奋的经历
tip_zh: 及物动词；人感到兴奋用exhilarated。

meanings_zh: adj. 极其微小的 | n. 无穷小量
definition_en: so small that it is almost impossible to measure | a mathematical quantity smaller in magnitude than any positive real number
example1_en: The scratch made an infinitesimal difference to the table's appearance.
example1_zh: 这道划痕对桌子外观的影响微乎其微。
example2_en: Even infinitesimal changes in ocean temperature can become significant when measured across vast areas over decades.
example2_zh: 即使海水温度变化极其微小，若在广阔海域持续数十年，也可能产生显著影响。
collocations: infinitesimal amount｜极微小的量 ; infinitesimal difference｜极微小的差别 ; infinitesimal change｜极微小的变化
tip_zh: 比small语气强得多；名词用法主要见于数学。

meanings_zh: adj. 成分的；成分分析的
definition_en: Relating to the separate parts that make up a whole
example1_en: Our tutor used componential analysis to compare similar words.
example1_zh: 我们的老师用成分分析法比较近义词。
example2_en: In linguistics, componential analysis examines word meanings by breaking them down into smaller, shared semantic features.
example2_zh: 在语言学中，成分分析通过将词义分解为较小的共有语义特征来研究词义。
collocations: componential analysis｜成分分析 ; componential approach｜成分分析方法
tip_zh: 专业形容词，常见于语言学术语componential analysis。

meanings_zh: adj. 上述的；前述的
definition_en: previously mentioned in the same document or statement
example1_en: The contract says we must pay the aforesaid fee.
example1_zh: 合同规定我们必须支付上述费用。
example2_en: The aforesaid conditions must be satisfied before the council can approve any construction within the protected area.
example2_zh: 必须满足上述条件，地方议会才能批准保护区内的任何建设项目。
collocations: the aforesaid conditions｜上述条件 ; the aforesaid agreement｜上述协议 ; the aforesaid property｜上述房产
tip_zh: 法律或正式书面语，通常置于名词前。

meanings_zh: adj. 亵渎的；粗俗的 | v. 亵渎
definition_en: Showing disrespect for religion, or using offensive language. | To treat something sacred with serious disrespect.
example1_en: The coach apologised for his profane language after the match.
example1_zh: 教练为赛后说的粗话道了歉。
example2_en: Museums should explain why objects considered ordinary by outsiders may be sacred, making careless treatment seem profane.
example2_zh: 博物馆应解释为何外人眼中的普通物品可能是神圣之物，以致随意对待会显得亵渎。
collocations: profane language｜粗俗的语言 ; profane remarks｜亵渎性言论 ; profane a sacred place｜亵渎圣地
tip_zh: 形容词常修饰language；动词指亵渎神圣事物。

meanings_zh: n. 胫骨
definition_en: The larger front bone between the knee and ankle
example1_en: The doctor showed me my tibia on the scan.
example1_zh: 医生在扫描影像上指给我看我的胫骨。
example2_en: A fracture of the tibia may require several months of rehabilitation before an athlete can safely resume training.
example2_zh: 胫骨骨折可能需要数月康复，运动员才能安全恢复训练。
collocations: a fractured tibia｜骨折的胫骨 ; the tibia and fibula｜胫骨和腓骨 ; tibial fracture｜胫骨骨折
tip_zh: 即shinbone；复数可用tibias或tibiae。

meanings_zh: adj. 激烈的；强烈的
definition_en: Expressing very strong feelings, especially anger or opposition
example1_en: Her vehement refusal surprised everyone at the table.
example1_zh: 她激烈的拒绝让桌旁的每个人都很惊讶。
example2_en: The proposed closure of the community library met with vehement opposition from residents and local educators.
example2_zh: 关闭社区图书馆的提议遭到了居民和当地教育工作者的强烈反对。
collocations: vehement opposition｜强烈反对 ; vehement denial｜坚决否认 ; vehement criticism｜激烈批评
tip_zh: 多形容反对、否认或批评的强烈程度，语气较正式。

meanings_zh: adj. 刺耳的；喧闹的
definition_en: Unpleasantly loud and harsh in sound.
example1_en: Raucous laughter from the kitchen woke the sleeping cat.
example1_zh: 厨房里传来刺耳的大笑声，吵醒了熟睡的猫。
example2_en: Residents argue that raucous nightlife disrupts sleep and reduces the appeal of otherwise attractive urban neighbourhoods.
example2_zh: 居民认为，喧闹的夜生活扰乱睡眠，也降低了原本宜居的城市街区的吸引力。
collocations: raucous laughter｜刺耳的大笑声 ; raucous crowd｜喧闹的人群 ; raucous voice｜粗哑刺耳的嗓音
tip_zh: 强调声音粗哑刺耳或喧闹，不只是嗓音沙哑。

meanings_zh: n. 蛋白石；欧泊
definition_en: A gemstone often showing changing colours when light strikes it
example1_en: The opal in her ring flashed green and blue.
example1_zh: 她戒指上的欧泊闪着绿色和蓝色的光。
example2_en: Opal mining can provide employment in remote regions, although it may also disturb fragile desert environments.
example2_zh: 欧泊开采能为偏远地区提供就业，但也可能破坏脆弱的沙漠环境。
collocations: opal ring｜欧泊戒指 ; opal mining｜欧泊开采 ; precious opal｜贵蛋白石
tip_zh: 珠宝语境常称“欧泊”；并非所有蛋白石都有变彩。

meanings_zh: adj. 多种多样的
definition_en: having many different kinds or aspects
example1_en: The market's multifarious offerings included spices, pottery, and handmade toys.
example1_zh: 市场上的商品五花八门，包括香料、陶器和手工玩具。
example2_en: Urban planners must consider the multifarious needs of residents when designing accessible and inclusive public spaces.
example2_zh: 城市规划者设计便利且包容的公共空间时，必须考虑居民多种多样的需求。
collocations: multifarious activities｜多种多样的活动 ; multifarious needs｜多方面的需求 ; multifarious responsibilities｜繁杂多样的职责
tip_zh: 正式词，强调种类多；日常多用varied或diverse。

meanings_zh: n. 推进剂；喷射剂 | adj. 起推进作用的
definition_en: A substance that drives something forward or forces liquid out | Providing the force that moves something forward
example1_en: This spray can uses compressed air as its propellent.
example1_zh: 这个喷雾罐用压缩空气作喷射剂。
example2_en: Developing cleaner rocket propellents could reduce the environmental impact of the growing commercial space industry.
example2_zh: 开发更清洁的火箭推进剂有望减少不断发展的商业航天业对环境的影响。
collocations: rocket propellent｜火箭推进剂 ; liquid propellent｜液体推进剂 ; propellent gas｜推进气体
tip_zh: 是propellant的较少见拼写；写作优先用后者。

meanings_zh: adj. 不情愿的；不愿意的
definition_en: Unwilling to do something.
example1_en: I was loath to leave the warm kitchen.
example1_zh: 我舍不得离开温暖的厨房。
example2_en: Many residents are loath to support redevelopment projects that could destroy the character of their neighbourhoods.
example2_zh: 许多居民不愿支持可能破坏社区特色的重建项目。
collocations: be loath to admit｜不愿承认 ; be loath to leave｜不愿离开 ; be loath to accept｜不愿接受
tip_zh: 常用be loath to do；勿混淆动词loathe（厌恶）。

meanings_zh: n. 万能药；万全之策
definition_en: Something believed to solve every problem or cure every illness.
example1_en: A new phone is no panacea for your troubles.
example1_zh: 换部新手机并不能解决你所有的烦恼。
example2_en: Although technology can improve classroom learning, it should not be regarded as a panacea for educational inequality.
example2_zh: 虽然技术可以改善课堂学习，但不应被视为解决教育不平等的万全之策。
collocations: a panacea for｜解决……的万能之策 ; no panacea｜并非万能之策 ; a universal panacea｜包治百病的灵丹妙药
tip_zh: 常用a panacea for；多用于否定万能解法。

meanings_zh: v. 流产 | v. 失败；未达目的
definition_en: Lose a pregnancy before the baby can survive outside the womb. | Fail to achieve the intended result.
example1_en: After she miscarried, her family offered comfort and support.
example1_zh: 她流产后，家人给予了安慰和支持。
example2_en: People who miscarry should have access to compassionate medical care and appropriate psychological support.
example2_zh: 流产者应能获得充满关怀的医疗服务和适当的心理支持。
collocations: miscarry early in pregnancy｜孕早期流产 ; a plan miscarries｜计划失败
tip_zh: 通常指流产；表示计划失败时较正式且少见。

meanings_zh: n. 保险承保人；承保机构 | n. 证券承销商
definition_en: A person or organisation that accepts insurance risks. | An institution guaranteeing to buy securities not purchased by investors.
example1_en: The underwriter checked our roof before approving the insurance.
example1_zh: 承保人在批准保险之前检查了我们的屋顶。
example2_en: An underwriter assesses potential losses before deciding whether to offer insurance for buildings in areas prone to flooding.
example2_zh: 承保人会评估潜在损失，再决定是否为易受洪灾地区的建筑提供保险。
collocations: insurance underwriter｜保险承保人 ; lead underwriter｜主承销商 ; mortgage underwriter｜抵押贷款审核员
tip_zh: 保险领域指承保人，证券领域指承销商。

meanings_zh: v. 转运；转船
definition_en: Transfer goods from one ship or vehicle to another.
example1_en: Workers transshipped the crates onto a smaller boat.
example1_zh: 工人们把这些板条箱转运到一艘较小的船上。
example2_en: Shipping companies often transship cargo at major ports to reduce costs and reach smaller markets.
example2_zh: 航运公司常在主要港口转运货物，以降低成本并进入较小的市场。
collocations: transship cargo｜转运货物 ; transship goods｜转运商品 ; transship containers｜转运集装箱
tip_zh: 过去式为transshipped，现在分词双写p。

meanings_zh: n. 桉树
definition_en: a tree mainly native to Australia, with strongly scented leaves
example1_en: A koala rested high in the eucalyptus tree.
example1_zh: 一只考拉在高高的桉树上休息。
example2_en: Planting eucalyptus outside its native range may affect local water supplies and reduce biodiversity.
example2_zh: 在原生分布区以外种植桉树可能影响当地供水，并减少生物多样性。
collocations: eucalyptus tree｜桉树 ; eucalyptus oil｜桉树精油 ; eucalyptus leaves｜桉树叶
tip_zh: 指树种；eucalyptus oil指从桉树叶提取的精油。

meanings_zh: n. 马笼头 | v. 给马套笼头 | v. 动怒；表示不满
definition_en: Straps fitted around a horse's head to control it. | To put a bridle on a horse. | To react angrily because something seems insulting or unfair.
example1_en: She checked the horse's bridle before climbing into the saddle.
example1_zh: 她上马前检查了马的笼头。
example2_en: Some employees bridle at strict monitoring policies because they feel their professional judgement is being questioned.
example2_zh: 一些员工对严格的监控政策感到不满，因为他们觉得自己的专业判断受到了质疑。
collocations: a leather bridle｜皮制马笼头 ; put a bridle on｜给……套笼头 ; bridle at criticism｜因批评而动怒
tip_zh: 指马笼头，不是笼子；与bridal（新娘的）同音。

meanings_zh: adj. 天真坦率的
definition_en: Honest and trusting, often through a lack of worldly experience.
example1_en: Her ingenuous question made everyone smile at the dinner table.
example1_zh: 她天真坦率的提问让餐桌旁的每个人都笑了。
example2_en: An ingenuous belief that technology solves every problem may prevent policymakers from considering its social costs.
example2_zh: 天真地相信技术能解决所有问题，可能使政策制定者忽视其社会代价。
collocations: an ingenuous smile｜天真无邪的微笑 ; an ingenuous question｜天真坦率的提问 ; ingenuous optimism｜天真的乐观态度
tip_zh: 勿与ingenious（巧妙的）混淆；本词强调天真坦率。

meanings_zh: n. 前事；先例 | n. 先行词 | adj. 先前的；先行的
definition_en: Something earlier that influenced or resembled a later thing. | A word or phrase that a later pronoun refers to. | Existing or happening before something else.
example1_en: This simple wooden tool is an antecedent of modern machines.
example1_zh: 这件简单的木制工具是现代机器的前身。
example2_en: Researchers examine the historical antecedents of urban inequality to understand why certain communities remain disadvantaged.
example2_zh: 研究人员考察城市不平等的历史根源，以理解某些社区为何一直处于弱势。
collocations: historical antecedents｜历史先例；历史根源 ; antecedent conditions｜先前条件 ; a pronoun's antecedent｜代词的先行词
tip_zh: 语法中指代词所指的先行词；不宜直接等同祖先。

meanings_zh: adj. 树栖的 | adj. 树木的
definition_en: living mainly in trees | relating to trees
example1_en: The zoo's arboreal snakes curled around branches above our heads.
example1_zh: 动物园里的树栖蛇盘绕在我们头顶的树枝上。
example2_en: Deforestation threatens arboreal species by removing the branches and canopy they depend on for survival.
example2_zh: 森林砍伐破坏了树栖物种赖以生存的树枝和林冠，威胁着它们的生存。
collocations: arboreal species｜树栖物种 ; arboreal habitat｜树上栖息地 ; arboreal mammals｜树栖哺乳动物
tip_zh: 常用于动物学，描述主要生活在树上的动物。

meanings_zh: v. 赔偿；保障免受损失
definition_en: To compensate for loss or provide financial protection against it.
example1_en: The insurer agreed to indemnify us for the damage.
example1_zh: 保险公司同意赔偿我们遭受的损失。
example2_en: Construction contracts often require companies to indemnify clients against financial losses caused by negligence.
example2_zh: 建筑合同通常要求公司赔偿客户因疏忽而遭受的经济损失。
collocations: indemnify someone against loss｜保障某人免受损失 ; indemnify someone for damage｜赔偿某人的损害
tip_zh: 法律正式用语：for接已受损害，against接防范风险。

meanings_zh: n. 评分标准；评分细则 | n. 题目说明；指示 | n. 标题；类别
definition_en: A set of criteria used to assess work. | Instructions explaining how to complete a task or examination. | A heading or category under which something is grouped.
example1_en: Our teacher explained the rubric before we started writing.
example1_zh: 动笔前，老师向我们讲解了评分标准。
example2_en: A clear assessment rubric helps students understand expectations and enables teachers to grade assignments more consistently.
example2_zh: 明确的评分细则有助于学生了解要求，也让教师能以更一致的标准评定作业。
collocations: an assessment rubric｜评估细则 ; a scoring rubric｜评分标准 ; under the rubric of｜归入……类别
tip_zh: 教育中常指评分细则，也可指试题作答说明。

meanings_zh: n. 婚姻；结婚
definition_en: The state of being married, especially in formal or religious language.
example1_en: The couple were joined in matrimony last spring.
example1_zh: 这对伴侣去年春天结为夫妻。
example2_en: Although attitudes towards matrimony vary across cultures, marriage continues to carry legal and social responsibilities.
example2_zh: 尽管不同文化对婚姻的态度各异，婚姻仍然伴随着法律和社会责任。
collocations: joined in matrimony｜结为夫妻 ; holy matrimony｜神圣婚姻 ; the bonds of matrimony｜婚姻的纽带
tip_zh: 正式或宗教用语；日常谈婚姻通常用marriage。

meanings_zh: adj. 一丝不苟的；严谨的 | adj. 正直的；恪守道德的
definition_en: extremely careful to do things correctly and thoroughly | careful to act honestly and avoid doing anything wrong
example1_en: She gave every cup a scrupulous wash before serving tea.
example1_zh: 上茶前，她把每个杯子都仔仔细细地洗了一遍。
example2_en: Scrupulous attention to research methods is essential for producing reliable evidence in public health studies.
example2_zh: 在公共卫生研究中，严谨关注研究方法是获得可靠证据的关键。
collocations: scrupulous attention to detail｜对细节的一丝不苟 ; scrupulous care｜极其细致的照料 ; scrupulous honesty｜绝对诚实
tip_zh: 既可指做事严谨，也可指恪守道德。

meanings_zh: n. 大树枝；主枝
definition_en: a large branch of a tree
example1_en: A heavy bough shaded the bench beside the pond.
example1_zh: 一根粗大的树枝为池塘边的长椅遮阴。
example2_en: The broad boughs of mature trees provide shelter for wildlife and shade for people in urban parks.
example2_zh: 城市公园中，成熟树木的宽大枝干为野生动物提供庇护，也为人们遮阴。
collocations: a low bough｜低垂的大树枝 ; a spreading bough｜向外伸展的大树枝
tip_zh: 读音与cow押韵；通常指大枝，小枝用twig。

meanings_zh: n. 硫化物
definition_en: A compound containing sulphur combined with another element or group
example1_en: Our teacher showed us a sample of iron sulphide.
example1_zh: 老师给我们展示了一份硫化铁样品。
example2_en: When exposed to air and water, some sulphide minerals can generate acidic drainage that damages nearby ecosystems.
example2_zh: 一些硫化物矿物接触空气和水后，会产生酸性排水，损害附近的生态系统。
collocations: iron sulphide｜硫化铁 ; hydrogen sulphide｜硫化氢 ; sulphide minerals｜硫化物矿物
tip_zh: 美式及国际化学命名常写sulfide；勿混同硫酸盐。

meanings_zh: v. 撒；散布；撒满
definition_en: To scatter things loosely across a surface or area
example1_en: The children strew flower petals along the garden path.
example1_zh: 孩子们沿着花园小径撒花瓣。
example2_en: Visitors who strew litter across beaches threaten marine wildlife and increase the cost of coastal maintenance.
example2_zh: 在海滩上乱扔垃圾的游客会威胁海洋野生动物，并增加海岸维护成本。
collocations: strew flowers｜撒花 ; be strewn with litter｜散落着垃圾 ; debris strewn across a road｜散落在路上的残骸
tip_zh: 过去式strewed，分词常用strewn；常见被动结构。

meanings_zh: v. 探究；深入查明 | v. 测量水深 | n. 铅锤
definition_en: examine something closely to understand it fully | measure how deep water is | a weight on a string used to check vertical alignment
example1_en: The documentary plumbs the mysteries of the deep ocean.
example1_zh: 这部纪录片深入探索深海的奥秘。
example2_en: Through detailed interviews, researchers sought to plumb the causes of declining public trust in local institutions.
example2_zh: 研究人员通过详尽访谈，力图深入查明公众对地方机构信任下降的原因。
collocations: plumb the depths of｜深入探究；达到低谷 ; plumb line｜铅垂线 ; plumb bob｜铅锤
tip_zh: 词尾 b 不发音；plumb the depths 常用于比喻。

meanings_zh: adj. 和平的；爱好和平的
definition_en: Peaceful in nature or intended to avoid conflict
example1_en: Her pacific manner helped calm the argument at dinner.
example1_zh: 她平和的态度帮助平息了晚餐时的争论。
example2_en: A pacific approach to international disputes prioritises negotiation and cooperation rather than threats or military action.
example2_zh: 以和平方式处理国际争端，重在谈判与合作，而非威胁或军事行动。
collocations: pacific approach｜和平的处理方式 ; pacific settlement｜和平解决 ; pacific intentions｜和平意图
tip_zh: 小写pacific是正式形容词；the Pacific指太平洋。

meanings_zh: v. 波动；呈波浪状起伏
definition_en: Move or rise and fall in a smooth, wave-like pattern.
example1_en: Long strands of seaweed undulate gently beneath the water.
example1_zh: 长长的海藻在水下轻轻起伏。
example2_en: The grasslands undulate towards the distant mountains, providing varied habitats for a wide range of species.
example2_zh: 草原绵延起伏，伸向远山，为众多物种提供了多样的栖息地。
collocations: undulate gently｜轻轻起伏 ; undulating hills｜连绵起伏的丘陵 ; undulating terrain｜波状起伏的地形
tip_zh: 描述地形起伏时，常用形容词undulating。

meanings_zh: adj. 美味的；可口的
definition_en: Extremely pleasant to taste or eat.
example1_en: The bakery sells delectable pastries filled with fresh fruit.
example1_zh: 这家面包店出售美味的鲜果馅酥点。
example2_en: Local markets attract visitors with delectable regional dishes, helping small food businesses benefit from tourism.
example2_zh: 当地市场以美味的地方菜肴吸引游客，帮助小型餐饮商家从旅游业中获益。
collocations: delectable dishes｜美味佳肴 ; a delectable dessert｜可口的甜点 ; delectable treats｜美味小食
tip_zh: 比delicious更正式或更具描写色彩，常形容食物。

meanings_zh: n. 名声；声誉 | v. 认为；据说
definition_en: the general opinion people have of someone or something | to consider someone or something to have a particular quality
example1_en: The workshop hired a violin maker of considerable repute.
example1_zh: 这家工坊聘请了一位颇有声望的小提琴制作师。
example2_en: Research institutions of international repute often attract talented students and substantial investment from overseas.
example2_zh: 享有国际声誉的研究机构往往能吸引优秀学生和大量海外投资。
collocations: of international repute｜享有国际声誉的 ; of good repute｜声誉良好的 ; be reputed to be｜据说是
tip_zh: 动词多用被动式be reputed to be，意为“据说是”。

meanings_zh: adj. 时髦的；流行的
definition_en: Following the styles that are currently fashionable.
example1_en: He arrived wearing a modish jacket and polished boots.
example1_zh: 他穿着时髦的夹克和擦得锃亮的靴子来了。
example2_en: Modish interiors may attract customers initially, but lasting success depends on reliable service and quality.
example2_zh: 时髦的室内装潢起初或许能吸引顾客，但长久的成功取决于可靠的服务和品质。
collocations: modish clothes｜时髦的服装 ; modish design｜时尚设计 ; modish interiors｜时髦的室内装潢
tip_zh: 较书面，有时暗含“追逐潮流”的意味。

meanings_zh: adj. 戴眼镜的
definition_en: wearing glasses
example1_en: A bespectacled librarian helped me find the missing book.
example1_zh: 一位戴眼镜的图书管理员帮我找到了那本找不到的书。
example2_en: Films often portray scientists as bespectacled figures in laboratories, reinforcing a narrow image of scientific careers.
example2_zh: 电影常把科学家描绘成实验室里戴眼镜的人物，强化了人们对科研职业的单一印象。
collocations: a bespectacled man｜戴眼镜的男子 ; a bespectacled professor｜戴眼镜的教授
tip_zh: 偏书面描写；日常更常说wearing glasses。

meanings_zh: adj. 暴虐的；专横的
definition_en: Using power cruelly and unfairly to control others.
example1_en: The club members finally challenged their tyrannical leader.
example1_zh: 俱乐部成员终于对他们专横的领导提出了质疑。
example2_en: Independent courts can help prevent tyrannical rule by limiting government power and protecting basic rights.
example2_zh: 独立的法院可以通过限制政府权力和保护基本权利来帮助防止暴政。
collocations: a tyrannical ruler｜暴虐的统治者 ; tyrannical rule｜暴政 ; a tyrannical boss｜专横的老板
tip_zh: 不仅指政治暴政，也可形容老板等人的专横行为。

meanings_zh: adj. 不肯通融的；不配合的
definition_en: Unwilling to help others or adjust to their needs.
example1_en: The unaccommodating host refused to provide an extra chair.
example1_zh: 那位不肯通融的主人拒绝再提供一把椅子。
example2_en: Unaccommodating employers may struggle to retain skilled workers who need flexible schedules to manage family responsibilities.
example2_zh: 不肯通融的雇主可能难以留住需要灵活时间安排来承担家庭责任的熟练员工。
collocations: an unaccommodating attitude｜不肯通融的态度 ; an unaccommodating employer｜不肯通融的雇主
tip_zh: 指不愿帮助或迁就他人，不表示没有住宿。

meanings_zh: adv. 在本文中；在此
definition_en: In this document, statement, or situation.
example1_en: The rental rules herein apply to all tenants.
example1_zh: 本文件中的租赁规定适用于所有租户。
example2_en: The evidence presented herein suggests that affordable public transport can improve access to employment.
example2_zh: 本文所呈现的证据表明，价格可负担的公共交通能够改善就业机会的可及性。
collocations: contained herein｜包含于本文中 ; described herein｜在本文中描述的 ; herein lies the problem｜问题就在于此
tip_zh: 正式或法律用语，常指“在本文件中”。

meanings_zh: adj. 令人厌恶的
definition_en: Causing strong dislike or a feeling of sickness.
example1_en: A disgustful smell rose from the forgotten food.
example1_zh: 被遗忘的食物散发出令人作呕的气味。
example2_en: The disgustful condition of neglected public toilets can discourage residents from using otherwise attractive parks.
example2_zh: 公共厕所因疏于维护而变得令人厌恶，可能使居民不愿前往原本很有吸引力的公园。
collocations: disgustful smell｜令人作呕的气味 ; disgustful sight｜令人厌恶的景象
tip_zh: 此词罕见且偏旧；现代英语通常用disgusting。

meanings_zh: n. 雨衣
definition_en: A coat made from waterproof material.
example1_en: She pulled on her mackintosh before walking into the rain.
example1_zh: 她穿上雨衣，然后走进雨中。
example2_en: A durable mackintosh can encourage people to walk rather than drive in wet weather.
example2_zh: 一件耐用的雨衣能鼓励人们在雨天步行而不是开车。
collocations: wear a mackintosh｜穿雨衣 ; a waterproof mackintosh｜防水雨衣
tip_zh: 英式用词，略显老派；不指苹果电脑。

meanings_zh: v. 刺激；激将；唆使 | n. 赶牲畜的刺棒 | n. 刺激因素；驱动力
definition_en: to provoke someone into acting through persistent pressure or annoyance | a pointed stick used to make animals move | something that strongly pushes a person to act
example1_en: His teasing goaded me into joining the race.
example1_zh: 他的取笑激得我参加了比赛。
example2_en: Competitive school environments may goad students into pursuing high grades at the expense of genuine understanding.
example2_zh: 竞争激烈的学校环境可能迫使学生追逐高分，而忽视真正理解知识。
collocations: goad someone into doing something｜激某人做某事 ; goad someone on｜不断刺激某人行动 ; a goad to action｜行动的驱动力
tip_zh: 常用goad sb into doing，通常含负面刺激。

meanings_zh: n. 西方；欧美国家
definition_en: the Western world, especially Europe and North America
example1_en: This old atlas describes the occident in great detail.
example1_zh: 这本旧地图集非常详细地描述了西方世界。
example2_en: Historical accounts often contrasted the occident with the orient, overlooking the considerable diversity within both regions.
example2_zh: 历史记述常把西方与东方对照，却忽视了两个地区各自内部的巨大差异。
collocations: the Occident｜西方世界 ; the Orient and the Occident｜东方与西方
tip_zh: 旧式用语，通常写作the Occident；现代多用the West。

meanings_zh: adj. 依照的；依据的
definition_en: in accordance with a law, rule, or agreement
example1_en: Pursuant to our agreement, your deposit will be refunded.
example1_zh: 根据我们的协议，你的押金将予以退还。
example2_en: Pursuant to environmental regulations, factories must treat wastewater before releasing it into local rivers.
example2_zh: 根据环境法规，工厂必须先处理废水，才能将其排入当地河流。
collocations: pursuant to an agreement｜根据协议 ; pursuant to regulations｜依照法规
tip_zh: 几乎总用于pursuant to，常见于法律等正式文本。

meanings_zh: v. 使膨胀；胀大
definition_en: To swell or become larger because of pressure from inside.
example1_en: Too much gas can distend your stomach after meals.
example1_zh: 饭后过多的气体会使你的胃胀大。
example2_en: During digestion, excess gas may distend the abdomen, causing discomfort that can affect daily activities.
example2_zh: 消化过程中，多余气体可能使腹部胀大，造成影响日常活动的不适。
collocations: a distended abdomen｜胀大的腹部 ; a distended stomach｜胀大的胃 ; distended with gas｜因气体而膨胀
tip_zh: 多用于医学，强调内部压力导致胀大。

meanings_zh: adj. 多种多样的；多方面的 | n. 歧管；多支管
definition_en: Numerous and varied | A pipe system distributing or collecting gas or liquid
example1_en: The benefits of growing your own vegetables are manifold.
example1_zh: 自己种蔬菜的好处是多方面的。
example2_en: The manifold challenges of urban growth require cooperation between local authorities, businesses, and residents.
example2_zh: 城市发展面临多方面的挑战，需要地方政府、企业和居民共同合作。
collocations: manifold benefits｜多方面的好处 ; manifold challenges｜多方面的挑战 ; exhaust manifold｜排气歧管
tip_zh: 形容词用法较正式，常修饰benefits、problems等复数名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 兴趣广泛的；兼收并蓄的 | adj. 天主教的 | n. 天主教徒
definition_en: Including or appreciating a wide variety of things. | Relating to the Christian church led by the Pope. | A member of the Christian church led by the Pope.
example1_en: Her catholic tastes include jazz, pottery, hiking, and opera.
example1_zh: 她的兴趣十分广泛，包括爵士乐、陶艺、徒步和歌剧。
example2_en: A catholic approach to reading exposes students to diverse perspectives across literature, science, and history.
example2_zh: 兼收并蓄的阅读方式能让学生接触文学、科学和历史领域的多元视角。
collocations: catholic tastes｜广泛的兴趣 ; Catholic Church｜天主教会 ; a practising Catholic｜践行信仰的天主教徒
tip_zh: 小写指广泛包容；指天主教或其信徒须大写Catholic。

meanings_zh: v. 误解；错误理解
definition_en: to understand something in the wrong way
example1_en: I misconceived her silence as a sign of agreement.
example1_zh: 我误把她的沉默理解为同意。
example2_en: Policymakers may misconceive local needs if they fail to consult residents before introducing changes.
example2_zh: 政策制定者若不在推行改革前征求居民意见，就可能误解当地需求。
collocations: misconceive someone's intentions｜误解某人的意图 ; misconceive the purpose｜误解目的
tip_zh: 较正式；日常表达“误解”更常用misunderstand。

meanings_zh: v. 杀死；杀害
definition_en: To kill someone or something, especially violently.
example1_en: In the old tale, a knight slays a dragon.
example1_zh: 在那个古老的故事里，一名骑士杀死了一条龙。
example2_en: Traditional legends often celebrate heroes who slay monsters to protect their communities from danger.
example2_zh: 传统传说常常颂扬那些杀死怪物、保护社区免受危险的英雄。
collocations: slay a dragon｜杀死恶龙 ; slay a monster｜杀死怪物
tip_zh: 过去式slew，过去分词slain；常见于文学或新闻。

meanings_zh: v. 悉心呵护；娇惯
definition_en: to give someone excessive care, comfort, and protection
example1_en: They cosset their elderly dog with blankets and treats.
example1_zh: 他们给年老的狗盖毯子、喂零食，把它照顾得无微不至。
example2_en: Parents who cosset their children may unintentionally limit opportunities for them to develop independence and cope with everyday challenges.
example2_zh: 过分呵护孩子的父母可能无意中限制孩子培养独立性及应对日常挑战的机会。
collocations: cosset a child｜娇惯孩子 ; a cosseted upbringing｜备受呵护的成长经历 ; cosseted guests｜受到悉心照料的客人
tip_zh: 及物动词，常暗示照顾过度；名词用法已罕见。

meanings_zh: n. 自由意志主义者 | adj. 自由意志主义的
definition_en: Someone favouring individual freedom and minimal government control | Favouring individual freedom and minimal government control
example1_en: My neighbour is a libertarian who values personal choice.
example1_zh: 我的邻居是一位重视个人选择的自由意志主义者。
example2_en: A libertarian approach to economic policy generally favours reducing government intervention and expanding individual choice.
example2_zh: 自由意志主义的经济政策取向通常主张减少政府干预，扩大个人选择空间。
collocations: libertarian views｜自由意志主义观点 ; libertarian principles｜自由意志主义原则 ; a libertarian approach｜自由意志主义的做法
tip_zh: 强调个人自由和有限政府，不等同于liberal。

meanings_zh: adj. 感染的；脓毒性的
definition_en: infected with harmful bacteria, or relating to such infection
example1_en: The nurse cleaned the septic wound and changed its dressing.
example1_zh: 护士清洁了感染的伤口，并更换了敷料。
example2_en: Prompt treatment of bacterial infections can reduce the risk of septic shock and improve patient outcomes.
example2_zh: 及时治疗细菌感染可以降低脓毒性休克的风险，改善患者的治疗结果。
collocations: a septic wound｜感染的伤口 ; septic shock｜脓毒性休克 ; a septic tank｜化粪池
tip_zh: septic tank 指化粪池；septic 不作“腐烂物”名词。

meanings_zh: n. 补偿；报酬 | v. 补偿；酬谢
definition_en: Payment or a reward for work, loss, or inconvenience. | To pay or reward someone for work, loss, or inconvenience.
example1_en: The shop offered a refund as recompense for the inconvenience.
example1_zh: 商店提出退款，以补偿给顾客造成的不便。
example2_en: Employees should receive fair recompense for additional duties rather than being expected to work extra hours without payment.
example2_zh: 员工承担额外职责应获得公平报酬，而不应被要求无偿加班。
collocations: fair recompense｜公平的报酬 ; recompense for｜对……的补偿 ; recompense someone for something｜因某事补偿某人
tip_zh: 较正式；动词用recompense sb for sth。

meanings_zh: n. 个人特有的习惯；特性
definition_en: an unusual habit or feature particular to someone or something
example1_en: One of his idiosyncrasies is sorting socks by colour.
example1_zh: 他的一个独特习惯是按颜色整理袜子。
example2_en: Effective teachers recognise individual idiosyncrasies and adapt their methods without discouraging students from expressing their personalities.
example2_zh: 优秀教师会认识到个体特有的习惯并调整教学方法，而不打击学生表达个性的积极性。
collocations: personal idiosyncrasies｜个人特有的习惯 ; individual idiosyncrasies｜个体特性 ; linguistic idiosyncrasies｜语言上的独特之处
tip_zh: 可数名词，复数为idiosyncrasies，常指独特习惯。

meanings_zh: adj. 热忱的；积极投入的
definition_en: Showing great enthusiasm and commitment to a cause or activity.
example1_en: A zealous volunteer cleaned the entire beach before lunch.
example1_zh: 一位热忱的志愿者午饭前就清理了整片海滩。
example2_en: Zealous campaigners can raise public awareness, but lasting environmental progress also requires effective government policies.
example2_zh: 热心的倡导者能够提高公众意识，但持久的环境改善还需要有效的政府政策。
collocations: a zealous supporter｜热忱的支持者 ; zealous in their efforts｜努力而热忱 ; overly zealous｜过分热心的
tip_zh: 语气比enthusiastic强，有时暗示热心得过头。

meanings_zh: v. 低声说；喃喃道 | n. 低语声；轻柔持续的声音 | n. 低声抱怨
definition_en: To speak in a quiet, gentle voice. | A quiet, continuous sound or softly spoken words. | A quiet expression of dissatisfaction or disagreement.
example1_en: She murmured a quiet thank you and smiled.
example1_zh: 她轻声道了谢，露出微笑。
example2_en: A murmur of concern spread through the audience as the proposed library closures were announced.
example2_zh: 拟议的图书馆关闭计划公布时，听众中传出一阵担忧的低语。
collocations: murmur softly｜轻声说 ; a murmur of approval｜低声赞同 ; without a murmur｜毫无怨言
tip_zh: 强调轻柔低声；mutter常带不满或含糊的意味。

meanings_zh: n. 纠正；修正 | n. 整流
definition_en: The process of correcting an error or putting something right | The process of converting alternating electric current into direct current
example1_en: The builder promised prompt rectification of the faulty wiring.
example1_zh: 建筑工人承诺及时修复有问题的线路。
example2_en: Independent inspections allow the early identification and rectification of structural defects before buildings are opened to the public.
example2_zh: 独立检查有助于在建筑向公众开放前，及早发现并修正结构缺陷。
collocations: rectification of errors｜错误的纠正 ; rectification work｜整改工作 ; half-wave rectification｜半波整流
tip_zh: 正式名词；日常说“纠正”常用correction。

meanings_zh: adv. 随同；与此一起 | adv. 随即；于是
definition_en: with that thing or together with it | immediately after that
example1_en: She handed him the parcel and a ribbon therewith.
example1_zh: 她把包裹连同一条丝带递给了他。
example2_en: Applicants must submit the completed form and all supporting documents therewith before the committee considers their request.
example2_zh: 申请人必须提交填好的表格及随附的全部证明文件，委员会才会审议其申请。
collocations: documents submitted therewith｜随同提交的文件 ; costs associated therewith｜与此相关的费用
tip_zh: 古旧或法律用语；日常用with it或along with it。

meanings_zh: v. 拖着脚缓慢行走 | n. 拖沓的步态
definition_en: To walk slowly and awkwardly, dragging your feet | A slow, awkward walk with dragging feet
example1_en: Still half asleep, he shambled into the kitchen.
example1_zh: 他还半睡半醒，拖着脚走进了厨房。
example2_en: After hours of physical work, exhausted labourers may shamble home rather than walk briskly.
example2_zh: 经过数小时的体力劳动，筋疲力尽的工人回家时可能脚步拖沓，而非步履轻快。
collocations: shamble along｜拖着脚缓慢前行 ; shamble into｜拖着脚走进 ; shamble across｜拖着脚穿过
tip_zh: 强调脚步拖沓、不利落，不一定是失去平衡。

meanings_zh: n. 牛轭 | n. 束缚；压迫 | v. 给…套轭；使强行结合
definition_en: A wooden frame joining two animals to pull a load. | A condition of being controlled or oppressed. | Join animals with a frame, or force things together.
example1_en: The farmer placed a wooden yoke across the oxen's necks.
example1_zh: 农夫把木轭架在两头牛的脖子上。
example2_en: Many communities struggled for generations to free themselves from the yoke of colonial rule.
example2_zh: 许多群体为摆脱殖民统治的枷锁，进行了数代人的抗争。
collocations: a wooden yoke｜木轭 ; the yoke of oppression｜压迫的枷锁 ; yoke together｜套轭连在一起
tip_zh: 与 yolk（蛋黄）同音；比喻义常指压迫的枷锁。

meanings_zh: v. 坚决否认；拒绝接受 | v. 拒绝履行；拒付
definition_en: To firmly reject a claim, belief, or association. | To refuse to honour an agreement or pay a debt.
example1_en: She firmly repudiated the rumour that she had cheated.
example1_zh: 她坚决否认了关于她作弊的传言。
example2_en: Professional associations should repudiate misleading claims that undermine public confidence in established medical treatments.
example2_zh: 专业协会应明确驳斥那些削弱公众对成熟医疗方法信心的误导性说法。
collocations: repudiate an allegation｜坚决否认指控 ; repudiate a claim｜驳斥某种说法 ; repudiate a contract｜拒绝履行合同 ; repudiate a debt｜拒付债务
tip_zh: 是正式动词，不是名词；名词为repudiation。

meanings_zh: n. 偶然事件；偶然性
definition_en: An event happening by chance, or chance itself.
example1_en: By sheer fortuity, we booked seats beside each other.
example1_zh: 纯属巧合，我们订的座位竟然挨在一起。
example2_en: Scientific breakthroughs sometimes involve fortuity, although careful observation remains essential for recognising the value of unexpected results.
example2_zh: 科学突破有时涉及偶然因素，但要认识到意外结果的价值，细致观察仍然至关重要。
collocations: by sheer fortuity｜纯属偶然 ; an element of fortuity｜偶然因素
tip_zh: 较罕见的正式词；日常表达多用chance或coincidence。

meanings_zh: n. 冲突；纷争
definition_en: serious disagreement or conflict between people or groups
example1_en: Arguments over money caused constant strife in the family.
example1_zh: 关于钱的争吵让这家人纷争不断。
example2_en: Economic inequality can fuel social strife when communities feel excluded from opportunities for a better life.
example2_zh: 当一些群体觉得自己被排除在改善生活的机会之外时，经济不平等可能加剧社会冲突。
collocations: social strife｜社会冲突 ; civil strife｜内乱 ; industrial strife｜劳资纠纷
tip_zh: 不可数名词，语气正式，比一般争论更严重。

meanings_zh: n. 小规模战斗；短暂冲突 | n. 小争执；短暂争论 | v. 发生小规模冲突
definition_en: A brief fight between small groups of opposing forces. | A brief argument, often within a larger disagreement. | Fight or argue briefly without a major confrontation.
example1_en: Their skirmish over the remote ended with a compromise.
example1_zh: 他们为遥控器起的小争执最终以妥协告终。
example2_en: A brief border skirmish can undermine diplomatic progress and discourage investment in nearby communities.
example2_zh: 短暂的边境冲突可能破坏外交进展，并削弱投资者对附近社区的投资意愿。
collocations: border skirmish｜边境小规模冲突 ; minor skirmish｜小冲突 ; skirmish over something｜围绕某事的争执
tip_zh: 强调规模小、时间短；也可比喻口头争执。

meanings_zh: n. 浮渣；浮垢 | n. 人渣（侮辱语）
definition_en: An unpleasant layer of waste or bubbles on a liquid. | An insulting word for people considered extremely unpleasant or immoral.
example1_en: He skimmed the scum off the simmering soup.
example1_zh: 他撇去了炖煮中的汤表面的浮沫。
example2_en: A thick layer of scum on a pond may indicate excessive nutrient levels caused by agricultural runoff.
example2_zh: 池塘表面厚厚的浮垢可能表明农业径流导致了水体营养物质过量。
collocations: skim off the scum｜撇去浮渣 ; a layer of scum｜一层浮垢 ; soap scum｜皂垢
tip_zh: 通常不可数；用来指人时侮辱性很强，应避免。

meanings_zh: adj. 滑溜的；蜿蜒滑行的
definition_en: slippery or moving smoothly with a twisting motion
example1_en: A slithery eel wriggled out of the fishing net.
example1_zh: 一条滑溜溜的鳗鱼扭动着钻出了渔网。
example2_en: Children can overcome their fear of slithery animals through supervised observation and lessons about local wildlife.
example2_zh: 通过有人指导的观察和有关当地野生动物的课程，孩子们可以克服对滑溜动物的恐惧。
collocations: a slithery snake｜蜿蜒滑行的蛇 ; a slithery eel｜滑溜溜的鳗鱼
tip_zh: 常形容蛇、鳗鱼等滑溜或扭动滑行的动物。

meanings_zh: adj. 小巧精致的 | adj. 文雅的；小心翼翼的
definition_en: small, delicate, and attractive | showing delicate or careful movements and manners
example1_en: She served the tea in dainty porcelain cups.
example1_zh: 她用小巧精致的瓷杯端上了茶。
example2_en: The exhibition features dainty ornaments that demonstrate the remarkable precision achieved by traditional craft workers.
example2_zh: 展览展出了小巧精美的饰品，体现出传统手工艺人令人赞叹的精湛技艺。
collocations: dainty jewellery｜小巧精致的首饰 ; dainty cups｜精巧的杯子 ; dainty bites｜小口进食
tip_zh: 常形容杯具、首饰等小而精致，不泛指高档。

meanings_zh: adj. 轻蔑的；鄙视的
definition_en: showing that you consider someone or something unworthy of respect
example1_en: She gave my muddy shoes a contemptuous glance.
example1_zh: 她轻蔑地瞥了一眼我沾满泥的鞋子。
example2_en: Leaders who are contemptuous of public concerns risk damaging trust in the institutions they represent.
example2_zh: 轻视公众关切的领导者可能损害公众对其所代表机构的信任。
collocations: contemptuous of｜鄙视……的 ; a contemptuous glance｜轻蔑的一瞥 ; a contemptuous tone｜轻蔑的语气
tip_zh: contemptuous是鄙视人的；contemptible是可鄙的。

meanings_zh: adj. 照相复制的
definition_en: Relating to copies of documents made by a photographic process.
example1_en: The archive kept a photostatic copy of her certificate.
example1_zh: 档案馆保存着她证书的一份照相复制件。
example2_en: Before digital scanning became widespread, photostatic reproduction allowed libraries to share rare documents without transporting the originals.
example2_zh: 在数字扫描普及之前，照相复制使图书馆能够共享珍贵文献，而无需运输原件。
collocations: a photostatic copy｜照相复制件 ; photostatic reproduction｜照相复制
tip_zh: 旧式技术用语，指照相复制，并非静电复印。

meanings_zh: adj. 不可撤销的；无法改变的
definition_en: Impossible to change, cancel, or take back.
example1_en: Once you sign, your decision becomes legally irrevocable.
example1_zh: 一旦签字，你的决定在法律上就不可撤销了。
example2_en: Governments should consult local communities before making irrevocable decisions about the destruction of historic buildings.
example2_zh: 政府在作出拆除历史建筑的不可撤销决定之前，应征求当地社区的意见。
collocations: an irrevocable decision｜不可撤销的决定 ; irrevocable consent｜不可撤销的同意 ; an irrevocable commitment｜不可撤回的承诺
tip_zh: 常修饰决定、同意或承诺，强调无法撤回。

meanings_zh: adv. 一般地；中等地
definition_en: To an ordinary degree, rather than exceptionally well or badly.
example1_en: The team played averagely but still won the match.
example1_zh: 这支球队表现一般，但还是赢了比赛。
example2_en: Students who perform averagely in examinations may still demonstrate considerable creativity through practical classroom projects.
example2_zh: 考试表现一般的学生，仍可能通过课堂实践项目展现出很强的创造力。
collocations: perform averagely｜表现一般 ; averagely talented｜天赋普通的
tip_zh: 此词较少见；表示“平均而言”通常用on average。

meanings_zh: n. 属（生物分类单位）
definition_en: a biological group containing closely related species
example1_en: These two garden plants belong to the same genus.
example1_zh: 这两种园艺植物属于同一个属。
example2_en: Scientists classified the newly discovered frog within an existing genus after comparing its genetic characteristics with related species.
example2_zh: 科学家将新发现的青蛙与近缘物种的遗传特征进行比较后，把它归入了一个已有的属。
collocations: belong to a genus｜属于某个属 ; the same genus｜同一个属 ; a new genus｜一个新属
tip_zh: 复数为genera；属低于科、高于种。

meanings_zh: v. 售货时缺斤少两
definition_en: Give a customer less weight of goods than paid for
example1_en: The shopkeeper short-weighted my rice by using faulty scales.
