example1_zh: 店主使用有问题的秤，卖给我的米缺斤少两。
example2_en: Regular inspections of market scales can prevent traders from short-weighting customers and help maintain confidence in local commerce.
example2_zh: 定期检查市场用秤可以防止商贩缺斤少两，并帮助维持消费者对当地商业的信任。
collocations: short-weight customers｜向顾客售货时缺斤少两 ; short-weight a buyer｜给买家不足分量的货
tip_zh: 动词指缺斤少两；名词通常分写为 short weight。

meanings_zh: adj. 轴的；轴向的
definition_en: relating to an axis or extending along it
example1_en: The mechanic checked the shaft for excessive axial movement.
example1_zh: 机械师检查了轴是否存在过大的轴向移动。
example2_en: Changes in the Earth's axial tilt influence how solar energy is distributed across the planet.
example2_zh: 地球自转轴倾角的变化会影响太阳能在全球的分布。
collocations: axial tilt｜轴倾角 ; axial rotation｜绕轴旋转 ; axial load｜轴向载荷
tip_zh: axial与轴有关；radial指沿半径方向的。

meanings_zh: v. 监督；主管
definition_en: To oversee and take responsibility for work or an activity.
example1_en: An experienced gardener superintended the planting of our trees.
example1_zh: 一位经验丰富的园丁监督了我们种树的过程。
example2_en: Qualified engineers should superintend major construction projects to ensure that safety standards are consistently maintained.
example2_zh: 大型建设项目应由合格工程师监督，以确保始终遵守安全标准。
collocations: superintend construction｜监督施工 ; superintend the work｜监督工作 ; superintend operations｜主管业务
tip_zh: 正式及物动词，直接接工作或活动；日常多用supervise。

meanings_zh: adj. 基本的；根本的 | adj. 自然力的 | adj. 元素态的
definition_en: Relating to the most basic features or forces of something. | Relating to powerful natural forces such as wind and water. | Consisting of a chemical element rather than a compound.
example1_en: The storm awakened an elemental fear deep inside me.
example1_zh: 暴风雨唤起了我内心深处最本能的恐惧。
example2_en: Access to food and shelter addresses elemental human needs that economic policy should never overlook.
example2_zh: 获得食物和住所满足了基本的人类需求，经济政策绝不应忽视这些需求。
collocations: elemental forces｜自然力量 ; an elemental fear｜本能的恐惧 ; elemental carbon｜单质碳
tip_zh: elemental强调根本或自然力；elementary常指初级。

meanings_zh: n. 精确复制品；摹本 | n. 传真；传真件
definition_en: An exact copy of a document, book, or picture | A copy of a document sent electronically over telephone lines
example1_en: The museum shop sells a facsimile of this ancient map.
example1_zh: 博物馆商店出售这幅古地图的精确复制品。
example2_en: A high-quality facsimile allows researchers to examine historical documents without damaging the fragile originals.
example2_zh: 高质量的摹本让研究人员能够查阅历史文献，而不损坏脆弱的原件。
collocations: a facsimile edition｜影印版 ; an exact facsimile｜精确复制品 ; send by facsimile｜通过传真发送
tip_zh: 指精确复制品；表示传真时通常简称fax。

meanings_zh: n. 镭（放射性金属元素）
definition_en: A radioactive metallic chemical element
example1_en: We learned about radium during our science lesson today.
example1_zh: 今天的科学课上，我们学习了有关镭的知识。
example2_en: The discovery of radium advanced scientific understanding of radioactivity, although its health risks were initially underestimated.
example2_zh: 镭的发现推动了科学界对放射性的认识，但其健康风险起初被低估了。
collocations: radium decay｜镭的衰变 ; radium exposure｜镭暴露 ; radium isotopes｜镭同位素
tip_zh: radium是不可数名词，元素符号为Ra。

meanings_zh: n. 人群；大群人 | v. 蜂拥；挤满
definition_en: a large crowd of people gathered closely together | to gather somewhere in large numbers
example1_en: We pushed through the throng to reach the exit.
example1_zh: 我们挤过人群，来到出口。
example2_en: Throngs of visitors can place considerable pressure on historic sites during the peak tourist season.
example2_zh: 在旅游旺季，大批游客可能给历史遗址带来相当大的压力。
collocations: a throng of people｜一大群人 ; throngs of tourists｜成群的游客 ; throng the streets｜挤满街道
tip_zh: 偏书面；a throng of后接复数名词。

meanings_zh: n. 溃疡
definition_en: an open sore on the skin or inside the body
example1_en: This mouth ulcer makes eating fresh oranges uncomfortable.
example1_zh: 这个口腔溃疡让我吃鲜橙时很不舒服。
example2_en: Early diagnosis of a stomach ulcer can help patients receive appropriate treatment and avoid complications.
example2_zh: 及早诊断胃溃疡有助于患者接受适当治疗并避免并发症。
collocations: a stomach ulcer｜胃溃疡 ; a mouth ulcer｜口腔溃疡 ; a peptic ulcer｜消化性溃疡
tip_zh: 可数名词，常用身体部位修饰，如mouth ulcer。

meanings_zh: adj. 坚韧不拔的；执着的 | adj. 紧抓不放的；难消除的
definition_en: determined to continue despite difficulties | holding firmly or remaining difficult to remove or change
example1_en: The tenacious runner kept going despite the steep hill.
example1_zh: 尽管山坡陡峭，那位意志顽强的跑者仍继续前进。
example2_en: Tenacious researchers often overcome repeated setbacks before producing discoveries that significantly improve public health.
example2_zh: 坚韧不拔的研究人员往往要克服重重挫折，才能取得显著改善公共健康的发现。
collocations: a tenacious campaigner｜坚持不懈的倡导者 ; a tenacious grip｜紧紧的抓握 ; tenacious resistance｜顽强的抵抗
tip_zh: 核心是坚持不放弃；也可形容抓得紧或难消除。

meanings_zh: n. 病情缓解期；缓解 | n. 减免；赦免
definition_en: A period when a serious illness improves or becomes inactive. | An official reduction or cancellation of a debt or punishment.
example1_en: Her illness is in remission, and she feels stronger.
example1_zh: 她的病情处于缓解期，身体也感觉更有力了。
example2_en: Advances in medical treatment have enabled more patients to achieve remission and enjoy a better quality of life.
example2_zh: 医疗进步使更多患者得以缓解病情，并享有更好的生活质量。
collocations: in remission｜处于病情缓解期 ; complete remission｜完全缓解 ; remission of debt｜债务减免
tip_zh: in remission指病情缓解，不一定表示治愈。

meanings_zh: n. 列宁主义
definition_en: Lenin's political theories, particularly concerning revolution and leadership by a party.
example1_en: Our history teacher explained Leninism during today's afternoon lesson.
example1_zh: 历史老师在今天下午的课上讲解了列宁主义。
example2_en: Students studying Leninism often examine its influence on revolutionary movements and political institutions during the twentieth century.
example2_zh: 研究列宁主义的学生常考察它对二十世纪革命运动和政治制度的影响。
collocations: the principles of Leninism｜列宁主义的原则 ; the influence of Leninism｜列宁主义的影响 ; Marxism-Leninism｜马克思列宁主义
tip_zh: 专有思想名称，首字母大写；通常作不可数名词。

meanings_zh: n. 性情；性格 | n. 倾向；意愿 | n. 部署；排列
definition_en: a person's usual mood and way of behaving | a natural tendency or willingness to do something | the arrangement of people or things in particular positions
example1_en: Her cheerful disposition makes even rainy mornings feel brighter.
example1_zh: 她开朗的性格让阴雨天的早晨也显得明亮起来。
example2_en: Children with a cautious disposition may benefit from gradual exposure to unfamiliar classroom activities.
example2_zh: 性格谨慎的孩子逐步接触陌生的课堂活动，可能会从中受益。
collocations: cheerful disposition｜开朗的性格 ; a disposition to help｜乐于助人的倾向 ; a disposition towards anxiety｜容易焦虑的倾向
tip_zh: 性情义常用单数；a disposition to do表示做某事的倾向。

meanings_zh: v. 有助于；产生某种结果
definition_en: To produce a particular result, especially credit or benefit.
example1_en: Your generosity will redound to the whole team's credit.
example1_zh: 你的慷慨之举将为整个团队增光。
example2_en: Sustained investment in public libraries can redound to the benefit of communities by expanding access to knowledge.
example2_zh: 持续投资公共图书馆可以扩大获取知识的机会，从而造福社区。
collocations: redound to someone's credit｜为某人增光 ; redound to the benefit of｜有益于 ; redound to someone's honour｜为某人增添荣誉
tip_zh: 正式且少见；常接to，不能直接接宾语表示增加。

meanings_zh: n. 洗清罪名；免责
definition_en: An official finding that someone is not guilty or responsible.
example1_en: Her exoneration brought relief to the whole family.
example1_zh: 她获证清白，让全家都松了一口气。
example2_en: The exoneration of wrongly convicted individuals demonstrates why legal systems must allow new evidence to be reviewed.
example2_zh: 被错误定罪者获证清白，说明司法体系必须允许重新审查新证据。
collocations: complete exoneration｜彻底洗清罪名 ; seek exoneration｜寻求洗清罪名 ; lead to exoneration｜使人获证清白
tip_zh: 强调证明无罪或无责；pardon指赦免。

meanings_zh: v. 仔细阅读；审阅
definition_en: To read or examine something carefully
example1_en: Please peruse the rental agreement before you sign it.
example1_zh: 签字前请仔细阅读租赁协议。
example2_en: Students should peruse the assessment criteria carefully before preparing their final research projects for submission.
example2_zh: 学生在准备提交最终研究项目之前，应仔细阅读评分标准。
collocations: peruse a document｜审阅文件 ; peruse a report｜仔细阅读报告 ; peruse carefully｜仔细审阅
tip_zh: 正式用词；直接接阅读对象，名词为perusal。

meanings_zh: n. 黄铁矿
definition_en: a shiny yellow mineral containing iron and sulphur
example1_en: The tiny piece of pyrite glittered in her palm.
example1_zh: 那小块黄铁矿在她掌心闪闪发亮。
example2_en: Although pyrite resembles gold, its chemical composition and commercial value are very different from those of gold.
example2_zh: 虽然黄铁矿看似黄金，但其化学成分和商业价值与黄金大不相同。
collocations: pyrite crystals｜黄铁矿晶体 ; pyrite deposits｜黄铁矿矿床 ; iron pyrite｜黄铁矿
tip_zh: 因外观似金，俗称 fool’s gold（愚人金）。

meanings_zh: n. 全身不适；不安 | n. 萎靡；低迷状态
definition_en: a general feeling of illness or unease without a clear cause | a widespread lack of confidence, energy, or progress in society
example1_en: A lingering malaise kept me on the sofa all afternoon.
example1_zh: 持续的不适让我整个下午都待在沙发上。
example2_en: Prolonged economic malaise can weaken public confidence and discourage businesses from investing in new projects.
example2_zh: 长期的经济低迷会削弱公众信心，并使企业不愿投资新项目。
collocations: general malaise｜全身不适 ; economic malaise｜经济低迷 ; a sense of malaise｜一种不安感
tip_zh: 较正式，既指笼统的身体不适，也可指社会经济低迷。

meanings_zh: v. 穿插；点缀；散布
definition_en: to place things among others at intervals
example1_en: She interspersed bright flowers among the herbs on her balcony.
example1_zh: 她在阳台的香草植物之间点缀了鲜艳的花朵。
example2_en: Teachers can intersperse short discussions throughout lectures to maintain attention and encourage students to participate.
example2_zh: 教师可以在讲课过程中穿插简短讨论，以保持学生的注意力并鼓励参与。
collocations: intersperse A with B｜在A中穿插B ; be interspersed with｜间杂着 ; intersperse throughout｜穿插于各处
tip_zh: intersperse A with B：在A中穿插B。

meanings_zh: n. 全套用具；杂七杂八的物品
definition_en: The various objects needed for a particular activity.
example1_en: Our camping paraphernalia filled every corner of the garage.
example1_zh: 我们的露营用具塞满了车库的每个角落。
example2_en: Schools need adequate storage for sports paraphernalia to keep shared spaces safe and equipment accessible to students.
example2_zh: 学校需要充足的空间存放体育用具，以确保公共区域安全，并方便学生取用器材。
collocations: camping paraphernalia｜露营用具 ; sports paraphernalia｜体育用具 ; all the paraphernalia｜全套杂项用具
tip_zh: 通常作不可数名词，不加a，也不再加复数s。

meanings_zh: n. 藻；藻类生物
definition_en: A simple organism that photosynthesises, usually living in water.
example1_en: Under the microscope, the tiny green alga looked beautiful.
example1_zh: 在显微镜下，这个微小的绿藻显得很美。
example2_en: Researchers are investigating whether this freshwater alga can remove pollutants from wastewater while producing material suitable for biofuel.
example2_zh: 研究人员正在探索这种淡水藻能否在去除废水污染物的同时，产生适合制造生物燃料的原料。
collocations: a freshwater alga｜一种淡水藻 ; green algae｜绿藻 ; algal growth｜藻类生长
tip_zh: alga是单数，复数为algae；整体谈藻类常用复数。

meanings_zh: adj. 悦耳的；旋律优美的
definition_en: Having a pleasant musical sound
example1_en: A melodious whistle drifted through the open kitchen window.
example1_zh: 一阵悦耳的口哨声从敞开的厨房窗户飘了进来。
example2_en: Traditional instruments produce melodious sounds that can introduce younger audiences to their cultural heritage.
example2_zh: 传统乐器奏出的优美乐声可以引导年轻听众了解自己的文化遗产。
collocations: melodious voice｜悦耳的嗓音 ; melodious song｜旋律优美的歌曲 ; melodious sound｜悦耳的声音
tip_zh: 强调声音悦耳；melodic侧重与旋律有关。

meanings_zh: n. 漩涡；涡流 | v. 打旋；形成漩涡
definition_en: A circular current in water or air. | To move in a circular current.
example1_en: A fallen leaf spun in an eddy beside the bridge.
example1_zh: 一片落叶在桥边的漩涡中打转。
example2_en: Small eddies behind river barriers can trap floating waste and affect the movement of aquatic organisms.
example2_zh: 河流障碍物后的小漩涡会困住漂浮垃圾，并影响水生生物的移动。
collocations: a swirling eddy｜旋转的涡流 ; river eddies｜河流中的漩涡 ; eddy currents｜涡流
tip_zh: 可指水流或气流打旋；复数为eddies。

meanings_zh: adj. 闷闷不乐的；阴沉的
definition_en: Silently showing anger or unhappiness and refusing to be friendly.
example1_en: He gave a sullen shrug and stared at the floor.
example1_zh: 他闷闷不乐地耸了耸肩，盯着地板。
example2_en: Students who feel excluded may become sullen and less willing to participate in classroom discussions.
example2_zh: 感到被排斥的学生可能变得郁郁不乐，也更不愿参与课堂讨论。
collocations: sullen silence｜阴郁的沉默 ; a sullen expression｜阴沉的表情 ; a sullen mood｜闷闷不乐的心情
tip_zh: 强调生气或不快时沉默、不友好的样子。

meanings_zh: v. 抢掠；掠夺 | n. 掠夺物；赃物
definition_en: To steal goods by force, especially during war. | Goods stolen by force, especially during war.
example1_en: The pirates plundered the ship and took its silver.
example1_zh: 海盗洗劫了那艘船，抢走了船上的白银。
example2_en: Invading armies often plunder historic sites, causing permanent damage to the cultural heritage of affected communities.
example2_zh: 入侵军队常常劫掠历史遗址，对当地社区的文化遗产造成永久损害。
collocations: plunder a city｜洗劫城市 ; plunder resources｜掠夺资源 ; stolen plunder｜抢来的财物
tip_zh: 常指战乱中的抢掠；也可指肆意掠夺资源。

meanings_zh: n. 四个一组；四件套 | n. 四分体
definition_en: A group or set of four things. | Four chromatids formed when homologous chromosomes pair during meiosis.
example1_en: Under the microscope, we spotted a tetrad of cells.
example1_zh: 在显微镜下，我们发现了一组四个细胞。
example2_en: During meiosis, each tetrad allows genetic material to be exchanged between paired chromosomes, contributing to biological diversity.
example2_zh: 在减数分裂过程中，每个四分体使配对染色体之间能够交换遗传物质，从而促进生物多样性。
collocations: a tetrad of cells｜一组四个细胞 ; tetrad formation｜四分体形成 ; tetrad analysis｜四分体分析
tip_zh: 专业词；生物学四分体含四条染色单体。

meanings_zh: v. 删节；节略
definition_en: To shorten a written work while keeping its main content.
example1_en: The publisher abridged the novel for younger readers.
example1_zh: 出版社为较年幼的读者推出了这部小说的删节版。
example2_en: Publishers often abridge classic novels to make them more accessible to students with limited reading experience.
example2_zh: 出版社经常删节经典小说，使阅读经验有限的学生更容易读懂。
collocations: abridge a novel｜删节小说 ; an abridged edition｜删节版 ; an abridged version｜节略版本
tip_zh: 删去部分内容但保留主干，不等同于写摘要。

meanings_zh: v. 投降；屈服；让步
definition_en: to stop resisting and accept another person's demands
example1_en: After hours of arguing, we capitulated and ordered pizza.
example1_zh: 争论了几个小时后，我们终于让步，点了披萨。
example2_en: Governments should not capitulate to commercial pressure when public health and environmental protection are at stake.
example2_zh: 当公共健康和环境保护受到威胁时，政府不应向商业压力屈服。
collocations: capitulate to pressure｜屈服于压力 ; capitulate to demands｜接受要求而让步
tip_zh: 不及物动词；向某人或压力屈服用capitulate to。

meanings_zh: v. 同意；应允 | v. 就任；即位
definition_en: to formally agree to a request, demand, or proposal | to take an important official position, especially as a ruler
example1_en: The landlord finally acceded to our request for repairs.
example1_zh: 房东终于答应了我们提出的维修要求。
example2_en: Governments may accede to public demands for greater transparency when trust in national institutions declines.
example2_zh: 当公众对国家机构的信任下降时，政府可能会同意提高透明度的要求。
collocations: accede to a request｜答应请求 ; accede to demands｜同意要求 ; accede to the throne｜即位
tip_zh: 正式用语，通常接to；勿与exceed（超过）混淆。

meanings_zh: n. 漫长而多波折的旅程
definition_en: a long journey involving many difficult or exciting experiences
example1_en: Their cycling odyssey took them across deserts and mountains.
example1_zh: 他们漫长的骑行历程带他们穿越了沙漠和群山。
example2_en: The documentary follows one family's odyssey across several continents, exploring how migration reshapes identity and belonging.
example2_zh: 这部纪录片跟随一个家庭跨越数大洲的漫长旅程，探讨迁移如何重塑身份认同与归属感。
collocations: epic odyssey｜壮阔的漫长旅程 ; personal odyssey｜个人的探索历程 ; spiritual odyssey｜心灵探索之旅
tip_zh: 文学色彩较强，也可比喻人生探索；复数odysseys。

meanings_zh: adv. 其中的；有关它的
definition_en: of or relating to the thing just mentioned
example1_en: We discussed dinner plans, or rather the lack thereof.
example1_zh: 我们讨论了晚餐安排，确切说，是根本没有安排这回事。
example2_en: Access to public transport, or the lack thereof, strongly influences employment opportunities in rural communities.
example2_zh: 能否使用公共交通，会显著影响农村社区居民的就业机会。
collocations: lack thereof｜其缺乏 ; parts thereof｜其中的部分 ; any portion thereof｜其中的任何部分
tip_zh: 意为of that，常见于法律文体，不等于therefore。

meanings_zh: adj. 与死亡有关而恐怖的
definition_en: Disturbing or frightening because of a connection with death.
example1_en: The old theatre displayed a macabre painting of dancing skeletons.
example1_zh: 那座老剧院陈列着一幅骷髅起舞的恐怖画作。
example2_en: Macabre imagery in literature can encourage readers to reflect on mortality rather than merely provoke fear.
example2_zh: 文学中与死亡有关的恐怖意象可以促使读者思考生命的终结，而不只是引发恐惧。
collocations: macabre humour｜死亡主题的黑色幽默 ; macabre imagery｜死亡主题的恐怖意象 ; macabre tale｜恐怖故事
tip_zh: 不泛指吓人，通常涉及死亡或令人不安的细节。

meanings_zh: n. 硬化；硬化症
definition_en: Abnormal hardening of tissue within the body.
example1_en: The specialist explained that sclerosis involves hardening of body tissue.
example1_zh: 专科医生解释说，硬化涉及身体组织变硬。
example2_en: Multiple sclerosis affects the central nervous system, and its symptoms can vary considerably between individuals.
example2_zh: 多发性硬化症影响中枢神经系统，其症状可能因人而异。
collocations: multiple sclerosis｜多发性硬化症 ; tissue sclerosis｜组织硬化
tip_zh: 医学词；multiple sclerosis是多发性硬化症。

meanings_zh: v. 束缚；限制 | n. 桎梏；束缚；脚镣
definition_en: To restrict someone's freedom or ability to act. | Something limiting freedom, or a chain securing someone's ankles.
example1_en: Don't let fear fetter your plans to travel alone.
example1_zh: 别让恐惧束缚你独自旅行的计划。
example2_en: Excessive administrative requirements can fetter small businesses, preventing them from investing in innovation and creating jobs.
example2_zh: 过多的行政要求可能束缚小企业，使其无法投资创新和创造就业机会。
collocations: be fettered by｜受到……束缚 ; fetter creativity｜束缚创造力 ; break free from fetters｜挣脱束缚
tip_zh: 较正式；名词通常用复数fetters。

meanings_zh: v. 为家具装软垫及面料
definition_en: To cover furniture with padding and fabric or leather.
example1_en: They upholstered the old chair in soft blue velvet.
example1_zh: 他们给那把旧椅子加了软垫，并包上柔软的蓝色天鹅绒。
example2_en: Learning to upholster furniture can help people extend its useful life and reduce household waste.
example2_zh: 学习给家具加装软垫和面料，有助于延长家具的使用寿命并减少家庭垃圾。
collocations: upholster a chair｜给椅子装软垫及面料 ; upholstered in leather｜用皮革包面的 ; upholstered furniture｜软包家具
tip_zh: 专指给家具装软垫、包面料，不泛指装修。

meanings_zh: n. 大比目鱼；其鱼肉
definition_en: A large flat sea fish, also eaten as food
example1_en: We ordered grilled halibut with potatoes and fresh lemon.
example1_zh: 我们点了烤大比目鱼，配土豆和鲜柠檬。
example2_en: Strict fishing limits can help protect halibut populations while supporting the long-term livelihoods of coastal communities.
example2_zh: 严格的捕捞限额有助于保护大比目鱼种群，同时保障沿海社区的长远生计。
collocations: grilled halibut｜烤大比目鱼 ; halibut fillet｜大比目鱼鱼片 ; halibut fishing｜大比目鱼捕捞
tip_zh: 指鱼时复数通常仍为halibut；指鱼肉时不可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 气动的；充气的
definition_en: operated by compressed air or filled with air
example1_en: Workers used a pneumatic drill to break the pavement.
example1_zh: 工人用风钻凿开路面。
example2_en: Pneumatic systems are widely used in manufacturing because compressed air can power tools safely and efficiently.
example2_zh: 气动系统广泛用于制造业，因为压缩空气能安全高效地驱动工具。
collocations: a pneumatic drill｜风钻 ; pneumatic tyres｜充气轮胎 ; a pneumatic system｜气动系统
tip_zh: 词首p不发音；常指靠压缩空气驱动的设备。

meanings_zh: n. 谵妄；急性精神错乱 | n. 极度兴奋；狂喜
definition_en: A sudden confused mental state, often caused by illness. | A state of extreme excitement or happiness.
example1_en: During his fever, he slipped into delirium and spoke incoherently.
example1_zh: 发烧期间，他陷入谵妄状态，说话语无伦次。
example2_en: Hospital staff need appropriate training to recognise delirium promptly, particularly among older patients recovering from surgery.
example2_zh: 医院工作人员需要接受适当培训，以及时识别谵妄，尤其是术后恢复中的老年患者出现的谵妄。
collocations: acute delirium｜急性谵妄 ; postoperative delirium｜术后谵妄 ; a state of delirium｜谵妄状态
tip_zh: 医学义是急性意识混乱，不等于长期痴呆。

meanings_zh: adj. 积习难改的；成癖的
definition_en: Having a long-established habit that is unlikely to change.
example1_en: My uncle is an inveterate collector of old maps.
example1_zh: 我叔叔收藏旧地图成癖。
example2_en: Inveterate car users may resist public transport initiatives unless services become substantially more convenient and reliable.
example2_zh: 除非服务变得便捷可靠得多，否则长期习惯开车的人可能会抵触推广公共交通的举措。
collocations: inveterate liar｜惯于撒谎的人 ; inveterate gambler｜嗜赌成性的人 ; inveterate traveller｜常年热衷旅行的人
tip_zh: 通常置于名词前，强调长期习惯难以改变。

meanings_zh: adj. 站得住脚的；可维持的
definition_en: Able to be defended or maintained against criticism.
example1_en: His excuse was no longer tenable after we checked.
example1_zh: 我们核实后，他的借口就再也站不住脚了。
example2_en: The assumption that economic growth always improves public wellbeing is no longer tenable in every context.
example2_zh: 经济增长总能改善公众福祉这一假设，已不能在所有情境下成立。
collocations: a tenable position｜站得住脚的立场 ; a tenable argument｜经得起推敲的论点 ; no longer tenable｜不再站得住脚
tip_zh: 常形容论点或立场站得住脚，不等于舒适。

meanings_zh: v. 紧握；抱紧 | n. 搭扣；扣环 | n. 紧握；紧抱
definition_en: To hold someone or something firmly. | A small fastening that holds something closed. | A firm hold with the hands or arms.
example1_en: She clasped my hand as we crossed the bridge.
example1_zh: 过桥时，她紧紧握住我的手。
example2_en: Young children may clasp a familiar toy during medical appointments because it provides comfort in unfamiliar surroundings.
example2_zh: 幼儿就诊时可能会紧抱熟悉的玩具，因为它能在陌生环境中带来安慰。
collocations: clasp someone's hand｜紧握某人的手 ; clasp your hands together｜双手紧握 ; a necklace clasp｜项链搭扣
tip_zh: clasp作动词强调握紧；作名词也可指首饰搭扣。

meanings_zh: n. 田园般的恬静生活 | n. 田园诗；田园短篇
definition_en: A peaceful, happy experience, especially in the countryside. | A poem or short story describing peaceful country life.
example1_en: Our summer idyll ended when the noisy builders arrived.
example1_zh: 吵闹的建筑工人一来，我们宁静美好的夏日生活便结束了。
example2_en: The rural idyll portrayed in tourism campaigns often overlooks the economic difficulties faced by farming communities.
example2_zh: 旅游宣传中描绘的田园乐境往往忽视了农业社区面临的经济困难。
collocations: rural idyll｜田园乐境 ; summer idyll｜夏日的恬静时光 ; pastoral idyll｜田园诗般的生活
tip_zh: 既可指田园诗，也常指田园般的恬静生活。

meanings_zh: adj. 哀怨的；悲伤的
definition_en: Sounding sad, especially in a gentle or complaining way.
example1_en: A plaintive cry came from the kitten outside our door.
example1_zh: 门外的小猫发出了一声哀怨的叫声。
example2_en: The musician uses a plaintive melody to convey the loneliness experienced by people living far from home.
example2_zh: 这位音乐家用哀伤的旋律表达远离家乡的人所感受到的孤独。
collocations: plaintive cry｜哀怨的叫声 ; plaintive voice｜哀伤的嗓音 ; plaintive melody｜忧伤的旋律
tip_zh: 多形容声音、语调或旋律中流露的哀伤。

meanings_zh: adj. 能构思的；有构想力的
definition_en: Capable of forming ideas or mental images.
example1_en: The philosopher described imagination as a conceptive faculty.
example1_zh: 这位哲学家把想象力描述为一种形成心中构想的能力。
example2_en: In older philosophical writing, the conceptive faculty enables people to form ideas beyond their immediate sensory experience.
example2_zh: 在较早的哲学著作中，构想能力使人能够形成超出当下感官经验的观念。
collocations: conceptive faculty｜构想能力 ; conceptive power｜构想力
tip_zh: 罕见词；勿与表示“概念上的”conceptual混用。

meanings_zh: v. 告知；通知
definition_en: to formally inform someone about something
example1_en: Please apprise me of any changes before Friday.
example1_zh: 如有任何变化，请在周五前告知我。
example2_en: Schools should apprise parents of significant policy changes before introducing new rules that affect their children.
example2_zh: 学校在推行影响孩子的新规定之前，应告知家长重大的政策变化。
collocations: apprise someone of something｜将某事告知某人 ; keep someone apprised｜随时向某人通报
tip_zh: 正式用语；用apprise sb of sth，勿混appraise。

meanings_zh: adv. 极其；非常
definition_en: To a very great degree, especially in a positive way.
example1_en: Your spare room looks eminently suitable for a study.
example1_zh: 你那间空房看起来非常适合用作书房。
example2_en: Improving insulation is an eminently sensible way to reduce household energy consumption and heating costs.
example2_zh: 改善隔热保温是降低家庭能耗和取暖费用的非常明智的方法。
collocations: eminently suitable｜非常合适 ; eminently sensible｜极为明智 ; eminently reasonable｜十分合理 ; eminently qualified｜完全胜任
tip_zh: 常修饰褒义形容词；勿与imminently（即将）混淆。

meanings_zh: n. 炼金术 | n. 神奇的转变力量
definition_en: An ancient practice seeking to turn ordinary metals into gold | A mysterious process that transforms ordinary things into something special
example1_en: The exhibition explored alchemy through old jars and furnaces.
example1_zh: 展览通过古老的罐子和熔炉来介绍炼金术。
example2_en: Although alchemy lacked a modern scientific framework, its experimental techniques contributed to the development of chemistry.
example2_zh: 虽然炼金术缺乏现代科学框架，但其实验技术推动了化学的发展。
collocations: medieval alchemy｜中世纪炼金术 ; practise alchemy｜从事炼金术 ; the alchemy of creativity｜创造力的神奇转化作用
tip_zh: 通常不可数；比喻义强调神奇转化，并非泛指魔法。

meanings_zh: n. 崇敬；敬畏
definition_en: Deep respect and admiration for someone or something.
example1_en: She handled her grandmother's old violin with quiet reverence.
example1_zh: 她怀着深深的敬意，轻轻拿起祖母的旧小提琴。
example2_en: Reverence for traditional craftsmanship can encourage communities to preserve skills that might otherwise disappear.
example2_zh: 对传统工艺的崇敬能促使社区保留那些可能失传的技艺。
collocations: reverence for｜对……的崇敬 ; deep reverence｜深深的敬意 ; treat with reverence｜恭敬对待
tip_zh: 通常不可数；对某人的崇敬用reverence for。

meanings_zh: n. 流行性腮腺炎
definition_en: A viral illness causing painful swelling near the jaw
example1_en: The doctor checked her swollen cheeks for signs of mumps.
example1_zh: 医生检查了她肿胀的脸颊，判断是否有腮腺炎的迹象。
example2_en: Routine vaccination helps prevent mumps and reduces the likelihood of outbreaks in schools and other crowded settings.
example2_zh: 常规接种疫苗有助于预防腮腺炎，并降低学校及其他人员密集场所暴发疫情的可能性。
collocations: catch mumps｜感染腮腺炎 ; mumps vaccine｜腮腺炎疫苗 ; mumps outbreak｜腮腺炎疫情暴发
tip_zh: 虽以s结尾，但作疾病名称用单数：mumps is。

meanings_zh: adj. 温文尔雅的；善于应酬的
definition_en: Polite, confident, and comfortable in social situations.
example1_en: Our urbane host welcomed everyone with a warm smile.
example1_zh: 我们温文尔雅的主人面带温暖的微笑欢迎每一位客人。
example2_en: An urbane manner can help diplomats build trust, although successful negotiations also require substantial expertise.
example2_zh: 温文尔雅的举止能帮助外交官建立信任，不过成功的谈判也需要扎实的专业知识。
collocations: urbane manner｜温文尔雅的举止 ; urbane charm｜儒雅的魅力 ; urbane host｜善于应酬的主人
tip_zh: urbane指人文雅善交际；urban指城市的。

meanings_zh: adj. 表面上的；声称的
definition_en: Stated or appearing to be true, but possibly not genuine
example1_en: His ostensible reason for visiting was to return my umbrella.
example1_zh: 他来访的表面理由是归还我的雨伞。
example2_en: The ostensible purpose of the policy was environmental protection, although it also benefited domestic manufacturers.
example2_zh: 这项政策声称旨在保护环境，但它也使国内制造商受益。
collocations: ostensible reason｜表面上的理由 ; ostensible purpose｜声称的目的 ; ostensible aim｜表面上的目标
tip_zh: 暗示表象可能不是真相，但不等于已证实虚假。

meanings_zh: n. 困境；难以摆脱的局面 | n. 泥沼；泥泞地
definition_en: A complicated, unpleasant situation that is difficult to escape. | An area of soft wet ground that can trap you.
example1_en: Our simple kitchen renovation became a quagmire of unexpected expenses.
example1_zh: 我们原本简单的厨房翻修变成了意外开支不断的困局。
example2_en: Without clear regulations, major infrastructure projects can become trapped in a quagmire of legal disputes and financial uncertainty.
example2_zh: 缺乏明确法规，大型基础设施项目可能陷入法律纠纷与财务不确定性交织的困境。
collocations: a legal quagmire｜法律困境 ; a political quagmire｜政治泥潭 ; be mired in a quagmire｜深陷泥潭
tip_zh: 常比喻复杂且难脱身的困境，不泛指普通困难。

meanings_zh: adj. 全体出席的 | n. 全体会议 | adj. 完全的；不受限制的
definition_en: Involving all members of a group or meeting. | A meeting attended by all participants in a larger event. | Complete or unrestricted, especially concerning official power.
example1_en: All workshop groups joined the plenary session after lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭后，所有研讨小组都参加了全体会议。
example2_en: During the plenary debate, delegates discussed how international cooperation could improve access to clean drinking water.
example2_zh: 在全体辩论中，代表们讨论了国际合作如何改善清洁饮用水的获取条件。
collocations: plenary session｜全体会议 ; plenary debate｜全体辩论 ; plenary powers｜全权
tip_zh: 会议语境指全体参加；plenary powers指全权。

meanings_zh: v. 使重伤致残
definition_en: To injure someone severely, causing lasting damage to their body.
example1_en: This machine could maim someone without its safety guard.
example1_zh: 这台机器若没有安全防护装置，可能会使人重伤致残。
example2_en: Strict workplace inspections are essential because unguarded machinery can maim workers and leave them with lifelong disabilities.
example2_zh: 严格的工作场所检查至关重要，因为缺乏防护的机器可能使工人重伤，并造成终身残疾。
collocations: maim workers｜使工人重伤致残 ; maimed in an accident｜在事故中重伤致残
tip_zh: 比injure严重，强调造成永久性身体损伤。

meanings_zh: n. 系数
definition_en: A numerical factor multiplying a variable or measuring a property.
example1_en: Our teacher explained how the coefficient changes the curve.
example1_zh: 老师解释了系数如何改变曲线的形状。
example2_en: A high correlation coefficient indicates a strong statistical relationship, but it does not necessarily establish causation.
example2_zh: 较高的相关系数表明存在较强的统计关联，但不一定能证明因果关系。
collocations: correlation coefficient｜相关系数 ; coefficient of friction｜摩擦系数 ; thermal expansion coefficient｜热膨胀系数
tip_zh: 数学中指系数；相关系数高不代表存在因果关系。

meanings_zh: n. 女男爵；男爵夫人
definition_en: A woman holding a baron's rank, or a baron's wife.
example1_en: The baroness welcomed visitors into her family's old castle.
example1_zh: 女男爵欢迎游客来到她家族的古堡。
example2_en: The portrait of the baroness illustrates how clothing once communicated social rank and wealth.
example2_zh: 这幅女男爵肖像展示了服饰过去如何传达社会地位和财富。
collocations: a life baroness｜终身女男爵 ; the title of baroness｜女男爵头衔
tip_zh: 可指本人拥有爵位的女性，也可指男爵之妻。

meanings_zh: n. 倒影；反射 | n. 深思；反省
definition_en: an image in a shiny surface, or light bouncing back | careful thought about an experience or idea
example1_en: She caught her reflexion in the still pond.
example1_zh: 她在平静的池塘里看到了自己的倒影。
example2_en: Regular reflexion on classroom experiences can help teachers identify more effective ways to support individual learners.
example2_zh: 定期反思课堂经历可以帮助教师找到更有效的方法，为不同学习者提供支持。
collocations: reflexion of light｜光的反射 ; on reflexion｜仔细考虑后 ; careful reflexion｜认真思考
tip_zh: reflexion 是少用变体；考试写作宜用 reflection。

meanings_zh: n. 脊髓灰质炎；小儿麻痹症
definition_en: A viral disease that can damage nerves and cause paralysis.
example1_en: The nurse explained how vaccination protects children against poliomyelitis.
example1_zh: 护士解释了接种疫苗如何保护儿童免患脊髓灰质炎。
example2_en: International vaccination programmes have greatly reduced poliomyelitis, although continued monitoring remains essential to prevent further outbreaks.
example2_zh: 国际疫苗接种计划大幅减少了脊髓灰质炎病例，但持续监测对于防止再次暴发仍至关重要。
collocations: vaccination against poliomyelitis｜预防脊髓灰质炎的疫苗接种 ; eradicate poliomyelitis｜根除脊髓灰质炎 ; poliomyelitis outbreak｜脊髓灰质炎暴发
tip_zh: 日常多用polio；虽俗称小儿麻痹症，成人也可感染。

meanings_zh: v. 崇敬；敬仰
definition_en: To regard someone or something with deep respect.
example1_en: People here venerate the elder who founded this school.
example1_zh: 这里的人们十分敬仰创办这所学校的长者。
example2_en: Many societies venerate historic buildings because they represent shared cultural achievements and a connection with the past.
example2_zh: 许多社会十分尊崇历史建筑，因为它们代表着共同的文化成就以及与过去的联系。
collocations: venerate ancestors｜敬奉祖先 ; venerate as a hero｜尊为英雄 ; widely venerated｜广受崇敬的
tip_zh: 正式用词，比respect语气强；后面直接接宾语。

meanings_zh: adj. 需极大力量或努力的
definition_en: Requiring an exceptionally large amount of strength or effort.
example1_en: Moving that enormous sofa upstairs was a herculean task.
example1_zh: 把那张巨大的沙发搬上楼真是一项艰巨的任务。
example2_en: Restoring transport networks after widespread flooding requires a herculean effort from engineers, local authorities and volunteers.
example2_zh: 大范围洪灾后恢复交通网络，需要工程师、地方政府和志愿者付出极大的努力。
collocations: a herculean task｜艰巨的任务 ; a herculean effort｜巨大的努力
tip_zh: 源于大力神Hercules；也常写作Herculean。

meanings_zh: n. 摆动；振荡 | n. 波动；摇摆
definition_en: Repeated movement backwards and forwards around a central position. | Repeated change between different values, states, or opinions.
example1_en: We watched the slow oscillation of the clock's pendulum.
example1_zh: 我们看着钟摆缓缓地来回摆动。
example2_en: Regular oscillations in ocean temperatures can influence rainfall patterns and agricultural productivity across large regions.
example2_zh: 海洋温度的周期性波动会影响广大地区的降雨规律和农业生产力。
collocations: pendulum oscillation｜钟摆摆动 ; frequency of oscillation｜振荡频率 ; temperature oscillations｜温度波动
tip_zh: 既指物体往复运动，也指数值或观点的反复变化。

meanings_zh: n. 面容；神情 | v. 赞同；容许
definition_en: A person's face or facial expression. | To accept or approve of something.
example1_en: Her calm countenance reassured the children during the storm.
example1_zh: 暴风雨期间，她镇定的神情让孩子们安心。
example2_en: Governments should not countenance discriminatory practices that prevent qualified candidates from accessing employment opportunities.
example2_zh: 政府不应容许妨碍合格求职者获得就业机会的歧视性做法。
collocations: a calm countenance｜镇定的神情 ; a stern countenance｜严肃的面容 ; refuse to countenance｜拒绝接受
tip_zh: 名词较文学化；动词常用于否定句，意为容许。

meanings_zh: n. 专有权利；特权
definition_en: a special right belonging to a particular person or group
example1_en: Choosing the final design is the team leader's prerogative.
example1_zh: 选定最终设计方案是组长的专有权利。
example2_en: Decisions about public spending should not be the exclusive prerogative of a small group of officials.
example2_zh: 公共支出的决策不应成为少数官员独享的特权。
collocations: royal prerogative｜王室特权 ; exclusive prerogative｜专有特权 ; exercise a prerogative｜行使特权
tip_zh: 指特定身份享有的权利，不是人人都有的普通权利。

meanings_zh: n. 炉渣；矿渣
definition_en: Waste material separated from metal during smelting
example1_en: Dark heaps of slag stood beside the old factory.
example1_zh: 旧工厂旁堆着一堆堆黑色的炉渣。
example2_en: Reusing slag in road construction can reduce industrial waste and demand for newly quarried materials.
example2_zh: 在道路建设中重新利用矿渣，可以减少工业废料及对新开采材料的需求。
collocations: blast furnace slag｜高炉矿渣 ; slag heap｜矿渣堆 ; steel slag｜钢渣
tip_zh: 工业义通常不可数；另有侮辱女性的英式俚语义，勿用。

meanings_zh: n. 水闸；闸控水道 | v. 用水冲洗 | v. 奔流；涌出
definition_en: A water channel with a gate that controls flow. | To wash something with a strong flow of water. | To flow quickly and in large amounts.
example1_en: We sluiced the mud off our boots outside.
example1_zh: 我们在外面用水冲掉了靴子上的泥。
example2_en: Engineers opened the sluice to release excess water and reduce pressure on the reservoir walls.
example2_zh: 工程师打开水闸排出多余的水，以减轻水库坝壁承受的压力。
collocations: sluice gate｜水闸闸门 ; open the sluice｜打开水闸 ; sluice down the floor｜用水冲洗地面
tip_zh: 作动词可指冲洗；sluice gate指控制水流的闸门。

meanings_zh: n. 神经症
definition_en: An older term for psychological difficulties involving anxiety or distress.
example1_en: The old psychology book devoted a chapter to neurosis.
example1_zh: 那本旧心理学书用一章的篇幅介绍神经症。
example2_en: Although neurosis appears frequently in older research, modern clinicians generally use more specific diagnostic terms.
example2_zh: 尽管神经症一词常见于早期研究，现代临床医生通常采用更具体的诊断术语。
collocations: anxiety neurosis｜焦虑性神经症 ; obsessional neurosis｜强迫性神经症
tip_zh: 旧心理学术语，不等于神经衰弱；复数为neuroses。

meanings_zh: v. 梳理头发；做发型
definition_en: Arrange or style hair.
example1_en: She learned to hairdress by practising on a mannequin.
example1_zh: 她通过在人头模型上练习学会了做发型。
example2_en: People who learn to hairdress professionally may develop practical skills that support employment in local service industries.
example2_zh: 学习专业美发的人可以培养实用技能，从而在当地服务行业就业。
collocations: hairdress professionally｜专业从事美发 ; learn to hairdress｜学习美发
tip_zh: 日常说做发型用 style hair；美发行业用 hairdressing。

meanings_zh: adj. 不可剥夺或转让的
definition_en: impossible to take away or transfer to someone else
example1_en: Our teacher explained why everyone has certain inalienable rights.
example1_zh: 老师解释了为什么每个人都享有某些不可剥夺的权利。
example2_en: Access to basic education should be recognised as an inalienable right, regardless of a child's background.
example2_zh: 无论儿童的背景如何，接受基础教育都应被承认为不可剥夺的权利。
collocations: inalienable rights｜不可剥夺的权利 ; an inalienable right to freedom｜不可剥夺的自由权
tip_zh: 正式用语，主要修饰rights，强调不能剥夺或转让。

meanings_zh: n. 皮重；容器自重 | v. 去皮称量；将秤归零
definition_en: the weight of packaging or a container without its contents | adjust a scale to exclude the weight of a container
example1_en: Tare the scale before adding flour to the bowl.
example1_zh: 往碗里加面粉前，先把秤去皮归零。
example2_en: Accurate tare measurements allow food producers to calculate product weight without including the packaging.
example2_zh: 准确测量皮重，能让食品生产商计算不含包装的产品重量。
collocations: tare weight｜皮重 ; tare the scale｜将秤去皮归零 ; deduct the tare｜扣除皮重
tip_zh: 皮重是容器重量；净重等于毛重减去皮重。

meanings_zh: n. 金属锭
definition_en: A solid block of metal cast for storage or processing.
example1_en: The worker lifted a shiny ingot with heavy tongs.
example1_zh: 工人用沉重的钳子夹起了一块闪亮的金属锭。
example2_en: Recycled aluminium can be cast into ingots before being processed into components for vehicles and buildings.
example2_zh: 回收铝可以先铸成锭，再加工成车辆和建筑所需的部件。
collocations: a gold ingot｜金锭 ; an aluminium ingot｜铝锭 ; cast into ingots｜铸成金属锭
tip_zh: 指铸成块的金属，不专指铁或纯铁。

meanings_zh: adj. 承诺的；约定支付的
definition_en: containing a promise, especially a written promise to pay
example1_en: She signed a promissory note before borrowing the money.
example1_zh: 她借钱前签署了一张本票。
example2_en: A promissory note provides written evidence of debt, helping lenders establish their legal right to repayment.
example2_zh: 本票提供书面的债务凭证，帮助出借人确立依法获得偿还的权利。
collocations: promissory note｜本票；期票 ; promissory obligation｜承诺义务
tip_zh: 主要用于法律金融语境，常见搭配为promissory note。

meanings_zh: adj. 唯利是图的 | n. 雇佣兵
definition_en: Caring mainly about money rather than other considerations | A soldier paid to fight for a foreign army or group
example1_en: His mercenary attitude spoiled our plans for the charity.
example1_zh: 他唯利是图的态度破坏了我们的慈善计划。
example2_en: A purely mercenary approach to healthcare risks placing financial returns above the needs of patients.
example2_zh: 对医疗服务采取纯粹逐利的做法，可能会使经济回报凌驾于患者需求之上。
collocations: mercenary motives｜唯利是图的动机 ; mercenary attitude｜唯利是图的态度 ; mercenary soldiers｜雇佣兵
tip_zh: 形容词带贬义，强调只看重金钱；作名词指雇佣兵。

meanings_zh: adj. 傲慢的；目中无人的
definition_en: Acting as though you are better than other people.
example1_en: The customer gave the waiter a haughty look.
example1_zh: 那位顾客傲慢地看了服务员一眼。
example2_en: A haughty attitude among senior managers can discourage employees from sharing ideas and reporting problems openly.
example2_zh: 高层管理者的傲慢态度会使员工不愿分享想法或公开反映问题。
collocations: haughty expression｜傲慢的神情 ; haughty attitude｜傲慢的态度 ; haughty tone｜傲慢的语气
tip_zh: 含贬义，强调自视高人一等，不等于自信。

meanings_zh: v. 懒洋洋地躺或倚靠 | v. 无力地下垂；耷拉
definition_en: To sit or lie in a relaxed, lazy way. | To hang loosely, especially the head or tongue.
example1_en: We lolled on the sofa after our long walk.
example1_zh: 长途散步后，我们懒洋洋地躺在沙发上。
example2_en: Comfortable public seating encourages visitors to loll in the shade rather than leave parks during hot weather.
example2_zh: 舒适的公共座椅让游客在炎热天气里愿意懒散地靠坐在树荫下，而不是离开公园。
collocations: loll about｜懒散地闲躺着 ; loll on the sofa｜懒洋洋地躺在沙发上 ; tongue lolling out｜舌头耷拉在外
tip_zh: 常接about或around，强调姿势松散、懒洋洋。

meanings_zh: n. 措辞；用词风格 | n. 吐字；发音方式
definition_en: The choice and style of words in speech or writing. | The way someone pronounces words, especially how clearly.
example1_en: Her formal diction sounded strange at our relaxed picnic.
example1_zh: 在我们轻松的野餐聚会上，她正式的措辞听起来很不协调。
example2_en: Writers often adapt their diction to make complex scientific ideas accessible to a wider audience.
example2_zh: 作者常会调整措辞，让更广泛的读者能够理解复杂的科学概念。
collocations: formal diction｜正式措辞 ; poetic diction｜诗歌用语 ; clear diction｜清晰的吐字
tip_zh: 既可指用词风格，也可指吐字是否清晰。

meanings_zh: n. 狂喜；欣喜若狂
definition_en: An extremely strong feeling of joy and delight.
example1_en: The children watched the dancing dolphins in rapture.
example1_zh: 孩子们欣喜万分地看着海豚跃动。
example2_en: The rapture experienced during live performances helps explain why audiences continue to value shared cultural events.
example2_zh: 现场演出带来的强烈喜悦，有助于解释观众为何依然珍视共同参与的文化活动。
collocations: in rapture｜欣喜若狂地 ; go into raptures over｜对……欣喜若狂 ; sheer rapture｜无比的喜悦
tip_zh: 语气强于happiness，常带文学色彩。

meanings_zh: adj. 使人产生错觉的
definition_en: Making something false seem true or something unreal seem real.
example1_en: The mirror created a delusive impression of extra space.
example1_zh: 这面镜子造成了空间更大的错觉。
example2_en: Early economic gains may create a delusive sense of security if governments ignore underlying weaknesses in public finances.
example2_zh: 如果政府忽视公共财政的潜在弱点，早期经济收益可能造成虚假的安全感。
collocations: delusive hopes｜虚妄的希望 ; delusive appearance｜迷惑人的表象 ; delusive sense of security｜虚假的安全感
tip_zh: 较正式且少见；日常多用misleading或deceptive。

meanings_zh: adj. 肌肉松弛的 | adj. 软弱无力的；松散的
definition_en: having soft, loose flesh rather than firm muscles | lacking strength, effectiveness, or clear structure
example1_en: He felt his muscles had grown flabby during recovery.
example1_zh: 他觉得自己的肌肉在康复期间变得松弛了。
example2_en: An essay with flabby arguments may fail to persuade readers, even when its topic is important.
example2_zh: 即使主题重要，论证松散无力的文章也可能无法说服读者。
collocations: flabby muscles｜松弛的肌肉 ; flabby arms｜肌肉松弛的手臂 ; flabby prose｜松散拖沓的文字
tip_zh: 多指肌肉松弛；形容文章时指松散无力，语气贬义。

meanings_zh: n. 车辆里程表
definition_en: a device measuring the total distance a vehicle has travelled
example1_en: The odometer showed how far we had driven.
example1_zh: 里程表显示了我们已经行驶的距离。
example2_en: When purchasing a used vehicle, consumers should check its odometer reading alongside its maintenance records.
example2_zh: 购买二手车时，消费者应将里程表读数与保养记录一并核查。
collocations: odometer reading｜里程表读数 ; check the odometer｜查看里程表
tip_zh: 记录累计里程；speedometer显示即时车速。

meanings_zh: v. 力劝；敦促
definition_en: To strongly urge someone to do something.
example1_en: Our coach exhorted us to keep trying until the end.
example1_zh: 教练力劝我们坚持努力到最后。
example2_en: Public health campaigns exhort citizens to exercise regularly, but affordable facilities are also needed to support lasting change.
example2_zh: 公共卫生宣传敦促市民经常锻炼，但要支持持久的改变，也需要价格亲民的设施。
collocations: exhort someone to act｜敦促某人行动 ; exhort citizens to vote｜敦促公民投票
tip_zh: 正式用词：exhort sb to do，不只是提出忠告。

meanings_zh: n. 词典编纂；词典学
definition_en: The practice or study of writing and editing dictionaries.
example1_en: My aunt works in lexicography and loves discussing words.
example1_zh: 我姑姑从事词典编纂工作，很喜欢讨论词语。
example2_en: Digital lexicography allows dictionary editors to track changes in language through large collections of authentic examples.
example2_zh: 数字词典编纂使编辑能够通过大量真实用例追踪语言变化。
collocations: digital lexicography｜数字词典编纂 ; practical lexicography｜词典编纂实践 ; a career in lexicography｜词典编纂职业
tip_zh: 指词典编纂或其研究，通常作不可数名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 虚幻的；迷惑人的
definition_en: appearing real but based on illusion
example1_en: The desert shimmered with illusive pools of water.
example1_zh: 沙漠中闪现着虚幻的水洼。
example2_en: Advertising may create an illusive sense of happiness by linking personal fulfilment exclusively to material possessions.
example2_zh: 广告可能将个人满足感完全与物质财富挂钩，从而营造出虚幻的幸福感。
collocations: illusive appearance｜虚幻的外表 ; illusive happiness｜虚幻的幸福
tip_zh: 较少用，常用illusory；elusive意为难以捉摸的。

meanings_zh: n. 子序列
definition_en: A sequence formed by selecting elements without changing their original order.
example1_en: We selected alternate beads to create a subsequence.
example1_zh: 我们隔一颗选一颗珠子，组成了一个子序列。
example2_en: Researchers can analyse a subsequence of genetic data to identify patterns associated with inherited diseases.
example2_zh: 研究人员可以分析遗传数据的子序列，以识别与遗传病有关的模式。
collocations: common subsequence｜公共子序列 ; convergent subsequence｜收敛子序列 ; increasing subsequence｜递增子序列
tip_zh: 主要是数学、计算机术语；“后果”用consequence。

meanings_zh: v. 幼儿蹒跚学步 | v. 悠闲地走
definition_en: To walk with short, unsteady steps, especially as a young child. | To walk somewhere casually and without hurrying.
example1_en: The baby toddled across the rug towards her father.
example1_zh: 宝宝摇摇晃晃地走过地毯，朝爸爸走去。
example2_en: As children begin to toddle, safe spaces allow them to develop balance and explore their surroundings independently.
example2_zh: 孩子开始蹒跚学步时，安全的空间能让他们练习平衡，并独立探索周围环境。
collocations: toddle across the room｜蹒跚着穿过房间 ; toddle towards someone｜蹒跚走向某人 ; toddle off｜慢悠悠地离开
tip_zh: 主要作不及物动词；学步幼儿叫toddler。

meanings_zh: v. 悔过；忏悔
definition_en: To regret wrongdoing deeply and intend to behave better.
example1_en: He came to repent of lying to his closest friend.
example1_zh: 他后来为向自己最亲密的朋友撒谎而深感懊悔。
example2_en: Some argue that justice should allow offenders to repent and rebuild their lives through education and community service.
example2_zh: 有人认为，司法应让违法者有机会悔过，并通过教育和社区服务重建生活。
collocations: repent of wrongdoing｜为过错忏悔 ; sincerely repent｜真诚悔过
tip_zh: 常用repent of sth；比regret更强调悔过。

meanings_zh: n. 甘油；丙三醇
definition_en: a thick clear liquid used in medicines, foods, and skincare products
example1_en: This hand cream contains glycerin to keep skin soft.
example1_zh: 这款护手霜含有甘油，能让皮肤保持柔软。
example2_en: Manufacturers often add glycerin to skincare products because it helps retain moisture and prevent dryness.
example2_zh: 制造商常在护肤品中加入甘油，因为它有助于保持水分并防止干燥。
collocations: vegetable glycerin｜植物甘油 ; pure glycerin｜纯甘油 ; glycerin soap｜甘油皂
tip_zh: 不可数名词；也拼作glycerine，化学名为glycerol。

meanings_zh: v. 打瞌睡；半睡半醒 | n. 瞌睡；半睡状态
definition_en: To sleep lightly or be almost asleep. | A state of being partly asleep.
example1_en: Grandfather drowsed in his chair beside the sunny window.
example1_zh: 爷爷坐在阳光照进的窗边，在椅子上打瞌睡。
example2_en: Passengers may drowse during long journeys, making comfortable seating an important consideration for transport providers.
example2_zh: 乘客在长途旅行中可能会打瞌睡，因此舒适的座椅是交通服务商的重要考量。
collocations: drowse in a chair｜坐在椅子上打瞌睡 ; drowse off｜迷迷糊糊睡着 ; in a drowse｜处于半睡状态
tip_zh: 较书面；日常说打瞌睡更常用doze。

meanings_zh: conj. 以免；唯恐
definition_en: To prevent something unwanted, or because of fearing it
example1_en: She whispered lest she wake the sleeping baby.
example1_zh: 她轻声说话，以免吵醒熟睡的婴儿。
example2_en: Policymakers should assess new technologies carefully lest short-term economic gains create lasting environmental problems.
example2_zh: 政策制定者应仔细评估新技术，以免短期经济收益造成长期环境问题。
collocations: lest we forget｜以免我们忘记 ; lest someone should｜唯恐某人会
tip_zh: 较正式；从句常用动词原形或should加原形。

meanings_zh: v. 拧；绞；榨出
definition_en: To twist and squeeze something, especially to remove liquid.
example1_en: Wring out the wet towel before hanging it up.
example1_zh: 把湿毛巾拧干后再挂起来。
example2_en: Where washing machines are unavailable, residents must wring out heavy clothes by hand after washing.
example2_zh: 在没有洗衣机的地方，居民洗完厚重衣物后必须用手拧干。
collocations: wring out a towel｜拧干毛巾 ; wring your hands｜焦虑地绞着双手 ; wring water from clothes｜拧出衣服里的水
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为wrung；拧干常用wring out。

meanings_zh: v. 挪用；侵吞
definition_en: To dishonestly take entrusted money or property for your own use.
example1_en: The treasurer misappropriated club funds to pay personal bills.
example1_zh: 财务主管挪用了俱乐部的资金来支付个人账单。
example2_en: Independent audits help prevent officials from misappropriating public funds intended for essential services such as healthcare and education.
example2_zh: 独立审计有助于防止官员挪用本应用于医疗、教育等基本服务的公共资金。
collocations: misappropriate funds｜挪用资金 ; misappropriate public money｜挪用公款 ; misappropriate assets｜侵吞资产
tip_zh: 正式用语，常搭配funds，强调擅自挪作私用。

meanings_zh: adj. 笨拙的；姿态不雅的
definition_en: Awkward in movement, shape or appearance.
example1_en: The young camel rose slowly on its ungainly legs.
example1_zh: 小骆驼用它那笨拙的长腿慢慢站了起来。
example2_en: Although early electric vehicles appeared ungainly, improvements in design have made them more attractive to consumers.
example2_zh: 虽然早期电动汽车外形笨拙，但设计上的改进使它们更能吸引消费者。
collocations: an ungainly movement｜笨拙的动作 ; an ungainly figure｜笨拙的身形 ; an ungainly shape｜不协调的外形
tip_zh: 虽以-ly结尾，现代常用词性是形容词。

meanings_zh: n. 冶金学；冶金技术
definition_en: The science of extracting metals and studying their properties.
example1_en: My cousin studies metallurgy and tests metals in a laboratory.
example1_zh: 我的表姐学习冶金学，在实验室检测金属。
example2_en: Advances in metallurgy have enabled manufacturers to develop lighter materials for more fuel-efficient vehicles.
example2_zh: 冶金技术的进步使制造商能够开发更轻的材料，用于制造更节能的车辆。
collocations: physical metallurgy｜物理冶金学 ; powder metallurgy｜粉末冶金 ; advances in metallurgy｜冶金技术的进步
tip_zh: 不可数名词；从业专家称metallurgist。

meanings_zh: v. 彻底毁灭；抹去
definition_en: Destroy or remove something completely, leaving little or no trace.
example1_en: Heavy snowfall had obliterated every footprint on the garden path.
example1_zh: 大雪已将花园小路上的所有脚印彻底覆盖。
example2_en: Rapid urban development can obliterate historic neighbourhoods unless effective conservation measures are introduced early in the planning process.
example2_zh: 快速的城市开发可能彻底毁掉历史街区，除非在规划初期就引入有效的保护措施。
collocations: obliterate all traces｜抹去所有痕迹 ; completely obliterate｜彻底摧毁 ; obliterate evidence｜销毁证据
tip_zh: 是动词，强调彻底消除，比普通 remove 语气更强。

meanings_zh: v. 证明无辜；证明正确
definition_en: To prove someone innocent or show that something was justified.
example1_en: The security footage vindicated the cleaner accused of stealing.
example1_zh: 监控录像证明了那位被指控偷窃的清洁工是无辜的。
example2_en: The significant decline in road accidents appears to vindicate the council's decision to introduce lower speed limits.
example2_zh: 交通事故显著减少，似乎证明市政委员会降低限速的决定是正确的。
collocations: vindicate a decision｜证明决定正确 ; vindicate an approach｜证明方法正确 ; feel vindicated｜感到自己得到证明
tip_zh: 强调证据或结果证明正确，不只是口头辩护。

meanings_zh: n. 苯
definition_en: A toxic, flammable liquid hydrocarbon used in chemical manufacturing.
example1_en: The technician tested the water for traces of benzene.
example1_zh: 技术人员检测了水中是否有微量苯。
example2_en: Strict controls on industrial emissions can reduce workers' exposure to benzene and other harmful chemicals.
example2_zh: 严格控制工业排放可以减少工人接触苯及其他有害化学物质的机会。
collocations: benzene exposure｜苯暴露 ; benzene emissions｜苯排放 ; benzene ring｜苯环
tip_zh: 苯是有毒化合物；勿与汽油的英式说法petrol混淆。

meanings_zh: v. 高度赞扬；颂扬 | v. 提升地位
definition_en: To praise someone or something very highly. | To raise someone to a higher rank or position.
example1_en: Her songs exalt the beauty of ordinary life.
example1_zh: 她的歌曲颂扬平凡生活中的美。
example2_en: Public monuments often exalt national heroes while overlooking the contributions of ordinary citizens.
example2_zh: 公共纪念碑往往颂扬民族英雄，却忽视普通公民的贡献。
collocations: exalt the virtues of｜盛赞……的美德 ; exalt someone to a position｜将某人提升至某职位
tip_zh: 正式用词；指高度颂扬，不是普通的表扬。

meanings_zh: n. 胸部；怀抱 | adj. 亲密的；知心的
definition_en: The chest, especially a woman's, or the embrace it provides. | Very close and trusted, used mainly before friend.
example1_en: The grandmother held the sleepy child to her bosom.
example1_zh: 祖母把困倦的孩子搂在怀里。
example2_en: Traditional paintings often depict a parent holding a child to their bosom, symbolising protection and affection.
example2_zh: 传统绘画常描绘父母将孩子搂在怀中的情景，象征着保护与关爱。
collocations: hold someone to one's bosom｜将某人搂在怀里 ; bosom friend｜知心朋友 ; in the bosom of the family｜在家庭的温暖怀抱中
tip_zh: 较文学化或旧式；bosom friend指知心朋友。

meanings_zh: adv. 欢快地 | adv. 色彩鲜艳地
definition_en: In a cheerful and lively way. | With bright, cheerful colours.
example1_en: The children laughed gaily as they chased bubbles outside.
example1_zh: 孩子们在外面追逐泡泡，欢快地笑着。
example2_en: Gaily decorated streets can attract visitors during local festivals and encourage spending in nearby shops.
example2_zh: 当地节庆期间，装饰鲜艳的街道能够吸引游客，促进周边商店的消费。
collocations: laugh gaily｜欢快地笑 ; gaily decorated｜装饰鲜艳的 ; gaily coloured｜色彩鲜艳的
tip_zh: 略带文学色彩；也可形容装饰色彩鲜艳。

meanings_zh: n. 大菱鲆；大菱鲆鱼肉
definition_en: a broad, flat sea fish, or its edible flesh
example1_en: We shared grilled turbot with potatoes by the harbour.
example1_zh: 我们在港口边一起吃了烤大菱鲆配土豆。
example2_en: Farming turbot can supply seafood markets, but producers must carefully manage water quality and waste.
example2_zh: 养殖大菱鲆能为海鲜市场提供货源，但生产者必须谨慎管理水质和废弃物。
collocations: grilled turbot｜烤大菱鲆 ; farmed turbot｜养殖大菱鲆 ; turbot fillets｜大菱鲆鱼柳
tip_zh: 指鱼肉时不可数；指鱼时复数通常仍为turbot。

meanings_zh: adj. 博学的；学术性的
definition_en: having or showing knowledge gained through extensive study
example1_en: Our learned neighbour can explain almost any historical mystery.
example1_zh: 我们那位博学的邻居几乎能解释任何历史谜团。
example2_en: Learned societies play an important role in sharing research findings and encouraging debate across academic disciplines.
example2_zh: 学术团体在分享研究成果、促进跨学科学术讨论方面发挥着重要作用。
collocations: a learned scholar｜博学的学者 ; a learned society｜学术团体 ; a learned journal｜学术期刊
tip_zh: 意为“博学的”读两音节；作 learn 过去式读一音节。

meanings_zh: n. 年金；年金保险
definition_en: An investment providing regular payments, often throughout retirement.
example1_en: My grandfather receives an annuity to cover his living costs.
example1_zh: 我祖父领取年金来支付生活开销。
example2_en: An annuity can provide retirees with a predictable income, although inflation may reduce its purchasing power.
example2_zh: 年金可以为退休者提供可预期的收入，但通货膨胀可能降低其购买力。
collocations: buy an annuity｜购买年金保险 ; annuity payments｜年金给付 ; a lifetime annuity｜终身年金
tip_zh: 年金可按月等定期支付，并非只能一年领一次。

meanings_zh: n. 运送；运输 | n. 运输工具 | n. 产权转让
definition_en: the act of transporting people or goods | a vehicle used for carrying people or goods | the legal transfer of property from one owner to another
example1_en: The hotel arranged conveyance of our luggage by boat.
example1_zh: 酒店安排用船运送我们的行李。
example2_en: Efficient conveyance of agricultural goods depends on reliable roads, suitable vehicles, and accessible regional markets.
example2_zh: 农产品的高效运输依赖可靠的道路、合适的车辆以及便利的区域市场。
collocations: conveyance of goods｜货物运输 ; means of conveyance｜交通工具 ; conveyance of property｜产权转让
tip_zh: 正式用词；日常运输多用transport，法律中可指产权转让。

meanings_zh: n. 林边；树林边缘
definition_en: The edge of a wood or the land beside it.
example1_en: We rested at the woodside, just beyond the meadow.
example1_zh: 我们穿过草地后，在林边休息。
example2_en: Preserving vegetation along the woodside can provide shelter for wildlife moving between forests and open farmland.
example2_zh: 保留林边植被可以为在森林与开阔农田之间活动的野生动物提供庇护。
collocations: at the woodside｜在林边 ; along the woodside｜沿着树林边缘
tip_zh: 罕见词；日常更常说the edge of the woods。

meanings_zh: n. 霉；霉菌；霉病 | v. 发霉；使发霉
definition_en: A thin fungal growth on damp surfaces or plants. | Develop mildew, or cause something to develop mildew.
example1_en: We found mildew on the bathroom ceiling after our holiday.
example1_zh: 度假回来后，我们发现浴室天花板发霉了。
example2_en: Improved ventilation in poorly maintained housing can limit mildew growth and create healthier living conditions for residents.
example2_zh: 改善维护不善的住房中的通风状况，可以抑制霉菌生长，为居民创造更健康的居住环境。
collocations: powdery mildew｜白粉病 ; mildew growth｜霉菌生长 ; prevent mildew｜防霉
tip_zh: 作名词通常不可数，常指潮湿表面的霉或植物霉病。

meanings_zh: adj. 不可阻挡的；无法改变的
definition_en: impossible to stop or prevent
example1_en: We watched the inexorable tide creep towards our sandcastle.
example1_zh: 我们看着无法阻挡的潮水逐渐逼近沙堡。
example2_en: The inexorable rise in demand for electricity highlights the need for investment in renewable energy.
example2_zh: 电力需求不可阻挡的增长凸显了投资可再生能源的必要性。
collocations: inexorable rise｜不可阻挡的增长 ; inexorable decline｜无法遏制的衰退 ; inexorable march of time｜时间不可阻挡的流逝
tip_zh: 侧重趋势或进程无法阻止，不只是“无情”。

meanings_zh: adj. 构成性的；构成要素的
definition_en: Helping to form something or define its essential nature.
example1_en: For our club, cooperation is constitutive of its identity.
example1_zh: 对我们俱乐部而言，合作精神是其身份认同的根本组成部分。
example2_en: Shared customs are constitutive of cultural identity, rather than merely optional features of community life.
example2_zh: 共同习俗是文化认同的根本组成部分，而非社区生活中可有可无的特征。
collocations: constitutive of｜构成……的 ; constitutive elements｜构成要素 ; constitutive role｜构成性作用
tip_zh: 指构成事物本质的；“宪法的”用constitutional。

meanings_zh: n. 犁沟 | n. 深皱纹；沟痕 | v. 皱起眉头；使起沟纹
definition_en: A long narrow channel cut into soil by a plough | A deep line in skin or another surface | Make deep lines in something, especially the forehead
example1_en: The farmer dropped seeds into a freshly ploughed furrow.
example1_zh: 农民把种子撒进刚犁好的沟里。
example2_en: Planting along furrows that follow the contours of hills can help farmers reduce soil erosion.
example2_zh: 沿着顺应山坡等高线的犁沟种植，有助于农民减少土壤侵蚀。
collocations: plough a furrow｜犁出一道沟 ; a deep furrow｜深沟；深皱纹 ; furrow your brow｜皱眉
tip_zh: furrow your brow是常用搭配，意为皱眉。

meanings_zh: n. 长篇激烈的训话 | v. 长篇训斥
definition_en: A long, forceful speech expressing anger or strong criticism. | To speak angrily and at length to someone.
example1_en: His harangue about dirty dishes spoiled our quiet breakfast.
example1_zh: 他为没洗的碗碟训斥个没完，破坏了我们早餐时的宁静。
example2_en: A lengthy harangue is unlikely to persuade citizens who expect constructive debate about public spending.
example2_zh: 对于期待就公共支出展开建设性讨论的公民，冗长激烈的训话很难有说服力。
collocations: a lengthy harangue｜冗长的训话 ; launch into a harangue｜开始长篇训斥 ; harangue someone about something｜为某事长篇训斥某人
tip_zh: 含贬义，强调冗长且激烈，不只是普通演讲。

meanings_zh: v. 撤销命令；取消指令
definition_en: to officially cancel an earlier order
example1_en: The manager countermanded the order to close the shop.
example1_zh: 经理撤销了关闭商店的命令。
example2_en: Local officials may countermand evacuation orders only when reliable evidence shows that the danger has passed.
example2_zh: 地方官员只有在可靠证据表明危险已经解除时，才可撤销疏散命令。
collocations: countermand an order｜撤销命令 ; countermand an instruction｜取消指令
tip_zh: 正式用语，宾语通常是order或instruction。

meanings_zh: adj. 故意作对的；悖理的 | adj. 事与愿违的；适得其反的
definition_en: Deliberately contrary to what is reasonable, expected, or wanted. | Producing effects opposite to those intended or considered desirable.
example1_en: He took perverse pleasure in disagreeing with every suggestion.
example1_zh: 他以反对每一个建议为乐，这种乐趣令人费解。
example2_en: Poorly designed subsidies can create perverse incentives, encouraging companies to increase pollution rather than invest in cleaner production.
example2_zh: 设计不当的补贴可能产生反向激励，鼓励企业增加污染，而不是投资更清洁的生产方式。
collocations: perverse pleasure｜反常的乐趣 ; perverse incentives｜反向激励 ; perverse effect｜适得其反的效果
tip_zh: 不泛指不正当；常指故意作对或结果适得其反。

meanings_zh: adj. 冲积的
definition_en: formed from soil or sand deposited by flowing water
example1_en: Our vegetables grow well in the rich alluvial soil.
example1_zh: 我们的蔬菜在肥沃的冲积土中长势良好。
example2_en: Alluvial plains often support intensive agriculture because rivers deposit fertile sediment across these lowland areas.
example2_zh: 冲积平原通常有利于集约农业，因为河流会在这些低地沉积肥沃的泥沙。
collocations: alluvial soil｜冲积土 ; alluvial deposits｜冲积沉积物 ; alluvial plain｜冲积平原
tip_zh: 常修饰soil、plain、deposits，强调流水沉积形成。

meanings_zh: n. 上部结构 | n. 社会上层建筑
definition_en: The part of a structure built above its base or deck. | Institutions and beliefs supported by a society's economic system.
example1_en: Workers painted the ship's superstructure white before its departure.
example1_zh: 工人在船出发前把船的上层结构漆成了白色。
example2_en: Engineers must ensure that a building's foundations can safely support its entire superstructure under varying environmental conditions.
example2_zh: 工程师必须确保建筑地基在不同环境条件下都能安全支撑整个上部结构。
collocations: ship's superstructure｜船舶上层建筑 ; steel superstructure｜钢制上部结构 ; ideological superstructure｜意识形态上层建筑
tip_zh: 建筑中指基础以上部分；船舶中指甲板以上部分。

meanings_zh: adj. 反义的；词义相反的
definition_en: Having opposite meanings, as two words do.
example1_en: Our teacher used pictures to explain several antonymous pairs.
example1_zh: 老师用图片讲解了几组反义词。
example2_en: Learning antonymous adjectives together can help language students distinguish contrasting meanings and expand their descriptive vocabulary.
example2_zh: 将反义形容词放在一起学习，有助于语言学习者区分相反的含义，扩充描述性词汇。
collocations: antonymous pairs｜反义词对 ; antonymous adjectives｜反义形容词 ; antonymous meanings｜相反的词义
tip_zh: 语言学用词，日常更常说opposite in meaning。

meanings_zh: n. 新造词；造词 | n. 硬币；铸币
definition_en: a newly invented word, or the creation of new words | coins used in a country, or the process of making them
example1_en: Her playful coinage quickly became popular among her friends.
example1_zh: 她随口创造的俏皮新词很快在朋友中流行起来。
example2_en: The rapid growth of digital technology encourages the coinage of terms for previously unfamiliar experiences.
example2_zh: 数字技术的快速发展促使人们创造新词，描述以往陌生的体验。
collocations: a recent coinage｜新近创造的词 ; the coinage of new words｜新词的创造 ; decimal coinage｜十进制硬币体系
tip_zh: 指某个新造词时可数；指造词或铸币过程时不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 铺地石板
definition_en: A flat stone slab used for paths or floors.
example1_en: Rainwater collected in the cracks between the old flagstones.
example1_zh: 雨水积在旧石板之间的缝隙里。
example2_en: Using locally sourced flagstones for public paths can preserve regional character while reducing transport emissions.
example2_zh: 公共步道采用当地出产的石板，既能保留地域特色，也能减少运输排放。
collocations: a flagstone floor｜石板地面 ; a flagstone path｜石板小路 ; lay flagstones｜铺设石板
tip_zh: 专指铺路或铺地的平整石板，不泛指所有石块。

meanings_zh: v. 用锄头锄地 | n. 锄头
definition_en: to loosen soil or remove weeds using a hoe | a long-handled garden tool with a flat blade for working soil
example1_en: We hoed the vegetable patch before planting the beans.
example1_zh: 种豆子前，我们把菜地锄了一遍。
example2_en: Farmers who hoe between crop rows can control weeds while reducing their dependence on chemical herbicides.
example2_zh: 在作物行间锄地的农民可以控制杂草，同时减少对化学除草剂的依赖。
collocations: hoe the soil｜锄土 ; hoe weeds｜锄草 ; garden hoe｜园艺锄头
tip_zh: 既是锄头也是锄地；现在分词为hoeing。

meanings_zh: n. 相关性；切题性
definition_en: the quality of being directly relevant to a particular matter
example1_en: The teacher questioned the pertinence of my final paragraph.
example1_zh: 老师质疑我最后一段是否切题。
example2_en: The pertinence of historical evidence to current policy debates depends partly on how closely the social conditions resemble ours.
example2_zh: 历史证据与当前政策辩论的相关性，部分取决于当时的社会条件与如今有多相似。
collocations: pertinence to the topic｜与主题的相关性 ; question the pertinence of｜质疑……的相关性
tip_zh: 正式且较少见；通常用relevance更自然。

meanings_zh: v. 使隔绝；使隐居
definition_en: To keep someone away from other people.
example1_en: She secluded herself in the cottage to finish painting.
example1_zh: 她独自待在小屋里，不受打扰地完成绘画。
example2_en: Some writers seclude themselves in remote locations to avoid distractions and concentrate on their work.
example2_zh: 一些作家隐居在偏远地区，以免受到干扰，专心创作。
collocations: seclude oneself｜独处；隐居 ; seclude oneself from others｜与他人隔绝
tip_zh: 常用seclude oneself，表示让自己远离他人。

meanings_zh: adj. 不恰当的；不贴切的
definition_en: Not suitable or appropriate for a particular situation.
example1_en: His inapt joke made everyone at dinner feel uncomfortable.
example1_zh: 他那个不合时宜的笑话让用餐的每个人都感到尴尬。
example2_en: Comparing schools solely by examination results is inapt when their students have very different social backgrounds.
example2_zh: 当学生的社会背景差异很大时，仅按考试成绩比较学校并不恰当。
collocations: an inapt comparison｜不贴切的比较 ; an inapt remark｜不恰当的评论 ; an inapt description｜不贴切的描述
tip_zh: 较正式且少见；勿与表示无能的inept混淆。

meanings_zh: n. 过氧化氢；过氧化物 | v. 用过氧化氢漂白
definition_en: Hydrogen peroxide, or a compound containing an oxygen–oxygen bond | To bleach hair using hydrogen peroxide
example1_en: The hairdresser used peroxide to lighten her hair.
example1_zh: 理发师用过氧化氢把她的头发颜色漂浅了。
example2_en: Hydrogen peroxide is used in some industrial processes to bleach paper and treat wastewater.
example2_zh: 过氧化氢用于某些工业流程，以漂白纸张和处理废水。
collocations: hydrogen peroxide｜过氧化氢 ; peroxide solution｜过氧化氢溶液 ; peroxide blonde｜漂染的金发女子
tip_zh: 日常语境常指过氧化氢，化学中也泛指过氧化物。

meanings_zh: v. 参加；参与 | v. 享用；吃喝
definition_en: to take part in an activity | to eat or drink something, especially when offered
example1_en: Everyone was invited to partake in the evening games.
example1_zh: 大家都受邀参加晚上的游戏活动。
example2_en: Community centres enable residents of different ages to partake in activities that strengthen social connections.
example2_zh: 社区中心让不同年龄的居民能够参与增进社会联系的活动。
collocations: partake in activities｜参与活动 ; partake in celebrations｜参与庆祝活动 ; partake of refreshments｜享用茶点
tip_zh: 较正式；参与用in，享用用of；过去式partook。

meanings_zh: n. 坚毅；逆境中的勇气
definition_en: Courage and mental strength during pain or difficulty.
example1_en: She faced months of painful treatment with remarkable fortitude.
example1_zh: 她以非凡的毅力面对了数月痛苦的治疗。
example2_en: Communities affected by natural disasters often show extraordinary fortitude while rebuilding their homes and livelihoods.
example2_zh: 受自然灾害影响的社区在重建家园和恢复生计时，往往表现出非凡的坚毅。
collocations: show fortitude｜表现出坚毅 ; mental fortitude｜精神上的坚韧 ; with remarkable fortitude｜以非凡的毅力
tip_zh: 正式用语，不可数，强调忍受痛苦或逆境。

meanings_zh: n. 税；关税 | n. 拱座
definition_en: A tax, especially one charged on imported goods. | A projecting support from which an arch rises.
example1_en: The guide explained the old impost on imported tea.
example1_zh: 导游讲解了过去对进口茶叶征收的税。
example2_en: An impost on imported grain could protect domestic farmers while increasing food costs for urban consumers.
example2_zh: 对进口谷物征税可以保护本国农民，却也可能增加城市消费者的食品开支。
collocations: an impost on imports｜进口税 ; levy an impost｜征税 ; impost block｜拱座石
tip_zh: 税义较古旧或专业；现代通常用tax或duty。

meanings_zh: v. 充满；有大量 | v. 下倾盆大雨
definition_en: to contain large quantities of living things or moving people | to rain very heavily
example1_en: The pond was teeming with tiny fish this morning.
example1_zh: 今天早上，池塘里满是小鱼。
example2_en: Healthy coral reefs teem with marine life, making their protection essential for maintaining ocean biodiversity.
example2_zh: 健康的珊瑚礁生活着大量海洋生物，因此保护珊瑚礁对维持海洋生物多样性至关重要。
collocations: teem with life｜生机盎然 ; teem with visitors｜挤满游客 ; teem down｜下倾盆大雨
tip_zh: 常用teem with，表示充满生物、人或活动。

meanings_zh: adv. 本文件的；关于此事
definition_en: Of this document, statement, or matter.
example1_en: Our lease says, “Keep a copy hereof for your records.”
example1_zh: 我们的租约上写着：“请保留本文件副本备查。”
example2_en: The housing agreement states that the provisions hereof apply equally to all tenants in the building.
example2_zh: 住房协议规定，本协议的条款平等适用于楼内所有租户。
collocations: the provisions hereof｜本文件的条款 ; a copy hereof｜本文件的副本 ; the terms hereof｜本文件的条件
tip_zh: 法律文体用词，相当于of this，不等于here。

meanings_zh: v. 正式废除；撤销
definition_en: To officially end a law, agreement, or established right.
example1_en: The council voted to abrogate the outdated parking regulation.
example1_zh: 议会投票决定废除那项过时的停车规定。
example2_en: Governments should not abrogate international agreements without carefully considering the consequences for regional stability and public trust.
example2_zh: 政府不应在未认真考虑对地区稳定和公众信任的影响时废止国际协议。
collocations: abrogate a treaty｜废止条约 ; abrogate an agreement｜废止协议 ; abrogate a law｜废除法律
tip_zh: 正式用语，常以法律、条约或协议作宾语。

meanings_zh: v. 正式撤销；废除
definition_en: Officially cancel a decision, agreement, or rule.
example1_en: The club rescinded its decision to close the pool.
example1_zh: 俱乐部撤销了关闭游泳池的决定。
example2_en: The council agreed to rescind the parking restrictions after residents raised concerns about access to local shops.
example2_zh: 居民对前往当地商店的便利性提出担忧后，地方议会同意撤销停车限制。
collocations: rescind a decision｜撤销决定 ; rescind an offer｜撤回提议 ; rescind a contract｜撤销合同
tip_zh: 是正式用语中的动词，通常不表示退款。

meanings_zh: adj. 一丝不苟的；挑剔的
definition_en: Very attentive to detail and difficult to satisfy.
example1_en: My brother is fastidious about keeping his shoes spotless.
example1_zh: 我哥哥对鞋子的清洁要求很高，总要保持一尘不染。
example2_en: Fastidious attention to hygiene in food preparation can reduce contamination risks and help maintain public confidence in restaurants.
example2_zh: 在备餐时一丝不苟地注意卫生，可以降低污染风险，并帮助维持公众对餐馆的信任。
collocations: fastidious about cleanliness｜对清洁要求极严 ; fastidious attention to detail｜对细节的一丝不苟 ; a fastidious eater｜挑食的人
tip_zh: 可褒可贬：既指严谨细致，也指过分挑剔。

meanings_zh: n. 内陆；腹地
definition_en: the inland area beyond a coast or major city
example1_en: We drove into the hinterland and found quiet villages.
example1_zh: 我们开车深入内陆，发现了几个宁静的村庄。
example2_en: Improved transport links between ports and their hinterlands can support regional trade and agricultural development.
example2_zh: 改善港口与其腹地之间的交通联系，可以促进区域贸易和农业发展。
collocations: rural hinterland｜乡村腹地 ; coastal hinterland｜沿海腹地 ; vast hinterland｜广阔腹地
tip_zh: 常指港口、沿海地区或大城市后方的内陆腹地。

meanings_zh: n. 继续；持续 | n. 诉讼延期
definition_en: The state of continuing or being kept in existence. | An official postponement of a court hearing or trial.
example1_en: The club's continuance depends on help from local volunteers.
example1_zh: 俱乐部能否继续运营取决于当地志愿者的帮助。
example2_en: The continuance of public funding is essential if rural libraries are to remain open.
example2_zh: 如果农村图书馆要继续开放，公共资金支持就必须持续。
collocations: continuance of support｜支持的持续 ; continued existence and continuance｜持续存在与延续 ; grant a continuance｜准予诉讼延期
tip_zh: 正式用词；法律义“诉讼延期”主要用于美式英语。

meanings_zh: n. 实际情况；现实
definition_en: What really exists or happens, rather than what is imagined.
example1_en: The flat looked spacious, but in actuality it was tiny.
example1_zh: 那套公寓看起来宽敞，实际上却很小。
example2_en: Although online services appear universally accessible, in actuality many rural communities still lack reliable internet connections.
example2_zh: 尽管在线服务似乎人人都能使用，实际上许多农村社区仍缺乏可靠的互联网连接。
collocations: in actuality｜实际上 ; turn into actuality｜变为现实
tip_zh: in actuality较正式；日常表达常用actually。

meanings_zh: adj. 潜意识感知的
definition_en: affecting your mind without you consciously noticing it
example1_en: The film used subliminal images that viewers barely noticed.
example1_zh: 影片使用了观众几乎未察觉的潜意识图像。
example2_en: Researchers continue to investigate whether subliminal cues can influence consumer choices under ordinary shopping conditions.
example2_zh: 研究人员仍在探究，在日常购物环境中，潜意识线索是否会影响消费者的选择。
collocations: subliminal message｜潜意识信息 ; subliminal advertising｜潜意识广告 ; subliminal perception｜阈下知觉
tip_zh: 指低于意识觉察阈限，并非泛指无意识行为。

meanings_zh: n. 解救；解脱
definition_en: The act of being freed from danger, suffering, or oppression
example1_en: The rescue boat brought deliverance from the rising flood.
example1_zh: 救援船使人们摆脱了不断上涨的洪水的威胁。
example2_en: For isolated communities, the arrival of emergency supplies can represent deliverance from prolonged hunger and hardship.
example2_zh: 对与外界隔绝的社区而言，应急物资的到来可能意味着摆脱长期的饥饿与困苦。
collocations: deliverance from danger｜脱离危险 ; pray for deliverance｜祈求解救 ; bring deliverance｜带来解救
tip_zh: 较正式，常见于文学或宗教语境；常接from。

meanings_zh: n. 粪便；排泄物
definition_en: Solid waste passed out of a person's or animal's body.
example1_en: We found bird excrement on the garden bench.
example1_zh: 我们发现花园长椅上有鸟粪。
example2_en: Untreated animal excrement can contaminate local water supplies and pose serious risks to public health.
example2_zh: 未经处理的动物粪便可能污染当地供水，并严重危害公众健康。
collocations: animal excrement｜动物粪便 ; human excrement｜人类粪便 ; bird excrement｜鸟粪
tip_zh: 不可数名词，语体正式；日常常用 poo。

meanings_zh: adj. 毁灭性的；导致破产的 | adj. 破败的；坍塌的
definition_en: Causing severe damage, especially financial loss. | Badly damaged and falling apart.
example1_en: The repairs were so ruinous that we sold the house.
example1_zh: 维修费高得让我们难以承受，只好卖掉了房子。
example2_en: Prolonged drought can have ruinous consequences for farming communities that depend entirely on seasonal rainfall.
example2_zh: 对于完全依赖季节性降雨的农业社区，长期干旱可能带来毁灭性的后果。
collocations: ruinous costs｜难以承受的费用 ; ruinous consequences｜灾难性后果 ; financially ruinous｜造成财务崩溃的
tip_zh: 常强调经济上难以承受，不只是一般的昂贵。

meanings_zh: v. 讥笑；嘲讽 | n. 讥笑；嘲讽的表情
definition_en: show disrespect through an unkind smile or remark | an unkind expression or remark showing disrespect
example1_en: Don't sneer at someone for asking a simple question.
example1_zh: 不要因为别人问了一个简单的问题就嘲笑对方。
example2_en: When colleagues sneer at unfamiliar ideas, employees may become less willing to suggest innovative solutions.
example2_zh: 当同事嘲讽陌生的想法时，员工可能会更不愿提出创新的解决方案。
collocations: sneer at someone｜嘲笑某人 ; a contemptuous sneer｜轻蔑的冷笑 ; with a sneer｜带着讥笑
tip_zh: 常用sneer at；表示轻蔑，不是普通微笑。

meanings_zh: adj. 划时代的
definition_en: So important that it begins a new historical period
example1_en: We watched a documentary about that epoch-making scientific discovery.
example1_zh: 我们看了一部关于那项划时代科学发现的纪录片。
example2_en: The development of printing was an epoch-making advance that transformed education and widened access to knowledge.
example2_zh: 印刷术的发展是划时代的进步，它改变了教育，并让更多人得以获取知识。
collocations: an epoch-making discovery｜划时代的发现 ; an epoch-making invention｜划时代的发明 ; an epoch-making event｜划时代的事件
tip_zh: 语气很强，指开创新时代，不泛指一般的重要。

meanings_zh: adj. 柔韧的；易弯曲的 | adj. 易受影响的；易摆布的
definition_en: Easy to bend or shape without breaking. | Easily influenced or controlled by other people.
example1_en: Warm the clay until it becomes soft and pliable.
example1_zh: 把黏土加热，直到它变得柔软易塑形。
example2_en: Pliable materials allow designers to create lightweight products that can be folded for easier storage and transport.
example2_zh: 柔韧材料让设计师能够制造可折叠的轻质产品，方便储存和运输。
collocations: soft and pliable｜柔软易弯曲的 ; pliable materials｜柔韧材料 ; keep something pliable｜使某物保持柔韧
tip_zh: 形容材料指柔韧；形容人常指易被摆布。

meanings_zh: n. 悲悯感染力；哀婉
definition_en: A quality that makes people feel pity or sadness.
example1_en: The abandoned toy gave the photograph a quiet pathos.
example1_zh: 那件被遗弃的玩具为照片增添了一种无声的哀婉。
example2_en: The pathos of personal stories can make documentaries about social inequality more emotionally engaging.
example2_zh: 个人故事中令人悲悯的力量，能让有关社会不平等的纪录片更打动人心。
collocations: full of pathos｜充满哀婉之情 ; a sense of pathos｜一种悲悯感 ; humour and pathos｜幽默与哀婉
tip_zh: 通常不可数，强调引起怜悯或悲伤的感染力。

meanings_zh: adj. 迅速而惊人的 | adj. 流星的
definition_en: Developing or becoming successful with remarkable speed | Relating to meteors
example1_en: Her meteoric rise surprised everyone at the small theatre.
example1_zh: 她迅速走红，让小剧院里的所有人都感到惊讶。
example2_en: The meteoric growth of online shopping has transformed consumer habits and increased demand for delivery services.
example2_zh: 网购的迅猛增长改变了消费习惯，也增加了对配送服务的需求。
collocations: a meteoric rise｜迅速崛起 ; meteoric growth｜迅猛增长 ; meteoric success｜迅速取得的成功
tip_zh: 常修饰rise，强调崛起迅速，不一定短暂。

meanings_zh: n. 海员；水手
definition_en: Someone who sails or works on a ship at sea.
example1_en: The experienced mariner guided our boat safely into harbour.
example1_zh: 那位经验丰富的海员引导我们的船安全驶入港口。
example2_en: Before modern navigation systems existed, mariners relied on stars and coastal landmarks to determine their position.
example2_zh: 在现代导航系统出现之前，海员依靠星辰和海岸地标确定位置。
collocations: an experienced mariner｜经验丰富的海员 ; a merchant mariner｜商船海员 ; a master mariner｜持证远洋船长
tip_zh: 比sailor正式，常见于航海或历史语境。

meanings_zh: adj. 愚蠢而自以为是的
definition_en: Foolish and unreasonable, often with misplaced confidence
example1_en: His fatuous suggestion was to water plants with lemonade.
example1_zh: 他竟自以为是地提议用柠檬汽水浇花。
example2_en: The fatuous assumption that technology alone can solve poverty ignores the importance of education and effective governance.
example2_zh: 认为单靠技术就能解决贫困的愚蠢假设，忽视了教育和有效治理的重要性。
collocations: a fatuous remark｜愚蠢的言论 ; a fatuous argument｜愚蠢的论点 ; a fatuous assumption｜愚蠢的假设
tip_zh: 正式且贬义，常批评言论或想法愚蠢而自满。

meanings_zh: n. 仪态；神情
definition_en: A person's appearance or manner, especially showing mood or character.
example1_en: Her cheerful mien brightened the room as she entered.
example1_zh: 她走进来时，愉快的神情让整个房间都明朗起来。
example2_en: Despite his stern mien, the headteacher encouraged students to discuss their concerns openly and without fear.
example2_zh: 尽管校长神情严肃，他仍鼓励学生无所畏惧地坦诚讨论自己的顾虑。
collocations: a serious mien｜严肃的神情 ; a cheerful mien｜愉快的神情 ; a dignified mien｜庄重的仪态
tip_zh: 正式或文学用词；与mean同音，指神情或仪态。

meanings_zh: n. 药剂师；药师
definition_en: A professional qualified to prepare and supply medicines
example1_en: The pharmaceutist carefully prepared the medicine for her patient.
example1_zh: 这位药剂师仔细地为她的病人配好了药。
example2_en: In historical accounts of healthcare, the pharmaceutist often appears as an important provider of medicines and practical advice.
example2_zh: 在医疗保健的历史记述中，药剂师常作为药物和实用建议的重要提供者出现。
collocations: a qualified pharmaceutist｜合格的药剂师 ; a practising pharmaceutist｜执业药剂师
tip_zh: 罕见旧式用词；现代英语通常用pharmacist。

meanings_zh: v. 声称；公开宣称 | v. 信奉；宣称信仰
definition_en: to openly claim a feeling or belief, sometimes without sincerity | to declare that you follow a particular religion
example1_en: My cousins profess to love cooking but always order takeaway.
example1_zh: 我的表亲们声称喜欢做饭，却总是点外卖。
example2_en: Many companies profess a commitment to sustainability, yet their production methods continue to generate substantial waste.
example2_zh: 许多企业宣称致力于可持续发展，但其生产方式仍不断产生大量废物。
collocations: profess to know｜声称知道 ; profess ignorance｜声称不知情 ; profess a belief｜公开表达信念 ; profess a religion｜信奉某宗教
tip_zh: 正式用语；profess to do常暗示声称未必属实。
